entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Improved sessions that move to a new runner: Claude now sees the tool call that was interrupted, marked as outcome unknown
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：改进了转移到新运行器的会话：克劳德现在看到被中断的工具调用，标记为结果未知

entries.en: Updated the bundled dataviz skill to accept APCA as a text-contrast measure (keeping WCAG 2 ratios where AA conformance is required), add an `apca(text, background)` function to its palette validator scripts, and say whether a label inside a colored chart fill should be white or near-black
entries.zh: 更新了捆绑的数据可视化技能，以接受 APCA 作为文本对比度度量（在需要符合 AA 的情况下保持 WCAG 2 比率），在其调色板验证器脚本中添加“apca(text,background)”函数，并说明彩色图表填充内的标签是否应该是白色或接近黑色

entries.en: Updated the /claude-api skill: service account keys and Workload Identity Federation tokens can now manage OpenTelemetry destinations
entries.zh: 更新了 /claude-api 技能：服务帐户密钥和工作负载身份联合令牌现在可以管理 OpenTelemetry 目标

entries.en: Changed `sed -i` to get the standard Bash prompt and run as written, not a simulated file-edit preview; like other Bash edits, it is no longer restored by `/rewind`
entries.zh: 更改了`sed -i`以获取标准 Bash 提示符并按编写的方式运行，而不是模拟文件编辑预览；与其他 Bash 编辑一样，它不再由`/rewind`恢复

entries.en: Changed `claude ultrareview` to require workspace trust: it asks on a terminal, else refuses; scripts pass `--trust-workspace`, which takes no value (put a PR number or base branch before it), or set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`
entries.zh: 更改了`claude ultrareview`以要求工作空间信任：它在终端上询问，否则拒绝；脚本传递 `--trust-workspace`，它不带任何值（在其前面放置 PR 编号或基本分支），或设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`

entries.en: Changed the dangerous `rm` and `rmdir` prompt in bypass permissions mode in the Desktop app and VS Code to deny the command at once with a rewrite hint, so unattended sessions keep going
entries.zh: 更改了桌面应用程序和 VS Code 中绕过权限模式下危险的`rm`和`rmdir`提示，以通过重写提示立即拒绝该命令，以便无人值守的会话继续进行

entries.en: Changed commands the settings exclude from the sandbox to ask before writing to its write-list paths while the sandbox is enabled but cannot run; the unsandboxed fallback is refused there
entries.zh: 更改了从沙箱中排除的设置，以在沙箱已启用但无法运行时写入其写入列表路径之前询问；那里拒绝未沙盒的后备

entries.en: Changed worktree creation and reuse so git no longer fetches objects on demand, in ordinary clones and in partial clones with a Bash sandbox configured; such a partial clone fetches them first
entries.zh: 更改了工作树的创建和重用，因此 git 不再在普通克隆和配置了 Bash 沙箱的部分克隆中按需获取对象；这样的部分克隆首先获取它们

entries.en: Changed the `/claude-api` skill to build Managed Agents subagent teams on `multiagent_20261001` with dynamic workflows on by default, instead of `coordinator`
entries.zh: 更改了`/claude-api`技能，以在`multiagent_20261001`上构建托管代理子代理团队，默认启用动态工作流程，而不是“协调器”

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a log warning that says what to do when dictation or the extension's own requests fail certificate verification, such as behind a TLS-inspecting proxy
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了一条日志警告，说明当听写或扩展程序自身的请求未能通过证书验证（例如在 TLS 检查代理后面）时该怎么做

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Claude panel staying blank after the editor cached an incomplete copy of its files; it now recovers by itself, or says what went wrong and how to fix it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了编辑器缓存不完整的文件副本后克劳德面板保持空白的问题；它现在可以自行恢复，或者说明出了什么问题以及如何修复它

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Session history filling up with empty "Untitled" sessions each time you start a new session without sending a message
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了每次启动新会话而不发送消息时会话历史记录都会填充空的“无标题”会话的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed long slash-command messages such as `/goal` filling the chat panel; they now fold behind Show more like other prompts (anthropics/claude-code#97469)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了长斜杠命令消息，例如填充聊天面板的`/goal`；它们现在像其他提示一样折叠在“显示更多”后面（anthropics/claude-code#97469）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed long messages not folding behind Show more after the chat panel is made narrower
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了聊天面板变窄后长消息不折叠在显示更多后面的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+J in the chat input always inserting a newline: it is now left to VS Code and the OS when "ctrl+j" is set to null in the Chat context of ~/.claude/keybindings.json
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了聊天输入中的 Ctrl+J 始终插入换行符的问题：当在 ~/.claude/keybindings.json 的聊天上下文中将“ctrl+j”设置为 null 时，现在将其留给 VS Code 和操作系统

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a mod's "From the … plugin" label above the prompt being drawn over the slash command and @-mention menus (anthropics/claude-code#102981)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在斜杠命令和 @-提及菜单上绘制的提示上方的 mod 的“来自…插件”标签 (anthropics/claude-code#102981)

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an empty list item, paragraph or code block, and list items renumbered from 1, when pasting copied LaTeX math
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了粘贴复制的 LaTeX 数学时出现的空列表项、段落或代码块以及从 1 重新编号的列表项

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the feedback error showing only an HTTP status when your organization does not accept feedback
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当您的组织不接受反馈时仅显示 HTTP 状态的反馈错误

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved Edit and Write speed in the chat panel: the wait for new problems after each edit is now 0.75 seconds in most cases, down from 1 to 1.5 seconds
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进了聊天面板中的编辑和写入速度：每次编辑后出现新问题的等待时间现在大多数情况下为 0.75 秒，从 1 秒缩短到 1.5 秒

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Add connector list in routine forms saying no connectors were available while they were still loading
entries.zh: [云会话] 修复了常规表单中的添加连接器列表，显示仍在加载时没有可用的连接器

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the cloud environment editor shuffling environment variables and adding backslashes to values that contain both kinds of quote
entries.zh: [云会话] 修复了云环境编辑器打乱环境变量并向包含两种引号的值添加反斜杠的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the self-hosted environment details dialog in admin settings so its title, tabs and buttons stay in view while only the content scrolls
entries.zh: [云会话] 修复了管理设置中的自托管环境详细信息对话框，使其标题、选项卡和按钮保持在视图中，而只有内容滚动

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the "read documentation" tool row in cloud sessions, which showed escaped JSON instead of a readable page
entries.zh: [云会话] 修复了云会话中的“读取文档”工具行，该工具行显示转义的 JSON 而不是可读页面

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved a cloud session's Changes pane, which now says when it lists only pushed commits or only Claude's edits
entries.zh: [云会话] 改进了云会话的“更改”窗格，现在显示何时仅列出推送的提交或仅列出 Claude 的编辑

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack posting a draft you approved for a channel into your DM by mistake; a post with no channel is now refused so it can go to the approved channel
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复了 Slack 中的 Claude 错误地将您批准的频道草稿发布到您的 DM 中的问题；没有频道的帖子现在会被拒绝，因此可以转到批准的频道

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Allow and Deny on Claude's approval cards in Slack doing nothing when the session had stopped; your answer now restarts the session
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复了当会话停止时，Slack 中 Claude 批准卡上的允许和拒绝不执行任何操作的问题；您的回答现在将重新启动会话

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude ignoring untagged messages in a Slack channel after its workspace moved to a different Claude organization, including unshared channels on Enterprise Grid
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复了在 Slack 通道的工作区移动到其他 Claude 组织（包括 Enterprise Grid 上的非共享通道）后，Claude 忽略 Slack 通道中未标记消息的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack channel posting a threaded reply before reading a newer message someone had just added to that thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复了 Slack 频道中的 Claude 在阅读某人刚刚添加到该线程的新消息之前发布线程回复的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the Slack page in Claude Tag admin settings saying no workspaces were connected when the list failed to load; it now shows an error with a Retry button
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复了 Claude Tag 管理设置中的 Slack 页面在列表加载失败时提示没有连接工作区的问题；现在显示错误并带有“重试”按钮

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed a finished review showing no check on the pull request when earlier tries to create it failed; a final try now adds a completed check
entries.zh: [代码审查] 修复了当之前尝试创建拉取请求失败时，已完成的审查显示没有对拉取请求进行检查的问题；最后一次尝试现在添加了已完成的检查

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed a push queued behind a running review still starting a review after `@claude review stop`; its check now closes and says why
entries.zh: [代码审查] 修复了在运行审查之后排队的推送在`@claude review stop`后仍开始审查的问题；它的检查现已结束并说明原因

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added `/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21`
entries.zh: 新增 `/claude-api api-version`，可把 Claude API 代码迁移到 API 版本 `2026-10-21`

entries.en: Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
entries.zh: 新增 `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry 事件：每当权限规则、自动模式、安全检查、钩子或沙箱拦截、询问或退回一次工具调用时都会记录

entries.en: Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` is set and the model is an alias with the `[1m]` suffix, such as `opus[1m]`
entries.zh: 修复设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` 且模型是带 `[1m]` 后缀的别名（如 `opus[1m]`）时，请求因找不到模型而失败

entries.en: Fixed the `prompt-caching-scope` beta header being sent behind custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect
entries.zh: 修复在自定义 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 网关和 Foundry 上仍发送不起作用的 `prompt-caching-scope` beta 请求头

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in `claude -p` on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in
entries.zh: 修复 macOS 登录钥匙串锁定时，`claude -p` 中 MCP 服务器显示「需要认证」；现在会说明原因，解锁后下次运行无需重新登录即可连接

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting
entries.zh: 修复 macOS 或 Linux 电脑在 MCP 服务器连接过程中休眠时，服务器被报告为超时、并在无界面运行中一直失败

entries.en: Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried
entries.zh: 修复连接在调用中途断开时 HTTP MCP 工具调用被发送两次；现在只有只读或幂等的工具才会重试

entries.en: Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running
entries.zh: 修复后台任务运行时，某一轮有时没有带上 SDK MCP 服务器的最新工具就开始

entries.en: Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results
entries.zh: 修复读取大量 PDF 页面、图片或其他大型工具结果的轮次中出现的部分「Autocompact is thrashing」错误

entries.en: Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted
entries.zh: 修复云端会话重启后 `/autocompact` 恢复为默认窗口

entries.en: Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted
entries.zh: 修复云端或自托管运行器会话重启后，用 `/clear` 清空的对话有时又回来

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 应用网关会话中 `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` 被忽略

entries.en: Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` is set
entries.zh: 修复设置了 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` 时，位于 Claude 应用网关后的 Claude Desktop 会话遥测数据被拒收

entries.en: Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description
entries.zh: 修复 `/permissions` > 最近拒绝 不显示被拒绝的 shell 命令，以及自动模式的本地分类器在检查重试命令时忽略在此处的批准；现在批准某一行会显示命令本身，而不是它的描述

entries.en: Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions
entries.zh: 修复 `/help` 和 `/` 命令菜单对 `/claude-api` 等内置技能显示面向模型的长描述，而不是简短描述

entries.en: Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses
entries.zh: 修复流式响应下子智能体记录里出现占位的 token 用量和空的停止原因

entries.en: Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds
entries.zh: 修复 API 确认模型超过 5 秒时，通过 Agent SDK 的 `setModel()`（及基于它的应用）切换模型被拒绝；Claude Code 现在最多等待 15 秒

entries.en: Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file
entries.zh: 修复通过已连接应用停止的后台命令（如桌面应用归档空闲会话）被报告为用户停止；提示现在会写出其输出文件

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions
entries.zh: 修复 Cowork 云端会话中网站返回 4xx 状态或 robots.txt 拒绝时 WebFetch 报工具错误；现在和本地会话一样作为正常结果返回

entries.en: Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab
entries.zh: 修复桌面应用 Code 标签页中，直接配置的 GitHub MCP 服务器的写入工具弹出表单后关闭却什么都没创建

entries.en: Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection
entries.zh: 修复服务器已关闭复用连接时，Artifact 工具读取因连接重置而失败

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复使用 `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 的会话把之前会话留在克隆目录中的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 提交进去

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复在检出钩子期间归档或重新排队会话、或停止运行器时，钩子进程仍在运行并占用运行器名额

entries.en: Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error
entries.zh: 改进无法解析的工具调用的恢复：Claude Code 现在会最多重试两次，再以错误结束本轮

entries.en: Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work
entries.zh: 改进同时启动的分叉子智能体：每个都会被告知哪个是自己的任务，大大减少互相抢做对方工作

entries.en: Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load
entries.zh: 改进浏览器登录：登录完成后立即显示成功页面，不再等待账号资料加载

entries.en: Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error"
entries.zh: 改进云端和自托管运行器会话的网页搜索错误：带原因的 403 拒绝现在会显示该原因，而不是笼统的「Authentication error」

entries.en: Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect
entries.zh: 缩短了桌面应用某个 MCP 服务器无法连接时云端会话的首次回复时间

entries.en: Improved Remote Control connect time for sessions whose transcript contains large pasted images or PDF reads
entries.zh: 缩短了记录中含大量粘贴图片或 PDF 读取的会话的 Remote Control 连接时间

entries.en: Changed the notice Claude gets when the WebSearch budget is used up to also tell it not to query search engines in a browser or through computer use
entries.zh: WebSearch 额度用完时给 Claude 的提示，现在也会告诉它不要通过浏览器或电脑操控去搜索引擎查询

entries.en: Changed the `axScreenReader` setting and `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` in a settings `env` block to apply only from user, managed or `--settings` settings (since 2.1.305)
entries.zh: `axScreenReader` 设置和 settings `env` 块里的 `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` 改为只在用户、托管或 `--settings` 设置中生效（自 2.1.305 起）

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：检出钩子默认 30 分钟后被停止并使会话初始化失败；如需更久，调大 `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` 或设为 `0`

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed the certificate file built for Anthropic-managed git to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does; a `[runner:warn]` line gives the number left out
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：为 Anthropic 托管 git 生成的证书文件改为像 CLI 一样过滤受信任证书；会有一行 `[runner:warn]` 显示被排除的数量

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a notice on the microphone button when voice dictation stops by itself (15 seconds without recognized speech, or the 2-minute limit), saying why and that the text so far is kept
entries.zh: [VSCode] 语音听写自动停止时（15 秒未识别到语音或达到 2 分钟上限），麦克风按钮上会显示提示，说明原因并告知已识别的文字会保留

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复用「Show more」展开的长提示覆盖整个聊天面板；置顶的提示现在最多占面板 40% 并可滚动

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复含 LaTeX 公式的列表项或表格单元格的一部分，在富文本编辑器中被粘贴成新的列表或表格

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复仅在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中设置 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 时，语音听写在 TLS 检查代理后失败；现在也会遵循 `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 「仍在别处打开」提示现在也涵盖扩展重启后遗留的 Claude 进程，这种进程通常会在约 10 分钟内自行结束

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does
entries.zh: [VSCode] 语音听写改为像 CLI 一样过滤受信任证书

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings
entries.zh: [VSCode] 扩展自身的请求改为像 CLI 一样过滤受信任证书，并信任环境变量或用户设置中指定的 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 文件

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the repository picker saying "No repositories match" while a search was still running; it now shows "Searching…" until the results arrive
entries.zh: [云端会话] 修复搜索仍在进行时仓库选择器显示「No repositories match」；现在会显示「Searching…」直到结果返回

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the "Waiting for a runner" status on self-hosted environments being cut off; with on-demand runners it now counts up from your last message and shows failed attempts
entries.zh: [云端会话] 修复自托管环境中「Waiting for a runner」状态显示被截断；使用按需运行器时，现在会从你最后一条消息开始计时并显示失败的尝试

entries.en: [Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review
entries.zh: [Code Review] 新增 `@claude review stop`（也可用 `off` 和 `pause`），可结束拉取请求上的 `@claude review always` 订阅且不触发新的审查

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
entries.zh: 修复了在没有会话环境变量的情况下启动时云会话中报告“未登录”的`claude -p`

entries.en: Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools
entries.zh: 修复了在使用许多 MCP 工具的会话中 API 错误被“提示太长”替换以及不必要的压缩的问题

entries.en: Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces`，因此 Linux 上的沙盒命令可以创建用户命名空间（Chromium、rootless podman）；这让他们可以绕过沙箱的文件保护

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS`，因此无人值守重试模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`）会注意到在重置之前已解除的使用限制

entries.en: Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of `--tools` (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it
entries.zh: 修复了当端点或网关拒绝工具搜索时，Vertex、Bedrock 和其他提供程序上的每个请求失败，以及在网关后面的 ToolSearch 不允许或被排除在`--tools`之外（2.1.304 回归）：克劳德代码现在在没有它的情况下重试

entries.en: Fixed `/effort` and `/autocompact` settings not applying when the model name differed from a `modelOverrides` value by letter case or a `[1m]` tag
entries.zh: 修复了当模型名称因字母大小写或`[1m]`标签与`modelOverrides`值不同时`/effort`和`/autocompact`设置不适用的问题

entries.en: Fixed new worktrees in a bare repository sometimes starting from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees sometimes not being cleaned up
entries.zh: 修复了裸存储库中的新工作树有时从本地 HEAD 而不是默认分支开始，以及未更改的子代理工作树有时未被清理的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash commands on a full disk failing with a raw `ENOSPC` file path: the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran
entries.zh: 修复了完整磁盘上的 Bash 命令因原始`ENOSPC`文件路径而失败的问题：错误现在表明磁盘已满并且没有运行任何内容

entries.en: Fixed an MCP server passed by a cloud session or by the SDK's `setMcpServers` being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings
entries.zh: 修复了云会话或 SDK 的`setMcpServers`传递的 MCP 服务器稍后在会话中被您自己的设置中的同名服务器替换的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude naming the wrong model for a subagent's work after the subagent switched to a fallback model
entries.zh: 修复了在子代理切换到后备模型后，克劳德为子代理的工作命名错误的模型

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions and teammates not telling Claude when a compaction had to leave the oldest messages out of its summary to fit
entries.zh: 修复了云会话和队友在压缩必须将最旧的消息从其摘要中留下来以适应时不告诉克劳德的问题

entries.en: Fixed more cases of scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
entries.zh: 修复了更多已安排的 Cowork 云会话等待五分钟的情况，每个子代理的 WebFetch 需要 URL 批准，但没有人在那里给予批准

entries.en: Fixed Workflow resume re-running already-completed `pipeline()` and `parallel()` agents instead of serving them from the run's journal
entries.zh: 修复了工作流程恢复重新运行已完成的`pipeline()`和`parallel()`代理，而不是从运行日志中提供服务

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control leaving empty "(session)" entries in `/resume` after switching conversations with `/resume`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`/resume`切换对话后，远程控制在`/resume`中留下空的“（会话）”条目的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` rows being cut off in narrow terminals
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`行在狭窄终端中被切断的问题

entries.en: Fixed startup warnings printing as raw text above the logo: they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner
entries.zh: 修复了在徽标上方打印为原始文本的启动警告：它们现在转到调试日志，并且不限制任何内容的权限规则在横幅下显示为警告行

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式：搜索框现在显示“搜索：”，而不是符号 VoiceOver 读取为“电话录音机”，并且突出显示的提示文本，例如 Ctrl+R 搜索匹配项和“ultrathink”，单词内不再有空格

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression)
entries.zh: 修复了只与运行器或编排器共享标准输出的启动脚本，在设置了 `TERM` 时报 `Resource temporarily unavailable` 的问题（2.1.300 的回归）

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed repository access failing since 2.1.296 when a git credential helper or askpass program reads its settings through `GIT_CONFIG`
entries.zh: 修复了 2.1.296 起，git 凭据助手或 askpass 程序通过 `GIT_CONFIG` 读取设置时，仓库访问失败的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed the orchestrator reporting a spawn-runner hook as timed out when a runner it started in the background kept its output open
entries.zh: 修复了编排器把后台启动的运行器钩子误报为超时的问题（该运行器保持输出打开）

entries.en: Improved `/usage`: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and `f` applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and `/doctor`
entries.zh: 改进 `/usage`：每条警告都是一行的修复建议，并注明来源；按 `f` 可应用这些修复；VS Code 和 `/doctor` 中也显示同样的修复

entries.en: Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 同意对话框：减少把本来给提示词的 Enter 误当成“接受”的情况

entries.en: Improved a mod's `Image` to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text
entries.zh: 改进 mod 的 `Image`：在 iTerm2 3.5 及更高版本的全屏渲染中能画出图片，此前只显示 `alt` 文本

entries.en: Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing `w` now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later `claude remote-control` start that uses the saved mode says where it came from
entries.zh: Remote Control 的启动模式提示已改进：按 `w` 会说明新模式已为该文件夹保存；之后用 `claude remote-control` 启动并使用已保存模式时，会说明该模式的来源

entries.en: Changed `allowedMcpServers` to stop filtering `managed-mcp.json` stdio servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env`: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off
entries.zh: 更改了`allowedMcpServers`以停止过滤仅在`env`中使用`${VAR}`的“management-mcp.json”stdio 服务器：您遗漏的许可列表现在会在升级时加载；使用 `deniedMcpServers` 来阻止它

entries.en: Changed plugins that Claude Desktop mounts by path to no longer keep their `allowed-tools` when your organization's managed settings set `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude Desktop 通过路径安装的插件，当您的组织的托管设置设置为`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`时，不再保留其“允许的工具”

entries.en: Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to take 1 or Enter to keep, 2 to delete, and Esc to cancel; `y` and `n` no longer answer it
entries.zh: 修改`/artifacts`删除确认为1或Enter保留，2删除，Esc取消； `y` 和 `n` 不再回答它

entries.en: Changed a mod's docked pane to stay within 45% of the terminal's width, including a width kept from a wider terminal
entries.zh: 更改了 mod 的停靠窗格，使其保持在终端宽度的 45% 范围内，包括与更宽的终端保持的宽度

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a "Running start-up hooks" spinner status, with a screen reader announcement, while SessionStart or Setup hooks run
entries.zh: [VSCode] SessionStart 或 Setup 钩子运行时，新增「Running start-up hooks」加载状态，并向屏幕阅读器播报

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the spinner cutting off "Compacting..." when your `spinnerVerbs` setting replaces the built-in verbs with short ones
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复设置 `spinnerVerbs` 用简短词替换内置动词时，加载动画会截断 "Compacting..." 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the message shown when a session does not start in time and no hook is running: it now leads with the output logs and lists causes instead of pointing to sign-in and network first
entries.zh: [VSCode] 调整了会话长时间无法启动、且没有 hook 在运行时的提示：现在开头先提示查看输出日志，并列出可能的原因，不再首先指向登录和网络

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Cloud environments admin page wrongly refusing to save an existing environment with an "installs packages" error
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复云端环境管理页面错误拒绝保存已有环境并提示「installs packages」错误的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved deleting a self-hosted environment so the dialog and error messages say what blocks the delete and what it will affect
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 改进删除自托管环境：对话框和错误信息会说明阻止删除的原因以及删除会影响什么

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added public Slack channels Claude hasn't joined to the Claude Tag admin Add place search, so admins can set one up from there
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude Tag 管理设置的「Add」频道搜索框中，新增 Claude 尚未加入的公开 Slack 频道，管理员可以直接从这里为其设置

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag access bundles so a repository that moved to another GitHub account can be added again
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 访问包中，已转移到另一个 GitHub 账户的仓库无法再次添加的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a routine set up in a Slack DM thread no longer posting after another routine in that thread restarted the conversation; both now keep posting there
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 私信话题中设置的例程，在同一话题中另一个例程重启对话后不再发帖的问题；现在两者都会继续在该话题中发帖

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed routines set up in a Slack thread reporting success without posting after the conversation ended; those runs are now skipped and the creator is told
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在 Slack 话题中设置的例程，在对话结束后报告成功却没有发帖的问题；现在这些运行会被跳过，并通知创建者

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag admin pages in large organizations so plugin, skill and bundle edits work while the channel list is still loading
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进大型组织中的 Claude Tag 管理页面：频道列表仍在加载时，也可以编辑插件、技能和访问包

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review sometimes not reviewing the newest commit when several pushes landed on a pull request during a review
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复审查期间拉取请求上有多次推送时，Code Review 有时不审查最新提交的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Changed Code Review re-reviews so they no longer open with LGTM while earlier blocking findings are still open
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进 Code Review 的重新审查：当较早的阻塞性问题仍未关闭时，不再以 LGTM 开头

entries.en: Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
entries.zh: 当首先运行的插件跳过您的 mod 的挂钩之一时添加了转录行，命名事件和插件

entries.en: Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked
entries.zh: 在mod的`tool.check`答案中添加了“decider：“person””：只有权限对话框或主机的回调可以批准该请求，并且由于mod的原因而拒绝，没有人可以被询问

entries.en: Added `e.isReadOnly` to a mod's `tool.check` event, set when the tool call is read-only
entries.zh: 将`e.isReadOnly`添加到 mod 的`tool.check`事件中，当工具调用为只读时设置

entries.en: Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions
entries.zh: 添加了`/auto-mode-setup`：引导设置，可读取您的项目和最近的会话，以教授有关您的环境的自动模式，现在也可在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、Claude 应用程序网关和遥测禁用会话上使用

entries.en: Added `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`, which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything
entries.zh: 添加了“/claude-api Managed-agents-secure”，它将 Managed Agents 代理的设置与 Anthropic 发布的安全指南进行比较，无需更改任何内容

entries.en: Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O)
entries.zh: 将之前调用的工具的名称添加到转录视图中的压缩摘要中（Ctrl+O）

entries.en: Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it
entries.zh: 在 Pro 和 Max 计划中添加了一条警告，当恢复不活动的对话将占用您 5 小时使用限制的明显份额时：无论如何都要恢复，或者开始新的对话，如果您参考的话，克劳德可以查找上一个对话

entries.en: Fixed the organization policy not refreshing until the hourly check after approving an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` at startup or switching "Use custom API key" in `/config`
entries.zh: 修复在启动时批准 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`，或在 `/config` 中切换"使用自定义 API 密钥"后，组织策略要等到每小时的检查才会刷新的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when a `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead` glob contains brackets that are not a character class, such as a `[user-id]` route folder
entries.zh: 修复了当`sandbox.filesystem.denyRead` glob 包含非字符类的括号（例如`[user-id]`路由文件夹）时，沙盒命令无法在 Linux 上启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed `rm -r` of a mounted drive or a folder at its top level (`/Volumes`, `/media`, WSL's `/mnt/c`) not getting the safety prompt that `rm -rf /Applications` gets
entries.zh: 修复了已安装驱动器或其顶层文件夹（`/Volumes`、`/media`、WSL 的`/mnt/c`）的`rm -r`未获得`rm -rf /Applications`获得的安全提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping messages from the saved transcript when the disk filled up while the file was being trimmed
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC`在修剪文件时磁盘已满时从保存的记录中删除消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, Stop, or ended input by spawning subagents or re-running a finished one
entries.zh: 修复了一个插件，通过生成子代理或重新运行已完成的代理来保持无头运行超过`--max-turns`、停止或结束输入

entries.en: Fixed a failed mod reload removing the tools and commands of the version that stays loaded, and its messages being wrong or silent about whether the previous version is still loaded
entries.zh: 修复了模组重新加载失败的问题，删除了保持加载版本的工具和命令，并且其有关先前版本是否仍加载的消息是错误的或无提示的

entries.en: Fixed a click on a mod's button being lost when buttons with the same label and no `key` were redrawn unchanged
entries.zh: 修复了当具有相同标签且没有`key`的按钮被重新绘制不变时，对 mod 按钮的点击丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill stopping at the secret scan on machines with managed settings and on Team and Enterprise plans
entries.zh: 修复了内置“插件创作”技能中的模组共享在具有托管设置的计算机以及团队和企业计划上的秘密扫描时停止的问题

entries.en: Fixed scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes again for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
entries.zh: 修复了计划的 Cowork 云会话再次等待五分钟的问题，因为每个子代理的 WebFetch 都需要 URL 批准，但没有人在那里给予批准

entries.en: Fixed Write results and rejected edits showing a file outside the working directory as `../../…`; they now show `~/…` or the full path
entries.zh: 修复了写入结果和拒绝编辑将工作目录之外的文件显示为`../../…`的问题；他们现在显示`~/…`或完整路径

entries.en: Fixed a claude.ai Directory plugin's skills not running as commands when picked from the "/" menu in Cowork cloud sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 claude.ai 目录插件的技能在从 Cowork 云会话中的“/”菜单中选取时未作为命令运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control permanently withholding a desktop conversation's history when a different account was signed in to the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了当其他帐户登录到终端时远程控制永久保留桌面对话历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control failing to start from Claude Desktop when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK is set on a paid plan
entries.zh: 修复了在付费计划中设置 DISABLE_TELEMETRY 或 DO_NOT_TRACK 时远程控制无法从 Claude Desktop 启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed model switches, messages and interrupts waiting behind a context usage check in SDK and desktop sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 和桌面会话中上下文使用检查后等待的模型切换、消息和中断

entries.en: Fixed `context_management: Extra inputs are not permitted` errors behind LLM gateways; Claude Code now resends the request without that field
entries.zh: 修复了 LLM 网关后面的“context_management：不允许额外输入”错误；克劳德代码现在重新发送没有该字段的请求

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry settings delivered through server-managed settings being ignored for the whole session after signing in during first-run setup or the first start after /logout
entries.zh: 修复了通过服务器管理的设置提供的 OpenTelemetry 设置在首次运行设置期间登录或 /logout 后首次启动后在整个会话中被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed unsandboxed Bash commands in Claude Desktop Code tab sessions on macOS and Linux not seeing environment variables exported in shell startup files such as ~/.zshrc
entries.zh: 修复 macOS 和 Linux 上 Claude Desktop 代码标签页会话中，未沙盒化的 Bash 命令看不到 `~/.zshrc` 等 shell 启动文件中导出的环境变量的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Consumer Terms notice being skipped for a day or longer after a server error
entries.zh: 修复 Consumer Terms 通知在服务器出错后，被跳过一天或更久的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/privacy-settings` offering choices that may not apply to you after a network or server error
entries.zh: 修复了网络或服务器错误后可能不适用于您的`/privacy-settings`选项

entries.en: Fixed a "Context limit reached" or "Prompt is too long" error after stopping a turn while Claude Code was compacting a conversation the API had rejected as too long
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 压缩 API 因太长而拒绝的对话时停止转弯后出现的“已达到上下文限制”或“提示太长”错误

entries.en: Fixed subagents sometimes forgetting their most recent work when they were messaged or resumed right after finishing
entries.zh: 修复了子代理在收到消息或完成后立即恢复时有时会忘记他们最近的工作

entries.en: Fixed `claude --help` text for `--tools`, `--resume`, `--debug`, `--json-schema`, `--disable-slash-commands`, `--system-prompt-snapshot` and `claude update` to match actual behavior
entries.zh: 修复了`--tools`、`--resume`、`--debug`、`--json-schema`、`--disable-slash-commands`、`--system-prompt-snapshot`和`claude update`的`claude --help`文本，以匹配实际行为

entries.en: Fixed `claude --worktree` removing the worktree and its branch without asking at exit when HEAD was detached or on another branch, which could lose commits
entries.zh: 修复了当 HEAD 分离或在另一个分支上时，`claude --worktree` 删除工作树及其分支而不在退出时询问的问题，这可能会丢失提交

entries.en: Fixed resumed and cloud sessions sending Claude the whole skill list again each time plugins reloaded at startup
entries.zh: 修复了每次启动时重新加载插件时恢复和云会话都会再次向克劳德发送整个技能列表的问题

entries.en: Fixed an interrupt not ending a Read that waits on an idle pipe or device named like an image
entries.zh: 修复了未结束等待空闲管道或命名为图像的设备的读取的中断

entries.en: Fixed `/effort status`, `/effort ultracode` and the prompt's effort indicator showing a guessed effort level when `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` is `auto` or `unset` and no level is sent
entries.zh: 修复了当`CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`为`auto`或`unset`且未发送任何级别时，`/effort status`、`/effort ultracode`和提示的工作量指示器显示猜测的工作量级别

entries.en: Fixed a PreToolUse hook's deny reason being replaced by a timeout error when an Agent SDK callback hook on the same tool call timed out
entries.zh: 修复了当同一工具调用上的 Agent SDK 回调挂钩超时时，PreToolUse 挂钩的拒绝原因被超时错误替换的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash and PowerShell deleting a large command's output file when it could not be copied to the session's tool-results folder, unless the disk is full
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 和 PowerShell 在无法将大型命令的输出文件复制到会话的工具结果文件夹时删除该文件的问题，除非磁盘已满

entries.en: Fixed notes typed into a multiple-choice question with previews being cut off with "…" in terminals under about 100 columns, hiding what was typed (anthropics/claude-code#82768)
entries.zh: 修复了在多项选择题中输入的注释，在大约 100 列的终端中，预览被“...”截断，隐藏了输入的内容 (anthropics/claude-code#82768)

entries.en: Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups scheduled at the 1-hour maximum firing just after the 1-hour prompt cache expired, so those wakeups no longer re-read the conversation uncached
entries.zh: 修复了在 1 小时提示缓存过期后按 1 小时最大触发安排的自定进度`/loop`唤醒，因此这些唤醒不再重新读取未缓存的对话

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: approving a shutdown request from the main session no longer exits the whole CLI
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：批准来自主会话的关闭请求不再退出整个 CLI

entries.en: Fixed a skill's `once` hook also removing another skill's identical hook after it ran
entries.zh: 修复了一个技能的`once`钩子在运行后也会删除另一个技能的相同钩子

entries.en: Fixed transcript mode's `{` and `}` landing the prompt on an inconsistent row, or off screen, instead of the transcript's first row
entries.zh: 修复转录模式下 `{` 和 `}` 使提示框落在不一致的行或屏幕之外，而不是转录的第一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200k` silently setting a 100K window: the variable now accepts `k` and `M` suffixes like `--autocompact`, and warns when a value is out of range or ignored
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200k`静默设置 100K 窗口的问题：该变量现在接受`k`和`M`后缀，例如`--autocompact`，并在值超出范围或被忽略时发出警告

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C in the agents view clearing a text selection without copying it when pressed before the mouse button was released
entries.zh: 修复了在释放鼠标按钮之前按下代理视图中的 Ctrl+C 时清除文本选择而不复制它的问题

entries.en: Improved `/usage` to say when a rate limit on usage data ends instead of "try again in a moment"
entries.zh: 改进 `/usage`：用量数据被限流时，会说明限流何时结束，而不是笼统的“稍后再试”

entries.en: Improved the lines shown when a mod written in the session loads, reloads or fails to load
entries.zh: 改进会话中编写的 mod 加载、重新加载或加载失败时显示的信息

entries.en: Improved artifacts with several views: when you ask for links to them, Claude now writes out each view's link and explains that the address bar stays the same as you switch views
entries.zh: 改进有多个视图的 artifact：你要链接时，Claude 会分别写出每个视图的链接，并说明切换视图时地址栏保持不变

entries.en: Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for the local (stdio) MCP servers of plugins synced from claude.ai, unless a server sets `alwaysLoad: true`
entries.zh: 改进云会话：新对话的第一轮不再等待从 claude.ai 同步的插件的本地（stdio）MCP 服务器，除非服务器设置了 `alwaysLoad: true`

entries.en: Improved how a remote session recovers its status when the server refuses a status update that carried other session data
entries.zh: 改进远程会话恢复状态的方式：服务器拒绝携带其他会话数据的状态更新时，会话仍能恢复

entries.en: Improved session file size in auto mode: the safety classifier's context is no longer stored with every request
entries.zh: 改进自动模式下的会话文件大小：安全分类器的上下文不再随每个请求存储

entries.en: Improved the `claude -p` invalid-settings warning: a file that did not load lists only what stopped it, and long lists are capped per file
entries.zh: 改进 `claude -p` 的无效设置警告：未能加载的文件只列出导致失败的内容，每个文件的长列表有数量上限

entries.en: Improved resume of large compacted sessions in SDK and headless mode: the first request after resuming is sent sooner
entries.zh: 改进 SDK 和无头模式下恢复大型压缩会话的速度：恢复后的第一个请求发送得更早

entries.en: Improved responsiveness and throughput when many subagents are running at the same time
entries.zh: 改进多个子智能体同时运行时的响应速度和吞吐量

entries.en: Improved memory use when sending requests in long or resumed conversations
entries.zh: 改进长对话或恢复的对话中发送请求时的内存占用

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when the git host answers "not found" for a session's repository: it now names the repository and whom to ask
entries.zh: 改进了 git 主机对会话所用仓库返回 "not found" 时的错误提示：现在会写明仓库名，并说明该找谁

entries.en: Windows: Improved git command start-up with a standard Git for Windows install by running its git.exe directly instead of through its cmd launcher
entries.zh: Windows：标准安装的 Git for Windows 现在直接运行其 `git.exe`，而不再通过 cmd 启动器，加快了 git 命令的启动速度

entries.en: Changed mods' `settings.read` hooks to receive each settings layer and rewrite the merged settings, so a managed mod can make an organization's setting a ceiling, including the `cleanupPeriodDays` the retention sweep uses
entries.zh: 更改了 mods 的`settings.read`挂钩以接收每个设置层并重写合并的设置，因此托管 mod 可以使组织的设置达到上限，包括保留扫描使用的`cleanupPeriodDays`

entries.en: Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to show numbered choices: 1 or Enter keeps the artifact, 2 deletes it, and y, n and Esc still work
entries.zh: 更改了`/artifacts`删除确认以显示编号选项：1 或 Enter 保留工件，2 删除它，y、n 和 Esc 仍然有效

entries.en: Changed the question that turns on the mods Claude writes in a session to plain text with no link or session id; it stays up when a new turn starts, and Claude tells you what loaded when you turn them on
entries.zh: 将打开 Claude 在会话中写入的 mods 的问题更改为没有链接或会话 ID 的纯文本；当新的回合开始时它会保持亮起状态，克劳德会告诉你打开它们时加载了什么

entries.en: Changed tool search to be on by default behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; a 400 or 422 from the gateway is retried without it
entries.zh: 将工具搜索更改为默认在自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`后面打开；如果没有网关，则重试来自网关的 400 或 422

entries.en: Changed compaction to send Claude the skill list again afterwards; `/reload-skills` now sends only new or changed skills
entries.zh: 更改了compaction之后再次向克劳德发送技能列表； `/reload-skills` 现在仅发送新的或更改的技能

entries.en: Changed skill hooks: the skills of one source (a repo, your own folder, or a plugin) can register at most 1,024 hooks and 16,384 matcher characters per session
entries.zh: 更改了技能挂钩：一个来源（存储库、您自己的文件夹或插件）的技能每个会话最多可以注册 1,024 个挂钩和 16,384 个匹配器字符

entries.en: Changed skills under a policy that allows hooks from plugins only: a skill used in the main conversation whose hooks are kept out no longer gets its `allowed-tools`
entries.zh: 在仅允许来自插件的挂钩的策略下更改了技能：在主要对话中使用的挂钩被排除在外的技能不再获得其“允许的工具”

entries.en: Updated the /claude-api skill to use the `ant` CLI on Claude Platform on AWS instead of falling back to the SDK or curl
entries.zh: `/claude-api` 技能在 AWS 上的 Claude Platform 中改用 `ant` CLI，而不再退回使用 SDK 或 curl

entries.en: Removed the notes from `claude plugin validate` that predicted where a mod's hooks would run
entries.zh: 从 `claude plugin validate` 中移除预测插件钩子运行位置的说明

entries.en: Removed the "(research preview)" label from the `/fast` dialog title on Opus 5.5
entries.zh: 在 Opus 5.5 上，`/fast` 对话框标题中的 "(research preview)" 标签已移除

entries.en: [VSCode] Added mod drawing in the chat panel for sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry, behind an LLM gateway, or with telemetry turned off
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在 Amazon Bedrock、Google Vertex AI 和 Microsoft Foundry 上运行、经过 LLM 网关，或关闭了遥测的会话，聊天面板新增模组绘图功能

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed one cause of sessions failing to start with "Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms": time a SessionStart command hook spends running no longer counts toward the limit, up to 10 minutes in total
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话报 "Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms" 的原因之一：SessionStart 命令 hook 的运行时间不再计入限制（总计最多 10 分钟）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a session closed while it was starting keeping its Claude Code process running until the start ended
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复启动中被关闭的会话，其 Claude Code 进程直到启动结束才退出的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a mod's drawings disappearing from a long-open panel until the next turn on machines that also run an older Claude Code
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在同时运行旧版 Claude Code 的机器上，长时间打开的面板中的 mod 绘图会消失、直到下一轮次才出现的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Past conversations hiding sessions when `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` is set
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复设置了 `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` 时，Past conversations 会隐藏部分会话的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed background sub-agents to show as one status line under their Agent card instead of streaming every step into the chat; the full transcript stays in /tasks
entries.zh: [VSCode] 后台子智能体在其 Agent 卡片下方只显示一行状态，不再把每一步都输出到聊天中；完整记录仍保存在 /tasks 中

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed folders in the composer's @ list showing no name in cloud sessions, where picking one added only a space instead of a mention
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复云端会话中，输入框 @ 列表里的文件夹没有名称，选择后只添加一个空格而非提及的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude going silent in a thread when its channel becomes shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces mid-task; it now posts a one-time note to @-mention it in a new thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复任务进行中频道变为跨 Enterprise Grid 工作区共享后，Claude 在话题中沉默的问题；现在会在新话题中发送一条一次性通知，供你 @ 它

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !fork` typed outside a thread getting no visible reply; Claude now shows you a private note saying to run it from inside a thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在话题外输入 `@Claude !fork` 时没有可见回复的问题；现在 Claude 会给你发一条仅你可见的提示，说明需要在话题内运行

entries.en: [Code Review] Added review levels to Code Review: Owners choose Quick, Standard (the default), or Deep for the organization, and can give individual repositories their own level
entries.zh: [Code Review] Code Review 新增审查级别：所有者可为组织选择 Quick、Standard（默认）或 Deep，并可为单个仓库设置各自的级别

entries.en: [Code Review] Added an option in Code Review admin settings to review every repository in a GitHub organization, including ones added later, without selecting them one by one
entries.zh: [Code Review] Code Review 管理设置新增选项：可审查 GitHub 组织中的所有仓库（包括之后新增的），无需逐个勾选

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed pull requests opened within a minute or two of an admin turning on Code Review being silently skipped; they are now retried and reviewed
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复管理员开启 Code Review 后一两分钟内打开的拉取请求被悄悄跳过的问题；现在会重试并审查这些 PR

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL`以选择客户端自动模式分类器使用的模型；它不会更改服务器端自动模式的模型

entries.en: Added an `Idle compaction` row to `/config` for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off
entries.zh: 在`/config`中添加了“空闲压缩”行，用于关闭或重新打开空闲压缩；空闲压缩后显示的通知现在说明如何将其关闭

entries.en: Added a notice to `/design-sync` and `/design-login` that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026
entries.zh: 在`/design-sync`和`/design-login`中添加了独立 Claude Design (claude.ai/design) 将于 2026 年 12 月 14 日关闭的通知

entries.en: Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted
entries.zh: 修复了在压缩对话时停止转弯时出现的“提示太长”错误

entries.en: Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted" after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中切换到 Vertex 或 Bedrock 后请求失败并显示“诊断：不允许额外输入”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Read tool loading an image file of any size, or a pipe or device named like an image, entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused
entries.zh: 修复 Read 工具会把任意大小的图片文件，或名称像图片的管道或设备，整个读入内存的问题；现在超过 128 MB 的图片源会被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed `/autocompact` and `/effort` saving to the wrong model when a gateway names Opus 4 or 4.1 with a prefix, such as `anthropic/claude-opus-4-1`
entries.zh: 修复了当网关使用前缀（例如`anthropic/claude-opus-4-1`）命名 Opus 4 或 4.1 时，`/autocompact`和`/effort`保存到错误模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed a prompt cache miss when a tool added mid-session was loaded again through ToolSearch or after compaction
entries.zh: 修复了通过 ToolSearch 或压缩后再次加载在会话中添加的工具时提示缓存未命中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin` and other subcommands sometimes exiting before a queued settings or config write finished, which could lose the change or leave a `.tmp` file behind
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin`和其他子命令有时在排队设置或配置写入完成之前退出的问题，这可能会丢失更改或留下`.tmp`文件

entries.en: Fixed plugin marketplaces re-cloning on every refresh, and newly installed git plugins showing version "unknown", when git defaults to the reftable ref format
entries.zh: 修复了每次刷新时插件市场都会重新克隆的问题，以及当 git 默认为 reftable ref 格式时新安装的 git 插件显示版本“未知”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the PowerShell tool not finding commands in a plugin's `bin/` folder, and reporting an error when a search that finds nothing (rg, grep, findstr, git grep) is piped into `Select-Object` or another formatting cmdlet
entries.zh: 修复 PowerShell 工具在插件的 `bin/` 文件夹中找不到命令的问题，以及搜索无结果（rg、grep、findstr、git grep）被管道传给 `Select-Object` 等格式化命令时报错的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in the desktop app pointing you to claude.ai settings or `/mcp` to authorize or reconnect an MCP server where that option isn't available
entries.zh: 修复了桌面应用程序中的 Claude 指向 claude.ai 设置或`/mcp`以授权或重新连接 MCP 服务器（该选项不可用）的问题

entries.en: Fixed artifact publishes sometimes failing when Claude sent an empty list of edits, and Claude retrying an artifact update the wrong way after a newer version of the artifact turned it away
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 发送空编辑列表时，工件发布有时会失败，以及在较新版本的工件将其关闭后，Claude 以错误的方式重试工件更新的问题

entries.en: Fixed `classifier_category` missing from OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events for most auto mode classifier blocks, and new `tool_decision` attributes pushing out `tool_use_id`, `tool_source` and `tool_parameters` when `OTEL_LOGRECORD_ATTRIBUTE_COUNT_LIMIT` is low
entries.zh: 修复了大多数自动模式分类器块的 OpenTelemetry`tool_decision`事件中缺少`classifier_category`的问题，以及当`OTEL_LOGRECORD_ATTRIBUTE_COUNT_LIMIT`较低时推出`tool_use_id`、`tool_source`和`tool_parameters`的新`tool_decision`属性

entries.en: Fixed rows in the agents view staying blank after moving down a long list or folding a section
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图中的行在向下移动长列表或折叠部分后保持空白的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control --help` not printing its usage and exiting when not signed in
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Remote-control --help”不打印其用法并在未登录时退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/design consent` and `/design revoke` suggesting `/design-login` when they fail in a cloud session, where it isn't available; the message now points to claude.ai/design/settings
entries.zh: 修复了“/design grant”和`/design revoke`在云会话中失败时建议`/design-login`（在云会话中不可用）的问题；该消息现在指向 claude.ai/design/settings

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers showing no tools, or every tool call failing, when the server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 but omits `resultType`, `ttlMs` or `cacheScope`
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器协商协议版本 2026-07-28 但省略`resultType`、`ttlMs`或`cacheScope`时，MCP 服务器显示没有工具或每个工具调用失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions spending usage credits on models your plan pays for only with credits: they are now skipped after a reply billed to credits
entries.zh: 修复了在您的计划仅使用积分支付的模型上花费使用积分的提示建议：现在在按积分计费的回复后会跳过它们

entries.en: Fixed URLs written in backticks being clickable only on their first row when they wrap; the whole URL is now one link in terminals that support hyperlinks
entries.zh: 修复了用反引号编写的 URL 在换行时只能在第一行单击的问题；整个 URL 现在是支持超链接的终端中的一个链接

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin details <name>@builtin` suggesting `claude plugin list`, which never shows built-in plugins, when the plugin isn't found; it now points to `/plugin`
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件详细信息 <name>@builtin” 建议“claude 插件列表”的问题，当找不到插件时，它永远不会显示内置插件；它现在指向`/plugin`

entries.en: Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists
entries.zh: 修复了一个表情符号，该表情符号在链接开始时将一列包裹得太宽，这将其隐藏在有问题的预览中并将表格变成列表

entries.en: Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray `.git` file points at a directory that doesn't exist
entries.zh: 修复 git 2.56 及以上版本中，若零散的 `.git` 文件指向不存在的目录，工作树隔离会拒绝创建或恢复工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process
entries.zh: 修复了在新进程中恢复会话后云会话的成本和使用量从零重新启动的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches failing with "bad object refs/heads" in sessions that reuse a checkout stored in git's reftable format
entries.zh: 修复了使用 git 的 reftable 格式保存的检出副本的会话中，git 拉取报 "bad object refs/heads" 的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or asked about for projects on exFAT or FAT32 drives, including in sessions started with `--plugin-dir`
entries.zh: Windows：修复了位于 exFAT 或 FAT32 驱动器上的项目中，所有文件写入都被拒绝或要求确认的问题，包括使用 `--plugin-dir` 启动的会话

entries.en: Improved startup time with many plugins enabled: plugin command and agent files now take far fewer file system calls to load, most of all on Windows
entries.zh: 改进启动 时间（装有大量插件时）：插件的命令和智能体文件加载时的文件系统调用大幅减少，Windows 上提升最明显

entries.en: Improved auto mode with the server-side classifier: a conversation too long for the safety check is now compacted, instead of every checked tool call being denied
entries.zh: 改进服务端分类器下的自动模式：对话太长、无法完成安全检查时，会先压缩对话，而不是拒绝每一个被检查的工具调用

entries.en: Improved the message when a background session reopened from another folder has no LLM gateway: it now says why, instead of "Not logged in"
entries.zh: 改进后台会话从其他文件夹重新打开、但没有 LLM 网关时的提示：会说明原因，而不是只显示「Not logged in」

entries.en: Changed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions with no permission mode to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; `--permission-mode auto` keeps auto
entries.zh: 更改了无权限模式的`claude -p`和 Agent SDK 会话，以在第三方提供商上以“默认”模式启动，并关闭遥测或全新安装； `--permission-mode auto` 保持自动

entries.en: Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already are in the terminal; `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off, and `claude mcp serve` never offers them
entries.zh: 将 fork 子代理 (`subagent_type: "fork"`) 更改为在 `claude -p`、Agent SDK、桌面应用程序和 VS Code 中默认启用，因为它们已经在终端中； `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` 将其关闭，并且 `claude mcpserve` 从不提供它们

entries.en: Changed the desktop app and VS Code to always run the main conversation's subagents in the background, as the terminal does, rather than let Claude choose; a subagent's own Agent calls in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code now run in the foreground by default
entries.zh: 更改了桌面应用程序和 VS Code，使其始终在后台运行主对话的子代理，就像终端一样，而不是让 Claude 选择；子代理自己的代理在`claude -p`中调用，代理 SDK、桌面应用程序和 VS Code 现在默认在前台运行

entries.en: Changed the `← for agents` footer hint to hide 10 seconds after a session opens; the count of agents waiting on you still shows
entries.zh: 将“代理的←”页脚提示更改为在会话打开 10 秒后隐藏；等待您的客服人员数量仍然显示

entries.en: Changed where the Claude in Chrome instructions sit in the system prompt so that new conversations can read them from the shared prompt cache
entries.zh: 更改了 Chrome 中的 Claude 指令在系统提示中的位置，以便新对话可以从共享提示缓存中读取它们

entries.en: Changed prompt and agent hooks so that at most 12 of one event run at a time; the rest wait their turn
entries.zh: 更改了提示和代理挂钩，以便一次最多运行 12 个事件；其余的人等待轮到他们

entries.en: Changed the message shown when your organization's policy turns off `/feedback`: it now points to GitHub issues instead of an organization admin
entries.zh: 更改了当组织的策略关闭`/feedback`时显示的消息：它现在指向 GitHub 问题而不是组织管理员

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed text after an unclosed code block in a list showing as plain text while a reply streams, then turning into code
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复列表中未闭合的代码块之后的文本，在回复流式输出时先显示为纯文本、随后才变成代码的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed MCP server sign-in from the panel opening a broken authorization page when the server URL contains a query string
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复服务器 URL 含查询字符串时，从面板进行 MCP 服务器登录会打开一个失效的授权页面的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the `@browser` banner saying "Browser connected" when no browser with the Claude extension can be reached
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复无法连接到安装了 Claude 扩展的浏览器时，`@browser` 横幅仍显示 "Browser connected" 的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added a banner on a routine's page that says why its last run didn't start, such as your organization reaching its limit on concurrent cloud sessions
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 例程页面新增横幅，说明其上一次运行为何没有开始，例如你的组织已达到并发云端会话上限

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Rewind to here" failing on every message except the newest in cloud sessions; self-hosted runners need Claude Code v2.1.246 or later
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复云端会话中，除最新一条消息外，其他消息的「Rewind to here」全部失败的问题；自托管运行器需要 Claude Code v2.1.246 或更高版本

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the pull request status bar in cloud sessions flipping a pull request with merge conflicts back to ready while GitHub rechecked it
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复 GitHub 重新检查时，云端会话的拉取请求状态栏会把有合并冲突的 PR 改回可合并状态的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs showing as Completed after their cloud session stopped unexpectedly, and as Cancelled when archived before they started, instead of failed
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复云端会话意外停止后，例程运行显示为 Completed，以及开始前被归档时显示为 Cancelled 而非失败的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the diff view in cloud sessions missing changes or failing to load after the session's GitHub repository was renamed or moved
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复云端会话的 GitHub 仓库被重命名或移动后，差异视图缺少改动或无法加载的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed a scheduled routine run that failed partway being run again from the start an hour or more later, which could repeat work such as posting the same report twice
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复定时例程运行中途失败后，在一小时或更久之后从头重新运行，可能重复执行工作（例如重复发布同一份报告）的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed an open cloud session sometimes not showing messages sent from another device until you reloaded the page or clicked away and back
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复已打开的云端会话，有时看不到从其他设备发来的消息，直到刷新页面或点击离开再回来的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved the error shown when a cloud session fails to start: it now says "Connection lost" or "Server error" instead of "Something went wrong"
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 改进云端会话启动失败时的错误提示：现在显示「Connection lost」或「Server error」，而不是「Something went wrong」

entries.en: [Remote Control] Fixed a subagent's pane spinning forever in a Remote Control session after your computer goes offline; it now says Remote Control is disconnected
entries.zh: [Remote Control] 修复电脑离线后，Remote Control 会话中子智能体的面板一直转圈的问题；现在会显示 Remote Control 已断开

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed "is thinking…" staying up under a mention in a Slack channel or DM after Claude answered it by editing one of its earlier messages
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 在 Slack 频道或私信中回答提及后，通过编辑自己之前的一条消息来回答，导致「is thinking…」仍显示在提及下方的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed URLs in code blocks under a numbered or bulleted step of Claude's Slack replies being wrapped in angle brackets, which broke copied commands
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 的 Slack 回复中，编号或项目符号步骤下代码块里的 URL 被尖括号包裹，导致复制的命令失效的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed HEIC, SVG, TIFF and BMP images attached in Slack never reaching Claude; they now arrive as files in its working files, like other file types
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在 Slack 中附加的 HEIC、SVG、TIFF 和 BMP 图片从未传到 Claude 的问题；现在它们会和其他文件类型一样，以文件形式放入其工作文件中

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed new channel managers losing access to Claude in Slack in organizations that restrict Claude Tag by role; the manager role now also grants Claude Tag in Slack
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在按角色限制 Claude Tag 的组织中，新频道管理员失去 Claude in Slack 访问权限的问题；管理员角色现在也会授予 Claude Tag in Slack 的权限

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed custom connectors whose MCP servers share one host showing as a single connector in Claude Tag admin settings; each server is now its own connector
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复共用同一主机的自定义连接器（其 MCP 服务器共享一个主机）在 Claude Tag 管理设置中显示为一个连接器的问题；现在每个服务器都是独立的连接器

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes answering a direct message with "DMs are temporarily unavailable" and dropping it when a single Slack lookup stalled; it now retries first
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复单次 Slack 查询卡住时，Claude in Slack 有时回复私信「DMs are temporarily unavailable」并丢弃消息的问题；现在会先重试

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed direct messages with Claude on a Slack Enterprise Grid ignoring Slack's workspace dropdown; they now run under the connected workspace you last opened Claude in
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack Enterprise Grid 上与 Claude 的私信忽略 Slack 工作区下拉菜单的问题；现在会在你最后打开 Claude 的已连接工作区中运行

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack's notice for a channel's monthly spend limit saying a channel manager can raise it; it now names an organization owner and links the usage page
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude in Slack 关于频道月度花费限额的通知，说频道管理员可以提高限额的问题；现在会指明组织所有者，并附上用量页面链接

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed links in Claude's Slack replies absorbing the closing bold or italic marks, or full-width punctuation, right after them, which broke the link and the formatting
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 的 Slack 回复中，链接之后紧跟的粗体或斜体结束符，或全角标点，被链接吞掉，导致链接和格式都失效的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved repository search in Claude Tag admin settings to cover up to 100 connected GitHub accounts and find private repositories past the first 5,000 of a GitHub App install
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude Tag 管理设置中的仓库搜索：可覆盖最多 100 个已连接的 GitHub 账户，并能在 GitHub App 安装的前 5,000 个之后找到私有仓库

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Add place in Claude Tag admin settings to list a channel you type or paste right away, instead of only after your organization's full channel list has loaded
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude Tag 管理设置中的「Add place」，输入或粘贴的频道会立即列出，不必等组织的完整频道列表加载完成

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Add > Domain on a workspace's or channel's page in Claude Tag admin settings to be available once that page loads, not only after every channel has loaded
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude Tag 管理设置中工作区或频道页面的「Add > Domain」，页面加载完成后即可使用，不必等所有频道加载完毕

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to organize Claude's access into four tabs: Bundles, Connectors, Skills and plugins, and Channels
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude Tag 管理设置改为把 Claude 的访问权限分为四个标签页：Bundles、Connectors、Skills and plugins 和 Channels

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the Roles page in organization settings to group the roles created for Claude Tag channel managers in a collapsed section below your organization's own roles
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 组织设置中的 Roles 页面改为：为 Claude Tag 频道管理员创建的角色，折叠显示在组织自有角色的下方

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review setup not resuming after you leave to connect GitHub; back in admin settings, it now reopens at the repository picker
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复离开去连接 GitHub 后，Code Review 设置无法继续的问题；返回管理设置后，会重新打开到仓库选择器

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS`，因此无人值守重试模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`）会在重置太远而不是等待的使用限制处结束请求

entries.en: Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
entries.zh: 为`claude-api`技能添加了 OpenTelemetry 跟踪指南，包括使用`ant` CLI 设置跟踪目标

entries.en: Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
entries.zh: 在 vim 模式中添加了`%`动作：单独或与 d/c/y 一起跳转到匹配的括号

entries.en: Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line
entries.zh: 将“行”添加到 mod 的“输入”：终端中多行的文本字段，其中 Enter 提交，Shift+Enter 或 Enter 之前的反斜杠开始新行

entries.en: Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules
entries.zh: 将`classifier_verdict`和`permission_mode`添加到 OpenTelemetry`tool_decision`事件中，因此可以将自动模式分类器决策与权限规则分开

entries.en: Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
entries.zh: 将`classifier_category`添加到 OpenTelemetry`tool_decision`事件中，当`OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`时，命名分类器块匹配的内置规则

entries.en: Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits
entries.zh: 修复了退出删除由`WorktreeCreate`挂钩创建的工作树而不询问它何时可以保留未推送的提交的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model
entries.zh: 修复当组织无法使用最新的 Fable 模型时，`fable`（及 `best`）模型别名在 Anthropic API 上报错的问题；现在 Claude Code 会自动改用上一个 Fable 模型重试一次

entries.en: Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files
entries.zh: 修复了磁盘已满导致登录无法刷新时出现的误导性“请运行/登录”错误；错误现在命名磁盘并表示删除文件

entries.en: Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed
entries.zh: 修复了当搜索程序在返回任何结果之前意外失败时 Grep 和 Glob 报告没有匹配项的问题；他们现在返回一个错误，表示搜索失败

entries.en: Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority
entries.zh: 修复工作流智能体在读取到"任务文本不具备用户授权"的系统说明后，有时会跳过步骤但仍报告运行成功的问题

entries.en: Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse 挂钩覆盖编辑或写入时工件更新被拒绝的问题；克劳德现在编辑文件，然后重新发布，而不是在发布调用中更改它

entries.en: Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in
entries.zh: 修复了参数名称非常多或非常长的技能和命令在调用时会停滞数秒的问题；现在仅填写前 64 个名称，每个名称最多 64 个字符

entries.en: Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders
entries.zh: 修复了当技能、命令和挂钩的参数填充许多占位符时使用大量内存的问题

entries.en: Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8
entries.zh: 修复了在 0.53 之前的 VTE 上构建的终端（例如 RHEL 8 上的 MATE 终端）中覆盖文件夹信任提示的`>0q`以及退出时 shell 提示之前的`>4m`等杂散字符

entries.en: Fixed stray `GOK` text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2
entries.zh: 修复了某些版本的 iTerm2 启动时提示中出现的杂散`GOK`文本

entries.en: Fixed switching to a model whose name contains `application-inference-profile` running your `awsAuthRefresh` command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock
entries.zh: 修复了切换到名称包含`application-inference-profile`的模型，运行`awsAuthRefresh`命令并在提供程序不是 Bedrock 时延迟模型切换挂钩

entries.en: Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list` exited in the middle of a token refresh
entries.zh: 修复了在令牌刷新过程中退出`claude auth status`或`claude plugin list`等短命令后登录刷新超时和意外注销的问题

entries.en: Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user
entries.zh: 修复了在权限检查期间发送的消息被报告给模型并被用户拒绝的工具调用被切断的问题

entries.en: Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first
entries.zh: 修复了切换到上下文窗口较小的模型可能会在不先询问的情况下将使用积分花费在先前模型的摘要上的情况

entries.en: Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested
entries.zh: 修复了 LLM 网关后面的对话在您未选择的模型上一遍又一遍地压缩的问题，该网关的响应命名的模型与请求的模型不同

entries.en: Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式在较慢或繁忙的机器上，按 Esc 后有时仍停留在 INSERT 模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL
entries.zh: 修复了 Esc 在 vim 模式下丢弃键入的 AskUserQuestion 答案的问题：自由文本字段现在支持 vim NORMAL 模式，并且 Esc 仅从 NORMAL 取消

entries.en: Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text
entries.zh: 修复 Read 工具把 .xlsm、.parquet、.epub、.heic 等二进制文件当作文本读取的问题

entries.en: Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card
entries.zh: 修复了一个 Markdown 表格，只有一个标题行，当对于终端来说太宽时，不会绘制任何内容，包括在计划批准卡上的计划中

entries.en: Fixed the /claude-api skill saying CMEK external-key endpoints aren't available on Claude Platform on AWS
entries.zh: 修复了 /claude-api 技能显示 CMEK 外部密钥端点在 AWS 上的 Claude Platform 上不可用的问题

entries.en: Fixed skills no longer being listed to the model after using `/rewind`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`/rewind`后技能不再列出到模型中的问题

entries.en: Fixed the compaction row in a resumed session offering ctrl+o for history that is not loaded; it now says where the earlier messages are saved, and also shows in fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复恢复的会话中压缩记录提供 ctrl+o 查看未加载历史的问题；现在会说明早期消息保存在何处，并且在全屏模式下也会显示

entries.en: Fixed the "new task? /clear to save tokens" hint coming back right after you interrupt a response
entries.zh: 修复了中断响应后立即返回的“新任务？/清除以保存令牌”提示

entries.en: Fixed the permission prompt for a plugin or skill hook's `ask` decision not showing which plugin or skill the hook comes from
entries.zh: 修复插件或技能钩子的 `ask` 决定所弹出的权限提示，没有显示该钩子来自哪个插件或技能的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/diff` not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories when one of its git checks timed out or failed
entries.zh: 修复了当 git 检查之一超时或失败时，`/diff`没有注意到可引用存储库中存在冲突的选择或恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed workflow scripts asking for permission or being refused when read, edited or re-run after a Bash `cd` in the same session
entries.zh: 修复同一会话中 Bash 执行 `cd` 之后，读取、编辑或重新运行工作流脚本时仍会请求权限或被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed dim text on the dark ANSI theme and 16-color terminals: faint inside filled boxes, not faint under selection and search highlights, and list descriptions dimmed like other secondary text
entries.zh: 修复了深色 ANSI 主题和 16 色终端上的暗淡文本：填充框内暗淡，在选择和搜索突出显示下不暗淡，并且列表描述像其他辅助文本一样变暗

entries.en: Fixed a mod's `$.model.fork` returning `nothing-to-fork` when called before the first response of a new Claude Code process had finished, as in `claude -p` runs and cloud sessions
entries.zh: 修复了在新 Claude 代码进程的第一个响应完成之前调用时，mod 的`$.model.fork`返回`nothing-to-fork`的问题，如`claude -p`运行和云会话中那样

entries.en: Fullscreen mode: Fixed `/compact` and auto-compact briefly freezing the UI while the visible transcript is rebuilt
entries.zh: 全屏模式：修复了 `/compact` 和自动压缩时，重建可见对话记录会让界面短暂卡住的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions started from Slack being unable to find or attach a repository when managed settings restrict MCP servers; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep those tools off
entries.zh: 修复了在托管设置限制 MCP 服务器时，从 Slack 启动的会话找不到或无法关联仓库的问题；如需屏蔽这些工具，请使用 `deniedMcpServers`

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions being reported as having a deleted source branch, and not retried, when an unrelated setup or session failure quoted git's missing-ref wording
entries.zh: 修复了某些无关的设置或会话失败中出现 git 缺失引用的字样时，会话被误报为源分支已删除且不会重试的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed the log promising a retry of a failed or declined session release for a session that is ending; repeated failures now show a count
entries.zh: 修复了日志中承诺会重试一个正在结束的会话的失败或被拒绝的释放；现在重复失败会显示次数

entries.en: Windows: Fixed stopped background PowerShell commands missing the closing `[killed]` line in their output file
entries.zh: Windows：修复了被停止的后台 PowerShell 命令，其输出文件缺少结尾的 `[killed]` 行的问题

entries.en: Improved switching to a model with a smaller context window: a conversation too long for the new model is now summarized by the previous model first
entries.zh: 改进切换到上下文窗口更小的模型：对于新模型装不下的长对话，会先由之前的模型做摘要

entries.en: Improved rendering performance while a long-running subagent works: its progress trail now updates incrementally instead of being reprocessed in full on every render
entries.zh: 改进子智能体运行时的渲染性能：其进度记录改为增量更新，不再每次渲染都全量重新处理

entries.en: Improved artifacts: pages Claude writes now paint the band above a sticky header, so scrolled text no longer shows there in the mobile apps
entries.zh: 改进 artifact：Claude 编写的页面现在会在粘性顶栏上方绘制颜色带，滚动的文字不会再在移动端应用中显示在那里

entries.en: Improved mods: in VS Code and the desktop and mobile apps, a tree drawn above the question dialog can now hold Markdown and up to 48 rows; the terminal keeps 12 plain rows
entries.zh: 改进 mod：在 VS Code 以及桌面端和移动端应用中，问题对话框上方的树形界面可包含 Markdown，并可显示最多 48 行；终端仍保持 12 行纯文本

entries.en: Changed a mod hook's `.catch` handler to run only when the hook throws or times out; events raised beneath the hook's own calls now skip that hook without asking its `.catch`
entries.zh: 更改了 mod 挂钩的`.catch`处理程序，使其仅在挂钩抛出或超时时运行；在钩子自己的调用下引发的事件现在会跳过该钩子，而不询问其`.catch`

entries.en: Changed a mod's `$.env.set` to resolve with `{}` once the variable is set or unset, or with `{ deny }` saying why when the write is not made
entries.zh: 更改了 mod 的 `$.env.set`，以便在设置或取消设置变量后使用 `{}` 进行解析，或者在未进行写入时使用 `{ deny }` 说明原因

entries.en: [VSCode] Added LaTeX math rendering in Claude's responses, including `$$` and multi-line `\[ … \]` blocks and inline `$…$` and `\(…\)` math
entries.zh: [VSCode] Claude 的回复支持 LaTeX 数学公式渲染，包括 `$$` 和多行的 `\[ … \]` 块，以及行内的 `$…$` 和 `\(…\)`

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a "Get more usage" link to the usage-limit banner for Pro and Max plans in the VS Code and JetBrains panels
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在 VS Code 和 JetBrains 面板中，Pro 和 Max 套餐的用量上限横幅新增「Get more usage」链接

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a conversation that crashes or freezes the panel being reopened on every reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复导致面板崩溃或卡死的对话，每次重新加载后都会再次打开并引发同样问题的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat panel slowing down during long thinking: it no longer re-parses the whole thinking text on every update
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复长时间思考时聊天面板变慢的问题：不再每次更新都重新解析整个思考文本

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed diagnostics showing "[object Object]" instead of the rule code (e.g. MD013) for some language servers
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复部分语言服务器的诊断信息显示 "[object Object]" 而不是规则代码（如 MD013）的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the native dictation audio module being loaded, to check microphone permission, where dictation is not offered (non-claude.ai sign-ins, remote windows)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在不提供听写的场景（非 claude.ai 登录、远程窗口）下，仍会加载原生听写音频模块来检查麦克风权限的问题

entries.en: Added `virtualText` to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt
entries.zh: 在mod的提示装饰中添加了`virtualText`：在提示框中绘制的文本，从未进入草稿或提交的提示

entries.en: Added `cache_creation_5m_tokens` and `cache_creation_1h_tokens` to the OpenTelemetry `api_request` event, splitting cache writes by lifetime
entries.zh: 将`cache_creation_5m_tokens`和`cache_creation_1h_tokens`添加到 OpenTelemetry`api_request`事件中，按生命周期拆分缓存写入

entries.en: Added `$.ui.view({ agentId })` for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and `$.ui.view({})` goes back
entries.zh: 为 mods 添加了 `$.ui.view({ agentId })`：当您询问时，在主视图中显示代理的记录，并且 `$.ui.view({})` 返回

entries.en: Added a `dir` prop on a mod's `Text` for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right
entries.zh: 在 mod 的`Text`上添加了一个`dir`属性，用于从右到左的文本：在 Windows 上和 VS Code 的终端中，其行以该方向读取并位于右侧齐平

entries.en: Added `/advisor` on Claude Platform on AWS; no advisor runs until you pick one with `/advisor`, `advisorModel` or `--advisor`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` turns it off
entries.zh: 在 AWS 上的 Claude 平台上添加了`/advisor`；除非您使用`/advisor`、`advisorModel`或`--advisor`选择一个顾问程序，否则不会运行任何顾问程序，并且`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1`将其关闭

entries.en: Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans, such as `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.conversation.id`, `gen_ai.tool.name` and `error.type`
entries.zh: 向跟踪跨度添加了 OpenTelemetry GenAI 语义约定属性，例如`gen_ai.provider.name`、`gen_ai.conversation.id`、`gen_ai.tool.name`和`error.type`

entries.en: Added support for rewriting a workflow agent's `prompt` and `model` in the `agent.spawn` mod hook, which could only refuse workflow agents before
entries.zh: 在`agent.spawn` mod hook中添加了对重写工作流代理的`prompt`和`model`的支持，之前只能拒绝工作流代理

entries.en: Added the `prompt.change` mod hook, raised when the prompt box's text changes without a typed edit: a recalled history entry, a clear, an undo, or a plugin's fill
entries.zh: 添加了`prompt.change` mod 挂钩，当提示框的文本在没有键入编辑的情况下发生更改时引发：调用的历史记录条目、清除、撤消或插件的填充

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that an organization policy blocked a host when the session's own network settings did
entries.zh: 修复了云会话告诉克劳德，当会话自己的网络设置阻止主机时，组织策略阻止了主机

entries.en: Fixed `/autocompact` warning about high token usage when you choose a smaller auto-compact window
entries.zh: 修复了当您选择较小的自动压缩窗口时有关高令牌使用的`/autocompact`警告

entries.en: Fixed SessionEnd hooks sometimes not running when you exit while a background command is still running
entries.zh: 修复了后台命令仍在运行时退出时 SessionEnd 挂钩有时不运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --help` naming a removed tool in its description of `--restricted`
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --help`在`--restricted`描述中命名已删除工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` not refreshing any pull request's status when the data for one of them came back incomplete
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”在其中一个请求的数据返回不完整时不刷新任何拉取请求的状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude being told a background agent was lost, not resumable, after a cloud session's container was replaced, when the agent had already been resumed once
entries.zh: 修复了在替换云会话的容器后，当代理已经恢复一次时，克劳德被告知后台代理丢失且不可恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents you had typed messages to disappearing from `/tasks` shortly after finishing, leaving no way back to the conversation
entries.zh: 修复了您输入的消息在完成后不久从`/tasks`中消失的子代理，无法返回对话

entries.en: Fixed a completed parent agent dropping off the breadcrumb (its child shown re-rooted at top level) while you were viewing the child
entries.zh: 修复了当您查看子级时，已完成的父级代理会掉落面包屑（其子级在顶层显示为重新扎根）

entries.en: Fixed the agents view taking a typed word such as "up", "down" or "escape" for that key when input arrived in a burst, which could move the peek mid-reply or clear a draft
entries.zh: 修复输入成批到达时，智能体视图把输入的"up""down""escape"等单词当作对应按键处理，可能在回复中移动预览或清空草稿的问题

entries.en: Fixed automatic tool search (`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto`) turning off part-way through a conversation, for example while MCP servers reconnect after a resume
entries.zh: 修复了自动工具搜索（`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto`）在对话过程中关闭的问题，例如在恢复后 MCP 服务器重新连接时

entries.en: Fixed a login refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID` leaving the refused organization's token stored, or live after `/login`
entries.zh: 修复了`forceLoginOrgUUID`拒绝的登录，导致被拒绝的组织的令牌被存储，或在`/login`之后生效

entries.en: Fixed the diff view in Claude Desktop and Remote Control sessions not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories
entries.zh: 修复 Claude Desktop 和远程控制会话中，差异视图在 reftable 仓库里未察觉有冲突的 cherry-pick 或 revert 的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool's verbose and ctrl+o line reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a call's input arrives; its row now shows "Waiting…" and "Running…" as Bash's does
entries.zh: 修复了当呼叫输入到达时 Artifact 工具的详细行和 ctrl+o 行读取 `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` 的问题；它的行现在显示“正在等待...”和“正在运行...”，就像 Bash 一样

entries.en: Fixed the first transcript entry written after resuming a session being lost when a crash had cut the transcript's last line short
entries.zh: 修复恢复会话后写入的第一条记录，在崩溃导致转录文件最后一行被截断时丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` dropping messages, and `claude purge` skipping subfolder projects, when they contain a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
entries.zh: 修复了当子文件夹项目包含 Unicode 行或段落分隔符时`/branch`丢弃消息和`claude purge`跳过子文件夹项目的问题（U+2028、U+2029）

entries.en: Fixed plugin `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hooks not running when Claude Code starts with `--worktree` (not yet with `--tmux`)
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 以 `--worktree` 开头（尚未使用 `--tmux`）时，插件 `WorktreeCreate` 和 `WorktreeRemove` 挂钩未运行

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` in repositories using reftable ref storage
entries.zh: 修复了使用可引用存储的存储库中`git commit -q`之后 OpenTelemetry`tool_result`事件丢失`git_commit_id`的问题
