entries.zh: 添加了程序状态协议 (OSC 7501) 支持：实现该协议的终端可以显示 Claude Code 是否正在工作、正在等待您或已完成

entries.en: Added quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without its `>` markers
entries.zh: 将引用的文本添加到`/copy`选择器，因此起草的消息在复制时不带`>`标记

entries.en: Added a warning to `claude plugin install`, `enable`, `disable` and `marketplace add` when the settings file they write to does not load
entries.zh: 当写入的设置文件未加载时，向`claude plugin install`、`enable`、`disable`和`marketplace add`添加了警告

entries.en: Added a line on stderr, when it is a terminal, that says what a `claude -p` run is waiting for when it stays open after its last turn
entries.zh: 在 stderr 上添加了一行，当它是终端时，表示`claude -p`运行在最后一轮后保持打开状态时正在等待什么

entries.en: Added support for `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` on the Claude apps gateway's Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other cloud upstreams: a value you set now limits how long a stream may take to start there, after which it fails over or gets a 502
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用程序网关的 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和其他云上游添加了对`timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms`的支持：您现在设置的值限制了流在此处启动所需的时间，之后它会进行故障转移或收到 502

entries.en: Added a "Backgrounding cancelled" message when you stop the turn while `←` is waiting for the current tool to finish
entries.zh: 添加了`←`等待当前工具完成时停止转动时的“背景取消”消息

entries.en: Added an optional `models` list to every Claude apps gateway upstream: only the listed models are sent there, on failover too, and one `*` in an entry is a wildcard
entries.zh: 向上游的每个 Claude 应用程序网关添加了一个可选的“模型”列表：只有列出的模型才会发送到那里，故障转移时也是如此，条目中的一个`*`是通配符

entries.en: Added support for `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` and `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in your own user settings on machines with no managed settings, so `/login` opens on that Claude apps gateway
entries.zh: 在没有托管设置的计算机上，在您自己的用户设置中添加了对 `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` 和 `forceLoginGatewayUrl` 的支持，因此 `/login` 在 Claude 应用程序网关上打开

entries.en: Added advice to `claude plugin validate` when a plugin's README has no install line: it prints the line to paste and never changes the exit code, even with `--strict`
entries.zh: 当插件的自述文件没有安装行时，向`claude plugin validate`添加了建议：它会打印要粘贴的行，并且永远不会更改退出代码，即使使用`--strict`

entries.en: Added `upstream_request_id` to the Claude apps gateway's `inference` audit event: the request ID from Amazon Bedrock, the Anthropic API or another upstream, for support cases
entries.zh: 将`upstream_request_id`添加到 Claude 应用程序网关的`inference`审核事件：来自 Amazon Bedrock、Anthropic API 或其他上游的请求 ID，用于支持案例

entries.en: Added `$.ui.notify` for mods: raises a native notification through your own notification setting and says which channel sent it
entries.zh: 为 mods 添加了 `$.ui.notify`：通过您自己的通知设置引发本机通知并说明哪个渠道发送了它

entries.en: Added children to a mod's `Button`: strings and `Text`, so a row of a list is one pressable with a chip or a dim detail inside
entries.zh: 将子项添加到 mod 的“按钮”：字符串和“文本”，因此列表的一行是可按下的，其中包含芯片或暗淡的细节

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` to limit how long unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) waits out 429 and 529 errors
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS`以限制无人值守重试模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`）等待 429 和 529 错误的时间

entries.en: Added a `request-id` header to the Claude apps gateway's successful inference responses, so `request_id` in Claude Code telemetry matches the gateway's audit log
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用网关的成功推理响应中添加了`request-id`标头，因此 Claude 代码遥测中的`request_id`与网关的审核日志相匹配

entries.en: Fixed every request failing on a `[1m]` model when a gateway, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry refuses the context-1m beta; Claude Code now resends without it
entries.zh: 修复了当网关、Bedrock、Vertex 或 Foundry 拒绝 context-1m beta 时`[1m]`模型上每个请求失败的问题；克劳德代码现在在没有它的情况下重新发送

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` text output dropping earlier responses when background work started another turn; each turn's response now prints when the turn ends
entries.zh: 修复了当后台工作开始另一轮时`claude -p`文本输出会丢弃较早响应的问题；现在，当回合结束时，会打印每个回合的响应

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP servers in headless and SDK sessions staying disconnected after an outage longer than 15 seconds, or reconnecting in a tight loop to a server that drops each connection right after it connects; repeated drops now back off, up to 30s
entries.zh: 修复了无头和 SDK 会话中的远程 MCP 服务器在中断超过 15 秒后保持断开连接的问题，或者在紧密循环中重新连接到连接后立即断开每个连接的服务器的问题；重复下降现在会减少，最多 30 秒

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP connections being dropped when a server's error reply happened to contain a network error name
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器的错误回复恰好包含网络错误名称时远程 MCP 连接被丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers that repeat a pagination cursor being asked for the same page up to 20 times at every connect
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 服务器在每次连接时重复请求同一页面最多 20 次的分页光标

entries.en: Fixed CSS, JavaScript and XML files returned by MCP tools being saved as .bin, which the Read tool refuses; font and icon files now get their own extension too
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 工具返回的 CSS、JavaScript 和 XML 文件被保存为 .bin 的问题，而读取工具拒绝这样做；字体和图标文件现在也有自己的扩展名

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool calls failing when the model passes `command_description` instead of `description`
entries.zh: 修复了当模型传递`command_description`而不是`description`时 Bash 工具调用失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome not applying a site deny rule written with port 80 (`host:80`) to plain `http://` pages on that host
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome 中的 Claude 未将使用端口 80（`host:80`）编写的站点拒绝规则应用于该主机上的普通`http://`页面的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin`'s Errors tab removing a marketplace that failed to load, and uninstalling its plugins, on Enter without asking first
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`的“错误”选项卡，删除了无法加载的市场，并在不先询问的情况下按 Enter 键卸载其插件

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add` reporting success for a marketplace whose name no plugin can be installed under; such an add is now refused
entries.zh: 修复了“claudepluginmarketplaceadd”报告无法在其名称下安装插件的市场成功的问题；现在这样的添加被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` moving a subagent to the background while an edit or shell command waited behind it, which started that call before the subagent finished
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS`将子代理移动到后台，而编辑或 shell 命令在其后面等待，这会在子代理完成之前启动该调用

entries.en: Fixed PushNotification saying a push was not sent in `claude remote-control` sessions right after a phone message, without the `/config` toggle, or when started from inside Claude Code
entries.zh: 修复了 PushNotification，显示在电话消息后、没有`/config`切换或从 Claude 代码内部启动时未在“claude 远程控制”会话中发送推送

entries.en: Fixed files sent from remote sessions being refused as "could not be vouched for" when more than 256 were sent at once
entries.zh: 修复了当一次发送超过 256 个文件时，从远程会话发送的文件被拒绝为“无法担保”的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare failure to load managed settings at startup right after a login refresh
entries.zh: 修复了登录刷新后启动时加载托管设置的罕见故障

entries.en: Fixed `/tui` exiting without a message, or with a raw system error, when Claude Code could not be started again
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 无法再次启动时`/tui`退出时没有消息或出现原始系统错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed a link address shown as text being hidden by a colour or conceal style a reply left on, including where it wraps in a table or a question preview
entries.zh: 修复了显示为文本被颜色或隐藏样式隐藏的回复留下的链接地址，包括它在表格或问题预览中的换行位置

entries.en: Fixed Fable models listed in `availableModels` not appearing in the `/model` picker for sessions signed in to a Claude apps gateway; such a model now shows its built-in row in place of a `modelPicker` row added for the same model
entries.zh: 修复了登录到 Claude 应用程序网关的会话的`availableModels`中列出的 Fable 模型未出现在`/model`选择器中的问题；这样的模型现在显示其内置行，而不是为同一模型添加的`modelPicker`行

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway's admin spend view showing a developer's old groups and group cap after their session stopped carrying groups
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 应用网关的管理员消费视图，在开发者会话不再携带分组后仍显示其旧分组和分组上限的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` hiding the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line. The spend limit request goes to the gateway the session is signed in to
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`在`/usage`和状态行中隐藏克劳德应用程序网关支出限制的问题。支出限制请求发送至会话登录的网关

entries.en: Fixed subagents in their own linked worktree being shown the parent session's git branch, status and recent commits
entries.zh: 修复了子代理在其自己链接的工作树中显示父会话的 git 分支、状态和最近提交的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude stopping at the end of the current tool when text typed in the prompt cancelled backgrounding with `←`; Claude now keeps working in the foreground
entries.zh: 修复了当在提示中输入文本时用`←`取消背景时克劳德停止在当前工具末尾的问题；克劳德现在继续在前台工作

entries.en: Fixed `--tools` and `--restricted` not applying to built-in tools that register after launch, and deprecated tool names reaching tools outside the caller's tool set
entries.zh: 修复了`--tools`和`--restricted`不适用于启动后注册的内置工具，以及已弃用的工具名称到达调用者工具集之外的工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed an interrupt not ending the turn until a timeout while Claude waited for an MCP server's resource list
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德等待 MCP 服务器的资源列表时，直到超时才结束回合的中断

entries.en: Fixed a mod's hook being handed a deeply nested tool input cut short with no error, so a guard could pass content it never saw
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的钩子被交给深度嵌套的工具输入而没有错误地缩短的问题，因此守卫可以传递它从未见过的内容

entries.en: Fixed Esc not stopping a self-paced `/loop` that was moved to the background with `←`; cancelling a pending wakeup now shows a notice
entries.zh: 修复了 Esc 无法停止使用`←`移至后台的自定进度`/loop`；取消挂起的唤醒现在会显示通知

entries.en: Fixed commands and hooks in background sessions inheriting `FORCE_COLOR=3`, which put color escape codes into the output Claude reads
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话中继承`FORCE_COLOR=3`的命令和挂钩，这些命令和挂钩将颜色转义代码放入 Claude 读取的输出中

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` starting a new background service as it exited when both were stopped with a session open (for example at a reboot), which could delay shutdown and restart an interrupted session
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”在会话打开时停止（例如重新启动时）退出时启动新后台服务的问题，这可能会延迟关闭并重新启动中断的会话

entries.en: Fixed a custom agent named `worker` being shown as "Agent" in auto-mode denial notices and in the activity lists of task detail views
entries.zh: 修复了名为`worker`的自定义代理在自动模式拒绝通知和任务详细信息视图的活动列表中显示为“代理”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks for for-loops over glob patterns, improving permission-check accuracy
entries.zh: 修复了针对 glob 模式上的 for 循环的 Bash 权限检查，提高了权限检查的准确性

entries.en: Fixed forked skills invoked from Workflow subagents delivering their results to the main conversation instead of the invoking agent
entries.zh: 修复了从工作流子代理调用的分叉技能，将其结果传递给主对话而不是调用代理

entries.en: Fixed in-process agent teammates failing their first SendMessage call until they loaded the tool through tool search
entries.zh: 修复了进程内代理队友在通过工具搜索加载工具之前第一次 SendMessage 调用失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude being told on resume that an unfinished background workflow may have been stopped by `TaskStop`, which can never be the cause
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在简历中被告知未完成的后台工作流程可能已被`TaskStop`停止的问题，但这永远不可能是原因

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told when you stop a long-running MCP tool call from the tasks panel or a connected client
entries.zh: 修复了当您从任务面板或连接的客户端停止长时间运行的 MCP 工具调用时，克劳德没有被告知的问题

entries.en: Fixed a background session's `/loop` stopping without notice when its next wakeup came due while the session's process was down; the session now says so and Claude is told
entries.zh: 修复了当会话进程关闭时，后台会话的`/loop`在下一次唤醒到期时停止而没有通知的问题；会议现在是这么说的，克劳德被告知

entries.en: Fixed raw terminal hyperlink bytes in a reply or a teammate's message being drawn as a clickable link with a hidden address
entries.zh: 修复了回复或队友消息中的原始终端超链接字节被绘制为带有隐藏地址的可点击链接

entries.en: Fixed plugin marketplaces whose repository has large git submodules failing to add or refresh: only the submodules that hold plugin files are now fetched
entries.zh: 修复了存储库具有大型 git 子模块的插件市场无法添加或刷新的问题：现在仅获取包含插件文件的子模块

entries.en: Fixed the `/advisor` dialog showing a checkmark on a saved advisor model that is no longer available; it now opens on "No advisor"
entries.zh: 修复 `/advisor` 对话框在已保存的顾问模型不再可用时仍显示勾选标记的问题；现在会默认显示"No advisor"

entries.en: Fixed the notification for an MCP tool call that moved to the background showing a shortened task id
entries.zh: 修复后台 MCP 工具调用的通知显示了缩短的任务 ID 的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode's `~` moving the cursor past the last character of a line, so `x` after it did nothing, and `3~` running on into the next line
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下 `~` 使光标越过行尾字符，导致其后的 `x` 无效，以及 `3~` 会延续到下一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed the cursor landing one character too far after pasting accented text copied from macOS (such as a file name) into the middle of the prompt
entries.zh: 修复从 macOS 复制带重音字符的文字（如文件名）粘贴到提示词中间后，光标多右移一个字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed the terminal freezing, with ctrl+c ignored, when a response ran to tens of thousands of lines
entries.zh: 修复回复长达数万行时，终端冻结且 ctrl+c 失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed calls a mod makes while it reloads during a plugin hooks worker restart getting past another mod's guard hook that has a `.catch`; such calls are now refused
entries.zh: 修复了在插件钩子工作进程重新启动期间模组重新加载时进行的调用，超过了另一个具有`.catch`的模组的防护钩子；此类电话现已被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed plugins whose hooks module nests code thousands of levels deep failing to load or validate with a bare stack-overflow message
entries.zh: 修复了钩子模块将代码嵌套数千层深的插件无法使用裸堆栈溢出消息加载或验证的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin test` passing a `session.append` hook that removes tool call, tool result or thinking blocks that a real session keeps
entries.zh: 修复了通过`session.append`钩子的“claude插件测试”，该钩子删除了真实会话保留的工具调用、工具结果或思考块

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told it can resume background subagents with SendMessage after a session was killed and resumed a second time
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 在会话被终止并第二次恢复后没有被告知可以使用 SendMessage 恢复后台子代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed a file being treated as already read after a Bash command such as `cat` ran without printing it
entries.zh: 修复了在运行`cat`等 Bash 命令后，文件被视为已读取但未打印的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin options named `constructor` or `prototype` always reading as their default and never reloading the plugin when edited
entries.zh: 修复了名为“构造函数”或“原型”的插件选项始终读取为默认值并且在编辑时从不重新加载插件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's hot reload missing a save made while `/reload-plugins` or session start was reading the mod's files
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的热重载缺少在 `/reload-plugins` 或会话启动正在读取 mod 文件时进行的保存的问题

entries.en: Fixed the mod hot-reloading question being asked again every turn for the whole session when it is approved without picking an answer
entries.zh: 修复 mod 热重载询问在批准时未选择答案，导致整个会话的每一回合都重复询问的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model`, `/fast` and `/output-style` saving their setting without asking a plugin's `config.set` hook
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`、`/fast`和`/output-style`在不询问插件的`config.set`挂钩的情况下保存其设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed bold text being drawn faint in piped output when it directly follows dim text
entries.zh: 修复了当粗体文本直接跟随暗淡文本时，在管道输出中被绘制模糊的问题

entries.en: Fixed replies whose quotes nest deeper every few lines freezing the terminal for seconds and using gigabytes of memory
entries.zh: 修复了引号每隔几行嵌套更深的回复，冻结终端几秒钟并使用千兆字节的内存

entries.en: Fixed a mod's hot reload missing a save made within a few milliseconds of its last reload, which left the mod on its old version until the next save
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的热重载丢失了上次重新加载后几毫秒内进行的保存，这导致 mod 保留旧版本，直到下一次保存

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp serve` background Bash results not naming the output file, and its tool description promising a notification that never arrives
entries.zh: 修复了“claude mcpserve”后台 Bash 结果未命名输出文件，及其工具描述承诺永远不会到达的通知

entries.en: Fixed an async SessionStart hook's unchanged context being added to the conversation again on every resume
entries.zh: 修复了异步 SessionStart 挂钩的未更改上下文在每次恢复时再次添加到对话中的问题

entries.en: Fixed variables a SessionStart hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool after an in-app `/resume` or `/branch`
entries.zh: 修复 SessionStart 钩子写入 `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` 的变量，在应用内 `/resume` 或 `/branch` 之后无法传给 Bash 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed a skill's `allowed-tools` and `effort` being dropped when the Skill tool finished before the response stream ended, which denied the skill's Bash commands in `-p` runs
entries.zh: 修复了当技能工具在响应流结束之前完成时技能的`allowed-tools`和`effort`被删除，这拒绝了`-p`运行中技能的 Bash 命令

entries.en: Fixed a tampered cache of server-managed settings making a person's own plugin count as organization-managed on machines whose managed settings list or enable plugins
entries.zh: 修复了服务器管理设置的被篡改缓存，使个人自己的插件在其托管设置列出或启用插件的计算机上被视为组织管理

entries.en: Fixed Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3.x Sonnet sessions being offered tool search, which those models reject, where feature flags are unavailable
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 3 Opus 和 Claude 3.x Sonnet 会话提供的工具搜索，这些模型拒绝这些工具搜索，其中功能标志不可用

entries.en: Fixed generated type files being written into a `--plugin-dir` plugin's folder in `-p` and SDK sessions; they are now written only where a mod is being developed
entries.zh: 修复了生成的类型文件被写入`-p`和 SDK 会话中`--plugin-dir`插件文件夹的问题；它们现在只在正在开发 mod 的地方编写

entries.en: Fixed text with tabs or bidirectional control characters losing its end at the edge of the screen or drawing over nearby rows
entries.zh: 修复文本中含 Tab 或双向控制字符时，文本末尾在屏幕边缘丢失或覆盖附近行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` saying a Max effort pick was saved as your default for new sessions; Max applies to the current session only
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`表示“最大努力”选择已保存为新会话的默认值的问题； Max仅适用于当前会话

entries.en: Fixed an async hook's JSON output being ignored when it is printed over several lines
entries.zh: 修复了异步挂钩的 JSON 输出在打印多行时被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Read tool rejecting calls with an empty `pages` parameter instead of treating it as omitted
entries.zh: 修复 Read 工具对空的 `pages` 参数直接拒绝调用，而不是当作未提供处理的问题

entries.en: Fixed project-scope plugins not loading in VS Code on Windows due to drive-letter casing (anthropics/claude-code#74612)
entries.zh: 修复了由于驱动器盘符大小写导致项目范围插件无法加载到 Windows 上的 VS Code 中的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#74612)

entries.en: Fixed `plugin install` and `uninstall` at project or local scope on Windows missing the install record, or adding a second one, when only the drive letter's case differs
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上项目或本地范围内的“插件安装”和“卸载”缺少安装记录，或在仅驱动器盘符大小写不同时添加第二个记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed a queued message being lost when pulled back into the prompt with `↑` or `Esc` just after `←`: prompt history now keeps it
entries.zh: 修复了在`←`之后使用`↑`或`Esc`拉回提示时丢失的排队消息：提示历史记录现在保留它

entries.en: Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the whole session when an SDK host closed its enable question before anyone answered; the question is now asked up to three times
entries.zh: 修复了当 SDK 主机在任何人回答之前关闭其启用问题时，整个会话中 mod 热重载关闭的问题；该问题现在最多被问三次

entries.en: Fixed a prompt that a mod's `prompt.submit` hook rewrote or dropped still being saved as typed to prompt history and to the transcript's queued-prompt records
entries.zh: 修复 mod 的 `prompt.submit` 钩子改写或丢弃了提示词后，提示词历史和转录文件中的排队提示记录仍保存原始输入的问题

entries.en: Fixed non-interactive sessions telling you about MCP servers that need authentication when your request doesn't use them
entries.zh: 修复了当您的请求不使用 MCP 服务器时，非交互式会话会告诉您需要身份验证的 MCP 服务器

entries.en: Fixed the `claude_code.auth` OpenTelemetry login event not being emitted on Claude apps gateway sign-in. The event is exported when OpenTelemetry is configured on the machine or the session is already signed in to the gateway
entries.zh: 修复在 Claude 应用网关登录时，不会发出 `claude_code.auth` OpenTelemetry 登录事件的问题；现在若本机配置了 OpenTelemetry，或会话已登录网关，该事件就会导出

entries.en: Fixed a plugin that adds very large interfaces getting another plugin unloaded when the plugin hooks worker stalls
entries.zh: 修复了一个插件，该插件添加了非常大的接口，当该插件挂钩工作线程停止时卸载另一个插件

entries.en: Fixed Edit treating a file as fully read when its contents changed without its modification time advancing
entries.zh: 修复了当文件内容发生更改且修改时间未提前时，编辑将文件视为已完全读取的问题

entries.en: Fixed short command output with Windows line endings (CRLF) being drawn on a single line
entries.zh: 修复了在单行上绘制 Windows 行结尾 (CRLF) 的短命令输出

entries.en: Fixed a stopped scheduled task coming back on resume after a rewind, and a scheduled task being lost on resume after Esc or a rewind following a compaction
entries.zh: 修复了停止的计划任务在倒回后恢复时返回，以及计划任务在 Esc 或压缩后倒回后恢复时丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed the terminal freezing for seconds or minutes while syntax highlighting code with very long lines, long runs of blank lines, or unclosed strings and heredocs
entries.zh: 修复对带有超长行、大量连续空行或未闭合字符串和 heredoc 的代码进行语法高亮时，终端冻结数秒甚至数分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed temporary files left under `~/.claude/seed-admin` by an interrupted `/ultrareview` upload never being removed by the retention cleanup
entries.zh: 修复被中断的 `/ultrareview` 上传所遗留的、位于 `~/.claude/seed-admin` 下的临时文件，从未被保留清理任务删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed Desktop and SDK sessions refusing to switch back to auto mode until restart after `disableAutoMode` was removed from settings
entries.zh: 修复了从设置中删除`disableAutoMode`后桌面和 SDK 会话拒绝切换回自动模式直至重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai-synced plugin hooks failing with "Plugin directory does not exist" in long-running sessions after another session synced a plugin update
entries.zh: 修复了在另一个会话同步插件更新后，在长时间运行的会话中 claude.ai 同步插件挂钩失败并显示“插件目录不存在”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the prompt sent after a `/rewind` being lost, and the removed turns coming back, when the session was moved to the background or resumed after being killed
entries.zh: 修复会话被移到后台或在被终止后恢复时，`/rewind` 之后发送的提示词丢失、被撤回的回合又重新出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions hanging when a mod's `session.receive` hook asked for permission before passing a message on
entries.zh: 修复了当模组的`session.receive`钩子在传递消息之前请求许可时云会话挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed macOS background sessions that restart together after an update sometimes running outside the stable app wrapper, so folder-access prompts could reappear
entries.zh: 修复了更新后有时会在稳定应用程序包装器之外运行的 macOS 后台会话，因此文件夹访问提示可能会重新出现

entries.en: Fixed an MCP sign-in or reconnect that finishes late in headless and SDK sessions relisting a server set with `setMcpServers()` as your own
entries.zh: 修复了在无头和 SDK 会话中较晚完成的 MCP 登录或重新连接，重新列出使用`setMcpServers()`作为您自己的服务器集

entries.en: Fixed changing the auto-update channel in `/config` saving before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked
entries.zh: 修复了在询问插件的`config.set`挂钩之前更改`/config`保存中的自动更新通道的问题

entries.en: macOS: Fixed a file count at session start that could reach other apps' data and raise the "access data from other apps" prompt when a session starts in the home folder or above it
entries.zh: macOS：修复了会话在主目录或其上级目录启动时，启动时的文件计数可能访问其他应用的数据并弹出 "access data from other apps" 提示的问题

entries.en: Improved token counts behind a Claude apps gateway on Amazon Bedrock, which `/context` and large file reads use: the gateway now gets them from AWS's CountTokens API instead of a one-token model request. Grant `bedrock:CountTokens` to use it
entries.zh: 改进 Amazon Bedrock 上 Claude 应用网关后的 token 计数（`/context` 和大文件读取会用到）：网关现在通过 AWS 的 CountTokens API 获取，而不是发送一个 token 的模型请求。使用前需授予 `bedrock:CountTokens`

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway to log a warning every 30 seconds while its PostgreSQL database is read-only, saying what fails and how to recover
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关：PostgreSQL 数据库为只读时，每 30 秒记录一次警告，说明哪里失败以及如何恢复

entries.en: Improved the status shown in Remote Control, claude.ai and the desktop app for a session waiting on a permission prompt to name an MCP tool by its server and readable name instead of its `mcp__server__tool` identifier
entries.zh: 改进 Remote Control、claude.ai 和桌面应用中「会话等待权限确认」的状态显示：用「服务器名 + 可读名称」标示 MCP 工具，而不是 `mcp__server__tool` 这样的内部标识

entries.en: Improved background requests behind a Claude apps gateway to use Haiku 4.5 instead of the session's model, falling back to the session's model where the gateway does not serve Haiku 4.5
entries.zh: 改进 Claude apps 网关背后的后台请求：改用 Haiku 4.5 而不是会话所用的模型；网关不提供 Haiku 4.5 时，回退到会话所用的模型

entries.en: Improved how the Claude apps gateway handles models not listed under `models:` in Amazon Bedrock regions outside AWS's US geography. AWS always refused those requests; the gateway now tries the model in your own region, and a refusal names the model to add
entries.zh: 改进 Claude apps 网关处理 Amazon Bedrock 中未在 `models:` 下列出的模型的方式（针对 AWS 美国以外的地区）。以前 AWS 一律拒绝这些请求；现在网关会尝试在你所在地区使用该模型，被拒绝时会注明需要添加的模型

entries.en: Improved headless `rate_limit_event` usage-limit warnings to say whether the account has extra usage turned on
entries.zh: 改进无界面模式下的 `rate_limit_event` 用量上限警告：会说明账号是否开启了额外用量

entries.en: Improved the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: it no longer tells a session with no terminal to run terminal commands, and explains sharing a mod only when asked
entries.zh: 改进内置的 `plugin-authoring` 技能：不再让没有终端的会话去运行终端命令；只有在被问到时，才解释如何分享 mod

entries.en: Improved Grep input handling: a search sent with grep's `-l`, `-c` or `-r` flag now runs instead of failing the call
entries.zh: 改进 Grep 输入处理：搜索时带上 grep 的 `-l`、`-c` 或 `-r` 参数，现在能正常运行，不再调用失败

entries.en: Improved `claude plugin validate` and plugin loading: when a hooks module is refused over a rebound top-level `var`, the error now names the line that rebinds it, the cause, and a fix
entries.zh: 改进 `claude plugin validate` 和插件加载：hooks 模块因重新绑定顶层 `var` 被拒绝时，错误信息会指出重新绑定的那一行、原因和修复方法

entries.en: Improved the Workflow tool's `scriptPath` refusal: it now says to pass the script inline via `script`, the route that works in sessions without a Read tool
entries.zh: 改进 Workflow 工具的 `scriptPath` 拒绝提示：现在会建议通过 `script` 以内联方式传入脚本，这种方式在没有 Read 工具的会话中也能用

entries.en: Improved what Claude is told when a large file it sends fails to upload with no reason given, so it reports the failure instead of shrinking the file
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 发送的大文件无故上传失败时，Claude 收到的信息：它会报告失败，而不是擅自缩小文件

entries.en: Changed MCP tool descriptions the model loads through tool search to be cut at 16,384 characters instead of 2,048
entries.zh: 更改了模型通过工具搜索加载的 MCP 工具描述，将其削减为 16,384 个字符，而不是 2,048 个字符

entries.en: Changed subagents to preload at most 32 skills from the `skills` field, each once; a subagent with the Skill tool can still invoke the rest
entries.zh: 更改子代理以从“技能”字段预加载最多 32 个技能，每个预加载一次；具有技能工具的子代理仍然可以调用其余部分

entries.en: Changed Ctrl+C at the idle prompt of an attached background session to leave a pending `/loop` wakeup alone, so pressing it twice detaches and the loop keeps running; press Esc to stop it
entries.zh: 更改了附加后台会话的空闲提示下的 Ctrl+C，以单独保留挂起的`/loop`唤醒，因此按两次会分离并且循环继续运行；按 Esc 停止它

entries.en: Changed `claude agents` stopped with its background service (macOS, or Linux without the service installed): running sessions now stop in about a minute unless it is run again, and a notice says so
entries.zh: 更改了“claude Agents”随其后台服务停止（macOS 或未安装服务的 Linux）：运行会话现在将在大约一分钟内停止，除非再次运行，并且有通知如此说明

entries.en: Changed claude.ai connectors to negotiate MCP protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on installs that fetch no flags; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
entries.zh: 更改了 claude.ai 连接器，以在未获取任何标志的安装上默认协商 MCP 协议版本 2026-07-28； `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` 选择退出

entries.en: Changed Artifact pages with no background of their own to show on white instead of off-white
entries.zh: 将没有自己背景的工件页面更改为白色而不是灰白色

entries.en: Changed what Claude and you read when a mod denies a tool call after the tool ran: it now says the tool ran and a plugin withheld its result
entries.zh: 更改了当 mod 在工具运行后拒绝工具调用时 Claude 和您所读到的内容：现在显示该工具已运行并且插件保留了其结果

entries.en: Changed tab stops to count from where a text starts instead of from the screen's left edge: an answer indented by 2 has its first stop 8 cells in, where it was 6
entries.zh: 将制表位更改为从文本开始位置开始计数，而不是从屏幕左边缘开始计数：缩进 2 的答案的第一个停止位位于 8 个单元格中，而原来是 6 个单元格

entries.en: Changed the Artifact tool's permission prompts with telemetry disabled to the same five questions other installs get, instead of asking before each read of someone else's artifact and each data edit
entries.zh: 将禁用遥测的 Artifact 工具的权限提示更改为其他安装遇到的相同的五个问题，而不是在每次读取其他人的工件和每次数据编辑之前询问

entries.en: Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs in installs with telemetry disabled to publish new private artifacts, and update your own, without asking, as in other installs
entries.zh: 更改了在禁用遥测的安装中运行的计划和立即运行例程，以发布新的私有工件，并更新您自己的工件，无需询问，就像在其他安装中一样

entries.en: Changed toasts from your organization's mods to show ahead of other mods' toasts instead of waiting behind them
entries.zh: 更改了组织 mod 的 toast，使其显示在其他 mod 的 toast 之前，而不是在它们后面等待

entries.en: Changed the Claude apps gateway to start with a warning and serve a `desktop` policy key its bundled Claude Desktop schema doesn't know, so new Desktop settings need no gateway upgrade
entries.zh: 更改了克劳德应用程序网关，以警告开始并提供其捆绑的克劳德桌面架构不知道的“桌面”策略密钥，因此新的桌面设置不需要网关升级

entries.en: Changed WebSocket (`ws`) MCP servers: a message over 16 MiB is no longer parsed and closes the connection, the limit the other transports already have
entries.zh: 更改了 WebSocket (`ws`) MCP 服务器：不再解析超过 16 MiB 的消息并关闭连接，这是其他传输已有的限制

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a chat row for files Claude sends you: click a file's name to open it in the editor; Claude's caption shows underneath, and the row stays visible in Focus view
entries.zh: [VSCode] 聊天中新增 Claude 发送给你的文件行：点击文件名即可在编辑器中打开；Claude 的说明文字显示在下方，且在 Focus 视图中该行保持可见

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Fork conversation from here" and Rewind's conversation restore failing with "Message not found in session" after a background agent's activity or one of the panel's own status lines
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复后台 agent 活动或面板自身状态行出现后，"Fork conversation from here" 和 Rewind 恢复对话时报 "Message not found in session" 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+Shift+Tab, Cmd+Shift+Tab and Alt+Shift+Tab in the chat input also switching the permission mode, and Ctrl+Tab accepting the suggested prompt
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复聊天输入框中 Ctrl+Shift+Tab、Cmd+Shift+Tab 和 Alt+Shift+Tab 同时会切换权限模式，以及 Ctrl+Tab 会接受推荐提示词的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed keyboard focus bouncing between two Claude views visible at once, which could send typed text to the wrong conversation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复两个 Claude 视图同时可见时键盘焦点来回跳动、可能把输入内容发送到错误对话的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed the runner to stop passing `CCR_AUTO_MODE_ALLOW`, `CCR_AUTO_MODE_ENVIRONMENT` and `CCR_AUTO_MODE_SOFT_DENY` into a session's environment
entries.zh: 运行器不再把 `CCR_AUTO_MODE_ALLOW`、`CCR_AUTO_MODE_ENVIRONMENT` 和 `CCR_AUTO_MODE_SOFT_DENY` 传入会话环境

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches being cut off while the git server was still reporting progress on a large repository; `CLAUDE_RUNNER_FETCH_SERVER_PROGRESS_CAP_MS` tunes or turns off the wait
entries.zh: 修复了大型仓库上 git 服务器仍在报告进度时，git 拉取被提前切断的问题；`CLAUDE_RUNNER_FETCH_SERVER_PROGRESS_CAP_MS` 可调整或关闭该等待

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed a message sent right after unarchiving a cloud session sometimes getting no reply because no container could start for it
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复取消归档云端会话后立即发送的消息，有时因无法为其启动容器而得不到回复的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed some older routines starting their runs without ever giving Claude their saved prompt; those routines now run their prompt again
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复部分较早的例程运行时从未把已保存的提示交给 Claude 的问题；这些例程现在会重新运行其提示

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved how quickly a cloud session catches up after its connection drops: activity you missed now appears all at once instead of row by row
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 改进云端会话连接断开后追赶进度的速度：错过的活动现在一次性显示，而不是逐行出现

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved the setup script box in the cloud environment form: it starts taller, grows with your script, and can be resized by dragging
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 改进云端环境表单中的设置脚本输入框：初始更高，随脚本内容增长，并可拖动调整大小

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the settings confirmation cards Claude posts in a Slack channel to stay open for 30 minutes instead of 10
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude 在 Slack 频道中发出的设置确认卡片，保留时间从 10 分钟改为 30 分钟

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed Claude's notice that a channel shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces uses organization defaults to post only when someone mentions Claude, at most once a month
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude 关于「跨 Enterprise Grid 工作区共享的频道使用组织默认设置」的通知，改为只在有人 @Claude 时发送，且每月最多一次

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed channel links and @-mentions in a forked thread's "Continued from" card showing as raw Slack codes
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复转发话题的「Continued from」卡片中，频道链接和 @ 提及显示为原始 Slack 代码的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack's Working status spinning on under a thread after `@Claude !restart` had already confirmed the restart
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 `@Claude !restart` 已确认重启后，Slack 话题下方的「Working」状态仍持续转圈的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed another app's or bot's @Claude going unanswered in a busy channel where Claude had stopped reading untagged messages
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在繁忙频道中，Claude 已停止读取未 @ 消息时，其他应用或机器人的 @Claude 得不到回应的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a confirmation in Claude Tag admin settings before adding a channel manager moves that member to Custom roles, which can remove their other access
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 在 Claude Tag 管理设置中，添加频道管理员会把该成员移到 Custom roles，可能移除其其他权限；现在操作前会先弹出确认

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review re-reviews saying no issues were found while earlier findings were still open; the comment now says how many remain open
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复较早的问题仍未关闭时，Code Review 的重新审查却说未发现问题的问题；评论现在会说明仍有多少未关闭

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review still skipping a large CLAUDE.md's rules when the pull request edits that file
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复拉取请求修改了大型 CLAUDE.md 文件时，Code Review 仍跳过其中规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed web searches and `agent` hook evaluations taking much longer at `xhigh` and `max` effort
entries.zh: 修复在 `xhigh` 和 `max` 努力级别下，网页搜索和 `agent` 钩子评估耗时明显变长的问题

entries.en: Fixed `prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block
entries.zh: 修复了以指令形式编写的“提示”和“代理”挂钩（例如“阻止...的命令”），允许它们应该阻止的内容

entries.en: Improved how `prompt` hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early
entries.zh: 改进对 Stop 和 SubagentStop 上以指令形式写的 `prompt` hook（如“如果构建失败就继续”）的判断方式，减少 Claude 提前停下来的可能

entries.en: Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K)
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`)，现在是 Anthropic API 上的默认 Haiku 模型 — 1M 上下文，每个 Mtok 0.10 美元/0.50 美元（超过 100K 的提示为 0.50 美元/2.50 美元）

entries.en: Added `agentType` to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart
entries.zh: 将`agentType`添加到`subagentStatusLine`有效负载中，以便脚本可以区分自定义子代理类型

entries.en: Added `isDeferred` to `$.tool.register` for mods: `false` lists the tool's schema in the prompt from the start instead of behind tool search
entries.zh: 为 mods 添加了 `isDeferred` 到 `$.tool.register`：`false` 从一开始就在提示中列出工具的架构，而不是在工具搜索后面

entries.en: Fixed Claude sometimes treating its own last actions before a context compaction as done after it, and retracting or redoing finished work
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德有时将上下文压缩之前的最后一个操作视为在上下文压缩之后完成的操作，并撤回或重做已完成的工作

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where an HTTP MCP connection kept every request it had sent until it closed
entries.zh: 修复了 HTTP MCP 连接保留其发送的每个请求直至关闭的内存泄漏问题

entries.en: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being lost when `←` moved the session to the background; if a queued message can't move, `←` now stays put and says so
entries.zh: 修复了当`←`将会话移至后台时克劳德工作时发送的消息丢失的问题；如果排队的消息无法移动，`←`现在会保持原状并如此表示

entries.en: Fixed `/model` effort ←/→ wrapping past the highest or lowest level, which could accidentally save Low as a model's default effort
entries.zh: 修复了 `/model` 工作量 ←/→ 环绕超过最高或最低级别的问题，这可能会意外地将“低”保存为模型的默认工作量

entries.en: Fixed `/tui` disconnecting Claude in Chrome in a session started with `--chrome`, and ignoring `--no-chrome`
entries.zh: 修复了`/tui`在以`--chrome`启动的会话中断开 Chrome 中 Claude 的连接，并忽略`--no-chrome`的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude being told to continue or message subagents with `SendMessage` in sessions, including resumed ones, where a host, a permission rule or a `--tools` list removed that tool
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德被告知在会话中继续使用`SendMessage`或向子代理发送消息的问题，包括恢复的会话，其中主机、权限规则或`--tools`列表删除了该工具

entries.en: Fixed subagents and `--agent` sessions being told a built-in tool was disabled for the whole session when only their own tool list left it out
entries.zh: 修复了子代理和`--agent`会话被告知内置工具在整个会话中被禁用的问题，而只有他们自己的工具列表将其排除在外

entries.en: Fixed a claude.ai-synced skill's edited description sometimes not reaching the model until a new conversation or `/clear`
entries.zh: 修复了 claude.ai 同步技能的编辑描述有时在新对话或`/clear`之前无法到达模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude logs`, `stop`, `kill`, `rm` and `claude daemon status`, `stop`, `uninstall` sometimes signing you out when your login had expired or was about to
entries.zh: 修复了`claude logs`、`stop`、`kill`、`rm`和`claude daemon status`、`stop`、`uninstall`有时会在您的登录过期或即将登录时注销您的问题

entries.en: Fixed the footer's agents count disappearing after a momentary failure to read the sessions folder (for example, too many open files)
entries.zh: 修复读取会话文件夹短暂失败（例如打开文件过多）后，页脚的智能体数量消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a custom agent named `worker` being shown as "Agent" when it starts, and the agent detail dialog's title losing the agent type once the agent finishes
entries.zh: 修复了名为`worker`的自定义代理在启动时显示为“代理”，以及代理详细信息对话框的标题在代理完成后丢失代理类型的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool's transcript row briefly reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a publish call was still streaming in
entries.zh: 修复了 Artifact 工具的转录行在发布调用仍在流入时短暂读取 `Artifact("(unprintable path)")`

entries.en: Fixed the `/ultrareview` upload on Linux wrongly refusing some repositories, such as one inside another checkout, over a settings file that "could not be parsed" while a sandboxed command was running
entries.zh: 修复 Linux 上 `/ultrareview` 上传时，在沙盒命令运行期间，因某个设置文件"无法解析"而错误拒绝部分仓库（如嵌套在另一个检出目录中的仓库）的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/ultrareview` upload's refusal over split-index files advising a git command that could leave git unable to read its index
entries.zh: 修复 `/ultrareview` 上传因分割索引（split-index）文件而拒绝时，给出的 git 命令可能导致 git 无法读取其索引的问题

entries.en: Fixed replies in very long Remote Control and cloud sessions that could still appear a block at a time instead of streaming in
entries.zh: 修复了很长的远程控制和云会话中的回复仍然可能一次出现一个块而不是流式传输的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control uploading a session's starting history again after every credential recovery
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制在每次凭据恢复后再次上传会话的启动历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed PushNotification reporting "Remote Control inactive" in sessions started with `claude remote-control`
entries.zh: 修复了以`claude remote-control`启动的会话中 PushNotification 报告“远程控制不活动”的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's hooks on `classic.*` events being skipped while the plugin hooks worker restarts, which left settings hooks to answer without them
entries.zh: 修复了插件钩子工作程序重新启动时会跳过`classic.*`事件上的 mod 钩子，这导致设置钩子在没有它们的情况下进行应答

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin test` failing for mods that call `$.session.append`; tests can read the appended rows back with the new `mock.session`
entries.zh: 修复了调用`$.session.append`的 mods 中“claude 插件测试”失败的问题；测试可以使用新的`mock.session`读回附加的行

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin eval` refusing every Bash-granting run on Macs with Docker Desktop (links under `~/.docker/bin`); the refusal now names which part of a credential store held the link
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件 eval” 拒绝使用 Docker Desktop 在 Mac 上运行的每个 Bash 授权的问题（链接位于`~/.docker/bin`下）；现在，拒绝指定凭证存储的哪个部分持有链接

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway refusing to start when a `desktop` policy sets Claude Desktop's built-in browser keys, such as `builtinBrowserEnabled`
entries.zh: 修复当 `desktop` 策略设置了 Claude Desktop 内置浏览器的配置项（如 `builtinBrowserEnabled`）时，Claude 应用网关拒绝启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` offering bypass permissions that background sessions then ignored when consent was saved only in `.claude/settings.local.json` or a `--settings` file; it now asks for consent first, and a session that ignores bypass shows a short notice that stays
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”提供绕过权限，当同意仅保存在`.claude/settings.local.json`或`--settings`文件中时，后台会话会忽略这些权限；现在它首先请求同意，并且忽略旁路的会话会显示一条简短的通知

entries.en: Fixed `←` backgrounding a session after 10 seconds while the prompt held unsent text (it now cancels the move) or a question was waiting for your answer
entries.zh: 修复了`←`在 10 秒后提示保留未发送文本（现在取消移动）或问题正在等待您回答时将会话置于后台的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc, or No without feedback, on a permission prompt not stopping the turn when `←` had just been pressed to move the session to the background
entries.zh: 修复了当刚刚按下`←`将会话移动到后台时，权限提示中的 Esc 或没有反馈的“否”不会停止转动的问题

entries.en: Fixed the agents view briefly replacing the session list with placeholder rows when the sessions folder could not be read (for example, too many open files)
entries.zh: 修复无法读取会话文件夹时（例如打开文件过多），智能体视图短暂用占位行替换会话列表的问题

entries.en: Fixed path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Claude views a file with a single-file cat, head, tail, sed -n or grep command in the Bash tool instead of the Read tool
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 在 Bash 工具而不是 Read 工具中使用单文件 cat、head、tail、sed -n 或 grep 命令查看文件时，路径范围规则和嵌套 CLAUDE.md 文件不会加载

entries.en: Fixed pasted text that begins and ends with the same words sometimes being sent to Claude as if it had been typed
entries.zh: 修复了以相同单词开头和结尾的粘贴文本有时会被发送给克劳德的问题，就好像它已被键入一样

entries.en: Fixed a skill name in pasted text being treated as typed when an accent typed or pasted right after the paste merged into its last letter
entries.zh: 修复了在粘贴合并到最后一个字母后立即键入或粘贴重音时，粘贴文本中的技能名称被视为键入的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/feedback` returning to the drafts list after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z while a report was sending, leaving the send impossible to cancel
entries.zh: 修复了发送报告时按 Ctrl+O 或 Ctrl+Z 后`/feedback`返回草稿列表，导致发送无法取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude purge` stopping silently (exit 0, or a hang in a terminal) when a file or folder could not be deleted; it now deletes the rest, lists what it could not delete, and exits 1
entries.zh: 修复了当无法删除文件或文件夹时`claude purge`静默停止（退出 0，或在终端中挂起）的问题；现在它会删除其余内容，列出无法删除的内容，然后退出 1

entries.en: Fixed keybindings.json checks: a lone " " (space key) is no longer reported as an error, and keys like "ctrl+ k" now get a warning
entries.zh: 修复了 keybindings.json 检查：单独的“”（空格键）不再报告为错误，并且像“ctrl+ k”这样的键现在会收到警告

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `>>` and `<<` on a line of only spaces leaving the cursor past the end of the line, where a following `x` deleted nothing
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，对只含空格的行执行 `>>` 和 `<<` 后光标越过行尾，导致后续 `x` 删除不了任何内容的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode: after deleting whole lines in Visual mode (`V` then `d`) the cursor lands on the first non-blank, and `.` after it acts on the cursor's line
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，在可视模式（`V` 然后 `d`）中删除整行后，光标落在第一个非空白字符上；之后的 `.` 会作用于光标所在行

entries.en: Windows: Fixed stopping a status line, hook, or shell command sometimes terminating an unrelated process that had been given the same process ID
entries.zh: Windows：修复了停止状态栏、钩子或 shell 命令时，有时会误终止另一个进程ID相同的无关进程的问题

entries.en: Reverted the auto mode denial message change from 2.1.281 that told Claude a denial covers the outcome, not only the exact command
entries.zh: 撤销了 2.1.281 中关于自动模式拒绝消息的变更：该变更曾告诉 Claude 拒绝会涵盖结果，而不只是那一条精确命令

entries.en: Reverted the 2.1.290 fix for cloud sessions staying asleep after a container restart lost a pending `/loop` wakeup or scheduled task; Claude is no longer told, and the session stays asleep
entries.zh: 撤销了 2.1.290 中的一项修复：云端会话在容器重启后，如果丢失了待执行的 `/loop` 唤醒或定时任务，会保持休眠；Claude 不再被告知此事，会话保持休眠

entries.en: Improved startup for Team and Enterprise organizations: policy and managed settings are fetched earlier, and a stalled request is retried after 3 seconds
entries.zh: 改进 Team 和 Enterprise 组织的启动：策略和托管设置更早获取，请求卡住时 3 秒后重试

entries.en: Improved Claude in Chrome: fewer page actions are refused when the browser is slow to report its tabs
entries.zh: 改进 Claude in Chrome：浏览器汇报标签页较慢时，被拒绝的页面操作更少了

entries.en: Improved the Claude in Chrome message in cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: if you belong to more than one organization, it now says the extension must be signed in to the same one, and how to change that
entries.zh: 改进云端会话中无法连接浏览器时的提示：如果你同时属于多个组织，会说明扩展必须登录到同一个组织，并告诉你如何切换

entries.en: Improved the Bash edit diff note to say the listed files changed while the command ran, which can include writes by other processes
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 编辑差异提示：会说明列出的文件在命令运行期间发生了变化，这可能包括其他进程的写入

entries.en: Improved artifacts: Claude pins libraries to exact versions two weeks old or older
entries.zh: 改进 artifact：Claude 会把库固定到两周或更早的确切版本

entries.en: Changed claude.ai skill syncing to check for changes about every 40 minutes, instead of every 10, while no session is in use
entries.zh: 更改了 claude.ai 技能同步，在没有使用会话时每 40 分钟检查一次更改，而不是每 10 分钟检查一次

entries.en: Changed the order of agent lists and of MCP servers announced to the model: names with non-ASCII characters now sort after ASCII names
entries.zh: 更改了向模型宣布的代理列表和 MCP 服务器的顺序：包含非 ASCII 字符的名称现在在 ASCII 名称之后排序

entries.en: Changed OpenTelemetry `claude_code.at_mention` logging to emit at most 100 agent and 100 MCP-resource events each time a prompt is read
entries.zh: 更改了 OpenTelemetry `claude_code.at_mention` 日志记录，以便每次读取提示时最多发出 100 个代理和 100 个 MCP 资源事件

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator to sleep 4 to 6 seconds between polls instead of a constant 5, so several replicas for one environment stop polling at the same moment
entries.zh: 编排器轮询间隔改为 4 到 6 秒随机，而不是固定 5 秒，同一环境的多个副本不会在同一时刻轮询

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack saying a workspace isn't set up in Enterprise Grid channels shared across workspaces when Slack labels a message with a workspace that isn't connected
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 为消息标注了未连接的工作区时，Claude in Slack 在跨工作区共享的 Enterprise Grid 频道中说该工作区未设置的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack stopping mid-task in a channel when an admin changed the channel's connectors, plugins, skills or rules; the change now applies once Claude finishes
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复管理员在任务进行中更改频道的连接器、插件、技能或规则时，Claude in Slack 在频道中途停止的问题；现在更改会在 Claude 完成后生效

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed asking Claude in Slack to run a thread's routine now with extra notes starting a separate run that couldn't post back; the run now continues in that thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在 Slack 中要求 Claude 立即运行某话题的例程并附加额外说明时，会启动一次无法回帖的独立运行的问题；现在运行会在该话题中继续

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed an access bundle's Add a connector dialog in Claude Tag admin settings showing every Google connector as connected after one Google sign-in
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 管理设置中，访问包的「Add a connector」对话框在一次 Google 登录后，把所有 Google 连接器都显示为已连接的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag admin settings to list an Enterprise Grid that isn't connected yet, with a Connect button
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude Tag 管理设置，可列出尚未连接的 Enterprise Grid，并提供 Connect 按钮

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed Claude in Slack to join announcement channels, where only admins can post, without posting its intro
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude in Slack 现在可以加入公告频道（只有管理员能发言的频道），且不会发送自我介绍

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the limit on channel rules in Claude Tag admin settings from 20 to 50 for each workspace and for the organization-wide Slack page
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 管理设置中频道规则的数量上限，从每个工作区和组织范围的 Slack 页面各 20 条改为 50 条

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved Code Review's Add a repository dialog to list each repository that couldn't be added and why, such as missing GitHub write access
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进 Code Review 的「Add a repository」对话框：会列出每个无法添加的仓库及原因（如缺少 GitHub 写入权限）

entries.en: Added `--marketplace <source>` to `claude plugin install`: adds the marketplace if needed, under the same policy checks as `claude plugin marketplace add`, then installs the plugin from it
entries.zh: 在“claude插件安装”中添加了`--marketplace <source>`：如果需要，在与“claude插件市场添加”相同的策略检查下添加市场，然后从中安装插件

entries.en: Added an `effort` parameter to the Agent tool, so Claude runs a sub-agent at the effort level you ask for
entries.zh: 在代理工具中添加了`effort`参数，因此 Claude 按照您要求的工作量运行子代理

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer base delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS`环境变量，以便在重试过载 (529) 请求时为退避设置更长的基本延迟

entries.en: Added `prompt.autocomplete`, an event a mod hooks to add its own rows to the prompt box's autocomplete list
entries.zh: 添加了`prompt.autocomplete`，这是 mod 挂钩的一个事件，用于将自己的行添加到提示框的自动完成列表中

entries.en: Added prompt caching to `$.model.complete` for mods: `prompt` and `system` take blocks of text, and `cache: true` on a block caches the request up to it
entries.zh: 为模组的`$.model.complete`添加了提示缓存：`prompt`和`system`采用文本块，块上的`cache: true`将请求缓存到该块

entries.en: Added workflow agents to the `agent.spawn` mod hook, with their run and index, so a mod can refuse them
entries.zh: 将工作流代理添加到`agent.spawn` mod hook，及其运行和索引，以便 mod 可以拒绝它们

entries.en: Fixed subagent definitions with `permissionMode: auto` entering auto mode when auto mode is unavailable (disabled by settings, circuit breaker, or a model that doesn't support it)
entries.zh: 修复了当自动模式不可用时`permissionMode: auto`进入自动模式的子代理定义（被设置、断路器或不支持它的模型禁用）

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed commands being able to read the staged file copies of `/ultrareview` uploads under `~/.claude/seed-admin`
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒命令能够读取`~/.claude/seed-admin`下上传的`/ultrareview`的暂存文件副本的问题

entries.en: Fixed a managed sandbox read-deny path (and user ones beside it) that appears or re-points mid-session not dropping project grants inside it or ending credential injection from files it covers
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中出现或重新指向的托管沙箱读取拒绝路径（及其旁边的用户路径），该路径不会将项目授权放入其中或结束从其覆盖的文件中的凭据注入

entries.en: Fixed a notebook or PDF read on macOS and Windows being able to return a file outside what was approved, through a link swapped in mid-read
entries.zh: 修复了在 macOS 和 Windows 上读取的笔记本或 PDF 能够通过在读取过程中交换的链接返回超出批准范围的文件

entries.en: Fixed a tampered on-disk cache of server-managed settings being able to switch off or unseat the built-in policy plugin while the settings fetch failed
entries.zh: 修复了服务器管理设置的磁盘缓存被篡改的问题，在设置获取失败时能够关闭或取消内置策略插件

entries.en: Fixed `rm -rf` on the 8.3 short name or another alternate Windows spelling of the home folder or a drive not being treated as removing it
entries.zh: 修复了 8.3 短名称上的`rm -rf`或主文件夹的其他替代 Windows 拼写或驱动器不被视为删除它

entries.en: Security: Fixed PreToolUse hook approvals and auto mode bypassing the permission prompt for file reads from network (UNC) paths
entries.zh: 安全：修复 PreToolUse 钩子的批准和自动模式绕过权限提示、读取网络（UNC）路径文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a skill's or slash command's `allowed-tools` rule coming back in a later turn when you leave auto mode or plan mode partway through that turn
entries.zh: 修复了当您在该回合中途离开自动模式或计划模式时，技能或斜杠命令的“允许工具”规则会在稍后的回合中返回

entries.en: Fixed `NO_PROXY` being ignored for Claude Code's own API requests (sign-in, policy, feedback, artifacts) when `HTTPS_PROXY` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`HTTPS_PROXY`时 Claude Code 自己的 API 请求（登录、策略、反馈、工件）忽略`NO_PROXY`的问题

entries.en: Fixed an MCP tool with a name longer than 128 characters making every request fail; that tool is now left out and an MCP error names it
entries.zh: 修复了名称超过 128 个字符的 MCP 工具导致每次请求失败的问题；该工具现在已被排除，并且 MCP 错误将其命名

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin` commands such as `marketplace add` and `install` running before an organization's managed settings had loaded on a first run
entries.zh: 修复了在首次运行时加载组织的托管设置之前运行的`claude plugin`命令，例如`marketplace add`和`install`

entries.en: Fixed one-shot `claude -p` and Agent SDK runs stopping a background command 5 seconds after the final result, and one-shot `claude -p` runs dropping a scheduled wakeup; both are now waited for
entries.zh: 修复了一次性`claude -p`和 Agent SDK 在最终结果后 5 秒运行停止后台命令，以及一次性`claude -p`运行丢弃计划唤醒的问题；两者现在都在等待

entries.en: Fixed plan mode not being restored when resuming a session from the `claude --resume` session picker or with `/resume`
entries.zh: 修复了从`claude --resume`会话选择器或使用`/resume`恢复会话时计划模式未恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed saved scheduled tasks created after `/resume`, `/branch` or `/clear` never firing, and saved tasks ignoring later creates and deletes after two writes to the tasks file milliseconds apart
entries.zh: 修复了在`/resume`、`/branch`或`/clear`之后创建的保存的计划任务永远不会触发，以及保存的任务在两次写入任务文件后忽略稍后创建和删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed a background session's `/loop` silently stopping when the session's process restarted (for example after a crash), because its pending wakeup was lost
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话的`/loop`在会话进程重新启动时（例如崩溃后）静默停止，因为其挂起的唤醒丢失了

entries.en: Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the file or folder they were given could not be read; Claude now retries once or tells you
entries.zh: 修复了当无法读取给定的文件或文件夹时 Grep 和 Glob 报告不匹配的问题；克劳德现在重试一次或者告诉你

entries.en: Fixed the Read tool returning only the first entry, with no error, when a PDF's `pages` was a list such as "6,9,15"; it now returns an error saying to read each page or range separately
entries.zh: 修复 PDF 的 `pages` 为 "6,9,15" 这类列表时，Read 工具只返回第一项且不报错的问题；现在会提示分别读取每一页或每个范围

entries.en: Fixed @-mentioned text files over 256KB being left out silently: Claude is now told the file's size and to read it in portions
entries.zh: 修复了@提到的超过 256KB 的文本文件被默默忽略的问题：克劳德现在被告知文件的大小并分部分读取它

entries.en: Fixed the usage limit alert repeating once per background agent when agents failed on a limit that had already stopped the main conversation
entries.zh: 修复智能体因已停止主对话的同一用量上限而失败时，用量上限提醒会按后台智能体逐个重复出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control viewers seeing an empty subagent pane for background subagents in sessions hosted by the desktop app or an IDE
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制查看器在桌面应用程序或 IDE 托管的会话中看到后台子代理的空子代理窗格的问题

entries.en: Fixed cross-session delivery notices showing two sessions with similar names as one recipient, and the expiry notice blaming the desktop app when a terminal session let the message lapse
entries.zh: 修复了跨会话传送通知，显示两个会话与一个收件人具有相似的名称，并且当终端会话让消息失效时，到期通知会指责桌面应用程序

entries.en: Fixed Send now in the desktop app ending the subagent a turn was waiting on when another message was already queued
entries.zh: 修复了当另一条消息已排队时，在桌面应用程序中立即发送以结束子代理轮次等待的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/bug`, `/share` and `/feedback <text>` starting over after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z while a report was being sent, and closing as cancelled after it had been sent
entries.zh: 修复了`/bug`、`/share`和`/feedback <text>`在发送报告时按 Ctrl+O 或 Ctrl+Z 后重新开始，并在发送后关闭为已取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-env` replacing your saved default environment when you pressed Enter right away: the list now opens on your default, and no row has a check mark when no default is in effect
entries.zh: 修复了当您立即按下 Enter 时`/remote-env`替换您保存的默认环境的问题：列表现在以您的默认值打开，并且当没有默认值生效时，没有行有复选标记

entries.en: Fixed some pasted text reaching Claude as typed text when several pastes overlapped in one prompt
entries.zh: 修复了当多个粘贴在一个提示中重叠时，一些粘贴的文本作为键入的文本到达克劳德的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a line, j/k losing their column on shorter lines, and `f`/`t`/`F`/`T`/`;`/`,` jumping to, or deleting up to, a match on another line of the prompt
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下光标越过行尾、j/k 在较短行上丢失列位置，以及 `f`/`t`/`F`/`T`/`;`/`,` 跳转到或删除到提示框其他行中匹配项的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/add-dir` path box letting Shift+Enter or a paste add a line break, and treating fast-typed "tab", "up" or "down" as those keys
entries.zh: 修复了`/add-dir`路径框，让 Shift+Enter 或粘贴添加换行符，并将快速键入的“tab”、“up”或“down”视为这些键

entries.en: Fixed fast typing, input-method text and decomposed accents being dropped while a prompt footer row was selected, and `!` leaving the row selected
entries.zh: 修复了选择提示页脚行时删除快速打字、输入法文本和分解重音以及`!`使该行保持选中状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode sending a full-screen clear on every window resize and Ctrl+L when iTerm2 is detected, which may be what filled iTerm2's scrollback with stale pages
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式在检测到 iTerm2 时在每个窗口大小调整和 Ctrl+L 上发送全屏清除，这可能是 iTerm2 的回滚中充满陈旧页面的原因

entries.en: Fixed a spurious "could not be examined" note for @-words that name no file when a Read deny rule is set and the working directory is under a symlink
entries.zh: 修复了 @-words 的虚假“无法检查”注释，当设置读取拒绝规则并且工作目录位于符号链接下时，该注释不会命名任何文件

entries.en: Fixed "instruction file not loaded" lines going stale or missing after `/cd` or a permission change, and added a transcript line when a nested one isn't loaded
entries.zh: 修复了`/cd`或权限更改后“指令文件未加载”行过时或丢失的问题，并在未加载嵌套行时添加了转录行

entries.en: Fixed a compaction summary that repeated `/name` letting Claude invoke a skill that is reserved for the user
entries.zh: 修复了重复`/name`的压缩摘要，让克劳德调用为用户保留的技能

entries.en: Fixed Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and LSP rows, and single Read, Grep and Glob rows, hiding why a mod denied the call: the row now shows the reason
entries.zh: 修复了 Write、Edit、NotebookEdit 和 LSP 行以及单个 Read、Grep 和 Glob 行，隐藏了 mod 拒绝调用的原因：该行现在显示原因

entries.en: Fixed a cloud session showing a turn that never ended when its worker was stopped just as the turn finished
entries.zh: 修复了一个云会话，显示当其工作人员在回合结束时停止时，回合从未结束

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions with a large transcript sometimes asking for a permission again after it was approved
entries.zh: 修复了具有大记录的云会话有时在获得批准后再次请求许可的问题

entries.en: Fixed scheduled tasks and other queued notifications being lost in cloud sessions when a message was retried or edited while Claude was reading them
entries.zh: 修复了当克劳德阅读消息时重试或编辑消息时，计划任务和其他排队通知在云会话中丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions forgetting the thinking setting chosen in the client when the session's container restarted
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在会话容器重新启动时忘记在客户端中选择的思考设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cowork cloud sessions saying a proxy blocked artifacts when Anthropic couldn't confirm the organization's settings
entries.zh: 修复了当 Anthropic 无法确认组织设置时 Cowork 云会话显示代理阻止工件的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugins whose hooks module makes many `$.state` calls through one const taking minutes to load or validate
entries.zh: 修复了其 hooks 模块通过一个 const 进行许多`$.state`调用，需要几分钟来加载或验证的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a matcher or state value for a hooks module that the engine reads from elsewhere
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`，列出了引擎从其他地方读取的钩子模块的匹配器或状态值

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a `$.state` value read through a top-level `var` that was declared again or reassigned; such a module is now refused
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`，列出了通过再次声明或重新分配的顶级`var`读取的`$.state`值；这样的模块现在被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's served `$` method restarting the hook origin, which could run a guard hook with a `.catch` above it again without end
entries.zh: 修复了插件的服务`$`方法重新启动钩子原点，该方法可以再次运行上面有`.catch`的防护钩子而没有结束

entries.en: Fixed plugin interface calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts running without the hooks other plugins put on them
entries.zh: 修复了插件钩子工作程序重新启动运行时进行的插件接口调用，而没有其他插件添加的钩子

entries.en: Fixed a mod's `config.set`, `state.set`, `env.set` or `agent.spawn` hook that denies after calling `next(e)` being answered as a refusal: the hook is now reported as failed, by name
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的 `config.set`、`state.set`、`env.set` 或 `agent.spawn` 钩子，该钩子在调用 `next(e)` 后被拒绝回答：该钩子现在按名称报告为失败

entries.en: Fixed `/theme`, the `/config` Theme menu and the first-run theme step saving a theme before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked
entries.zh: 修复了`/theme`、`/config`主题菜单和首次运行主题步骤在询问插件的`config.set`挂钩之前保存主题的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's `tool.check` hook answering allow running a tool that requires your answer (a question, a plan approval) without showing its dialog
entries.zh: 修复插件的 `tool.check` 钩子在需要你回答的工具（如提问、计划审批）上直接放行运行、没有弹出对话框的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's start-up prompt, command or subagent being queued a second time when the hooks worker was replaced
entries.zh: 修复了更换 hooks 工作线程后，mod 的启动提示、命令或子代理再次排队的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's hook that called `next(e)` and then failed while the turn was interrupted letting the call through; the call is now rejected
entries.zh: 修复了一个 mod 的钩子，该钩子调用了`next(e)`，然后在回合被中断以让调用通过时失败；呼叫现已被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's prompt drop or setting deny being ignored when its reason was longer than 4,096 characters
entries.zh: 修复了插件的提示删除或设置拒绝在其原因超过 4,096 个字符时被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed an organization's plugin being unloaded on its own reload, or after another plugin crashed, when it returned a `$` name that a user-installed mod had added; the mod is now unloaded instead
entries.zh: 修复了组织的插件在其自身重新加载时或在另一个插件崩溃后返回用户安装的 mod 添加的`$`名称时被卸载的问题；该模组现在已被卸载

entries.en: Fixed tool calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts being answered without the plugins' permission hooks
entries.zh: 修复插件钩子工作进程重启期间发出的工具调用，被回复时缺少插件权限钩子的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin `tool.call` hooks seeing some tool calls before misnamed parameters were repaired; a hook now sees the arguments the tool will run with
entries.zh: 修复了插件`tool.call`挂钩在修复错误命名的参数之前看到一些工具调用的问题；钩子现在可以看到该工具运行时使用的参数

entries.en: Fixed a mod's guard hook with a `.catch` being skipped silently for calls another mod's hook makes beneath the guard's own `$` call; its `.catch` is now asked
entries.zh: 修复了一个 mod 的防护钩子，当另一个 mod 的钩子在防护器自己的`$`调用之下进行调用时，会默默地跳过`.catch`；现在询问它的`.catch`

entries.en: Improved startup of `claude -p` and SDK sessions: the first turn no longer waits for HTTP and SSE MCP servers to answer `resources/list`
entries.zh: 改进 `claude -p` 和 SDK 会话的启动：第一轮对话不再等待 HTTP 和 SSE 类 MCP 服务器响应 `resources/list`

entries.en: Improved rendering speed of long bulleted or numbered replies: they stream, resize and re-open in the transcript (ctrl+o) much faster
entries.zh: 改进长篇项目符号或编号列表回复的渲染速度：流式输出、调整大小以及用 ctrl+o 重新打开转录时都更快

entries.en: Improved Ctrl+C draft recovery: a cleared prompt now stays reachable with Up after a slash command or a sent message
entries.zh: 改进 Ctrl+C 草稿恢复：被清空的提示词在发送斜杠命令或消息后，仍可以按上方向键找回

entries.en: Improved hook output handling: `<system-reminder>` tags written in a hook's output are escaped before they reach Claude
entries.zh: 改进 hook 输出处理：hook 输出中写的 `<system-reminder>` 标签在送给 Claude 前会被转义

entries.en: Improved tool input handling: Grep accepts `file_path` for `path`, and Write, WebFetch and Read ignore a few stray parameters instead of failing the call
entries.zh: 改进工具输入处理：Grep 接受 `file_path` 代替 `path`；Write、WebFetch 和 Read 会忽略几个多余的参数，而不是直接报错

entries.en: Improved the steps shown when a marketplace declared in a settings file has a name that looks like an official Anthropic marketplace
entries.zh: 改进：设置文件中声明的市场如果名称看起来像 Anthropic 官方市场，会显示相应的提示步骤

entries.en: Improved sandbox auto-allow: with strict sandbox mode set in user, managed or --settings settings, an interpreter command with an env var prefix like `FOO=bar python3 app.py` runs unprompted
entries.zh: 改进沙盒自动放行：在用户、托管或 `--settings` 设置中启用严格沙盒模式后，带环境变量前缀的解释器命令（如 `FOO=bar python3 app.py`）无需提示即可运行

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's listing: Claude now sees how many published artifacts you have and can list up to 200 at once instead of 50
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具的列表：Claude 能看到你已发布的 Artifact 数量，并且一次最多可列出 200 个（以前是 50 个）

entries.en: Improved cloud sessions after a restart: Claude is now told which stopped background agents it can resume by id
entries.zh: 改进云会话重启后的情况：Claude 会被告知哪些已停止的后台 agent 可以按 id 恢复

entries.en: Improved the Claude in Chrome message in claude.ai cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: Claude is now told it may continue with alternatives if the user prefers
entries.zh: 改进 claude.ai 云端会话中「无法连接 Chrome 浏览器」的提示：如果用户希望，Claude 现在会被告知可以改用其他方案继续

entries.en: Improved the /focus tip: it now invites you to try focus view mid-turn and shows how to switch back
entries.zh: 改进 /focus 提示：现在会邀请你在回合进行中尝试专注视图，并说明如何切换回来

entries.en: Improved startup with local (stdio) MCP servers that ignore the newer protocol check: after one slow connect they are remembered for 7 days and connected the older way without the wait
entries.zh: 改进启动：忽略较新协议检查的本地（stdio）MCP 服务器，若首次连接较慢，之后 7 天内会记住该结果，并以旧方式直接连接，不再等待

entries.en: Changed local (stdio) MCP server connections to negotiate protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on every install, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
entries.zh: 更改了本地 (stdio) MCP 服务器连接，以在每次安装时默认协商协议版本 2026-07-28，包括 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry； `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` 选择退出

entries.en: Changed `claude plugin test`: a failed `expect` inside a hook the test registered, or a stub answer the engine refuses, now fails the test instead of passing silently
entries.zh: 更改了“claude插件测试”：测试注册的钩子内失败的`expect`，或者引擎拒绝的存根答案，现在使测试失败，而不是默默地通过

entries.en: Changed usage limit messages to write claude.ai settings links with https:// so terminals and apps can make them clickable
entries.zh: 更改了使用限制消息，以使用 https:// 编写 claude.ai 设置链接，以便终端和应用程序可以使它们可点击

entries.en: Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs to publish a new artifact only you can see without asking for approval; artifacts that request connectors or other access still ask
entries.zh: 更改了计划和立即运行例行运行，以发布只有您可以看到的新工件，而无需请求批准；请求连接器或其他访问的工件仍然会询问

entries.en: Changed agent names to allow at most 256 characters: a longer one is rejected, and a skill's or a plugin file's `name` longer than that is ignored
entries.zh: 更改了代理名称以允许最多 256 个字符：较长的字符将被拒绝，并且技能或插件文件的“名称”长于此的将被忽略

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs occasionally staying listed as running for hours after they had finished
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复例程运行结束后，偶尔仍显示为运行中长达数小时的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed editing or duplicating a routine turning off its push notifications when the routine had no saved notification setting
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复例程没有已保存的通知设置时，编辑或复制例程会关闭其推送通知的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed SVG, HEIC, TIFF and other less common image files failing to attach; they now attach as regular files
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复 SVG、HEIC、TIFF 等较少见的图片文件无法附加的问题；现在会作为普通文件附加

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed approval prompts offering "Always allow" for connector tools that an organization set to require approval; the choice had no effect
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复组织要求连接器工具必须批准时，批准提示仍提供「Always allow」选项、且该选择无效的问题

entries.en: [Remote Control] Fixed the first message of a new Remote Control session started from claude.ai/code accepting only images; it now accepts PDFs and other files like later messages
entries.zh: [Remote Control] 修复从 claude.ai/code 发起的新 Remote Control 会话，其第一条消息只接受图片的问题；现在和后续消息一样，可以接受 PDF 和其他文件

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added an Edit button to the Allowed domains card on a channel's Configure page, so Enterprise admins can open the access bundle that sets the channel's domains
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 频道配置页面的「Allowed domains」卡片新增「Edit」按钮，企业版管理员可直接打开设置该频道域名的访问包

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed replies sent in a Slack thread while Claude was still on its first request there being held until that request finished, or missed when sent seconds apart
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 仍在处理话题的第一个请求时，在该话题中发送的回复会被延迟到请求结束才处理，或在相隔几秒发送时被漏掉的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads woken only by GitHub pull request activity or a routine staying on their original model after an admin changed the channel or workspace default model
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复仅由 GitHub 拉取请求活动或例程唤醒的 Slack 话题，在管理员修改频道或工作区默认模型后，仍停留在原模型的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes posting a spend limit notice in Slack when the real cause was that your organization had run out of usage credits
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复实际原因是组织用尽用量额度，但 Claude 有时却在 Slack 中发出花费限额通知的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a session hanging until interrupted when a permission prompt that can't be answered from Slack was denied automatically
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复无法在 Slack 中回答的权限提示被自动拒绝后，会话挂起直到被中断的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved `@Claude !status` in a channel to say when Claude has stopped reading its untagged messages, why, and that an @-mention starts it reading again
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进频道中的 `@Claude !status`：会说明 Claude 何时停止读取未 @ 的消息、原因为何，以及 @ 提及会让它重新开始读取

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the first message of a Slack thread continued with `!fork` to a card showing where it came from, the request, and who asked, with a link to the original thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 用 `!fork` 延续的 Slack 话题，其第一条消息改为卡片显示：来源、请求内容、提问人，并附原话题链接

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the organization-wide and default spend limit boxes on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings to save only when you press Save or Enter, not when you click away
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 管理设置花费限额页面中，组织范围和默认花费限额输入框改为只在按 Save 或 Enter 时保存，点击别处不再保存

entries.en: [Code Review] Added the period's total with its change from the previous period, and a breakdown by repository, to the PRs reviewed chart in Code Review analytics
entries.zh: [Code Review] Code Review 分析中的「PRs reviewed」图表新增本期总数及与上期的变化，并新增按仓库的细分

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed a queued review failing when the pull request moved to a new base branch and the old one was deleted; the commit is now re-queued for review
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复拉取请求切换到新的基础分支、而旧分支被删除时，排队中的审查失败的问题；现在该提交会重新排队审查

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed reviews ignoring a CLAUDE.md's rules when the pull request edits that file; reviews now use its version from the base branch
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复拉取请求修改了 CLAUDE.md 时，审查忽略其中规则的问题；现在审查会使用基础分支中的版本

entries.en: Fixed a regression in 2.1.290 where cloud sessions could drop answers to permission prompts
entries.zh: 修复了 2.1.290 中的回归，其中云会话可能会放弃对权限提示的回答

entries.en: Fixed a regression in 2.1.288 where the last messages of a session could be lost when quitting
entries.zh: 修复了 2.1.288 中的一个回归问题，即退出时会话的最后一条消息可能会丢失

entries.en: Added `serverToolUses` to the result of a mod's `turn.step` hook: the tool calls the API ran itself (the advisor), each with its id, name, input, start and end
entries.zh: 将`serverToolUses`添加到 mod 的`turn.step`挂钩的结果中：该工具调用 API 运行本身（顾问），每个 API 都有其 id、名称、输入、开始和结束

entries.en: Added `agentId` to the `tool.check` event of plugin hooks, so a hook can tell a subagent's permission check from the main session's
entries.zh: 将`agentId`添加到插件钩子的`tool.check`事件中，因此钩子可以从主会话的权限检查中得知子代理的权限检查

entries.en: Added `ceiling` to the question and verdict a mod's `tool.check` hook reads, naming the approval an organization requires for a tool
entries.zh: 在问题中添加了`ceiling`，并判定 mod 的`tool.check`挂钩读取，命名组织对工具所需的批准

entries.en: Added `ThemeKey` and `Color` types to the plugin hooks typings, so an editor lists the theme colors a mod's drawing can name
entries.zh: 在插件挂钩类型中添加了`ThemeKey`和`Color`类型，因此编辑器列出了 mod 绘图可以命名的主题颜色

entries.en: Added to `claude plugin validate`: each hook a mod registers at a gating site is listed with whether it has a `.catch` (`gatingHooks` under `--json`)
entries.zh: 添加到“claude插件验证”：mod在门控站点注册的每个钩子都会列出它是否具有`.catch`（`--json`下的`gatingHooks`）

entries.en: Added a Deny button to the Claude apps gateway's sign-in approval page: it ends the pending sign-in, so the waiting terminal stops within seconds
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用程序网关的登录批准页面添加了拒绝按钮：它会结束待处理的登录，因此等待的终端会在几秒钟内停止

entries.en: Added `claude attach <name>` and `claude logs <name>`: part of a session name works in place of the id
entries.zh: 添加了 `claude Attach <name>` 和 `claude logs <name>`：会话名称的一部分代替了 id

entries.en: Added `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard <url>` to set up the Managed Agents pattern a page describes as `ant apply` files
entries.zh: 添加了“/claude-api Managed-agents-onboard <url>”来设置页面描述为`ant apply`文件的托管代理模式

entries.en: Added `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard <quickstart-name>` to build a Console quickstart template, such as `deep-researcher`, with the `ant` CLI
entries.zh: 添加了“/claude-api Managed-agents-onboard <quickstart-name>”以使用`ant` CLI 构建控制台快速入门模板，例如`deep-researcher`

entries.en: Added a warning when a managed settings file is a link to a file outside the managed settings folder
entries.zh: 添加了当托管设置文件是指向托管设置文件夹外部文件的链接时的警告

entries.en: Added a /status and doctor warning when managed settings ignore user-configured sandbox allowRead paths or allowed domains
entries.zh: 当托管设置忽略用户配置的沙箱允许读取路径或允许的域时添加了 /status 和 doctor 警告

entries.en: Fixed requests failing behind proxies and gateways that reject one of Claude Code's beta headers with a status other than 400, or together with a second beta
entries.zh: 修复了请求在代理和网关后面失败的问题，这些请求会拒绝状态不是 400 的 Claude Code 的 Beta 标头之一，或者与第二个 Beta 一起拒绝

entries.en: Fixed long sessions with hundreds of images getting stuck on "Request rejected as unprocessable by the model" errors
entries.zh: 修复了数百张图像陷入“请求因模型无法处理而被拒绝”错误的长时间会话

entries.en: Fixed a turn ending at once when the API's output content filter stopped a reply while Claude was still thinking; the request is now retried once before the error is shown
entries.zh: 修复了当克劳德仍在思考时 API 的输出内容过滤器停止回复时回合立即结束的问题；现在，在显示错误之前会重试请求一次

entries.en: Fixed resumed subagents and teammates losing their earlier thinking and prompt cache after receiving a message mid-run
entries.zh: 修复了恢复的子代理和队友在运行中途收到消息后丢失先前的思维和提示缓存的问题

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch silently dropping page text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and takes an `offset` to read on
entries.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 静默丢弃超过 100,000 个字符的页面文本的问题；现在它会显示有多少内容未读，并需要一个“偏移量”来继续阅读

entries.en: Fixed a crash ("Maximum call stack size exceeded") when a response nested lists or quotes thousands of levels deep
entries.zh: 修复了响应嵌套列表或引用数千级深度时发生的崩溃（“超出最大调用堆栈大小”）

entries.en: Fixed `/rewind` not listing a prompt sent while Claude was still working
entries.zh: 修复了`/rewind`未列出克劳德仍在工作时发送的提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed scheduled tasks (`/loop` with an interval, reminders) silently not coming back on resume once the conversation was compacted; covers compactions made from this version on
entries.zh: 修复了计划任务（带有间隔的`/loop`，提醒）一旦对话被压缩，就不会默默地返回恢复；涵盖从此版本开始的压缩

entries.en: Fixed scheduled tasks set in the foreground never firing after a ← or `/background` hand-off, and recurring ones firing an extra run on every resume, respawn or fork
entries.zh: 修复了前台设置的计划任务在 ← 或 `/background` 交接后永远不会触发，并且重复任务在每次恢复、重生或分叉时都会触发额外运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed headless `--json-schema` runs exiting non-zero with `is_error: true` on a `success` result when the connection dropped after the structured output was already delivered
entries.zh: 修复了当结构化输出已交付后连接断开时，无头`--json-schema`在`success`结果上以`is_error: true`运行退出非零的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode letting the auto mode classifier approve non-read-only connector tools that carry a server-pushed ask policy
entries.zh: 固定计划模式让自动模式分类器批准带有服务器推送询问策略的非只读连接器工具

entries.en: Fixed a project `CLAUDE.md`, rule or `AGENTS.md` symlinked outside the working directories loading under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` or a `Read` deny rule
entries.zh: 修复项目中的 `CLAUDE.md`、规则文件或 `AGENTS.md` 若是指向工作目录之外的符号链接，仍会在 `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` 或 `Read` 拒绝规则下被加载的问题

entries.en: Fixed URL allow and deny patterns with a wildcard inside an `xn--` host label matching differently from one process to the next
entries.zh: 修复了`xn--`主机标签内带有通配符的 URL 允许和拒绝模式，该模式与一个进程与下一个进程的匹配方式不同

entries.en: Fixed an MCP server provided by your organization being relisted as your own after signing in or reconnecting, including from a late result in headless and SDK sessions
entries.zh: 修复了您的组织提供的 MCP 服务器在登录或重新连接后重新列为您自己的服务器，包括无头和 SDK 会话中的延迟结果

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` dropping uncommitted changes without a warning on Windows when `git stash create` failed, and refusing them after a `git add -N` file was deleted or moved
entries.zh: 修复了当`git stash create`失败时，`/ultrareview`在 Windows 上丢弃未提交的更改而不发出警告，并在删除或移动`git add -N`文件后拒绝它们的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `plansDirectory` setting's project-root check for paths that contain a backslash on macOS and Linux
entries.zh: 修复 `plansDirectory` 设置在 macOS 和 Linux 上，对包含反斜杠的路径的项目根目录检查问题

entries.en: Fixed replies in very long Remote Control and cloud sessions that could appear a block at a time instead of streaming in
entries.zh: 修复了很长的远程控制和云会话中的回复可能一次出现一个块而不是流式传输的问题

entries.en: Fixed the background daemon's log passing terminal control characters to the screen under `claude daemon run` and `claude daemon logs`; they now show as `\uXXXX` escapes
entries.zh: 修复后台守护进程在 `claude daemon run` 和 `claude daemon logs` 下，把终端控制字符直接输出到屏幕的问题；现在会显示为 `\uXXXX` 转义形式

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a crafted, very long line of a session's error output freezing the runner for several seconds
entries.zh: 修复了会话错误输出中一行特别长的精心构造内容，导致运行器卡死几秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin hook with a `.catch` being unloaded, and its `.catch` skipped, when the hook kept the hooks worker busy on a prompt or tool call
entries.zh: 修复了一个插件钩子，当钩子使钩子工作人员忙于提示或工具调用时，卸载了`.catch`，并且跳过了`.catch`

entries.en: Fixed a mod's `turn.step` result listing a tool call that a mid-response model fallback had discarded
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的`turn.step`结果，列出了中间响应模型回退已丢弃的工具调用

entries.en: Fixed a Cowork cloud session's reply sometimes never finishing when its container restarted just after Claude sent a message or a file
entries.zh: 修复了在克劳德发送消息或文件后容器重新启动时，Cowork 云会话的回复有时永远无法完成的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` and plugin loading refusing a hooks module that destructures an option named like one of its top-level functions
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件验证”和插件加载拒绝钩子模块的问题，该模块会解构一个名为其顶级函数之一的选项

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` failing to upload uncommitted changes when `core.safecrlf=true` is set in git's configuration
entries.zh: 修复了在 git 配置中设置 `core.safecrlf=true` 时 `/ultrareview` 无法上传未提交的更改的问题

entries.en: Fixed the effort level changing when a flagged message is retried on a fallback model that has a different level saved in settings
entries.zh: 修复被标记的消息在回退到另一个模型重试时，努力级别被改变的问题（该模型在设置中保存了不同的级别）

entries.en: Windows: Fixed multi-line `!` shell blocks in skills and commands failing when the file is saved with CRLF line endings
entries.zh: Windows：修复了文件以 CRLF 换行符保存时，技能和命令中多行 `!` shell 代码块执行失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code hanging until killed when a `/permissions` tab was clicked while searching in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下搜索时单击`/permissions`选项卡时克劳德代码挂起直至被杀死的问题

entries.en: Fixed conversation compaction sometimes failing with a "null is not an object" error
entries.zh: 修复了对话压缩有时会失败并出现“null 不是对象”错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin hooks reading an empty `answer` on `turn.complete` for a subagent that hands its report back in auto mode
entries.zh: 修复了插件挂钩在`turn.complete`上读取空`answer`的问题，以便在自动模式下将其报告交还给子代理

entries.en: Fixed a mod being unloaded without a message when a refresh followed its failed reload; its failure line now says the version loaded before is unloaded
entries.zh: 修复了重新加载失败后刷新时未显示任何消息的 mod 卸载问题；它的故障行现在显示之前加载的版本已卸载

entries.en: Fixed a mod's `prompt.submit` hook that drops a prompt after calling `next(e)` being ignored silently: the hook is now reported as failed, by name
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的 `prompt.submit` 钩子，该钩子在调用 `next(e)` 后会删除提示并被静默忽略：该钩子现在按名称报告为失败

entries.en: Fixed a mod's pane or band being redrawn without end when it followed its end over a tree that changed height at every drawing
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的窗格或带区在每次绘制都改变高度的树上跟随其末端时被无休止地重绘的问题

entries.en: Fixed an image read on macOS and Windows being able to return a file outside what was approved, through a link swapped in mid-read
entries.zh: 修复了在 macOS 和 Windows 上读取的图像能够通过在读取过程中交换的链接返回超出批准范围的文件

entries.en: Fixed a case where a user-installed mod could get an organization's plugin unloaded; the mod is now the one unloaded
entries.zh: 修复了用户安装的 mod 可能会卸载组织插件的情况；该模组现在已被卸载

entries.en: Fixed `disableClaudeAiConnectors` and `allowedMcpServers` URL rules not being applied to some MCP entries declared in `.mcp.json`, plugins or agents
entries.zh: 修复了`disableClaudeAiConnectors`和`allowedMcpServers` URL 规则未应用于`.mcp.json`、插件或代理中声明的某些 MCP 条目的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's inline pane being redrawn without end when its tree changed height at every drawing
entries.zh: 修复了当 Mod 的树在每次绘制时改变高度时，它的内嵌窗格会被无休止地重绘的问题

entries.en: Fixed an `@`-mention under the read block or `--restricted` being able to read a file outside the working directories through a link changed mid-read
entries.zh: 修复了读取块下的`@`提及或`--restricted`能够通过读取过程中更改的链接读取工作目录之外的文件

entries.en: Fixed Esc in the agents view confirming "Press enter again to restart this session — it isn't responding"; Esc now just reopens the session
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图中的 Esc 确认“再次按 Enter 重新启动此会话 - 它没有响应”的问题； Esc 现在只是重新打开会话

entries.en: Fixed agent view losing a background session's `/loop` run count, countdown and live status line after the session enters a worktree that it creates
entries.zh: 修复了在会话进入其创建的工作树后代理视图丢失后台会话的`/loop`运行计数、倒计时和实时状态行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` sessions in manual permission mode asking for approval to read an image pasted into a reply or a new agent's prompt
entries.zh: 修复了手动权限模式下的“克劳德代理”会话，要求批准读取粘贴到回复或新代理提示中的图像
