entries.en: Fixed a deny or ask rule missing a command or path whose name came from a variable set as a prefix on `declare`, `typeset`, `export` or `readonly`
entries.zh: 修复了拒绝或询问规则缺少名称来自设置为`declare`、`typeset`、`export`或`readonly`前缀的变量的命令或路径的问题

entries.en: Fixed Read deny rules not applying to image paths pasted or dragged into the prompt, or to file names listed for an @-mentioned folder
entries.zh: 修复了读取拒绝规则不适用于粘贴或拖动到提示中的图像路径，或不适用于为@提到的文件夹列出的文件名

entries.en: Fixed a case where a user-installed mod could make an organization's guard skip its check; such a mod is now unloaded
entries.zh: 修复了用户安装的模组可能会使组织的守卫跳过检查的情况；这样的mod现在已经卸载了

entries.en: Fixed plugin hooks stalling each redraw when a mod draws a long multi-line text holding non-Latin characters
entries.zh: 修复了当 mod 绘制包含非拉丁字符的长多行文本时，插件挂钩会导致每次重绘停止的问题

entries.en: Fixed repeated Ctrl+X in the agents view deleting the whole next section after the bottom session of a section was deleted
entries.zh: 修复了在删除某个部分的底部会话后，在代理视图中重复使用 Ctrl+X 删除整个下一部分的问题

entries.en: Fixed You should know writing its notes in English regardless of the `language` setting
entries.zh: 固定你应该知道用英语写笔记，无论“语言”设置如何

entries.en: Fixed a freeze after sending some very long messages
entries.zh: 修复了发送一些很长消息后的冻结问题

entries.en: Fixed a slowdown when expanding the transcript (ctrl+o) or resizing over large tool output that contains non-ASCII characters such as arrows, dashes or box-drawing
entries.zh: 修复了扩展文字记录 (ctrl+o) 或调整包含非 ASCII 字符（例如箭头、破折号或方框图）的大型工具输出大小时的速度减慢问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude respawn` re-sending an earlier message to a backgrounded session that has no saved transcript instead of starting it with an empty conversation
entries.zh: 修复了`claude respawn`将较早的消息重新发送到没有保存记录的后台会话，而不是用空对话启动它的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc after an `n:` or Ctrl+F search in the agents view moving focus to a section header, where Ctrl+X twice would delete every session in the section
entries.zh: 修复了在代理视图中执行`n:`或 Ctrl+F 搜索后将焦点移至部分标题后的 Esc 问题，其中 Ctrl+X 两次将删除该部分中的每个会话

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` saving a slash command it could not deliver to a stopped session and then running it by itself the next time that session restarted
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”保存无法传递到已停止会话的斜杠命令，然后在下次会话重新启动时自行运行它的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` uploading uncommitted changes unfiltered for files under a git filter driver named `unset` or `unspecified`; the upload now stops and asks you to rename the driver
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`在名为`unset`或`unspecified`的 git 过滤器驱动程序下上传未过滤的未提交更改的文件；上传现在停止并要求您重命名驱动程序

entries.en: Fixed auto mode denials suggesting a permission rule that would skip the classifier for a whole tool or that Claude Code would ignore
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式拒绝建议的权限规则，该规则将跳过整个工具的分类器或克劳德代码将忽略

entries.en: Fixed `claude --teleport` and `/teleport` deleting the files in a folder that had replaced a tracked file of the same name when you chose to stash: the stash is now refused, and says why
entries.zh: 修复了当您选择存储时`claude --teleport`和`/teleport`删除已替换同名跟踪文件的文件夹中的文件的问题：存储现在被拒绝，并说明原因

entries.en: Fixed Esc confirming agent view's "Press enter again to restart this session fresh" prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 Esc 确认代理视图的“再次按 Enter 以重新启动此会话”提示

entries.en: Fixed agent view's `/loop` run count freezing and its countdown disappearing after `/clear`; the count now restarts with the new conversation
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图的`/loop`运行计数冻结及其倒计时在`/clear`后消失的问题；现在，计数将随着新对话重新开始

entries.en: Fixed `--channels` permission relay: a reply ID that repeats within a session is now ignored instead of approving a different prompt
entries.zh: 修复了`--channels`权限中继：现在会忽略会话中重复的回复 ID，而不是批准不同的提示

entries.en: Fixed `/chrome` "Reconnect extension" not restoring browser tools after a failed Chrome connection, and added an explanation when it can't (anthropics/claude-code#98135)
entries.zh: 修复了`/chrome`“重新连接扩展”在 Chrome 连接失败后不恢复浏览器工具的问题，并在无法恢复时添加了解释 (anthropics/claude-code#98135)

entries.en: Fixed mods staying off for people who reach Claude through a gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`) and have no Anthropic account
entries.zh: 修复了通过网关（带有`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`的`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`）联系克劳德并且没有 Anthropic 帐户的人无法使用模组的问题

entries.en: Fixed replies sent from `claude agents` just after a background session crashed being refused after 2 seconds: they are now retried for up to 12 seconds while the session restarts
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话崩溃后从“claude Agents”发送的回复在 2 秒后被拒绝的问题：现在，在会话重新启动时，它们会重试最多 12 秒

entries.en: Fixed slash commands and answers to a multiple-choice question that `claude agents` could not deliver to a running session being saved and sent by themselves the next time it was restarted
entries.zh: 修复了斜线命令和多项选择问题的答案，即“克劳德代理”无法交付给正在保存的正在运行的会话，并在下次重新启动时自行发送

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed commands that pipe a heredoc into another command (`cat <<EOF | python3`) asking for approval on every run
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒命令，该命令将heredoc通过管道传输到另一个命令（`cat <<EOF | python3`），要求每次运行时获得批准

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` failing with "Couldn't restart the background service" and background sessions stopping after a Homebrew upgrade (takes effect from the upgrade after this one)
entries.zh: 修复了 `claude Agents` 失败并显示“无法重新启动后台服务”以及 Homebrew 升级后后台会话停止的问题（此升级后生效）

entries.en: Fixed agent view's "restart this session fresh" re-sending an earlier message from the session instead of starting with an empty conversation
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图的“重新启动此会话”，从会话中重新发送较早的消息，而不是从空对话开始

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving some read-only commands (such as `rg` or `git grep`) whose arguments the shell would still expand as wildcards; these now prompt for approval
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查自动批准某些只读命令（例如 `rg` 或 `git grep`）的问题，shell 仍会将其参数扩展为通配符；这些现在提示批准

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin test` refusing to run after an upgrade because of an out-of-date saved setting
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件测试”由于保存的设置已过期而在升级后拒绝运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving certain commands whose variable names zsh reads differently from bash; these now prompt for approval
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查自动批准某些变量名称 zsh 读取与 bash 不同的命令；这些现在提示批准

entries.en: Fixed a short form of a `git clone` option keeping the sandbox exemption from a git pattern such as `git *` in `sandbox.excludedCommands`; it is now treated like the long form
entries.zh: 修复了`git clone`选项的简短形式，使沙箱免受 git 模式的影响，例如`sandbox.excludedCommands`中的`git *`；现在它被视为长形式

entries.en: Fixed the first feature-flag request of a session ignoring a proxy or API endpoint set in a project's settings
entries.zh: 修复会话的第一个功能开关请求忽略了项目设置中配置的代理或 API 端点的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` of a local branch silently leaving uncommitted work out of the upload in a repository that keeps its branches outside `.git` (git 2.54+); it now refuses with an explanation
entries.zh: 修复了本地分支的`/ultrareview`默默地将未提交的工作留在存储库中的上传中，该存储库将其分支保留在`.git`之外（git 2.54+）；现在拒绝并给出解释

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions staying asleep after a container restart lost a pending `/loop` wakeup or scheduled task; Claude is now told and can schedule it again
entries.zh: 修复了容器重启后保持睡眠状态的云会话丢失挂起的`/loop`唤醒或计划任务的问题；克劳德现在已被告知并可以再次安排

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway's retention sweep deleting a returning developer's identity row refreshed at the same moment, on PostgreSQL versions without the November 2025 fixes
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 应用网关的保留期清理任务，在返回开发者的身份记录同时被刷新时将其误删的问题（适用于 2025 年 11 月修复之前的 PostgreSQL 版本）

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Monitor tool commands skipping the permission prompt under sandbox auto-allow; they now follow your permission rules
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒监控工具命令在沙盒自动允许下跳过权限提示的问题；他们现在遵循您的许可规则

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway failing to start when the certificate it presents to the identity provider has an empty subject
entries.zh: 修复当身份提供方收到的证书主题（subject）为空时，Claude 应用网关无法启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway exiting with a bare "Invalid URL" when `store.postgres_url` can't be parsed; the error now names the setting and says what the URL may hold
entries.zh: 修复了当无法解析`store.postgres_url`时，克劳德应用程序网关退出时仅显示“无效 URL”；现在，错误会命名设置并说明 URL 可能包含的内容

entries.en: Fixed background agents failing with "Agent stalled" and Workflow tool subagents restarting from their prompt when a Mac woke from sleep
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理因“代理停止”而失败以及当 Mac 从睡眠状态唤醒时工作流程工具子代理从提示符重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed slow or failed startup since 2.1.285 under SDK hosts such as the VS Code extension when managed settings deny reads of many paths on a slow filesystem (notably Windows drives under WSL)
entries.zh: 修复了自 2.1.285 起，当托管设置拒绝读取慢速文件系统（特别是 WSL 下的 Windows 驱动器）上的许多路径时，在 SDK 主机（例如 VS Code 扩展）下启动缓慢或失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed a response interrupted by computer sleep being treated as a stalled stream on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and custom gateways
entries.zh: 修复了因计算机睡眠被视为 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和自定义网关上停滞流而中断的响应

entries.en: Fixed a freeze before the first request and in the `/sandbox` Config tab on Linux and WSL when a sandbox read rule such as `~/**/.env` covers a large folder
entries.zh: 修复了当沙箱读取规则（例如`~/**/.env`）覆盖大文件夹时，第一个请求之前以及 Linux 和 WSL 上的`/sandbox`配置选项卡中的冻结

entries.en: Fixed skills not being found when asked for by the name in SKILL.md when their folder has a different name (for example a non-English name): the skill listing now shows both names
entries.zh: 修复了当文件夹具有不同名称（例如非英文名称）时按 SKILL.md 中的名称询问时找不到技能的问题：技能列表现在显示两个名称

entries.en: Fixed a plan written in plan mode being lost when a cloud session's container restarted before the plan was presented
entries.zh: 修复了在计划呈现之前云会话的容器重新启动时以计划模式编写的计划丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Bash tool occasionally losing shell aliases, functions and plugin PATH entries for a whole session when its first command ran seconds after startup on a new config directory
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具在新的配置目录启动后几秒钟运行第一个命令时偶尔会丢失整个会话的 shell 别名、函数和插件 PATH 条目的问题

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory use when an HTTP MCP server sends a very large response
entries.zh: 修复 HTTP MCP 服务器返回超大响应时内存使用无限增长的问题

entries.en: Fixed artifact operations failing in a Claude Code run started from inside a cloud session (for example `claude -p` run from the Bash tool)
entries.zh: 修复了从云会话内部启动的 Claude Code 运行失败的工件操作（例如从 Bash 工具运行的`claude -p`）

entries.en: Fixed files sent from remote sessions sometimes being refused as "not the one approved" when four or more were sent at once
entries.zh: 修复了当同时发送四个或更多文件时，从远程会话发送的文件有时会被拒绝为“未批准的文件”的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode not being restored when resuming a session with `--continue` or `--resume <session-id>` in the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在终端中使用`--continue`或`--resume <session-id>`恢复会话时计划模式未恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed a marketplace named after another GitHub marketplace's download folder stopping that marketplace from downloading
entries.zh: 修复了以另一个 GitHub 市场的下载文件夹命名的市场，导致该市场无法下载

entries.en: Fixed automatic compaction giving up with "Prompt is too long" when a Mac went to sleep while it was running
entries.zh: 修复了当 Mac 在运行时进入睡眠状态时自动压缩放弃并显示“提示太长”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the rewind menu (Esc Esc / `/rewind`) freezing for hundreds of milliseconds per keypress when the conversation contains a very large pasted stack trace or source file
entries.zh: 修复对话中含有超大粘贴的堆栈跟踪或源文件时，回退菜单（Esc Esc / `/rewind`）每次按键都卡顿数百毫秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed a subdirectory's AGENTS.md not being attached when a file under it is @-mentioned
entries.zh: 修复了子目录下的文件被@提及时未附加子目录的 AGENTS.md 的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions resumed after a stopped runner failing with "missing but already registered worktree" when the sessions folder is a relative symlink
entries.zh: 修复了当会话文件夹是相对符号链接时，停止的运行器因“丢失但已注册的工作树”而失败后恢复的自托管运行器会话

entries.en: Fixed a freeze when the secret scan or a permission prompt met long token-like text
entries.zh: 修复了秘密扫描或权限提示遇到类似令牌的长文本时的冻结问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks not applying Read deny rules or the outside-directory read block to a wildcard in some option values of read-only commands
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查未将读取拒绝规则或外部目录读取块应用于只读命令的某些选项值中的通配符的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS=5m` being read as 5 ms and cancelling remote dialogs at once; values with a unit suffix now fall back to `dialogExpiry`
entries.zh: 修复了 `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS=5m` 被读取为 5 毫秒并立即取消远程对话的问题；带有单位后缀的值现在回退到`dialogExpiry`

entries.en: Fixed a stall when an MCP server's tool listing contains very long runs of combining characters
entries.zh: 修复了当 MCP 服务器的工具列表包含很长的组合字符时出现的停顿

entries.en: Fixed two pastes that overlap in one prompt being sent to the model partly as typed text instead of as one pasted block
entries.zh: 修复同一提示框中两次重叠的粘贴，部分内容被当作普通输入发给模型，而非作为一个粘贴块发送的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome's browser picker showing a message meant for Claude when the chosen browser is no longer connected, and the VS Code dialog's list going stale after a switch
entries.zh: 修复了当所选浏览器不再连接时，Chrome 浏览器选择器中的 Claude 显示一条针对 Claude 的消息，并且 VS Code 对话框的列表在切换后变得陈旧的问题

entries.en: Fixed background subagents losing write and Bash access in their worktree after the main session enters or exits a different worktree
entries.zh: 修复了主会话进入或退出不同工作树后后台子代理在其工作树中丢失写入和 Bash 访问权限的问题

entries.en: Fixed background commands, the agents view and daemon workers sending telemetry and a feature-flag request to Anthropic behind a Claude apps gateway when no managed settings on the machine force gateway login
entries.zh: 修复了后台命令、代理视图和守护进程工作人员在机器强制网关登录上没有托管设置时向 Claude 应用程序网关后面的 Anthropic 发送遥测和功能标记请求的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--restricted` (and `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`) sessions opening the cross-session messaging socket
entries.zh: 修复了打开跨会话消息套接字的`--restricted`（和`CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`）会话

entries.en: Fixed sessions moved to the background while idle reopening as "no saved transcript" after a restart or idle cleanup; they now resume their conversation
entries.zh: 修复了重启或空闲清理后，空闲重新打开时会话移至后台的问题，因为“没有保存的记录”；他们现在继续谈话

entries.en: Fixed background workers honoring `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` on respawn without the bypass-permissions disclaimer having been accepted
entries.zh: 修复了后台工作人员在重生时尊重`--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`而未接受旁路权限免责声明的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude replying in an endless loop when a plugin's async Stop hook passes an unquoted script path under a folder with a space, such as Application Support
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的异步停止钩子在带有空格的文件夹下传递未加引号的脚本路径时，克劳德在无限循环中进行回复的问题，例如应用程序支持

entries.en: Fixed a freeze of several seconds when secret masking met very long unbroken text
entries.zh: 修复了当秘密屏蔽遇到很长的不间断文本时冻结几秒钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed some permission rules and safety checks not being applied to a tool call after a PreToolUse hook rewrote its input
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse 挂钩重写其输入后，一些权限规则和安全检查未应用于工具调用的问题

entries.en: Fixed first launch asking to pick a login method again after `claude auth login` or with a credentials file already in the config directory
entries.zh: 修复了首次启动要求在`claude auth login`之后再次选择登录方法或使用配置目录中已有的凭据文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed file names containing line breaks being displayed incorrectly in file tool errors and permission prompts
entries.zh: 修复了文件工具错误和权限提示中包含换行符的文件名显示不正确的问题

entries.en: Fixed a large paste expanded in place being sent to the model as typed text after the next keystroke when it held accents stored as separate characters, as macOS file names do
entries.zh: 修复了在下一次击键后，当它包含存储为单独字符的重音符号（就像 macOS 文件名一样）时，在适当位置展开的大粘贴会作为键入文本发送到模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed macOS `/login` reporting success when the keychain refused the new login and kept an old one it could not remove
entries.zh: 修复了当钥匙串拒绝新登录并保留无法删除的旧登录时 macOS`/login` 报告成功的问题

entries.en: Fixed SDK hosts using `--include-partial-messages` seeing a reply stay open after the turn ended when its stream was cut, interrupted or fell back to non-streaming
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--include-partial-messages`的 SDK 主机在其流被切断、中断或回退到非流式传输时看到回复在回合结束后保持打开状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on Linux running `ConfigChange` hooks and reloading settings mid-command when `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` does not exist
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上运行`ConfigChange`挂钩的沙盒 Bash 命令，以及当`.claude/settings.json`或`.claude/settings.local.json`不存在时在命令中重新加载设置

entries.en: Fixed errors reading "Premature close" instead of naming the missing program when a tool Claude Code runs, such as git or gh, is not installed (macOS, Linux)
entries.zh: 修复了未安装 Claude Code 运行工具（例如 git 或 gh）时读取“过早关闭”而不是命名缺失程序的错误（macOS、Linux）

entries.en: Fixed `/loop` and other recurring session-only scheduled tasks running an extra time after a sandboxed Bash command on Linux or after `.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` was deleted
entries.zh: 修复了在 Linux 上的沙盒 Bash 命令后或删除`.claude/scheduled_tasks.json`后额外运行`/loop`和其他仅重复会话的计划任务

entries.en: Fixed edits to the file a symlinked settings file points at running without the settings-file permission question
entries.zh: 修复了对符号链接设置文件在没有设置文件权限的情况下运行时指向的文件的编辑问题

entries.en: Improved MCP startup behind a network proxy: a server the proxy blocks (HTTP 403) is no longer retried three times
entries.zh: 改进网络代理后的 MCP 启动：被代理拦截的服务器（HTTP 403）不再重试三次

entries.en: Improved permission prompts from background agents to show the Ctrl+X Ctrl+K shortcut that stops all background agents
entries.zh: 改进后台智能体发出的权限提示：显示可停止所有后台智能体的快捷键 Ctrl+X Ctrl+K

entries.en: Improved the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: Claude now gives the one command another person runs to install a mod you made, and writes it in a README's install section
entries.zh: 改进内置的 `plugin-authoring` 技能：Claude 现在会给出一条命令，供他人安装你做的 mod，并写进 README 的安装部分

entries.en: Improved the reply to `/plugin` in the desktop app's Code tab: it now says where to install and manage plugins there
entries.zh: 改进桌面应用 Code 标签页中对 `/plugin` 的回复：会说明在哪里安装和管理插件

entries.en: Improved the Bash changed-files view: when a chained command includes git merge, pull or checkout, it lists the files without full diffs
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 变更文件视图：链式命令中包含 git merge、pull 或 checkout 时，只列出文件，不显示完整差异

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's log when an upstream's cloud credentials or connection fail: the warning now ends with the underlying cause
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关：上游的云凭证或连接失败时，日志警告会以根本原因结尾

entries.en: Improved the error shown when a cloud session is started without a claude.ai sign-in: it now names `claude auth login` and /login and no longer blames API-key authentication
entries.zh: 改进未登录 claude.ai 就启动云端会话时的报错：会提示 `claude auth login` 和 /login，不再错误归因于 API 密钥认证

entries.en: Improved the Read tool's message for binary files: it now points Claude to a skill or a shell command that can read the format
entries.zh: 改进 Read 工具对二进制文件的提示：会指引 Claude 使用能读取该格式的技能或 shell 命令

entries.en: Improved the error shown when a git config file stops the `/ultrareview` upload: it is about half as long and says what kind of file is the problem
entries.zh: 改进 git 配置文件导致 `/ultrareview` 上传失败时的报错：篇幅缩短约一半，并说明问题出在哪类文件上

entries.en: Improved the errors shown when the `/ultrareview` upload refuses a checkout: each known cause now has its own message, with a way to fix it
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview` 上传拒绝检出内容时的报错：每种已知原因都有各自的提示，并附修复方法

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway to log a warning during the last 30 days before the certificate it presents to the identity provider expires
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关：在它提供给身份提供方的证书到期前最后 30 天，会记录警告日志

entries.en: Improved Claude in Chrome: a `browser_batch` call now gets 90 seconds, up from 60, before it is reported as timed out
entries.zh: 改进 Claude in Chrome：`browser_batch` 调用的超时时间从 60 秒提高到 90 秒，之后才会被报告为超时

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's browser sign-in pages: brand fonts, centered layout, and dark mode
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关的浏览器登录页面：采用品牌字体、居中布局，并支持深色模式

entries.en: Improved responsiveness while resuming large sessions: timers, input and rendering keep running while the transcript loads
entries.zh: 改进恢复大型会话时的响应速度：转录加载期间，计时器、输入和渲染仍然正常运行

entries.en: Improved the / and @ suggestion lists: the selected row now starts with a ❯ pointer, so you can see it without color
entries.zh: 改进 / 和 @ 建议列表：选中行开头显示 ❯ 指示符，不依赖颜色也能看出选中项

entries.en: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` to also skip the startup connection warm-up
entries.zh: 更改了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`以跳过启动连接预热

entries.en: Changed Claude in Chrome so that a project's settings files can no longer turn it on; use `--chrome`, `/chrome` or your user settings
entries.zh: 更改了 Chrome 中的 Claude，使项目的设置文件无法再打开它；使用 `--chrome`、`/chrome` 或您的用户设置

entries.en: Changed the Bash tool to ask for permission before running `pyright`, which is no longer treated as a read-only command
entries.zh: 将 Bash 工具更改为在运行`pyright`之前请求许可，该命令不再被视为只读命令

entries.en: Changed what a mod's `$.process.spawn` rejects with when another mod denies it after the child ran: it now says the call ran and a plugin withheld its result
entries.zh: 更改了当子进程运行后另一个 mod 拒绝它时，mod 的`$.process.spawn`拒绝的内容：它现在说调用已运行并且插件保留了其结果

entries.en: Changed the background daemon's log to write a multi-line message as one JSON-quoted line
entries.zh: 更改了后台守护程序的日志，将多行消息写入 JSON 引用的一行

entries.en: Changed skills and custom commands to refuse a `!` shell command that contains raw control characters other than tab and newline, with a message that shows where they are
entries.zh: 更改了技能和自定义命令以拒绝包含除制表符和换行符之外的原始控制字符的`!` shell 命令，并显示一条消息显示它们所在的位置

entries.en: Changed `/artifacts`: opening an artifact in your browser now closes the list
entries.zh: 更改了`/artifacts`：在浏览器中打开工件现在会关闭列表

entries.en: Changed Bash permission checks so that more forms of the `ps` command ask for approval instead of running without asking
entries.zh: 更改了 Bash 权限检查，以便更多形式的`ps`命令请求批准，而不是不询问就运行

entries.en: Changed plugin hooks so long text is clipped and logged instead of being refused or dropped silently
entries.zh: 更改了插件挂钩，以便剪裁并记录长文本，而不是默默地拒绝或丢弃

entries.en: Changed background sessions whose scheduled task is gone: they now move to Completed about 20 seconds later and can be updated or shut down when idle
entries.zh: 更改了计划任务已消失的后台会话：它们现在会在大约 20 秒后移至“已完成”，并且可以在空闲时更新或关闭

entries.en: Changed the "Press ← again" confirm on a just-cleared prompt: a second ← no longer has to wait a second before it switches, and holding ← down now switches too
entries.zh: 更改了刚刚清除的提示上的“再次按 ←”确认：第二个 ← 不再需要等待一秒钟才能切换，并且现在按住 ← 也可以切换

entries.en: Changed the errors shown when the `/ultrareview` upload fails at a git step: they name the step and what to try, and no longer repeat git's own error text
entries.zh: 更改了在 git 步骤中`/ultrareview`上传失败时显示的错误：它们命名了该步骤以及要尝试的内容，并且不再重复 git 自己的错误文本

entries.en: Changed `/code-review` at medium effort to also report cleanup and CLAUDE.md conventions findings on models without tuned review settings, including Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
entries.zh: 中等程度地更改了`/code-review`，以报告未调整审核设置的模型的清理和 CLAUDE.md 约定结果，包括 Opus 5.5 和 Sonnet 5.5

entries.en: Changed an in-process teammate's `agent_id` in Agent results to its agent ID (its `name@team` address stays in `teammate_id`); TeammateIdle hooks no longer fire from its subagents or forks
entries.zh: 将代理结果中进程内队友的`agent_id`更改为其代理 ID（其`name@team`地址保留在`teammate_id`中）； TeammateIdle 钩子不再从其子代理或叉子中触发

entries.en: Changed background sessions waiting on a scheduled wakeup (`/loop`): they are now left running through updates and low memory, where being restarted or shut down could silently lose the wakeup
entries.zh: 更改了等待计划唤醒（`/loop`）的后台会话：它们现在在更新和内存不足时保持运行，重新启动或关闭可能会默默地失去唤醒

entries.en: Changed `/model`, `/effort` and `/rename` sent from `claude agents` to a busy background session to apply right away, without a confirmation, instead of when the turn ends
entries.zh: 更改了从“claude Agents”发送到繁忙后台会话的`/model`、`/effort`和`/rename`，以便立即应用，无需确认，而不是在回合结束时应用

entries.en: Changed the Claude apps gateway's minimum supported PostgreSQL version from 14 to 11
entries.zh: 将 Claude 应用程序网关支持的最低 PostgreSQL 版本从 14 更改为 11

entries.en: Changed the interactive session's WebSearch budget to refill over time (100 calls/hour; `CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR` sets the rate, 0 turns it off) instead of ending after 200 calls
entries.zh: 更改了交互式会话的 WebSearch 预算，使其随着时间的推移重新填充（100 次调用/小时；`CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR` 设置费率，0 将其关闭），而不是在 200 次调用后结束

entries.en: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS` so a repository's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` can no longer set it; shell, user and managed settings still can
entries.zh: 更改了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS`，因此存储库的`.claude/settings.json`或`.claude/settings.local.json`无法再设置它； shell、用户和托管设置仍然可以

entries.en: Changed `claude plugin update` on a plugin loaded from a directory to print just its reason, without the "Failed to update plugin" prefix, as for built-in plugins
entries.zh: 更改了从目录加载的插件上的`claude plugin update`，以仅打印其原因，而没有“无法更新插件”前缀，就像内置插件一样

entries.en: Changed the built-in `gh api` in cloud sessions: a host other than github.com set in `GH_HOST` or `GH_REPO` is now refused (use `--hostname` or a full URL), and stderr notes requests to other hosts
entries.zh: 更改了云会话中的内置`gh api`：`GH_HOST`或`GH_REPO`中设置的 github.com 以外的主机现在被拒绝（使用`--hostname`或完整 URL），并且 stderr 会记录对其他主机的请求

entries.en: Changed the `claude-api` skill's Managed Agents examples to turn off the web tools unless the agent needs them and to use the `auto` permission policy
entries.zh: 更改了`claude-api`技能的托管代理示例，以关闭 Web 工具（除非代理需要它们）并使用“自动”权限策略

entries.en: Self-hosted runners: Changed `claude --environment <id>` to create its session through the current Sessions API; printed and JSON session ids keep their session_… form
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：`claude --environment <id>` 改为通过当前的 Sessions API 创建会话；打印和 JSON 输出中的会话 ID 仍保持 `session_…` 形式

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a screen reader announcement, "Message queued.", when you send a message while Claude is working
entries.zh: [VSCode] Claude 工作时发送消息，会向屏幕阅读器播报「Message queued.」

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a way to review and run a plugin marketplace's install or update command from the Manage plugins dialog
entries.zh: [VSCode] 管理插件对话框新增功能，可查看并运行插件市场的安装或更新命令

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a blank chat you never typed into keeping a background Claude process running after you open a saved conversation in its place
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复你打开已保存对话时，未输入任何内容的空白聊天仍让后台 Claude 进程保持运行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs blaming a timeout when Claude Code stopped unexpectedly during a save
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude Code 在保存过程中意外停止时，设置对话框错误地归咎于超时的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the branch switch dialog offering to switch when it could not check for uncommitted changes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复分支切换对话框在无法检查未提交更改时，仍提供切换选项的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a permission prompt that arrived behind an open dialog taking keyboard focus, so a key pressed in the dialog could answer it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复权限提示出现在已打开的对话框后面时，会抢走键盘焦点，导致在对话框中按的键会误答该提示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-in and new sessions giving no clear reason when Claude Code cannot find or start its program
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude Code 找不到或无法启动其程序时，登录和新会话没有给出明确原因的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the agent map showing a nested sub-agent with "Tool calls (0)" and placing the agents it starts under the main agent
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 agent 地图显示嵌套子 agent 为 "Tool calls (0)"，并把它启动的 agent 放在主 agent 下面的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved Continue After Reload: tabs reopened after VS Code restarts its extensions now also finish a step the restart interrupted
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进 Continue After Reload：VS Code 重启扩展后重新打开的标签页，现在也会完成被重启打断的步骤

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved file pills in messages: hovering one now shows the file's path from the project folder, so same-named files can be told apart
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进消息中的文件标签：悬停时会显示相对于项目文件夹的路径，便于区分同名文件

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed message timestamps to show by default (turn them off with the Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps setting)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 消息时间戳默认显示（可通过 Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps 设置关闭）

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed turning off prompt suggestions through a cloud environment's environment variables having no effect in new cloud sessions
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复通过云端环境变量关闭提示建议功能，在新云端会话中无效的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the working indicator in a cloud session spinning on for several seconds after Claude's reply had finished; it now stops with the reply
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复 Claude 回复结束后，云端会话的工作指示器仍转动数秒的问题；现在会随回复一起停止

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed History on a never-run routine's page still saying "No runs yet" after you pressed Run now; it now shows the new run
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复从未运行过的例程页面中，点击 Run now 后「History」仍显示「No runs yet」的问题；现在会显示新的运行记录

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed an unarchived cloud session looking as if Claude were still working until you sent another message
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复取消归档的云端会话看起来仍在工作，直到你发送下一条消息的问题

entries.en: [Remote Control] Fixed a computer that just started Remote Control taking up to a minute to appear in the Remote Control menu of a new session; it now appears within seconds
entries.zh: [Remote Control] 修复刚启动 Remote Control 的电脑，在新会话的 Remote Control 菜单中最多需要一分钟才出现的问题；现在几秒内即可显示

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added fast mode in Slack: mention Claude with `!fast` to switch a thread to fast mode, moving it to Opus if needed, and `!fast off` to switch back; replies show (fast) while it's on
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Slack 新增快速模式：在消息中 @Claude 并加上 `!fast` 可把话题切换为快速模式（必要时切到 Opus），`!fast off` 切回；开启期间回复会显示 (fast)

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added the optional Path prefixes field when creating a custom connection in an access bundle, so its allow rule can cover only those paths instead of the whole host
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 在访问包中创建自定义连接时，新增可选的「Path prefixes」字段，使其允许规则只覆盖指定路径，而不是整个主机

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed members with the Claude Tag Admin permission getting "Couldn't load memory files" on the Activity page's Memory tab; they can now read workspace and channel memory
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复拥有 Claude Tag Admin 权限的成员，在活动页面的 Memory 标签页中显示「Couldn't load memory files」的问题；现在他们可以读取工作区和频道的记忆

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a workspace guest's Confirm on a Claude settings card in Slack removing its buttons for everyone; only the guest sees the refusal, and members can still confirm or cancel
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复工作区访客在 Slack 的 Claude 设置卡片上点击 Confirm 时，会让所有人的按钮消失的问题；现在只有访客看到拒绝提示，成员仍可确认或取消

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled routines in Slack channels running on a model other than the channel's default; each run that starts a new session now uses the current default model
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 频道中的定时例程使用的不是频道默认模型的问题；现在每个启动新会话的运行都会使用当前默认模型

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed GitHub repositories in an access bundle attached by a channel-name rule being refused in the channels the rule covers; Claude can now add, list and clone them there
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复通过频道名称规则附加的访问包中，GitHub 仓库在规则覆盖的频道中被拒绝的问题；现在 Claude 可以在这些频道中添加、列出和克隆它们

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's notice in your direct messages when your own Claude plan's usage limit is reached: it shows within seconds and says when the limit resets
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进你自己的 Claude 套餐用量达到上限时，Claude 在你私信中的提示：几秒内即可显示，并说明限额何时重置

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the earlier Claude in Slack app's reply when it can't start a session: it now says what failed and who can fix it, in full only once per thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进较早的 Claude in Slack 应用在无法启动会话时的回复：现在会说明失败原因以及由谁来修复，完整说明每个话题只显示一次

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the channel instructions limit to 8,192 characters instead of bytes, so non-English text gets the same room, and added a character count beside Save on the Configure page
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 频道指令的长度限制改为 8,192 个字符（原为字节），使非英文文本有同样的空间；配置页面的保存按钮旁新增字符计数

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed blocking review comments sometimes opening with a "nit" label that contradicted their severity
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复阻塞性审查评论有时以与严重程度相矛盾的「nit」标签开头的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed tips to comment "@claude review" being posted on fork and Manual-mode pull requests in organizations that have turned Code Review off
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复在已关闭 Code Review 的组织中，提示用户评论「@claude review」的内容仍发布在 fork 和手动模式的拉取请求上的问题

entries.en: Fixed a deny or ask rule on a nested part of a compound shell command not holding over a user-installed mod's approval on managed machines
entries.zh: 修复了复合 shell 命令嵌套部分的拒绝或询问规则，该规则不支持受管计算机上用户安装的 mod 的批准

entries.en: Fixed the terminal freezing on short code blocks with many unclosed `<script>` tags or deeply nested `${` substitutions
entries.zh: 修复短代码块中含大量未闭合 `<script>` 标签或深层嵌套 `${` 替换时，终端冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Read` deny rules not applying to files @-mentioned, changed, or selected in the IDE through a symlink
entries.zh: 修复了“读取”拒绝规则不适用于通过符号链接在 IDE 中提及、更改或选择的文件

entries.en: [VSCode] Reverted a 2.1.288 change to `claude auth status` that may have made sign-outs more frequent
entries.zh: [VSCode] 撤销 2.1.288 中对 `claude auth status` 的一项改动，该改动可能导致登出更加频繁

entries.en: Improved how quickly large files open in a plugin code pane by laying the highlighted view out once at its final width
entries.zh: 改进插件代码面板中大文件的打开速度：高亮视图只按最终宽度排版一次

entries.en: Fixed `plugin list`, `plugin eval` and `plugin update` showing a stale copy of a plugin installed from a local folder marketplace, and hot reload for a symlinked `--plugin-dir`
entries.zh: 修复了“插件列表”、“插件评估”和“插件更新”显示从本地文件夹市场安装的插件的过时副本，以及符号链接`--plugin-dir`的热重载

entries.en: Fixed installed mods not loading in the first session after an upgrade
entries.zh: 修复了升级后第一个会话中未加载已安装模组的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's rows above the prompt showing a stale row while the Background tasks dialog was open in fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复了当后台任务对话框全屏打开时，提示上方的插件行显示过时的行

entries.en: Fixed plugin panes drawing nothing when a link used a localhost address, an `@` in its path, an uppercase host or a `file:` path
entries.zh: 修复了当链接使用本地主机地址、路径中的`@`、大写主机或`file:`路径时插件窗格不显示任何内容的问题

entries.en: Fixed a user-installed plugin being able to rewrite the descriptions of an organization-managed MCP server's sign-in tools
entries.zh: 修复了用户安装的插件能够重写组织管理的 MCP 服务器登录工具的描述

entries.en: Fixed a freeze or forced quit at launch when a plugin drew a Box with a border style the terminal does not know
entries.zh: 修复了当插件绘制具有终端不知道的边框样式的框时启动时冻结或强制退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed supervised and background sessions ending when a plugin's on-screen handler threw asynchronously
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的屏幕处理程序异步抛出时结束的受监督和后台会话

entries.en: Fixed sessions ending with an interface error when a plugin region with no height kept growing
entries.zh: 修复了当没有高度的插件区域持续增长时以界面错误结束的会话

entries.en: Fixed Bash deny and ask rules missing a command behind an environment variable prefix with an expanded value (e.g. `TZ="$HOME" rm -rf build`) when the sandbox auto-allows commands
entries.zh: 修复了当沙箱自动允许命令时，Bash 拒绝和询问规则缺少带有扩展值的环境变量前缀后面的命令（例如 `TZ="$HOME" rm -rf build`）

entries.en: Fixed a Bash deny or ask rule being skipped under sandbox auto-allow when a bare variable assignment came before the command
entries.zh: 修复了当命令之前出现裸变量赋值时在沙箱自动允许下跳过 Bash 拒绝或询问规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` skipping the plugin when the folder also holds a marketplace manifest
entries.zh: 修复了当文件夹还包含市场清单时`claude plugin validate`跳过插件的问题

entries.en: Added `agent.spawn` for teammates, one agent id across plugin hook events, and idle and waiting states in `$.agent.list()`
entries.zh: 为队友添加了`agent.spawn`，跨插件挂钩事件的一个代理 ID，以及`$.agent.list()`中的空闲和等待状态

entries.en: Fixed sessions ending with "unrecoverable interface error" when a value a mod's `ui.render` hook wrote made a row throw while drawn; the engine now draws its own row instead
entries.zh: 修复了当 mod 的 `ui.render` 钩子写入的值在绘制时引发行抛出时以“不可恢复的接口错误”结束的会话；引擎现在绘制自己的行

entries.en: Fixed text with a tab, a stray escape and a C1 control, or a short text with a tab and CRLF line endings, drawing over the rows below it
entries.zh: 修复包含 Tab、杂散转义符和 C1 控制字符的文本，或带 Tab 与 CRLF 换行的短文本，覆盖在下方行上的问题

entries.en: Fixed right-aligned content in a mod's pane or band drawing under the close mark or `[-]`, which now also keep one column in from the terminal's edge
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 窗格中的右对齐内容或关闭标记或`[-]`下的带状图，现在还从终端边缘保留一列

entries.en: Fixed a mod's `Client` that fails while drawn taking down everything the mod drew around it; it now fails alone and raises `ui.fault`
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的“客户端”在绘制时失败，并删除了 mod 在其周围绘制的所有内容；现在它单独失败并引发`ui.fault`

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` failing an Anthropic marketplace's own plugin and listing a clean `plugin.json` in `--json`
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件验证”使 Anthropic 市场自己的插件失败并在`--json`中列出干净的`plugin.json`的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's band that fails to draw briefly telling the cards under it to step aside
entries.zh: 修复了模组的乐队无法短暂绘制并告诉其下方的卡牌靠边的问题

entries.en: Fixed a failed plugin component showing `Error` or nothing as its reason when the failure carried no message
entries.zh: 修复了失败的插件组件，当失败不携带任何消息时，显示“错误”或没有任何内容作为其原因

entries.en: Improved the line a mod's author sees when its band or pane fails to draw: it names the mod and says nothing was drawn
entries.zh: 改进 mod 作者看到的信息：当 mod 的条带或窗格绘制失败时，会点明是哪个 mod，并说明什么都没画出来

entries.en: Fixed published artifact pages freezing or crashing the reader's browser tab on short code blocks with many unclosed `<script>` tags
entries.zh: 修复了已发布的工件页面在带有许多未封闭的`<script>`标签的短代码块上冻结或崩溃读者浏览器选项卡的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's Client region staying failed for the whole session after the terminal threw while drawing it
entries.zh: 修复了绘制时终端抛出异常后 mod 的客户端区域在整个会话中保持失败的问题

entries.en: Added `$.ui.selection()` for mods: returns the text you last selected in fullscreen mode and, when the selection lies within one transcript row, that row
entries.zh: 为 mods 添加了 `$.ui.selection()`：返回您最后在全屏模式下选择的文本，并且当选择位于一个记录行内时，返回该行

entries.en: Added a built-in `gh api` to cloud sessions whose image has no GitHub CLI, and fixed the built-in sending control characters from file names, jq filters or GitHub errors to the terminal
entries.zh: 为镜像没有 GitHub CLI 的云会话添加了内置的`gh api`，并修复了从文件名、jq 过滤器或 GitHub 错误到终端的内置发送控制字符的问题

entries.en: Added recovery for a prompt cleared with Ctrl+C: pressing Up on the empty prompt brings the draft back, including pasted text and images
entries.zh: 添加了对使用 Ctrl+C 清除的提示的恢复：在空提示上按向上键可恢复草稿，包括粘贴的文本和图像

entries.en: Added a re-authenticate prompt when an MCP server asks for more OAuth scope during a tool call
entries.zh: 当 MCP 服务器在工具调用期间请求更多 OAuth 范围时添加了重新身份验证提示

entries.en: Added `--max-findings <n>|all` to /code-review to report more or fewer findings than the usual limit; the choice is reused until you pass `--max-findings default`
entries.zh: 在 /code-review 中添加了 `--max-findings <n>|all` 以报告比通常限制更多或更少的发现；该选择将被重复使用，直到您通过`--max-findings default`

entries.en: Added Ctrl+F to find a session by name and Alt+↑/↓ to jump between groups in the agents view; both, and rename, can be rebound in keybindings.json
entries.zh: 添加了 Ctrl+F 按名称查找会话和 Alt+↑/↓ 在代理视图中的组之间跳转；两者和重命名都可以在 keybindings.json 中反弹

entries.en: Added a screen reader mode announcement of the new permission mode when you approve a plan, including with Shift+Tab
entries.zh: 添加了批准计划时新权限模式的屏幕阅读器模式公告，包括使用 Shift+Tab

entries.en: Fixed mid-response API timeouts failing the turn: non-interactive sessions and subagents now continue from the partial response, and thinking-only responses are retried
entries.zh: 修复了中间响应 API 超时失败的问题：非交互式会话和子代理现在从部分响应继续，并且仅重试仅思考响应

entries.en: Fixed long conversations failing with "Prompt is too long" instead of auto-compacting when the last reply reported zero token usage
entries.zh: 修复了当最后一个回复报告零令牌使用时，长对话失败并显示“提示太长”而不是自动压缩的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` sometimes dropping files and other context that a compaction had just restored
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`有时会删除压缩刚刚恢复的文件和其他上下文的问题

entries.en: Fixed a resumed session sometimes not saving the last response of a turn, so that the next `--resume` showed the prompt unanswered
entries.zh: 修复了恢复的会话有时不保存回合的最后一个响应，以便下一个`--resume`显示未应答的提示

entries.en: Fixed resume occasionally loading a transcript cut short when the same session rewrote the file during the load
entries.zh: 修复了当同一会话在加载期间重写文件时，简历偶尔加载记录会被缩短的问题

entries.en: Fixed resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier dropping the model's earlier thinking
entries.zh: 修复了恢复从 2.1.286 或更早版本开始的对话，从而放弃模型的早期思考

entries.en: Fixed session titles, memory recall and prompt hooks failing on Mantle or behind gateways that reject structured outputs; added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS` to turn structured outputs off
entries.zh: 修复了 Mantle 上或拒绝结构化输出的网关后面的会话标题、记忆调用和提示挂钩失败的问题；添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS`以关闭结构化输出

entries.en: Fixed auto mode denials pointing Claude at a Bash permission rule when the blocked tool was not Bash
entries.zh: 修复了当被阻止的工具不是 Bash 时自动模式拒绝将 Claude 指向 Bash 权限规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode on Bedrock and Mantle switching to the local classifier for the rest of the session after a request to an older model, such as a WebFetch summary or a `sonnet` subagent
entries.zh: 修复了在请求旧模型（例如 WebFetch 摘要或`sonnet`子代理）后，Bedrock 和 Mantle 上的自动模式切换到本地分类器以进行会话的其余部分

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions that restarted on a newly picked model replying with that model after the server refused it
entries.zh: 修复了在服务器拒绝后在新选择的模型上重新启动并回复该模型的云会话

entries.en: Fixed Cowork cloud sessions staying marked as waiting for input after a WebFetch permission prompt for an unapproved URL went unanswered for five minutes
entries.zh: 修复了在未批准 URL 的 WebFetch 权限提示五分钟内无人应答后，Cowork 云会话仍标记为等待输入的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions not appearing on a phone that joins a Cowork cloud session started on another device
entries.zh: 修复了加入在另一台设备上启动的 Cowork 云会话的手机上未出现提示建议的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's button sometimes running a different button's action when pressed on a view drawn before Claude Code restarted
entries.zh: 修复了在克劳德代码重新启动之前绘制的视图上按下时，mod 的按钮有时会运行不同按钮的操作

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's pane showing nothing when one `Code` element held a diff that does not parse; it now draws as plain code
entries.zh: 修复了当一个`Code`元素包含无法解析的差异时插件窗格不显示任何内容的问题；它现在绘制为纯代码

entries.en: Fixed plugin LSP servers receiving literal `${user_config.*}` and `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` placeholders in `initializationOptions` and `settings` instead of substituted values or manifest defaults
entries.zh: 修复了插件 LSP 服务器在`initializationOptions`和`settings`中接收文字`${user_config.*}`和`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`占位符，而不是替换值或清单默认值

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's `tool.call` hook making Bash fail and file searches read the wrong folder in subagents that run in a worktree
entries.zh: 修复了插件的`tool.call`钩子导致 Bash 失败并且文件搜索读取工作树中运行的子代理中的错误文件夹

entries.en: Fixed `git-subdir` plugin installs failing, or caching an incomplete plugin, on older git (before 2.39, e.g. Ubuntu 22.04's 2.34)
entries.zh: 修复了旧版 git 上`git-subdir`插件安装失败或缓存不完整插件的问题（2.39 之前的版本，例如 Ubuntu 22.04 的 2.34）

entries.en: Fixed plugins loaded with `--plugin-dir` not showing "Configure options" in `/plugin`
entries.zh: 修复了使用 `--plugin-dir` 加载的插件未在 `/plugin` 中显示“配置选项”

entries.en: Fixed background sessions ending when a plugin was reloaded or disabled while one of its timers or reads was still running
entries.zh: 修复了当插件重新加载或禁用而其计时器或读取之一仍在运行时后台会话结束的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed heredocs with an unquoted delimiter (`python3 <<EOF`) asking for approval on every run under sandbox auto-allow when the body holds only plain text and simple `$VAR` references
entries.zh: 修复了带有不带引号的分隔符 (`python3 <<EOF`) 的沙盒文档，当主体仅包含纯文本和简单的 `$VAR` 引用时，要求沙盒自动允许下的每次运行都获得批准

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool permission check to prompt before a `BASHPID` assignment whose value the shell would evaluate as arithmetic, instead of allowing it silently
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具权限检查，以在`BASHPID`分配之前进行提示，shell 会将其值评估为算术值，而不是默默地允许它

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen sessions exiting with "unrecoverable interface error" when opening the background tasks dialog while a plugin or mod showed rows above the prompt
entries.zh: 修复了当插件或 mod 在提示上方显示行时打开后台任务对话框时，全屏会话因“不可恢复的界面错误”而退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude reporting a message to another session as delivered when that session held it: the notice now says it wasn't delivered and names the session, and in SDK sessions Claude can now learn of it mid-turn
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 将消息报告给另一个会话时该会话持有该消息时已传递的问题：通知现在显示该消息未传递并命名该会话，并且在 SDK 会话中 Claude 现在可以在中途了解该消息

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry `claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user` spans reporting `unknown` source or decision in `-p` and SDK sessions and for PreToolUse hook approvals
entries.zh: 修复了 OpenTelemetry`claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user`在`-p`和 SDK 会话以及 PreToolUse 挂钩批准中报告“未知”来源或决策的问题

entries.en: Fixed permission asks that ended unanswered, in `-p` or on an interrupted turn, emitting no `tool_decision` event
entries.zh: 修复了在`-p`中或在中断的回合中未得到答复而结束的权限请求，不发出`tool_decision`事件

entries.en: Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork cloud sessions refusing a message sent before `/compact` even though its history was still saved
entries.zh: 修复了 Cowork 云会话中的编辑和重试拒绝在`/compact`之前发送的消息，即使其历史记录仍被保存

entries.en: Fixed unattended sessions (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) retrying for hours after a very long response stream failed; Claude Code now streams again, and gives up after three timeouts
entries.zh: 修复无人值守会话（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`）在超长响应流失败后会重试数小时的问题；现在 Claude Code 会重新流式输出，并在三次超时后放弃

entries.en: Fixed `/login` reporting "Login successful" when credentials could not be saved to secure storage; it now shows the failure, and offers a retry when the new login didn't take effect (anthropics/claude-code#73861)
entries.zh: 修复了当凭证无法保存到安全存储时`/login`报告“登录成功”的问题；它现在显示失败，并在新登录未生效时提供重试（anthropics/claude-code#73861）

entries.en: Fixed a Stop during Bedrock credential lookup sometimes moving the session to a fallback model instead of ending the request
entries.zh: 修复了基岩凭证查找期间的停止有时会将会话移动到后备模型而不是结束请求

entries.en: Fixed a second `gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh` browser sign-in opening when a laptop wakes from sleep while another Claude Code process is signing in
entries.zh: 修复了当笔记本电脑从睡眠状态唤醒而另一个 Claude Code 进程正在登录时，第二个`gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh`浏览器登录打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: a plugin-defined agent spawned by name now runs with its own prompt, tools, disallowedTools and effort instead of the defaults
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：按名称生成的插件定义代理现在使用自己的提示、工具、disallowedTools 和工作量运行，而不是默认值

entries.en: Fixed headless (`-p` / SDK) sessions occasionally ignoring SIGTERM when a supervisor such as `timeout` or systemd sends SIGCONT alongside it
entries.zh: 修复了当`timeout`或 systemd 等监督者同时发送 SIGCONT 时，无头（`-p`/SDK）会话偶尔会忽略 SIGTERM

entries.en: Fixed restarted cloud sessions restoring a model that the organization's enforced model list refuses
entries.zh: 修复了重新启动的云会话恢复组织强制模型列表拒绝的模型

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls sometimes running twice when a remote server's result was over 16 MB or could not be parsed
entries.zh: 修复了当远程服务器的结果超过 16 MB 或无法解析时，MCP 工具调用有时会运行两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents in Claude Desktop's Code tab getting none of the tools of a user-configured MCP server named `memory`
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Desktop 的“代码”选项卡中的子代理无法获取用户配置的名为“内存”的 MCP 服务器的任何工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome asking before every screenshot and page read on a site you allowed when auto mode is unavailable (such as with `disableAutoMode` or an older model); typing, navigation and JavaScript still ask
entries.zh: 修复了当自动模式不可用时（例如使用`disableAutoMode`或旧型号）时，Chrome 中的 Claude 在您允许的网站上读取每个屏幕截图和页面之前询问的问题；打字、导航和 JavaScript 仍然有问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub-source plugins on macOS and Linux machines with no GitHub SSH key: the clone now falls back to HTTPS and prints a notice
entries.zh: 修复了在没有 GitHub SSH 密钥的 macOS 和 Linux 计算机上 GitHub 源插件安装失败的问题：克隆现在回退到 HTTPS 并打印通知

entries.en: Fixed `sandbox.credentials.files` entries on git config files not taking effect while `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` is on
entries.zh: 修复了 git 配置文件中的`sandbox.credentials.files`条目在`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`打开时不生效的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude leaving out your organization's design systems when starting slides or a design with the Artifact tool on Team and Enterprise plans or machines with managed settings
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在使用团队和企业计划或具有托管设置的机器上的 Artifact 工具启动幻灯片或设计时遗漏了组织的设计系统的问题

entries.en: Fixed the keyboard not working on Windows after Claude Code restarts itself (first sign-in to a Claude apps gateway, provider setup, `/tui`)
entries.zh: 修复 Claude Code 自行重启后（如首次登录 Claude 应用网关、服务商设置、`/tui`），Windows 上键盘失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed a stall when launching an agent whose `tools:` lists very many `Agent(...)` entries
entries.zh: 修复了启动“工具：”列出大量`Agent(...)`条目的代理时出现的停顿

entries.en: Fixed sessions on Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3 Sonnet failing on every turn after a whole PDF entered the conversation
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 3 Opus 和 Claude 3 Sonnet 上的会话在整个 PDF 进入对话后每次都会失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed the npm auto-updater reporting success when the platform-native binary failed to download and only the placeholder `claude` stub was installed
entries.zh: 修复 npm 自动更新程序在原生二进制下载失败、只安装了占位 `claude` 存根时仍报告成功的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control cleanup archiving a session that is still connected or was just re-attached by another Claude Code process
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制清理归档仍处于连接状态或刚刚被另一个 Claude Code 进程重新附加的会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `owner/repo` plugin marketplaces showing only the second attempt's error when both the SSH and HTTPS fetch fail; both errors are now shown, with the transport tried first on top
entries.zh: 修复了当 SSH 和 HTTPS 获取失败时`owner/repo`插件市场仅显示第二次尝试的错误；现在显示了两个错误，首先尝试的传输位于顶部

entries.en: Fixed path-scoped `.claude/rules` and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Write or Edit creates or changes a file in their scope (previously only Read loaded them)
entries.zh: 修复了当“写入”或“编辑”在其范围内创建或更改文件时，路径范围的`.claude/rules`和嵌套的 CLAUDE.md 文件不会加载（以前只能读取加载它们）

entries.en: Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) inside a `bash -c` or `sh -c` script running without a prompt in bypassPermissions mode or under a shell allow rule (anthropics/claude-code#96300)
entries.zh: 修复了`bash -c`或`sh -c`脚本中危险的`rm`（例如`/`或主目录上的一个），在bypassPermissions模式下或在shell允许规则下没有提示的情况下运行（anthropics/claude-code#96300）

entries.en: Fixed LSP tool calls hanging indefinitely when a language server uses dynamic capability registration or stops responding; requests now time out after 60s (per-server `requestTimeout`)
entries.zh: 修复了语言服务器使用动态能力注册或停止响应时 LSP 工具调用无限期挂起的问题；现在请求会在 60 秒后超时（每个服务器`requestTimeout`）

entries.en: Fixed `idle_prompt` notification hooks firing while background agents are still running (anthropics/claude-code#93672)
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理仍在运行时触发的`idle_prompt`通知挂钩（anthropics/claude-code#93672）

entries.en: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks being skipped when matching them failed or the tool's input could not be serialized to JSON; the call is now blocked
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse 和 PermissionRequest 钩子在匹配失败或工具的输入无法序列化为 JSON 时被跳过的问题；呼叫现已被阻止

entries.en: Fixed the first request in a fresh environment or after a model switch using the built-in output limit and auto-compact window, not the server's; that request may now wait up to 1.5 seconds
entries.zh: 修复全新环境中或切换模型后的第一个请求，使用的是内置输出上限和自动压缩窗口，而非服务器下发的值的问题；现在该请求可能最多等待 1.5 秒

entries.en: Fixed the "What should Claude do instead?" hint showing on the Interrupted row after sending queued messages with ctrl+enter
entries.zh: 修正了“克劳德应该做什么？”使用 ctrl+enter 发送排队消息后，提示显示在中断行上

entries.en: Fixed `/login` in a `--bare` session running a sign-in the session never reads, which could replace your saved login; it now says which credentials work
entries.zh: 修复了运行登录的`--bare`会话中的`/login`，该会话永远不会读取，这可能会替换您保存的登录信息；现在它会说明哪些凭据有效

entries.en: Fixed the InstructionsLoaded hook omitting agent_id and agent_type when a subagent's file access loads a rule or nested CLAUDE.md; rules and nested CLAUDE.md files loaded on file access now also report effort
entries.zh: 修复子智能体访问文件加载规则或嵌套 CLAUDE.md 时，InstructionsLoaded 钩子漏掉 agent_id 和 agent_type 的问题；现在按文件访问加载的规则和嵌套 CLAUDE.md 也会上报 effort

entries.en: Fixed the Agent tool in `claude mcp serve` always reporting no available agents and rejecting every subagent_type
entries.zh: 修复了“claude mcpserve”中的代理工具始终报告没有可用代理并拒绝每个 subagent_type

entries.en: Fixed the terminal cursor not following the typed text in the fullscreen transcript viewer's search and in `/theme`'s custom color search
entries.zh: 修复全屏转录查看器的搜索和 `/theme` 的自定义颜色搜索中，终端光标不跟随输入文字的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/permissions` in screen reader mode: typing a rule's number now picks it instead of opening the search box
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式下的`/permissions`：现在输入规则编号即可选择它，而不是打开搜索框

entries.en: Improved auto mode: when a conversation grows too long for the client-side safety classifier to review, it is now compacted instead of prompting for, or failing, every tool call
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：对话长到客户端安全分类器无法审查时，会先压缩，而不是对每个工具调用都弹窗询问或直接失败

entries.en: Improved screen reader mode: short announcements, such as a deleted word, now stay on screen until your next key press or until something above them on screen changes
entries.zh: 改进屏幕阅读器模式：简短提示（如删除了一个词）会一直停留在屏幕上，直到你按下下一个键，或其上方内容发生变化

entries.en: Improved screen reader mode: answered questions in question dialogs now say "answered" beside their box
entries.zh: 改进屏幕阅读器模式：问题对话框中已回答的问题，框旁会显示「answered」

entries.en: Improved the `/usage-credits` message shown to Team and Enterprise members whose organization has turned off usage credit requests
entries.zh: 改进 `/usage-credits` 提示：对于所在组织已关闭用量积分申请的 Team 和 Enterprise 成员，会显示相应说明

entries.en: Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for a stdio MCP server whose config sets `alwaysLoad: false`
entries.zh: 改进云会话：`alwaysLoad: false` 的 stdio MCP 服务器尚未就绪时，新对话的第一轮不再等待它

entries.en: Improved "You should know" notes to say "we", "the main agent" or "you" depending on who was responsible for a decision
entries.zh: 改进“You should know”提示的措辞：根据决定是谁做的，改用“我们”、“主代理”或“你”

entries.en: Improved the error for an artifact database write refused at the database's size limit: it now states the limit and what frees space
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 数据库写入因达到大小上限被拒绝时的报错：会说明上限是多少，以及什么可以释放空间

entries.en: Improved Bash permission prompts to give a shorter reason when part of a command can't be checked before it runs
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 权限弹窗：命令中有部分内容无法在运行前检查时，给出更简短的理由

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Improved the built-in `gh api`: a refused gh command now prints its `gh api` equivalent, `--paginate` follows every page of a repository's lists, and a nested `claude` no longer removes it
entries.zh: 改进了内置的 `gh api`：被拒绝的 gh 命令会打印其等效的 `gh api` 写法，`--paginate` 会翻完仓库列表的每一页，嵌套的 `claude` 也不再移除它

entries.en: Improved Remote Control's recovery from an expired server credential: sessions stay connected during renewal and are kept if it gives up after a server outage
entries.zh: 改进远程控制对过期服务端凭证的恢复：续期期间会话保持连接；即使服务器故障后放弃续期，会话也会保留

entries.en: Changed the background command time limit to apply only in unattended sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK, CI, cloud); terminal, desktop app and VS Code sessions have no limit
entries.zh: 更改了后台命令时间限制，使其仅适用于无人值守会话（`-p`、Agent SDK、CI、云）；终端、桌面应用程序和 VS Code 会话没有限制

entries.en: Changed the client-side auto mode classifier to ignore an `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` pin that names Claude Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 and use Claude Sonnet 5 instead
entries.zh: 更改了客户端自动模式分类器，以忽略命名 Claude Sonnet 5.5 或 Opus 5.5 的`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`引脚，并改用 Claude Sonnet 5

entries.en: Changed `claude project purge` to `claude purge`; the old name still works and prints a notice
entries.zh: 将“克劳德项目清除”更改为“克劳德清除”；旧名称仍然有效并打印通知

entries.en: Changed the agents view `n:` filter (and Ctrl+F search) so Enter opens the session whose name matches best instead of the top row
entries.zh: 更改了代理视图`n:`过滤器（和 Ctrl+F 搜索），以便按 Enter 键打开名称最匹配的会话，而不是顶行

entries.en: Changed `/autocompact` to save the auto-compact window per model, so each model keeps its own setting when you switch
entries.zh: 更改了`/autocompact`以保存每个模型的自动压缩窗口，因此当您切换时每个模型都会保留自己的设置

entries.en: Changed MCP URL prompts from servers that can't report when you're done to wait for "I'm done, continue" before the tool call continues, so you can finish in the browser first
entries.zh: 更改了无法报告完成时间的服务器的 MCP URL 提示，以便在工具调用继续之前等待“我完成了，继续”，以便您可以先在浏览器中完成

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a claude.ai connector staying on "Needs authentication" after you authorize it: the MCP servers dialog now offers Check connection
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 claude.ai 连接器授权后仍显示 "Needs authentication" 的问题：MCP 服务器对话框现在提供 Check connection 选项

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the opt-in New Conversation shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+N) starting a conversation in every visible Claude view instead of only the one you are in
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复可选的 New Conversation 快捷键（Cmd/Ctrl+N）会在所有可见的 Claude 视图中各开始一个对话、而不是只在当前视图中开始的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat view resuming the next saved session after you archive the one it shows; it now starts a new conversation instead
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复归档当前显示的会话后，聊天视图会恢复到下一个已保存会话的问题；现在改为开始新对话

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Cloud sessions switch in Claude Code admin settings staying locked off while an unrelated security setting was loading or had failed to load
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复无关的安全设置加载中或加载失败时，Claude Code 管理设置中的云端会话开关一直锁定关闭的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed pressing Stop while a self-hosted runner was still starting not cancelling the queued message, which could then run once the runner was up
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复自托管运行器仍在启动时按下 Stop，排队中的消息没有取消、运行器启动后仍会执行的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin settings offering a "Remove this scope" option, which always failed, on channels whose settings were created automatically
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 管理设置在自动创建设置的频道上，显示总是失败的「Remove this scope」选项的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude to also follow a related Slack thread in another channel that it only read, so updates there reach the conversation that depends on them
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude：对于它只读过的另一个频道中的相关 Slack 话题，也会跟进，使那里的更新能传达给依赖它们的对话

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved save errors on a channel's Configure page: too-long channel instructions now say to shorten them, and a save refused for lost access no longer says to try again
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进频道配置页面的保存错误提示：频道指令过长时会提示缩短，因失去访问权限而被拒绝的保存不再提示你重试

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin test` reporting mods as turned off remotely when it had only read an out-of-date saved setting
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德插件测试”报告模块在仅读取过时的保存设置时远程关闭的问题

entries.en: Added Claude Mods: plugins may now modify deeper behavior
entries.zh: 添加了克劳德模组：插件现在可以修改更深层次的行为

entries.en: Added You should know, a built-in mod where a side agent watches your back and flags things you or Claude might miss. Turn it on with `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin` (for first-party sessions with telemetry on)
entries.zh: 添加了“你应该知道”，这是一个内置模组，其中有一个侧面代理监视您的背后并标记您或克劳德可能错过的事情。使用`/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin`将其打开（对于启用遥测功能的第一方会话）

entries.en: Added an `n:<text>` filter to the agents view that matches session names and tasks; a filter now shows matches in collapsed sections and Enter opens the first match
entries.zh: 在代理视图中添加了一个`n:<text>`过滤器来匹配会话名称和任务；现在，过滤器会显示折叠部分中的匹配项，然后按 Enter 键打开第一个匹配项

entries.en: Added `prompt_text` to the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event, a copy of `prompt` for backends that nest dotted keys; drop or mask it wherever you drop or mask `prompt` (anthropics/claude-code#70763)
entries.zh: 将`prompt_text`添加到 OpenTelemetry`user_prompt`事件中，这是嵌套点键后端的`prompt`的副本；无论您在何处删除或屏蔽“提示”，都将其删除或屏蔽（anthropics/claude-code#70763）

entries.en: Added URL prompts from MCP servers on the 2025-11-25 protocol, for example to sign in. If a server no longer connects after this update, add "bareElicitationCapability": true to its MCP config entry
entries.zh: 添加了来自 2025-11-25 协议的 MCP 服务器的 URL 提示，例如登录。如果服务器在此更新后不再连接，请将 "bareElicitationCapability": true 添加到其 MCP 配置条目

entries.en: Windows: Added a startup warning when denying the Bash tool also turns off the PowerShell tool, so Claude has no shell tool
entries.zh: Windows：拒绝 Bash 工具时若同时关闭了 PowerShell 工具，现在会给出启动警告，使 Claude 没有任何可用的 shell 工具

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added a built-in `gh api` (REST only) for sessions that use Anthropic-managed git on macOS and Linux machines where the GitHub CLI is not installed
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：为使用 Anthropic 托管 git 且未安装 GitHub CLI 的 macOS 和 Linux 机器，新增内置的 `gh api`（仅 REST）

entries.en: Fixed fast mode staying off in remote sessions owned by an agent with no user account, even when the organization allows it
entries.zh: 修复了快速模式在没有用户帐户的代理拥有的远程会话中保持关闭的问题，即使组织允许

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control not receiving messages for minutes at a time when a reconnect request got no response; it now gives up after 30 seconds and retries
entries.zh: 修复了重新连接请求未得到响应时远程控制有时无法接收消息的问题；现在它会在 30 秒后放弃并重试

entries.en: Fixed hooks configured with `asyncRewake` waking Claude over and over with "found issues" notifications when the hook's script file is missing; the broken hook is now reported once
entries.zh: 修复了配置了`asyncRewake`的钩子，当钩子的脚本文件丢失时，会一遍又一遍地用“发现问题”通知唤醒克劳德；现在报告一次损坏的钩子

entries.en: Fixed tool heartbeats not reaching SDK hosts while the model's response stream was stalled with no data arriving
entries.zh: 修复模型响应流停滞、长时间没有数据到达时，工具心跳无法送达 SDK 宿主的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock and Vertex startup model checks ignoring an enforced `availableModels` list, which could collapse `/model` to one Opus row
entries.zh: 修复了 Bedrock 和 Vertex 启动模型检查忽略强制执行的`availableModels`列表，该列表可能会将`/model`折叠到一个 Opus 行

entries.en: Fixed the Claude in Chrome browser picker showing a JSON parse error when Chrome could not be reached
entries.zh: 修复 Claude in Chrome 浏览器选择器在无法连接 Chrome 时显示 JSON 解析错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed picking Fable in `/model` on a claude.ai login saving the current version's id, so your saved default now follows the newest Fable like Opus and Sonnet do
entries.zh: 修复了在 claude.ai 登录时在`/model`中选择《寓言》的问题，保存当前版本的 ID，因此您保存的默认值现在遵循最新的《寓言》，就像 Opus 和 Sonnet 一样

entries.en: Fixed switching between Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 (`/model`, `opusplan`) rewriting earlier MCP tool announcements, which could drop earlier extended thinking
entries.zh: 修复了 Opus 5.5 和 Sonnet 5.5（`/model`、`opusplan`）之间的切换，重写了早期的 MCP 工具公告，这可能会放弃早期的扩展思维

entries.en: Fixed Amazon Bedrock Guardrails blocks that arrive mid-response ending the turn with an API error instead of the guardrail's message when the reply began with thinking
entries.zh: 修复了在响应中途到达的 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 块，当回复开始思考时，会以 API 错误结束回合，而不是护栏消息

entries.en: Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) losing its always-ask safeguard when the same command also redirected output to a `~` or wildcard path
entries.zh: 修复了当同一命令还将输出重定向到`~`或通配符路径时，危险的`rm`（例如`/`或主目录上的`rm`）失去其始终询问保护的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` and SDK sessions repeating a model fallback on every later message after the model was switched while a reply was running
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`和 SDK 会话在回复运行时切换模型后对每条后续消息重复模型回退的问题

entries.en: Fixed a folder's CLAUDE.md being attached a second time after resuming a session or after a compaction
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话或压缩后第二次附加文件夹的 CLAUDE.md

entries.en: Fixed background sessions that could not be reopened from `claude agents` after the agent exited and removed the worktree the session was started in
entries.zh: 修复了代理退出并删除会话启动所在的工作树后无法从“claude Agents”重新打开的后台会话

entries.en: Fixed `/advisor` pairing checks: Sonnet 5.5 can now advise Opus 4.7 and 4.8, and advisors the API would refuse are flagged up front instead of being silently dropped
entries.zh: 修复了`/advisor`配对检查：Sonnet 5.5 现在可以为 Opus 4.7 和 4.8 提供建议，并且 API 将拒绝的顾问会预先标记，而不是默默地删除

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission prompts showing internal parser names such as "Contains simple_expansion" instead of a plain explanation
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限提示，显示内部解析器名称，例如“Contains simple_expansion”，而不是简单的解释

entries.en: Fixed a cause of fullscreen sessions on slow or busy machines exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" while a scroll key was held in a long conversation
entries.zh: 修复了在长时间对话中按住滚动键时，缓慢或繁忙的计算机上的全屏会话退出并显示“无法恢复的界面错误后克劳德代码退出”的原因

entries.en: Fixed organization per-tool permission ceilings being silently dropped for an MCP tool named `__proto__`
entries.zh: 修复了名为`__proto__`的 MCP 工具悄悄降低组织每个工具权限上限的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude being told to page large MCP results saved as JSON with Read's offset and limit, which cannot split one long line
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 被告知将大型 MCP 结果分页保存为 JSON 并带有读取偏移量和限制的问题，该结果无法分割一长行

entries.en: Fixed the commit attribution reminder being delivered inside a tool result after a compaction
entries.zh: 修复压缩之后，提交署名提醒被放进工具结果中投递的问题

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode leaving the cursor away from the typed text in search boxes (such as /resume and /permissions) and sign-in code fields
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式，使光标远离搜索框（例如 /resume 和 /permissions）和登录代码字段中键入的文本

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode refusing Enter with nothing typed on /rewind's summarize options, whose added context is optional
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式拒绝在 /rewind 的摘要选项上输入任何内容的情况下回车的问题，其添加的上下文是可选的

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode showing a "Tab to amend" hint on approval prompts, where Tab does nothing
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式，在批准提示中显示“Tab 进行修改”提示，其中 Tab 不执行任何操作

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode listing arrow keys that do nothing in /permissions and /mcp, and saying "Select with numbers" in empty menus or while a search box has the keys
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式列出在 /permissions 和 /mcp 中不执行任何操作的箭头键，并在空菜单中或搜索框有这些键时显示“使用数字选择”的问题

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode leaving out the changed lines in file edit approval prompts and other diffs
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式忽略文件编辑批准提示和其他差异中已更改的行

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode sending the `claude --teleport` progress screen, and an MCP form field while it is being checked, to the screen reader again on every spinner frame
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式在每个旋转帧上再次向屏幕阅读器发送`claude --teleport`进度屏幕和检查时的 MCP 表单字段的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not removing the structured-output format from session-title and prompt-hook requests, which Bedrock-backed gateways reject
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS`未从会话标题和提示挂钩请求中删除结构化输出格式，而基岩支持的网关会拒绝该格式

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode leaving out the top lines of a second approval prompt, a changed /config row or the rejected-plan line when the previous screen was taller than the terminal window
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式，当前一个屏幕比终端窗口高时，会遗漏第二个批准提示的顶行、更改的 /config 行或拒绝计划行

entries.en: Fixed `--include-partial-messages` sending a cut-short reply's `message_stop` late or never, so apps could show the reply as still in progress
entries.zh: 修复了`--include-partial-messages`发送简短回复的`message_stop`迟到或不发送的问题，以便应用程序可以将回复显示为仍在进行中

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` sometimes not showing the permission prompt a background session is waiting on
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”有时不显示后台会话正在等待的权限提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` giving advice about `.git/info/attributes` when the upload stops on a committed `.gitattributes` it cannot read, such as one saved as UTF-16
entries.zh: 修复了当上传停止在无法读取的已提交`.gitattributes`（例如保存为 UTF-16 的文件）时，`/ultrareview`提供有关`.git/info/attributes`的建议

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control` failing to register behind an HTTP proxy with a misleading "Check your organization permissions" error (anthropics/claude-code#97352)
entries.zh: 修复了 `claude Remote-control` 无法在 HTTP 代理后面注册并出现误导性的“检查您的组织权限”错误的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#97352)

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on Linux inheriting an open handle on the Claude Code executable
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上的沙盒 Bash 命令继承了 Claude Code 可执行文件上的开放句柄

entries.en: Fixed the running-tool dot and three spinners still moving with the "Reduce motion" setting on, and /rewind's confirm screen updating its "ago" time while you type a note
entries.zh: 修复开启"减少动态效果"后，运行中工具的圆点和三个旋转指示器仍在移动，以及 /rewind 确认界面在你输入备注时仍更新"几分钟前"时间的问题

entries.en: Fixed times in `claude agents` changing every second in screen reader mode; they now change at most every 10 seconds
entries.zh: 修复屏幕阅读器模式下 `claude agents` 中的时间每秒都变化的问题；现在最多每 10 秒变化一次

entries.en: Fixed a revoked claude.ai login showing a generic `API Error: 401` instead of "OAuth token revoked"; in `-p` mode the error now starts with "Failed to authenticate"
entries.zh: 修复了已撤销的 claude.ai 登录显示通用“API 错误：401”而不是“OAuth 令牌已撤销”的问题；在`-p`模式下，错误现在以“无法验证”开头

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` upload refusals advising you to copy a variable named by a repository's settings file into your own user settings
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`上传拒绝建议您将存储库设置文件命名的变量复制到您自己的用户设置中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--output-format stream-json` and the SDK not streaming the turns of a `context: fork` skill run by typing `/<skill>` as the prompt, as they do for the Skill tool's fork
entries.zh: 修复了`--output-format stream-json`和 SDK 不通过输入`/<skill>`作为提示来流式传输`context: fork`技能运行的问题，就像技能工具的 fork 一样

entries.en: Fixed /feedback and /bug: the pre-filled GitHub issue no longer includes your recent error messages, and the confirmation screen now lists them as part of the report
entries.zh: 修复了 /feedback 和 /bug：预填的 GitHub 问题不再包含您最近的错误消息，确认屏幕现在将它们列为报告的一部分

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add --sparse` and `git-subdir` plugin installs failing with "transport 'http' not allowed" when the repository is served over plain http
entries.zh: 修复了当存储库通过纯 http 提供服务时，“claude 插件市场添加 --sparse” 和`git-subdir` 插件安装失败并显示“不允许传输‘http’”的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions sometimes losing the earlier conversation when the session restarted while it was being compacted
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在压缩期间重新启动时有时会丢失早期对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin reload that overlapped the startup `--plugin-url` download corrupting the session's cached copy of the plugin archive
entries.zh: 修复了与启动`--plugin-url`下载重叠的插件重新加载，损坏了会话的插件存档的缓存副本

entries.en: Fixed `/desktop` quoting partial output when opening Claude Desktop timed out or printed too much output; the error now names the cause
entries.zh: 修复了打开 Claude Desktop 时`/desktop`引用部分输出超时或打印过多输出的问题；现在错误列出了原因

entries.en: Fixed an MCP connector tool call occasionally running twice, or the connector's calls failing until restart, when its server changed which MCP protocol version it supports
entries.zh: 修复了当其服务器更改其支持的 MCP 协议版本时，MCP 连接器工具调用偶尔会运行两次，或者连接器的调用在重新启动之前失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed SessionStart hooks from synced plugins not running in new cloud sessions
entries.zh: 修复了未在新云会话中运行的同步插件的 SessionStart 挂钩

entries.en: Fixed the transcript's "N hooks ran" summary and the verbose debug log's matched-hooks count including Claude Code's internal callbacks, so one configured hook no longer shows as two
entries.zh: 修复转录的"N hooks ran"摘要和详细调试日志中的匹配钩子计数，把 Claude Code 的内部回调也算进去，导致一个已配置的钩子显示为两个的问题

entries.en: Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing when the upload finished just after the 30-second timeout; it now waits 35 seconds
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德从云端发送的文件和远程控制会话在 30 秒超时后上传完成时失败的问题；现在等待 35 秒

entries.en: Fixed repositories added mid-session in cloud and SDK sessions not loading their skills and plugins, and loading CLAUDE.md late, after Claude changed directory
entries.zh: 修复了在云和 SDK 会话中添加的存储库未加载其技能和插件，以及在 Claude 更改目录后较晚加载 CLAUDE.md 的问题

entries.en: Fixed PNG, JPEG and WebP images over 8,000 pixels on a side failing to send from a remote session; Claude now sends a scaled-down copy
entries.zh: 修复了单边超过 8,000 像素的 PNG、JPEG 和 WebP 图像无法从远程会话发送的问题；克劳德现在发送缩小版副本

entries.en: Fixed messages sent from the Claude apps with 17 to 20 attached files delivering only the first 16
entries.zh: 修复了从 Claude 应用程序发送的包含 17 到 20 个附加文件的消息，仅传送前 16 个文件

entries.en: Fixed headless sessions reporting an MCP server as needing authentication after one refused call, even though later calls succeed
entries.zh: 修复了无头会话在一次拒绝呼叫后报告 MCP 服务器需要身份验证的问题，即使后来的呼叫成功

entries.en: macOS: Fixed Remote Control sessions started with `claude remote-control` stopping mid-turn when the Mac went to idle sleep
entries.zh: macOS：修复了用 `claude remote-control` 启动的 Remote Control 会话，在 Mac 进入空闲休眠时会在轮次中途停止的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed interactive `claude` hanging or crashing with "Raw mode is not supported" when its input is piped or redirected; it now says why and exits (use `-p` for piped input)
entries.zh: Windows：修复了输入通过管道或重定向时，交互式 `claude` 挂起或报 "Raw mode is not supported" 而崩溃的问题；现在会说明原因并退出（管道输入请使用 `-p`）

entries.en: Bedrock, Vertex, Mantle: Fixed model availability checks under `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH` sending a different `Authorization` header than real requests when `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` repeats it
entries.zh: 基岩、顶点、地幔：修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH`下的模型可用性检查，当`ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS`重复时，发送与实际请求不同的`Authorization`标头

entries.en: Improved `/config`: settings that cycle show ‹ › and step both ways with ←/→, narrow terminals stack each value under its label, and PgUp/PgDn page the list
entries.zh: 改进 `/config`：可循环切换的设置显示 ‹ ›，用 ←/→ 双向切换；窄终端中每个值显示在标签下方；PgUp/PgDn 可翻页

entries.en: Improved plugin marketplace errors to say in plain words why a marketplace was ignored or refused, and what to do
entries.zh: 改进插件市场报错：用大白话说明市场为什么被忽略或拒绝，以及该怎么做

entries.en: Improved plugin listings to note when a plugin's dependencies were not installed, and updating a plugin now retries an install that did not finish
entries.zh: 改进插件列表：会提示插件的依赖未安装；更新插件时，未完成的安装会自动重试

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's error when Amazon Bedrock rejects a model ID: developers now see which model is unavailable, and the gateway log names the ID that was sent
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关：Amazon Bedrock 拒绝某个模型 ID 时，开发者能看到哪个模型不可用，网关日志会写出所发送的 ID

entries.en: Improved SDK sessions so a message sent with priority "now" no longer cancels a running web fetch or web search; it keeps loading in the background
entries.zh: 改进 SDK 会话：以优先级“now”发送的消息不再取消正在运行的网页抓取或搜索，而是转入后台继续加载

entries.en: Improved `/memory`: the left and right arrow keys now flip its on/off settings, such as Auto-memory
entries.zh: 改进 `/memory`：左右方向键可切换其中的开关设置（如自动记忆）

entries.en: Improved `/skill` names typed mid-message: Claude is now told they are skills, including `disable-model-invocation` ones
entries.zh: 改进 `/skill`：对话中间输入的技能名称，Claude 会知道它们是技能，包括 `disable-model-invocation` 类型的技能

entries.en: Improved the contrast of the prompt input border in light themes and of the ❯ before your earlier messages
entries.zh: 改进浅色主题下提示输入框边框的对比度，以及你之前消息前 ❯ 符号的对比度

entries.en: Improved delivery of files Claude sends from cloud sessions and Remote Control: an upload that fails on a timeout, a network error or a 502, 503 or 504 is now retried once
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 从云会话和远程控制发出的文件的投递：因超时、网络错误或 502、503、504 而失败的上传，会自动重试一次

entries.en: Improved what Claude says when a file cannot be sent for a reason that may be temporary: it now mentions that you can ask for the file again in a few minutes
entries.zh: 改进文件因可能是暂时性原因无法发送时，Claude 的回复：会提示你可以过几分钟再请求发送该文件

entries.en: Improved the prompt for a held message from another session to show the message between dashed lines, matching other permission prompts
entries.zh: 改进来自其他会话的待处理消息的提示：消息用虚线框起来，与其他权限提示保持一致

entries.en: Improved MCP and other tool permission prompts to show the tool call between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 及其他工具的权限弹窗：工具调用用虚线框起来显示，与文件编辑弹窗保持一致

entries.en: Improved MCP startup in headless mode: a remote server whose first connect fails transiently is now retried without waiting for the slowest server to finish connecting
entries.zh: 改进无界面模式下的 MCP 启动：远程服务器首次连接临时失败时，直接重试，不必等最慢的服务器连接完成

entries.en: Improved files Claude sends from a remote session: large files now stream from disk instead of being read into memory, and a file over the size limit is refused with the server's limit named
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 从远程会话发送的文件：大文件改为从磁盘流式传输，不再整个读入内存；超过大小限制的文件会被拒绝，并注明服务器的限制

entries.en: Improved the explanation Claude gives when the server refuses a file it sends from a Remote Control or cloud session, such as an oversized image
entries.zh: 改进服务器拒绝从远程控制或云端会话发来的文件（如超大图片）时，Claude 给出的解释

entries.en: Improved handling of large MCP tool results: less memory, smaller session files, and no extra upload to count tokens for results far over the limit
entries.zh: 改进大型 MCP 工具结果的处理：占用内存更少，会话文件更小；远超限制的结果在统计 token 时无需额外上传

entries.en: Windows: Improved Bash tool speed by removing a subshell that ran before every command
entries.zh: Windows：移除了每条命令前运行的子 shell，提升了 Bash 工具的速度

entries.en: Changed a shell write through a repo-committed symlink onto a sensitive file or out of the working tree to name where it lands and wait for a person, on lines with a `~` target too
entries.zh: 更改了通过存储库提交的符号链接写入敏感文件或从工作树中写入的 shell，以命名它的着陆位置并等待一个人，也可以在带有`~`目标的行上进行

entries.en: Changed Opus 4.7+ and Fable to use a 1M context window by default on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and the Claude apps gateway, with no `[1m]` suffix (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` keeps 200K)
entries.zh: 将 Opus 4.7+ 和 Fable 更改为在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和 Claude 应用程序网关上默认使用 1M 上下文窗口，没有`[1m]`后缀（`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1`保留 200K）

entries.en: Changed replies from `claude agents` to arrive as queued messages; slash commands other than `/stop` sent while a turn is running now run when it ends
entries.zh: 更改了“克劳德代理”的回复以排队消息的形式到达；在回合运行时发送除`/stop`之外的斜杠命令现在在回合结束时运行

entries.en: Changed whole-tool `Bash` allow rules and allowing hooks to prompt for, not run, shell writes to files Claude Code's file tools refuse outright (the Anthropic profile store, the host credentials file)
entries.zh: 更改了整个工具`Bash`允许规则，并允许挂钩提示（而不是运行）shell 写入文件 Claude Code 的文件工具完全拒绝（Anthropic 配置文件存储、主机凭据文件）

entries.en: Changed right-click paste on Windows and Linux, and middle-click paste on Linux, to happen when the button is released; moving the pointer away before releasing cancels it
entries.zh: 更改了 Windows 和 Linux 上的右键单击粘贴以及 Linux 上的中键单击粘贴，以在释放按钮时发生；在释放之前将指针移开会取消它

entries.en: Changed MCP server `alwaysLoad: false` to defer all of that server's tools behind tool search
entries.zh: 更改了 MCP 服务器`alwaysLoad: false`以推迟工具搜索后面的所有该服务器工具

entries.en: Changed screen reader mode to write new or changed lines without first pausing with the cursor at the start of the line; set `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` to restore the pause
entries.zh: 更改了屏幕阅读器模式以写入新的或更改的行，而无需先将光标暂停在行的开头；设置 `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` 以恢复暂停

entries.en: Changed automatic model switches after a flagged message to keep your current effort level instead of the new model's default
entries.zh: 更改了标记消息后的自动模型切换，以保持当前的工作水平而不是新模型的默认值

entries.en: Changed waiting permission prompts to show oldest first, so a new prompt no longer covers the one you're reading (prompts with a countdown still open on top)
entries.zh: 将等待权限提示更改为首先显示最旧的提示，因此新提示不再覆盖您正在阅读的提示（顶部仍打开倒计时提示）

entries.en: [VSCode] Added "Run in background" to a running command or sub-agent, to move it to the background and keep working
entries.zh: [VSCode] 正在运行的命令或子智能体新增「Run in background」，可将其转到后台继续工作

entries.en: [VSCode] Added the output of background shells and Monitors to their cards in the agent map
entries.zh: [VSCode] 智能体地图中，后台 shell 和 Monitor 的输出显示在其卡片中

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs blaming a timeout when Claude Code's reply was too large to confirm a save
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude Code 的回复过大、无法确认保存结果时，设置对话框错误地归咎于超时的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed reopening a cloud session that the side bar already brought to this machine opening it again in a new tab; the side bar is shown instead
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新打开一个侧边栏已将其带到本机的云端会话时，会在新标签页中再次打开的问题；现在改为显示侧边栏

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the side bar's Web tab not listing cloud sessions started after the window loaded; a failed load now says "Remote server is not connected" instead of "No web sessions yet"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复侧边栏的 Web 标签页不显示窗口加载后启动的云端会话的问题；加载失败时现在显示 "Remote server is not connected"，而不是 "No web sessions yet"

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a tab restored after a reload starting a second Claude process on a conversation the side bar already has open; it now shows the "still open somewhere else" notice
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新加载后恢复的标签页，会在侧边栏已打开的对话上再启动一个 Claude 进程的问题；现在会显示 "still open somewhere else" 提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed tool-row file links, session-list links and two hints showing in plain text
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复工具行中的文件链接、会话列表中的链接以及两处提示以纯文本显示的问题
