entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a background agent's still-running command showing as failed once the main turn ended
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复主轮次结束后，后台 agent 仍在运行的命令显示为失败的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/usage` or `/context` command opening the extension's dialog instead of running when picked from the command menu
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复你自己的 `/usage` 或 `/context` 命令在从命令菜单选中时，打开的是扩展对话框而不是正常执行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed file links in the plan preview tab doing nothing when clicked; they now open the file like links in chat replies
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复计划预览标签页中的文件链接点击无反应的问题；现在与聊天回复中的链接一样，会打开文件

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed opening a tool's input or output in an editor tab failing with "Timeout waiting after 1000ms" on remote hosts such as WSL when the tab is slow to appear
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 WSL 等远程主机上，标签页出现较慢时，在编辑器标签页中打开工具的输入或输出会报 "Timeout waiting after 1000ms" 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: a failed marketplace add, remove or refresh now says what went wrong
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进 Manage plugins 对话框：添加、删除或刷新市场失败时，会说明具体原因

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the Claude in Chrome "Enabled by default" switch to also connect the editor's own sessions, which still ask before browser actions
entries.zh: [VSCode] Claude in Chrome 的「Enabled by default」开关现在也会连接编辑器自己的会话，这些会话在浏览器操作前仍会询问

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed occasional failures to fetch from or push to GitHub when GitHub briefly refused a newly issued access token
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复 GitHub 短暂拒绝新签发的访问令牌时，从 GitHub 拉取或推送偶尔失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude posting a failure warning, such as a spend limit notice, in a Slack thread when a background event like GitHub activity woke it and nobody was waiting on a reply
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 GitHub 活动等后台事件唤醒 Claude，且没有人在等待回复时，它仍在 Slack 话题中发出失败警告（如花费限额通知）的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings leaving out recently created and private channels in organizations with many channels
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在频道很多的组织中，Claude Tag 管理设置的花费限额页面漏掉最近创建的频道和私密频道的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's task list in long Slack threads: background work no longer reposts it as a new message on its own, so people following the thread aren't notified
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进长 Slack 话题中的 Claude 任务清单：后台工作不再自行把清单作为新消息重新发布，因此关注该话题的人不会被通知

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed finding comments and their "Why this was flagged" text stopping mid-sentence; they now end on a complete sentence
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复问题评论及其「Why this was flagged」文字在句子中间中断的问题；现在会以完整句子结束

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review skipping a pull request after a new push when its review had failed twice on the previous commit; it now reviews the latest commit
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复新推送后，若上一提交的审查已失败两次，Code Review 会跳过该拉取请求的问题；现在会审查最新提交

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved the failed-review card on a pull request whose conversation is locked: it now says the lock blocked the review and that nothing was posted or charged
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进对话已锁定的拉取请求上失败审查的卡片：现在会说明是锁定阻止了审查，且没有发布任何内容，也没有收费

entries.en: Added a count such as "2 of 5" to the permission prompt when several permission requests stack up
entries.zh: 当多个权限请求叠加时，在权限提示中添加“2 of 5”等计数

entries.en: Added mouse support for the "N more" rows of lists in fullscreen mode: click one to jump to that end of the list, with hover and pressed states
entries.zh: 在全屏模式下添加了对“N 多”行列表的鼠标支持：单击某一行可跳转到列表的末尾，具有悬停和按下状态

entries.en: Fixed several Claude Code processes and IDE extensions each opening a login browser when gcpAuthRefresh or awsAuthRefresh credentials expire
entries.zh: 修复了多个 Claude Code 进程和 IDE 扩展，当 gcpAuthRefresh 或 awsAuthRefresh 凭证过期时，每个进程和 IDE 扩展都会打开登录浏览器

entries.en: Fixed `claude --resume` and `--continue` sometimes losing every turn after a batch of parallel tool calls when the earlier session crashed or was killed
entries.zh: 修复了当早期会话崩溃或被终止时，在一批并行工具调用后，`claude --resume`和`--continue`有时会丢失每个回合的问题

entries.en: Fixed API 400 errors after a tool or hook returned an object, number or boolean instead of text, including in resumed sessions
entries.zh: 修复了工具或挂钩返回对象、数字或布尔值而不是文本后的 API 400 错误，包括在恢复的会话中

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions with very large histories never waking up because the container was stopped while the transcript was still loading
entries.zh: 修复了具有非常大的历史记录的云会话永远不会唤醒的问题，因为容器在记录仍在加载时已停止

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway's spend meter pricing 1-hour prompt cache writes at the cheaper 5-minute rate, and counting only the first model call's input tokens on streamed turns that run a server-side tool such as web search
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 应用网关的消费计量，把 1 小时提示词缓存写入按较便宜的 5 分钟费率计价，以及在流式回合中运行服务端工具（如网页搜索）时只统计第一次模型调用输入 token 的问题

entries.en: Fixed macOS sessions still showing "Not logged in" or "Login expired" after `/login` succeeds in another Claude Code window when a leftover `~/.claude/.credentials.json` exists
entries.zh: 修复了当存在剩余的`~/.claude/.credentials.json`时，在另一个 Claude 代码窗口中`/login`成功后，macOS 会话仍显示“未登录”或“登录已过期”的问题

entries.en: Fixed every turn failing when the Anthropic API refuses the model your default or a model alias resolves to: Claude Code now retries once on the previous model of the same tier
entries.zh: 修复了当 Anthropic API 拒绝您的默认模型或模型别名解析为的模型时每次失败的问题：Claude Code 现在会在同一层的前一个模型上重试一次

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions (including `claude remote-control`) staying connected after your organization's policy turns Remote Control off; they now disconnect with a notice
entries.zh: 修复了在组织的策略关闭远程控制后远程控制会话（包括“claude Remote-control”）保持连接的问题；他们现在断开连接并发出通知

entries.en: Fixed refusal and `--fallback-model` retries failing when the fallback model can't run fast; they now run at standard speed, with a one-time notice in interactive sessions
entries.zh: 修复了后备模型无法快速运行时拒绝和 `--fallback-model` 重试失败的问题；它们现在以标准速度运行，并在交互式会话中发出一次性通知

entries.en: Fixed headless sessions repeating the "MCP servers require authentication" reminder after a successful re-authentication when the MCP discovery cache is enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用 MCP 发现缓存后，无头会话在成功重新身份验证后重复“MCP 服务器需要身份验证”提醒的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude auth status` reporting a Console sign-in's stored API key as `claude.ai`; it now reports `api_key`, and the VS Code extension treats that session as an API key session
entries.zh: 修复了`claude auth status`将控制台登录存储的 API 密钥报告为`claude.ai`的问题；它现在报告`api_key`，VS Code 扩展将该会话视为 API 密钥会话

entries.en: Fixed `/status` listing an Anthropic profile beside an API key as if both were in effect; the profile is now marked as not in use
entries.zh: 修复了`/status`在 API 密钥旁边列出 Anthropic 配置文件的问题，就好像两者都有效一样；该配置文件现已标记为未使用

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control did not arrive, and a file sometimes getting only 10 seconds for its last download try
entries.zh: 修复了当通过远程控制发送的消息所附的文件未到达时，克劳德没有被告知，并且文件有时仅在最后一次下载尝试中等待 10 秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed a Remote Control message that arrived while Claude Code was exiting being marked delivered and then never answered; it now stays queued for the session's next run
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德·代码退出时到达的远程控制消息被标记为已发送但从未应答的问题；它现在保持排队等待会话的下一次运行

entries.en: Fixed MCP error messages showing a credential's value when "Bearer" or "Basic" came before its key name
entries.zh: 修复了当“Bearer”或“Basic”出现在其密钥名称之前时显示凭证值的 MCP 错误消息

entries.en: Fixed percent-encoded Bearer tokens being only partly masked in error messages
entries.zh: 修复了错误消息中仅部分掩盖百分比编码的承载令牌的问题

entries.en: Fixed redacted logs and transcripts showing a secret whose key name has an invisible character inside, such as a zero-width space
entries.zh: 修复了显示密钥名称内部包含不可见字符（例如零宽度空格）的秘密的编辑日志和记录

entries.en: Fixed logs and transcripts showing part of a URL password that contains punctuation such as `)`, quotes, `]`, `&` or a second `@`, or that runs past a `/` to a bracketed host such as `[::1]` in an ssh URL
entries.zh: 修复了显示部分 URL 密码的日志和记录，其中包含标点符号，例如 `)`、引号、`]`、`&` 或第二个 `@`，或者经过 `/` 到括号内的主机，例如 ssh URL 中的 `[::1]`

entries.en: Fixed the session transcript in the zip that `/feedback` saves to disk containing invalid JSON lines after secret redaction
entries.zh: 修复 `/feedback` 保存到磁盘的 zip 中，会话转录在脱敏后出现无效 JSON 行的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP connectors listing no tools for up to a day after their server dropped the older MCP handshake
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 连接器在服务器丢弃旧的 MCP 握手后一天内未列出任何工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed a repeat MCP sign-in request from Claude replacing the pending sign-in link, which could stop that link from working
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 重复 MCP 登录请求替换挂起的登录链接的问题，这可能会阻止该链接工作

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` not crediting an MCP server for a tool call made while that server was still connecting or had only just connected, such as right after a restart
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`不将 MCP 服务器仍在连接或刚刚连接（例如重新启动后）时进行的工具调用计入该服务器的情况

entries.en: Fixed plugins enabled on claude.ai occasionally going missing from Claude Code for a session after a transient server error
entries.zh: 修复了在短暂的服务器错误后，在 claude.ai 上启用的插件偶尔会从会话的 Claude Code 中丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a message typed into a running subagent showing twice in its transcript after the subagent read it
entries.zh: 修复了输入到正在运行的子代理中的消息在子代理读取后在其记录中显示两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagent hand-back messages showing a raw task id instead of the agent's name when the subagent had no registered name
entries.zh: 修复了当子代理没有注册名称时显示原始任务 ID 而不是代理名称的子代理交回消息

entries.en: Fixed foreground subagents sometimes missing the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) in sessions that have them enabled
entries.zh: 修复了前台子代理有时会在启用任务跟踪工具（TaskCreate/Get/Update/List、TodoWrite）的会话中丢失这些工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents spawned with worktree isolation loading the project CLAUDE.md and its imports a second time from the worktree copy on their first file read
entries.zh: 修复了工作树隔离生成的子代理加载项目 CLAUDE.md 及其在读取第一个文件时从工作树副本中第二次导入的问题

entries.en: Fixed Workflow tool subagents being restarted from their original prompt when a connection stalled for a few minutes mid-response
entries.zh: 修复了当连接在响应过程中停滞几分钟时工作流程工具子代理会从原始提示重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/compact`, `/clear`, and `/rewind` typed while viewing a background agent's or teammate's transcript silently acting on the main conversation: a dialog now names the target and asks first
entries.zh: 修复了在查看后台特工或队友的记录时键入的`/compact`、`/clear`和`/rewind`，这些记录默默地作用于主要对话：现在有一个对话框命名目标并首先询问

entries.en: Fixed background jobs showing done while waiting for your approval
entries.zh: 修复了后台作业在等待您批准时显示已完成的问题

entries.en: Fixed the commit attribution reminder being re-sent inside tool output when a model fallback lasts only one turn
entries.zh: 修复模型回退只持续一个回合时，提交署名提醒被重新发送到工具输出中的问题

entries.en: Fixed a click on the space between words of a collapsed row (such as "Thought for 4s") highlighting the row without expanding it in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了单击折叠行的单词之间的空格（例如“Thought for 4s”）突出显示该行而不在全屏模式下展开它的问题

entries.en: Fixed a row with no details, such as an action row with a long name, pushing every other row's details to the right in list screens
entries.zh: 修复了没有详细信息的行，例如名称很长的操作行，将所有其他行的详细信息推到列表屏幕的右侧

entries.en: Fixed files with very long names not reaching a cloud session when attached to it
entries.zh: 修复了名称很长的文件在附加到云会话时无法到达的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin errors for a marketplace Claude Code refuses to load: they now say why and how to fix it instead of "not found"
entries.zh: 修复了市场克劳德代码拒绝加载的插件错误：他们现在说为什么以及如何修复它，而不是“未找到”

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin`'s Discover tab showing a marketplace name unquoted in its "Checking … for new plugins" line when its rows already show that name in quotes
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`的“发现”选项卡，当其行已在引号中显示该名称时，该选项卡在“检查...新插件”行中显示未加引号的市场名称

entries.en: Improved commit guidance: when your project or user skills include one named `verify`, Claude is now told to run it right before committing, except for docs-only and tests-only commits
entries.zh: 改进提交指引：若项目或用户技能中有名为 `verify` 的技能，Claude 会被告知在提交前运行它；纯文档或纯测试的提交除外

entries.en: Improved send now (ctrl+enter) in a subagent's view: it now moves the subagent's running command to the background so your message is read right away
entries.zh: 改进子智能体视图中的「立即发送」（ctrl+enter）：现在会把子智能体正在运行的命令移到后台，让你的消息立即被处理

entries.en: Improved replies from background agents to your messages so they no longer open with a separate recap of what you said
entries.zh: 改进后台智能体对你消息的回复：不再先单独复述一遍你说的话

entries.en: Improved claude.ai artifact link reads: WebFetch now asks the same questions as the Artifact tool's read (no artifact prompt while the session's network access is on, one per artifact while it is off), and an auto-mode yes no longer counts where only you can answer
entries.zh: 改进 claude.ai artifact 链接读取：WebFetch 现在会问与 Artifact 工具读取时相同的问题（会话网络访问开启时不再询问 artifact 提示，关闭时每个 artifact 询问一次）；只有你才能回答的问题，自动模式下的“是”不再算数

entries.en: Improved fetch, skill, file read, sandbox network, Claude in Chrome, workflow script and notebook edit permission prompts to match the look of file edit prompts
entries.zh: 改进 fetch、skill、文件读取、沙箱网络、Claude in Chrome、workflow 脚本和 notebook 编辑的权限弹窗，使其外观与文件编辑弹窗一致

entries.en: Improved Bash, PowerShell and Monitor permission prompts to show the command between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts
entries.zh: 改进 Bash、PowerShell 和 Monitor 的权限弹窗：命令用虚线框起来显示，与文件编辑弹窗保持一致

entries.en: Improved list scrollbars in fullscreen mode: in most lists the bar no longer shifts as the "N more" rows come and go, and it now has ↑/↓ arrows you can click or hold to scroll
entries.zh: 改进全屏模式下的列表滚动条：多数列表中，“N more”行出现或消失时滚动条不再跳动；并新增可点击或按住滚动的 ↑/↓ 箭头

entries.en: Improved the external editor (Ctrl+G): editors that take a line number now open on the line your cursor is on in the prompt
entries.zh: 改进外部编辑器（Ctrl+G）：支持指定行号的编辑器，会直接打开到提示框中光标所在的行

entries.en: Improved slash command suggestion responsiveness while typing when many skills or plugin commands are installed; command descriptions now match by word prefix
entries.zh: 改进装有大量技能或插件命令时，输入过程中斜杠命令建议的响应速度；命令描述改为按词的前缀匹配

entries.en: Improved the output style picker: it now opens on your current style instead of Default, with each style's description on the line under its name; number keys no longer pick a style
entries.zh: 改进输出样式选择器：打开时定位在当前样式而不是默认样式，每种样式的说明显示在名称下方一行；数字键不再直接选中样式

entries.en: Improved `/hooks`: the closing line of a hook's detail screen now says "this hook" instead of "it"
entries.zh: 改进 `/hooks`：hook 详情页结尾改为“this hook”，不再用“it”

entries.en: Improved the model fallback notice and the autocompact-thrashing error to say when a fallback dropped the context window from 1M to 200K tokens
entries.zh: 改进模型回退提示和自动压缩抖动报错：会说明回退时上下文窗口从 1M 降到 200K token 的情况

entries.en: Improved responsiveness of SDK and `-p` sessions when a host re-sends an MCP server enable for a server that is already connected
entries.zh: 改进 SDK 和 `-p` 会话的响应速度：宿主重复发送已连接服务器的启用指令时不再额外处理

entries.en: Improved the protocol page a Claude apps gateway serves at `/protocol`: it now says not to reject unknown input and matches what Claude Code sends today
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关在 `/protocol` 提供的协议页面：说明不应拒绝未知输入，并与 Claude Code 当前发送的内容保持一致

entries.en: Changed prompts sent while nothing is running or queued to show in the normal text color right away instead of gray
entries.zh: 更改了在没有任何运行或排队时发送的提示，以立即以正常文本颜色而不是灰色显示

entries.en: Changed how failed API requests are retried: one limit now covers a whole model call, so with the default retry settings a failing call sends at most 14 requests
entries.zh: 更改了失败的 API 请求的重试方式：现在一个限制涵盖整个模型调用，因此使用默认重试设置，失败的调用最多发送 14 个请求

entries.en: Changed `--bare` to connect only the MCP servers named on the command line, send the model no system reminders, and start no background tasks; under `--bare`, a shell command that reaches its timeout now stops instead of moving to the background
entries.zh: 更改了`--bare`以仅连接命令行上指定的MCP服务器，不向模型发送系统提醒，并且不启动后台任务；在“--bare”下，达到超时的 shell 命令现在会停止，而不是移动到后台

entries.en: Changed the send-now key (ctrl+enter) to move a skill's own shell command to the background instead of ending it
entries.zh: 更改了立即发送键（ctrl+enter）以将技能自己的 shell 命令移至后台而不是结束它

entries.en: Changed the WebFetch error for a rate-limited domain safety check to tell Claude not to retry it in a loop
entries.zh: 更改了限速域安全检查的 WebFetch 错误，以告诉 Claude 不要循环重试

entries.en: Changed plugin installs to refuse npm sources that are git repositories or folders, and to install plugin dependencies only from registry packages
entries.zh: 更改了插件安装以拒绝 git 存储库或文件夹的 npm 源，并仅从注册表包安装插件依赖项

entries.en: Changed list screens (`/artifacts`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, `/hooks` and others) to always line up each row's details in one column after the names
entries.zh: 更改了列表屏幕（`/artifacts`、`/mcp`、`/skills`、`/hooks` 等），以始终将每一行的详细信息排列在名称后面的一列中

entries.en: Changed the overflow rows of lists to read "↑ N more" / "↓ N more" instead of "N more above" / "N more below"
entries.zh: 将列表的溢出行更改为“↑ N 更多”/“↓ N 更多”而不是“上方 N 更多”/“下方 N 更多”

entries.en: Changed `/hooks` to open on one list of your configured hooks grouped by event, so viewing a hook takes one Enter instead of three
entries.zh: 将`/hooks`更改为在按事件分组的已配置挂钩列表中打开，因此查看挂钩只需按一次 Enter 键，而不是按 3 次 Enter

entries.en: Changed the theme picker to a scrolling list that fits your terminal instead of pushing the preview off screen; number keys no longer pick a theme
entries.zh: 将主题选择器更改为适合您终端的滚动列表，而不是将预览推离屏幕；数字键不再选择主题

entries.en: Changed `/exit`'s Remove worktree to run after Claude Code stops the servers and shells it started there, which on Windows could keep the folder from being deleted
entries.zh: 更改了`/exit`的删除工作树，使其在 Claude Code 停止其启动的服务器和 shell 后运行，这在 Windows 上可以防止文件夹被删除

entries.en: Changed the `claude-api` skill's Managed Agents examples to create environments with limited networking
entries.zh: 更改了`claude-api`技能的托管代理示例以创建网络有限的环境

entries.en: Removed the browser link from `/ultrareview` and `claude ultrareview` output
entries.zh: 从 `/ultrareview` 和 `claude ultrareview` 的输出中移除浏览器链接

entries.en: Windows: Fixed `claude --bg` and the agents view refusing a folder that `claude` already trusts when its trust record was saved with different letter case
entries.zh: Windows：修复了 `claude --bg` 和代理视图拒绝 `claude` 已信任的文件夹的问题，原因是信任记录保存时大小写不同

entries.en: [VSCode] Added bookmarks: save Claude's responses and keep them in view in a Bookmarks side panel
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增书签：可保存 Claude 的回复，并在 Bookmarks 侧边栏中随时查看

entries.en: [VSCode] Added the questions Claude asks and your answers to the conversation: after you answer a question card, a Questions row shows each question with your picks
entries.zh: [VSCode] 对话中会记录 Claude 提出的问题及你的回答：回答问题卡片后，会出现「Questions」行，列出每个问题和你的选择

entries.en: [VSCode] Added option previews to question cards in the chat panel: the highlighted choice's mockup or snippet shows beside or under the options
entries.zh: [VSCode] 聊天面板中的问题卡片新增选项预览：高亮选项的样例图或代码片段会显示在选项旁或下方

entries.en: [VSCode] Added rows under a message that open to the terminal output, browser tab, browser instructions and selected code sent with it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 消息下方新增若干行，点击可查看随消息发送的终端输出、浏览器标签页、浏览器说明和所选代码

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a second copy of a conversation opening in a tab when it was already open in the side bar; the side bar now switches to it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复某个对话已在侧边栏打开时，又在标签页中打开第二份副本的问题；现在侧边栏会切换到该对话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs reporting a failed save, without re-checking, when Claude Code printed more than 1 MB of output
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude Code 输出超过 1 MB 时，设置对话框直接报告保存失败而不重新检查的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an endless "Teleporting session…" spinner when the extension stops responding
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展停止响应时，"Teleporting session…" 转圈无限持续的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: it says when a turned-off plugin is still on because of other settings, and explains a plugin folder clash
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进 Manage plugins 对话框：如果某个已关闭的插件因其他设置仍处于开启状态，会给出说明；并解释插件文件夹冲突的原因

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed Stop and Escape to end only the current turn; background agents keep running and can be stopped one by one from the agent map
entries.zh: [VSCode] Stop 和 Escape 现在只结束当前这一轮；后台智能体会继续运行，可在智能体地图中逐个停止

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the "✻ Claude Code" status bar item to show in every window, so you can open Claude when no file is open
entries.zh: [VSCode] 「✻ Claude Code」状态栏项目改为在每个窗口中显示，即使没有打开文件也能打开 Claude

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed an answered question card or approved tool call getting no reply when the session had gone idle after Claude sent a message
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复 Claude 发出消息后，会话进入空闲状态时，已回答的问题卡片或已批准的工具调用得不到回复的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed clearing an organization environment's setup script in admin settings leaving new cloud sessions still running the old script
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复在管理设置中清空组织环境的设置脚本后，新云端会话仍运行旧脚本的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Runner actions menu on the self-hosted environments admin page closing on its own a few seconds after it opened
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复自托管环境管理页面中，Runner actions 菜单打开几秒后会自行关闭的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs whose cloud session never started showing as Succeeded in the Runs pane, the routine's page and the sidebar; they now show as Failed
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复云端会话从未启动的例程运行，在 Runs 面板、例程页面和侧边栏中显示为 Succeeded 的问题；现在显示为 Failed

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed clicking an audio or video file in a cloud session's Outputs card opening an empty file search instead of playing the file
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复在云端会话的 Outputs 卡片中点击音频或视频文件，打开的是空的文件搜索而非播放文件的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Changed a routine's page to read "Due" with the scheduled time, instead of a next run time in the past, when a scheduled run is late and hasn't started
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 定时运行迟到且尚未开始时，例程页面改为显示「Due」和计划时间，而不是一个已过去的下次运行时间

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added an Add channel button to Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings, so a limit can be set on any channel, including a private one, from its channel ID or Slack link
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude Tag 管理设置的花费限额页面新增「Add channel」按钮，可通过频道 ID 或 Slack 链接为任意频道（包括私密频道）设置限额

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed memory recall finding nothing in organizations that cannot use the default Sonnet model
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复无法使用默认 Sonnet 模型的组织中，记忆检索结果为空的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack channel losing its Claude settings when an Enterprise Grid admin moves it to another workspace and the first post afterward doesn't mention Claude
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Enterprise Grid 管理员把频道转移到另一个工作区后，若其后的第一条消息没有 @Claude，该频道丢失 Claude 设置的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack thread occasionally starting over on a fresh machine, losing work it hadn't pushed, when your reply answered a question it had just asked
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复当你的回复回答了 Claude 刚提出的问题时，Slack 话题中的 Claude 在新机器上偶尔从头开始、丢失未推送工作的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed public channel names on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings showing as raw Slack IDs in larger organizations
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复较大组织中，Claude Tag 管理设置的花费限额页面，公开频道名称显示为原始 Slack ID 的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the titles of sessions started from Slack as shown on claude.ai: they now read as the words you typed, without Slack user IDs or escape codes
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进在 claude.ai 上显示的从 Slack 发起的会话标题：现在显示你输入的文字，不再包含 Slack 用户 ID 或转义代码

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH` environment variable to turn off the WebFetch tool
entries.zh: 添加了 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH` 环境变量以关闭 WebFetch 工具

entries.en: Added `claude --desktop` to open the Claude desktop app on the current directory, or on a session with `--continue` / `--resume <id>`
entries.zh: 添加了 `claude --desktop` 以在当前目录或使用 `--continue` / `--resume <id>` 的会话中打开 Claude 桌面应用程序

entries.en: Added `claude plugin configure <plugin>` to show a plugin's options and which are unset, or save new values read from stdin with `--values-stdin`
entries.zh: 添加了`claude plugin configure <plugin>`以显示插件的选项以及未设置的选项，或使用`--values-stdin`保存从标准输入读取的新值

entries.en: Added `<server>.<key>=<value>` to `claude plugin install --config`, so a bundled `.mcpb` MCP server's own settings can be set at install time and it starts without visiting `/plugin` → Configure
entries.zh: 在 `claude plugin install --config` 中添加了 `<server>.<key>=<value>`，因此可以在安装时设置捆绑的 `.mcpb` MCP 服务器自己的设置，并且无需访问 `/plugin` 即可启动 → 配置

entries.en: Added `allowedProviders` managed setting to limit which API providers a machine may use (Anthropic API, a custom endpoint, Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex AI, Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, or a Cloud gateway)
entries.zh: 添加了`allowedProviders`托管设置，以限制机器可以使用哪些 API 提供商（Anthropic API、自定义端点、Bedrock、Mantle、Vertex AI、Foundry、AWS 上的 Claude Platform 或云网关）

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES` environment variable to cap re-sends of a non-streaming fallback request that timed out
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES`环境变量以限制重新发送超时的非流回退请求

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` with `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1`: a subagent's own Agent call now runs in the foreground, so the subagent gets the child's result
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`和`CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1`：子代理自己的代理调用现在在前台运行，因此子代理获取子代理的结果

entries.en: Fixed plugin and marketplace installs and updates over SSH ignoring the ssh program set in `GIT_SSH` or in your git config's `core.sshCommand`
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SSH 忽略在`GIT_SSH`或 git 配置的`core.sshCommand`中设置的 ssh 程序的插件和市场安装和更新问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code refusing to start when the OS denies reading the managed settings file; it now warns and starts without that file's policies. Other read errors and unparseable files stop every session
entries.zh: 修复了当操作系统拒绝读取托管设置文件时 Claude Code 拒绝启动的问题；现在它会发出警告并在没有该文件策略的情况下启动。其他读取错误和无法解析的文件会停止每个会话

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions that restarted after their conversation was compacted refusing the next update to an artifact the session had already read or published
entries.zh: 修复了会话压缩后重新启动的云会话，拒绝对会话已读取或发布的工件进行下一次更新

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin disable` and `enable` with a full `name@marketplace` id changing a settings entry in another letter case instead of the installed plugin's own
entries.zh: 修复了带有完整`name@marketplace`id 的“claude 插件禁用”和“启用”，更改了另一个字母大小写的设置条目，而不是已安装插件自己的设置条目

entries.en: Fixed files attached to a message sent over Remote Control being left out after a single failed download; a network error, timeout or server error is now retried up to twice
entries.zh: 修复了在一次下载失败后通过远程控制发送的消息中附加的文件被遗漏的问题；网络错误、超时或服务器错误现在最多重试两次

entries.en: Fixed switching models mid-session with a `set_model` request (such as the Agent SDK's `setModel`) leaving the new model on the built-in output-token limit and auto-compact window until restart
entries.zh: 修复了使用`set_model`请求（例如 Agent SDK 的`setModel`）在会话中切换模型的问题，将新模型保留在内置输出令牌限制和自动压缩窗口上，直到重新启动

entries.en: Fixed redacted logs and transcripts showing part of a URL password that contains `@`, or all of it when the URL writes its `@` as `%40`
entries.zh: 修复了显示包含`@`的 URL 密码的一部分或当 URL 将其`@`写为`%40`时显示全部内容的编辑日志和记录

entries.en: Fixed SSH passphrase and new-host prompts from worktree and `/teleport` fetches taking over the terminal; these fetches now fail fast instead of asking
entries.zh: 修复了工作树中的 SSH 密码和新主机提示以及接管终端的`/teleport`获取；这些获取现在会快速失败而不是询问

entries.en: Fixed switching off an MCP server added mid-session in SDK and `-p` sessions leaving its tools available
entries.zh: 修复了关闭在 SDK 和`-p`会话中添加的 MCP 服务器的问题，使其工具可用

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p --permission-prompt-tool`: a background subagent's permission request now goes to the prompt tool instead of being auto-denied
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p --permission-prompt-tool`：后台子代理的权限请求现在转到提示工具，而不是被自动拒绝

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get`, and the not-found error of `claude mcp remove`, `login` and `logout`, printing line breaks and terminal escape sequences from MCP server names and values
entries.zh: 修复了`claude mcp list`和`claude mcp get`，以及`claude mcp remove`、`login`和`logout`的未找到错误，从 MCP 服务器名称和值打印换行符和终端转义序列

entries.en: Fixed sandbox auto-allow asking for approval on every run of many inline scripts (`python3 -c`, `node -e`) just because they contain `=`
entries.zh: 修复了沙箱自动允许在每次运行许多内联脚本（`python3 -c`、`node -e`）时请求批准的问题，只是因为它们包含`=`

entries.en: Fixed fork subagents not keeping the session's plan mode or `dontAsk` mode: a fork now runs under its parent's permission mode and cannot exit plan mode
entries.zh: 修复了分叉子代理不保持会话的计划模式或`dontAsk`模式的问题：分叉现在在其父级的权限模式下运行，并且无法退出计划模式

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control --help` saying `--[no-]chrome` defaults to the machine's `/chrome` setting; spawned sessions keep Claude in Chrome off unless `--chrome` is passed
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Remote-control --help”说`--[no-]chrome`默认为机器的`/chrome`设置；生成的会话会使 Chrome 中的 Claude 保持关闭状态，除非传递了`--chrome`

entries.en: Fixed background subagents in auto mode prompting a second, redundant reply after each report
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式下的后台子代理在每次报告后提示第二个冗余回复的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud session creation and `/remote-env` reading only the newest 20 of an account's environments
entries.zh: 修复了云会话创建和`/remote-env`仅读取最新的 20 个帐户环境的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control marking a message as read as soon as it arrived instead of when Claude started on it, and losing a message still queued when the terminal quit (it now arrives on the next resume)
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制将消息一到达就标记为已读的问题，而不是克劳德开始处理该消息时，以及在终端退出时丢失仍在排队的消息的问题（现在它在下一个恢复时到达）

entries.en: Fixed installing a plugin with `claude plugin install` or `/plugin` putting it into an installed plugin's cache or data folder when their ids differ only in `.`, `-`, `@` or (macOS, Windows) capitals; the install is now refused
entries.zh: 修复了使用`claude plugin install`或`/plugin`安装插件时，当其 ID 仅在`.`、`-`、`@`或（macOS、Windows）大写字母不同时，将其放入已安装插件的缓存或数据文件夹中；现在安装被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed hooks and SDK permission callbacks seeing a missing or outdated plan on ExitPlanMode when the plan was written in the same response
entries.zh: 修复了当计划写入同一响应时，挂钩和 SDK 权限回调会在 ExitPlanMode 上看到丢失或过时的计划

entries.en: Fixed the first reply in cloud sessions arriving tens of milliseconds late, a regression in 2.1.283
entries.zh: 修复云会话中第一条回复晚到数十毫秒的问题（2.1.283 版本的回归问题）

entries.en: Fixed sessions that authenticate with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` against the Anthropic API never loading the organization's policy
entries.zh: 修复了针对 Anthropic API 使用`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`进行身份验证的会话永远不会加载组织的策略的问题

entries.en: Fixed a failed `agent()`, `parallel()` or `pipeline()` call that a workflow script awaits later, or not at all, being treated as an unhandled promise rejection, which could end a background session
entries.zh: 修复了工作流脚本稍后等待或根本不等待的失败的`agent()`、`parallel()`或`pipeline()`调用，被视为未处理的承诺拒绝，这可能会结束后台会话

entries.en: Fixed synchronous hooks hanging Claude Code while a background process the hook started (for example `some-daemon &`) kept its output open; the hook now finishes shortly after its own process exits
entries.zh: 修复了同步钩子在钩子启动的后台进程（例如`some-daemon &`）保持其输出打开时挂起克劳德代码的问题；现在，钩子在其自己的进程退出后不久就会完成

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch reporting a rate-limited domain safety check as a network or enterprise policy block
entries.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 将限速域安全检查报告为网络或企业策略块的问题

entries.en: Fixed the fullscreen ctrl+o transcript freezing briefly when opened on turns with hundreds of file reads or searches; tool calls still running when the transcript opens now show their results when they finish
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下，对包含数百次文件读取或搜索的回合打开 ctrl+o 转录视图时短暂卡顿的问题；打开转录时仍在运行的工具调用，现在会在完成时显示结果

entries.en: Fixed Amazon Bedrock mid-stream `modelTimeoutException` and `serviceUnavailableException` errors showing a raw JSON body instead of the error message
entries.zh: 修复了 Amazon Bedrock 中流`modelTimeoutException`和`serviceUnavailableException`错误，显示原始 JSON 正文而不是错误消息

entries.en: Fixed `/autofix-pr` and `/schedule` saying the Claude GitHub App is not installed on a repository whose install status had not been checked yet
entries.zh: 修复了 `/autofix-pr` 和 `/schedule` 表示 Claude GitHub 应用程序未安装在尚未检查安装状态的存储库上的问题

entries.en: Fixed dismissing a row (x) in `/artifacts` unlinking its file from the artifact, so publishing the same file again created a new artifact instead of updating it
entries.zh: 修复了忽略`/artifacts`中的行 (x)，取消其文件与工件的链接，因此再次发布同一文件会创建一个新工件而不是更新它

entries.en: Fixed Artifact tool publishes after a conversation rewind (Esc Esc) overwriting a file's newer content that Claude had read only in the rewound turns; the publish is now refused until Claude re-reads the file
entries.zh: 修复了工件工具在对话倒回 (Esc Esc) 后发布的问题，覆盖了克劳德仅在倒回回合中读取的文件的较新内容；现在拒绝发布，直到克劳德重新阅读该文件

entries.en: Fixed an `Artifact` allow rule ("don't ask again") letting the Artifact tool publish a file outside the working directories without asking; add the file's folder with `--add-dir` for the rule to cover it
entries.zh: 修复了`Artifact`允许规则（“不再询问”），允许 Artifact 工具在工作目录之外发布文件而无需询问；使用`--add-dir`添加文件的文件夹以使规则覆盖它

entries.en: Fixed `/cost` and SDK `modelUsage` reporting a turn under the wrong model when the server answered a refusal with a different fallback model than the client expected
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器使用与客户端预期不同的后备模型回答拒绝时，`/cost` 和 SDK `modelUsage` 报告在错误模型下转弯的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool so that publishing a page no longer lets Claude overwrite its source file without re-reading it when Claude's earlier read was cut short or the file had changed since
entries.zh: 修复了 Artifact 工具，以便发布页面不再让 Claude 在 Claude 之前的读取被缩短或文件发生更改时覆盖其源文件而无需重新读取它

entries.en: Fixed auto mode skipping its classifier for Artifact tool asset uploads and reads of someone else's artifact when you had approved that artifact earlier in another permission mode
entries.zh: 修复了当您之前在另一种权限模式下批准该工件时，自动模式会跳过工件工具资产上传的分类器并读取其他人的工件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a misleading "core.worktree is set" error from `/ultrareview` when the project folder briefly could not be read
entries.zh: 修复了当项目文件夹短暂无法读取时来自`/ultrareview`的误导性“core.worktree is set”错误

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux failing to upload the working tree from a git worktree whose per-worktree config sets `core.longpaths`
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 和 Linux 上的`/ultrareview`无法从每个工作树配置设置`core.longpaths`的 git 工作树上传工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool sometimes reporting a publish as a conflict with another session after retrying a temporary server error, when the first attempt had actually succeeded
entries.zh: 修复了 Artifact 工具有时会在重试临时服务器错误后报告发布与另一个会话冲突，而第一次尝试实际上已成功

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` uploads including uncommitted changes to credential files whose name has a colon before the extension, such as `server:8443.key`
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`上传，包括对名称扩展名前有冒号的凭证文件进行未提交的更改，例如`server:8443.key`

entries.en: Fixed a rare auth failure when two sessions recover a login refresh lock left by a crashed process at the same time
entries.zh: 修复了当两个会话同时恢复崩溃进程留下的登录刷新锁时罕见的身份验证失败

entries.en: Fixed the PowerShell tool's permission check skipping deny and ask rules, and caching that failure for later checks, when its command parser failed to start (for example when the machine was out of memory)
entries.zh: 修复 PowerShell 工具的命令解析器启动失败（例如机器内存不足）时，权限检查会跳过 deny 和 ask 规则，并缓存这一失败结果供后续检查使用的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux running slowly on some unusual file names, and their credential-file check missing file or folder names with many backup or editor marks
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 和 Linux 上的`/ultrareview`上传在某些不寻常的文件名上运行缓慢的问题，并且其凭证文件检查丢失的文件或文件夹名称以及许多备份或编辑器标记

entries.en: Fixed a cancelled shell command or hook still starting, and running to its end, when the cancel arrived while it was being set up
entries.zh: 修复了当取消在设置过程中到达时，已取消的 shell 命令或挂钩仍然启动并运行到结束的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode: after editing in the external editor (Ctrl+G), `x` or `r` in NORMAL mode no longer breaks a pasted-text placeholder at the end of the prompt
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，在外部编辑器（Ctrl+G）中编辑后，NORMAL 模式的 `x` 或 `r` 会破坏提示框末尾的粘贴文本占位符的问题

entries.en: Fixed responses blocked by the API's output content filter being re-sent and retried, sometimes for minutes, instead of showing the filter's error right away
entries.zh: 修复了被重新发送和重试的 API 输出内容过滤器阻止的响应，有时需要几分钟，而不是立即显示过滤器的错误

entries.en: Fixed plugins silently skipping a bundled `.mcpb` MCP server that still needs configuration: `/plugin`, the install message and `claude plugin install` now say so and point to Configure
entries.zh: 修复了插件默默地跳过仍然需要配置的捆绑`.mcpb`MCP服务器：`/plugin`，安装消息和“claude插件安装”现在这样说并指向“配置”

entries.en: Fixed compacting or resuming a session failing, opening without its history, or crashing when its saved transcript holds a compaction marker or loop wakeup entry with missing or malformed fields
entries.zh: 修复了压缩或恢复会话失败、在没有历史记录的情况下打开或在其保存的记录包含压缩标记或循环唤醒条目（字段丢失或格式错误）时崩溃的问题

entries.en: WSL: Fixed `/ultrareview` refusing to upload a checkout on a Linux volume when a changed file's name has a colon or ends in a dot or space
entries.zh: WSL：修复了当变更文件名包含冒号或以点或空格结尾时，`/ultrareview` 拒绝上传位于 Linux 卷上的检出副本的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that had ended at `--max-turns`
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN`重新运行已在`--max-turns`结束的回合

entries.en: Fixed sign-in that could wait forever after the browser showed success
entries.zh: 修复了浏览器显示成功后登录可能永远等待的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed `/ultrareview` uploading a linked worktree of a repository rooted at your home folder in some cases
entries.zh: Windows：修复了某些情况下 `/ultrareview` 会上传主目录下仓库的关联 worktree 的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions reporting the uploads folder as missing before any file had been uploaded
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在上传任何文件之前报告上传文件夹丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a reply sent from `claude agents` to a background session waiting on a permission prompt sometimes approving the pending command
entries.zh: 修复了从“克劳德代理”发送到等待权限提示的后台会话的回复，有时会批准挂起的命令

entries.en: Fixed `claude attach`, `logs`, `stop`, `respawn` and `rm` starting a new session with the command name as its prompt when options came before it, such as from a shell alias
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Attach”、`logs`、`stop`、`respawn`和`rm`，当选项出现在其前面时（例如来自 shell 别名），以命令名称作为提示符启动新会话

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp list` leaving out WebSocket (`ws`) MCP servers; each is now listed with its URL and health status
entries.zh: 修复了 `claude mcp list` 遗漏了 WebSocket (`ws`) MCP 服务器的问题；每个现在都列出了其 URL 和健康状态

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp get` showing no Type, Command, Args, or Environment for stdio servers whose config entry omits the `type` field
entries.zh: 修复了配置条目省略`type`字段的 stdio 服务器没有显示类型、命令、参数或环境的`claude mcp get`问题

entries.en: Fixed `.claude/settings.local.json` allow rules being held back outside a git repository when git's trace2 output is configured
entries.zh: 修复了 `.claude/settings.local.json` 允许在配置 git 的 trace2 输出时将规则保留在 git 存储库之外的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/claude-api` eval runner scaffold and report builder writing through a symlink or hard link planted at an output file
entries.zh: 修复 `/claude-api` 评测运行器的脚手架和报告生成器，会通过输出文件处预先放置的符号链接或硬链接写入的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/claude-api` eval runner scaffold counting responses cut off at `max_tokens` in the score averages; they are now marked truncated and counted separately
entries.zh: 修复 `/claude-api` 评测运行器脚手架在计算平均分时，把因 `max_tokens` 被截断的回复也计入的问题；现在这些回复会被标记为截断并单独统计

entries.en: Fixed ` ` showing as literal text in the terminal when a reply uses it to indent text, such as row labels in a markdown table
entries.zh: 修复了当回复使用它来缩进文本（例如 Markdown 表中的行标签）时，“`”在终端中显示为文字文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed a brief freeze (up to a second) partway through long sessions outside fullscreen mode, which came back after `/clear` or `/compact`
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式之外的长时间会话中途的短暂冻结（最多一秒），该冻结在`/clear`或`/compact`之后返回

entries.en: Fixed an approved Edit never going through when its target is a device, such as a file symlinked to /dev/null, and the approval came from the IDE diff view or changed the edit
entries.zh: 修复了当目标是设备（例如符号链接到 /dev/null 的文件）并且批准来自 IDE diff 视图或更改编辑时，已批准的编辑永远不会通过的问题

entries.en: Fixed a failing API request being retried up to 21 times when streaming kept failing; the non-streaming fallback now shares the request's retry budget instead of getting a fresh set of retries
entries.zh: 修复了当流持续失败时重试失败的 API 请求最多 21 次的问题；非流式回退现在共享请求的重试预算，而不是获取一组新的重试

entries.en: Improved Claude in Chrome: the native host now reports your computer's name, so connected browsers can be labeled by computer instead of "Browser 1" / "Browser 2"
entries.zh: 改进 Claude in Chrome：本地原生主机现在会上报你电脑的名称，已连接的浏览器可以按电脑名称区分，而不是“Browser 1”“Browser 2”

entries.en: Improved Bedrock and Vertex AI sessions to switch to an older available model of the same tier, instead of failing, when an admin removes access to the default model; session titles and summaries now fall back with it
entries.zh: 改进 Bedrock 和 Vertex AI 会话：管理员移除默认模型的权限时，会自动切换到同级别的较旧可用模型，而不是直接失败；会话标题和摘要也随之回退

entries.en: Improved plugin marketplace errors to name why a git address is refused instead of citing enterprise policy
entries.zh: 改进插件市场报错：会说明 git 地址被拒绝的原因，而不是只笼统地引用企业策略

entries.en: Improved validation of git URLs for plugins, marketplaces and the current repository's remote
entries.zh: 改进插件、市场和当前仓库远程地址的 git URL 校验

entries.en: Improved Artifact tool results: they now suggest publishing in the same step as writing or editing the page, which can save a round trip
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具结果：现在会建议在写入或编辑页面的同一步里直接发布，可以省掉一次往返

entries.en: Improved Remote Control: a `/btw` side question asked of a session hosted by an app such as Claude Desktop now sees the turn in progress, not only the last finished one
entries.zh: 改进远程控制：对由 Claude Desktop 等应用托管的会话使用 `/btw` 侧边提问时，现在能看到正在进行的这一轮，而不只是上一轮已完成的内容

entries.en: Improved pictures Claude sends as BMP, HEIC, HEIF, AVIF or TIFF files: the Claude apps now show a preview where Claude Code can convert them
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 以 BMP、HEIC、HEIF、AVIF 或 TIFF 格式发送的图片：Claude 应用现在会显示预览，Claude Code 也能进行转换

entries.en: Improved subagents in auto mode: a subagent's run now ends as soon as it hands its report back to its caller, instead of taking extra turns that reach no one
entries.zh: 改进自动模式下的子智能体：子智能体一旦把报告交回给调用方，运行就结束，不再多跑无人接收结果的轮次

entries.en: Improved Bedrock and Vertex start-up model checks: models your account cannot use are now remembered for up to a day instead of being re-checked on every launch
entries.zh: 改进 Bedrock 和 Vertex 启动时的模型检查：账号无法使用的模型会记住一天，不再每次启动都重新检查

entries.en: Improved Artifact tool publish results to use fewer tokens: the note on updating an artifact is shorter, and where to find your artifacts is no longer repeated after every publish
entries.zh: 精简 Artifact 发布结果以节省 token：更新 artifact 的说明更短，且每次发布后不再重复说明去哪里找 artifact

entries.en: Improved SDK liveness during a non-streaming fallback request: with partial messages on, a `ping` stream event is now sent every 30 seconds on the Anthropic API, Claude Platform on AWS and gateways
entries.zh: 改进 SDK 在非流式回退请求期间的活性检测：开启部分消息时，在 Anthropic API、Claude Platform on AWS 和网关上每 30 秒发送一次 `ping` 事件

entries.en: Improved `/resume` and `claude --resume` on a session that is running in the background: they now open that session instead of refusing, and a prompt given with `claude --resume <id> "prompt"` is sent to it as its next turn
entries.zh: 改进 `/resume` 和 `claude --resume`：对后台运行中的会话，改为直接打开它，而不是拒绝；用 `claude --resume <id> "提示词"` 给出的提示词，会作为该会话的下一轮发送

entries.en: Improved per-turn performance when many permission deny rules and MCP tools are configured
entries.zh: 改进配置了大量权限拒绝规则和 MCP 工具时每轮对话的性能

entries.en: Improved responsiveness when leaving the ctrl+o transcript view in long sessions when fullscreen rendering is off
entries.zh: 改进长会话中退出 ctrl+o 转录视图的响应速度（关闭全屏渲染时）

entries.en: Improved Bedrock, Vertex and Mantle start-up model checks to send the same User-Agent, x-app and session ID headers as regular requests
entries.zh: 改进 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Mantle 启动时的模型检查：发送与常规请求相同的 User-Agent、x-app 和会话 ID 请求头

entries.en: Changed MCP tools so a tool that sets its own `_meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad']` to false stays deferred when its `--mcp-config`, Agent SDK or plugin server is set to `alwaysLoad`
entries.zh: 更改了 MCP 工具，以便将其自身的 `_meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad']` 设置为 false 的工具在其 `--mcp-config`、Agent SDK 或插件服务器设置为 `alwaysLoad` 时保持延迟

entries.en: Changed background Bash and PowerShell commands to stop after a time limit (their `timeout` with `run_in_background`, default 30 min, max 2 h); Claude is notified when one is stopped
entries.zh: 更改了后台 Bash 和 PowerShell 命令，使其在时间限制后停止（它们的`timeout`与`run_in_background`，默认 30 分钟，最长 2 小时）；当有人停下来时克劳德会收到通知

entries.en: Changed Code Review's pull request reviews and `/ultrareview` to run when `disableWorkflows` is on, unless the machine running the review has it set by its own administrator (MDM or the managed-settings file)
entries.zh: 更改了代码审查的拉取请求审查和`/ultrareview`，使其在`disableWorkflows`打开时运行，除非运行审查的计算机由其自己的管理员（MDM 或托管设置文件）进行设置

entries.en: Changed sessions behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to use the 1M context window of models that have one (Opus 4.7+, Sonnet 5+, Fable); run `/autocompact 200k` if your gateway stops at 200K
entries.zh: 更改了自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`后面的会话，以使用具有该模型的 1M 上下文窗口（Opus 4.7+、Sonnet 5+、Fable）；如果您的网关停在 200K，请运行`/autocompact 200k`

entries.en: Changed Team and Enterprise sessions, and sessions whose sign-in plan Claude Code can't determine, to withhold WebFetch until the organization policy loads if it couldn't be loaded at startup
entries.zh: 更改了团队和企业会话以及 Claude Code 无法确定其登录计划的会话，如果在启动时无法加载，则保留 WebFetch，直到组织策略加载为止

entries.en: Changed /memory so that Auto-memory can no longer be turned on from a background session or from a session one of Claude Code's own tools started; turning it off there still works
entries.zh: 更改了 /memory，以便不再可以从后台会话或从 Claude Code 自己的工具之一启动的会话打开自动内存；把它关掉仍然有效

entries.en: Changed the one-time offer to make auto mode your default permission mode to also show on third-party providers and with telemetry off, when your user settings default to another mode
entries.zh: 更改了一次性优惠，使自动模式成为您的默认权限模式，当您的用户设置默认为另一种模式时，也可以在第三方提供商上显示并关闭遥测

entries.en: Changed `claude -p` and Python Agent SDK sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured, like interactive sessions; `--permission-mode` still overrides it
entries.zh: 更改了第三方提供商上的`claude -p`和 Python Agent SDK 会话，或者在未配置权限模式（如交互式会话）时关闭遥测以自动模式启动； `--permission-mode` 仍然会覆盖它

entries.en: Changed Bedrock, Mantle and Claude Platform on AWS requests to a base URL with a non-default port to include the port in the SigV4-signed Host header
entries.zh: 将 AWS 上的 Bedrock、Mantle 和 Claude Platform 请求更改为具有非默认端口的基本 URL，以将该端口包含在 SigV4 签名的主机标头中

entries.en: Changed the MCP server name `widgets` to be reserved in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners: your own server under it, or a close spelling such as `widgets_`, no longer loads, so rename it
entries.zh: 更改了 MCP 服务器名称`widgets`，以在云会话和自托管运行器中保留：您自己的服务器，或者类似`widgets_`的紧密拼写，不再加载，因此将其重命名

entries.en: Changed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux to leave symbolic refs out when uploading a local checkout; a checkout whose current branch is a symbolic ref is now refused with an explanation
entries.zh: 更改了 macOS 和 Linux 上的`/ultrareview`，以便在上传本地结帐时保留符号引用；当前分支是符号引用的结帐现在被拒绝并给出解释

entries.en: Windows: Changed project and local settings `env` to no longer set `ALLUSERSPROFILE`, `SystemDrive`, or the `CommonProgramFiles` variables; set them in user or managed settings instead
entries.zh: Windows：项目和本地设置中的 `env` 不再设置 `ALLUSERSPROFILE`、`SystemDrive` 或 `CommonProgramFiles` 变量；请改在用户或托管设置中设置

entries.en: Changed `/tasks` to fold background work Claude Code runs for itself under one "System tasks" row; press Enter on it to show those tasks
entries.zh: 更改了`/tasks`以折叠后台工作 Claude Code 在“系统任务”行下自行运行；按 Enter 键即可显示这些任务

entries.en: Changed `/ultrareview` on macOS and Linux to require git 2.31 or newer to upload a local repository; checkouts made with `--separate-git-dir` are now refused instead of being uploaded with an older method
entries.zh: 更改了 macOS 和 Linux 上的`/ultrareview`，要求 git 2.31 或更高版本才能上传本地存储库；使用`--separate-git-dir`进行的结账现在被拒绝，而不是使用旧方法上传

entries.en: Changed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux to send a partial clone as a working-tree snapshot on git 2.31 or newer, instead of falling back or refusing when git's version looked too old
entries.zh: 更改了 macOS 和 Linux 上的`/ultrareview`上传，以将部分克隆作为 git 2.31 或更高版本上的工作树快照发送，而不是在 git 的版本看起来太旧时回退或拒绝

entries.en: Changed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux to refuse, instead of fetching, a partial clone missing some of its working tree's files on older git versions; a clone made without `--filter` uploads
entries.zh: 更改了 macOS 和 Linux 上的`/ultrareview`上传，以拒绝而不是获取旧版 git 版本上缺少部分工作树文件的部分克隆；没有`--filter`上传的克隆

entries.en: Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Mantle start-up model checks to identify themselves as Claude Code, like other Claude Code requests
entries.zh: 更改了基岩、顶点和地幔启动模型检查，以将自己标识为克劳德代码，就像其他克劳德代码请求一样

entries.en: Changed `claude mcp get` to hide the command, arguments, and environment values of stdio MCP servers provided by plugins; variable names are still shown
entries.zh: 更改了 `claude mcp get` 以隐藏插件提供的 stdio MCP 服务器的命令、参数和环境值；变量名称仍然显示

entries.en: Changed `/claude-api` so it can no longer be run from Remote Control clients
entries.zh: 更改了`/claude-api`，使其无法再从远程控制客户端运行

entries.en: Changed `/config chrome=true` to direct you to the /config panel instead of enabling Claude in Chrome by default; `/config chrome=false` still turns it off when it was on
entries.zh: 更改了 `/config chrome=true` 以引导您进入 /config 面板，而不是默认在 Chrome 中启用 Claude； `/config chrome=false` 仍然会在打开时将其关闭

entries.en: Changed sandbox settings so project settings cannot widen or turn off an admin-required sandbox, replace the proxy behind a managed deny list, extend a strict allowlist, or reopen managed read-denies
entries.zh: 更改了沙箱设置，以便项目设置无法扩大或关闭管理员所需的沙箱、替换托管拒绝列表后面的代理、扩展严格的允许列表或重新打开托管读取拒绝

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a note under a restored tab's last message when a window reload interrupted it and no reply will follow
entries.zh: [VSCode] 窗口重新加载打断了恢复标签页的最后一条消息、且之后不会再有回复时，该消息下方会显示一条提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a plugin options form to Manage plugins: installing a plugin that has options asks for the unset ones, and a gear on its row changes them later
entries.zh: [VSCode] 管理插件中新增插件选项表单：安装带选项的插件时会询问未设置的选项，之后可通过该插件行上的齿轮图标修改

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an on-demand diagnostics tool so Claude in the panel can read the Problems panel's current errors and warnings at any time, not only right after it edits a file
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增按需诊断工具，使面板中的 Claude 随时都能读取「问题」面板中当前的错误和警告，而不只是在编辑文件后

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter after typing a slash command running an unrelated menu item picked by fuzzy match, or doing nothing
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复输入斜杠命令后按 Enter，会运行通过模糊匹配选中的无关菜单项、或毫无反应的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an open agent transcript losing the agent's newer messages during a long session
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复长会话中，打开的 agent 记录丢失该 agent 较新消息的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message that quotes a Claude Code or IDE tag losing the rest of its text in the chat
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复引用 Claude Code 或 IDE 标签的消息，在聊天中丢失其余文本的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message sent while Claude was working disappearing from the conversation after the session was reopened
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude 工作期间发送的消息，在会话重新打开后从对话中消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list's Web tab showing the previous account's sessions after an account switch
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复切换账号后，会话列表的 Web 标签页仍显示上一个账号会话的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed restored tabs re-running an interrupted turn when VS Code was started with `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` set, even with Continue After Reload off
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 后启动 VS Code 时，即使关闭了 Continue After Reload，恢复的标签页仍会重新运行被中断的轮次的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping the running turn instead of closing the command menu after clicking one of its rows
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复点击命令菜单中的某一行后，按 Escape 会停止正在运行的轮次，而不是关闭菜单的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed opening Past conversations replacing a live conversation with its saved copy
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复打开 Past conversations 时，把正在运行的对话替换成其保存副本的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a Claude tab reloaded after an extension restart staying blank instead of saying how to recover
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展重启后重新加载的 Claude 标签页一直空白、也不告知如何恢复的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed opening a conversation that is already open in another window or app starting a second copy of it without warning; it now asks first
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复打开已在其他窗口或应用中打开的对话时，会无提示地再启动一份副本的问题；现在会先询问

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a hook's reason for blocking or stopping a prompt disappearing after a window reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复窗口重新加载后，hook 阻止或停止提示的原因消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed tabs stuck on a conversation that can't be resumed: the error now says so and offers to start a new conversation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复标签页卡在无法恢复的对话上的问题：现在会说明原因，并提供开始新对话的选项

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed every file Read, Write and Edit stalling for ten minutes and then being skipped when the editor stops responding to the extension's automatic save before the tool runs
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复编辑器停止响应扩展的自动保存时，每次文件读取、写入和编辑都会卡住十分钟然后被跳过的问题（发生在工具运行之前）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the agent map labeling a sub-agent with the session's model instead of the model it actually ran on (e.g. under `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE` or an agent's own `model`)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 agent 地图把子 agent 标注为会话模型、而不是其实际运行模型的问题（例如设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE` 或 agent 自身的 `model` 时）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed uninstalling a plugin from the Manage plugins dialog, which removed the wrong installation or failed for a plugin installed for the project
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 Manage plugins 对话框中卸载插件时，卸载了错误的安装，或对项目安装的插件卸载失败的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-in staying on the authorization-code step after going back and choosing the same sign-in method again
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复返回后再次选择同一登录方式时，登录停留在授权码步骤的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat panel stalling when a long session trims its oldest rows
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复长会话裁剪最旧的行时，聊天面板卡顿的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the conversation disappearing from a session when many agents run
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复同时运行大量 agent 时，对话从会话中消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the editor tab keeping an old name after a session was renamed with /rename, by a SessionStart hook, or on claude.ai
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话通过 /rename、SessionStart hook 或 claude.ai 重命名后，编辑器标签页仍保留旧名称的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the agent map's transcript view leaving out messages sent to a running agent
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 agent 地图的记录视图遗漏了发送给正在运行的 agent 的消息的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: a failed plugin action now opens a popup that explains it and, where there is one, offers the fix
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进 Manage plugins 对话框：插件操作失败时，会弹出说明，并在可能的情况下给出修复方法

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the Manage plugins dialog to ask before removing a marketplace or turning off a plugin that your project's shared `.claude/settings.json` turns on
entries.zh: [VSCode] 管理插件对话框中，若项目共享的 `.claude/settings.json` 启用了某插件，移除其市场或关闭该插件前会先询问

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed Run now on a routine showing internal error text when the run is refused before it starts; it now shows the same explanation as the routine's failure notification
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复例程点击 Run now 后，运行在开始前即被拒绝时显示内部错误文字的问题；现在显示与例程失败通知相同的说明

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Changed `MCP_DISCOVERY_CACHE=1`, when set in your cloud environment's variables rather than a settings file, to reuse your connectors' tool lists after a session restart; other MCP servers are no longer cached and connect at startup
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 若 `MCP_DISCOVERY_CACHE=1` 是在云端环境变量中设置（而非设置文件中），会话重启后将复用连接器的工具列表；其他 MCP 服务器不再缓存，改为启动时连接

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added direct messages with Claude for members on an Enterprise plan Standard or Usage-Based Chat seat who also have Cowork; a seat that includes Claude Code is no longer required
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 企业版 Standard 或 Usage-Based Chat 席位、且同时拥有 Cowork 的成员，现在可以与 Claude 私信；不再要求席位包含 Claude Code

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the Default model setting in admin settings and a channel's Configure page offering models your organization can't use, which made saves or new sessions fail
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复管理设置中的 Default model 设置和频道配置页面提供组织无法使用的模型，导致保存或新会话失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the note under Claude's Slack messages saying it answered on a fallback model, and why, disappearing when Claude later edited that message
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 之后编辑某条 Slack 消息时，消息下方说明其使用了备用模型及原因的提示消失的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed the organization menu in Code Review's "Add a repository" dialog showing only a few of your GitHub organizations; it now loads more as you scroll
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复 Code Review「Add a repository」对话框中的组织菜单只显示少数 GitHub 组织的问题；现在滚动时会加载更多

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved the Code Review check run to say when your repository's REVIEW.md wasn't applied, for example on a very large pull request or when REVIEW.md is a symbolic link
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进 Code Review 检查运行：当仓库的 REVIEW.md 未被应用时（例如拉取请求非常大，或 REVIEW.md 是符号链接）会给出说明

entries.en: Added Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`), now the default Sonnet model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $2/$10 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`)，现在是 Anthropic API 上的默认 Sonnet 模型 — 1M 上下文，每个 Mtok $2/$10，其中 $0.20/Mtok 缓存读取

entries.en: Added a "Yes, but ask again next time" answer to auto mode's prompt before a read outside the working directories, so you can allow that one read and still be asked about later ones
entries.zh: 在读取工作目录之外的内容之前，在自动模式的提示中添加了“是，但下次再询问”答案，这样您就可以允许该读取，但仍会被询问稍后的内容

entries.en: Added dollar amounts to the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line (for example "$271.40 / $500.00 spent this month") when the gateway runs this version or later; the status line's `rate_limits.spend_limit` also gains `used_usd`, `limit_usd` and `period`
entries.zh: 当网关运行此版本或更高版本时，在`/usage`和状态行中为 Claude 应用程序网关支出限制添加了美元金额（例如“本月支出 271.40 美元/500.00 美元”）；状态行的 `rate_limits.spend_limit` 也获得 `used_usd`、`limit_usd` 和 `period`

entries.en: Added `effortSlider:decreaseEffort`, `increaseEffort` and `toggleUltracode` keybinding actions, so the `/effort` slider's arrow and Tab keys can be rebound in `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 添加了 `effortSlider:decreaseEffort`、`increaseEffort` 和 `toggleUltracode` 键绑定操作，因此 `/effort` 滑块的箭头和 Tab 键可以在 `keybindings.json` 中反弹

entries.en: Added `/rate-limit-options` to `/help` and the command menu for claude.ai subscribers, so the usage-limit notices that mention it point to a command you can find
entries.zh: 将`/rate-limit-options`添加到`/help`和 claude.ai 订阅者的命令菜单中，因此提及它的使用限制通知指向您可以找到的命令

entries.en: Added `/mcp reconnect all` in the interactive terminal to retry every MCP server that failed to connect or needs authentication at once
entries.zh: 在交互式终端中添加了`/mcp reconnect all`，以立即重试每个连接失败或需要身份验证的 MCP 服务器

entries.en: Added Claude apps gateway startup warnings when a managed policy's `availableModels` is empty, or leaves out the model Claude Code starts on without setting `model` or `enforceAvailableModels`
entries.zh: 当托管策略的`availableModels`为空或遗漏模型时，添加了克劳德应用程序网关启动警告，克劳德代码在未设置`model`或`enforceAvailableModels`的情况下启动

entries.en: Added `auth: { google: {} }` for Claude apps gateway `telemetry.forward_to` destinations, so telemetry can be exported straight to Google Cloud's OTLP endpoint using the gateway's Google Cloud credentials
entries.zh: 为 Claude 应用网关`telemetry.forward_to`目的地添加了`auth: { google: {} }`，因此可以使用网关的 Google Cloud 凭据将遥测数据直接导出到 Google Cloud 的 OTLP 端点

entries.en: Added certificate client authentication (`private_key_jwt`) between the Claude apps gateway and its identity provider, for identity providers that issue certificate credentials instead of client secrets
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用程序网关与其身份提供商之间添加了证书客户端身份验证 (`private_key_jwt`)，适用于颁发证书凭据而不是客户端密钥的身份提供商

entries.en: Fixed a damaged response stream showing raw errors such as "JSON Parse error" or "undefined is not an object", or writing the word "undefined" into an answer, instead of being retried or reported as an interrupted response
entries.zh: 修复了显示原始错误（例如“JSON 解析错误”或“未定义不是对象”）的损坏响应流，或将“未定义”一词写入答案，而不是重试或报告为中断响应

entries.en: Fixed an overloaded or server error arriving right after a thinking block ending the turn with an error instead of being retried
entries.zh: 修复了思维块以错误结束回合而不是重试后立即出现的过载或服务器错误

entries.en: Fixed "Prompt is too long" errors that persisted after compacting: when the compacted request is still too long, Claude Code now compacts once more, keeping less of the recent conversation
entries.zh: 修复了压缩后仍然存在的“提示太长”错误：当压缩的请求仍然太长时，克劳德代码现在会再次压缩，保留较少的最近对话

entries.en: Fixed a session whose model is unavailable, with no fallback model left, showing a bare "is currently unavailable" message (or "Something went wrong" in cloud sessions) instead of the model-unavailable notice and its Learn more link
entries.zh: 修复了模型不可用的会话，没有留下后备模型，仅显示“当前不可用”消息（或云会话中的“出现问题”），而不是模型不可用通知及其“了解更多”链接

entries.en: Fixed Agent SDK sessions crashing when a user message contains an image with a malformed `source`, and failing on every later turn after a malformed document block; a malformed image is now replaced with an explanatory note
entries.zh: 修复了当用户消息包含带有格式错误的“源”的图像时代理 SDK 会话崩溃，以及在格式错误的文档块之后的每个回合中失败的问题；格式错误的图像现已替换为解释性注释

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls in a resumed session failing with "No such tool available" while their server was still connecting; the call now waits up to 10 seconds for the server
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话中的 MCP 工具调用在服务器仍在连接时失败并显示“没有此类工具可用”的问题；呼叫现在等待服务器长达 10 秒

entries.en: Fixed repeated calls to the plan-usage endpoint after it rate-limits or rejects your login: `/usage`, `/extra-usage` and IDE usage views now back off instead of re-asking
entries.zh: 修复了在限制速率或拒绝登录后重复调用计划使用端点的问题：`/usage`、`/extra-usage`和 IDE 使用视图现在会后退而不是重新询问

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp add` reporting success when managed settings restrict MCP servers to plugins; it now refuses and says what to do, instead of saving a server that never loads
entries.zh: 修复了当托管设置将 MCP 服务器限制为插件时`claude mcp add`报告成功的问题；它现在拒绝并说明要做什么，而不是保存永远不会加载的服务器

entries.en: Fixed the `/plugin` configure screen: boolean options are now a true/false choice instead of free text, number options refuse invalid input, and ←/→ change an options field instead of switching tabs
entries.zh: 修复 `/plugin` 配置界面：布尔选项现在是"true/false"二选一而非自由输入，数字选项会拒绝无效输入，←/→ 现在用于切换选项字段而非切换标签页

entries.en: Fixed `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE` being interpolated into the Foundry endpoint host unvalidated; a value that is not a plain resource name is now refused
entries.zh: 修复了插入到未验证的 Foundry 端点主机中的`ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE`；现在拒绝非普通资源名称的值

entries.en: Fixed Claude Desktop behind a Claude apps gateway offering no 1M context option: the gateway now marks each 1M-capable model for Desktop automatically
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 应用程序网关后面的 Claude Desktop 不提供 1M 上下文选项的问题：网关现在自动标记每个支持 1M 的桌面模型

entries.en: Fixed ↓ in shell mode selecting a hidden background-tasks pill, which stopped Backspace and Ctrl+U from editing the prompt
entries.zh: 修复 shell 模式下按 ↓ 会选中隐藏的后台任务标签，导致 Backspace 和 Ctrl+U 无法编辑提示框的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool failing on Windows with many plugins enabled: plugin `bin/` directories that don't exist are no longer added to PATH, and inherited entries aren't added twice
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具在启用了许多插件的 Windows 上失败的问题：不存在的插件 `bin/` 目录不再添加到 PATH，并且继承的条目不会添加两次

entries.en: Fixed `sparsePaths` plugin marketplaces cloning empty and replacing a working local copy on older git (before 2.39), which failed every refresh with "marketplace.json file is no longer present"
entries.zh: 修复了 `sparsePaths` 插件市场克隆空并替换较旧 git（2.39 之前）上的工作本地副本的问题，该问题导致每次刷新都会失败，并显示“marketplace.json 文件不再存在”

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen rendering erasing the terminal output above the session when `[` in transcript mode writes the conversation to scrollback (macOS and Linux)
entries.zh: 修复了当转录模式下的`[`将对话写入回滚时，全屏渲染会擦除会话上方的终端输出（macOS 和 Linux）

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen scroll position jumping to the previous message or to the bottom when a reply finished streaming while scrolled up
entries.zh: 修复了当向上滚动回复完成流式传输时，全屏滚动位置跳转到上一条消息或底部的问题

entries.en: Fixed tab bars in dialogs such as `/config` and `/plugin` breaking the title and tab labels mid-word in a narrow terminal; a tab that doesn't fit now moves to the next line whole
entries.zh: 修复了`/config`和`/plugin`等对话框中的选项卡栏，在狭窄的终端中破坏了标题和选项卡标签的中字；不适合的选项卡现在会整个移动到下一行

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker showing "+1 model" below the list after scrolling to the last model; the count now covers only the models below the visible rows
entries.zh: 修复滚动到最后一个模型后，`/model` 选择器列表下方仍显示"+1 model"的问题；计数现在只统计可见行下方的模型

entries.en: Fixed `/keybindings` writing Backspace and Delete bindings for a footer action that does nothing into the generated `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了为页脚操作写入退格键和删除绑定的`/keybindings`，该操作对生成的`keybindings.json`没有任何作用

entries.en: Fixed a rebound agent panel close key (`footer:close`) typing "x" instead of itself on the row of the agent you're viewing
entries.zh: 修复了反弹代理面板关闭键（`footer:close`）在您正在查看的代理行上键入“x”而不是其本身

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `.` not repeating text typed very fast (for example over ssh or in tmux) or pasted without bracketed paste, and leaving the prompt in INSERT mode after repeating a change with nothing typed (such as `cw` then Esc)
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下 `.` 无法重复快速输入（例如通过 ssh 或在 tmux 中）或未用括号粘贴方式粘贴的文字，并且在重复一个没有输入任何内容的修改（如 `cw` 然后按 Esc）后，提示框停留在 INSERT 模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor on an image placeholder's opening bracket after `dd` on the last line or `yy` at the end of the prompt, where `r` or `x` would break or delete the image
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，在最后一行执行 `dd` 或在提示框末尾执行 `yy` 后，光标停在图片占位符的开括号上，导致 `r` 或 `x` 会破坏或删除该图片的问题

entries.en: Fixed a key pressed the instant the terminal regained focus answering the Remote Control enable prompt before its short safety delay restarted
entries.zh: 修复了在终端重新获得焦点并在短暂的安全延迟重新启动之前回答远程控制启用提示时按下的按键

entries.en: Fixed the workspace trust dialog appearing a second time after switching renderers or updating when Claude Code was started in the home directory
entries.zh: 修复在主目录中启动 Claude Code 后切换渲染器或更新，工作区信任对话框会再次出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed rules symlinked into `.claude/rules` from outside the project being skipped without ever showing the external-imports approval prompt; a `.claude` directory symlinked from outside the project now asks for the same approval
entries.zh: 修复了从项目外部符号链接到`.claude/rules`的规则被跳过，而不会显示外部导入批准提示；从项目外部符号链接的`.claude`目录现在要求相同的批准

entries.en: Fixed plugins from marketplaces, claude.ai and npm pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; only plugins from an official Anthropic source or a source that managed settings vouch for keep that pre-approval
entries.zh: 修复了来自市场、claude.ai 和 npm 的插件通过托管`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`下的`allowed-tools`预先批准自己的工具；仅来自官方 Anthropic 来源或管理设置的来源保证保持预先批准的插件

entries.en: Fixed a failed first `claude plugin install` leaving the plugin enabled and recorded when a dependency's version range could not be met
entries.zh: 修复了第一个失败的“claude 插件安装”，当无法满足依赖项的版本范围时，启用并记录插件

entries.en: Fixed the debug log dropping a failed hook's stderr when the hook also wrote to stdout, and logging nothing for a failed hook with no output; failed hooks now also log their status code
entries.zh: 修复调试日志在钩子同时写入 stdout 时丢失失败钩子的 stderr，以及失败且无输出的钩子完全不记录的问题；现在失败的钩子也会记录其状态码

entries.en: Fixed `{"decision":"block"}` returned by Elicitation and ElicitationResult hooks being ignored; it now declines the MCP elicitation, as exit code 2 does
entries.zh: 修复了 Eliitation 和 EliitationResult 钩子返回的 `{"decision":"block"}` 被忽略的问题；它现在拒绝 MCP 引发，如退出代码 2 所做的那样

entries.en: Fixed sessions launched without the `SendMessage` tool (such as by Claude Desktop) still being told to message other sessions with it
entries.zh: 修复了在没有`SendMessage`工具（例如 Claude Desktop）的情况下启动的会话仍被告知用它向其他会话发送消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed a photo sent from the Claude app over Remote Control being lost when its queued message was pulled back into the terminal prompt to edit, and the cursor moving one character for a photo with no caption
entries.zh: 修复了通过远程控制从克劳德应用程序发送的一张照片，当其排队消息被拉回终端提示进行编辑时丢失，并且光标为没有标题的照片移动一个字符

entries.en: Fixed typing a message during an automatic usage-limit wait taking the wait out of the "Continue automatically at usage limit" setting's control when that turn hit the limit again
entries.zh: 修复自动用量上限等待期间输入消息，且该回合再次触碰上限时，等待不再受"在用量上限时自动继续"设置控制的问题

entries.en: Fixed usage-limit warnings suggesting `/upgrade` to users already on the highest Max plan; the warnings and `/upgrade` itself now point at `/usage-credits` when it is available
entries.zh: 修复已是最高 Max 套餐的用户仍收到建议使用 `/upgrade` 的用量上限警告的问题；警告和 `/upgrade` 本身在可用时现在会指向 `/usage-credits`

entries.en: Fixed the Explore subagent switching to Opus on the Claude API when the session runs a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as a custom model behind a proxy; Explore now inherits that model
entries.zh: 修复会话使用 Claude Code 无法识别的模型 ID（如代理后的自定义模型）时，Explore 子智能体在 Claude API 上切换到 Opus 的问题；现在 Explore 会继承该模型

entries.en: Fixed `/loop` status updates in self-paced mode often not being shown because Claude wrote them only in its reasoning; Claude now writes each update, and the outcome when the loop stops, as visible text
entries.zh: 修复了自定进度模式下的`/loop`状态更新经常不会显示的问题，因为克劳德只在推理中编写了它们；克劳德现在将每次更新以及循环停止时的结果写入可见文本

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` failing to upload the working tree when started from a git worktree that the Claude desktop app created on macOS or Linux
entries.zh: 修复了从 Claude 桌面应用程序在 macOS 或 Linux 上创建的 git 工作树启动时`/ultrareview`无法上传工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing to start on Linux when the working directory is write-denied and contains a read-denied directory
entries.zh: 修复了当工作目录被拒绝写入且包含拒绝读取目录时，沙盒 Bash 命令无法在 Linux 上启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed artifact database write results telling Claude that every viewer sees a write to a viewer's private `data/users/` subtree, and added a "view" level to `as_level`
entries.zh: 修复了工件数据库写入结果，告诉 Claude 每个查看者都会看到对查看者私有`data/users/`子树的写入，并向`as_level`添加“查看”级别

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway answering `431 Request Header Fields Too Large` to every request from a sign-in whose identity provider lists many groups; it now accepts request headers up to 256 KiB
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德应用程序网关对来自身份提供商列出许多组的登录的每个请求应答“431 请求标头字段太大”的问题；它现在接受最大 256 KiB 的请求标头

entries.en: Improved the usage-limit wait: the limit's state and the countdown with the usage-credits option now show as one block under the prompt, and limit messages no longer repeat the countdown
entries.zh: 改进用量限额等待提示：限额状态和带用量积分选项的倒计时合并显示为提示框下方的一个区块，限额消息不再重复显示倒计时

entries.en: Improved the "No such tool available" error for Claude in Chrome tools called without their prefix: it now names the tool to call
entries.zh: 改进 Claude in Chrome 工具在缺少前缀时的「No such tool available」报错：现在会指出应调用的工具名

entries.en: Improved Monitor event rows to show what each event printed instead of repeating the description, and stopped repeating an unchanged "Waiting for N … to finish" line after every event
entries.zh: 改进 Monitor 事件行：显示每个事件实际输出的内容，而不是重复描述；未变化的“Waiting for N … to finish”行不再在每个事件后重复出现

entries.en: Improved Workflow tool sandbox hardening for errors thrown by async script hooks
entries.zh: 改进 Workflow 工具的沙箱加固：针对异步脚本钩子抛出的错误

entries.en: Improved startup time and memory use by building only the parts of the settings schema that your settings files actually use
entries.zh: 改进启动时间和内存占用：只构建你的设置文件实际用到的那部分设置 schema

entries.en: Improved `/claude-api`: `hillclimb` no longer spends rounds on prompt rewordings too small for the eval to measure, and an extra page you ask for beside `report.html` is built as one local file that loads nothing from the network
entries.zh: 改进 `/claude-api`：`hillclimb` 不再把轮次浪费在评测无法衡量的微小措辞改动上；你要求的、与 `report.html` 并列的额外页面，会构建为一个不从网络加载任何内容的本地文件

entries.en: Improved lists such as `/tasks`, `/copy` and `/hooks`: the details after each name now line up in one column when they fit, and otherwise sit at the right edge
entries.zh: 改进 `/tasks`、`/copy`、`/hooks` 等列表：名称后的详情在空间足够时对齐成一列，否则靠右边缘显示

entries.en: Improved `claude plugin marketplace add` to say when it replaces a marketplace already added under the same name from a different source, and how to undo it
entries.zh: 改进 `claude plugin marketplace add`：若替换了同名但来源不同的已添加市场，会说明替换情况以及如何撤销

entries.en: Improved the startup refusal when managed settings require a sign-in (`forceLoginMethod` or `forceLoginOrgUUID`) and an API key, token or `apiKeyHelper` is configured: it now names the credential in use, where it is set, and how to remove it
entries.zh: 改进启动拒绝提示：当托管设置要求登录（`forceLoginMethod` 或 `forceLoginOrgUUID`），而又配置了 API 密钥、令牌或 `apiKeyHelper` 时，会写明正在使用的凭证、它在哪里设置，以及如何删除

entries.en: Improved auto-memory loading: invisible characters and tags that imitate Claude Code's own markup are neutralized in `MEMORY.md` and recalled memory notes before they reach Claude
entries.zh: 改进自动记忆加载：`MEMORY.md` 和被调用的记忆笔记中，模仿 Claude Code 自身标记的不可见字符和标签，在送给 Claude 前会被中和

entries.en: Improved `claude remote-control`: in a folder you haven't trusted yet, it now asks for workspace trust on the terminal instead of exiting
entries.zh: 改进 `claude remote-control`：在尚未信任的文件夹中，会在终端上询问工作区信任，而不是直接退出

entries.en: Improved artifact pages: Claude writes its design plan into the page instead of the reply, and uses the name you already gave something as the page title
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 页面：Claude 把设计方案写进页面而不是回复里；页面标题沿用你已经给它起的名字

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool so that when Claude is given a claude.ai chat or project link, an artifact from a chat, or an artifact id on its own, it asks for the right link or the content instead of stopping
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具：当 Claude 拿到 claude.ai 聊天或项目链接、聊天中的 Artifact，或单独一个 Artifact ID 时，会请你提供正确的链接或内容，而不是直接停止

entries.en: Changed interactive terminal and VS Code sessions to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured, on every plan and provider; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it
entries.zh: 将交互式终端和 VS Code 会话更改为在每个计划和提供程序上未配置权限模式时以自动模式启动； `permissions.defaultMode` 仍然会覆盖它

entries.en: Changed Ultracode into its own toggle in `/effort` (Tab, or `/effort ultracode [on|off]`): it no longer forces xhigh effort and stays on at any effort level
entries.zh: 将 Ultracode 更改为`/effort`中自己的切换（Tab 或`/effort ultracode [on|off]`）：它不再强制 xhigh 努力并保持在任何努力级别

entries.en: Changed retries after a dropped connection mid-response to share one budget with the rest of the request's retries, so a failing request gives up sooner
entries.zh: 更改了响应中途连接断开后的重试，以便与请求的其余重试共享一个预算，因此失败的请求会更快放弃

entries.en: Changed the notice shown when a Sonnet model's safeguards flag a message to explain why it happened and to offer editing and retrying
entries.zh: 更改了 Sonnet 模型的防护措施标记消息以解释其发生原因并提供编辑和重试时显示的通知

entries.en: Changed safety-related model switches in sessions that pin an Opus model with `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` or `modelOverrides`: on the Anthropic API, the API now picks the model to switch to for each kind of flag, not the pinned model
entries.zh: 更改了使用`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`或`modelOverrides`固定 Opus 模型的会话中的安全相关模型开关：在 Anthropic API 上，API 现在为每种标志选择要切换到的模型，而不是固定模型

entries.en: Changed the non-interactive first turn to still wait up to 2s for connecting MCP servers named by `--allowedTools` or an `mcp_tool` hook, even when `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` is `0`
entries.zh: 更改了非交互式第一轮，即使当`CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS`为`0`时，仍等待最多 2 秒来连接由`--allowedTools`或`mcp_tool`挂钩命名的 MCP 服务器

entries.en: Changed `/recap` to decline with a short notice when it arrives relayed from a chat thread (your own included) or from a routine or webhook; typed in the terminal, the Claude apps, Remote Control, `-p` or an SDK host, it runs as before
entries.zh: 将`/recap`更改为当从聊天线程（包括您自己的）或例程或 Webhook 中继到达时立即拒绝；在终端、Claude 应用程序、远程控制、`-p` 或 SDK 主机中输入，它会像以前一样运行

entries.en: Changed `/artifacts` to show its filter tabs beside the title with one-word labels (All, Mine, Shared), using the same tab bar as `/config` and `/plugin`
entries.zh: 更改了`/artifacts`，以在标题旁边显示带有单字标签（“全部”、“我的”、“共享”）的过滤器选项卡，使用与`/config`和`/plugin`相同的选项卡栏

entries.en: Changed artifact publishing to refuse a file on a network share (a `\\host\share` path or a `/net` automount) unless it is on a mapped network drive added with `--add-dir`
entries.zh: 更改了工件发布以拒绝网络共享（`\\host\share`路径或`/net`自动挂载）上的文件，除非该文件位于使用`--add-dir`添加的映射网络驱动器上

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an optional time above each prompt and response, with a date line where the day changes (Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps setting, off by default)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 每条提示和回复上方可选显示时间，日期变化时会显示日期行（设置为 Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps，默认关闭）

entries.en: [VSCode] Added plugin load errors and notes to the Manage plugins rows, with a popup to disable, uninstall or copy the error
entries.zh: [VSCode] 管理插件的每一行显示插件加载错误和说明，并提供弹窗以禁用、卸载或复制错误信息

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an Ultracode on/off switch under the Effort slider, replacing the slider's Ultracode stop; the model pill shows "· Ultracode" at any effort level
entries.zh: [VSCode] Effort 滑块下方新增 Ultracode 开关，取代滑块原有的 Ultracode 档位；在任何 effort 级别下，模型标签都会显示「· Ultracode」

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Reload Claude from the Memory dialog restarting before an edited file was saved
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 Memory 对话框中执行 Reload Claude 时，在编辑过的文件保存之前就重启的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a restored tab opening a conversation another Claude process still has open; it now asks first
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复恢复的标签页会打开另一个 Claude 进程仍在使用的对话的问题；现在会先询问

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view sections you expanded closing on their own while a sub-agent is working or when the section's first step is trimmed from view
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复子 agent 工作时，或该区块的第一步被移出视野时，你展开的 Focus 视图区块自行收起的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed typing `/model` and Enter printing usage text into the chat instead of opening the model selector
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复输入 `/model` 并按 Enter 时，用量文字被打印到聊天中、而不是打开模型选择器的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `/feedback` on Vertex, Bedrock and Foundry being refused after you pressed Send; the report is now saved on this computer, as the terminal does
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 Vertex、Bedrock 和 Foundry 上按下发送后，`/feedback` 被拒绝的问题；现在和终端一样，报告会保存在本机

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-in waiting up to a minute for the Python extension after a window reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复窗口重新加载后，登录最多要等待一分钟 Python 扩展的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Claude Code tabs that stopped responding after Restart Extensions: they now reopen on their conversation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复执行 Restart Extensions 后 Claude Code 标签页无响应的问题：现在会重新打开并恢复到原对话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message from another agent with no recorded sender showing as raw XML in the chat
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复没有记录发送者的其他 agent 消息在聊天中以原始 XML 显示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed messages from other agents, sessions or channels disappearing after a reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新加载后，来自其他 agent、会话或频道的消息消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/mcp`, `/config` or `/settings` command being shadowed by the extension's dialog
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复你自己的 `/mcp`、`/config` 或 `/settings` 命令被扩展的对话框遮住的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping every background agent when no turn was running
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在没有任何轮次运行时按 Escape 会停止所有后台 agent 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed plugin install links replacing a marketplace you already have that uses the same name
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复插件安装链接替换了你已有的、同名市场的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Prompt is too long" errors after compaction when a large text file is attached to a message
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复压缩（compaction）后，消息附带大型文本文件时出现 "Prompt is too long" 错误的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed chat links to files with non-ASCII characters, spaces or brackets in their path not opening
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复聊天中指向路径含非 ASCII 字符、空格或方括号的文件的链接无法打开的问题
