entries.en: [VSCode] Changed `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` in the `claudeCode.environmentVariables` setting to apply only when it is an absolute path, and passed it to terminals that continue the chat
entries.zh: [VSCode] `claudeCode.environmentVariables` 设置中的 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 仅在为绝对路径时生效，并会传递给用于继续聊天的终端

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed a routine's Edit and Duplicate controls saying the routine was still loading while you were offline; they now tell you you're offline
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复离线时，例程的 Edit 和 Duplicate 控件提示例程仍在加载的问题；现在会提示你当前处于离线状态

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added model family choices such as "Opus (latest)" for a thread, a channel default or your DM, so the choice follows the newest model in that family
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 话题、频道默认设置或你的私信中新增模型系列选项（如「Opus (latest)」），选择后会自动跟随该系列的最新模型

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added the spend that counts toward your organization-wide limit to the analytics spend projection chart, with how much of the limit is used
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 花费分析的预计支出图表中，新增计入组织总限额的花费，并显示已使用的限额比例

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the earlier Claude in Slack app's progress card and link previews omitting the repository and Create PR button when a GitHub Enterprise host name contains an underscore
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 GitHub Enterprise 主机名包含下划线时，较早的 Claude in Slack 应用的进度卡片和链接预览不显示仓库及 Create PR 按钮的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude staying silent in a channel whose environment declines to start it; it now posts one notice asking you to contact an admin, and retries when @-mentioned
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复频道的运行环境拒绝启动时，Claude 在该频道中保持沉默的问题；现在它会发送一条通知，请你联系管理员，并在被 @ 时重试

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed Claude to post its private sign-in notice at every @mention from someone who hasn't connected their Claude account, instead of going quiet after the first
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude 每次被尚未连接 Claude 账户的人 @ 时，都会发送一条仅本人可见的登录提示，而不是第一次之后就不再提示

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved "Notify members now" in admin settings: one press reaches every workspace your organization claimed in an Enterprise Grid, and more members in large workspaces
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进管理设置中的「Notify members now」：一次点击即可覆盖组织在 Enterprise Grid 中认领的所有工作区，并覆盖大型工作区中更多的成员

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's wait notice on self-hosted environments with on-demand runners: it now says whether a runner is starting, a start will be retried, or no runner will start
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进按需运行器的自托管环境中 Claude 的等待提示：现在会说明运行器是否正在启动、启动是否会重试，或是否不会启动任何运行器

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the error shown when adding a channel manager fails because the channel's Slack workspace can't be confirmed as connected to your organization
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进添加频道管理员失败时的错误提示：当无法确认该频道所在的 Slack 工作区已连接到你的组织时，会给出说明

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved a channel's access lists in admin settings to show the connectors, repositories and plugins an auto-join pattern attaches, and where each comes from
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进管理设置中的频道访问列表：会显示自动加入规则附加的连接器、仓库和插件，以及每项的来源

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved adding repositories as a channel manager: when your GitHub sign-in can't confirm you're a repository admin, the page asks you to sign in with GitHub
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进频道管理员添加仓库的流程：如果你的 GitHub 登录无法确认你是仓库管理员，页面会要求你用 GitHub 登录

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review giving up without posting a finished review when an unsubmitted review under its GitHub App was open on the pull request; it now retries the post first
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复 GitHub 应用下有未提交的审查草稿留在拉取请求上时，Code Review 放弃发布已完成审查的问题；现在会先重试发布

entries.en: Added `x-claude-code-prompt-id` to the gateway hint headers so LLM gateways can group the requests that serve one user prompt; opt in with `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`
entries.zh: 在网关提示标头中添加了`x-claude-code-prompt-id`，以便 LLM 网关可以对服务于一个用户提示的请求进行分组；使用`CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`选择加入

entries.en: Added `availableModelsMatch` managed setting: with `"exact"`, an `availableModels` entry allows only the model version it names, so new releases stay blocked until listed
entries.zh: 添加了`availableModelsMatch`托管设置：使用“exact”，`availableModels`条目仅允许其命名的模型版本，因此新版本在列出之前将被阻止

entries.en: Added `deniedModels` managed setting to block specific models, even when `availableModels` allows them
entries.zh: 添加了`deniedModels`托管设置来阻止特定模型，即使`availableModels`允许它们

entries.en: Added MCP tool, WebFetch and WebSearch outputs to the `tool.output` OpenTelemetry span event when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1`
entries.zh: 当`OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1`时，将 MCP 工具、WebFetch 和 WebSearch 输出添加到`tool.output` OpenTelemetry 跨度事件

entries.en: Added `/doctor prompt-audit` (also `/checkup prompt-audit`) to audit your CLAUDE.md files, skills, agents and commands for prompting patterns written for older models
entries.zh: 添加了“/doctor Prompt-audit”（也称为“/checkup Prompt-audit”）来审核您的 CLAUDE.md 文件、技能、代理和命令，以提示为旧模型编写的模式

entries.en: Added click-to-expand for truncated messages from your other sessions in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 为全屏模式下其他会话中的截断消息添加了点击展开功能

entries.en: Added `path` to `--plugin-dir` load-failure entries in the stream-json `system/init` `plugin_errors`, naming the directory that did not load
entries.zh: 在stream-json `system/init` `plugin_errors` 中的 `--plugin-dir` 加载失败条目中添加了 `path`，命名未加载的目录

entries.en: Added an opt-in `load_test_mode` block to the Claude apps gateway config: requests are built and signed but not sent upstream, and clients get a canned reply, so a deployment can be load tested
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用程序网关配置中添加了一个可选的`load_test_mode`块：请求已构建并签名，但不发送到上游，客户端会收到预设回复，因此可以对部署进行负载测试

entries.en: Added a `mantle` upstream provider to the Claude apps gateway for Amazon Bedrock's Mantle endpoint
entries.zh: 向 Amazon Bedrock 的 Mantle 端点的 Claude 应用程序网关添加了`mantle`上游提供商

entries.en: Fixed SDK sessions losing a deferred tool call or finished tool result when a turn ended early, a held approval prompt after a worker restart, and a non-streaming fallback's `result.usage`
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 会话在回合提前结束时丢失延迟的工具调用或完成的工具结果、工作人员重新启动后保留的批准提示以及非流回退的`result.usage`

entries.en: Fixed MCP progress notifications being discarded once a long-running tool call moved to the background; the background task now shows the latest progress
entries.zh: 修复了一旦长时间运行的工具调用移至后台就会丢弃 MCP 进度通知的问题；后台任务现在显示最新进度

entries.en: Fixed stdio MCP servers being left running when the session ended while they were still starting
entries.zh: 修复了 stdio MCP 服务器在会话结束但仍在启动时仍保持运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed a brief HTTP 404 from a stateless remote MCP server (for example a proxy mid-redeploy) leaving that server unusable for the rest of the session while still shown as connected
entries.zh: 修复了来自无状态远程 MCP 服务器（例如重新部署中的代理）的简短 HTTP 404，导致该服务器在会话的其余部分无法使用，同时仍显示为已连接

entries.en: Fixed MCP sign-in for a server with no valid URL failing with an opaque SDK error; `/mcp` no longer offers Authenticate for such servers
entries.zh: 修复了没有有效 URL 的服务器的 MCP 登录失败并出现不透明 SDK 错误的问题； `/mcp` 不再为此类服务器提供身份验证

entries.en: Fixed the weekly Fable limit not appearing in `/usage` and the VS Code usage meters when telemetry is disabled
entries.zh: 修复禁用遥测时，`/usage` 和 VS Code 用量仪表中不显示每周 Fable 限额的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` accepting Sonnet 4.6 or Sonnet 5 with `[1m]` when the id carried a date or `-v1:0` suffix, in the cases where the plain id was refused
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`在 id 带有日期或`-v1:0`后缀（在普通 ID 被拒绝的情况下）接受带有`[1m]`的 Sonnet 4.6 或 Sonnet 5 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` picker showing a hardcoded Haiku version and price when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL` pins a different model
entries.zh: 修复了当`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL`固定不同模型时显示硬编码俳句版本和价格的`/model`选择器

entries.en: Fixed dynamic workflows started during a model fallback running every agent on the fallback model instead of retrying the configured model
entries.zh: 修复了模型回退期间启动的动态工作流程，在回退模型上运行每个代理，而不是重试配置的模型

entries.en: Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU` having no effect when Haiku is the session's main model
entries.zh: 修复了当 Haiku 是会话的主要模型时`DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU`无效的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` saying Claude Code accepts a plugin or marketplace name it cannot install; such names in `marketplace.json` now fail validation
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件验证”指出 Claude Code 接受无法安装的插件或市场名称的问题； `marketplace.json`中的此类名称现在无法验证

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing plugins whose `outputStyles`, `themes`, `monitors`, or `lspServers` paths are missing or point outside the plugin directory
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`传递`outputStyles`、`themes`、`monitors`或`lspServers`路径丢失或指向插件目录之外的插件的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin details` showing 0 MCP servers for plugins that declare their servers in `plugin.json`
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件详细信息”，显示在`plugin.json`中声明其服务器的插件有 0 个 MCP 服务器

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin marketplace remove` not saying which installed plugins it uninstalled with the marketplace; it now lists them
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件市场删除”未说明它从市场中卸载了哪些已安装的插件；现在列出了它们

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin uninstall` removing the other of two installed plugins whose ids differ only in case, with its options and secrets, when the one named had no `enabledPlugins` entry at that scope
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin uninstall`，删除了两个已安装插件中的另一个，其 ID 仅在情况下不同，其选项和秘密，当指定的插件在该范围内没有`enabledPlugins`条目时

entries.en: Fixed plugins that declare no version being silently restored at their source's newest commit, not the installed one, when their cached files were missing
entries.zh: 修复了当缓存文件丢失时，声明没有版本在其源的最新提交（而不是安装的版本）中静默恢复的插件

entries.en: Fixed user-installed plugins and marketplaces failing to load with "cache-miss" after the home or config directory was moved, for example in bind-mounted devcontainers
entries.zh: 修复启用多个插件时，用户级技能在斜杠命令自动补全中重复出现多次的问题

entries.en: Fixed `installed_plugins.json` showing no plugins when it holds a record under an invalid plugin id; such a file loads again
entries.zh: 修复了`installed_plugins.json`在无效插件 ID 下保存记录时显示无插件的问题；这样的文件再次加载

entries.en: Fixed `installed_plugins.json` being rewritten, losing records, when it holds a record this version cannot read; `claude plugin` commands now name the record and say how to recover
entries.zh: 修复了`installed_plugins.json`被重写，当它保存此版本无法读取的记录时丢失记录的问题； `claude plugin`命令现在命名记录并说明如何恢复

entries.en: Fixed permission dialogs in screen-reader mode reading quoted commands and paths as if they were the dialog's own text
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式下的权限对话框读取引用的命令和路径的问题，就好像它们是对话框自己的文本一样

entries.en: Fixed `/context` not counting MCP server instructions: they now appear as their own row and count toward the total
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`不计算 MCP 服务器指令的问题：它们现在显示为自己的行并计入总数

entries.en: Fixed markdown links in the Warp terminal rendering as plain text instead of clickable hyperlinks
entries.zh: 修复了 Warp 终端中的 Markdown 链接呈现为纯文本而不是可点击的超链接的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp add`, `add-json`, and `remove` reporting success when the user or local config file could not be written, for example inside a sandbox
entries.zh: 修复了当无法写入用户或本地配置文件时（例如在沙箱内）`claude mcp add`、`add-json`和`remove`报告成功的问题

entries.en: Fixed the first words of a reply in a cloud session sometimes appearing late instead of streaming as Claude writes them
entries.zh: 修复云会话中回复的开头几个字有时延迟出现，而不是随 Claude 书写实时流式显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude's built-in keybindings guide saying chords time out after 1 second instead of 3, and calling `cmd` an alias of `meta`, which could produce `cmd+` shortcuts most terminals never send
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 的内置键绑定指南说和弦在 1 秒而不是 3 秒后超时，并将`cmd`称为`meta`的别名，这可能会产生大多数终端从不发送的`cmd+`快捷方式

entries.en: Fixed `keybindings.json` silently accepting a misspelled modifier such as `ctl+k`; it now warns in the debug log and suggests the fix
entries.zh: 修复了`keybindings.json`静默接受拼写错误的修饰符（例如`ctl+k`）的问题；它现在在调试日志中发出警告并建议修复

entries.en: Fixed footer hints still saying "Enter to view" after `footer:openSelected` was rebound or unbound in `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了在`keybindings.json`中`footer:openSelected`反弹或取消绑定后，页脚提示仍然显示“Enter to view”的问题

entries.en: Fixed keys typed quickly together (type-ahead, key repeat, bursts over ssh or tmux) sometimes being handled against stale state
entries.zh: 修复了一起快速输入的按键（提前输入、按键重复、通过 ssh 或 tmux 突发）有时会针对过时状态进行处理的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree checkouts failing certificate verification (for example on Git LFS downloads) when the CA certificate is passed to git as `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` environment pairs
entries.zh: 修复 CA 证书以 `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` 环境变量对的形式传给 git 时，工作树检出（例如 Git LFS 下载）证书校验失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed `git` asking credential helpers to store the sandbox proxy's login, which printed "failed to store"
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒`git`要求凭证助手存储沙盒代理的登录信息，该登录打印出“无法存储”

entries.en: Fixed managed `sandbox` settings being ignored entirely when one nested value was invalid; the invalid value now fails closed and the rest of the block still applies
entries.zh: 修复了当一个嵌套值无效时完全忽略托管“沙箱”设置的问题；无效值现在无法关闭，并且块的其余部分仍然适用

entries.en: Fixed Claude's edits to its own auto-memory notes being blocked as sensitive-file writes when Claude Code was started in a subdirectory of a git repository
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 在 git 存储库的子目录中启动时，Claude 对自己的自动记忆注释的编辑被阻止为敏感文件写入的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control being unavailable on paid plans when telemetry is turned off with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK`
entries.zh: 修复了当使用`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`或`DO_NOT_TRACK`关闭遥测时，远程控制在付费计划中不可用的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/remote-control` menu cutting its QR-code hint mid-word in narrow terminals
entries.zh: 修复窄终端中 `/remote-control` 菜单的二维码提示在单词中间被截断的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `.` dropping a Shift+Enter newline, leaving the cursor inside an accented letter, and repeating an older change after `3J` or Visual-mode `J` on the last line
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下 `.` 会丢失 Shift+Enter 换行、光标停在重音字母内部，并且在最后一行执行 `3J` 或可视模式 `J` 后重复了更早的修改的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode cursor placement: recalling a prompt over 10,000 characters in normal mode no longer leaves the cursor past the end, and `V` then `p` now lands on the first non-blank
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式光标定位：在普通模式下召回超过 10,000 个字符的提示词后，光标不再越过行尾；`V` 然后 `p` 现在会落在第一个非空白字符上

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `J` joining lines with different spacing than Vim (such as a space before `)` or after a tab), and `3J` or Visual-mode `J` on the last line not moving the cursor as Vim does
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下 `J` 合并行时的间距与 Vim 不一致（如 `)` 前的空格、Tab 后的空格），以及在最后一行执行 `3J` 或可视模式 `J` 时光标不像 Vim 那样移动的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed the PowerShell tool letting `cmd /c rd`, `rmdir`, `del` or `erase` delete drive roots, the home folder and other folders that `Remove-Item` refuses
entries.zh: Windows：修复了 PowerShell 工具允许 `cmd /c rd`、`rmdir`、`del` 或 `erase` 删除驱动器根目录、主目录以及 `Remove-Item` 会拒绝删除的文件夹的问题

entries.en: Improved the `/mcp` tool list: it shows more tools at once, scrolls with the page keys and mouse, and marks tools your organization blocked with a warning icon
entries.zh: 改进 `/mcp` 工具列表：一次显示更多工具，可用翻页键和鼠标滚动；被组织屏蔽的工具会带警告图标

entries.en: Improved MCP tool results: images returned by MCP tools are now also saved to a file, so Bash, Read and other tools can open them
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 工具结果：MCP 工具返回的图片现在也会保存为文件，Bash、Read 等工具都能打开

entries.en: Improved `/tasks`: rows show a status icon, the name and whole facts, the title and key hints stay on screen with many tasks, and the list gains paging keys, the mouse wheel and clicks
entries.zh: 改进 `/tasks`：每行显示状态图标、名称和完整信息；任务多时，标题和按键提示保持在屏幕上；列表增加翻页键、鼠标滚轮和点击操作

entries.en: Improved lists in `/help`, `/hooks`, `/copy`, `/chrome`, `/memory`, `/ide`, `/release-notes`, `/rewind`, `/diff`, `/remote-env`, `/plugin` and other pickers with page keys, mouse wheel and clicks
entries.zh: 改进 `/help`、`/hooks`、`/copy`、`/chrome`、`/memory`、`/ide`、`/release-notes`、`/rewind`、`/diff`、`/remote-env`、`/plugin` 等选择器中的列表：支持翻页键、鼠标滚轮和点击

entries.en: Improved lists beside a search box, such as `/skills` and `/artifacts`, to draw their pointer dim while the search box has the keys, so only one pointer is highlighted
entries.zh: 改进 `/skills`、`/artifacts` 等带搜索框的列表：搜索框有键盘焦点时，列表的指针变暗，确保只有一个指针高亮

entries.en: Improved the compaction spinner: its timer now starts when compaction begins and it counts the summary's tokens as they stream, replacing the percentage bar
entries.zh: 改进压缩加载动画：计时器在压缩开始时启动，并在摘要的 token 流式输出时计数，取代了原来的百分比进度条

entries.en: Improved the browser page shown after signing in to an MCP server: centered layout, dark mode, and new artwork
entries.zh: 改进登录 MCP 服务器后显示的浏览器页面：居中布局、深色模式，并换了新的插图

entries.en: Improved the Skill tool's reply when a skill belongs to a plugin that failed to load, so Claude tells you the plugin could not be loaded instead of calling the skill uninstalled
entries.zh: 改进 Skill 工具：技能所属插件加载失败时，Claude 会告诉你插件无法加载，而不是误称技能未安装

entries.en: Improved `prompt-audit` on Claude Code configuration: stale paths, stale commands and contradicting instruction files now lead the report, and thinking keywords that Claude Code documents are kept
entries.zh: 改进 `prompt-audit` 对 Claude Code 配置的检查：过时路径、过时命令和互相矛盾的指令文件排在报告最前面；Claude Code 文档中记录的思考关键词予以保留

entries.en: Improved recovery from an `installed_plugins.json` that cannot be read at all: its contents are kept in a file beside it before it is rebuilt, and `claude plugin list` names that file
entries.zh: 改进 `installed_plugins.json` 完全无法读取时的恢复：重建前会把其内容保存到旁边的文件中，`claude plugin list` 会指出该文件

entries.en: Improved artifact database reads: an ordered query that returns a full page now says it is one page and how to read the rest
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 数据库读取：有序查询返回整页结果时，会说明这只是一页，并告诉你如何读取其余部分

entries.en: Improved first-reply latency: a pattern-compile step that ran at the end of a session's first reply now runs while the reply streams in
entries.zh: 改进首次回复延迟：会话第一次回复结束时运行的一个模式编译步骤，现在改为在回复流式输出时同时进行

entries.en: Improved first-request latency by reusing the preconnected API connection
entries.zh: 改进首次请求延迟：复用已预先连接好的 API 连接

entries.en: Improved startup: `claude -p` and Claude Code Remote no longer load the interactive UI, and the auto-mode classifier's rules and the Artifact tool load on first use instead of at launch
entries.zh: 改进启动：`claude -p` 和 Claude Code Remote 不再加载交互界面；自动模式分类器的规则和 Artifact 工具改为首次使用时才加载，而不是启动时加载

entries.en: Improved startup for claude.ai accounts whose Artifact tool features aren't known yet, as on a first run: the prompt no longer waits up to 1.5 s to check them; the first message waits if needed
entries.zh: 改进 claude.ai 账户的启动：首次运行时 Artifact 工具功能状态尚未确定，提示不再等待最多 1.5 秒去检查，必要时由第一条消息等待

entries.en: Changed interactive sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it
entries.zh: 更改了第三方提供商的交互式会话或在未配置权限模式时以自动模式启动遥测关闭的情况； `permissions.defaultMode` 仍然会覆盖它

entries.en: Changed the `/ultrareview` launch dialog to say that reviewing a local branch may upload uncommitted changes to tracked files
entries.zh: 更改了`/ultrareview`启动对话框，以表明审查本地分支可能会将未提交的更改上传到跟踪文件

entries.en: Changed the `/model` picker's Opus row and the Default model's name to drop "(1M context)" where Opus already has a 1M context window; the window is unchanged
entries.zh: 更改了 `/model` 选择器的 Opus 行和默认模型的名称，以删除“(1M context)”，其中 Opus 已经具有 1M 上下文窗口；窗口没有变化

entries.en: Changed prompt suggestions in the terminal to appear less often after 20 in a row go unused; using one brings them back
entries.zh: 更改了终端中的提示建议，使其在连续 20 个未使用后出现的频率降低；使用一个可以让他们回来

entries.en: Changed `--system-prompt` and `--append-system-prompt` to accept their text and `-file` forms together; the file's text comes first
entries.zh: 更改了 `--system-prompt` 和 `--append-system-prompt` 以同时接受它们的文本和 `-file` 形式；文件的文本首先出现

entries.en: Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` deny rules to also block that skill when Claude Desktop delivers it as a plugin, and `Skill(skill:<name>)` denies to match the skill's alias and display name
entries.zh: 更改了 `Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` 拒绝规则，以便在 Claude Desktop 将其作为插件提供时也阻止该技能，并且 `Skill(skill:<name>)` 拒绝匹配技能的别名和显示名称

entries.en: Changed `/rewind` and `/diff` lists to move on the same keybinding actions as every other list (`select:*`); `messageSelector:*`/`diff:*` rebinds still work
entries.zh: 更改了`/rewind`和`/diff`列表，以与其他列表一样移动相同的键绑定操作（`select:*`）； `messageSelector:*`/`diff:*` 重新绑定仍然有效

entries.en: Changed the `/workflows` run list to size itself like other lists: half the terminal inline, and it keeps its title on screen when the prompt shows below
entries.zh: 将`/workflows`运行列表更改为与其他列表一样的自身大小：终端内联的一半，并且当提示显示在下面时，它将其标题保留在屏幕上

entries.en: Changed `claude plugin eval` to require git 2.31 or later when git is installed; a run on an older git is refused with a message naming the version
entries.zh: 将 `claude plugin eval` 更改为在安装 git 时需要 git 2.31 或更高版本；在较旧的 git 上运行被拒绝，并显示一条命名版本的消息

entries.en: Changed artifact watching: a watch that was armed automatically (not one you asked for) now ends after 3.5 hours with no activity; publishing or watching the artifact again re-arms it
entries.zh: 更改了工件监视：自动武装的手表（不是您要求的）现在在 3.5 小时没有活动后结束；再次发布或观看工件会重新武装它

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed lifecycle hooks' git to skip a repository's Git LFS `pre-push` hook, ignore a writable system `core.hooksPath`, and not sign commits without `--configure-git`
entries.zh: 生命周期钩子中的 git 现在会跳过仓库的 Git LFS `pre-push` 钩子，忽略可写的系统 `core.hooksPath`，并且在没有 `--configure-git` 时不再签名提交

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `GIT_SSL_CAINFO` and `GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` under Anthropic-managed git: the runner's own git always verifies Anthropic's git route, and warning lines say what applies where
entries.zh: Anthropic 托管 git 下，`GIT_SSL_CAINFO` 和 `GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` 的行为有变化：运行器自身的 git 始终校验 Anthropic 的 git 路由，警告信息会说明各项设置在哪里生效

entries.en: Reverted the 2.1.282 reservation of the `claude-ai` name: skills, commands, workflows and MCP servers' skills and prompts so named load again, and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` rules are ordinary prefix rules
entries.zh: 撤销了 2.1.282 中对 `claude-ai` 名称的保留：技能、命令、工作流以及 MCP 服务器的技能和提示词，现在可以再次以该名称加载；`Skill(claude-ai:*)` 规则恢复为普通前缀规则

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the permission mode indicator showing Default while the session kept running in auto or bypass mode after an automatic switch out of it failed; the switch is now retried until it lands
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话自动切出 auto 或 bypass 模式失败后，权限模式指示器仍显示 Default、而会话实际仍在 auto 或 bypass 模式下运行的问题；现在会一直重试直到切换成功

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a session teleported from the web dropping the messages sent while Claude was working
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复从 Web 传送过来的会话丢失 Claude 工作期间发送的消息的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a Web session staying hidden from the session list, and an empty chat opening in its place, when an older version had saved an empty local copy of it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复旧版本保存了一个空的本地副本后，某个 Web 会话在会话列表中被隐藏、并在原位置打开空白聊天的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a reopened session splitting a turn at a message Claude received mid-turn, such as an automatic continuation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新打开的会话把一个轮次拆开，拆分点位于 Claude 在轮次中途收到的消息（如自动续接）处的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a reloaded session showing a rewound-away turn, or only the rows before a compaction
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新加载的会话显示了已回退的轮次，或只显示压缩之前的部分记录的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the footer's agents pill drawing its icon off-center, with the status dot against the edge, in narrow panels
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复窄面板中，页脚的 agents 标签图标位置偏离中心、状态点贴边的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat input showing its text slightly below the cursor and selection after pasting lines that end with a line break into a long prompt
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复向长提示词粘贴以换行结尾的多行文本后，聊天输入框中文字比光标和选区略低的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved adding a repository to a running cloud session: a private repository your GitHub account can read but not push to now attaches for reading
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 改进向运行中的云端会话添加仓库：你的 GitHub 账户可读但无推送权限的私有仓库，现在会以只读方式附加

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud sessions occasionally redoing an already-finished step, such as posting a duplicate comment or push, after recovering from a server-side restart
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复云端会话从服务器端重启中恢复后，偶尔重复执行已完成的步骤（如重复发布评论或推送）的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Changed new routine schedules to default to a few minutes past the hour, with a note that routines set exactly on the hour can start several minutes late
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 新建例程的计划时间默认设为整点后几分钟，并附注说明设在整点的例程可能会晚几分钟启动

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a "Channels Claude can search" admin setting that limits Claude's Slack search to public channels it has been added to, set per organization, workspace or channel
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 新增「Channels Claude can search」管理设置，可限制 Claude 的 Slack 搜索只能查看它已被加入的公开频道，可按组织、工作区或频道设置

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a Back to Slack button on the page shown after connecting your Claude account, returning you to the thread you started from
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 连接 Claude 账户后显示的页面新增「Back to Slack」按钮，点击即可返回你发起的话题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a channel's configure page listing no connectors or plugins when the channel gets its access bundle through an attach rule; rule-attached bundles are now shown
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复频道通过附加规则获得访问包时，其配置页面不显示任何连接器或插件的问题；现在会显示由规则附加的访问包

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed access-bundle repository search missing repositories on GitHub App installs that are limited to a large list of selected repositories
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 GitHub App 安装仅限于大量已选仓库时，访问包的仓库搜索会漏掉仓库的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude occasionally posting the same reply twice when a new message interrupted it mid-reply
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复回复过程中有新消息打断时，Claude 偶尔重复发送同一条回复的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed channel routines that stopped running in older private channels whose Slack channel ID changed, for example after a Slack Connect share
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复较早的私密频道（其 Slack 频道 ID 已改变，例如经过 Slack Connect 共享后）中的频道例程停止运行的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed conversations in a channel set to "Channel only" all ending when a non-guest member joined and Slack was slow to confirm their membership
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复「仅频道」设置的频道中，非访客成员加入而 Slack 确认成员资格较慢时，所有对话都会结束的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed "@claude review" requests going silent when GitHub failed to return the pull request: the request is retried once, and a comment explains if it still fails
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复 GitHub 未能返回拉取请求时，「@claude review」请求无回应的问题：请求会重试一次，若仍失败则会留言说明

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed billing for a review that stopped at its time limit with nothing verified: it now shows as incomplete, isn't charged, and is retried once
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复审查达到时间上限且未验证任何内容就停止时的计费问题：现在会显示为未完成、不收费，并自动重试一次

entries.en: Added a `maxProseWidth` setting that caps the width of Claude's prose in wide terminals while tables and code blocks keep the full width
entries.zh: 添加了`maxProseWidth`设置，该设置限制宽终端中克劳德散文的宽度，而表格和代码块保持完整宽度

entries.en: Added a startup notice, and `/status` and `claude doctor` entries, listing telemetry variables in a project's settings files that were ignored or that turned telemetry off
entries.zh: 添加了启动通知以及`/status`和`claude doctor`条目，列出了项目设置文件中被忽略或关闭遥测的遥测变量

entries.en: Added the `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` managed setting to let `claude --chrome` run alongside an exclusive `managed-mcp.json`; the error shown when Chrome is blocked now names it
entries.zh: 添加了`allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp`托管设置，让`claude --chrome`与独占的“management-mcp.json”一起运行； Chrome 被阻止时显示的错误现在将其命名

entries.en: Added `store.readiness_grace_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway so `/readyz` can stay ready through a short Postgres outage such as a database failover
entries.zh: 将`store.readiness_grace_seconds`添加到 Claude 应用程序网关，以便`/readyz`可以在短暂的 Postgres 中断（例如数据库故障转移）中保持就绪状态

entries.en: Added a scrollbar to the `/feedback` drafts list in fullscreen mode; it appears while the mouse is over the list
entries.zh: 在全屏模式下为`/feedback`草稿列表添加了滚动条；当鼠标悬停在列表上时它会出现

entries.en: Fixed every request failing with a 400 error in conversations whose history holds web search results the API cannot decrypt (for example, from a turn answered through a third-party gateway)
entries.zh: 修复了历史记录包含 API 无法解密的 Web 搜索结果的对话中每个请求失败并出现 400 错误的问题（例如，通过第三方网关应答的回合）

entries.en: Fixed more cases of continued or resumed sessions (`--continue`, `--resume`) re-sending earlier messages in a changed form, which could make the API drop Claude's earlier reasoning
entries.zh: 修复了更多继续或恢复会话（`--continue`、`--resume`）以更改的形式重新发送早期消息的情况，这可能使 API 放弃 Claude 早期的推理

entries.en: Fixed earlier extended thinking being dropped when `/model`, `/rename`, `/artifacts` or another immediate slash command was used while Claude was working
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德工作时使用`/model`、`/rename`、`/artifacts`或其他直接斜杠命令时早期扩展思维被丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed continued or resumed conversations losing earlier extended thinking when relaunched with a `--tools` list that leaves out a built-in tool offered earlier in the conversation
entries.zh: 修复了当使用`--tools`列表重新启动时，继续或恢复的对话会丢失早期的扩展思维，该列表遗漏了对话中先前提供的内置工具

entries.en: Fixed sessions failing on every turn with an "Invalid `data` in `redacted_thinking` block" API error; Claude Code now drops the conversation's thinking blocks and retries once
entries.zh: 修复了会话每次都会失败并出现“`redacted_thinking` 块中的无效‘数据’”API 错误的问题；克劳德·科德现在会放弃对话的思维障碍并重试一次

entries.en: Fixed compaction failing when the summarization request is refused; it now retries on a fallback model
entries.zh: 修复了汇总请求被拒绝时压缩失败的问题；它现在重试后备模型

entries.en: Fixed a failed turn ("Effort 'xhigh' isn't available with thinking turned off") after a safety-related model switch in sessions with thinking off and effort above high
entries.zh: 修复了在思考关闭且努力高于高的会话中进行安全相关模型切换后失败的转弯（“思考关闭时，努力‘xhigh’不可用”）

entries.en: Fixed an unanswered Fable usage-credits prompt switching models in SDK-hosted sessions such as Claude Desktop; the turn now ends instead, and Remote Control clients now see the model-switch notice
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 托管会话（例如 Claude Desktop）中未答复的《神鬼寓言》使用积分提示切换模型的问题；回合现在结束，远程控制客户端现在会看到模型切换通知

entries.en: Fixed `/model` with a full Fable model id stopping at an API error instead of opening the usage-credits prompt when the plan needs usage credits that aren't turned on yet
entries.zh: 修复了带有完整 Fable 模型 ID 的`/model`，当计划需要尚未打开的使用积分时，它会在 API 错误处停止，而不是打开使用积分提示

entries.en: Fixed requests failing for up to a minute with an "another Claude Code process is refreshing it" login error after that other process was closed or killed mid-refresh
entries.zh: 修复了在刷新过程中关闭或终止其他进程后，请求失败长达一分钟并出现“另一个克劳德代码进程正在刷新它”登录错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions started while another Claude Code window was refreshing the sign-in (common with several VS Code windows) not retrying their organization policy fetch
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个 Claude Code 窗口刷新登录（常见于多个 VS Code 窗口）时启动的会话，而不重试其组织策略提取的问题

entries.en: Fixed CLAUDE.md and rules being read at startup through a repository symlink reaching macOS's `/Network` via `..` or a `/.vol`-style kernel path, or a rules link to macOS's `/home` being listed
entries.zh: 修复了启动时通过存储库符号链接读取的 CLAUDE.md 和规则，该存储库符号链接通过`..`或`/.vol`样式内核路径到达 macOS 的`/Network`，或者列出了指向 macOS`/home`的规则链接

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission rules with a mid-pattern `:*` being skipped in settings files while `--allowedTools` honored them; they now work from every source, with a startup warning on how they match
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限规则，在设置文件中跳过中间模式`:*`，而`--allowedTools`则遵循它们；他们现在可以从各个来源工作，并有关于他们如何匹配的启动警告

entries.en: Fixed a command approved on a restored permission prompt running twice when a remote session's worker restarted
entries.zh: 修复了在远程会话的工作人员重新启动时运行两次的恢复权限提示下批准的命令

entries.en: Fixed managed settings ignoring a mistyped value for boolean lock keys such as `disableClaudeAiConnectors` or `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; the lock now applies and startup names the key
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置忽略布尔锁键输入错误的值，例如`disableClaudeAiConnectors`或`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`；现在锁已应用，并且启动程序命名了密钥

entries.en: Fixed managed `permissions`, `autoMode`, `worktree` and `attribution` settings being ignored entirely when one nested value was invalid; the rest of the block now still applies
entries.zh: 修复了当一个嵌套值无效时，托管的`permissions`、`autoMode`、`worktree`和`attribution`设置被完全忽略的问题；该块的其余部分现在仍然适用

entries.en: Fixed repository, user and `--add-dir` skills, commands and skills-directory plugin manifests pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`
entries.zh: 修复了存储库、用户和`--add-dir`技能、命令和技能目录插件清单，通过托管`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`下的`allowed-tools`预先批准自己的工具

entries.en: Fixed safeguard block messages on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock Mantle not showing a request ID; block messages now also show the message ID
entries.zh: 修复了 Amazon Bedrock 和 Bedrock Mantle 上的防护阻止消息不显示请求 ID 的问题；阻止消息现在还显示消息 ID

entries.en: Vertex AI: Fixed web search not being offered for models Claude Code doesn't recognize yet, such as newly released ones
entries.zh: Vertex AI：修复了 Claude Code 尚不认识的新发布模型（如刚发布的）未提供网页搜索的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash and PowerShell hiding a full disk quota behind "Exit code 1" and leaving large output files in temp
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 和 PowerShell 将完整磁盘配额隐藏在“退出代码 1”后面并将大型输出文件留在临时文件中的问题

entries.en: Fixed tool input validation errors naming only an unknown, missing or mistyped parameter when other parameters in the same call were also invalid; those are now listed too
entries.zh: 修复工具输入校验错误只指出未知、缺失或类型错误的一个参数，而同一调用中的其他参数也有错误时未列出它们的问题；现在会一并列出

entries.en: Fixed pasted multi-line text being submitted line by line after the terminal's bracketed paste mode was reset mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中重置终端的括号粘贴模式后逐行提交粘贴的多行文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed the prompt's example text flashing and disappearing at startup in projects with a `SessionStart` hook
entries.zh: 修复在带有 `SessionStart` 钩子的项目中，启动时提示框的示例文字闪烁并消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a blank screen flashing before the first frame when starting in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了以全屏模式启动时第一帧之前闪烁的空白屏幕

entries.en: Fixed garbled, misplaced rows in the non-fullscreen renderer after the screen got shorter while still taller than the terminal, e.g. deleting a prompt line while a shell command streams output
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕变短但仍比终端高后非全屏渲染器中乱码、错位的行，例如在 shell 命令流输出时删除提示行

entries.en: Fixed a stale character left in the last column of a diff when a redrawn line's CJK character or emoji wrapped to the next row
entries.zh: 修复了当重绘行的 CJK 字符或表情符号换行到下一行时，差异最后一列中留下的过时字符

entries.en: Fixed the cursor landing before the end of a prompt recalled from history when the prompt contains a tab
entries.zh: 修复从历史记录召回的提示词包含制表符时，光标落在末尾之前的问题

entries.en: Fixed the send-now hint showing ctrl+enter on terminals that send it as a newline (Windows Terminal before 1.25); it now shows ctrl+x ctrl+s there
entries.zh: 修复在把 ctrl+enter 当作换行发送的终端（1.25 之前的 Windows Terminal）中，"立即发送"提示仍显示 ctrl+enter 的问题；现在该终端会显示 ctrl+x ctrl+s

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control --debug` failing with "Unknown argument: --debug", although Remote Control's own eligibility error says to run with `--debug`
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Remote-control --debug”失败并显示“未知参数：--debug”的问题，尽管远程控制自身的资格错误表明要使用`--debug`运行

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` saying "cancelled" and then still pushing the branch and saving the API key secret; leaving now stops the remaining steps and reports what was already done
entries.zh: 修复了 `/install-github-app` 说“已取消”，然后仍然推送分支并保存 API 密钥秘密；现在离开将停止剩余步骤并报告已完成的操作

entries.en: Fixed /feedback, /bug and /share on Bedrock, Vertex and other third-party providers still saving the report file after you cancelled during the save
entries.zh: 修复了在保存过程中取消后，Bedrock、Vertex 和其他第三方提供商仍然保存报告文件的 /feedback、/bug 和 /share

entries.en: Fixed plugin uninstall reporting success and deleting the plugin's saved options when its settings file still enabled it or could not be read; it now stops and names the file
entries.zh: 修复了插件卸载报告成功并在其设置文件仍然启用或无法读取时删除插件的已保存选项的问题；它现在停止并命名该文件

entries.en: Fixed plugin uninstall deleting a plugin's saved options and secrets when the list of installed plugins could not be read after the removal; they are now kept and the uninstall says so
entries.zh: 修复了插件卸载在删除后无法读取已安装插件列表时删除插件保存的选项和机密的问题；它们现在被保留，卸载也是如此

entries.en: Fixed a key typed right after `/` in `/skills` moving the skill list instead of reaching the search box
entries.zh: 修复了在`/skills`中的`/`之后立即键入的键会移动技能列表而不是到达搜索框

entries.en: Fixed the terminal cursor jumping from the `/skills` search box to the skill list while typing, which could hide the caret and put IME input in the wrong place
entries.zh: 修复输入时终端光标从 `/skills` 搜索框跳到技能列表，导致插入符被隐藏、输入法输入位置错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed lists with a scrollbar, such as `/skills` and `/mcp`, being two columns narrower outside fullscreen mode, where the scrollbar can never appear
entries.zh: 修复了带有滚动条的列表，例如`/skills`和`/mcp`，在全屏模式下两列变窄，滚动条永远不会出现

entries.en: Fixed the agent panel footer wrapping onto two lines with long rebound keys, and its "Esc to collapse" hint ignoring a rebound collapse key
entries.zh: 修复快捷键重新绑定为长文本时，智能体面板页脚换行成两行，以及"Esc to collapse"提示忽略已重绑定的折叠键的问题

entries.en: Fixed a doubled ` · ` separator in the `/tasks` dialog footer when the stop-all-agents shortcut is unbound in `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了当`keybindings.json`中取消绑定“停止所有代理”快捷方式时，`/tasks`对话框页脚中的双“·”分隔符

entries.en: Fixed artifact publishes failing when Claude gave the version a label longer than 60 characters; the label is now shortened
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 为版本指定的标签长度超过 60 个字符时工件发布失败的问题；标签现已缩短

entries.en: Fixed screen-reader mode, quoted lists and very long lists dropping the blank lines at the top of a code block that opens a list item, directly or inside a quote
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式、引用列表和非常长的列表，直接或在引用内删除打开列表项的代码块顶部的空白行

entries.en: Fixed PDF page-read error messages: paths with accented or non-Latin characters now appear readably, and a folder named like "password" or "invalid" can no longer make the error name the wrong cause
entries.zh: 修复了 PDF 页面读取错误消息：带有重音字符或非拉丁字符的路径现在可读，并且名为“密码”或“无效”的文件夹不再使错误名称成为错误原因

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `>>` indenting empty lines, `r` with a count longer than the line changing text, `2J` joining one line too many, and a count on the last line (`2dd`, `2>>`) shifting or deleting it
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下 `>>` 会缩进空行、`r` 带计数超过行长时会改写文本、`2J` 多合并一行，以及在最后一行使用计数（`2dd`、`2>>`）会错误移动或删除该行的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode cursor placement: after `dd`, `dj`, `dG` or a whole-line `p`/`P` it lands on the first non-blank, `yy` no longer moves it, and Esc after an emoji no longer leaves it inside the emoji
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式光标定位：执行 `dd`、`dj`、`dG` 或整行 `p`/`P` 后，光标落在第一个非空白字符上；`yy` 不再移动光标；emoji 后按 Esc 不再让光标停在 emoji 内部

entries.en: Fixed vim mode ignoring a count typed before `.` when repeating `x`, `s`, `p`, `d` or `c`, and whole-line `p`/`P`, `o`, `O`, `J`, `>>` and `<<` acting on the wrong line when a line above wraps
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，在 `.` 前输入计数后重复 `x`、`s`、`p`、`d` 或 `c` 时计数被忽略，以及上一行换行时整行 `p`/`P`、`o`、`O`、`J`、`>>` 和 `<<` 作用于错误行的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a prompt recalled from history or pulled back from the queue in normal mode, so `x` did nothing
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，从历史召回或从队列拉回的提示词，在普通模式下光标越过末尾导致 `x` 无效的问题

entries.en: Improved the time to resume very large sessions, including ones that were never compacted
entries.zh: 改进恢复超大会话（包括从未压缩过的会话）时的速度

entries.en: Improved the error shown on Windows when a session can't be resumed because its transcript file could not be read (EBADF): it now names possible causes and what to try
entries.zh: 改进 Windows 上会话无法恢复（转录文件无法读取，EBADF）时的报错：会列出可能原因和可尝试的操作

entries.en: Improved the Claude Desktop unknown-model error to suggest switching to a different model
entries.zh: 改进 Claude Desktop 的未知模型报错：建议切换到其他模型

entries.en: Improved rendering of unusual Unicode in permission prompts
entries.zh: 改进权限提示中罕见 Unicode 字符的显示

entries.en: Improved `/artifacts`: titles line up in one column, details are dropped whole instead of cut mid-word, and the list supports PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, the mouse wheel and clicks
entries.zh: 改进 `/artifacts`：标题对齐成一列，详情整段显示或整段隐藏（不再在词中间截断）；列表支持 PgUp/PgDn、Home/End、鼠标滚轮和点击

entries.en: Updated the `claude-api` skill: pre-output refusal billing now links to the How refusals are billed docs, mid-stream refusals bill at normal rates, and pre-output refusals count against rate limits
entries.zh: `claude-api` 技能：拒绝前输出的计费现在链接到“拒绝如何计费”文档；流式输出中途的拒绝按正常费率计费；输出前的拒绝计入速率限制

entries.en: Updated the `claude-api` skill to recommend `ant apply` for keeping Managed Agents resources as version-controlled files
entries.zh: `claude-api` 技能现在推荐使用 `ant apply` 将 Managed Agents 资源保存为受版本控制的文件

entries.en: Changed auto mode to use the server-side classifier by default on a direct Anthropic API connection when telemetry is off (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out)
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式，以便在遥测关闭时在直接 Anthropic API 连接上默认使用服务器端分类器（`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 选择退出）

entries.en: Changed `sandbox.excludedCommands` to ignore project and local settings entries when managed settings or `--settings` set `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`, or managed `allowManagedDomainsOnly: true`
entries.zh: 更改了`sandbox.excludedCommands`，以在托管设置或`--settings`设置`allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`或托管`allowManagedDomainsOnly: true`时忽略项目和本地设置条目

entries.en: Changed project and local settings to ignore OpenTelemetry variables that turn on export, set its endpoint, or capture content, like `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY` and `OTEL_LOG_*`
entries.zh: 更改了项目和本地设置以忽略打开导出、设置端点或捕获内容的 OpenTelemetry 变量，例如`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY`和`OTEL_LOG_*`

entries.en: Changed Windows/WSL managed settings so an admin policy that is present but invalid or unreadable (HKLM, `managed-settings.json`) keeps user-writable HKCU and WSL `/etc/claude-code` from applying
entries.zh: 更改了 Windows/WSL 托管设置，以便存在但无效或不可读的管理策略（HKLM、“托管设置.json”）阻止用户可写的 HKCU 和 WSL`/etc/claude-code`应用

entries.en: Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` allow rules to cover only skills synced from claude.ai, not plugins or other skills that merely use such a name
entries.zh: 更改了 `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` 和 `Skill(claude-ai:*)` 允许规则仅涵盖从 claude.ai 同步的技能，而不涵盖仅使用此类名称的插件或其他技能

entries.en: Changed skill folders, command files and workflow commands in the `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` namespace to no longer load; a plugin so named still loads but yields name ties to synced skills
entries.zh: 更改了`anthropic-skills`或`claude-ai`命名空间中的技能文件夹、命令文件和工作流命令，不再加载；如此命名的插件仍然会加载，但会产生与同步技能相关的名称

entries.en: Changed MCP servers configured under the name `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` to list no skills or prompts (their tools still work); rename the server in your MCP configuration to list them again
entries.zh: 更改了以`anthropic-skills`或`claude-ai`名称配置的 MCP 服务器，以不列出任何技能或提示（他们的工具仍然有效）；重命名 MCP 配置中的服务器以再次列出它们

entries.en: Changed the `ultracode` visuals in `/effort` and the prompt input to plain styling (no ripple, border flourish or keyword glimmer) and removed the dynamic-workflows spinner tip
entries.zh: 将`/effort`中的`ultracode`视觉效果和提示输入更改为简单样式（无波纹、边框华丽或关键字闪烁），并删除了动态工作流程微调器提示

entries.en: Changed the Clawd mascot's feet in the start-up banner to sit under the corners of his body
entries.zh: 将初创横幅中 Clawd 吉祥物的脚改为坐在他的身体角落下

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed long replies falling behind the stream: the panel no longer re-parses the whole reply on every update
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复长回复跟不上流式输出的问题：面板不再在每次更新时重新解析整个回复

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the dictation mic button covering the message input's scrollbar when the input is tall enough to scroll
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复输入框内容高到可以滚动时，听写麦克风按钮遮住输入框滚动条的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Remote Control sessions started on this computer not opening from their Web entry in the session list; they now open the local conversation unless it's running elsewhere
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在本机发起的 Remote Control 会话，从会话列表的 Web 入口无法打开的问题；现在除非该会话正在其他地方运行，否则会打开本地对话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an editor tab's sign-in screen hanging silently after the extension host restarts; it now shows the "stopped responding" notice too
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展宿主重启后，编辑器标签页的登录界面静默卡住的问题；现在也会显示 "stopped responding" 提示

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added Claude GitHub App status to Settings › Connectors › GitHub: whether the app is installed and reachable for your account, plus steps to connect, install or reconnect
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 在 Settings › Connectors › GitHub 中新增 Claude GitHub App 状态：显示应用是否已安装且对你的账户可用，并提供连接、安装或重新连接的步骤

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added "Open repository" and "Open compare page" links to the repository menu of a cloud session whose repository is hosted on a Git server other than GitHub
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 对于托管在 GitHub 以外 Git 服务器上的仓库，云端会话的仓库菜单新增「Open repository」和「Open compare page」链接

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added attaching a repository from a different GitHub owner, such as a fork's upstream, to a running cloud session that already has one, including sessions started from Slack
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 运行中的云端会话（包括从 Slack 发起的会话）若已有仓库，现在可以再附加一个来自其他 GitHub 所有者的仓库，例如 fork 的上游仓库

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the next run time shown for an hourly routine being 30 minutes off for people in half-hour-offset time zones such as India
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复每小时运行的例程，在印度等有半小时时差的时区中，显示的下次运行时间偏差 30 分钟的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved how quickly the Routines page and the sidebar's Scheduled list load for accounts whose past sessions scheduled many check-in reminders
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 改进过去会话安排了大量签到提醒的账户，其 Routines 页面和侧边栏 Scheduled 列表的加载速度

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed auto-join channel patterns saved for one workspace in Claude Tag admin settings being ignored on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install; Claude now joins matching new channels
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在 Claude Tag 管理设置中为某工作区保存的自动加入频道规则，在 Enterprise Grid 组织范围安装中被忽略的问题；现在 Claude 会加入符合规则的新频道

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude not responding in an Enterprise Grid channel shared between two workspaces of one organization when the channel's Claude Tag version was saved from the other workspace
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复同一组织两个工作区共享的 Enterprise Grid 频道中，若该频道的 Claude Tag 版本是在另一个工作区保存的，Claude 不回应的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the earlier Claude in Slack app's progress card for sessions on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository: it now names the repository and offers a working Create PR button
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复较早的 Claude in Slack 应用，在 GitHub Enterprise Server 仓库会话中的进度卡片问题：现在会显示仓库名称，并提供可用的 Create PR 按钮

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads whose model has been retired falling back to another model on every reply, slower and with a fallback note each time; the thread now moves to a working model
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 话题的模型已退役时，每次回复都改用其他模型（更慢，且每次都附带备用模型说明）的问题；现在该话题会切换到可用的模型

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed files Claude uploads to Slack not being able to carry a caption containing a table; captions now render with the same formatting as replies
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 上传到 Slack 的文件无法在说明文字中包含表格的问题；说明文字现在与回复使用相同的格式

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's threads in Slack's Agents & tools view sometimes being listed under their first message instead of their name; later renames now update the list too
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 在 Slack「Agents & tools」视图中的话题，有时以首条消息而非话题名称列出的问题；之后的重命名也会同步更新列表

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed removing a GitHub organization's grant from an access bundle's Repositories tab in Claude Tag admin settings failing to save after that GitHub organization was disconnected
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 GitHub 组织断开连接后，在 Claude Tag 管理设置访问包的 Repositories 标签页中移除该组织授权，保存失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude always replying "Couldn't check this channel just now" in a channel shared with a Grid workspace it isn't added to; the notice now says which workspace needs the app
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在未添加 Claude 的 Grid 工作区所共享的频道中，Claude 总是回复「Couldn't check this channel just now」的问题；通知现在会说明哪个工作区需要安装应用

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the cost and token totals in Claude's reply footer reading many times too high after the session's cloud worker restarted
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复会话的云端工作进程重启后，Claude 回复页脚中的费用和 token 总数被高估数倍的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the bordered cards Claude uses in Slack replies for plans, tables and details to render wide by default instead of a narrow width
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude 在 Slack 回复中用于计划、表格和详情的带边框卡片，默认改为宽版显示，不再是窄版

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed newly connected Slack workspaces to follow the current default model instead of keeping whichever model was the default when they were connected
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 新连接的 Slack 工作区改为跟随当前默认模型，而不是保留连接时的默认模型

entries.en: Added Claude apps gateway support for newer Claude Desktop keys in `desktop` policy blocks, including `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` and `disableBypassPermissionsMode`
entries.zh: 在“桌面”策略块中添加了对较新的克劳德桌面密钥的克劳德应用程序网关支持，包括`blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`和`disableBypassPermissionsMode`

entries.en: Added `assume_role` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams: the gateway calls Bedrock as an IAM role it assumes through STS, in another AWS account if needed, optionally one session per developer
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用程序网关 Bedrock 上游添加了`assume_role`：网关将 Bedrock 调用为它通过 STS 承担的 IAM 角色，如果需要，可以在另一个 AWS 账户中，每个开发人员可选择一个会话

entries.en: Added `guardrail: {id, version}` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams to apply an Amazon Bedrock guardrail to every request sent through them (set it on all Bedrock upstreams or none)
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用程序网关 Bedrock 上游添加了`guardrail: {id, version}`，以将 Amazon Bedrock 护栏应用于通过它们发送的每个请求（在所有 Bedrock 上游设置或不设置）

entries.en: Added `telemetry.resource_attributes` to the Claude apps gateway config, to put fixed labels on the telemetry of Claude Desktop and `/login` sessions
entries.zh: 将`telemetry.resource_attributes`添加到 Claude 应用程序网关配置中，以在 Claude Desktop 和`/login`会话的遥测上放置固定标签

entries.en: Added `"attribution": false` in `settings.json` to hide all commit and PR attribution; older CLI versions skip a settings file that holds it, so keep the object form in files shared across versions
entries.zh: 在 `settings.json` 中添加了 `"attribution": false` 以隐藏所有提交和 PR 归因；较旧的 CLI 版本会跳过保存它的设置文件，因此将对象形式保留在跨版本共享的文件中

entries.en: Added MCP URL-mode elicitation on 2026-07-28 protocol connections, so servers can ask Claude Code to open a browser-based flow; no waiting dialog is left on screen when the server has no way to confirm completion
entries.zh: 在 2026-07-28 协议连接上添加了 MCP URL 模式引出，因此服务器可以要求 Claude Code 打开基于浏览器的流程；当服务器无法确认完成时，屏幕上不会留下等待对话框

entries.en: Added MCP server checks to `claude plugin validate`: it reports `.mcp.json` entries that would be silently dropped at load, undeclared `${user_config.*}` references, and insecure URLs
entries.zh: 向`claude plugin validate`添加了 MCP 服务器检查：它报告在加载时会默默删除的`.mcp.json`条目、未声明的`${user_config.*}`引用以及不安全的 URL

entries.en: Added an auto mode recommendation to `/insights` that estimates how many permission prompts auto mode could have handled in your recent sessions
entries.zh: 在`/insights`中添加了自动模式建议，可估计自动模式在您最近的会话中可以处理的权限提示数量

entries.en: Added a scrollbar to the `/skills`, `/mcp` and `/plugin` Installed lists in fullscreen mode, like the one `/workflows` now has: it appears while the mouse is over the list and can be clicked or dragged
entries.zh: 在全屏模式下的`/skills`、`/mcp`和`/plugin`已安装列表中添加了一个滚动条，就像现在的`/workflows`：当鼠标悬停在列表上时它会出现，并且可以单击或拖动

entries.en: Fixed a crash ("unrecoverable interface error") that could end a session while an API request was being retried
entries.zh: 修复了重试 API 请求时可能会结束会话的崩溃（“不可恢复的接口错误”）

entries.en: Fixed a turn that could retry indefinitely, ignoring `--max-turns`, when the model alternated unparseable tool calls and output-limit truncation
entries.zh: 修复了当模型交替不可解析的工具调用和输出限制截断时，可以无限期重试的回合，忽略`--max-turns`

entries.en: Fixed resumed sessions re-sending earlier turns in a changed form (a parallel tool-call turn, an MCP tool call's input or a tool-search result while its server was still reconnecting, or a tool-search result whose loading turn was interrupted), which could make the API drop the conversation's prior reasoning
entries.zh: 修复了以更改的形式重新发送早期轮次的恢复会话（并行工具调用轮次、MCP 工具调用的输入或工具搜索结果，而其服务器仍在重新连接，或者加载轮次被中断的工具搜索结果），这可能会使 API 放弃对话的先前推理

entries.en: Fixed resuming a very large session sometimes restoring only its last few messages
entries.zh: 修复了恢复非常大的会话有时仅恢复其最后几条消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed a session resumed after a restart during a pending permission prompt sending a different history than before, which broke the prompt cache from that point
entries.zh: 修复了在待定权限提示期间重新启动后恢复的会话发送与之前不同的历史记录，这会破坏该点的提示缓存

entries.en: Fixed resuming a session that ended during a tool call: Claude now sees the call and is told its outcome is unknown, and a manual resume no longer adds a hidden "Continue" message
entries.zh: 修复了恢复在工具调用期间结束的会话：克劳德现在看到该调用并被告知其结果未知，并且手动恢复不再添加隐藏的“继续”消息

entries.en: Fixed sessions with an earlier advisor result the API could no longer read failing one request every turn and repeatedly losing earlier reasoning; the history is now repaired once
entries.zh: 修复了与早期顾问的会话结果，API 无法再读取每回合失败的一个请求并反复丢失早期推理；历史记录现已修复一次

entries.en: Fixed the prompt cache being lost when an MCP server disconnects mid-conversation, or is still connecting after a resume, while tool search is off (for example behind a proxy or gateway)
entries.zh: 修复 MCP 服务器在对话中途断开，或恢复后仍在连接时，在工具搜索关闭的情况下（例如经过代理或网关）提示词缓存丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed responses cut short by a proxy or gateway that closes the stream cleanly being shown as complete with no warning, and tool calls running twice on duplicated stream events
entries.zh: 固定响应被代理或网关缩短，干净地关闭流，显示为完整且没有警告，并且工具调用在重复的流事件上运行两次

entries.en: Fixed responses failing with "Content block not found" when a proxy drops a stream event mid-response; the partial response is now kept, and web search keeps results that already arrived
entries.zh: 修复了当代理在响应中删除流事件时响应失败并显示“未找到内容块”的问题；现在保留部分响应，并且网络搜索保留已经到达的结果

entries.en: Fixed an empty completed response being requested twice when the connection dropped before the stream's final event
entries.zh: 修复了当连接在流的最终事件之前断开时两次请求空的已完成响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed the stop reason being lost when a proxy sends a trailing usage-only frame
entries.zh: 修复代理发送仅含用量的尾随帧时，停止原因丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` sessions failing on the first 5xx or dropped connection after a run of 429/529 waits, and sleeping uncapped and silently on a long `Retry-After` from a 5xx
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`会话在第一个 5xx 上失败或在运行 429/529 等待后断开连接，以及在 5xx 的长时间`Retry-After`上无上限且安静地休眠

entries.en: Fixed fast mode retrying rate-limited requests back to back when the server sent `Retry-After: 0`
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器发送`Retry-After: 0`时，快速模式会连续重试限速请求的问题

entries.en: Fixed a tool that returned an oversized image leaving sibling tool calls unanswered and still running, or ending the turn with no final message
entries.zh: 修复了一个工具，该工具返回超大图像，导致同级工具调用未应答且仍在运行，或者在没有最终消息的情况下结束回合

entries.en: Fixed conversations getting permanently stuck on "tool_use.name: String should have at most 200 characters" after the model called a tool by an overlong name
entries.zh: 修复了模型通过过长名称调用工具后对话永久卡在“tool_use.name：字符串最多应有 200 个字符”的问题

entries.en: Fixed tool calls failing with "Failed to get memory usage", or being reported as failed after they ran, when Claude Code cannot read its own memory usage, for example when it has run out of file descriptors
entries.zh: 修复 Claude Code 无法读取自身内存用量时（例如文件描述符耗尽），工具调用报"Failed to get memory usage"，或在已执行后仍被报告为失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--input-format stream-json` sessions (Agent SDK, VS Code extension) and scheduled cloud sessions failing every turn with an error when an earlier assistant message had plain-string content
entries.zh: 修复了`--input-format stream-json`会话（Agent SDK、VS Code 扩展）和计划的云会话在早期助理消息具有纯字符串内容时每次失败并出现错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) failing on the next turn after the directory they were started in was deleted mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了非交互式会话（`-p`、Agent SDK）在会话中启动的目录被删除后在下一回合失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed headless sessions with host-side (SDK) MCP servers stalling on the first message when the host stops responding mid-handshake; remote sessions now wait a few seconds at most
entries.zh: 修复了当主机在握手过程中停止响应时，与主机端 (SDK) MCP 服务器的无头会话在第一条消息上停止的问题；远程会话现在最多等待几秒钟

entries.en: Fixed interactive startup waiting on the managed-settings network request (about 80 ms, 17+ seconds when the network is unreachable) when no MCP servers or plugins are configured
entries.zh: 修复了未配置 MCP 服务器或插件时等待托管设置网络请求的交互式启动（大约 80 毫秒，当网络无法访问时超过 17 秒）

entries.en: Fixed a delay of up to two minutes before responding when reading or @-mentioning a PDF larger than 3 MB
entries.zh: 修复了阅读或@提及大于 3 MB 的 PDF 时最多延迟两分钟才做出响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed an interrupted Read of specific PDF pages leaving its page render running for up to two minutes
entries.zh: 修复了特定 PDF 页面的读取中断导致页面渲染运行长达两分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed permission dialogs and attachment checks reading a path under macOS's `/.vol`, `/.nofollow` or `/.resolve` (which can reach a network mount) before approval
entries.zh: 修复了在批准之前读取 macOS 的`/.vol`、`/.nofollow`或`/.resolve`（可以到达网络挂载）下的路径的权限对话框和附件检查

entries.en: Fixed a recursive `rm` whose target is only command-substitution output, such as `rm -rf "$(pwd)"`, running unprompted in auto and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` mode; it now asks even with a Bash allow rule, unless run with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SUBSTITUTION_RM_PROMPT=1`
entries.zh: 修复了一个递归 `rm`，其目标仅是命令替换输出，例如 `rm -rf "$(pwd)"`，在自动和 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 模式下无提示运行；现在，即使使用 Bash 允许规则，它也会询问，除非使用`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SUBSTITUTION_RM_PROMPT=1`运行

entries.en: Fixed a permission rule containing a NUL byte being expanded into a wildcard match; such a rule now matches nothing
entries.zh: 修复了包含 NUL 字节被扩展为通配符匹配的权限规则；这样的规则现在不匹配任何内容

entries.en: Fixed sandbox `excludedCommands` entries not matching `git rev-parse --git-dir`, programs named like shell builtins, and commit messages containing `[WIP]` or `#` lines
entries.zh: 修复了沙箱 `excludedCommands` 条目与 `git rev-parse --git-dir` 不匹配、名为 shell 内置程序的程序以及包含 `[WIP]` 或 `#` 行的提交消息

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands being unable to write to `$TMPDIR` when `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`时沙盒 Bash 命令无法写入`$TMPDIR`的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg` starting a background session, and running its project hooks, in a directory that had not passed the workspace trust prompt; it now asks for trust first, or exits when not run interactively
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --bg`在未通过工作区信任提示的目录中启动后台会话并运行其项目挂钩的问题；现在它首先请求信任，或者在不交互运行时退出

entries.en: Fixed `--setting-sources` (and SDK `settingSources`) not being forwarded to spawned sessions: teammates, `/bg`, `claude agents` sessions and `--worktree --tmux` now start with the parent's restriction
entries.zh: 修复了`--setting-sources`（和 SDK`settingSources`）未转发到生成的会话：队友、`/bg`、“claude Agents”会话和`--worktree --tmux`现在以父级限制开始

entries.en: Fixed Read, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit: a file path containing a null byte now fails that tool call with a clear error instead of ending the whole turn
entries.zh: 修复了读取、写入、编辑和笔记本编辑：包含空字节的文件路径现在使该工具调用失败并出现明显错误，而不是结束整个回合

entries.en: Fixed Write refusing a call that gives the file path or content twice under two parameter names with identical values
entries.zh: 修复了 Write 拒绝在具有相同值的两个参数名称下两次给出文件路径或内容的调用

entries.en: Fixed CLAUDE.md and rules files from an `--add-dir` directory inside the working directory being sent to the model twice in headless and SDK sessions
entries.zh: 修复了工作目录中`--add-dir`目录中的 CLAUDE.md 和规则文件在无头和 SDK 会话中两次发送到模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions staying on "needs approval" with a stale prompt after a permission prompt and a sandbox network-access prompt overlapped and both were answered
entries.zh: 修复了在权限提示和沙箱网络访问提示重叠且两者均得到答复后，远程会话保持“需要批准”状态并出现陈旧提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions not telling Claude about background agents that finished just before a worker restart
entries.zh: 修复了云会话不告诉克劳德有关在工作人员重新启动之前完成的后台代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed scheduled routine and notification turns in remote sessions not receiving turn-start notices (newly available tools, MCP changes, date, todos) until after the first tool call
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话中的计划例程和通知轮次在第一次工具调用之后才收到轮次启动通知（新可用工具、MCP 更改、日期、待办事项）的问题

entries.en: Fixed scheduled tasks and `/loop` wakeups being fired again every second when their delivery failed, which could make Claude Code exit at the end of a turn
entries.zh: 修复了计划任务和`/loop`唤醒在交付失败时每秒再次触发的问题，这可能会使克劳德代码在回合结束时退出

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control reporting "disabled by your organization's policy" when the org policy simply hadn't loaded yet; it now retries the fetch and says it couldn't verify
entries.zh: 修复了当组织策略尚未加载时远程控制报告“被组织策略禁用”的问题；它现在重试获取并表示无法验证

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool missing from Remote Control sessions that `claude remote-control` starts for you to open from Claude Desktop, claude.ai or the mobile app
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话中缺少 Artifact 工具的问题，“claude 远程控制”启动供您从 Claude Desktop、claude.ai 或移动应用程序打开

entries.en: Fixed macOS credential writes dropping stored MCP OAuth tokens or deleting the keychain entry when the login keychain was locked (e.g. right after wake)
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 凭证写入删除存储的 MCP OAuth 令牌或在登录钥匙串锁定时删除钥匙串条目（例如，唤醒后）

entries.en: Fixed `gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh` login processes being left running (and holding their localhost callback port on Windows) when Claude Code exits or the refresh times out
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 退出或刷新超时时，`gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh`登录进程保持运行状态（并在 Windows 上保留其本地主机回调端口）

entries.en: Fixed the "Not logged in · Run /login" footer and missing claude.ai connectors persisting in a session after logging in from another Claude Code process
entries.zh: 修复了“未登录·运行/登录”页脚以及从另一个 Claude 代码进程登录后会话中持续存在的 claude.ai 连接器缺失问题

entries.en: Fixed `mcp_tool` hooks on blocking events (PreToolUse and similar) being skipped while their MCP server was still connecting; they now wait for it, up to the MCP connect timeout
entries.zh: 修复了当 MCP 服务器仍在连接时跳过阻塞事件（PreToolUse 和类似事件）的`mcp_tool`挂钩；他们现在等待，直到 MCP 连接超时

entries.en: Fixed the same MCP server being connected twice when a plugin or claude.ai connector and a configured server spell its URL differently (host letter case, default port, trailing slash)
entries.zh: 修复插件或 claude.ai 连接器与已配置的服务器对同一 URL 写法不同（主机名大小写、默认端口、末尾斜杠）时，同一 MCP 服务器被连接两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed `MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0` giving up on claude.ai connectors after 1s instead of honoring `MCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`
entries.zh: 修复了`MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0`在 1 秒后放弃 claude.ai 连接器而不是遵循`MCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--channels` plugin entries being checked against the installed plugin's marketplace alone; the installed plugin's name must now match the entry as well
entries.zh: 修复了仅根据已安装插件的市场检查`--channels`插件条目的问题；安装的插件的名称现在也必须与条目匹配

entries.en: Fixed `--plugin-dir` on a folder of plugins that also has a `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` loading one empty plugin instead of the plugins in it
entries.zh: 修复了插件文件夹中的`--plugin-dir`，该文件夹还具有`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`，加载一个空插件而不是其中的插件

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin uninstall` refusing to remove a project-scope plugin that isn't enabled, saying it is "enabled at project scope" while `claude plugin disable` says it is already disabled
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件卸载”拒绝删除未启用的项目范围插件，称其“在项目范围启用”，而“claude 插件禁用”则表示它已被禁用的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin update` failing for project-scoped plugins when `--scope` is omitted — it now resolves the scope the plugin is installed at instead of assuming user
entries.zh: 修复了当省略`--scope`时项目范围插件的“claude插件更新”失败的问题 - 它现在解析插件安装的范围，而不是假设用户

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` reporting `privacyPolicyUrl`, `supportUrl` and other listing metadata keys in plugin.json as unknown fields
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`将plugin.json中的`privacyPolicyUrl`、`supportUrl`和其他列表元数据键报告为未知字段的问题

entries.en: Fixed `known_marketplaces.json` recording a marketplace as refreshed when its remote could not be reached and `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE` kept the existing clone
entries.zh: 修复了`known_marketplaces.json`在无法到达远程时将市场记录为刷新的问题，并且`CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE`保留了现有克隆

entries.en: Fixed the `/plugin` Errors tab showing no confirmation after its last error is resolved
entries.zh: 修复 `/plugin` 的"错误"标签页在最后一个错误解决后没有任何确认提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` starting a second uninstall or update of the same plugin when Enter was pressed again while the first was still running
entries.zh: 修复了当第一个插件仍在运行时再次按下 Enter 时`/plugin`开始第二次卸载或更新同一插件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a `y` held while `/plugin` checks a marketplace source adding the marketplace the instant the "Add marketplace?" question appears, before it can be read
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`检查市场源时按住`y`的问题，并在“添加市场？”时立即添加市场。在阅读之前出现问题

entries.en: Fixed `1` answering Yes in `/permissions`' delete and remove-directory confirms while the pointer is on No, which let a held `1` remove one workspace directory after another
entries.zh: 修复了`1`在`/permissions`删除中回答“是”，并在指针位于“否”时确认删除目录，这让持有的`1`删除一个又一个工作区目录

entries.en: Fixed Alt+T and `/config` offering to turn thinking off on models that can't; thinking now stays on there, with a one-line reason in place of the switch
entries.zh: 修复了 Alt+T 和`/config`提供的功能，可以关闭对不能执行此操作的模型的思考；现在的想法停留在那里，用一行理由代替开关

entries.en: Fixed `/context` total leaving out messages added since the last response; it now matches its categories and can read higher than the status line
entries.zh: 修复了自上次响应以来添加的`/context`总遗漏消息；它现在匹配其类别并且可以读取高于状态行的内容

entries.en: Fixed `/model` showing the raw API error JSON and request ID when the API refuses the picked model; it now shows the server's message and says the model was not changed
entries.zh: 修复了当 API 拒绝所选模型时显示原始 API 错误 JSON 和请求 ID 的`/model`；现在显示服务器的消息并表示模型未更改

entries.en: Fixed API errors from an HTML error page (such as a proxy's 429 or 502 page) printing the page's raw markup or leaving out the HTTP status, and error messages breaking onto a second line when the server's error text ended in a newline
entries.zh: 修复了 HTML 错误页面（例如代理的 429 或 502 页面）打印页面的原始标记或遗漏 HTTP 状态的 API 错误，以及当服务器的错误文本以换行符结尾时错误消息中断到第二行

entries.en: Fixed /feedback, /bug and /share still sending your report after you cancelled it while it was being sent
entries.zh: 修复了在发送报告时取消报告后 /feedback、/bug 和 /share 仍在发送报告的问题

entries.en: Fixed /feedback, /bug and /share failing every send with "Couldn't send feedback" after a Remote Control Stop arrived while the dialog was open
entries.zh: 修复了在对话框打开时远程控制停止到达后每次发送失败并显示“无法发送反馈”的 /feedback、/bug 和 /share

entries.en: Fixed `/ide` showing "No available IDEs detected" while also listing a running IDE
entries.zh: 修复了 `/ide` 显示“未检测到可用 IDE”的问题，同时还列出了正在运行的 IDE

entries.en: Fixed the terminal being left in a broken state (crash or garbled input) when `/setup-bedrock` or `/setup-vertex` restarts Claude Code to apply new settings
entries.zh: 修复 `/setup-bedrock` 或 `/setup-vertex` 为应用新设置而重启 Claude Code 时，终端可能被留在损坏状态（崩溃或输入乱码）的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/config` exiting when `respectGitignore` or `copyFullResponse` in `~/.claude.json` holds `null`
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude.json`中的`respectGitignore`或`copyFullResponse`持有`null`时`/config`退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed the session name from /rename disappearing while Claude asks a multiple-choice question, so side-by-side sessions stay identifiable
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 向你提出多选题时，`/rename` 设置的会话名称消失的问题，以便并排的会话仍可辨认

entries.en: Fixed one-line pastes showing on their own lines in the sent message for prompts from VS Code or Remote Control and for expanded paste placeholders
entries.zh: 修复了针对来自 VS Code 或远程控制的提示以及扩展粘贴占位符的已发送消息中单行粘贴显示在其自己的行上的问题

entries.en: Fixed a message queued while Claude is working losing or changing the IDE selection it was written with, and queued messages not showing their selection
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德正在工作时排队的消息丢失或更改其写入的 IDE 选择，以及排队的消息不显示其选择的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing Shift+Tab twice quickly landing on the wrong permission mode
entries.zh: 修复了按 Shift+Tab 两次快速登陆错误的权限模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D pressed twice quitting Claude Code instead of closing the dialog in the remaining dialogs and pickers, such as `/memory`, `/hooks`, `/mcp` (including a server's sign-in screen), `/export`, `/copy`, `/theme`, and `/teleport`'s uncommitted-changes and login prompts (where Esc also quit)
entries.zh: 修复了按 Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+D 两次退出 Claude Code 而不是关闭其余对话框和选取器中的对话框，例如`/memory`、`/hooks`、`/mcp`（包括服务器的登录屏幕）、`/export`、`/copy`、`/theme`和`/teleport`的未提交更改和登录提示（其中 Esc 也会退出）

entries.en: Fixed keys that arrive in one burst of input (e.g. over Remote Control), such as an arrow key followed by Enter, `x` or `s`, acting on the previous selection: a stale effort level in `/effort` and the model picker, and the previously highlighted row in `/skills`, the background task rows under the prompt, MCP server prompts and `/install-github-app`
entries.zh: 修复了在一次输入突发中到达的键（例如通过远程控制），例如箭头键后跟 Enter、`x`或`s`，作用于先前的选择：`/effort`和模型选择器中的陈旧工作级别、`/skills`中先前突出显示的行、提示下的后台任务行、MCP 服务器提示和`/install-github-app`

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` updating the workflow after "Skip workflow update" was chosen, running setup twice on a repeated Enter, and ↑ on the repository step blocking a typed repository name when no repository was detected
entries.zh: 修复了选择“跳过工作流程更新”后更新工作流程的`/install-github-app`问题，在重复 Enter 时运行安装程序两次，并在未检测到存储库时阻止键入存储库名称的存储库步骤上的 ↑

entries.en: Fixed vim mode: `dj`/`dk`/`dG`/`dgg` and their `c`/`y` forms acting on part of a line; `1G` going to the last line; `d0`/`c0`/`y0` doing nothing; the cursor being off by one after `.` repeats an insert; and `o`/`p` on a `!`-prefixed line switching to shell mode
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下 `dj`/`dk`/`dG`/`dgg` 及其 `c`/`y` 形式只作用于一行的一部分、`1G` 跳到最后一行、`d0`/`c0`/`y0` 无效、`.` 重复插入后光标偏移一格，以及在以 `!` 开头的行上执行 `o`/`p` 会切换到 shell 模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `cw` on a space, an empty line, a word's last letter or a one-letter word also changing the next word; word motions stopping inside words in Hindi, Bengali and other scripts; and `.`, `p` or `P` that inserts text starting with `!` switching to shell mode, losing text or editing the wrong character
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下：在空格、空行、单词末字母或单字母单词上执行 `cw` 时会改动下一个单词；印地语、孟加拉语等文字的单词移动会停在词内；输入以 `!` 开头的文本时，`.`、`p` 或 `P` 会切换到 shell 模式、丢失文字或编辑错误的字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed the prompt cursor moving one character too far after an accent typed as its own key
entries.zh: 修复用独立按键输入重音符后，提示光标多右移一个字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed an extra blank line above a list item whose text starts on the line after its bullet, in screen-reader mode, quoted lists and long lists
entries.zh: 修复了在屏幕阅读器模式、引用列表和长列表中列表项上方的额外空白行，该列表项的文本从项目符号后的行开始

entries.en: Fixed bulleted lists of plain numbers (like `- 316.`) showing as letters, roman numerals or the wrong numbers
entries.zh: 修复了显示为字母、罗马数字或错误数字的普通数字（例如“- 316”）的项目符号列表

entries.en: Fixed the agent panel's footer hint ignoring keys rebound in `keybindings.json`, and showing a stray ` · ` when the stop-all-agents shortcut is unbound
entries.zh: 修复智能体面板页脚提示忽略 `keybindings.json` 中重绑定的按键，以及停止所有智能体的快捷键未绑定时显示多余的 ` · ` 的问题

entries.en: Fixed the agent panel footer offering "Enter to view" and "x to stop" on the agent you are already viewing (where x types into its input), and "Enter to view" on the main row when main is already shown
entries.zh: 修复智能体面板页脚在你正在查看的智能体上仍提示"Enter to view"和"x to stop"（而 x 实际会输入到其输入框中），以及主会话已显示时主行上仍提示"Enter to view"的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mouse click on an agent-panel row leaving the keyboard cursor on the previously selected row
entries.zh: 修复了鼠标单击代理面板行时将键盘光标留在先前选定的行上的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc interrupting the running turn instead of deselecting the selected agent-panel row
entries.zh: 修复了 Esc 中断正在运行的回合而不是取消选择选定的代理面板行的问题

entries.en: Fixed PgUp and PgDn doing nothing in a dialog's list (for example `/skills`) in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了 PgUp 和 PgDn 在全屏模式下在对话框列表（例如`/skills`）中不执行任何操作的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/heapdump` summary saying most memory is native when it is in the JS heap snapshot
entries.zh: 修复了`/heapdump`摘要，表明大多数内存位于 JS 堆快照中时是本机内存

entries.en: Fixed Bash edit-diff snapshot directories piling up in the temp folder: abandoned ones are now deleted right away and the rest when Claude Code exits
entries.zh: 修复了临时文件夹中堆积的 Bash edit-diff 快照目录：废弃的目录现在会立即删除，其余的则在 Claude Code 退出时删除

entries.en: Fixed /workflows moving the pointer to a different run, and `x` stopping it, when a new run started while the list was open
entries.zh: 修复了当列表打开时开始新的运行时 /workflows 将指针移动到不同的运行，并使用`x`停止它

entries.en: Fixed the selected tab in tabbed dialogs (`/config`, `/plugin`, `/permissions`) showing no highlight while the tab bar has focus when color is off (`NO_COLOR`)
entries.zh: 修复颜色关闭（`NO_COLOR`）时，标签栏获得焦点后，标签式对话框（`/config`、`/plugin`、`/permissions`）中选中的标签不显示高亮的问题

entries.en: Fixed the mouse wheel over the `/plugin` Installed list scrolling the pane behind it instead of the list
entries.zh: 修复鼠标滚轮在 `/plugin` 的已安装列表上滚动的是后面的窗格而不是列表本身的问题

entries.en: Fixed the hover highlight lingering on a list row in fullscreen mode after scrolling or filtering moved it away from the mouse
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下滚动或筛选使列表行离开鼠标位置后，悬停高亮仍残留在该行上的问题

entries.en: Fixed long list rows, such as in the /remote-control menu, wrapping onto a second line in narrow terminals; they're now cut with …
entries.zh: 修复了长列表行，例如在 /remote-control 菜单中，在窄终端中换行到第二行；他们现在被削减了……

entries.en: Fixed `/hooks` and `/mcp` detail views printing a long value over the row below it in narrow terminals
entries.zh: 修复了`/hooks`和`/mcp`详细信息视图在窄终端中在其下方的行上打印长值

entries.en: Fixed lists such as a skill's state options in `/plugin` not being answerable by typing a number in screen-reader mode
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`中的诸如技能状态选项之类的列表无法通过在屏幕阅读器模式下键入数字来应答的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed Bash commands that write to `$TMPDIR/…` failing with "Permission denied"
entries.zh: Windows：修复了写入 `$TMPDIR/…` 的 Bash 命令报 "Permission denied" 的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed a race in which Claude Code sessions updating at the same moment could delete each other's `claude.exe` backup, which could leave no `claude.exe` behind
entries.zh: Windows：修复了同时更新的 Claude Code 会话可能删除彼此的 `claude.exe` 备份，导致最终没有 `claude.exe` 的竞态问题

entries.en: Improved Claude Desktop sign-in and usage-limit error messages to point at the app instead of terminal commands
entries.zh: 改进 Claude Desktop 的登录和用量上限错误提示，指向应用本身，而不是终端命令

entries.en: Improved startup: managed settings and policy fetches no longer retry requests that can never succeed
entries.zh: 改进启动：托管设置和策略获取不再重试那些永远不可能成功的请求

entries.en: Improved interactive startup time: git reads, startup telemetry and the Bedrock/Vertex model-upgrade checks no longer run before the first frame
entries.zh: 改进交互式启动时间：git 读取、启动遥测和 Bedrock/Vertex 模型升级检查，不再在首帧显示之前运行

entries.en: Improved the time to resume long sessions that read many files; the restored file cache now matches the files as they were read
entries.zh: 改进恢复读取了大量文件的长会话时的速度；恢复的文件缓存现在与读取时的文件内容一致

entries.en: Improved the time to resume very long sessions that have been compacted, most noticeably through the Agent SDK and Claude Desktop
entries.zh: 改进恢复经过压缩的超长会话时的速度，在 Agent SDK 和 Claude Desktop 中尤其明显

entries.en: Improved "Prompt is too long" recovery in sessions dominated by one very large first prompt: that prompt is now summarized on its own instead of being left out of the summary
entries.zh: 改进“Prompt is too long”的恢复：如果会话开头是一条超大的提示词，现在会单独对它做摘要，而不是把它排除在摘要之外

entries.en: Improved auto mode after resuming a session in a new process: the permission classifier can now reuse its earlier prompt cache instead of rewriting it
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：在新进程中恢复会话后，权限分类器可以复用先前的提示词缓存，而不必重写缓存

entries.en: Improved the auto mode denial message so Claude treats a denial as covering the outcome, not only the exact command
entries.zh: 改进自动模式的拒绝提示：Claude 会把一次拒绝理解为覆盖整个结果，而不只是那一条具体命令

entries.en: Improved the dangerous-rm check to also flag a removal at a shell variable followed by a top-level directory name, at a variable derived from the working directory, or at a backslash-only target
entries.zh: 改进危险 rm 检查：也会标记指向 shell 变量后接顶层目录名的删除、基于工作目录派生的变量的删除，以及仅含反斜杠目标的删除

entries.en: Improved sandbox guidance on macOS: when a local dev server can't bind a port, Claude now points to `sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding`
entries.zh: 改进 macOS 上的沙盒提示：本地开发服务器无法绑定端口时，Claude 会指向 `sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding`

entries.en: Improved `--agents` to accept the path to a JSON file (with `-p`) as well as inline JSON, and to allow an empty `prompt`
entries.zh: 改进 `--agents`：既可接受内联 JSON，也可（配合 `-p`）接受 JSON 文件路径；并允许 `prompt` 为空

entries.en: Improved `/batch` to run where a WorktreeCreate hook provides the agent worktrees, not only inside a git repository
entries.zh: 改进 `/batch`：在 WorktreeCreate 钩子提供代理 worktree 的环境中也能运行，不再只限于 git 仓库内

entries.en: Improved plugin hook-failure errors to name the offending plugin, and added a `claude plugin validate` warning when a shell-form hook leaves `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` unquoted (it breaks on plugin paths with spaces)
entries.zh: 改进插件 hook 失败时的报错，会指明出问题的插件；新增 `claude plugin validate` 警告：当 shell 形式的 hook 未给 `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` 加引号时提示（路径含空格时会出错）

entries.en: Improved the `/` menu, `/skills`, `/context` and the `/plugin` Installed list to show skills synced from claude.ai by their short name when no other command uses it, not `anthropic-skills:<name>`
entries.zh: 改进 `/` 菜单、`/skills`、`/context` 和 `/plugin` 已安装列表：从 claude.ai 同步来的技能，若没有其他命令重名，就用简短名称显示，而不是 `anthropic-skills:<名称>`

entries.en: Improved `/deep-research` reliability on long research briefs by removing unused required fields from the scope step's output
entries.zh: 改进 `/deep-research` 在长研究简报上的可靠性：从范围步骤的输出中去掉了不必要的必填字段

entries.en: Improved the writing in published artifact pages: the bundled artifact-design skill now asks Claude for plain, direct prose
entries.zh: 改进已发布 Artifact 页面的文字：内置的 artifact-design 技能会要求 Claude 使用平实、直接的文字

entries.en: Improved artifact publishing on slow connections: large page uploads are now sent compressed
entries.zh: 改进慢速网络下的 artifact 发布：大页面上传改为压缩后发送

entries.en: Improved the large CLAUDE.md startup notice to also count instruction files together, so many mid-sized files and @-imports are caught
entries.zh: 改进 CLAUDE.md 过大时的启动提示：也会把指令文件合并统计，从而发现多个中等大小的文件和 @ 导入的情况

entries.en: Improved debug logs to name settings `env` variables ignored because the session's launch environment already sets them
entries.zh: 改进调试日志：会指出 `settings` 中的 `env` 变量因启动环境已设定而被忽略的情况

entries.en: Improved keyboard navigation in tabbed dialogs such as `/permissions` and `/usage`: ↑/↓ move focus between the tab row and the content, and a list responds to keys only while it has focus
entries.zh: 改进 `/permissions` 和 `/usage` 等标签式对话框的键盘导航：↑/↓ 在标签行和内容之间移动焦点；列表只有获得焦点时才响应按键

entries.en: Improved `/help` and `/sandbox`: ←/→ and Tab switch tabs from inside a tab's list, and ↓ on an empty Custom commands tab in `/help` no longer leaves the keys stuck until Esc
entries.zh: 改进 `/help` 和 `/sandbox`：在标签页的列表内，←/→ 和 Tab 可切换标签页；`/help` 的自定义命令标签页为空时，按 ↓ 不再让按键卡住，直到按 Esc

entries.en: Improved `/install-github-app`, `/desktop`, the `/permissions` auto mode environment prompts, and the `/plugin` "Add marketplace?" and "Run this command?" prompts: they now use the standard dialog frame with key hints, and Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D cancels them on the second press like other dialogs
entries.zh: 改进 `/install-github-app`、`/desktop`、`/permissions` 自动模式的环境提示，以及 `/plugin` 中“Add marketplace?”和“Run this command?”提示：统一使用标准对话框框架并显示按键提示；Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+D 按两次即可取消，与其他对话框一致

entries.en: Improved the `/workflows` and `/mcp` lists: they page (PgUp/PgDn, Home/End) and take j/k and the mouse like other lists, their arrows follow `select:previous`/`select:next` rebinds, and `x` in `/workflows` stops the run the pointer is on
entries.zh: 改进 `/workflows` 和 `/mcp` 列表：支持翻页（PgUp/PgDn、Home/End），也支持 j/k 键和鼠标，与其他列表一致；箭头键跟随 `select:previous`/`select:next` 的快捷键重绑定；在 `/workflows` 中按 `x` 可停止光标所在的运行

entries.en: Improved the `/plugin` plugin and marketplace details menus and the `/remote-control` already-connected menu: they now support Home/End and clicking a row
entries.zh: 改进 `/plugin` 的插件和市场详情菜单，以及 `/remote-control` 的已连接菜单：现在支持 Home/End 键，并可点击行
