entries.en: Improved the background workflow row below the prompt: it now shows the name, a progress bar, the agent count on wide terminals, elapsed time, total tokens, and the large-workflow warning
entries.zh: 改进提示框下方的后台工作流行：现在显示名称、进度条、宽终端下的智能体数量、已用时间、总 token 数，以及大型工作流警告

entries.en: Improved the /plugin Installed list: rows now line up in columns (status, name, type, details) across every section
entries.zh: 改进 /plugin 已安装列表：每个分区的行都按列对齐（状态、名称、类型、详情）

entries.en: Improved `/skills`: each row now leads with the skill's name, with ✔ or ◯ alone showing on or off, and stays on one line in narrow terminals
entries.zh: 改进 `/skills`：每行以技能名称开头，只用 ✔ 或 ◯ 表示开或关，窄终端中也保持单行显示

entries.en: Improved narrow list rows (`/skills`, `/workflows`, `/feedback`): a name keeps 20 columns beside its first detail, and details are shown whole or not at all
entries.zh: 改进窄列表行（`/skills`、`/workflows`、`/feedback`）：名称在第一个详情旁保留 20 列宽；详情要么完整显示，要么完全不显示

entries.en: Improved `/diff`: a scrollbar shows where you are in a long list of changed files, and long paths no longer wrap their rows
entries.zh: 改进 `/diff`：长列表旁有滚动条显示当前位置，长路径不再换行

entries.en: Improved `/hooks`: a hook's detail screen now says what kind of hook it is and where to change it, instead of always pointing at settings.json, and the hooks-disabled, safe mode and managed-hooks-only notices each say what is happening in one plain sentence
entries.zh: 改进 `/hooks`：hook 详情页会说明这是哪种 hook、应在哪里修改，而不是一律指向 settings.json；hook 被禁用、安全模式和仅托管模式的提示，各用一句话说明情况

entries.en: Improved screen-reader output in `/mcp`: a disabled server is read as "off" instead of "pending"
entries.zh: 改进 `/mcp` 的屏幕阅读器输出：已禁用的服务器读作「off」，而不是「pending」

entries.en: Improved the Remote Control confirmation: its options are briefly inactive again after the terminal window regains focus, so a key pressed while switching back cannot answer it
entries.zh: 改进 Remote Control 确认框：终端窗口重新获得焦点后，选项会短暂失效，切换回来时按下的键不会误选它

entries.en: Changed send now (ctrl+enter or ctrl+x ctrl+s) to move running tools to the background instead of cancelling the turn
entries.zh: 更改了立即发送（ctrl+enter 或 ctrl+x ctrl+s）以将正在运行的工具移动到后台，而不是取消转弯

entries.en: Changed auto mode so that, where its classifier review runs server-side, read-only and sandboxed shell commands also wait for that review and are blocked when it flags them
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式，以便在其分类器审查运行服务器端时，只读和沙盒 shell 命令也会等待该审查，并在标记它们时被阻止

entries.en: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER` to also apply on a direct Anthropic API connection: `0` opts out of the server-side auto mode classifier (the local classifier then counts toward usage), `1` opts in
entries.zh: 更改了`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER`，使其也适用于直接 Anthropic API 连接：`0`选择退出服务器端自动模式分类器（本地分类器随后计入使用量），`1`选择加入

entries.en: Changed the dangerous `rm` prompt in `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and auto mode to wait 2 minutes for an answer, then deny the command with a rewrite hint so unattended sessions keep going (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT=1` turns this off)
entries.zh: 更改了`--dangerously-skip-permissions`和自动模式中危险的`rm`提示，等待 2 分钟以获得答案，然后使用重写提示拒绝该命令，以便无人值守的会话继续进行（`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT=1`将其关闭）

entries.en: Changed AGENTS.md support to also work on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry, LLM gateways, and sessions with telemetry disabled
entries.zh: 更改了 AGENTS.md 支持，使其也适用于 Amazon Bedrock、Google Vertex AI、Microsoft Foundry、LLM 网关以及禁用遥测的会话

entries.en: Changed Claude apps gateway to refuse to start when a `managedMcpServers` entry's `envHelper` path starts with `\??\` or `/??/`, a path form current Claude Desktop refuses to run
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude 应用程序网关，使其在“managementMcpServers”条目的`envHelper`路径以`\??\`或`/??/`开头时拒绝启动，当前 Claude 桌面的路径拒绝运行

entries.en: Changed self-hosted runners to pass system prompts to Claude Code as private files instead of command-line text, so large prompts no longer fail the launch; a wrapper or `command` hook that appends `--system-prompt` or `--append-system-prompt` must switch to `--system-prompt-file` or `--append-system-prompt-file`
entries.zh: 更改了自托管运行程序，将系统提示作为私有文件而不是命令行文本传递给 Claude Code，因此大型提示不再导致启动失败；附加`--system-prompt`或`--append-system-prompt`的包装器或`command`挂钩必须切换到`--system-prompt-file`或`--append-system-prompt-file`

entries.en: Changed queued messages to show in the conversation above the spinner instead of under it
entries.zh: 更改了排队消息以显示在微调器上方的对话中，而不是显示在微调器下方

entries.en: Changed the session artifact links under the prompt into one footer pill (`⧉ name` or `⧉ N`) that opens `/artifacts`, which now lists this session's artifacts first
entries.zh: 将提示下的会话工件链接更改为打开`/artifacts`的一个页脚药丸（`⧉ name`或`⧉ N`），现在首先列出该会话的工件

entries.en: Changed the Artifact tool to let Claude load scripts from unpkg.com in artifact pages
entries.zh: 更改了 Artifact 工具，让 Claude 在 Artifact 页面中加载来自 unpkg.com 的脚本

entries.en: Changed hovering a list row in fullscreen mode, including in `/config`, to tint the row instead of drawing a second ❯ pointer beside the focused row's
entries.zh: 更改了在全屏模式下悬停列表行（包括在`/config`中）以对该行着色，而不是在焦点行旁边绘制第二个❯指针

entries.en: Changed /mcp: each server's row now starts with its status icon and name, says its state once, and in a narrow terminal drops trailing facts like "managed" before shortening the name
entries.zh: 更改了 /mcp：每个服务器的行现在以其状态图标和名称开头，一次表示其状态，并且在狭窄的终端中，在缩短名称之前会删除诸如“托管”之类的尾随事实

entries.en: Changed /workflows: each run's row leads with its status icon and elapsed time, and a narrow terminal keeps the run's name and time, dropping the agent and token counts first
entries.zh: 更改/工作流程：每个运行的行以其状态图标和经过的时间开头，狭窄的终端保留运行的名称和时间，首先删除代理和令牌计数

entries.en: Changed Remote Control attachment downloads to reuse connections and to skip files already downloaded in the session
entries.zh: 更改了远程控制附件下载以重用连接并跳过会话中已下载的文件

entries.en: Changed MCP resource lists (the resource list tool and @-mention suggestions) to skip MCP Apps UI resources; reading one by URI still works
entries.zh: 更改了 MCP 资源列表（资源列表工具和@提及建议）以跳过 MCP Apps UI 资源；通过 URI 读取一个仍然有效

entries.en: Changed `claude plugin uninstall --json` and the /plugin dialog to say a plugin's data was kept when its folder stays because another installed plugin uses it or install records cannot be read
entries.zh: 更改了 `claude plugin uninstall --json` 和 /plugin 对话框，表示插件的数据在其文件夹保留时被保留，因为另一个已安装的插件使用它或无法读取安装记录

entries.en: Changed the background tasks list (`/tasks`): pressing `x` on a running `/ultrareview` now asks for confirmation before stopping the review
entries.zh: 更改了后台任务列表（`/tasks`）：在运行的`/ultrareview`上按`x`现在要求在停止审核之前进行确认

entries.en: Removed the leftover "(removed)" `/agents` entry from the command menu and `/help`; typing `/agents` still explains where the wizard went
entries.zh: 从命令菜单和 `/help` 中移除遗留的 "(removed)" `/agents` 条目；输入 `/agents` 仍会说明向导已去向何处

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Continue/Stop prompt in the VS Code and JetBrains panels when auto mode falls back to billed classifier requests, replacing the unanswerable warning line
entries.zh: [VSCode] 自动模式回退到按量计费的分类器请求时，VS Code 和 JetBrains 面板新增「继续/停止」提示，取代原来无法作答的警告行

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed opening a Web session with no messages saving an empty local copy that could not be resumed; an error now says where to continue it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复打开一个没有消息的 Web 会话时，会保存一个无法恢复的空本地副本的问题；现在会提示在哪里继续该会话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a claude.ai/code session opening empty or with only part of its conversation, with no error, when the server failed to return its history, part of it failed to load, or a network sign-in page answered in its place; it now shows an error and can be opened again
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 claude.ai/code 会话打开时为空或只显示部分对话且没有任何报错的问题（原因包括服务器未返回历史、部分历史加载失败，或网络登录页替代了返回内容）；现在会显示错误，并可以重新打开

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed conversations in editor tabs hanging silently after the extension host restarts; the tab now tells you to reopen it from the session list
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展宿主重启后，编辑器标签页中的对话静默卡住的问题；现在标签页会提示你从会话列表重新打开

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Claude attaching option previews to multiple-choice questions in the chat panel, where the question card never shows them
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude 在聊天面板的选择题中附带选项预览的问题（问题卡片从不显示这些预览）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session manager's cost and usage block wrapping mid-text on a narrow side bar, and showing totals from a previous login after an account switch
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话管理器的费用和用量区块在窄侧边栏中于文字中间换行，以及切换账号后仍显示上一次登录总计的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a Fast mode switch to the composer's model menu in cloud sessions, shown when your plan includes fast mode and the selected model supports it
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 云端会话的输入框模型菜单新增 Fast mode 开关，当你的套餐包含快速模式且所选模型支持时显示

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a settings shortcut on the GitHub setup tip and a "Troubleshoot GitHub connection" link in the repository pickers, both opening your GitHub connection page
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] GitHub 设置提示上新增设置快捷入口，仓库选择器中新增「Troubleshoot GitHub connection」链接，两者都会打开你的 GitHub 连接页面

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed routines with a GitHub trigger for a pull request being converted to draft never firing; they now start a run when the pull request is converted
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复基于 GitHub 拉取请求触发、在 PR 转为草稿时，例程从不触发的问题；现在 PR 转为草稿时会开始运行

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed cloud sessions on a repository that isn't hosted on GitHub showing a Create PR button that could never work; the button is now hidden there
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复托管在非 GitHub 仓库上的云端会话显示一个永远无法使用的「Create PR」按钮的问题；现在该按钮会在这种情况下隐藏

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed the GitHub setup tip on claude.ai/code covering the repository picker's search box and rows while the picker is open; it now steps aside until the picker closes
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复 claude.ai/code 上的 GitHub 设置提示，在仓库选择器打开时覆盖其搜索框和列表行的问题；现在选择器打开时它会暂时让开，直到选择器关闭

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved the file card shown when a cloud session can't open a file: it now says whether the file no longer exists or the session's permission settings block reading it
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 改进云端会话无法打开文件时显示的文件卡片：现在会说明是文件已不存在，还是会话的权限设置阻止了读取

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a short line in the Slack thread after someone presses Stop, naming who stopped Claude's response and saying to mention @Claude to continue
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 有人在 Slack 话题中点击停止后，话题中会出现一行简短提示，说明是谁停止了 Claude 的回复，并告诉大家 @Claude 可以继续

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack channels where Claude could permanently stop responding to replies inside threads; affected channels now recover on their own with the next new message to Claude
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 频道中 Claude 可能永久停止回复话题内消息的问题；受影响的频道现在会在下一条发给 Claude 的新消息时自行恢复

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude resuming a stopped request after you press Stop in Slack, for example when a check-in fired or a background task ended; messages sent mid-response are now read
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复你在 Slack 中按下停止后，Claude 恢复已停止请求的问题（例如签到触发或后台任务结束时）；回复过程中发送的消息现在会被读取

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack replies arriving many minutes late, or never, after Claude's session crashed mid-task, such as on a failed setup script; it now restarts on its own within minutes
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 会话在任务中途崩溃（例如安装脚本失败）后，Slack 回复延迟数分钟甚至永远收不到的问题；现在会在几分钟内自行重启

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack promising an automatic restart, then failing generically, when a session's configuration is too large to start; the thread now says why and how to retry
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复会话配置过大无法启动时，Claude in Slack 承诺会自动重启，随后却笼统地失败的问题；现在话题中会说明原因以及如何重试

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed very long Slack threads: Claude could silently withhold a reply after judging it against weeks-old messages, and a restart deep into the thread could lose recent context
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复超长 Slack 话题的问题：Claude 可能因与数周前的消息对比后认为不该回复，而悄悄不回复；话题深处的重启还可能丢失最近的上下文

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude answering every mention with "Couldn't check this channel just now" in a Slack channel moved from Enterprise Grid org-wide sharing into a single workspace
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复从 Enterprise Grid 组织范围共享改为单个工作区的 Slack 频道中，Claude 对每次提及都回复「Couldn't check this channel just now」的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed very large Enterprise Grid workspaces reached mostly through channels shared across workspaces getting "Couldn't check this channel" again after a quiet hour
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复超大 Enterprise Grid 工作区（主要通过跨工作区共享的频道访问）在安静一小时后再次显示「Couldn't check this channel」的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack request blocked by your organization's inference hook showing a generic retry notice; the thread now shows the hook's deny message and Claude doesn't retry
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 请求被组织的推理钩子拦截时，话题只显示笼统重试通知的问题；现在会显示钩子的拒绝信息，且 Claude 不再重试

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack offering to switch to models your organization can't use; it now lists and offers only models the switch will actually accept
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude in Slack 提议切换到组织无法使用的模型的问题；现在只列出并提议实际可以切换的模型

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed requests to DynamoDB and Kinesis account-based endpoints failing to authenticate when sent through an AWS connection in Claude Tag
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 中通过 AWS 连接发送的 DynamoDB 和 Kinesis 基于账户的端点请求，身份验证失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the Plugins sections in Claude Tag admin settings failing to load for organization admins and listing attached plugins as raw IDs; they now load and show each plugin's name
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 管理设置中的 Plugins 部分对组织管理员加载失败、并把已附加插件显示为原始 ID 的问题；现在会正常加载并显示每个插件的名称

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the routine list Claude gives when asked in a Slack thread to show that thread's own scheduled tasks by default instead of every routine in the channel
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 在 Slack 话题中询问例程列表时，默认只显示该话题自己的定时任务，而不是频道中的所有例程

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed a pull request getting no review when its reviewed commit was force-pushed away while a failed review was being retried in a repository not set to review every push
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复在未设置为每次推送都审查的仓库中，审查失败并重试时，所审查的提交被强制推送覆盖，导致拉取请求得不到审查的问题

entries.en: Added Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`), now the default Opus model — 1M context, $4/$20 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`)，现在是默认 Opus 模型 — 1M 上下文，每个 Mtok 4 美元/20 美元，每 Mtok 缓存读取 0.20 美元

entries.en: Added mouse support to more lists in fullscreen mode: the wheel scrolls the `/skills` list, and a skill's state options in `/plugin` can be clicked
entries.zh: 在全屏模式下为更多列表添加了鼠标支持：滚轮滚动`/skills`列表，并且可以单击`/plugin`中的技能状态选项

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH` to change the 2,048-character cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions for every MCP server in the session
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH`，以更改会话中每个 MCP 服务器的 MCP 工具描述和服务器指令的 2,048 个字符上限

entries.en: Added hook output sizes and the number of oversized outputs saved to a file to the `hook_execution_complete` OpenTelemetry event
entries.zh: 添加了挂钩输出大小以及保存到文件中的超大输出数量到`hook_execution_complete` OpenTelemetry 事件

entries.en: Fixed writes through a symlinked path being judged by their in-tree spelling: the prompt names where the write lands, and `acceptEdits`, allow rules and auto mode no longer approve one landing outside
entries.zh: 修复通过符号链接路径写入时，按树内写法判断的问题：提示现在会说明写入的实际落点，`acceptEdits`、允许规则和自动模式不再批准落在外部的写入

entries.en: Fixed auto mode retrying an action over and over when a safety check declined to review it; the action is now denied once, noting that retrying won't help
entries.zh: 修复了当安全检查拒绝审查某个操作时，自动模式会一遍又一遍地重试某个操作的问题；该操作现在被拒绝一次，并指出重试无济于事

entries.en: Fixed auto mode denying actions over and over without pause when a safety check gave no answer; retries now back off, and the turn stops with a message after ten in a row
entries.zh: 修复了当安全检查没有给出答案时，自动模式会一遍又一遍地拒绝操作而不会暂停的问题；重试现在停止，连续十次后轮流停止并显示一条消息

entries.en: Fixed Write calls failing validation when a model sends `path`, `file_text`, `file_content` or a stray `description` instead of `file_path` and `content`
entries.zh: 修复了当模型发送“路径”、“文件文本”、“文件内容”或杂散“描述”而不是“文件路径”和“内容”时，写入调用验证失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D pressed twice in most dialogs (`/model`, `/effort`, `/config`, `/status`, `/usage`, `/plugin`, `/sandbox`, `/permissions`, `/artifacts`, `/mobile`, `/login`, `/upgrade`, `/usage-credits`, `/install-github-app`, `/setup-bedrock`, `/setup-vertex`) quitting Claude Code instead of closing the dialog
entries.zh: 修复了在大多数对话框中按两次 Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+D 的问题（`/model`、`/effort`、`/config`、`/status`、`/usage`、`/plugin`、`/sandbox`、`/permissions`、`/artifacts`、`/mobile`、`/login`、`/upgrade`、`/usage-credits`、`/install-github-app`、`/setup-bedrock`、 `/setup-vertex`) 退出 Claude Code 而不是关闭对话框

entries.en: Fixed a click that only brought the terminal window to the front also triggering the item under the pointer — in search pickers, tab bars, agent/workflow rows, slash-command links and suggestion dropdowns
entries.zh: 修复了一次单击，该单击仅将终端窗口带到前面，同时还会触发指针下的项目 - 在搜索选择器、选项卡栏、代理/工作流程行、斜杠命令链接和建议下拉菜单中

entries.en: Fixed a stray `n` closing dialogs and a stray `y` confirming them; Enter and Esc accept and cancel (bind `y`/`n` to `confirm:yes`/`confirm:no` in `keybindings.json` to restore)
entries.zh: 修复了一个杂散的“n”关闭对话框和一个杂散的“y”确认对话框； Enter 并 Esc 接受并取消（将 `y`/`n` 绑定到 `keybindings.json` 中的 `confirm:yes`/`confirm:no` 即可恢复）

entries.en: Fixed text fields in dialogs losing a typed letter, digit or Space to a keybinding on that key
entries.zh: 修复对话框中的文本输入框，输入的字母、数字或空格被某个快捷键吞掉的问题

entries.en: Fixed the prompt line staying scrambled on Windows terminals after invisible characters were removed on Enter; the screen is now repainted so you review the exact text that will be sent
entries.zh: 修复 Windows 终端中，回车时移除不可见字符后提示行保持错乱的问题；现在会重绘屏幕，让你审阅将要发送的确切文本

entries.en: Fixed the invisible-character cleanup removing the zero-width non-joiner that Persian and Arabic text uses to attach a suffix to a Latin word or number, such as the plural of "PDF"
entries.zh: 修复不可见字符清理会删除波斯语和阿拉伯语中用于给拉丁文字或数字附加后缀（如 "PDF" 的复数）的零宽不连字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed voice dictation not stopping on Ctrl+C (the prompt cleared but the microphone kept recording), Esc not cancelling while a transcript was processing, and held Space starting dictation from the transcript view and vim NORMAL mode
entries.zh: 修复语音听写在按 Ctrl+C 后不停止（提示框已清空但麦克风仍在录音）、转录处理中按 Esc 无法取消，以及在转录视图和 vim NORMAL 模式下长按空格会启动听写的问题

entries.en: Fixed a model switch made from a host app (Claude Desktop, VS Code, SDK) while Claude is working causing a prompt-cache miss on the next prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 工作时从主机应用程序（Claude Desktop、VS Code、SDK）进行的模型切换，导致下一个提示出现提示缓存缺失

entries.en: Fixed resumed fork subagents rebuilding their tool list instead of re-sending the one they first used, which broke prompt caching for that agent
entries.zh: 修复了恢复的分叉子代理重建其工具列表，而不是重新发送他们第一次使用的工具列表，这会破坏该代理的提示缓存

entries.en: Fixed subagent hand-back messages showing an internal provenance preamble when expanded outside verbose mode
entries.zh: 修复了在详细模式之外扩展时显示内部来源前导码的子代理返还消息

entries.en: Fixed `installed_plugins.json` keeping the install-time commit after updating a plugin from a GitHub repository or git URL that tracks a branch or tag
entries.zh: 修复了`installed_plugins.json`在从跟踪分支或标签的 GitHub 存储库或 git URL 更新插件后保持安装时提交的问题

entries.en: Fixed skills in `~/.claude/skills/` being moved to `~/.claude/skills/.trash/` when a `manifest.json` in that folder listed their names
entries.zh: 修复了当该文件夹中的`manifest.json`列出其名称时，`~/.claude/skills/`中的技能被移动到`~/.claude/skills/.trash/`的问题

entries.en: Fixed the session feedback survey showing no hover highlight on light and ANSI themes
entries.zh: 修复浅色和 ANSI 主题下，会话反馈调查没有悬停高亮的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/workflows` briefly showing a one-row list before opening the only run
entries.zh: 修复了`/workflows`在打开唯一运行之前短暂显示单行列表的问题

entries.en: Fixed the mouse wheel not scrolling selection lists with hidden options (such as `/model` and `/permissions`) in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下鼠标滚轮无法滚动带隐藏选项的选择列表（如 `/model` 和 `/permissions`）的问题

entries.en: Fixed a skill you switched off showing the same red ✘ as a plugin that failed to load in `/plugin` and `/skills`; off now shows a dim ◯
entries.zh: 修复了您关闭的技能显示与无法在`/plugin`和`/skills`中加载的插件相同的红色✘的问题；关闭现在显示暗淡 ◯

entries.en: Fixed multi-select option descriptions being indented under the option number instead of under the label
entries.zh: 修复了多选选项描述在选项编号下方而不是在标签下方缩进的问题

entries.en: Fixed the search box in `/plugin`, `/skills` and `/mcp` losing its right border in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下，`/plugin`、`/skills` 和 `/mcp` 中的搜索框丢失右边框的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` showing △ in the server list but ⚠ in the detail view for the same server; the list, detail views and `/plugin` now all show ⚠
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`在服务器列表中显示 △ 但在同一服务器的详细视图中显示 ⚠ 的问题；列表、详细视图和 `/plugin` 现在全部显示 ⚠

entries.en: Fixed Home and End doing nothing in the `/config` settings list and in selection lists such as `/model`, `/memory` and permission prompts
entries.zh: 修复了 Home 和 End 在 `/config` 设置列表和选择列表（例如 `/model`、`/memory` 和权限提示）中不执行任何操作的问题

entries.en: Fixed PgUp/PgDn in the `/skills` menu wrapping past the first or last skill instead of stopping there
entries.zh: 修复了`/skills`菜单中的 PgUp/PgDn 绕过第一个或最后一个技能而不是停在那里的问题

entries.en: Fixed Tab silently changing the selected setting's value in the `/config` list; it now does nothing there
entries.zh: 修复了 Tab 默默地更改`/config`列表中所选设置的值的问题；现在它什么也不做

entries.en: Fixed conversations failing on every turn with a "role 'system' must precede an 'assistant' message" API error
entries.zh: 修复了对话每次失败并出现“角色‘系统’必须在‘助理’消息之前”API 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed conversations with the advisor on failing every turn with API Error 400 "Input tag 'advisor_20260301'" behind a proxy or gateway that doesn't support it; the request now retries without it
entries.zh: 修复了在不支持的代理或网关后面出现 API 错误 400“输入标签‘advisor_20260301’”时与顾问的对话每轮失败的问题；现在，请求将在没有它的情况下重试

entries.en: Fixed a session failing on every turn and `/compact` when its saved history held a malformed notice about MCP tools that could not be loaded
entries.zh: 修复了当保存的历史记录包含有关无法加载 MCP 工具的格式错误的通知时，会话每次都会失败以及`/compact`的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash when resuming a session whose saved transcript holds a malformed system message or a memory-saved notice without its file list
entries.zh: 修复了恢复保存的记录包含格式错误的系统消息或没有文件列表的内存保存通知的会话时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed one cause of long-running fullscreen sessions exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error": a damaged cached message list is now rebuilt
entries.zh: 修复了长时间运行的全屏会话退出时出现“无法恢复的界面错误后克劳德代码退出”的一个原因：现在重建了损坏的缓存消息列表

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code hanging when a settings file, or a file it re-reads after an edit, is replaced by a named pipe mid-read
entries.zh: 修复了当设置文件或编辑后重新读取的文件被读取中的命名管道替换时克劳德代码挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/config` crashing and some on/off preferences being misread when a preference that has moved to `settings.json` still holds a value like `null` or `"false"` in `~/.claude.json`
entries.zh: 修复了当已移至`settings.json`的首选项在`~/.claude.json`中仍保留`null`或“false”等值时，`/config`崩溃以及一些开/关首选项被误读的问题

entries.en: Fixed resuming a session with unfinished background agents, shells or workflows starting a model turn on its own before you typed anything
entries.zh: 修复了在您输入任何内容之前恢复未完成的后台代理、shell 或工作流程的会话，启动模型自行打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed messages sent to a background subagent being silently lost in headless and SDK sessions when the subagent was finishing its turn
entries.zh: 修复了当子代理完成轮流时发送到后台子代理的消息在无头和 SDK 会话中默默丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a finished subagent's report being lost when the conversation that launched it was compacted before the report was read
entries.zh: 修复了在读取报告之前压缩启动子代理的对话时已完成的子代理报告丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed background subagents being unable to use the LSP tool when an LSP plugin is active
entries.zh: 修复了当 LSP 插件处于活动状态时后台子代理无法使用 LSP 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed background shell tasks reporting benign non-zero exits (e.g. grep with no matches) as failures
entries.zh: 修复了后台 shell 任务将良性非零退出（例如 grep 没有匹配项）报告为失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions (`claude --bg`) being unable to run git, hooks, plugins and other helper programs when an environment variable handed to the session contained a NUL character
entries.zh: 修复了当传递给会话的环境变量包含 NUL 字符时后台会话 (`claude --bg`) 无法运行 git、hooks、插件和其他帮助程序的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C needing three or four presses to exit while background subagents are running; two presses now exit
entries.zh: 修复了后台子代理运行时 Ctrl+C 需要按三到四次才能退出的问题；现在按两下退出

entries.en: Fixed IDE selection being dropped when a sent prompt comes back into the input, such as pressing Esc to edit it, rewinding to it, or pressing Esc while startup hooks run
entries.zh: 修复了当发送的提示返回输入时，IDE 选择被删除的问题，例如按 Esc 对其进行编辑、倒回至它，或在启动挂钩运行时按 Esc

entries.en: Fixed a `!` shell-mode prompt stashed with Ctrl+S coming back as a plain prompt when restored, and `/` listing file paths right after stashing one
entries.zh: 修复了`!` shell 模式提示符，在恢复时使用 Ctrl+S 作为普通提示符返回，并且`/`在隐藏后立即列出文件路径

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` showing a blank, unresponsive screen instead of an error when the temp directory is full, not writable or owned by another user
entries.zh: 修复了当临时目录已满、不可写或由其他用户拥有时“claude Agents”显示空白、无响应的屏幕而不是错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed an MCP server re-added under the same name after `claude mcp remove` still showing as needing authentication instead of reconnecting
entries.zh: 修复了`claude mcp remove`后以相同名称重新添加的 MCP 服务器仍显示为需要身份验证而不是重新连接

entries.en: Fixed background plugin marketplace auto-update ignoring git credential helpers, so private-repo marketplaces were re-cloned every run or never updated
entries.zh: 修复了后台插件市场自动更新忽略 git 凭证助手的问题，因此私人回购市场每次运行都会重新克隆或从未更新

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin update` clearing a plugin's recorded commit and moving it to version "unknown" when the official marketplace's snapshot file is a link or too large
entries.zh: 修复了当官方市场的快照文件是链接或太大时“claude插件更新”清除插件记录的提交并将其移动到“未知”版本的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool silently disappearing when your organization's policy can't be loaded (for example behind a web proxy); Claude now says what's blocking it
entries.zh: 修复了当您的组织的策略无法加载时（例如在 Web 代理后面），Artifact 工具会默默消失的问题；克劳德现在说出了阻碍它的因素

entries.en: Fixed artifact republishes silently resetting stored database access rules or dropping the viewer profile scope when that capability was re-sent without them; they are now refused
entries.zh: 修复了工件重新发布时静默重置存储的数据库访问规则或在没有这些功能的情况下重新发送该功能时删除查看器配置文件范围的问题；他们现在被拒绝了

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` reporting a stopped cloud review as completed or as an error to retry, and waiting out the full timeout when its session was deleted or the signed-in account changed
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`将已停止的云审核报告为已完成或重试错误，并在其会话被删除或登录帐户更改时等待完全超时的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Claude app showing a missing or stale context usage figure for Remote Control and cloud sessions right after /compact or /clear
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德应用程序在 /compact 或 /clear 之后显示远程控制和云会话的上下文使用情况缺失或过时的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Claude app's diff view for Remote Control and cloud sessions dropping a branch's committed files whenever there are also uncommitted changes
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德应用程序的远程控制和云会话的差异视图，只要还有未提交的更改，就会删除分支的已提交文件

entries.en: Fixed cloud and self-hosted runner sessions failing with "Authentication failed" after waiting out a long overload during which the session's access token was rotated
entries.zh: 修复了云和自托管运行器会话在等待长时间过载（在此期间轮换会话的访问令牌）后失败并显示“身份验证失败”的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory write conflicts in Cowork sessions showing Claude only the start and end of a memory file over about 10,800 characters, so the retried write dropped the middle
entries.zh: 修复了 Cowork 会话中的内存写入冲突，显示 Claude 仅包含约 10,800 个字符的内存文件的开头和结尾，因此重试的写入会落在中间

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed lifecycle-hook commits failing to sign under `--configure-git`
entries.zh: 修复了 `--configure-git` 下生命周期钩子的提交签名失败的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed background cleanup deleting a directory symlink or junction used to relocate `~/.claude/session-env`, `image-cache` or another cleaned-up folder
entries.zh: Windows：修复了后台清理会删除用于迁移 `~/.claude/session-env`、`image-cache` 或其他被清理文件夹的目录符号链接或联接点的问题

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a turn that ended right at a `--retire-at` release losing its finished signal; the runner now briefly waits for the turn to be reported before stopping the session
entries.zh: 修复了在 `--retire-at` 释放时刚好结束的一轮对话丢失完成信号的问题；运行器现在会先短暂等待该轮对话上报，再停止会话

entries.en: Reverted `ctrl+l` / `cmd+k` in fullscreen mode clearing the transcript view (added in 2.1.260); they redraw the screen again
entries.zh: 撤销了 2.1.260 中加入的变更：全屏模式下 `ctrl+l` / `cmd+k` 不再清空对话视图，它们恢复为重新绘制屏幕

entries.en: Improved `/permissions`: focus returns to the rule list after viewing, adding or deleting a rule, and the delete-rule and remove-directory confirmations now default to No
entries.zh: 改进 `/permissions`：查看、添加或删除规则后，焦点回到规则列表；删除规则和移除目录的确认默认选“否”

entries.en: Improved `/permissions` tab navigation: ←/→ and Tab pressed in a rule list now switch tabs without moving focus to the tab bar
entries.zh: 改进 `/permissions` 标签切换：在规则列表中按 ←/→ 或 Tab，可直接切换标签页，不必把焦点移到标签栏

entries.en: Improved `/cost` cache-miss causes to name thinking mode and thinking display changes
entries.zh: 改进 `/cost` 的缓存未命中原因说明：会指出 thinking 模式和 thinking 显示方式的变化

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool so that when Claude cannot read an artifact link it was given, it tells the user before continuing
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具：Claude 无法读取所给的 Artifact 链接时，会在继续之前先告诉用户

entries.en: Improved `/install-github-app`: the GitHub CLI check and repository selection steps now show "Esc to cancel"
entries.zh: 改进 `/install-github-app`：GitHub CLI 检查和仓库选择步骤现在显示“Esc to cancel”

entries.en: Improved the `/artifacts` and `/workflows` lists: a scrollbar at the right edge shows how much of a long list is hidden and where you are in it
entries.zh: 改进 `/artifacts` 和 `/workflows` 列表：右侧滚动条会显示长列表中被隐藏的部分有多少，以及你当前所在的位置

entries.en: Improved the workflow progress tree: running agents and phases now show a dim dot instead of ⟳
entries.zh: 改进工作流进度树：运行中的智能体和阶段现在显示暗色圆点，不再用 ⟳

entries.en: Improved `/plugin`'s Add Marketplace form in fullscreen: it no longer draws a box inside the pane, and its text and key hints line up with the rest of `/plugin`
entries.zh: 改进全屏模式下 `/plugin` 的“添加市场”表单：不再在面板内画框，文字和按键提示与 `/plugin` 的其他部分对齐

entries.en: Improved the `/workflows` detail view in fullscreen: it no longer draws a second horizontal rule under the pane's divider
entries.zh: 改进全屏模式下的 `/workflows` 详情视图：不再在窗格分隔线下方多画一条横线

entries.en: Improved code blocks that don't name a language: they are now colored like inline code, so commands stand out from the surrounding text
entries.zh: 改进未注明语言的代码块：与行内代码一样着色，命令能从周围的文字中凸显出来

entries.en: Improved `/btw` asked while a tool is still running: the side question now knows that call is in progress instead of reading it as a failed one
entries.zh: 改进 `/btw`：工具仍在运行时提出的侧边问题，会知道该调用仍在进行中，而不会把它当成失败

entries.en: Improved the UserPromptSubmit hook timeout notice and the debug log to name which hook command timed out
entries.zh: 改进 UserPromptSubmit hook 超时提示和调试日志：会写出是哪条 hook 命令超时

entries.en: Improved `@` file suggestions: a file whose name contains the query now ranks above one that only matches across its folder names
entries.zh: 改进 `@` 文件建议：文件名包含查询词的，排在只在文件夹名中匹配的前面

entries.en: Improved artifact pages: no Print buttons, confirm dialogs or device features the viewer blocks, email and phone details shown as text, and dark mode that reaches form controls and scrollbars
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 页面：去掉打印按钮、确认对话框以及查看者屏蔽的设备功能；邮箱和电话以文字显示；暗色模式覆盖表单控件和滚动条

entries.en: Improved `/ultrareview` uploads: renamed copies of key files, such as `id_rsa copy` or `kubeconfig (1).yaml`, now also stay on your machine
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview` 上传：`id_rsa copy`、`kubeconfig (1).yaml` 等重命名的关键文件副本，也会留在你的电脑上，不会上传

entries.en: Improved the cross-session messaging startup warning to explain that `--debug-file` writes a debug log to a path you choose
entries.zh: 改进跨会话消息的启动警告：说明 `--debug-file` 会把调试日志写入你指定的路径

entries.en: Changed the default model on Pro and Team Standard plans from Sonnet to Opus, matching Max, Team Premium, and Enterprise
entries.zh: 将 Pro 和 Team Standard 计划的默认模型从 Sonnet 更改为 Opus，匹配 Max、Team Premium 和 Enterprise

entries.en: Changed an effort level saved before `/effort` became per-model to no longer apply to newly released models such as Opus 5.5; they start at their default until you pick a level
entries.zh: 更改了`/effort`成为每个模型之前保存的工作级别，不再适用于新发布的模型，例如 Opus 5.5；它们从默认值开始，直到您选择一个级别

entries.en: Changed Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 to stop holding their launch-default effort over `/effort` in `-p` or the Agent SDK, a project, managed or `--settings` `effortLevel`, or a per-model level
entries.zh: 更改了 Opus 4.7、Opus 4.8 和 Fable 5，以停止在`-p`或 Agent SDK、项目、托管或`--settings`、`effortLevel`或每个模型级别中的`/effort`上保留其启动默认工作量

entries.en: Changed `/autocompact`'s footer hint to name ←/→, the keys that adjust other ordered values
entries.zh: 将 `/autocompact` 的页脚提示更改为 ←/→，调整其他有序值的键

entries.en: Changed `/fast`'s footer to name Space as the toggle key
entries.zh: 更改了`/fast`的页脚以命名 Space 作为切换键

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed git in lifecycle hooks to ignore hook folders and programs named in the runner's shared git files; local-path and `git://` remotes there now need `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`
entries.zh: 生命周期钩子中的 git 现在会忽略运行器共享 git 文件中指定的钩子目录和程序；这些位置的本地路径和 `git://` 远程仓库需要设置 `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`

entries.en: Changed plugin marketplaces whose name imitates a reserved marketplace name to be refused when added, and to stop loading if one was already added
entries.zh: 更改了名称模仿保留市场名称的插件市场，添加时将被拒绝，如果已添加则停止加载

entries.en: Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks: an agent-type hook no longer runs there, since its answer could never allow or deny the request; it now shows an error pointing to command or http hooks
entries.zh: 更改了`PermissionRequest`挂钩：代理类型挂钩不再在那里运行，因为它的答案永远不会允许或拒绝该请求；现在显示指向命令或 http 挂钩的错误

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Status dialog, with a typed `/status`, showing the session's version, account, model and server details
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增 Status 对话框，可输入 `/status` 打开，显示会话的版本、账户、模型和服务器信息

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Sandbox dialog for the sandbox mode, the unsandboxed fallback and excluded commands, opened from the panel menu or by typing `/sandbox`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增沙盒对话框，用于设置沙盒模式、非沙盒回退和排除的命令，可从面板菜单打开，或输入 `/sandbox`

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Claude in Chrome dialog (extension status, the install, reconnect and permissions pages, the enabled-by-default setting), opened from the panel menu or by typing `/chrome`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增 Claude in Chrome 对话框（显示扩展状态、安装、重新连接和权限页面，以及默认启用设置），可从面板菜单打开，或输入 `/chrome`

entries.en: [VSCode] Added Export conversation, with a typed `/export`, to copy or save the conversation as plain text
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增「Export conversation」，也可输入 `/export`，将对话复制或保存为纯文本

entries.en: [VSCode] Added each skill's source, token estimate and on/off state to the Slash commands dialog, with a click to change the state, and a typed `/skills` that opens it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 斜杠命令对话框中显示每个技能的来源、token 估算和开关状态，点击即可切换；输入 `/skills` 即可打开

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a typed `/plan` that switches to plan mode, sends a first planning prompt, or shows the session's plan
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增 `/plan` 命令，可切换到计划模式、发送第一条规划提示，或显示当前会话的计划

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved pasted-text handling in the chat box: a paste over 800 characters or over 2 line breaks is now marked so Claude can tell it from what you typed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进聊天框的粘贴文本处理：超过 800 个字符或超过 2 个换行的粘贴内容会被标记，以便 Claude 与你的输入区分开

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved prompt handling in the chat box: invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters are removed from pasted text with a notice, and from anything else before it is sent
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进聊天框的提示词处理：粘贴内容中不可见的 Unicode 格式字符和标签字符会被移除并给出提示；发送前的其他内容也会做同样处理

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed "Open in New Tab" to open Claude beside the editor group you are working in rather than after the last group
entries.zh: [VSCode] 「Open in New Tab」改为在你正在编辑的编辑器分组旁打开 Claude，而不是放在最后一个分组之后

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the effort chip showing a stale saved effort level instead of the level the session runs at
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 effort 标签显示过时的已保存 effort 级别、而不是会话实际运行级别的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Claude Code never starting when the Python extension hangs while activating; it now starts after 60 seconds without the Python environment
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Python 扩展在激活时卡死导致 Claude Code 永远无法启动的问题；现在若 60 秒内仍未获取到 Python 环境，会继续启动

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the plan approval card never offering auto mode: when auto mode is available, its first option is now "Yes, and use auto mode", as in the terminal
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复计划审批卡片从不提供 auto 模式的问题：在可用时，第一个选项现在为 "Yes, and use auto mode"，与终端一致

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed arrow-key navigation in the session list stopping after archiving or unarchiving a session from the keyboard
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复用键盘归档或取消归档会话后，会话列表中的方向键导航失效的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed paste marker lines showing in your own messages after reopening a session
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新打开会话后，粘贴标记行出现在你自己的消息中的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the admin Routines on/off setting to live under Admin settings → Capabilities → Remote sessions; the Claude Code admin page now links to it
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 管理员的 Routines 开关移到「Admin settings → Capabilities → Remote sessions」下；Claude Code 管理页面现在会链接到那里

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls inside a cloud session on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository failing after about eight hours; the token now renews automatically
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复云端会话中对 GitHub Enterprise Server 仓库执行 `gh` 和 GitHub API 调用时，约八小时后失败的问题；令牌现在会自动续期

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed a routine that resumes an existing session running with its old prompt and name when it was edited moments before the scheduled run started
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复例程恢复已有会话时，若在定时运行开始前刚编辑过，仍使用旧提示和旧名称运行的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed file links in a cloud session transcript that point outside the session's working directory opening a file card that never loads; they're now disabled and say why
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 云端会话记录中指向会话工作目录之外的文件链接，原来打开的文件卡片永远加载不出来；现在这些链接会被禁用，并说明原因

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed auto mode refusing to retry a tool call because an approval prompt that expired unanswered, or was superseded by a newer message, had been recorded as your rejection
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复自动模式拒绝重试工具调用的问题：过期未回应的批准提示，或被新消息取代的批准提示，曾被记录为你的拒绝

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved cloud sessions viewed in the Claude app: Claude now saves files meant for you where the app can open them
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 改进在 Claude 应用中查看云端会话的体验：Claude 现在会把需要交给你的文件保存到应用可以打开的位置

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Removed the empty repository picker shown when starting a session on a self-hosted environment in an organization where an admin has turned GitHub off
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 移除了在管理员关闭 GitHub 的组织中，使用自托管环境启动会话时显示的空仓库选择器

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added Slack's native Working indicator, Stop button and thread title to Claude's threads in channels; the indicator stays up until Claude finishes, and Stop interrupts the task
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude 在频道中的话题新增 Slack 原生的「Working」指示器、停止按钮和话题标题；指示器会一直显示到 Claude 完成，点击停止即可中断任务

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a short notice in the Slack channel when a guest joining, or the last guest leaving, changes how Claude responds there under a Restrict or Channel only guest setting
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 当有访客加入，或最后一位访客离开，并因此改变 Claude 在该频道中的回复方式（Restrict 或 Channel only 访客设置）时，Slack 频道中会出现简短通知

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled routines silently failing to run in Slack workspaces that were connected to Claude before the workspace joined its Enterprise Grid
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在加入 Enterprise Grid 之前就已连接 Claude 的 Slack 工作区中，定时例程悄悄无法运行的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude asking you to re-upload a Slack file when a brief file-scanning outage, not the file, was the problem; it now retries the scan and is told when the scanner is down
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 文件扫描服务短暂故障（而非文件本身有问题）时，Claude 要求你重新上传文件的问题；现在它会重试扫描，并在扫描器故障时告知你

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a bullet in Claude's Slack reply whose text starts with +, - or * rendering as an empty bullet with a stray nested item; it now shows as one bullet with the character kept
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 的 Slack 回复中，以 +、- 或 * 开头的项目符号显示为空条目并带有多余嵌套项的问题；现在会显示为一个项目符号并保留该字符

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the Slack notice for a failed cloud environment setup script sometimes being a generic "mention me to retry"; it now names the setup script and says to fix it first
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复云端环境设置脚本失败时，Slack 通知有时只是笼统的「mention me to retry」的问题；现在会指明设置脚本，并提示先修复

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the GitHub banner in Claude Tag admin settings to say why GitHub isn't connected: not signed in, app not linked or not installed, sign-in expired, or SSO not authorized
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude Tag 管理设置中的 GitHub 横幅，说明 GitHub 未连接的原因：未登录、应用未关联或未安装、登录已过期，或未授权 SSO

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved the Code Review check run to say when REVIEW.md instructions were cut or left out of a review for exceeding a size limit, naming the file and the limit
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进 Code Review 检查运行：当 REVIEW.md 指令因超过大小限制而被截断或未用于审查时，会指出文件名和限制值

entries.en: Changed auto mode for Claude API and Enterprise users, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways, to default to the server-side classifier, which does not charge for classifier overhead (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways); warns on billed fallback. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude API 和 Enterprise 用户以及 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和网关上的自动模式，默认为服务器端分类器，该分类器不收取分类器开销（`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0`在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和网关上选择退出）；警告计费回退。请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing

entries.en: Added an `Auto mode server` row to `/status` showing whether this session's auto mode classifier runs on the server
entries.zh: 在`/status`中添加了“自动模式服务器”行，显示此会话的自动模式分类器是否在服务器上运行

entries.en: Added AGENTS.md support: in a project with no CLAUDE.md, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md instead; change it under "Project instructions" in `/config`
entries.zh: 添加了 AGENTS.md 支持：在没有 CLAUDE.md 的项目中，Claude Code 改为读取 AGENTS.md；在`/config`中的“项目说明”下更改它

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_PROXY_IS_EGRESS_BOUNDARY=1` for Claude apps gateways whose only egress is a forward proxy: every outbound request hands the proxy the hostname instead of resolving it locally
entries.zh: 为唯一出口是转发代理的 Claude 应用程序网关添加了`CLAUDE_GATEWAY_PROXY_IS_EGRESS_BOUNDARY=1`：每个出站请求都会将主机名交给代理，而不是在本地解析它

entries.en: Added an optional `headers:` map on Claude apps gateway upstreams, to send static headers to a proxy you run in front of a provider
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用程序网关上游添加了可选的`headers:`映射，以将静态标头发送到您在提供商面前运行的代理

entries.en: Added a line saying a background task's update is waiting when it finishes while a panel such as `/tasks` is open
entries.zh: 添加了一行，表示当`/tasks`等面板打开时，后台任务的更新正在等待完成

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions that could hang with no result after an internal error; they now report the error and exit with code 1
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`和 Agent SDK 会话在内部错误后可能挂起且没有任何结果的问题；他们现在报告错误并以代码 1 退出

entries.en: Fixed conversations failing every request with "text content blocks must be non-empty" when an earlier assistant turn held an empty text block beside other content, including after `--resume`
entries.zh: 修复了当先前的助理在其他内容旁边持有空文本块时（包括在`--resume`之后），每个请求都失败的问题，并显示“文本内容块必须非空”

entries.en: Fixed being unexpectedly logged out when an older Claude Code build (for example an IDE extension's bundled CLI) runs on the same machine as the current one
entries.zh: 修复了当较旧的 Claude Code 版本（例如 IDE 扩展的捆绑 CLI）与当前计算机在同一台计算机上运行时意外注销的问题

entries.en: Fixed interactive start-up hanging or showing an error for `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` users when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed `customApiKeyResponses` value
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude.json`包含格式错误的`customApiKeyResponses`值时，交互式启动挂起或显示`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`用户错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed update checks erroring every 30 minutes, and `claude update` hanging when a minimum or maximum version is set, if a proxy returns an invalid version; a malformed `minimumVersion` is now ignored
entries.zh: 修复代理返回无效版本时，更新检查每 30 分钟报错、设置了最低或最高版本时 `claude update` 挂起的问题；格式错误的 `minimumVersion` 现在会被忽略

entries.en: Fixed `claude update` on winget- or apk-managed installs reporting "up to date" when the version lookup failed
entries.zh: 修复了 winget 或 apk 管理的安装上的`claude update`在版本查找失败时报告“最新”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin install` sometimes failing and breaking the installed copy when reinstalling a plugin version that a session or another program was using; an unchanged copy is now left alone
entries.zh: 修复了重新安装会话或其他程序正在使用的插件版本时，“claude 插件安装”有时会失败并破坏已安装副本的问题；未更改的副本现在被保留

entries.en: Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search could not start because the system was out of processes, memory or file handles; they now return an error saying so
entries.zh: 修复了当由于系统进程、内存或文件句柄不足而无法启动搜索时，Grep 和 Glob 报告没有匹配项的问题；他们现在返回一个错误，这样说

entries.en: Fixed the Write tool silently ending the turn as a declined permission when the target path is an existing directory; it now reports a clear error
entries.zh: 修复 Write 工具在目标路径是已存在的目录时，静默地以被拒绝的权限结束回合的问题；现在会给出明确错误

entries.en: Fixed the Edit tool treating an escaped backslash followed by `uXXXX` text as a `\uXXXX` escape, which could make an edit of a non-ASCII character rewrite an escaped backslash sequence instead
entries.zh: 修复 Edit 工具把转义的反斜杠后跟 `uXXXX` 文本误当作 `\uXXXX` 转义的问题，此问题可能导致编辑非 ASCII 字符时错误改写转义的反斜杠序列

entries.en: Fixed the Edit tool reporting "Invalid regular expression: regular expression too large" instead of "String not found in file" when a very large edit containing non-ASCII text did not match the file
entries.zh: 修复 Edit 工具在非 ASCII 文本的超大编辑未能匹配文件时，报告"Invalid regular expression: regular expression too large"而非"String not found in file"的问题

entries.en: Fixed a turn ending early with "Path contains null bytes" when a tool call's file path contained `\u0000` written as an escape sequence; escaped control characters now stay as literal text
entries.zh: 修复了当工具调用的文件路径包含写为转义序列的`\u0000`时，回合以“路径包含空字节”提前结束的问题；转义控制字符现在保留为文字文本

entries.en: Fixed background sessions (`claude --bg`) exiting when a plugin's LSP server exited or closed its stdin
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的 LSP 服务器退出或关闭其标准输入时后台会话 (`claude --bg`) 退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash ("Type error") when opening `/mcp` or `/plugin manage` with a malformed `claudeAiMcpEverConnected` value in `~/.claude.json`
entries.zh: 修复了在`~/.claude.json`中使用格式错误的`claudeAiMcpEverConnected`值打开`/mcp`或`/plugin manage`时发生的崩溃（“类型错误”）

entries.en: Fixed a crash at launch when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed `theme` value
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude.json`包含格式错误的`theme`值时启动时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed a crash ("unrecoverable interface error") when the prompt held text containing terminal color codes, for example a prompt recalled from history or text loaded from the external editor
entries.zh: 修复了当提示包含包含终端颜色代码的文本时发生的崩溃（“不可恢复的界面错误”），例如从历史记录中调用的提示或从外部编辑器加载的文本

entries.en: Fixed a crash when resuming a session whose saved history holds an assistant message stored as a plain string
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话时发生的崩溃，该会话的保存历史记录包含以纯字符串形式存储的助理消息

entries.en: Fixed sessions on slow or heavily loaded machines sometimes exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" when the first spinner appeared
entries.zh: 修复了当第一个微调器出现时，缓慢或负载过重的计算机上的会话有时会退出并显示“无法恢复的接口错误后克劳德代码退出”的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare case where the screen could stop updating for the rest of the session after an internal rendering error
entries.zh: 修复了一种罕见的情况，即在内部渲染错误后屏幕可能会在会话的其余部分停止更新

entries.en: Fixed a rare case on Windows where a turn could stop with an error such as "Out of memory" right after Claude replied, so that reply's tool calls never ran
entries.zh: 修复 Windows 上的罕见情况：Claude 回复后，回合可能因"Out of memory"等错误停止，导致该回复中的工具调用未能执行的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions continued after `/clear` (restart, `--continue`, `--resume`) missing part of their first message when a SessionStart hook printed output, causing a full prompt-cache miss
entries.zh: 修复了会话在 SessionStart 挂钩打印输出时在`/clear`（重新启动、`--continue`、`--resume`）后继续丢失第一条消息的部分，导致完整的提示缓存缺失

entries.en: Fixed messages from other agents (such as a subagent's SendMessage) that arrived mid-turn showing up below the "Ran N shell commands" row instead of where they arrived
entries.zh: 修复了来自其他代理（例如子代理的 SendMessage）的中途到达的消息显示在“Ran N shell 命令”行下方，而不是它们到达的位置

entries.en: Fixed the "copied" notice not appearing after drag-selecting text in the fullscreen `/resume` picker and other panels that cover the prompt area
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏`/resume`选择器和覆盖提示区域的其他面板中拖动选择文本后不出现“已复制”通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed `$TMPDIR` expanding empty in Bash commands that run outside the sandbox while sandboxing is enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用沙箱时在沙箱外部运行的 Bash 命令中的`$TMPDIR`扩展为空的问题

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch and WebSearch in Cowork cloud sessions not telling Claude why a request was refused, such as a used-up fetch budget or an admin policy
entries.zh: 修复了 Cowork 云会话中的 WebFetch 和 WebSearch 不告诉 Claude 请求被拒绝的原因，例如用完的获取预算或管理策略

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway's telemetry relay ignoring a collector hostname or domain listed in `NO_PROXY` when a proxy is set
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 应用网关的遥测转发在设置了代理时忽略 `NO_PROXY` 中列出的收集器主机名或域名的问题

entries.en: Fixed one malformed `strictKnownMarketplaces` or `blockedMarketplaces` entry silently disabling the whole enterprise marketplace policy
entries.zh: 修复了一个格式错误的`strictKnownMarketplaces`或`blockedMarketplaces`条目会默默地禁用整个企业市场策略

entries.en: Fixed failed auto-updates leaving large staged downloads behind in `~/.cache/claude/staging`
entries.zh: 修复了失败的自动更新，在`~/.cache/claude/staging`中留下大量分阶段下载

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` not stripping terminal control characters from messages on the Installed tab, such as the error of a failed plugin update
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`不从“已安装”选项卡上的消息中剥离终端控制字符的问题，例如插件更新失败的错误

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` → Installed and `/skills` crashing when a skill or legacy command is named like a built-in Object property such as `constructor` or `toString`
entries.zh: 修复了当技能或旧命令被命名为内置对象属性（例如`constructor`或`toString`）时，`/plugin`→“已安装”和`/skills`崩溃

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` closing with no message when every install in a multi-select failed
entries.zh: 修复了当多选中的每个安装失败时`/plugin`关闭时没有消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed uninstalled plugins reappearing as "failed to load" rows in `/plugin` Installed, and Remove not clearing such a row
entries.zh: 修复已卸载的插件在 `/plugin` 已安装列表中以"failed to load"行重新出现，且点击移除也无法清除该行的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugins from the official marketplace being recorded without their commit in `installed_plugins.json`, and `installed_plugins.json` keeping the old commit after updating a pinned-commit plugin
entries.zh: 修复了来自官方市场的插件在未提交到`installed_plugins.json`的情况下被记录的问题，以及`installed_plugins.json`在更新固定提交插件后保留旧提交的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin reload previews keeping every previewed copy of a plugin archive unpacked until exit, and overwriting the cached `--plugin-url` archive a reload falls back to when its download fails
entries.zh: 修复了插件重新加载预览，使插件存档的每个预览副本都处于解压状态，直到退出，并覆盖缓存的`--plugin-url`存档，重新加载会在下载失败时回退到该位置

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control session bookkeeping failing when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed placeholder record
entries.zh: 修复了`~/.claude.json`保存格式错误的占位符记录时远程控制会话簿记失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed the error after a revoked claude.ai login blaming an expired Anthropic profile; it now leads with `/login`
entries.zh: 修复 claude.ai 登录被撤销后的错误提示归咎于 Anthropic 配置过期的问题；现在提示会首先建议执行 `/login`

entries.en: Fixed typed or pasted text occasionally coming out scrambled in the `claude agents` dispatch input during key repeat or very fast input
entries.zh: 修复快速输入或按键重复时，`claude agents` 派发输入框中输入或粘贴的文字偶尔错乱的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash ("unrecoverable interface error") when resuming a session whose saved transcript contains a stop hook summary without a well-formed hook list
entries.zh: 修复了恢复保存的记录包含停止钩子摘要而没有格式良好的钩子列表的会话时发生的崩溃（“不可恢复的接口错误”）

entries.en: Fixed Enter on a selected agent panel row doing nothing when `keybindings.json` rebinds Enter in the Chat context, for example to `chat:queueSubmit`
entries.zh: 修复了当`keybindings.json`在聊天上下文中重新绑定 Enter 时，选定代理面板行上的 Enter 不执行任何操作，例如`chat:queueSubmit`

entries.en: Fixed PDF page reads on Windows failing when the working folder's path is long (about 120 characters or more)
entries.zh: 修复了当工作文件夹的路径较长（大约 120 个字符或更多）时在 Windows 上读取 PDF 页面失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed a headless resume (`claude -p --resume`, the SDK, a VS Code extension window reload) starting the session's cost and usage totals at zero; headless sessions now save their totals at exit
entries.zh: 修复了无头恢复（`claude -p --resume`、SDK、VS Code 扩展窗口重新加载），使会话的成本和使用总计为零；无头会话现在在退出时保存总数

entries.en: Fixed project skills from the main repository not loading in `--worktree` sessions when `.claude/skills` is untracked
entries.zh: 修复了当`.claude/skills`未跟踪时主存储库中的项目技能未加载到`--worktree`会话中的问题

entries.en: Fixed a `sandbox.excludedCommands` glob exempting an entire compound Bash command from the sandbox when only one part matched; every part must now match
entries.zh: 修复了`sandbox.excludedCommands`全局变量，当只有一部分匹配时，该全局变量将整个复合 Bash 命令从沙箱中排除；现在每个部分都必须匹配

entries.en: Fixed resumed subagents and teammates re-rendering the MCP tool definitions they had loaded, which broke prompt caching for that agent
entries.zh: 修复了恢复的子代理和队友重新渲染他们已加载的 MCP 工具定义，这会破坏该代理的提示缓存

entries.en: Fixed rate-limited artifact publishes telling Claude to stop retrying; Claude is now told nothing was published and when to send the same publish again
entries.zh: 修复了速率限制的工件发布告诉克劳德停止重试的问题；克劳德现在被告知没有发布任何内容以及何时再次发送相同的发布内容

entries.en: Fixed attachments recorded earlier in a conversation being re-rendered after a resume or relaunch, which dropped extended thinking and missed the prompt cache
entries.zh: 修复了对话中先前记录的附件在恢复或重新启动后重新呈现的问题，这会导致扩展思考并错过提示缓存

entries.en: Fixed Console sign-in showing only "Request failed with status code 400" when the server refuses to create an API key; it now shows the server's message
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器拒绝创建 API 密钥时控制台登录仅显示“请求失败，状态代码 400”的问题；它现在显示服务器的消息

entries.en: Fixed messages typed while Claude is still working sometimes being ignored by the model
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德仍在工作时输入的消息有时会被模型忽略的问题

entries.en: Improved session start-up for SDK and headless (`-p`) use: the first turn no longer waits on the per-directory CLAUDE.md lookup
entries.zh: 改进 SDK 和无头（`-p`）使用时的启动：第一轮对话不再等待每个目录的 CLAUDE.md 查找

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's loopback error messages to name `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_ALLOW_LOOPBACK`
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关的本地回环报错信息：会指出应设置的 `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_ALLOW_LOOPBACK`

entries.en: Improved `/plugin` Installed: an MCP server listed apart from its plugin now shows which plugin it belongs to
entries.zh: 改进 `/plugin` 的 Installed 列表：与所属插件分开列出的 MCP 服务器，会显示它属于哪个插件

entries.en: Improved `claude plugin install` on an already-installed plugin: it now says when the marketplace offers a newer version and names the `claude plugin update` command
entries.zh: 改进 `claude plugin install`：插件已安装时，若市场有更新版本，会提示并给出 `claude plugin update` 命令

entries.en: Improved the startup notice overflow line under the logo: it now reads "N more notices hidden" instead of "+N more · /status"
entries.zh: 改进 logo 下方启动提示的溢出行：现在显示「N more notices hidden」，而不是「+N more · /status」

entries.en: Improved prompt handling: invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters in a prompt are removed and the cleaned prompt is shown for review before it is sent
entries.zh: 改进提示处理：提示中不可见的 Unicode 格式字符和标签字符会被删除，清理后的提示会先显示供检查，再发送

entries.en: Improved `/ultrareview` when there's nothing to review: messages say which case you're in, offer a command that reviews your latest commit, and a new repository's first commit is reviewed in full
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview` 无内容可评审的情况：提示会说明属于哪种情况，并给出评审最新提交的命令；新仓库的第一次提交会被完整评审

entries.en: Improved artifact link handling so Claude reads claude.ai artifact links with the Artifact tool instead of WebFetch when that tool is available
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 链接处理：Artifact 工具可用时，Claude 会用它读取 claude.ai 的 artifact 链接，而不是 WebFetch

entries.en: Improved the dangerous-rm permission prompt to name the flagged rm command and suggest a `${VAR:?}` guard, so headless runs can recover
entries.zh: 改进危险 rm 权限提示：会点明被标记的 rm 命令，并建议使用 `${VAR:?}` 保护写法，方便无头运行时恢复

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's permission prompts: shorter sentences, pages and artifacts named by title or file name, and links listed after the text
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具的权限提示：句子更短，页面和 Artifact 以标题或文件名称呈现，链接列在文字之后

entries.en: Changed Fable to always appear in `/model` on the Anthropic API; it is greyed out only when your organization's settings disable it
entries.zh: 将《寓言》更改为始终出现在 Anthropic API 上的`/model`中；仅当您的组织设置禁用它时，它才会显示为灰色

entries.en: Changed the Bash sandbox instructions on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to the first-party wording, which frames the sandbox as the boundary of what the task was given
entries.zh: 将 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上的 Bash 沙箱指令更改为第一方措辞，将沙箱框定为任务分配的边界

entries.en: Changed `/ultrareview` in non-interactive sessions to refuse when the repository has no base branch or shared history
entries.zh: 更改了非交互式会话中的`/ultrareview`，以在存储库没有基本分支或共享历史记录时拒绝

entries.en: Changed subagent results to reach the main agent under a header marking them as subagent output, with the result indented, so text in a subagent's result cannot pass as the session's own instructions
entries.zh: 更改了子代理结果以在标头下到达主代理，将其标记为子代理输出，结果缩进，因此子代理结果中的文本无法作为会话自己的指令传递

entries.en: Changed workflow scripts' computed `agent()` prompts on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to reach the subagent framed as script-authored text, so the safety classifier does not read them as the user
entries.zh: 更改了工作流程脚本在 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上的计算`agent()`提示，以到达作为脚本创作文本构建的子代理，因此安全分类器不会将它们作为用户读取

entries.en: Removed the background Haiku auto-title request from `claude -p` runs launched outside an SDK or IDE
entries.zh: 移除在 SDK 或 IDE 之外启动的 `claude -p` 运行中，后台自动发起的 Haiku 标题请求

entries.en: Removed the deprecated TaskOutput tool; Claude reads a background task's output file with Read instead, and the `taskOutputMaxChars` setting and `TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH` no longer have any effect
entries.zh: 移除已弃用的 TaskOutput 工具；Claude 改用 Read 读取后台任务的输出文件，`taskOutputMaxChars` 设置和 `TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH` 不再有任何作用

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Sign out row to the panel menu, with `/logout` in the typed command menu
entries.zh: [VSCode] 面板菜单新增 Sign out 选项，输入命令菜单中的 `/logout` 也可使用

entries.en: [VSCode] Added background shells and other running tasks to the agent map, each with a Stop, and a typed `/tasks` that opens it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 智能体地图新增后台 shell 和其他正在运行的任务，每项都带有 Stop 按钮；输入 `/tasks` 即可打开

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Copy response button on responses and a typed `/copy`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 回复上新增「Copy response」按钮，并支持输入 `/copy`

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a one-time notice when inactive sessions are archived automatically, and an "Unarchive all" action on the Archived sessions group
entries.zh: [VSCode] 不活跃会话被自动归档时，新增一次性通知；已归档会话分组新增「Unarchive all」操作

entries.en: [VSCode] Added the session's cost and token usage to the Account & usage dialog and the session manager where plan limits do not apply (Vertex, Bedrock, Foundry, API key)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 在不适用套餐限制的情况下（Vertex、Bedrock、Foundry、API 密钥），Account & usage 对话框和会话管理器中显示该会话的费用和 token 用量

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the "General config" menu row showing `/config` usage text instead of opening settings, and made typed `/mcp`, `/hooks`, `/memory`, `/rewind` and similar commands open their dialogs
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 "General config" 菜单项显示 `/config` 用法文字而不是打开设置的问题；并让输入 `/mcp`、`/hooks`、`/memory`、`/rewind` 等命令时打开对应对话框

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the effort slider's level not persisting into later sessions on a model that already had a level saved with `/effort`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复某模型已用 `/effort` 保存过级别时，effort 滑块的级别无法保存到之后的会话中的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Auto missing from the mode picker for conversations opened in an already-used panel when the saved model setting is a differently-cased alias such as "Sonnet"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在已使用过的面板中打开对话时，若保存的模型设置是大小写不同的别名（如 "Sonnet"），模式选择器里缺少 Auto 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `/fast` not saving fast mode as the default, so it was lost when the extension relaunched Claude Code
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 `/fast` 无法把快速模式保存为默认值，导致扩展重新启动 Claude Code 后设置丢失的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added Personal and Organization sections to the environment picker on Team and Enterprise plans, and admins can now share a personal environment with the organization
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 在 Team 和 Enterprise 套餐的环境选择器中新增「个人」和「组织」两个分区，管理员现在可以把个人环境共享给组织

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed organization environments to open as a read-only summary from the Code tab on Team and Enterprise plans, with editing under Admin settings → Cloud environments
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] Team 和 Enterprise 套餐中，组织环境改为从 Code 标签页以只读摘要打开；编辑请到「Admin settings → Cloud environments」

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed a cloud environment saved with Custom network access and no domains silently reverting to Trusted; the dialog now asks for at least one domain
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复云端环境以「Custom network access」保存但未填写域名时，会悄悄恢复为 Trusted 的问题；对话框现在会要求至少填写一个域名

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the admin Claude Code setting labeled "Web" to "Cloud sessions" and removed the redundant read-only Mobile row beneath it
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 管理员 Claude Code 设置中原来标为「Web」的项改名为「Cloud sessions」，并移除了其下多余的只读 Mobile 行

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed routines created in a Slack channel on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install failing to read other public channels in their workspace when they ran
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack Enterprise Grid 组织范围安装中，在某频道创建的例程运行时，无法读取所在工作区其他公开频道的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the "Learn more" links on credential presets in Claude Tag access bundles to open each vendor's credential-setup page instead of a generic API reference
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 访问包中凭据预设的「Learn more」链接，打开的是通用 API 参考而非各服务商凭据设置页面的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the Pylon credential preset in Claude Tag access bundles so admins can point it at Pylon's EU host
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修改 Claude Tag 访问包中的 Pylon 凭据预设，管理员可以将其指向 Pylon 的欧盟站点

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Google Cloud credential forms in Claude Tag access bundles: a refused key file now says why, the website and scopes stay locked, and a rejected rotation keeps the pasted key
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 访问包中的 Google Cloud 凭据表单：被拒绝的密钥文件现在会说明原因，网站和权限范围保持锁定，轮换失败时保留已粘贴的密钥

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the network events log in Claude Tag admin settings showing no response status for requests through connections that use AWS signing, client certificates or a custom CA
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复管理设置中的网络事件日志，对使用 AWS 签名、客户端证书或自定义 CA 的连接，不显示响应状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed every request failing with `400 … Input tag 'advisor_20260301'` when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at a proxy or gateway (2.1.275 regression)
entries.zh: 修复了当`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`指向代理或网关时，每个请求都会因“400 …输入标记“advisor_20260301”而失败（2.1.275 回归）

entries.en: Added the signed-in account to Claude apps gateway sign-in: when the gateway names it, you confirm it before the credential is saved, and `/status` shows it
entries.zh: 将登录帐户添加到 Claude apps 网关登录中：当网关命名它时，您在保存凭据之前确认它，并且`/status`显示它

entries.en: Added a send-now key (ctrl+enter, or ctrl+x ctrl+s) that interrupts the current turn and sends all queued messages at once; sent and queued messages show in gray until the model receives them
entries.zh: 添加了立即发送键（ctrl+enter 或 ctrl+x ctrl+s），该键可中断当前回合并立即发送所有排队的消息；已发送和排队的消息显示为灰色，直到模型收到它们

entries.en: Added a startup warning when a configured `otelHeadersHelper` fails, so sessions that silently export no telemetry are noticed
entries.zh: 添加了当配置的`otelHeadersHelper`失败时的启动警告，因此不会注意到静默导出遥测数据的会话

entries.en: Added syncing of the skills and plugins enabled on your claude.ai account to terminal sessions signed in with it; opt out with `syncClaudeAiSkills: false` or `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false`
entries.zh: 添加了将 claude.ai 帐户上启用的技能和插件同步到使用该帐户登录的终端会话；使用 `syncClaudeAiSkills: false` 或 `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false` 选择退出

entries.en: Added `/plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source>`, which offers to add the marketplace before installing the plugin
entries.zh: 添加了 `/plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source>`，它可以在安装插件之前添加市场

entries.en: Fixed a restored memory file's age note changing between requests after a compaction or resume, which caused prompt cache misses
entries.zh: 修复了恢复的内存文件的年龄注释在压缩或恢复后的请求之间发生变化，这会导致提示缓存丢失

entries.en: Fixed `--forward-subagent-text` stream-json and SDK output dropping the messages of subagents spawned by a `context: fork` skill, and of forked skills invoked by a subagent or another forked skill
entries.zh: 修复了 `--forward-subagent-text` 流 json 和 SDK 输出，删除了由 `context: fork` 技能生成的子代理的消息，以及由子代理或其他分叉技能调用的分叉技能的消息

entries.en: Fixed @-mention file suggestions being buried below MCP resources when using a custom `fileSuggestion` command or typing `@.`/`@./`
entries.zh: 修复了使用自定义`fileSuggestion`命令或键入`@.`/`@./`时隐藏在 MCP 资源下方的@提及文件建议

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode placing background-task completion notices beneath a long turn's collapsed tool row instead of where they arrived; each notice now closes the open row
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式将后台任务完成通知放置在长回合折叠工具行下方而不是它们到达的位置；现在每个通知都会关闭打开的行

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin marketplace update` deleting a GitHub marketplace's local copy when the fetch failed and the marketplace was named after its repository
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件市场更新”在获取失败且市场以其存储库命名时删除 GitHub 市场的本地副本的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin and marketplace messages, logs and `claude plugin marketplace list` showing a password or token stored in a git, ssh or marketplace URL
entries.zh: 修复了插件和市场消息、日志和“claude 插件市场列表”，显示存储在 git、ssh 或市场 URL 中的密码或令牌

entries.en: Fixed a resumed cloud session leaving an unanswered question open in the transcript after a queued message superseded it
entries.zh: 修复了恢复的云会话在排队消息取代后在记录中留下未回答的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode placing the cursor one character right after a dot-repeated "!" or a fast-typed "i!" switched a non-empty prompt into shell mode
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，用 `.` 重复 "!" 或快速输入 "i!" 时，光标右移一格，并把非空提示框切换到 shell 模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode freezing or blanking for several seconds when scrolling up past a large file diff
entries.zh: 修复了向上滚动经过大文件差异时全屏模式冻结或空白几秒钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed a stray `</ccmemory>`-style closing tag occasionally appearing in responses
entries.zh: 修复了偶尔出现在响应中的杂散`</ccmemory>`样式的结束标记

entries.en: Fixed plugin messages, logs and the VS Code plugin dialog showing the wrong server for some git addresses
entries.zh: 修复了插件消息、日志和 VS Code 插件对话框显示某些 git 地址的错误服务器

entries.en: Fixed a terminal `API Error: 400` on every turn for users behind a network gateway that rewrites API error responses when a beta request header is rejected
entries.zh: 修复了网络网关后面的用户每次都会出现的终端“API 错误：400”问题，当测试版请求标头被拒绝时，该网关会重写 API 错误响应

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on Linux reporting exit code 0 for failed commands when the shell is zsh
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上的沙盒 Bash 命令在 shell 为 zsh 时报告失败命令的退出代码 0

entries.en: Fixed the Read tool hanging instead of reporting an error when part of a large file could not be decoded under memory pressure
entries.zh: 修复 Read 工具在内存压力下部分大文件无法解码时挂起而非报错的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume`, the resume picker preview, resumed background agents and the transcript view failing on a session whose saved history contains a malformed task-reminder or @-file attachment entry
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`、恢复选择器预览、恢复后台代理和记录视图在保存的历史记录包含格式错误的任务提醒或 @ 文件附件条目的会话上失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash when resuming a conversation whose transcript contains a malformed message entry, and a fullscreen crash when such a conversation received new messages while scrolled up
entries.zh: 修复了恢复对话记录中包含格式错误的消息条目时发生的崩溃，以及此类对话在向上滚动时收到新消息时发生的全屏崩溃

entries.en: Fixed sessions failing to resume or start when their saved transcript contains a malformed message content block
entries.zh: 修复了当保存的记录包含格式错误的消息内容块时会话无法恢复或启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed Grep, Glob and @-file suggestions hanging or running out of memory on searches over the 20MB output cap, and system ripgrep reporting "no matches" instead of an error after a flood of warnings
entries.zh: 修复了 Grep、Glob 和 @-file 建议在超过 20MB 输出上限的搜索中挂起或耗尽内存，以及系统 ripgrep 在出现大量警告后报告“不匹配”而不是错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/rewind` in a forked or background session restoring a zero-filled or truncated file when the session's file-history backups could not be fully copied
entries.zh: 修复了当会话的文件历史记录备份无法完全复制时，分叉或后台会话中的`/rewind`恢复零填充或截断文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen sessions sometimes exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" when typing fast or holding a key with the slash-command dropdown open
entries.zh: 修复了在快速输入或在打开斜杠命令下拉菜单的情况下按住按键时，全屏会话有时会退出并显示“无法恢复的界面错误后克劳德代码退出”的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions crashing and restarting their worker when a command fed through stdin ran on a machine that had run out of file descriptors
entries.zh: 修复了当通过标准输入输入的命令在文件描述符已用完的计算机上运行时后台会话崩溃并重新启动工作程序的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash at launch when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed `mcpNeedsAuthNoticed` value
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude.json`包含格式错误的`mcpNeedsAuthNoticed`值时启动时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` and `--continue` dropping a conversation's earlier thinking when a built-in tool it started with has since been switched off by a server-side flag
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`和`--continue`在对话启动的内置工具被服务器端标志关闭时放弃对话的早期思考的问题

entries.en: Fixed text selected with the mouse in the fullscreen `claude --resume` session picker never reaching the clipboard
entries.zh: 修复全屏 `claude --resume` 会话选择器中用鼠标选中的文本无法复制到剪贴板的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin reload previews replacing a running session's extracted plugin files when the plugin was loaded from a `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` archive
entries.zh: 修复了从`--plugin-dir`或`--plugin-url`存档加载插件时，插件重新加载预览替换正在运行的会话提取的插件文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners with `--drain-wait-sec` losing the final result of a turn that finished during a SIGTERM drain; the runner now waits briefly for the turn to be reported
entries.zh: 修复了带有`--drain-wait-sec`的自托管跑步者丢失在 SIGTERM 排水期间完成的回合的最终结果的问题；跑步者现在短暂等待转弯报告

entries.en: Fixed `SubagentStop` hooks with a specific `matcher` firing for every stopping subagent whose agent type was empty
entries.zh: 修复了`SubagentStop`挂钩，并为每个代理类型为空的停止子代理触发特定的`matcher`

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands being unable to write to project directories named `hooks/` or `config/`
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒 Bash 命令无法写入名为`hooks/`或`config/`的项目目录的问题

entries.en: Fixed Artifact updates failing with "File not found" after a session resumes on another machine or its scratchpad is cleared: the page's last published version is restored
entries.zh: 修复了在另一台计算机上恢复会话或清除其暂存器后工件更新失败并显示“找不到文件”的问题：页面的最后发布版本已恢复

entries.en: Fixed `/update-config` writing `Write(path)` permission rules, which file permission checks don't match, instead of `Edit(path)` rules
entries.zh: 修复了`/update-config`写入`Write(path)`权限规则（文件权限检查不匹配）的问题，而不是`Edit(path)`规则

entries.en: Fixed four dead documentation URLs (Pricing, Computer Use, Skills, CLI) in the bundled claude-api skill's live-sources table
entries.zh: 修复了捆绑的 claude-api 技能的实时源表中的四个死文档 URL（定价、计算机使用、技能、CLI）

entries.en: Improved prompt caching for a `--system-prompt` that contains a `__SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__` line: the text above it is now cached globally, as the SDK's array form already is
entries.zh: 改进 `--system-prompt` 含 `__SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__` 行时的提示缓存：该行以上的文字现在会全局缓存，与 SDK 的数组形式一致

entries.en: Improved the `/desktop` error when Claude Desktop does not open: it now says why and what to do next
entries.zh: 改进 Claude Desktop 无法打开时 `/desktop` 的报错：会说明原因和下一步该怎么做

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's publish and read results: they now say who can open the page and what the owner's Share menu offers
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具发布和读取的结果：会说明谁能打开该页面，以及所有者的「分享」菜单提供哪些选项

entries.en: Improved artifact publish results: they name the tab icon sent, warn when the page contains a NUL byte, and retry a flaky fetch of the newer page to merge after a stale publish
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 发布结果：会注明发送的标签页图标；页面含 NUL 字节时发出警告；过期发布后，会自动重试拉取较新的页面用于合并

entries.en: Improved pasted and attached images: they are now saved where Claude can open them as files without a permission prompt, including in Desktop and VS Code
entries.zh: 改进粘贴和附加的图片：现在会保存为 Claude 可直接打开的文件，无需权限确认，桌面版和 VS Code 中同样适用

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's guidance so Claude updates a shared artifact in place when you were given edit access to it, instead of publishing a separate copy
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具指引：当你获得共享 Artifact 的编辑权限时，Claude 会直接更新原件，而不是另发一份副本

entries.en: Improved plan-usage reads: editor windows and non-interactive sessions on one machine now share a read made in the last minute instead of each calling the usage endpoint
entries.zh: 改进计划用量读取：同一台机器上的编辑器窗口和非交互会话共享一分钟内的读取结果，不再各自调用用量接口

entries.en: Improved the `ListPlugins` tool description so Claude knows it lists plugins enabled on your claude.ai account, not plugins installed locally with `/plugin`
entries.zh: 改进 `ListPlugins` 工具的描述：让 Claude 知道它列出的是你 claude.ai 账户上启用的插件，而不是通过 `/plugin` 在本地安装的插件

entries.en: Improved responsiveness when the terminal is slow or paused: output no longer falls further behind while the terminal catches up
entries.zh: 改进终端慢或暂停时的响应：终端追赶期间，输出不再越落越远

entries.en: Improved Write and Edit results for files in the synced account-skills folder: they now say the change is not saved to your account and how to save it
entries.zh: 改进同步账户技能文件夹中文件的 Write 和 Edit 结果：会说明此修改未保存到你的账户，并告诉你如何保存

entries.en: Updated `/logout` for Claude apps gateway sign-ins to also end the session on gateways that advertise token revocation
entries.zh: Claude 应用网关登录的 `/logout` 现在，在支持令牌撤销的网关上，也会结束会话

entries.en: Changed hosted sessions to keep an unanswered permission prompt up after a container restart, instead of asking again
entries.zh: 更改了托管会话，以在容器重新启动后保持未答复的权限提示，而不是再次询问

entries.en: Changed the Artifact tool to ask for a one-word tab icon on a first publish instead of an emoji favicon
entries.zh: 更改了 Artifact 工具，要求在第一次发布时使用单字选项卡图标，而不是表情符号图标

entries.en: Changed Claude in Chrome in auto mode to skip the extension's per-site check for classifier-approved calls, as bypass mode does, fixing `browser_batch` "Permission denied" after a redirect
entries.zh: 在自动模式下更改了 Chrome 中的 Claude，以跳过扩展程序对分类器批准的调用的每个站点检查，就像旁路模式一样，修复了重定向后`browser_batch`“权限被拒绝”的问题

entries.en: Changed plugins installed from an npm source to be fetched with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` and integrity-verified, so a package's install scripts no longer run
entries.zh: 更改了从 npm 源安装的插件，以使用`npm pack --ignore-scripts`获取并进行完整性验证，因此包的安装脚本不再运行

entries.en: Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs to save data to, and republish the page of, an artifact you can edit without asking; public artifacts, first publishes and deletes still ask
entries.zh: 更改了计划和立即运行例程运行，以将数据保存到并重新发布该工件的页面，您无需询问即可编辑该工件；公共工件，先发布再删除还问

entries.en: Removed the startup notice that told you a one-off scheduled routine had run since your last session
entries.zh: 移除启动时提示“一次性定时任务在你上次会话后已运行”的通知

entries.en: [VSCode] Added viewing, editing and deleting a saved memory inside the Memory dialog
entries.zh: [VSCode] 记忆对话框中可查看、编辑和删除已保存的记忆

entries.en: [VSCode] Added sending an attached image without typing any text
entries.zh: [VSCode] 发送附带的图片时无需输入任何文字

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Retry link to the MCP servers dialog when the server list fails to load
entries.zh: [VSCode] MCP 服务器列表加载失败时，MCP 服务器对话框新增 Retry 链接

entries.en: [VSCode] Added accept and reject buttons under each change in the proposed-change diff tab, so an edit can be reviewed change by change
entries.zh: [VSCode] 建议修改的差异标签页中，每处改动下方新增接受和拒绝按钮，可逐条审查修改

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the transcript creeping toward the bottom in small steps while a permission card waits and content keeps arriving
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复权限卡片等待、内容仍在持续到达时，会话记录会一小步一小步向底部滚动的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed rewound and forked conversations not keeping the permission mode you had picked for the original conversation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复回退和分叉后的对话没有保留你为原对话选择的权限模式的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed an empty `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` entry in the `environmentVariables` setting making Claude Code keep its files in the workspace
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 `environmentVariables` 设置中 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 为空时，Claude Code 把文件保存在工作区内的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed plugin install links opening the Manage plugins dialog for plugin names and marketplace addresses that can't be used in a link
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复插件安装链接对于无法在链接中使用的插件名或市场地址，会打开管理插件对话框的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Remote Control staying shown as connected after a turn-off that Claude Code reported as failed; it now shows as off
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude Code 报告关闭失败后，Remote Control 仍显示为已连接的问题；现在会显示为关闭

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the scroll to the bottom on send stopping short of the reply when the reply starts arriving during the scroll
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复发送时滚动到底部，在滚动过程中回复开始到达时，停在回复之前的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the agent map showing agents a crash left unfinished as stopped instead of failed once the session is reopened
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话重新打开后，agent 地图把因崩溃而未完成的 agent 显示为已停止、而不是失败的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the "Continuing the step" notice not appearing, and the continue limit resetting, after a reload that follows a crash with background tasks still running
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复崩溃且后台任务仍在运行后重新加载，"Continuing the step" 提示不出现、继续次数上限被重置的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list showing when a session was last reopened, such as after a window reload, instead of when its last message was sent
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话列表显示的是会话最后一次被重新打开的时间（如窗口重新加载后），而不是最后一条消息发送时间的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Fork conversation from here" failing on the message right after one sent while Claude was working
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 Claude 工作期间发送的消息之后的那条消息，无法使用 "Fork conversation from here" 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock showing too few minutes after reopening a session with a message sent while Claude was working
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 Claude 工作期间发送了消息的会话重新打开后，提示缓存计时器显示的分钟数偏少的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a background agent that finished while Claude was running a tool losing its completion notice, and its result on the agent map, after a window reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复后台 agent 在 Claude 运行工具时结束，窗口重新加载后丢失完成通知以及 agent 地图上的结果的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a rare case where text selected in a git-ignored file could be sent to Claude after the extension was unresponsive for several seconds
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复极少数情况下：扩展无响应数秒后，在被 git 忽略的文件中选中的文本仍会被发送给 Claude 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed renaming a running session reverting to the generated name (regression in 2.1.269)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重命名正在运行的会话后，名称恢复为自动生成名称的问题（2.1.269 中的回归问题）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed slash commands typed while Claude is responding being sent to the model as text instead of running once the response finishes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude 回复期间输入的斜杠命令被当作文本发送给模型、而不是在回复结束后执行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed unreadable code in the plan preview and the Hooks and Permission rules dialogs with the High Contrast Light theme
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 High Contrast Light 主题下，计划预览、Hooks 和 Permission rules 对话框中代码难以辨认的问题
