entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `/remote-control` being ignored while Remote Control is still connecting: running it again now turns Remote Control off immediately
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Remote Control 仍在连接中时 `/remote-control` 被忽略的问题：现在再次执行会立即关闭 Remote Control

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the conversation pulling you back to the bottom while a reply streams after you scroll up, and added a `claudeCode.scrollToBottomOnSend` setting to turn off the jump on send
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复回复流式输出时，你向上滚动后对话又把你拉回底部的问题；并新增 `claudeCode.scrollToBottomOnSend` 设置，用于关闭发送时的跳转

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Manage plugins dialog showing a password or token that was typed into a marketplace URL
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Manage plugins 对话框显示了输入在市场 URL 中的密码或令牌的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the agent map: the pill counts running agents and turns red after a failure, the main agent stays in view while the map scrolls, and agents sort by state then end time
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进 agent 地图：标签会统计正在运行的 agent 数量，失败后变红；地图滚动时主 agent 保持可见；agent 按状态再按结束时间排序

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed New session in a Claude editor tab to open in the sidebar when Preferred Location is set to Sidebar, instead of always opening another tab
entries.zh: [VSCode] 当「Preferred Location」设为侧边栏时，Claude 编辑器标签页中的「New session」会在侧边栏中打开，而不是总是另开一个标签页

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed a message sent while Claude is working to wait at the bottom of the conversation until Claude starts on it
entries.zh: [VSCode] Claude 工作时发送的消息，改为在对话底部等待，直到 Claude 开始处理它

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a "New routine" button to the page shown when a routine link no longer resolves, next to the link back to your routines list
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 当例程链接失效时显示的页面上，在返回例程列表链接旁新增「New routine」按钮

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed routine "paused" and "on hold" notifications being cut off mid-sentence; the paused-subscription notice now says to turn the routine back on yourself
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复例程「paused」和「on hold」通知被截断的问题；订阅暂停的提示现在会说明需要你自己重新开启例程

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed cloud environments with a very long allowed-domains list saving fine and then failing every session start; saving now fails up front and says how much to trim
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复允许域名列表很长的云端环境能保存成功，但每次会话启动都失败的问题；现在保存时会直接报错，并说明需要删减多少

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed Claude's guidance when a cloud session on a personal account is denied GitHub access: it now links to claude.ai/connect-github instead of an admin settings page
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复个人账户的云端会话被拒绝 GitHub 访问时 Claude 给出的指引：现在会链接到 claude.ai/connect-github，而不是管理设置页面

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved what Claude tells you when asked to edit, delete or run a routine it didn't create: it now links to the routine's page so you can do it yourself
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 改进当你要求编辑、删除或运行一个并非由 Claude 创建的例程时，Claude 的回复：现在会附上例程页面的链接，方便你自己操作

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added attach conditions for access bundles in Claude Tag settings: an Owner can let a bundle also apply in channels with guests or Slack Connect channels, not just member-only
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude Tag 设置中新增访问包的附加条件：所有者可以让访问包也适用于有访客或 Slack Connect 的频道，而不仅限于仅成员的频道

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added Amazon CloudWatch, CloudWatch Logs, Amazon SNS, Google Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging presets to an access bundle's Credentials tab in Claude Tag admin settings
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 在 Claude Tag 管理设置的访问包「Credentials」标签页中，新增 Amazon CloudWatch、CloudWatch Logs、Amazon SNS、Google Cloud Monitoring 和 Cloud Logging 预设

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added Datadog presets for the US3, AP1, AP2 and US1-FED sites; new Datadog connections are now limited to Datadog's read and query API routes
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 新增 Datadog 的 US3、AP1、AP2 和 US1-FED 站点预设；新建的 Datadog 连接现在只允许访问 Datadog 的读取和查询 API 路由

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed S3 uploads from recent AWS CLI and SDK versions failing with a 502 error when sent through an AWS connection
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复近期 AWS CLI 和 SDK 版本通过 AWS 连接上传 S3 时返回 502 错误的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude treating a channel as inactive, and skipping untagged messages there, while it was still posting in that channel from a routine or a thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 仍在频道中通过例程或话题发帖时，却将该频道视为不活跃并跳过未 @ 消息的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a thread's "Claude [task]" display name reverting to plain "Claude" after the session behind that thread was refreshed or restarted
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复话题的「Claude [task]」显示名称，在该话题背后的会话刷新或重启后变回普通「Claude」的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the model you switched to in a Slack thread silently reverting to the channel's default after that thread's session was restarted or refreshed
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在 Slack 话题中切换的模型，在该话题的会话重启或刷新后，悄悄回退为频道默认模型的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes replying twice when another app or bot @mentioned it in a top-level channel message
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复其他应用或机器人在频道顶层消息中 @ Claude 时，它有时回复两次的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's notices in Enterprise Grid channels shared across workspaces: they now say when no workspace is set up yet, or why only organization defaults apply
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude 在跨工作区共享的 Enterprise Grid 频道中的提示：现在会说明尚未设置任何工作区，或为何只应用组织默认设置

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed reviews occasionally dropping part of their analysis when one of the reviewing agents returned its findings in an unexpected format
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复某个审查智能体以意外格式返回其发现时，审查偶尔丢失部分分析的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed pull requests with more than 100 Claude reviews getting a full re-review on every clean merge from the base branch instead of the lighter merge-focused review
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复拥有超过 100 次 Claude 审查的拉取请求，每次从基础分支干净地合并后都进行完整重新审查、而非较轻量的合并审查的问题

entries.en: Added a visible warning when memory usage is critical, with steps to free memory or restart safely
entries.zh: 添加了内存使用严重时的可见警告，以及释放内存或安全重新启动的步骤

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` to bound how long the first non-interactive turn waits for connecting MCP servers (`0` = don't wait)
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS`来限制第一个非交互式回合等待连接 MCP 服务器的时间（`0`=不等待）

entries.en: Added `effort` attribute to the `claude_code.llm_request` OpenTelemetry trace span, matching the `api_request` event
entries.zh: 将`effort`属性添加到`claude_code.llm_request`OpenTelemetry 跟踪范围，匹配`api_request`事件

entries.en: Added `claude_code.managed_settings_resolved` OTel event: managed-settings sources and policy helper state; redacted settings and digests with `OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1`
entries.zh: 添加了`claude_code.managed_settings_resolved` OTel 事件：托管设置源和策略助手状态；使用`OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1`编辑设置和摘要

entries.en: Added `store.connect_timeout_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway config to lengthen the Postgres connect timeout (default 5 seconds), and improved the boot error when the database is unreachable to point to `store.postgres_url` and the configured timeout
entries.zh: 在 Claude apps gateway 配置中添加了 `store.connect_timeout_seconds` 以延长 Postgres 连接超时（默认 5 秒），并改进了数据库无法访问时的启动错误，以指向 `store.postgres_url` 和配置的超时

entries.en: Added `enduser.sub`, the IdP subject, to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway
entries.zh: 将 IdP 主题`enduser.sub`添加到通过 Claude 应用程序网关发送的遥测 Claude Desktop 和 Cowork

entries.en: Added a Claude apps gateway warning when a replica has more requests open than the 256 it sends upstream at once, and a startup log line showing that limit
entries.zh: 添加了当副本打开的请求数量多于一次向上游发送的 256 个请求时发出的 Claude 应用程序网关警告，以及显示该限制的启动日志行

entries.en: Added click-to-expand for collapsed teammate and agent messages in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 添加了全屏模式下折叠的队友和代理消息的点击展开功能

entries.en: Fixed sessions getting stuck endlessly retrying "unexpected tool_use_id" 400 errors: corrupted transcripts now self-heal where possible, and otherwise a clear error (with a `/rewind` hint) ends the loop
entries.zh: 修复了会话无休止地重试“意外的 tool_use_id”400 错误的问题：损坏的转录本现在可以在可能的情况下进行自我修复，否则一个明显的错误（带有`/rewind`提示）会结束循环

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers configured as `http` that only speak legacy HTTP+SSE failing to connect when they answer the first request with 422 or another 4xx error
entries.zh: 修复了配置为`http`的 MCP 服务器，仅使用旧版 HTTP+SSE，当它们用 422 或另一个 4xx 错误应答第一个请求时无法连接

entries.en: Fixed Streamable HTTP MCP tool calls timing out after about 5 minutes even when a longer per-server `timeout` was set
entries.zh: 修复了 Streamable HTTP MCP 工具调用在大约 5 分钟后超时的问题，即使设置了更长的每服务器“超时”

entries.en: Fixed MCP prompts and resources not refreshing when a server sends list-changed notifications without declaring `listChanged`
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器在未声明`listChanged`的情况下发送列表更改通知时 MCP 提示和资源不刷新的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls refused with 403 insufficient_scope being reported as an expired sign-in: the error now names the missing permissions and points to `/mcp` re-authentication
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 工具调用被拒绝并报告 403 unavailable_scope 为过期登录的问题：该错误现在命名了缺少的权限并指向`/mcp`重新身份验证

entries.en: Fixed hook-driven sessions (such as an active `/goal`) ending with "Prompt is too long" instead of compacting when the context overflowed again after a reactive compaction
entries.zh: 修复了钩子驱动的会话（例如活动的`/goal`），当上下文在反应性压缩后再次溢出时以“提示太长”结束而不是压缩

entries.en: Fixed an active `/goal` being lost when resuming (`--continue` / `--resume`) a session that had compacted
entries.zh: 修复了恢复（“--继续”/`--resume`）已压缩的会话时丢失的活动“/目标”

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` losing `--model`, `--effort`, `--permission-mode`, `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` and `--agent` after an auto-update relaunch
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”在自动更新重新启动后丢失`--model`、`--effort`、`--permission-mode`、`--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`和`--agent`的问题

entries.en: Fixed a per-turn slowdown when a language server publishes project-wide diagnostics for thousands of files
entries.zh: 修复了语言服务器发布数千个文件的项目范围诊断时每轮速度减慢的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents with `model: "opus"` on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry leaving the session's model when its id has no recognizable model family (unless `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` is set)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bedrock、Vertex 或 Foundry 上带有`model: "opus"`的子代理，当其 id 没有可识别的模型系列时离开会话模型（除非设置了`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`）

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing every turn with a 401 after a few failed token refreshes, until the next scheduled refresh; the runner now keeps retrying, and fetches a new token after a 401
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行者会话在几次失败的令牌刷新后每回合都会失败并显示 401 的问题，直到下一次计划的刷新为止；运行程序现在不断重试，并在 401 之后获取新令牌

entries.en: Fixed clickable links to local file paths doing nothing in VS Code and other terminals that require a `file://` URI
entries.zh: 修复了本地文件路径的可点击链接在 VS Code 和其他需要 `file://` URI 的终端中不执行任何操作的问题

entries.en: Fixed the transcript renumbering ordered lists in your own messages (typing "3. 2. 1." displayed "3. 4. 5."); numbers and "N)" markers now show as typed
entries.zh: 修复转录视图对你自己消息中的有序列表重新编号的问题（输入 "3. 2. 1." 显示为 "3. 4. 5."）；数字和 "N)" 标记现在按输入原样显示

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion preview notes being attached to a previously chosen option instead of the highlighted one
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 预览注释附加到先前选择的选项而不是突出显示的选项的问题

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion preview mode dropping the highlighted option when submitting a note with Enter
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 预览模式在使用 Enter 提交注释时丢弃突出显示的选项

entries.en: Fixed a resumed background agent keeping half of an interrupted tool batch when one of its calls was approved with a message
entries.zh: 修复了当其中一个调用通过消息批准时，已恢复的后台代理会保留一半中断的工具批次的问题

entries.en: Fixed a local `claude -p --resume` started with `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` not reporting background tasks the previous process left unfinished
entries.zh: 修复了以`CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN`启动的本地`claude -p --resume`不报告上一个进程未完成的后台任务

entries.en: Fixed the first turn of a cloud session sometimes starting without the tools of an SDK-hosted MCP server that was still connecting
entries.zh: 修复云会话的第一回合有时在 SDK 托管的 MCP 服务器仍在连接时就开始，导致缺少其工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agent notifications claiming the agent had no live background work when it was still waiting on its own background task and would resume
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理通知，声称代理仍在等待自己的后台任务并将恢复时没有实时后台工作

entries.en: Fixed error hints in Claude Desktop sessions to suggest slash commands like `/usage-credits` instead of CLI flags that cannot be used there
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Desktop 会话中的错误提示，以建议诸如`/usage-credits`之类的斜线命令，而不是不能在此处使用的 CLI 标志

entries.en: Fixed `/schedule` saving a routine's prompt without its message role when Claude writes the routine in the shape that listing routines returns
entries.zh: 修复了当克劳德以列出例程返回的形状编写例程时，`/schedule`保存例程的提示而没有其消息角色

entries.en: Fixed `/status` not showing the `apiKeyHelper` failure that its own error banner told you to check
entries.zh: 修复了`/status`不显示`apiKeyHelper`失败的问题，其自己的错误横幅告诉您检查

entries.en: Fixed `/fast on` in non-interactive sessions reporting on and then turning off under an organization's managed fast mode policy; it now says the organization has disabled it
entries.zh: 修复了非交互式会话中的`/fast on`在组织的托管快速模式策略下报告然后关闭的问题；现在它说该组织已禁用它

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool asking you to approve an update to an artifact that it then refused because the session had not read the latest version
entries.zh: 修复了工件工具要求您批准对工件的更新，但随后由于会话未读取最新版本而拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cowork and claude.ai cloud sessions with network access on treating reads of a teammate's artifact as if network access were off
entries.zh: 修复了具有网络访问权限的 Cowork 和 claude.ai 云会话，将读取队友的工件视为网络访问已关闭

entries.en: Fixed a plugin or marketplace directory with no git repository of its own taking its version from an enclosing git repository, such as a git-managed `~/.claude`
entries.zh: 修复了没有自己的 git 存储库的插件或市场目录，从封闭的 git 存储库获取其版本，例如 git 管理的 `~/.claude`

entries.en: Fixed `--strict-mcp-config` with an empty `--mcp-config` holding the first non-interactive turn for up to `MCP_TIMEOUT` on incidental MCP servers
entries.zh: 修复了`--strict-mcp-config`，其中空的`--mcp-config`在附带的 MCP 服务器上保持第一个非交互式轮次长达`MCP_TIMEOUT`

entries.en: Fixed Stop prompt hooks re-sending their whole prompt on every block in a conversation; repeat blocks now name the condition with a 500-character label
entries.zh: 修复了停止提示挂钩在对话中的每个块上重新发送整个提示的问题；重复块现在使用 500 个字符的标签命名条件

entries.en: Fixed extra empty editor windows opening at startup on Linux under Wayland when running inside the Cursor or VS Code terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在 Cursor 或 VS Code 终端内运行时在 Wayland 下的 Linux 上启动时打开的额外空编辑器窗口

entries.en: Fixed an unhandled promise rejection in the Claude apps gateway when Postgres drops a connection during a spend check
entries.zh: 修复了当 Postgres 在支出检查期间断开连接时 Claude 应用程序网关中未处理的承诺拒绝

entries.en: Fixed Claude apps gateway cutting every open stream on SIGTERM: it now lets in-flight requests finish for up to 25 seconds before exiting (`CLAUDE_GATEWAY_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS`)
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 应用程序网关在 SIGTERM 上切断每个开放流的问题：现在，它允许进行中的请求在退出前最多完成 25 秒（`CLAUDE_GATEWAY_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS`）

entries.en: Fixed `installed_plugins.json` being rewritten on nearly every start-up when plugin policy comes from remote managed settings, which made Claude Desktop reload every open session's plugins
entries.zh: 修复了当插件策略来自远程管理设置时几乎每次启动时都会重写`installed_plugins.json`，这使得 Claude Desktop 重新加载每个打开会话的插件

entries.en: Fixed headless and SDK sessions making a separate model call for every background task that finished; completions already queued are now answered by one call
entries.zh: 修复了无头和 SDK 会话，为每个已完成的后台任务进行单独的模型调用；已经排队的完成现在只需一个呼叫即可应答

entries.en: Fixed the Bash tool re-sourcing the shell profile (a multi-second stall on the next command) after every plugin reload; it now does so only when the plugins' `bin/` directories changed
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具在每次插件重新加载后重新获取 shell 配置文件的问题（下一个命令的几秒停顿）；现在只有当插件的`bin/`目录发生更改时才会这样做

entries.en: Fixed plugins with a top-level `$schema` in `hooks/hooks.json` showing an "unknown key" notice
entries.zh: 修复了 `hooks/hooks.json` 中具有顶级 `$schema` 的插件显示“未知密钥”通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP connection errors and the MCP login tool's description showing secrets resolved from `${VAR}` placeholders in MCP configs
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 连接错误和 MCP 登录工具的描述，显示从 MCP 配置中的`${VAR}`占位符解析的机密

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks for commands that loop over or assign certain special shell variables; these commands now ask for permission
entries.zh: 修复了循环或分配某些特殊 shell 变量的命令的 Bash 权限检查；这些命令现在请求许可

entries.en: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting Bash commands with certain nested shell expansions; these are now refused
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离的会话会接受某些嵌套 shell 展开的 Bash 命令；现在会拒绝这些命令

entries.en: Fixed the Edit permission prompt preview sometimes showing a different location than the approved edit in files with multi-byte characters
entries.zh: 修复编辑权限提示的预览有时显示的位置与已批准的编辑位置不同（针对含多字节字符的文件）的问题

entries.en: Fixed background commands being stopped after 30 idle minutes on machines under mild memory pressure; they're now stopped only when memory is critically low, and the debug log says why
entries.zh: 修复了在轻度内存压力下的机器上 30 分钟空闲后后台命令停止的问题；现在，只有当内存严重不足时，它们才会停止，并且调试日志会说明原因

entries.en: Fixed a message a subagent sends to the main session disappearing from the Claude Desktop transcript after a relaunch
entries.zh: 修复了子代理发送到主会话的消息在重新启动后从克劳德桌面记录中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin loaded from a `.zip` being served from a stale extraction after several overlapping reloads
entries.zh: 修复了在多次重叠重新加载后从陈旧提取中提供的从`.zip`加载的插件

entries.en: Fixed a sub-agent's progress summary being replaced by a runaway multi-paragraph reply
entries.zh: 修复了子代理的进度摘要被失控的多段回复替换的问题

entries.en: Improved startup in `--input-format stream-json` sessions: the first turn no longer waits up to 2s for still-connecting MCP servers whose tools tool search defers; they arrive on a later turn
entries.zh: 改进 `--input-format stream-json` 会话的启动：第一轮对话不再等待最多 2 秒，让仍在连接中的 MCP 服务器（其工具会被工具搜索延后加载）；这些工具会在之后的轮次中到达

entries.en: Improved Monitor tool notifications: a script's final output and its exit now arrive as one notification instead of two, saving a model turn
entries.zh: 改进 Monitor 工具通知：脚本的最终输出和退出合并为一条通知，而不是两条，节省一轮模型调用

entries.en: Improved Artifact tool errors: when you are not signed in to claude.ai the terminal now says so on the first attempt, and Claude is told to stop retrying a rejected call sooner
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具的错误提示：未登录 claude.ai 时，终端会在第一次尝试时就直接说明，并更快地告诉 Claude 停止重试被拒绝的调用

entries.en: Improved artifact publishing: a publish built on an older version is stopped before it is sent, with the newer page to merge
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 发布：基于旧版本的发布会在发送前被拦截，并附上需要合并的较新页面

entries.en: Improved safety checks before removing an agent worktree that contains submodule checkouts
entries.zh: 改进删除包含子模块检出的智能体工作树前的安全检查

entries.en: Improved `OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES=file:<dir>` output: a new `index.jsonl` and `request_body_id` / `message.id` event attributes link each response to its request file and transcript message
entries.zh: 改进 `OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES=file:<dir>` 输出：新增 `index.jsonl`，并增加 `request_body_id` / `message.id` 事件属性，把每个响应与其请求文件和记录中的消息关联起来

entries.en: Improved Claude apps gateway boot: it now tries the first Postgres connection up to three times before exiting, so a database that is reachable a few seconds late no longer fails the boot
entries.zh: 改进 Claude apps 网关启动：首次连接 Postgres 最多尝试三次再退出，数据库晚几秒才就绪也不会导致启动失败

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend-limit check under load: it now takes one database round trip instead of four, so fewer checks time out on a busy gateway
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关高负载下的消费上限检查：现在只需一次数据库往返（以前是四次），繁忙时超时的检查更少

entries.en: Improved Claude apps gateway sign-in rate limit errors: `/login` now explains the refusal, and the gateway log says which limit was hit and which setting to change
entries.zh: 改进 Claude apps 网关的登录限流错误：`/login` 会说明被拒绝的原因，网关日志会写明触发了哪个限制以及该改哪个设置

entries.en: Changed Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and telemetry-disabled installs to use the v2 MCP client and MCP 2026-07-28 negotiation with direct HTTP servers by default, as other installs already do (opt out: `MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1` or `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy`)
entries.zh: 更改了 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和遥测禁用安装，默认使用 v2 MCP 客户端和 MCP 2026-07-28 与直接 HTTP 服务器协商，就像其他安装已经做的那样（选择退出：`MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1` 或 `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy`）

entries.en: Changed `/code-review` to use leaner inline review prompts for every model that has no tuned settings of its own, instead of spawning many review subagents
entries.zh: 更改了`/code-review`，为每个没有自己调整设置的模型使用更精简的内联审核提示，而不是产生许多审核子代理

entries.en: Changed `"type": "sdk"` MCP entries in `.mcp.json`, settings, plugins and agent files to be skipped with a warning: only an SDK host application can register in-process servers
entries.zh: 更改了`.mcp.json`中的“type”：“sdk”MCP 条目、设置、插件和代理文件，并跳过警告：只有 SDK 主机应用程序可以注册进程内服务器

entries.en: Changed artifact watching in local sessions: a new version published elsewhere no longer starts a turn; Claude learns of it from a later Artifact tool result
entries.zh: 更改了本地会话中的工件观看：在其他地方发布的新版本不再开始回合； Claude是从后来的Artifact工具结果中得知的

entries.en: Changed plugin and marketplace clones to leave Git LFS files as pointers instead of downloading them; `git lfs pull` in the checkout fetches them
entries.zh: 更改了插件和市场克隆，将 Git LFS 文件保留为指针，而不是下载它们；结帐中的`git lfs pull`会获取它们

entries.en: Changed self-hosted runners to skip a read-only repository the git host refuses at the access check instead of failing the session start
entries.zh: 更改了自托管运行程序以跳过 git 主机在访问检查时拒绝的只读存储库，而不是使会话启动失败

entries.en: Changed the `/status` GitHub line to read "Cloud sessions", and `/web-setup`, `/ultrareview`, and teleport messages to say "cloud session" instead of "Claude Code on the web"
entries.zh: 将 `/status` GitHub 行更改为“云会话”，并将`/web-setup`、`/ultrareview`和传送消息更改为“云会话”而不是“网络上的克劳德代码”

entries.en: [VSCode] Added continuation of the step a window reload interrupted, labeled in the chat, with a Claude Code: Continue After Reload setting to turn it off
entries.zh: [VSCode] 窗口重新加载打断的步骤可以继续，并在聊天中加以标注；新增「Claude Code: Continue After Reload」设置，可关闭此功能

entries.en: [VSCode] Added Memory and Instructions entries to the Customize menu: Memory shows the auto-memory toggles, the saved memories and the memory folders, and Instructions edits the CLAUDE.md files
entries.zh: [VSCode] Customize 菜单新增 Memory 和 Instructions 两项：Memory 显示自动记忆开关、已保存的记忆和记忆文件夹，Instructions 用于编辑 CLAUDE.md 文件

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` setting to stop Claude from locking the editor groups it opens in
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增 `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` 设置，用于阻止 Claude 锁定它打开所在的编辑器分组

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a `/btw` side question asked in a new conversation's first seconds occasionally showing another session's side-question history
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在新对话的头几秒提出 `/btw` 旁问时，偶尔会显示其他会话的旁问历史的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a brief freeze when the extension first looks up your global gitignore file
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展首次查找全局 gitignore 文件时短暂卡顿的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message sent while Claude was running a tool disappearing from the conversation after a window reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude 运行工具时发送的消息，在窗口重新加载后从对话中消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Manage Plugins enable toggle and MCP servers dialog rows being unreachable from the keyboard
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复无法用键盘操作 Manage Plugins 的启用开关和 MCP 服务器对话框中的行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-ins and sign-outs made in a terminal not showing until a reload after `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` changed in the Environment Variables setting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在终端中完成的登录和登出，要等到 Environment Variables 设置中 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 变更并重新加载后才显示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Edit diffs in the chat being cut off at the bottom at some panel widths and for long wrapped lines; diff boxes now fit the rows shown
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复聊天中的 Edit 差异在某些面板宽度下以及长的换行行底部被截断的问题；差异框现在会完整显示所展示的行

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed overlapping settings writes from the extension leaving `~/.claude/settings.json` unparseable or dropping a setting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展的设置写入相互重叠，导致 `~/.claude/settings.json` 无法解析或丢失设置的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Open in New Tab (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Esc) sometimes leaving the new tab's message box unfocused, so typing went nowhere until you clicked it
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Open in New Tab（Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Esc）有时新标签页的输入框没有获得焦点，导致在点击之前输入的内容无处可去的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed reopening a closed Claude tab splitting the editor layout when its locked group still holds another Claude tab and a file
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复关闭的 Claude 标签页被重新打开时，若其锁定的分组中仍有另一个 Claude 标签页和一个文件，编辑器布局会被拆分的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed New session opening another locked editor group whenever a file tab shared the group with your Claude tab
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复当文件标签页与你的 Claude 标签页位于同一编辑器分组时，New session 会再打开一个被锁定的编辑器分组的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed session names shifting sideways in the session picker while typing a search query
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在会话选择器中输入搜索词时，会话名称左右晃动的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the plan review card cutting off its Send feedback button and reason field when a plan has several comments; the comment list now scrolls
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复计划包含多条评论时，计划审阅卡片会截断 Send feedback 按钮和原因输入框的问题；现在评论列表可以滚动

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed inline code and code blocks in chat replies being unreadable under the High Contrast themes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 High Contrast 主题下，聊天回复中的行内代码和代码块难以辨认的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved screen reader navigation of the conversation: each message is announced as "You" or "Claude", with the tool name for tool steps
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进屏幕阅读器对对话的导航：每条消息会播报为 "You" 或 "Claude"，工具步骤会播报工具名称

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the default global gitignore file to `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/ignore` when `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is an absolute path
entries.zh: [VSCode] 当 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 为绝对路径时，默认全局 gitignore 文件改为 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/ignore`

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a "Compare against" branch picker to a cloud session's diff view, so you can diff its changes against any branch instead of only the base branch
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 云端会话的差异视图新增「Compare against」分支选择器，可以把改动与任意分支对比，而不只是基础分支

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed git operations in cloud sessions failing with "service unavailable" when GitHub's token renewal briefly errors
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复 GitHub 令牌续期短暂出错时，云端会话中的 git 操作报「service unavailable」而失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed editing a routine occasionally making it fire twice or re-enabling a routine that had just been paused
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复编辑例程时偶尔导致其触发两次，或重新启用了刚被暂停的例程的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed commits in cloud sessions occasionally failing with a signing error for a few minutes after the session's credentials refreshed
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复云端会话凭据刷新后的几分钟内，提交偶尔因签名错误而失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed the toast after saving a routine whose GitHub trigger couldn't be linked to show the reason, such as a per-repository trigger limit, instead of only "edit to retry"
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复保存例程后，若其 GitHub 触发器无法关联，提示只显示「edit to retry」而不说明原因（如每个仓库的触发器数量上限）的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed sessions sometimes flipping back to unread right after you mark them read
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复会话刚被标记为已读，有时又马上变回未读的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed routines to skip a run and retry for up to 72 hours when the owner's GitHub connection is missing, instead of switching the routine off at the first failed check
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 当例程所有者的 GitHub 连接缺失时，例程会跳过本次运行，并最多重试 72 小时，而不是在第一次检查失败时直接关闭

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed a routine's on-hold notice: when your subscription is paused it now tells you to turn the routine back on yourself instead of promising an automatic resume
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 例程的暂停提示有改动：订阅暂停时，现在会提示你自己重新开启例程，而不是承诺自动恢复

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a Guests setting to the Add channel and Add workspace forms in Claude Tag admin settings, so owners can pick Inherit, Allow, Channel only or Restrict up front
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 在 Claude Tag 管理设置的「Add channel」和「Add workspace」表单中新增「Guests」选项，所有者可提前选择 Inherit、Allow、Channel only 或 Restrict

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude not answering when another Slack app or bot @mentions it; the tag now gets a reply and wakes Claude in a channel it had stopped following after days of inactivity
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复其他 Slack 应用或机器人 @ Claude 时它不回应的问题；现在该提及会得到回复，并唤醒已停止关注数日未活动频道的 Claude

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude missing another app's message that tagged @Claude right after a new Slack channel was created; it's now delivered once Claude has joined
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复新建 Slack 频道后，其他应用 @Claude 的消息被漏掉的问题；Claude 加入后现在会投递该消息

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude folding a follow-up sent minutes after its last Slack message into it as a silent edit; late updates such as blockers now post as a new reply that notifies
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 把在其最后一条 Slack 消息几分钟后发送的跟进消息，静默合并为编辑的问题；阻塞等后续更新现在会作为新回复发出并通知你

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's Slack search failing with an error whenever it searched within a single channel; it now returns that channel's matching messages
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 在单个频道内搜索时，Slack 搜索总是报错的问题；现在会返回该频道中匹配的消息

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a safety-filter stop silently resetting a Slack thread's context when nobody was waiting; Claude now always says so and no longer cancels background work still running
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复安全过滤器停止对话时，若无人等待，会悄悄重置 Slack 话题上下文的问题；现在 Claude 总会说明，并且不再取消仍在运行的后台任务

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed email addresses in Claude's Slack replies rendering with a visible `mailto:` prefix; they now show as the plain, clickable address
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 的 Slack 回复中，邮箱地址前显示可见 `mailto:` 前缀的问题；现在显示为普通的可点击地址

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to watch an Enterprise Grid channel shared with the whole organization when asked from another workspace in the grid
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复从 Grid 中的其他工作区请求时，Claude 拒绝关注整个组织共享的 Enterprise Grid 频道的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the Environment picker in Claude Tag admin settings showing a raw environment ID instead of the environment's name for archived or app-created environments
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 管理设置的 Environment 选择器，对已归档或由应用创建的环境显示原始环境 ID 而非名称的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's live progress checklist in Slack: capped at 2,000 characters, reposted at most every 15 minutes in busy threads, with older "Latest task list" links updated
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude 在 Slack 中的实时进度清单：上限为 2,000 个字符，在繁忙话题中最多每 15 分钟重新发布一次，并更新较早的「Latest task list」链接

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Removed the repeated guest-attribution note Claude appended to a Slack canvas each time it edited one in a channel using the "Channel only" guest setting
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 移除 Claude 在「Channel only」访客设置的频道中每次编辑 Slack canvas 时，附加在其后的重复访客归属说明

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed re-reviews occasionally leaving a fixed finding's thread open when the new review also filed a lower-severity note under it
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复重新审查时，若新审查在已修复问题的话题下另外记录了一条较低严重程度的备注，该已修复问题的话题有时仍保持打开的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed rare reviews ending with "Code review encountered an error" when GitHub or an internal service failed transiently at launch; they now wait and retry
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复 GitHub 或内部服务在启动时短暂故障，导致审查偶尔以「Code review encountered an error」结束的问题；现在会等待后重试

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved how Code Review words each posted finding: short plain sentences that say who is affected, where the code goes wrong, and the fix up front
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进 Code Review 发布问题的措辞：用简短、直白的句子，开头就说明受影响的人、代码出错的位置和修复方法

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved the check-run card and PR comment when a review is skipped because of an organization limit: each cause now links the admin page that fixes it
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进因组织限制而跳过审查时的检查运行卡片和 PR 评论：每个原因都会链接到解决它的管理页面

entries.en: Added `x-claude-code-request-class`, `x-claude-code-agent-type`, `x-claude-code-prev-tool-durations`, `x-claude-code-compaction` and `x-claude-code-context-compacted` request headers for LLM gateways; opt in with `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`
entries.zh: 为 LLM 网关添加了 `x-claude-code-request-class`、`x-claude-code-agent-type`、`x-claude-code-prev-tool-durations`、`x-claude-code-compaction` 和 `x-claude-code-context-compacted` 请求标头；使用`CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`选择加入

entries.en: Added a notification when an MCP server disconnects mid-session and automatic reconnection gives up, pointing at `/mcp`
entries.zh: 添加了当 MCP 服务器在会话中断开连接并且自动重新连接放弃时的通知，指向`/mcp`

entries.en: Added forking a session started with `claude --remote-control` or `/remote-control` from the Claude app; the fork runs as a background session on your computer
entries.zh: 添加了从 Claude 应用程序中分叉以`claude --remote-control`或`/remote-control`启动的会话；该 fork 在您的计算机上作为后台会话运行

entries.en: Fixed Bash commands the permission checker cannot fully analyze skipping the prompt under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`, and a subshell hiding a dangerous `rm` in bypass mode
entries.zh: 修复了权限检查器无法完全分析的 Bash 命令，跳过`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`下的提示，以及在旁路模式下隐藏危险`rm`的子 shell

entries.en: Fixed skills synced from claude.ai staying available after your organization turns Skills off; they now move to the recoverable trash
entries.zh: 修复了从 claude.ai 同步的技能在您的组织关闭技能后仍然可用的问题；他们现在转移到可回收垃圾中

entries.en: Fixed `allowManagedMcpServersOnly`, `deniedMcpServers` and `disableClaudeAiConnectors` set via MDM or `managed-settings.json` being ignored when server-managed settings are also present
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器管理的设置也存在时，通过 MDM 设置的`allowManagedMcpServersOnly`、`deniedMcpServers`和`disableClaudeAiConnectors`被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed 401/403 errors on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry, and Claude apps gateway 403s, telling you to run `/login`; the message now names the credential to refresh or points to your gateway administrator
entries.zh: 修复了 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 以及 Claude 应用程序网关 403 上的 401/403 错误，告诉您运行`/login`；该消息现在指定要刷新的凭据或指向您的网关管理员

entries.en: Fixed `/login`, `/upgrade`, and `/extra-usage` discarding earlier thinking from the conversation, which forced a full prompt-cache rewrite on the next request
entries.zh: 修复了`/login`、`/upgrade`和`/extra-usage`丢弃对话中早期想法的问题，这会强制在下一个请求上进行完整的提示缓存重写

entries.en: Fixed auto mode stopping for approval when the Artifact tool uploads a file you attached to the chat in a cloud or Remote Control session
entries.zh: 修复了当 Artifact 工具上传您附加到云或远程控制会话中的聊天的文件时，自动模式停止等待批准的问题

entries.en: Fixed a long-running session recreating a stub `.git/info/exclude` after the repository's `.git` directory was removed or moved away
entries.zh: 修复了在删除或移走存储库的`.git`目录后重新创建存根`.git/info/exclude`的长时间运行会话

entries.en: Fixed the main prompt dropping a `!` typed at the start while already in shell mode, so negated commands like `! grep …` can be typed
entries.zh: 修复已处于 shell 模式时，在提示框开头输入的 `!` 被丢弃的问题，现在可以输入类似 `! grep …` 这样的取反命令

entries.en: Fixed Read on macOS refusing a dragged-in screenshot, or any file the system reports under a second path, with "symlink resolution changed after permission was checked"
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上的 Read 拒绝拖入屏幕截图或系统在第二个路径下报告的任何文件的问题，并显示“检查权限后符号链接分辨率已更改”

entries.en: Fixed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`: a memory directory chosen by a repository's settings is no longer loaded into the prompt, recalled, indexed, or used by memory extraction
entries.zh: 修复了`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`：由存储库设置选择的内存目录不再加载到提示中、调用、索引或由内存提取使用

entries.en: Fixed sub-agents and background agents being reported as failed, with their result never delivered, when the final streamed reply omitted token usage or carried no model id
entries.zh: 修复了当最终流式回复省略令牌使用或不携带模型 ID 时，子代理和后台代理被报告为失败，其结果从未交付的问题

entries.en: Fixed the context meter and auto-compact counting advisor-tool turns at roughly twice their real context size, which made auto-compact fire at about half the real window
entries.zh: 修复上下文计量表和自动压缩把顾问工具的回合按约两倍于实际的上下文大小计算，导致自动压缩在约一半的实际窗口时就触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/tui` refusing to restart because of an agent-team teammate that had already finished its work and was no longer shown in the agents panel
entries.zh: 修复了`/tui`由于代理团队队友已经完成工作并且不再显示在代理面板中而拒绝重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed saved scheduled tasks running in the wrong session after `.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` was copied into another folder, such as a new worktree
entries.zh: 修复了将`.claude/scheduled_tasks.json`复制到另一个文件夹（例如新的工作树）后在错误会话中运行的已保存计划任务

entries.en: Fixed SDK and `--output-format stream-json` output dropping a subagent's remaining messages and final report after it is moved to the background mid-run (e.g. by `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS`)
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 和 `--output-format stream-json` 输出在运行中移动到后台后丢弃子代理的剩余消息和最终报告的问题（例如通过 `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS`）

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` reporting a SAML single sign-on block as "admin permissions required"
entries.zh: 修复了`/install-github-app`将 SAML 单点登录块报告为“需要管理员权限”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control clients attached to a Claude Desktop, VS Code or JetBrains session being refused when they ask for the session's context window usage
entries.zh: 修复了附加到 Claude Desktop、VS Code 或 JetBrains 会话的远程控制客户端在请求会话的上下文窗口使用情况时被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed the spinner showing a doubled ellipsis ("……") on compaction status lines such as "Running PreCompact hooks…"
entries.zh: 修复压缩状态行（如 "Running PreCompact hooks…"）上的旋转指示器显示双省略号（"……"）的问题

entries.en: Fixed a false-positive spinner tip suggesting the frontend-design plugin after reading or publishing Artifacts
entries.zh: 修复了阅读或发布工件后建议使用前端设计插件的误报旋转提示

entries.en: Reverted a 2.1.268 change that checked Read and Edit deny rules on Bash lines the permission checker can't analyze (`eval`, `env -C`); commands like `time -p make build` prompt again instead of being denied
entries.zh: 撤销了 2.1.268 中的一项变更：该变更会对权限检查器无法分析的 Bash 命令（如 `eval`、`env -C`）检查 Read 和 Edit 的拒绝规则；`time -p make build` 之类的命令会重新弹出提示，而不是被直接拒绝

entries.en: Improved responsiveness in long sessions: hook progress and sub-agent activity no longer re-process the whole conversation on every update
entries.zh: 改进长会话响应速度：hook 进度和子智能体活动更新时，不再重新处理整段对话

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's error when a publish includes a file type artifacts don't serve: Claude is told which types are served and what to do instead, and the terminal shows one plain line
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具报错：发布时包含 Artifact 不提供的文件类型时，会告诉 Claude 支持哪些类型以及该怎么做，终端只显示一行简短说明

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's page read to state the capabilities and database rules the artifact service holds for the page, for anyone who can publish to it
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具的页面读取：会说明 Artifact 服务为该页面设定的功能和数据库规则，供有发布权限的人查看

entries.en: Improved artifact database writes: an update can now remove a single field instead of rewriting the whole document
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 数据库写入：更新操作可以只删除单个字段，不必重写整个文档

entries.en: Improved artifact publishing: a publish whose connection drops after reaching claude.ai is now re-sent safely instead of failing or creating a duplicate version
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 发布：到达 claude.ai 后连接中断的发布，现在会被安全地重新发送，不再失败，也不会产生重复版本

entries.en: Improved the cloud-session GitHub error for an IP allow list, a suspended app installation or SAML single sign-on to show the cause instead of a generic install hint
entries.zh: 改进云端会话 GitHub 报错：对于 IP 白名单、应用安装被暂停或 SAML 单点登录的问题，会显示具体原因，而不是笼统的安装提示

entries.en: Improved `/autofix-pr`: when `gh pr view` fails it now shows gh's own error (sign-in, SAML, rate limit) instead of a generic exit-code line
entries.zh: 改进 `/autofix-pr`：`gh pr view` 失败时，显示 gh 自己的错误（登录、SAML、限流等），而不是笼统的退出码提示

entries.en: Improved `/autofix-pr` to say why GitHub webhook delivery couldn't be set up for the PR (for example, no linked GitHub account) instead of a generic warning
entries.zh: 改进 `/autofix-pr`：无法为 PR 设置 GitHub webhook 时，会说明原因（例如未关联 GitHub 账号），不再只给笼统的警告

entries.en: Improved `/web-setup` errors: a refused GitHub token now lists the likely reasons and the fix, and a connection failure names a configured proxy or TLS certificate problem
entries.zh: 改进 `/web-setup` 错误提示：GitHub 令牌被拒绝时，列出可能原因和解决办法；连接失败时指出是否为已配置的代理或 TLS 证书问题

entries.en: Improved the in-session SSL certificate and proxy connection errors to name the error code and what to fix, such as `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` for an untrusted corporate CA
entries.zh: 改进会话中的 SSL 证书和代理连接报错：会写出错误代码和修复方法，例如不受信任的企业 CA 可设置 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`

entries.en: Improved the error when a cloud session can't be created because your Claude login expired or was revoked: it now tells you to run `/login`
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 登录过期或被撤销导致云端会话无法创建时的报错：会提示你运行 `/login`

entries.en: Improved the error shown when an MCP server's sign-in expires mid-session to say how to re-authenticate (`/mcp`)
entries.zh: 改进会话中 MCP 服务器登录过期时的报错：会说明如何重新认证（`/mcp`）

entries.en: Changed auto mode on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to use the local classifier by default for now; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` to use the platform's server-side classifier
entries.zh: 更改了 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上的自动模式，暂时默认使用本地分类器；设置`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1`以使用平台的服务器端分类器

entries.en: Changed `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` to also include real agent, skill, plugin and MCP server names on cost and token metrics
entries.zh: 更改了`OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`，以在成本和令牌指标上包含真实代理、技能、插件和 MCP 服务器名称

entries.en: Changed sign-in with a Claude account to also request access to your claude.ai plugins
entries.zh: 更改了使用 Claude 帐户的登录方式，以请求访问您的 claude.ai 插件

entries.en: Changed `/bug` and `/feedback` reports to include only model-behavior params (model, system prompt, tools) from the last API request, omitting request metadata and `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` fields
entries.zh: 更改了`/bug`和`/feedback`报告，使其仅包含上次 API 请求中的模型行为参数（模型、系统提示、工具），省略请求元数据和`CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY`字段

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Report a problem" still appearing, and `/bug` / `/feedback` opening a report form, for organizations that have product feedback disabled
entries.zh: [VSCode] 对于已关闭产品反馈功能的组织，修复仍显示 "Report a problem"，以及 `/bug` / `/feedback` 仍打开反馈表单的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a red "Claude Code process exited with code 4294967295" banner appearing after completed turns on Windows
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Windows 上完成轮次后偶尔出现红色横幅 "Claude Code process exited with code 4294967295" 的问题

entries.en: Windows: Improved the network-path permission check for UNC paths when a mapped network drive was added with `--add-dir`
entries.zh: Windows：为使用 `--add-dir` 添加映射网络驱动器时，改进了 UNC 路径的网络路径权限检查

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed routines losing access to an organization connector, and still calling the old one, after an admin removed and re-added that connector
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复管理员移除并重新添加某个组织连接器后，例程失去该连接器的访问权限、仍在调用旧连接器的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed creating a self-hosted environment from organization settings occasionally failing with a server error and leaving a half-created environment behind
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复在组织设置中创建自托管环境时，偶尔因服务器错误失败并留下半成品环境的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the admin "Share cloud sessions" setting to live under Data and privacy instead of the Claude Code page, where Data and privacy admins can also manage it
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 管理员的「Share cloud sessions」设置移到「Data and privacy」下，不再在 Claude Code 页面中；具有 Data and privacy 权限的管理员也可以在那里管理

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a "Discard unsaved changes?" confirmation before the New routine page or the Edit routine dialog throws away a routine name, prompt or edit you typed
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 在「New routine」页面或「Edit routine」对话框会丢弃你输入的例程名称、提示或修改时，新增「Discard unsaved changes?」确认提示

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Removed the full-page desktop-app download screen that new users without a cloud environment saw on Mac and Windows; they now go straight to setup
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 移除了 Mac 和 Windows 上没有云端环境的新用户原本会看到的整页桌面应用下载界面；他们现在直接进入设置

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved the routine detail page: menu and rename in the breadcrumb, the on/off switch and Run now at the top, and run history beside the routine's settings
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 改进例程详情页：面包屑中提供菜单和重命名，顶部提供开关和「Run now」，运行历史显示在例程设置旁边

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude going silent minutes after reinstalling the app when an Enterprise Grid was disconnected but one of its workspaces stayed connected
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Enterprise Grid 已断开、但其中一个工作区仍保持连接时，重新安装应用后几分钟 Claude 就沉默的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled tasks set up in an organization-shared private Slack channel silently never posting; they now keep running in the thread they were created in
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复组织共享的私密 Slack 频道中设置的定时任务悄悄不再发帖的问题；现在它们会继续在创建时所在的话题中运行

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed replying in an older Slack thread while Claude is mid-task sometimes restarting it from scratch and losing work it had not pushed yet
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 正在执行任务时，在较早的 Slack 话题中回复，有时会让它从头重启，并丢失尚未推送的工作的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude occasionally dropping a message with an incorrect "couldn't find a Claude Code environment" notice right after your account token refreshed
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复账户令牌刷新后，Claude 偶尔丢弃消息并错误提示「couldn't find a Claude Code environment」的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed AWS connections refusing region-less endpoints such as Budgets, Savings Plans, WAF Classic and Import/Export; Global Accelerator requests now sign correctly
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 AWS 连接拒绝不带区域的端点（如 Budgets、Savings Plans、WAF Classic、Import/Export）的问题；Global Accelerator 请求现在可以正确签名

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved AWS connection failures: when a request can't be signed, such as a hostname with no region, Claude is told why and how to fix it instead of a bare error
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 AWS 连接失败的提示：当请求无法签名（例如主机名中没有区域）时，Claude 会被告知原因和修复方法，而不只是一个笼统错误

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed OAuth client-credentials and JWT-bearer connections failing with providers that return a lowercase token type; requests now send the standard Bearer scheme
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 OAuth 客户端凭据和 JWT-bearer 连接，与返回小写令牌类型的服务商连接失败的问题；请求现在使用标准的 Bearer 方案

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed adding a channel manager being refused on Enterprise Grid shared channels, on channels where Claude hasn't been used yet, and on legacy private channels
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在 Enterprise Grid 共享频道、尚未使用过 Claude 的频道和旧版私密频道上，添加频道管理员被拒绝的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed Claude to start watching related public channels on its own, such as an incident channel a conversation depends on, instead of only when asked
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude 现在会主动开始关注相关的公开频道（例如某次对话所依赖的事故频道），而不只是在被要求时才关注

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the admin Memory page not listing Slack channels Claude set up on its own even when they had saved memory; admins can now open, edit and delete that memory
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复管理员的 Memory 页面不列出 Claude 自行设置的 Slack 频道的问题，即使这些频道已保存记忆；管理员现在可以打开、编辑和删除这些记忆

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed merging the base branch into a PR whose earlier review listed "Additional findings" triggering a full re-review; these pushes now get the lighter follow-up review
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复将基础分支合并到较早审查列出「Additional findings」的 PR 时，触发完整重新审查的问题；现在这类推送会得到较轻量的后续审查

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed a whole REVIEW.md being ignored because of an @-mention, a code span wrapped across lines, or a backticked HTML tag; only lines linking to changed files are withheld
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复整个 REVIEW.md 因一个 @ 提及、跨行的代码片段或带反引号的 HTML 标签而被忽略的问题；现在只忽略链接到已更改文件的行

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved suggested fixes to say what the fix must keep working when other code depends on the behavior being changed
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进修复建议：当其他代码依赖被修改的行为时，说明修复必须保证哪些功能仍然正常

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved review comments that point to a second affected location to state that location's issue in a full sentence instead of a cut-off stub
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进指向第二个受影响位置的审查评论：该位置的问题改为完整句子说明，而不是残缺的简短描述

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed `/ultrareview --post` so a retry after a GitHub error posts the findings comment exactly once instead of never or twice; the comment now names the reviewed commit
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复 `/ultrareview --post` 在 GitHub 出错后重试时，发布结果评论的次数不正确（从不发布或发布两次）的问题；现在会精确发布一次，并注明所审查的提交

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed empty or content-identical pushes being re-reviewed on GitHub repositories whose owner or name contains a capital letter; these pushes are now skipped
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复在所有者或仓库名包含大写字母的 GitHub 仓库中，空推送或内容相同的推送被重新审查的问题；现在这些推送会被跳过

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added fast mode in Claude Code Remote sessions (cloud and self-hosted runners): the host's fast-mode setting or `/fast` typed in the session applies where your organization allows it
entries.zh: 在 Claude Code 远程会话（云和自托管运行器）中添加了快速模式：主机的快速模式设置或在会话中键入的`/fast`适用于组织允许的情况

entries.en: Added mouse support to the `/config` panel in fullscreen mode: the wheel scrolls the settings list, a click on a setting's value changes it, and the row under the pointer is highlighted
entries.zh: 在全屏模式下向`/config`面板添加了鼠标支持：滚轮滚动设置列表，单击设置的值会更改它，并且指针下方的行会突出显示

entries.en: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --drain-marker-file <path>`: when that file exists at a SIGTERM drain, the runner reports its exit to the server as a host drain (telemetry only)
entries.zh: 添加了`claude self-hosted-runner --drain-marker-file <path>`：当该文件存在于 SIGTERM 消耗时，运行程序将其退出作为主机消耗向服务器报告（仅限遥测）

entries.en: Added per-command `allowed_domains` to Bash, PowerShell and Monitor in auto mode with sandboxing: the hosts a command needs are reviewed with it and opened for it alone; other hosts are refused
entries.zh: 通过沙箱在自动模式下向 Bash、PowerShell 和 Monitor 添加了每个命令的`allowed_domains`：使用它来审查命令所需的主机并单独为其打开；其他主机被拒绝

entries.en: Added `omitClaudeMd` to agent frontmatter and `--agents` JSON, letting custom and plugin subagents run without user, project and local CLAUDE.md files; managed policy files still load
entries.zh: 将 `omitClaudeMd` 添加到代理 frontmatter 和 `--agents` JSON，让自定义和插件子代理在没有用户、项目和本地 CLAUDE.md 文件的情况下运行；托管策略文件仍然加载

entries.en: Added `--accept-command <sha256>` to `claude plugin install` and `claude plugin update` to accept exactly the command a previous `--json` run displayed, instead of `-y`
entries.zh: 在“claude插件安装”和“claude插件更新”中添加了`--accept-command <sha256>`，以准确接受先前`--json`运行显示的命令，而不是`-y`

entries.en: Added support for a `multiplier` above 1, up to 10, in the `modelPricing` managed setting and the Claude apps gateway `pricing` block, for marked-up internal chargeback rates
entries.zh: 在`modelPricing`托管设置和 Claude 应用程序网关“定价”块中添加了对高于 1 的“乘数”（最多 10）的支持，以实现标记的内部退款率

entries.en: Added a spinner tip pointing Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry and LLM gateway users to the Claude desktop app; the claude.ai desktop app tip now suggests `/desktop`, which offers to download the app
entries.zh: 添加了一个旋转提示，将 Bedrock、Vertex AI、Foundry 和 LLM 网关用户指向 Claude 桌面应用程序； claude.ai 桌面应用程序提示现在建议`/desktop`，它提供下载应用程序的功能

entries.en: Fixed a cached organization policy being reused after switching accounts, organizations, or API keys, and the policy not refreshing until the hourly check when the credential changes mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了切换帐户、组织或 API 密钥后重用缓存的组织策略，以及在凭证在会话中更改时进行每小时检查之前策略不会刷新的问题

entries.en: Fixed the tool and command lists not updating when the organization policy finishes loading after startup or changes mid-session
entries.zh: 修复组织策略在启动后加载完成或会话中途变化时，工具和命令列表不更新的问题

entries.en: Fixed an enterprise `managed-mcp.json` that can't be read or parsed being ignored: it now keeps exclusive MCP control (user, project and plugin servers don't load) and warns at startup
entries.zh: 修复了无法读取或解析的企业“托管-mcp.json”被忽略的问题：它现在保留独占的 MCP 控制（用户、项目和插件服务器不加载）并在启动时发出警告

entries.en: Fixed org policy being fetched through, and rejected by, third-party local proxies set via `ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET`; they are again treated like other custom gateways, including for Remote Control
entries.zh: 修复了通过`ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET`设置的第三方本地代理获取并拒绝组织策略的问题；它们再次像其他自定义网关一样对待，包括远程控制

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions rejecting every subagent tool call ("updatedInput … failed schema validation") when a workflow or agent approval was applied after the session's worker restarted
entries.zh: 修复了在会话工作线程重新启动后应用工作流或代理批准时，云会话拒绝每个子代理工具调用（“updatedInput ...失败的架构验证”）

entries.en: Fixed `/fast off` answering "Fast mode unavailable" instead of turning fast mode off when the organization has fast mode disabled
entries.zh: 修复了`/fast off`在组织禁用快速模式时回答“快速模式不可用”而不是关闭快速模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions started with `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_ORG_CHECK` re-sending fast requests every turn after the API rejected fast mode; the rejection now stands and its reason is shown
entries.zh: 修复了在 API 拒绝快速模式后以`CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_ORG_CHECK`每轮重新发送快速请求开始的会话；拒绝现已成立并说明其原因

entries.en: Fixed fast mode under `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` failing the turn on a usage-credits limit, or retrying an overload at fast speed, instead of falling back to standard speed
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`下的快速模式无法打开使用积分限制，或以快速速度重试过载，而不是回落到标准速度的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks missing the file that `fmt`, `column` and similar commands read when it follows an option the checker doesn't recognize
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查在遵循检查器无法识别的选项时缺少`fmt`、`column`和类似命令读取的文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks skipping files a wildcard expands to when the wildcard sits in a command's pattern or option value (for example `grep -v dir/* file`)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查，当通配符位于命令的模式或选项值中时，会跳过通配符扩展的文件（例如 `grep -v dir/* file`）

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks so that shell variable declaration flags cannot misrepresent the command being run
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查，以便 shell 变量声明标志不能歪曲正在运行的命令

entries.en: Fixed Bash commands with two directory changes, a subshell, or a `cd`+`git` chain skipping the prompt under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` in bypass and auto mode
entries.zh: 修复了具有两个目录更改、子 shell 或 `cd`+`git` 链的 Bash 命令，在旁路和自动模式下跳过 `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` 下的提示

entries.en: Fixed a stale `.git/config.lock` breaking `git checkout -b`, `git push -u` and `git config` for the rest of a session after a sandboxed command failed to start (Linux)
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒命令启动失败后，旧的`.git/config.lock`会破坏会话剩余部分的`git checkout -b`、`git push -u`和`git config`（Linux）

entries.en: Fixed settings file changes made outside the session going unnoticed on macOS machines whose system file-event service is saturated; the watcher now falls back to polling
entries.zh: 修复了在系统文件事件服务饱和的 macOS 计算机上，在会话之外进行的设置文件更改不会被注意到的问题；观察者现在退回到轮询

entries.en: Fixed resumed `claude -p` sessions whose tools all come from MCP servers failing with "At least one tool must have defer_loading=false"
entries.zh: 修复了恢复的`claude -p`会话，其工具全部来自 MCP 服务器，失败并显示“至少一个工具必须具有 defer_loading=false”

entries.en: Fixed turns failing with "API returned an empty or malformed response" when an LLM gateway returns the non-streaming reply as `text/plain`
entries.zh: 修复 LLM 网关将非流式回复以 `text/plain` 返回时，回合因"API returned an empty or malformed response"失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed sustained high CPU usage and repeated tool-list requests when an MCP server sends `list_changed` notifications in a tight loop
entries.zh: 修复了当 MCP 服务器在紧密循环中发送`list_changed`通知时持续的高 CPU 使用率和重复的工具列表请求

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth mishandling client registrations: denying consent forced a new one, one for another redirect URI was reused, and a concurrent write could delete a valid one or keep a mismatched one
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP OAuth 错误处理客户端注册的问题：拒绝同意会强制创建新的同意，重复使用另一个重定向 URI 的同意，并发写入可能会删除有效的同意或保留不匹配的同意

entries.en: Fixed tool search returning no match when Claude selects an MCP tool by its bare name instead of its full `mcp__server__tool` name
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 用裸名称（而非完整的 `mcp__server__tool` 名称）选择 MCP 工具时，工具搜索找不到匹配项的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+O cancelling pending MCP server reconnects, and `/mcp` sent from Remote Control failing while the transcript view is open
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+O 取消挂起的 MCP 服务器重新连接以及在转录视图打开时从远程控制发送的`/mcp`失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Claude in Chrome prompt telling the model to load tools through ToolSearch when ToolSearch is unavailable
entries.zh: 修复 Claude in Chrome 的提示词在 ToolSearch 不可用时，仍让模型通过 ToolSearch 加载工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed cross-session messages held by the receiving session's permission-mode policy leaving no trace: headless senders now get a delivery notice, and `SendMessage` results no longer imply it was read
entries.zh: 修复了接收会话的权限模式策略保留的跨会话消息，不留下任何痕迹：无头发件人现在会收到送达通知，并且`SendMessage`结果不再暗示它已被读取

entries.en: Fixed Claude starting a second copy of a background command (such as a watch task or dev server) that was still running after the conversation was compacted
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德启动后台命令的第二个副本（例如监视任务或开发服务器）的问题，该命令在压缩对话后仍在运行

entries.en: Fixed `/model` warning about losing the conversation cache when switching back to the model the conversation actually ran on
entries.zh: 修复了切换回对话实际运行的模型时有关丢失对话缓存的`/model`警告

entries.en: Fixed `/reload-skills` reporting a skill count that disagreed with the slash menu after `/cd`
entries.zh: 修复了`/reload-skills`报告的技能计数与`/cd`之后的斜杠菜单不一致的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` and `/continue` showing only 1-2 sessions in fullscreen mode on short terminals
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`和“/ continue”在短终端上全屏模式下仅显示 1-2 个会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` and `/teleport` keeping the previous conversation's file-read tracking, so Claude could edit files the resumed conversation had never read
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`和`/teleport`保留先前对话的文件读取跟踪，以便克劳德可以编辑恢复的对话从未读取过的文件

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` dropping the 1M context window (`[1m]`) when the resumed session's model family differs from the configured default model
entries.zh: 修复了当恢复会话的模型系列与配置的默认模型不同时`--resume`删除 1M 上下文窗口 (`[1m]`)

entries.en: Fixed artifacts attached with `/artifacts` disappearing from the session after `--resume`
entries.zh: 修复了`/artifacts`附加的工件在`--resume`之后从会话中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions (`claude --bg`, `claude agents`) not watching the artifacts they publish for republishes made elsewhere
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话（`claude --bg`、“claude Agents”）不观看他们为在其他地方重新发布而发布的工件

entries.en: Fixed custom agents, slash commands and output styles beyond the first not loading from a virtual drive that reports inode 0, such as an encrypted vault mounted as a Windows drive
entries.zh: 修复了自定义代理、斜杠命令和输出样式超出第一个不从报告 inode 0 的虚拟驱动器加载的问题，例如作为 Windows 驱动器安装的加密保管库

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions silently losing all host config (settings, skills, plugins, MCP servers) when the host config directory exceeds 64 MiB; added `--host-config-snapshot disk|memory`
entries.zh: 修复了当主机配置目录超过 64 MiB 时，自托管运行器会话会默默丢失所有主机配置（设置、技能、插件、MCP 服务器）的问题；添加了`--host-config-snapshot磁盘|内存`

entries.en: Fixed skills synced from claude.ai staying on disk indefinitely after signing out; copies not refreshed within `cleanupPeriodDays` now move to the recoverable trash at the next launch
entries.zh: 修复了从 claude.ai 同步的技能在注销后无限期保留在磁盘上的问题；在`cleanupPeriodDays`内未刷新的副本现在会在下次启动时移至可回收垃圾箱

entries.en: Fixed spinner tips suggesting commands that aren't available for your account type or are disabled in your session
entries.zh: 修复了微调器提示建议的命令不适用于您的帐户类型或在您的会话中禁用的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/add-dir` path input: the left and right arrow keys now move the cursor, and Enter adds only the typed path instead of also adding the highlighted completion
entries.zh: 修复 `/add-dir` 路径输入：左右方向键现在可以移动光标，回车只添加你输入的路径，而不会同时添加高亮的补全项的问题

entries.en: Fixed text fields outside the main prompt moving a leading `!` to the end of what you typed (`!foo` came out as `foo!`)
entries.zh: 修复主提示框之外的文本输入框会把开头的 `!` 移到末尾的问题（`!foo` 变成 `foo!`）

entries.en: Fixed the interactive `/hooks` menu crashing when a hook matcher is named after an inherited object property such as `__proto__` or `constructor`
entries.zh: 修复交互式 `/hooks` 菜单在钩子匹配器名称与继承的对象属性（如 `__proto__` 或 `constructor`）相同时崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a fullscreen rendering glitch where text kept a stale background color after the box around it lost its background
entries.zh: 修复了全屏渲染故障，该故障导致文本周围的框失去背景后仍保持陈旧的背景颜色

entries.en: Fixed Delete in st and Alt+arrow keys in rxvt-unicode not working in attached background sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 rxvt-unicode 中 st 中的删除键和 Alt+箭头键在附加后台会话中不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed the terminal's replies to capability queries (`^[[?1;2c`) appearing at the shell prompt or in an editor when Claude Code exits, is suspended, or opens an editor right after starting
entries.zh: 修复 Claude Code 退出、挂起或刚启动就打开编辑器时，能力查询的回复（`^[[?1;2c`）出现在 shell 提示符或编辑器中的问题

entries.en: Improved terminal rendering performance: large diffs and long transcripts render faster, with fewer slow frames
entries.zh: 改进终端渲染性能：大型差异和长转录渲染更快，卡顿帧更少

entries.en: Improved startup time slightly by skipping a redundant validation of built-in model data on every launch
entries.zh: 小幅改进启动时间：每次启动时跳过对内置模型数据的重复校验

entries.en: Improved hook feedback: while a SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse or SessionEnd hook runs, the spinner says so with elapsed time, and Esc cancels a prompt waiting on a SessionStart hook
entries.zh: 改进 hook 反馈：运行 SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、PreToolUse 或 SessionEnd 的 hook 时，加载提示会显示已用时间；等待 SessionStart hook 的提示按 Esc 可取消

entries.en: Improved the spinner status during long thinking: it now reads "deep in thought" after 45s, and shows "picking the thought back up" while recovering from the output-token limit
entries.zh: 改进长时间思考时的加载状态：45 秒后显示「deep in thought」，从输出 token 上限恢复时显示「picking the thought back up」

entries.en: Improved dynamic workflows to pause when you hit your usage limit and continue automatically when it resets, instead of dropping the affected agents
entries.zh: 改进动态工作流：达到用量上限时暂停，重置后自动继续，而不是丢弃受影响的 agent

entries.en: Improved Remote Control to leave fewer empty sessions on claude.ai when setup fails on a flaky network
entries.zh: 改进远程控制：网络不稳定导致设置失败时，在 claude.ai 上留下的空会话更少

entries.en: Improved the Claude in Chrome message in cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: it now says the computer may be asleep before it suggests an install
entries.zh: 改进云端会话中无法连接浏览器时的提示：在建议安装之前，会先提示电脑可能处于睡眠状态

entries.en: Improved `claude mcp serve`: a running tool call now sends a progress update every 30 seconds, so clients show it is still running and idle timeouts don't abort a long command that prints nothing
entries.zh: 改进 `claude mcp serve`：正在运行的工具调用每 30 秒发送一次进度更新，客户端能看出它仍在运行，空闲超时也不会中止长时间且无输出的命令

entries.en: Improved Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS sessions: an `alwaysLoad` MCP server that finishes connecting mid-conversation is usable on the next turn without a tool-search round trip
entries.zh: 改进 Foundry 和 Claude Platform on AWS 会话：会话中途连接完成的 `alwaysLoad` MCP 服务器，下一轮即可使用，无需一次工具搜索往返

entries.en: Improved Markdown files published as artifacts: they now render as styled document pages (title header, document typography, syntax-highlighted code)
entries.zh: 改进作为 artifact 发布的 Markdown 文件：现在会渲染为带样式的文档页面（标题栏、文档排版、语法高亮的代码）

entries.en: Improved Artifact tool publish errors: a publish with no file now says to write the page to a file first, and an unsupported file type is reported before a missing favicon
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 发布错误：没有文件时会提示先把页面写入文件；不支持的文件类型会先于缺少 favicon 被报告

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's error when a page declares a capability its contract version lacks: it now lists every supported capability and notes when a newer contract version has it
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具报错：当页面声明了其契约版本不支持的功能时，会列出所有支持的功能，并说明更新的契约版本是否支持该功能

entries.en: Improved artifact watching: a session can now watch up to 10 published artifacts at once for republishes made elsewhere, up from 5
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 监视：会话现在可以同时监视 10 个已发布的 artifact（用于监控在其他地方做出的重新发布），从原来的 5 个提高到 10 个

entries.en: Improved PDF @-mentions to say "page count unknown" instead of a page count guessed from the file size when pdfinfo cannot count the pages
entries.zh: 改进 PDF @ 提及：pdfinfo 无法统计页数时，显示“页数未知”，而不是根据文件大小猜一个页数

entries.en: Improved `/mobile` to show a single QR code for claude.ai/mobile, which opens the right app store for your phone
entries.zh: 改进 `/mobile`：显示一个统一的二维码，指向 claude.ai/mobile，扫码后会打开适合你手机的应用商店

entries.en: Changed auto mode so that a skill's or slash command's inline `!` shell commands follow default-mode permission rules instead of the classifier; a command no rule decides runs as a reviewed tool call
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式，以便技能或斜杠命令的内联 `!` shell 命令遵循默认模式权限规则而不是分类器；没有规则决定的命令作为经过审查的工具调用运行

entries.en: Changed auto mode so a subagent reports back to its caller through a dedicated hand-back call that the safety classifier reviews, instead of its last message being reviewed after the fact
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式，以便子代理通过安全分类器审查的专用回拨呼叫向其呼叫者报告，而不是事后审查其最后一条消息

entries.en: Changed Monitor watches to always have a deadline (at most 30 minutes; 10 in single-prompt `-p` runs) and notify Claude to re-arm, replacing the no-timeout `persistent` option
entries.zh: 将监视器监视更改为始终有截止时间（最多 30 分钟；单提示`-p`运行中为 10 分钟）并通知 Claude 重新启动，替换无超时“持久”选项

entries.en: Changed the IDE selection indicator in the prompt to a `[⧉ …]` pill that wraps with the text instead of squeezing multi-line prompts; delete it with Backspace to leave the selection out
entries.zh: 将提示中的 IDE 选择指示器更改为与文本一起包裹的`[⧉ …]`药丸，而不是挤压多行提示；使用 Backspace 将其删除以保留所选内容

entries.en: Changed the default dynamic workflow size to small on Pro plans and lowered the medium size guideline from 15 to 10 agents
entries.zh: 将 Pro 计划中的默认动态工作流程大小更改为小型，并将中等规模指南从 15 个座席减少到 10 个座席

entries.en: Changed Claude apps gateway, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry sessions so that they no longer refresh a leftover claude.ai login that the session does not use
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude 应用程序网关、Bedrock、Vertex AI 和 Foundry 会话，以便它们不再刷新会话不使用的剩余 claude.ai 登录信息

entries.en: Updated the bundled `claude-api` skill to enable `eager_input_streaming` on streaming custom tools, and to start deliverable-shaped Managed Agents work with `user.define_outcome`
entries.zh: 内置 `claude-api` 技能：为流式自定义工具启用 `eager_input_streaming`，并可用 `user.define_outcome` 开始以交付物为导向的 Managed Agents 工作

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an Attach Open File setting that, when turned off, stops the open file from being added to messages; selected text is still attached
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增 Attach Open File 设置：关闭后，当前打开的文件不再附加到消息中；选中的文字仍会附加

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Hooks and Permission rules dialogs reporting a save that landed as failed, and the Hooks dialog going blank under a plugin-only policy lock or showing color codes in save errors
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Hooks 和 Permission rules 对话框把实际保存成功的操作报告为失败的问题；修复仅插件策略锁定时 Hooks 对话框空白，以及保存错误中显示颜色代码的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Hooks dialog saves: no duplicate hook on replace, a header name retyped in other capitals keeps its secret, and settings.local.json is gitignored before the save returns
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Hooks 对话框保存的几个问题：替换时不再产生重复 hook；用其他大小写重新输入的 header 名称会保留其密钥；settings.local.json 在保存返回前会先加入 gitignore

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed session history showing only the current session when the workspace is on a Windows mapped network drive or SUBST drive
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复工作区位于 Windows 映射网络驱动器或 SUBST 驱动器时，会话历史只显示当前会话的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list's Active filter hiding open idle sessions when Open is also checked in the filter menu
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复筛选菜单中同时勾选 Open 时，会话列表的 Active 筛选会隐藏已打开的空闲会话的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a new chat switching back to the previous chat when the session list refreshed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话列表刷新时，新聊天会切换回上一个聊天的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed open tabs and the side bar keeping the old config folder until a window reload after `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` changed in the `environmentVariables` setting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 `environmentVariables` 设置中 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 变更后，已打开的标签页和侧边栏仍沿用旧配置文件夹、直到窗口重新加载的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed console windows flashing on Windows when the extension runs background commands such as git, ripgrep, and the sign-in status check
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展在后台运行 git、ripgrep 和登录状态检查等命令时，Windows 上会闪现控制台窗口的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock's hover text appearing only after a delay, and the auto-compact icon showing the browser's own tooltip beside its popup
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复提示缓存计时器的悬停文字延迟才出现，以及自动压缩图标旁同时显示浏览器自带提示框的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the Hooks dialog: a save refused because of the settings file itself now opens a popup with an "Open settings file" button and the reason behind "Copy error"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进 Hooks 对话框：因设置文件本身而被拒绝的保存，现在会弹出带有 "Open settings file" 按钮的提示，并提供 "Copy error" 显示具体原因

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the on state of toggle switches from Claude orange to the editor theme's button color
entries.zh: [VSCode] 开关（toggle）处于开启状态时的颜色，从 Claude 橙色改为编辑器主题的按钮颜色

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed a cloud session sometimes taking about ten minutes to respond after its process exited while the session still looked live; sending a message now restarts it right away
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复云端会话进程退出后、会话仍显示为在线时，有时要约十分钟才响应的问题；现在发送消息会立即重启它

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the Routines page on claude.ai/code to a new layout with Yours and Templates tabs and two-column routine cards that show run status, and removed its calendar view
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] claude.ai/code 的 Routines 页面改为新布局，包含「Yours」和「Templates」两个标签页，例程卡片为两列并显示运行状态，同时移除了日历视图

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a Custom network access option to the Cloud environments editor in admin settings, with the same allowed-domains list the environment dialog on claude.ai/code offers
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 管理员设置中的云端环境编辑器新增「Custom network access」选项，与 claude.ai/code 环境对话框提供的允许域名列表相同

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved the Cloud environments admin page: it shows the default environment for Claude Tag and Claude Code, with a link to change it, and marks the recommended kind to create
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 改进云端环境管理页面：现在会显示 Claude Tag 和 Claude Code 的默认环境，并附有修改链接，还会标出推荐创建的类型

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a channel where it stays active losing its working context about once an hour when the conversation is mostly in threads; thread activity now keeps it from being reset
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 所在频道的对话主要发生在话题中时，它大约每小时丢失一次工作上下文的问题；话题中的活动现在会防止其被重置

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a thread that asked Claude to watch a pull request no longer hearing about CI failures, comments and reviews after Claude was restarted in that thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复话题中要求 Claude 关注某个拉取请求的用户，在该话题中 Claude 重启后就收不到 CI 失败、评论和审查通知的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed deleting the first message of a thread Claude had already replied in not ending Claude's work there; it now stops, as it did when a message with no replies was deleted
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复删除 Claude 已回复过的话题首条消息后，Claude 仍在该话题继续工作的问题；现在它会停止，与删除无回复消息时的行为一致

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude holding back a post because of an earlier instruction addressed to a different bot or assistant; only instructions addressed to Claude bind it, and it asks when unsure
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 因更早一条发给其他机器人或助手的指令，而拦截发送内容的问题；只有发给 Claude 的指令才对它有约束力，不确定时它会询问

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the reply-mode card Claude posts on joining a busy channel saying it "sees a lot of automated posts" when the channel is only chatty or large; the card now names the real reason
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 加入繁忙频道时发出的回复模式卡片，在频道只是话多或规模大时，却说它「看到大量自动发帖」的问题；现在卡片会说明真正的原因

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the Environment picker in Claude Tag admin settings: options are labeled Anthropic-hosted or self-hosted, with links to edit that environment or create one
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude Tag 管理设置中的 Environment 选择器：选项标注为 Anthropic-hosted 或 self-hosted，并附有编辑该环境或创建新环境的链接

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed a pull request in a repository reviewed once per PR sometimes getting no review when a commit arrived while its review was waiting to start; it now reviews the requested commit
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复每个 PR 只审查一次的仓库中，审查等待启动期间有新提交到达，导致拉取请求得不到审查的问题；现在会审查指定的提交

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review occasionally posting the same findings two or three times when GitHub reported an error for a review it had in fact created
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复 GitHub 报告其实已创建的审查出错时，Code Review 偶尔把同一批问题发布两三次的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed follow-up reviews re-posting a security finding a person had already resolved when a later push moved the lines it was anchored to
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复后续一次推送移动了安全问题所在的行后，后续审查重新发布该用户已解决的安全问题的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed reopening a finished /ultrareview cloud session in the Claude app starting the whole review over again unprompted
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复在 Claude 应用中重新打开已完成的 /ultrareview 云端会话时，未经提示就从头开始整个审查的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands failing with "Exit code 1" and no output when the session's temp output path reaches 260 characters
entries.zh: Windows：修复了会话临时输出路径达到 260 个字符时，PowerShell 命令报 "Exit code 1" 且无输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed read-only git commands in Bash unexpectedly asking for permission after a session had been running for a while (regression in 2.1.269)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 中的只读 git 命令在会话运行一段时间后意外请求权限的问题（2.1.269 中的回归）

entries.en: Added `claude plugin eval`: run a plugin's eval suite against Claude Code and get scored, reproducible results (JSON + HTML report); see `claude plugin eval --help`
entries.zh: 添加了“claude 插件评估”：针对 Claude 代码运行插件的评估套件并获得评分、可重现的结果（JSON + HTML 报告）；请参阅“claude 插件 eval --help”

entries.en: Added `/output-style [name]` to list and switch output styles, including over Remote Control and in cloud and other headless sessions
entries.zh: 添加了`/output-style [name]`来列出和切换输出样式，包括通过远程控制、云和其他无头会话

entries.en: Added a diff of the files a Bash command changed to the Bash tool result when the Bash tool handles file edits (setting `bashEditDiffEnabled`)
entries.zh: 当 Bash 工具处理文件编辑时，添加了 Bash 命令更改为 Bash 工具结果的文件差异（设置 `bashEditDiffEnabled`）

entries.en: Added `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY` to tag OpenTelemetry metrics and events with `vcs.*` repository attributes; commit events get `vcs.ref.head.*` with `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`
entries.zh: 添加了`OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY`以使用`vcs.*`存储库属性标记 OpenTelemetry 指标和事件；提交事件通过`OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`获取`vcs.ref.head.*`

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS` to extend the LLM gateway `/v1/models` discovery timeout (default 3s)
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS`以延长 LLM 网关`/v1/models`发现超时（默认 3 秒）

entries.en: Added a spinner tip suggesting `/focus` for a view with just your prompt, a one-line work summary, and the response
entries.zh: 添加了一个旋转提示，建议仅包含提示的视图`/focus`、一行工作摘要和响应

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS` (1–256) to raise the Workflow tool's per-run concurrent agent limit for inference-bound fan-outs
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS`(1–256)，以提高工作流工具针对推理绑定扇出的每次运行并发代理限制

entries.en: Fixed the prompt cache being partially invalidated on the turn after a response was cut off at the output-token limit and automatically resumed
entries.zh: 修复响应因输出 token 上限被截断并自动续写后，下一回合的提示词缓存被部分失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed a case where resuming a session after interrupting Claude mid-thought could change how earlier context was re-sent, hurting prompt-cache reuse
entries.zh: 修复了中断克劳德思考后恢复会话可能会改变先前上下文重新发送方式的情况，从而损害提示缓存重用

entries.en: Fixed F1/F2/F4 not working in kitty-protocol terminals and Delete in st, Alt+arrows acting as Escape in rxvt-unicode, and Shift+punctuation typing the unshifted key in WezTerm (regression in 2.1.247)
entries.zh: 修复了 F1/F2/F4 在 kitty 协议终端中不起作用以及 st 中的删除、Alt+箭头在 rxvt-unicode 中充当转义符以及 Shift+标点符号在 WezTerm 中键入未移动的键（2.1.247 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed remote and headless sessions reporting "waiting for your input" while background agents were still running (set `CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING=0` to restore the old behavior)
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理仍在运行时报告“正在等待您的输入”的远程和无头会话（设置`CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING=0`以恢复旧行为）

entries.en: Fixed the terminal's replies to capability queries (`^[[?1;2c`) appearing as stray text at startup in some terminals
entries.zh: 修复某些终端在启动时，把能力查询的回复（`^[[?1;2c`）显示为乱码文字的问题

entries.en: Fixed rows at the top or bottom of the transcript going blank in fullscreen after resizing the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了调整终端大小后，记录顶部或底部的行在全屏显示为空白的问题

entries.en: Fixed a deny or ask permission rule starting with `!` applying beyond the settings source that wrote it; such a rule now applies only within its own source, and a bare `!` negation is ignored
entries.zh: 修复了以“！”开头的拒绝或询问权限规则，适用于编写它的设置源之外；这样的规则现在仅适用于其自己的源代码，并且忽略简单的“！”否定

entries.en: Fixed the git status Claude is told after a compaction: it is now the current status, not the one from the start of the session
entries.zh: 修复压缩之后告诉 Claude 的 git 状态不正确的问题：现在提供的是当前状态，而不是会话开始时的状态

entries.en: Fixed synced plugin MCP servers not connecting when a remote session resumes
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话恢复时同步插件 MCP 服务器无法连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed resumed headless sessions losing a turn's replies when the model was switched or a request was retried mid-turn
entries.zh: 修复了当模型切换或在回合中重试请求时恢复的无头会话丢失回合回复的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal escape codes, line breaks and oversized text from a background task's on-disk record reaching the task list and task notifications when work is resumed
entries.zh: 修复后台任务的磁盘记录中的终端转义码、换行和超长文本，在恢复工作时出现在任务列表和任务通知中的问题

entries.en: Fixed CMYK JPEG images failing to attach with "cannot decode"; they are now converted and resized like other JPEGs
entries.zh: 修复了 CMYK JPEG 图像无法附加并显示“无法解码”的问题；它们现在可以像其他 JPEG 一样进行转换和调整大小

entries.en: Fixed the managed settings approval dialog not naming the collector for a gRPC telemetry endpoint set without a scheme
entries.zh: 修复在启动时设置了不带协议前缀的 gRPC 遥测端点时，托管设置审批对话框未指明收集器名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin `headersHelper` consent prompts showing a URL path that could be misread as a different host
entries.zh: 修复了插件`headersHelper`同意提示，显示可能被误读为不同主机的 URL 路径

entries.en: Fixed plugin errors showing `[redacted URL]` in place of a relative Windows path with a folder name that starts with `@`
entries.zh: 修复了显示`[redacted URL]`代替文件夹名称以`@`开头的相对 Windows 路径的插件错误

entries.en: Fixed missing cursor in the permission-rule, auto-mode-rule, add-directory, session-rename and feedback-review text fields when the terminal's native cursor is enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用终端本机光标时权限规则、自动模式规则、添加目录、会话重命名和反馈审核文本字段中光标缺失的问题

entries.en: Fixed repeated clicks on a `/fork` receipt, each under a second apart, never backgrounding the session right away while it waited for the current tool to finish
entries.zh: 修复了重复点击`/fork`收据（每次点击间隔不到一秒）的问题，在等待当前工具完成时不会立即将会话置于后台

entries.en: Fixed plugin LSP servers that reject `shutdown` params (e.g. rust-analyzer) being left running at session end; `exit` is now sent even if `shutdown` fails
entries.zh: 修复了拒绝`shutdown`参数（例如 rust-analyzer）在会话结束时继续运行的插件 LSP 服务器；即使`shutdown`失败，现在也会发送`exit`

entries.en: Fixed the attribution reminder overriding a CLAUDE.md or memory rule against commit and pull request attribution; lines set by managed settings still apply
entries.zh: 修复归因提醒覆盖了 CLAUDE.md 或记忆中关于提交和拉取请求署名的规则的问题；由托管设置指定的行仍然生效

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions being dropped for text in Japanese, Chinese, Thai and other languages written without spaces between words
entries.zh: 修复了日语、中文、泰语和其他语言中单词之间没有空格的文本的提示建议被删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed synchronized output being assumed from the terminal's name in GNOME Terminal and Konsole versions that do not support it
entries.zh: 修复了不支持 GNOME 终端和 Konsole 版本中从终端名称假定同步输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed `permission_denials` in `--output-format stream-json` results omitting Read, Edit and Write calls blocked by a path-scoped deny rule
