entries.zh: 修复了`--output-format stream-json`结果中的`permission_denials`，忽略了被路径范围拒绝规则阻止的读取、编辑和写入调用

entries.en: Fixed sessions run through the SDK or the desktop app showing an unknown status in other sessions' agent list
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SDK 或桌面应用程序运行的会话在其他会话的代理列表中显示未知状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/insights` failing on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and gateway deployments whose account can't reach the default Opus model by using the session model there instead
entries.zh: 修复了`/insights`在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和网关部署上失败的问题，这些部署的帐户无法通过使用会话模型来访问默认 Opus 模型

entries.en: Fixed organization policy limits not loading for the session when another Claude Code process refreshed the login at the same moment
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个克劳德代码进程同时刷新登录时不会加载会话的组织策略限制

entries.en: Fixed Claude Desktop sessions using Bedrock, Vertex, or a gateway not getting the contextual "what Claude needs" turn-end notification text
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Bedrock、Vertex 或网关的 Claude 桌面会话无法获取上下文“Claude 需要什么”的回合结束通知文本

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers reconnecting when an updated config only changed the order of the server URL's query parameters
entries.zh: 修复了当更新的配置仅更改服务器 URL 查询参数的顺序时 MCP 服务器重新连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed the prompt box's top border splitting into extra lines when viewing a background agent whose name or description has line breaks or is wider than the terminal
entries.zh: 修复查看名称或描述包含换行或比终端更宽的后台智能体时，提示框顶部边框被拆成多行的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions getting permanently stuck on "Prompt is too long" when auto-compaction had no complete earlier exchange to summarize (mostly Agent SDK sessions with very large prompts)
entries.zh: 修复了当自动压缩没有完整的早期交换进行总结时会话永久卡在“提示太长”的问题（主要是具有非常大提示的 Agent SDK 会话）

entries.en: Fixed `/goal` runs silently stalling after API errors, network drops, or token limits: the goal now retries with backoff, or pauses and says why, including until a usage limit resets
entries.zh: 修复了`/goal`在 API 错误、网络中断或令牌限制后无提示运行的问题：目标现在通过退避重试，或暂停并说明原因，包括直到使用限制重置

entries.en: Fixed prompt cache misses in cloud sessions by waiting briefly for server configuration before the first request
entries.zh: 通过在第一个请求之前短暂等待服务器配置来修复云会话中的提示缓存丢失

entries.en: Fixed `/btw` answers that contained made-up tool calls and output: the side question is now told not to write them, and any that appear are flagged as not executed
entries.zh: 修复了包含虚构工具调用和输出的`/btw`答案：现在告诉附带问题不要写它们，并且任何出现的问题都被标记为未执行

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that had failed with an API error over 6 hours earlier, or longer ago than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` when set
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN`重新运行因 API 错误而失败的回合，该回合早于 6 小时或比设置时的`CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS`更早

entries.en: Fixed organization plugins enabled through managed settings not loading in headless sessions and on Claude Desktop (once Desktop bundles this CLI version); they load from the next session
entries.zh: 修复了通过托管设置启用的组织插件无法在无头会话和 Claude Desktop 上加载（一旦 Desktop 捆绑此 CLI 版本）；他们从下一个会话加载

entries.en: Fixed plugin archives extracted for a session being readable by other local users, extracted files keeping world-writable bits from the archive, and stale files surviving re-extraction
entries.zh: 修复了为其他本地用户可读的会话提取的插件存档、提取的文件保留存档中的世界可写位以及陈旧文件在重新提取中幸存的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Edit()` deny rules and the write-path check not applying to the file a Bash `tee` command writes; a `Bash(tee:*)` allow rule no longer covers destinations outside the working directories
entries.zh: 修复了`Edit()`拒绝规则和写入路径检查不适用于 Bash`tee`命令写入的文件的问题； `Bash(tee:*)` 允许规则不再涵盖工作目录之外的目的地

entries.en: Fixed stray characters like `22c`, or a terminal's color or version reply, being typed into the prompt at startup over slow connections (ssh, browser terminals)
entries.zh: 修复了在启动时通过慢速连接（ssh、浏览器终端）在提示符中键入`22c`等杂散字符或终端的颜色或版本回复的问题

entries.en: Fixed the terminal's block cursor showing under the interface in rxvt-unicode after leaving or re-entering fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复 rxvt-unicode 中离开或重新进入全屏后，终端的方块光标显示在界面下方的问题

entries.en: Fixed the cursor block staying visible after returning from an external editor in fullscreen mode on rxvt-unicode
entries.zh: 修复 rxvt-unicode 上全屏模式从外部编辑器返回后，光标块仍保持可见的问题

entries.en: Fixed the interface being drawn twice after returning from an external editor (Ctrl+G) outside fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复非全屏模式下从外部编辑器（Ctrl+G）返回后，界面被绘制两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed the interface being drawn twice in Konsole after returning from an external editor
entries.zh: 修复 Konsole 中从外部编辑器返回后，界面被绘制两次的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed PowerShell tool commands sent to the background stopping when Claude Code exits
entries.zh: Windows：修复了转入后台的 PowerShell 工具命令在 Claude Code 退出时被停止的问题

entries.en: Improved the `/diff` panel to open fully rendered in one step instead of showing a loading state first
entries.zh: 改进 `/diff` 面板：一步打开即为完整渲染的内容，不再先显示加载状态

entries.en: Improved prompt suggestion filtering for Japanese, Chinese and Korean text: mixed-script and single-word suggestions are kept, and meta or evaluative text is dropped as it is for English
entries.zh: 改进日语、中文和韩文提示建议的过滤：保留混合文字和单个词的建议，并像英文一样过滤掉元信息或评价性文字

entries.en: Improved the Skill tool's "Unknown skill" error to name the plugin skill's full name when a bare name matches exactly one plugin skill
entries.zh: 改进 Skill 工具的「Unknown skill」报错：当裸名称恰好只对应一个插件技能时，会写出该插件技能的完整名称

entries.en: Improved keyboard support over SSH and in unrecognized terminals: terminals that answer the kitty keyboard query (such as foot and Alacritty 0.16+) now get Shift+Enter and Ctrl+Shift shortcuts
entries.zh: 改进 SSH 下及无法识别的终端中的键盘支持：能响应 kitty 键盘查询的终端（如 foot 和 Alacritty 0.16+）现在可以使用 Shift+Enter 和 Ctrl+Shift 快捷键

entries.en: Improved responsiveness in long sessions: transcript updates no longer re-process the whole conversation to build the collapsed tool-use summaries
entries.zh: 改进长会话响应速度：转录更新时，不再为生成折叠的工具调用摘要而重新处理整段对话

entries.en: Improved first-party sessions with telemetry disabled: an `alwaysLoad` MCP server that finishes connecting mid-conversation is usable on the next turn without a tool-search round trip
entries.zh: 改进首方会话（禁用遥测时）：会话中途连接完成的 `alwaysLoad` MCP 服务器，下一轮即可使用，无需一次工具搜索往返

entries.en: Changed `/ultrareview --post` to post the PR comment directly when the findings arrive and print the comment link, instead of starting a second cloud session to post it
entries.zh: 更改了`/ultrareview --post`，以便在调查结果到达时直接发布 PR 评论并打印评论链接，而不是启动第二个云会话来发布它

entries.en: Changed artifact database reads that save into the session scratchpad so they no longer stop for working-folder approval
entries.zh: 更改了保存到会话暂存器中的工件数据库读取，以便它们不再停止工作文件夹批准

entries.en: Changed skills synced from claude.ai in cloud sessions to be named `anthropic-skills:<name>`, matching Claude Desktop; the bare name still works when nothing else uses it
entries.zh: 将云会话中从 claude.ai 同步的技能更改为`anthropic-skills:<name>`，与 Claude Desktop 相匹配；当没有其他人使用它时，裸名称仍然有效

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an agent map: an "N agents" footer pill opens a map of the session's sub-agents with per-agent cards, Stop agent, and read-only transcripts
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增智能体地图：点击底部的「N agents」标签，即可打开会话子智能体的地图，包括每个智能体的卡片、Stop agent 按钮和只读记录

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Hooks dialog to the command menu for viewing hooks and adding, editing, or removing them in user, project, and local settings; managed, plugin, and session hooks stay read-only
entries.zh: [VSCode] 命令菜单新增 Hooks 对话框，可查看钩子，并在用户、项目和本地设置中添加、编辑或删除；托管、插件和会话钩子保持只读

entries.en: [VSCode] Added live progress rows for running subagents under the tool-call groups in Focus view
entries.zh: [VSCode] Focus 视图中，工具调用分组下方新增正在运行的子智能体的实时进度行

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Permission rules dialog that lists permission rules and adds or removes them in user, project, and local settings; startup-option, session-only, and managed rules stay read-only
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增权限规则对话框，可列出权限规则，并在用户、项目和本地设置中添加或删除；启动选项、仅会话和托管规则保持只读

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Cancel button to the Switch account screen that returns to your session as the current account
entries.zh: [VSCode] 切换账户页面新增 Cancel 按钮，点击后返回当前账户的会话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view showing a turn started by a delivered plain-text prompt, such as a scheduled task's, as part of the previous turn
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Focus 视图把通过纯文本提示送达的新轮次（如定时任务的提示）显示为上一轮次一部分的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the footer's prompt cache clock hiding its minutes when the panel is narrow
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复面板较窄时，页脚的提示缓存计时器隐藏了分钟数的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list keeping sessions from the default folder when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in a settings file or the `environmentVariables` setting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在设置文件或 `environmentVariables` 设置中指定了 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 时，会话列表仍保留默认文件夹中会话的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a plan preview that finished loading late sometimes hiding its comment box or showing an older plan
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复计划预览加载较晚时，有时会隐藏评论框或显示旧计划的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a plan preview accepting comments that went nowhere after its Claude tab closed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude 标签页关闭后，计划预览接受的评论无处可去的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock and reopen notice for a session compacted after its last reply and then closed, which now reads as cold when reopened
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话在最后一次回复后被压缩并关闭的情况下，提示缓存计时器和重新打开提示的状态不正确的问题；现在重新打开时会显示为冷缓存

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a session renamed in the extension while Remote Control is on keeping its old name on claude.ai/code
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在扩展中重命名会话、同时 Remote Control 已开启时，claude.ai/code 上仍显示旧名称的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" toggle keeping its last position after the setting was reset to default from a terminal
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在终端中把设置重置为默认值后，"Enable Remote Control for all sessions" 开关仍保持上次位置的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed restored Claude tabs not counting as open in the session list after a window reload until clicked, and their row opening a second tab
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复窗口重新加载后，恢复的 Claude 标签页在点击前不被会话列表视为已打开，且其列表项会再打开一个标签页的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Switch account making a tab forget its dismissed usage-limit warnings when you sign back in as the same account
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复切换账号时，若以同一账号重新登录，标签页会忘记已关闭的用量限制提醒的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a session rename being replaced by the generated name after a window reload when the session was renamed during a long turn
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话在长时间轮次中被重命名，窗口重新加载后名称被自动生成的名称覆盖的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the sidebar usage meter keeping a stale per-model weekly limit row after the account loses that limit
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复账号失去某个按模型计算的每周限额后，侧边栏用量仪表仍保留过期的限额行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a rare case where an @-mention sent with the keyboard shortcut while a new chat view was still starting could be inserted into the input long after the keystroke
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复极少数情况下：新聊天视图仍在启动时，用快捷键发送的 @ 提及会在按键很久之后才插入到输入框中的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list jumping down when the Account & usage header appeared a moment after opening the Claude side bar
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复打开 Claude 侧边栏后，Account & usage 标题稍晚出现时，会话列表向下跳动的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved documents and messages written for someone other than the user: Claude now writes them for that audience and names it at the top of its reply
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进为他人（而非用户本人）撰写的文档和消息：Claude 会面向该读者撰写，并在回复顶部注明读者对象

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved screen reader and keyboard accessibility in the slash-command menu, @-mention menu, output-style picker, Send/Stop button, permission and question cards, and onboarding checklist
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进斜杠命令菜单、@ 提及菜单、输出样式选择器、发送/停止按钮、权限和问题卡片以及入门清单的屏幕阅读器和键盘无障碍支持

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the current-file chip in the message box: an X now removes it, replacing the Hide toggle
entries.zh: [VSCode] 消息框中的当前文件标签改为：点击 X 即可移除，取代原来的 Hide 开关

entries.en: [VSCode] Removed the Claude Code items from a session tab's right-click menu and the editor title bar's "..." menu; they could not act on the tab the menu was opened on
entries.zh: [VSCode] 移除会话标签页右键菜单和编辑器标题栏 "..." 菜单中的 Claude Code 项目，因为它们无法作用于打开菜单的那个标签页

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added taking back a queued message in a cloud session before Claude reads it: remove it from the queue, or press Esc or Up, and the text returns to the message box
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 云端会话中，排队的消息在 Claude 读取前可以收回：从队列中移除，或按 Esc 或上箭头，文字会回到输入框

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed `/model default` in a cloud session leaving every later message failing in organizations that restrict which models Claude Code can use
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复云端会话中执行 `/model default` 后，在限制 Claude Code 可用模型的组织中，之后每条消息都失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed one-off scheduled routines occasionally running a second time after a transient server error
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复一次性定时例程在遇到临时服务器错误后，偶尔会再运行一次的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed routine runs that use subagents sometimes being treated as finished too early, which could skip the retry after a real failure or start a duplicate run
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复使用子智能体的例程运行有时被过早判定为结束的问题，这可能导致跳过真实失败后的重试，或启动重复运行

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed file links in cloud session transcripts opening a GitHub 404 when Claude was working from a subfolder of the repository
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复 Claude 在仓库子文件夹中工作时，云端会话记录里的文件链接打开 GitHub 404 页面的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the Cloud environments admin page to list every environment instead of capping each table at five rows behind a Show more control that could be unreachable
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 云端环境管理页面现在列出所有环境，不再把每个表格限制为 5 行并藏在可能点不到的「Show more」后面

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed claude.ai/code for Free-plan users to open the plans page with a path to upgrade, instead of a "Disabled by org admin" page with no way forward
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] claude.ai/code 对免费套餐用户改为打开套餐页面并提供升级路径，不再显示没有出路的「Disabled by org admin」页面

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a confirmation dialog before Connect all or Disconnect on a GitHub installation in admin settings, to guard against accidental organization-wide changes
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 在管理设置中对 GitHub 安装执行「Connect all」或「Disconnect」前，新增确认对话框，防止误操作影响整个组织

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed threads occasionally going silent after a failed turn because the failure notice was dropped when Slack briefly rate-limited it; the notice is now retried
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复失败的一轮对话后，话题有时会变得沉默，因为 Slack 短暂限流时丢弃了失败通知；现在会重试发送该通知

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude accepting a switch to a model your organization hasn't enabled and then quietly answering with a fallback model; it now declines and says an admin can enable it
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 接受切换到组织未启用的模型，然后悄悄用备用模型回答的问题；现在会拒绝切换，并说明管理员可以启用该模型

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a table posting as raw pipe text when Claude attached files to the same message; the table now posts as a normal reply and the files follow with a plain caption
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 同时附加文件时，表格以原始竖线文本发出的问题；现在表格会作为普通回复发出，文件随后以简单说明发送

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` at the top level of a channel where Claude isn't active starting an unrelated conversation; it now privately says there is nothing to restart
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在 Claude 未启用的频道顶层输入 `@Claude !restart` 时，会开启一段无关对话的问题；现在它会私下提示没有可重启的内容

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed plugin rows in Slack access settings showing an unlabeled raw ID with no way to turn the plugin off; they now show its name and link to the bundle that manages it
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 访问设置中的插件行显示无标签的原始 ID、且无法关闭插件的问题；现在会显示插件名称，并链接到管理它的访问包

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the shared-session banner and Share dialog on sessions started from Slack claiming the whole organization could open the link; they now name the Slack channel's audience
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复从 Slack 发起的会话中，共享会话横幅和 Share 对话框声称整个组织都能打开链接的问题；现在会注明 Slack 频道的受众范围

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved load time of the admin settings page and its Slack channel picker, most noticeably for organizations with many channels or several connected workspaces
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进管理设置页面及其 Slack 频道选择器的加载速度，对频道很多或连接了多个工作区的组织尤为明显

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved scheduled routines in Slack channels: a routine run can now reply in an existing thread instead of always posting a new top-level channel message
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Slack 频道中的定时例程：例程运行现在可以在已有话题中回复，而不是总是发布新的顶层频道消息

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the timestamp on Claude's live progress checklists to show each reader's local time and how long ago it was updated, instead of a fixed UTC time
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude 实时进度清单上的时间戳：现在显示每位查看者的本地时间，以及距上次更新过去了多久，而不是固定的 UTC 时间

entries.en: Added to the Claude apps gateway: with `pricing:` set in `gateway.yaml`, signed-in Claude Code clients receive the same rates through managed settings, so `/cost` and telemetry match the spend meter
entries.zh: 添加到 Claude 应用程序网关：通过在`gateway.yaml`中设置`pricing:`，登录的 Claude Code 客户端通过托管设置接收相同的费率，因此`/cost`和遥测与支出表匹配

entries.en: Added a startup warning for gateways when `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty, and a one-time warning the first time a request arrives from a public address
entries.zh: 添加了当`access_control.allow_cidrs`为空时网关的启动警告，以及第一次从公共地址到达请求时的一次性警告

entries.en: Added the `gatewayInternalNetworks` managed setting, letting administrators allow `/login` to a Claude apps gateway on their organization's own public IPv4 block
entries.zh: 添加了`gatewayInternalNetworks`托管设置，让管理员允许`/login`访问其组织自己的公共 IPv4 块上的 Claude 应用程序网关

entries.en: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --remove-session-state` (default off): delete each session's per-session directories under `<base-dir>/_sessions/` when the session ends
entries.zh: 添加了`claude self-hosted-runner --remove-session-state`（默认关闭）：在会话结束时删除`<base-dir>/_sessions/`下每个会话的每个会话目录

entries.en: Added `configDirectory` to the output of `claude auth status --json`
entries.zh: 将`configDirectory`添加到`claude auth status --json`的输出中

entries.en: Added `--json` to `claude plugin install`, `uninstall`, `update`, `enable` and `disable`, and `errorDetails`/`noteDetails` to each row of `claude plugin list --json`
entries.zh: 在“claude插件安装”、“卸载”、“更新”、“启用”和“禁用”中添加了`--json`，在“克劳德插件列表--json”的每一行添加了`errorDetails`/`noteDetails`

entries.en: Added browser-tab icons for published artifacts, chosen by Claude to match each page
entries.zh: 添加了已发布工件的浏览器选项卡图标，由克劳德选择以匹配每个页面

entries.en: Fixed every turn failing with HTTP 400 on third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoints (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) since 2.1.265: a regex in the Artifact tool's input schema that those endpoints reject
entries.zh: 修复了自 2.1.265 起第三方 Anthropic 兼容端点 (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) 上的 HTTP 400 失败的每个回合：Artifact 工具的输入模式中的正则表达式被这些端点拒绝

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch hanging indefinitely on a server that keeps the response open without finishing; a fetch now fails after 300 seconds. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS` to override the deadline (0 turns it off)
entries.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 无限期挂在服务器上的问题，该问题使响应保持打开状态而未完成；现在，提取会在 300 秒后失败。设置`CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS`以覆盖截止日期（0 将其关闭）

entries.en: Fixed a respawned in-process teammate picking up tools or a system prompt from a same-named agent file in a folder you have not trusted
entries.zh: 修复了重生的进程内队友从您不信任的文件夹中的同名代理文件中拾取工具或系统提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed sustained high CPU usage: a busy loop in long-running idle sessions no longer pins a CPU core, and rapid terminal focus reports during a session recap no longer keep the CPU high
entries.zh: 修复了持续较高的 CPU 使用率：长时间运行的空闲会话中的繁忙循环不再固定 CPU 核心，并且会话回顾期间的快速终端焦点报告不再使 CPU 保持较高水平

entries.en: Fixed Claude sometimes replying "your message came through empty" after an MCP tool call
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 有时在 MCP 工具调用后回复“您的消息为空”的问题

entries.en: Fixed deny and ask permission rules on symlinked directories (`/etc`, `/tmp`, `/var` on macOS; `/bin` on Linux) not applying when a path was given by its real location, and Bash commands ignoring deny rules written on a symlinked path spelling
entries.zh: 修复了当路径由其真实位置给出时，符号链接目录（macOS 上的`/etc`、`/tmp`、`/var`；Linux 上的`/bin`）上的拒绝和请求权限规则不适用，并且 Bash 命令忽略在符号链接路径拼写上写入的拒绝规则

entries.en: Fixed a case where a Read or Edit deny rule did not apply when an `env -C`, `eval` or similar command the permission checker cannot analyze was on the same line
entries.zh: 修复了当权限检查器无法分析的`env -C`、`eval`或类似命令位于同一行时，读取或编辑拒绝规则不适用的情况

entries.en: Fixed plugin and marketplace errors showing a token or password from a git source URL
entries.zh: 修复了显示来自 git 源 URL 的令牌或密码的插件和市场错误

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` and `/plugin` server details, `claude mcp list`/`get`, and MCP login errors showing secrets resolved from `${VAR}` placeholders in MCP configs
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`和`/plugin`服务器详细信息、`claude mcp list`/`get`和 MCP 登录错误，显示从 MCP 配置中的`${VAR}`占位符解析的机密

entries.en: Fixed prompt caching and extended thinking breaking mid-session for SDK sessions using `excludeDynamicSections`: the first message is no longer re-rendered each request
entries.zh: 使用`excludeDynamicSections`修复了 SDK 会话中的提示缓存和扩展思维中断：第一条消息不再重新呈现每个请求

entries.en: Fixed entitled users being told a model is restricted after restart or in the Desktop Code tab when a cached model-access denial was stale
entries.zh: 修复了当缓存的模型访问拒绝过时时，授权用户在重新启动后或在“桌面代码”选项卡中被告知模型受到限制的问题

entries.en: Fixed a running session silently switching to the organization's default model when another Claude Code process refreshed a stale model-access entry
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个 Claude Code 进程刷新过时的模型访问条目时，正在运行的会话会自动切换到组织的默认模型

entries.en: Fixed long-context 429s on Fable models showing the usage-credits consent prompt instead of the 1M-context message on Pro and Team plans
entries.zh: 修复了 Fable 模型上的长上下文 429，显示使用积分同意提示，而不是 Pro 和 Team 计划上的 1M 上下文消息

entries.en: Fixed workload identity federation via a profile (as claude-code-action configures it): processes sharing the profile could fail mid-run with `401 … jti reused`
entries.zh: 修复通过配置文件（如 claude-code-action 配置的方式）使用工作负载身份联合时，共享该配置文件的进程可能在运行中途报 `401 … jti reused` 失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP server OAuth sign-in failing with "No available ports for OAuth redirect" when the local callback port range can't be bound
entries.zh: 修复了当本地回调端口范围无法绑定时，MCP 服务器 OAuth 登录失败并显示“没有用于 OAuth 重定向的可用端口”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the conversation summary produced by `/compact` and auto-compact mangling text that contained `$` sequences
entries.zh: 修复 `/compact` 和自动压缩生成的对话摘要中，包含 `$` 序列的文本被弄乱的问题

entries.en: Fixed resuming a conversation that ended with `/compact`: its restored-file notes now load in the same order on every resume
entries.zh: 修复了恢复以`/compact`结尾的对话：其恢复的文件注释现在以相同的顺序加载在每个简历上

entries.en: Fixed SDK prompt suggestions, side questions and `/rename` sending the conversation from before a compaction
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 提示建议、附带问题和“/重命名”在压缩之前发送对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `@` file and `/` command suggestions not appearing after recalling a previous prompt with the up arrow and editing it
entries.zh: 修复了使用向上箭头调用上一个提示并进行编辑后不出现的`@`文件和`/`命令建议

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents`: pressing ← again at a natural pace to go back to the agent list no longer gets ignored until you pause for over a second
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德特工”：以自然的速度再次按 ← 返回特工列表不再被忽略，直到您暂停超过一秒

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` session delete getting stuck when a worktree can't be removed: the message names the cause and next step, and for a git worktree ctrl+x again deletes the directory anyway
entries.zh: 修复了无法删除工作树时“claude Agents”会话删除卡住的问题：消息列出了原因和下一步，对于 git worktree ctrl+x 仍然会再次删除目录

entries.en: Fixed background agent and workflow rows in the agents panel expanding to many lines when their text contained line breaks
entries.zh: 修复了代理面板中的后台代理和工作流程行在其文本包含换行符时扩展为多行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Slack sessions losing their Slack tools when org managed settings set an MCP allowlist
entries.zh: 修复了当组织管理设置设置 MCP 白名单时 Slack 会话中的 Claude 丢失其 Slack 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome asking to allow the host "https" when a navigation URL had a scheme but a host that could not be parsed
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome 中的 Claude 在导航 URL 有方案但主机无法解析时要求允许主机“https”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the spinner wrapping onto several lines when the current task's label is long; the label and the "Next:" task line now stay within one terminal row
entries.zh: 修复当前任务的标签很长时，旋转指示器换行成多行的问题；标签和"Next:"任务行现在都保持在一行终端内

entries.en: Fixed the `/bug` and `/feedback` description field showing no cursor when the terminal's native cursor is enabled
entries.zh: 修复终端启用原生光标时，`/bug` 和 `/feedback` 的描述输入框不显示光标的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions served by `claude remote-control` showing a generated name instead of their session title in `ListAgents`
entries.zh: 修复了`claude remote-control`提供的远程控制会话在`ListAgents`中显示生成的名称而不是其会话标题的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` rejecting plugin paths whose directory name begins with two dots, which the plugin loader accepts
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`拒绝插件加载器接受的目录名称以两个点开头的插件路径的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugins silently skipping a default monitors file or root SKILL.md that could not be checked
entries.zh: 修复了插件静默跳过无法检查的默认监视器文件或根 SKILL.md

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch's error for localhost and other dotless hostnames to explain why the URL is refused and suggest curl
entries.zh: 修复了 localhost 和其他无点主机名的 WebFetch 错误，以解释 URL 被拒绝的原因并建议使用curl

entries.en: Fixed PermissionRequest hooks not firing in `--print` mode
entries.zh: 修复了 PermissionRequest 挂钩在`--print`模式下不触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed policy-helper warnings not printing on headless (`-p`) runs
entries.zh: 修复了在无头 (`-p`) 运行时不打印策略帮助器警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` listing a `/fork` background session under its parent's name instead of its own `⑂` fork name
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`在其父级名称而不是其自己的`⑂`分叉名称下列出`/fork`后台会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` and other claude.ai-gated commands to suggest `/login` when signed out instead of showing a Claude for Enterprise migration message
entries.zh: 修复了`/remote-control`和其他 claude.ai 门控命令，以在注销时建议`/login`，而不是显示 Claude for Enterprise 迁移消息

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` not extending SessionEnd hooks that have no per-hook `timeout` (they were still cancelled after 1.5 seconds)
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS`不扩展没有每个钩子“超时”的 SessionEnd 钩子（它们在 1.5 秒后仍然被取消）

entries.en: Fixed `/autofix-pr` and other cloud-session commands saying to retry or install the Claude GitHub App when no GitHub account is connected; they now point to `/web-setup` or the web connect page
entries.zh: 修复了`/autofix-pr`和其他云会话命令在未连接 GitHub 帐户时重试或安装 Claude GitHub 应用程序的问题；他们现在指向`/web-setup`或网络连接页面

entries.en: Fixed cloud-session commands such as `/teleport` and `/remote-env` to explain when an organization policy turns them off, instead of answering "Unknown command"
entries.zh: 修复了云会话命令，例如`/teleport`和`/remote-env`，以解释组织策略何时关闭它们，而不是回答“未知命令”

entries.en: Fixed Bash sandbox instructions over-stating confinement: no unenforced path lists when filesystem isolation is off, and strict mode no longer claims commands can never run unsandboxed
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 沙盒指令过度限制的问题：当文件系统隔离关闭时，没有未强制执行的路径列表，并且严格模式不再声明命令永远不能在未沙盒的情况下运行

entries.en: Improved fullscreen mode: adding or removing a prompt line (Shift+Enter) now repaints as fast as typing a character instead of re-rendering the visible transcript
entries.zh: 改进全屏模式：增加或删除提示行（Shift+Enter）时，重绘速度与输入一个字符一样快，不再重新渲染可见的对话记录

entries.en: Improved `--continue` / `--resume`: the conversation appears immediately instead of waiting for SessionStart hooks, and the first message no longer re-reads the whole transcript
entries.zh: 改进 `--continue` / `--resume`：会话立即显示，不再等待 SessionStart 钩子；第一条消息也不再重新读取整个记录

entries.en: Improved responsiveness during tool-heavy turns by no longer redrawing the transcript for a hidden per-tool-batch reminder
entries.zh: 改进工具密集轮次的响应速度：不再为隐藏的每批工具提醒重绘转录

entries.en: Improved startup time in projects with `.claude/workflows/` scripts: listing them no longer parses each script
entries.zh: 改进含 `.claude/workflows/` 脚本的项目启动时间：列出脚本时不再解析每个脚本

entries.en: Improved auto mode denials: the message Claude receives now names the rule that blocked the action and asks Claude to try a safer method and finish unrelated work before stopping to ask you
entries.zh: 改进自动模式的拒绝提示：Claude 收到的消息会点名被拦截的规则，并要求它先尝试更安全的方法、完成无关工作，然后才停下来问你

entries.en: Improved Claude in Chrome: long page reads now stay inline instead of being saved to a file and read back
entries.zh: 改进 Claude in Chrome：较长的页面读取结果保持内联显示，不再先存成文件再读回

entries.en: Improved the MEMORY.md truncation warning to say how many lines were cut and where the cut starts
entries.zh: 改进 MEMORY.md 截断警告：会说明截掉了多少行，以及从哪一行开始截断

entries.en: Improved the terminal permission prompt for artifacts: it now leads with the ask's question
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 的终端权限提示：开头直接显示请求的问题

entries.en: Improved the prompt footer: an editor or `/diff` selection now shows inside the prompt input, and fullscreen mode shows Remote Control status in the header instead of the footer
entries.zh: 改进提示框底部信息：编辑器或 `/diff` 的选中内容显示在提示输入框内；全屏模式下，Remote Control 状态显示在顶部标题栏而不是底部

entries.en: Improved the "Usage credits required for 1M context" message to say that usage credits turned on mid-session take effect after restarting Claude Code
entries.zh: 改进「1M 上下文需要用量积分」提示：说明会话中途开启的用量积分需要重启 Claude Code 后才生效

entries.en: Improved `/plugin`: installing, enabling or disabling a plugin now takes effect when you close the menu; `/reload-plugins` is no longer needed afterwards
entries.zh: 改进 `/plugin`：安装、启用或禁用插件后，关闭菜单时即生效，不再需要再运行 `/reload-plugins`

entries.en: Changed the system prompt on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to deliver environment, model and settings details as attachments, matching first-party sessions
entries.zh: 更改了 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上的系统提示，以附件形式提供环境、模型和设置详细信息，匹配第一方会话

entries.en: Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry sessions to keep the tool list byte-stable across a conversation (late-connecting tools load deferred instead of rewriting it), matching first-party sessions
entries.zh: 更改了 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 会话，以在对话中保持工具列表字节稳定（后期连接工具加载延迟而不是重写），匹配第一方会话

entries.en: Changed the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) to be offered only on Claude 3.x, Opus 4.0–4.7, Sonnet 4.0–4.6, Haiku 4.5; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` elsewhere
entries.zh: 更改了任务跟踪工具（TaskCreate/Get/Update/List、TodoWrite），使其仅在 Claude 3.x、Opus 4.0–4.7、Sonnet 4.0–4.6、Haiku 4.5 上提供；在其他地方设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1`

entries.en: Changed the artifact data-edit permission prompt in the terminal to a card that shows the document count and who can open the artifact
entries.zh: 将终端中的工件数据编辑权限提示更改为显示文档计数以及谁可以打开工件的卡片

entries.en: Changed local Cowork sessions set to skip all approvals: the Artifact tool now refuses a local file outside the session's folders, or behind a symlink, instead of reading it without asking
entries.zh: 更改了本地 Cowork 会话设置为跳过所有批准：Artifact 工具现在拒绝会话文件夹之外或符号链接后面的本地文件，而不是在不询问的情况下读取它

entries.en: Changed plain `WebFetch` deny and ask rules to no longer apply to Artifact tool reads and updates; use an `Artifact` rule (or `WebFetch(domain:claude.ai)`) to block or gate them
entries.zh: 更改了普通的`WebFetch`拒绝和询问规则，使其不再适用于 Artifact 工具读取和更新；使用`Artifact`规则（或`WebFetch(domain:claude.ai)`）来阻止或控制它们

entries.en: Changed the "N MCP servers need authentication" startup notice to announce each server once instead of at every launch
entries.zh: 更改了“N MCP 服务器需要身份验证”启动通知，以宣布每个服务器一次，而不是每次启动时都宣布

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list, settings toggles, and chat tabs when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in a settings file or the `environmentVariables` setting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在设置文件或 `environmentVariables` 设置中指定 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 时，会话列表、设置开关和聊天标签页出现异常的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the model pill, model picker and command menu going blank in open tabs for a few seconds after a login, logout or account switch
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复登录、登出或切换账号后，已打开标签页中的模型标签、模型选择器和命令菜单会空白几秒的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Auto disappearing from the mode picker in new-tab or just-reloaded conversations when a project or local setting overrides the model named in `~/.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复当项目或本地设置覆盖了 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中指定的模型时，新标签页或刚重新加载的对话中，模式选择器里缺少 Auto 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed session names reverting to the last prompt after a window reload when a SessionStart hook is configured
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复配置了 SessionStart hook 时，窗口重新加载后会话名称恢复为最后一条提示词的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the footer's model pill and Remote Control pill waiting for the new tab's Claude process to start when another tab in the window is already up
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复窗口中已有其他标签页的 Claude 进程运行时，页脚的模型标签和 Remote Control 标签仍要等待新标签页的 Claude 进程启动的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a second Claude process running through its full startup when a session tab's launch arrived more than half a second after its config read
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话标签页的启动请求在配置读取超过半秒后才到达时，第二个 Claude 进程会完整走完启动流程的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed resuming a session from the session list ignoring `claudeCode.preferredLocation: "sidebar"` (it always opened a panel), and programmatic opens resetting that setting to "panel"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复从会话列表恢复会话时忽略 `claudeCode.preferredLocation: "sidebar"`（总是打开面板），以及程序化打开会把该设置重置为 "panel" 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Windows issues: the WSL install prompt no longer appears on machines without WSL installed, and IDE diagnostics are now returned correctly for Windows files when WSL is installed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Windows 相关问题：未安装 WSL 的机器不再弹出 WSL 安装提示；安装了 WSL 时，Windows 文件的 IDE 诊断信息现在能正确返回

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the custom style builder saving a User level style in a folder the CLI does not read when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set through settings
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复通过设置指定 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 时，自定义样式生成器把用户级样式保存到 CLI 不会读取的文件夹的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Added Left and Right arrow keys to change where an always-allow permission rule is saved, for keyboard and screen reader users
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增用左右方向键更改「总是允许」权限规则保存位置的功能，方便键盘和屏幕阅读器用户

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a "Claude Code: Focus last message" command that moves keyboard focus to the newest message in the conversation, for keyboard and screen reader users
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增「Claude Code: Focus last message」命令，可把键盘焦点移到对话中最新的消息，方便键盘和屏幕阅读器用户

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the Manage plugins dialog to apply installs, enables, disables and uninstalls to open sessions without a restart
entries.zh: [VSCode] 管理插件对话框中的安装、启用、禁用和卸载操作，现在可直接作用于已打开的会话，无需重启

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed some artifact permission prompts to omit the "don't ask again" choice, matching the terminal
entries.zh: [VSCode] 部分 artifact 权限提示改为省略「don't ask again」选项，与终端保持一致

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed cloud sessions running longer than about six hours silently losing files saved to persisted session folders; saves now persist for up to a day
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复运行超过约六小时的云端会话，保存到持久化会话文件夹的文件会悄悄丢失的问题；现在保存最长可保留一天

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed "Invalid effort level" errors when a routine resumes a session, or a session starts with no set effort, in orgs where an admin caps a model's effort
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复了在组织管理员限制某模型的 effort 上限时，例程恢复会话或会话在未设置 effort 的情况下启动，出现「Invalid effort level」错误的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved routine creation from a conversation: when the new routine has no connectors, Claude now says so and how to add them instead of only confirming it
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 改进从对话中创建例程的体验：新例程没有连接器时，Claude 现在会说明这一点并告诉你如何添加，而不只是确认创建

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the admin settings page hanging on a loading skeleton or going blank after a transient load failure; a section that fails to load now shows a Retry button
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复管理设置页面在一次临时加载失败后停留在加载占位图或变成空白的问题；加载失败的部分现在会显示重试按钮

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a link from a Slack channel's configure page back to the organization's Claude in Slack admin settings
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 新增从 Slack 频道的配置页面返回组织「Claude in Slack」管理设置的链接

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack Enterprise Grid channel losing its Claude settings (repository, environment, access) after a Slack admin moved it to another workspace
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 管理员把 Enterprise Grid 频道转移到另一个工作区后，该频道丢失 Claude 设置（仓库、环境、访问权限）的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved how Claude explains a blocked action: it now says whether a permission check, its own decision to confirm first, or missing access stopped it
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude 解释被阻止操作的方式：现在会说明是权限检查、它自己决定先确认，还是缺少访问权限导致的阻止

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved reply speed: Claude now runs several read-only lookups (searching Slack, reading a thread, finding people) at once instead of one after another
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进回复速度：Claude 现在会同时执行多个只读查询（搜索 Slack、读取话题、查找人员），而不是逐个执行

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved formatting of comparisons: sentence-length comparisons now come as lists instead of wide tables that scroll sideways, and long table cells wrap
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进对比内容的格式：句子长度的对比现在以列表呈现，不再用需要横向滚动的宽表格，并且长表格单元格会自动换行

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` in a thread with its own session sometimes also posting a contradictory "this thread is handled by the channel session" notice
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在拥有独立会话的话题中输入 `@Claude !restart` 时，有时还会同时发出矛盾提示「this thread is handled by the channel session」的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the message shown when your Claude account is in a different organization than the Slack workspace: it now explains how to connect the workspace to your org
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进你的 Claude 账户与 Slack 工作区所在组织不同时的提示：现在会说明如何将该工作区连接到你的组织

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Markdown links whose URL is wrapped in angle brackets showing as literal bracket text in Slack instead of a clickable link
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 URL 用尖括号包裹的 Markdown 链接，在 Slack 中显示为普通括号文字而非可点击链接的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a workspace guest's top-level @mention in a channel where guests may use Claude sometimes getting a "your Slack account isn't connected" reply instead of an answer
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在允许访客使用 Claude 的频道中，工作区访客顶层的 @ 有时得到「your Slack account isn't connected」回复而非答案的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a channel's long-running session being replaced with a fresh one mid-conversation; the scheduled refresh now waits until the channel and its threads are quiet
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复频道的长期会话在对话中途被替换为新会话的问题；定时刷新现在会等到该频道及其话题都安静下来再进行

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed channel-settings cards clicked more than once telling the proposing session the change was refused after it had already applied; the outcome is now sent once
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复频道设置卡片被多次点击后，会告诉提出修改的会话「已拒绝」，而实际上修改已生效的问题；现在结果只发送一次

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed memory in public channels: each channel now keeps its own notes, and Claude no longer recalls notes it saved in other public channels; workspace notes stay shared
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 公开频道的记忆改为：每个频道保留自己的笔记，Claude 不再调用其他公开频道中保存的笔记；工作区笔记仍然共享

entries.en: [Code Review] Added a note under the still-open findings list in follow-up reviews: resolving a finding's thread, not just replying to it, stops later reviews from counting it as open
entries.zh: [Code Review] 在后续审查的未关闭问题列表下新增说明：解决（而不仅是回复）某个问题的话题后，之后的审查不再将其计为未关闭

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed reviews sometimes ending as incomplete when one of the agents verifying a finding failed midway; the review now replaces that agent and reaches a verdict
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复验证某个问题的智能体中途失败时，审查有时以未完成结束的问题；现在审查会更换该智能体并得出结论

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed a push-triggered review that was queued behind a running review still posting after the pull request had been converted to draft
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复推送触发的审查排在正在运行的审查之后，而拉取请求已转为草稿后它仍在发布结果的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed reviews ignoring a directory's CLAUDE.md conventions when the PR edited a root file (e.g. README.md) that only shares a name with a file that CLAUDE.md lists
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复 PR 修改根目录文件（如 README.md）且其名称与 CLAUDE.md 所列文件同名时，审查忽略子目录 CLAUDE.md 约定的问题

entries.en: Added `maxEffortLevel` setting (top-level or per model under `modelSettings`): caps the effort level on every provider, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; users can still pick a lower level
entries.zh: 添加了`maxEffortLevel`设置（顶级或`modelSettings`下的每个模型）：限制每个提供商的工作量级别，包括 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry；用户仍然可以选择较低的级别

entries.en: Added `--system-prompt-snapshot off` to render the system prompt fresh on every request instead of reusing the conversation's recorded prompt (for iterating on prompt text)
entries.zh: 添加了`--system-prompt-snapshot off`，以在每个请求上呈现新鲜的系统提示，而不是重用对话的记录提示（用于迭代提示文本）

entries.en: Fixed Cowork scheduled tasks in the cloud failing at startup for organizations whose managed settings require sandboxing
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置需要沙箱的组织在启动时失败的云中 Cowork 计划任务

entries.en: Fixed `/context` and other local command output rendering blank on mobile clients
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`和其他本地命令输出在移动客户端上呈现空白的问题

entries.en: Fixed shift+enter and option+backspace not working after reconnecting to a tmux or ssh session inside an agent view
entries.zh: 修复了重新连接到代理视图内的 tmux 或 ssh 会话后，shift+enter 和 option+backspace 不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed the dim last-prompt header not appearing at the top of the conversation when scrolling up in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下向上滚动时，灰色的"上一条提示"标题不出现在对话顶部的问题

entries.en: Fixed Workflow `agent()` calls with large output schemas being refused in auto mode instead of being checked by the safety classifier
entries.zh: 修复了在自动模式下拒绝大型输出模式的工作流程`agent()`调用，而不是由安全分类器检查

entries.en: Fixed a case where a marketplace entry path containing a backslash could bypass the containment check for fetched marketplaces on macOS and Linux
entries.zh: 修复了包含反斜杠的市场入口路径可能绕过 macOS 和 Linux 上获取的市场的遏制检查的情况

entries.en: Fixed expired AWS or Google Cloud credentials under a host app such as Claude Desktop retrying ten times with a generic "request failed" before the re-authenticate error appeared
entries.zh: 修复了主机应用程序（例如 Claude Desktop）下过期的 AWS 或 Google Cloud 凭证在出现重新身份验证错误之前重试十次并出现通用“请求失败”的问题

entries.en: Fixed resuming a session after `/compact` or another slash command ran via `-p --resume`: a spurious "Continue from where you left off." turn is no longer inserted
entries.zh: 修复了在通过`-p --resume`运行`/compact`或另一个斜杠命令后恢复会话的问题：虚假的“从您离开的地方继续”。不再插入转弯

entries.en: Fixed resuming a large session (transcript over 5 MB): parallel tool calls and their hook output are no longer dropped from the reloaded conversation
entries.zh: 修复了恢复大型会话（超过 5 MB 的脚本）：并行工具调用及其挂钩输出不再从重新加载的对话中删除

entries.en: Fixed managed `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` and `allowedChannelPlugins` to admit nothing, not everything, when unreadable
entries.zh: 修复了托管的`allowedHttpHookUrls`、`httpHookAllowedEnvVars`和`allowedChannelPlugins`，在不可读时不承认任何内容，而不是所有内容

entries.en: Fixed `/login` on machines whose managed settings require Claude apps gateway sign-in: Esc now closes the dialog instead of doing nothing
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置需要 Claude 应用程序网关登录的计算机上的`/login`：Esc 现在关闭对话框而不是不执行任何操作

entries.en: Fixed artifact publishes cut off by a dropped connection mid-upload: they now retry once when Claude Code can tell the upload never completed, instead of reporting an unknown outcome
entries.zh: 修复了工件发布因上传过程中连接断开而中断的问题：现在，当克劳德代码可以告诉上传从未完成时，它们会重试一次，而不是报告未知的结果

entries.en: Fixed `effort:` frontmatter on custom commands, skills, and subagents being ignored on models whose default effort is still pinned (Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8, Fable 5)
entries.zh: 修复了自定义命令、技能和子代理上的“工作量：”在默认工作量仍然固定的模型上被忽略的问题（Opus 4.7、Opus 4.8、Fable 5）

entries.en: Fixed artifact publish failing with an unhelpful error when the page file isn't valid UTF-8 or contains a replacement character (U+FFFD); the error now names the line and column to fix
entries.zh: 修复了当页面文件不是有效的 UTF-8 或包含替换字符 (U+FFFD) 时工件发布失败并出现无用错误的问题；错误现在指定了要修复的行和列

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` `@` directory menu not listing repositories created after the session started
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”`@`目录菜单未列出会话启动后创建的存储库的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control clients that join a Claude Desktop or VS Code session showing a stale permission mode until it was changed again
entries.zh: 修复了加入 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 会话的远程控制客户端显示过时的权限模式，直到再次更改为止

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control` exiting and dropping every attached session when its server credential expires (about 30 days after start); the host now re-registers and keeps going
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Remote-control”在服务器凭证过期时（启动后大约 30 天）退出并删除每个附加会话的问题；主机现在重新注册并继续

entries.en: Fixed the usage-limit warning flickering on and off during a session when requests for different models or modes report different limit windows
entries.zh: 修复会话中不同模型或模式的请求报告不同的限额窗口时，用量上限警告在开启和关闭之间闪烁的问题

entries.en: Fixed earlier reasoning being dropped when an MCP server re-sends, or a built-in tool re-renders, a tool the model already loaded
entries.zh: 修复了当 MCP 服务器重新发送或内置工具重新渲染模型已加载的工具时早期推理被丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a tool that disappears mid-conversation, from a disconnected MCP server or an upgrade, rewriting the tool list and discarding earlier thinking
entries.zh: 修复了一个工具在对话过程中从断开连接的 MCP 服务器或升级中消失的问题，重写了工具列表并放弃了之前的想法

entries.en: Fixed a background worker forked from a conversation adding EnterWorktree to the conversation's tool block mid-session, which broke prompt-cache reuse
entries.zh: 修复了从会话中分叉的后台工作人员将 EnterWorktree 添加到会话中的会话工具块，这会破坏提示缓存重用

entries.en: Fixed mid-session MCP and plugin tools being added to the tool list in sessions without ToolSearch, which broke prompt-cache reuse; supported models now receive them as deferred definitions
entries.zh: 修复了在没有 ToolSearch 的会话中将会话中 MCP 和插件工具添加到工具列表中的问题，这会破坏提示缓存的重用；支持的模型现在将它们作为延迟定义接收

entries.en: Fixed switching models with /model re-sending every tool definition (a prompt-cache miss); commit and PR attribution text now arrives as a conversation note that updates on model changes
entries.zh: 修复了使用 /model 重新发送每个工具定义的切换模型（提示缓存未命中）；提交和 PR 归属文本现在作为对话注释到达，更新模型更改

entries.en: Fixed resumed sessions rewriting the inline tool set when an MCP connector reconnects at a different moment than before
entries.zh: 修复了当 MCP 连接器在与之前不同的时刻重新连接时恢复的会话重写内联工具集的问题

entries.en: Fixed resumed sessions re-rendering tool descriptions instead of replaying the recorded ones when the first turn ran a tool
entries.zh: 修复了第一轮运行工具时恢复的会话重新渲染工具描述，而不是重播记录的描述

entries.en: Fixed prompt-cache misses and dropped extended thinking when a claude.ai connector's tools change between a session and its resume
entries.zh: 修复了当 claude.ai 连接器的工具在会话和恢复之间发生变化时提示缓存未命中并放弃扩展思考的问题

entries.en: Fixed resumed sessions rewriting earlier MCP tool announcements (and dropping extended thinking) before their connectors reconnect
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话在连接器重新连接之前重写早期 MCP 工具公告（并放弃扩展思考）的问题

entries.en: Fixed a prompt-cache break when a print-mode (`-p`) conversation is resumed interactively: the system prompt prefix no longer changes
entries.zh: 修复了交互恢复打印模式 (`-p`) 对话时的提示缓存中断：系统提示前缀不再更改

entries.en: Improved the `/diff` panel: it no longer flashes "0 files changed" and a spinner before settling, and its empty state is centered in the panel
entries.zh: 改进 `/diff` 面板：不再先闪现「0 files changed」和加载动画才稳定下来，空状态居中显示在面板中

entries.en: Improved the Bash tool's description guidance so Claude describes what a command does in plain words instead of echoing the command
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 工具的描述指引：Claude 用大白话说明命令的作用，而不是原样复述命令

entries.en: Improved sandbox guidance so Claude suggests `/copy` when clipboard commands such as `pbcopy` fail inside the sandbox
entries.zh: 改进沙盒提示：`pbcopy` 等剪贴板命令在沙盒内失败时，Claude 会建议使用 `/copy`

entries.en: Improved `--resume` first-render time for sessions with many Bash tool calls
entries.zh: 改进 `--resume` 对含大量 Bash 工具调用的会话的首次渲染速度

entries.en: Improved prompt input responsiveness: keystrokes no longer occasionally wait a frame behind spinner or streaming repaints
entries.zh: 改进提示输入的响应速度：按键不再偶尔要等一帧，才能跟上加载动画或流式输出的重绘

entries.en: Improved prompt-cache stability: subagents and sessions started with `--system-prompt` or `--append-system-prompt` now record the system prompt and tool definitions once instead of re-rendering them
entries.zh: 改进提示缓存稳定性：使用 `--system-prompt` 或 `--append-system-prompt` 启动的子智能体和会话，现在只记录一次系统提示和工具定义，不再反复渲染

entries.en: Improved Artifact tool publish errors: when a publish is refused, the message now says why and what to do about it
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 发布错误：发布被拒绝时，消息会说明原因以及该怎么处理

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` to be reported to the server at registration and to print a warning for each session that still clones through the legacy git proxy
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：`--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 现在会在注册时上报给服务器；每个仍通过旧 git 代理克隆的会话，都会打印一条警告

entries.en: Gateway: Changed `forward_user_identity` upstreams to return a 429 as-is to a developer whose email was forwarded, instead of failing over to the next upstream, so the proxy's per-user limits hold
entries.zh: 网关：`forward_user_identity` 上游遇到 429 时，原样返回给邮箱已被转发的开发者，不再切换到下一个上游，确保代理的单用户限额生效

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the extension host hanging at 100% CPU when forking, editing an earlier message, or rewinding in a conversation whose saved transcript contains a cyclic parent link
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复对话的已保存记录中存在循环父级链接时，分叉、编辑早先消息或回退会导致扩展宿主 CPU 占用 100% 而卡死的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed pasting a screenshot on WSL2/WSLg inserting raw image bytes into the chat input; the image is now attached when the clipboard provides it, otherwise the paste is ignored
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 WSL2/WSLg 中粘贴截图时，原始图片字节被插入聊天输入框的问题；现在剪贴板提供图片时会附加图片，否则忽略此次粘贴

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed chat diff blocks always rendering with a dark editor theme; they now follow the active VS Code color theme, including high contrast
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复聊天中的差异块始终以深色编辑器主题渲染的问题；现在会跟随当前 VS Code 配色主题，包括高对比度主题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed mixed right-to-left and English text rendering in the wrong order while typing in the message input
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在消息输入框中输入时，从右到左文本与英文混排顺序错乱的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed accepting an edit in the diff view on a file with Windows (CRLF) line endings failing with "String not found in file"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在使用 Windows（CRLF）换行符的文件中，于差异视图里接受编辑时报 "String not found in file" 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed @-mentions dropping files whose paths contain spaces
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 @ 提及时，路径中含空格的文件被丢弃的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the sessions list view failing to load in windows connected over Remote-SSH when the workspace folder exists only on the remote host
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复通过 Remote-SSH 连接的窗口中，工作区文件夹只存在于远程主机时，会话列表视图无法加载的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed runaway ripgrep processes when viewing files in large or symlink-heavy workspaces
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在大型或含大量符号链接的工作区中查看文件时，ripgrep 进程失控的问题

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed GitHub Enterprise Server sessions showing your GitHub account as disconnected once its token expired; PR and issue operations now refresh it automatically
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复 GitHub Enterprise Server 会话在令牌过期后显示 GitHub 账户已断开的问题；PR 和 issue 操作现在会自动刷新令牌

entries.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls failing in organizations without the Claude GitHub App; they now use your connected GitHub account and say so when none is connected
entries.zh: [Claude Code on the web] 修复在未安装 Claude GitHub App 的组织中 `gh` 和 GitHub API 调用失败的问题；现在会使用你已连接的 GitHub 账户，若未连接则会明确提示

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added a "Use a custom connector" link to the preset connection forms in Claude Tag admin settings, so you can switch to a custom connection without starting over
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 在 Claude Tag 管理设置的预设连接表单中新增「Use a custom connector」链接，无需重新开始即可切换为自定义连接

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude replying "The API rejected the request as invalid" when the organization has run out of usage credits; the reply now says so and explains how to add more
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复组织用尽用量额度时，Claude 回复「The API rejected the request as invalid」的问题；现在回复会说明原因，并告诉你如何充值

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed thread requests to edit or delete a message Claude posted at the channel's top level being answered with a correction instead of reaching the session that posted it
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在话题中要求编辑或删除 Claude 在频道顶层发出的消息时，得到的是更正提示，而非转交给发出该消息的会话的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed **Connect** on Tool access requests under Admin settings > Review requests failing with "Authorization failed" or showing the requested access bundle as deleted
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复管理设置 > Review requests 下的工具访问请求中，点击 **Connect** 时出现「Authorization failed」，或把所请求的访问包显示为已删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed a 2.1.265 regression affecting LLM-gateway and proxy setups: the undocumented `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY` environment variable, previously ignored unless `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were both set, began forcing Cloud-gateway sign-in on its own in 2.1.265, so configurations that set it alongside an API key, `apiKeyHelper`, or custom auth headers failed every request with "Not signed in to the Cloud gateway". The variable on its own is ignored again; no configuration change is needed
entries.zh: 修复了影响 LLM 网关和代理设置的 2.1.265 回归：未记录的`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY`环境变量之前被忽略，除非同时设置了`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`和`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`，在 2.1.265 中开始强制云网关自行登录，因此将其与 API 密钥、`apiKeyHelper`或自定义一起设置的配置auth 标头因“未登录云网关”而导致每个请求失败。变量本身再次被忽略；无需更改配置

entries.en: Added `user.email` and `user.groups` to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway, matching terminal sessions
entries.zh: 添加了`user.email`和`user.groups`到通过 Claude 应用程序网关发送的遥测 Claude Desktop 和 Cowork，匹配终端会话

entries.en: Added support for pointing `--plugin-dir` at a folder of plugins: each child folder with a manifest loads, and children added or removed while running are picked up
entries.zh: 添加了对将`--plugin-dir`指向插件文件夹的支持：每个带有清单的子文件夹都会加载，并且会拾取运行时添加或删除的子文件夹

entries.en: Added a 1 GB cap on tool results saved to disk; the in-conversation preview says when a saved file was truncated
entries.zh: 添加了保存到磁盘的工具结果 1 GB 的上限；对话中预览显示保存的文件何时被截断

entries.en: Fixed resuming a foreground-spawned subagent changing its tool list and system prompt prefix, which broke prompt-cache reuse for that agent
entries.zh: 修复了恢复前台生成的子代理更改其工具列表和系统提示符前缀的问题，这会破坏该代理的提示缓存重用

entries.en: Fixed agent teammates and resumed subagents moving SubagentStart hook context and preloaded skills out of the prompt prefix on later turns, which broke prompt-cache reuse
entries.zh: 修复了代理队友和恢复的子代理在稍后的回合中将 SubagentStart 挂钩上下文和预加载技能移出提示前缀的问题，这会破坏提示缓存重用

entries.en: Fixed resume after the previous process died while a tool was running: the last prompt is no longer rewritten, and the interrupted tool call is kept and marked interrupted
entries.zh: 修复了工具运行时前一个进程死亡后的恢复：最后的提示不再重写，中断的工具调用被保留并标记为已中断

entries.en: Fixed `/model opusplan[1m]` being rejected with "Model not found"
entries.zh: 修复了 `/model opusplan[1m]` 被拒绝并显示“未找到模型”的问题

entries.en: Fixed syntax-highlighted code in permission prompts and messages sometimes omitting a character after a Ruby `?`, Erlang `$`, or Perl `$` sigil
entries.zh: 修复了权限提示和消息中的语法突出显示代码有时会在 Ruby `?`、Erlang `$` 或 Perl `$` 符号后省略字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed the fullscreen transcript jumping by one row whenever the slash-command or @-file suggestion list opened or closed
entries.zh: 修复斜杠命令或 @文件建议列表打开或关闭时，全屏转录视图跳动一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin path containing a backslash bypassing the symlink containment check on macOS and Linux
entries.zh: 修复了包含反斜杠的插件路径，绕过了 macOS 和 Linux 上的符号链接包含检查

entries.en: Fixed plugin directories whose names begin with two dots being wrongly refused as outside the plugin root
entries.zh: 修复了名称以两个点开头的插件目录被错误地拒绝为插件根目录之外的问题

entries.en: Fixed VS Code and SDK sessions occasionally requiring re-login when a session was closed while refreshing its token
entries.zh: 修复了 VS Code 和 SDK 会话在会话关闭并刷新其令牌时偶尔需要重新登录的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions sending the end-of-turn signal before the reply's last message, which could show a reply as finished in the Claude app before its last part arrived
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话在回复的最后一条消息之前发送回合结束信号的问题，这可能会在最后一部分到达之前在 Claude 应用程序中显示回复已完成

entries.en: Fixed background (`--bg`) sessions occasionally being retired mid-turn when a message arrived just before the idle timeout
entries.zh: 修复了当消息在空闲超时之前到达时，后台 (`--bg`) 会话偶尔会在轮流中退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code's own git status and diff probes running clean filters configured by a nested repository inside the working tree
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Code 自己的 git status 和 diff 探针，运行由工作树内的嵌套存储库配置的干净过滤器

entries.en: Fixed the advisor tool and its instructions being re-decided per request from the request's model; the decision is now made once and announced in the conversation when it changes
entries.zh: 修复顾问工具及其说明，每次请求都根据请求的模型重新决定的问题；现在只决定一次，并在变化时在对话中提示

entries.en: Fixed artifact publish accepting connector tool names the connector doesn't expose; the publish is now refused when none of the declared tools exist, and warned when only some don't
entries.zh: 修复了工件发布接受连接器工具名称而连接器未公开的问题；现在，当声明的工具都不存在时，发布会被拒绝，而只有某些工具不存在时，则会发出警告

entries.en: Fixed `/add-dir <subdirectory>` refusing to load a subdirectory's agents when managed settings lock only skills to plugins, and promising agents when only agents are locked
entries.zh: 修复了当托管设置仅锁定插件技能时`/add-dir <subdirectory>`拒绝加载子目录的代理，以及当仅锁定代理时承诺代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed two-key keyboard shortcuts cancelling silently when the second key arrived more than a second later, as happens inside tmux; they now wait 3 seconds and show a notice when they time out
entries.zh: 修复双键快捷键在第二个键于一秒后才到达（如在 tmux 中）时静默取消的问题；现在会等待 3 秒，超时时显示提示

entries.en: Fixed forked skills (`context: fork`) not streaming their kickoff prompt and, with `--forward-subagent-text`, their text turns as progress events in stream-json
entries.zh: 修复了分叉技能 (`context: fork`) 不流式传输其启动提示的问题，并且使用 `--forward-subagent-text`，它们的文本会变成 Stream-json 中的进度事件

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's default component folder that the OS cannot check, such as a symlink loop, being silently skipped; it is now reported in `/plugin` with the error code
entries.zh: 修复了操作系统无法检查的插件的默认组件文件夹，例如符号链接循环，被静默跳过；现在在`/plugin`中报告错误代码

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway's OTLP telemetry relay pausing all forwarding to a collector for 30 seconds after it rejected a few payloads as malformed or too large
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 应用网关的 OTLP 遥测转发器在收集器拒绝少量格式错误或过大的数据包后，暂停向收集器转发 30 秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Discover/Browse and `claude plugin list --json --available` showing no description or display name for marketplace plugins whose metadata lives only in their `plugin.json`
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`发现/浏览和`claude plugin list --json --available`，未显示其元数据仅存在于`plugin.json`中的市场插件的描述或显示名称

entries.en: Fixed `/login` showing "no gateway URL is configured" when re-run in a session that signed in to a Claude apps gateway set by managed settings
entries.zh: 修复了`/login`在登录到由托管设置设置的 Claude 应用程序网关的会话中重新运行时显示“未配置网关 URL”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` claiming a model was "saved as your default" when the settings file couldn't be written; it now says the save failed and why
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`在无法写入设置文件时声称模型“另存为默认值”的问题；现在显示保存失败以及原因

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` from Remote Control waiting on SessionStart hooks and on open terminal dialogs before completing
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制中的`/clear`在完成之前等待 SessionStart 挂钩和打开的终端对话框的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/config` dialog changing height when switching between its tabs
entries.zh: 修复 `/config` 对话框在切换标签页时高度会变化的问题

entries.en: Fixed resuming a workflow run after its container restarted; a resume whose run journal is missing now fails with a clear error instead of rerunning every agent
entries.zh: 修复了容器重新启动后恢复工作流运行的问题；缺少运行日志的简历现在失败并出现明显错误，而不是重新运行每个代理

entries.en: Fixed the `claude-api` skill's error-code reference: model access failures return 404 and unavailable beta headers return 400, not 403
entries.zh: 修复 `claude-api` 技能的错误码参考：模型访问失败应返回 404，不可用的 beta 请求头应返回 400，而非 403

entries.en: Fixed non-interactive sessions (`-p` with stream-json input, Agent SDK, cloud sessions) resetting the shell working directory at each new user message; a `cd` now persists across turns
entries.zh: 修复了非交互式会话（带有流 json 输入的`-p`、Agent SDK、云会话），在每个新用户消息处重置 shell 工作目录； `cd`现在在回合中持续存在

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers configured as `http` that only speak the legacy HTTP+SSE transport never connecting; Claude Code now falls back to SSE as the MCP spec describes
entries.zh: 修复了配置为`http`的 MCP 服务器，仅使用旧版 HTTP+SSE 传输从不连接；正如 MCP 规范所述，Claude Code 现在回退到 SSE

entries.en: Fixed some claude.ai connectors in cloud sessions showing as needing authentication even though they are connected in claude.ai (servers that answer an unsupported request with HTTP 401)
entries.zh: 修复了云会话中的一些 claude.ai 连接器显示为需要身份验证，即使它们已在 claude.ai 中连接（使用 HTTP 401 应答不受支持的请求的服务器）

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions keeping their sandbox container alive while a connector approval or sign-in link waits for you
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话在连接器批准或登录链接等待您时保持其沙箱容器处于活动状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed resumed sessions showing long model-facing recovery instructions in "background task didn't finish" notices instead of a short status line
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话在“后台任务未完成”通知中显示较长的面向模型的恢复指令，而不是较短的状态行

entries.en: Windows: Fixed Read, Write and Edit refusing every file ("symlink resolution changed after permission was checked") when running inside an AppContainer or restricted-token sandbox
entries.zh: Windows：修复了在 AppContainer 或受限令牌沙箱中运行时，Read、Write、Edit 拒绝所有文件（"symlink resolution changed after permission was checked"）的问题

entries.en: Improved `--worktree` startup on large repositories: the new worktree is now checked out in parallel (git 2.32+)
entries.zh: 改进大型仓库上的 `--worktree` 启动：新 worktree 改为并行检出（需要 git 2.32+）

entries.en: Improved `/workflows` agent detail: tool calls are marked running, failed or done, the subagent's task list is shown when it has one, and Enter unfolds the listed calls with their inputs and results
entries.zh: 改进 `/workflows` 代理详情：工具调用标注为运行中、失败或已完成；子代理有任务列表时会显示；按 Enter 可展开所列调用及其输入和结果

entries.en: Improved slash commands typed mid-prompt: matches now show in a list (Tab opens it outside fullscreen) instead of a single suggestion, and a plugin skill is now found by its bare name
entries.zh: 改进在提示中间输入斜杠命令的体验：匹配结果以列表显示（非全屏时按 Tab 展开），而不是只给一个建议；插件技能现在可以用不带前缀的名字找到

entries.en: Improved remote MCP servers that need sign-in: Claude Code no longer registers an OAuth client with them until you actually authenticate
entries.zh: 改进需要登录的远程 MCP 服务器：在你真正认证之前，Claude Code 不再向其注册 OAuth 客户端

entries.en: Improved the time to resume long sessions that read many files
entries.zh: 改进恢复读取了大量文件的长会话时的速度

entries.en: Improved the error shown when an image over the size limits cannot be decoded: it now names the cause and how to fix it instead of only citing the limit
entries.zh: 改进图片超出大小限制无法解码时的报错：会说明原因以及如何修复，而不只是引用限制值

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's read of an artifact someone else wrote: the summary now treats the page as untrusted content and flags embedded instructions rather than relaying them
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具读取他人创建的 Artifact：摘要会把页面视为不可信内容，并标出其中嵌入的指令，而不是照搬转述

entries.en: Updated the `.claude` folder permission option to say what it actually allows: editing files in the project's `.claude` folder (or `~/.claude`) for the session
entries.zh: `.claude` 文件夹的权限选项现在明确说明其允许的范围：在本次会话中编辑项目 `.claude` 文件夹（或 `~/.claude`）中的文件

entries.en: Changed machines with `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in managed settings to be Claude apps gateway sessions from startup, like `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"`; a leftover claude.ai login or API key is not used
entries.zh: 将托管设置中具有`forceLoginGatewayUrl`的计算机从启动时更改为 Claude 应用程序网关会话，例如“forceLoginMethod：“gateway””；未使用剩余的 claude.ai 登录名或 API 密钥

entries.en: Changed image processing to use the runtime's built-in image support; the CLI no longer extracts a native image module to the temp directory
entries.zh: 更改了图像处理以使用运行时的内置图像支持； CLI 不再将本机映像模块提取到临时目录

entries.en: Changed plugin display metadata to prefer the marketplace entry over `plugin.json` on the Installed tab and `claude plugin details`, filling gaps from `plugin.json`
entries.zh: 更改了插件显示元数据，以更喜欢“已安装”选项卡上的`plugin.json`和“claude 插件详细信息”上的市场条目，填补了`plugin.json`中的空白

entries.en: Changed Claude apps gateway sessions to export OpenTelemetry directly to a collector the gateway's managed settings name in `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, instead of through the gateway's relay; sessions without a named collector still use the relay
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude 应用程序网关会话，将 OpenTelemetry 直接导出到`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`中网关托管设置名称的收集器，而不是通过网关的中继；没有指定收集器的会话仍然使用中继

entries.en: [VSCode] Added automatic archiving of sessions inactive for a set period (new "Archive inactive sessions" setting, default 14 days)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增自动归档：超过设定时间未活动的会话会被归档（新增「Archive inactive sessions」设置，默认 14 天）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the sidebar chat coming back blank after Reload Window or a restart when the conversation had been open for more than 10 minutes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复对话打开超过 10 分钟后，执行 Reload Window 或重启，侧边栏聊天恢复为空白的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the timeline dot sitting below the text on the "Remote Control is active" message
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 "Remote Control is active" 消息中的时间线圆点位置低于文字的问题

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added an "Organization policy" line to `/status` and `claude doctor` that says why your organization's policy could not be loaded, such as a proxy not passing the endpoint through
entries.zh: 在`/status`和`claude doctor`中添加了“组织策略”行，说明无法加载组织策略的原因，例如代理未通过端点传递

entries.en: Added `bashOutputMaxChars` and `taskOutputMaxChars` settings to raise how much command and background-task output Claude receives inline before it is saved to a file, up to 128K characters
entries.zh: 添加了`bashOutputMaxChars`和`taskOutputMaxChars`设置，以提高 Claude 在保存到文件之前内联接收的命令和后台任务输出的数量，最多 128K 个字符

entries.en: Added `--append-subagent-system-prompt-file` to read the subagent system prompt from a file, for prompts too large to pass on the command line
entries.zh: 添加了 `--append-subagent-system-prompt-file` 以从文件中读取子代理系统提示符，以应对提示太大而无法在命令行上传递的情况

entries.en: Added `/skill-doctor` to show which loaded skills go unused and what they cost in context, so you can prune them
entries.zh: 添加了`/skill-doctor`以显示哪些已加载的技能未使用以及它们在上下文中的成本，以便您可以修剪它们

entries.en: Fixed typed or pasted characters occasionally landing out of order or being dropped during fast input or key repeat
entries.zh: 修复快速输入或按键重复时，输入或粘贴的字符偶尔顺序错乱或丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/add-dir <subdirectory>` printing a false "couldn't be resolved" error when the working directory is on a `/net` automount
entries.zh: 修复了当工作目录位于`/net`自动挂载时`/add-dir <subdirectory>`打印错误的“无法解析”错误

entries.en: Fixed the Bedrock setup wizard hanging when AWS or an AWS credential helper never responds (it now times out with a clear error), and its model checks failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy
entries.zh: 修复了当 AWS 或 AWS 凭证助手从未响应时 Bedrock 设置向导挂起的问题（现在超时并出现明显错误），并且其模型检查在 TLS 检查代理后面失败

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions discarding a plugin synced from claude.ai when managed settings force-enable it in `enabledPlugins`, then falling back to a marketplace clone that could fail
entries.zh: 修复了当托管设置在`enabledPlugins`中强制启用从 claude.ai 同步的插件时，云会话会丢弃该插件，然后回退到可能失败的市场克隆的问题

entries.en: Fixed being unable to delete the character immediately before an inline `[Image #N]` chip in the prompt input
entries.zh: 修复了无法删除提示输入中内联`[Image #N]`芯片之前的字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed resuming a session losing hook output and other context around parallel tool calls, which changed the resumed request
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话丢失挂钩输出和并行工具调用周围的其他上下文，这改变了恢复的请求

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control showing a stale permission mode when a phone, browser, or claude.ai app attaches to a terminal session or after the mode changes in the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了当手机、浏览器或 claude.ai 应用程序连接到终端会话时或终端中的模式更改后，远程控制显示陈旧的权限模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions showing as still working (stuck spinner and Stop button) after stopping a turn from a connected phone or browser, or after a local slash command like `/clear`
entries.zh: 修复了在连接的手机或浏览器停止转动后，或在使用`/clear`等本地斜杠命令后，远程控制会话显示为仍在工作的问题（卡住的旋转器和停止按钮）

entries.en: Fixed SDK and cloud sessions ignoring a Stop or interrupt sent just after the first prompt, before the turn had started; the turn now stops instead of running to completion
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 和云会话忽略第一个提示之后、回合开始之前发送的停止或中断的问题；转弯现在停止而不是跑完

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control uploading a session pulled with `/teleport` into the connected session, which appeared appended to the original on phone and web
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制将使用`/teleport`拉出的会话上传到连接的会话中的问题，该会话在电话和网络上显示为附加到原始会话

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control's inbound event stream failing behind TLS-inspecting corporate proxies on native Windows
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制的入站事件流在本机 Windows 上的 TLS 检查企业代理后面失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions showing the default effort level on claude.ai when the effort comes from settings
entries.zh: 修复了当工作量来自设置时，远程控制会话在 claude.ai 上显示默认工作量级别的问题

entries.en: Fixed `gcpAuthRefresh` opening a browser at startup when the Google credential check was slow, even though the credential was still valid
entries.zh: 修复了当 Google 凭据检查速度缓慢时，即使凭据仍然有效，`gcpAuthRefresh`也会在启动时打开浏览器的问题

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai connectors staying absent for the whole session when the startup connector fetch timed out — the CLI now retries in the background
entries.zh: 修复了当启动连接器获取超时时 claude.ai 连接器在整个会话中保持缺席的问题 — CLI 现在在后台重试

entries.en: Fixed sustained high CPU usage when a background agent could not be resumed and its wake-up was retried in a tight loop
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理无法恢复且在紧密循环中重试唤醒时 CPU 使用率持续较高的问题

entries.en: Fixed feature flags gated to a newer version occasionally applying to an older Claude Code version running on the same machine
entries.zh: 固定功能标志门控到新版本偶尔适用于同一台机器上运行的旧克劳德代码版本

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` and the VS Code usage panel dropping a model-specific weekly limit row when the usage endpoint is rate limited or when opened right after startup
entries.zh: 修复了当使用端点受到速率限制或启动后立即打开时，`/usage`和 VS Code 使用面板会删除特定于模型的每周限制行

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p --resume <file>` adopting a malformed session ID recorded in the transcript; it now resumes under a fresh session ID instead
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p --resume <file>`采用记录在记录中的格式错误的会话 ID 的问题；现在它会在新的会话 ID 下恢复

entries.en: Fixed the terminal progress indicator (iTerm2, Ghostty, ConEmu) showing the session as finished while a background workflow or agent was still running
entries.zh: 修复后台工作流或智能体仍在运行时，终端进度指示器（iTerm2、Ghostty、ConEmu）却显示会话已完成的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare layout glitch where a box could render with the wrong height after its container switched between row and column direction
entries.zh: 修复了一个罕见的布局故障，即容器在行和列方向之间切换后，框可能会以错误的高度渲染

entries.en: Fixed Claude apps gateway client IP when a trusted proxy appends a port to `X-Forwarded-For`; with an access list set, an unreadable entry now gets 403
entries.zh: 修复了受信任代理将端口附加到`X-Forwarded-For`时克劳德应用程序网关客户端 IP 的问题；设置访问列表后，不可读的条目现在会收到 403

entries.en: Fixed Claude apps gateway telling Claude Desktop to export OpenTelemetry as JSON even when the terminal CLI uses protobuf, so protobuf-only collectors rejected Desktop's data
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 应用网关告诉 Claude Desktop 将 OpenTelemetry 导出为 JSON，即使终端 CLI 使用 protobuf，因此仅使用 protobuf 的收集器会拒绝 Desktop 的数据

entries.en: Fixed Desktop and web showing a session as busy while it only watches an artifact for updates
entries.zh: 修复了桌面和网络显示会话繁忙而仅监视工件更新的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome `file_upload` failing with "paths: expected array, received undefined" in local Cowork sessions run from the Claude Desktop app
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome`file_upload` 中的 Claude 在从 Claude 桌面应用程序运行的本地 Cowork 会话中失败并出现“路径：预期数组，收到未定义”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `SendMessage` to an offline Remote Control session on another machine reading as delivered; the result now says delivery is queued until that machine reconnects
entries.zh: 修复了另一台机器上离线远程控制会话的`SendMessage`读取交付内容；结果现在显示交付已排队，直到该机器重新连接

entries.en: Fixed plugin install hints from CLIs run in background Bash commands: they are now detected, and the raw `<claude-code-hint>` tag no longer leaks into the conversation
entries.zh: 修复了在后台 Bash 命令中运行的 CLI 的插件安装提示：现在可以检测到它们，并且原始的`<claude-code-hint>`标签不再泄漏到对话中

entries.en: Fixed in-process agent-team teammates re-sending their first-turn tool and skill announcements on the second turn, which changed the request prefix and missed the prompt cache
entries.zh: 修复了进程中的代理团队队友在第二回合重新发送第一回合工具和技能公告，这会更改请求前缀并错过提示缓存

entries.en: Improved the `/model` picker and the VS Code model pill to show a model's name instead of its raw Bedrock, Vertex AI, or LLM gateway ID when Claude Code recognizes it
entries.zh: 改进 `/model` 选择器和 VS Code 模型标签：Claude Code 能识别的模型，会显示模型名称，而不是原始的 Bedrock、Vertex AI 或 LLM 网关 ID

entries.en: Improved startup on Google Vertex AI when `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` is set: API client creation no longer re-runs Google Cloud project discovery or spawns extra `gcloud` processes
entries.zh: 改进 Google Vertex AI 的启动（设置了 `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` 时）：创建 API 客户端不再重新运行 Google Cloud 项目发现，也不再多开 `gcloud` 进程

entries.en: Improved streaming performance: already-rendered blocks are no longer re-checked by layout on each update
entries.zh: 改进流式输出性能：已渲染的块不再在每次更新时由布局重新检查

entries.en: Improved the dangerous-`rm` safety prompt to also catch `rm -rf` on positional parameters and inside double-quoted `sh -c` scripts
entries.zh: 改进危险 `rm` 安全提示：现在也能识别位置参数上的 `rm -rf`，以及双引号 `sh -c` 脚本中的 `rm -rf`

entries.en: Improved handling when the API sends no response headers: the retry now waits up to `API_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 minutes by default) instead of another 3 minutes, and the messages say what to change
entries.zh: 改进 API 未返回任何响应头时的处理：重试会等待最多 `API_TIMEOUT_MS`（默认 10 分钟），而不是再等 3 分钟；提示会说明该改哪个设置

entries.en: Changed a Claude apps gateway 403 on the managed settings load (at startup or after `/login`) to say Claude Code may not be enabled for the organization, instead of advising a new sign-in
entries.zh: 更改了托管设置负载上的克劳德应用程序网关 403（在启动时或“/登录”之后），表示可能无法为组织启用克劳德代码，而不是建议重新登录

entries.en: Changed machines whose managed settings pin `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` to ignore a leftover API key or claude.ai login and ask for `/login`; Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry sessions are unaffected
entries.zh: 更改了托管设置固定 `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` 的计算机，以忽略剩余的 API 密钥或 claude.ai 登录并请求 `/login`； Bedrock、Vertex AI 和 Foundry 会话不受影响

entries.en: Changed auto mode to treat a link that packs content into a public diagram renderer's URL as an upload to that site: no longer auto-approved unless you asked for it
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式，将将内容打包到公共图表渲染器的 URL 中的链接视为上传到该站点：不再自动批准，除非您要求

entries.en: Changed the prompt's word-editing keys to match Bash: Ctrl+W deletes back to whitespace, Alt+F and Alt+D stop at word end, punctuation separates words; `keybindingFlavor` no longer has any effect
entries.zh: 更改了提示符的单词编辑键以匹配 Bash：Ctrl+W 删除回空格，Alt+F 和 Alt+D 在单词末尾停止，标点符号分隔单词； `keybindingFlavor` 不再有任何效果

entries.en: Changed `/context` token counting to use a local estimate when the token-counting API is unavailable, instead of extra small-model requests
entries.zh: 更改了`/context`令牌计数，以在令牌计数 API 不可用时使用本地估计，而不是额外的小模型请求

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a "Build a custom style" walkthrough to the Output styles menu that writes a custom output style file and lists it right away
entries.zh: [VSCode] 输出样式菜单新增「Build a custom style」向导，可生成自定义输出样式文件并立即列出

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an Add server form and a Remove action to the MCP servers dialog, so MCP servers can be added and removed without leaving the IDE
entries.zh: [VSCode] MCP 服务器对话框新增 Add server 表单和 Remove 操作，无需离开 IDE 即可添加和移除 MCP 服务器

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a hollow ring in the session list for sessions open in a terminal, another VS Code window, or Claude Desktop, so they no longer look closed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 会话列表中，在终端、其他 VS Code 窗口或 Claude 桌面版中打开的会话新增空心圆环标记，不会再显示为已关闭

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a fold button to permission and question prompts so the conversation behind them can be read without dismissing them; the space beside the prompt now scrolls the conversation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 权限和问题提示新增折叠按钮，无需关闭提示即可阅读其后的对话；提示旁的空白区域现在可滚动对话

entries.en: [VSCode] Added "Archive session" to the session list's right-click menu and gave Unarchive its own icon
entries.zh: [VSCode] 会话列表的右键菜单新增「Archive session」，并为 Unarchive 设置了独立图标

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a session teleported from Claude Code on the web treating a question that was cut off when the cloud session shut down as declined
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复从 Claude Code on the web 传送过来的会话，把云端会话关闭时被截断的问题误判为已拒绝的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session tab's Rename box opening empty for a tab restored with the window; it now starts with the current name
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复随窗口恢复的标签页，其 Rename 输入框打开时为空的问题；现在会显示当前名称

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed collapsed sections in the session list panel briefly showing expanded each time the panel loaded
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话列表面板加载时，折叠的区块会短暂显示为展开的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view showing a tool call as still running after Claude had moved on, such as while a question waited for your answer
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude 已经继续往下执行（如正在等你回答问题）时，Focus 视图仍显示某个工具调用在运行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list's active-row highlight going stale when an unfocused Claude tab's session ID is corrected
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复未聚焦的 Claude 标签页的会话 ID 被修正后，会话列表的当前行高亮过期的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T reopen and deep-link opens placing the Claude tab outside the Claude editor group when a Claude tab has focus
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复当 Claude 标签页获得焦点时，Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T 重新打开和深链接打开会把 Claude 标签页放到 Claude 编辑器分组之外的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session tab's "Add to group" putting a session opened from Claude Code on the Web in two groups; it now moves the entry the session list shows
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话标签页的 "Add to group" 会把从 Claude Code on the Web 打开的会话放进两个分组的问题；现在会移动会话列表中显示的那一项

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the model picker showing models an organization has since disabled until the window was reloaded twice
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复模型选择器在组织停用某些模型后，仍要重新加载窗口两次才会更新的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a tab opened from the session list jumping back to that session, and a tab opened from a Web session restarting its teleport or staying empty, after VS Code reloads the tab's view
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 VS Code 重新加载标签页视图后，从会话列表打开的标签页会跳回原会话，以及从 Web 会话打开的标签页会重新开始传送或保持空白的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `/btw` side-question history from earlier sessions being overwritten when a question is asked right after a window reload or while a settings file has errors
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复窗口重新加载后，或设置文件有错误时立即提问，导致之前会话的 `/btw` 旁问历史被覆盖的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the pending question card not reappearing after the Claude panel reloads when signed in with a Claude.ai or Console account
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复使用 Claude.ai 或 Console 账号登录时，Claude 面板重新加载后，待回答的问题卡片不再出现的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed claude.ai-only features staying visible in a window's other Claude panels after one panel picked up a third-party provider from a settings file
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复当某个面板从设置文件中获取了第三方提供商后，同一窗口其他 Claude 面板仍显示仅限 claude.ai 的功能的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen appearing despite the Disable Login Prompt setting when Claude Code reports no login or a request fails for lack of one
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude Code 报告未登录，或请求因缺少登录而失败时，即使设置了 Disable Login Prompt 仍显示登录界面的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the next queued permission prompt keeping text typed on the previous prompt and accepting an immediate second click
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复下一个排队的权限提示会保留上一个提示中输入的文字，并接受紧接着的第二次点击的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed install-plugin links opening the Claude sidebar without the install dialog in a window where only the session list had been shown
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在只显示过会话列表的窗口中，安装插件链接打开了 Claude 侧边栏却没有弹出安装对话框的问题
