entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the sidebar usage meter staying empty on a new window until the Account & usage dialog was opened, and a 0% usage limit being left out of the meter
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复新窗口中侧边栏用量仪表一直为空、直到打开 Account & usage 对话框才显示的问题，以及 0% 的用量限额未出现在仪表中的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Start new session in this group" losing the group after New conversation, and a missing unread dot for a session that finished before the sidebar's unread list loaded
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 "Start new session in this group" 在 New conversation 后丢失分组的问题，以及会话在侧边栏未读列表加载前已结束时缺少未读小红点的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the editor tab badge showing unread during a running turn or missing on a tab opened from the session list, and "Add Session Tab to Group" doing nothing for an archived session
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复编辑器标签页角标在轮次运行时显示未读、或从会话列表打开的标签页上缺失的问题；以及 "Add Session Tab to Group" 对已归档会话无效的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" so flipping it also applies right away to sessions open in other VS Code windows
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" 开关后，对其他 VS Code 窗口中已打开的会话也立即生效

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list's Open filter for sessions continued from claude.ai whose tab was still recorded under the web session, and labeled the filter menu's sections for screen readers
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复从 claude.ai 继续的会话，其标签页仍被记录在 Web 会话下时，会话列表的 Open 筛选无法识别的问题；并为屏幕阅读器标注了筛选菜单的分区

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the model picker to one flat list of every model, with rows kept for older model spellings listed last
entries.zh: [VSCode] 模型选择器改为一个扁平列表展示所有模型，旧版模型写法的条目放在最后

entries.en: Added a diff panel that opens beside the conversation in fullscreen mode and shows your uncommitted changes as Claude edits; toggle it with `/diff`
entries.zh: 添加了一个差异面板，该面板在全屏模式下在对话旁边打开，并在 Claude 编辑时显示您未提交的更改；使用 `/diff` 切换它

entries.en: Added a likely cause for prompt-cache misses (e.g. tool definitions or system prompt changed, idle past the TTL) to `/cost` and the status line's `prompt_cache` field
entries.zh: 添加了提示缓存未命中的可能原因（例如工具定义或系统提示更改、超过 TTL 空闲）到`/cost`和状态行的`prompt_cache`字段

entries.en: Added `/reload-plugins` to headless sessions, so it appears in the Claude Code Desktop and SDK command lists
entries.zh: 将`/reload-plugins`添加到无头会话中，因此它出现在 Claude Code Desktop 和 SDK 命令列表中

entries.en: Added a text form of `/advisor` (`/advisor`, `/advisor <model>`, `/advisor off`) for the desktop app, Remote Control, and other headless (`-p`/Agent SDK) sessions
entries.zh: 为桌面应用程序、远程控制和其他无头 (`-p`/Agent SDK) 会话添加了文本形式的 `/advisor`（`/advisor`、`/advisor <model>`、`/advisor off`）

entries.en: Added `oidc.scope_on_refresh` to the Claude apps gateway for IdPs that return an id_token on refresh only when asked for `openid` again
entries.zh: 将`oidc.scope_on_refresh`添加到 IdP 的 Claude 应用程序网关，仅在再次请求`openid`时才在刷新时返回 id_token

entries.en: Added Claude apps gateway support for newer Claude Desktop keys in `desktop` policy blocks, including `userPluginMarketplacesEnabled` and `userPluginUploadsEnabled`
entries.zh: 在“桌面”策略块中添加了对较新的克劳德桌面密钥的克劳德应用程序网关支持，包括`userPluginMarketplacesEnabled`和`userPluginUploadsEnabled`

entries.en: Fixed `Edit`/`Write`/`Read` permission rules whose path contains parentheses being dropped as invalid or ignored by the Bash sandbox, which left "read-only" folders writable
entries.zh: 修复了“编辑”/“写入”/“读取”权限规则，其路径包含括号，该规则被视为无效而被删除或被 Bash 沙箱忽略，从而使“只读”文件夹可写

entries.en: Fixed one file permission rule with an uncompilable pattern (e.g. an unclosed `[`) making every file edit fail with `Invalid regular expression`; such a deny rule now guards the literal path it spells
entries.zh: 修复了一个具有不可编译模式的文件权限规则（例如未闭合的`[`），导致每个文件编辑都因“无效的正则表达式”而失败；这样的拒绝规则现在保护它所拼写的字面路径

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving zsh commands that hide a command substitution in a REPORTTIME, REPORTMEMORY or DIRSTACKSIZE assignment; these now prompt for approval
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查自动批准的 zsh 命令，这些命令隐藏 REPORTTIME、REPORTMEMORY 或 DIRSTACKSIZE 分配中的命令替换；这些现在提示批准

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock model discovery, token counting and AWS SSO/STS credential calls failing with "unable to get local issuer certificate" when the corporate root CA is only in the OS certificate store
entries.zh: 修复了当公司根 CA 仅位于操作系统证书存储中时，Bedrock 模型发现、令牌计数和 AWS SSO/STS 凭证调用因“无法获取本地颁发者证书”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` on macOS hiding the user's git config from sandboxed git and hiding a worktree-isolated sub-agent's own checkout
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上的`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`，从沙盒 git 中隐藏用户的 git 配置，并隐藏工作树隔离的子代理自己的结账

entries.en: Fixed managed settings not loading for claude.ai Enterprise/Team users who also had a leftover API key from an earlier `/login`
entries.zh: 修复了无法为 claude.ai 企业/团队用户加载托管设置的问题，这些用户还拥有早期`/login`中剩余的 API 密钥

entries.en: Fixed `/status` listing a signed-in claude.ai account and a configured API key as if both were in effect; the credential not in use is now marked
entries.zh: 修复了列出已登录 claude.ai 帐户和配置的 API 密钥的`/status`，就好像两者都有效一样；未使用的凭证现已标记

entries.en: Fixed managed `skillOverrides` entries keyed on a bundled skill's alias (e.g. `checkup` for `/doctor`) not applying, and `Skill(name)` deny rules not covering a nested skill listed as `<dir>:name`
entries.zh: 修复了以捆绑技能别名（例如`/doctor`的`checkup`）为关键的托管`skillOverrides`条目不适用，以及`Skill(name)`拒绝规则不涵盖列为`<dir>:name`的嵌套技能

entries.en: Fixed `model: fable` agents ignoring the `[1m]` tag on an `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL` pin and silently running with a 200K context window
entries.zh: 修复了`model: fable`代理忽略`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL`引脚上的`[1m]`标签并使用 200K 上下文窗口静默运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker not showing Fable 5.1 for organizations that can use it, which was only accepted when typed as `/model claude-fable-5-1`
entries.zh: 修复对可使用 Fable 5.1 的组织，`/model` 选择器未显示该模型的问题（此前只能手动输入 `/model claude-fable-5-1` 才能使用）

entries.en: Fixed prompt caching on Claude Fable 5.1 not covering the context attached after tool results, so it was re-sent as uncached input on every tool-call turn
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德寓言 5.1 上的提示缓存未覆盖工具结果后附加的上下文，因此它在每个工具调用回合中作为未缓存的输入重新发送

entries.en: Fixed model switching staying blocked for the rest of the session after a plugin hook load failure; each switch now re-checks and the refusal names the cause
entries.zh: 修复了插件钩子加载失败后模型切换在会话的剩余时间内保持阻塞的问题；现在每个交换机都会重新检查并列出拒绝的原因

entries.en: Fixed model switching being blocked for the session when an organization-managed plugin's marketplace could not be loaded
entries.zh: 修复了当无法加载组织管理的插件市场时会话被阻止的模型切换

entries.en: Fixed SDK-provided MCP servers (e.g. Desktop connectors) sometimes missing from the first turn and only appearing on the next one
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 提供的 MCP 服务器（例如桌面连接器）有时会在第一轮中丢失而仅出现在下一轮中的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome tools failing with "Not connected" mid-task in cloud-hosted claude.ai sessions when a connector was added or removed
entries.zh: 修复了添加或删除连接器时，Chrome 工具中的 Claude 在云托管的 claude.ai 会话中出现“未连接”任务中期失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed flags, joined emoji and accented letters splitting across wrapped lines, and stale text staying on screen when a flag or joined emoji falls in the terminal's last two columns (now shown as `…`)
entries.zh: 修复了标志、连接的表情符号和重音字母在换行中分开，以及当标志或连接的表情符号落在终端的最后两列中时，过时的文本留在屏幕上（现在显示为“...”）

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control accepting a model pick that is not a valid model name; it is now refused with an error instead of failing on the next message
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制接受不是有效模型名称的模型选择的问题；现在它被拒绝并出现错误，而不是在下一条消息上失败

entries.en: Fixed `/rewind` and `--rewind-files` reporting success when checkpoint backup files were missing and nothing was actually restored
entries.zh: 修复了检查点备份文件丢失且实际未恢复任何内容时`/rewind`和`--rewind-files`报告成功的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/rewind` leaving stale file-read tracking from the rewound-away turns, which caused "File unchanged since last read" stubs and full-file re-injection after external edits
entries.zh: 修复了`/rewind`在回滚轮中留下过时的文件读取跟踪，这导致“文件自上次读取后未更改”存根以及外部编辑后的完整文件重新注入

entries.en: Fixed `-p --resume`/`--continue` (as used by the desktop app) failing on every retry once a session's worktree directory lost its git metadata; it now fails once, then resumes without the worktree
entries.zh: 修复了一旦会话的工作树目录丢失其 git 元数据，每次重试都会失败的问题；现在失败一次，然后在没有工作树的情况下恢复

entries.en: Fixed a subagent that resumed another agent via SendMessage never being woken by that agent's completion (the notification went to the main conversation instead)
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SendMessage 恢复另一个代理的子代理永远不会被该代理完成唤醒的问题（通知转至主对话）

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: an in-process teammate's transcript losing messages, or going blank, during long API retry waits (e.g. under `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) as retry notices evicted real messages
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：在长时间的 API 重试等待期间（例如在`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`下），进程内队友的成绩单丢失消息或变为空白，因为重试通知驱逐了真实消息

entries.en: Fixed a session that moved to the background appearing twice in ListAgents (once as a phantom "interactive" twin with the same name) and receiving SendMessage deliveries in the viewer
entries.zh: 修复了移至后台的会话在 ListAgents 中出现两次（一次作为同名的虚拟“交互式”双胞胎）并在查看器中接收 SendMessage 传送的问题

entries.en: Fixed intermittent "task output swap refused" errors when many sessions share a project directory
entries.zh: 修复了许多会话共享项目目录时间歇性的“任务输出交换被拒绝”错误

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+Z in fullscreen leaving the shell on the alternate screen, drawn over the paused interface
entries.zh: 修复了全屏中的 Ctrl+Z 将 shell 留在备用屏幕上、在暂停的界面上绘制的问题

entries.en: Fixed Workflow tool subagents being restarted as stalled while a long context compaction was still in progress
entries.zh: 修复了工作流工具子代理在长上下文压缩仍在进行时因停滞而重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugins from a URL marketplace failing to install with "marketplace entry path does not stay inside the marketplace directory" when a host app (e.g. Claude Desktop) stores it as a directory
entries.zh: 修复了当主机应用程序（例如 Claude Desktop）将其存储为目录时，来自 URL 市场的插件无法安装，并出现“市场入口路径不保留在市场目录内”的问题

entries.en: Fixed an extra browser tab opening when an artifact is published in a session you're driving from claude.ai, the desktop app, or mobile (Remote Control)
entries.zh: 修复了在您从 claude.ai、桌面应用程序或移动设备（远程控制）驾驶的会话中发布工件时打开的额外浏览器选项卡

entries.en: Fixed the Artifact tool's first call failing with an "Invalid tool parameters" validation error in some Cowork sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 Artifact 工具的首次调用在某些 Cowork 会话中因“工具参数无效”验证错误而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed IDE line selections being dropped when running a skill or slash command (the "N lines selected" context now reaches Claude)
entries.zh: 修复了运行技能或斜杠命令时删除 IDE 行选择的问题（“选择了 N 行”上下文现在到达了克劳德）

entries.en: Fixed repository detection for GitLab projects in nested subgroups (e.g. `gitlab.com/group/subgroup/project`)
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套子组中 GitLab 项目的存储库检测（例如 `gitlab.com/group/subgroup/project`）

entries.en: Fixed `owner/repo#123` issue references in rendered output linking to github.com when working in a GitLab repository; they now link to the gitlab.com issue
entries.zh: 修复了在 GitLab 存储库中工作时链接到 github.com 的渲染输出中的`owner/repo#123`问题引用；他们现在链接到 gitlab.com 问题

entries.en: Glob/Grep: Fixed the search path being probed on disk before the permission check; a missing path is now reported after permission is decided, as Read does
entries.zh: Glob/Grep：修复了搜索路径在权限检查之前就被探测磁盘的问题；路径不存在时，现在会在权限判定之后再报告，与 Read 一致

entries.en: Reverted the 2.1.259 change applying `Read()` deny rules to Bash arguments; it denied `npm run build` under a `Read(./**/build/**)` rule in every mode and made `cd … && grep` prompt even in auto mode
entries.zh: 撤销了 2.1.259 中把 `Read()` 拒绝规则应用于 Bash 参数的变更：它会在所有模式下，因 `Read(./**/build/**)` 规则拒绝 `npm run build`，并让自动模式下的 `cd … && grep` 仍弹出提示

entries.en: Improved structured output: Workflow `agent({schema})` rejects a JSON Schema that can never be satisfied up front, and retry-cap errors now include the last validation failure
entries.zh: 改进结构化输出：工作流的 `agent({schema})` 会预先拒绝永远无法满足的 JSON Schema；重试次数达到上限的报错会包含最后一次校验失败的原因

entries.en: Improved deleting a background session whose worktree has unpushed commits: the message now names the branch and commit count, and deleting again discards the worktree
entries.zh: 改进删除后台会话：若其 worktree 有未推送的提交，提示会说明分支名和提交数；再次删除即丢弃该 worktree

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's refresh-failure log to name the step that failed
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关的刷新失败日志：会写明是哪一步失败

entries.en: Improved idle CPU usage of non-interactive (`-p` / SDK) sessions
entries.zh: 改进非交互会话（`-p` / SDK）的空闲 CPU 占用

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway on Amazon Bedrock: input tokens for an aborted request are now counted with AWS's free CountTokens API (grant `bedrock:CountTokens`) instead of a one-token request
entries.zh: 改进 Amazon Bedrock 上的 Claude 应用网关：中止请求的输入 token 现在通过 AWS 免费的 CountTokens API 计数（需授予 `bedrock:CountTokens`），而不是发送一个 token 的请求

entries.en: Improved the settings error for rules such as `Edit(C:\dir\(name)\**)`, where `\(` is read as an escaped parenthesis rather than a path separator, to suggest an unambiguous spelling
entries.zh: 改进设置报错：对于 `Edit(C:\dir\(name)\**)` 这类规则（其中 `\(` 被当作转义括号而不是路径分隔符），会建议写法更明确的规则

entries.en: Improved auto-compact for 1M-context models: Opus and Fable sessions now compact shortly before the 1M-token limit, and recovery compaction on very large contexts no longer times out at 10 minutes
entries.zh: 改进 1M 上下文模型的自动压缩：Opus 和 Fable 会话会在接近 100 万 token 上限前提前压缩；超大上下文的恢复压缩不再在 10 分钟时超时

entries.en: Improved `/ultrareview` and `claude ultrareview` to wait up to 45 minutes (previously 30) for long-running cloud reviews
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview` 和 `claude ultrareview`：长时间运行的云端评审等待时间从 30 分钟提高到 45 分钟

entries.en: Improved `/effort` on Claude Fable 5.1 so changing effort mid-session no longer invalidates the prompt cache
entries.zh: 改进 Claude Fable 5.1 上的 `/effort`：会话中途修改 effort 不再使提示词缓存失效

entries.en: Updated the bundled `claude-api` skill so its Go, Java, and C# samples use current-generation model IDs, and clarified that cheaper worker or sub-agent models should be current-generation too
entries.zh: 内置 `claude-api` 技能的 Go、Java 和 C# 示例改用当前一代的模型 ID，并说明更便宜的工作者或子代理模型也应使用当前一代

entries.en: Changed `ctrl+l` / `cmd+k` in fullscreen mode to clear the transcript view like a terminal `clear`; scroll up to see earlier messages
entries.zh: 更改了全屏模式下的`ctrl+l`/`cmd+k`，以像终端`clear`一样清除记录视图；向上滚动查看较早的消息

entries.en: Changed permission rules with text after the closing parenthesis (e.g. `Bash(ls) x`), which never matched anything, to be reported as invalid settings instead of being silently ignored
entries.zh: 更改了右括号后文本的权限规则（例如 `Bash(ls) x`），它从未匹配任何内容，将被报告为无效设置，而不是被默默忽略

entries.en: Changed server-managed settings so a managed CLAUDE.md (`claudeMd`) no longer triggers the security approval dialog; hooks, shell-command, sandbox, and unsafe `env` settings still require approval
entries.zh: 更改了服务器托管设置，以便托管 CLAUDE.md (`claudeMd`) 不再触发安全审批对话框；挂钩、shell 命令、沙箱和不安全的`env`设置仍然需要批准

entries.en: Changed Claude in Chrome to follow your organization's Claude in Chrome admin setting; when an admin turns it off, `--chrome`, `/chrome` and the browser tools are unavailable
entries.zh: 更改了 Chrome 中的 Claude，以在 Chrome 管理设置中关注您组织的 Claude；当管理员将其关闭时，`--chrome`、`/chrome`和浏览器工具将不可用

entries.en: Changed Claude apps gateway to send `orgPluginSettings` in the list form read by Claude Desktop 1.15200.0 and later; older desktops ignore it
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude 应用程序网关，以 Claude Desktop 1.15200.0 及更高版本读取的列表形式发送`orgPluginSettings`；较旧的桌面会忽略它

entries.en: Changed Claude apps gateway to also refuse to start, naming the field, when a `desktop` policy misspells a field in a nested object of a `managedMcpServers` or `orgPluginSettings` entry
entries.zh: 将 Claude 应用程序网关更改为当“桌面”策略拼写错误“managementMcpServers”或`orgPluginSettings`条目的嵌套对象中的字段时，也拒绝启动并命名字段

entries.en: Changed commands typed at the `!` bash-mode prompt to run outside the sandbox even when strict sandbox mode (`sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`) is on, like typing into your own terminal
entries.zh: 更改了在 bash 模式提示符处键入的命令，使其在沙箱之外运行，即使在严格沙箱模式（`sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`）打开时也是如此，就像在您自己的终端中输入一样

entries.en: Changed self-hosted runner `--kill-session-after-min` to release a session that is only waiting on its user (paused, resumable on the next message) instead of killing it and reporting a failure
entries.zh: 更改了自托管运行程序 `--kill-session-after-min` 以释放仅等待用户的会话（已暂停，可在下一条消息时恢复），而不是终止它并报告失败

entries.en: Removed the one-hour time limit on background commands started by subagents; they now run until they exit or are stopped, matching the main session
entries.zh: 子代理启动的后台命令不再有一小时时间限制；它们会一直运行直到退出或被停止，与主会话保持一致

entries.en: [VSCode] Added the selected effort level to the footer model pill, fixed a stale effort level after switching models, and returned the footer pills to their earlier compact size
entries.zh: [VSCode] 输入区底部的模型标签显示所选的 effort 级别，修复了切换模型后 effort 级别过期的问题，并把底部标签恢复为之前较小的尺寸

entries.en: [VSCode] Added Open and Closed to the session list's status filter menu
entries.zh: [VSCode] 会话列表的状态筛选菜单新增 Open 和 Closed 选项

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the welcome screen disappearing in a new session when Remote Control turns on automatically
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复新会话中 Remote Control 自动开启时，欢迎界面消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session history picker loading a session a second time when it is already open in another tab; it now switches to that tab
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话历史选择器中，已在其他标签页打开的会话被再次加载的问题；现在会切换到该标签页

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session tab's Rename command silently doing nothing while the tab's view was reloading; it now always applies
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复标签页视图重新加载时，会话标签页的 Rename 命令静默不生效的问题；现在总会生效

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a half-finished message, an empty tool card or an extra "Thought for" line staying on screen after Claude Code retried a dropped response
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude Code 重试中断的响应后，半截消息、空的工具卡片或多出的 "Thought for" 行仍留在屏幕上的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" not applying to a session tab that was still starting when the toggle was flipped
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在会话标签页仍在启动时切换 "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" 不生效的问题

entries.en: Added `managedMcpServers` managed setting: organizations can provide HTTP/SSE MCP servers to every user (same entry shape as `.mcp.json`); entries that name a command to run are skipped
entries.zh: 添加了`managedMcpServers`托管设置：组织可以向每个用户提供 HTTP/SSE MCP 服务器（与`.mcp.json`相同的条目形状）；指定要运行的命令的条目将被跳过

entries.en: Added `--permission-prompts none` for unattended headless hosts: anything that would prompt is denied automatically while the active permission mode (including auto mode) keeps deciding
entries.zh: 为无人值守的无头主机添加了`--permission-prompts none`：当活动权限模式（包括自动模式）不断决定时，任何提示都会被自动拒绝

entries.en: Added recognition of `glab mr create/merge/close/reopen/note/update` so GitLab merge requests show as `MR !N` in the collapsed tool summary and refresh the footer MR badge
entries.zh: 添加了对 `glab mr create/merge/close/reopen/note/update` 的识别，因此 GitLab 合并请求在折叠的工具摘要中显示为 `MR !N` 并刷新页脚 MR 徽章

entries.en: Added `--json` to `claude plugin validate` for a machine-readable validation report
entries.zh: 在`claude plugin validate`中添加了`--json`以获得机器可读的验证报告

entries.en: Fixed concurrent sessions silently reverting each other's `~/.claude.json` changes — workspace trust no longer resets and MCP/project state is no longer lost when running many sessions at once
entries.zh: 修复了并发会话默默地恢复彼此的 `~/.claude.json` 更改 — 工作区信任不再重置，并且一次运行多个会话时 MCP/项目状态不再丢失

entries.en: Fixed a conversation whose thinking was rejected once being rejected again on every later turn
entries.zh: 修复了一个对话，该对话的想法一旦被拒绝，之后的每个回合都会再次被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed Bash `Read()` deny rules not covering files given as option values (`--ignore-revs-file=.env`, `-f.env`, `@file`), `git diff`/`git grep` file operands, or `cd DIR && cat FILE` compounds; `grep -r`/`cp -r` over a directory holding a denied file now asks
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash `Read()` 拒绝规则不涵盖作为选项值给出的文件（`--ignore-revs-file=.env`、`-f.env`、`@file`）、`git diff`/`git grep` 文件操作数或 `cd DIR && cat FILE` 化合物；现在会询问保存被拒绝文件的目录的 `grep -r`/`cp -r`

entries.en: Fixed the prompt cache being invalidated when the OAuth token refreshed in sessions with telemetry disabled
entries.zh: 修复禁用遥测的会话中，OAuth 令牌刷新后提示词缓存被失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode showing a blank conversation after a long turn with hundreds of tool calls
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式在数百次工具调用长时间转动后显示空白对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode running a turn on a model it doesn't support when a command or skill's frontmatter `model:` named one; the turn now keeps the session model
entries.zh: 修复了当命令或技能的 frontmatter `model:` 命名为 one 时，在不支持的模型上运行回合的自动模式；现在回合保持会话模型

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` being ignored for Vertex-style model IDs (`@YYYYMMDD` suffix) of model versions Claude Code doesn't recognize
entries.zh: 修复了模型版本 Claude Code 无法识别的 Vertex 样式模型 ID（`@YYYYMMDD`后缀）会忽略`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS`的问题

entries.en: Fixed the live output preview of a running shell command hiding its newest lines when an earlier line wrapped
entries.zh: 修复运行中的 shell 命令的实时输出预览，在较早的一行换行后隐藏了最新行的问题

entries.en: Fixed a background GitHub connection check that ran on every launch for claude.ai users; the result is now remembered across launches
entries.zh: 修复了 claude.ai 用户每次启动时运行的后台 GitHub 连接检查；现在，每次启动都会记住结果

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` failing (and `--continue` opening an empty conversation) when a saved session contains an attachment entry with no payload
entries.zh: 修复了当保存的会话包含没有有效负载的附件条目时`--resume`失败（以及`--continue`打开空对话）的问题

entries.en: Fixed frontmatter `model:` on custom commands and skills being ignored in interactive sessions
entries.zh: 修复了交互式会话中忽略的自定义命令和技能的 frontmatter`model:`

entries.en: Fixed Artifact publishing failing once with an "unexpected parameter `note`" error in conversations continued from an older version
entries.zh: 修复了 Artifact 发布失败一次，并在从旧版本继续的对话中出现“意外参数`note`”错误

entries.en: Fixed managed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` being ignored at startup when a policy helper configured by MDM or the managed settings file had already run
entries.zh: 修复了当 MDM 配置的策略帮助程序或托管设置文件已运行时，托管`forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`在启动时被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree isolation refusing hook-created worktrees on machines where `git rev-parse` fails with a message other than "not a git repository"
entries.zh: 修复在 `git rev-parse` 报错信息不是 "not a git repository" 的机器上，工作树隔离会拒绝钩子创建的工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry metrics and events from cloud sessions missing the `user.email`, `organization.id`, and `user.account_uuid` attributes
entries.zh: 修复了云会话中缺少`user.email`、`organization.id`和`user.account_uuid`属性的 OpenTelemetry 指标和事件

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers that disconnect while their tools are being listed at startup showing as connected with no tools instead of reporting the error
entries.zh: 修复了在启动时列出其工具时断开连接的 MCP 服务器显示为没有工具连接而不是报告错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed the file edit permission dialog sometimes showing a changed line cut short with no indication
entries.zh: 修复文件编辑权限对话框有时显示被截断的修改行、且没有任何提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed repository detection dropping a known repo identity after a transient git probe failure
entries.zh: 修复了存储库检测在暂时 git 探针失败后删除已知存储库标识的问题

entries.en: Fixed managed settings silently going unenforced when the managed-settings file, a drop-in, the MDM plist, or the HKLM value cannot be parsed: Claude Code now refuses to start and names the source
entries.zh: 修复了当无法解析托管设置文件、插入项、MDM plist 或 HKLM 值时，托管设置会自动不强制执行的问题：Claude Code 现在拒绝启动并命名源

entries.en: Fixed Stop not actually stopping background agents and workflows in remote-control sessions: killed tasks now stay visible and re-stoppable until their processes exit
entries.zh: 修复了“停止”实际上并未停止远程控制会话中的后台代理和工作流程：被终止的任务现在保持可见并可重新停止，直到其进程退出

entries.en: Fixed resuming a workflow run while its previous stopped run was still exiting, which could run duplicate copies of its agents
entries.zh: 修复了在先前停止的运行仍在退出时恢复工作流程运行的问题，这可能会运行其代理的重复副本

entries.en: Fixed marketplace repo URLs on github.com with a trailing slash or dangling `?`/`#` producing an unusable `.git` clone URL
entries.zh: 修复了 github.com 上的市场仓库 URL，带有尾部斜杠或悬空的`?`/`#`，生成不可用的`.git`克隆 URL

entries.en: Fixed blocking Stop hooks causing the turn after a block to lose the model's reasoning from that turn and, on some models, miss the prompt cache
entries.zh: 修复了阻塞停止钩子，导致阻塞后的转弯丢失该转弯的模型推理，并且在某些模型上错过提示缓存

entries.en: Fixed remote (claude.ai) sessions taking 60 seconds to start a turn after a browser-hosted MCP server's page had gone away
entries.zh: 修复了浏览器托管的 MCP 服务器页面消失后，远程 (claude.ai) 会话需要 60 秒才能开始一轮的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions refusing common Bash loops, xargs pipelines and launcher-wrapped commands that cannot reach the main checkout
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离的会话拒绝常见 Bash 循环、xargs 管道以及包装启动器命令的问题；这些命令本来无法触及主检出目录

entries.en: Improved terminal resize and first-render performance for long responses by reusing text measurements
entries.zh: 改进长回复时终端调整大小和首次渲染的性能：复用文本测量结果

entries.en: Improved `/workflows` agent detail: JSON outcomes are pretty-printed with syntax colors and real line breaks, and long outcomes fold behind an expand toggle
entries.zh: 改进 `/workflows` 代理详情：JSON 结果带语法颜色并正确换行，过长的结果可折叠展开

entries.en: Improved headless/SDK session start: the first turn begins up to 50 ms sooner when MCP servers finish connecting
entries.zh: 改进无界面和 SDK 会话启动：MCP 服务器连接完成时，首轮最多提前 50 毫秒开始

entries.en: Improved `/install-github-app` to explain it is GitHub-only and point to the GitLab CI/CD docs when run inside a GitLab repository
entries.zh: 改进 `/install-github-app`：说明它仅支持 GitHub；在 GitLab 仓库中运行时，指向 GitLab CI/CD 文档

entries.en: Improved nested background subagent results to be saved in the parent subagent's transcript, so resumed subagents keep them and shared transcripts show the delivery
entries.zh: 改进嵌套的后台子代理结果：保存到父子代理的记录中，恢复子代理时仍保留这些结果，共享记录中也能看到交付情况

entries.en: Changed `allowedMcpServers` to govern only servers users add: a literal `managed-mcp.json` server your allowlist used to filter out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off
entries.zh: 更改了`allowedMcpServers`以仅管理用户添加的服务器：用于过滤掉白名单的字面“management-mcp.json”服务器现在在升级时加载；使用 `deniedMcpServers` 来阻止它

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an Active quick filter and a status filter menu (Needs input, Working, Completed) to the session list sidebar
entries.zh: [VSCode] 会话列表侧边栏新增 Active 快速筛选，以及状态筛选菜单（Needs input、Working、Completed）

entries.en: Fixed remote and scheduled sessions doing nothing after a connector-tool permission prompt was approved while the session was paused
entries.zh: 修复了在会话暂停期间批准连接器工具权限提示后远程和计划会话不执行任何操作的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code failing to launch on macOS 12 (Monterey), a regression introduced in 2.1.255
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Code 无法在 macOS 12 (Monterey) 上启动的问题，这是 2.1.255 中引入的回归问题

entries.en: Fixed remote and scheduled sessions failing with "user messages must have non-empty content" after a re-sent permission approval could not be applied
entries.zh: 修复了无法应用重新发送权限批准后远程和计划会话失败并显示“用户消息必须包含非空内容”的问题

entries.en: Added Claude Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $10/$50 per Mtok with $0.25/Mtok cache reads
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`)，现在是默认的 Fable 模型 — 1M 上下文，每个 Mtok 10/50 美元，每 Mtok 缓存读取 0.25 美元

entries.en: Added "Time format" (`timeFormat`) and `timeZone` settings: 12-hour, 24-hour, 24-hour UTC, or a strftime pattern for the turn-end clock and transcript-view timestamps
entries.zh: 添加了“时间格式”(`timeFormat`) 和 `timeZone` 设置：12 小时、24 小时、24 小时 UTC 或回合结束时钟和成绩单视图时间戳的 strftime 模式

entries.en: Added a Containment Escape rule to auto mode so cloud metadata-credential fetches, egress evasion, and cross-tenant reach are no longer auto-approved unless your environment marks them expected
entries.zh: 在自动模式中添加了遏制逃逸规则，因此云元数据凭据获取、出口规避和跨租户访问不再自动批准，除非您的环境将其标记为预期

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE` to apply `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` (or the main model) to every subagent, ignoring per-spawn and agent-definition model overrides
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE`以将`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`（或主模型）应用于每个子代理，忽略每个生成和代理定义模型覆盖

entries.en: Added `s` in `/effort` to change effort for the current session only, matching `/model`
entries.zh: 在`/effort`中添加`s`以仅更改当前会话的工作量，匹配`/model`

entries.en: Added a `/doctor` warning for stale sandbox mask files left by a killed session
entries.zh: 添加了`/doctor`警告，以防止被终止的会话留下的陈旧沙箱掩码文件

entries.en: Added a one-time prompt in auto mode before the first file read outside the working directories, with the option to block such reads (`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`)
entries.zh: 在工作目录之外读取第一个文件之前，在自动模式下添加了一次性提示，并可以选择阻止此类读取（`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`）

entries.en: Added support for a gateway-supplied `description` on discovered `/model` picker entries (`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY`); entries without one still read "From gateway"
entries.zh: 添加了对发现的`/model`选择器条目上网关提供的“描述”的支持（`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY`）；没有的条目仍显示为“来自网关”

entries.en: Fixed settings in a `.claude/` folder created after startup not being picked up until restart
entries.zh: 修复了启动后创建的`.claude/`文件夹中的设置在重新启动之前不会被拾取的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions dispatched from an agent view opened with `←` always starting in the original session's permission mode, overriding the target directory's `defaultMode` and the agent's `permissionMode`
entries.zh: 修复了从使用`←`打开的代理视图分派的会话始终以原始会话的权限模式启动，覆盖目标目录的`defaultMode`和代理的`permissionMode`

entries.en: Fixed `keybindings.json` rebinds of Ctrl+G being ignored in `claude agents`; its Ctrl+S / Ctrl+T are now rebindable via the new `Agents` context
entries.zh: 修复了`keybindings.json`重新绑定在“claudeagents”中被忽略的 Ctrl+G；它的 Ctrl+S / Ctrl+T 现在可以通过新的`Agents`上下文重新绑定

entries.en: Fixed background sessions failing to start on macOS npm installs during a self-update, and on Windows when a stale daemon lock file pointed at a reused process id
entries.zh: 修复了在自我更新期间在 macOS npm 安装上以及在 Windows 上当过时的守护程序锁定文件指向重复使用的进程 ID 时无法启动后台会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed the working spinner stopping while a response streams behind a slash-command panel
entries.zh: 修复响应在斜杠命令面板后方流式输出时，工作中的旋转指示器停止的问题

entries.en: Fixed a background session's `state.json` `detail` repeating its own dispatch prompt after a scheduled wake-up
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话的`state.json``detail`在计划唤醒后重复其自己的调度提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` keeping a background session you re-prompted buried in Completed after it finished again; Completed now orders by the latest finish
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”在再次完成后将您重新提示的后台会话埋在“已完成”中的问题；截至目前已完成订单

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg` from a directory that was just deleted reporting "backgrounded" and leaving a crashed session row; it now prints the reason and exits 1
entries.zh: 修复了刚刚删除的目录中的`claude --bg`报告“后台”并留下崩溃的会话行；现在打印原因并退出 1

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control connecting mid-session re-sending the Bash tool definition, causing a prompt-cache miss
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制连接在会话中重新发送 Bash 工具定义，导致提示缓存丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a doubly-listed custom `Authorization` header overriding the configured credential on Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, and WIF, and the Vertex setup wizard picking up a leftover Anthropic profile from `~/.config/anthropic`
entries.zh: 修复了双重列出的自定义“授权”标头覆盖基岩、地幔、顶点和 WIF 上配置的凭据，以及顶点设置向导从`~/.config/anthropic`中拾取剩余的人类配置文件

entries.en: Fixed Claude apps gateway sending stray host `Authorization` or profile headers to Foundry, Vertex, and Bedrock, and Foundry Entra ID upstreams not starting when `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY` is set
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 应用程序网关向 Foundry、Vertex 和 Bedrock 发送杂散主机`Authorization`或配置文件标头的问题，并且在设置`ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY`时，Foundry Entra ID 上游未启动

entries.en: Fixed a leftover Anthropic API key or auth token being sent alongside your Foundry subscription key in API-key mode
entries.zh: 修复了在 API 密钥模式下与 Foundry 订阅密钥一起发送的剩余 Anthropic API 密钥或身份验证令牌

entries.en: Fixed `/schedule` routines whose prompt was saved without a message role and then ran with nothing to do
entries.zh: 修复了`/schedule`例程，其提示在没有消息角色的情况下保存，然后无事可做地运行

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` not saying that a background session is waiting for you to approve a message from another session, or who sent it
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”没有说后台会话正在等待您批准来自另一个会话的消息，或者是谁发送的消息

entries.en: Fixed a prompt stashed with Ctrl+S inside an opened background session being lost when the session went idle or was stopped and then reopened
entries.zh: 修复了在打开的后台会话中使用 Ctrl+S 隐藏的提示在会话闲置或停止然后重新打开时丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed telemetry (OTEL) settings pushed through server-managed settings being ignored on warm starts, including desktop-app Code sessions
entries.zh: 修复通过服务器托管设置下发的遥测（OTEL）配置在热启动时被忽略的问题，包括桌面应用中的 Code 会话

entries.en: Fixed a teammate permission request being answered twice when the leader's mailbox write was briefly locked
entries.zh: 修复了当领导者的邮箱写入被短暂锁定时，队友权限请求被应答两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed a phantom duplicate slash-command row rendering below the in-flight turn while a command's auto-continued response streamed
entries.zh: 修复了命令的自动连续响应流式传输时，飞行中转弯下方出现幻影重复斜线命令行渲染的问题

entries.en: Fixed `policyHelper` `timeoutMs` and `refreshIntervalMs` values above the timer maximum (2147483647) causing failures or re-runs every millisecond; they are now clamped
entries.zh: 修复了`policyHelper`、`timeoutMs`和`refreshIntervalMs`值高于计时器最大值（2147483647）导致失败或每毫秒重新运行的问题；他们现在被夹住了

entries.en: Fixed the token counter freezing or crawling after switching to another subagent's transcript, and made background subagents' and teammates' counters update live while a response streams
entries.zh: 修复切换到另一个子智能体的转录后，令牌计数器冻结或更新极慢的问题；现在后台子智能体和队友的计数器会在回复流式输出时实时更新

entries.en: Fixed sandbox network hosts written with a trailing dot (`example.com.`): a `deniedDomains` entry didn't block the host inside the sandbox, and "don't ask again" for such a host kept prompting
entries.zh: 修复了用尾随点（`example.com.`）编写的沙箱网络主机：`deniedDomains`条目没有阻止沙箱内的主机，并且对于此类主机不断提示“不要再询问”

entries.en: Fixed dismissing the Remote Control consent prompt (Esc, or `n` at `claude remote-control`) counting as consent, so the next request connected without asking
entries.zh: 修复了忽略远程控制同意提示（Esc，或`claude remote-control`处的`n`）算作同意，因此下一个请求无需询问即可连接

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` reconnect and enable still connecting a settings-file MCP server that a managed MCP allow/deny list or `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` loaded after startup should block
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`重新连接并启用仍然连接设置文件 MCP 服务器，启动后加载的托管 MCP 允许/拒绝列表或`strictPluginOnlyCustomization`应阻止的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp remove` leaving a remote server's stored OAuth credentials behind when `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` locks MCP to plugin-only servers
entries.zh: 修复了当`strictPluginOnlyCustomization`将 MCP 锁定到仅限插件的服务器时，`claude mcp remove`留下远程服务器存储的 OAuth 凭据的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control (`claude remote-control`) sessions started from the Claude app ignoring the selected model and running on the machine's default instead
entries.zh: 修复了从 Claude 应用程序启动的远程控制（“claude 远程控制”）会话忽略所选模型并在计算机的默认模型上运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--disallowedTools` and session deny rules being dropped after the first settings reload when `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` is enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`时重新加载第一个设置后删除的`--disallowedTools`和会话拒绝规则

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` listing a backgrounded conversation twice and `--continue` reopening its stalled pre-background copy; `--continue` now also opens finished background sessions
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`两次列出后台对话并“--continue”重新打开其停滞的预后台副本的问题； `--continue` 现在也打开已完成的后台会话

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode not letting you click `!` shell command output to expand it
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式不允许您单击`!` shell 命令输出来展开它的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions left running an older Claude Code binary piling up across auto-updates instead of being retired
entries.zh: 修复了运行较旧的克劳德代码二进制文件的后台会话在自动更新中堆积而不是被淘汰的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents --json` briefly switching the terminal to raw mode and undoing another program's terminal settings on exit
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents --json”将终端短暂切换到原始模式并在退出时撤消另一个程序的终端设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed Proactive output style sessions busy-looping with filler messages and repeated log reads instead of idling while a background command or Monitor they started is still running
entries.zh: 修复了主动输出样式会话在后台命令或启动的监视器仍在运行时忙于循环填充消息和重复日志读取而不是空闲的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents stopping when a response was cut off mid-stream by a computer sleep, dropped connection, or server error; they now automatically continue instead of ending with an incomplete response
entries.zh: 修复了由于计算机睡眠、连接断开或服务器错误导致响应中途中断时子代理停止的问题；他们现在会自动继续，而不是以不完整的响应结束

entries.en: Fixed `←` doing nothing in the `/btw` panel inside a `claude agents` session: it now returns to the agents list (even mid-answer), and the panel comes back when you reopen the session
entries.zh: 修复了`←`在“claude Agents”会话内的`/btw`面板中不执行任何操作的问题：它现在返回到代理列表（甚至是中间答案），并且当您重新打开会话时该面板会返回

entries.en: Fixed sessions with an advisor model set missing the prompt cache on background requests (compaction, `/recap`, prompt suggestions) and re-sending the full conversation uncached each time
entries.zh: 修复了顾问模型集的会话缺少后台请求的提示缓存（压缩、`/recap`、提示建议）并每次重新发送未缓存的完整对话

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` exiting about 5 seconds after its final result while a Monitor the model armed was still running; it now waits for the watch to fire or time out
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`在最终结果后约 5 秒退出，而模型武装的监视器仍在运行的问题；现在等待手表触发或超时

entries.en: Fixed a `permissions.ask` rule being skipped in auto mode when the matching command ran inside a compound command or subshell, letting it run without the confirmation prompt
entries.zh: 修复了当匹配命令在复合命令或子 shell 中运行时，在自动模式下跳过`permissions.ask`规则，使其在没有确认提示的情况下运行

entries.en: Fixed plugins being able to read files outside their own directory through a declared command, agent, skill, hooks or other component path that is a symlink; such paths are now refused with an error
entries.zh: 修复了插件能够通过声明的命令、代理、技能、挂钩或其他作为符号链接的组件路径读取自己目录之外的文件的问题；现在，此类路径会被拒绝并出现错误

entries.en: Fixed `/add-dir` rejecting a directory inside the current working directory; it now loads that directory's skills, commands, and agents like `--add-dir` does at startup
entries.zh: 修复了`/add-dir`拒绝当前工作目录中的目录的问题；现在，它会加载该目录的技能、命令和代理，就像`--add-dir`在启动时所做的那样

entries.en: Fixed the main agent not being told when you resume a subagent you had stopped from its transcript view
entries.zh: 修复你在转录视图中停止某个子智能体后又恢复它时，主智能体没有被告知的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash when pasting ANSI-colored text (e.g. a CI log) into dialogs like `/feedback`
entries.zh: 修复了将 ANSI 颜色文本（例如 CI 日志）粘贴到`/feedback`等对话框中时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp add/remove` hanging or exhausting memory when the project's `.mcp.json` is a FIFO or a device-file symlink; it now fails fast with an actionable message
entries.zh: 修复了当项目的`.mcp.json`是 FIFO 或设备文件符号链接时`claude mcp add/remove`挂起或耗尽内存的问题；现在它会快速失败并显示可操作的消息

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth when non-JSONL data is piped into `claude -p --input-format stream-json`; it now fails fast with a clear error
entries.zh: 修复非 JSONL 数据通过管道传给 `claude -p --input-format stream-json` 时内存无限增长的问题；现在会快速失败并给出清晰错误

entries.en: Fixed backgrounding a turn (`←` or Ctrl+B) while a subagent or other tool was running occasionally making the background session treat that tool as rejected instead of re-running it
entries.zh: 修复了当子代理或其他工具运行时偶尔会进入后台（`←` 或 Ctrl+B），使后台会话将该工具视为被拒绝而不是重新运行它

entries.en: Fixed Bash `Read()`/`Edit()` deny rules not applying to `< file` redirects and reader commands like `tac` and `egrep`; a deny rule on any argument or redirect target now refuses the command
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash `Read()`/`Edit()` 拒绝规则不适用于 `< file` 重定向和读取器命令，如 `tac` 和 `egrep`；任何参数或重定向目标的拒绝规则现在拒绝该命令

entries.en: Fixed resuming or messaging a subagent whose transcript had grown past 5 MB (for example after reading many images) failing with "No transcript found"
entries.zh: 修复了对转录本已超过 5 MB（例如在读取许多图像后）的子代理进行恢复或发送消息时失败并显示“未找到转录本”的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions refusing Bash loops, `$VAR` reads, `"$(…)"` and heredocs that never touch git as "too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree"
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离的会话把从不涉及 git 的 Bash 循环、`$VAR` 读取、`"$(…)"` 和 heredoc 误判为"过于复杂，无法验证是否留在工作树内"而拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` and `/effort` showing a prompt-cache warning after rewinding a conversation back to empty
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`和`/effort`在将对话倒回到空后显示提示缓存警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt-cache misses on every turn in long screenshot-heavy sessions once images exceeded the per-request size cap
entries.zh: 修复了一旦图像超出每个请求大小上限，在长屏幕截图密集会话中每回合都会出现提示缓存丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Edit permission prompt's diff view rendering emoji and multi-code-point characters with incorrect widths
entries.zh: 修复编辑权限提示的 diff 视图中，emoji 和多码点字符宽度显示错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed WebSocket MCP server connection failures being logged as "[object ErrorEvent]" instead of the underlying error
entries.zh: 修复了 WebSocket MCP 服务器连接失败被记录为“[object ErrorEvent]”而不是底层错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions failing to open with "Couldn't start the background service" while another Claude Code process was downloading an npm update; the start now waits for it
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个 Claude Code 进程正在下载 npm 更新时后台会话无法打开并显示“无法启动后台服务”的问题；现在开始等待它

entries.en: Fixed background commands that detach from their shell (for example under `timeout` or `setsid`) surviving a task stop or Claude Code exit
entries.zh: 修复了在任务停止或 Claude Code 退出时脱离 shell 的后台命令（例如在`timeout`或`setsid`下）

entries.en: Fixed Claude not being told when you stop a background command from the tasks panel or a connected client
entries.zh: 修复了当您从任务面板或连接的客户端停止后台命令时克劳德没有被告知的问题

entries.en: Fixed stopping a background subagent leaving its monitors running
entries.zh: 修复了停止后台子代理并使其监视器保持运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed git commands in a linked worktree losing write access to the repository's common `.git` directory after `cd` into a subdirectory
entries.zh: 修复了链接工作树中的沙盒 git 命令在`cd`进入子目录后丢失对存储库公共`.git`目录的写访问权限的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock and Bedrock Mantle requests going silent during long hidden-thinking phases on Opus 4.7 and later, which let idle timeouts cut the connection; the stream now carries progress events
entries.zh: 修复了 Opus 4.7 及更高版本上的基岩和基岩地幔请求在长时间隐藏思考阶段保持沉默的问题，这会导致空闲超时切断连接；该流现在携带进度事件

entries.en: Fixed launching Claude Code after a Claude apps gateway expired or revoked your session: it now says the session ended and offers `/login` instead of reporting a network error
entries.zh: 修复了在克劳德应用程序网关过期或撤销会话后启动克劳德代码的问题：它现在表示会话已结束并提供`/login`，而不是报告网络错误

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions losing git/GitHub credentials for the rest of the session when the session's network proxy failed to start at launch; it now retries in the background and recovers
entries.zh: 修复了当会话的网络代理在启动时启动失败时，云会话会丢失会话其余部分的 git/GitHub 凭据的问题；它现在在后台重试并恢复

entries.en: Fixed leftover `cc-daemon-*` folders in the system temp directory after an interrupted background daemon start; the `cleanupPeriodDays` retention sweep now removes them
entries.zh: 修复了后台守护程序启动中断后系统临时目录中剩余的`cc-daemon-*`文件夹； `cleanupPeriodDays`保留扫描现在将其删除

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving certain `[[ ]]` conditionals that zsh parses differently from bash; these commands now prompt for approval
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查自动批准 zsh 与 bash 解析方式不同的某些 `[[ ]]` 条件；这些命令现在提示批准

entries.en: Fixed the managed-settings approval prompt showing the generic warning instead of its telemetry wording when the settings also turn detailed tracing or raw API body logging off, or trace export on
entries.zh: 修复托管设置同时关闭详细追踪或原始 API 请求体日志、或开启追踪导出时，审批提示仍显示通用警告而非遥测相关说明的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent-team teammates in tmux/iTerm2 panes sometimes staying open after acknowledging a shutdown request
entries.zh: 修复了 tmux/iTerm2 窗格中的代理团队队友有时在确认关闭请求后保持打开状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed the keyless Console sign-in ("Sign in with your Console account") not applying your organization's server-managed settings, and `/status` not showing the Organization for that sign-in
entries.zh: 修复无密钥的 Console 登录（"使用 Console 账户登录"）未应用组织的服务器托管设置，且 `/status` 对该登录不显示组织的问题

entries.en: Improved rendering performance: less re-render work per turn in long conversations, streaming no longer slows down as the reply grows, and background-agent updates no longer re-render the whole screen
entries.zh: 改进渲染性能：长对话中每轮的重绘工作量减少，流式输出不再随回复变长而变慢，后台智能体更新不再重绘整个屏幕

entries.en: Improved prompt input responsiveness by reducing per-keystroke rendering work
entries.zh: 改进提示输入的响应速度：减少了每次按键时的渲染工作量

entries.en: Improved policy helper diagnostics — refresh failures now show in `/status`, declining the managed-settings dialog prints why Claude Code exited, and helper timeouts are reported as timeouts
entries.zh: 改进策略辅助工具的诊断：刷新失败现在会显示在 `/status` 中；拒绝托管设置对话框时会打印 Claude Code 退出的原因；辅助工具超时会明确标为超时

entries.en: Improved `/code-review --comment` to post findings on GitLab merge requests via `glab mr note` instead of reporting the target as unsupported
entries.zh: 改进 `/code-review --comment`：可通过 `glab mr note` 在 GitLab 合并请求上发布评审意见，而不是报告该目标不受支持

entries.en: Improved notifications: an MCP elicitation or permission ask queued under another dialog now sends its idle desktop notification at the same delay as a visible ask
entries.zh: 改进通知：排在其他对话框之后的 MCP 请求或权限询问，其空闲桌面通知与可见询问的延迟相同

entries.en: Improved verbose/transcript output: async hook completion notices that arrive together now appear on one line instead of one line per hook
entries.zh: 改进详细/转录输出：同时到达的异步 hook 完成通知现在合并显示在一行，不再每个 hook 一行

entries.en: Improved `claude self-hosted-runner --configure-git` to also enable git push negotiation, so the first push of a new branch from a stale clone uploads only the new commits instead of the whole tree
entries.zh: 改进 `claude self-hosted-runner --configure-git`：同时启用 git push 协商，从旧克隆推送新分支时只上传新提交，而不是整个目录树

entries.en: Improved liveness reporting to SDK hosts while a response is held open by gateway keep-alives, so long waits under a raised `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` are not mistaken for a hung session
entries.zh: 改进向 SDK 宿主报告的活性信息：网关保活连接维持响应期间，即使设置了较大的 `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`，长时间等待也不会被误判为会话卡死

entries.en: Improved MCP connection and OAuth debug/error logs so credentials carried in a server's URL or request headers are redacted
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 连接和 OAuth 的调试与错误日志：服务器网址或请求头中携带的凭证会被脱敏

entries.en: Improved `/fork` to keep the original conversation's prompt cache in the new background session: its worktree briefing now arrives as a message instead of a system-prompt change
entries.zh: 改进 `/fork`：原对话的提示词缓存在新的后台会话中保留；其 worktree 说明改为一条消息，不再修改系统提示

entries.en: Improved emoji autocomplete to accept the remaining GitHub/Slack shortcode aliases (`:satisfied:`, `:telephone:`, `:collision:`, …)
entries.zh: 改进 emoji 自动补全：可接受剩余的 GitHub/Slack 短代码别名（`:satisfied:`、`:telephone:`、`:collision:` 等）

entries.en: Changed `--effort` to lift a new model's default-effort hold for that session only rather than permanently; an effort picked on claude.ai for a Remote Control session now applies during the hold
entries.zh: 更改了`--effort`以仅解除新模型在该会话中的默认努力保留，而不是永久保留；现在，在 claude.ai 上为远程控制会话选择的一项工作在暂停期间适用

entries.en: Changed a `policyHelper` in MDM or `managed-settings.json` shadowed at launch by cached server-managed settings to run (or exit) as soon as the fetch reports them removed, not at the next launch
entries.zh: 更改了 MDM 中的`policyHelper`或在启动时被缓存的服务器管理设置隐藏的“management-settings.json”，以便在提取报告它们已删除后立即运行（或退出），而不是在下次启动时运行（或退出）

entries.en: Changed `managedSourcesBehavior: "merge"` to take `sandbox.credentials.awsPairs` and `sandbox.ripgrep` whole from the highest managed source that sets them instead of combining the sources' values
entries.zh: 更改了“managedSourcesBehavior：“merge””，以从设置它们的最高托管源中获取`sandbox.credentials.awsPairs`和`sandbox.ripgrep`，而不是组合源的值

entries.en: Changed gateway model discovery (`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1`) to run even when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` is set, since it only queries your gateway
entries.zh: 更改了网关模型发现（`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1`），即使设置了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`也可以运行，因为它只查询您的网关

entries.en: Changed `claude --resume <session-id> --bg` to continue that session under its own ID when nothing is running it, instead of silently starting a copy; a copy is now announced
entries.zh: 更改了`claude --resume <session-id> --bg`，以便在没有任何内容运行时使用自己的 ID 继续该会话，而不是默默地启动副本；现已公布副本

entries.en: Changed `/btw` history browsing from `←`/`→` to `Shift+←`/`Shift+→` (or `[`/`]`), stepping through your recent side questions and back to the live answer
entries.zh: 将`/btw`历史浏览从`←`/`→`更改为`Shift+←`/`Shift+→`（或`[`/`]`），逐步浏览您最近的附带问题并返回实时答案

entries.en: Changed `defaultMode: "bypassPermissions"` in `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` to be ignored, like `"auto"`; set it in user or managed settings, or pass `--permission-mode`
entries.zh: 将 `.claude/settings.json` 或 `.claude/settings.local.json` 中的 `defaultMode: "bypassPermissions"` 更改为忽略，如 `"auto"`；在用户或托管设置中设置它，或传递`--permission-mode`

entries.en: Changed `fable` and `best` in Claude apps gateway sessions to keep resolving to Fable 5 for now, since gateways not yet configured for Fable 5.1 reject it; pick Fable 5.1 in `/model` to use it
entries.zh: 更改了克劳德应用程序网关会话中的“寓言”和“最佳”，以暂时继续解析《寓言 5》，因为尚未为《寓言 5.1》配置的网关会拒绝它；在`/model`中选择Fable 5.1来使用它

entries.en: Changed `--add-dir`, `/add-dir`, and `additionalDirectories` to refuse network paths (UNC shares, `/net/<host>` automounts) with a message before touching them; on Windows use a mapped drive letter
entries.zh: 更改了 `--add-dir`、`/add-dir` 和 `additionalDirectories` 以在接触网络路径（UNC 共享、`/net/<host>` 自动挂载）之前显示一条消息来拒绝它们；在 Windows 上使用映射的驱动器号

entries.en: Changed Claude apps gateway sign-in and token refresh requests to verify the gateway's pinned TLS certificate, as the managed settings fetch already does
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude 应用程序网关登录和令牌刷新请求，以验证网关的固定 TLS 证书，就像托管设置获取已执行的操作一样

entries.en: Changed Cowork and claude.ai cloud sessions: reading an artifact that isn't yours now always asks you first, even in auto mode
entries.zh: 更改了 Cowork 和 claude.ai 云会话：读取不属于您的工件现在总是先询问您，即使在自动模式下也是如此

entries.en: Removed the Ctrl+E command explanation on Bash and PowerShell permission prompts
entries.zh: 移除 Bash 和 PowerShell 权限提示上的 Ctrl+E 功能说明

entries.en: [VSCode] Added collapsible ACCOUNT & USAGE and SESSION MANAGER section headers to the session list panel, with the account email, the usage meter, and a View details link opening the usage dialog
entries.zh: [VSCode] 会话列表面板新增可折叠的「ACCOUNT & USAGE」和「SESSION MANAGER」分区标题，显示账户邮箱、用量仪表，并附有「View details」链接，可打开用量对话框

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a model pill to the input footer that shows the current model and opens the model picker, with an Effort row and a "More models" page
entries.zh: [VSCode] 输入区底部新增模型标签，显示当前模型并可打开模型选择器，其中包含 Effort 行和「More models」页面

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a collapse toggle to the Ungrouped section of the session list
entries.zh: [VSCode] 会话列表中的「Ungrouped」分区新增折叠开关

entries.en: [VSCode] Added output style selection to the command menu, including custom styles
entries.zh: [VSCode] 命令菜单新增输出样式选择，包括自定义样式

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed third-party provider deployments (Bedrock, Vertex, and others) still showing claude.ai-only features (remote sessions, dictation, usage) and calling claude.ai with a leftover login
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复使用第三方提供商部署（Bedrock、Vertex 等）时，仍显示仅限 claude.ai 的功能（远程会话、听写、用量），并使用残留登录信息调用 claude.ai 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list panel's usage meter staying blank after the panel loads; it now shows the last known usage immediately
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话列表面板加载后用量仪表一直空白的问题；现在会立即显示最近一次已知的用量

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" toggle so turning it on or off applies to sessions that are already open, not only to new ones
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" 开关的开启或关闭只对新会话生效、对已打开会话无效的问题；现在对已打开的会话也生效

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed screen reader announcements: a control character before a fence or heading no longer drops visible lines from speech, and bold markers spanning a heading are no longer mis-paired
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复屏幕阅读器播报问题：代码围栏或标题前的控制字符不再导致可见行从语音中丢失；跨越标题的粗体标记不再被错误配对

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the action menu to list slash commands in a filterable "Slash commands" dialog instead of inline; picking one runs it; the MCP servers dialog gained the same filter box
entries.zh: [VSCode] 操作菜单中的斜杠命令改为在可筛选的「Slash commands」对话框中列出，而不是直接内嵌显示；选择某条命令即可运行；MCP 服务器对话框也新增了相同的筛选框

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed "Delete session" to "Archive session": archived sessions move to a collapsible "Archived sessions" group at the bottom of the list with an Unarchive action
entries.zh: [VSCode] 「Delete session」改为「Archive session」：已归档会话移到列表底部可折叠的「Archived sessions」分组中，并提供 Unarchive 操作

entries.en: Fixed Bash commands failing with "task output swap refused (tasks dir moved or linked)" on some Macs
entries.zh: 修复了某些 Mac 上的 Bash 命令因“任务输出交换被拒绝（任务目录已移动或链接）”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed "always allow" not saving in a project that has no .claude/settings.local.json yet
entries.zh: 修复了“始终允许”不保存在还没有 .claude/settings.local.json 的项目中的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by Claude Desktop or VS Code stalling for minutes after a tool finished when the connection to claude.ai was degraded
entries.zh: 修复了当与 claude.ai 的连接降级时，工具完成后由 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 托管的远程控制会话会停滞几分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed background task notifications with very large failure output (for example git errors on a full disk) making the conversation exceed the API request size limit
entries.zh: 修复了具有非常大的失败输出（例如完整磁盘上的 git 错误）的后台任务通知，导致对话超出 API 请求大小限制

entries.en: Added `PreModelSwitch` and `PostModelSwitch` hook events (block, confirm, or annotate a model switch); `SessionStart` resume hooks now receive session staleness and the estimated re-cache cost
entries.zh: 添加了 `PreModelSwitch` 和 `PostModelSwitch` 钩子事件（阻止、确认或注释模型切换）； `SessionStart`恢复挂钩现在接收会话陈旧性和估计的重新缓存成本

entries.en: Added live streaming of a foreground subagent's tool calls and results to Remote Control clients (background subagents, the default, still show status only)
entries.zh: 添加了将前台子代理的工具调用和结果实时流传输到远程控制客户端的功能（默认情况下，后台子代理仍然仅显示状态）

entries.en: Added a Spend limit bar to `/usage` and a `rate_limits.spend_limit` status line field for developers behind a Claude apps gateway with spend limits
entries.zh: 为`/usage`添加了支出限制栏，并为具有支出限制的 Claude 应用程序网关背后的开发人员添加了`rate_limits.spend_limit`状态行字段

entries.en: Added a per-session prompt-cache line to `/cost` (hit ratio, misses, tokens re-cached, warm/cold) and a matching `prompt_cache` object for status line scripts
entries.zh: 向`/cost`添加了每会话提示缓存行（命中率、未命中、重新缓存的令牌、热/冷）以及状态行脚本的匹配`prompt_cache`对象

entries.en: Added `attach`, `logs`, `stop`, `respawn`, and `rm` to `claude --help`; the `--resume` message for a running background session now names the exact `claude attach <id>` command
entries.zh: 在`claude --help`中添加了`attach`、`logs`、`stop`、`respawn`和`rm`；正在运行的后台会话的`--resume`消息现在命名为确切的“claude Attach <id>”命令

entries.en: Fixed file tools (Read, Write, Edit) following a symlink swapped inside the working directory after the permission check, which could read or write outside the approved location
entries.zh: 修复了权限检查后在工作目录内交换符号链接后的文件工具（读取、写入、编辑），该工具可以在批准的位置之外读取或写入

entries.en: Fixed plugin commands declared in a marketplace entry being able to point outside the plugin directory; such paths are now rejected with a path-traversal error
entries.zh: 修复了在市场条目中声明的插件命令能够指向插件目录之外的问题；现在，此类路径会因路径遍历错误而被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed project settings being able to enable detailed beta tracing or raw API body logging, and a lower-scope beta tracing endpoint bypassing an OTLP collector pinned by managed settings or a host app
entries.zh: 修复了项目设置，能够启用详细的 beta 跟踪或原始 API 正文日志记录，以及绕过由托管设置或主机应用程序固定的 OTLP 收集器的较低范围 beta 跟踪端点

entries.en: Fixed the Workflow tool reading (and quoting in errors) a `scriptPath` outside what the session may read before the permission check ran
entries.zh: 修复 Workflow 工具在权限检查之前就读取（并在错误信息中引用）会话无权读取的 `scriptPath` 的问题

entries.en: Fixed Grep and Glob not applying `Read(...)` deny rules to files reached through a symlinked search path
entries.zh: 修复了 Grep 和 Glob 未对通过符号链接搜索路径到达的文件应用`Read(...)`拒绝规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed conversations getting stuck on "text content blocks must be non-empty" errors after a turn where the model produced only thinking
entries.zh: 修复了模型仅产生思考的回合后对话陷入“文本内容块必须非空”错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed the first launch on a fresh install starting in default mode instead of auto mode for accounts whose startup default is auto mode
entries.zh: 修复全新安装后首次启动时，对于启动默认为自动模式的账户，却以默认模式而非自动模式启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed Opus 5 requests failing with "effort … is not supported when thinking is disabled" when effort was xhigh/max and thinking was turned off; effort is now sent as `high` in that case
entries.zh: 修复了当努力为 xhigh/max 且思考被关闭时，Opus 5 请求失败并出现“思考被禁用时不支持努力”的问题；在这种情况下，努力现在被发送为“高”

entries.en: Fixed replying to a message Claude Desktop delivered from another session: `SendMessage` to that session id now delivers through Claude Desktop instead of failing with "not reachable"
entries.zh: 修复了回复 Claude Desktop 从另一个会话发送的消息：`SendMessage`到该会话 ID 现在通过 Claude Desktop 发送，而不是因“无法访问”而失败

entries.en: Fixed TUI lag with many parallel subagents: per-second progress ticks now replace their predecessor instead of piling up in the transcript
entries.zh: 修复了许多并行子代理的 TUI 滞后问题：每秒进度滴答现在取代了它们的前身，而不是堆积在记录中

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: a teammate's final answer not reaching the team lead — it now arrives in the idle notification instead of a content-free "available" notice
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：队友的最终答案未到达团队负责人 - 它现在到达空闲通知而不是无内容的“可用”通知

entries.en: Fixed background subagents being unable to reply to a message from an unnamed sibling or parent agent (`from` was the agent type, which is not an address)
entries.zh: 修复了后台子代理无法回复来自未命名兄弟或父代理的消息（`from`是代理类型，不是地址）

entries.en: Fixed managed-settings `disableAutoMode` arriving mid-session not moving an already-running auto-mode session back to default mode
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中到达的托管设置`disableAutoMode`不会将已运行的自动模式会话移回默认模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed a "switch to Opus 1M for 5x more context" tip that appeared even when the current Opus model already has a 1M context window
entries.zh: 修复了即使当前 Opus 模型已经具有 1M 上下文窗口也会出现的“切换到 Opus 1M 以获得 5 倍多上下文”提示

entries.en: Fixed Claude apps gateway sessions treating a stored Anthropic profile (e.g. a Console sign-in) as active: listing it in `/status` and retrying gateway 401s with it, though requests never use it
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 应用程序网关会话将存储的 Anthropic 配置文件（例如控制台登录）视为活动状态：将其列在`/status`中并用它重试网关 401，尽管请求从不使用它

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude the model had changed when the host was only setting the session's initial model
entries.zh: 修复了当主机仅设置会话的初始模型时云会话告诉 Claude 模型已更改的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control reporting a failure when an organization's policy disables it; it now shows a single quiet notice instead
entries.zh: 修复了当组织的策略禁用远程控制时报告失败的问题；它现在显示一个安静的通知

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp reconnect` on Remote Control showing a generic withheld-detail error instead of the real remedy when a server was disabled in another session
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制上的`/mcp reconnect`，在另一个会话中禁用服务器时显示一般保留详细信息错误，而不是真正的补救措施

entries.en: Fixed `--input-format stream-json`: client-injected assistant tool calls sent without a message id were merged into the first one and their results lost, including when resuming older sessions
entries.zh: 修复了`--input-format stream-json`：在没有消息 ID 的情况下发送的客户端注入辅助工具调用被合并到第一个调用中，并且其结果丢失，包括在恢复旧会话时

entries.en: Fixed session transcripts being silently overwritten when a directory change relocated a session onto an existing same-ID transcript
entries.zh: 修复了当目录更改将会话重新定位到现有相同 ID 转录本时，会话转录本会被静默覆盖的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions and their subagents being unable to edit files inside a git worktree they created with `git worktree add`
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话及其子代理无法编辑使用`git worktree add`创建的 git worktree 内的文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions occasionally starting without any plugin skills (and staying that way) when another Claude Code process was refreshing the plugin marketplace at the same moment
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个克劳德代码进程同时刷新插件市场时，后台会话偶尔会在没有任何插件技能的情况下启动（并保持这种状态）的问题

entries.en: Fixed selecting text in an opened background session inside tmux over SSH: it now copies to the tmux buffer like a foreground session instead of falling back to OSC 52
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SSH 在 tmux 内打开的后台会话中选择文本的问题：它现在像前台会话一样复制到 tmux 缓冲区，而不是回退到 OSC 52

entries.en: Fixed SDK and cloud sessions hanging indefinitely when an SDK MCP server's handshake acknowledgment was lost; the wait now times out after 70 seconds and marks only that server failed
entries.zh: 修复了当 SDK MCP 服务器的握手确认丢失时 SDK 和云会话无限期挂起的问题；现在等待会在 70 秒后超时并仅标记服务器失败

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner leaving a stuck session's Bash tool processes running after the session was force-stopped
entries.zh: 修复了自托管运行程序在会话强制停止后使卡住的会话的 Bash 工具进程仍在运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/usage-credits` for Team and Enterprise members whose admin set the org's usage-credit limit to $0: it now offers to ask the admin instead of saying a cap was reached
entries.zh: 修复了管理员将组织的使用信用限额设置为 0 美元的团队和企业成员的`/usage-credits`：现在它会询问管理员，而不是说已达到上限

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree --tmux` with a merge-request number on a gitlab.com origin trying a doomed GitHub-style fetch first instead of fetching the GitLab ref directly
entries.zh: 修复了 gitlab.com 源上带有合并请求编号的`--worktree --tmux`，首先尝试使用注定失败的 GitHub 样式获取，而不是直接获取 GitLab 引用

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+G failing with "Emacs quit unexpectedly" in background sessions for editors that open `/dev/tty`, such as `emacs -nw` and `micro`
entries.zh: 修复了打开 `/dev/tty` 的编辑器（例如 `emacs -nw` 和 `micro`）在后台会话中 Ctrl+G 失败并出现“Emacs 意外退出”的问题

entries.en: Fixed an `additionalDirectories` entry containing a null byte crashing startup, or breaking `/add-dir` and later settings updates when it came from an SDK host, IDE, or hook; it is now skipped
entries.zh: 修复了包含空字节的`additionalDirectories`条目，导致启动崩溃，或在来自 SDK 主机、IDE 或挂钩时破坏`/add-dir`和后续设置更新；现在已被跳过

entries.en: Fixed the MCP server menu's copy shortcut: it now says how the sign-in URL was copied instead of always claiming success
entries.zh: 修复 MCP 服务器菜单的复制快捷键：现在会说明登录链接是如何复制的，而不是总是显示成功

entries.en: Fixed italic text (such as the session recap line) rendering as highlighted blocks in GNU screen and in tmux sessions using a `screen` terminal type
entries.zh: 修复了使用`screen`终端类型在 GNU 屏幕和 tmux 会话中将斜体文本（例如会话回顾行）呈现为突出显示块的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp add --header` and `claude mcp add-json` help text naming the wrong transports
entries.zh: 修复了`claude mcp add --header`和`claude mcp add-json`帮助文本命名错误的传输

entries.en: Fixed `claude ultrareview` and `/ultrareview` waiting the full 30 minutes when the cloud session fails to start; they now stop early and report the reason
entries.zh: 修复了`claude ultrareview`和`/ultrareview`在云会话启动失败时等待整整 30 分钟的问题；他们现在提前停止并报告原因

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving commands that assign an arithmetic expression to an integer shell variable (e.g. `OPTIND=1/0`, `RANDOM=2+2`); these now prompt for approval
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查自动批准将算术表达式分配给整数 shell 变量的命令（例如`OPTIND=1/0`、`RANDOM=2+2`）；这些现在提示批准

entries.en: Fixed backgrounded sessions (`←`, `/background`, `--bg`) losing a Vertex/Bedrock gateway (`ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` + `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH`) exported in the shell, so every request failed
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话（`←`、`/background`、`--bg`）丢失在 shell 中导出的 Vertex/Bedrock 网关（`ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` + `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH`），因此每个请求都失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg --model fable` on Max plans stopping to ask for usage credits while the interactive session on the same account still had Fable allowance
entries.zh: 修复了 Max 计划停止请求使用积分时的`claude --bg --model fable`，而同一帐户上的交互式会话仍然有《寓言》津贴

entries.en: Fixed the one-time "make auto mode your default" offer appearing in unattended sessions (e.g. agent-team teammate panes), where a stray keypress could accept it unread
entries.zh: 修复无人值守会话（如智能体团队的队友窗格）中，一次性的"把自动模式设为默认"提示仍会出现，且误按的按键可能将其接受的问题

entries.en: Fixed the managed-settings approval prompt re-appearing after signing in again to the same Claude apps gateway when the settings are unchanged
entries.zh: 修复在同一 Claude 应用网关上重新登录后，即使设置未变，托管设置审批提示仍再次出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed disabled `/bug` and `/share` reporting that `/feedback` was disabled; tips, `/help`, and refusal messages no longer suggest `/feedback` when an org policy or env var turns it off
entries.zh: 修复了禁用的`/bug`和`/share`报告`/feedback`被禁用的问题；当组织策略或环境变量将其关闭时，提示、`/help`和拒绝消息不再建议`/feedback`

entries.en: Fixed cloud session creation advising GitHub setup after a transient GitHub connection failure — the message now says to retry instead
entries.zh: 修复了在暂时的 GitHub 连接失败后建议 GitHub 设置的云会话创建问题 — 该消息现在改为重试

entries.en: Improved CPU usage during turns in interactive sessions by cutting redundant UI re-renders
entries.zh: 改进交互会话中一轮对话期间的 CPU 占用，减少多余的界面重绘

entries.en: Improved install size: the native binary is about 5 MB smaller
entries.zh: 改进安装体积：原生二进制文件减小约 5 MB

entries.en: Improved cloud sessions: when the session's network proxy drops a connection during a Bash command, the tool result now names the host and reason instead of only "connection reset"
entries.zh: 改进云会话：会话的网络代理在 Bash 命令执行期间断开连接时，工具结果会说明主机和原因，而不只是“connection reset”

entries.en: Improved `/schedule` to explain that MCP servers configured in Claude Code can't be attached to cloud routines, instead of a bare "No MCP connectors" message
entries.zh: 改进 `/schedule`：说明在 Claude Code 中配置的 MCP 服务器无法挂到云端例程上，不再只显示笼统的“No MCP connectors”

entries.en: Improved framing of messages from your own subagents: Claude is told the sender is a worker inside this session, not an unrelated Claude session
entries.zh: 改进你自己的子代理消息的表述：Claude 会被告知发送者是本会话内的工作代理，而不是无关的 Claude 会话

entries.en: Improved the prompt placeholder to read "Message @name…" while viewing a background subagent or fork transcript opened from the subagent panel or `/tasks`
entries.zh: 改进提示占位文字：查看从子智能体面板或 `/tasks` 打开的后台子智能体或分叉转录时，显示「Message @name…」

entries.en: Improved sanitization of MCP server names in error messages, menus, and command results
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 服务器名称在报错信息、菜单和命令结果中的显示安全处理

entries.en: Improved Amazon Bedrock session start under `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` (e.g. Claude Desktop): a session given a Bedrock model ID or ARN no longer waits for inference-profile discovery
entries.zh: 改进 `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` 下（如 Claude Desktop）的 Bedrock 会话启动：传入 Bedrock 模型 ID 或 ARN 的会话不再等待推理配置文件发现

entries.en: Improved the managed settings approval dialog to list only the settings that changed since you last approved them
entries.zh: 改进托管设置批准对话框：只列出自上次批准以来发生变化的设置

entries.en: Improved retry when the model's tool call is malformed: the broken output is now dropped from the retry context, including on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry
entries.zh: 改进模型工具调用格式错误时的重试：错误输出会从重试上下文中去掉，Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上同样如此

entries.en: Changed `/radio` to be available on Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS, and when telemetry is disabled
entries.zh: 将`/radio`更改为在 AWS 上的 Bedrock、Vertex AI、Foundry 和 Claude Platform 上以及禁用遥测时可用

entries.en: Changed Claude in Chrome so browser actions always go through Claude Code's permission checks, including in sessions with telemetry disabled, which previously used the Chrome extension's own prompts
entries.zh: 更改了 Chrome 中的 Claude，以便浏览器操作始终经过 Claude Code 的权限检查，包括在禁用遥测的会话中，该会话之前使用 Chrome 扩展程序自己的提示

entries.en: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to set the default subagent model rather than override everything: an agent definition's `model:` and an explicit per-spawn model now take precedence over it
entries.zh: 更改了`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`以设置默认子代理模型，而不是覆盖所有内容：代理定义的`model:`和显式的每生成模型现在优先于它

entries.en: Changed the default commit trailer to `Co-Authored-By: Claude Code` when the active model isn't a recognized Claude model (e.g. third-party models behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)
entries.zh: 当活动模型不是公认的 Claude 模型时（例如自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`背后的第三方模型），将默认提交预告片更改为“共同作者：Claude Code”

entries.en: Changed the default model for seat-based Enterprise subscriptions to Opus 5, matching other premium plans
entries.zh: 将基于席位的企业订阅的默认模型更改为 Opus 5，以匹配其他高级计划

entries.en: Changed `/effort` to save your default effort level per model, so each model keeps its own setting when you switch
entries.zh: 更改了`/effort`以保存每个模型的默认工作量级别，因此当您切换时每个模型都会保留自己的设置

entries.en: Changed analytics to no longer turn off before sign-in solely because managed settings force gateway login (or cannot be read); they stay off once signed in to the gateway or via `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`
entries.zh: 将分析更改为不再仅因为托管设置强制网关登录（或无法读取）而在登录前关闭；一旦登录到网关或通过`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`，它们就会保持关闭状态

entries.en: Changed the footer PR badge on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry is off, to call the GitHub API directly (via `gh auth token`, `GH_TOKEN`, or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) instead of `gh pr view`
entries.zh: 更改了 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上的页脚 PR 徽章，并且当遥测关闭时，直接调用 GitHub API（通过`gh auth token`、`GH_TOKEN`或`GITHUB_TOKEN`）而不是`gh pr view`

entries.en: Changed how Bash command output files are created and read back when commands run in the sandbox, so a sandboxed command cannot redirect or replace them
entries.zh: 更改了命令在沙箱中运行时创建和读回 Bash 命令输出文件的方式，因此沙箱命令无法重定向或替换它们

entries.en: Changed plugin/LSP install suggestions and the auto-mode default offer to wait until you've sent or cleared what you're typing, so the Enter that sends your prompt can't answer them
entries.zh: 更改了插件/LSP 安装建议和自动模式默认提议，等待您发送或清除您正在输入的内容，因此发送提示的 Enter 无法回答它们

entries.en: Changed server-managed settings that terminate sandbox TLS, route sandbox traffic through your own proxy, inject credentials, or weaken sandbox isolation to require approval before they apply
entries.zh: 更改了服务器管理的设置，这些设置终止沙箱 TLS、通过您自己的代理路由沙箱流量、注入凭据或削弱沙箱隔离，以便在应用之前需要批准

entries.en: Changed `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` from managed or project settings to require approval when it sets a credential, org/tenant, routing, or API-behavior header (e.g. `Authorization`, `Host`)
entries.zh: 将`ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS`从托管或项目设置更改为在设置凭据、组织/租户、路由或 API 行为标头（例如“授权”、“主机”）时需要批准

entries.en: Changed project-level `.claude/settings.json` `env` to no longer set `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`, or `TMPDIR`/`TMP`/`TEMP`; set them in your shell, user, or managed settings instead
entries.zh: 更改了项目级 `.claude/settings.json` `env` ，不再设置 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`、`CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` 或 `TMPDIR`/`TMP`/`TEMP`；在您的 shell、用户或托管设置中设置它们

entries.en: Removed syntax highlighting for six rarely used languages (1c, gml, isbl, mathematica, maxima, sqf); the binary is 2.5 MB smaller
entries.zh: 移除六种少用语言的语法高亮（1c、gml、isbl、mathematica、maxima、sqf），二进制体积减小 2.5 MB

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen's "Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex" button opening the docs at the top of the page instead of the third-party provider setup section
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复登录界面的 "Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex" 按钮打开的是文档顶部、而不是第三方提供商设置章节的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the Remote Control banner to a footer pill (shown while Remote Control is on or has failed) that opens the session on claude.ai/code; turn it on or off with `/remote-control`
entries.zh: [VSCode] Remote Control 横幅改为底部标签（在 Remote Control 开启或失败时显示），点击可在 claude.ai/code 中打开该会话；可用 `/remote-control` 开启或关闭

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added `--restricted` (or `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`): removes the built-in tools that run commands or code and `WebFetch` (unless named in `--tools`), keeps file tools inside the working directory, refuses `bypassPermissions`, and ignores user, project and local settings files
entries.zh: 添加了`--restricted`（或`CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`）：删除运行命令或代码的内置工具和`WebFetch`（除非在`--tools`中命名），将文件工具保留在工作目录中，拒绝`bypassPermissions`，并忽略用户、项目和本地设置文件

entries.en: Added `experimental.cacheTtl` (`"5m"` or `"1h"`) to agent frontmatter: a per-agent prompt cache TTL used when no subagent TTL setting is configured
entries.zh: 在代理 frontmatter 中添加了 `experimental.cacheTtl`（`"5m"` 或 `"1h"`）：未配置子代理 TTL 设置时使用的每个代理提示缓存 TTL

entries.en: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --client-label <label>` (or `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL`) to override the label the runner registers with (default: hostname)
entries.zh: 添加了`claude self-hosted-runner --client-label <label>`（或`SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL`）以覆盖运行程序注册的标签（默认：主机名）

entries.en: Added server-managed settings diagnostics: a startup warning when the settings fail to load, and a `/doctor` and `/status` line explaining a load failure or why they weren't fetched (Bedrock/Vertex/third-party provider, custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)
entries.zh: 添加了服务器管理的设置诊断：设置加载失败时出现启动警告，以及解释加载失败或未获取它们的原因的`/doctor`和`/status`行（Bedrock/Vertex/第三方提供商、自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`）

entries.en: Added a warning in `/web-setup` when the GitHub CLI token lacks the `workflow` scope, since pushes to very large repositories can be rejected without it
entries.zh: 当 GitHub CLI 令牌缺少`workflow`范围时，在`/web-setup`中添加了警告，因为如果没有它，推送到非常大的存储库可能会被拒绝

entries.en: Added `/usage-credits` for Enterprise organizations billed through AWS Marketplace, self-serve Enterprise, and Enterprise trials, so members can request a higher usage limit from their admin
entries.zh: 为通过 AWS Marketplace、自助企业和企业试用计费的企业组织添加了`/usage-credits`，以便成员可以向管理员请求更高的使用限制

entries.en: Added cross-session messaging (`SendMessage` / `ListAgents`) between sessions on the same machine on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled
entries.zh: 在 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上同一台计算机上的会话之间以及禁用遥测时添加了跨会话消息传递（`SendMessage`/`ListAgents`）

entries.en: Fixed a prompt-cache miss (and lost extended-thinking context) roughly once an hour in long sessions, caused by tool definitions being re-rendered after an OAuth token refresh
entries.zh: 修复长会话中大约每小时一次的提示词缓存未命中（以及丢失扩展思考上下文），原因是 OAuth 令牌刷新后工具定义被重新渲染的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `ScheduleWakeup` tool definition changing between a session and its `--resume` when the account had entered usage overage, causing a full prompt-cache miss on the resumed session's first turn
entries.zh: 修复账户进入用量超额状态后，`ScheduleWakeup` 工具定义在会话与其 `--resume` 恢复之间发生变化，导致恢复会话的第一回合提示词缓存完全未命中的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Desktop and Cowork sessions disappearing after 30 days: the transcript cleanup now keeps desktop-written sessions while they are in the app (unless org policy manages retention); the new `desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays` setting caps the exemption
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 桌面和 Cowork 会话在 30 天后消失的问题：记录清理现在会在应用程序中保留桌面编写的会话（除非组织策略管理保留）；新的`desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays`设置限制了豁免

entries.en: Fixed being sent to the login screen when another Claude Code process held the token refresh lock while the session token had expired; the request now fails with a retryable error instead
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个 Claude Code 进程在会话令牌过期时持有令牌刷新锁时发送到登录屏幕的问题；现在请求失败并出现可重试错误

entries.en: Windows: Fixed the `claude agents` list not responding to the keyboard after detaching from a session, or when launched in a terminal tab left in win32-input-mode
entries.zh: Windows：修复了从会话中分离后，或在处于 win32-input-mode 的终端标签页中启动时，`claude agents` 列表无法响应键盘的问题

entries.en: Fixed the recommended Console sign-in in `/login` failing with an OAuth error before showing a sign-in URL on machines where it can't be used (for example when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an API key helper is set); it now falls back to the API-key sign-in
entries.zh: 修复在无法使用的机器上（例如设置了 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 或 API 密钥辅助工具时），`/login` 推荐的 Console 登录在显示登录链接前就因 OAuth 错误失败的问题；现在会回退为 API 密钥登录

entries.en: Fixed model names in `/model` and fast-mode switch notices to render as code, so suffixes like `[1m]` display literally instead of as a link
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`中的模型名称和快速模式切换通知以代码形式呈现的问题，因此像`[1m]`这样的后缀按字面显示而不是作为链接显示

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` skipping the workspace trust prompt when the `CI` environment variable is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`CI`环境变量时“claude Agents”跳过工作区信任提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` crashing on launch when the PR-status cache held a malformed entry
entries.zh: 修复了当 PR 状态缓存保存格式错误的条目时“claude Agents”在启动时崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent view resurrecting a weeks-old background session after the machine was off: such a session now shows as stopped at its real end, and opening it asks before resuming its saved conversation
entries.zh: 固定代理视图在机器关闭后恢复了几周前的后台会话：此类会话现在显示为在其实际结束处停止，并且在恢复其保存的对话之前打开它会询问

entries.en: Fixed agent view sometimes opening an older conversation, and dropping the typed prompt, when starting a new session
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图在开始新会话时有时会打开旧对话并删除键入的提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents`: opening a stopped session that you already resumed in another terminal no longer starts a second process on that conversation; the row now says it is open in a terminal
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”：打开已在另一个终端中恢复的已停止会话不再启动该对话的第二个进程；该行现在表示它已在终端中打开

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` and `claude rm` refusing to delete a session ("has commits that are not pushed anywhere") when its worktree branch was already merged into your checked-out default branch (e.g. local `main`) but not yet pushed
entries.zh: 修复了当工作树分支已合并到签出的默认分支（例如本地`main`）但尚未推送时，“claude Agents”和`claude rm`拒绝删除会话（“具有未推送到任何地方的提交”）的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions waiting silently when a `PermissionRequest` or `PreToolUse` hook prints an invalid answer: the `claude agents` row now names the hook and the schema error
entries.zh: 修复了当`PermissionRequest`或`PreToolUse`挂钩打印无效答案时后台会话静默等待的问题：“claude Agents”行现在命名该挂钩和架构错误

entries.en: Fixed hooks silently treating a stdout `{…}` object that isn't valid JSON as plain text; it's now reported as a hook error with the parse message
entries.zh: 修复了挂钩以静默方式将非有效 JSON 的 stdout `{...}` 对象视为纯文本的问题；现在，它被报告为解析消息的挂钩错误

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` listing a project `.mcp.json` entry that declares the claude.ai connector type under the trusted "claude.ai" heading; it now appears under its real scope
entries.zh: 修复了列出项目`.mcp.json`条目的`/mcp`，该条目在受信任的“claude.ai”标题下声明了 claude.ai 连接器类型；它现在出现在其真实范围内

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers whose `headersHelper` supplies the `Authorization` header falling into OAuth discovery on a 401 instead of re-running the helper and retrying the call as documented
entries.zh: 修复了`headersHelper`提供`Authorization`标头的 MCP 服务器落入 401 上的 OAuth 发现的问题，而不是重新运行帮助程序并重试记录中的调用

entries.en: Fixed `/login` to a Claude apps gateway hanging when the managed-settings security approval dialog was required
entries.zh: 修复了需要托管设置安全审批对话框时克劳德应用程序网关挂起的`/login`问题

entries.en: Fixed gateway model discovery (`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY`) never running when `apiKeyHelper` is the only credential
entries.zh: 修复了当`apiKeyHelper`是唯一凭证时网关模型发现（`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY`）永远不会运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude logs` leaving mouse tracking, bracketed paste and the alternate screen switched on in the terminal it was run from
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德日志”留下鼠标跟踪、括号内的粘贴以及在运行它的终端中打开的备用屏幕的问题

entries.en: Fixed the trust dialog's list of repo permission rules showing a garbled character when a long rule was cut off in the middle of an emoji
entries.zh: 修复信任对话框中仓库权限规则列表在长规则于 emoji 中间被截断时显示乱码字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed the permission mode indicator staying hidden behind the "Press Ctrl-C again to exit" hint when you press shift+tab right after ctrl+c
entries.zh: 修复在按下 ctrl+c 后立即按 shift+tab，权限模式指示器被"再按一次 Ctrl-C 退出"提示遮挡的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` and locally seeded cloud sessions uploading uncommitted edits to `prod.env`-style and `*.tfvars` files, or to editor swap, temp, and backup copies of credential files (e.g. `key.pem.tmp`, `id_rsa.swo`); they now stay on your machine
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`和本地种子云会话，将未提交的编辑上传到`prod.env`样式和`*.tfvars`文件，或编辑凭证文件的交换、临时和备份副本（例如`key.pem.tmp`、`id_rsa.swo`）；他们现在留在你的机器上

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions occasionally never showing a permission prompt or the latest messages on the connected device after the CLI silently reconnected
entries.zh: 修复了 CLI 静默重新连接后，远程控制会话偶尔不会在连接的设备上显示权限提示或最新消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions occasionally failing at startup when the container's session credentials were not yet readable
entries.zh: 修复了当容器的会话凭据尚不可读时云会话在启动时偶尔会失败的问题
