entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control` rejecting its own flags (e.g. `--spawn`, `--name`) when a global flag or a wrapper-injected option precedes the subcommand
entries.zh: 修复了当全局标志或包装器注入选项位于子命令之前时，“claude Remote-Control”拒绝其自己的标志（例如`--spawn`、`--name`）

entries.en: Fixed startup warnings (e.g. "N MCP servers need authentication") rendering one column right of the rest of the transcript
entries.zh: 修复了启动警告（例如“N MCP 服务器需要身份验证”），在转录本其余部分的右侧呈现一列

entries.en: Fixed a backgrounded worktree session losing its checkout: the background session now holds the worktree's lock while it runs, so cleanup and `git worktree remove` leave it alone
entries.zh: 修复了后台工作树会话丢失签出的问题：后台会话现在在运行时持有工作树的锁，因此清理和“git worktree删除”不会影响它

entries.en: Fixed @-mentions of other sessions not matching names typed with non-Latin characters (for example Korean entered through an IME)
entries.zh: 修复了其他会话的@提及与使用非拉丁字符输入的名称不匹配的问题（例如通过 IME 输入的韩语）

entries.en: Fixed an invalid `crossSessionInbound` value being silently ignored: it now warns and holds cross-session messages (user settings) or refuses them (managed settings) until fixed
entries.zh: 修复了被默默忽略的无效`crossSessionInbound`值：它现在警告并保留跨会话消息（用户设置）或拒绝它们（托管设置），直到修复为止

entries.en: Fixed rate-limit, usage, and fast-mode messages telling you to run `/usage-credits` when that command isn't available for your organization (e.g. hidden with `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND`)
entries.zh: 修复了速率限制、使用情况和快速模式消息，当您的组织无法使用该命令时，告诉您运行`/usage-credits`（例如使用`DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND`隐藏）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a chat tab getting stuck on "No conversation found" when its session was never saved; it now starts a new conversation instead
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话从未保存时，聊天标签页卡在 "No conversation found" 的问题；现在会改为开始新对话

entries.en: Improved the Workflow tool's prompt footprint: its description is now about 1k tokens instead of 5.7k, with the script-writing reference moved into a bundled `workflow-authoring` skill
entries.zh: 改进 Workflow 工具的提示词体积：描述从约 5.7k token 减少到约 1k token，脚本编写参考移到了内置的 `workflow-authoring` 技能中

entries.en: Improved the prompt-footer PR badge to check GitHub less often while the pull request is unchanged; a push or a `gh pr` command still refreshes it right away
entries.zh: 改进提示框底部的 PR 徽章：PR 没有变化时减少检查 GitHub 的频率；推送或执行 `gh pr` 命令时仍会立即刷新

entries.en: Improved managed settings: client-side timeout, MCP startup-mode, and stream-watchdog env vars no longer trigger the settings-approval prompt
entries.zh: 改进托管设置：客户端超时、MCP 启动模式和流监控的环境变量不再触发设置审批提示

entries.en: Improved `/ultrareview <PR#>` to check before launch that the GitHub account connected to your Claude account can access the repository, and to explain how to fix it, instead of failing after the cloud session starts
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview <PR#>`：启动前检查连接到你 Claude 账号的 GitHub 账号能否访问该仓库，并说明如何修复，而不是等云会话启动后才失败

entries.en: Improved cross-session messaging: falls back to a private per-user `/tmp` directory when the default one can't be used, and the notice and `/status` name the directory to fix
entries.zh: 改进跨会话消息：默认的 `/tmp` 目录不可用时，回退到每个用户私有的 `/tmp` 目录；通知和 `/status` 会说明需要修复的目录

entries.en: Changed shift+enter in the agent view dispatch input to insert a newline (matching the prompt); ctrl+enter now dispatches and attaches
entries.zh: 更改了代理视图调度输入中的shift+enter以插入换行符（与提示符匹配）； ctrl+enter 现在发送并附加

entries.en: Changed `/loop`: self-paced dynamic mode and the no-prompt autonomous default are now always available, including on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry
entries.zh: 更改了`/loop`：自定进度动态模式和无提示自主默认设置现在始终可用，包括在 Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry 上

entries.en: Changed Anthropic telemetry export failures to log at debug level as `[Anthropic telemetry]` instead of `[3P telemetry] OTEL diag error`, so they are not mistaken for your OTel collector failing
entries.zh: 将 Anthropic 遥测导出失败更改为在调试级别记录为`[Anthropic telemetry]`，而不是`[3P telemetry] OTEL diag error`，因此它们不会被误认为您的 OTel 收集器失败

entries.en: Changed cross-session messaging in Linux user namespaces: root-equivalent trust for unmapped owners is limited to canonical system directories
entries.zh: 更改了 Linux 用户命名空间中的跨会话消息传递：未映射所有者的 root 等效信任仅限于规范系统目录

entries.en: Changed `SendMessage` from a subagent to another session: the result now notes that any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to the subagent
entries.zh: 将`SendMessage`从子代理更改为另一个会话：结果现在注意到任何回复都会传递到父会话的对话，而不是传递到子代理

entries.en: Added the `SendFeedback` tool: when something goes wrong in a session, Claude can draft a feedback report for you to review and send from `/feedback` (turn off with the `feedbackDrafts` setting)
entries.zh: 添加了`SendFeedback`工具：当会话中出现问题时，Claude 可以起草反馈报告供您查看并从`/feedback`发送（使用`feedbackDrafts`设置关闭）

entries.en: Added `{id, text, cooldownSessions, priority}` entries, `tipsFile`, and `label` to `spinnerTipsOverride`, so organizations can rotate their own tips alongside the built-in ones
entries.zh: 在`spinnerTipsOverride`中添加了“{id、text、cooldownSessions、priority}”条目、`tipsFile`和`label`，以便组织可以将自己的提示与内置提示一起轮换

entries.en: Added a tip on Bash permission prompts pointing to auto mode, with a one-keystroke "Yes, and switch to auto mode" option
entries.zh: 添加了关于 Bash 权限提示指向自动模式的提示，并带有一键“是，并切换到自动模式”选项

entries.en: Added `/claude-api cost-optimize` to profile an existing project's Claude API spend and work through cost levers (caching, token hygiene, batch, effort, model choice) one measured change at a time
entries.zh: 添加了`/claude-api cost-optimize`来分析现有项目的 Claude API 支出，并通过成本杠杆（缓存、令牌卫生、批量、工作量、模型选择）一次测量一个变化

entries.en: Updated the `/claude-api` skill with Admin API coverage (organization members, invites, workspaces, API keys, rate limit reports, workload identity federation, CMEK)
entries.zh: `/claude-api` 技能新增 Admin API 覆盖范围（组织成员、邀请、工作区、API 密钥、限流报告、工作负载身份联合、CMEK）

entries.en: Fixed fast arrow-key + Enter sequences acting on the row above the one you navigated to in history search, `/config`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, background tasks, and `/model`
entries.zh: 修复了快速箭头键 + 输入序列作用于您在历史搜索中导航到的行上方的行、`/config`、`/mcp`、`/skills`、后台任务和`/model`

entries.en: Fixed sub-agents dying on a first-call model 404: they now use the session's fallback model chain, and the error returned to the parent includes the error type, status, request id, and model
entries.zh: 修复了子代理因首次调用模型 404 而死亡的问题：它们现在使用会话的后备模型链，并且返回给父级的错误包括错误类型、状态、请求 ID 和模型

entries.en: Fixed a hook or background agent that printed megabytes of error output being able to overflow the conversation and wedge the session on "Prompt is too long"
entries.zh: 修复了打印兆字节错误输出的挂钩或后台代理，能够溢出对话并将会话楔入“提示太长”

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl keyboard shortcuts not firing under non-Latin (e.g. Cyrillic) keyboard layouts in kitty-protocol terminals
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl 键盘快捷键在 kitty 协议终端中的非拉丁语（例如西里尔语）键盘布局下不触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed text like `<35;150;7M` being inserted into the prompt when a mouse report arrived split across reads right after the escape prefix
entries.zh: 修复鼠标报告在转义前缀之后被分段读取时，类似 `<35;150;7M` 的文本被插入提示框的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Bash sandbox's after-command cleanup deleting a dotfile-managed `~/.claude/settings.json` symlink (nix/home-manager, stow) when it is repointed outside the sandbox's writable area
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 沙箱的命令后清理，当它被重新指向沙箱的可写区域之外时，会删除点文件管理的`~/.claude/settings.json`符号链接（nix/home-manager，stow）

entries.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` overwriting your entire Zed `keymap.json` instead of merging in its keybinding
entries.zh: 修复了`/terminal-setup`覆盖整个 Zed`keymap.json`而不是合并到其键绑定中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` silently confirming when the session registry could not be updated; it now says other sessions may still show the old name
entries.zh: 修复了会话注册表无法更新时以静默方式确认的`/rename`；现在它说其他会话可能仍显示旧名称

entries.en: Fixed `/compact` and "Summarize from here" in sessions started with `--agent` summarizing under the default system prompt instead of the conversation's own
entries.zh: 修复了以`--agent`开始的会话中的`/compact`和“从这里总结”，在默认系统提示下而不是对话自己的提示下进行总结

entries.en: Fixed a background session showing "opening…" forever in `claude agents` after its terminal host process died; the row now fails within seconds with the reason, and Enter restarts it
entries.zh: 修复了终端主机进程死亡后，后台会话在“claude Agents”中永远显示“正在打开...”的问题；该行现在会在几秒钟内失败并显示原因，然后按 Enter 重新启动它

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth when a hook's or background task's output file could not be written; the file now notes where output was lost
entries.zh: 修复钩子或后台任务的输出文件无法写入时内存无限增长的问题；现在该文件会注明输出在何处丢失

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` over SSH: the copy shortcut now says how the sign-in URL was copied instead of always claiming success, and the URL appears immediately when no browser can open
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 修复了`/install-github-app`：复制快捷方式现在显示如何复制登录 URL，而不是始终声明成功，并且当没有浏览器可以打开时，该 URL 会立即出现

entries.en: Fixed shell commands carried over from the foreground logging an internal error or showing a misleading `[exited with code -1]` line when they finish in background sessions
entries.zh: 修复了从前台继承的 shell 命令，记录内部错误或在后台会话中完成时显示误导性的`[exited with code -1]`行

entries.en: Fixed a version-less marketplace plugin's live cache directory being deleted and recreated on a second-scope install, which could disrupt a running session using it
entries.zh: 修复了无版本市场插件的实时缓存目录被删除并在第二范围安装上重新创建的问题，这可能会中断使用它的正在运行的会话

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions started with `/remote-control` not reporting the working-tree diff to connected clients
entries.zh: 修复了以`/remote-control`启动的远程控制会话不向连接的客户端报告工作树差异的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions reporting `running` before Claude Code had started, which could trigger a premature "Claude is waiting for your input" notification from the Claude desktop app
entries.zh: 修复了在 Claude Code 启动之前自托管的运行器会话报告“正在运行”的问题，这可能会触发来自 Claude 桌面应用程序的过早“Claude 正在等待您的输入”通知

entries.en: Fixed first-run setup exiting with "Unable to connect to Anthropic services" when managed settings configure Claude apps gateway sign-in and Anthropic endpoints are unreachable
entries.zh: 修复了当托管设置配置 Claude 应用程序网关登录且 Anthropic 端点无法访问时，首次运行设置会退出并显示“无法连接到 Anthropic 服务”的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions (Claude Code on the web, desktop and mobile apps) sometimes showing the previous permission mode when you switch modes right after sending a message
entries.zh: 修复了当您在发送消息后立即切换模式时，云会话（Web、桌面和移动应用程序上的 Claude Code）有时会显示之前的权限模式

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions going silent when the session's container restarts between turns while a background agent, shell, or monitor is still running — the resumed session now reports the lost work
entries.zh: 修复了当会话的容器在轮次之间重新启动而后台代理、shell 或监视器仍在运行时，云会话会变得静默的问题 — 恢复的会话现在会报告丢失的工作

entries.en: Improved plugin marketplace hardening: names containing control or invisible characters are rejected, and marketplace-supplied text in `/plugin` and `claude plugin` output is escape-safe
entries.zh: 加强插件市场安全：名称中含控制字符或不可见字符的会被拒绝；市场提供的文字在 `/plugin` 和 `claude plugin` 输出中会做转义处理，确保安全

entries.en: Improved Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry sessions (and any with telemetry disabled): Claude is now told when a configured MCP server failed to connect, instead of concluding its tools don't exist
entries.zh: 改进：在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 会话中（或禁用遥测时），Claude 现在会被告知某个已配置的 MCP 服务器连接失败，而不是误以为工具不存在

entries.en: Changed Sonnet 5's default auto-compact window to its full 1M context, so sessions on the 1M window now auto-compact at about 967K tokens instead of about 934K
entries.zh: 将 Sonnet 5 的默认自动压缩窗口更改为完整的 1M 上下文，因此 1M 窗口上的会话现在自动压缩为大约 967K 令牌，而不是大约 934K

entries.en: Changed cross-session peer messages to collapse by default to a one-line `Message from @<sender>: <first line>` preview; Ctrl+O expands the full body
entries.zh: 更改了跨会话对等消息，默认折叠为单行“来自@<发件人>的消息：<第一行>”预览； Ctrl+O 展开全身

entries.en: Changed terminal hyperlinks in rendered markdown: link targets that point at a network or automounter path, contain a control character, or lead with an invisible character now render as plain text
entries.zh: 更改了呈现的 Markdown 中的终端超链接：指向网络或自动安装程序路径、包含控制字符或带有不可见字符的引导的链接目标现在呈现为纯文本

entries.en: Changed the prompt-footer PR badge to skip its GitHub re-check on terminal refocus when the last check is under a minute old
entries.zh: 更改了提示页脚 PR 徽章，以在最后一次检查不到一分钟时跳过终端重新聚焦时的 GitHub 重新检查

entries.en: Changed analytics to stay off from startup, not only after login, when managed settings force gateway login or a custom OAuth deployment is configured
entries.zh: 更改了分析以阻止启动，不仅是在登录后，当托管设置强制网关登录或配置自定义 OAuth 部署时

entries.en: Changed Claude apps gateway sign-in requests to identify Claude Code (a `surface=claude_code` device-authorization parameter and a `claude-code/<version>` User-Agent)
entries.zh: 更改了 Claude 应用程序网关登录请求以识别 Claude Code（`surface=claude_code`设备授权参数和`claude-code/<version>`用户代理）

entries.en: Changed organization sign-in enforcement to exit at start when the administrator's managed settings cannot be read, even if host-supplied or per-user Windows registry settings exist
entries.zh: 将组织登录强制更改为在无法读取管理员的托管设置时在启动时退出，即使存在主机提供的或每用户的 Windows 注册表设置

entries.en: Added a startup warning for Bash allow rules with a wildcard before the subcommand (e.g. `Bash(git * main)`), since they also match options inserted before the subcommand
entries.zh: 在子命令之前添加了针对带有通配符的 Bash 允许规则的启动警告（例如`Bash(git * main)`），因为它们还匹配在子命令之前插入的选项

entries.en: Added an Auto mode tab to `/permissions` for viewing and editing auto mode classifier rules
entries.zh: 在`/permissions`中添加了自动模式选项卡，用于查看和编辑自动模式分类器规则

entries.en: Added the turn's completion time to the end-of-turn duration line, e.g. `✻ Sautéed for 23s · done 6:05 PM`
entries.zh: 将回合的完成时间添加到回合结束持续时间线中，例如`✻炒23秒·下午6:05完成`

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode showing a blank transcript after resizing the terminal and jumping to the bottom until the next keypress
entries.zh: 修复了调整终端大小并跳到底部直到下一次按键后显示空白记录的全屏模式

entries.en: Fixed a severe transcript slowdown when a diff contained a very long single line (e.g. a base64 string); such lines now render truncated with a marker
entries.zh: 修复了当 diff 包含很长的单行（例如，base64 字符串）时，转录严重减慢的问题；这些行现在用标记截断呈现

entries.en: Fixed erratic fullscreen scrolling when positioned at an earlier message, including jump-to-bottom getting stuck mid-transcript
entries.zh: 修复了定位到较早消息时不稳定的全屏滚动，包括跳到底部卡在脚本中间

entries.en: Fixed background sessions failing to open after 45 seconds when Claude Code's starting directory had been deleted, the machine had slept, or the host is slow to start processes
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 的起始目录被删除、机器已休眠或主机启动进程缓慢时，后台会话在 45 秒后无法打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions failing to open with "Couldn't start the background service … EACCES" when another Claude Code process was re-installing the npm package at that moment
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个 Claude Code 进程当时重新安装 npm 包时后台会话无法打开并显示“无法启动后台服务... EACCES”的问题

entries.en: Fixed markdown rendering being disabled for a whole message when its first 500 characters contained no markdown, and for `+`/`N)` lists and setext headings
entries.zh: 修复了当前 500 个字符不包含 Markdown 时整条消息以及`+`/`N)`列表和 setext 标题禁用 Markdown 渲染的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls interrupted by an incoming message in headless/remote sessions being reported to the model as "completed with no output" instead of an explicit interrupted error
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 工具调用因无头/远程会话中的传入消息而中断的问题，并报告给模型“已完成，无输出”，而不是显式中断错误

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool arguments being sent as JSON strings when the parameter's schema is empty (`{}`), instead of their real type
entries.zh: 修复了当参数架构为空 (`{}`) 时 MCP 工具参数作为 JSON 字符串发送，而不是其真实类型

entries.en: Fixed a command interrupted mid-run showing as "Ran 1 shell command" with no sign it was cut
entries.zh: 修复了一个命令在运行中中断，显示为“Ran 1 shell 命令”，没有任何迹象表明它被切断

entries.en: Fixed pressing ← or running `/background` during a dynamic workflow restarting its finished subagents; it now asks first and says how many subagents would restart
entries.zh: 修复了在动态工作流程重新启动其已完成的子代理期间按 ← 或运行`/background`的问题；现在它首先询问并说明将重新启动多少个子代理

entries.en: Fixed opening a just-started session in `claude agents` while its worker was still booting (common on Windows) stopping it with "was stopped while the respawn was in flight"
entries.zh: 修复了在“克劳德代理”中打开刚刚启动的会话，而其工作人员仍在启动（在 Windows 上常见）的问题，并以“重生正在飞行中时停止”来停止它

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` listing a backgrounded named session twice; backgrounding the same conversation again now numbers the new row (e.g. `my-session (2)`)
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”两次列出后台命名会话的问题；现在再次将同一对话置于后台对新行进行编号（例如`my-session (2)`）

entries.en: Fixed the background retention sweep removing git worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` that you created yourself when an old background-session record pointed at them
entries.zh: 修复后台保留期清理会删除你自己创建的、位于 `.claude/worktrees/` 下的 git 工作树（因为某个旧后台会话记录指向了它们）的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode tool calls being denied as "temporarily unavailable" on very large sessions by scaling the safety-check deadline with prompt size
entries.zh: 通过按提示大小调整安全检查期限，修复了在大型会话中自动模式工具调用被拒绝为“暂时不可用”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the plugin cache creating duplicate SHA-named directories for the same plugin
entries.zh: 修复插件缓存为同一插件创建了重复的 SHA 命名目录的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin skills whose frontmatter `name` already includes the `<plugin>:` prefix showing it doubled in the slash menu (e.g. `/plugin:plugin:skill`)
entries.zh: 修复了其 frontmatter `name` 已经包含 `<plugin>:` 前缀的插件技能，显示它在斜杠菜单中加倍（例如 `/plugin:plugin:skill`）

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin update` failing for an installed plugin given its bare name (only the fully-qualified name worked)
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件更新”对于给定其裸名称的已安装插件失败的问题（只有完全限定的名称有效）

entries.en: Fixed plugin installation failing when `plugin.json` was saved with a UTF-8 byte-order mark (BOM)
entries.zh: 修复了使用 UTF-8 字节顺序标记 (BOM) 保存`plugin.json`时插件安装失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/reload-plugins` reporting 0 skills for plugins that define skills under `skills/*/SKILL.md`
entries.zh: 修复了在`skills/*/SKILL.md`下定义技能的插件的`/reload-plugins`报告 0 技能的问题

entries.en: Fixed hook error messages showing a literal `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` instead of the resolved plugin path
entries.zh: 修复了显示文字`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`而不是解析的插件路径的挂钩错误消息

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` replacing the theme's prompt border color (including a custom theme's `promptBorder`) with the default cyan; the border now keeps your theme's color unless you pick one with `/color`
entries.zh: 修复了`/rename`将主题的提示边框颜色（包括自定义主题的`promptBorder`）替换为默认青色的问题；边框现在会保留主题的颜色，除非您选择带有`/color`的颜色

entries.en: Fixed custom theme diff colors (`diffAdded`/`diffRemoved` and their dimmed variants) being ignored in diffs and the `/theme` preview
entries.zh: 修复了差异和`/theme`预览中忽略的自定义主题差异颜色（`diffAdded`/`diffRemoved`及其变暗变体）

entries.en: Fixed a `keybindings.json` binding with an unknown action name silently deadening that key; it is now skipped so the default binding keeps working, and a warning is logged under `--debug`
entries.zh: 修复了`keybindings.json`与未知操作名称的绑定，默默地使该键失效；现在它被跳过，因此默认绑定继续工作，并且在`--debug`下记录警告

entries.en: Fixed `/stats` activity heatmap showing each day's activity one cell off (Sunday's count under Monday) in timezones east of UTC
entries.zh: 修复了`/stats`活动热图，显示 UTC 以东时区每天的活动相差一个单元格（周日的计数低于周一）

entries.en: Fixed `/fork` from an already-forked or backgrounded session starting the new session with an empty conversation
entries.zh: 修复了已分叉或后台会话中的`/fork`，以空对话启动新会话

entries.en: Fixed prompts beginning with `/--` (e.g. Lean doc comments) being rejected as an unknown slash command instead of being sent to Claude
entries.zh: 修复了以`/--`开头的提示（例如精益文档注释）被作为未知斜杠命令拒绝而不是发送给克劳德

entries.en: Fixed the `@` file picker staying open after the typed text stopped matching a real path
entries.zh: 修复输入的文字已与真实路径不匹配后，`@` 文件选择器仍保持打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed the status line's cost and duration resetting to zero after navigating to the agents view and back
entries.zh: 修复导航到智能体视图再返回后，状态行的费用和时长被重置为零的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode moving keyboard focus onto the control under the pointer when you clicked the terminal window only to bring it back into focus
entries.zh: 修复了当您单击终端窗口时仅将其重新聚焦到全屏模式时，将键盘焦点移动到指针下方的控件上的问题

entries.en: Fixed path completion failing when the completion token or working directory contained a null byte
entries.zh: 修复了当完成标记或工作目录包含空字节时路径完成失败的问题

entries.en: Windows/macOS: Fixed headless sessions not cleaning up stale entries in `~/.claude/sessions` left by sessions that exited uncleanly
entries.zh: Windows/macOS：修复了无界面会话未清理 `~/.claude/sessions` 中因异常退出而残留的过期条目的问题

entries.en: Fixed the UI stopping with a render error on the first tool call when a third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoint (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) streams a `tool_use` block without an `id`
entries.zh: 修复第三方 Anthropic 兼容端点（`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`）发送的 `tool_use` 块缺少 `id` 时，界面在第一次工具调用时出现渲染错误并停止的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Write tool reporting "Out of memory" or freezing for a long time after overwriting a very large existing file, even though the file had been written
entries.zh: 修复 Write 工具覆盖一个很大的已有文件后报告"Out of memory"或长时间卡死（尽管文件已写入）的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin install <name>` exiting silently (or hanging in a terminal) instead of reporting an error when `~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json` is empty or corrupted
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json`为空或损坏时`claude plugin install <name>`静默退出（或挂在终端中）而不是报告错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed resumed sessions failing every turn with a 400 when the saved history contains tool blocks the Anthropic API does not accept (typically written by a third-party API proxy)
entries.zh: 修复了当保存的历史记录包含 Anthropic API 不接受的工具块（通常由第三方 API 代理编写）时，恢复的会话每次都会失败并显示 400

entries.en: Fixed `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash` failing with "Raw mode is not supported" for some Team/Enterprise users with server-managed settings
entries.zh: 修复了 `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh |对于某些具有服务器管理设置的团队/企业用户，bash` 失败并显示“不支持原始模式”

entries.en: Fixed sessions that ended in plan mode resuming outside plan mode in the VS Code extension, and in `claude -p --continue`/`--resume` with a permission prompt tool, when no permission mode was set
entries.zh: 修复了在 VS Code 扩展中以计划模式结束的会话，以及在未设置权限模式时使用权限提示工具在“claude -p --Continue”/`--resume`中恢复计划模式之外的会话

entries.en: Fixed the `Notification` hook not firing while the sandbox "Network request outside of sandbox" permission prompt is waiting
entries.zh: 修复沙盒"沙盒外网络请求"权限提示等待期间，`Notification` 钩子不触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks to always require approval for malformed commands with a dangling `&&` or `||` operator
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查，始终要求使用悬空的`&&`或`||`运算符批准格式错误的命令

entries.en: Fixed `--strict-mcp-config` sessions prompting to approve `.mcp.json` servers they would never load, which left background sessions waiting at startup
entries.zh: 修复了`--strict-mcp-config`会话提示批准它们永远不会加载的`.mcp.json`服务器，这导致后台会话在启动时等待

entries.en: Fixed telemetry and metrics requests to Anthropic carrying the API key configured for a third-party gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`); a credential is now only sent to its own host
entries.zh: 修复发给 Anthropic 的遥测和指标请求携带了第三方网关（`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`）所配置的 API 密钥的问题；现在凭证只会发送到其自身的主机

entries.en: Fixed a visible API error on the first prompt after idle when `apiKeyHelper` returns short-lived JWTs: an expired cached token is now refreshed before sending, and 401/403 auth errors retry quietly
entries.zh: 修复了当`apiKeyHelper`返回短暂的 JWT 时空闲后第一个提示上的可见 API 错误：现在会在发送之前刷新过期的缓存令牌，并且 401/403 身份验证错误会安静地重试

entries.en: Fixed memory growing with session length in the fullscreen and Ctrl+O transcript views: each rendered message row no longer retains a full copy of the transcript-wide tool lookups
entries.zh: 修复了全屏和 Ctrl+O 记录视图中的内存随着会话长度而增长的问题：每个渲染的消息行不再保留记录范围工具查找的完整副本

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` runs and cloud sessions launched at the same time from one repository (e.g. from several worktrees) sometimes starting with another launch's uncommitted changes
entries.zh: 修复了从一个存储库（例如从多个工作树）同时启动的`/ultrareview`运行和云会话，有时会从另一次启动的未提交更改开始

entries.en: Fixed the task progress count (e.g. `3/5`) shown for background cloud sessions such as `/autofix-pr` occasionally missing a task
entries.zh: 修复后台云会话（如 `/autofix-pr`）显示的任务进度计数（如 `3/5`）偶尔漏计任务的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions keeping their placeholder name in claude.ai and the Claude app until the second prompt; the auto-generated title now appears after the first prompt
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话在出现第二个提示之前将其占位符名称保留在 claude.ai 和 Claude 应用程序中的问题；自动生成的标题现在出现在第一个提示之后

entries.en: Fixed MCP tools marked `requiresUserInteraction` still offering "Yes, and don't ask again" in their permission prompt; the option wrote an allow rule the tool then ignored
entries.zh: 修复了标记为`requiresUserInteraction`的 MCP 工具在权限提示中仍提供“是，不再询问”的问题；该选项写入了允许规则，然后该工具忽略了

entries.en: Fixed the self-hosted runner ending its live sessions or exiting when a work-poll response is malformed (e.g. an intercepting proxy's HTML page); it now retries the poll
entries.zh: 修复自托管运行器在工作轮询响应格式错误（例如被拦截代理返回的 HTML 页面）时，结束正在进行的会话或退出的问题；现在会重试轮询

entries.en: Improved `/cd`: the new directory's project settings, hooks, `.mcp.json` servers (behind the usual approval prompt), skills, and agents now take effect right after the move instead of on `--resume`
entries.zh: 改进 `/cd`：切换目录后，新目录的项目设置、钩子、`.mcp.json` 服务器（仍需通常的批准提示）、技能和代理立即生效，不必等到 `--resume`

entries.en: Improved Bash tool latency on bash shells by replaying snapshot functions without a base64 subshell per function
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 工具延迟：重放快照函数时，不再为每个函数单独启动一个 base64 子 shell

entries.en: Improved subagent results: a subagent that stops at its `maxTurns` limit now returns its output marked as partial, with a hint to continue it via `SendMessage`, instead of appearing finished
entries.zh: 改进子智能体结果：子智能体达到 `maxTurns` 上限而停止时，其输出会标为不完整，并提示可通过 `SendMessage` 继续，而不是看起来已经完成

entries.en: Improved non-interactive sessions (`-p`, SDK, cloud sessions) to automatically continue a response cut off mid-stream by a server error, connection loss, or stall instead of ending with an error
entries.zh: 改进非交互会话（`-p`、SDK、云会话）：回复因服务器错误、连接丢失或停滞而中途被截断时，会自动继续，而不是以错误结束

entries.en: Improved attribution of usage telemetry to your organization for workload identity federation sessions, events sent while `apiKeyHelper` runs at startup, and after a login token expired while idle
entries.zh: 改进工作负载身份联合会话、启动时运行 `apiKeyHelper` 期间发出的事件，以及登录令牌空闲过期后的用量遥测归属：归属到你所在的组织

entries.en: Changed `/code-review` so Claude can also start it on its own on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry, through the Claude apps gateway, and when telemetry or non-essential traffic is disabled
entries.zh: 更改了`/code-review`，以便 Claude 还可以在禁用遥测或非必要流量时，通过 Claude 应用程序网关在 Bedrock、Vertex AI 和 Foundry 上自行启动它

entries.en: `/goal`: Changed idle sessions to start at most three check-ins on long-running background work per goal; your next message allows three more
entries.zh: `/goal`：空闲会话对每个目标针对长时间运行的后台工作，最多只会自动检查三次；你的下一条消息会再允许三次

entries.en: Changed `claude install` and `claude update` to defer a pending managed-settings consent prompt to the next interactive session instead of prompting mid-command
entries.zh: 更改了`claude install`和`claude update`，以将待处理的托管设置同意提示推迟到下一个交互式会话，而不是在命令中提示

entries.en: Changed OpenTelemetry plugin events for plugins synced from claude.ai: `plugin_id_hash` now reflects the plugin's real marketplace, and `enabled_via` is `admin-install` for admin-installed plugins
entries.zh: 更改了从 claude.ai 同步的插件的 OpenTelemetry 插件事件：`plugin_id_hash`现在反映了插件的真实市场，`enabled_via`是管理员安装的插件的`admin-install`

entries.en: Fixed the command sandbox's filesystem configuration not respecting `--setting-sources`
entries.zh: 修复命令沙盒的文件系统配置未遵守 `--setting-sources` 的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash on startup on Linux distributions that ship glibc 2.44 (for example Arch Linux, CachyOS and Fedora Rawhide)
entries.zh: 修复了搭载 glibc 2.44 的 Linux 发行版（例如 Arch Linux、CachyOS 和 Fedora Rawhide）上启动时崩溃的问题

entries.en: Added a Loops breakdown to `/usage`: per-loop run count, total tokens, tokens per run, and last run, so runaway or chatty `/loop` tasks are easy to spot
entries.zh: 在`/usage`中添加了循环细分：每个循环的运行计数、总令牌、每次运行的令牌和上次运行，因此失控或喋喋不休的`/loop`任务很容易被发现

entries.en: Added `modelPicker` setting: curate the `/model` picker with an ordered, labeled list of models (any id spelling, including Vertex/Bedrock ids), appended to or replacing the built-in lineup
entries.zh: 添加了`modelPicker`设置：使用有序、带标签的模型列表（任何 id 拼写，包括顶点/基岩 id）来管理`/model`选择器，附加到或替换内置阵容

entries.en: Added `promptCacheTtl` and `subagentPromptCacheTtl` settings so API-key and cloud-provider users can keep a 1-hour prompt cache on the main conversation while subagents stay at 5 minutes
entries.zh: 添加了`promptCacheTtl`和`subagentPromptCacheTtl`设置，以便 API 密钥和云提供商用户可以在主对话上保留 1 小时的提示缓存，而子代理则保留 5 分钟

entries.en: Added `modelPricing` managed setting so an organization's contracted per-model rates and discount multiplier are used for `/cost`, the status line, and telemetry cost figures instead of list price
entries.zh: 添加了`modelPricing`托管设置，以便组织的每个型号的合同费率和折扣乘数用于`/cost`、状态行和遥测成本数据，而不是标价

entries.en: Added a keyless sign-in under `/login` → Anthropic Console: "Sign in with your Console account" (recommended) alongside creating an API key, so organizations that don't allow API keys can sign in
entries.zh: 在`/login`下添加了无密钥登录 → Anthropic Console：“使用您的控制台帐户登录”（推荐）并创建 API 密钥，以便不允许 API 密钥的组织可以登录

entries.en: Added a `Skipped sources` line to `/status` that lists managed settings sources (for example `managed-settings.json`) present but not applied because a higher-precedence managed source is active
entries.zh: 在`/status`中添加了“跳过的源”行，列出了存在但未应用的托管设置源（例如“托管设置.json”），因为更高优先级的托管源处于活动状态

entries.en: Added a `managed` marker in `/mcp` and `/plugins` on claude.ai connectors whose authentication is managed by your organization
entries.zh: 在 claude.ai 连接器上的`/mcp`和`/plugins`中添加了“托管”标记，其身份验证由您的组织管理

entries.en: Added a tip pointing claude.ai users who haven't connected GitHub for Claude Code on the web to `/web-setup`
entries.zh: 添加了一条提示，指出尚未将 GitHub for Claude Code on the web 连接到 '`/web-setup`' 的 claude.ai 用户

entries.en: Added a `/status` line showing whether GitHub is connected for Claude Code on the web (Pro/Max), pointing to `/web-setup` when it isn't
entries.zh: 添加了一个`/status`行，显示 GitHub 是否已连接到网络上的 Claude Code（Pro/Max），如果未连接，则指向`/web-setup`

entries.en: Added the model (and effort level) each subagent ran on to `/tasks` and the agent detail dialogs
entries.zh: 添加了每个子代理运行的模型（和工作级别）到`/tasks`和代理详细信息对话框

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP servers in non-interactive (`-p`) and SDK sessions never recovering after a dropped connection; they now reconnect automatically or report as failed
entries.zh: 修复了非交互式 (`-p`) 中的远程 MCP 服务器和 SDK 会话在连接断开后永远无法恢复的问题；他们现在自动重新连接或报告失败

entries.en: Fixed MCP server sign-in started from the desktop app failing with "Invalid redirect URI" on servers that support client ID metadata documents (for example Linear)
entries.zh: 修复了在支持客户端 ID 元数据文档（例如 Linear）的服务器上从桌面应用程序启动的 MCP 服务器登录失败并显示“无效重定向 URI”的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode staying unavailable at startup when a temporary server-side disable was cached and later flag fetches failed
entries.zh: 修复了当缓存临时服务器端禁用并且后来的标志获取失败时，自动模式在启动时保持不可用的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode tool calls being denied as "temporarily unavailable" after about a minute of waiting when the API was briefly overloaded and asked the client to retry
entries.zh: 修复了当 API 短暂过载并要求客户端重试时，自动模式工具调用在等待大约一分钟后被拒绝为“暂时不可用”

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker silently ignoring an Ultracode selection; picking Ultracode now applies it to the current session
entries.zh: 修复 `/model` 选择器静默忽略 Ultracode 选项的问题；现在选择 Ultracode 会应用到当前会话

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` only listing the 50 most recent sessions; the picker now loads more as you scroll
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`仅列出最近 50 个会话的问题；现在，当您滚动时，选择器会加载更多内容

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions resuming after a mid-turn restart with a pending hook or background-task notification re-sent as the prompt instead of the normal continuation message
entries.zh: 修复了中途重新启动后云会话恢复的问题，其中挂起的挂钩或后台任务通知作为提示重新发送，而不是正常的继续消息

entries.en: Fixed cross-session messaging silently turning off inside user namespaces and rootless containers after the 2.1.232 socket-directory hardening
entries.zh: 修复了 2.1.232 套接字目录强化后以静默方式关闭内部用户命名空间和无根容器的跨会话消息传递

entries.en: Fixed text that hangs outside its container (for example the sign-in URL in `/login`) losing its leading columns when another part of the screen repaints
entries.zh: 修复超出容器的文字（例如 `/login` 中的登录链接）在屏幕其他部分重绘时丢失开头几列的问题

entries.en: Fixed `spellcheck` not underlining a misspelled word typed directly after an emoji
entries.zh: 修复了“拼写检查”未在表情符号后直接输入的拼写错误单词下划线的问题

entries.en: Fixed background subagents not waking when their last background Bash task completes
entries.zh: 修复了后台子代理在最后一个后台 Bash 任务完成时未唤醒的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions going silent for 10+ minutes when the Anthropic API never starts a response: the request now times out after ~3 minutes, retries once, then shows `API Error: No response from API`
entries.zh: 修复了当 Anthropic API 从未开始响应时会话静默 10 分钟以上的问题：请求现在在大约 3 分钟后超时，重试一次，然后显示“API 错误：API 没有响应”

entries.en: Fixed auth, model-availability, and other client-generated error messages rendering like model output instead of as error lines
entries.zh: 修复了身份验证、模型可用性和其他客户端生成的错误消息，它们呈现为模型输出而不是错误行

entries.en: Fixed workload identity federation in CI: processes in one job share the exchanged token instead of re-exchanging the single-use token; a rejected exchange fails fast with the server's message
entries.zh: 修复 CI 中的工作负载身份联合：同一任务中的进程共享已换取的令牌，而不是重复换取一次性令牌；换取被拒绝时会快速失败并显示服务器消息

entries.en: Fixed server-managed `companyAnnouncements` not showing at startup in a session that began with signing in (for example the first launch after `/logout`)
entries.zh: 修复了服务器管理的`companyAnnouncements`在以登录开始的会话启动时不显示的问题（例如`/logout`后的首次启动）

entries.en: Fixed hook `if` conditions like `Bash(cat *)` firing on unrelated Bash commands when the command contained `$()` or backtick command substitution followed by more arguments
entries.zh: 修复了钩子`if`条件，例如当命令包含`$()`或反引号命令替换后跟更多参数时，在不相关的 Bash 命令上触发`Bash(cat *)`

entries.en: Fixed plugin dependencies declared with a `marketplace` field never resolving when both plugins are loaded together via `--plugin-dir`
entries.zh: 修复了当两个插件通过`--plugin-dir`一起加载时，使用`marketplace`字段声明的插件依赖关系永远不会解析的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/reload-plugins` keeping the LSP tool after the last LSP plugin is disabled; it now also warns before an LSP plugin change that would re-read the conversation
entries.zh: 修复了`/reload-plugins`在禁用最后一个 LSP 插件后保留 LSP 工具的问题；现在，它还会在 LSP 插件更改之前发出警告，从而重新读取对话

entries.en: Fixed `--agents` silently ignoring invalid JSON or invalid agent definitions; it now exits with a clear error, like `--mcp-config`
entries.zh: 修复了`--agents`默默忽略无效 JSON 或无效代理定义的问题；现在退出时出现明显错误，例如`--mcp-config`

entries.en: Fixed `/status` showing "Found invalid entries in: ." with no filename when `~/.claude.json` has an invalid MCP server entry
entries.zh: 修复了`/status`显示“在以下位置找到无效条目：”的问题。当`~/.claude.json`具有无效的 MCP 服务器条目时，没有文件名

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` removing the `/rename` session name from the prompt bar even though the name was kept for the new session
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`从提示栏中删除`/rename`会话名称的问题，即使该名称已保留用于新会话

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+R history search and up-arrow history breaking when `~/.claude/history.jsonl` contains a malformed entry
entries.zh: 修复了当 `~/.claude/history.jsonl` 包含格式错误的条目时 Ctrl+R 历史搜索和向上箭头历史记录中断的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+[ not leaving vim INSERT mode in terminals that encode modified keys (modifyOtherKeys / kitty protocol)
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+[ 在编码修改键的终端中不离开 vim INSERT 模式（modifyOtherKeys / kitty 协议）

entries.en: Fixed the local IDE connection being routed through `HTTPS_PROXY` (and sometimes failing) when `localhost` was listed in `NO_PROXY` but not lowercase `no_proxy`; both casings are now honored
entries.zh: 修复在 `NO_PROXY` 中列出了 `localhost` 但未列出小写 `no_proxy` 时，本地 IDE 连接被错误地经由 `HTTPS_PROXY` 转发（有时会失败）的问题；现在两种写法都会生效

entries.en: Fixed sandbox network-violation details being dropped from the Bash tool result when the blocked command still exited 0 (for example `curl` printing the proxy's 403 page)
entries.zh: 修复了当被阻止的命令仍然退出 0 时，沙箱网络违规详细信息会从 Bash 工具结果中删除（例如`curl`打印代理的 403 页面）

entries.en: Fixed the status line `rate_limits` fields and `/usage` still showing a rate-limit window's pre-reset usage percentage after the window reset while the session was idle
entries.zh: 修复空闲会话中速率限制窗口重置后，状态行的 `rate_limits` 字段和 `/usage` 仍显示重置前用量百分比的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --teleport <session>` exiting on uncommitted changes instead of offering to stash them and continue, as the session picker already does
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --teleport <session>`因未提交的更改而退出的问题，而不是像会话选择器已经做的那样提供存储它们并继续

entries.en: Fixed `/web-setup` repeatedly asking you to log in when an older GitHub CLI (without `gh auth token`) was already authenticated
entries.zh: 修复了当较旧的 GitHub CLI（没有`gh auth token`）已经通过身份验证时，`/web-setup`反复要求您登录的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome losing its connection to Claude Code after an auto-update cleaned up the version it was set up with; the native host now launches via the stable `claude` launcher
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome 中的 Claude 在自动更新清理了其设置的版本后失去与 Claude Code 的连接的问题；本机主机现在通过稳定的`claude`启动器启动

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed sessions started before feature flags were first fetched (for example right after install) opening in the default permission mode instead of auto mode or your configured default mode
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在功能开关首次获取前启动的会话（例如安装后立即启动的会话）会以默认权限模式打开，而不是 auto 模式或你配置的默认模式的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view sections you expanded collapsing on their own during subagent tool activity
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复子 agent 工具活动期间，你展开的 Focus 视图区块自行折叠的问题

entries.en: Improved startup time: sandbox and MCP bring-up no longer block the first frame, bare launches skip subcommand registration, and workflow discovery, settings, and trust-store work is cheaper
entries.zh: 改进启动时间：沙盒和 MCP 的初始化不再阻塞首帧画面，直接启动时跳过子命令注册，工作流发现、设置和信任存储的处理也更省时

entries.en: Improved native install and auto-update download size: the binary is now zstd-compressed (about 75 MB instead of 340 MB on Linux x64)
entries.zh: 改进原生安装和自动更新的下载体积：二进制文件改为 zstd 压缩（Linux x64 上约 75 MB，原为 340 MB）

entries.en: Improved attribution of usage telemetry to your organization for sessions that authenticate with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` directly against the Anthropic API, so its data-handling settings apply
entries.zh: 改进用 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` 直接连接 Anthropic API 的会话的用量遥测归属：归属到你所在的组织，使该组织的数据处理设置适用

entries.en: Improved native binary size: about 2 MB smaller by storing the bundled skill and prompt text more compactly
entries.zh: 改进原生二进制文件大小：内置技能和提示文本以更紧凑的方式存储，约小 2 MB

entries.en: Improved memory usage of native builds: code is now loaded on demand instead of keeping the whole bundle resident (roughly 40–70 MB less memory per session)
entries.zh: 改进原生构建版本的内存占用：代码按需加载，不再把整个包常驻内存（每个会话减少约 40–70 MB）

entries.en: Improved peak memory usage in long-running sessions (the runtime now garbage-collects sooner as the heap grows)
entries.zh: 改进长时间运行会话的内存峰值占用（运行时随堆增长会更早进行垃圾回收）

entries.en: Improved `/login` over SSH: the sign-in URL appears immediately, pressing `c` reports how the URL was copied instead of always claiming success, and a hint explains how to select text in fullscreen
entries.zh: 改进 SSH 下的 `/login`：登录网址立即显示；按 `c` 会如实报告网址是怎样复制的，而不是一律显示成功；提示说明了全屏模式下如何选中文字

entries.en: Improved the error when effort `xhigh`/`max` is used with thinking turned off: it now names the level, the setting that disabled thinking, and `/effort high` as the fix
entries.zh: 改进 effort 设为 `xhigh`/`max` 但思考已关闭时的报错：会写出该级别、关闭思考的设置，并给出 `/effort high` 作为修复方法

entries.en: Improved `/loop`: consecutive wake-ups where Claude has nothing to do now fold into a single line in the terminal instead of printing each one
entries.zh: 改进 `/loop`：Claude 无事可做的连续唤醒，在终端中合并为一行，不再逐条打印

entries.en: Changed the sandboxed Bash tool prompt to no longer list allowed network hosts, so Claude attempts requests (and you can approve new hosts) instead of assuming unlisted hosts are blocked
entries.zh: 将沙盒 Bash 工具提示更改为不再列出允许的网络主机，因此 Claude 会尝试请求（并且您可以批准新主机），而不是假设未列出的主机被阻止

entries.en: Updated the `/model` picker and the bundled `claude-api` skill to show Sonnet 5's $2/$10 per Mtok pricing as its standard list price rather than a limited-time promo
entries.zh: `/model` 选择器和内置的 `claude-api` 技能，现在将 Sonnet 5 的 $2/$10（每百万 token）价格显示为标准标价，而不是限时促销价

entries.en: Changed computer use on macOS so clicking the desktop, Dock, or a Finder window requires granting Finder via the access dialog, like any other app
entries.zh: 更改了 macOS 上的计算机使用方式，因此单击桌面、Dock 或 Finder 窗口需要通过访问对话框授予 Finder 权限，就像任何其他应用程序一样

entries.en: Changed `/model`, `/fast`, and `/effort` to also run immediately instead of queueing until the turn ends on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry and when telemetry is disabled
entries.zh: 更改了`/model`、`/fast`和`/effort`，使其也立即运行，而不是排队直到基岩、顶点和铸造厂的回合结束以及禁用遥测时

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control` exiting and stranding attached Remote Control sessions when the server drops its environment mid-session; it now recovers
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器在会话中途删除其环境时，“克劳德远程控制”退出并搁浅附加的远程控制会话；现在已经恢复了

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions served by `claude remote-control` sometimes getting stuck after it was stopped and restarted, for Team and Enterprise members without an admin or owner role
entries.zh: 修复了对于没有管理员或所有者角色的团队和企业成员，“claude Remote Control”服务的远程控制会话在停止并重新启动后有时会卡住的问题

entries.en: Changed the cross-session messaging inbox socket to close connections that send no complete line within 30 seconds; scripts posting to it should connect once their data is ready
entries.zh: 更改了跨会话消息收件箱套接字，以关闭 30 秒内未发送完整行的连接；发送到它的脚本应该在数据准备好后进行连接

entries.en: Improved the notice when resuming a conversation whose Remote Control is held by another terminal: it now says sessions on other machines can't be seen from, or reach, this one
entries.zh: 改进恢复对话时的提示：如果该对话的 Remote Control 被其他终端占用，会说明其他机器上的会话无法从本机看到，也无法连接到本机

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved history trimming in long sessions: older tool-activity rows are dropped first so your messages and Claude's replies stay visible
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进长会话的历史裁剪：优先删除较早的工具活动行，确保你的消息和 Claude 的回复仍然可见

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved attribution of the extension's own usage telemetry to your organization when you are signed in with a Claude account, so its data-handling settings apply
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进扩展自身用量遥测数据与你所在组织的归属关系：使用 Claude 账号登录时，数据处理设置现在会正确生效

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Cost estimates (`/cost`, status line, `--max-budget-usd`) now include the 1.1× US-only-inference premium for data-residency workspaces
entries.zh: 成本估算（`/cost`、状态行、`--max-budget-usd`）现在包括数据驻留工作空间的 1.1 倍仅限美国的推理溢价

entries.en: Added the one-time fullscreen renderer offer on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other previously excluded setups; new installs there now start in fullscreen
entries.zh: 在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和其他先前排除的设置上添加了一次性全屏渲染器功能；新安装现在以全屏模式开始

entries.en: Added `/claude-api upgrade` to migrate Python projects from `anthropic` 0.x to 1.x, and updated the skill's Python reference for 1.x (timeouts use `anthropic.Timeout`, not `httpx.Timeout`)
entries.zh: 添加了“/claude-api升级”以将Python项目从`anthropic`0.x迁移到1.x，并更新了1.x的技能的Python参考（超时使用`anthropic.Timeout`，而不是`httpx.Timeout`）

entries.en: Cloud sessions: plugins synced from claude.ai now show as `name@synced`, work with `claude plugin enable/disable <name>@synced`, and never override a same-named plugin you installed
entries.zh: 云会话：从 claude.ai 同步的插件现在显示为`name@synced`，与“claude 插件启用/禁用 <name>@synced”配合使用，并且永远不会覆盖您安装的同名插件

entries.en: Alpine/musl builds: native image paste, clipboard, and audio-capture add-ons now load (musl-built binaries instead of glibc ones refused by the runtime)
entries.zh: Alpine/musl 构建：现在加载本机图像粘贴、剪贴板和音频捕获附加组件（musl 构建的二进制文件，而不是运行时拒绝的 glibc 二进制文件）

entries.en: The usage-limit message shown when your monthly spend limit is already used up now also says when your session or weekly limit resets
entries.zh: 当月消费上限已用完时显示的用量限制消息，现在还会说明会话限制或每周限制的重置时间

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock streaming behind proxies that strip the response Content-Type header, which silently doubled billed API calls by re-running every turn non-streaming
entries.zh: 修复了代理后面的基岩流，该代理会剥离响应 Content-Type 标头，通过重新运行每轮非流式传输，默默地使计费 API 调用增加一倍

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code hanging at startup behind an HTTPS proxy when using Bedrock with an SSO profile and `awsAuthRefresh` — the credential pre-check now honors `HTTPS_PROXY`
entries.zh: 修复了当将 Bedrock 与 SSO 配置文件和`awsAuthRefresh`一起使用时，Claude 代码在启动时挂在 HTTPS 代理后面的问题 — 凭证预检查现在支持`HTTPS_PROXY`

entries.en: Fixed a raw crash dump when starting Claude Code from a directory that no longer exists; it now prints a clear message
entries.zh: 修复了从不再存在的目录启动 Claude Code 时的原始故障转储；它现在打印一条清晰的消息

entries.en: Fixed Edit and Write calls pausing for about 5 seconds in JetBrains IDE terminals when the Claude Code plugin is connected
entries.zh: 修复了连接 Claude Code 插件时 JetBrains IDE 终端中的编辑和写入调用暂停约 5 秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed a race where pressing Esc with a prompt queued could let the next turn finish early, leaving the session idle while Claude was still working and letting a later resubmit repeat actions
entries.zh: 修复一个竞态：提示词排队时按 Esc，可能导致下一回合提前结束，会话在 Claude 仍在工作时就变为空闲，之后重新提交时会重复执行操作的问题

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch retaining expired page content in memory for the whole session instead of the intended 15 minutes
entries.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 在整个会话期间（而不是预期的 15 分钟）在内存中保留过期页面内容的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions (Claude Code on the web, desktop and mobile apps) resuming out of plan mode after an idle worker restart
entries.zh: 修复了闲置工作人员重新启动后云会话（Web、桌面和移动应用程序上的 Claude Code）恢复计划模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP elicitation forms taller than the terminal being clipped in fullscreen mode: the form now fits the window, with hidden fields reachable by scrolling and Accept/Decline always visible
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 引出表单比在全屏模式下剪切的终端更高的问题：表单现在适合窗口，通过滚动可访问隐藏字段，并且“接受/拒绝”始终可见

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP servers staying failed after a transient 5xx on a mid-session reconnect in cloud sessions or via SDK `setMcpServers()`
entries.zh: 修复了在云会话中或通过 SDK`setMcpServers()`进行会话中重新连接时发生短暂 5xx 后，远程 MCP 服务器保持失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed custom session titles disappearing from `/resume` after more than ~64 KB of conversation was written following the rename
entries.zh: 修复了重命名后写入超过 ~64 KB 的对话后自定义会话标题从`/resume`中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude -c`/resume picking up sessions from a different directory whose path differed only by characters like `_`, `-`, or `.`
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -c`/resume 从不同目录中拾取会话的问题，该目录的路径仅因`_`、`-`或`.`等字符不同而有所不同。

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` and the agents view showing a session as recently changed (and reordering it) when only its file was touched or it was merely reopened
entries.zh: 修复了仅触及文件或仅重新打开会话时`/resume`和代理视图显示最近更改的会话（并重新排序）的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` in all-projects mode telling you to `cd` into a deleted directory (e.g. a removed worktree); such sessions now resume in the current directory
entries.zh: 修复了所有项目模式中的`/resume`，告诉您`cd`到已删除的目录（例如已删除的工作树）；此类会话现在在当前目录中恢复

entries.en: Fixed the `dark-ansi` theme rendering expanded tool results in fullscreen mode with text the same color as the background
entries.zh: 修复 `dark-ansi` 主题在全屏模式下展开的工具结果中，文字与背景同色的问题

entries.en: Fixed the fullscreen renderer prompt reappearing on every launch when it could never be answered; it now stops after being shown on three launches
entries.zh: 修复全屏渲染器的提示在无法回答的情况下，每次启动都重复出现的问题；现在在显示三次后停止

entries.en: Fixed `.worktreeinclude` patterns starting with `**/` silently matching nothing when the target lived in a gitignored directory
entries.zh: 修复了当目标位于 gitignored 目录中时以`**/`开头的`.worktreeinclude`模式静默匹配任何内容

entries.en: Fixed agents, skills, and commands whose `.md` file starts with a UTF-8 BOM being silently ignored
entries.zh: 修复了`.md`文件以 UTF-8 BOM 开头的代理、技能和命令被默默忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/insights` echoing literal `<message>` tags in its response on some models
entries.zh: 修复了`/insights`在某些型号的响应中回显文字`<message>`标签的问题

entries.en: Fixed marketplace `metadata.pluginRoot` having no effect: bare plugin source names now resolve under it as the docs describe
entries.zh: 修复了市场`metadata.pluginRoot`无效的问题：裸插件源名称现在按照文档描述在其下解析

entries.en: Fixed mouse movement in browser-based terminals inserting text like `"35;150;7M"` into the prompt when a mouse report arrived split across writes
entries.zh: 修复了基于浏览器的终端中的鼠标移动，当鼠标报告到达时，在写入时将“35;150;7M”等文本插入提示中

entries.en: Fixed custom theme overrides for the effort/ultracode status badge colors being ignored
entries.zh: 修复了被忽略的工作/超代码状态徽章颜色的自定义主题覆盖

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry trace fragmentation: tool executions deferred by a `PreToolUse` hook now resume in the original turn's trace instead of starting a new trace
entries.zh: 修复了 OpenTelemetry 跟踪碎片：由`PreToolUse`挂钩推迟的工具执行现在在原始回合的跟踪中恢复，而不是开始新的跟踪

entries.en: Fixed vim mode in the agent view: Escape now switches to NORMAL mode and keeps your text instead of clearing the prompt
entries.zh: 修复智能体视图中的 vim 模式：按 Esc 现在会切换到 NORMAL 模式并保留你的文字，而不是清空提示框

entries.en: Fixed the `selection:copy` keybinding silently dropping a text selection that had been extended with Shift+Arrow keys
entries.zh: 修复 `selection:copy` 快捷键静默丢弃用 Shift+方向键扩展过的文本选区的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/voice` startup tip still appearing after voice dictation was enabled via the `voice.enabled` setting
entries.zh: 修复通过 `voice.enabled` 设置启用语音听写后，`/voice` 启动提示仍然出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed shell-mode (`!`) Tab completion dropping the `./` from a `./script` path, which left a command the shell couldn't run
entries.zh: 修复了 shell 模式 (`!`) Tab 补全从 `./script` 路径中删除 `./` 的问题，这导致 shell 无法运行命令

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode answering a permission prompt or pressing a button when you clicked the terminal window only to bring it back into focus
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式在单击终端窗口时回答权限提示或按下按钮仅使其重新成为焦点的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash-command panels (e.g. `/config`, `/model`) in fullscreen mode covering the latest messages; the conversation now stays pinned above the panel
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下的斜杠命令面板（例如`/config`、`/model`），涵盖最新消息；对话现在固定在面板上方

entries.en: Fixed the `/workflows` detail dialog overflowing the terminal and losing its header off-screen when opened while Claude is still responding
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 仍在回复时打开 `/workflows` 详情对话框，导致内容超出终端、标题移出屏幕的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Linux sandbox making a nonexistent `.git/config.worktree` unreadable, which broke every sandboxed git command in repos with `extensions.worktreeConfig` set
entries.zh: 修复 Linux 沙盒使不存在的 `.git/config.worktree` 变为不可读，导致设置了 `extensions.worktreeConfig` 的仓库中所有沙盒 git 命令失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed hooks failing with "posix_spawn ENOENT" after the session's working directory was deleted; they now run from the project root or home directory instead
entries.zh: 修复了删除会话工作目录后挂钩因“posix_spawn ENOENT”而失败的问题；他们现在从项目根目录或主目录运行

entries.en: Fixed `claudeMdExcludes` not excluding a symlinked `.claude/rules` file when the pattern names the rules directory or the symlink rather than its target
entries.zh: 修复了当模式命名规则目录或符号链接而不是其目标时，`claudeMdExcludes`不排除符号链接的`.claude/rules`文件

entries.en: Fixed runaway session-title syncing to Remote Control when two Claude Code processes shared one background job's state (2.1.232 regression); title updates are now deduplicated and rate-limited
entries.zh: 修复了当两个 Claude Code 进程共享一个后台作业状态时，会话标题同步到远程控制的失控问题（2.1.232 回归）；标题更新现在已进行重复数据删除且速率受到限制

entries.en: Fixed sessions whose title starts with `/` being unaddressable by `SendMessage` and shown as "(untitled)" in `ListAgents`
entries.zh: 修复了标题以`/`开头的会话无法被`SendMessage`寻址并在`ListAgents`中显示为“（无标题）”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+W, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+K, Option+Backspace, Option+D and vim `df`/`dt` leaving a broken `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder when the cursor was inside it
entries.zh: 修复了当光标位于其中时 Ctrl+W、Ctrl+U、Ctrl+K、Option+Backspace、Option+D 和 vim `df`/`dt` 留下损坏的 `[粘贴文本 #N]` 占位符

entries.en: Fixed masked (password-style) inputs such as the login code field letting their text be pasted back with Ctrl+Y elsewhere or saved to prompt history when cleared with double Esc
entries.zh: 修复了屏蔽（密码式）输入，例如登录代码字段，允许使用 Ctrl+Y 将其文本粘贴回其他位置，或者在使用双 Esc 清除时保存到提示历史记录

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+Backspace deleting one character instead of a word in search boxes
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+Backspace 在搜索框中删除一个字符而不是一个单词的问题

entries.en: Fixed a request rejected by an organization policy check being re-sent before the rejection was shown
entries.zh: 修复了在显示拒绝之前重新发送的被组织策略检查拒绝的请求

entries.en: Improved the reminder shown after compaction so a skill's original arguments are not re-run as a new request
entries.zh: 改进压缩后的提醒：技能的原始参数不会再被当作新请求重新执行

entries.en: Long file paths on tool-use rows now truncate in the middle to stay on one line
entries.zh: 工具调用行中过长的文件路径现在从中间截断，保持在一行内显示

entries.en: Remote sessions keep sending keep-alives while a long `SessionStart` or `Setup` hook runs, so the container is not idle-reaped mid-hook
entries.zh: 长时间运行的 `SessionStart` 或 `Setup` 钩子期间，远程会话持续发送保活信号，避免容器因闲置在钩子执行中途被回收

entries.en: `/goal`: repeat check-ins on long-running background work now back off (30 min, then 1 h, then every 2 h) instead of repeating every 30 minutes
entries.zh: `/goal`：对长时间运行的后台工作的重复检查现在会逐步拉长间隔（先 30 分钟，然后 1 小时，之后每 2 小时），而不是每 30 分钟重复一次

entries.en: `/goal`: resuming a session from the `claude --resume` picker now restores its active goal
entries.zh: `/goal`：从 `claude --resume` 选择器恢复会话时，现在会还原其正在进行的目标

entries.en: `ListAgents` now tells a session its own name (the one peers use to message it), and `SendMessage` to your own name says so instead of "no agent named …"
entries.zh: `ListAgents` 现在会告诉会话它自己的名字（其他会话用来给它发消息的名字）；对自己的名字执行 `SendMessage` 时，会明确说明，而不是报 "no agent named …"

entries.en: `ListAgents` and `/list-agents` now list your live teammates (previously only subagents and other sessions appeared, so a reachable teammate looked absent)
entries.zh: `ListAgents` 和 `/list-agents` 现在会列出你正在运行的队友（此前只显示子 agent 和其他会话，可访问的队友会被误判为不存在）

entries.en: `keybindingFlavor: "readline"` now also matches Bash for word keys: Alt+F and Ctrl/Option+→ stop at the end of the word, Alt+D deletes to it (Ctrl+Y pastes it back), and punctuation separates words
entries.zh: `keybindingFlavor: "readline"` 现在对 Bash 的单词键也生效：Alt+F 和 Ctrl/Option+→ 在单词末尾停止，Alt+D 删除到单词末尾（Ctrl+Y 可粘贴回来），标点符号会分隔单词

entries.en: Persistent retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) now fails immediately on organization spend-limit and out-of-credits errors instead of waiting indefinitely for a reset
entries.zh: 持续重试模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`）现在遇到组织消费上限或额度用尽的错误时会立即失败，不再无限期等待重置

entries.en: Claude in Chrome: `/clear` now closes the session's Chrome tab group, and empty groups are closed on `/resume` and when Claude Code exits
entries.zh: Chrome 中的 Claude：`/clear` 现在会关闭会话的 Chrome 选项卡组，并且在`/resume` 上以及 Claude Code 退出时关闭空组

entries.en: Remote sessions: images uploaded from mobile now include their saved file path, so Claude can copy them into files it creates
entries.zh: 远程会话：从手机上传的图片现在包含其保存的文件路径，Claude 可以把它们复制到自己创建的文件中

entries.en: Claude Code on the web: requests from Bash and other tools to non-API anthropic.com hosts (e.g. www, docs) now go through the session's network proxy, so your environment's allowed domains apply
entries.zh: 网络上的 Claude Code：从 Bash 和其他工具到非 API anthropic.com 主机（例如 www、docs）的请求现在通过会话的网络代理，因此您的环境允许的域适用

entries.en: Remote Control: clearer message and `claude doctor` wording when Remote Control isn't enabled for your account
entries.zh: 账号未开通 Remote Control 时，提示文字和 `claude doctor` 的说明更清楚

entries.en: Windows: cross-session messaging is now available, so Claude Code sessions across your machines can message each other with `SendMessage` and find each other with `ListAgents`, as on macOS and Linux
entries.zh: Windows：现在支持跨会话消息，你不同电脑上的 Claude Code 会话可以用 `SendMessage` 互相发消息，用 `ListAgents` 互相找到，与 macOS 和 Linux 一致

entries.en: [VSCode] "View usage" in the usage-limit banner now sits inline with the warning text instead of floating mid-banner
entries.zh: [VSCode] 用量上限横幅中的「View usage」现在与警告文字同行显示，不再悬浮在横幅中间

entries.en: Added a `keybindingFlavor` setting: set it to `"readline"` to make Ctrl+W in the prompt delete back to the previous whitespace, as in Bash; the default (`"classic"`) is unchanged
entries.zh: 添加了 `keybindingFlavor` 设置：将其设置为 `"readline"` 以使提示符中的 Ctrl+W 删除回之前的空格，如 Bash 中一样；默认值（“classic”）不变

entries.en: Plugin marketplaces: `headersHelper` on a url marketplace or a catalog entry runs a command that mints HTTP headers (e.g. a short-lived token) for catalog and same-origin archive fetches
entries.zh: 插件市场：url 类型市场或目录条目上的 `headersHelper` 会运行一条命令，为目录和同源归档获取请求生成 HTTP 请求头（如短期令牌）

entries.en: A catalog entry's `headersHelper` runs only when you install or update that plugin, after its command is shown; `claude plugin install/update` ask `[y/N]` (or pass `-y`)
entries.zh: 仅当您安装或更新该插件时，在显示其命令后，目录条目的`headersHelper`才会运行； `claude 插件安装/更新` 询问 `[y/N]` （或传递 `-y`）

entries.en: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <minutes>`: on SIGTERM, keep serving attached sessions, park what is left after that many minutes, then exit
entries.zh: 添加了“claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <分钟>”：在 SIGTERM 上，继续提供附加会话，在几分钟后保留剩余的会话，然后退出

entries.en: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --proxy-authorization-command` / `--proxy-authorization-file` for egress proxies that require a freshly issued `Proxy-Authorization` header on every connection
entries.zh: 为每个连接上需要新发布的`Proxy-Authorization`标头的出口代理添加了`claude self-hosted-runner --proxy-authorization-command`/`--proxy-authorization-file`

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth in long interactive sessions: subagent tool results are now released once they leave the recent display window
entries.zh: 修复长交互会话中内存无限增长的问题：子智能体工具结果在移出最近显示窗口后即会释放

entries.en: Fixed custom, project, and plugin output styles drifting back to the default voice mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了自定义、项目和插件输出样式在会话中移回默认语音的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=true` not keeping prompt suggestions on when your account is near, but not over, its usage limit
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=true`在您的帐户接近但未超过其使用限制时不保留提示建议的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree-isolation Bash refusals telling you to remove a redirect when the command had none
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离拒绝 Bash 命令时，即使命令中没有重定向，仍提示你删除重定向的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners occasionally being removed by the server after a single slow or lost poll request, handing their healthy session to another runner
entries.zh: 修复了在单个缓慢或丢失的轮询请求后，自托管运行程序偶尔会被服务器删除，将其健康会话交给另一个运行程序的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP elicitation dialogs showing nothing for URLs longer than 4,096 characters, and permission prompts dropping the "don't ask again" option when the project path didn't fit the terminal width
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 诱导对话框对于长度超过 4,096 个字符的 URL 不显示任何内容，并且当项目路径不适合终端宽度时，权限提示会删除“不再询问”选项

entries.en: Fixed leftover `/tmp/claude-*-cwd` files when a Bash command is killed, times out, or is interrupted
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 命令被终止、超时或中断时剩余的`/tmp/claude-*-cwd`文件

entries.en: Fixed held Backspace being ignored on terminals that send Ctrl+H for Backspace when keystrokes arrive in large bursts (slow SSH/mosh links)
entries.zh: 修复了当大量按键到达时发送 Ctrl+H 进行退格键的终端上保留的退格键被忽略的问题（缓慢的 SSH/mosh 链接）

entries.en: Fixed text-wrapping in permission prompt diffs: lines containing wide multi-code-point characters (such as emoji) or tabs are no longer clipped
entries.zh: 修复了权限提示差异中的文本换行：包含宽多代码点字符（例如表情符号）或制表符的行不再被剪切

entries.en: Fixed killing a suspended (Ctrl+Z) session sometimes leaving the terminal in bracketed-paste mode with the cursor hidden
entries.zh: 修复了终止挂起的 (Ctrl+Z) 会话有时会使终端处于括号粘贴模式且光标隐藏的问题

entries.en: Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving a `server/discover` request before `initialize`, forcing lazy servers to start their backend on every session open
entries.zh: 修复了 stdio MCP 服务器在“初始化”之前接收“服务器/发现”请求，强制惰性服务器在每个打开的会话时启动其后端

entries.en: Fixed a proxy's refusal of a connection being reported as a generic network error instead of naming the proxy
entries.zh: 修复了代理拒绝连接被报告为一般网络错误而不是命名代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` and `/effort` cache-miss warning appearing when the prompt cache had already expired
entries.zh: 修复提示词缓存已过期时，`/model` 和 `/effort` 仍显示缓存未命中警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed per-task Stop from the Remote Control tasks panel doing nothing on CLI-hosted sessions
entries.zh: 修复了从远程控制任务面板按任务停止在 CLI 托管会话上不执行任何操作的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions exiting when a client delivered a user message without a valid role
entries.zh: 修复了当客户端在没有有效角色的情况下传递用户消息时远程会话退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions started by `claude remote-control` inheriting session-scoped environment variables from the launching shell
entries.zh: 修复了由“claude Remote-control”启动的远程控制会话从启动 shell 继承会话范围的环境变量

entries.en: Fixed a Remote Control session whose process crashed staying unavailable until `claude remote-control` was restarted; it can now be reused when you next message it
entries.zh: 修复了一个远程控制会话，该会话的进程崩溃后一直不可用，直到“claude Remote-control”重新启动为止；现在，当您下次向它发送消息时，可以重复使用它

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control messages sent from the web or Desktop while Claude is mid-turn disappearing from the transcript after the turn finishes
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在回合中途从网络或桌面发送的远程控制消息在回合结束后从记录中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control model picks made on a phone or web not updating the model shown in the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在电话或网络上进行的远程控制模型选择不会更新终端中显示的模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control disconnecting with "login expired" when a brief network hiccup delays renewing your sign-in; it now retries and stays connected
entries.zh: 修复了当短暂的网络故障延迟更新登录时，远程控制会因“登录已过期”而断开连接的问题；它现在重试并保持连接

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control reporting a failed reconnect on sign-out; signing out now ends the session with a clear message
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制在注销时报告重新连接失败的问题；现在注销并以明确的消息结束会话

entries.en: Fixed `ListAgents`/`SendMessage` reporting "Remote Control is not connected" in sessions run by `claude remote-control` (server mode) or Desktop/IDE hosts; they now list and reach Remote Control peers
entries.zh: 修复了`ListAgents`/`SendMessage`在“claude Remote-control”（服务器模式）或桌面/IDE 主机运行的会话中报告“远程控制未连接”的问题；他们现在列出并联系远程控制伙伴

entries.en: Fixed `ListAgents` and `SendMessage` exposing the idle worker that the agent view pre-warms for your next background session; it now appears only once a task claims it
entries.zh: 修复了`ListAgents`和`SendMessage`暴露了代理视图为下一个后台会话预热的空闲工作线程；现在只有当任务声明它时它才会出现

entries.en: Cross-session messaging: sending to a session on this machine that refuses inbound messages (e.g. `crossSessionInbound: "refuse"`) now reports "refused" to the sender instead of a silent success
entries.zh: 跨会话消息传递：发送到本机上拒绝入站消息的会话（例如“crossSessionInbound：“拒绝””）现在向发送者报告“拒绝”，而不是静默成功

entries.en: Cross-session messaging: a session whose inbox drops your messages (rate limit or full queue) now tells your session, instead of the messages vanishing silently
entries.zh: 跨会话消息传递：收件箱丢弃消息（速率限制或已满队列）的会话现在会告诉您的会话，而不是消息默默消失

entries.en: Improved startup: bare `claude` starts sooner on macOS
entries.zh: 改进启动：在 macOS 上，裸 `claude` 启动更快

entries.en: Improved Bash tool permission checking for zsh-specific syntax in shell conditionals
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 工具权限检查：支持条件语句中 zsh 特有的语法

entries.en: Improved Remote Control connection resilience: brief HTTP 403 refusals from a network edge, VPN, or proxy are now tolerated for up to 3 minutes, with the refusing party named when a block persists
entries.zh: 改进远程控制连接的韧性：来自网络边缘、VPN 或代理的短暂 HTTP 403 拒绝，最多容忍 3 分钟；若持续被拦截，会指出是哪一方在拒绝

entries.en: Improved startup responsiveness: the automatic update check now runs about 10 seconds after launch instead of competing with startup for CPU
entries.zh: 改进启动响应速度：自动更新检查改为启动约 10 秒后再运行，不再与启动争抢 CPU

entries.en: Updated the bundled `claude-api` skill for the Managed Agents Aug 19 release: web search/fetch domain settings and memory stores on self-hosted sandboxes
entries.zh: `claude-api` 技能配合 Managed Agents 8 月 19 日的发布更新：网页搜索/抓取的域名设置，以及自托管沙箱上的记忆存储

entries.en: Changed Ctrl+L and Cmd+K in fullscreen to always just repaint — the double-press `/clear` shortcut was removed, and 1-row nvim terminals no longer trigger automatic `/clear` loops
entries.zh: 将全屏中的 Ctrl+L 和 Cmd+K 更改为始终重新绘制 - 删除了双击`/clear`快捷键，并且 1 行 nvim 终端不再触发自动`/clear`循环

entries.en: Changed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` to show disabled servers as `⊘ Disabled` instead of connecting to them for a health check
entries.zh: 更改了`claude mcp list`和`claude mcp get`以将禁用的服务器显示为“⊘已禁用”，而不是连接到它们进行运行状况检查

entries.en: MCP `headersHelper` in a project `.mcp.json`, and inline MCP servers in project or `--add-dir` agent files, now require that folder's trust dialog to have been accepted (also under `claude -p`)
entries.zh: 项目 `.mcp.json` 中的 MCP `headersHelper`，以及项目或 `--add-dir` 智能体文件中的内联 MCP 服务器，现在要求该文件夹的信任对话框已被接受（`claude -p` 下同样适用）

entries.en: MCP `headersHelper` from a project `.mcp.json`, plugin, or agent file runs without inherited credential env vars; user, managed and claude.ai-scope helpers now run from the Claude config dir
entries.zh: 项目 `.mcp.json`、插件或智能体文件中的 MCP `headersHelper`，现在运行时不再继承凭证环境变量；用户级、托管级和 claude.ai 范围的 helper 则从 Claude 配置目录运行

entries.en: Fixed prompt caching for sessions using an LLM gateway or custom base URL
entries.zh: 修复了使用 LLM 网关或自定义基本 URL 的会话的提示缓存

entries.en: Added a built-in "Concise" output style: Claude leads with results and skips preamble and narration, while doing the work just as thoroughly. Select it under Output style in /config.
entries.zh: 添加了内置的“简洁”输出风格：克劳德以结果为主导，跳过序言和旁白，同时彻底完成工作。在 /config 中的输出样式下选择它。

entries.en: Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable: sets the model new sessions start on, while a `/model` pick still overrides it and persists across restarts (unlike `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`)
entries.zh: 添加了`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL`环境变量：设置新会话启动的模型，而`/model`选择仍然覆盖它并在重新启动后持续存在（与`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`不同）

entries.en: Added `notify_when_idle` to cross-session `SendMessage`: ask another Claude Code session on this machine to send one notice when it next goes idle — opt-in, one-shot, no polling (macOS and Linux)
entries.zh: 在跨会话`SendMessage`中添加了`notify_when_idle`：要求该计算机上的另一个 Claude Code 会话在下次空闲时发送一个通知 - 选择加入、一次性、无轮询（macOS 和 Linux）

entries.en: Sandbox: on macOS, wildcard read-deny rules (e.g. `**/.env`) now take precedence inside allowed read regions, cover matched directories' contents, and can't be bypassed by renaming the denied file
entries.zh: 沙箱（macOS）：通配符读取拒绝规则（如 `**/.env`）现在优先于允许读取的区域，覆盖匹配目录下的内容，且无法通过重命名被拒绝的文件来绕过

entries.en: Fixed clipboard copy, background housekeeping, background sessions, and local MCP logs breaking after the directory a session had switched into was removed (since 2.1.229)
entries.zh: 修复了在删除会话切换到的目录后剪贴板复制、后台管理、后台会话和本地 MCP 日志中断的问题（自 2.1.229 起）

entries.en: Fixed the fullscreen renderer failing permanently after a single failed start: it now falls back to the classic renderer instead of exiting on every subsequent launch
entries.zh: 修复全屏渲染器在一次启动失败后永久失效的问题：现在会回退到经典渲染器，而不是每次启动都退出

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker rendering taller than the terminal: it now shows only as many models as fit the window, with the rest reachable by scrolling
entries.zh: 修复 `/model` 选择器高度超出终端的问题：现在只显示窗口能容纳的模型数量，其余可通过滚动查看

entries.en: Fixed `SendMessage` calls being rejected when a malformed closing tag left the message text inside the summary field
entries.zh: 修复了当格式错误的结束标记将消息文本留在摘要字段内时`SendMessage`调用被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed unhandled promise rejections when a subprocess fails to start, for example `powershell.exe` on WSL with Windows interop disabled (regression in 2.1.234)
entries.zh: 修复子进程启动失败（例如在禁用 Windows 互操作的 WSL 上运行 `powershell.exe`）时出现未处理的 Promise 拒绝（2.1.234 版本的回归问题）的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode sometimes not showing a newly sent message until the next update after the terminal was resized
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式有时不会显示新发送的消息，直到调整终端大小后的下一次更新

entries.en: Fixed a blank band that could remain above the prompt after clearing a multi-line prompt, and panes not repainting after resizing the terminal away and back, in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下清除多行提示后可能保留在提示上方的空白带，以及在全屏模式下调整终端大小后无法重新绘制窗格的问题

entries.en: Fixed the managed-settings approval prompt sometimes not appearing at startup while still capturing the first keypress as approval
entries.zh: 修复启动时托管设置审批提示有时不出现，却仍把第一次按键当作批准的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal tab titles jumping in tmux (iTerm tmux integration): the title is now written only when its text changes instead of animating every 960ms
entries.zh: 修复在 tmux（iTerm tmux 集成）中终端标签标题跳动的问题：现在只在文字变化时才写入标题，而不是每 960 毫秒动画一次

entries.en: Fixed an unclear error when the cloud environments list came back empty or malformed
entries.zh: 修复了云环境列表返回为空或格式错误时出现的不清楚错误

entries.en: Fixed the Fable 5 first-time usage-credits prompt auto-selecting the fallback model after 60 seconds with no answer when using Remote Control
entries.zh: 修复 Fable 5 首次使用额度提示在使用远程控制时，60 秒无回应后自动选中备用模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed spinner tips never appearing, with a repeated background error, when the cached guest-pass reward in `~/.claude.json` was malformed
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude.json`中缓存的访客通行证奖励格式错误时，旋转器提示永远不会出现，并重复出现后台错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed skills hot-reload in SDK/VS Code sessions raising an error on every skills change after the session's working directory was deleted (2.1.229+)
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK/VS Code 会话中的技能热重载，在删除会话的工作目录后，每次技能更改都会引发错误 (2.1.229+)

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions released on idle, retire, or startup timeout occasionally resuming on another runner before the post-session hook had finished
entries.zh: 修复了在空闲、退出或启动超时时释放的自托管运行器会话偶尔会在会话后挂钩完成之前在另一个运行器上恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Clawd mascot's eyes and feet rendering unevenly in iTerm2 at some font sizes
entries.zh: 修复 Clawd 吉祥物在 iTerm2 某些字号下眼睛和脚显示不均匀的问题

entries.en: Fixed occasional runaway session recaps: recap text (automatic and `/recap`) is now capped at 400 characters, cut at a word boundary
entries.zh: 修复了偶尔失控的会话回顾：回顾文本（自动和`/recap`）现在上限为 400 个字符，在单词边界处剪切

entries.en: Improved startup performance: the session counter is now written in the background
entries.zh: 改进启动性能：会话计数器改为在后台写入

entries.en: Improved auto mode: `Monitor` allow rules are now set aside while auto mode is active, so Monitor commands are reviewed the same way Bash commands are
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：自动模式生效期间，`Monitor` 的允许规则暂时搁置，使 Monitor 命令与 Bash 命令一样接受审查

entries.en: Improved auto mode on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled: the classifier now uses the same defaults as on the Claude API, including severity-scored classification
entries.zh: 改进 Bedrock、Vertex AI、Foundry 上及禁用遥测时的自动模式：分类器使用与 Claude API 相同的默认设置，包括带严重程度评分的分类

entries.en: Improved auto mode: the git status check can no longer be fooled by a repo's `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` setting into reporting a clean tree
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：git 状态检查不会再因仓库设置 `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` 而误报工作区干净

entries.en: Changed the `/model` picker to highlight only the newest model's name, so the highlight marks the new release rather than an arbitrary subset of the list
entries.zh: 更改了`/model`选择器以仅突出显示最新型号的名称，因此突出显示标记新版本而不是列表的任意子集

entries.en: `/goal`: an idle session whose goal is parked behind long-running background work now checks in automatically after 30 minutes (then 1h, 2h) instead of waiting for you to return
entries.zh: `/goal`：目标因长时间运行的后台工作而暂停时，空闲会话现在会在 30 分钟后（之后为 1 小时、2 小时）自动检查，而不是一直等你回来

entries.en: `/usage` now shows the usage-credits spend row for Team and Enterprise members, and shows a capped row at 0% before anything is spent
entries.zh: `/usage` 现在会为 Team 和 Enterprise 成员显示用量额度的消费行，并在尚未消费时在 0% 处显示带上限的行

entries.en: SIGTERM in print/SDK mode no longer records an interrupted turn or synthetic tool denials before exiting; running commands are still terminated and the process still exits with code 143
entries.zh: print/SDK 模式下收到 SIGTERM 时，退出前不再记录被打断的一轮对话，也不再生成合成的工具拒绝；正在运行的命令仍会被终止，进程仍以退出码 143 退出

entries.en: Pressing Enter on a slash-command typo or a command unavailable in this session now reports it instead of running the closest fuzzy match; prefixes and aliases still run
entries.zh: 在斜杠命令输错或本会话不可用的命令上按 Enter，现在会直接提示，不再运行最接近的模糊匹配；前缀和别名仍可运行

entries.en: Remote Control now marks a session offline within seconds when the CLI exits or its terminal closes
entries.zh: CLI 退出或终端关闭时，Remote Control 现在会在几秒内把会话标记为离线

entries.en: `SendMessage` now refuses further messages to a session up front once a rapid burst would exceed what that session's inbox accepts, instead of reporting them sent while they were dropped
entries.zh: 当短时间内的突发消息会超过某会话的收件箱容量时，`SendMessage` 现在会预先拒绝后续消息，而不是报告已发送但实际被丢弃

entries.en: Aligned the session title chip on the prompt border with the footer's right edge
entries.zh: 将提示边框上的会话标题芯片与页脚的右边缘对齐

entries.en: Right-aligned footer items (goal indicator, session state, background agent status) and truncated notices now share a consistent right margin with the rest of the prompt area
entries.zh: 底部右侧的项目（目标指示、会话状态、后台代理状态）和被截断的通知，现在与提示区其他部分保持一致的右边距

entries.en: [VSCode] Added screen reader support for the transcript: live announcements for replies, permission requests, errors, and status changes, plus per-turn heading navigation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 对话记录支持屏幕阅读器：对回复、权限请求、错误和状态变化进行实时播报，并支持按轮次进行标题导航

entries.en: Added an optional `spellcheck` setting that underlines misspelled words in the prompt input as you type, using your installed `aspell`, `hunspell`, or `ispell`
entries.zh: 添加了可选的“拼写检查”设置，可使用安装的`aspell`、`hunspell`或`ispell`在您键入时在提示输入中强调拼写错误的单词

entries.en: Fixed whole-prompt-cache invalidation when a language server disconnected or reconnected mid-session
entries.zh: 修复会话中途语言服务器断开或重连时，整个提示词缓存被失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed nested markdown list items misaligning at depth 3+ and added a hanging indent to wrapped list items in the terminal UI
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套 Markdown 列表项在深度 3+ 处未对齐的问题，并在终端 UI 中向包装列表项添加了悬挂缩进

entries.en: Fixed prompt input highlights (slash commands, keywords, mentions) appearing shifted by one or more characters in some multi-line prompts
entries.zh: 修复了在某些多行提示中提示输入突出显示（斜杠命令、关键字、提及）出现一个或多个字符偏移的问题

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Tab inside the permission prompt's comment field approving the edit and granting session-wide edit permission instead of closing the field
entries.zh: 修复了权限提示注释字段内的 Shift+Tab 批准编辑并授予会话范围编辑权限而不是关闭字段的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Agent tool advertising a general-purpose default in sessions where that agent is unavailable: an omitted `subagent_type` there now gets a clear error listing the available agents
entries.zh: 修复了代理工具在代理不可用的会话中广告通用默认值的问题：省略的`subagent_type`现在会出现列出可用代理的明显错误

entries.en: Fixed notebook cell delete/replace approval dialogs silently omitting the existing cell content when the notebook or cell could not be read; the dialog now says why
entries.zh: 修复了笔记本单元格删除/替换批准对话框在无法读取笔记本或单元格时默默地忽略现有单元格内容；对话框现在说明了原因

entries.en: Fixed slash commands run while Claude is responding showing HTML entities instead of the actual characters
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德响应时运行的斜杠命令显示 HTML 实体而不是实际字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed the prompt footer not showing the "Update installed" restart notice after a background auto-update
entries.zh: 修复后台自动更新完成后，提示框页脚不显示"Update installed"重启提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed the expanded task list (`ctrl+t`) always starting collapsed when resuming or relaunching into a session that still has open tasks
entries.zh: 修复恢复或重新启动仍有未完成任务的会话时，展开的任务列表（`ctrl+t`）总是默认折叠的问题

entries.en: Improved memory and CPU usage while cloud sessions such as `/ultrareview` or `/autofix-pr` run in the background — their event streams are no longer re-scanned and re-rendered on every update
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview`、`/autofix-pr` 等云会话在后台运行时的内存和 CPU 占用：事件流不再在每次更新时被重新扫描和重新渲染

entries.en: Improved permission dialogs: display text and "don't ask again" options now always match what a grant would cover, and "don't ask again" is withheld when contents cannot be fully displayed
entries.zh: 改进权限对话框：显示的文字和「不再询问」选项现在始终与授权范围一致；内容无法完整显示时，不提供「不再询问」

entries.en: Improved the embedded `grep` in native macOS/Linux builds: pathological patterns now fail fast instead of exhausting memory, and `-m N` with `-A/-C` prints correct context
entries.zh: 改进原生 macOS/Linux 版本内置的 `grep`：病态正则会快速失败，而不是耗尽内存；`-m N` 配合 `-A/-C` 时输出正确的上下文

entries.en: Improved the context-limit error to say when auto-compact is off and point to `/config` to re-enable it
entries.zh: 改进上下文超限报错：会说明自动压缩已关闭，并指向 `/config` 以重新开启

entries.en: Vim mode: NORMAL mode and cursor position are now preserved when toggling the detailed transcript (ctrl+o) or closing a panel
entries.zh: Vim 模式：切换详细转录（ctrl+o）或关闭面板时，NORMAL 模式和光标位置现在会保留

entries.en: Dialogs: arrow keys and Enter pressed in quick succession now select the option you navigated to instead of the previously highlighted one
entries.zh: 对话框：快速连续按下箭头键和 Enter 现在选择您导航到的选项，而不是之前突出显示的选项

entries.en: `SendMessage` now refuses messages too large for cross-session delivery up front instead of silently dropping them
entries.zh: `SendMessage` 现在会预先拒绝超出跨会话投递大小限制的消息，而不是静默丢弃

entries.en: Remote Control: `claude rc` now applies the same enterprise-gateway availability check as interactive startup
entries.zh: `claude rc` 现在和交互式启动一样，执行企业网关可用性检查

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed focus jumping between open Claude tabs on its own when a window with several Claude panels is restored or reloaded
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复恢复或重新加载包含多个 Claude 面板的窗口时，焦点在已打开的 Claude 标签页之间自行跳转的问题

entries.en: Added the optional `CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME` environment variable: hosts that give each session its own config directory can choose a short name for the per-project transcript directory
entries.zh: 添加了可选的`CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME`环境变量：为每个会话提供自己的配置目录的主机可以为每个项目的脚本目录选择一个短名称

entries.en: Added the `selection:clear` keybinding action, so a key can be bound to clear an in-app text selection; also works in the agents view
entries.zh: 添加了 `selection:clear` 按键绑定操作，因此可以绑定一个按键来清除应用内的文本选择；也适用于代理视图

entries.en: Added a GitLab merge request badge to the footer and statusline: repos with a GitLab remote and an authenticated glab CLI show MR !N with draft/pending/green states
entries.zh: 在页脚和状态行中添加了 GitLab 合并请求徽章：带有 GitLab 远程仓库和经过身份验证的 glab CLI 显示 MR !N 以及草稿/待处理/绿色状态

entries.en: Claude Code now continues your session automatically when a claude.ai usage limit resets; turn it off in `/config` ("Continue automatically at usage limit")
entries.zh: 现在，当 claude.ai 使用限制重置时，Claude Code 会自动继续您的会话；在 `/config` 中将其关闭（“在使用限制时自动继续”）

entries.en: Claude is now told to use your account email only to identify you, and not to send it to unrelated services unless you ask
entries.zh: 现在，克劳德被告知仅使用您的帐户电子邮件来识别您的身份，除非您要求，否则不要将其发送到不相关的服务

entries.en: Security: remote file reads, session restore, CLAUDE.md includes, workflow scripts and file uploads now reject Windows NT-namespace (`\??\`) paths, hardening the remaining pre-approval file accesses against the NTLM credential-leak vector
entries.zh: 安全：远程文件读取、会话恢复、CLAUDE.md 包含、工作流脚本和文件上传，现在都会拒绝 Windows NT 命名空间（`\??\`）路径，堵住剩余的预先批准文件访问中的 NTLM 凭据泄露途径

entries.en: Fixed auto mode in very long sessions repeatedly re-checking and denying sandboxed commands' network access after the conversation had been compacted
entries.zh: 修复了在很长的会话中自动模式在会话被压缩后反复重新检查和拒绝沙盒命令的网络访问

entries.en: Fixed session-scoped permission answers (including denies) being dropped when answering background subagent tool permission prompts
entries.zh: 修复了在回答后台子代理工具权限提示时丢弃会话范围的权限答案（包括拒绝）的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash when an API response on the non-streaming fallback path (typically via third-party gateways) contained a thinking block missing its thinking field or a text block missing its text field
entries.zh: 修复了当非流式回退路径（通常通过第三方网关）上的 API 响应包含缺少其思考字段的思维块或缺少其文本字段的文本块时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed markdown rendering becoming extremely slow for some messages containing unusual Unicode sequences
entries.zh: 修复了某些包含异常 Unicode 序列的消息的 Markdown 渲染变得极其缓慢的问题

entries.en: Fixed `SendMessage` rejecting a recipient copied from `ListAgents` when the session name is at the 200-character cap or emoji-heavy
entries.zh: 修复了当会话名称达到 200 个字符上限或表情符号较多时，`SendMessage`拒绝从`ListAgents`复制的收件人的问题

entries.en: Fixed repository detection mis-reading the host of git remotes with unusual userinfo, producing links and repo-specific behavior for the wrong host
entries.zh: 修复了存储库检测错误读取具有异常用户信息的 git 远程主机，为错误主机生成链接和特定于存储库的行为
