entries.en: Fixed MCP diagnostics printing resolved secrets: scope-conflict warnings now show the configured `${VAR}` form, and connection-failure details show only the server origin
entries.zh: 修复了打印已解析机密的 MCP 诊断：范围冲突警告现在显示配置的`${VAR}`表单，并且连接失败详细信息仅显示服务器源

entries.en: Fixed `strictKnownMarketplaces` allowlists accepting SCP-style git marketplace sources whose host differs from the one git would actually connect to
entries.zh: 修复了`strictKnownMarketplaces`许可名单，接受 SCP 风格的 git 市场源，其主机与 git 实际连接的主机不同

entries.en: Fixed modal text such as the `/login` OAuth URL losing characters when copied in fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复了模式文本（例如`/login`OAuth URL）在全屏复制时丢失字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed a `---` horizontal rule in rendered markdown running into the line after it
entries.zh: 修复了渲染 Markdown 中的`---`水平规则运行到其后的行中

entries.en: Fixed consecutive shell commands splitting into multiple "Ran 1 shell command" rows when todo/task updates were interleaved between them
entries.zh: 修复了当待办事项/任务更新在它们之间交错时，连续的 shell 命令分成多个“Ran 1 shell command”行

entries.en: Fixed dialogs like `/permissions` opened while a `!` shell command was running being dismissed when the command finished
entries.zh: 修复了在`!` shell 命令运行时打开的`/permissions`等对话框在命令完成后被关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed a queued `!` shell command being sent to the model as plain text after pressing up-arrow to edit the queued input
entries.zh: 修复了按向上箭头编辑排队输入后，排队的`!` shell 命令以纯文本形式发送到模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed queued messages reappearing in the prompt history while still queued, Esc while selecting a queued message no longer interrupts the turn, and `!` mode no longer sticks after a mid-turn submit
entries.zh: 修复了排队消息在仍在排队时重新出现在提示历史记录中的问题，选择排队消息时按 Esc 键不再中断回合，并且`!`模式在中途提交后不再保留

entries.en: Fixed accepting the "Try the new fullscreen renderer?" prompt restarting the session without its permission mode (e.g. `--dangerously-skip-permissions`), tool allow/deny rules, model or effort flags
entries.zh: 修复了接受“尝试新的全屏渲染器？”的问题提示重新启动会话而不使用其权限模式（例如`--dangerously-skip-permissions`）、工具允许/拒绝规则、模型或工作量标志

entries.en: Fixed `/tui` dropping launch `--allowed-tools`/`--disallowed-tools` rules when it restarts; it now declines to switch, with the reason, when the session has restrictions a restart can't carry over
entries.zh: 修复了`/tui`在重新启动时删除启动`--allowed-tools`/`--disallowed-tools`规则；它现在拒绝切换，原因是，当会话有限制时，重新启动无法继续

entries.en: Fixed trust prompts omitting the repository-wide scope warning when the directory was first seen before the repository existed there
entries.zh: 修复目录首次被看到时仓库尚不存在，之后信任提示未显示仓库级范围警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed a case where an IDE diff tab closing during a permission re-prompt could answer the new prompt with the previous input
entries.zh: 修复了在权限重新提示期间关闭 IDE diff 选项卡可能会使用之前的输入回答新提示的情况

entries.en: Fixed: files sent to the user during Remote Control sessions hosted by Claude Code Desktop or VS Code now upload, so they open on phone and web instead of showing an empty card
entries.zh: 修复：在 Claude Code 桌面版或 VS Code 托管的 Remote Control 会话中发给用户的文件，现在会上传，因此可在手机和网页上打开，而不是显示空白卡片

entries.en: Fixed: after `/login` while `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` is set, the stale-token reminder no longer leaks into Claude's automatically resumed turn — it now appears only to you
entries.zh: 修复：设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` 时执行 `/login` 后，过期令牌提醒不再混入 Claude 自动恢复的回合中，现在只会显示给你

entries.en: Fixed: permission previews now relay only to channel servers admitted by the inbound trust gate, and a server's explicit permission-capability opt-out is honored
entries.zh: 修复：权限预览现在只转发给通过入站信任关卡的频道服务器，并且会尊重服务器明确选择退出的权限能力设置

entries.en: Fixed: credential masking on relayed permission previews can no longer hide commands, paths, or destinations from the approver; oversized private-key blocks now redact under full-strength redaction
entries.zh: 修复：转发的权限预览中的凭证打码，不再隐藏审批人需要看到的命令、路径或目标；超大的私钥块在完整强度打码下也会被脱敏

entries.en: Fixed: provider API tokens that mask on permission previews now mask even when directly followed by shell delimiters
entries.zh: 修复：服务商 API 令牌在权限预览中被打码后，即使紧跟在 shell 分隔符之后，现在也会被打码

entries.en: Fixed Claude Desktop inter-session messages being silently dropped by the recipient session when cross-session messaging read as disabled, which left the sender's query "thinking" for many minutes
entries.zh: 修复了当跨会话消息读取为禁用时，Claude Desktop 会话间消息被收件人会话静默丢弃的问题，这使得发件人的查询“思考”了很多分钟

entries.en: Remote Control: signing this computer in to a different claude.ai account or organization now stops the running session within seconds and says why, instead of a misleading HTTP 404 hours later
entries.zh: 把本机登录到另一个 claude.ai 账号或组织时，正在运行的会话会在几秒内停止并说明原因，而不是几小时后出现误导性的 HTTP 404

entries.en: Remote Control sessions started from Claude Code Desktop or VS Code now keep phones and claude.ai/code updated on the session's permission mode (and claude.ai/code on the model) as they change
entries.zh: 从 Claude Code Desktop 或 VS Code 启动的 Remote Control 会话，现在会在权限模式变化时同步更新手机端和 claude.ai/code（模型变化时也同步）

entries.en: Remote Control: effort picks made on a phone or on claude.ai/code now apply to terminal- and Desktop/VS Code-hosted sessions, and the session publishes its effort level to connected clients
entries.zh: 在手机或 claude.ai/code 上选择的强度，现在会应用到终端和 Desktop/VS Code 托管的会话，且会话会把当前强度级别告知已连接的客户端

entries.en: `SendMessage` and `ListAgents` now say when your account's session list was too long to check completely, instead of treating unseen sessions as absent
entries.zh: 当账号的会话列表过长、无法完整检查时，`SendMessage` 和 `ListAgents` 现在会明确说明，而不是把未检查到的会话当作不存在

entries.en: Expired Anthropic profile credential now points you at `/login` when a claude.ai login would take precedence
entries.zh: 当 claude.ai 登录优先时，过期的 Anthropic 配置文件凭据现在会将您指向`/login`

entries.en: Improved the transcript: your own prompts now render markdown (highlighted code blocks, inline code, lists) the same way replies do
entries.zh: 改进转录：你自己的提示现在也会像回复一样渲染 Markdown（高亮代码块、行内代码、列表）

entries.en: Improved the "API returned an empty or malformed response" error to say what came back (content type, body kind, size, request ID) and why the original streaming request failed
entries.zh: 改进「API 返回了空的或格式错误的响应」报错：会说明返回的是什么（内容类型、正文类型、大小、请求 ID），以及原始流式请求为什么失败

entries.en: Improved auto-generated session titles to read as short, specific names (e.g. "Login button bug") rather than sentences restating your request (e.g. "Fix the login button on mobile")
entries.zh: 改进自动生成的会话标题：读起来是简短具体的名称（如“Login button bug”），而不是把你的请求整句复述一遍（如“Fix the login button on mobile”）

entries.en: Reduced the context cost of loading the built-in `claude-api` skill from ~200k+ tokens to ~25k by loading reference docs on demand
entries.zh: 加载内置 `claude-api` 技能的上下文成本从 20 万以上 token 降到约 2.5 万，参考文档改为按需加载

entries.en: `/permissions` can now be opened while Claude is working — rule changes apply to the rest of the current turn
entries.zh: Claude 工作时也可以打开 `/permissions`，规则更改会应用于当前轮次的剩余部分

entries.en: `/add-dir <path>` can now be used while Claude is working; `/add-dir`, `/autocompact`, `/theme`, `/help`, `/config` and `/advisor` dialogs open mid-turn in the fullscreen TUI
entries.zh: `/add-dir <path>` 现在可在 Claude 工作时使用；全屏 TUI 中，`/add-dir`、`/autocompact`、`/theme`、`/help`、`/config` 和 `/advisor` 对话框现在可在轮次进行中打开

entries.en: `/goal` now clears itself with a notice when a turn dies on an unrecoverable error (e.g. revoked auth, an exhausted credit balance, or a context overflow) instead of staying armed
entries.zh: 轮次因不可恢复的错误（如授权被撤销、额度耗尽或上下文溢出）而中断时，`/goal` 现在会清除自身并给出提示，而不是保持激活

entries.en: `/goal`: when background tasks keep a goal waiting for 30+ minutes, Claude now checks in on them instead of waiting indefinitely (set `CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0` to opt out)
entries.zh: `/goal`：后台任务使目标等待 30 分钟以上时，Claude 现在会主动检查这些任务，而不是无限期等待（设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0` 可关闭此功能）

entries.en: `claude setup-token` now rejects unexpected extra arguments instead of silently ignoring them
entries.zh: `claude setup-token` 现在会拒绝多余的意外参数，而不再静默忽略

entries.en: Changed Esc in fullscreen mode to no longer clear a mouse text selection: it interrupts or dismisses as usual and the selection stays highlighted
entries.zh: 更改了全屏模式下的 Esc，不再清除鼠标文本选择：它会照常中断或取消，并且选择保持突出显示

entries.en: Removed the redundant "Allowed by auto mode classifier" line that auto mode showed under every Agent tool call
entries.zh: 移除自动模式在每个 Agent 工具调用下显示的重复行 "Allowed by auto mode classifier"

entries.en: Removed the "Default teammate model" setting from `/config`; agent-team teammates now use the leader's model unless the spawn names one
entries.zh: 从 `/config` 中移除 "Default teammate model" 设置；除非生成时指定，否则代理团队的队友使用负责人的模型

entries.en: Dimmed the elapsed-time counter on the running tool header so it no longer competes with the bold counts
entries.zh: 使运行工具标题上的经过时间计数器变暗，使其不再与粗体计数竞争

entries.en: Background task notifications delivered between turns are now sent to the model inside `<system-reminder>` tags, matching mid-turn delivery
entries.zh: 现在，轮次之间传递的后台任务通知将发送到`<system-reminder>`标签内的模型，与轮次中传递相匹配

entries.en: Mantle: skip the admin-pin availability probe at startup when a main-loop model is already picked
entries.zh: Mantle：当主循环模型已选定时，启动时跳过管理员固定可用性检测

entries.en: Windows: startup no longer stalls on repeated rename retries when `~/.claude.json` is read-only
entries.zh: Windows：当 `~/.claude.json` 只读时，启动不再因反复重试重命名而卡住

entries.en: Added GitLab merge request URL support to the `--worktree` flag and the `claude agents` view (where MRs display as `!N`)
entries.zh: 添加了对`--worktree`标志和“claude Agents”视图的 GitLab 合并请求 URL 支持（其中 MR 显示为`!N`）

entries.en: Added an opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per user
entries.zh: 在 Anthropic 上游添加了一个可选的`forward_user_identity`应用程序网关设置，该设置将登录用户的身份作为标头发送，因此网关后面的代理可以归因于每个用户的支出

entries.en: Added opt-in memory cgroup support for Bash tool commands on Linux (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`) so a runaway build can't stall the session
entries.zh: 添加了对 Linux 上的 Bash 工具命令的选择加入内存 cgroup 支持（`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`），因此失控的构建无法停止会话

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` environment variable to configure the WebFetch session URL cache TTL (default unchanged: 15 minutes)
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS`环境变量来配置WebFetch会话URL缓存TTL（默认不变：15分钟）

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions occasionally being marked as lost when the environment shut down while Claude was waiting on a permission prompt
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 等待权限提示时环境关闭时，云会话偶尔会被标记为丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP v2 connections endlessly reopening the subscriptions/listen stream against servers that terminate long-held streams on a fixed timeout (e.g. serverless hosts)
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP v2 连接不断重新打开订阅/监听流的问题，这些服务器在固定超时时终止长期持有的流（例如无服务器主机）

entries.en: Fixed Notification hooks not firing for permission prompts when running under Claude Desktop or VS Code
entries.zh: 修复了在 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 下运行时通知挂钩不会触发权限提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed idle sessions on Linux sometimes keeping one CPU core at 100% when sandboxing is enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用沙箱时 Linux 上的空闲会话有时会将一个 CPU 核心保持在 100% 的问题

entries.en: Fixed bundled skill aliases like `/checkup` and `/review` reporting "Unknown command" in `-p` mode or with plugins/MCP loaded when a user or project skill shadows the bundled skill
entries.zh: 修复了捆绑技能别名，如`/checkup`和`/review`，在`-p`模式下或在用户或项目技能隐藏捆绑技能时加载插件/MCP时报告“未知命令”

entries.en: Fixed skill/command argument substitution to prevent argument values from being re-expanded as template markers
entries.zh: 修复了技能/命令参数替换，以防止参数值重新扩展为模板标记

entries.en: Fixed Windows paths spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix bypassing UNC path validation, closing an NTLM credential-leak vector
entries.zh: 修复了拼写为 NT `\??\` 设备前缀的 Windows 路径绕过 UNC 路径验证，从而关闭 NTLM 凭据泄漏向量

entries.en: Improved `claude self-hosted-runner` session start time: the session branch is now created without rewriting the working tree, and two server round trips no longer block the agent's launch
entries.zh: 改进 `claude self-hosted-runner` 的会话启动时间：不再改写工作树即可创建会话分支，两次服务器往返也不再阻塞代理启动

entries.en: Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway
entries.zh: 改进 apps 网关的错误转发：Vertex、Foundry 和 Claude Platform on AWS 上游返回的 400/413 错误会带上上游自己的消息；同时修复了 apps 网关上自动压缩的一个问题

entries.en: Improved `claude plugin validate` to check a bare `.claude/skills` directory, reporting SKILL.md files whose frontmatter fails to parse
entries.zh: 改进 `claude plugin validate`：检查单独的 `.claude/skills` 目录，并报告 frontmatter 解析失败的 SKILL.md 文件

entries.en: Improved screen reader mode: the `/effort` selector renders as a numbered list with a typed-number prompt, and hint and dialog text is no longer clipped
entries.zh: 改进屏幕阅读器模式：`/effort` 选择器改为带编号的列表，并支持输入数字；提示和对话框文字不再被截断

entries.en: Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence
entries.zh: 改进打印模式诊断：请求发往 Claude Code 无法识别的模型 ID 时，会在 stderr 输出一行 `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`；用 `modelOverrides` 映射即可消除该提示

entries.en: Changed the GitHub app setup tip to no longer appear in repositories whose origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org; the enterprise marketplace tip now covers non-GitHub internal git hosts
entries.zh: 更改了 GitHub 应用程序设置提示，使其不再出现在源远程位于 gitlab.com 或 bitbucket.org 上的存储库中；企业市场提示现在涵盖非 GitHub 内部 git 主机

entries.en: Todo/task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) are no longer available on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to bring them back
entries.zh: 待办/任务跟踪工具（TaskCreate/Get/Update/List、TodoWrite）在 Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5、Fable 5、Mythos 5 及更新的模型上不再可用；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` 可重新开启

entries.en: Windows: fixed auto mode repeatedly stopping for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands (a 2.1.232 regression)
entries.zh: Windows：修复自动模式在普通的 `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash 命令上反复停下来等待手动批准的问题（2.1.232 版本的回归问题）

entries.en: Reverted the 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows and for input redirections (`< file`); a narrower version will return in a later release
entries.zh: 撤销了 2.1.232 中关于 Windows 上 Cygwin 风格符号链接和输入重定向（`< file`）的 Bash 权限变更；更窄的版本会在后续版本中回归

entries.en: Subagent forking is now on by default: a `subagent_type: "fork"` subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default
entries.zh: 子代理派生默认开启：`subagent_type: "fork"` 的子代理会继承完整对话和提示词缓存；交互式会话中，非队友的代理生成默认在后台运行

entries.en: Type `@` in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses `SendMessage` to reach that session directly
entries.zh: 在提示中输入 `@` 可按名称提及另一个 Claude 会话；Claude 随后会用 `SendMessage` 直接联系该会话

entries.en: `SendMessage` now delivers to a bare name that exactly matches one live session, instead of asking to confirm with a ref first
entries.zh: `SendMessage` 现在会把消息投递给与某个活动会话完全匹配的裸名称，而不再要求先用引用确认

entries.en: Interactive sessions on one machine now keep unique names: starting or renaming a session to a name another live session already uses gives it a `name-word-word` variant and tells you
entries.zh: 同一台机器上的交互式会话现在保持名称唯一：如果启动或重命名会话时使用了另一个正在运行的会话已用的名称，会自动加上 `name-word-word` 后缀并提示你

entries.en: Added `/config` rows for "Dialog expiry" and "Messages from your other sessions" (cross-session inbound accept/hold/refuse)
entries.zh: 添加了“对话到期”和“来自其他会话的消息”的`/config`行（跨会话入站接受/保留/拒绝）

entries.en: Added secret redaction for GitLab token families (`glrt-`, `gloas-`, `glptt-`, `glagent-`, `glimt-`, `glsoat-`, `glcbt-`, `glft-`, `glffct-`) and full redaction of routable `glpat-`/`gldt-` tokens; the `glab` CLI config store gets the same sandbox and credential-path protection as `gh`
entries.zh: 为 GitLab 令牌系列（`glrt-`、`gloas-`、`glptt-`、`glagent-`、`glimt-`、`glsoat-`、`glcbt-`、`glft-`、`glffct-`）添加了秘密编辑，并对可路由的 `glpat-`/`gldt-` 令牌进行了完整编辑； `glab` CLI 配置存储获得与 `gh` 相同的沙箱和凭证路径保护

entries.en: Added GitLab support to plugin marketplaces: bare `gitlab.com` repo URLs (including nested subgroups) now clone like `github.com` URLs, and clone auth-failure hints name your actual git host
entries.zh: 添加了对插件市场的 GitLab 支持：裸露的 `gitlab.com` 存储库 URL（包括嵌套子组）现在可以像 `github.com` URL 一样克隆，并且克隆身份验证失败提示会命名您的实际 git 主机

entries.en: Settings: `additionalMarketplaces` and `allowedMarketplaces` are now accepted as friendlier aliases for `extraKnownMarketplaces` and `strictKnownMarketplaces`
entries.zh: 设置：`additionalMarketplaces` 和 `allowedMarketplaces` 现在可作为 `extraKnownMarketplaces` 和 `strictKnownMarketplaces` 的更易记别名使用

entries.en: Enterprise policy: a url-typed `blockedMarketplaces` entry for a bare repo URL keeps blocking that URL when the CLI classifies it as a git clone
entries.zh: 企业策略：当 CLI 将其分类为 git 克隆时，裸存储库 URL 的 url 类型`blockedMarketplaces`条目会持续阻止该 URL

entries.en: Gateway: the `desktop:` overlay now accepts every released Desktop setting (was 11 hand-listed keys), validated at boot against Desktop's own schema; unknown or invalid keys fail boot
entries.zh: 网关：`desktop:` 覆盖配置现在接受所有已发布的 Desktop 设置（以前手动列出 11 个键），启动时按 Desktop 自身的 schema 校验；未知或无效的键会导致启动失败

entries.en: Gateway: empty `managed.policies[].match.groups`/`admin.admin_groups` entries and malformed `email_domain` values (empty, or containing `@`, whitespace, or commas) now fail at boot instead of silently matching no one or granting admin access
entries.zh: 网关：`managed.policies[].match.groups`、`admin.admin_groups` 中的空条目，以及格式错误的 `email_domain`（为空，或含 `@`、空白、逗号），现在会在启动时直接报错，而不是悄悄匹配不到任何人或误授管理员权限

entries.en: Fable 5 is offered as an advisor in `/advisor` again for organizations with Fable access, with usage-credits consent set up through `/model fable`
entries.zh: Fable 5 再次作为`/advisor`中的顾问提供给具有 Fable 访问权限的组织，并通过`/model fable`设置使用积分同意

entries.en: Fixed a PowerShell permission bypass where variable-writing parameters could silently overwrite `$PSDefaultParameterValues` and redirect later commands' file access
entries.zh: 修复了 PowerShell 权限绕过问题，其中变量写入参数可能会静默覆盖`$PSDefaultParameterValues`并重定向后续命令的文件访问

entries.en: Fixed a Windows permission bypass where Git Bash followed Cygwin-style symlinks that path validation saw as regular files; writes through them now require permission approval
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 权限绕过问题，其中 Git Bash 遵循 Cygwin 风格的符号链接，路径验证将其视为常规文件；现在通过它们写入需要许可批准

entries.en: Fixed nested git repositories inheriting trust from a parent directory; each repository now requires its own trust confirmation
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套 git 存储库从父目录继承信任的问题；每个存储库现在都需要自己的信任确认

entries.en: Fixed MCP connections hanging for the full 30-second connect timeout when a server fails to answer or sends a malformed reply to the protocol-version probe
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器无法应答或向协议版本探测发送格式错误的答复时，MCP 连接在整个 30 秒连接超时期间挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by a bridge inside a cloud session inheriting that session's transcript or credentials
entries.zh: 修复了由云会话内的网桥托管的远程控制会话继承该会话的记录或凭据

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions started from Claude Desktop or an IDE appearing as a new claude.ai session each time the local session was resumed; they now reattach to the existing one
entries.zh: 修复了每次恢复本地会话时从 Claude Desktop 或 IDE 启动的远程控制会话显示为新的 claude.ai 会话的问题；他们现在重新连接到现有的

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions appearing unreachable to newly attached clients while idle
entries.zh: 修复了空闲时新连接的客户端无法访问远程控制会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control bridge sessions not restoring conversation history when the session worker restarts
entries.zh: 修复了会话工作进程重新启动时远程控制桥接会话不会恢复对话历史记录的问题

entries.en: Remote Control: resuming a conversation whose session was deleted from claude.ai or the app now starts a replacement instead of failing with a message about your login (regressed in v2.1.227)
entries.zh: 恢复一个会话已在 claude.ai 或 App 中被删除的对话时，现在会启动替代会话，而不是因登录相关的消息而失败（v2.1.227 中出现过此回归）

entries.en: Fixed Cloud gateway `/login` exiting silently or leaving an unresponsive terminal after "Press Enter to continue" when managed settings failed to load; the reason is now shown
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置加载失败时“按 Enter 继续”后云网关`/login`静默退出或留下无响应终端的问题；原因现已显示

entries.en: Fixed voice mode on native builds getting stuck on "listening…" when the voice service rejected the connection; the rejection is now shown immediately
entries.zh: 修复语音服务拒绝连接时，原生构建版语音模式卡在"listening…"的问题；现在会立即显示拒绝信息

entries.en: Fixed mTLS client certificate rotation requiring a restart; Claude Code now reloads the rotated cert and key automatically on connection errors
entries.zh: 修复了 mTLS 客户端证书轮换需要重新启动的问题；克劳德代码现在会在连接错误时自动重新加载轮换的证书和密钥

entries.en: Fixed malformed AWS or Vertex region values being used to build request URLs; they now fall back to the default region
entries.zh: 修复了用于构建请求 URL 的格式错误的 AWS 或 Vertex 区域值；他们现在回退到默认区域

entries.en: Fixed stream idle timeout errors failing the request instead of recovering on Bedrock, Vertex, and gateway deployments
entries.zh: 修复了导致请求失败而不是在 Bedrock、Vertex 和网关部署上恢复的流空闲超时错误

entries.en: Fixed content-sized overlays containing truncated text rendering one column too wide, and start-truncated text collapsing to an ellipsis
entries.zh: 修复了包含截断文本的内容大小覆盖，导致一列太宽，以及开始截断文本折叠为省略号

entries.en: Fixed a stray garbled character where a long shell-command or agent-description preview was cut off mid-emoji
entries.zh: 修复了长 shell 命令或代理描述预览在表情符号中间被切断的杂乱字符

entries.en: Fixed a startup race that could silently unregister a plugin marketplace due to concurrent writes to `known_marketplaces.json`
entries.zh: 修复了一个启动竞赛，由于并发写入`known_marketplaces.json`，该竞赛可能会默默地取消注册插件市场

entries.en: Fixed `/update` and `/tui` refusing to restart while work that survives the relaunch was running
entries.zh: 修复了`/update`和`/tui`在重新启动后仍然存在的工作正在运行时拒绝重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed usage-limit guidance suggesting unavailable slash commands in SDK and remote sessions
entries.zh: 修复 SDK 和远程会话中，用量上限指引建议了不可用斜杠命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed the consent message for interactive `--advisor fable` launches, which told you to run `/model fable` in an interactive session that had just exited
entries.zh: 修复交互式 `--advisor fable` 启动时的同意提示，错误地让你在刚退出的交互会话中运行 `/model fable` 的问题

entries.en: Improved fullscreen streaming: long sessions stay responsive because the whole conversation is no longer re-normalized on every update
entries.zh: 改进全屏流式输出：长会话保持流畅，因为每次更新不再重新规范化整个对话

entries.en: Improved the managed settings approval dialog: shows endpoint URLs, uses clearer wording for telemetry-only changes, skips routine OpenTelemetry options, and requires approval for server-managed sandbox binary overrides (`sandbox.bwrapPath`, `sandbox.socatPath`, `sandbox.ripgrep`)
entries.zh: 改进托管设置批准对话框：显示端点 URL，对仅涉及遥测的改动使用更清楚的措辞，跳过例行的 OpenTelemetry 选项，并要求批准服务器托管的沙盒二进制覆盖项（`sandbox.bwrapPath`、`sandbox.socatPath`、`sandbox.ripgrep`）

entries.en: `/feedback` and `/bug` now open immediately when invoked while Claude is responding, instead of waiting for the turn to finish
entries.zh: Claude 回复时调用 `/feedback` 和 `/bug`，现在会立即打开，不再等待当前轮次结束

entries.en: `/plugin install plugin@marketplace` now refreshes the marketplace first, so newly published plugins install without a manual marketplace update
entries.zh: `/plugin install plugin@marketplace` 现在会先刷新市场，因此新发布的插件无需手动更新市场即可安装

entries.en: `/code-review` at high, xhigh, and max effort now runs in a background agent like the other levels
entries.zh: 高、xhigh 和 max 强度下的 `/code-review` 现在与其他强度一样，在后台 agent 中运行

entries.en: Pasted and clipboard images are read without blocking the event loop
entries.zh: 粘贴和剪贴板中的图片现在读取时不再阻塞事件循环

entries.en: Remote Control now keeps reconnecting for about 30 minutes after a network blip and no longer drops after a few blips spread across an hour
entries.zh: 网络短暂中断后，Remote Control 现在会持续重连约 30 分钟，不再因为一小时内零散出现的几次中断就断开

entries.en: Remote Control: resuming a conversation no longer silently takes Remote Control away from another Claude Code on the same machine that still has it; run `/remote-control` there to move it
entries.zh: 恢复会话时，不再悄悄把同一台电脑上仍在使用 Remote Control 的另一个 Claude Code 的 Remote Control 抢走；如需转移，请在那边运行 `/remote-control`

entries.en: Updated agent panel: completed subagents hide immediately with a `/tasks` footer hint, and the "↓ N more" overflow indicator moved left for visibility
entries.zh: 更新了代理面板：已完成的子代理会立即隐藏，并显示 `/tasks` 底部提示；"↓ N more" 溢出指示器移到了左侧，更容易看到

entries.en: Remote Control: the terminal now says whether a session was taken over by another device, ended from another app, or deleted, and stops suggesting a reconnect that would undo it
entries.zh: 终端现在会说明会话是被其他设备接管、被其他应用结束，还是被删除，并且不再建议那种会撤销该操作的重连

entries.en: Bash input redirections (`< file`) are now permission-checked like their argument spellings on all platforms
entries.zh: Bash 输入重定向（`< file`）现在像所有平台上的参数拼写一样进行权限检查

entries.en: Shortened the message shown when resuming a completed background agent
entries.zh: 缩短了恢复已完成后台代理时显示的消息

entries.en: Cowork sessions no longer inline external @-imports from user-scope memory files
entries.zh: Cowork 会话不再从用户范围内存文件内联外部 @-导入

entries.en: Hardened the auto-generated cross-session messaging socket directory on shared `/tmp`: a pre-planted symlink or another user's directory is now refused instead of used
entries.zh: 加固跨会话消息自动生成的套接字目录（位于共享的 `/tmp`）：如果该目录被预先放置了符号链接，或是其他用户的目录，现在会拒绝使用

entries.en: Hardened the Linux filesystem sandbox against a protected-path bypass
entries.zh: 加固 Linux 文件系统沙箱，修复受保护路径被绕过的问题

entries.en: Changed `sandbox.ripgrep` to be honored only from user, managed, and `--settings` settings; project settings can no longer override the sandbox's ripgrep binary
entries.zh: 将`sandbox.ripgrep`更改为仅从用户、托管和`--settings`设置中启用；项目设置无法再覆盖沙箱的 ripgrep 二进制文件

entries.en: Removed the startup tip suggesting you create custom subagents, and the matching nudge in the `/powerup` tour
entries.zh: 移除建议你创建自定义子代理的启动提示，以及 `/powerup` 导览中的对应提示

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with a redirect URI mismatch for servers that use a pre-registered OAuth client, such as Slack
entries.zh: 修复了使用预注册 OAuth 客户端（例如 Slack）的服务器因重定向 URI 不匹配而导致 MCP OAuth 登录失败的问题

entries.en: Documented `claude remote-control --continue` for resuming the most recent Remote Control session
entries.zh: 记录了`claude remote-control --continue`，用于恢复最近的远程控制会话

entries.en: Added server-supplied Claude Code hook support for self-hosted runner sessions, matching managed-environment behavior
entries.zh: 为自托管运行器会话添加了服务器提供的 Claude Code 挂钩支持，以匹配托管环境行为

entries.en: Added SSE keepalive pings to gateway streaming responses during long thinking pauses, preventing idle-timeout disconnects on Vertex and Bedrock upstreams
entries.zh: 在长时间思考暂停期间向网关流响应添加了 SSE keepalive ping，防止 Vertex 和 Bedrock 上游的空闲超时断开连接

entries.en: Added plugin marketplace `command` sources: a local command (e.g. an IDE) prints the plugin directory, which is re-resolved each session and applied without a restart; `mode: "link"` uses it in place
entries.zh: 添加了插件市场“命令”源：本地命令（例如 IDE）打印插件目录，该目录会重新解析每个会话并在无需重新启动的情况下应用； `mode: "link"` 就地使用它

entries.en: `ListAgents` now marks disconnected Remote Control sessions as `offline` and labels your cloud sessions as `cloud`
entries.zh: `ListAgents` 现在会把已断开的 Remote Control 会话标记为 `offline`，并把你的云端会话标记为 `cloud`

entries.en: Fixed long responses partly disappearing while streaming and being printed twice in the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了长响应在流式传输并在终端中打印两次时部分消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash to the error screen (including on `--resume` of the affected session) when a tool call had a non-string `glob`, `file_path`, or `command` value
entries.zh: 修复了当工具调用具有非字符串`glob`、`file_path`或`command`值时错误屏幕崩溃（包括受影响会话的`--resume`）

entries.en: Fixed a RangeError crash when a progress bar or markdown table rendered in a very narrow terminal window (could also crash `claude --continue`/`--resume` at startup)
entries.zh: 修复了在非常狭窄的终端窗口中呈现进度条或降价表时出现的 RangeError 崩溃问题（启动时也可能导致 `claude --continue`/`--resume` 崩溃）

entries.en: Fixed a crash on Windows when a tool call or message referenced a file by an extended-length (`\\?\`) or UNC path
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上工具调用或消息通过扩展长度 (`\\?\`) 或 UNC 路径引用文件时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed auto mode failing on every tool call for users who disable the attribution header via `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER` (direct Anthropic API connections)
entries.zh: 修复了通过`CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER`（直接 Anthropic API 连接）禁用归因标头的用户每次工具调用时自动模式失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` rejecting Sonnet/Opus 1M for claude.ai subscribers using a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway
entries.zh: 修复了使用自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`网关的`/model`拒绝 claude.ai 订阅者的 Sonnet/Opus 1M 的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth with strict authorization servers by using `127.0.0.1` instead of `localhost` in the redirect URI
entries.zh: 通过在重定向 URI 中使用`127.0.0.1`而不是`localhost`，修复了具有严格授权服务器的 MCP OAuth

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control clients showing a stuck working spinner after a slash command typed in the laptop terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在笔记本电脑终端中输入斜杠命令后远程控制客户端显示卡住的工作微调器的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Claude Code Review workflow generated by `/install-github-app` completing without posting its review on the pull request
entries.zh: 修复了由 `/install-github-app` 生成的 Claude Code Review 工作流程完成后未在拉取请求上发布其审核

entries.en: Fixed multi-second UI stalls after editing a file with thousands of IDE diagnostics while the IDE extension is connected
entries.zh: 修复了在连接 IDE 扩展时编辑包含数千个 IDE 诊断的文件后出现多秒 UI 停顿的问题

entries.en: Fixed one-shot `claude plugin` commands leaving a stray liveness file that could prevent cleanup of outdated plugin versions
entries.zh: 修复了一次性`claude plugin`命令留下的杂散活动文件，该文件可能会阻止清理过时的插件版本

entries.en: Fixed dynamic workflows inside CPU-limited containers using the host machine's core count instead of the container's CPU limit
entries.zh: 使用主机的核心计数而不是容器的 CPU 限制修复了 CPU 限制的容器内的动态工作流程

entries.en: Fixed a file-watcher handle leak after atomic file replacements, and an uncaught error on Windows when the scheduled-tasks watcher failed on a network or virtual filesystem
entries.zh: 修复了原子文件替换后的文件观察器句柄泄漏，以及计划任务观察器在网络或虚拟文件系统上失败时在 Windows 上出现的未捕获错误

entries.en: Fixed SDK and `--input-format stream-json` sessions getting a 400 API error when a whitespace-only message was submitted
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 和`--input-format stream-json`会话在提交纯空白消息时出现 400 API 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed conversations whose messages alone exceed the API's 32 MB request limit retrying compaction when no images or documents can be stripped; they now fail once with a clear message
entries.zh: 修复了仅消息超过 API 的 32 MB 请求限制的对话，当没有图像或文档可以被剥离时重试压缩；他们现在失败一次并发出明确的信息

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry export from Claude Desktop sessions being rejected by the Desktop-managed gateway when that gateway is also the telemetry endpoint
entries.zh: 修复了当桌面管理网关同时也是遥测端点时，从 Claude Desktop 会话导出的 OpenTelemetry 被桌面管理网关拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner and other remote sessions exiting at startup when `managed-mcp.json` is deployed and the server delivers MCP servers; those servers are now skipped with a warning
entries.zh: 修复了部署“management-mcp.json”且服务器提供 MCP 服务器时启动时退出的自托管运行器和其他远程会话；现在会跳过这些服务器并发出警告

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runner repository preparation hanging on a Git Credential Manager prompt; git now fails fast when credentials are missing
entries.zh: 修复了 Git 凭证管理器提示中挂起的自托管运行程序存储库准备问题；现在，当凭据丢失时，git 会快速失败

entries.en: Improved workflow fan-outs to stagger same-prefix sibling agents so subsequent agents read the cached prompt prefix instead of re-paying it (`CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS=0` disables)
entries.zh: 改进工作流扇出：同前缀的兄弟智能体会错开启动，使后续智能体读取缓存的提示前缀，而不必重复付费（设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS=0` 可关闭）

entries.en: Improved "prompt is too long" errors to explain why automatic compaction could not recover instead of only suggesting `/compact`
entries.zh: 改进“prompt is too long”错误提示，说明自动压缩为什么没能恢复，而不只是建议 `/compact`

entries.en: Improved sandbox: IPv6 literals in network domain lists are now bracketed (`[::1]:443`), and ambiguous spellings are enforced fail-closed and flagged by `/doctor`
entries.zh: 改进沙盒：网络域名列表中的 IPv6 地址现在要加方括号（`[::1]:443`），含糊的写法会按失败即拒绝执行，并由 `/doctor` 标记

entries.en: Updated `/login` to repeat the `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` override warning after a successful login
entries.zh: 成功登录后，`/login` 会再次提示 `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` 覆盖设置的警告

entries.en: Changed `/commit-push-pr` so git/gh commands with dangerous flags (`--force`, `--amend`, `--no-verify`, etc.) are no longer auto-approved
entries.zh: 更改了 `/commit-push-pr`，因此带有危险标志（`--force`、`--amend`、`--no-verify` 等）的 git/gh 命令不再自动批准

entries.en: Changed self-hosted runner Windows startup to require an explicit `--base-dir`; there is no default checkout directory on Windows
entries.zh: 更改了自托管运行程序 Windows 启动以需要显式的`--base-dir`； Windows 上没有默认的结账目录

entries.en: [VSCode] "Report a problem" and `/bug` now open the built-in feedback dialog instead of a retired survey link
entries.zh: [VSCode] 「Report a problem」和 `/bug` 现在会打开内置反馈对话框，不再跳转到已停用的问卷链接

entries.en: [VSCode] Made the `/btw` side-question panel resizable by dragging its boundary, in both side-docked and stacked layouts
entries.zh: [VSCode] 让 `/btw` 旁问面板可以通过拖动边界调整大小，支持侧边停靠和堆叠两种布局

entries.en: [VSCode] Added session groups in the sidebar — right-click to create, rename, or delete; Cmd/Ctrl- or Shift-click to move several sessions at once
entries.zh: [VSCode] 侧边栏新增会话分组：右键可创建、重命名或删除；按住 Cmd/Ctrl 或 Shift 点击可同时移动多个会话

entries.en: Fixed interactive sessions that could stop redrawing entirely, while the process kept running, after a rare internal layout error
entries.zh: 修复了在出现罕见的内部布局错误后，交互式会话可能会完全停止重绘，而进程仍在运行的情况

entries.en: Fixed `git` / Git Bash not being found on Windows when Claude Code is launched from a parent folder of the git installation
entries.zh: 修复了从 git 安装的父文件夹启动 Claude Code 时在 Windows 上找不到`git`/Git Bash 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/tui` reverting the session to an earlier model when `/model` had been changed since the last response
entries.zh: 修复了自上次响应以来`/model`发生更改时`/tui`将会话恢复到早期模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed cross-session messaging sometimes starting without an inbox in the first session after install or upgrade
entries.zh: 修复了跨会话消息传递有时在安装或升级后的第一个会话中没有收件箱的情况下启动

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control `/resume` while connected leaking the resumed conversation's title or history into the connected session
entries.zh: 修复了连接时远程控制`/resume`将恢复的对话的标题或历史记录泄漏到连接的会话中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` sessions failing on every fresh runner when the `checkout` hook fails for a repository the session doesn't push to; that repository is now skipped with a warning
entries.zh: 修复了当会话未推送到的存储库的`checkout`挂钩失败时，`claude self-hosted-runner`会话在每个新运行器上失败的问题；该存储库现在已被跳过并带有警告

entries.en: Fixed self-hosted runners ending sessions in the gap between a background task finishing and the follow-up turn starting
entries.zh: 修复了自托管跑步者在后台任务完成和后续回合开始之间的间隙结束会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed session cleanup deleting contents inside a project's memory folder
entries.zh: 修复了会话清理删除项目内存文件夹内的内容的问题

entries.en: Fixed background plugin-cache cleanup deleting a plugin's cache when its only version is a symlinked development checkout
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的唯一版本是符号链接开发签出时后台插件缓存清理会删除插件缓存的问题

entries.en: Fixed a settings-merge issue where a marketplace entry redefined in a higher-precedence settings tier could inherit another tier's custom headers; marketplace entries now merge as whole entries
entries.zh: 修复了设置合并问题，即在较高优先级设置层中重新定义的市场条目可能会继承另一层的自定义标头；市场条目现在合并为整个条目

entries.en: Fixed the deferred-tools reminder occasionally being sent to the model twice after a skill invocation
entries.zh: 修复技能调用之后，延迟工具提醒偶尔被两次发送给模型的问题

entries.en: Hardened skills synced from claude.ai: they no longer shadow local commands or MCP prompts, their descriptions are sanitized and labeled, and on your machine their bodies don't run `!` commands or expand `@` files
entries.zh: 加固从 claude.ai 同步的技能：它们不再覆盖本地命令或 MCP 提示，描述会被清理并加上标注；在你的电脑上，其正文不会执行 `!` 命令，也不会展开 `@` 文件

entries.en: Improved cross-session messages: the sender and body now display inline instead of a collapsed line, and messages to Remote Control sessions on other machines show your Remote Control session name as the sender
entries.zh: 改进跨会话消息：发送者和正文直接内联显示，不再是折叠的一行；发给其他机器上远程控制会话的消息，发送者会显示为你的远程控制会话名称

entries.en: Improved Vertex AI credential handling: expired or missing Google Cloud credentials now fail within seconds instead of retrying for minutes
entries.zh: 改进 Vertex AI 凭证处理：Google Cloud 凭证过期或缺失时，几秒内即报错，不再重试好几分钟

entries.en: Improved compaction progress: the retry countdown and stall hint now appear during compaction instead of only a progress bar
entries.zh: 改进压缩进度：压缩期间显示重试倒计时和停滞提示，而不只是进度条

entries.en: Updated terminal title busy-spinner glyphs to reduce tab-bar jitter on some terminals
entries.zh: 终端标题的忙碌加载字符已调整，减少某些终端标签栏的抖动

entries.en: Changed the Write tool so newer models can overwrite an existing file they haven't read this session, matching the Edit tool's rules; older models still require the read first
entries.zh: 更改了写入工具，以便较新的模型可以覆盖他们在本次会话中未读取的现有文件，这符合编辑工具的规则；旧型号仍然需要先阅读

entries.en: Removed the outdated note about auto mode sessions costing slightly more from the first-use notice for Pro, Max, and Team plans
entries.zh: 从 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐的首次使用通知中，移除关于自动模式会话成本略高的过时说明

entries.en: Fixed feature flags being evaluated without the user's subscription tier when a session started with an expired login token, which could wrongly prompt Max plan users to enable usage credits for Fable
entries.zh: 修复了当会话使用过期的登录令牌启动时，在没有用户订阅级别的情况下评估功能标志的问题，这可能会错误地提示 Max 计划用户启用 Fable 的使用积分

entries.en: Fixed every Bash command failing under `claude-code-action` with `allowed_non_write_users` on GitHub-hosted runners
entries.zh: 修复了在 GitHub 托管的运行器上使用`allowed_non_write_users`在`claude-code-action`下失败的每个 Bash 命令

entries.en: Fixed `/tui` bringing back a conversation that had been rewound to before its first message
entries.zh: 修复了`/tui`返回已回退到第一条消息之前的对话的问题

entries.en: Improved slash-command menu: blue now marks only the selected row, matched characters are bolded instead of recolored, and emoji or accented names keep their glyphs
entries.zh: 改进斜杠命令菜单：蓝色只标记选中行，匹配的字符改为加粗而不是变色，表情符号和带重音的名称保持原样显示

entries.en: Improved performance: fewer event-loop stalls on file-not-found suggestions and at-mention size checks
entries.zh: 改进性能：减少文件不存在时的建议和 @ 提及大小检查造成的事件循环卡顿

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added gateway spend-limit support to Claude Code's usage warning; the limit-reached message now names the cap, its reset time, and the operator's message (requires the gateway on 2.1.225)
entries.zh: 为 Claude Code 的使用警告添加了网关支出限制支持；达到限制的消息现在命名上限、其重置时间和操作员的消息（需要 2.1.225 上的网关）

entries.en: Added a workspace trust prompt to `claude agents` for untrusted directories, matching the behavior of `claude`
entries.zh: 为不受信任的目录添加了工作区信任提示，以匹配`claude`的行为

entries.en: Fixed a transient 401 replacing a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` with a stored login's short-lived token, breaking headless sessions until restart
entries.zh: 修复了瞬态 401，用存储的登录名的短期令牌替换长期的`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`，从而中断无头会话直到重新启动

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth servers on macOS intermittently failing with a burst of 401 errors, as if never authenticated, after a keychain read timed out
entries.zh: 修复了钥匙串读取超时后，macOS 上的 MCP OAuth 服务器间歇性失败并出现大量 401 错误，就好像从未经过身份验证一样

entries.en: Fixed auto mode counting a safety-filter refusal of its own permission check toward the consecutive-block limit; the action is still denied, but the model is now told to move on rather than retry
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式，将安全过滤器拒绝其自身权限检查的次数计入连续块限制；该操作仍然被拒绝，但模型现在被告知继续前进而不是重试

entries.en: Fixed cross-session messages staying parked without a notice or expiry in headless sessions and during startup
entries.zh: 修复了无头会话和启动期间跨会话消息在没有通知或过期的情况下保持停放状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed conversation history breaking on Remote Control session resume after very large conversations were compacted
entries.zh: 修复了压缩非常大的对话后，远程控制会话恢复时对话历史记录中断的问题

entries.en: Fixed hovering over a session in another project in the agents list changing the directory the next agent starts in
entries.zh: 修复了将鼠标悬停在代理列表中另一个项目中的会话上更改下一个代理启动的目录的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` registering and then failing every session when `--base-dir` cannot be created or written; it now exits at startup with a clear error
entries.zh: 修复了`claude self-hosted-runner`注册，然后在无法创建或写入`--base-dir`时每个会话失败的问题；现在它在启动时退出并出现明显错误

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code on the web sessions being misreported as stuck, re-sending a growing event backlog on every reconnect
entries.zh: 修复了网络会话上的克劳德代码被错误报告为卡住的问题，每次重新连接时都会重新发送不断增长的事件积压

entries.en: Improved Remote Control: photos attached from the Claude app are now shown to Claude directly instead of being read from disk with a separate tool call
entries.zh: 改进远程控制：从 Claude 应用附加的照片，现在直接展示给 Claude，而不是用单独的工具调用从磁盘读取

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view folding away the latest to-do list, a pending question's context, and settled answers; thinking-only folds show "Thought for Ns" and re-collapse when their turn completes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Focus 视图折叠掉最新的待办列表、待回答问题的上下文以及已结束的回答的问题；仅含思考的折叠项会显示 "Thought for Ns"，并在该轮次完成后重新折叠

entries.en: SendMessage can now start a conversation with your Remote Control sessions on other machines by name (`ListAgents` shows them as `name [ref]`), instead of only replying after they message you first
entries.zh: SendMessage 现在可以按名称（`ListAgents` 显示为 `name [ref]`）与其他机器上的 Remote Control 会话开始对话，而不再只能在对方先发消息后回复

entries.en: SendMessage: a Remote Control recipient you already confirmed is never swapped for a same-named session on this machine when its own list couldn't be checked
entries.zh: SendMessage：已确认的 Remote Control 接收方，在其自身列表无法核实时，永远不会被本机上同名的会话替换

entries.en: Added self-hosted environments: `claude self-hosted-runner` turns your own machines or containers into a place Claude Code web, mobile, and desktop sessions can run, on Team and Enterprise plans
entries.zh: 添加了自托管环境：`claude self-hosted-runner`将您自己的计算机或容器变成可以在团队和企业计划上运行 Claude Code Web、移动和桌面会话的地方

entries.en: Added `archive` plugin source: install plugins from a zip over HTTPS without git or npm, with optional SHA-256 pinning
entries.zh: 添加了`archive`插件源：通过 HTTPS 从 zip 安装插件，无需 git 或 npm，并具有可选的 SHA-256 固定

entries.en: Added a cancel-and-confirm step when removing an unavailable paste changes a command's text
entries.zh: 添加了删除不可用的粘贴更改命令文本时的取消和确认步骤

entries.en: Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX` env var for Bedrock to prefer a specific cross-region inference profile over the `AWS_REGION`-derived one
entries.zh: 为 Bedrock 添加了`ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX`环境变量，以优先选择特定的跨区域推理配置文件而不是`AWS_REGION`派生的配置文件

entries.en: Added `crossSessionInbound` and `dialogExpiry` settings: cross-session messages sent to a session running with bypassed permissions are held for your approval, and messages to other sessions auto-deliver
entries.zh: 添加了`crossSessionInbound`和`dialogExpiry`设置：发送到以绕过权限运行的会话的跨会话消息将保留供您批准，并且发送到其他会话的消息将自动传送

entries.en: Added sandbox credential-masking options: `extract` and `onExtractNoMatch` for structured env values, `decode: "jwt"` with `maskClaims` for JWT-aware masking, and `awsPairs`/`sigv4` for AWS SigV4 re-signing; these need `network.tlsTerminate` and are honored only from user, managed, or `--settings` settings
entries.zh: 添加了沙盒凭证屏蔽选项：用于结构化环境值的`extract`和`onExtractNoMatch`，用于 JWT 感知屏蔽的`decode: "jwt"`和`maskClaims`，以及用于 AWS SigV4 重新签名的`awsPairs`/`sigv4`；这些需要`network.tlsTerminate`，并且只能从用户、托管或`--settings`设置中获得

entries.en: Added cross-session `SendMessage`: Claude Code sessions can now message each other, on any of your machines, with `ListAgents` to discover them (macOS and Linux)
entries.zh: 添加了跨会话`SendMessage`：Claude Code 会话现在可以在任何计算机上使用`ListAgents`互相发送消息来发现它们（macOS 和 Linux）

entries.en: Fixed long (>200 char) project paths resolving to another project's session directory under a shared sanitized prefix; session list, rename, fork, delete and `/resume` no longer cross projects
entries.zh: 修复了长（>200 个字符）项目路径解析为共享清理前缀下的另一个项目的会话目录；会话列表、重命名、分叉、删除和`/resume`不再跨项目

entries.en: Fixed `SendMessage` reporting "Message sent" when the write to a teammate's inbox had actually failed; failed deliveries are now reported as errors
entries.zh: 修复了当写入队友收件箱实际上失败时`SendMessage`报告“消息已发送”的问题；失败的交付现在被报告为错误

entries.en: Fixed sandbox filesystem deny entries written with a trailing slash (e.g. `denyRead: "~/.aws/"`) being silently bypassable on Linux and macOS
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒文件系统拒绝使用尾部斜杠写入的条目（例如 `denyRead: "~/.aws/"`）在 Linux 和 macOS 上可静默绕过的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandbox violation details never appearing in Bash tool results; Claude now sees which file or network access was denied and why
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具结果中从未出现的沙箱违规详细信息；克劳德现在可以看到哪个文件或网络访问被拒绝以及原因

entries.en: Fixed MCP tools that connect mid-turn being deferred for tool search without their names announced to the model
entries.zh: 修复了在中途连接的 MCP 工具被推迟进行工具搜索而未向模型公布其名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin install records being silently corrupted when the same plugin is installed in multiple projects
entries.zh: 修复了在多个项目中安装相同插件时插件安装记录被无提示损坏的问题

entries.en: Fixed recalled or restored paste content occasionally attaching wrong data or silently losing text when the paste had aged out or placeholder numbers collided
entries.zh: 修复了当粘贴过期或占位符数字冲突时，召回或恢复的粘贴内容偶尔会附加错误数据或默默丢失文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed copy-on-select on Wayland sometimes not reaching the clipboard; the two selection writes no longer race
entries.zh: 修复了 Wayland 上的选择复制有时无法到达剪贴板的问题；两个选择写入不再竞争

entries.en: Fixed the feedback survey's transcript share silently failing on long sessions; a failed share now shows an error instead of a success message
entries.zh: 修复长会话中反馈调查的对话记录分享静默失败的问题；现在分享失败会显示错误，而不是显示成功提示

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control auto-start intermittently failing with "Remote credentials fetch failed" on a cold start with a stale login token
entries.zh: 修复了使用过时的登录令牌冷启动时远程控制自动启动间歇性失败并显示“远程凭据获取失败”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control and SDK clients showing a blank "(no content)" message after `/clear` and other output-less commands
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制和 SDK 客户端在`/clear`和其他无输出命令之后显示空白“（无内容）”消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed a Remote Control session recreated after its server session expired uploading prior local conversation history into the new session
entries.zh: 修复了服务器会话过期后重新创建的远程控制会话，将之前的本地对话历史记录上传到新会话中

entries.en: Improved fullscreen mode to keep the full pre-compaction history in scrollback across repeated compactions, instead of only the most recent interval
entries.zh: 改进全屏模式：多次压缩后，完整的压缩前历史仍保留在滚动回看中，而不是只保留最近一段

entries.en: Improved Remote Control: attached web and mobile clients now see compaction progress and the post-compaction boundary instead of a silent pause; `/clear` resets now propagate to attached clients
entries.zh: 改进远程控制：已连接的网页和移动端客户端现在能看到压缩进度和压缩后的分界点，不再是一段沉默；`/clear` 的重置也会同步给已连接的客户端

entries.en: Improved Remote Control: connection failures now show a persistent failure indicator with details and a reconnect shortcut, instead of only an 8-second toast
entries.zh: 改进远程控制：连接失败时显示持续的失败指示器，附带详情和重连快捷键，而不是只弹出 8 秒的提示

entries.en: Removed the 200-subagent-per-session spawn cap; long-running sessions no longer refuse new agents (concurrency and depth limits still apply)
entries.zh: 移除每个会话 200 个子代理的生成上限；长时间运行的会话不再拒绝新代理（并发和深度限制仍然生效）

entries.en: Changed managed settings: the approval prompt no longer re-appears after re-login or org switching when the organization's settings are unchanged
entries.zh: 更改托管设置：在组织设置未更改的情况下，重新登录或组织切换后不再出现审批提示

entries.en: Changed the feedback-survey transcript share: with your consent it now also uploads the last request's model settings — the system prompt (which includes your `CLAUDE.md` instructions), tool definitions, and model parameters. Secrets are redacted as before, and these fields are dropped first if the share is too large
entries.zh: 更改了反馈调查记录共享：在您同意的情况下，它现在还会上传最后一个请求的模型设置 - 系统提示（包括您的`CLAUDE.md`指令）、工具定义和模型参数。像以前一样对秘密进行编辑，如果份额太大，这些字段将首先被删除

entries.en: Changed the Bash tool description to always note that command output is displayed to the model, not reliably to the user
entries.zh: 更改了 Bash 工具描述，以始终注意命令输出显示给模型，而不是可靠地显示给用户

entries.en: Changed recalled paste placeholder numbers to renumber when accepted into the input
entries.zh: 更改了召回的粘贴占位符编号，以便在接受输入时重新编号

entries.en: Changed Remote Control to archive the stale server session instead of leaving a dead one listed when a fresh session is minted after compaction or `/resume`
entries.zh: 更改了远程控制以存档过时的服务器会话，而不是在压缩或`/resume`后创建新会话时列出已失效的会话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the extension showing Remote Control as connected after the connection failed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复连接失败后，扩展仍显示 Remote Control 已连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed a session resume silently reconnecting Remote Control after the user turned it off (`--resume`, SDK hosts, and the VS Code extension)
entries.zh: 修复了用户关闭远程控制后以静默方式重新连接远程控制的会话恢复（`--resume`、SDK 主机和 VS Code 扩展）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed sessions not honoring `remoteControlAtStartup` when explicitly enabled
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复明确开启 `remoteControlAtStartup` 后，会话未遵循该设置的问题

entries.en: Added owner wildcard entries (`"owner/*"`) to the `strictKnownMarketplaces` and `blockedMarketplaces` managed settings for allowing or blocking all marketplace repos under a GitHub org
entries.zh: 将所有者通配符条目（“owner/*”）添加到`strictKnownMarketplaces`和`blockedMarketplaces`托管设置中，以允许或阻止 GitHub 组织下的所有市场存储库

entries.en: Added a warning when workflow agents, forked skills, slash commands, or resumed background agents' requested subagent model is restricted and the parent model runs instead
entries.zh: 添加了当工作流代理、分叉技能、斜线命令或恢复的后台代理请求的子代理模型受到限制而运行父模型时的警告

entries.en: Added a `/teleport` hint in cloud sessions showing how to continue locally with `claude --teleport <session id>`
entries.zh: 在云会话中添加了`/teleport`提示，显示如何使用`claude --teleport <session id>`在本地继续

entries.en: Fixed a Bash permission bypass where a crafted command could hide parts of itself from permission checks
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限绕过问题，其中精心设计的命令可能会隐藏其部分内容以防止权限检查

entries.en: Fixed permission prompts so commands padded with tabs or invisible Unicode can no longer hide part of the command from the approval dialog
entries.zh: 修复了权限提示，因此用选项卡或不可见 Unicode 填充的命令无法再在批准对话框中隐藏部分命令

entries.en: Fixed workflow scripts being able to use dynamic `import()` to run code outside the workflow sandbox
entries.zh: 修复工作流脚本可以使用动态 `import()` 在工作流沙盒之外运行代码的问题

entries.en: Fixed a permission gap where an agent definition's `bypassPermissions` mode ignored the org bypass-permissions disable policy
entries.zh: 修复了代理定义的`bypassPermissions`模式忽略组织旁路权限禁用策略的权限差距

entries.en: Fixed resuming a session after a mid-session `/cd` coming back empty
entries.zh: 修复了会话中`/cd`返回空后恢复会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed gateway model discovery hiding Claude models registered under provider-prefixed IDs such as `vertex_ai/claude-*` or `bedrock/anthropic.claude-*`
entries.zh: 修复了网关模型发现隐藏在提供商前缀 ID（例如`vertex_ai/claude-*`或`bedrock/anthropic.claude-*`）下注册的 Claude 模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed `modelOverrides` keys that aren't Anthropic model IDs being treated as the session's canonical model ID; unknown keys are now ignored as documented
entries.zh: 修复了非 Anthropic 模型 ID 的`modelOverrides`键被视为会话的规范模型 ID 的问题；正如记录的那样，未知的键现在被忽略

entries.en: Fixed managed settings: server-delivered settings no longer disable the env block of a machine-local `managed-settings.json` or MDM profile; admin env now merges per key
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置：服务器提供的设置不再禁用计算机本地`managed-settings.json`或 MDM 配置文件的 env 块；管理环境现在按键合并

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when `sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite` covers the working directory
entries.zh: 修复了当`sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite`覆盖工作目录时沙盒命令无法在 Linux 上启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed forked background agents getting stuck "already resuming" for the rest of the session when rebuilding the fork's parent prompt failed during resume
entries.zh: 修复了在恢复期间重建分叉的父提示失败时，分叉的后台代理在会话的其余部分中陷入“已恢复”状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed a resumed session failing every turn, or leaving the interactive app on an unresponsive error screen, when its history held a malformed diagnostics attachment
entries.zh: 修复了当其历史记录包含格式错误的诊断附件时，恢复的会话每次都会失败，或者使交互式应用程序处于无响应的错误屏幕上的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare hang when parsing unusual `git push` output
entries.zh: 修复了解析异常“git Push”输出时罕见的挂起问题

entries.en: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` to hold every Claude model with a native 1M window to 200K via auto-compaction, not just a fixed list; a startup warning now appears when auto-compaction isn't holding the session to 200K
entries.zh: 更改了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT`，以通过自动压缩将具有本机 1M 窗口的每个 Claude 模型保存到 200K，而不仅仅是固定列表；当自动压缩未将会话保持在 200K 时，现在会出现启动警告

entries.en: Changed auto-compact to keep sessions on unrecognized model IDs within the assumed context window instead of letting them grow past it; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT=1` to restore the previous behavior
entries.zh: 更改了自动压缩，以将无法识别的模型 ID 上的会话保留在假定的上下文窗口内，而不是让它们增长超过它；设置“CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCMENT=1”以恢复之前的行为

entries.en: Changed `/review` to be an alias of `/code-review`, which reviews the current diff or a PR (`/code-review <level> <pr#>`); use `/code-review ultra` for a deep cloud review
entries.zh: 将 `/review` 更改为 `/code-review` 的别名，用于审查当前差异或 PR (`/code-review <level> <pr#>`)；使用`/code-review ultra`进行深度云审查

entries.en: Changed `/code-review` with no effort level to reuse the level you typed last; type a level like `/code-review high` to change it
entries.zh: 更改了`/code-review`，无需费力即可重用您上次输入的级别；输入`/code-review high`之类的级别来更改它

entries.en: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions and their subagents being able to run destructive git commands against the main checkout; isolation now applies to file edits and Bash in every session type
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离的会话及其子智能体可以对主检出目录运行破坏性 git 命令的问题；隔离现在适用于所有会话类型的文件编辑和 Bash

entries.en: Fixed PreToolUse auto-allow hooks bypassing tool restrictions in background agent tasks (summaries, compaction, renames)
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse 自动允许钩子绕过后台代理任务中的工具限制（摘要、压缩、重命名）

entries.en: Fixed `/usage-credits` on Team and Enterprise showing "you've already sent a usage credit request" for members whose earlier request was dismissed, blocking them from sending a new one
entries.zh: 修复了团队和企业上的`/usage-credits`，对于先前请求被驳回的成员显示“您已经发送了使用积分请求”，阻止他们发送新的请求

entries.en: Fixed the startup connectivity check hanging and then failing behind an HTTPS proxy; it now uses the same proxy-aware transport as API requests and times out with a clear message
entries.zh: 修复启动时的连通性检查在 HTTPS 代理后挂起然后失败的问题；现在它使用与 API 请求相同的代理感知传输，并会以清晰的消息超时

entries.en: Fixed "Connection closed mid-response" errors being reported on responses that had actually completed
entries.zh: 修复了实际完成的响应中报告的“连接在响应中关闭”错误

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` overattributing usage to MCP servers: a server's share now reflects only the requests that actually consumed its tool results, instead of every turn after any call to it
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`将使用过度归因于 MCP 服务器的问题：服务器的共享现在仅反映实际消耗其工具结果的请求，而不是调用它后的每个回合

entries.en: Fixed sessions not linking to pull requests created after the branch was pushed, including through the GitHub REST API
entries.zh: 修复了会话未链接到推送分支后创建的拉取请求的问题，包括通过 GitHub REST API

entries.en: Fixed org-restricted `model: opus`-style subagent and teammate family aliases dropping to the parent model instead of stepping down to the newest org-allowed model in the family
entries.zh: 修复了组织限制的“模型：opus”风格的子代理和队友家族别名下降到父模型，而不是下降到家族中最新的组织允许的模型

entries.en: Fixed stream idle timeout firing on custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways despite server keep-alive pings arriving on the wire
entries.zh: 修复了自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`网关上的流空闲超时触发，尽管服务器保持活动 ping 已到达网络

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai connectors being falsely marked as needing authorization when the session token is invalid — they now show a `/login` hint instead
entries.zh: 修复了当会话令牌无效时 claude.ai 连接器被错误地标记为需要授权的问题 — 它们现在显示`/login`提示

entries.en: Fixed tool errors not being displayed for tools no longer available locally, for example after an MCP server is removed
entries.zh: 修复对于本地已不可用的工具（例如 MCP 服务器被移除后），工具错误不显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `SendMessage` rejecting a long summary — it now truncates instead, so sends no longer fail on a character limit
entries.zh: 修复了`SendMessage`拒绝长摘要的问题 - 现在它会截断，因此发送不再因字符限制而失败

entries.en: Fixed the spinner's effort label in a subagent's transcript view showing the session's effort level instead of the subagent's own `effort:` setting
entries.zh: 修复子智能体转录视图中，旋转指示器的努力级别标签显示的是会话的努力级别，而非子智能体自身 `effort:` 设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed rare crashes when a file watcher hit a filesystem error or during file-watcher teardown
entries.zh: 修复了文件观察器遇到文件系统错误或文件观察器拆卸期间罕见的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed screen readers re-reading the whole input line on every backspace in `--ax-screen-reader` mode — end-of-line deletions now echo just the deleted characters
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器在`--ax-screen-reader`模式下在每个退格键上重新读取整个输入行的问题 - 行尾删除现在仅回显已删除的字符

entries.en: Fixed host model-selection keys not taking precedence over a stale on-disk `managed-settings.json` when `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST`时，主机模型选择键不优先于过时的磁盘上“management-settings.json”的问题

entries.en: Improved auto mode safety: messages sent to other agent sessions via `SendMessage` are now evaluated by the permission classifier before dispatch
entries.zh: 改进自动模式安全性：通过 `SendMessage` 发给其他代理会话的消息，发送前会先由权限分类器审查

entries.en: Improved the refusal when Claude tries to invoke a skill with `disable-model-invocation`: Claude is now told to ask you to run the skill instead of replicating its workflow
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 试图调用带 `disable-model-invocation` 的技能时的拒绝提示：现在会让 Claude 请你自己运行该技能，而不是复制它的工作流程

entries.en: Improved the `/diff` view, the Remote Control workspace diff, and file-edit diffs in Claude Code on the web sessions to use raw git blob content, ignoring workspace-configured diff drivers and textconv
entries.zh: 改进 `/diff` 视图、Remote Control 工作区差异，以及 Claude Code 网页版会话中的文件编辑差异：改用原始 git blob 内容，忽略工作区配置的 diff 驱动和 textconv

entries.en: Changed Remote Control auto-start so repo-local settings (`.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json`) can no longer turn it on (they can still turn it off); enable it at user scope via `/config`
entries.zh: 更改了远程控制自动启动，因此存储库本地设置（`.claude/settings.json` 或 `.claude/settings.local.json`）无法再打开它（他们仍然可以将其关闭）；通过 `/config` 在用户范围内启用它

entries.en: Removed ultraplan feature
entries.zh: 移除 ultraplan 功能

entries.en: [VSCode] Added Focus view: a chat-menu toggle that hides tool activity behind an expandable per-turn summary with a live running-tool indicator, toggled with `Ctrl+Alt+F` or the "Claude Code: Toggle Focus view" command
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增 Focus 视图：聊天菜单中的开关，把工具活动隐藏到每轮可展开的摘要中，并显示正在运行的工具指示器；可用 `Ctrl+Alt+F` 或「Claude Code: Toggle Focus view」命令切换

entries.en: Added `mode: "mask"` for sandbox credential files on Linux and WSL — sandboxed commands read a sentinel copy (the whole file, or just the spans captured by an `extract` regex) while the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value on egress; on macOS file masking falls back to `deny`
entries.zh: 为 Linux 和 WSL 上的沙箱凭证文件添加了“mode:“mask””——沙箱命令读取哨兵副本（整个文件，或只是`extract`正则表达式捕获的跨度），而沙箱代理替换出口上的实际值；在 macOS 上，文件屏蔽会退回到“拒绝”

entries.en: Added warnings to `claude plugin validate` when a marketplace or plugin name would be rejected by Claude Desktop's managed marketplace sync
entries.zh: 当 Claude Desktop 的托管市场同步拒绝市场或插件名称时，向“claude 插件验证”添加了警告

entries.en: Added a `prompt-audit` subcommand to the `claude-api` skill for auditing prompts and tool descriptions for patterns written for older models
entries.zh: 在`claude-api`技能中添加了`prompt-audit`子命令，用于审核为旧模型编写的模式的提示和工具描述

entries.en: Fixed a Bash tool permission-check bypass where zsh could execute hidden commands in `[[ ]]` regex conditionals; affected commands now prompt for permission
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具权限检查绕过，其中 zsh 可以执行`[[ ]]`正则表达式条件中的隐藏命令；受影响的命令现在提示权限

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell permission checks mishandling paths containing quote characters on Windows; such paths now prompt for approval
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上 PowerShell 权限检查错误处理包含引号字符的路径；此类路径现在提示批准

entries.en: Fixed the thinking toggle having no effect for the rest of a session that started with thinking off; disabling an MCP server mid-connect no longer silently reverts
entries.zh: 修复会话以关闭思考模式开始后，思考开关在本会话中无效的问题；另外，在 MCP 服务器连接过程中将其禁用，不再静默回退

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers from `--mcp-config` not being connected before the first turn in print mode (`-p`), which made the model emit tool calls as literal text
entries.zh: 修复了`--mcp-config`中的 MCP 服务器在第一次进入打印模式（`-p`）之前未连接的问题，这使得模型以文字文本形式发出工具调用

entries.en: Fixed @-mentioned files being silently dropped when pressing Esc to retract a prompt and resubmitting it
entries.zh: 修复了按 Esc 键撤回提示并重新提交时@提到的文件被默默删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash when preparing API requests for SDK MCP tools named after built-in object properties such as `constructor`
entries.zh: 修复了为以内置对象属性（例如“构造函数”）命名的 SDK MCP 工具准备 API 请求时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed WebSearch failing with a 400 error at effort `xhigh`/`max` when thinking is disabled
entries.zh: 修复了禁用思考时`xhigh`/`max`时 WebSearch 失败并出现 400 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed large uploads failing with TLS errors through the sandbox proxy
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒大型上传通过沙盒代理失败并出现 TLS 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed Team and Enterprise spend-limit message incorrectly blaming the org's monthly limit instead of your individual spend limit
entries.zh: 修复了团队和企业支出限制消息错误地将组织的每月限额归咎于您的个人支出限额的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock authentication with AWS SSO named profiles failing in desktop-managed sessions on Windows machines that set a stray `HOME` environment variable
entries.zh: 修复了在设置了杂散`HOME`环境变量的 Windows 计算机上的桌面管理会话中使用 AWS SSO 命名配置文件进行的 Bedrock 身份验证失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN=0` not disabling interrupted-turn auto-resume; falsy values are now honored
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN=0`不禁用中断转弯自动恢复的问题；错误的价值观现在受到尊重

entries.en: Fixed a rare wake-from-sleep race where two Claude Code processes could both refresh the same MCP connector or WIF OAuth token at once, forcing re-authentication
entries.zh: 修复了罕见的睡眠唤醒竞赛，其中两个 Claude Code 进程都可以同时刷新相同的 MCP 连接器或 WIF OAuth 令牌，从而强制重新进行身份验证

entries.en: Fixed renaming a session from Claude Code Desktop or claude.ai not updating the CLI's session name; session names from every rename surface are now sanitized
entries.zh: 修复了从 Claude Code Desktop 或 claude.ai 重命名会话而不更新 CLI 会话名称的问题；每个重命名表面的会话名称现在都已清理

entries.en: Fixed plugin- and org-delivered skills named after terminal-only built-ins (e.g. `/help`, `/feedback`) being un-invocable in non-interactive sessions
entries.zh: 修复了以仅终端内置程序命名的插件和组织提供的技能（例如`/help`、`/feedback`）在非交互式会话中不可调用的问题

entries.en: Fixed the "Plugins changed" notification lingering after plugins were reloaded instead of clearing
entries.zh: 修复了重新加载插件而不是清除后“插件已更改”通知挥之不去的问题

entries.en: Fixed Vim mode: the yank register now survives dialogs, history search, and the transcript view instead of being silently emptied
entries.zh: 修复了 Vim 模式：复制寄存器现在可以在对话框、历史搜索和记录视图中保留下来，而不是默默地清空

entries.en: Fixed Vim mode: undoing back to an empty prompt now arms the "press ← again" confirm before returning to the agent view
entries.zh: 修复了 Vim 模式：撤消回到空提示，现在在返回代理视图之前启用“再次按 ←”确认

entries.en: Improved tool search on Google Vertex AI: re-enabled for Claude 4.5-generation and newer models
entries.zh: 改进 Google Vertex AI 上的工具搜索：已为 Claude 4.5 及更新的模型重新启用

entries.en: Improved auto mode: permission checks for parallel tool calls are now cache-efficient, and switching modes while a check is pending reliably prompts instead of applying the stale result
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：并行工具调用的权限检查更节省缓存；检查等待期间切换模式，会可靠地弹出提示，而不是套用过期的结果

entries.en: Reduced prompt-cache costs for auto-mode permission checks by reusing the cached conversation prefix across decisions
entries.zh: 自动模式的权限检查复用缓存的对话前缀，提示词缓存成本降低

entries.en: Improved Stats panel to count cache tokens in its token totals, with a breakdown by input, output, cache read, and cache write
entries.zh: 改进统计面板：token 总数计入缓存 token，并按输入、输出、缓存读取、缓存写入分项显示

entries.en: Improved `/ultrareview` error messages when a repo shares no history with its base: a checkout with no branches is now refused up front with advice to create one, and refusal hints no longer suggest `git fetch --unshallow` on clones that are already complete
entries.zh: 改进仓库与基准分支没有共同历史时 `/ultrareview` 的错误提示：没有分支的检出会被提前拒绝，并建议新建分支；对已经是完整克隆的仓库，不再建议执行 `git fetch --unshallow`

entries.en: Improved Windows startup: process creation times are now read via a native kernel32 call instead of spawning PowerShell, so endpoint security tools that gate `powershell.exe` no longer prompt
entries.zh: 改进 Windows 启动：进程创建时间改用原生 kernel32 调用读取，不再启动 PowerShell，因此拦截 `powershell.exe` 的终端安全工具不会再弹窗

entries.en: Changed background sessions to commit and push to preserve work, open a draft PR only when the task calls for one, follow your CLAUDE.md git instructions, and always end by reporting where the work lives
entries.zh: 更改了后台会话以提交并推送以保留工作，仅在任务需要时打开草稿 PR，遵循 CLAUDE.md git 说明，并始终以报告工作所在位置结束

entries.en: Changed `/plugin install` to refresh a stale marketplace catalog and retry before reporting a plugin not found
entries.zh: 更改了`/plugin install`以刷新过时的市场目录并在报告找不到插件之前重试

entries.en: Changed plugins installed from `/plugin` to activate immediately when safe, instead of always requiring `/reload-plugins`
entries.zh: 更改了从`/plugin`安装的插件，以在安全时立即激活，而不是总是需要`/reload-plugins`

entries.en: Changed plugins to accept `"."` as a `skills` path, and the root-level `SKILL.md` validation error now suggests using the plugin root
entries.zh: 更改插件以接受“.”作为“技能”路径，并且根级别`SKILL.md`验证错误现在建议使用插件根

entries.en: Changed `/status` to show the session kind: `interactive`, or a background job that is `attached` or `unattended`
entries.zh: 更改了`/status`以显示会话类型：“交互式”，或“附加”或“无人值守”的后台作业

entries.en: Changed emoji autocomplete to accept common alternate shortcodes like `:thumbsup:`, `:thumbsdown:`, and `:love:`
entries.zh: 更改了表情符号自动完成以接受常见的替代短代码，例如`:thumbsup:`、`:thumbsdown:`和`:love:`

entries.en: Changed sessions forked with `/fork` to create a new worktree of their own instead of working in the original session's checkout
entries.zh: 更改了使用`/fork`分叉的会话，以创建自己的新工作树，而不是在原始会话的结账中工作

entries.en: Changed Claude in Chrome to close the browser tabs it opens once it no longer needs them
entries.zh: 更改了 Chrome 中的 Claude，以便在不再需要时关闭它打开的浏览器选项卡

entries.en: Changed fast mode to report on the stream when usage credits run out mid-session, instead of failing silently
entries.zh: 更改了快速模式，以便在使用积分在会话中用完时报告流，而不是静默失败

entries.en: Changed Monitor: a watch that exits without producing any output now says so instead of reporting "stream ended"
entries.zh: 更改了监视器：退出时不产生任何输出的手表现在会这样说，而不是报告“流结束”

entries.en: Changed the Gateway `model` field validation: non-string values are rejected with a 400 instead of being forwarded
entries.zh: 更改了网关`model`字段验证：非字符串值将被拒绝并返回 400，而不是被转发

entries.en: Removed the repeated "Permission mode changed while the auto-mode classifier call was queued" notice from approval prompts
entries.zh: 移除权限提示中反复出现的 "Permission mode changed while the auto-mode classifier call was queued" 通知

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added Claude Opus 5 (`claude-opus-5`), now the default Opus model — 1M context, fast mode at $10/$50 per Mtok
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Opus 5 (`claude-opus-5`)，现在是默认 Opus 模型 — 1M 上下文，快速模式，每个 Mtok 10/50 美元

entries.en: Added `sandbox.network.strictAllowlist` setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.network.strictAllowlist`设置，以拒绝非白名单主机执行沙盒命令而不提示

entries.en: Added `DirectoryAdded` hook that fires after `/add-dir` or the SDK `register_repo_root` control request registers a new working directory mid-session
entries.zh: 添加了`DirectoryAdded`挂钩，该挂钩在`/add-dir`或 SDK`register_repo_root`控制请求在会话中注册新工作目录后触发

entries.en: Added `mcp_server_errors` to the headless stream-json init event, listing `--mcp-config` entries skipped by config validation; terminal runs print a startup warning
entries.zh: 将 `mcp_server_errors` 添加到 headless stream-json init 事件中，列出配置验证跳过的 `--mcp-config` 条目；终端运行打印启动警告

entries.en: Added the `workflowSizeGuideline` settings key so the advisory Dynamic workflow size guideline can be set from any settings file; the `/config` row is hidden while one does
entries.zh: 添加了`workflowSizeGuideline`设置键，以便可以从任何设置文件设置咨询动态工作流程大小指南； `/config` 行被隐藏，而另一行则被隐藏

entries.en: Added nested subagent forwarding in stream-json: subagents spawned at depth-2+ now appear when `--forward-subagent-text` is set, keyed by their spawning Agent `tool_use` id
entries.zh: 在stream-json中添加了嵌套子代理转发：当设置`--forward-subagent-text`时，现在会出现在深度2+处生成的子代理，并通过其生成代理`tool_use`id进行键入

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` text output dropping the answer already produced when a turn dies on a mid-stream API error
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`文本输出，当回合因中流 API 错误而终止时，会丢弃已生成的答案

entries.en: Added HTTP status and error text to `claude mcp list` and `/mcp` when a server fails to connect, and a warning for MCP config values with hidden leading or trailing whitespace
entries.zh: 当服务器无法连接时，将 HTTP 状态和错误文本添加到`claude mcp list`和`/mcp`，并对带有隐藏前导或尾随空格的 MCP 配置值发出警告

entries.en: Fixed the Fable model row showing "Requires usage credits" for plans that include it, when a stale cache had baked the label in
entries.zh: 修复当套餐包含 Fable 模型，但陈旧缓存留有旧标签时，Fable 模型行仍显示"需要使用额度"的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker showing the merged Opus row as plain "Opus" instead of "Opus (1M context)"
entries.zh: 修复 `/model` 选择器中合并后的 Opus 行显示为"Opus"而非"Opus (1M context)"的问题

entries.en: Fixed copy-on-select inside GNU screen printing base64 into the terminal instead of copying the selection
entries.zh: 修复了 GNU 丝网打印 base64 内的选择复制到终端而不是复制选择的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control clients keeping a stale fast-mode status after a model switch, reconnect, or failed org check
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制客户端在模型切换、重新连接或组织检查失败后保持过时的快速模式状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` on Windows exiting or being used as bash when the path isn't a bash/sh binary; it's now ignored with a warning
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的`CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH`，当路径不是 bash/sh 二进制文件时退出或用作 bash；现在它被忽略并带有警告

entries.en: Fixed Vim mode: pressing ← on an empty prompt now returns to the agent view from NORMAL mode, not just INSERT
entries.zh: 修复了 Vim 模式：在空提示符下按 ← 现在可以从 NORMAL 模式返回到代理视图，而不仅仅是 INSERT

entries.en: Fixed screen-reader mode rewriting the entire input line on every keystroke instead of echoing only the typed character
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式在每次击键时重写整个输入行，而不是仅回显键入的字符

entries.en: Improved the "Remote Control is only available via api.anthropic.com" error to name the specific setting that caused it
entries.zh: 改进「Remote Control 只能通过 api.anthropic.com 使用」报错：会指出导致该问题的具体设置

entries.en: Improved `claude --teleport` to show which repo your current checkout points at when it doesn't match the session's repo
entries.zh: 改进 `claude --teleport`：当前检出目录指向的仓库与会话所在仓库不一致时，会显示该仓库的信息

entries.en: Changed dynamic workflows to default to a medium size guideline (aim for fewer than 15 agents); pick another size or unrestricted with Dynamic workflow size in `/config`
entries.zh: 将动态工作流程更改为默认中等规模准则（目标是少于 15 个代理）；选择其他大小或不受`/config`中动态工作流程大小的限制

entries.en: Changed managed MCP allowlist/denylist `${VAR}` entries to resolve from the startup environment and managed-settings env instead of settings-file env
entries.zh: 更改了托管 MCP 允许列表/拒绝列表`${VAR}`条目，以从启动环境和托管设置环境（而不是设置文件环境）解析

entries.en: Changed the `/model` picker to highlight only the newest model's name, so the highlight marks the new release rather than an arbitrary subset of the list
entries.zh: 更改了`/model`选择器以仅突出显示最新型号的名称，因此突出显示标记新版本而不是列表的任意子集

entries.en: Added the current default workflow size to the running-workflow status line, with a pointer to `/config` for changing it
entries.zh: 将当前默认工作流程大小添加到正在运行的工作流程状态行，并使用指向`/config`的指针来更改它

entries.en: Removed Opus 4.7 from fast mode; `/fast` now applies to Opus 5 and Opus 4.8
entries.zh: Opus 4.7 已从快速模式中移除；`/fast` 现在适用于 Opus 5 和 Opus 4.8

entries.en: Updated the claude-api skill to default to Claude Opus 5, with a migration path from Opus 4.8
entries.zh: `claude-api` 技能默认改为 Claude Opus 5，并提供从 Opus 4.8 迁移的路径

entries.en: Subagents can now spawn nested subagents up to depth 3 by default (was 1); set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1 to disable nesting
entries.zh: 子代理现在默认可以嵌套生成子代理，深度最多为 3（原为 1）；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1` 可关闭嵌套

entries.en: Changed `/code-review` to run as a background subagent, so review work no longer fills your conversation and keeps stacked slash commands as its review target
entries.zh: 将`/code-review`更改为作为后台子代理运行，因此审核工作不再填满您的对话，并将堆叠的斜杠命令保留为审核目标

entries.en: Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text for word and line deletions (`Option+Delete`, `Ctrl+W`, `Cmd+Backspace`, `Ctrl+U`, `Ctrl+K`) in `--ax-screen-reader` mode
entries.zh: 在`--ax-screen-reader`模式下添加了针对单词和行删除的已删除文本的屏幕阅读器公告（`Option+Delete`、`Ctrl+W`、`Cmd+Backspace`、`Ctrl+U`、`Ctrl+K`）

entries.en: Fixed Windows paths with `\u`-prefixed segments (like `C:\Users\unicorn`) being corrupted into CJK characters in tool inputs, which made those files inaccessible
entries.zh: 修复了带有`\u`前缀段的 Windows 路径（例如`C:\Users\unicorn`）在工具输入中被损坏为 CJK 字符，从而导致这些文件无法访问

entries.en: Fixed the left arrow key discarding the conversation with no undo: presses right after editing now ask to confirm, and Esc in the agent view returns to the conversation it backgrounded
entries.zh: 修复左方向键会在没有撤销的情况下丢弃对话的问题：编辑后按右方向键现在会要求确认，智能体视图中按 Esc 会返回其切到后台的对话

entries.en: Fixed multi-line paste collapsing into one line with `j` in place of newlines in terminals that encode pasted newlines as Ctrl+J
entries.zh: 修复了多行粘贴折叠成一行，并用`j`代替终端中的换行符，将粘贴的换行符编码为 Ctrl+J

entries.en: Fixed `/context` reporting stale pre-compact token usage after compacting from the message picker
entries.zh: 修复了从消息选择器压缩后报告过时的预压缩令牌使用情况的`/context`

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` failing on descriptive arguments like "review my auth changes" — they now run a review of your current branch with the text applied as a note to the findings
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`在描述性参数（例如“查看我的身份验证更改”）上失败的问题 - 他们现在对您当前的分支进行审查，并将文本用作结果注释

entries.en: Fixed `/code-review ultra` silently running a local review in non-interactive sessions — it now launches the cloud review
entries.zh: 修复了`/code-review ultra`在非交互式会话中静默运行本地审核的问题 - 现在启动云审核

entries.en: Fixed gateway spend metering to price Bedrock application-inference-profile ARNs and other config-mapped upstream model IDs at the configured model's rates
entries.zh: 固定网关支出计量，以按配置模型的费率对 Bedrock 应用程序推理配置文件 ARN 和其他配置映射的上游模型 ID 进行定价

entries.en: Fixed mojibake when a long IDE selection was truncated mid-emoji, and a case where a tool executor error could be silently dropped
entries.zh: 修复了长 IDE 选择在表情符号中间被截断时的 mojibake，以及工具执行器错误可能会被静默删除的情况

entries.en: Fixed an engine teardown race that could start and abandon a phantom turn, and made input pushed after close consistently rejected
entries.zh: 修复了一个引擎拆卸竞赛，该竞赛可能会启动并放弃幻象转弯，并在关闭后持续拒绝输入

entries.en: Fixed spurious "[Request interrupted by user]" messages after interrupted tool calls, and an unpaired `tool_use` block left in the transcript when a tool aborted mid-response
entries.zh: 修复了中断工具调用后的虚假“[请求被用户中断]”消息，以及当工具在响应中中止时记录中留下不成对的`tool_use`块

entries.en: Fixed VoiceOver reading "new line" instead of echoing the typed space at the end of the input in `--ax-screen-reader` mode
entries.zh: 修复了 VoiceOver 读取“新行”的问题，而不是在`--ax-screen-reader`模式下回显输入末尾的键入空格

entries.en: Fixed plugin and settings panels not moving the terminal cursor to the focused row, so screen readers and magnifiers can follow arrow-key navigation
entries.zh: 修复了插件和设置面板未将终端光标移动到焦点行的问题，因此屏幕阅读器和放大器可以遵循箭头键导航

entries.en: Fixed crashes (maximum call stack exceeded) when a deeply nested watched directory tree was deleted or moved, and when rendering deeply nested UI trees
entries.zh: 修复了删除或移动深层嵌套的监视目录树以及渲染深层嵌套的 UI 树时发生的崩溃（超出最大调用堆栈）

entries.en: Fixed pull request events occasionally being lost when a session exited immediately after creating or linking a PR
entries.zh: 修复了创建或链接 PR 后会话立即退出时偶尔会丢失拉取请求事件的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Bedrock setup wizard failing profile verification for assume-role profiles in partitioned AWS regions and on proxy-only networks
entries.zh: 修复了 Bedrock 设置向导在分区 AWS 区域和仅代理网络上无法对假设角色配置文件进行配置文件验证的问题

entries.en: Fixed rare negative or incorrect turn duration measurements after a system clock adjustment by timing turns with a monotonic clock
entries.zh: 修复了通过使用单调时钟计时轮次进行系统时钟调整后罕见的负值或不正确的轮次持续时间测量

entries.en: Fixed the "N MCP servers need authentication" startup notice over-counting claude.ai connectors that aren't connected in claude.ai
entries.zh: 修复了“N MCP 服务器需要身份验证”启动通知过度计数 claude.ai 中未连接的 claude.ai 连接器

entries.en: Fixed prompt history entries being dropped or duplicated when history writes raced or failed
entries.zh: 修复了历史记录写入争用或失败时提示历史记录条目被删除或重复的问题

entries.en: Fixed a retry loop that re-sent identical doomed requests after a context-overflow error with a large thinking budget; `Ctrl+B` backgrounding now applies the same background-shell caps as other paths
entries.zh: 修复了一个重试循环，该循环会在上下文溢出错误后以大量思考预算重新发送相同的注定失败的请求； `Ctrl+B` 背景现在应用与其他路径相同的背景外壳上限

entries.en: Fixed agent frontmatter hooks running from untrusted folders: hooks now require the agent file's own folder to have accepted workspace trust
entries.zh: 修复了从不受信任的文件夹运行的代理 frontmatter 挂钩：挂钩现在要求代理文件自己的文件夹接受工作区信任

entries.en: Fixed fork-session lineage being lost after compaction in headless and SDK sessions
entries.zh: 修复了在无头会话和 SDK 会话中压缩后分叉会话沿袭丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a resumed session failing every turn, or crashing on resume, when its history held a malformed delta attachment
entries.zh: 修复了当其历史记录包含格式错误的增量附件时，恢复的会话每次都会失败或恢复时崩溃的问题

entries.en: Improved `/ultrareview` error feedback so Claude can correct an invalid argument instead of retrying it unchanged
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview` 的错误反馈：Claude 可以修正无效参数，而不是原样重试

entries.en: Improved auto mode: the dangerous-rm, background-`&`, and suspicious-Windows-path checks no longer open permission dialogs; the auto-mode classifier adjudicates them instead
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：危险 rm、后台 `&` 和可疑的 Windows 路径检查不再弹出权限对话框，改由自动模式分类器裁定

entries.en: Improved sandbox command restrictions for IDE interactions
entries.zh: 改进 IDE 交互时的沙盒命令限制

entries.en: Improved trust dialogs to name the repository root the grant covers
entries.zh: 改进信任对话框：会写出授权所覆盖的仓库根目录

entries.en: Changed `/deep-research` to start only when invoked manually; Claude no longer launches it on its own
entries.zh: 将 `/deep-research` 更改为仅在手动调用时启动；克劳德不再单独推出它

entries.en: Changed plan mode with auto to no longer prompt for Bash commands the static analyzer can't prove read-only; the auto-mode classifier judges them instead
entries.zh: 将计划模式更改为自动，不再提示输入静态分析器无法证明只读的 Bash 命令；自动模式分类器会判断它们

entries.en: Added an announcement when fast mode changes as a result of switching models via `/config model=<x>` or Remote Control
entries.zh: 添加了由于通过`/config model=<x>`或远程控制切换模型而导致快速模式更改时的公告

entries.en: Changed server-managed settings so benign feature and cost toggles no longer trigger the settings-approval prompt
entries.zh: 更改了服务器管理的设置，因此良性功能和成本切换不再触发设置批准提示

entries.en: Changed agent markdown files to reject agent names containing `:`, which is reserved for plugin namespacing
entries.zh: 更改了代理降价文件以拒绝包含`:`的代理名称，该名称是为插件命名空间保留的

entries.en: Changed skills with `context: fork` to run in the background by default; opt out per skill with `background: false`
entries.zh: 更改了 `context: fork` 的技能默认在后台运行；通过`background: false`选择退出每项技能

entries.en: Added `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`/`1`/`0` (case-insensitive) as accepted values for skill and plugin frontmatter booleans, alongside `true`/`false`
entries.zh: 添加了`yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`/`1`/`0`（不区分大小写）作为技能和插件 frontmatter 布尔值的可接受值，以及`true`/`false`

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions continuing to send heartbeats after their worker was replaced, which left long-lived desktop and IDE processes retrying a rejected request every few seconds forever
