entries.zh: 修复了远程会话在工作线程被替换后继续发送心跳的问题，这导致长期存在的桌面和 IDE 进程每隔几秒就永远重试被拒绝的请求

entries.en: Added emoji shortcode autocomplete in the prompt input: type `:heart:` to insert ❤️, or `:hea` for suggestions — disable with the `emojiCompletionEnabled` setting
entries.zh: 在提示输入中添加了表情符号短代码自动完成：输入 `:heart:` 插入 ❤️，或输入 `:hea` 获取建议 - 使用 `emojiCompletionEnabled` 设置禁用

entries.en: Added warnings when transcript writes are failing (e.g. disk full) or when session saving is off due to an inherited environment variable, instead of losing transcripts silently
entries.zh: 添加了当脚本写入失败（例如磁盘已满）或会话保存由于继承的环境变量而关闭时发出的警告，而不是默默地丢失脚本

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where truncated MCP tool outputs kept the full untruncated result in memory for the rest of the session
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，截断的 MCP 工具输出将完整的未截断结果保留在内存中以供会话的其余部分使用

entries.en: Fixed Windows auto-update failures that could leave `claude.exe` missing; failed updates now restore the preserved executable automatically
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 自动更新失败可能导致`claude.exe`丢失的问题；失败的更新现在自动恢复保留的可执行文件

entries.en: Fixed background session isolation not canonicalizing symlinked working directories, which could let sessions escape their workspace folder
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话隔离未规范化符号链接工作目录的问题，这可能会让会话逃脱其工作区文件夹

entries.en: Fixed auto-compact never triggering for Claude Opus 4.8 on Bedrock and `/compact` failing once over the limit
entries.zh: 修复了基岩上的 Claude Opus 4.8 永远不会触发自动压缩以及`/compact`一旦超过限制就会失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed corporate mTLS, TLS-verify, OAuth scope, and proxy settings being ignored in Claude Desktop sessions
entries.zh: 修复了在 Claude Desktop 会话中忽略的公司 mTLS、TLS 验证、OAuth 范围和代理设置

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode's startup announcement being cut off by the first prompt render, and the thinking status row re-rendering every few seconds to update elapsed time and token counts
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式的启动公告被第一次提示渲染中断的问题，并且思考状态行每隔几秒重新渲染一次以更新经过的时间和令牌计数

entries.en: Fixed managed settings that set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` not governing all signals — lower-scope signal-specific overrides no longer redirect telemetry away from the managed endpoint
entries.zh: 修复了将`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`设置为不管理所有信号的托管设置 - 较低范围的信号特定覆盖不再将遥测重定向到托管端点

entries.en: Fixed `--resume`/`--continue` and `/resume` failing with a TypeError when a transcript has a malformed attachment entry
entries.zh: 修复了当转录本具有格式错误的附件条目时，`--resume`/`--continue`和`/resume`因类型错误而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions not showing a pending permission prompt or dialog to viewers that connected after it appeared
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话不向出现后连接的查看者显示挂起的权限提示或对话框的问题

entries.en: Fixed background shells sometimes becoming impossible to stop after a session is sent to the background (`/background` or `←`) or when the session exits on a heavily loaded machine, most visible on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了后台 shell 有时在会话发送到后台（`/background` 或 `←`）后或会话在负载较重的计算机上退出时变得无法停止的问题，这在 Windows 上最为明显

entries.en: Fixed a `CLAUDE.md` or `SKILL.md` paths frontmatter value with many brace groups OOM-killing or stalling the CLI at startup — brace expansion is now budget-bounded
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE.md`或`SKILL.md`路径 frontmatter 值，其中许多大括号组导致 OOM 终止或在启动时停止 CLI — 大括号扩展现在受到预算限制

entries.en: Fixed the transcript preview sitting flush against the input area when attaching to a starting background session; it now leaves the same one-line gap as the live layout, so the transcript no longer shifts when the session takes over
entries.zh: 修复附加到正在启动的后台会话时，转录预览紧贴输入区的问题；现在它与实时布局保持相同的一行间距，会话接管时转录不再移位

entries.en: Improved footer PR badge links to be clickable hyperlinks even when terminal support can't be detected (e.g. over ssh/tmux); set `FORCE_HYPERLINK=0` to opt out
entries.zh: 改进页脚的 PR 徽标：即使终端无法识别，也能做成可点击的超链接（如通过 ssh/tmux）；设置 `FORCE_HYPERLINK=0` 可关闭

entries.en: Changed the login-expiry warning to appear 3 days before expiry instead of 5
entries.zh: 将登录到期警告更改为在到期前 3 天而不是 5 天出现

entries.en: Capped the frontend-design plugin suggestion tip at 3 lifetime impressions instead of repeating indefinitely
entries.zh: 将前端设计插件建议提示限制为 3 次终生印象，而不是无限期地重复

entries.en: Added a cap on concurrently-running subagents (default 20, override with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`) so one message can't fan out unbounded background agents
entries.zh: 添加了并发运行子代理的上限（默认为 20，用`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`覆盖），因此一条消息无法扇出无限制的后台代理

entries.en: Changed subagents to no longer spawn nested subagents by default; set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` to allow deeper nesting
entries.zh: 将子代理更改为默认情况下不再生成嵌套子代理；设置`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH`以允许更深层次的嵌套

entries.en: Fixed `--max-budget-usd` not stopping background subagents: once the cap is reached, new spawns are denied and running background agents are halted
entries.zh: 修复了`--max-budget-usd`不停止后台子代理的问题：一旦达到上限，新的生成将被拒绝，并且正在运行的后台代理将停止

entries.en: Added `sandbox.filesystem.disabled` setting to skip filesystem isolation while keeping network egress control
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.filesystem.disabled`设置以跳过文件系统隔离，同时保持网络出口控制

entries.en: Fixed a slowdown in long sessions where message normalization cost grew quadratically with the number of turns, causing multi-second stalls and slow resumes
entries.zh: 修复了长会话中的速度减慢问题，其中消息标准化成本随轮数呈二次方增长，导致多秒停顿和缓慢恢复

entries.en: Fixed auto mode denying commands with "HTTP 401" classifier errors after the OAuth token expired or rotated mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了 OAuth 令牌过期或在会话中轮换后自动模式拒绝带有“HTTP 401”分类器错误的命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion telling Claude to continue even when your answer asked it to wait or explain first — free-text answers now get neutral wording
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 告诉克劳德继续，即使你的答案要求它先等待或解释 - 自由文本答案现在得到中性措辞

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code on the web re-asking the same question and dropping your answer after the session sat idle for a few minutes
entries.zh: 修复了网络上的克劳德代码重新提出相同问题并在会话闲置几分钟后放弃答案的问题

entries.en: Fixed @-mentions silently attaching nothing after file-modifying hooks, vim dot-repeat of `c`-operators and paste, statusline running twice on resume, and resume-picker hangs on failure
entries.zh: 修复了@-提及在文件修改挂钩后无提示附加任何内容、vim 点重复`c`操作符和粘贴、状态行在恢复时运行两次以及恢复选择器在失败时挂起

entries.en: Fixed resumed background agent sessions reverting to the default agent: the agent's prompt and tool restrictions are now restored
entries.zh: 修复了恢复后台代理会话恢复为默认代理的问题：代理的提示和工具限制现已恢复

entries.en: Fixed worktree-isolated subagents redirecting git into the shared checkout via `git -C`, `--git-dir`, or `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE`
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离的子智能体通过 `git -C`、`--git-dir` 或 `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE` 把 git 重定向到共享检出目录的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree sessions landing in another project's leftover worktree when the working directory did not match the selected project
entries.zh: 修复工作目录与所选项目不匹配时，工作树会话会进入其他项目遗留的工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions whose worktree has no git repository being undeletable
entries.zh: 修复了工作树没有 git 存储库的后台会话不可删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude daemon stop --any` potentially terminating an unrelated process via a stale legacy daemon lockfile
entries.zh: 修复了`claude daemon stop --any`可能通过过时的遗留守护进程锁定文件终止不相关进程的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc-Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind picker in long-running sessions with background tasks
entries.zh: 修复了在带有后台任务的长时间运行会话中，空闲提示下的 Esc-Esc 未打开倒带选择器的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash command permission checking for compound statements with redirects inside `&&` lists or negations
entries.zh: 修复了对`&&`列表或否定内带有重定向的复合语句的 Bash 命令权限检查

entries.en: Fixed pressing Ctrl+X twice in the agent list failing to delete a session, and deleted sessions reappearing when their background worker had died
entries.zh: 修复了在代理列表中按 Ctrl+X 两次无法删除会话的问题，以及删除的会话在其后台工作人员死亡后重新出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed background subagents getting cancelled when a high-priority message arrives during their startup window
entries.zh: 修复了当高优先级消息在启动窗口期间到达时后台子代理被取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed mouse and focus garbage in the terminal while a GUI editor from `/memory`, `/plan`, `/keybindings`, or Ctrl+G is open; `/memory` no longer waits for the editor to close
entries.zh: 修复了当“/memory”、`/plan`、`/keybindings`或 Ctrl+G 打开 GUI 编辑器时终端中的鼠标和焦点垃圾； `/memory` 不再等待编辑器关闭

entries.en: Fixed Claude-in-Chrome 403-looping on reconnect when the session's OAuth token lacks a required scope
entries.zh: 修复了当会话的 OAuth 令牌缺少所需范围时重新连接时的 Claude-in-Chrome 403 循环

entries.en: Fixed workflow saves and scheduled-task writes following a symlink at `.claude`, which could redirect writes outside the project
entries.zh: 修复工作流保存和定时任务写入会跟随 `.claude` 处的符号链接，可能把写入重定向到项目之外的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP re-authenticate revoking working credentials before the new sign-in succeeds, and the reconnect needs-auth message in background sessions pointing at an unusable command
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 重新身份验证在新登录成功之前撤销工作凭据，以及后台会话中的重新连接需要身份验证消息指向不可用命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed read-only commands on Windows accessing network paths without a permission prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的只读命令在没有权限提示的情况下访问网络路径的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash command parsing of non-ASCII characters to match real shell word boundaries
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 命令解析非 ASCII 字符以匹配真实 shell 字边界的问题

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell tool permission validation of commands containing invisible Unicode characters
entries.zh: 修复了包含不可见 Unicode 字符的命令的 PowerShell 工具权限验证

entries.en: Fixed dialogs in fullscreen mode stretching past the right-hand edge of their panel
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下的对话框超出面板右侧边缘的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/config` settings list in fullscreen mode clipping its keyboard-hint footer
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下 `/config` 设置列表的键盘提示页脚被裁切的问题

entries.en: Fixed the transcript-mode (Ctrl+O) footer hint wrapping on terminals narrower than 104 columns
entries.zh: 修复终端宽度小于 104 列时，转录模式（Ctrl+O）页脚提示换行的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Prometheus metrics endpoint (`OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=prometheus`) emitting invalid `# UNIT` lines
entries.zh: 修复 Prometheus 指标端点（`OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=prometheus`）输出无效 `# UNIT` 行的问题

entries.en: Fixed skills and commands changed during a session not appearing in the slash menu until restart
entries.zh: 修复了会话期间更改的技能和命令在重新启动之前不会出现在斜线菜单中的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin skills with a `name` frontmatter field losing their plugin prefix in slash-command autocomplete
entries.zh: 修复了“名称”frontmatter 字段的插件技能在斜杠命令自动完成中丢失插件前缀的问题

entries.en: Fixed telemetry misreporting permission denials: failed permission-prompt requests no longer count as user rejections, and user interrupts are now reported as user aborts instead of rejections
entries.zh: 修复遥测对权限拒绝的误报：失败的权限提示请求不再计为用户拒绝，用户中断现在记为用户中止而非拒绝

entries.en: Improved the `/fork` confirmation to one line with the new session's name, `claude attach` id, and a note when the copy shares your checkout
entries.zh: 改进 `/fork` 确认信息：压缩为一行，显示新会话的名称、`claude attach` 的 ID；如果副本与你的工作目录共享，还会加一条说明

entries.en: Improved validation of `git` and `gh` command arguments in the PowerShell tool
entries.zh: 改进 PowerShell 工具中 `git` 和 `gh` 命令参数的校验

entries.en: Improved the `/ultrareview` diff-too-large error to show configured limits, measured diff size, and largest contributing files
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview` 的差异过大报错：会显示已配置的限制、实际测得的差异大小，以及贡献最大的文件

entries.en: Improved `/code-review ultra` empty-diff message to name the exact base ref and suggest passing an explicit base
entries.zh: 改进 `/code-review ultra` 的空差异提示：指明具体的基准分支，并建议显式传入基准分支

entries.en: Improved the spend limit adjustment prompt to show the server's reason when a spend limit change is rejected
entries.zh: 改进消费上限调整提示：服务器拒绝修改消费上限时，会显示服务器给出的原因

entries.en: `/context` now shows an explicit warning when the conversation exceeds the context window, and a failed `/compact` displays as an error
entries.zh: 当对话超过上下文窗口时，`/context` 现在会显示明确警告；`/compact` 失败时会以错误形式显示

entries.en: `/rewind` no longer restores or deletes files through symlinks or hard links at tracked paths and reports how many paths it skipped
entries.zh: `/rewind` 不再通过被追踪路径上的符号链接或硬链接恢复或删除文件，并会报告它跳过了多少路径

entries.en: Background sessions: `/mcp` and `/install-github-app` now park a "needs input" request in the agent view when no client is attached
entries.zh: 后台会话：当没有附加客户端时，`/mcp`和`/install-github-app`现在会在代理视图中放置“需要输入”请求

entries.en: Updated the bundled dataviz skill: reordered the default chart palette and fixed guidance that suggested direct labels for four-series charts
entries.zh: 内置 dataviz 技能：重新排列了默认图表配色，并修正了对四系列图表建议直接标注的错误指导

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed right-to-left text (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian) rendering in the wrong order when mixed with English or code
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复右到左文本（阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语）与英文或代码混排时顺序错乱的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions dropping the in-flight message when the session's container restarts mid-turn — the interrupted turn now re-runs on resume instead of leaving the session unresponsive
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在会话的容器在中途重新启动时丢弃运行中消息的问题 - 中断的轮次现在会在恢复时重新运行，而不是让会话无响应

entries.en: Claude no longer runs the `/verify` and `/code-review` skills on its own; invoke them with `/verify` or `/code-review` when you want them
entries.zh: 克劳德不再单独运行`/verify`和`/code-review`技能；当您需要它们时，使用`/verify`或`/code-review`调用它们

entries.en: Fixed single-segment `dir/**` allow rules like `Edit(src/**)` auto-approving writes to nested `dir/` directories anywhere in the tree instead of only `<cwd>/dir`
entries.zh: 修复了单段`dir/**`允许`Edit(src/**)`等规则自动批准写入树中任意位置的嵌套`dir/`目录，而不仅仅是`<cwd>/dir`

entries.en: Fixed a permission-check bypass affecting commands run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 sessions
entries.zh: 修复了影响 Windows PowerShell 5.1 会话中运行的命令的权限检查绕过

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks to fail closed on file-descriptor redirect forms that bash parses differently than the permission analyzer
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查在 bash 解析方式与权限分析器不同的文件描述符重定向表单上失败关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks misjudging very long commands — commands over 10,000 characters now always prompt instead of running automatically
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查错误判断很长命令的问题 — 超过 10,000 个字符的命令现在总是提示而不是自动运行

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks treating zsh variable subscripts and modifiers in `[[ ]]` comparisons as inert text — these commands now prompt for approval
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查，将 `[[ ]]` 比较中的 zsh 变量下标和修饰符视为惰性文本 - 这些命令现在提示批准

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission checks to no longer auto-approve certain `help` and `man` commands that could run unsafe options, command substitutions, or backslash paths
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查，不再自动批准某些可能运行不安全选项、命令替换或反斜杠路径的`help`和`man`命令

entries.en: Fixed permission prompts on remote sessions that could proceed before the local confirmation dialog
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话上可能在本地确认对话框之前进行的权限提示

entries.en: Added the EndConversation tool: Claude can end sessions with highly abusive users or jailbreak attempts, as on claude.ai since 2025 — see https://www.anthropic.com/research/end-subset-conversations
entries.zh: 添加了 EndConversation 工具：Claude 可以结束与高度滥用用户或越狱尝试的会话，就像自 2025 年以来在 claude.ai 上一样 - 请参阅 https://www.anthropic.com/research/end-subset-conversations

entries.en: Added a periodic progress heartbeat for long-running tool calls that previously went silent
entries.zh: 为之前处于静默状态的长时间运行的工具调用添加了定期进度心跳

entries.en: Added an ISO `modified` timestamp to memory file frontmatter
entries.zh: 向内存文件 frontmatter 添加了 ISO“修改”时间戳

entries.en: Added `message.uuid`, `client_request_id`, and `tool_source` attributes to OpenTelemetry log events for message-level correlation and tool provenance
entries.zh: 向 OpenTelemetry 日志事件添加了`message.uuid`、`client_request_id`和`tool_source`属性，以实现消息级关联和工具来源

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_CONTENT_MAX_LENGTH` to configure the 60 KB truncation limit on OpenTelemetry content attributes
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_CONTENT_MAX_LENGTH`以配置 OpenTelemetry 内容属性的 60 KB 截断限制

entries.en: Added reasoning effort to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so custom agent rows can render model and effort
entries.zh: 在`subagentStatusLine`有效负载中添加了推理工作，因此自定义代理行可以呈现模型和工作

entries.en: Added permission prompts for `docker` commands (including the Podman `docker` shim) carrying daemon-redirect flags (`--url`, `--connection`, `--identity`, and Podman's remote mode) that previously ran without one
entries.zh: 添加了对带有守护进程重定向标志（`--url`、`--connection`、`--identity` 和 Podman 的远程模式）的 `docker` 命令（包括 Podman `docker` shim）的权限提示，这些标志之前没有运行

entries.en: Fixed a crash when a GrowthBook feature evaluates to null, and a bug where a malformed flag payload could wipe the cached feature flags
entries.zh: 修复了 GrowthBook 功能评估为 null 时发生的崩溃，以及格式错误的标志负载可能会擦除缓存的功能标志的错误

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool killing the Claude session when a `pkill -f` pattern accidentally matched the CLI's own process (Linux)
entries.zh: 修复了当`pkill -f`模式意外匹配 CLI 自己的进程时 Bash 工具终止 Claude 会话的问题 (Linux)

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth when `--settings` points at a device file or multi-GB file; oversized (>2 MiB) settings files now fail at startup with a clear error
entries.zh: 修复 `--settings` 指向设备文件或数 GB 大文件时内存无限增长的问题；超过 2 MiB 的设置文件现在会在启动时报出清晰错误并失败

entries.en: Fixed streaming turns failing with "Socket is closed" behind corporate proxies on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的企业代理后面的流转失败并出现“套接字已关闭”的问题

entries.en: Fixed stream-json output truncation at exit for slow-reading SDK/pipeline consumers; the exit drain now scales with queued bytes instead of a flat 2s cap
entries.zh: 修复了读取缓慢的 SDK/管道消费者在退出时的 Stream-json 输出截断；出口消耗现在随排队字节而不是固定的 2 秒上限进行缩放

entries.en: Fixed scheduled tasks refusing their own configured prompt as untrusted input — the fired prompt is now delivered as the session's assigned task
entries.zh: 修复了计划任务拒绝将其自己配置的提示作为不受信任的输入的问题 - 触发的提示现在作为会话分配的任务进行传递

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell tool commands hanging until timeout when a child process waited on standard input (Windows)
entries.zh: 修复了子进程等待标准输入时 PowerShell 工具命令挂起直至超时的问题 (Windows)

entries.en: Fixed Python scripts under the PowerShell tool crashing with UnicodeDecodeError when reading non-UTF-8 data from standard input (Windows)
entries.zh: 修复了从标准输入 (Windows) 读取非 UTF-8 数据时 PowerShell 工具下的 Python 脚本因 UnicodeDecodeError 崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed Python scripts run via the PowerShell tool crashing with UnicodeEncodeError on non-ASCII output, and PowerShell 7 error messages containing raw ANSI escape sequences (Windows)
entries.zh: 修复了通过 PowerShell 工具运行的 Python 脚本在非 ASCII 输出上崩溃并出现 UnicodeEncodeError 的问题，以及包含原始 ANSI 转义序列的 PowerShell 7 错误消息 (Windows)

entries.en: Fixed the PowerShell tool reporting `where.exe`, `fc.exe`, and `diff.exe` as errors when they return a valid negative answer (Windows)
entries.zh: 修复 PowerShell 工具把 `where.exe`、`fc.exe` 和 `diff.exe` 的有效否定结果报告为错误的问题（Windows）

entries.en: Fixed `>` and `>>` under the PowerShell tool on Windows PowerShell 5.1 writing UTF-16LE files that other tools couldn't read as UTF-8
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上 PowerShell 工具下的`>`和`>>`写入其他工具无法读取为 UTF-8 的 UTF-16LE 文件

entries.en: Fixed a displaced background daemon deleting its successor's control socket on shutdown, which made the next client kill the healthy replacement daemon
entries.zh: 修复了一个移位的后台守护进程在关闭时删除其后继的控制套接字，这使得下一个客户端杀死健康的替换守护进程

entries.en: Fixed background sessions parked with `←` or `/background` and left idle keeping the background daemon and a worker process alive indefinitely
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话以`←`或`/background`停放并保持空闲状态，使后台守护进程和工作进程无限期地保持活动状态

entries.en: Fixed completed background sessions being impossible to remove via `claude rm` or the agent view once the background service had gone idle
entries.zh: 修复了后台服务闲置后无法通过`claude rm`或代理视图删除已完成的后台会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions dispatched from a non-git folder being impossible to delete from the agents view
entries.zh: 修复了从非 git 文件夹调度的后台会话无法从代理视图中删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed reopening a stopped background session failing to restore its saved conversation when an unreadable folder exists in the session store
entries.zh: 修复了当会话存储中存在不可读的文件夹时重新打开已停止的后台会话无法恢复其保存的对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Remote Control "session ready" push notification firing for sessions where Remote Control was not explicitly enabled
entries.zh: 修复未明确启用远程控制的会话也触发远程控制"会话就绪"推送通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` and the `/mcp` settings menu being blocked in agent-view sessions — they're now refused only in background sessions with no terminal attached
entries.zh: 修复了`/install-github-app`和`/mcp`设置菜单在代理视图会话中被阻止的问题 - 它们现在仅在没有附加终端的后台会话中被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed plugins enabled via the `--settings` CLI flag not loading (regression since v2.1.181)
entries.zh: 修复了通过 `--settings` CLI 标志启用的插件未加载（自 v2.1.181 以来的回归）

entries.en: Fixed feature flags going stale in long-running sessions after the OAuth token rotates
entries.zh: 修复了 OAuth 令牌轮换后长时间运行的会话中功能标志变得过时的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` refusing to run in repos with no merge base — it now offers to review all tracked files
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`拒绝在没有合并基础的存储库中运行的问题——它现在提供审查所有跟踪文件的功能

entries.en: Fixed `claude update` and `claude doctor` hanging silently, and the `/status` System diagnostics section going blank, when a shell-config path is a directory
entries.zh: 修复了当 shell 配置路径是目录时`claude update`和`claude doctor`静默挂起以及`/status`系统诊断部分变为空白的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory frontmatter values being silently truncated at an inline `#` when memory files are saved
entries.zh: 修复了保存内存文件时内存 frontmatter 值在内联`#`处被静默截断的问题

entries.en: Fixed session cost and token telemetry double-counting on streams that emit multiple cumulative `message_delta` frames
entries.zh: 修复了发出多个累积`message_delta`帧的流上的会话成本和令牌遥测重复计算问题

entries.en: Fixed a spurious "check your network" warning that appeared while the advisor was thinking
entries.zh: 修复了顾问思考时出现的虚假“检查网络”警告

entries.en: Fixed hooks with exit code 2 not blocking as documented when the hook's stdout JSON fails schema validation
entries.zh: 修复了退出代码 2 的钩子在钩子的 stdout JSON 架构验证失败时不会按照记录阻塞的问题

entries.en: Fixed OTel log events emitted outside the turn's async context missing the interaction span's trace context
entries.zh: 修复了在回合的异步上下文之外发出的 OTel 日志事件缺少交互范围的跟踪上下文的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP transient errors during prompts/resources refresh clearing the server's slash commands and resources
entries.zh: 修复了提示/资源刷新期间清除服务器的斜线命令和资源期间的 MCP 瞬时错误

entries.en: Improved the `claude rc` workspace-trust error in the home directory to say trust there is never saved and to suggest running from a project directory
entries.zh: 改进主目录中 `claude rc` 的工作区信任报错：说明在那里的信任永远不会被保存，并建议在项目目录中运行

entries.en: Changed single-segment `dir/**` hook `if:` conditions to match only `<cwd>/dir`; write `**/dir/**` for any-depth matching. `deny`/`ask` permission rules keep their any-depth match.
entries.zh: 更改了单段 `dir/**` 挂钩 `if:` 条件以仅匹配 `<cwd>/dir`；为任意深度匹配编写`**/dir/**`。 `deny`/`ask`权限规则保持其任意深度匹配。

entries.en: Changed `file` commands using `-m`/`--magic-file` or `-f`/`--files-from` to require permission instead of being auto-allowed as read-only
entries.zh: 使用`-m`/`--magic-file`或`-f`/`--files-from`更改了`file`命令以需要权限，而不是自动允许为只读

entries.en: Changed keep-alive connection pooling to disable after a stale-connection error, so retries open a fresh socket
entries.zh: 将保持活动连接池更改为在失效连接错误后禁用，因此重试打开新套接字

entries.en: Changed SessionStart hooks to report source `"fork"` when a session begins as a fork instead of `"resume"`
entries.zh: 更改了 SessionStart 挂钩，以在会话作为分叉而不是“恢复”开始时报告源“分叉”

entries.en: `/fork` now copies your conversation into a new background session (its own row in `claude agents`) while you keep working; the in-session subagent it used to launch is now `/subtask`
entries.zh: `/fork` 现在会把你的对话复制到一个新的后台会话中（在 `claude agents` 中有自己的一行），你可以继续工作；原先在会话内启动的子 agent 现在改用 `/subtask`

entries.en: Added `claude auto-mode reset` to restore the default auto-mode configuration, with a confirmation prompt (pass `--yes` to skip)
entries.zh: 添加 `claude auto-mode Reset` 以恢复默认自动模式配置，并带有确认提示（通过 `--yes` 跳过）

entries.en: Added a session-wide limit on WebSearch tool calls (default 200, tunable via `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION`) to stop runaway search loops
entries.zh: 添加了对 WebSearch 工具调用的会话范围限制（默认 200，可通过`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION`进行调整）以阻止失控的搜索循环

entries.en: Added a per-session cap on subagent spawns (default 200, override with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION`) to stop runaway delegation loops; `/clear` resets the budget
entries.zh: 添加了子代理生成的每会话上限（默认 200，用`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION`覆盖）以阻止失控的委托循环； `/clear` 重置预算

entries.en: MCP tool calls running longer than 2 minutes now move to the background automatically so the session stays usable; configure the threshold or disable with `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS`
entries.zh: 运行超过 2 分钟的 MCP 工具调用现在会自动转入后台，使会话保持可用；可通过 `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS` 设置阈值，或将其关闭

entries.en: Typing `/resume` in the agent view now opens a picker of past sessions — including sessions deleted from the list — and resumes your pick as a background session
entries.zh: 在代理视图中输入 `/resume`，会打开过去会话的选择器（包括已从列表中删除的会话），选中后以后台会话的形式恢复

entries.en: Fixed plan mode auto-running file-modifying Bash commands (e.g. `touch`, `rm`) without a permission prompt or SDK `canUseTool` callback
entries.zh: 修复了计划模式自动运行文件修改 Bash 命令（例如 `touch`、`rm`）而没有权限提示或 SDK `canUseTool` 回调的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree creation following a repository-committed symlink at `.claude/worktrees`, which could create files outside the repository
entries.zh: 修复工作树创建会跟随仓库中提交的 `.claude/worktrees` 符号链接，可能在仓库之外创建文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a `continue:false` hook's halt being dropped when the tool fails or completes mid-stream, and hook infrastructure errors being misreported as user rejections
entries.zh: 修复了当工具失败或中途完成时“继续：假”挂钩的停止被删除，以及挂钩基础设施错误被错误报告为用户拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed SIGTERM during a running Bash tool orphaning the command's process tree in print/SDK mode; the CLI now aborts the turn, kills the tree, and exits 143
entries.zh: 修复了在打印/SDK 模式下运行 Bash 工具期间孤立命令的进程树期间的 SIGTERM； CLI 现在中止转弯，杀死树，并退出 143

entries.en: Fixed `/background` and `claude --bg` failing with "EUNKNOWN: unknown error, uv_spawn" on Windows when Group Policy blocks PowerShell 5.1; the daemon now prefers PowerShell 7
entries.zh: 修复了当组策略阻止 PowerShell 5.1 时 Windows 上`/background`和`claude --bg`失败并显示“EUNKNOWN：未知错误，uv_spawn”的问题；守护进程现在更喜欢 PowerShell 7

entries.en: Fixed shell mode (`!`) not executing commands containing file paths while the path autocomplete popup was open
entries.zh: 修复了当路径自动完成弹出窗口打开时 shell 模式 (`!`) 不执行包含文件路径的命令

entries.en: Fixed auto-mode denial notifications rendering broken characters when a long denial reason was truncated mid-emoji
entries.zh: 修复了当表情符号中长拒绝原因被截断时，自动模式拒绝通知会呈现损坏的字符

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+J not inserting a newline in the agent view dispatch input on terminals with extended key reporting, and surfaced the newline shortcut in the `?` help overlay
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+J 未在具有扩展键报告的终端上的代理视图调度输入中插入换行符的问题，并在`?`帮助叠加层中显示换行符快捷方式

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` rejecting PR references like `#123`, `PR 123`, and pasted PR URLs; error hints now name the command you actually typed
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`拒绝 PR 引用（例如`#123`、`PR 123`和粘贴的 PR URL）的问题；错误提示现在命名您实际输入的命令

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview <branch>` not fetching the branch from origin when it exists remotely; it now suggests the closest branch name on typos
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview <branch>`在远程存在时不从原点获取分支的问题；现在它会建议拼写错误时最接近的分支名称

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` skipping the billing confirmation in a new conversation after `/clear`
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`在`/clear`之后在新对话中跳过账单确认的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview`'s "not a git repository" error on Claude Desktop now suggesting the project's repository folder instead of terminal commands
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Desktop 上`/ultrareview`的“不是 git 存储库”错误，现在建议使用项目的存储库文件夹而不是终端命令

entries.en: Fixed hosted (host-managed) sessions failing at startup when repository settings configured mTLS certs, extra CA bundles, or OAuth scopes; these transport settings are now ignored with a warning
entries.zh: 修复了当存储库设置配置 mTLS 证书、额外 CA 捆绑包或 OAuth 范围时托管（主机管理）会话在启动时失败的问题；现在将忽略这些传输设置并显示警告

entries.en: Fixed a spurious "File has not been read yet" error when editing a file that had been read with offset/limit before resuming a session
entries.zh: 修复了在恢复会话之前编辑已使用偏移/限制读取的文件时出现的虚假“文件尚未读取”错误

entries.en: Fixed `ExitWorktree` failing with "no active EnterWorktree session" after resuming a session with `--continue`/`--resume` in print/SDK mode
entries.zh: 修复了在打印/SDK 模式下使用`--continue`/`--resume`恢复会话后`ExitWorktree`失败并显示“没有活动的 EnterWorktree 会话”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the workflow agent grid staying empty for Remote Control clients that join a session mid-run
entries.zh: 修复运行中途加入会话的 Remote Control 客户端，工作流智能体网格一直为空的问题

entries.en: Fixed streaming-mode control requests being marked complete before their handler finished, which could lose the request on session restart
entries.zh: 修复了流模式控制请求在其处理程序完成之前被标记为完成的问题，这可能会在会话重新启动时丢失请求

entries.en: Fixed background sessions created with `/fork` losing their live-parent protection after a state write failure
entries.zh: 修复了使用`/fork`创建的后台会话在状态写入失败后失去其实时父保护的问题

entries.en: Fixed reopening a stopped background session from the agent view failing silently — it now resumes the session, or shows why it can't and lets you force a restart
entries.zh: 修复了从代理视图重新打开停止的后台会话失败的问题 - 现在它可以恢复会话，或者显示为什么不能恢复并让您强制重新启动

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: a stopping teammate could send the leader duplicate idle notifications when team initialization re-ran within a session
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：当团队初始化在会话中重新运行时，停止的队友可能会向领导者发送重复的空闲通知

entries.en: Fixed the plan-approval dialog footer splitting "ctrl+g to edit in <editor>" apart when the file path is long
entries.zh: 修复文件路径很长时，计划审批对话框底部的"ctrl+g 在 <编辑器> 中编辑"被拆开的问题

entries.en: Fixed the welcome banner keeping its old panel widths after a combined width+height terminal resize in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下同时改变终端宽度和高度后，欢迎横幅仍保留旧面板宽度的问题

entries.en: Fixed diff previews losing their line numbers and +/- markers in narrow layouts
entries.zh: 修复了差异预览在狭窄布局中丢失行号和 +/- 标记的问题

entries.en: Fixed @-mentions attaching nothing after a partial file read, plugin uninstall targeting the wrong marketplace, and false "Command timed out" on exit code 143
entries.zh: 修复了读取部分文件后不附加任何内容的 @-提及、针对错误市场的插件卸载以及退出代码 143 上的错误“命令超时”

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry HTTP exports being rejected with 411/400 by Azure Monitor and other endpoints that don't accept chunked transfer encoding
entries.zh: 修复了 OpenTelemetry HTTP 导出被 Azure Monitor 和其他不接受分块传输编码的终结点拒绝并显示 411/400 的问题

entries.en: Fixed OTLP event log records missing `trace_id`/`span_id` when `TRACEPARENT` is set in SDK/headless mode
entries.zh: 修复了在 SDK/headless 模式下设置 `TRACEPARENT` 时 OTLP 事件日志记录丢失 `trace_id`/`span_id` 的问题

entries.en: Fixed conversations with many images incorrectly failing with "Request too large" errors, and improved the error message to explain the actual cause
entries.zh: 修复了与许多图像的对话因“请求太大”错误而错误失败的问题，并改进了错误消息以解释实际原因

entries.en: Fixed web search and web fetch returning "API Error" text as search results or page content when the API was overloaded
entries.zh: 修复 API 过载时，网页搜索和网页抓取把"API Error"文字当作搜索结果或页面内容返回的问题

entries.en: Improved web search and web fetch reliability by retrying 529 errors and rate-limited requests with bounded backoff
entries.zh: 改进网页搜索和网页抓取的可靠性：遇到 529 错误和被限流的请求，会以有上限的退避方式重试

entries.en: Improved prompt caching: the mid-conversation system block now works behind LLM gateways and custom base URLs (Bedrock, Vertex, 1P)
entries.zh: 改进中途系统块的提示缓存：现在可在 LLM 网关和自定义 base URL（Bedrock、Vertex、一方接口）后正常工作

entries.en: Improved background agent attach: cold-attaching now instantly shows the formatted transcript while the session boots, instead of a blank wait
entries.zh: 改进后台 agent 连接：冷连接时立即显示格式化的对话记录，会话启动期间不再是空白等待

entries.en: Reduced token usage in inter-agent messaging: `SendMessage` bodies are no longer duplicated into replayed history and tool results
entries.zh: 减少代理间通信的 token 用量：`SendMessage` 的正文不再重复写入回放的历史和工具结果中

entries.en: Changed `/fork` to name the copy after your prompt when the session has no title, so the row is recognizable in the agent view
entries.zh: 当会话没有标题时，更改了`/fork`以在提示后命名副本，以便在代理视图中可以识别该行

entries.en: Changed bare `/btw` to reopen the side-question panel on your most recent exchange so you can browse earlier answers
entries.zh: 更改了裸露的`/btw`以重新打开最近交流中的附带问题面板，以便您可以浏览之前的答案

entries.en: Changed the `←` footer hint to pulse `N done` for a moment when a background agent finishes while nothing needs your input
entries.zh: 当后台代理完成而无需您输入任何内容时，将`←`页脚提示更改为“N 完成”一段时间

entries.en: Deprecated the Task tool's `mode` parameter (now ignored); subagents inherit the parent session's permission mode by default
entries.zh: 已弃用任务工具的`mode`参数（现已忽略）；子代理默认继承父会话的权限模式

entries.en: Changed Enterprise `forceLoginMethod` to be enforced for VS Code extension, SDK, `setup-token`, and `install-github-app` logins, not just the terminal
entries.zh: 更改了企业`forceLoginMethod`，以强制 VS Code 扩展、SDK、`setup-token`和`install-github-app`登录，而不仅仅是终端

entries.en: Changed session transcripts to record the reasoning effort level on each assistant message
entries.zh: 更改了会话记录以记录每条助理消息的推理工作水平

entries.en: Changed headless/SDK sessions to apply a `set_model` control request mid-turn; the next model round-trip uses the new model instead of waiting for the next turn
entries.zh: 更改了 headless/SDK 会话以在中途应用`set_model`控制请求；下一个模型往返使用新模型而不是等待下一个转弯

entries.en: Changed agent view / `claude agents --json`: sessions waiting on a sandbox, MCP-input, or managed-settings prompt now show as "Needs input" instead of "Working"
entries.zh: 更改了代理视图/`claude Agents --json`：等待沙箱、MCP 输入或托管设置提示的会话现在显示为“需要输入”而不是“正在工作”

entries.en: Updated the auth status panel title from "Cloud authentication" to "Authentication"
entries.zh: 设置中认证状态面板的标题从 "Cloud authentication" 改为 "Authentication"

entries.en: Corrected an earlier release note (2.1.200): tmux through the 3.6 series lacks synchronized output; newer tmux with support is detected automatically
entries.zh: 更正了早期的发行说明 (2.1.200)：3.6 系列中的 tmux 缺乏同步输出；自动检测支持的较新 tmux

entries.en: Added `--forward-subagent-text` flag and `CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT` environment variable to include subagent text and thinking in stream-json output
entries.zh: 添加了`--forward-subagent-text`标志和`CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT`环境变量，以包含子代理文本和stream-json输出中的思考

entries.en: Fixed permission previews relayed to chat channels not neutralizing bidirectional-override, zero-width, and look-alike quote characters, so tool inputs cannot visually alter the approval message
entries.zh: 修复了转发到聊天频道的权限预览，不会中和双向覆盖、零宽度和相似的引号字符，因此工具输入无法在视觉上改变批准消息

entries.en: Fixed auto mode overriding a PreToolUse hook's `ask` decision for unsandboxed Bash — a hook `ask` now floors the decision at a prompt
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式覆盖 PreToolUse 钩子对未沙盒 Bash 的`ask`决定的问题 — 钩子`ask`现在会在提示时做出决定

entries.en: Fixed parallel Claude Code sessions all logging out simultaneously after wake-from-sleep when many sessions share one credential store
entries.zh: 修复了当许多会话共享一个凭证存储时，并行 Claude Code 会话在从睡眠中唤醒后同时注销的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin MCP servers not reconnecting after an idle web session woke, leaving MCP calls failing until the next message
entries.zh: 修复了插件 MCP 服务器在空闲 Web 会话唤醒后无法重新连接，导致 MCP 调用失败直到下一条消息为止

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code on Vertex and Bedrock attempting the default Opus model at startup and printing a spurious fallback notice when a model is explicitly configured
entries.zh: 修复了 Vertex 和 Bedrock 上的 Claude 代码在启动时尝试默认 Opus 模型并在显式配置模型时打印虚假后备通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents spawned with an explicit model override reverting to the parent's model when resumed or sent a follow-up message
entries.zh: 修复了使用显式模型覆盖生成的子代理在恢复或发送后续消息时恢复到父级模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed nested `.claude/rules/*.md` files loading even when setting sources exclude project settings
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套的`.claude/rules/*.md`文件加载，即使设置源排除项目设置也是如此

entries.en: Fixed file upload validation: filenames ending in a DOS device suffix (`.prn`) or trailing dot are now accepted, and files with multiple hard links are refused
entries.zh: 修复了文件上传验证：现在接受以 DOS 设备后缀 (`.prn`) 或尾随点结尾的文件名，并拒绝具有多个硬链接的文件

entries.en: Fixed file uploads to Claude in Chrome from remote and CLI sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome 中从远程和 CLI 会话将文件上传到 Claude 的问题

entries.en: Fixed edits that leave the input as "?" being silently swallowed and toggling the shortcuts panel
entries.zh: 修复了将输入保留为“？”的编辑被无声地吞噬并切换快捷方式面板

entries.en: Fixed a startup hang when the Claude in Chrome extension is enabled but Chrome is not running
entries.zh: 修复了启用 Chrome 扩展程序但 Chrome 未运行时启动挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed a 300ms delay revealing async content (Settings tabs, Stats, diff views, and other loading states)
entries.zh: 修复了显示异步内容（设置选项卡、统计信息、差异视图和其他加载状态）的 300 毫秒延迟

entries.en: Fixed reopening a just-stopped background session from the agents view starting a blank conversation under the same session id
entries.zh: 修复了从代理视图重新打开刚刚停止的后台会话在同一会话 ID 下启动空白对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/loop` hiding the session from `/resume` after a single use
entries.zh: 修复了`/loop`在单次使用后隐藏`/resume`会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed screen reader users losing the audible terminal bell after `/terminal-setup` or onboarding terminal setup
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器用户在`/terminal-setup`或载入终端设置后丢失终端声音的问题

entries.en: Fixed background jobs on LLM gateway auth (`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` + `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) coming back "Not logged in" after the daemon respawns them
entries.zh: 修复了 LLM 网关身份验证（`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` + `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`）上的后台作业在守护进程重新生成后返回“未登录”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` jobs becoming permanently undeletable when git no longer recognizes their worktree — the row now shows why the delete was refused instead of silently reappearing
entries.zh: 修复了当 git 不再识别其工作树时“claude Agents”作业永久不可删除的问题 - 该行现在显示删除被拒绝而不是默默重新出现的原因

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` not resetting the session cost counter — the statusline's cost now starts at $0 after `/clear`
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`不重置会话成本计数器的问题 - 在`/clear`之后状态栏的成本现在从 0 美元开始

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome setup pages failing to open in the browser on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome 设置页面中的 Claude 无法在 Windows 浏览器中打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed headless print-mode sessions on Windows crashing or silently exiting when stdin is unreadable
entries.zh: 修复了当标准输入不可读时 Windows 上的无头打印模式会话崩溃或无提示退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed background session titles in the agents view showing the naming model's refusal text when the prompt contains a link
entries.zh: 修复了当提示包含链接时代理视图中显示命名模型的拒绝文本的后台会话标题

entries.en: Fixed background agents killed by the user auto-respawning, and revived agents re-running stale prompts from old sessions
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理被用户自动重生杀死的问题，并恢复了代理从旧会话中重新运行陈旧提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed routines with no schedule reporting a next run time in the year 1
entries.zh: 修复了没有时间表报告第一年下一次运行时间的例程

entries.en: Hardened synced skill/plugin directory naming on Windows and kept CCR web fetch/search proxies working after `/clear`
entries.zh: 加固 Windows 上同步技能/插件的目录命名，并确保 `/clear` 之后 CCR 网页抓取/搜索代理仍能正常工作

entries.en: Improved terminal layout and rendering performance
entries.zh: 改进终端布局和渲染性能

entries.en: Improved background agent result reporting — Claude now reports the status of still-running agents and waits for the real completion instead of fabricating results
entries.zh: 改进后台 agent 结果报告：Claude 会报告仍在运行的代理的状态，并等待真正完成，不再编造结果

entries.en: Improved the memory index over-limit warning to measure only loaded content, excluding frontmatter and HTML comments
entries.zh: 改进记忆索引超限警告：只统计已加载的内容，不计入 frontmatter 和 HTML 注释

entries.en: Updated integer environment variables (timeouts, token budgets, retry counts) to accept scientific notation and digit-separator spellings like `1e6` and `64_000`
entries.zh: 整数类环境变量（超时、token 预算、重试次数）现在可接受科学计数法和带数字分隔符的写法，如 `1e6` 和 `64_000`

entries.en: Updated documentation links to the current docs sites
entries.zh: 文档链接已更新为当前的文档站点

entries.en: Changed "always allow" permission rules to save at the repository root, so approvals granted in a git worktree persist across sessions and worktrees
entries.zh: 更改了“始终允许”权限规则以保存在存储库根目录中，因此 git 工作树中授予的批准可以跨会话和工作树保留

entries.en: Changed `/usage-credits` to ask for confirmation before sending a request to organization admins
entries.zh: 更改了`/usage-credits`以在向组织管理员发送请求之前要求确认

entries.en: Changed Vim mode `s` and `S` (substitute char/line) to work in NORMAL mode, matching vim behavior
entries.zh: 更改了 Vim 模式 `s` 和 `S`（替换字符/行）以在正常模式下工作，匹配 vim 行为

entries.en: [VSCode] Updated the Remote Control banner to describe what it does
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更新了 Remote Control 横幅的说明文字，使其描述功能用途

entries.en: Claude in Chrome: hardened file-upload path validation
entries.zh: Chrome 中的 Claude：强化文件上传路径验证

entries.en: Claude in Chrome: `save_to_disk` on screenshot actions now writes the image to disk and returns the path; previously it did nothing
entries.zh: Chrome 中的 Claude：屏幕截图操作中的`save_to_disk`现在将图像写入磁盘并返回路径；之前它什么也没做

entries.en: Fixed a prompt-caching regression on Bedrock, Vertex, Mantle, and Foundry that billed the trailing system context block as fresh input tokens on every request.
entries.zh: 修复 Bedrock、Vertex、Mantle 和 Foundry 上的提示词缓存回归问题：每次请求都把末尾的系统上下文块当作新输入 token 计费

entries.en: Added a live elapsed-time counter to the collapsed tool summary line so long-running tool calls visibly tick instead of looking stuck
entries.zh: 在折叠的工具摘要行中添加了一个实时运行时间计数器，因此长时间运行的工具调用会明显地勾选而不是看起来被卡住

entries.en: Added a startup warning for `Write(path)`, `NotebookEdit(path)`, and `Glob(path)` permission rules — use `Edit(path)` or `Read(path)` instead
entries.zh: 添加了针对`Write(path)`、`NotebookEdit(path)`和`Glob(path)`权限规则的启动警告 - 请改用`Edit(path)`或`Read(path)`

entries.en: Fixed `isolation: 'worktree'` subagents being able to run git-mutating commands against the main repo checkout instead of their own isolated worktree
entries.zh: 修复了“隔离：‘工作树’”子代理能够针对主存储库签出运行 git-mutating 命令，而不是针对其自己的隔离工作树

entries.en: Fixed the `ultracode` keyword opt-in firing on non-human-originated input such as webhook payloads and relayed PR comments
entries.zh: 修复 `ultracode` 关键词选择加入功能会被非人工输入（如 webhook 负载和转发的 PR 评论）触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rendered text fragment leaking into crash telemetry when a UI component returned content outside a styled text element
entries.zh: 修复了当 UI 组件返回样式文本元素之外的内容时渲染的文本片段泄漏到崩溃遥测中的问题

entries.en: Fixed paste markers leaking into external editors opened from Claude Code, which could appear as stray È/É characters around pasted text
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴标记泄漏到从 Claude Code 打开的外部编辑器中的问题，这些标记可能在粘贴的文本周围显示为杂散 È/É 字符

entries.en: Fixed `claude attach` sometimes failing with "job not found" or "agent is still starting" errors during session transitions — attach now waits for the daemon to settle, and terminal resizes during a slow attach are applied once it completes
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Attach”有时会在会话转换期间失败并出现“未找到作业”或“代理仍在启动”错误的问题 - 连接现在等待守护进程稳定下来，并且一旦完成，就会应用慢速连接期间的终端调整大小

entries.en: Fixed a session crash when a tool's result renderer returned a numeric bigint value or plain text instead of a UI element
entries.zh: 修复了当工具的结果渲染器返回数字 bigint 值或纯文本而不是 UI 元素时会话崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a hook callback timeout being misreported to the model as a user rejection, which made unattended sessions stop and wait
entries.zh: 修复了钩子回调超时被错误报告给模型作为用户拒绝，这导致无人值守会话停止并等待

entries.en: Fixed Claude assuming a `cd` took effect after its command was moved to the background; the tool result now states the working directory is unchanged
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德假设`cd`在其命令移至后台后生效的问题；工具结果现在表明工作目录未更改

entries.en: Fixed plugin-provided MCP servers being torn down when MCP servers are re-synced mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中重新同步 MCP 服务器时插件提供的 MCP 服务器被拆除的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan approvals without edits being labeled "(edited by user)" and overwriting the plan file with a stale snapshot
entries.zh: 修复了计划批准，无需将编辑标记为“（由用户编辑）”并用过时的快照覆盖计划文件

entries.en: Fixed `/doctor` skipping its auto-mode-default proposal on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, where auto mode no longer needs an opt-in
entries.zh: 修复了`/doctor`在 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上跳过其自动模式默认建议的问题，其中自动模式不再需要选择加入

entries.en: Fixed Grep content mode claiming "No matches found" when paginating past the end of results
entries.zh: 修复了 Grep 内容模式在对结果末尾进行分页时声称“未找到匹配项”的问题

entries.en: Fixed unmatched `$1`/`$2` positional placeholders in skills and commands being silently stripped; they are now preserved verbatim
entries.zh: 修复技能和命令中未匹配的 `$1`/`$2` 位置占位符被静默删除的问题；现在会原样保留

entries.en: Fixed plugin cache writes leaving temp files behind on failure and failing on locked-file renames on Windows and network filesystems
entries.zh: 修复了插件缓存写入失败时留下临时文件以及 Windows 和网络文件系统上锁定文件重命名失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed background workers crash-looping when a client resets its connection to the background service
entries.zh: 修复了客户端重置与后台服务的连接时后台工作人员崩溃循环的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents --effort ultracode` not reaching dispatched sessions; the value was silently dropped
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents --effort ultracode”未到达已调度会话的问题；价值悄然下降

entries.en: Fixed pressing ← to open the agents view dropping the task tracker when returning to the session
entries.zh: 修复了返回会话时按 ← 打开代理视图并删除任务跟踪器的问题

entries.en: Fixed the agents dashboard retaining pasted images from abandoned reply drafts after their session was deleted
entries.zh: 修复会话被删除后，智能体仪表盘仍保留已放弃回复草稿中粘贴图片的问题

entries.en: Fixed killed background sessions leaving a permanent `git worktree lock` behind; the periodic sweep now releases locks whose owning process is gone
entries.zh: 修复了被杀死的后台会话留下永久的`git worktree lock`的问题；定期扫描现在会释放其所属进程已消失的锁

entries.en: Fixed SDK MCP servers registered via an `initialize` control request waiting until the next turn to start connecting
entries.zh: 修复了通过“初始化”控制请求注册的 SDK MCP 服务器等待下一轮开始连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed returning to the agents view from a session leaving overlapping ghost frames with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1`
entries.zh: 修复了从会话返回代理视图时留下重叠幻影帧的问题，其中包含`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1`

entries.en: Fixed late-appearing `.claude/*` symlinks not being reconciled into the sandbox deny-write list
entries.zh: 修复了后期出现的`.claude/*`符号链接未协调到沙箱拒绝写入列表中的问题

entries.en: Hardened the Agent tool against indirect prompt injection via content a subagent read
entries.zh: 加固 Agent 工具，防止子代理读取的内容里夹带的间接提示注入

entries.en: Improved the Bash/PowerShell tool message when a command hits its timeout and is auto-backgrounded, so the model can distinguish a hang from an explicit background request
entries.zh: 改进 Bash/PowerShell 工具消息：命令超时并自动转入后台时，模型能区分是卡住还是明确要求后台运行

entries.en: Improved auto mode: the permission classifier now defaults to Sonnet 5 for external sessions, validated on the session's first request and pinned for the session
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：外部会话的权限分类器默认使用 Sonnet 5，并在会话的第一个请求时验证，之后固定使用

entries.en: Improved the bundled dataviz skill's chart color validation with perceptual OKLab color difference and recalibrated color-blindness thresholds
entries.zh: 改进内置 dataviz 技能的图表颜色校验：采用感知型 OKLab 色差，并重新校准了色盲阈值

entries.en: Memory writes that leave a MEMORY.md index over its read limit now produce an explicit error instead of silent truncation
entries.zh: 使 MEMORY.md 索引超过读取上限的记忆写入现在会报出明确错误，而不是悄悄截断

entries.en: Screen reader mode now announces permission mode changes aloud when cycling modes with Shift+Tab
entries.zh: 屏幕阅读器模式下，用 Shift+Tab 切换权限模式时，会语音播报模式变化

entries.en: The agents footer hint now shows how many background agents are waiting on your input, with a brief color emphasis when the count changes
entries.zh: 代理底部提示现在会显示有多少后台代理正在等待你的输入，数字变化时会短暂高亮

entries.en: Agent view: the session you pressed ← from stays visibly marked even after mouse hover or arrow keys move the selection
entries.zh: 代理视图：即使在鼠标悬停或箭头键移动选择后，您按下 ← 的会话仍会保持明显标记

entries.en: Fable temporarily shows as unavailable in the advisor picker while a server-side issue causing Fable advisor failures is fixed
entries.zh: Fable 暂时在 Advisor 选择器中显示为不可用，同时修复了导致 Fable Advisor 失败的服务器端问题

entries.en: Fixed /model and other dialogs being blocked in `claude agents` background sessions (reverts an overly broad guard)
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”后台会话中阻止的 /model 和其他对话框（恢复过于广泛的防护）

entries.en: Added screen reader mode: opt-in plain-text rendering for screen reader users. Run `claude --ax-screen-reader`, set CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER=1, or add "axScreenReader": true to settings.
entries.zh: 添加了屏幕阅读器模式：为屏幕阅读器用户选择纯文本渲染。运行 `claude --ax-screen-reader`，设置 CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER=1，或将 "axScreenReader": true 添加到设置中。

entries.en: Added `vimInsertModeRemaps` setting: map two-key insert-mode sequences like `jj` to Escape in vim mode
entries.zh: 添加了 `vimInsertModeRemaps` 设置：将像 `jj` 这样的两键插入模式序列映射到 vim 模式下的 Escape

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER`: agent view and the background service now honor a corporate launcher by running every Claude Code self-spawn through a required wrapper executable
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER`：代理视图和后台服务现在通过所需的包装器可执行文件运行每个克劳德代码自生成，从而支持企业启动器

entries.en: Added mouse-click support for multi-select menus and "Other" input rows in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 添加了对全屏模式下多选菜单和“其他”输入行的鼠标单击支持

entries.en: Changed the Fable 5 usage-credits consent prompt to start with the decline option focused
entries.zh: 将《神鬼寓言 5》使用积分同意提示更改为以拒绝选项为重点

entries.en: Fixed fast mode staying off after switching back to a model that supports it — it now restores automatically when enabled in settings
entries.zh: 修复了切换回支持快速模式后保持关闭状态的问题 - 现在在设置中启用后会自动恢复

entries.en: Fixed replies typed to a background agent being lost when delivery fails — the text is now saved and delivered when the session restarts
entries.zh: 修复了在传递失败时输入给后台代理的回复丢失的问题 - 现在，文本会在会话重新启动时保存并传递

entries.en: Fixed background-session attach failing permanently ("Couldn't start the background daemon") after an update replaced the binary a running `claude agents` process was launched from
entries.zh: 修复了更新替换二进制文件后，后台会话附加永久失败（“无法启动后台守护进程”）的问题

entries.en: Fixed the context window (and auto-compact indicator) briefly resetting to 200k after the CLI auto-updates, causing a false "100% context used" when resuming long-context sessions
entries.zh: 修复 CLI 自动更新后，上下文窗口（及自动压缩指示器）短暂重置为 200k，导致恢复长上下文会话时误报"100% context used"的问题

entries.en: Fixed supervised and background sessions crashing when a server closed an HTTP/2 connection with a GOAWAY while requests were in flight
entries.zh: 修复了当请求正在进行时服务器关闭带有 GOAWAY 的 HTTP/2 连接时受监督和后台会话崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed truncated stream-json/JSON output and missing result message when piping large responses from `claude -p`
entries.zh: 修复 `claude -p` 通过管道输出大型回复时，stream-json/JSON 输出被截断、缺少结果消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` and similar env vars silently using the mantissa of scientific-notation values (`1e6` became `1`)
entries.zh: 使用科学记数法值的尾数静默修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`和类似的环境变量（`1e6`变为`1`）

entries.en: Fixed very large markdown tables stalling rendering or using excessive memory; tables over 200 rows show the first 200 with a "… N more rows" notice
entries.zh: 修复超大 Markdown 表格导致渲染停滞或占用过多内存的问题；超过 200 行的表格现在只显示前 200 行，并附带"… N more rows"提示

entries.en: Fixed the Edit tool failing on files modified after reading when the target text still matches uniquely
entries.zh: 修复 Edit 工具在文件读取后又被修改时编辑失败、但目标文本仍唯一匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed Read reporting empty files as "shorter than offset", Grep silently returning "No files found" for invalid regex patterns, Grep count mode under-reporting totals when paginated, and Glob crashing with an unclear error when the pattern, path, or working directory contained a null byte
entries.zh: 修复了 Read 将空文件报告为“短于偏移量”、Grep 对于无效的正则表达式模式默默地返回“未找到文件”、Grep 计数模式在分页时报告总数不足以及当模式、路径或工作目录包含空字节时 Glob 因不清楚错误而崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed `apiKeyHelper` script failures being hidden behind a generic 401 after ~10 silent retries; the script's own error is now shown within 3 attempts
entries.zh: 修复了大约 10 次静默重试后隐藏在通用 401 后面的`apiKeyHelper`脚本故障；脚本自身的错误现在会在 3 次尝试内显示

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock streaming requests failing with a misleading "Truncated event message received" when a gateway transforms the response — the error now names the content-type and points at the proxy
entries.zh: 修复了当网关转换响应时基岩流请求失败并出现误导性的“已收到截断的事件消息”的问题 — 该错误现在命名内容类型并指向代理

entries.en: Fixed `/upgrade` showing a login flow instead of the upgrade URL when the browser fails to open
entries.zh: 修复了浏览器无法打开时显示登录流程而不是升级 URL 的`/upgrade`

entries.en: Fixed stream-json input killing the session on blank CRLF or whitespace-only lines from Windows-style SDK hosts
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 风格 SDK 主机中的流 json 输入终止空白 CRLF 或仅空白行上的会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed headless stream-json sessions hanging permanently when a `control_request` carried a non-string `set_model` payload; the CLI now answers with an error response
entries.zh: 修复了当`control_request`携带非字符串`set_model`负载时无头stream-json会话永久挂起的问题； CLI 现在给出错误响应

entries.en: Fixed repeated "No completion record was found" notices on session resume — orphaned background tasks now collapse into a single summary
entries.zh: 修复了会话恢复时重复出现的“未找到完成记录”通知 — 孤立的后台任务现在折叠为单个摘要

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control clients attaching to a terminal-hosted session not seeing background agents and workflow progress until a task started or stopped
entries.zh: 修复了附加到终端托管会话的远程控制客户端在任务启动或停止之前看不到后台代理和工作流程进度的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Agent tool launching with no tools when a subagent's `tools` list resolves to nothing — it now returns a clear error naming the unrecognized entries
entries.zh: 修复了当子代理的“工具”列表解析为空时，代理工具在没有工具的情况下启动 - 它现在返回一个明确的错误，命名无法识别的条目

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` showing stale cached bars over fresher data, and `/mcp` not reclassifying placeholder servers after config edits
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`在更新的数据上显示陈旧的缓存栏，以及`/mcp`在配置编辑后不重新分类占位符服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Change directory" in SDK hosts (e.g. Claude Desktop) failing with "A turn is in progress" on idle sessions that have a running background task
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 主机（例如 Claude Desktop）中的“更改目录”在具有正在运行的后台任务的空闲会话上失败并显示“轮次正在进行中”的问题

entries.en: Fixed the workflow save dialog showing `~/.claude/workflows/` instead of the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` location for user-scope saves
entries.zh: 修复用户级保存时，工作流保存对话框显示 `~/.claude/workflows/` 而非 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 所指位置的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/release-notes` adding the viewed notes to the model's context — "Show all" previously injected the entire changelog into every subsequent request
entries.zh: 修复了`/release-notes`将查看的注释添加到模型上下文中的问题——“显示全部”之前将整个变更日志注入到每个后续请求中

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak in the agent view where pasted images were retained for the screen's lifetime after sending peek replies
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图中的内存泄漏，其中粘贴的图像在发送查看回复后在屏幕的整个生命周期内保留

entries.en: Fixed SDK sessions losing agents defined via the initialize request when a plugin refresh ran before the client attached
entries.zh: 修复了在客户端连接之前运行插件刷新时 SDK 会话丢失通过初始化请求定义的代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed several memory leaks in long sessions: MCP stdio server stderr accumulating up to 64 MB per server, LSP documents staying open indefinitely (now LRU with 50-doc cap), async hook output retained after backgrounding, and unbounded growth in headless/SDK sessions from large tool-result payloads
entries.zh: 修复了长会话中的多个内存泄漏：MCP stdio 服务器 stderr 每台服务器累积高达 64 MB，LSP 文档无限期保持打开状态（现在为 LRU，上限为 50 个文档），后台后保留异步挂钩输出，以及来自大型工具结果负载的无头/SDK 会话无限增长

entries.en: Fixed a memory blowup when reading files with extremely long single lines using offset/limit — the read now returns a clean error instead of loading the whole line
entries.zh: 修复了使用偏移/限制读取具有极长单行的文件时的内存爆炸问题 - 读取现在返回一个干净的错误，而不是加载整行

entries.en: Fixed multi-second per-turn slowdowns in sessions with many permission deny/ask rules — rule matchers are now compiled once and cached
entries.zh: 修复了具有许多权限拒绝/询问规则的会话中每回合多秒的减速问题 - 规则匹配器现在编译一次并缓存

entries.en: Improved input responsiveness while agent task lists update — task updates no longer re-render the entire UI
entries.zh: 改进 agent 任务列表更新时的输入响应：任务更新不再重新渲染整个界面

entries.en: Reduced per-tool-call CPU overhead in print/SDK sessions with many MCP tools by caching tool-pool assembly (up to 7x faster tool rounds at high tool counts)
entries.zh: 在有大量 MCP 工具的 print/SDK 会话中，通过缓存工具池的组装，每次工具调用的 CPU 开销降低（工具数很多时，工具轮次最多快 7 倍）

entries.en: Reduced memory usage by bounding the file edit read cache to 16 MB instead of pinning up to 1,000 full files
entries.zh: 文件编辑读取缓存上限设为 16 MB，不再最多占住 1000 个完整文件，内存占用降低

entries.en: Reduced session transcript size (up to 79x in edit-heavy sessions) and bounded checkpoint disk usage by pruning superseded file-history backups
entries.zh: 通过清理已被替代的文件历史备份，会话记录体积减小（编辑较多的会话最多减小 79 倍），检查点的磁盘占用也设了上限

entries.en: Reduced memory usage when resuming sessions with background agents or forks spawned from large conversations
entries.zh: 恢复带有后台代理或从大型对话派生出的分支的会话时，内存占用降低

entries.en: Completed background agents now stay listed in `/tasks` until cleanup instead of vanishing the moment they finish
entries.zh: 已完成的后台代理现在会保留在`/tasks`中，直到清理，而不是在完成后立即消失

entries.en: Attaching to a stopped background agent now shows its transcript immediately while the session warms up, instead of a blank "Session is starting" screen
entries.zh: 现在，连接到已停止的后台代理会在会话预热时立即显示其脚本，而不是空白的“会话正在启动”屏幕

entries.en: Background sessions: an older daemon no longer silently restarts workers spawned by a newer version onto the older binary
entries.zh: 后台会话：旧的守护进程不再默默地将新版本生成的工作进程重新启动到旧二进制文件上

entries.en: Agent view: Ctrl+X now deletes renamed-branch worktrees, never destroys unpushed commits, keeps the session row when a worktree is kept, and reused worktree names reset to the current base
entries.zh: 代理视图：Ctrl+X 现在删除重命名的分支工作树，从不销毁未推送的提交，在保留工作树时保留会话行，并将重用的工作树名称重置为当前基数

entries.en: Catastrophic removals (e.g. `rm -rf ~`) in commands containing `$(…)`/backticks/`<(…)` now prompt in `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and auto mode, matching the plain form
entries.zh: 包含`$(…)`/反引号/`<(…)`的命令中的灾难性删除（例如`rm -rf ~`）现在会在`--dangerously-skip-permissions`和自动模式下提示，与普通形式匹配

entries.en: `/install-github-app` and the `/mcp` settings menu no longer open in background sessions
entries.zh: `/install-github-app` 和 `/mcp` 设置菜单不再在后台会话中打开

entries.en: MCP servers configured with an empty URL now show as "not configured" in `/mcp` instead of a config error
entries.zh: 配置了空 URL 的 MCP 服务器现在在 `/mcp` 中显示为「未配置」，而不是配置错误

entries.en: `/usage` now shows your last-known usage bars with an "as of" note when the usage endpoint is rate-limited, instead of an error screen
entries.zh: 当用量接口被限速时，`/usage` 现在会显示最近一次已知的用量进度条并附带 "as of" 说明，而不再显示错误界面

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock auth failing with "Session token not found or invalid" for AWS SSO profiles whose sso_region differs from the Bedrock region (2.1.207 regression)
entries.zh: 修复了 sso_region 与 Bedrock 区域不同的 AWS SSO 配置文件的 Bedrock 身份验证失败并显示“会话令牌未找到或无效”的问题（207 年 1 月回归）

entries.en: Auto mode is now available without `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE` opt-in on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry; disable via `disableAutoMode` in settings
entries.zh: 现在无需在 Bedrock、Vertex AI 和 Foundry 上选择`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE`即可使用自动模式；通过设置中的`disableAutoMode`禁用

entries.en: Fixed the terminal freezing and keystrokes lagging while streaming responses containing very long lists, tables, paragraphs, or code blocks
entries.zh: 修复流式输出包含超长列表、表格、段落或代码块时，终端冻结且按键延迟的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote managed settings from a non-interactive run (`claude -p`, the SDK) being permanently recorded as consented without ever showing the security consent dialog
entries.zh: 修复了非交互式运行（`claude -p`，SDK）中的远程管理设置被永久记录为同意的情况，而不会显示安全同意对话框

entries.en: Fixed spurious prompt-injection warnings triggered by benign system-generated conversation updates
entries.zh: 修复了由良性系统生成的对话更新触发的虚假提示注入警告

entries.en: Fixed the auto-updater overwriting a custom launcher script or symlink at `~/.local/bin/claude` on every release; `/doctor` now reports an externally managed launcher
entries.zh: 修复自动更新程序每次发布都会覆盖 `~/.local/bin/claude` 上自定义启动脚本或符号链接的问题；`/doctor` 现在会报告启动器由外部管理

entries.en: Fixed compound commands with `cd` prompting for permission when the only output redirect was to `/dev/null`
entries.zh: 当唯一的输出重定向到`/dev/null`时，修复了带有`cd`提示权限的复合命令

entries.en: Fixed the transcript jumping above the start of the answer when a response finishes streaming
entries.zh: 修复回复流式输出完成时，转录视图跳到回答开头之上的问题

entries.en: Fixed `extensions.worktreeConfig` being left in the repo's `.git/config` (breaking go-git tools like `tea`) after the last `worktree.sparsePaths` worktree was removed
entries.zh: 修复了删除最后一个`worktree.sparsePaths`工作树后，留在存储库的`.git/config`中的`extensions.worktreeConfig`（破坏了`tea`等 go-git 工具）

entries.en: Fixed malformed bracket patterns in rules globs, skill paths, `.ignore`, and `.worktreeinclude` breaking file reads, file suggestions, and worktree creation
entries.zh: 修复了规则全局、技能路径、`.ignore`和`.worktreeinclude`中格式错误的括号模式，破坏了文件读取、文件建议和工作树创建

entries.en: Fixed a crash loop in agent teams where a malformed teammate mailbox message caused repeated errors every second until the mailbox file was manually deleted
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队中的崩溃循环，其中格式错误的队友邮箱消息每秒导致重复错误，直到手动删除邮箱文件

entries.en: Fixed background sessions auto-named by accepting a plan not showing that name on their agent-view row
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话通过接受未在其代理视图行上显示该名称的计划来自动命名的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions that entered a git worktree resuming blank after a cold reopen from the agent list
entries.zh: 修复了从代理列表冷重新打开后进入 git 工作树的后台会话恢复为空白的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control task status updates being lost when the connection recovered from a network interruption or credential refresh
entries.zh: 修复了当连接从网络中断或凭据刷新中恢复时远程控制任务状态更新丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by the desktop app not showing background agent and workflow progress on mobile and web
entries.zh: 修复了桌面应用程序托管的远程控制会话不显示移动设备和 Web 上的后台代理和工作流程进度的问题

entries.en: Fixed Deep research runs labeling every Fetch-phase agent "unknown" — chips now show the source hostname
entries.zh: 修复了深度研究运行，将每个获取阶段代理标记为“未知”——芯片现在显示源主机名

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock repeatedly requesting fresh AWS SSO credentials from IAM Identity Center on every API request
entries.zh: 修复了 Bedrock 在每次 API 请求时反复从 IAM Identity Center 请求新的 AWS SSO 凭证的问题

entries.en: Improved agent view: pasting the same text again now expands the collapsed `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder instead of adding a second one
entries.zh: 改进 agent 视图：再次粘贴相同文本时，展开已折叠的 `[Pasted text #N]` 占位符，而不是新增第二个

entries.en: Improved agent view: blocked session peeks now lead with the question and show a worded staleness clock (`waiting 3m`) instead of the same timestamp twice
entries.zh: 改进 agent 视图：阻塞中的会话预览先显示问题本身，并用文字化的停滞时长（如 `waiting 3m`）代替重复的同一时间戳

entries.en: Changed Bedrock, Vertex, and Claude Platform on AWS to default to Claude Opus 4.8
entries.zh: 将 AWS 上的 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Claude Platform 更改为默认为 Claude Opus 4.8

entries.en: Changed auto mode to no longer read `autoMode` from `.claude/settings.local.json` (repo-resident); use `~/.claude/settings.json` instead
entries.zh: 更改了自动模式，不再从`.claude/settings.local.json`（存储库驻留）读取`autoMode`；使用 `~/.claude/settings.json` 代替

entries.en: Fixed an indefinite hang on Windows when AWS credential resolution stalls (e.g. a stuck `credential_process`): the 60-second stall guard now fires instead of waiting forever.
entries.zh: 修复了当 AWS 凭证解析停止时 Windows 上无限期挂起的问题（例如`credential_process`卡住）：现在会触发 60 秒的停止保护，而不是永远等待。

entries.en: Plugin hooks/monitors/MCP headersHelper: `${user_config.*}` in shell-form commands is now rejected (shell-injection fix). Hooks: use exec form (`args` array) or `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>`; monitors and headersHelper: read the value inside the script (config file or the server's `env` block).
entries.zh: 插件 hook/monitors/MCP headersHelper：shell 形式的命令中若含 `${user_config.*}`，现在会被拒绝（修复命令注入漏洞）。hook 请使用 exec 形式（`args` 数组）或 `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>`；monitors 和 headersHelper 请在脚本内部读取值（配置文件或服务器的 `env` 块）

entries.en: Plugin option values (`pluginConfigs`) are no longer read from project-level `.claude/settings.json`; only user, `--settings`, and managed settings are honored
entries.zh: 插件选项值（`pluginConfigs`）不再从项目级 `.claude/settings.json` 读取，只采用用户级、`--settings` 和托管设置

entries.en: Fixed `/usage-credits` amount inputs silently stripping malformed values (e.g. a pasted timestamp) to digits; malformed amounts are now rejected with an error, and amounts over $1,000 require a typed confirmation
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage-credits`金额输入，默默地将格式错误的值（例如粘贴的时间戳）剥离为数字；现在，格式错误的金额会被拒绝并显示错误，超过 1,000 美元的金额需要打字确认

entries.en: Added directory path suggestions to `/cd`, matching `/add-dir` behavior
entries.zh: 向`/cd`添加了目录路径建议，匹配`/add-dir`行为

entries.en: Added a `/doctor` check that proposes trimming checked-in `CLAUDE.md` files by cutting content Claude could derive from the codebase
entries.zh: 添加了`/doctor`检查，建议通过剪切 Claude 可能从代码库派生的内容来修剪签入的`CLAUDE.md`文件

entries.en: `/commit-push-pr` now auto-allows `git push` to the repo's configured push remote (`remote.pushDefault`, or the sole remote when only one is configured) in addition to `origin`
entries.zh: `/commit-push-pr` 现在除 `origin` 外，还会自动允许对仓库配置的推送远端（`remote.pushDefault`，或仅配置了一个远端时的该远端）执行 `git push`

entries.en: Gateway: `/login` now supports Anthropic-operated public gateway endpoints
entries.zh: 网关：`/login` 现在支持 Anthropic 运营的公共网关端点

entries.en: `EnterWorktree` now asks for confirmation before entering a git worktree outside the project's `.claude/worktrees/` directory
entries.zh: `EnterWorktree` 进入项目 `.claude/worktrees/` 目录之外的 git worktree 前，现在会先请求确认

entries.en: Background agents now upgrade to a new version in the background right after a Claude Code update, instead of paying a slow stale-session upgrade when you attach
entries.zh: 后台代理现在在克劳德代码更新后立即在后台升级到新版本，而不是在附加时支付缓慢的陈旧会话升级费用

entries.en: Fixed an expired login failing every model with a misleading "There's an issue with the selected model" error instead of prompting to run `/login`
entries.zh: 修复了过期登录导致每个模型失败的问题，并出现误导性的“所选模型存在问题”错误，而不是提示运行`/login`

entries.en: Fixed `claude --resume` and `--continue` not responding to keyboard input on startup
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --resume`和“-- continue”在启动时不响应键盘输入的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers configured via `--mcp-config` or `.mcp.json` ignoring a per-server `request_timeout_ms`, which caused long-running MCP tool calls to time out at the 60s default in fresh sessions
entries.zh: 修复了通过`--mcp-config`或`.mcp.json`配置的 MCP 服务器忽略每个服务器的`request_timeout_ms`，这导致长时间运行的 MCP 工具调用在新会话中默认为 60 秒超时

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` being silently ignored by `claude agents` / `--bg` background workers; the shell-exported override now follows the dispatching session
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY`被“claude Agents”/`--bg`后台工作人员默默忽略的问题； shell 导出的覆盖现在遵循调度会话

entries.en: Fixed OAuth MCP servers requiring manual re-authentication after a single failed token refresh
entries.zh: 修复了在单次失败的令牌刷新后需要手动重新身份验证的 OAuth MCP 服务器

entries.en: Fixed `--permission-prompt-tool` pointing at an MCP server crashing with "MCP tool not found" on cold start before the server finishes connecting
entries.zh: 修复了`--permission-prompt-tool`指向 MCP 服务器在服务器完成连接之前冷启动时崩溃并显示“未找到 MCP 工具”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` picker rows printing a price for a different model than the row named, and stopped quoting first-party list prices on providers that don't bill them
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`选择器行打印与指定行不同型号的价格，并停止引用不向其开具账单的提供商的第一方标价

entries.en: Fixed server-provided model rows being misplaced in the `/model` picker when an entitlement or allowlist restriction drops the row they were positioned against
entries.zh: 修复了当权利或白名单限制删除了它们所针对的行时，服务器提供的模型行在`/model`选择器中被放错位置的问题

entries.en: Fixed desktop sessions getting stuck showing "running" after a slash command was sent mid-turn
entries.zh: 修复了在中途发送斜杠命令后桌面会话卡住显示“正在运行”的问题

entries.en: Fixed keyboard input being ignored in the agents view when a setup prompt appeared before a bare `claude --resume` on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了当 Windows 上的`claude --resume`之前出现设置提示时，代理视图中的键盘输入被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude rm` leaving the removed job in the daemon roster, causing the row to reappear in `claude agents`
entries.zh: 修复了`claude rm`将删除的作业留在守护进程名册中，导致该行重新出现在“claude Agents”中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` showing "Unknown command" when logged out — it now explains how to sign in
entries.zh: 修复了`/remote-control`在注销时显示“未知命令”的问题 - 现在它解释了如何登录

entries.en: Fixed left arrow not stepping back out of a phase or agent in the workflow detail view
entries.zh: 修复了左箭头未退出工作流详细信息视图中的阶段或代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/status` listing the same broken-install warning twice
entries.zh: 修复了`/status`两次列出相同的损坏安装警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed false "disused plugin" tips and skewed disuse telemetry for LSP plugins
entries.zh: 修复了错误的“废弃插件”提示以及 LSP 插件废弃遥测的偏差

entries.en: Fixed `/doctor`'s update check to compare Homebrew installs against their cask's channel instead of the settings channel
entries.zh: 修复了`/doctor`的更新检查，以将 Homebrew 安装与其木桶的频道而不是设置频道进行比较

entries.en: Fixed the fullscreen jump-to-bottom pill suggesting Ctrl+End on macOS, not showing rebound chords, and wrapping over the transcript
entries.zh: 修复全屏"跳到底部"提示在 macOS 上建议使用 Ctrl+End、不显示已重绑定的组合键、且会在转录上方换行的问题

entries.en: Bedrock: fixed a multi-minute startup hang when using an `awsCredentialExport` helper on networks with restricted egress
entries.zh: 基岩：修复了在出口受限的网络上使用`awsCredentialExport`帮助程序时出现的多分钟启动挂起问题

entries.en: Improved `/code-review` findings quality on claude-opus-4-8 across all effort levels
entries.zh: 改进 claude-opus-4-8 上 `/code-review` 的评审质量，覆盖所有 effort 级别

entries.en: Improved agents view: status column now uses full terminal width instead of truncating at 64 characters
entries.zh: 改进 agents 视图：状态列使用整个终端宽度，不再在 64 个字符处截断

entries.en: Changed agents view: Ctrl+X now permanently removes a completed session, and sessions no longer render twice; deleted background jobs stay deleted
entries.zh: 更改了代理视图：Ctrl+X 现在永久删除已完成的会话，并且会话不再渲染两次；已删除的后台作业仍保持删除状态

entries.en: Added an auto mode rule that blocks tampering with session transcript files
entries.zh: 添加了自动模式规则，可阻止篡改会话转录文件

entries.en: Fixed `--json-schema` silently producing unstructured output when the schema was invalid, and schemas using the `format` keyword being rejected
entries.zh: 修复了当模式无效时`--json-schema`静默生成非结构化输出，并且使用`format`关键字的模式被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being silently lost when the turn ended at the `--max-turns` limit
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德工作时发送的消息在回合结束于`--max-turns`限制时默默丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Windows worktree removal deleting files outside the worktree when an NTFS junction or directory symlink existed inside it
entries.zh: 修复了当 NTFS 连接或目录符号链接存在于工作树内部时，Windows 工作树删除会删除工作树外部的文件

entries.en: Fixed background agents staying shown as "failed" or "completed" in the agent list after being resumed with `SendMessage`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`SendMessage`恢复后后台代理在代理列表中显示为“失败”或“已完成”的问题

entries.en: Fixed background jobs flipping from "needs input" back to "working" in the agent list when the agent's turn contained no readable text
entries.zh: 修复了当代理轮到不包含可读文本时，后台作业在代理列表中从“需要输入”翻转回“工作”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude attach` erroring when a background agent was mid-upgrade restart instead of waiting for it to come back
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理在升级过程中重新启动而不是等待其返回时出现的“claude Attach”错误

entries.en: Fixed session-to-PR linking missing a PR created in a Bash call whose output exceeded the 30K inline limit
entries.zh: 修复了会话到 PR 链接缺少在 Bash 调用中创建的 PR（其输出超出 30K 内联限制）的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop` getting stuck when a server name contains unsupported characters; invalid names are now reported and remaining servers still import
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器名称包含不支持的字符时`claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop`卡住的问题；现在会报告无效名称，其余服务器仍会导入

entries.en: Fixed a plugin LSP server that fails to initialize preventing a valid LSP server from another plugin handling the same file extension
entries.zh: 修复了无法初始化的插件 LSP 服务器，阻止处理相同文件扩展名的另一个插件提供有效的 LSP 服务器

entries.en: Fixed a Windows crash when the directory Claude was launched from is deleted, locked, or unmounted while a command is running
entries.zh: 修复了在命令运行时删除、锁定或卸载 Claude 启动目录时 Windows 崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash when a file watcher was closed while a directory scan was still in flight
entries.zh: 修复了目录扫描仍在进行时关闭文件观察器时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed project verify skills being rewritten on every session instead of only when a documented command changed
entries.zh: 修复了项目验证技能在每个会话中重写的问题，而不是仅在记录的命令发生更改时重写

entries.en: Fixed the agent view rendering one line too high and clipping its header when the job list slightly overflowed the screen
entries.zh: 修复任务列表略微超出屏幕时，智能体视图整体上移一行并裁切标题的问题

entries.en: Fixed background tasks in the web and mobile Remote Control panels showing stale "Running" status by forwarding full task state on every membership change
entries.zh: 通过在每次成员资格更改时转发完整任务状态，修复了网络和移动远程控制面板中的后台任务显示陈旧的“正在运行”状态的问题

entries.en: Improved auto mode to ask before running `rm -rf` on a variable it can't resolve from context
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：遇到无法从上下文确定的变量时执行 `rm -rf`，会先询问你

entries.en: Auto-update binary downloads now stream to disk instead of buffering in memory, cutting the updater's peak memory usage by roughly 400 MB
entries.zh: 自动更新二进制下载现在流式传输到磁盘而不是在内存中缓冲，从而将更新程序的峰值内存使用量减少了大约 400 MB

entries.en: Background task notifications now explicitly state that no human input has occurred, preventing fabricated in-transcript approvals from being acted on
entries.zh: 后台任务通知现在明确指出没有发生人工输入，从而防止对伪造的转录本批准采取行动

entries.en: Improved agent view: sessions that edit, merge, comment on, or push to an existing PR now link it in `claude agents`
entries.zh: 改进 agent 视图：编辑、合并、评论或推送已有 PR 的会话，现在会在 `claude agents` 中链接到该 PR

entries.en: Improved agent view: rows now show a colored state word and a classifier-written headline instead of raw tool call text, and the peek opens with full status including the exact ask for blocked sessions
entries.zh: 改进 agent 视图：每行显示带颜色的状态词和分类器生成的标题，不再显示原始工具调用文本；预览会显示完整状态，阻塞中的会话还会显示具体的询问内容

entries.en: `/doctor` is now a full setup checkup that can diagnose and fix issues; `/checkup` is its alias
entries.zh: `/doctor` 现在是完整的设置体检，可以诊断并修复问题；`/checkup` 是它的别名

entries.en: Reserved the "Claude Browser" MCP server name (alongside "Claude Preview") ahead of the Claude Desktop pane rename; user-configured MCP servers can no longer register under either name
entries.zh: 在 Claude Desktop 面板改名之前，预留了 "Claude Browser" MCP 服务器名称（与 "Claude Preview" 并列）；用户配置的 MCP 服务器无法再以这两个名称注册

entries.en: Fixed Cowork VM-mode local-agent sessions failing to start with "Not logged in · Please run /login" on CLI 2.1.203+
entries.zh: 修复了 Cowork VM 模式本地代理会话在 CLI 2.1.203+ 上无法启动并显示“未登录·请运行 /login”的问题

entries.en: Fixed hook events not streaming during SessionStart hooks in headless sessions, which could cause remote workers to be idle-reaped mid-hook
entries.zh: 修复了在无头会话中的 SessionStart 挂钩期间挂钩事件未流式传输的问题，这可能导致远程工作人员在挂钩中处于空闲状态

entries.en: Added a warning when your login is about to expire, so you can re-authenticate before background sessions are interrupted
entries.zh: 添加了登录即将过期时的警告，以便您可以在后台会话中断之前重新进行身份验证

entries.en: Added a grey ⏸ badge to the footer when in manual permission mode, making the active mode always visible
entries.zh: 在手动权限模式下，在页脚添加了灰色 ⏸ 徽章，使活动模式始终可见

entries.en: Added the session's additional working directories to MCP `roots/list`, with `notifications/roots/list_changed` sent when the set changes
entries.zh: 将会话的附加工作目录添加到 MCP `roots/list`，并在集合更改时发送 `notifications/roots/list_changed`

entries.en: Fixed opening or switching background agent sessions on macOS stalling for 15–20 seconds due to a false low-memory detection (regression in 2.1.196)
entries.zh: 修复了由于错误的低内存检测而导致 macOS 上打开或切换后台代理会话停滞 15-20 秒的问题（2.1.196 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed background sessions becoming permanently unresponsive to attach, replies, and stop when the daemon's session token went stale — the session now recovers automatically
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话在守护进程的会话令牌过时时永久无响应附加、回复和停止的问题 - 会话现在会自动恢复

entries.en: Fixed returning to `claude agents` silently stopping running subagents and re-running the prompt from scratch — their work now carries over
entries.zh: 修复了返回到“克劳德代理”时默默停止运行子代理并从头开始重新运行提示的问题 - 他们的工作现在继续进行

entries.en: Fixed a memory and per-turn CPU regression in interactive sessions: the context-usage indicator no longer re-analyzes the entire transcript after every turn
entries.zh: 修复了交互式会话中的内存和每回合 CPU 回归：上下文使用指示器不再在每回合后重新分析整个记录

entries.en: Fixed background agents inheriting a stale `PATH` from the daemon instead of the dispatching shell, causing missing tools on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理从守护进程而不是调度 shell 继承过时的`PATH`，导致 Windows 上缺少工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed background and agent-view sessions dropping a shell-exported `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, which sent API keys to the default endpoint and failed with 401
entries.zh: 修复了后台和代理视图会话删除 shell 导出的`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`的问题，该会话将 API 密钥发送到默认端点并失败并返回 401

entries.en: Fixed Bash failing with "argument list too long" in repos with many git worktrees
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 在具有许多 git 工作树的存储库中因“参数列表太长”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree-isolated subagents sometimes running shell commands in the parent checkout instead of their own worktree
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离的子智能体有时在父检出目录而非自己的工作树中运行 shell 命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree creation rejecting nested repositories in multi-repo workspaces, leaving background sessions unable to isolate and edit
entries.zh: 修复多仓库工作区中，工作树创建会拒绝嵌套仓库，导致后台会话无法隔离和编辑的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents crash-looping when their working directory was deleted, replaced by a file, or became an invalid path — they now fail once with a clear error
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理在其工作目录被删除、替换为文件或成为无效路径时崩溃循环的问题 - 现在它们会失败一次并出现明显错误

entries.en: Fixed a background daemon auto-upgrade failure silently killing all running background sessions
entries.zh: 修复了后台守护程序自动升级失败，以静默方式终止所有正在运行的后台会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `TaskStop` and `TaskOutput` failing to find background agents spawned by another agent — errors now list running agents by id and description
entries.zh: 修复了`TaskStop`和`TaskOutput`无法找到另一个代理生成的后台代理的问题 - 错误现在按 ID 和描述列出正在运行的代理

entries.en: Fixed the `claude agents` composer discarding your typed message when a slash command isn't available there
entries.zh: 修复 `claude agents` 编辑器在输入斜杠命令而该命令在此不可用时，丢弃已输入消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed the agent list crashing when opening a stopped session whose conversation was already open in another session
entries.zh: 修复打开已在另一个会话中打开过的已停止会话时，智能体列表崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions showing "Needs input" in the agent list after the question was already answered
entries.zh: 修复了问题已得到解答后，后台会话在代理列表中显示“需要输入”的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agent startup failures showing only "exit_with_message" instead of the actual error
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理启动失败仅显示“exit_with_message”而不是实际错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions ignoring `effortLevel` changes in settings.json when forked through the daemon
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话在通过守护进程分叉时忽略 settings.json 中`effortLevel`更改的问题

entries.en: Fixed attached background sessions ignoring `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE` and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS` opt-outs
entries.zh: 修复了附加后台会话忽略`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE`和`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS`选择退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/exit` incorrectly warning about running background agents after all named agents had completed
entries.zh: 修复了`/exit`在所有指定代理完成后错误地警告运行后台代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions started from a non-git directory unable to edit files when a `WorktreeCreate` hook was configured
entries.zh: 修复了配置`WorktreeCreate`挂钩时从非 git 目录启动的后台会话无法编辑文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `@` directory picker in `claude agents` not showing registered git worktrees
entries.zh: 修复 `claude agents` 中的 `@` 目录选择器不显示已注册的 git 工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed background task output on Windows being permanently replaced by an empty file after `/clear`
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的后台任务输出在`/clear`之后被永久替换为空文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed content jumping when scrolling up through long transcript history
entries.zh: 修复了向上滚动长记录历史记录时内容跳跃的问题

entries.en: Fixed the terminal flickering and jumping while typing in bash mode when a shell-history suggestion was shown
entries.zh: 修复 bash 模式下显示 shell 历史建议时，输入过程中终端闪烁和跳动的问题

entries.en: Fixed literal `^[[I` / `^[[O` escape codes being printed when reattaching to a background session
entries.zh: 修复了重新附加到后台会话时打印的文字`^[[I`/`^[[O`转义代码

entries.en: Fixed LSP-only plugins being incorrectly flagged for disuse when their language servers deliver diagnostics or answer navigation requests
entries.zh: 修复了当语言服务器提供诊断或应答导航请求时仅 LSP 插件被错误标记为不使用的问题
