entries.en: Improved responsiveness while long responses stream: live-preview updates no longer re-render the whole screen
entries.zh: 改进长回复流式输出时的响应速度：实时预览更新不再重绘整个屏幕

entries.en: Improved subagent behavior: agents are now less likely to re-delegate their entire task to another subagent
entries.zh: 改进子智能体行为：智能体更不容易把整个任务再交给另一个子智能体

entries.en: Reduced binary size by ~7 MB and startup memory by ~7 MB by loading a large bundled dependency lazily instead of inlining it
entries.zh: 通过按需加载一个大型内置依赖（而不是直接打包进来），二进制体积减小约 7 MB，启动内存减少约 7 MB

entries.en: Changed left arrow to no longer close the background tasks, diff, and workflow detail views — press Esc instead
entries.zh: 更改了向左箭头，不再关闭后台任务、差异和工作流程详细信息视图 - 按 Esc 键

entries.en: Changed the empty `claude agents` view to always show the organized sections (Needs input / Working / Completed) with descriptions
entries.zh: 更改了空的“克劳德代理”视图，以始终显示有组织的部分（需要输入/工作/已完成）和描述

entries.en: Removed the startup "claude command missing or broken" warnings — they now appear in `/doctor` and `/status` instead
entries.zh: 移除启动时的 "claude command missing or broken" 警告，改为在 `/doctor` 和 `/status` 中显示

entries.en: Removed a redundant navigation hint from the `claude agents` footer
entries.zh: 移除 `claude agents` 底部一条多余的导航提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a Settings toggle for "Enable Remote Control for all sessions"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 设置中新增「Enable Remote Control for all sessions」开关

entries.en: Added a "Dynamic workflow size" setting in `/config` for controlling how large Claude generally makes dynamic workflows (small/medium/large agent counts) — an advisory guideline, not an enforced cap
entries.zh: 在`/config`中添加了“动态工作流程大小”设置，用于控制克劳德通常创建的动态工作流程的大小（小/中/大代理计数）——建议指南，而不是强制上限

entries.en: Added `workflow.run_id` and `workflow.name` OpenTelemetry attributes to telemetry emitted by workflow-spawned agents, so a workflow run's activity can be reconstructed from OTel data
entries.zh: 向工作流生成的代理发出的遥测添加了`workflow.run_id`和`workflow.name` OpenTelemetry 属性，以便可以从 OTel 数据重建工作流运行的活动

entries.en: Fixed a crash in the inline Ctrl+R history search when accepting or cancelling while the search was still scanning the history file
entries.zh: 修复了当搜索仍在扫描历史文件时接受或取消时内联 Ctrl+R 历史搜索中的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` on background sessions being reverted when the job restarts, which broke addressing the session by its new name
entries.zh: 修复了作业重新启动时后台会话上的`/rename`，这会破坏通过新名称对会话进行寻址

entries.en: Fixed transient mTLS handshake failures when settings were re-applied during an in-place client certificate rotation
entries.zh: 修复设置在原地更换客户端证书时被重新应用，导致临时 mTLS 握手失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed commands sent from Remote Control (mobile/web) into an interactive session failing with "Unknown command"
entries.zh: 修复了从远程控制（移动/网络）发送到交互式会话的命令失败并显示“未知命令”的问题

entries.en: Fixed images and files sent from the Remote Control mobile or web app without a caption being silently dropped
entries.zh: 修复了从远程控制移动或网络应用程序发送的图像和文件，且标题没有被静默删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed the sign-in URL printed by `claude auth login` and `claude mcp login --no-browser` not being reliably clickable when it wraps over SSH — it is now emitted as a single hyperlink
entries.zh: 修复 `claude auth login` 和 `claude mcp login --no-browser` 打印的登录链接在 SSH 中换行后无法稳定点击的问题；现在它会作为一个完整超链接输出

entries.en: Fixed opening a chat from `claude agents` sometimes failing with "currently running as a background agent" followed by a worker crash/respawn loop
entries.zh: 修复了从“克劳德代理”打开聊天有时会失败并显示“当前作为后台代理运行”，然后出现工作人员崩溃/重生循环的问题

entries.en: Fixed workflow scripts with unicode quote escapes in strings being corrupted before parsing; workflow parse errors now show the offending line instead of always blaming TypeScript
entries.zh: 修复字符串中含有 Unicode 引号转义的工作流脚本在解析前被损坏的问题；工作流解析错误现在会显示出错行，而不是总是归咎于 TypeScript

entries.en: Fixed voice dictation retrying in an unbounded loop when the microphone or audio recorder fails — repeated capture failures now pause voice input
entries.zh: 修复麦克风或录音器失败时，语音听写会无限循环重试的问题；现在反复的录音失败会暂停语音输入

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` sessions showing the wrong permission mode in the mobile and web apps
entries.zh: 修复了`/remote-control`会话在移动和网络应用程序中显示错误的权限模式

entries.en: Fixed resuming a session by name, or opening the resume picker, taking minutes and using a large amount of memory in repositories with many git worktrees
entries.zh: 修复了按名称恢复会话或打开简历选择器、需要几分钟时间并在具有许多 git 工作树的存储库中使用大量内存的问题

entries.en: Fixed installer and updater downloads failing immediately with "aborted" when a proxy or network drops the connection mid-download — transient connection drops now retry
entries.zh: 修复了当代理或网络在下载过程中断开连接时，安装程序和更新程序下载立即失败并“中止”的问题 - 暂时连接断开现在重试

entries.en: Fixed re-invoking an already-loaded skill appending a duplicate copy of its instructions to context
entries.zh: 修复了重新调用已加载的技能并将其指令的重复副本附加到上下文的问题

entries.en: Improved `/workflows` agent list layout: wider titles, a dedicated time column, shorter model names, and no per-row tool-call counts
entries.zh: 改进 `/workflows` 代理列表布局：标题更宽，新增专门的时间列，模型名称更短，不再显示每行的工具调用次数

entries.en: Improved MCP error messages: clearer error when a server config has `url` but no `type`, suggesting `"type": "http"` instead of the misleading "command: expected string"
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 错误提示：配置中有 `url` 但没有 `type` 时，会给出更清楚的报错，并建议使用 `"type": "http"`，不再误导性地提示“command: expected string”

entries.en: Changed `/review <pr>` back to a fast single-pass review; use `/code-review <level> <pr#>` for the multi-agent review at a chosen effort level
entries.zh: 将 `/review <pr>` 更改回快速单遍审核；使用`/code-review <level> <pr#>`在选定的工作级别进行多代理审核

entries.en: Claude Sonnet 5 sessions no longer use the mid-conversation system role for harness reminders
entries.zh: Claude Sonnet 5 会话不再使用对话中系统角色来进行安全带提醒

entries.en: Changed `AskUserQuestion` dialogs to no longer auto-continue by default; opt into an idle timeout via `/config`
entries.zh: 更改了`AskUserQuestion`对话框，默认情况下不再自动继续；通过`/config`选择空闲超时

entries.en: Changed the "default" permission mode to "Manual" across the CLI, `--help`, VS Code, and JetBrains; `--permission-mode manual` and `"defaultMode": "manual"` are accepted alongside `default`
entries.zh: 将 CLI、`--help`、VS Code 和 JetBrains 中的“默认”权限模式更改为“手动”； `--permission-mode manual` 和 `"defaultMode": "manual"` 与 `default` 一起接受

entries.en: Fixed a crash at startup when `disabledMcpServers` or `enabledMcpServers` in `.claude.json` is set to a non-array value
entries.zh: 修复了当`.claude.json`中的`disabledMcpServers`或`enabledMcpServers`设置为非数组值时启动时崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions silently stopping mid-turn after sleep/wake or when reopening a stalled session
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话在睡眠/唤醒后或重新打开停止的会话时默默停止的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions re-running a turn cancelled with Esc after a stall respawn
entries.zh: 修复了失速重生后使用 Esc 取消的后台会话重新运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents never starting again after a crash left a stale `daemon.lock` whose PID the OS reused
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理在崩溃留下陈旧的`daemon.lock`后永远不会再次启动的问题，其 PID 被操作系统重用

entries.en: Fixed background-agent daemon handover so a reinstalled older build can no longer take over the daemon; build recency is now judged by the version's embedded build timestamp
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理守护进程切换，以便重新安装的旧版本无法再接管守护进程；现在根据版本的嵌入构建时间戳来判断构建新近度

entries.en: Fixed background-agent roster issues: transient corruption permanently disabling orphan cleanup, older binaries not preserving fields written by newer versions, and socket auth tokens being stripped during daemon restarts
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理名册问题：暂时损坏永久禁用孤立清理、较旧的二进制文件不保留较新版本写入的字段以及在守护程序重新启动期间剥离套接字身份验证令牌

entries.en: Fixed subagents cut off by a rate limit before producing any text output returning an empty result instead of failing cleanly
entries.zh: 修复了子代理在生成任何文本输出之前被速率限制切断，返回空结果而不是彻底失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed control bytes from background-agent output reaching the terminal in the agent view
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理输出的控制字节到达代理视图中的终端的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents --plugin-dir <dir>` not showing the plugin's agents and skills in the agent view when the flag is placed after `agents`
entries.zh: 修复了当标志放置在`agents`之后时，“claudeagents --plugin-dir <dir>”不会在代理视图中显示插件的代理和技能

entries.en: Fixed project-scoped plugins not loading correctly from git worktrees of the same repository
entries.zh: 修复了项目范围的插件无法从同一存储库的 git 工作树正确加载的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` server list not tracking focus for screen readers and magnifiers
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`服务器列表不跟踪屏幕阅读器和放大镜焦点的问题

entries.en: Fixed voice dictation showing a misleading "Voice connection failed" message when a recording captures no audio
entries.zh: 修复录音未采集到任何音频时，语音听写显示误导性的"Voice connection failed"信息的问题

entries.en: Fixed rendering flicker under tmux 3.4+ by enabling synchronized terminal output
entries.zh: 通过启用同步终端输出修复了 tmux 3.4+ 下的渲染闪烁

entries.en: Improved screen-reader output: decorative glyphs are now hidden, transcript symbols read as short labels, and nested tables read as `Header: value.` lines
entries.zh: 改进屏幕阅读器输出：装饰性符号被隐藏，转录中的符号读作简短标签，嵌套表格读作 `Header: value.` 形式的行

entries.en: Improved the install script to explain when installation is killed by the system running out of memory
entries.zh: 改进安装脚本：说明安装过程因系统内存不足被终止的情况

entries.en: Stacked slash-skill invocations like `/skill-a /skill-b do XYZ` now load all leading skills (up to 5), not just the first
entries.zh: 连续调用斜杠技能（如 `/skill-a /skill-b 做某事`）时，现在会加载前面所有的技能（最多 5 个），而不只是第一个

entries.en: Fixed SSL certificate errors (TLS-inspecting proxies, missing `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, expired certs) burning retries before showing actionable guidance — they now fail immediately with the fix hint
entries.zh: 修复了 SSL 证书错误（TLS 检查代理、缺少`NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`、过期证书）在显示可操作指导之前进行重试 — 现在，它们会立即失败并显示修复提示

entries.en: Fixed streaming responses being discarded when the API emits a mid-stream overloaded/server error after partial output — the partial is now kept with an incomplete-response notice
entries.zh: 修复了当 API 在部分输出后发出中流过载/服务器错误时被丢弃的流响应 - 部分内容现在保留有不完整响应通知

entries.en: Fixed subagents cut off by a rate limit or server error silently failing instead of returning their partial work to the parent
entries.zh: 修复了因速率限制或服务器错误而导致子代理无提示失败而不是将部分工作返回给父代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents reporting API errors (e.g. usage limit reached) as successful results — the error is now reported to the parent agent
entries.zh: 修复了子代理将 API 错误（例如达到使用限制）报告为成功结果的问题 - 现在将错误报告给父代理

entries.en: Fixed the background-agent daemon on Linux killing itself and every running agent every ~50 seconds after an unclean shutdown left a corrupted worker record
entries.zh: 修复 Linux 上后台智能体守护进程在一次异常关闭留下损坏的工作进程记录后，每约 50 秒自杀并终止所有运行中的智能体的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents failing to cold-start over SSH on macOS with "Could not switch to audit session" (regression in 2.1.196)
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理无法在 macOS 上通过 SSH 冷启动并显示“无法切换到审核会话”的问题（2.1.196 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed `claude stop` being silently undone when it raced a background-agent respawn — the respawn now honors the stop
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德停止”在与后台代理重生竞争时被默默撤消的问题 - 重生现在尊重停止

entries.en: Fixed background job progress indicators stalling for minutes while the job ran long commands
entries.zh: 修复了后台作业进度指示器在作业运行长命令时停滞几分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions on memory-starved machines showing a generic error — they now indicate low memory and suggest freeing resources
entries.zh: 修复了内存不足的机器上显示一般错误的后台会话 - 它们现在指示内存不足并建议释放资源

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions briefly flapping between Working and Idle in the agent view when a background agent completes
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理完成时远程会话在代理视图中的“工作”和“空闲”之间短暂切换的问题

entries.en: Fixed idle subagents vanishing from the agent panel while other subagents were still working; surplus idle agents now collapse into an expandable summary row
entries.zh: 修复了空闲子代理在其他子代理仍在工作时从代理面板中消失的问题；多余的空闲代理现在折叠成可扩展的摘要行

entries.en: Fixed typing `/model` or `/fast` while viewing a subagent silently opening the lead's model picker — a notice now explains the command applies to the lead
entries.zh: 修复查看子智能体时输入 `/model` 或 `/fast`，会静默打开负责人的模型选择器的问题；现在会提示该命令适用于负责人

entries.en: Fixed `SessionStart`, `Setup`, and `SubagentStart` hooks silently hiding stderr when exiting with code 2 — the error is now shown in the transcript
entries.zh: 修复了`SessionStart`、`Setup`和`SubagentStart`挂钩在使用代码 2 退出时默默隐藏 stderr — 错误现在显示在记录中

entries.en: Fixed `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions daemon <subcommand>` being treated as a chat prompt instead of running the subcommand
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --dangerously-skip-permissions daemon <subcommand>`被视为聊天提示而不是运行子命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed `SendMessage` silently misrouting when a re-spawned agent reuses a previous agent's name — the tool now detects the mismatch and asks the caller to retarget
entries.zh: 修复了当重新生成的代理重复使用先前代理的名称时`SendMessage`静默错误路由的问题 - 该工具现在可以检测到不匹配并要求调用者重新定位

entries.en: Fixed opening or resuming a session with no new messages needlessly growing the transcript file
entries.zh: 修复了在没有新消息的情况下打开或恢复会话而不必要地增加脚本文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed backgrounding a session with `←` or `/background` dropping its `/color` from the agent view row
entries.zh: 修复了使用`←`或`/background`从代理视图行删除其`/color`的会话背景

entries.en: Fixed resetting a corrupted config file from the startup recovery dialog destroying it unrecoverably — it now backs up the file first
entries.zh: 修复了从启动恢复对话框重置损坏的配置文件导致其无法恢复的问题 - 现在它首先备份该文件

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome repeatedly opening the reconnect page when sessions run from different builds or config directories
entries.zh: 修复了当会话从不同的构建或配置目录运行时，Chrome 中的 Claude 重复打开重新连接页面的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode not prompting for state-changing browser tool calls; read-only `browser_batch` calls are now correctly auto-allowed
entries.zh: 修复了计划模式不提示状态更改浏览器工具调用的问题；现在可以正确自动允许只读`browser_batch`调用

entries.en: Transient server rate-limit errors (429s unrelated to your usage limit) are now retried automatically with backoff for subscribers instead of failing the turn
entries.zh: 对订阅用户，与用量上限无关的服务器限流错误（429）现在会自动带退避重试，而不是直接导致该轮失败

entries.en: `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` now raises the default retry count for non-capacity transient errors to 300 and lifts the cap of 15 on `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES`
entries.zh: `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` 现在会把非容量类临时错误的默认重试次数提高到 300，并取消 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES` 上限 15 的限制

entries.en: `claude agents` session rows now show pull-request links as bare `#N` without the redundant "PR" label
entries.zh: `claude agents` 会话行中的拉取请求链接现在只显示为 `#N`，去掉了多余的 "PR" 字样

entries.en: Subagents now run in the background by default, so Claude keeps working while they run and is notified when they finish (previously a gradual rollout)
entries.zh: 子代理现在默认在后台运行，Claude 可在它们运行时继续工作，并在完成时收到通知（此前为逐步推出）

entries.en: Claude in Chrome is now generally available
entries.zh: Chrome 中的 Claude 现已全面可用

entries.en: Added background agent notifications in `claude agents` — sessions that need input or finish now fire the `Notification` hook (`agent_needs_input` / `agent_completed`)
entries.zh: 在“claude Agents”中添加了后台代理通知 - 需要输入或完成的会话现在会触发`Notification`挂钩（`agent_needs_input`/`agent_completed`）

entries.en: Added `/dataviz` skill for chart and dashboard design guidance with a runnable color-palette validator
entries.zh: 添加了`/dataviz`技能，用于使用可运行的调色板验证器来指导图表和仪表板设计

entries.en: Gateway: added Claude Platform on AWS (anthropicAws) as an upstream provider; model-not-found responses now advance the failover chain
entries.zh: 网关：新增 Claude Platform on AWS（anthropicAws）作为上游提供商；“找不到模型”的响应现在会推进故障切换链

entries.en: Background agents launched from `claude agents` now commit, push, and open a draft PR when they finish code work in a worktree, instead of stopping to ask
entries.zh: 从“claude Agents”启动的后台代理现在在完成工作树中的代码工作时提交、推送和打开草稿 PR，而不是停下来询问

entries.en: The built-in Explore agent now inherits the main session's model (capped at opus) instead of running on haiku
entries.zh: 内置的 Explore 代理现在继承主会话的模型（最高到 opus），不再固定使用 haiku

entries.en: Subagents and context compaction now inherit the session's extended thinking configuration, improving output quality on delegated tasks
entries.zh: 子代理和上下文压缩现在会继承会话的扩展思考配置，委派任务的输出质量更高

entries.en: Fixed brief network drops mid-response aborting the turn — transient errors like ECONNRESET now retry with backoff instead of failing
entries.zh: 修复了短暂的网络中止响应中止转弯的问题 - 像 ECONNRESET 这样的暂时性错误现在会通过退避重试，而不是失败

entries.en: Fixed excessive background classifier requests when sandboxed processes repeatedly accessed the same network host
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒进程重复访问同一网络主机时过多的后台分类器请求

entries.en: Fixed background tasks in web, desktop, and VS Code task panels getting stuck on "Running" after they finish or after resuming a session
entries.zh: 修复了 Web、桌面和 VS Code 任务面板中的后台任务在完成后或恢复会话后卡在“正在运行”的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: a teammate that dies on an API error now reports "failed" to the lead, and messaging a stuck teammate wakes it to retry immediately
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：因 API 错误而死亡的队友现在向领导报告“失败”，并且向卡住的队友发送消息会唤醒其立即重试

entries.en: Fixed the `/diff` panel not refreshing when you switch branches or commit outside the session
entries.zh: 修复在会话外切换分支或提交后，`/diff` 面板不会刷新的问题

entries.en: Fixed markdown tables overflowing and wrapping their right border when rendered in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下渲染时 Markdown 表格溢出并包裹其右边框的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Platform on AWS and Mantle sessions dead-ending with "Please run /login" when the STS token expires — `awsAuthRefresh` now runs automatically
entries.zh: 修复了 AWS 上的 Claude Platform 和 Mantle 会话在 STS 令牌过期时出现“请运行 /login”的死胡同 — `awsAuthRefresh` 现在会自动运行

entries.en: Fixed "no route to host" for local-network hosts in macOS background agent sessions by declaring Local Network entitlements
entries.zh: 通过声明本地网络权利，修复了 macOS 后台代理会话中本地网络主机的“无主机路由”问题

entries.en: Fixed `/desktop` failing with "Cannot determine working directory" after entering and exiting a worktree
entries.zh: 修复了进入和退出工作树后`/desktop`失败并显示“无法确定工作目录”的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents repeatedly showing "Reconnecting…" every ~52 seconds on macOS while the agents view was open
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图打开时，后台代理在 macOS 上每约 52 秒重复显示“正在重新连接...”的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing `←` inside `claude attach <id>` exiting to the shell instead of opening the agent view
entries.zh: 修复了在“claude Attach <id>”内按`←`退出 shell 而不是打开代理视图的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg` silently creating an unattachable session when combined with `--print`/`-p`; the conflicting flags are now rejected up front
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --bg`与`--print`/`-p`组合时静默创建不可附加会话的问题；冲突的标志现在被预先拒绝

entries.en: Fixed the workflow progress view dropping the earliest agents from the list while the phase counter stayed correct in SDK and desktop-app sessions
entries.zh: 修复在 SDK 和桌面应用会话中，工作流进度视图丢弃列表中最早的智能体、而阶段计数器仍正确的问题

entries.en: Fixed `.claude/rules/` conditional rules not loading when the target file is reached via a symlinked path
entries.zh: 修复了通过符号链接路径到达目标文件时不加载`.claude/rules/`条件规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cmd+click not opening URLs in fullscreen mode in Warp on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了 Cmd+click 在 macOS 上的 Warp 中无法以全屏模式打开 URL 的问题

entries.en: Fixed double-click word selection in fullscreen mode to select the entire URL including the scheme
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下双击单词选择以选择整个 URL（包括方案）的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode not auto-allowing read-only tool calls when a session starts in plan mode
entries.zh: 修复了当会话在计划模式下启动时，计划模式不会自动允许只读工具调用

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` deriving its default fork name from the compaction summary instead of the first real prompt
entries.zh: 修复了从压缩摘要而不是第一个真实提示中派生默认分叉名称的`/branch`

entries.en: Improved focus mode: subagents launched in a turn now appear in its activity summary, and completed background notifications fold into a single count
entries.zh: 改进专注模式：本轮启动的子代理会出现在活动摘要中，已完成的后台通知合并为一个计数

entries.en: Improved syntax highlighting accuracy in code blocks, diffs, and file previews by upgrading to highlight.js 11
entries.zh: 改进代码块、差异和文件预览的语法高亮准确度：升级到 highlight.js 11

entries.en: Keyboard shortcut hints now show opt/cmd instead of alt/super when connected from a Mac over SSH
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 从 Mac 连接时，快捷键提示现在显示 opt/cmd，而不是 alt/super

entries.en: Improved API retry UX: the error reason is now shown after the second attempt, and a status page link replaces the spinner tip when the API is overloaded
entries.zh: 改进 API 重试体验：第二次尝试后会显示出错原因；API 过载时，用状态页链接代替加载提示

entries.en: `/login` now opens the sign-in dialog from the `claude agents` view instead of saying it isn't available
entries.zh: `/login` 现在会从 `claude agents` 视图打开登录对话框，而不再提示不可用

entries.en: Subagents now treat messages from the agent that launched them as normal task direction; an agent's message is still never treated as the user's approval
entries.zh: 子代理现在把启动它的代理发来的消息视为正常的任务指示；但代理的消息仍然绝不会被当作用户的批准

entries.en: Removed the `/agents` wizard; ask Claude to create or manage subagents, or edit `.claude/agents/` directly
entries.zh: 移除 `/agents` 向导；请让 Claude 创建或管理子代理，或直接编辑 `.claude/agents/`

entries.en: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5: now the default model in Claude Code, with a native 1M-token context window and promotional pricing of $2/$10 per Mtok through August 31. Update to version 2.1.197 for access. https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-5
entries.zh: 推出 Claude Sonnet 5：现已成为 Claude Code 的默认模型，原生支持 100 万 token 的上下文窗口，促销价为每百万 token 2 美元（输入）/ 10 美元（输出），截至 8 月 31 日。需更新到 2.1.197 版本才能使用。https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-5

entries.en: Added support for organization default models — admins set it in the org console; it shows as "Org default" (or "Role default") in `/model` when you haven't picked one yourself
entries.zh: 添加了对组织默认模型的支持 - 管理员在组织控制台中设置它；当您自己没有选择一个时，它会在`/model`中显示为“组织默认值”（或“角色默认值”）

entries.en: Added readable default names for sessions at start, making them easier to identify and message
entries.zh: 在启动时为会话添加了可读的默认名称，使它们更易于识别和发送消息

entries.en: Added clickable file attachments in chat — Cmd/Ctrl-click reveals the file in Finder/Explorer
entries.zh: 在聊天中添加了可点击的文件附件 - Cmd/Ctrl-单击在 Finder/Explorer 中显示文件

entries.en: Security: `claude mcp list`/`get` no longer spawn `.mcp.json` servers that a repo self-approved via a committed `.claude/settings.json`; untrusted workspaces show `⏸ Pending approval`
entries.zh: 安全：`claude mcp list`/`get` 不再启动仓库通过已提交的 `.claude/settings.json` 自行批准的 `.mcp.json` 服务器；不受信任的工作区会显示 `⏸ Pending approval`

entries.en: Fixed waking a background job permanently deleting its conversation and re-running the original prompt when the transcript probe misread a real transcript; the file is now set aside, never deleted
entries.zh: 修复唤醒后台任务时，因转录探测误读了真实转录，导致其对话被永久删除并重新执行原始提示的问题；现在该文件会被另行存放，而不会被删除

entries.en: Fixed the rate-limit warning flickering off and rate-limit telemetry being over-counted when multiple parallel requests were in flight at the moment a usage limit was hit
entries.zh: 修复在碰到用量上限的瞬间有多个并行请求在途时，速率限制警告闪烁熄灭，且速率限制遥测被多计数的问题

entries.en: Fixed duplicate recap lines after a background session's turn: a schema-rejected StructuredOutput attempt no longer renders alongside its retry
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话轮后重复的回顾行：模式拒绝的 StructuredOutput 尝试不再与重试一起呈现

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell `git diff`/`git grep`, `egrep`/`fgrep`, and quoted search patterns containing `|` being reported as failures when they exit 1, matching Bash behavior
entries.zh: 修复了 PowerShell `git diff`/`git grep`、`egrep`/`fgrep` 以及包含 `|` 的引用搜索模式在退出 1 时被报告为失败的问题，与 Bash 行为相匹配

entries.en: Fixed multiple `claude agents` side panel issues: keyboard focus getting stuck when opening an agent, background jobs losing their subagent types on every open, and sessions showing incorrect status while actively running
entries.zh: 修复了多个“克劳德代理”侧面板问题：打开代理时键盘焦点卡住，后台作业在每次打开时丢失其子代理类型，以及会话在主动运行时显示不正确的状态

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions` silently falling back to auto mode instead of showing the bypass disclaimer and applying bypass mode to spawned agents
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents --dangerously-skip-permissions”默默地回退到自动模式，而不是显示绕过免责声明并将旁路模式应用于生成的代理

entries.en: Fixed mid-turn crash recovery for Remote sessions — sessions interrupted by a server restart now auto-resume on the next worker
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话的中途崩溃恢复 - 由于服务器重启而中断的会话现在可以在下一个工作人员上自动恢复

entries.en: Fixed sessions moved with `/cd` reappearing in the old directory's resume list after a non-graceful exit when the old path contained special characters
entries.zh: 修复了当旧路径包含特殊字符时，在非正常退出后，使用`/cd`移动的会话重新出现在旧目录的恢复列表中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` skipping local plugins whose source is "." and stopping after the first error class
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`跳过源为“.”的本地插件的问题。并在第一个错误类别后停止

entries.en: Fixed Esc Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind menu (regression); use Ctrl+C or Ctrl+X Ctrl+K to stop background agents
entries.zh: 修复了空闲提示时 Esc Esc 不打开快退菜单的问题（回归）；使用 Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+X Ctrl+K 停止后台代理

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth requesting the authorization server's full `scopes_supported` catalog when no scope is specified, causing `invalid_scope` failures on GitLab self-hosted and other enterprise IdPs
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP OAuth 在未指定范围时请求授权服务器的完整`scopes_supported`目录，导致 GitLab 自托管和其他企业 IdP 上的`invalid_scope`失败

entries.en: Fixed `/context` showing 0 tokens for all tool groups on Bedrock
entries.zh: 修复了基岩上所有工具组的`/context`显示 0 标记的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/deep-research` misreporting verifier failures as "all claims refuted" instead of `unverified`
entries.zh: 修复了`/deep-research`将验证器失败误报为“所有声明均被驳回”而不是“未经验证”的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin dependency version pins not being honored when the marketplace was added as a local folder path backed by a git repo
entries.zh: 修复了当市场被添加为 git 存储库支持的本地文件夹路径时，插件依赖版本引脚不被接受的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` session status: completed rows no longer flip between "Done" and "Needs your input", stalled agents are now labeled "Needs attention", and results that mention a PR show a clickable link
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”会话状态：已完成的行不再在“完成”和“需要您的输入”之间切换，停滞的代理现在被标记为“需要注意”，提及 PR 的结果显示可点击的链接

entries.en: Fixed voice dictation swallowing spaces and spuriously starting a recording during very fast typing when voice mode is enabled
entries.zh: 修复开启语音模式后，极快速打字时语音听写吞掉空格并意外开始录音的问题

entries.en: Improved background session reliability: long-running commands and workflows now survive the session's process being stopped, restarted, or updated — including on Windows, where background shells are handed off instead of being killed
entries.zh: 改进后台会话可靠性：长时间运行的命令和工作流，在会话进程被停止、重启或更新后仍能存活，包括 Windows 上后台 shell 会被移交而不是被终止

entries.en: Improved background agents: workers killed by a daemon restart are now automatically resumed from where they left off the next time the agents view opens
entries.zh: 改进后台 agent：因守护进程重启而中断的 worker，下次打开 agents 视图时会自动从中断处恢复

entries.en: Improved `/code-review` workflow: merged five cleanup finders into one, cutting token usage by roughly 25%
entries.zh: 改进 `/code-review` 流程：把五个清理检查器合并为一个，token 用量约减少 25%

entries.en: Reduced per-frame rendering work in the terminal UI by skipping no-op subtree walks during streaming
entries.zh: 流式输出期间跳过无变化的子树遍历，终端界面每帧的渲染工作量降低

entries.en: The streaming idle watchdog is now on by default for all providers — it aborts and retries when a response stream produces no events for 5 minutes. Set `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=0` to disable.
entries.zh: 流式空闲看门狗现已对所有提供商默认开启：响应流超过 5 分钟没有任何事件时，会中止并重试。设置 `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=0` 可关闭

entries.en: Remote Control is now disabled when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at a non-Anthropic host, matching the existing behavior under `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK`/`_VERTEX`/`_FOUNDRY`
entries.zh: 当 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 指向非 Anthropic 主机时，Remote Control 现已禁用，与 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK`/`_VERTEX`/`_FOUNDRY` 下的现有行为一致

entries.en: Changed opening the agents view from a foreground session to require a single `←` press instead of two, matching the behavior in background sessions
entries.zh: 更改了从前台会话打开代理视图的方式，要求按一次`←`而不是两次，与后台会话中的行为相匹配

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS` to disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode while keeping wheel scroll
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS`以在全屏模式下禁用鼠标单击/拖动/悬停，同时保持滚轮滚动

entries.en: Fixed hook matchers with hyphenated identifiers (e.g. `code-reviewer`, `mcp__brave-search`) accidentally substring-matching — they now exact-match. Use `mcp__brave-search__.*` to match all tools from a hyphenated MCP server.
entries.zh: 修复了带有连字符标识符的钩子匹配器（例如`code-reviewer`、`mcp__brave-search`）意外的子字符串匹配 - 它们现在完全匹配。使用`mcp__brave-search__.*`匹配来自连字符 MCP 服务器的所有工具。

entries.en: Fixed voice dictation on macOS capturing silence in long-running sessions after the default input device changes
entries.zh: 修复 macOS 上长时间运行的会话中，默认输入设备切换后，语音听写录入静音的问题

entries.en: Fixed voice dictation auto-submit never firing for languages written without spaces (Japanese, Chinese, Thai)
entries.zh: 修复语音听写在无空格书写的语言（日语、中文、泰语）中，自动提交从不触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed external plugins enabled only by project `.claude/settings.json` not requiring explicit install consent on every loader path
entries.zh: 修复了仅由项目`.claude/settings.json`启用的外部插件，不需要在每个加载器路径上明确安装同意

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Enable/Disable not working when a plugin's `plugin.json` `name` differs from its marketplace entry name
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的`plugin.json`“名称”与其市场条目名称不同时`/plugin`启用/禁用不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed background jobs disappearing from `claude agents` or losing data when written by a newer Claude Code version
entries.zh: 修复了后台作业从“克劳德代理”消失或由较新的克劳德代码版本编写时丢失数据的问题

entries.en: Fixed reopening a crashed background task showing a blank screen for up to 5 seconds instead of its restart
entries.zh: 修复了重新打开崩溃的后台任务时显示黑屏长达 5 秒而不是重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agent daemons running unreachable when the control socket fails to start, blocking restarts
entries.zh: 修复了控制套接字无法启动时无法访问的后台代理守护进程，阻止重新启动

entries.en: Improved voice mode on Linux: now distinguishes "no microphone" from "SoX not installed" when SoX is present but no audio capture device exists
entries.zh: 改进 Linux 上的语音模式：当安装了 SoX 但没有音频采集设备时，能区分「没有麦克风」和「未安装 SoX」

entries.en: Improved `claude agents` completed list to fill available vertical space; on short terminals the header compacts so live sessions stay visible
entries.zh: 改进 `claude agents` 的已完成列表：填满可用的垂直空间；在较矮的终端中，标题会压缩，以确保实时会话仍然可见

entries.en: Improved Remote session startup with a provisioning checklist while the container starts
entries.zh: 改进远程会话启动：容器启动期间显示准备清单

entries.en: Added `autoMode.classifyAllShell` setting to route all Bash/PowerShell commands through the auto-mode classifier instead of only arbitrary-code-execution patterns
entries.zh: 添加了`autoMode.classifyAllShell`设置，以通过自动模式分类器路由所有 Bash/PowerShell 命令，而不仅仅是任意代码执行模式

entries.en: Added auto-mode denial reasons to the transcript, the denial toast, and `/permissions` recent denials
entries.zh: 在记录、拒绝 toast 和`/permissions`最近拒绝中添加了自动模式拒绝原因

entries.en: Added `claude_code.assistant_response` OpenTelemetry log event containing the model's response text. Redacted unless `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1`; when that var is unset it follows `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`, so deployments that already log prompt content will start receiving response content on upgrade — set `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0` to keep prompts-only.
entries.zh: 添加了包含模型响应文本的`claude_code.assistant_response` OpenTelemetry 日志事件。已编辑，除非`OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1`；当该变量未设置时，它遵循`OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`，因此已经记录提示内容的部署将在升级时开始接收响应内容 - 设置`OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0`以仅保留提示。

entries.en: Added live file path autocomplete to bash mode (`!`)
entries.zh: 向 bash 模式添加了实时文件路径自动完成功能 (`!`)

entries.en: Added a startup notice when MCP servers need authentication, pointing at `/mcp`
entries.zh: 添加了 MCP 服务器需要身份验证时的启动通知，指向`/mcp`

entries.en: Added automatic memory-pressure reaping for idle background shell commands (disable with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP=1`)
entries.zh: 为空闲后台 shell 命令添加了自动内存压力收获（使用`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP=1`禁用）

entries.en: Fixed `/model` and other client-data-gated UI showing stale/empty state immediately after `/login`
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`和其他客户端数据门控 UI 在`/login`后立即显示陈旧/空状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed backgrounding (←←) spuriously cancelling with "N background tasks would be abandoned" when all running tasks carry over to the new session
entries.zh: 当所有正在运行的任务转移到新会话时，修复了后台 (←←) 虚假取消“N 个后台任务将被放弃”的问题

entries.en: Fixed pinned background agents being re-prompted to "Continue from where you left off" after every auto-update
entries.zh: 修复了每次自动更新后固定的后台代理都会重新提示“从上次中断的地方继续”的问题

entries.en: Fixed backgrounding the main turn spawning a phantom "general-purpose (resumed)" subagent that re-ran the main conversation
entries.zh: 修复了主要回合的后台生成一个幻影“通用（已恢复）”子代理，该子代理重新运行主要对话

entries.en: Fixed agent panel hiding sibling agents when viewing a subagent
entries.zh: 修复了查看子代理时代理面板隐藏同级代理的问题

entries.en: Improved background agents: the launch result no longer instructs Claude to "end your response" — it keeps working on other tasks while the agent runs
entries.zh: 改进后台 agent：启动结果不再指示 Claude“结束你的回复”，代理运行期间它会继续处理其他任务

entries.en: Improved MCP `headersHelper` auth: the helper now re-runs and reconnects automatically when a tool call returns 401/403
entries.zh: 改进 MCP `headersHelper` 认证：工具调用返回 401/403 时，辅助程序会自动重新运行并重新连接

entries.en: Improved plugin auto-rename: marketplace `renames` maps are now followed automatically, updating your settings to the new name
entries.zh: 改进插件自动重命名：现在会自动遵循市场中的 `renames` 映射，并把你的设置更新为新名称

entries.en: Improved `/add-dir` message when the directory is already a working directory
entries.zh: 改进 `/add-dir` 的提示：目录已经是工作目录时，给出更清楚的信息

entries.en: Added `/rewind` support for resuming a conversation from before `/clear` was run
entries.zh: 添加了`/rewind`支持，用于从运行`/clear`之前恢复对话

entries.en: Fixed scroll position jumping to the bottom while reading earlier output during a streaming response
entries.zh: 修复了在流响应期间读取较早输出时滚动位置跳到底部的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents resurrecting after being stopped — stopping an agent from the tasks panel is now permanent
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理在被停止后复活的问题 - 从任务面板停止代理现在是永久性的

entries.en: Fixed `/voice` showing a generic "not available" message when disabled by an organization's policy — it now explains the restriction
entries.zh: 修复了`/voice`在被组织策略禁用时显示通用“不可用”消息的问题 - 现在它解释了该限制

entries.en: Fixed `/login` URL opening truncated in Windows Terminal when it wraps across lines
entries.zh: 修复了`/login` URL 打开在 Windows 终端中换行时被截断的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cmd+click on links in fullscreen mode for Ghostty over ssh/tmux
entries.zh: 修复了通过 ssh/tmux 在全屏模式下使用 Cmd+单击 Ghostty 链接的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` sending builtin slash commands like `/usage` to background sessions as prompt text instead of showing a hint
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”将内置斜杠命令（例如`/usage`）作为提示文本发送到后台会话而不是显示提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` job rows showing full filesystem paths for pasted images instead of the `[Image #N]` placeholder
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”作业行显示粘贴图像的完整文件系统路径，而不是`[Image #N]`占位符

entries.en: Fixed hooks with comma-separated matchers (e.g. `"Bash,PowerShell"`) silently never firing
entries.zh: 修复了带有逗号分隔匹配器的钩子（例如`“Bash，PowerShell”`）默默地从不触发

entries.en: Fixed `/permissions` Recently-denied tab: approving a denial now persists on close instead of being silently discarded
entries.zh: 修复了`/permissions`最近被拒绝的选项卡：批准拒绝现在在关闭时持续存在，而不是被默默丢弃

entries.en: Fixed the agent panel jumping by one row when scrolling the roster past the overflow cap
entries.zh: 修复智能体列表超出溢出上限滚动时，智能体面板跳动一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed the welcome splash art overflowing the default 80×24 macOS Terminal window
entries.zh: 修复欢迎启动画面的艺术图在默认 80×24 的 macOS 终端窗口中溢出的问题

entries.en: Fixed managed settings: `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` now takes effect when set via MDM or file policy, and the fetch sends `Cache-Control: no-cache` to prevent proxies from serving stale responses
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置：`forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`现在在通过 MDM 或文件策略设置时生效，并且获取会发送`Cache-Control: no-cache`以防止代理提供过时的响应

entries.en: Improved sandbox network permission dialog: hosts you allow with "Yes" are now remembered for the rest of the session instead of re-prompting on every connection
entries.zh: 改进沙盒网络权限对话框：选择「是」允许的主机在本次会话中会被记住，不再每次连接都重新询问

entries.en: Improved MCP server reliability: capability discovery (`tools/list`, `prompts/list`, `resources/list`) now retries transient network errors with short backoff
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 服务器可靠性：能力发现（`tools/list`、`prompts/list`、`resources/list`）遇到临时网络错误时，会短暂退避后重试

entries.en: Improved MCP OAuth: discovery and token requests now retry once after transient network errors, and headless environments skip the browser popup and go straight to the paste-the-URL prompt
entries.zh: 改进 MCP OAuth：发现和令牌请求遇到临时网络错误时会重试一次；无界面环境会跳过浏览器弹窗，直接进入“粘贴网址”提示

entries.en: Improved MCP error messages: HTTP 404 errors now show the URL and point to your MCP config
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 错误提示：HTTP 404 错误现在会显示网址，并指向你的 MCP 配置

entries.en: Improved vim mode prompt-history search (NORMAL `/`) to hint how to reach slash commands
entries.zh: 改进 vim 模式下的提示历史搜索（NORMAL 模式下按 `/`）：会提示如何进入斜杠命令

entries.en: Reduced CPU usage during streaming responses by ~37% by coalescing text updates to 100ms
entries.zh: 通过把文本更新合并为每 100 毫秒一次，流式输出时 CPU 占用降低约 37%

entries.en: Reduced long-session memory growth from terminal output cache
entries.zh: 通过限制终端输出缓存，减缓长会话中的内存增长

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added `sandbox.credentials` setting to block sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret environment variables
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.credentials`设置以阻止沙盒命令读取凭证文件和秘密环境变量

entries.en: Added org-configured model restrictions to the model picker, `--model`, `/model`, and `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`, with a "restricted by your organization's settings" message when a restricted model is selected
entries.zh: 向模型选择器`--model`、`/model`和`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`添加了组织配置的模型限制，当选择受限模型时会显示“受组织设置限制”消息

entries.en: Added mouse click support to select menus (permission prompts, `/model`, `/config`, etc.) in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 添加了鼠标单击支持在全屏模式下选择菜单（权限提示、`/model`、`/config` 等）

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` failing with "No conversation found" when the original `-p` run produced no model turns
entries.zh: 修复了当原始`-p`运行没有产生模型转向时`--resume`失败并显示“未找到对话”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--json-schema` and workflow `agent({schema})` structured output: the model can no longer re-call `StructuredOutput` indefinitely after a successful call, and follow-up turns now reliably return structured output
entries.zh: 修复了 `--json-schema` 和工作流程 `agent({schema})` 结构化输出：模型无法在成功调用后无限期地重新调用 `StructuredOutput`，并且后续轮次现在可以可靠地返回结构化输出

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP tool calls that hang with no response for 5 minutes — they now abort with an error instead of blocking indefinitely (override with `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT`)
entries.zh: 修复了 5 分钟内挂起且无响应的远程 MCP 工具调用 — 它们现在会因错误而中止，而不是无限期地阻塞（使用`CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT`覆盖）

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code Remote sessions taking ~2.7s longer to start after the agent proxy CA system-trust install was added
entries.zh: 修复了添加代理 CA 系统信任安装后 Claude Code 远程会话启动时间延长约 2.7 秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasted Korean/CJK text turning into mojibake in terminals that deliver paste as per-byte extended-key events
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴的韩语/CJK 文本在以每字节扩展键事件形式提供粘贴的终端中变成 mojibake 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/update` over Remote Control hanging when a startup trust dialog would have shown
entries.zh: 修复了当显示启动信任对话框时`/update`在远程控制上挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed background jobs in the agents view getting stuck in "working" indefinitely when the agent ended a turn without producing structured output
entries.zh: 修复了当代理结束回合而不产生结构化输出时，代理视图中的后台作业无限期地陷入“工作”状态

entries.en: Fixed channel connections dropping after navigating to the agents view and back, and after `/bg`, `/tui`, or `/update`
entries.zh: 修复了导航到代理视图并返回后以及在`/bg`、`/tui`或`/update`之后通道连接丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent stop notifications not correctly attributing who stopped the agent, and improved wording ("finished"/"stopped" instead of "came to rest")
entries.zh: 修复了代理停止通知无法正确归因谁停止代理的问题，并改进了措辞（“完成”/“停止”而不是“开始休息”）

entries.en: Fixed subagent depth tracking: resumed subagents now restore their original spawn depth, and forked subagents now count toward the depth cap
entries.zh: 修复了子代理深度跟踪：恢复的子代理现在恢复其原始生成深度，分叉的子代理现在计入深度上限

entries.en: Fixed leaked agent worktree registrations: locked `.git/worktrees/` entries from killed agents are now cleaned up automatically
entries.zh: 修复了泄漏的代理工作树注册：现在会自动清除被杀死的代理中锁定的`.git/worktrees/`条目

entries.en: Fixed Cmd+click not opening URLs in fullscreen mode in Ghostty on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上的 Ghostty 中 Cmd+click 无法在全屏模式下打开 URL 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --help` not listing the `--bg`/`--background` flag
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --help`未列出`--bg`/`--background`标志的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc, Ctrl-C, and Ctrl-D not working while `/share` is uploading
entries.zh: 修复了`/share`上传时 Esc、Ctrl-C 和 Ctrl-D 不起作用的问题

entries.en: Improved `/install-github-app`: GitHub Actions workflow setup is now optional — you can install just the GitHub App and skip the workflow/secret steps
entries.zh: 改进 `/install-github-app`：GitHub Actions 工作流设置改为可选，可以只安装 GitHub App，跳过工作流和密钥步骤

entries.en: Improved `/btw` with ←/→ arrow navigation to step through earlier answers
entries.zh: 改进 `/btw`：支持用 ←/→ 方向键切换查看之前的回答

entries.en: Improved `/plugin` to surface plugins you haven't used recently so you can clean them up
entries.zh: 改进 `/plugin`：会列出你最近没用过的插件，方便清理

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed extension becoming unresponsive when resuming a large session
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复恢复大型会话时扩展失去响应的问题

entries.en: Added `claude mcp login <name>` and `claude mcp logout <name>` to authenticate MCP servers from the CLI without opening the interactive `/mcp` menu, with `--no-browser` stdin redirect support for completing over SSH
entries.zh: 添加了`claude mcp login <name>`和`claude mcp logout <name>`，以从 CLI 验证 MCP 服务器，而无需打开交互式`/mcp`菜单，并通过`--no-browser`标准输入重定向支持通过 SSH 完成

entries.en: Added status filtering (press `f`) to the `/workflows` agent detail view
entries.zh: 添加状态过滤（按`f`）到`/workflows`代理详细信息视图

entries.en: Added a "Skills" section to the `/plugin` Installed tab
entries.zh: 在`/plugin`已安装选项卡中添加了“技能”部分

entries.en: Added `teammateMode: "iterm2"` setting with a warning when auto mode cannot find the `it2` CLI
entries.zh: 添加了 `teammateMode: "iterm2"` 设置，并在自动模式找不到 `it2` CLI 时发出警告

entries.en: Added "Claude Platform on AWS - refresh credentials" option to `/login` when `awsAuthRefresh` is configured
entries.zh: 配置`awsAuthRefresh`时，在`/login`中添加了“AWS 上的 Claude Platform - 刷新凭证”选项

entries.en: `!` bash commands now trigger Claude to respond to the output automatically; set `"respondToBashCommands": false` in settings.json to keep the previous context-only behavior
entries.zh: `!` 开头的 bash 命令现在会触发 Claude 自动对输出作出回应；如需保留之前仅作为上下文的行为，请在 settings.json 中设置 `"respondToBashCommands": false`

entries.en: Fixed streaming requests failing with "Content block not found" or JSON parse errors after the machine wakes from sleep
entries.zh: 修复了机器从睡眠状态唤醒后，流请求因“未找到内容块”或 JSON 解析错误而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagent transcript scroll position bleeding into the main transcript on exit
entries.zh: 修复了退出时子代理记录滚动位置渗入主记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed background task previews flashing raw tool names before the agent's plan loaded
entries.zh: 修复了后台任务预览在加载代理计划之前闪烁原始工具名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed Chrome tab-group isolation not applying when the in-product permissions gate is off for concurrent CLI sessions
entries.zh: 修复了当并发 CLI 会话的产品内权限门关闭时 Chrome 选项卡组隔离不适用的问题

entries.en: Fixed background session recaps being duplicated; the agent's own end-of-turn summary now shows as the recap line
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话回顾重复的问题；代理自己的回合结束摘要现在显示为回顾行

entries.en: Fixed opening a background session from `claude agents` leaving the previous screen painted behind it
entries.zh: 修复了从“claude Agents”打开后台会话并将前一个屏幕绘制在其后面的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Agent(type)` deny rules and `Agent(x,y)` allowed-types restrictions not being enforced for named subagent spawns
entries.zh: 修复了`Agent(type)`拒绝规则和`Agent(x,y)`允许类型限制未对命名子代理生成强制执行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc and Ctrl+C not responding while background agents are still running after the main turn ends
entries.zh: 修复了主回合结束后后台代理仍在运行时 Esc 和 Ctrl+C 没有响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed misaligned option numbers in permission prompts when the option text overflows
entries.zh: 修复了选项文本溢出时权限提示中选项编号未对齐的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing `x` on a finished subagent in the agent panel not dismissing it
entries.zh: 修复了在代理面板中按已完成的子代理上的`x`不会将其关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed a misleading "MCP server disconnected" notice for intentionally retired tools when resuming older sessions
entries.zh: 修复了恢复旧会话时故意停用的工具的误导性“MCP 服务器已断开连接”通知

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Installed showing a "more above" indicator when already scrolled to the top
entries.zh: 修复了已安装的`/plugin`在滚动到顶部时显示“更多上方”指示器的问题

entries.en: Fixed `~~strikethrough~~` showing literal tildes in assistant messages instead of rendering as strikethrough
entries.zh: 修复了“~~删除线~~”在助理消息中显示文字波浪线而不是呈现为删除线的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--tools` allowing feature-gated tools to slip through before flags loaded on a cold first launch
entries.zh: 修复了`--tools`，允许功能门控工具在首次冷启动时加载标志之前滑过

entries.en: Fixed background job status in `claude agents` showing a stale "needs input" message after replying
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”中的后台作业状态，在回复后显示陈旧的“需要输入”消息

entries.en: Fixed a dark-theme flash when opening a background session from `claude agents` on a light terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在轻型终端上从“克劳德代理”打开后台会话时出现的深色主题闪烁问题

entries.en: Fixed mouse-selected text staying highlighted after deleting it in `claude agents`
entries.zh: 修复了在“克劳德代理”中删除鼠标选择的文本后保持突出显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed session cost not showing for usage-based Enterprise and Team subscribers
entries.zh: 修复了基于使用情况的企业和团队订阅者不显示会话成本的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: teammates spawned via tmux/pane backends now inherit the leader's `--effort` level
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：通过 tmux/pane 后端生成的队友现在继承领导者的`--effort`级别

entries.en: Fixed Workflow `agent({schema})` subagents looping forever on repeated schema validation failures instead of aborting after 5 attempts
entries.zh: 修复了工作流程`agent({schema})`子代理在重复的架构验证失败时永远循环，而不是在 5 次尝试后中止

entries.en: Improved `claude mcp get` and `claude mcp remove` to suggest the closest configured server name on a typo and truncate long server lists
entries.zh: 改进 `claude mcp get` 和 `claude mcp remove`：拼错服务器名时，建议最接近的已配置名称；服务器列表过长时会截断显示

entries.en: Improved memory: the agent is now reminded to compact its `MEMORY.md` index when nearing the size limit
entries.zh: 改进内存：接近大小上限时，会提醒 agent 压缩其 `MEMORY.md` 索引

entries.en: Improved skill frontmatter: `display-name`, `default-enabled`, `fallback`, and `metadata.*` keys now accept kebab-case, snake_case, and camelCase
entries.zh: 改进技能 frontmatter：`display-name`、`default-enabled`、`fallback` 和 `metadata.*` 等键现在支持 kebab-case、snake_case 和 camelCase 三种写法

entries.en: Improved malformed `SKILL.md` YAML frontmatter handling: loads the skill body with empty metadata instead of failing silently
entries.zh: 改进 `SKILL.md` 的 YAML frontmatter 格式错误处理：以空元数据加载技能正文，而不是静默失败

entries.en: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES` to cap at 15; for unattended sessions, use `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` instead
entries.zh: 将 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES` 更改为上限为 15；对于无人值守会话，请改用`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`

entries.en: Changed background subagents to surface permission prompts in the main session instead of auto-denying; the dialog shows which agent is asking, and Esc denies just that tool
entries.zh: 将后台子代理更改为在主会话中显示权限提示，而不是自动拒绝；对话框显示哪个代理正在询问，Esc 拒绝该工具

entries.en: Changed `/review <pr>` to use the same review engine as `/code-review medium`
entries.zh: 更改了`/review <pr>`以使用与“/code-reviewmedium”相同的审核引擎

entries.en: The stream-stall hint now reads "Waiting for API response · will retry in …" instead of "No response from API · Retrying in …", and triggers after 20s of silence instead of 10s
entries.zh: 流停滞提示现在显示 "Waiting for API response · will retry in …"，而不再是 "No response from API · Retrying in …"；静默时间从 10 秒改为 20 秒后触发

entries.en: Improved auto mode safety: destructive git commands (`git reset --hard`, `git checkout -- .`, `git clean -fd`, `git stash drop`) are now blocked when you didn't ask to discard local work, `git commit --amend` is blocked when the commit wasn't made by the agent this session, and `terraform destroy`/`pulumi destroy`/`cdk destroy` are blocked unless you asked for the specific stack
entries.zh: 改进自动模式的安全性：你没要求丢弃本地工作时，屏蔽破坏性 git 命令（`git reset --hard`、`git checkout -- .`、`git clean -fd`、`git stash drop`）；本会话中非代理创建的提交，禁止 `git commit --amend`；除非你明确要求某个具体堆栈，否则屏蔽 `terraform destroy`、`pulumi destroy`、`cdk destroy`

entries.en: Added a warning when the requested model is deprecated or automatically updated to a newer model, shown on stderr in print mode (`-p`) and now also covering models set in agent frontmatter
entries.zh: 添加了当请求的模型被弃用或自动更新为较新模型时发出的警告，以打印模式（`-p`）显示在 stderr 上，现在还覆盖代理 frontmatter 中设置的模型

entries.en: Added `attribution.sessionUrl` setting to omit the claude.ai session link from commits and PRs in web and Remote Control sessions
entries.zh: 添加了`attribution.sessionUrl`设置，以忽略 Web 和远程控制会话中提交和 PR 中的 claude.ai 会话链接

entries.en: Added `/config --help` to list all available shorthand keys for `/config key=value`
entries.zh: 添加了`/config --help`以列出`/config key=value`的所有可用简写键

entries.en: Changed `/config` toggle behavior: Enter and Space both change the selected setting, and Esc now saves and closes instead of reverting
entries.zh: 更改了`/config`切换行为：Enter 和 Space 都会更改所选设置，Esc 现在保存并关闭而不是恢复

entries.en: Removed the startup "setup issues" line under the logo — run `/doctor` to see configuration issues or use `--debug`
entries.zh: 移除 logo 下方启动时的 "setup issues" 一行；如需查看配置问题，请运行 `/doctor` 或使用 `--debug`

entries.en: Fixed `thinking.disabled.display: Extra inputs are not permitted` 400 errors on subagent spawns and session-title generation for affected configurations
entries.zh: 修复了受影响配置的子代理生成和会话标题生成上的“thinking.disabled.display：不允许额外输入”400 错误

entries.en: Fixed WebSearch returning empty results in subagents
entries.zh: 修复了 WebSearch 在子代理中返回空结果的问题

entries.en: Fixed the terminal cursor being stranded above the prompt after navigating history in vim mode with the native cursor enabled
entries.zh: 修复原生光标启用时，在 vim 模式中浏览历史后，终端光标被留在提示框上方的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen TUI corruption (statusline mid-screen, duplicated spinner rows, merged text) in Windows Terminal under heavy nested-subagent load
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套子代理负载过重时 Windows 终端中的全屏 TUI 损坏（屏幕中状态线、重复的微调器行、合并文本）

entries.en: Fixed turns silently completing with no visible output when the model returned only a thinking block; Claude now re-prompts once
entries.zh: 修复模型只返回了思考块时，回合静默完成且没有任何可见输出的问题；现在 Claude 会自动重新提示一次

entries.en: Fixed user-level skills appearing multiple times in slash-command autocomplete when multiple plugins are enabled
entries.zh: 修复主目录或配置目录被移动后（例如在绑定挂载的 devcontainer 中），用户安装的插件和市场报"cache-miss"无法加载的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers requiring authentication exposing auth-stub tools to the model in headless/SDK mode
entries.zh: 修复了需要身份验证的 MCP 服务器，在 headless/SDK 模式下将 auth-stub 工具暴露给模型

entries.en: Fixed tmux teammate panes failing to launch when the shell has slow rc-file initialization, and keystrokes typed during agent spawn leaking into the new tmux pane instead of the leader prompt
entries.zh: 修复 shell 的 rc 文件初始化较慢时，tmux 队友窗格无法启动，以及智能体启动期间输入的按键泄漏到新的 tmux 窗格而非负责人提示框的问题

entries.en: Fixed background tasks started by a teammate being killed when the teammate finishes a turn
entries.zh: 修复了队友完成回合后被杀死而启动的后台任务

entries.en: Fixed scheduled task and webhook trigger deliveries being treated as keyboard input; they now classify as task notifications and can no longer approve a pending action or set the session title in auto mode
entries.zh: 修复了计划任务和 webhook 触发器交付被视为键盘输入的问题；他们现在分类为任务通知，并且不能再批准待处理的操作或在自动模式下设置会话标题

entries.en: Fixed focus mode showing "Ran N PostToolUse hooks" timing lines under each response
entries.zh: 固定焦点模式在每个响应下显示“Ran N PostToolUse hooks”计时线

entries.en: Added `/config key=value` syntax to set any setting from the prompt (e.g. `/config thinking=false`) — works in interactive, `-p`, and Remote Control
entries.zh: 添加了`/config key=value`语法以通过提示设置任何设置（例如“/configthinking=false”）——适用于交互、`-p`和远程控制

entries.en: Added `sandbox.allowAppleEvents` opt-in setting that lets sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.allowAppleEvents`选择加入设置，允许沙盒命令在 macOS 上发送 Apple 事件

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE` environment variable: point it at a marker file to suppress mobile push notifications while you're at the machine
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE`环境变量：将其指向标记文件以在您在计算机上时抑制移动推送通知

entries.en: Upgraded the bundled Bun runtime to 1.4
entries.zh: 内置 Bun 运行时升级到 1.4

entries.en: Improved streaming of long paragraphs: text now appears line-by-line instead of waiting for the first line break
entries.zh: 改进长段落的流式输出：文字逐行显示，不再等到第一个换行符才出现

entries.en: Improved auto-retry: API connection drops mid-thinking now automatically retry instead of showing "Connection closed while thinking"
entries.zh: 改进自动重试：API 连接在思考过程中断开时，现在会自动重试，不再显示“Connection closed while thinking”

entries.en: Improved the subagent panel: idle subagents auto-hide after 30s, the list caps at 5 rows with scroll hints, and keyboard hints now show in the footer
entries.zh: 改进子智能体面板：空闲的子智能体 30 秒后自动隐藏，列表最多显示 5 行并带滚动提示，键盘快捷键提示显示在底部

entries.en: Improved the MCP OAuth browser page to match Claude Code's visual style and auto-close on success
entries.zh: 改进 MCP OAuth 浏览器页面：视觉风格与 Claude Code 一致，成功后自动关闭

entries.en: Changed fullscreen mode URL opening to require Cmd+click (macOS) / Ctrl+click, matching native terminal behavior
entries.zh: 将全屏模式 URL 打开更改为需要 Cmd+click (macOS) / Ctrl+click，匹配本机终端行为

entries.en: Changed the `Improved N memories` line to no longer list individual files outside verbose mode
entries.zh: 更改了“改进的 N 个内存”行，不再列出详细模式之外的单个文件

entries.en: Fixed prompt caching not reading on custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and on Foundry due to a per-request attestation token changing every turn
entries.zh: 修复了由于每个请求的证明令牌每回合都在变化而导致提示缓存无法在自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`和 Foundry 上读取的问题

entries.en: Fixed Write/Edit producing 0-byte or truncated files on network drives and cloud-synced folders
entries.zh: 修复了写入/编辑在网络驱动器和云同步文件夹上生成 0 字节或截断文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed `open`, `osascript`, and browser-based auth flows failing with error -600 on macOS by adding the Apple Events entitlement
entries.zh: 通过添加 Apple Events 权利，修复了 macOS 上`open`、`osascript`和基于浏览器的身份验证流程失败并出现错误 -600 的问题

entries.en: Fixed a startup regression (~120ms per launch in fresh environments, introduced in 2.1.169): the first prompt no longer waits for the managed-settings fetch when no MCP servers are configured
entries.zh: 修复了启动回归（在新环境中每次启动约 120 毫秒，在 2.1.169 中引入）：当未配置 MCP 服务器时，第一个提示不再等待托管设置获取

entries.en: Fixed startup blocking with a blank terminal for up to 15 seconds when the account settings fetch is slow on a degraded network
entries.zh: 修复了在降级网络上帐户设置获取速度缓慢时，空白终端的启动阻塞长达 15 秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed startup crash (`TypeError: Cannot read properties of null`) when `.claude.json` contains corrupted null project entries
entries.zh: 修复了当`.claude.json`包含损坏的空项目条目时启动崩溃（“TypeError：无法读取 null 的属性”）

entries.en: Fixed macOS TUI freezing at session start (Ctrl+C unresponsive) when Spotlight is busy reindexing
entries.zh: 修复了当 Spotlight 忙于重新索引时 macOS TUI 在会话开始时冻结（Ctrl+C 无响应）的问题

entries.en: Fixed long-running idle sessions losing their history when another Claude Code process ran the 30-day transcript cleanup
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个 Claude Code 进程运行 30 天的记录清理时，长时间运行的空闲会话会丢失历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed foreground subagents spawning unbounded nested chains; they now respect the same 5-level depth limit as background subagents
entries.zh: 修复了前景子代理产生无界嵌套链的问题；他们现在遵循与后台子代理相同的 5 级深度限制

entries.en: Fixed `/recap` and conversation forks using the previous model immediately after a model switch
entries.zh: 修复了模型切换后立即使用先前模型的`/recap`和对话分支

entries.en: Fixed subagent "Thinking" duration showing the parent agent's elapsed time instead of the subagent's own
entries.zh: 修复了子代理“思考”持续时间，显示父代理的已用时间而不是子代理自己的时间

entries.en: Fixed subagents blocked on a nested agent showing a ticking elapsed time instead of "waiting" in the agent panel
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套代理上被阻止的子代理，显示滴答流逝的时间，而不是在代理面板中“等待”

entries.en: Fixed the API retry indicator ("Retrying in 0s · attempt N/10") staying on screen after the retry succeeded
entries.zh: 修复了重试成功后 API 重试指示器（“0 秒内重试·尝试 N/10”）停留在屏幕上的问题

entries.en: Fixed AWS `awsCredentialExport` credentials with a short remaining lifetime causing credential refreshes every minute, and now accepts the JSON shape from `aws configure export-credentials`
entries.zh: 修复了剩余生命周期较短的 AWS `awsCredentialExport` 凭证，导致凭证每分钟刷新一次，现在接受来自 `aws configure export-credentials` 的 JSON 形状

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp get`/`list` showing `✓ Connected` when tools/list fails; they now show `! Connected · tools fetch failed` with the error detail
entries.zh: 修复了当工具/列表失败时`claude mcp get`/`list`显示“✓已连接”的问题；他们现在展示`！已连接·工具获取失败`并显示错误详细信息

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` leaving a stale "connecting…" line; it now confirms in the transcript once connected
entries.zh: 修复了`/remote-control`留下陈旧的“正在连接…”行的问题；一旦连接，它现在会在记录中确认

entries.en: Fixed ExitWorktree refusing to remove a clean worktree with "Could not verify worktree state" when bare `git` cannot be resolved on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了当 Windows 上无法解析裸露的 `git` 时，ExitWorktree 拒绝删除干净的工作树并显示“无法验证工作树状态”的问题

entries.en: Fixed settings changes (such as `/effort` or `/model`) failing with ENOENT when `~/.claude/settings.json` is a relative symlink under a symlinked `~/.claude`
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude/settings.json`是符号链接`~/.claude`下的相对符号链接时，设置更改（例如`/effort`或`/model`）因 ENOENT 失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed IDE selection line numbers in context reminders being off by one (IntelliJ and VS Code)
entries.zh: 修复了上下文提醒中的 IDE 选择行号减一的问题（IntelliJ 和 VS Code）

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C in fullscreen after a native terminal selection (modifier+drag) overwriting the clipboard with the app's prior selection
entries.zh: 修复了本机终端选择（修改器+拖动）后全屏使用 Ctrl+C 使用应用程序之前的选择覆盖剪贴板的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+V showing "No image found in clipboard" instead of pasting when the clipboard contains text
entries.zh: 修复了当剪贴板包含文本时 Ctrl+V 显示“剪贴板中找不到图像”而不是粘贴的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent creation failing with "EEXIST: file already exists" when the agents directory already exists (Windows/OneDrive)
entries.zh: 修复了代理目录已存在时创建代理失败并显示“EEXIST：文件已存在”的问题 (Windows/OneDrive)

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion preview content being cut off at the dialog edge instead of word-wrapping
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 预览内容在对话框边缘被切断而不是自动换行的问题

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion multi-select questions silently dropping a typed "Other" free-text answer when submitting
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 多选问题在提交时无提示地丢弃键入的“其他”自由文本答案的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/stats` "Most active day" and daily token chart dates showing one day early in UTC-negative timezones
entries.zh: 修复了`/stats`“最活跃日”和每日代币图表日期在 UTC 负时区中早一天显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/copy` and copy-on-select on Linux not detecting a clipboard utility installed after Claude Code started
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上的`/copy`和选择复制未检测到 Claude Code 启动后安装的剪贴板实用程序的问题

entries.en: Fixed tab-indented code rendering with incorrect indentation in the Write (create-file) preview
entries.zh: 修复 Write（创建文件）预览中，带 Tab 缩进的代码缩进显示错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed user prompts queued mid-turn not showing a full-width background highlight in the transcript
entries.zh: 修复回合中途排队的用户提示，在转录中没有全宽背景高亮的问题

entries.en: Fixed the activity spinner's pulse dwelling on the wrong glyph size in Ghostty
entries.zh: 修复 Ghostty 中活动旋转指示器的脉动停留在错误字形大小上的问题

entries.en: Fixed mid-stream connection drops: partial responses are now preserved instead of showing a raw error, and the spinner no longer gets stuck at "running tool"
entries.zh: 修复了中流连接丢失：现在保留部分响应而不是显示原始错误，并且微调器不再卡在“运行工具”处

entries.en: Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling in WSL2 under Windows Terminal and VS Code (regression in 2.1.172)
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 终端和 VS Code 下 WSL2 中的鼠标滚轮滚动问题（2.1.172 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed a sandbox `denyRead`/`allowRead` glob over a large directory tree making the Bash tool description enormous and the session unusable on Linux
entries.zh: 修复了大型目录树上的沙箱`denyRead`/`allowRead`全局，导致 Bash 工具描述庞大且会话在 Linux 上无法使用

entries.en: Fixed the feedback survey capturing a single-digit reply as a session rating immediately after a turn completes
entries.zh: 修复回合刚结束时，反馈调查把单个数字的回复误记为会话评分的问题

entries.en: Fixed the welcome screen stacking multiple promotional banners — at most one promo now shows per session
entries.zh: 修复欢迎界面同时堆叠多条推广横幅的问题；现在每个会话最多只显示一条推广

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+O not showing the subagent's transcript when viewing a subagent
entries.zh: 修复了查看子代理时 Ctrl+O 不显示子代理的记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed clicking the prompt input not returning focus from the subagent/footer panel
entries.zh: 修复了单击提示输入不会从子代理/页脚面板返回焦点的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote session background tasks appearing stuck as "still running" between turns
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话后台任务在轮次之间显示为“仍在运行”的问题

entries.en: Improved plugin loading performance in remote sessions
entries.zh: 改进远程会话中的插件加载性能

entries.en: Agent teams: removed the `TeamCreate` and `TeamDelete` tools. With `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1` set, every session now has one implicit team — spawn teammates directly with the Agent tool's `name` parameter, no setup step needed. The `team_name` parameter on the Agent tool is still accepted but ignored.
entries.zh: 代理团队：删除了`TeamCreate`和`TeamDelete`工具。设置`CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1`后，每个会话现在都有一个隐式团队 - 直接使用代理工具的`name`参数生成队友，无需任何设置步骤。代理工具上的`team_name`参数仍然被接受但被忽略。

entries.en: Added `Tool(param:value)` syntax for permission rules to match a tool's input parameters (with `*` wildcard), e.g. `Agent(model:opus)` to block Opus subagents
entries.zh: 为权限规则添加了`Tool(param:value)`语法，以匹配工具的输入参数（带有`*`通配符），例如`Agent(model:opus)` 用于阻止 Opus 子代理

entries.en: Skills in nested `.claude/skills` directories now load when working on files there; on a name clash, the nested skill appears as `<dir>:<name>` so both stay available
entries.zh: 在处理嵌套 `.claude/skills` 目录中的文件时，会加载其中的技能；若名称冲突，嵌套的技能显示为 `<目录>:<名称>`，两者都可用

entries.en: Nested `.claude/` directories: the agent, workflow, and output-style closest to the working directory now wins when names collide; project-scope workflow saves now target the closest existing `.claude/workflows/`
entries.zh: 嵌套 `.claude/` 目录：名称冲突时，离工作目录最近的智能体、工作流和输出样式优先；项目范围的工作流保存会写入最近的已有 `.claude/workflows/`

entries.en: Improved auto mode: subagent spawns are now evaluated by the classifier before launch, closing a gap where a subagent could request a blocked action without review
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：子代理启动前会先由分类器审查，堵上了子代理可以请求被拦截操作而不经审查的漏洞

entries.en: Improved `/doctor` with consistent flat tree layout across all sections, clearer section status icons, and highlighted command names
entries.zh: 改进 `/doctor`：各部分统一为扁平的树形布局，状态图标更清楚，命令名高亮显示

entries.en: Improved the skill listing truncation warning to show how many skill descriptions are affected
entries.zh: 改进技能列表截断警告：会显示受影响的技能描述数量

entries.en: Changed the workflow prompt keyword to use a purple shimmer highlight and trigger only on explicit phrases like "run a workflow" or "workflow:", not on any mention of the word
entries.zh: 更改了工作流程提示关键字，以使用紫色闪光突出显示，并且仅在明确的短语（例如“运行工作流程”或“工作流程：”）上触发，而不是在任何提及该词的情况下触发

entries.en: Improved Remote Control error messages: connection failures now show a persistent red "/rc failed" indicator in the footer, and the "not yet enabled" error now explains whether it's a gate, a check failure, stale entitlement, or org policy
entries.zh: 改进远程控制错误提示：连接失败时，底部显示持续的红色“/rc failed”指示器；“未启用”错误会说明原因是功能开关、检查失败、授权过期还是组织策略

entries.en: `/bug` now requires a description before submitting, and no longer uses model-refusal text as the GitHub issue title
entries.zh: `/bug` 提交前现在必须填写描述，且不再把模型的拒绝文本用作 GitHub issue 标题

entries.en: Fixed a crash (out-of-memory) when the CLI inherits a stale websocket/OAuth file-descriptor environment variable from a parent process
entries.zh: 修复了 CLI 从父进程继承过时的 websocket/OAuth 文件描述符环境变量时发生的崩溃（内存不足）

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome silently failing to connect when the OAuth token belongs to a different account than the Claude Code login
entries.zh: 修复了当 OAuth 令牌属于与 Claude 代码登录不同的帐户时，Chrome 中的 Claude 无提示连接失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed nested `.claude/skills` skills with directory-qualified names being blocked by permission prompts in non-interactive runs
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套的`.claude/skills`技能，其中目录限定名称在非交互式运行中被权限提示阻止

entries.en: Fixed several subagent issues: viewing a subagent's transcript now shows tool results and live progress, messages sent while it finishes its turn are no longer dropped, and backgrounding a running subagent (ctrl+b) no longer restarts it from scratch
entries.zh: 修复了几个子代理问题：查看子代理的记录现在会显示工具结果和实时进度，完成轮次时发送的消息不再被丢弃，并且后台运行的子代理 (ctrl+b) 不再从头开始重新启动

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` workers failing with `401 Invalid bearer token` when the daemon was started from a shell with a custom API gateway via `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`
entries.zh: 修复了当守护进程通过`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`和`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`从具有自定义 API 网关的 shell 启动时，“claude Agents”工作人员因“401 无效承载令牌”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed compaction not honoring `--fallback-model`: compaction now falls back to the configured fallback model chain on overload or model-availability errors
entries.zh: 修复了压缩不遵循`--fallback-model`的问题：压缩现在在过载或模型可用性错误时回退到配置的后备模型链

entries.en: Fixed model requests continuing to fail with auth errors after credentials were refreshed outside the session, due to a stale cached request configuration
entries.zh: 修复了在会话外刷新凭据后，由于缓存的请求配置过时，模型请求继续失败并出现身份验证错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions created with `/bg` or `←←` after a turn finished showing "Working" forever in the agents list
entries.zh: 修复了回合结束后使用`/bg`或`←←`创建的后台会话，在代理列表中永远显示“正在工作”

entries.en: Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start when `.claude/skills` or `.claude/hooks` is a symlink
entries.zh: 修复了当 `.claude/skills` 或 `.claude/hooks` 是符号链接时 Linux 沙箱无法启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE=1` preventing fresh marketplace installs from cloning
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE=1`，防止克隆新的市场安装

entries.en: Fixed MCP server-level specs (`mcp__server`, `mcp__server__*`, `mcp__*`) in subagent `disallowedTools` being silently ignored
entries.zh: 修复了子代理`disallowedTools`中被默默忽略的 MCP 服务器级规范（`mcp__server`、`mcp__server__*`、`mcp__*`）

entries.en: Fixed vim mode undo: `u` now steps through NORMAL/VISUAL-mode commands one at a time instead of merging commands in quick succession into a single undo step
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式撤销：`u` 现在会逐条撤销 NORMAL/VISUAL 模式的命令，而不会把快速连续的命令合并为一次撤销

entries.en: Fixed statusline links with custom URI schemes (e.g. `vscode://`) not opening when clicked in `claude agents`
entries.zh: 修复了在“claude Agents”中单击时带有自定义 URI 方案（例如`vscode://`）的状态栏链接无法打开的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed pressing Esc to dismiss a CJK IME candidate window canceling the running Claude task
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复按 Esc 关闭中文等输入法（CJK IME）的候选窗口时，误取消了正在运行的 Claude 任务的问题

entries.en: Session titles are now generated in the language of your conversation (set the `language` setting to pin a specific language)
entries.zh: 会话标题现在使用对话所用的语言生成（可用 `language` 设置固定为某种语言）

entries.en: Added `footerLinksRegexes` setting for regex-matched link badges in the footer row, configurable via user or managed settings
entries.zh: 为页脚行中正则表达式匹配的链接徽章添加了`footerLinksRegexes`设置，可通过用户或托管设置进行配置

entries.en: Improved Bedrock credential caching: credentials from `awsCredentialExport` are now cached until their `Expiration` instead of a fixed 1 hour
entries.zh: 改进 Bedrock 凭证缓存：`awsCredentialExport` 的凭证现在缓存到其 `Expiration` 时间为止，不再固定为 1 小时

entries.en: Fixed `availableModels` enforcement: alias model picks can no longer be redirected to a blocked model via `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL` environment variables, and `/fast` now refuses to toggle when it would switch to a model outside the allowlist
entries.zh: 修复了`availableModels`强制执行：别名模型选择不再可以通过`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL`环境变量重定向到被阻止的模型，并且`/fast`现在拒绝在切换到允许列表之外的模型时进行切换

entries.en: Fixed auto mode failing on Fable 5 for organizations without Opus 4.8 enabled — the classifier now falls back to the best available Opus model
entries.zh: 修复了未启用 Opus 4.8 的组织在《神鬼寓言 5》中自动模式失败的问题 — 分类器现在回落到最佳可用 Opus 模型

entries.en: Fixed hook `if` conditions for Read/Edit/Write tool paths: documented patterns like `Edit(src/**)`, `Read(~/.ssh/**)`, and `Read(.env)` now match correctly
entries.zh: 修复了读取/编辑/写入工具路径的钩子`if`条件：记录的模式如`Edit(src/**)`、`Read(~/.ssh/**)`和`Read(.env)`现在可以正确匹配

entries.en: Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start when `.claude/settings.json` is a symlink with an absolute target
entries.zh: 修复了当 `.claude/settings.json` 是具有绝对目标的符号链接时 Linux 沙箱无法启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/copy` and mouse-selection copy not reaching the system clipboard inside tmux over SSH, and tmux paste buffer not loading on versions older than 3.2
entries.zh: 修复了`/copy`和鼠标选择副本无法通过 SSH 到达 tmux 内的系统剪贴板，以及 tmux 粘贴缓冲区无法在 3.2 之前的版本上加载的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control connecting from web/mobile silently switching the session's model
entries.zh: 修复了从网络/移动设备进行远程控制连接时静默切换会话模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control disconnect notifications showing a bare numeric code instead of a human-readable reason, and connection failures adding a duplicate line to the conversation transcript
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制断开连接通知显示裸露的数字代码而不是人类可读的原因，以及连接失败在对话记录中添加重复行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions not disconnecting when you sign in to a different account
entries.zh: 修复了登录其他帐户时远程控制会话不会断开连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/cd` and worktree moves leaving the session reporting the previous directory's git branch
entries.zh: 修复了`/cd`和工作树移动导致会话报告上一个目录的 git 分支的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents`: pressing back in one window no longer detaches other windows attached to the same session
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”：在一个窗口中按回键不再分离附加到同一会话的其他窗口

entries.en: Fixed backgrounded sessions showing "Working" forever when `/bg` mid-turn had nothing left to continue
entries.zh: 修复了当`/bg`中途没有任何内容可以继续时后台会话永远显示“工作”的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agent search by PR URL: PRs opened during scheduled wakeups or while a job was blocked now appear in `claude agents` search
entries.zh: 通过 PR URL 修复了后台代理搜索：在计划唤醒期间或作业被阻止时打开的 PR 现在显示在“claude Agents”搜索中

entries.en: Fixed the agents view input showing no text cursor on Windows
entries.zh: 修复 Windows 上智能体视图的输入框不显示文字光标的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg -cn <name>` not seeding the session name
entries.zh: 修复了 `claude --bg -cn <name>` 未播种会话名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions to neutralize Windows network paths in persisted state before respawn
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话，以在重生前消除处于持久状态的 Windows 网络路径

entries.en: Fixed background-session respawn rejecting malformed resume IDs from corrupted state files
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话重生拒绝来自损坏的状态文件的格式错误的简历 ID 的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Windows background-service daemon not starting when `~/.claude/daemon` has the ReadOnly attribute set
entries.zh: 修复 `~/.claude/daemon` 设置了只读属性时，Windows 后台服务守护进程无法启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions failing with "Could not resolve authentication method" when idle for too long before being claimed
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在被认领之前闲置时间过长时失败并显示“无法解析身份验证方法”的问题

entries.en: Background sessions now show clearer guidance when a window left open across an auto-update can't submit a reply, and `claude daemon status` explains version-skew behavior
entries.zh: 当自动更新中保持打开状态的窗口无法提交回复时，后台会话现在会显示更清晰的指导，并且`claude daemon status`解释了版本偏差行为

entries.en: Added `enforceAvailableModels` managed setting — when enabled, the `availableModels` allowlist also constrains the Default model (a Default that would resolve to a disallowed model now falls back to the first allowed model), and user or project settings can no longer widen a managed `availableModels` list
entries.zh: 添加了`enforceAvailableModels`托管设置 - 启用后，`availableModels`允许列表还会限制默认模型（将解析为不允许的模型的默认模型现在回退到第一个允许的模型），并且用户或项目设置无法再扩大托管`availableModels`列表

entries.en: Added `wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled` setting to disable mouse-wheel scroll acceleration in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 添加了`wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled`设置以在全屏模式下禁用鼠标滚轮滚动加速

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker hiding the model family that Default resolves to — Opus now appears as its own row on Max/Team Premium/Enterprise plans, Sonnet on Pro/Team plans, and Opus on pay-as-you-go API accounts
entries.zh: 修复 `/model` 选择器隐藏了"默认"所指向的模型系列的问题：现在 Max、Team Premium、Enterprise 套餐会单独显示 Opus 一行，Pro、Team 套餐显示 Sonnet，按量付费 API 账户显示 Opus

entries.en: Fixed `/model` picker showing a hardcoded Sonnet version label when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` pins a different Sonnet
entries.zh: 修复了当`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`固定不同的十四行诗时，`/model`选择器显示硬编码的十四行诗版本标签

entries.en: Fixed the "Fable 5 is now consuming usage credits" banner incorrectly showing for enterprise accounts with usage-based billing
entries.zh: 修复了基于使用量计费的企业帐户错误显示的“神鬼寓言 5 正在消耗使用积分”横幅

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock GovCloud regions (`us-gov-*`) deriving the wrong inference profile prefix (`global` instead of `us-gov`), causing 400 errors on derived model IDs
entries.zh: 修复了基岩 GovCloud 区域 (`us-gov-*`) 派生错误的推理配置文件前缀（`global` 而不是 `us-gov`），导致派生模型 ID 出现 400 错误

entries.en: Fixed background sessions inheriting another session's `ANTHROPIC_*` provider env (gateway URL, custom headers, `/model` aliases) from the shell that started the background daemon
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话从启动后台守护进程的 shell 继承另一个会话的`ANTHROPIC_*`提供程序环境（网关 URL、自定义标头、`/model`别名）的问题

entries.en: Fixed a 1-2 second pause when exiting Claude Code shortly after a shell command was interrupted or killed on macOS and Linux
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 和 Linux 上 shell 命令被中断或终止后不久退出 Claude Code 时出现 1-2 秒暂停的问题

entries.en: Fixed git commit co-author attribution showing an incorrect model name for some models
entries.zh: 修复了 git commit 共同作者属性显示某些模型的模型名称不正确的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/advisor` dialog pre-selecting a saved advisor model that is blocked by the `availableModels` allowlist
entries.zh: 修复 `/advisor` 对话框预先选中了已保存、但被 `availableModels` 允许列表屏蔽的顾问模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed skill hot-reload re-sending the entire skill listing when a single skill changed; only changed skills are now re-announced
entries.zh: 修复了单个技能更改时技能热重载重新发送整个技能列表的问题；现在仅重新公布更改的技能

entries.en: Fixed Workflow tool `agent()` subagents missing per-agent attribution headers
entries.zh: 修复了工作流程工具`agent()`子代理缺少每个代理归因标头的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Added usage attribution to the Account & usage dialog (`/usage`) showing cache misses, long context, subagents, and per-skill/agent/plugin/MCP breakdowns over the last 24h or 7d
entries.zh: [VSCode] Account & usage 对话框（`/usage`）新增用量归因，显示最近 24 小时或 7 天内的缓存未命中、长上下文、子智能体，以及按技能、智能体、插件和 MCP 的细分

entries.en: Fixed pre-warmed background workers failing with "Could not resolve authentication method" when claimed after sitting idle
entries.zh: 修复了预热后台工作人员在闲置后声明时失败并显示“无法解析身份验证方法”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Fable 5 model names with a `[1m]` suffix not being normalized — Fable 5 includes 1M context by default, so the suffix is now stripped automatically
entries.zh: 修复了带有`[1m]`后缀的《神鬼寓言 5》模型名称未标准化的问题 - 《神鬼寓言 5》默认包含 1M 上下文，因此现在会自动删除后缀

entries.en: Fixed a spurious "sandbox dependencies missing" startup warning on Windows when sandbox was enabled in settings
entries.zh: 修复了在设置中启用沙箱时 Windows 上虚假的“沙箱依赖项缺失”启动警告

entries.en: Sub-agents can now spawn their own sub-agents (up to 5 levels deep)
entries.zh: 子代理现在可以再生成自己的子代理，最多 5 层

entries.en: Amazon Bedrock now reads the AWS region from `~/.aws` config files when `AWS_REGION` isn't set, matching AWS SDK precedence; `/status` shows where the region came from
entries.zh: 现在，当未设置`AWS_REGION`时，Amazon Bedrock 会从`~/.aws`配置文件中读取 AWS 区域，以匹配 AWS SDK 优先级； `/status` 显示该区域的来源

entries.en: Added a search bar when browsing a marketplace's plugins in `/plugin`
entries.zh: 在`/plugin`中浏览市场插件时添加了搜索栏

entries.en: Added `model` attribute to the `claude_code.lines_of_code.count` OTEL metric
entries.zh: 向`claude_code.lines_of_code.count` OTEL 指标添加了`model`属性

entries.en: Fixed sessions using 1M context without usage credits getting permanently stuck — the session now automatically compacts back under the standard context limit
entries.zh: 修复了使用 1M 上下文而没有使用积分永久卡住的会话 - 会话现在自动压缩回标准上下文限制以下

entries.en: Fixed a repeating "an image in the conversation could not be processed and was removed" error when the conversation contained multiple images
entries.zh: 修复了当对话包含多个图像时重复出现的“对话中的图像无法处理并被删除”的错误

entries.en: Fixed the agents view keeping a session under Working with a busy spinner for up to 30 seconds after the worker replied
entries.zh: 修复智能体视图在工作进程回复后，仍将会话保持在"工作中"状态并显示忙碌旋转指示器长达 30 秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents potentially reading another directory's project settings (`.mcp.json` approvals, trust) when dispatched onto a pre-warmed worker
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理在分派到预热工作人员时可能会读取另一个目录的项目设置（`.mcp.json`批准、信任）的问题

entries.en: Fixed background-session attach failing with EAUTH for sessions started on an older version after the daemon auto-updated
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话附加在守护程序自动更新后在旧版本上启动的会话时 EAUTH 失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed a background sub-agent staying stuck as "active" in the agent panel after a nested agent it spawned was stopped
entries.zh: 修复了后台子代理在其生成的嵌套代理停止后在代理面板中保持“活动”状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` suggestions in the `claude agents` dispatch input rendering with a misleading slash prefix and showing models disabled for your org
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”调度输入渲染中的`/model`建议，带有误导性的斜杠前缀，并显示为您的组织禁用的模型

entries.en: Fixed `availableModels` restrictions not being applied to subagent model overrides, the agent dispatch model picker, and the advisor model
entries.zh: 修复了`availableModels`限制不适用于子代理模型覆盖、代理调度模型选择器和顾问模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed `availableModels` allowlists hiding the `/model` picker's Opus and Sonnet 1M rows when entries use version-specific IDs like `claude-opus-4-8`
entries.zh: 修复了当条目使用版本特定 ID（如`claude-opus-4-8`）时，`availableModels`允许列表隐藏`/model`选择器的 Opus 和 Sonnet 1M 行

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker on Bedrock offering models the provider doesn't serve — selecting one silently switched the session model and lit the selection marker on multiple rows
entries.zh: 修复 Bedrock 上 `/model` 选择器提供了服务商并不支持的模型的问题：选中后会静默切换会话模型，并导致多行同时显示选中标记

entries.en: Fixed model IDs getting a doubled 1M-context suffix (e.g. `[1M][1m]`) when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` already includes one
entries.zh: 修复了当`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`已包含一个时模型 ID 获得双倍 1M 上下文后缀（例如`[1M][1m]`）

entries.en: Fixed `opusplan` model setting not shipping with 1M context in plan mode for entitled users; the `opusplan[1m]` workaround now also correctly switches to Opus in plan mode
entries.zh: 修复了`opusplan`模型设置未在计划模式下为授权用户提供 1M 上下文的问题； `opusplan[1m]` 解决方法现在也可以在计划模式下正确切换到 Opus

entries.en: Fixed `WebFetch(domain:*.example.com)` wildcard domain rules never matching subdomains in allow, deny, and ask position, and file permission rules with mid-pattern wildcards (e.g. `Read(secrets-*/config.json)`) being rejected at startup
entries.zh: 修复了`WebFetch(domain:*.example.com)`通配符域规则永远不会匹配允许、拒绝和询问位置中的子域，以及带有中间模式通配符的文件权限规则（例如`Read(secrets-*/config.json)`）在启动时被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed up-arrow prompt history showing the main agent's prompts while a subagent's chat tab is open
entries.zh: 修复打开子智能体的聊天标签页时，上箭头提示历史显示的是主智能体的提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory recall not finding mounted team memory stores (`CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES`) in remote sessions
entries.zh: 修复了内存调用在远程会话中找不到已安装的团队内存存储（`CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES`）的问题

entries.en: Fixed workflow validation rejecting scripts whose prompt strings or comments merely mention `Date.now()`/`Math.random()`
entries.zh: 修复工作流校验误拒绝提示字符串或注释中仅提到 `Date.now()`/`Math.random()` 的脚本的问题

entries.en: Disable mouse tracking on Windows consoles that don't fully support it
entries.zh: 在不完全支持鼠标跟踪的 Windows 控制台上禁用鼠标跟踪

entries.en: Fixed the `/plugin` marketplace list losing its cursor after backing out of a long plugin list, and Esc from the plugin browser returning to the wrong tab
entries.zh: 修复 `/plugin` 市场列表在退出长插件列表后丢失光标位置，以及在插件浏览器中按 Esc 返回了错误标签页的问题
