entries.en: Improved performance in long conversations by removing redundant message normalization and avoiding full message-history transforms when streaming tool-use state is unchanged
entries.zh: 改进长对话性能：去掉多余的消息标准化，在流式工具调用状态不变时避免整段消息历史的转换

entries.en: Reduced idle CPU usage: `/goal` status chip no longer re-renders the terminal at 5 Hz while idle, and fewer UI re-renders while subagents run in parallel
entries.zh: 降低空闲 CPU 占用：`/goal` 状态标记空闲时不再以每秒 5 次的频率重绘终端；子代理并行运行时界面重绘也更少

entries.en: Improved Claude in Chrome tool loading: browser tools now load in a single batched call instead of one per tool
entries.zh: 改进 Claude in Chrome 的工具加载：浏览器工具改为一次批量加载，而不是每个工具单独加载一次

entries.en: Improved the non-interactive Usage Policy refusal message to suggest starting a new session or changing your model
entries.zh: 改进非交互模式下使用政策拒绝的提示：建议开启新会话或更换模型

entries.en: `/code-review` now keeps the `ultra` option visible when you're not signed in to claude.ai, with an explanation that the cloud review requires a claude.ai account
entries.zh: 未登录 claude.ai 时，`/code-review` 现在会保留 `ultra` 选项，并说明云端审查需要 claude.ai 账号

entries.en: Shortened the Remote Control footer indicator to "/rc active" and hid it on narrow terminals
entries.zh: 将 Remote Control 底部指示器缩短为 "/rc active"，并在窄终端中隐藏

entries.en: Stopped promoting `/loop` in remote sessions, where pending loops don't keep the container alive
entries.zh: 不再在远程会话中推广 `/loop`，因为待执行的循环不会让容器保持运行

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed PowerShell tool calls rendering as raw JSON instead of a proper command display and permission dialog, and stripped ANSI escape codes from displayed shell output
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 PowerShell 工具调用以原始 JSON 显示、而不是正常的命令显示和权限对话框的问题；并去除了 shell 输出中的 ANSI 转义码

entries.en: Introducing Claude Fable 5: a Mythos-class model that we’ve made safe for general use. Fable’s capabilities exceed those of any model we’ve ever made generally available. Update to version 2.1.170 for access. https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5
entries.zh: 推出 Claude Fable 5：属于 Mythos 级别的模型，我们已使其可供一般用户安全使用。Fable 的能力超过我们以往任何一款正式开放的模型。需更新到 2.1.170 版本才能使用。https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5

entries.en: Fixed sessions not saving transcripts (and not appearing in --resume) when launched from the VS Code integrated terminal or any shell that inherited Claude Code environment variables.
entries.zh: 修复了从 VS Code 集成终端或继承 Claude Code 环境变量的任何 shell 启动时不保存记录的会话（并且不出现在 --resume 中）的问题。

entries.en: Added `--safe-mode` flag (and `CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE`) to start Claude Code with all customizations (CLAUDE.md, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP servers) disabled for troubleshooting
entries.zh: 添加了`--safe-mode`标志（和`CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE`）以启动 Claude Code，并禁用所有自定义项（CLAUDE.md、插件、技能、挂钩、MCP 服务器）以进行故障排除

entries.en: Added `/cd` command to move a session to a new working directory without breaking the prompt cache mid-session
entries.zh: 添加了`/cd`命令以将会话移动到新的工作目录，而不会破坏会话中的提示缓存

entries.en: Added a `disableBundledSkills` setting and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS` environment variable to hide bundled skills, workflows, and built-in slash commands from the model
entries.zh: 添加了`disableBundledSkills`设置和`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS`环境变量，以隐藏模型中的捆绑技能、工作流程和内置斜杠命令

entries.en: Fixed Up/Down arrows jumping to command history past the wrapped rows of a long input line — they now move through each visual row first, and history recall enters at the near edge
entries.zh: 修复了向上/向下箭头跳转到超过长输入行的换行行的命令历史记录 - 它们现在首先移动穿过每个可视行，并且历史记录调用在近边缘输入

entries.en: Fixed enterprise managed MCP policies (`allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers`) not being enforced on reconnect, IDE-typed configs, `--mcp-config` servers during the first session after install, or before remote settings loaded; also fixed slow cold starts for orgs without remote settings
entries.zh: 修复了在安装后的第一个会话期间或加载远程设置之前，在重新连接、IDE 类型的配置、`--mcp-config`服务器上不强制实施企业管理的 MCP 策略（`allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers`）；还修复了没有远程设置的组织的缓慢冷启动问题

entries.en: Fixed a ~30-50ms UI stall at the start of each turn for macOS users logged in with claude.ai credentials
entries.zh: 修复了使用 claude.ai 凭据登录的 macOS 用户在每轮开始时约 30-50 毫秒的 UI 停顿问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` being slow or appearing to hang on Windows while waiting for the slash-command/skill scan (regression in 2.1.161)
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`在等待斜杠命令/技能扫描时速度缓慢或在 Windows 上挂起的问题（2.1.161 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control getting stuck on "reconnecting" after resuming a session when an OAuth token refresh happened at the same time
entries.zh: 修复了当 OAuth 令牌刷新同时发生时，远程控制在恢复会话后陷入“重新连接”状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed Git Credential Manager's "Connect to GitHub" popup appearing on Windows at startup when background git commands ran without cached credentials
entries.zh: 修复了当后台 git 命令在没有缓存凭据的情况下运行时，Git 凭据管理器在启动时出现在 Windows 上的“连接到 GitHub”弹出窗口

entries.en: Fixed footer hints (e.g. "esc to interrupt") not showing for users with a custom statusline
entries.zh: 修复了不向具有自定义状态行的用户显示的页脚提示（例如“esc 中断”）

entries.en: Fixed stale permission and dialog prompts reappearing every time you reattached to a remote session whose worker had died while waiting on them
entries.zh: 修复了每次重新连接到其工作人员在等待期间死亡的远程会话时，陈旧的权限和对话框提示都会重新出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents --json` omitting blocked and just-dispatched background sessions; added `--all` to include completed sessions, plus new `id` and `state` fields
entries.zh: 修复了 `claude Agents --json` 忽略被阻止和刚刚调度的后台会话；添加了`--all`以包含已完成的会话，以及新的`id`和`state`字段

entries.en: Fixed agents view leaving a stale/garbled frame after navigating back from an agent on WSL in Windows Terminal
entries.zh: 修复了从 Windows 终端中的 WSL 上的代理导航回来后代理视图留下陈旧/乱码的帧

entries.en: Fixed background agents ignoring project-level settings `env` values (e.g. `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`) when dispatched onto a pre-warmed worker
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理在分派到预热工作人员时忽略项目级设置`env`值（例如`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`）的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCPB plugin cache being spuriously invalidated on Windows, causing unnecessary re-extraction
entries.zh: 修复了 MCPB 插件缓存在 Windows 上被虚假失效，导致不必要的重新提取的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin `.in_use` PID lock files accumulating without bound; stale markers from crashed sessions are now swept once per day
entries.zh: 修复插件 `.in_use` PID 锁定文件无限制累积的问题；崩溃会话中的陈旧标记现在每天清除一次

entries.en: Fixed untrusted project settings being able to set OTEL client-certificate paths without trust confirmation
entries.zh: 修复未受信任的项目设置可以在未经信任确认的情况下设置 OTEL 客户端证书路径的问题

entries.en: `/workflows` now opens immediately even while a turn is in progress
entries.zh: `/workflows` 现在即使在轮次进行中也会立即打开

entries.en: Improved `TaskCreate` reliability: malformed inputs are repaired automatically and validation errors for unloaded tools include the schema
entries.zh: 改进 `TaskCreate` 的可靠性：格式错误的输入会自动修复；未加载工具的校验错误会附上 schema

entries.en: Improved the error message shown when your organization has disabled API key authentication, with guidance based on where the active API key comes from
entries.zh: 改进组织已禁用 API 密钥认证时的报错信息：会根据当前 API 密钥的来源给出指引

entries.en: Reduced CPU usage while responses stream and during spinner animations
entries.zh: 回复流式输出和加载动画期间的 CPU 占用降低

entries.en: Restored a default 5-minute idle timeout on Vertex/Foundry so a stalled stream aborts instead of hanging indefinitely; set `API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT=0` to opt out
entries.zh: Vertex/Foundry 上恢复默认的 5 分钟空闲超时，流卡住时会中止而不是无限挂起；设置 `API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT=0` 可关闭

entries.en: Remote-managed settings with an invalid entry now apply their remaining valid policies and surface the validation error, instead of silently dropping the whole payload
entries.zh: 远程托管设置中有无效条目时，现在会应用其余有效的策略并显示校验错误，而不是悄悄丢弃整个配置

entries.en: Background sessions now preserve `--ide`, `--chrome`, `--bare`, `--remote-control`, and other flags across retire→wake, and respawn state validation was hardened
entries.zh: 后台会话现在在退出→唤醒过程中保留`--ide`、`--chrome`、`--bare`、`--remote-control`和其他标志，并且强化了重生状态验证

entries.en: Background sessions are now told that shared-checkout edits are blocked until they enter a worktree, avoiding a wasted rejected edit before `EnterWorktree`
entries.zh: 现在，后台会话被告知，共享签出编辑在进入工作树之前会被阻止，从而避免在`EnterWorktree`之前浪费拒绝编辑

entries.en: The "CLAUDE.md is too long" warning threshold now scales with the model's context window
entries.zh: "CLAUDE.md is too long" 警告的阈值现在会随模型的上下文窗口缩放

entries.en: Auto-updater on Windows now stops retrying within a session once `claude.exe` is held by another process
entries.zh: 一旦`claude.exe`被另一个进程持有，Windows 上的自动更新程序现在会停止在会话中重试

entries.en: Improved color contrast for skill tags in the slash-command menu
entries.zh: 改进斜杠命令菜单中技能标签的颜色对比度

entries.en: Promo credit claims for Apple/Google-billed subscribers without a payment method now explain where to add one
entries.zh: 对于通过 Apple/Google 付费且没有支付方式的订阅用户，促销积分领取页面现在会说明在哪里添加支付方式

entries.en: Added a tip suggesting `claude agents` when running multiple concurrent sessions
entries.zh: 添加了在运行多个并发会话时建议“claudeagents”的提示

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added `fallbackModel` setting to configure up to three fallback models tried in order when the primary model is overloaded or unavailable; `--fallback-model` now also applies to interactive sessions
entries.zh: 添加了`fallbackModel`设置，以在主模型过载或不可用时按顺序配置最多三个尝试的后备模型； `--fallback-model` 现在也适用于交互式会话

entries.en: Added glob pattern support in deny rule tool-name position (`"*"` denies all tools); allow rules reject non-MCP globs, and unknown tool names in deny rules warn at startup
entries.zh: 在拒绝规则工具名称位置添加了 glob 模式支持（“*”拒绝所有工具）；允许规则拒绝非 MCP 全局对象，并且拒绝规则中的未知工具名称在启动时发出警告

entries.en: Hardened cross-session messaging: messages relayed via `SendMessage` from other Claude sessions no longer carry user authority — receivers refuse relayed permission requests, and auto mode blocks them
entries.zh: 加固跨会话消息：通过 `SendMessage` 从其他 Claude 会话转发的消息不再拥有用户权限，接收方会拒绝转发来的权限请求，自动模式也会拦截

entries.en: `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0`, `--thinking disabled`, and the per-model thinking toggle now disable thinking on models that think by default via the Claude API (3P providers unchanged)
entries.zh: `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0`、`--thinking disabled` 以及按模型的思考开关，现在会通过 Claude API 禁用默认会思考的模型的思考功能（第三方提供商不变）

entries.en: Claude Code now retries a turn once on the fallback model when the API rejects an unexpected non-retryable error; auth, rate-limit, request-size, and transport errors still surface immediately
entries.zh: 现在，当 API 拒绝意外的不可重试错误时，Claude Code 会在后备模型上重试一次；身份验证、速率限制、请求大小和传输错误仍然会立即出现

entries.en: `claude update` now announces the target version before downloading instead of going silent
entries.zh: `claude update` 现在会在下载前先说明目标版本，而不再毫无提示

entries.en: `claude agents`: typing a URL into the list now filters to the session whose first prompt contained it
entries.zh: `claude agents`：在列表中输入 URL 会筛选出首条提示词包含该 URL 的会话

entries.en: Fixed a recurring "image could not be processed" error and extra token usage when an unprocessable image was sent in a session
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中发送无法处理的图像时反复出现的“无法处理图像”错误和额外令牌使用问题

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions becoming permanently stuck when a brief backend disruption occurred during worker registration at startup
entries.zh: 修复了启动时工作人员注册期间发生短暂后端中断时远程会话永久卡住的问题

entries.en: Fixed flickering in JetBrains IDE terminals (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.) on 2026.1+ by enabling synchronized output
entries.zh: 通过启用同步输出，修复了 2026.1+ 上 JetBrains IDE 终端（IntelliJ、PyCharm、WebStorm 等）的闪烁问题

entries.en: Fixed Shift+non-ASCII characters (e.g. Shift+ä → Ä) being dropped in terminals using the Kitty keyboard protocol (WezTerm, Ghostty, kitty)
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Kitty 键盘协议（WezTerm、Ghostty、kitty）在终端中删除 Shift+非 ASCII 字符（例如 Shift+ä → ä）的问题

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell command validation occasionally hanging far past its time budget on Windows when a killed process's children held its output pipes
entries.zh: 修复了当被杀死的进程的子进程持有其输出管道时，PowerShell 命令验证偶尔会在 Windows 上远远超出其时间预算

entries.en: Fixed orphaned `claude --bg-pty-host` processes spinning at 100% CPU after the daemon dies while connected on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了守护进程在 macOS 连接时死亡后以 100% CPU 旋转的孤立`claude --bg-pty-host`进程

entries.en: Fixed voice mode requiring `/login` to clear a stale auth check after toggling `/voice`
entries.zh: 修复切换 `/voice` 后，需要运行 `/login` 才能清除过期认证检查的问题

entries.en: Fixed managed settings with an invalid entry silently disabling enforcement of their remaining valid policies
entries.zh: 修复了具有无效条目的托管设置，该设置会默默地禁用其余有效策略的执行

entries.en: Fixed managed-settings `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` predicates not matching when they use `${VAR}` references
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置`allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers`谓词在使用`${VAR}`引用时不匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agent sessions that entered a git worktree crash-looping with "No conversation found" when reopened from `claude agents`
entries.zh: 修复了从“claude Agents”重新打开时进入 git worktree 崩溃循环并显示“未找到对话”的后台代理会话

entries.en: Fixed duplicated thinking text in the Ctrl+O transcript view while streaming
entries.zh: 修复了流式传输时 Ctrl+O 转录视图中重复的思考文本

entries.en: Fixed `/doctor` showing a contradictory failed "Not inside a remote session" check when run inside a remote session
entries.zh: 修复了`/doctor`在远程会话内运行时显示矛盾的失败“不在远程会话内”检查的问题

entries.en: Fixed the cursor sticking at the end of the first line when typing a multiline prompt in the `claude agents` dispatch and reply inputs
entries.zh: 修复在 `claude agents` 的派发和回复输入框中输入多行提示词时，光标卡在第一行末尾的问题

entries.en: Fixed blank lines appearing between background agent rows in the task list on terminals without Unicode support
entries.zh: 修复了不支持 Unicode 的终端上任务列表中后台代理行之间出现的空白行

entries.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements
entries.zh: 错误修复和可靠性改进

entries.en: Added `requiredMinimumVersion` and `requiredMaximumVersion` managed settings — Claude Code refuses to start if its version is outside the allowed range and directs the user to an approved version
entries.zh: 添加了`requiredMinimumVersion`和`requiredMaximumVersion`托管设置 - 如果版本超出允许范围，Claude Code 将拒绝启动，并引导用户使用批准的版本

entries.en: Added `/plugin list` command to list installed plugins, with `--enabled`/`--disabled` filters
entries.zh: 添加了`/plugin list`命令来列出已安装的插件，并带有`--enabled`/`--disabled`过滤器

entries.en: Added a "c to copy" shortcut to `/btw` that copies the raw markdown answer to the clipboard, preserving formatting when pasted elsewhere
entries.zh: 添加了`/btw`的“c to copy”快捷方式，将原始 Markdown 答案复制到剪贴板，在粘贴到其他地方时保留格式

entries.en: Hooks: Stop and SubagentStop hooks can now return `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` to give Claude feedback and keep the turn going without being labeled a hook error
entries.zh: Stop 和 SubagentStop 钩子现在可以返回 `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext`，向 Claude 反馈并让本轮继续，且不会被当成 hook 错误

entries.en: Skills: added `\$` escape syntax to include a literal `$` before a digit in command bodies
entries.zh: 命令正文中新增 `\$` 转义语法，可在数字前输出字面量 `$`

entries.en: stdio MCP servers now receive the same `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` as hooks/Bash on `--resume`
entries.zh: stdio MCP 服务器在 `--resume` 时，现在会与 hook/Bash 收到相同的 `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` hanging forever after its final result when a backgrounded command never exits — background shells are now stopped ~5s after the result once stdin closes
entries.zh: 修复了当后台命令永远不会退出时，`claude -p`在其最终结果后永远挂起的问题 - 一旦标准输入关闭，后台 shell 现在会在结果后约 5 秒停止

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` failing with "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required" on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry when `CI=true` and no Anthropic API key is set
entries.zh: 修复了当`CI=true`且未设置 Anthropic API 密钥时，`claude -p`在 Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry 上失败并显示“需要 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY”的问题

entries.en: Fixed bash commands failing under bazel and EDR-protected Go workflows: `$TMPDIR` was overridden to `/tmp/claude-{uid}` for all commands instead of only sandboxed ones (regression in 2.1.154)
entries.zh: 修复了 bash 命令在 bazel 和受 EDR 保护的 Go 工作流程下失败的问题：所有命令的`$TMPDIR`被覆盖为`/tmp/claude-{uid}`，而不仅仅是沙盒命令（2.1.154 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed Bash commands failing on Windows with "EEXIST: file already exists" on the session-env directory when it has the read-only attribute or is inside OneDrive
entries.zh: 修复了当会话环境目录具有只读属性或位于 OneDrive 内时，Bash 命令在 Windows 上失败并显示“EEXIST：文件已存在”的问题

entries.en: Fixed org-managed permission rules not applying for the entire session when the managed settings fetch completed during startup on a fresh config directory
entries.zh: 修复了在新配置目录上启动期间完成托管设置提取时，组织管理的权限规则不适用于整个会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions in `claude agents` losing their running background tasks when reattached after a Claude Code update
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”中的后台会话在克劳德代码更新后重新连接时丢失正在运行的后台任务的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal misalignment and a multi-second hang when exiting the agent view by pressing Esc
entries.zh: 修复按 Esc 退出智能体视图时终端错位以及挂起数秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed clicking Stop on a background-task chip in the desktop app not clearing the chip when the underlying process was already gone
entries.zh: 修复了当底层进程已经消失时，在桌面应用程序中单击后台任务芯片上的“停止”不会清除芯片的问题

entries.en: Fixed keyboard input becoming permanently unresponsive after a paste operation whose end marker is dropped by the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴操作结束标记被终端丢弃后键盘输入永久无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed hook `if: "Bash(...)"` conditions firing on every Bash command containing `$()` or `$VAR`; the pattern now matches against commands inside subshells and backticks too
entries.zh: 修复了钩子 `if: "Bash(...)"` 在每个包含 `$()` 或 `$VAR` 的 Bash 命令上触发的条件；该模式现在也与子 shell 和反引号内的命令匹配

entries.en: Fixed deny rules on home-directory paths (e.g. `Read(~/Desktop/**)`) not blocking Bash commands that reference the path via `$HOME`
entries.zh: 修复了主目录路径上的拒绝规则（例如`Read(~/Desktop/**)`），不会阻止通过`$HOME`引用路径的 Bash 命令

entries.en: Fixed a stray "(no content)" line left in the transcript after closing panel dialogs like /mcp and /plugins
entries.zh: 修复了关闭 /mcp 和 /plugins 等面板对话框后记录中留下的杂散“（无内容）”行

entries.en: Background agent sessions now update to a new Claude Code version in the background, so opening a session after an update no longer waits on a cold restart
entries.zh: 后台代理会话现在在后台更新到新的克劳德代码版本，因此更新后打开会话不再等待冷重启

entries.en: Clearer descriptions for built-in commands and skills in the / menu
entries.zh: / 菜单中内置命令和技能的描述更加清晰

entries.en: The subscription-switch suggestion now shows in the startup announcement slot instead of a toast
entries.zh: 订阅切换建议现在显示在启动公告位置，而不再以弹窗形式出现

entries.en: `claude agents` dispatching from the state-grouped view now starts the session in the directory the agent view was opened from
entries.zh: 在按状态分组的视图中，`claude agents` 派发会话时，现在会在打开 agent 视图的目录中启动会话

entries.en: `claude agents --json` now includes `waitingFor` showing what a waiting session is blocked on (e.g. permission prompt)
entries.zh: `claude agents --json` 现在包含 `waitingFor` 字段，显示等待中的会话被什么阻塞（如权限提示）

entries.en: `--tools`: explicitly listing Grep/Glob now provides the dedicated search tools on native builds with embedded search (previously these names were silently ignored)
entries.zh: `--tools`：显式列出 Grep/Glob 后，在内置嵌入式搜索的原生版本中会提供专用搜索工具（此前这些名称被静默忽略）

entries.en: `/effort` now confirms when your chosen level will persist as the default for new sessions
entries.zh: `/effort` 现在会在你选择的级别将作为新会话默认值保存时进行确认

entries.en: Clicking a slash command in the autocomplete menu now fills it into your prompt instead of running it immediately; press Enter to run
entries.zh: 现在，单击自动完成菜单中的斜杠命令会将其填充到提示中，而不是立即运行它；按 Enter 运行

entries.en: Remote Control now shows as a persistent footer pill (with a link to the session) instead of a startup message
entries.zh: Remote Control 现在以底部常驻小标签的形式显示（附会话链接），不再是启动时的一条消息

entries.en: Renamed Windsurf to Devin Desktop in the `/ide` menu, `/terminal-setup`, and `/scroll-speed`, following the editor's rebrand
entries.zh: `/ide` 菜单、`/terminal-setup` 和 `/scroll-speed` 中的 Windsurf 改称 Devin Desktop，跟随该编辑器的更名

entries.en: Fixed a silent startup hang when the config directory is read-only or unwritable — Claude Code now starts with in-memory config and surfaces startup errors instead of showing a blank screen
entries.zh: 修复了配置目录为只读或不可写时静默启动挂起的问题 — Claude Code 现在以内存中配置启动，并显示启动错误，而不是显示空白屏幕

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch permission rules not being applied to built-in preapproved domains; explicit `WebFetch(domain:...)` deny/ask/allow rules now take precedence over the preapproved-host auto-allow
entries.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 权限规则不适用于内置预先批准的域的问题；显式`WebFetch(domain:...)`拒绝/询问/允许规则现在优先于预先批准的主机自动允许

entries.en: Fixed Windows permission rules never matching when spelled with backslashes (`~\`, `\\server\share`) or case-variant paths, and Read deny rules not hiding files from Glob/Grep results
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 权限规则在使用反斜杠（`~\`、`\\server\share`）或大小写变体路径拼写时永远不会匹配的问题，以及读取拒绝规则不会从 Glob/Grep 结果中隐藏文件

entries.en: Fixed an interrupt (Esc) sent at the very start of a turn being silently dropped in stream-json/SDK sessions, leaving the turn running with no "Interrupted" feedback
entries.zh: 修复了在回合开始时发送的中断 (Esc) 在 Stream-json/SDK 会话中默默丢弃，导致回合运行时没有“中断”反馈

entries.en: Fixed API 400 `no low surrogate in string` errors for classifier side-queries and MCP server descriptions containing emoji near a truncation boundary
entries.zh: 修复了分类器侧查询和在截断边界附近包含表情符号的 MCP 服务器描述的 API 400“字符串中没有低代理项”错误

entries.en: Fixed MCP per-server `timeout` config values below 1000 ms being floored to a 1-second watchdog that aborted every tool call; sub-1000 ms values are now ignored (falling back to `MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT` or default), and `claude mcp get` annotates them accordingly
entries.zh: 修复了低于 1000 毫秒的 MCP 每服务器“超时”配置值被限制为 1 秒的看门狗，该看门狗会中止每个工具调用；现在忽略低于 1000 毫秒的值（回退到`MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT`或默认值），并且`claude mcp get`相应地注释它们

entries.en: Fixed the LSP tool's `workspaceSymbol` operation returning no results; it now accepts a `query` parameter and passes it to the language server
entries.zh: 修复 LSP 工具的 `workspaceSymbol` 操作无返回结果的问题；现在它接受 `query` 参数并将其传给语言服务器

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` cutting live status text (tool args, replies, prompts, exec output) at 60–120 columns on wide terminals; the status detail now uses the full terminal width
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”在宽终端上将实时状态文本（工具参数、回复、提示、执行输出）剪切为 60-120 列的问题；状态详细信息现在使用完整的终端宽度

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` truncating long session names at 40 columns; the name column now grows with terminal width
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”将长会话名称截断为 40 列的问题；名称列现在随着终端宽度而增长

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` attach occasionally bouncing straight back to the session list on the first try after a background-service restart
entries.zh: 修复了后台服务重启后第一次尝试时偶尔会直接弹回会话列表的“claude Agents”附加问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` Ctrl+V image paste doing nothing in the dispatch input and the session reply box; pasting with no image now shows a hint
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”Ctrl+V 图像粘贴在调度输入和会话回复框中不执行任何操作的问题；粘贴无图像现在会显示提示

entries.en: Fixed backgrounding a session with ← silently losing the conversation when the background service cannot start; the session stays in the list as a failed row you can wake with Enter
entries.zh: 修复了后台服务无法启动时使用 ← 静默丢失对话的会话；该会话作为失败行保留在列表中，您可以使用 Enter 唤醒

entries.en: Fixed replies from the agents view that fail to send being lost; they are now queued for delivery on the next session start
entries.zh: 修复了坐席视图中发送失败的回复丢失的问题；他们现在正在排队等待下一次会话开始时的交付

entries.en: Fixed cross-session messaging (`SendMessage`) silently breaking when `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` or `$TMPDIR` points at a deep directory
entries.zh: 修复了当`CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`或`$TMPDIR`指向深层目录时跨会话消息传递（`SendMessage`）无提示地中断的问题

entries.en: Fixed opening a running background session from `claude agents` stalling for 5 seconds before attaching
entries.zh: 修复了从“claude Agents”打开正在运行的后台会话在附加之前停滞 5 秒的问题

entries.en: Quieter startup: notices group by severity, and session info and announcements share a single line per launch
entries.zh: 启动更安静：通知按严重程度分组，会话信息和公告每次启动合并为一行

entries.en: Startup warnings rewritten to be shorter and clearer, each with a concrete fix
entries.zh: 启动警告改写得更简短清楚，并且每条都附有具体的修复方法

entries.en: Launch-prompt warnings (deep link/pre-filled prompt) now stay pinned below the input until you act instead of scrolling away
entries.zh: 启动提示警告（深层链接或预填提示）现在会固定在输入框下方，直到你处理为止，不再滚动消失

entries.en: Failed turns now show a compact warning line instead of a multi-line red error block
entries.zh: 失败的转弯现在显示紧凑的警告线，而不是多行红色错误块

entries.en: Improved background service startup and `claude update` verification to wait out endpoint-security scanning of new binaries instead of failing after 5 seconds
entries.zh: 改进后台服务启动和 `claude update` 的校验：等待终端安全软件扫描新二进制文件，而不是 5 秒后就失败

entries.en: Background dispatch spawn failures now report the error class name when no errno is available
entries.zh: 当没有可用的 errno 时，后台调度生成失败现在会报告错误类名称

entries.en: Removed the "Claude in Chrome enabled" and "marketplace installed" startup messages; model auto-updates and the team-onboarding tip now show as quiet notices under the logo
entries.zh: 移除启动时的 "Claude in Chrome enabled" 和 "marketplace installed" 消息；模型自动更新和团队入门提示改为 logo 下方的安静通知

entries.en: `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` values are now included as labels on metric datapoints, so you can slice usage metrics by custom dimensions like team or repo
entries.zh: `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` 的值现在会作为标签包含在指标数据点中，便于按团队或仓库等自定义维度拆分用量指标

entries.en: `claude agents` rows now show `done/total` before the detail when work is fanned out; peek shows the longest-running item
entries.zh: 当工作被分派给多个项目时，`claude agents` 的行现在会在详情前显示 `done/total`；peek 会显示运行时间最长的项目

entries.en: `/mcp` now collapses claude.ai connectors you've never signed in to behind a "Show unused connectors" row
entries.zh: `/mcp` 现在会把你从未登录过的 claude.ai 连接器折叠到 "Show unused connectors" 行下面

entries.en: Parallel tool calls: a failed Bash command no longer cancels other calls in the same batch — each tool returns its own result independently
entries.zh: 并行工具调用：一个 Bash 命令失败不再取消同一批次中的其他调用，每个工具都独立返回自己的结果

entries.en: Fullscreen mode: clipboard now uses `wl-copy`/`xclip`/`xsel` on Linux when available, copies to both the clipboard and PRIMARY selection for middle-click paste, and the "hold {key} for native selection" hint now shows the correct key per terminal
entries.zh: 全屏模式：Linux 上剪贴板优先使用 `wl-copy`/`xclip`/`xsel`，同时写入剪贴板和 PRIMARY 选区（支持中键粘贴）；“hold {key} for native selection” 提示现在会显示各终端对应的正确按键

entries.en: Fixed the `/effort` dialog, workflow animations, and prompt keyword shimmer not honoring the "Reduce motion" setting
entries.zh: 修复 `/effort` 对话框、工作流动画和提示关键词闪光效果未遵守"减少动态效果"设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed `forceLoginOrgUUID`/`forceLoginMethod` managed-settings policies blocking third-party provider sessions (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Mantle) alongside the org pin (regression in 2.1.146)
entries.zh: 修复了`forceLoginOrgUUID`/`forceLoginMethod`托管设置策略，阻止第三方提供商会话（Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、Mantle）以及组织 pin（2.1.146 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed background subagent output corrupting `claude -p` stdout when using `--output-format text` or `json`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--output-format text`或`json`时后台子代理输出损坏`claude -p`标准输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/usage-credits` starting a re-login for Team and Enterprise admins instead of pointing to the organization's usage settings page
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage-credits`启动团队和企业管理员重新登录而不是指向组织的使用设置页面

entries.en: Fixed `/autofix-pr` reporting "cannot run on the default branch" when the session is inside a git worktree or another repository
entries.zh: 修复了当会话位于 git 工作树或其他存储库内时`/autofix-pr`报告“无法在默认分支上运行”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` picker not showing sessions from the current directory when it isn't a git worktree (e.g., jj workspaces)
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`选择器在当前目录不是 git 工作树（例如 jj 工作区）时不显示当前目录中的会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed Windows hooks that invoke bash explicitly (e.g., `/usr/bin/bash script.sh`) failing with "command not found" or "cannot execute binary file"
entries.zh: 修复了显式调用 bash 的 Windows 挂钩（例如`/usr/bin/bash script.sh`）失败并显示“找不到命令”或“无法执行二进制文件”的问题

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry log events (`user_prompt`, `api_request`, `tool_result`, `tool_decision`) being silently dropped when emitted before telemetry initialization completed
entries.zh: 修复了在遥测初始化完成之前发出的 OpenTelemetry 日志事件（`user_prompt`、`api_request`、`tool_result`、`tool_decision`）被静默丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp` list/get/add printing secrets to the terminal: `${VAR}` references are no longer expanded, and credential headers and URL secrets are redacted
entries.zh: 修复了`claude mcp`列表/获取/添加打印机密到终端的问题：不再扩展`${VAR}`引用，并且对凭证标头和 URL 机密进行了编辑

entries.en: Fixed Workflow agents spawned with `isolation: "worktree"` in background sessions being blocked from editing files inside their own worktree
entries.zh: 修复了在后台会话中使用“隔离：“工作树””生成的工作流代理被阻止在其自己的工作树内编辑文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions dispatched from `claude agents` booting on a stale model from the daemon's environment instead of the model in `settings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了从守护进程环境中的陈旧模型（而不是`settings.json`中的模型）启动的“claude Agents”调度的后台会话

entries.en: Fixed a potential crash when rendering Write tool results after resuming a session
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话后渲染写入工具结果时可能发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed completed subagents getting stuck showing as running when an error occurs while finalizing their result
entries.zh: 修复了在最终确定结果时发生错误时已完成的子代理卡住显示为正在运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `EADDRINUSE` errors from tools that bind Unix sockets under `$TMPDIR` when `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` is set to a deep path
entries.zh: 修复了当`CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`设置为深层路径时在`$TMPDIR`下绑定 Unix 套接字的工具中的`EADDRINUSE`错误

entries.en: Improved terminal rendering performance by stabilizing the layout engine's JIT compilation profile
entries.zh: 改进终端渲染性能：稳定了布局引擎的 JIT 编译配置

entries.en: Improved rendering performance for large file writes
entries.zh: 改进大文件写入的渲染性能

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a tip suggesting disabling terminal GPU acceleration (or running `/terminal-setup`) to fix garbled glyphs
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增提示：建议关闭终端 GPU 加速（或运行 `/terminal-setup`），以修复字符乱码

entries.en: Added a prompt before writing to shell startup files (`.zshenv`, `.zlogin`, `.bash_login`) and `~/.config/git/`, which could otherwise lead to unintended command execution
entries.zh: 在写入 shell 启动文件（`.zshenv`、`.zlogin`、`.bash_login`）和 `~/.config/git/` 之前添加了提示，否则可能会导致意外的命令执行

entries.en: `acceptEdits` mode now prompts before writing build-tool config files that grant code execution (`.npmrc`, `.yarnrc*`, `bunfig.toml`, `.bazelrc`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.devcontainer/`, etc.)
entries.zh: `acceptEdits` 模式现在会在写入可授予代码执行权限的构建工具配置文件前进行提示（如 `.npmrc`、`.yarnrc*`、`bunfig.toml`、`.bazelrc`、`.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`.devcontainer/` 等）

entries.en: Edit no longer requires a separate Read after viewing a file with `grep`: single-file `grep`/`egrep`/`fgrep` commands now satisfy the read-before-edit check
entries.zh: 使用`grep`查看文件后，编辑不再需要单独的读取：单文件`grep`/`egrep`/`fgrep`命令现在满足编辑前读取检查

entries.en: Fixed copy-on-select not writing to the Windows clipboard on WSL — now uses PowerShell interop instead of OSC 52, which terminals like MobaXterm don't support
entries.zh: 修复了 WSL 上的选择时复制不写入 Windows 剪贴板的问题 - 现在使用 PowerShell 互操作而不是 OSC 52，MobaXterm 等终端不支持 OSC 52

entries.en: Fixed restoring a completed session from `claude agents` dropping chat history and re-running the original prompt
entries.zh: 修复了从“克劳德代理”恢复已完成的会话，删除聊天历史记录并重新运行原始提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions re-attached after overnight retire losing their conversation and re-running the original prompt
entries.zh: 修复了隔夜退出后重新连接的后台会话丢失对话并重新运行原始提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg` occasionally failing with "socket missing" when the background daemon was cold-starting on a loaded machine
entries.zh: 修复了当后台守护进程在已加载的计算机上冷启动时，`claude --bg`偶尔会失败并出现“套接字丢失”的问题

entries.en: Fixed an issue on Windows where the directory a background session was started in could not be deleted after `claude rm` until the background daemon exited
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的一个问题：在`claude rm`之后，直到后台守护进程退出后，才能删除启动后台会话的目录

entries.en: Fixed background agents that resumed work being shown under Completed in the agents list
entries.zh: 修复了恢复工作的后台代理显示在代理列表中的“已完成”下的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` freezing for several seconds when returning to the session list due to the auto-updater re-checking on every exit
entries.zh: 修复了由于自动更新程序在每次退出时重新检查而返回会话列表时“克劳德代理”冻结几秒钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc, arrow keys, and typing becoming unresponsive on Windows when attached to a background session or in the agent view while the host is under heavy CPU load
entries.zh: 修复了当主机处于高 CPU 负载时附加到后台会话或在代理视图中时 Esc、箭头键和键入在 Windows 上变得无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents emitting terminal sync-output markers to terminals that don't support them (Apple Terminal, tmux), causing render artifacts when entering a running agent
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理向不支持它们的终端（Apple 终端、tmux）发出终端同步输出标记，从而在进入正在运行的代理时导致渲染工件的问题

entries.en: Fixed mouse wheel scrolling prompt history instead of the transcript right after opening a session from the agents list
entries.zh: 修复了从代理列表打开会话后鼠标滚轮滚动提示历史记录而不是记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed CJK IME composition appearing at the bottom-left of the screen instead of at the input caret in the `claude agents` view
entries.zh: 修复了 CJK IME 组合出现在屏幕左下角而不是“claude Agents”视图中的输入插入符号处

entries.en: Fixed valid `file:///C:/...` links being rewritten to a broken path on Windows terminals with hyperlink support
entries.zh: 修复在支持超链接的 Windows 终端中，有效的 `file:///C:/...` 链接被改写为无效路径的问题

entries.en: Fixed voice mode failing to connect when the project directory or branch name contains non-ASCII or special characters
entries.zh: 修复项目目录或分支名包含非 ASCII 或特殊字符时，语音模式无法连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed the auto mode unavailability message on third-party providers (Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry) to point to the `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE` opt-in instead of incorrectly blaming the model
entries.zh: 修复第三方服务商（Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry）上自动模式不可用的提示信息错误地归咎于模型的问题；现在会指向 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE` 选择加入设置

entries.en: Fixed `/effort ultracode` incorrectly blaming the dynamic workflows setting when the model cannot run xhigh; ultracode is no longer offered on models that do not support it
entries.zh: 修复了模型无法运行 xhigh 时`/effort ultracode`错误地归咎于动态工作流程设置的问题；不支持的型号不再提供 ultracode

entries.en: Fixed model-not-found errors suggesting `--model` when running via the SDK or other hosts where the CLI flag doesn't apply
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SDK 或 CLI 标志不适用的其他主机运行时提示`--model`的模型未找到错误

entries.en: Fixed Claude's past replies disappearing from scrollback when resuming a brief mode session with brief mode turned off
entries.zh: 修复了在关闭简短模式的情况下恢复简短模式会话时克劳德过去的回复从回滚中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `p` pasting on the line below instead of at the cursor when the register was yanked with `v$`
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，使用 `v$` 复制的寄存器内容，`p` 粘贴到光标所在行下方而非光标处的问题

entries.en: Improved performance of opening recently-inactive background agent sessions in `claude agents`
entries.zh: 改进 `claude agents` 中打开最近不活跃后台智能体会话的性能

entries.en: Improved auto mode classifier latency by reducing reasoning on routine actions, lowering the chance of "could not evaluate this action" blocks
entries.zh: 改进自动模式分类器的延迟：对常规操作减少推理，降低出现“could not evaluate this action”拦截的概率

entries.en: Improved background-session teardown (`claude rm`/`stop`, idle reap) to send SIGTERM to running shell subprocesses before SIGKILL, so cleanup handlers run
entries.zh: 改进后台会话的清理（`claude rm`/`stop`、空闲回收）：先向运行中的 shell 子进程发送 SIGTERM，再发送 SIGKILL，让清理处理程序得以运行

entries.en: Removed `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE`; the environment variable is now a no-op
entries.zh: 移除 `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE`；该环境变量现在不起作用

entries.en: Removed the JetBrains plugin install suggestion from startup
entries.zh: 移除启动时的 JetBrains 插件安装建议

entries.en: Renamed the dynamic-workflow trigger keyword from `workflow` to `ultracode`. The word "workflow" no longer triggers a run; asking for one in your own words still works. The trigger keyword is highlighted in violet in the prompt input
entries.zh: 动态工作流的触发关键词从 `workflow` 改为 `ultracode`。单独的 "workflow" 一词不再触发运行；用自己的话提出需求仍然有效。触发关键词会在提示输入框中以紫色高亮

entries.en: Internal infrastructure improvements (no user-facing changes)
entries.zh: 内部基础设施改进（对用户无可见变化）

entries.en: Auto mode is now available on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry for Opus 4.7 and Opus 4.8. Opt in by setting `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE=1`
entries.zh: 自动模式现已在 Opus 4.7 和 Opus 4.8 的 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上可用。通过设置`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE=1`选择加入

entries.en: Plugins in `.claude/skills` directories are now automatically loaded, no marketplace required
entries.zh: `.claude/skills` 目录中的插件现在会自动加载，无需插件市场

entries.en: Added `claude plugin init <name>` to scaffold a new plugin in `.claude/skills`
entries.zh: 添加了`claude plugin init <name>`以在`.claude/skills`中搭建新插件

entries.en: Added autocomplete for `/plugin` arguments: subcommands, installed plugin names, and plugins from known marketplaces
entries.zh: 添加了`/plugin`参数的自动完成功能：子命令、已安装的插件名称以及来自已知市场的插件

entries.en: `claude agents`: the `agent` field in `settings.json` is now honored for dispatched sessions, with `--agent <name>` to override it
entries.zh: `claude agents`：`settings.json` 中的 `agent` 字段现在会对派发的会话生效，并可用 `--agent <name>` 覆盖

entries.en: `EnterWorktree` can now switch between Claude-managed worktrees mid-session
entries.zh: `EnterWorktree` 现在可以在会话中途切换到 Claude 管理的 worktree

entries.en: `tool_decision` telemetry events now include `tool_parameters` (bash commands, MCP/skill names) when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
entries.zh: 设置 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` 后，`tool_decision` 遥测事件现在会包含 `tool_parameters`（bash 命令、MCP/skill 名称）

entries.en: Worktrees managed by Claude are now left unlocked when the agent finishes, so `git worktree remove`/`prune` can clean them up
entries.zh: Claude 管理的工作树在智能体结束后保持解锁，这样 `git worktree remove`/`prune` 就能清理它们

entries.en: Fixed unprocessable images (zero-byte, corrupt) attached via paste, MCP, or dialog crashing the request instead of becoming a text placeholder
entries.zh: 修复通过粘贴、MCP 或对话框附加的无法处理的图片（零字节、损坏）导致请求崩溃，而不是变为文本占位符的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandbox network permission prompts appearing in auto and bypass-permissions mode when using the desktop app, IDE extensions, or SDK
entries.zh: 修复了使用桌面应用程序、IDE 扩展或 SDK 时在自动和绕过权限模式下出现的沙箱网络权限提示

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` completed sessions not retiring when an idle subagent was still parked or had leaked a backgrounded shell
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”完成的会话在空闲子代理仍处于停放状态或泄漏了后台 shell 时不会退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` pressing Esc not cancelling a slow "opening…", leaving the list unresponsive
entries.zh: 修复了按 Esc 键的“克劳德特工”不会取消缓慢的“打开…”，导致列表无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agent worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` being orphaned after the 30-day job retention sweep
entries.zh: 修复了`.claude/worktrees/`下的后台代理工作树在 30 天的工作保留扫描后被孤立的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions re-attached after a sleep/wake not telling the model the correct date
entries.zh: 修复了睡眠/唤醒后重新连接的后台会话不告诉模型正确的日期的问题

entries.en: Fixed copy-on-select in `claude agents` not reaching the system clipboard inside tmux with `set-clipboard on` (regression in 2.1.153)
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”中的“copy-on-select”无法通过`set-clipboard on`到达 tmux 内的系统剪贴板的问题（2.1.153 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` not reporting background subagents that were running when the previous Claude Code process exited
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`不报告前一个 Claude Code 进程退出时正在运行的后台子代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `--resume` session picker leaving its contents on the terminal after exiting in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下退出 `--resume` 会话选择器后，其内容残留在终端上的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree` and `--worktree --tmux` returning to the canonical repo root instead of the current linked worktree
entries.zh: 修复了 `--worktree` 和 `--worktree --tmux` 返回规范存储库根而不是当前链接的工作树

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker showing an incorrect "Newer version available" hint when the selected model is already the newest in its family; the pinned-model row now shows the model's description instead of its raw ID
entries.zh: 修复所选模型已是同系列最新版本时，`/model` 选择器仍错误显示"Newer version available"提示的问题；固定模型的一行现在显示模型说明，而不是原始 ID

entries.en: Fixed literal markdown markers (backticks, asterisks) appearing in the in-progress message text in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下正在进行的消息文本中出现的文字降价标记（反引号、星号）

entries.en: Fixed the terminal freezing after approving the managed-settings security dialog at startup
entries.zh: 修复启动时批准托管设置安全对话框后终端冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare duplicate line appearing in scrollback after the terminal UI redraws
entries.zh: 修复了终端 UI 重绘后回滚中出现的罕见重复行

entries.en: Fixed right-click paste duplicating the clipboard in the VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf integrated terminals
entries.zh: 修复了在 VS Code、Cursor 和 Windsurf 集成终端中右键单击粘贴复制剪贴板的问题

entries.en: WSL: fixed image paste (`alt+v` keybinding), screenshot paste on Windows 11, and added support for dragging images from Windows Explorer
entries.zh: WSL：修复了图片粘贴（`alt+v` 快捷键）和 Windows 11 上的截图粘贴，并新增支持从 Windows 资源管理器拖入图片

entries.en: Improved performance of long and resumed conversations by eliminating redundant message-rendering recomputations
entries.zh: 改进长对话和恢复会话的性能：去掉重复的消息渲染计算

entries.en: `/terminal-setup` now disables GPU acceleration in VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf integrated terminals to prevent garbled-text rendering
entries.zh: `/terminal-setup` 现在会在 VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf 集成终端中关闭 GPU 加速，以防止文字显示乱码

entries.en: The Feature of the Week credit-claim status now appears as a notification in the status area instead of a line above the prompt
entries.zh: "Feature of the Week" 的积分领取状态现在以通知形式显示在状态区，而不再显示在提示上方的一行中

entries.en: `claude agents`: slash-command autocomplete in the dispatch input now matches substrings
entries.zh: `claude agents`：派发输入框中的斜杠命令自动补全现在支持子串匹配

entries.en: Removed the "bash commands will be sandboxed" startup banner — sandbox status still shows in `/status` and when a command is blocked
entries.zh: 移除 "bash commands will be sandboxed" 启动横幅；沙箱状态仍会显示在 `/status` 中，并在命令被拦截时提示

entries.en: Removed the "/ide for …" startup hint toast
entries.zh: 移除启动时 "/ide for …" 的提示小弹窗

entries.en: [IDE] Fixed clicking Stop while a background subagent is running not actually stopping it
entries.zh: [IDE] 修复后台子智能体运行时点击 Stop 没有真正停止它的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the fast mode indicator not appearing on Opus 4.8
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复快速模式指示器在 Opus 4.8 上不显示的问题

entries.en: Pressing backspace right after a workflow trigger keyword now dismisses the workflow request (same as alt+w) instead of deleting a character
entries.zh: 工作流触发关键词后立刻按退格键，现在会取消该工作流请求（与 `alt+w` 相同），不再删除一个字符

entries.en: Added a "Workflow keyword trigger" setting in /config to stop the word "workflow" in a prompt from triggering a dynamic workflow
entries.zh: 在 /config 中添加了“工作流关键字触发器”设置，以阻止提示中的“工作流”一词触发动态工作流

entries.en: Fixed an issue when using Opus 4.8 where thinking blocks were modified, leading to API errors.
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Opus 4.8 时思维块被修改导致 API 错误的问题。

entries.en: Opus 4.8 is here! Now defaults to high effort · /effort xhigh for your hardest tasks
entries.zh: Opus 4.8 发布！现在默认使用高 effort。遇到最难的任务，可用 `/effort xhigh`

entries.en: Introducing dynamic workflows: ask Claude to create a workflow and it orchestrates work across tens to hundreds of agents in the background, so you can take on larger, more complex tasks. Run `/workflows` to view your runs
entries.zh: 推出动态工作流：让 Claude 创建工作流后，它会在后台协调数十到数百个智能体的工作，让你可以承担更大、更复杂的任务。运行 `/workflows` 查看你的运行记录

entries.en: Fast mode on Opus 4.8 is now available at a fraction of its previous cost: 2x the standard rate for 2.5x the speed
entries.zh: Opus 4.8 上的快速模式现在只需以前成本的一小部分：2 倍标准费率，2.5 倍速度

entries.en: The lean system prompt is now the default for all models except Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus 4.7 and earlier
entries.zh: 除 Haiku、Sonnet 和 Opus 4.7 及更早版本外，所有模型现在默认使用精简版系统提示词

entries.en: Claude now reserves the multiple-choice question prompt for decisions it genuinely cannot make itself, instead of asking when it already has enough context to proceed
entries.zh: 克劳德现在将多项选择题提示保留给它真正无法自行做出的决定，而不是在它已经有足够的上下文来继续时询问

entries.en: `/simplify` now runs a cleanup-only review (reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude) and applies the fixes, instead of running the full `/code-review --fix` bug-hunting review
entries.zh: `/simplify` 现在只运行仅清理类的审查（复用、简化、效率、高度），并应用修复，而不再运行完整的 `/code-review --fix` 漏洞排查审查

entries.en: Renamed the `/effort` slider labels from "Speed"/"Intelligence" to "Faster"/"Smarter" for clarity
entries.zh: `/effort` 滑块的标签从 "Speed"/"Intelligence" 改为 "Faster"/"Smarter"，更清楚

entries.en: `claude agents`: type `! <command>` to run a shell command as a background session you can attach to and detach from. Also available as `claude --bg --exec '<command>'`
entries.zh: `claude agents`：输入 `! <command>` 可将 shell 命令作为后台会话运行，你可以随时附加或分离。也可以用 `claude --bg --exec '<command>'`

entries.en: `claude agents`: `/logout` now signs you out instead of being sent to a background session
entries.zh: `claude agents`：`/logout` 现在会直接登出，而不再被发送到后台会话

entries.en: `←←` to open the agents view now works on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and with telemetry disabled
entries.zh: 在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 上，以及在禁用遥测时，`←←` 现在都可以打开 agent 视图

entries.en: Claude in Chrome: pick which connected browser to use via `/chrome` → "Select browser…", or in-chat when a browser action runs with multiple connected
entries.zh: Chrome 中的 Claude：通过 `/chrome` 选择要使用的已连接浏览器→“选择浏览器...”，或者当浏览器操作在多个已连接的情况下运行时在聊天中

entries.en: Plugins can now declare `defaultEnabled: false` in `plugin.json` or a marketplace entry; enable them with `/plugin` or `claude plugin enable`. Dependencies of enabled plugins are still enabled automatically
entries.zh: 插件现在可以在 `plugin.json` 或市场条目中声明 `defaultEnabled: false`；可通过 `/plugin` 或 `claude plugin enable` 启用。已启用插件的依赖仍会自动启用

entries.en: The `/plugin` Discover tab now pins plugins whose relevance signals match the current directory with a "suggested for this directory" annotation
entries.zh: `/plugin` 的 Discover 标签页现在会把与当前目录相关的插件置顶，并标注 "suggested for this directory"

entries.en: Streaming tool execution is now always enabled, including when telemetry is disabled or on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry (previously behind a feature flag)
entries.zh: 流式工具执行现已始终启用，包括禁用遥测时以及在 Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry 上（此前由功能开关控制）

entries.en: Stdio MCP server subprocesses now receive `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` and `CLAUDECODE=1` in their environment
entries.zh: 标准输入输出的 MCP 服务器子进程，环境中现在会包含 `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` 和 `CLAUDECODE=1`

entries.en: `claude mcp list`/`get` now show unapproved `.mcp.json` servers as `⏸ Pending approval` instead of auto-approving and connecting when output is piped
entries.zh: 管道输出时，`claude mcp list`/`get` 现在会把未批准的 `.mcp.json` 服务器显示为 `⏸ Pending approval`，而不是自动批准并连接

entries.en: `/remote-control` autocomplete now shows "Disconnect Remote Control" when Remote Control is already active
entries.zh: 当 Remote Control 已激活时，`/remote-control` 的自动补全现在会显示 "Disconnect Remote Control"

entries.en: Added Claude Opus 4.8 support and 4.7 → 4.8 migration guidance to the `/claude-api` skill
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Opus 4.8 支持和 4.7 → 4.8 迁移指南到 `/claude-api` 技能

entries.en: Deprecated `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE` (will be removed on 06/01). To use fast mode on Opus 4.6, switch with `/model claude-opus-4-6[1m]` and then `/fast on`
entries.zh: 已弃用`CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE`（将于 06/01 删除）。要在 Opus 4.6 上使用快速模式，请使用 `/model claude-opus-4-6[1m]` 进行切换，然后使用 `/fast on`

entries.en: Improved the auto-mode classifier's detection of data exfiltration, particularly bulk transfers of repository contents
entries.zh: 改进自动模式分类器对数据外泄的识别，尤其是大批量转移仓库内容的情况

entries.en: Fixed `rm -rf $HOME` not being blocked as a dangerous path when `HOME` has a trailing slash
entries.zh: 修复了当`HOME`尾部有斜杠时`rm -rf $HOME`不会被阻止为危险路径

entries.en: Fixed `$TMPDIR` resolving to different directories in sandboxed vs unsandboxed Bash commands within the same session
entries.zh: 修复了同一会话中沙盒与非沙盒 Bash 命令中`$TMPDIR`解析为不同目录的问题

entries.en: Fixed unreadable highlighted-row text in `claude agents` when the Claude Code theme doesn't match the terminal background
entries.zh: 修复 Claude Code 主题与终端背景不匹配时，`claude agents` 中高亮行的文字难以辨认的问题

entries.en: Fixed background-agent completion notifications triggering premature "out of context" behavior on some 1M-context models
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理完成通知在某些 1M 上下文模型上触发过早的“脱离上下文”行为的问题

entries.en: Fixed background-session classifier losing the user's goal when a scheduled `/command` fires
entries.zh: 修复了当计划的`/command`触发时后台会话分类器丢失用户目标的问题

entries.en: Fixed pinned background sessions respawning every minute after a Claude Code update, causing repeated agent-start notifications and process churn at idle
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德代码更新后每分钟重新生成的固定后台会话，导致重复的代理启动通知和空闲时的进程搅动

entries.en: Fixed background sessions stuck at "blocked", "running", or "working" not retiring after the idle grace period
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话卡在“已阻止”、“正在运行”或“正在工作”状态，在空闲宽限期后不会退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents in background sessions bypassing the worktree-isolation guard and writing to the shared checkout
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话中的子代理绕过工作树隔离防护并写入共享结帐的问题

entries.en: Fixed orphaned `claude --bg-pty-host` processes spinning at 100% CPU after the daemon exits on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了守护进程在 macOS 上退出后，孤立的`claude --bg-pty-host`进程以 100% CPU 运行

entries.en: Fixed number key shortcuts not working for options shown below the divider in option dialogs
entries.zh: 修复了数字键快捷键不适用于选项对话框中分隔线下方显示的选项的问题

entries.en: Fixed `worktree.baseRef: "head"` resolving to the main checkout's HEAD instead of the current worktree's HEAD when spawning subagents or calling `EnterWorktree` from inside a linked worktree
entries.zh: 修复了当生成子代理或从链接的工作树内部调用`EnterWorktree`时，“worktree.baseRef：“head””解析为主结帐的 HEAD 而不是当前工作树的 HEAD

entries.en: Fixed a stray leading space on wrapped lines when the previous line ended exactly at the terminal width
entries.zh: 修复了当前一行恰好以终端宽度结束时换行上的杂散前导空格

entries.en: Fixed intermittent terminal rendering corruption in VS Code by capping the number of distinct colors the thinking spinner produces
entries.zh: 通过限制思考旋转器产生的不同颜色的数量，修复了 VS Code 中的间歇性终端渲染损坏

entries.en: Fixed plan file names including `[Image #N]` / `[Pasted text #N]` placeholders when a plan-mode prompt starts with pasted images or text
entries.zh: 当计划模式提示以粘贴的图像或文本开始时，修复了计划文件名，包括“[图像#N]”/“[粘贴的文本#N]”占位符

entries.en: Fixed a phantom expand/click affordance on colored tool output: short ANSI-colored lines that fit on screen no longer show a "ctrl+o to expand" hint
entries.zh: 修复了彩色工具输出上的幻像展开/单击可供性：适合屏幕的 ANSI 彩色短线不再显示“ctrl+o 展开”提示

entries.en: Fixed a single invalid `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` entry in managed settings discarding all managed-settings policy; the bad entry is now dropped with a `claude doctor` warning
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置中单个无效的`allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers`条目，丢弃所有托管设置策略；现在，错误的条目已被删除，并带有`claude doctor`警告

entries.en: Fixed API 400 errors on models that don't support the effort parameter when `CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT`时不支持工作量参数的模型上的 API 400 错误

entries.en: Windows: Fixed update failures caused by `claude.exe` being in use showing a generic error instead of telling you to close other sessions and retry
entries.zh: Windows：修复了 `claude.exe` 正被占用导致更新失败时，只显示笼统错误的问题；现在会提示关闭其他会话后重试

entries.en: Removed the stale "& for background" hint from the shortcuts help panel
entries.zh: 从快捷键帮助面板中移除过时的 "& for background" 提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Auto mode no longer requires the bypass-permissions setting to appear in the mode picker, and a dismissable notice on the new-session screen explains auto mode the first time it's active
entries.zh: [VSCode] 自动模式不再要求开启绕过权限设置才能在模式选择器中显示；首次使用时，新会话界面会出现可关闭的提示，说明自动模式

entries.en: Fixed the task panel below the prompt showing a stray unselectable "main" row when only a workflow is running
entries.zh: 修复只有工作流在运行时，提示框下方的任务面板显示一个无法选中的多余"main"行的问题

entries.en: Fixed /mcp tools list and tool detail rendering when MCP servers have long or multi-line tool names or long descriptions
entries.zh: 修复了当 MCP 服务器具有长或多行工具名称或长描述时 /mcp 工具列表和工具详细信息呈现

entries.en: Fixed the /model picker not showing fast mode pricing on the Default option for API (pay-as-you-go) users when fast mode is on
entries.zh: 修复了当快速模式开启时 /model 选择器未在 API（按需付费）用户的默认选项上显示快速模式定价的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode incorrectly blocking actions with "could not evaluate this action" when the safety classifier ran out of output tokens while reasoning
entries.zh: 修复了当安全分类器在推理时用完输出令牌时，自动模式错误地阻止操作并显示“无法评估此操作”的问题

entries.en: Added `skipLfs` option to `github`/`git` plugin marketplace sources to skip Git LFS downloads during clone and update
entries.zh: 在 `github`/`git` 插件市场源中添加了 `skipLfs` 选项，以在克隆和更新期间跳过 Git LFS 下载

entries.en: Claude Code now shows a one-time notice when your npm global install can't auto-update; `/doctor` lists the fixes
entries.zh: 现在，当您的 npm 全局安装无法自动更新时，Claude Code 会显示一次性通知； `/doctor` 列出了修复程序

entries.en: Status line commands now receive `COLUMNS` and `LINES` environment variables so scripts can size output to the terminal width
entries.zh: 状态栏命令现在会收到 `COLUMNS` 和 `LINES` 环境变量，脚本可据此调整输出宽度

entries.en: `claude agents`: autocomplete in the dispatch input now suggests native slash commands and bundled skills, not just project skills
entries.zh: `claude agents`：派发输入框中的自动补全现在会推荐原生斜杠命令和内置 skill，而不只是项目 skill

entries.en: `claude agents`: PR column now shows `PR #N` for a single PR or `N PRs` for multiple
entries.zh: `claude agents`：PR 列对单个 PR 显示 `PR #N`，对多个 PR 显示 `N PRs`

entries.en: `claude doctor` now shows the result of your last update attempt
entries.zh: `claude doctor` 现在会显示你上次更新尝试的结果

entries.en: Combined the separate "needs authentication" startup notifications for MCP servers and connectors into a single message
entries.zh: 将 MCP 服务器和连接器的单独“需要身份验证”启动通知合并为一条消息

entries.en: macOS: background agents now appear as "Claude Code" in Privacy & Security and keep their permission grants across upgrades
entries.zh: macOS：后台 agent 现在会在"隐私与安全性"中显示为 "Claude Code"，并在升级后保留其权限授权

entries.en: Fixed stateful MCP servers without the optional GET SSE stream reconnect-looping on `tools/list` (regression in v2.1.147)
entries.zh: 修复了在`tools/list`上没有可选 GET SSE 流重新连接循环的有状态 MCP 服务器（v2.1.147 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed a regression where a custom API gateway could receive the user's Anthropic OAuth credential instead of the gateway's own token
entries.zh: 修复了自定义 API 网关可以接收用户的 Anthropic OAuth 凭证而不是网关自己的令牌的回归问题

entries.en: Fixed subagent (Agent tool) frontmatter MCP servers ignoring `--strict-mcp-config`, `--bare`, remote mode, enterprise managed MCP config, and managed-settings MCP server allow/deny policies
entries.zh: 修复了子代理（代理工具）frontmatter MCP 服务器忽略 `--strict-mcp-config`、`--bare`、远程模式、企业管理的 MCP 配置和托管设置 MCP 服务器允许/拒绝策略

entries.en: `--strict-mcp-config` no longer strips inline `mcpServers` from explicitly-passed agent definitions (`--agents` / SDK `agents`), and blocked subagent MCP servers now surface a visible warning
entries.zh: `--strict-mcp-config` 不再移除通过 `--agents`（或 SDK 的 `agents`）显式传入的 agent 定义中的内联 `mcpServers`；被拦截的子 agent MCP 服务器现在会显示可见警告

entries.en: Fixed the Windows PowerShell installer reporting "Installation complete!" when installation actually failed
entries.zh: 修复 Windows PowerShell 安装程序在安装实际失败时仍显示"Installation complete!"的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude update` installing the latest version instead of the configured release channel's version for npm installations
entries.zh: 修复了`claude update`安装最新版本而不是为 npm 安装配置的发布通道版本

entries.en: Fixed excessive memory usage (multiple GB) when resuming a session by transcript file path on machines with many stored sessions
entries.zh: 修复了在具有许多存储会话的计算机上通过脚本文件路径恢复会话时内存使用过多（多个 GB）的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` and `claude --bg` running on a stale daemon started before binary-takeover support, even after upgrading
entries.zh: 修复了在二进制接管支持之前启动的陈旧守护进程上运行的“claude Agents”和`claude --bg`，即使在升级之后也是如此

entries.en: Fixed a hang where the CLI could fail to exit when stdin was closed without EOF in stream-json mode, leaving a stale session marker behind
entries.zh: 修复了在流 json 模式下在没有 EOF 的情况下关闭 stdin 时 CLI 可能无法退出的挂起，留下过时的会话标记

entries.en: Fixed malformed `file://` links in Claude's responses not being clickable in the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德响应中格式错误的`file://`链接在终端中不可点击的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --help` rendering unwrapped output on terminals narrower than 92 columns
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --help`在窄于 92 列的终端上呈现未包装输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool progress notifications not rendering in the collapsed tool view
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 工具进度通知未在折叠工具视图中呈现的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Agent` tool with `subagent_type: 'claude'` running in an undocumented temporary worktree, which could silently discard outputs written to gitignored paths
entries.zh: 修复了在未记录的临时工作树中运行的带有`subagent_type: 'claude'`的`Agent`工具，该工具可能会默默地丢弃写入 gitignored 路径的输出

entries.en: `/bg` while Claude is responding now continues the response in the background session instead of dropping it
entries.zh: Claude 正在回复时执行 `/bg`，现在会在后台会话中继续回复，而不是丢弃

entries.en: Fixed `/btw` keyboard shortcuts becoming unresponsive in background sessions while a task is running
entries.zh: 修复了任务运行时`/btw`键盘快捷键在后台会话中变得无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions writing temp files to `$CLAUDE_JOB_DIR` triggering a "sensitive file" permission prompt
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话将临时文件写入`$CLAUDE_JOB_DIR`触发“敏感文件”权限提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed recovering a background agent whose working directory was deleted showing a truncated stack trace instead of a clear error message
entries.zh: 修复了恢复工作目录已删除的后台代理，显示截断的堆栈跟踪而不是清晰的错误消息

entries.en: Fixed `EnterWorktree` not being available immediately in background sessions (previously required `ToolSearch` first)
entries.zh: 修复了`EnterWorktree`在后台会话中无法立即使用的问题（之前需要先使用`ToolSearch`）

entries.en: Fixed `cmd+k` in iTerm2/Terminal.app not repainting attached background sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 iTerm2/Terminal.app 中的`cmd+k`不重新绘制附加后台会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed the IME candidate window appearing at the bottom of the screen instead of next to the input caret in attached background sessions on Windows
entries.zh: 修复 Windows 上后台会话附加时，输入法候选窗口出现在屏幕底部而非输入光标旁的问题

entries.en: Fixed background-color bleed when attaching to a background agent from 256-color-only terminals after the agent had rendered file diffs
entries.zh: 修复了代理渲染文件差异后从仅 256 色终端连接到后台代理时的背景颜色渗色问题

entries.en: Fixed `/copy` and copy-on-select silently failing to update the system clipboard when attached to a background session inside tmux
entries.zh: 修复了`/copy`和“选择时复制”在附加到 tmux 内的后台会话时无法更新系统剪贴板的问题

entries.en: Fixed opening `claude agents` with Remote Control enabled leaving zombie session entries on the Code tab after exiting
entries.zh: 修复了在启用远程控制的情况下打开“克劳德代理”，退出后在“代码”选项卡上留下僵尸会话条目的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` in background sessions not updating the session banner immediately
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话中的`/rename`未立即更新会话横幅的问题

entries.en: Fixed Windows update rollback: if a Windows update fails, Claude Code now restores the original executable by copy and tells you how to recover
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 更新回滚：如果 Windows 更新失败，Claude Code 现在会通过副本恢复原始可执行文件并告诉您如何恢复

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Claude Code processes not shutting down cleanly when VS Code closed on Windows, causing false "unclean exit" reports and orphaned MCP servers
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Windows 上关闭 VS Code 时 Claude Code 进程无法正常退出，导致误报 "unclean exit" 并留下孤立 MCP 服务器的问题

entries.en: `/model` now saves your selection as the default for new sessions (matching the IDE). Press `s` in the picker to switch models for the current session only.
entries.zh: `/model` 现在会把你的选择保存为新会话的默认值（与 IDE 一致）。在选择器中按 `s` 可仅为当前会话切换模型。

entries.en: If you customized the `modelPicker:setAsDefault` keybinding, rename it to `modelPicker:thisSessionOnly` in keybindings.json (the `d` action was replaced by `s`)
entries.zh: 如果你自定义过 `modelPicker:setAsDefault` 快捷键，请在 keybindings.json 中改名为 `modelPicker:thisSessionOnly`（`d` 操作已被 `s` 取代）

entries.en: `/code-review --fix` now applies review findings to your working tree after the review, surfacing reuse, simplification, and efficiency suggestions; `/simplify` now invokes `/code-review --fix`
entries.zh: `/code-review --fix` 现在会在审查后把审查结果应用到你的工作区，并给出复用、简化和效率方面的建议；`/simplify` 现在会调用 `/code-review --fix`

entries.en: Skills and slash commands can now set `disallowed-tools` in frontmatter to remove tools from the model while the skill is active
entries.zh: 技能和斜杠命令现在可以在前置字段中设置 `disallowed-tools`，在技能生效期间从模型中移除这些工具

entries.en: Added `/reload-skills` command to re-scan skill directories without restarting the session
entries.zh: 添加了`/reload-skills`命令来重新扫描技能目录，而无需重新启动会话

entries.en: `SessionStart` hooks can now return `reloadSkills: true` to re-scan skill directories, making skills installed by the hook available in the same session
entries.zh: `SessionStart` hook 现在可以返回 `reloadSkills: true`，重新扫描 skill 目录，使该 hook 安装的 skill 在同一会话中可用

entries.en: `SessionStart` hooks can now set the session title via `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle` on startup and resume
entries.zh: `SessionStart` hook 现在可以在启动和恢复时通过 `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle` 设置会话标题

entries.en: Added a `MessageDisplay` hook event that lets hooks transform or hide assistant message text as it is displayed
entries.zh: 添加了`MessageDisplay`挂钩事件，允许挂钩在显示时转换或隐藏助手消息文本

entries.en: Added `pluginSuggestionMarketplaces` managed setting: admins can allowlist org marketplaces whose plugins may be suggested via context-aware tips
entries.zh: 添加了`pluginSuggestionMarketplaces`托管设置：管理员可以将组织市场列入白名单，其插件可以通过上下文感知提示来建议

entries.en: `claude plugin marketplace remove` now accepts `--scope user|project|local` for symmetry with `marketplace add`, `install`, and `uninstall`
entries.zh: `claude plugin marketplace remove` 现在接受 `--scope user|project|local`，与 `marketplace add`、`install` 和 `uninstall` 保持一致

entries.en: Claude Code now switches to your configured `--fallback-model` for the rest of the session when the primary model is not found, instead of failing every request
entries.zh: 现在，当找不到主模型时，克劳德代码会在会话的其余部分切换到您配置的`--fallback-model`，而不是使每个请求失败

entries.en: Auto mode no longer requires opt-in consent
entries.zh: 自动模式不再需要选择加入同意

entries.en: Vim mode: `/` in NORMAL mode now opens reverse history search (like Ctrl+R), matching bash/zsh vi-mode
entries.zh: Vim 模式：NORMAL 模式下按 `/` 现在会打开反向历史搜索（与 Ctrl+R 相同），与 bash/zsh 的 vi 模式一致

entries.en: The `/usage` breakdown now includes large session files; files are scanned with a streaming read so memory usage stays flat
entries.zh: `/usage` 的统计现在包含大型会话文件；文件以流式方式读取，内存占用保持平稳

entries.en: Thinking summaries in the collapsed group now stay readable for at least 3 seconds, render as markdown, and cap at 10 lines (`Ctrl+O` shows the full thinking)
entries.zh: 折叠组中的思考摘要现在至少保持可读 3 秒，以 Markdown 格式渲染，最多显示 10 行（`Ctrl+O` 可查看完整思考内容）

entries.en: In fullscreen mode, the "Thinking for Ns" indicator now counts up live while the model is thinking, and keeps its value if you interrupt mid-thought
entries.zh: 全屏模式下，「Thinking for Ns」指示器在模型思考时实时计数，中途打断思考时保留已计的数值

entries.en: Simplified the Workflow tool's inline progress display — live agent counts now show only in the persistent workflow status row below the prompt
entries.zh: 工作流工具的行内进度显示简化：实时代理数量只显示在提示下方的持久工作流状态行中

entries.en: The post-response timer now shows "Waiting for N background agents/workflows to finish" when backgrounded agents or workflows are still running, and reports the cumulative time once their results are processed
entries.zh: 回复后的计时器现在会在有后台代理或工作流仍在运行时显示 "Waiting for N background agents/workflows to finish"，并在其结果处理完后报告累计耗时

entries.en: Added the session entrypoint as an OpenTelemetry metric attribute (`app.entrypoint`, opt-in via `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ENTRYPOINT=true`)
entries.zh: 添加会话入口点作为 OpenTelemetry 指标属性（`app.entrypoint`，通过`OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ENTRYPOINT=true`选择加入）

entries.en: Fixed terminal styling degrading in very long sessions by recycling the renderer's style pool
entries.zh: 修复超长会话中终端样式退化的问题，方法是回收渲染器的样式池

entries.en: Fixed the sandbox-enabled warning not appearing in condensed startup mode — it now shows in every layout
entries.zh: 修复精简启动模式下不显示沙盒已启用警告的问题；现在在所有布局中都会显示

entries.en: Fixed the loading spinner showing "still thinking"/"almost done thinking" while a tool is running, and reset the thinking status to "thinking" after each tool
entries.zh: 修复工具运行时加载旋转指示器仍显示"still thinking"/"almost done thinking"的问题；现在每次工具调用后，思考状态会重置为"thinking"

entries.en: Fixed focus mode showing a spurious "N messages hidden" count on turns with no hidden activity
entries.zh: 固定焦点模式在没有隐藏活动的回合中显示虚假的“隐藏 N 条消息”计数

entries.en: Fixed clicking a link inside an expanded tool result collapsing the section instead of opening the link
entries.zh: 修复了单击扩展工具内的链接会导致该部分折叠而不是打开链接的问题

entries.en: Fixed markdown table cell borders inheriting the color of inline code, wrapped continuation lines losing their style, and empty header cells showing a label in the narrow-terminal stacked layout
entries.zh: 修复了继承内联代码颜色的 Markdown 表格单元格边框、丢失样式的连续行以及在窄终端堆叠布局中显示标签的空标题单元格

entries.en: Fixed plugin MCP servers with the same command but different environment variables being incorrectly deduplicated
entries.zh: 修复了使用相同命令但不同环境变量的插件 MCP 服务器被错误地重复数据删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/doctor` reporting "marketplace not found" or "plugin not found" for stale `enabledPlugins` entries referencing removed marketplaces or dropped plugins
entries.zh: 修复了引用已删除市场或删除插件的过时`enabledPlugins`条目的`/doctor`报告“找不到市场”或“找不到插件”的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugins that track a git branch silently no longer receiving updates after the plugin registry was rebuilt
entries.zh: 修复了在插件注册表重建后静默跟踪 git 分支的插件不再接收更新的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP servers failing to connect in Claude Code Remote sessions when the egress proxy is enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用出口代理时远程 MCP 服务器无法在 Claude Code Remote 会话中连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed the effort-change confirmation dialog appearing when the conversation has no messages or when switching between effort levels that resolve to the same underlying value
entries.zh: 修复对话没有消息时，或在解析为同一底层值的努力级别之间切换时，仍弹出努力级别变更确认对话框的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Agent tool description referencing an agent list that is never delivered when running with `--bare` or with attachments disabled
entries.zh: 修复了引用代理列表的代理工具描述，该列表在使用`--bare`或禁用附件运行时永远不会传递

entries.en: Fixed a background worker crash in `claude agents` when accepting a stale permission prompt after a subagent was cancelled
entries.zh: 修复了取消子代理后接受陈旧权限提示时“克劳德代理”中后台工作人员崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed `cache_creation_input_tokens` reporting as 0 in transcript and result usage when the API reports cache writes only via the nested `cache_creation` breakdown
entries.zh: 修复了当 API 仅通过嵌套的`cache_creation`细分报告缓存写入时，`cache_creation_input_tokens`在记录和结果使用中报告为 0

entries.en: Fixed the PushNotification tool incorrectly reporting "Mobile push not sent (Remote Control inactive)" in SDK-hosted sessions when Remote Control is enabled
entries.zh: 修复 PushNotification 工具在启用远程控制的 SDK 托管会话中，错误报告"Mobile push not sent (Remote Control inactive)"的问题

entries.en: Fixed sessions getting stuck after a model or login switch left stale thinking-block signatures in history; now stripped proactively with a retry safety-net
entries.zh: 修复了模型或登录切换在历史记录中留下过时的思维块签名后会话卡住的问题；现在通过重试安全网主动剥离

entries.en: Internal infrastructure improvements (no user-facing changes)
entries.zh: 内部基础设施改进（对用户无可见变化）

entries.en: `/usage` now shows a per-category breakdown of what's driving your limits usage — skills, subagents, plugins, and per-MCP-server cost
entries.zh: `/usage` 现在会按类别分解说明哪些内容消耗了你的限额，包括 skill、子 agent、插件和每个 MCP 服务器的成本

entries.en: `/diff` detail view can now be scrolled with the keyboard (arrows, `j`/`k`, `PgUp`/`PgDn`, `Space`, `Home`/`End`)
entries.zh: `/diff` 详情视图现在可以用键盘滚动（方向键、`j`/`k`、`PgUp`/`PgDn`、空格、`Home`/`End`）

entries.en: Markdown output now renders GFM task list checkboxes (`- [ ] todo` / `- [x] done`) instead of plain bullets
entries.zh: Markdown 输出现在会渲染 GFM 任务列表复选框（`- [ ] 待办` / `- [x] 完成`），而不再显示为普通项目符号

entries.en: Enterprise: added the `allowAllClaudeAiMcps` managed setting to load claude.ai cloud MCP connectors alongside `managed-mcp.json`
entries.zh: 企业：添加了`allowAllClaudeAiMcps`托管设置，以加载 claude.ai 云 MCP 连接器以及“driven-mcp.json”

entries.en: Fixed a PowerShell permission bypass: built-in `cd` functions (`cd..`, `cd\`, `cd~`, `X:`) changed the working directory undetected, letting a later command read outside the workspace
entries.zh: 修复了 PowerShell 权限绕过：内置 `cd` 函数（`cd..`、`cd\`、`cd~`、`X:`）更改了未检测到的工作目录，让稍后的命令在工作区之外读取

entries.en: Fixed the sandbox write allowlist in git worktrees covering the entire main repository root instead of only the shared `.git` directory (with `hooks/` and `config` denied)
entries.zh: 修复 git 工作树中的沙盒写入允许列表覆盖了整个主仓库根目录，而不仅是共享的 `.git` 目录（其中 `hooks/` 和 `config` 被拒绝）的问题

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell prefix/wildcard allow rules (e.g. `PowerShell(dotnet.exe build *)`) not pre-approving native executables and scripts
entries.zh: 修复了 PowerShell 前缀/通配符允许规则（例如`PowerShell(dotnet.exe build *)`）不预先批准本机可执行文件和脚本

entries.en: Fixed a permission-analysis gap where the parser trusted stale variable-tracking values for `PWD`/`OLDPWD`/`DIRSTACK` across `cd`/`pushd`/`popd`
entries.zh: 修复了权限分析差距，其中解析器信任`cd`/`pushd`/`popd`中`PWD`/`OLDPWD`/`DIRSTACK`的过时变量跟踪值

entries.en: Fixed `find` in the Bash tool exhausting the macOS system file/vnode table and crashing the host on large directory trees
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具中的`find`耗尽 macOS 系统文件/vnode 表并导致大型目录树上的主机崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed the managed-settings approval dialog leaving the terminal frozen after accepting at startup
entries.zh: 修复托管设置审批对话框在启动时接受后，终端仍然冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultraplan` and remote session creation failing with "Could not capture uncommitted changes" when the working tree has no real changes
entries.zh: 修复了当工作树没有实际更改时`/ultraplan`和远程会话创建失败并显示“无法捕获未提交的更改”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `otelHeadersHelper` failing silently when the script path contains spaces; helper failures are now reported in `/doctor` and the debug log
entries.zh: 修复了当脚本路径包含空格时`otelHeadersHelper`无提示失败的问题；助手失败现在在`/doctor`和调试日志中报告

entries.en: Fixed the thinking spinner staying amber across tool calls and onto fresh thinking bursts
entries.zh: 修复思考旋转指示器在工具调用之间以及新的思考片段中仍保持琥珀色的问题

entries.en: Fixed collapsed Bash output reporting the wrong hidden-line count for outputs with many short lines
entries.zh: 修复了折叠的 Bash 输出报告具有许多短行的输出的错误隐藏行计数

entries.en: Fixed slash-command argument-hint clipping trailing typed characters when the hint overflows the input box
entries.zh: 修复了斜杠命令参数提示在提示溢出输入框时剪切尾随键入字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed argument-hint and progressive arg suggestions not appearing after Tab-completing a skill whose frontmatter `name:` differs from its directory basename
entries.zh: 固定参数提示和渐进式参数建议在按 Tab 键补全其前面内容“名称：”与其目录基本名称不同的技能后不会出现

entries.en: Fixed the status bar showing the user's baseline `/effort` setting instead of the effort level applied by skill/agent `effort:` frontmatter
entries.zh: 修复状态栏显示用户的基础 `/effort` 设置，而不是技能或智能体 `effort:` 前置配置所应用的努力级别的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+O transcript view freezing at the moment it was opened instead of tailing new messages
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+O 转录视图在打开时冻结而不是拖尾新消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed editing a recalled prompt-history entry losing the edit when navigating further up/down with arrow keys
entries.zh: 修复了使用箭头键进一步向上/向下导航时编辑召回的提示历史记录条目会丢失编辑的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/config` exit summary reporting phantom changes to auto-compact and theme when toggling unrelated settings
entries.zh: 修复了切换不相关设置时`/config`退出摘要报告对自动压缩和主题的虚拟更改

entries.en: Fixed `/insights` crashing when cached session-meta files are missing optional fields
entries.zh: 修复了当缓存的会话元文件缺少可选字段时`/insights`崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed malformed PowerShell and History tool calls with missing input being misclassified as reads in transcript collapsing
entries.zh: 修复了格式错误的 PowerShell 和历史记录工具调用，缺少输入被错误分类为转录本折叠中的读取

entries.en: Fixed renaming a Remote Control session from claude.ai or the Claude mobile app not updating the local session name for `claude --resume`
entries.zh: 修复了从 claude.ai 重命名远程控制会话或 Claude 移动应用程序未更新`claude --resume`的本地会话名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed a race where a just-submitted prompt could appear twice in the up-arrow history
entries.zh: 修复了刚刚提交的提示可能会在向上箭头历史记录中出现两次的竞赛

entries.en: Fixed tapping the "Jump to bottom" pill in fullscreen mode not dismissing it immediately
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下点击"跳到底部"提示条时，它不会立即消失的问题

entries.en: Improved `/feedback` reports to include the conversation that happened before context compaction, making issues from earlier in long sessions easier to triage
entries.zh: 改进 `/feedback` 报告：包含上下文压缩之前的对话，便于排查长会话早期的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Bash tool returning exit code 127 on every command for some users (a regression introduced in 2.1.147)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具在某些用户的每个命令上返回退出代码 127（2.1.147 中引入的回归）

entries.en: Pinned background sessions (`Ctrl+T` in `claude agents`) now stay alive when idle, are restarted in place to apply Claude Code updates, and are shed under memory pressure only after non-pinned sessions
entries.zh: 固定的后台会话（在 `claude agents` 中按 `Ctrl+T`）现在空闲时保持运行，更新 Claude Code 时会原地重启以应用更新，内存紧张时只有在非固定会话被清理后才会被清理

entries.en: Renamed `/simplify` to `/code-review`. It now reports correctness bugs at a chosen effort level (e.g., `/code-review high`); pass `--comment` to post findings as inline GitHub PR comments. The old cleanup-and-fix behavior has been removed
entries.zh: `/simplify` 改名为 `/code-review`。它现在会按所选的强度级别报告正确性问题（例如 `/code-review high`）；传入 `--comment` 可把发现的问题以行内 GitHub PR 评论的形式发布。旧的清理与修复功能已移除

entries.en: Improved auto-updater: retries transient network failures, reports specific error categories and OS error codes on failure, and shows the current version when an update fails
entries.zh: 改进自动更新器：会重试临时网络故障，失败时报告具体的错误类别和操作系统错误码，并显示当前版本

entries.en: Improved diff rendering performance for large file edits
entries.zh: 改进大文件编辑时的差异渲染性能

entries.en: Prompt history no longer records consecutive duplicate entries — recalling a prompt with arrow-up and submitting it again won't add another copy
entries.zh: 提示词历史不再记录连续重复的条目：用上箭头调出提示词并再次提交，不会多出一条

entries.en: Fixed enterprise login restrictions (`forceLoginOrgUUID` and `forceLoginMethod` managed-settings) not being enforced against third-party-provider and API-key sessions
entries.zh: 修复了未针对第三方提供商和 API 密钥会话强制执行的企业登录限制（`forceLoginOrgUUID`和`forceLoginMethod`托管设置）

entries.en: Fixed `&` in `!` command output displaying as `&`, which broke copy-pasting URLs from commands like `gcloud auth login` on headless machines
entries.zh: 修复了`!`命令输出中的`&`显示为`&`的问题，这会破坏无头计算机上`gcloud auth login`等命令的复制粘贴 URL

entries.en: Fixed unknown slash commands silently doing nothing in headless/SDK mode — they now show an error message
entries.zh: 修复无界面或 SDK 模式下，未知斜杠命令静默不执行的问题；现在会显示错误信息

entries.en: Fixed `/help` rendering a broken tab header and showing only one command per page on small terminals when not in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了`/help`在不处于全屏模式时呈现损坏的选项卡标题并在小型终端上每页仅显示一个命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed shell snapshot dropping user functions whose names start with a single underscore, which broke aliases referencing them
entries.zh: 修复了 shell 快照删除名称以单个下划线开头的用户函数的问题，这会破坏引用它们的别名

entries.en: Fixed plugin agents that declare multiple `Agent(...)` types in `tools:` frontmatter dropping all but the last entry
entries.zh: 修复了在 `tools:` frontmatter 中声明多个 `Agent(...)` 类型的插件代理，删除除最后一个条目之外的所有条目

entries.en: Fixed hook `if` conditions like `PowerShell(git push*)` never matching — only `PowerShell(*)` worked
entries.zh: 修复了钩子`if`条件，如`PowerShell(git push*)`永远不匹配——只有`PowerShell(*)`有效

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell tool dropping output for commands that rely on the default formatter
entries.zh: 修复了 PowerShell 工具丢弃依赖默认格式化程序的命令的输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed: on Windows, "Yes, and don't ask again" for a PowerShell script invocation now writes a rule that actually matches on subsequent runs
entries.zh: 修复：在 Windows 上，对 PowerShell 脚本调用选择"Yes, and don't ask again"后，现在写入的规则在之后运行时能真正匹配

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell tool failing on Windows with exit code 1 when `pwsh` is installed via winget or the Microsoft Store
entries.zh: 修复了通过 winget 或 Microsoft Store 安装`pwsh`时 PowerShell 工具在 Windows 上失败并退出代码 1 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/effort` opening with the slider on the wrong level — it now starts at your current effort
entries.zh: 修复了`/effort`打开时滑块位于错误级别的问题 - 现在从您当前的努力开始

entries.en: Fixed paginating MCP servers dropping resources, templates, and prompts past page 1
entries.zh: 修复了分页 MCP 服务器丢弃资源、模板和提示超过第 1 页的问题

entries.en: Fixed full-screen strobing in attached background sessions on Windows Terminal while Claude is streaming
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 进行流式传输时 Windows 终端上附加后台会话中的全屏选通

entries.en: Fixed: on Windows, removing a background-job worktree no longer follows NTFS junctions into the main repo
entries.zh: 修复：在 Windows 上，删除后台任务工作树时不再跟随 NTFS 连接点（junction）进入主仓库的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/background` refusing sessions whose only typed input was a skill or custom slash command
entries.zh: 修复了`/background`拒绝仅输入技能或自定义斜线命令的会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode suppressing `AskUserQuestion` when the user or a skill explicitly relies on it; the auto-mode classifier now sees the user's answers as intent signal
entries.zh: 修复了当用户或技能明确依赖`AskUserQuestion`时自动模式会抑制`AskUserQuestion`的问题；自动模式分类器现在将用户的答案视为意图信号

entries.en: Fixed `/theme` "New custom theme" and color editor dialogs not responding to Esc
entries.zh: 修复了`/theme`“新自定义主题”和颜色编辑器对话框不响应 Esc 的问题

entries.en: Fixed an uncaught exception at the end of streaming sessions when running via the Agent SDK
entries.zh: 修复了通过 Agent SDK 运行时流会话结束时未捕获的异常

entries.en: Fixed a rare hang when waiting for scroll to settle on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 上等待滚动稳定时罕见的挂起问题

entries.en: Fixed stale and doubled rows in the agent view list on Windows when background session results contain wide (CJK) characters
entries.zh: 修复了当后台会话结果包含宽 (CJK) 字符时 Windows 上代理视图列表中的陈旧行和双行问题

entries.en: Fixed pasted text being delivered to agents as an unreadable `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder instead of the actual content
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴文本作为不可读的“[粘贴文本#N]”占位符而不是实际内容传递给代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin component counts in `claude plugin details` and `/plugin` being doubled when a plugin's manifest listed paths overlapping its default directories
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的清单列出的路径与其默认目录重叠时，“claude 插件详细信息”和`/plugin`中的插件组件计数加倍的问题

entries.en: Fixed backgrounded sessions re-prompting for tool permissions you already granted with "don't ask again"
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话重新提示您已通过“不再询问”授予的工具权限

entries.en: Fixed GNOME Terminal right-click and middle-click paste not inserting text
entries.zh: 修复了 GNOME 终端右键单击和中键单击粘贴不插入文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` not applying to teammate processes spawned by agent teams
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`不适用于代理团队生成的队友进程的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash commands followed by a tab or newline being treated as an unknown command
entries.zh: 修复了斜杠命令后跟制表符或换行符被视为未知命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed several spacing and layout glitches in the `/plugin`, `/status`, `/mobile`, `/sandbox`, and `/permissions` menus
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`、`/status`、`/mobile`、`/sandbox`和`/permissions`菜单中的多个间距和布局问题

entries.en: Fixed stripped images prompting the model to repeatedly re-read media that was no longer present
entries.zh: 修复了提示模型重复重新读取不再存在的媒体的剥离图像

entries.en: Added `claude agents --json` to list live Claude sessions as JSON for scripting (tmux-resurrect, status bars, session pickers)
entries.zh: 添加了 `claude Agents --json` 以将实时 Claude 会话列为 JSON 以便编写脚本（tmux-resurrect、状态栏、会话选择器）

entries.en: Added `agent_id` and `parent_agent_id` attributes to `claude_code.tool` OTEL spans, and fixed trace parenting so background subagent spans nest under the dispatching Agent tool span
entries.zh: 向`claude_code.tool`OTEL 跨度添加了`agent_id`和`parent_agent_id`属性，并修复了跟踪父子关系，以便后台子代理跨度嵌套在调度代理工具跨度下

entries.en: Status line JSON input now includes GitHub repo and PR information when detected
entries.zh: 状态栏的 JSON 输入现在包含检测到的 GitHub 仓库和 PR 信息

entries.en: `/plugin` Discover and Browse screens now show a plugin's commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP/LSP servers before installation
entries.zh: `/plugin` 的 Discover 和 Browse 页面现在会在安装前显示插件的命令、agent、skill、hook 以及 MCP/LSP 服务器

entries.en: `claude agents` terminal tab title now shows the awaiting-input count so an alt-tabbed window tells you when an agent needs attention
entries.zh: `claude agents` 的终端标签标题现在会显示等待输入的数量，这样切换到其他窗口时就能知道哪个 agent 需要处理
