entries.en: Slash command and @-mention suggestion list now supports mouse hover and click in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 全屏模式下，斜杠命令和 @ 提及的建议列表现在支持鼠标悬停和点击

entries.en: Stop and SubagentStop hook input now includes `background_tasks` and `session_crons` fields
entries.zh: Stop 和 SubagentStop 钩子的输入现在包含 `background_tasks` 和 `session_crons` 字段

entries.en: Fixed a permission-prompt bypass where bare variable assignments to non-allowlisted environment variables in Bash commands were auto-approved
entries.zh: 修复了权限提示旁路，其中 Bash 命令中对非白名单环境变量的裸变量分配被自动批准

entries.en: Fixed MCP prompt slash commands showing raw server validation errors when a required argument is omitted — the error now names the missing argument and shows expected usage
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 提示斜杠命令在省略必需参数时显示原始服务器验证错误 — 该错误现在命名缺少的参数并显示预期用法

entries.en: Fixed the spinner and elapsed-time display freezing until a keypress after the terminal was resized or refocused
entries.zh: 修复终端调整大小或重新获得焦点后，旋转指示器和已用时间显示冻结，直到按下一个键才恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed the cross-project resume hint failing in default Windows PowerShell 5.1 — Windows now uses `;` as the command separator
entries.zh: 修复默认的 Windows PowerShell 5.1 中跨项目恢复提示失效的问题；现在 Windows 使用 `;` 作为命令分隔符

entries.en: Fixed voice push-to-talk not working in the agent view's reply pane
entries.zh: 修复智能体视图的回复窗格中，语音一键通话不工作的问题

entries.en: Fixed task lists rendering in random order when several tasks are created at once
entries.zh: 修复同时创建多个任务时，任务列表顺序随机的问题

entries.en: Fixed stale "Failed to install Anthropic marketplace" banner showing when the marketplace is already installed
entries.zh: 修复了市场已安装时显示的陈旧“无法安装 Anthropic 市场”横幅

entries.en: Fixed the PR badge in the footer not updating immediately after `gh pr create` and other PR-state-changing commands run in-session
entries.zh: 修复在会话中运行 `gh pr create` 等改变 PR 状态的命令后，页脚的 PR 标记不会立即更新的问题

entries.en: Fixed Agent Teams teammates with non-ASCII names failing every API call due to invalid header encoding
entries.zh: 修复了具有非 ASCII 名称的 Agent Teams 队友由于标头编码无效而导致每次 API 调用失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/review` using a deprecated `projectCards` GraphQL query that errored on repos with Classic Projects
entries.zh: 修复了使用已弃用的`projectCards`GraphQL 查询的`/review`，该查询在经典项目的存储库上出错

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` not flagging `skills:` entries that point at a file instead of a directory — the error now suggests the parent directory
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`不标记指向文件而不是目录的`skills:`条目——错误现在建议父目录

entries.en: Fixed an infinite loop where a skill using `context: fork` could repeatedly re-invoke itself instead of running
entries.zh: 修复了一个无限循环，其中使用“context:fork”的技能可以重复地重新调用自身而不是运行

entries.en: Improved the Read tool to return a truncated first page with a "PARTIAL view" notice instead of a hard error when a whole-file read exceeds the token limit
entries.zh: 改进 Read 工具：整个文件读取超出 token 上限时，不再直接报错，而是返回截断的第一页，并带有「PARTIAL view」提示

entries.en: Added `/resume` support for background sessions — sessions started via `claude --bg` or agent view now appear alongside interactive ones, marked with `bg`
entries.zh: 添加了对后台会话的`/resume`支持 - 通过`claude --bg`或代理视图启动的会话现在显示在交互式会话旁边，并标记为`bg`

entries.en: Added elapsed duration to background subagent completion notifications (e.g. "Agent completed · 3h 2m 5s")
entries.zh: 在后台子代理完成通知中添加了经过的持续时间（例如“代理已完成 · 3h 2m 5s”）

entries.en: The `/plugin` browse and discover panes now show when a plugin was last updated
entries.zh: `/plugin` 的浏览和发现面板现在会显示插件的最后更新时间

entries.en: `/model` now changes the model for the current session only; press `d` in the model picker to set a default for new sessions
entries.zh: `/model` 现在只更改当前会话的模型；在模型选择器中按 `d` 可设置新会话的默认值

entries.en: Renamed "extra usage" to "usage credits" across CLI copy; `/extra-usage` is now `/usage-credits` (old name still works)
entries.zh: CLI 文案中的 "extra usage" 改称 "usage credits"；`/extra-usage` 改为 `/usage-credits`（旧名称仍可用）

entries.en: Fixed startup hanging up to 75s when `api.anthropic.com` is unreachable (captive portal, firewall, VPN issues) — side-channel API calls now time out after 15s
entries.zh: 修复了当`api.anthropic.com`无法访问时启动挂起长达 75 秒的问题（强制门户、防火墙、VPN 问题）——侧通道 API 调用现在在 15 秒后超时

entries.en: Fixed garbled terminal output after a missed window-resize event (e.g. dragging a VS Code split-pane divider) — now self-heals on the next frame instead of requiring Ctrl+L
entries.zh: 修复了错过窗口调整大小事件（例如拖动 VS Code 分割窗格分隔线）后出现乱码的终端输出 — 现在可以在下一帧上自我修复，而不需要使用 Ctrl+L

entries.en: Fixed progressive terminal display corruption (stale/garbled glyphs) that could appear in very long sessions and only cleared on terminal resize or restart
entries.zh: 修复了渐进式终端显示损坏（陈旧/乱码），该损坏可能出现在很长的会话中，并且仅在终端调整大小或重新启动时清除

entries.en: Reduced terminal rendering glitches in VS Code by reducing spinner animation color count
entries.zh: 通过减少加载动画的颜色数量，减少 VS Code 中终端的渲染异常

entries.en: Fixed macOS background sessions crashing with "exit 1 before init" when the project lives under a Full Disk Access-protected folder (regression in 2.1.143)
entries.zh: 修复了当项目位于受全盘访问保护的文件夹下时，macOS 后台会话因“init 之前退出 1”而崩溃的问题（2.1.143 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed an unrecoverable conversation when reading a file whose image extension doesn't match its contents (e.g. HTML saved as .png) — now falls back to text
entries.zh: 修复了读取图像扩展名与其内容不匹配的文件时出现的不可恢复的对话（例如，保存为 .png 的 HTML）——现在回退到文本

entries.en: Fewer spurious tool errors during search: `head`/`tail` file views now satisfy the read-before-edit check, and a "no matches" result (exit code 1) from `egrep`, `fgrep`, `git grep`, or `git diff` is no longer reported as a command failure
entries.zh: 搜索过程中的虚假工具错误更少：`head`/`tail`文件视图现在满足编辑前读取检查，并且来自`egrep`、`fgrep`、`git grep`或`git diff`的“不匹配”结果（退出代码 1）不再报告为命令失败

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` failing with "No conversation to branch" after entering a worktree or in some background sessions
entries.zh: 修复了进入工作树或某些后台会话后`/branch`失败并出现“无分支对话”的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing Escape in the AskUserQuestion notes field aborting the turn instead of returning to answer selection
entries.zh: 修复了在 AskUserQuestion 注释字段中按 Escape 会中止回合而不是返回答案选择的问题

entries.en: Fixed model selection not applying when changed via the IDE model picker or `applyFlagSettings` after startup
entries.zh: 修复了启动后通过 IDE 模型选择器或`applyFlagSettings`更改时模型选择不应用的问题

entries.en: Resumed sessions now keep the model they were using instead of picking up another session's `/model` choice
entries.zh: 恢复的会话现在保留其原本使用的模型，不再沿用其他会话的 `/model` 选择

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock and Vertex users unable to select "Opus (1M context)" from the `/model` picker (regression in v2.1.129)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bedrock 和 Vertex 用户无法从`/model`选择器中选择“Opus（1M 上下文）”的问题（v2.1.129 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed remote-session login failing with "Can't access this organization" for users with `forceLoginMethod` and `forceLoginOrgUUID` set
entries.zh: 修复了设置了`forceLoginMethod`和`forceLoginOrgUUID`的用户远程会话登录失败并显示“无法访问此组织”的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers with paginated `tools/list` responses only returning the first page, silently dropping tools
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 服务器的分页“工具/列表”响应仅返回第一页，默默地删除工具

entries.en: Fixed MCP images with unsupported MIME types (e.g. SVG) breaking the conversation — now saved to disk and referenced in the tool result
entries.zh: 修复了具有不支持的 MIME 类型（例如 SVG）的 MCP 图像，从而破坏了对话 - 现在保存到磁盘并在工具结果中引用

entries.en: Fixed file descriptor exhaustion when a build runs inside a skill directory — non-`.md` files no longer trigger skill reloads
entries.zh: 修复了构建在技能目录中运行时文件描述符耗尽的问题 - 非`.md`文件不再触发技能重新加载

entries.en: Fixed session title being generated from plugin monitor output instead of the user's first prompt
entries.zh: 修复了从插件监视器输出而不是用户的第一个提示生成的会话标题

entries.en: Fixed Skill tool failing with permission error in headless mode (regression in v2.1.141)
entries.zh: 修复了无头模式下技能工具因权限错误而失败的问题（v2.1.141 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed plugins enabled in your own settings showing "not cached" errors after first load on a fresh machine; plugins enabled only by a project's `.claude/settings.json` now show an actionable `claude plugin install` hint
entries.zh: 修复了在您自己的设置中启用的插件在首次加载到新计算机上后显示“未缓存”错误的问题；仅由项目的`.claude/settings.json`启用的插件现在显示可操作的“claude 插件安装”提示

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp list` silently reporting no servers when `.mcp.json` can't be parsed (e.g. using VS Code's `"servers"` key instead of `"mcpServers"`) — now shows configuration errors
entries.zh: 修复了当无法解析`.mcp.json`时`claude mcp list`静默报告没有服务器的问题（例如，使用 VS Code 的“servers”键而不是“mcpServers”）——现在显示配置错误

entries.en: Fixed background side-queries on custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` setups and Bedrock Mantle not using Haiku — now falls back correctly when a first-party API key is configured or no Haiku model is set
entries.zh: 修复了自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`设置和基岩地幔不使用俳句的后台侧查询 - 现在，当配置第一方 API 密钥或未设置俳句模型时，可以正确回退

entries.en: Fixed scrolling in attached background sessions on Windows — PgUp/PgDn, mouse wheel, and Ctrl+O transcript navigation now work
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上附加后台会话中的滚动问题 - PgUp/PgDn、鼠标滚轮和 Ctrl+O 转录导航现在可以使用

entries.en: Fixed a crash when closing the terminal while attached to a background session
entries.zh: 修复了连接到后台会话时关闭终端时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed on Windows, pressing ← in `claude agents` leaving the list unresponsive to keyboard input
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 上，在“claude Agents”中按 ← 使列表对键盘输入无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed ghost characters at the left edge when switching panes in Agent View on Windows Terminal with CJK content
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 终端上的代理视图中切换带有 CJK 内容的窗格时左侧边缘出现重影字符的问题

entries.en: `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve directories added via `/add-dir`
entries.zh: `/bg` 和 `←` 分离现在会保留通过 `/add-dir` 添加的目录

entries.en: Fixed Edit/Write refusing with "background session hasn't isolated its changes yet" right after detaching a session that was already editing in place
entries.zh: 修复了在分离已就位编辑的会话后立即拒绝编辑/写入的问题，并显示“后台会话尚未隔离其更改”

entries.en: Fixed `claude respawn <id>` on a stopped background session showing "stopped" instead of running
entries.zh: 修复了`claude respawn <id>`在已停止的后台会话上显示“已停止”而不是正在运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` picker not showing sessions forked from a background session
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`选择器不显示从后台会话分叉的会话

entries.en: Fixed opening a session from `claude agents` or running `claude logs <id>` hanging when the background service is unresponsive — now times out after 10s with a recovery hint
entries.zh: 修复了当后台服务无响应时从“claudeagents”打开会话或运行“claudelogs<id>”挂起的问题 - 现在在 10 秒后超时，并显示恢复提示

entries.en: Fixed background Bash tasks spawned by subagents staying "Running" in SDK task panels after the process exits
entries.zh: 修复了进程退出后在 SDK 任务面板中保持“运行”状态的子代理生成的后台 Bash 任务

entries.en: Fixed completed or stopped background sessions briefly failing to wake being permanently marked as a startup crash
entries.zh: 修复了已完成或停止的后台会话暂时无法唤醒并被永久标记为启动崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed markdown links in `claude agents` attached sessions rendering as plain text instead of clickable hyperlinks
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”附加会话中的降价链接呈现为纯文本而不是可点击的超链接

entries.en: Fixed custom `spinnerVerbs` applying to the post-turn duration message — past-tense built-ins like "Worked for 5s" are restored there
entries.zh: 修复了应用于回合后持续时间消息的自定义`spinnerVerbs` - 过去时内置项（例如“工作了 5 秒”）在那里恢复

entries.en: `claude agents` / `--bg` rejection messages now name the specific gate (non-TTY, env var, or setting) instead of a generic message
entries.zh: `claude agents` 和 `--bg` 的拒绝信息现在会指明具体限制条件（非 TTY、环境变量或设置），而不是通用提示

entries.en: `claude --bg --name <label>` now echoes the name in the post-spawn confirmation
entries.zh: `claude --bg --name <label>` 现在会在启动后的确认信息中显示该名称

entries.en: `claude agents`: renaming a background session with Ctrl+R now updates the attached session's banner immediately
entries.zh: `claude agents`：用 Ctrl+R 重命名后台会话后，已附加会话的横幅会立即更新

entries.en: Background session worktree isolation guard now applies for non-git VCS users with `WorktreeCreate` hooks configured
entries.zh: 后台会话工作树隔离防护现在适用于配置了`WorktreeCreate`挂钩的非 git VCS 用户

entries.en: Plugin marketplace add/update now respects `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS`
entries.zh: 插件市场的添加和更新现在遵循 `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS`

entries.en: `/plugin` now returns to the Installed list after enabling, disabling, or uninstalling a plugin
entries.zh: `/plugin` 在启用、禁用或卸载插件后，现在会返回 Installed 列表

entries.en: `/doctor` now shows an exec-form example when a command hook is missing the `command` field
entries.zh: 当命令 hook 缺少 `command` 字段时，`/doctor` 现在会显示 exec 形式的示例

entries.en: Skill-listing truncation is no longer shown as a startup notification — run `/doctor` for the full breakdown
entries.zh: 技能列表截断不再作为启动通知显示；如需完整说明，请运行 `/doctor`

entries.en: Improved recovery from rare pre-response stream stalls — now retries streaming once instead of falling back to a slower non-streaming request
entries.zh: 改进响应前偶发的流卡顿恢复：现在会重试一次流式请求，而不是退回到较慢的非流式请求

entries.en: Improved SDK/headless MCP startup: pre-wait now overlaps startup instead of blocking before the first turn (up to 2s faster with slow MCP servers)
entries.zh: 改进 SDK 和无界面模式的 MCP 启动：预等待与启动过程重叠，不再阻塞第一轮对话（MCP 服务器较慢时最多快 2 秒）

entries.en: The post-survey follow-up hint now appears after every non-dismiss survey response with context-aware copy, making it easier to share more detail via /feedback.
entries.zh: 每次非“不再提示”的问卷反馈后，现在都会出现后续提示，文案会根据上下文变化，方便通过 /feedback 分享更多细节

entries.en: Added plugin dependency enforcement: `claude plugin disable` now refuses when another enabled plugin depends on the target (with a copy-pasteable disable-chain hint), and `claude plugin enable` force-enables transitive dependencies
entries.zh: 添加了插件依赖项强制执行：当另一个启用的插件依赖于目标（带有可复制粘贴禁用链提示）时，“claude 插件禁用”现在会拒绝，并且“claude 插件启用”强制启用传递依赖项

entries.en: Added projected context cost (per-turn and per-invocation token estimates) to the `/plugin` marketplace browse pane
entries.zh: 在`/plugin`市场浏览窗格中添加了预计的上下文成本（每轮和每次调用令牌估计）

entries.en: Added `worktree.bgIsolation: "none"` setting to let background sessions edit the working copy directly without `EnterWorktree`, for repos where worktrees are impractical
entries.zh: 添加了 `worktree.bgIsolation: "none"` 设置，让后台会话直接编辑工作副本，而无需使用 `EnterWorktree`，适用于工作树不切实际的存储库

entries.en: PowerShell tool now passes `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`. Opt out with `CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY=1`
entries.zh: PowerShell 工具现在会传入 `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`。如需退出，设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY=1`

entries.en: Background sessions now preserve the model and effort level you set after waking from idle
entries.zh: 后台会话现在保留您从空闲状态唤醒后设置的模型和工作量级别

entries.en: Shift+Tab in attached agent sessions now includes auto mode in the cycle
entries.zh: 已连接的代理会话中，Shift+Tab 的循环现在包含自动模式

entries.en: Fixed a corrupt `.credentials.json` with a non-array `scopes` value hanging the CLI on startup or silently aborting OAuth token refresh
entries.zh: 修复了损坏的`.credentials.json`，其非数组`scopes`值在启动时挂起 CLI 或静默中止 OAuth 令牌刷新

entries.en: Fixed right-click paste in `claude agents` on Windows Terminal and WSL
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 终端和 WSL 上“克劳德代理”中的右键单击粘贴问题

entries.en: Fixed stop hooks that block repeatedly looping forever — the turn now ends with a warning after 8 consecutive blocks (override via `CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP`)
entries.zh: 修复了永远阻止重复循环的停止钩子 — 现在，回合在连续 8 个块后以警告结束（通过`CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP`覆盖）

entries.en: Fixed Esc/Ctrl+C not cancelling a pending `/loop` wakeup while Claude is idle between iterations
entries.zh: 修复了当克劳德在迭代之间空闲时 Esc/Ctrl+C 不会取消挂起的`/loop`唤醒

entries.en: Fixed `/goal` evaluator firing while background shells or delegated subagents are still running
entries.zh: 修复了后台 shell 或委托子代理仍在运行时触发`/goal`评估器的问题

entries.en: Fixed `NO_COLOR`/`FORCE_COLOR` in settings.json `env` stripping Claude Code's own UI colors — they now apply to subprocesses only
entries.zh: 修复了 settings.json `env` 中的 `NO_COLOR`/`FORCE_COLOR` 剥离 Claude Code 自己的 UI 颜色 - 它们现在仅适用于子进程

entries.en: Fixed agent view spawning repeated PowerShell processes on Windows when listing sessions
entries.zh: 修复了列出会话时代理视图在 Windows 上生成重复的 PowerShell 进程的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/bg` without a prompt sending "continue" to the forked session — the fork now waits for input
entries.zh: 修复了`/bg`，没有提示发送“继续”到分叉会话 - 分叉现在等待输入

entries.en: Fixed `--agent <name>` not finding plugin-contributed agents without the `plugin:` prefix
entries.zh: 修复了`--agent <name>`找不到没有`plugin:`前缀的插件贡献的代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed deleting a session from agent view not removing its transcript file
entries.zh: 修复了从代理视图中删除会话而不删除其脚本文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed stale-fragment rendering when scrolling in attached background sessions on Windows Terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 终端上附加的后台会话中滚动时出现陈旧片段渲染的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents false-positive worker-stall detection storm after host sleep or macOS App Nap
entries.zh: 修复了主机睡眠或 macOS App Nap 后后台代理误报工作停止检测风暴

entries.en: Fixed 5xx error messages pointing at status.claude.com instead of naming the configured gateway or cloud provider
entries.zh: 修复了指向 status.claude.com 而不是命名已配置网关或云提供商的 5xx 错误消息

entries.en: The PowerShell tool is now enabled by default on Windows for Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry users. Opt out with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=0`.
entries.zh: PowerShell 工具现在在 Windows 上对 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 用户默认启用。可用 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=0` 关闭

entries.en: `claude agents` now accepts `--add-dir`, `--settings`, `--mcp-config`, and `--plugin-dir` and applies them to the dashboard and to background sessions dispatched from it
entries.zh: `claude agents` 现在接受 `--add-dir`、`--settings`、`--mcp-config` 和 `--plugin-dir`，并将其应用于仪表盘以及从仪表盘派发的后台会话

entries.en: `claude agents` accepts `--permission-mode`, `--model`, `--effort`, and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to set defaults for sessions dispatched from the view
entries.zh: `claude agents` 现在接受 `--permission-mode`、`--model`、`--effort` 和 `--dangerously-skip-permissions`，用于设置从该视图派发的会话的默认值

entries.en: `claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions` now persists across retire→wake
entries.zh: `claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions` 现在在 retire→wake 之后仍然保持生效

entries.en: Fixed background sessions silently capturing IDE file references into the warm spare's input, which caused the reference to be prepended to the next prompt dispatched from `claude agents`
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话以静默方式将 IDE 文件引用捕获到热备用输入中的问题，这导致该引用被添加到从“claude Agents”调度的下一个提示符之前

entries.en: Worktree cleanup no longer falls back to `rm -rf` when `git worktree remove` fails, preventing loss of gitignored or in-progress files
entries.zh: 工作树清理在 `git worktree remove` 失败时不再回退到 `rm -rf`，避免丢失被 gitignore 的文件或正在编辑的文件

entries.en: Fixed background-job sessions on macOS getting "Operation not permitted" errors when reading files under `~/Documents`, `~/Desktop`, or `~/Downloads`, even with Full Disk Access granted.
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上的后台作业会话在读取 `~/Documents`、`~/Desktop` 或 `~/Downloads` 下的文件时出现“不允许操作”错误的问题，即使授予了完全磁盘访问权限也是如此。

entries.en: `/bg` now preserves `--mcp-config`, `--settings`, `--add-dir`, `--plugin-dir`, and `--strict-mcp-config`, so backgrounded sessions keep their MCP servers and settings across respawn.
entries.zh: `/bg` 现在会保留 `--mcp-config`、`--settings`、`--add-dir`、`--plugin-dir` 和 `--strict-mcp-config`，使后台会话在重新启动后仍保留其 MCP 服务器和设置

entries.en: Background sessions launched from `claude agents` now honor `permissions.defaultMode` from settings.json (was previously overridden to auto mode)
entries.zh: 从“claude Agents”启动的后台会话现在支持 settings.json 中的`permissions.defaultMode`（之前被覆盖为自动模式）

entries.en: Fixed: on Windows, pressing ← in `claude agents` while a response was streaming could leave the agents list unresponsive to all input
entries.zh: 修复：在 Windows 上，回复流式输出时在 `claude agents` 中按 ←，可能导致智能体列表对所有输入都无响应的问题

entries.en: `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve `--fallback-model`, so backgrounded workers degrade to the fallback model on overload instead of hard-failing.
entries.zh: `/bg` 和 `←` 分离现在会保留 `--fallback-model`，使后台工作进程在过载时降级到备用模型，而不是直接失败。

entries.en: `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`, so the forked worker keeps bypass-permissions available in its Shift+Tab cycle.
entries.zh: `/bg` 和 `←` 分离现在会保留 `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`，因此分叉出的工作进程仍可在 Shift+Tab 循环中使用 bypass permissions 模式。

entries.en: Fixed: background daemon spawn now falls back to the running binary when the `~/.local/bin/claude` launcher is missing or non-executable
entries.zh: 修复：当 `~/.local/bin/claude` 启动器缺失或不可执行时，后台守护进程启动会回退到正在运行的二进制文件

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` defaulting dispatched sessions to bypass mode instead of making it available in the permission cycle
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions”，默认分派会话为绕过模式，而不是使其在权限周期中可用

entries.en: Added new `claude agents` flags: `--add-dir`, `--settings`, `--mcp-config`, `--plugin-dir`, `--permission-mode`, `--model`, `--effort`, and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to configure dispatched background sessions
entries.zh: 添加了新的“claude Agents”标志：`--add-dir`、`--settings`、`--mcp-config`、`--plugin-dir`、`--permission-mode`、`--model`、`--effort`和`--dangerously-skip-permissions`来配置分派的后台会话

entries.en: Fast mode now uses Opus 4.7 by default (previously Opus 4.6). Set `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE=1` to pin fast mode to Opus 4.6
entries.zh: 快速模式现在默认使用 Opus 4.7（之前为 Opus 4.6）。设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE=1` 将快速模式固定到 Opus 4.6

entries.en: Plugins with a root-level `SKILL.md` and no `skills/` subdirectory are now surfaced as a skill
entries.zh: 根目录下有 `SKILL.md` 且没有 `skills/` 子目录的插件，现在会被识别为一个技能

entries.en: The `/plugin` details pane and `claude plugin details` now show LSP servers a plugin provides
entries.zh: `/plugin` 的详情面板和 `claude plugin details` 现在会显示插件提供的 LSP 服务器

entries.en: `/web-setup` warns before replacing an existing GitHub App connection
entries.zh: `/web-setup` 在替换已有的 GitHub App 连接前会先给出警告

entries.en: Fixed `MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT` not raising the per-request fetch timeout for remote HTTP and SSE MCP servers, which capped tool calls at 60 seconds regardless of the configured value
entries.zh: 修复了`MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT`不会提高远程 HTTP 和 SSE MCP 服务器的每个请求获取超时的问题，这将工具调用限制为 60 秒，无论配置的值如何

entries.en: Fixed background sessions not recognizing pre-existing git worktrees, blocking Edit while EnterWorktree refused to create a duplicate
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话无法识别预先存在的 git 工作树、阻止编辑而 EnterWorktree 拒绝创建重复项的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions disappearing and daemon reconnect failing after macOS sleep/wake — the daemon now detects clock jumps instead of treating them as elapsed idle time
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 睡眠/唤醒后后台会话消失和守护程序重新连接失败的问题 - 守护程序现在检测时钟跳跃，而不是将其视为已用的空闲时间

entries.en: Fixed daemon not exiting cleanly after the binary is upgraded (e.g. `brew upgrade`), causing dispatched agents to crash-loop on the deleted path
entries.zh: 修复了二进制文件升级后守护进程未完全退出的问题（例如“brew升级”），导致调度的代理在已删除的路径上崩溃循环

entries.en: Fixed background agents crash-looping when the Claude-in-Chrome extension is connected without a shared tab
entries.zh: 修复了在没有共享选项卡的情况下连接 Claude-in-Chrome 扩展程序时后台代理崩溃循环的问题

entries.en: Fixed clicking links in an attached `claude agents` session — the background worker's headless browser shim no longer applies while attached
entries.zh: 修复了附加的“克劳德代理”会话中的单击链接 - 后台工作人员的无头浏览器垫片在附加时不再适用

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` "v to open in editor" using the daemon's default editor instead of your shell's `$EDITOR`/`$VISUAL`
entries.zh: 使用守护程序的默认编辑器而不是 shell 的`$EDITOR`/`$VISUAL`修复了“claude Agents”“v 在编辑器中打开”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` deadlocking on Windows with network-drive working directories; Ctrl+C now works during startup
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上使用网络驱动器工作目录的“claude Agents”死锁问题； Ctrl+C 现在可以在启动期间使用

entries.en: Fixed background-color bleed when attaching to a `claude agents` session from Apple Terminal or other 256-color-only terminals
entries.zh: 修复了从 Apple 终端或其他仅 256 色终端连接到“claude Agents”会话时出现的背景颜色溢出问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions` not persisting across retire/wake
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions`在退休/唤醒期间不持续存在的问题

entries.en: Fixed session titles being derived from the URL when the first message is a link
entries.zh: 修复了当第一条消息是链接时从 URL 派生的会话标题

entries.en: Fixed redundant `set_model` requests from remote clients injecting duplicate `/model` breadcrumbs into the transcript
entries.zh: 修复了来自远程客户端的冗余`set_model`请求，将重复的`/model`面包屑注入到转录本中

entries.en: Fixed plugins using `skills: ["./"]` showing a false "path escapes plugin directory" error
entries.zh: 修复了使用 `skills: ["./"]` 的插件显示错误的“路径转义插件目录”错误

entries.en: Fixed plugin cache cleanup deleting the active plugin version directory when no installation metadata is present
entries.zh: 修复了插件缓存清理在不存在安装元数据时删除活动插件版本目录的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` browse pane showing "0 installs" for newly published plugins
entries.zh: 修复了新发布插件的`/plugin`浏览窗格显示“0 安装”的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin advisories not naming every `plugin.json` key that shadows a default folder
entries.zh: 修复了插件建议未命名每个隐藏默认文件夹的`plugin.json`键的问题

entries.en: Improved reactive compaction: the first summarize attempt now seeds from the original request's overflow size, avoiding a wasted near-full-context retry
entries.zh: 改进响应式压缩：第一次摘要尝试会以原始请求的超出长度为起点，避免一次接近满上下文的无效重试

entries.en: Improved hook configuration error: configuring a prompt- or agent-type hook for `SessionStart`/`Setup`/`SubagentStart` now shows a clear "use a command-type hook instead" error
entries.zh: 改进 hook 配置错误提示：为 `SessionStart`、`Setup`、`SubagentStart` 配置 prompt 或 agent 类型的 hook 时，会明确提示“请改用 command 类型的 hook”

entries.en: Removed stale `/model claude-sonnet-4-20250514` suggestion from Usage Policy refusal messages
entries.zh: 用量政策拒绝消息中，移除了过时的 `/model claude-sonnet-4-20250514` 建议

entries.en: Added `terminalSequence` field to hook JSON output so hooks can emit desktop notifications, window titles, and bells without a controlling terminal
entries.zh: 添加了`terminalSequence`字段来挂钩 JSON 输出，以便挂钩可以在没有控制终端的情况下发出桌面通知、窗口标题和铃声

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS` to clone GitHub plugin sources over HTTPS instead of SSH, for environments without a GitHub SSH key
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS`，以通过 HTTPS 而不是 SSH 克隆 GitHub 插件源，适用于没有 GitHub SSH 密钥的环境

entries.en: Added `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID` environment variable for workload identity federation — scopes the minted token to a specific workspace when the federation rule covers more than one
entries.zh: 为工作负载身份联合添加了`ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID`环境变量 - 当联合规则涵盖多个工作区时，将铸造令牌的范围限定为特定工作区

entries.en: Added `claude agents --cwd <path>` to scope the session list to a directory
entries.zh: 添加了“claude Agents --cwd <path>”以将会话列表范围限定到目录

entries.en: `/feedback` can now include recent sessions (last 24 hours or 7 days) for issues spanning more than the current session
entries.zh: `/feedback` 现在可以包含最近的会话（最近 24 小时或 7 天），用于涵盖超出当前会话的问题

entries.en: Rewind menu: added "Summarize up to here" to compress earlier context while keeping recent turns intact
entries.zh: 回滚菜单新增 "Summarize up to here"，可压缩较早的上下文，同时保留最近几轮对话

entries.en: Auto mode permission dialog now explains when a `permissions.ask` rule caused the prompt
entries.zh: 自动模式权限对话框现在会解释`permissions.ask`规则何时导致提示

entries.en: Restored the "view diff in your IDE" option on file-edit permission prompts when an IDE is connected
entries.zh: 连接了 IDE 时，文件编辑权限提示上的 "在 IDE 中查看差异" 选项已恢复

entries.en: Background agents launched via `/bg` or `←←` now preserve the current permission mode instead of reverting to default
entries.zh: 通过`/bg`或`←←`启动的后台代理现在保留当前权限模式，而不是恢复为默认模式

entries.en: `claude agents`: agents that finish work but leave a background shell running now move to Completed instead of staying under Working
entries.zh: `claude agents`：完成工作但留下后台 shell 仍在运行的 agent，现在会移到 Completed，而不是留在 Working 中

entries.en: Improved spinner feedback during long thinking periods — the spinner now warms to amber after 10 seconds to signal Claude is still working
entries.zh: 改进长时间思考时的加载提示：10 秒后加载动画会变为琥珀色，提示 Claude 仍在工作

entries.en: Improved plugin menu navigation: `→`/Tab switch tabs, `↑` moves to the tab strip, and tab headers and search box are clickable in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 改进插件菜单导航：`→`/Tab 切换标签页，`↑` 移到标签栏；全屏模式下，标签页标题和搜索框可以点击

entries.en: Fixed background side-queries sending an unavailable Haiku model ID on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/gateway when no `ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL` override is set — now falls back to the main-loop model
entries.zh: 修复了当未设置`ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL`覆盖时在 Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/gateway 上发送不可用 Haiku 模型 ID 的后台侧查询 - 现在回退到主循环模型

entries.en: Fixed `claude daemon status` and `/doctor` on Windows throwing when the daemon pipe key file is locked or unreadable — now shows the underlying error instead of an opaque failure
entries.zh: 修复了当守护进程管道密钥文件被锁定或不可读时 Windows 上的`claude daemon status`和`/doctor`抛出的问题 - 现在显示潜在错误而不是不透明的故障

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` showing the agent-type list instead of the dashboard when launched through a wrapper that adds flags
entries.zh: 修复了通过添加标志的包装器启动时显示代理类型列表而不是仪表板的“克劳德代理”

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` opening a crashed session firing redundant dispatches when the working directory was deleted
entries.zh: 修复了删除工作目录时打开崩溃会话并触发冗余调度的“克劳德代理”

entries.en: Fixed background jobs on a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway not getting auto-named — the namer now uses the main model when no Haiku model is configured
entries.zh: 修复了自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`网关上的后台作业未自动命名的问题 - 当未配置俳句模型时，命名器现在使用主模型

entries.en: Fixed `/model` in one session silently changing the autocompact threshold in other concurrent sessions
entries.zh: 修复了一个会话中的`/model`默默地更改其他并发会话中的自动压缩阈值的问题

entries.en: Fixed switching permission mode while a tool-permission prompt is open not auto-dismissing the prompt when the new setting permits the tool
entries.zh: 修复了在打开工具权限提示时切换权限模式，当新设置允许该工具时不会自动关闭提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing Enter while a permission/dialog prompt is open also submitting text in the input box
entries.zh: 修复了在权限/对话框提示打开时按 Enter 键并在输入框中提交文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed hooks receiving a non-existent `transcript_path` after `EnterWorktree` switches the working directory
entries.zh: 修复了在`EnterWorktree`切换工作目录后接收不存在的`transcript_path`的钩子

entries.en: Fixed markdown tables with cell wrapping falling back to the vertical key-value layout instead of rendering as a bordered grid (regression in 2.1.136)
entries.zh: 修复了单元格换行回落到垂直键值布局的降价表，而不是呈现为有边框的网格（2.1.136 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed cancelled prompts being removed from Up-arrow history when auto-restored into the input box, avoiding duplicate entries
entries.zh: 修复了自动恢复到输入框中时从向上箭头历史记录中删除已取消的提示，避免重复输入

entries.en: Fixed prompts cancelled with Ctrl+C/Esc before any response being dropped from Up-arrow history
entries.zh: 修复了在从向上箭头历史记录中删除任何响应之前使用 Ctrl+C/Esc 取消的提示

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C not interrupting a running turn while in vim INSERT/VISUAL mode
entries.zh: 修复了在 vim INSERT/VISUAL 模式下 Ctrl+C 不会中断正在运行的转弯

entries.en: Fixed alternative `chat:submit` keybindings (e.g. `meta+enter`, `ctrl+enter`) not working when `enter` is rebound to `chat:newline`
entries.zh: 修复了当`enter`反弹到`chat:newline`时替代`chat:submit`键绑定（例如`meta+enter`、`ctrl+enter`）不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions being silently disabled when an output style was configured
entries.zh: 修复了配置输出样式时提示建议被默默禁用的问题

entries.en: Fixed `spinnerVerbs` setting not being honored in turn-completion messages
entries.zh: 修复了回合完成消息中未遵循`spinnerVerbs`设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion popup hiding the last line of preceding chat content
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 弹出窗口隐藏前面聊天内容的最后一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Web Search status showing "Did 0 searches" when searches returned errors
entries.zh: 修复了搜索返回错误时显示“进行 0 次搜索”的 Web 搜索状态

entries.en: Fixed multi-line statusline output dropping or corrupting rows when any line exceeds terminal width
entries.zh: 修复了当任何行超过终端宽度时多行状态行输出会丢弃或损坏行的问题

entries.en: Fixed light-ansi theme using invisible white for diff context lines on light backgrounds — now uses black
entries.zh: 修复了 light-ansi 主题，在浅色背景上使用不可见的白色来区分上下文线 - 现在使用黑色

entries.en: Fixed error overlay dumping minified bundle source that hid the original error message
entries.zh: 修复了错误覆盖转储隐藏原始错误消息的缩小包源的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing Enter after typing a feedback survey rating digit submitting it as a chat message instead of the rating
entries.zh: 修复了输入反馈调查评级数字后按 Enter 键将其作为聊天消息而不是评级提交的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing `x` on a selected subagent in the agent panel typing into the prompt instead of stopping the agent
entries.zh: 修复了在代理面板中的选定子代理上按`x`输入提示而不是停止代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed session title being derived from plugin monitor notifications before the user's first prompt
entries.zh: 修复了在用户第一次提示之前从插件监视器通知派生的会话标题

entries.en: Fixed "Allowed by PermissionRequest hook" repeating once per tool call under a collapsed read/search group
entries.zh: 修复了折叠读取/搜索组下每个工具调用重复一次的“PermissionRequest 挂钩允许”问题

entries.en: Fixed `/tui` silently dropping running background shells and subagents — now refuses and asks to wait for them to finish
entries.zh: 修复了`/tui`默默地丢弃正在运行的后台 shell 和子代理 - 现在拒绝并要求等待它们完成

entries.en: Fixed welcome banner showing "API Usage Billing" on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and other third-party providers — now shows the provider name
entries.zh: 修复在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 等第三方服务商上，欢迎横幅显示"API Usage Billing"的问题；现在会显示服务商名称

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` server list not keeping the focused server visible in short terminals in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`服务器列表不使焦点服务器在全屏模式下的短终端中可见的问题

entries.en: Fixed redaction in `/feedback` bundles producing invalid JSON for quoted values like session IDs
entries.zh: 修复了`/feedback`包中的编辑，为会话 ID 等引用值生成无效 JSON

entries.en: Fixed desktop and third-party provider sessions incorrectly inheriting `apiKeyHelper`/`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` from host managed-settings
entries.zh: 修复了桌面和第三方提供商会话错误地从主机托管设置继承`apiKeyHelper`/`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`的问题

entries.en: Fixed early analytics events being silently dropped when fired before logger initialization
entries.zh: 修复了在记录器初始化之前触发时早期分析事件被静默丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for plugins whose marketplace `ref` no longer exists upstream when a `sha` is also pinned
entries.zh: 修复了当`sha`也被固定时，其市场`ref`不再存在于上游的插件的“claude插件安装”失败问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin details pane showing 0 MCP servers for plugins that declare them via `.mcp.json`
entries.zh: 修复了插件详细信息窗格，显示通过`.mcp.json`声明的插件的 0 个 MCP 服务器

entries.en: Fixed plugin MCP servers with unset config variables showing a generic connection failure instead of a "config issue" message with a fix-it hint; malformed `.mcp.json` entries no longer drop other MCP servers
entries.zh: 修复了未设置配置变量的插件 MCP 服务器显示一般连接失败，而不是带有修复提示的“配置问题”消息；格式错误的`.mcp.json`条目不再删除其他 MCP 服务器

entries.en: Fixed MCP server configs using POSIX shell parameter expansions (e.g. `${var%pattern}`) being incorrectly flagged as missing environment variables
entries.zh: 修复了使用 POSIX shell 参数扩展（例如 `${var%pattern}`）的 MCP 服务器配置被错误地标记为缺少环境变量的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP HTTP/SSE servers returning 403 on connect showing as "failed" instead of "needs auth"
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP HTTP/SSE 服务器在连接时返回 403 显示为“失败”而不是“需要身份验证”的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote MCP servers disconnecting unnecessarily when the optional server-events stream failed to reconnect — tool calls continue over POST
entries.zh: 修复了当可选服务器事件流无法重新连接时远程 MCP 服务器不必要地断开连接 — 工具调用通过 POST 继续进行

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control MCP connectors all failing with 401 when the worker session token rotated mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了当工作会话令牌在会话中轮换时，远程控制 MCP 连接器全部失败并显示 401

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control automatically re-enrolling a trusted device when the server rejects a stale token, instead of looping through `/login`
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器拒绝过时令牌时远程控制自动重新注册受信任的设备，而不是通过`/login`循环

entries.en: Fixed a race where early OTel spans could be silently dropped in SDK/headless mode with beta tracing enabled
entries.zh: 修复了在启用 Beta 跟踪的情况下，早期 OTel 跨度可能会在 SDK/无头模式下默默丢弃的竞赛

entries.en: Fixed custom `voice:pushToTalk` keybindings and `"space": null` unbinds being silently ignored
entries.zh: 修复了自定义 `voice:pushToTalk` 键绑定和 `"space": null` 解除绑定被默默忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed Windows Alt+V image paste reporting "no image found" when the clipboard contains a screenshot
entries.zh: 修复了当剪贴板包含屏幕截图时 Windows Alt+V 图像粘贴报告“未找到图像”的问题

entries.en: Fixed SDK "Claude Code native binary not found" on Linux when both glibc and musl platform packages are installed
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上同时安装 glibc 和 musl 平台软件包时 SDK“未找到 Claude Code 本机二进制文件”的问题

entries.en: Bedrock: `awsCredentialExport` now always runs when configured instead of being skipped when ambient AWS credentials resolve, fixing auth for cross-account access
entries.zh: 基岩：`awsCredentialExport`现在在配置时始终运行，而不是在环境 AWS 凭证解析时被跳过，修复了跨账户访问的身份验证

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed in-chat mic showing no feedback when the microphone produced only silence — now shows "No audio detected"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复聊天中的麦克风在只收到静音时没有任何反馈的问题；现在会显示 "No audio detected"

entries.en: [VSCode] Voice mode: the WSL error now suggests installing `sox libsox-fmt-pulse` for WSLg users
entries.zh: [VSCode] 语音模式：WSL 报错时，现在会建议 WSLg 用户安装 `sox libsox-fmt-pulse`

entries.en: `claude agents`: launching a session no longer fails when the pre-warmed background worker is unhealthy — now falls back to a fresh launch
entries.zh: `claude agents`：预热的后台工作进程不健康时，启动会话不再失败，现在会回退为全新启动

entries.en: `claude agents` no longer shows empty placeholder sessions left over from backgrounding a fresh REPL, and shows onboarding text when entered via ← with no other agents
entries.zh: `claude agents` 不再显示从新建 REPL 转入后台后遗留的空白占位会话；通过 ← 进入且没有其他 agent 时，会显示引导文字

entries.en: Empty idle background sessions left over from `←` are now automatically retired by the daemon after 5 minutes
entries.zh: 现在，守护进程会在 5 分钟后自动退出`←`留下的空空闲后台会话

entries.en: Improved Agent tool `subagent_type` matching to accept case- and separator-insensitive values (e.g. `"Code Reviewer"` resolves to `code-reviewer`)
entries.zh: 改进 Agent 工具的 `subagent_type` 匹配：忽略大小写和分隔符差异（如 `"Code Reviewer"` 可匹配到 `code-reviewer`）

entries.en: Updated agent color palette
entries.zh: 更新了代理的颜色方案

entries.en: Fixed `/goal` silently hanging when `disableAllHooks` or `allowManagedHooksOnly` is set — now shows a clear message instead of an indicator that never resolves
entries.zh: 修复了设置`disableAllHooks`或`allowManagedHooksOnly`时`/goal`静默挂起的问题 - 现在显示一条清晰的消息，而不是永远无法解析的指示器

entries.en: Fixed a regression in settings hot-reload where symlinked settings files caused misattributed change events and spurious `ConfigChange` hooks
entries.zh: 修复了设置热重载中的回归，其中符号链接的设置文件导致错误归因的更改事件和虚假的`ConfigChange`挂钩

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg` failing with "connection dropped mid-request" when the background service was about to idle-exit
entries.zh: 修复了当后台服务即将空闲退出时`claude --bg`因“连接在请求中丢失”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed background service startup failing on machines with enterprise endpoint security by allowing more time
entries.zh: 通过允许更多时间，修复了具有企业端点安全性的计算机上后台服务启动失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote managed settings not retrying on 401 — now retries once with a force-refreshed token
entries.zh: 修复了远程管理设置不在 401 上重试的问题 - 现在使用强制刷新令牌重试一次

entries.en: Fixed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` auto-update policy not being persisted to `known_marketplaces.json`
entries.zh: 修复了托管`extraKnownMarketplaces`自动更新策略未保留到`known_marketplaces.json`的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/loop` scheduling redundant wakeups to poll for background tasks that already notify on completion
entries.zh: 修复了`/loop`调度冗余唤醒以轮询已通知完成的后台任务

entries.en: Fixed a recurring event-loop stall on Windows when a missing executable (e.g. `gh`) triggered synchronous `where.exe` re-spawns on every check
entries.zh: 修复了当缺少的可执行文件（例如`gh`）在每次检查时触发同步`where.exe`重新生成时，Windows 上重复发生的事件循环停顿的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Read` tool calls failing validation when `offset` is passed as a whitespace-padded or `+`-prefixed string
entries.zh: 修复了当`offset`作为空格填充或`+`前缀字符串传递时，`Read`工具调用验证失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed native terminal cursor not staying at the input caret when the terminal loses focus
entries.zh: 修复了当终端失去焦点时本机终端光标不停留在输入插入符处的问题

entries.en: Plugins now warn when a default component folder (e.g. `commands/`) is silently ignored because `plugin.json` sets the matching key. Shown in `/doctor`, `claude plugin list`, and `/plugin`.
entries.zh: 当 `plugin.json` 设置了对应的键，导致默认组件目录（如 `commands/`）被静默忽略时，插件现在会发出警告。会显示在 `/doctor`、`claude plugin list` 和 `/plugin` 中

entries.en: Added agent view (Research Preview): a single list of every Claude Code session — running, blocked on you, or done. Run `claude agents` to get started. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view
entries.zh: 添加了代理视图（研究预览）：每个 Claude Code 会话的单个列表 - 正在运行、被阻止或已完成。运行“claude Agents”即可开始。请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view

entries.en: Added `/goal` command: set a completion condition and Claude keeps working across turns until it's met. Works in interactive, `-p`, and Remote Control. Shows live elapsed/turns/tokens as an overlay panel
entries.zh: 添加了`/goal`命令：设置完成条件，克劳德继续轮流工作，直到满足为止。适用于交互式、`-p`和远程控制。将实时经过/回合/令牌显示为覆盖面板

entries.en: Added `/scroll-speed` command to tune mouse wheel scroll speed with a live preview
entries.zh: 添加了`/scroll-speed`命令以通过实时预览调整鼠标滚轮滚动速度

entries.en: Added `claude plugin details <name>` to show a plugin's component inventory and projected per-session token cost
entries.zh: 添加了“claude 插件详细信息 <name>”，以显示插件的组件库存和预计的每个会话令牌成本

entries.en: Added transcript view navigation: `?` for keyboard shortcuts, `{`/`}` to jump between user prompts, `v` to toggle shortcut panel
entries.zh: 添加了文字记录视图导航：`?`用于键盘快捷键，“{`/`}”用于在用户提示之间跳转，`v`用于切换快捷面板

entries.en: Added hook `args: string[]` field (exec form) that spawns the command directly without a shell, so path placeholders never need quoting
entries.zh: 添加了钩子 `args: string[]` 字段（exec 形式），无需 shell 即可直接生成命令，因此路径占位符永远不需要引用

entries.en: Added hook `continueOnBlock` config option for `PostToolUse` — set to `true` to feed the hook's rejection reason back to Claude and continue the turn
entries.zh: 为`PostToolUse`添加了钩子`continueOnBlock`配置选项 - 设置为`true`以将钩子的拒绝原因反馈给 Claude 并继续回合

entries.en: MCP stdio servers now receive `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` in their environment, matching hooks. Plugin configs can reference `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` in commands
entries.zh: MCP stdio 服务器现在会在环境变量中收到 `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`，与 hook 保持一致。插件配置的命令中可以引用 `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}`

entries.en: Compaction prompt now asks the model to preserve sensitive user instructions
entries.zh: 压缩提示现在要求模型保留敏感的用户指令

entries.en: `/mcp` Reconnect now picks up `.mcp.json` edits without a restart, and shows the HTTP status and URL when reconnecting fails
entries.zh: `/mcp` 的 Reconnect 现在无需重启即可读取 `.mcp.json` 的修改；重连失败时会显示 HTTP 状态和 URL

entries.en: `/context all` per-skill token estimates now account for the model's tokenizer and show rounded values
entries.zh: `/context all` 中每个 skill 的 token 估算现在会考虑模型的分词器，并显示取整后的数值

entries.en: `claude plugin install <name>@<marketplace>` now auto-refreshes the marketplace and retries before reporting a plugin as not found
entries.zh: `claude plugin install <name>@<marketplace>` 现在会先自动刷新市场并重试，然后才报告插件未找到

entries.en: `/plugin` installed-plugin details now show hook event names and MCP server names cleanly
entries.zh: `/plugin` 中已安装插件的详情现在会清晰显示 hook 事件名称和 MCP 服务器名称

entries.en: `/context` now shows the providing plugin's name for plugin-sourced skills
entries.zh: 对于插件提供的 skill，`/context` 现在会显示提供该插件的名称

entries.en: Remote MCP server reconnect retry on transient failures is now enabled for all users
entries.zh: 远程 MCP 服务器遇到临时故障时的重连重试，现已对所有用户开启

entries.en: API requests from subagents now carry `x-claude-code-agent-id` / `x-claude-code-parent-agent-id` headers, and `claude_code.llm_request` OTEL spans include `agent_id` / `parent_agent_id` attributes
entries.zh: 来自子代理的 API 请求现在携带 `x-claude-code-agent-id` / `x-claude-code-parent-agent-id` 标头，并且 `claude_code.llm_request` OTEL 跨度包含 `agent_id` / `parent_agent_id` 属性

entries.en: Remote Control, `/schedule`, claude.ai MCP connectors, and notification preferences are now disabled when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `apiKeyHelper` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` is set, even if a Claude.ai login also exists. Unset the API key to use these features
entries.zh: 设置了 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`、`apiKeyHelper` 或 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` 后，Remote Control、`/schedule`、claude.ai MCP 连接器和通知偏好现已禁用，即使同时存在 Claude.ai 登录。取消设置 API 密钥即可使用这些功能

entries.en: Fixed a deadlock where expired credentials and the `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` policy setting blocked `claude auth login`/`logout`/`status` with no way to recover
entries.zh: 修复了过期凭据和`forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`策略设置阻止`claude auth login`/`logout`/`status`且无法恢复的死锁

entries.en: Fixed `autoAllowBashIfSandboxed` not auto-approving commands with shell expansions like `$VAR` and `$(cmd)`
entries.zh: 修复了`autoAllowBashIfSandboxed`不自动批准带有`$VAR`和`$(cmd)`等 shell 扩展的命令

entries.en: Fixed a bug where a hook writing to the terminal could corrupt an on-screen interactive prompt; hooks now run without terminal access
entries.zh: 修复了写入终端的钩子可能会破坏屏幕上的交互式提示的错误；挂钩现在无需终端访问即可运行

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth when an HTTP/SSE MCP server streams non-protocol data — response bodies now capped at 16 MB per SSE frame
entries.zh: 修复 HTTP/SSE MCP 服务器流式输出非协议数据时内存无限增长的问题；现在每个 SSE 帧的响应体上限为 16 MB

entries.en: Fixed `Skill(name *)` permission rules — the wildcard form now works as a prefix match, matching `Bash(ls *)` behavior
entries.zh: 修复了 `Skill(name *)` 权限规则 - 通配符形式现在用作前缀匹配，匹配 `Bash(ls *)` 行为

entries.en: Fixed settings hot-reload not detecting edits to symlinked `~/.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了设置热重载未检测到对符号链接`~/.claude/settings.json`的编辑

entries.en: Fixed plugin details failing to load when the marketplace key differs from the manifest name
entries.zh: 修复了当市场密钥与清单名称不同时无法加载插件详细信息的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` picker "Default" row not reflecting `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`/`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` overrides
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`选择器“默认”行不反映`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`/`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`覆盖的问题

entries.en: Fixed spurious "stream idle timeout" 5 minutes after a response completed, caused by the watchdog timer not being cleared on stream cancellation
entries.zh: 修复了响应完成后 5 分钟出现虚假“流空闲超时”的问题，该超时是由于在流取消时未清除看门狗计时器而导致的

entries.en: Fixed silent `exit 1` when 10+ MCP servers are configured and the cache directory is unwritable — the error message now includes the underlying cause
entries.zh: 修复了配置超过 10 个 MCP 服务器且缓存目录不可写时出现静默`exit 1`的问题 — 错误消息现在包含根本原因

entries.en: Fixed a typing cursor blinking on tab names, list pointers, and select rows in dialogs
entries.zh: 修复了打字光标在选项卡名称、列表指针和对话框中选择行上闪烁的问题

entries.en: Fixed transcript view letter shortcuts not working after mouse click
entries.zh: 修复鼠标点击后，转录视图的字母快捷键失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash-mode up-arrow history repeating the first entry and clobbering the in-progress draft
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 模式向上箭头历史记录重复第一个条目并破坏正在进行的草稿的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasting or dropping multiple images only inserting the last one
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴或删除多个图像时仅插入最后一张图像的问题

entries.en: Fixed hyperlinks using unreadable dark navy on dark themes — they now adapt to the active theme
entries.zh: 修复了在深色主题上使用不可读的深色海军蓝的超链接 - 它们现在适应活动主题

entries.en: Fixed model picker showing a redundant "Current model" row for third-party users whose model is set to the `opus` alias
entries.zh: 修复了模型选择器为模型设置为`opus`别名的第三方用户显示冗余“当前模型”行的问题

entries.en: Fixed legacy Opus picker entry on PAYG 3P providers resolving to the same model as the default entry
entries.zh: 修复了 PAYG 3P 提供商上的旧版 Opus 选择器条目解析为与默认条目相同的模型

entries.en: Fixed mouse wheel scrolling speed in Cursor and VS Code 1.92–1.104; the trackpad now scrolls at a steady rate and the mouse wheel keeps ~3 lines per notch
entries.zh: 修复了光标和 VS Code 1.92–1.104 中的鼠标滚轮滚动速度；触控板现在以稳定的速度滚动，鼠标滚轮每格保持约 3 行

entries.en: Fixed scroll behavior in Windows Terminal and VS Code when attached to background sessions
entries.zh: 修复了附加到后台会话时 Windows 终端和 VS Code 中的滚动行为

entries.en: Fixed MCP resources from disconnected servers lingering in `@server:` autocomplete
entries.zh: 修复了来自断开连接的服务器的 MCP 资源在`@server:`自动完成中徘徊的问题

entries.en: Fixed two-file diff snippets over-reporting the number of truncated lines by one
entries.zh: 修复双文件差异片段对被截断行数多报了一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Grep results not relativizing Windows drive-letter paths and count mode reporting wrong totals for single-file paths
entries.zh: 修复了 Grep 结果未相对化 Windows 驱动器盘符路径和计数模式报告单文件路径总数错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed border-embedded text overflowing on CJK/emoji due to visual cell width miscalculation
entries.zh: 修复了由于视觉单元宽度计算错误导致的边框嵌入文本在 CJK/emoji 上溢出的问题

entries.en: Fixed fuzzy-match highlighting splitting emoji and astral-plane characters mid-pair
entries.zh: 修复了模糊匹配突出显示分割表情符号和星体平面字符中间对的问题

entries.en: Fixed skill argument names containing regex metacharacters breaking argument substitution
entries.zh: 修复了包含正则表达式元字符的技能参数名称，破坏了参数替换

entries.en: Fixed ProgressBar rendering a full block for an almost-full fractional cell
entries.zh: 修复了 ProgressBar 为几乎满的分数单元格呈现完整块的问题

entries.en: Fixed task polling and `fs.watch` being resurrected when the last subscriber leaves while a fetch is in flight
entries.zh: 修复最后一个订阅者离开而某次获取仍在进行时，任务轮询和 `fs.watch` 被重新启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin dependency resolution leaving a stale count when the manifest name differs from the source identifier
entries.zh: 修复了当清单名称与源标识符不同时插件依赖项解析留下陈旧计数的问题

entries.en: Fixed Insights Time-of-Day chart skewing when a session has an unparseable timestamp
entries.zh: 修复了当会话具有无法解析的时间戳时 Insights 时间图表倾斜的问题

entries.en: Fixed keybindings using only the cmd/super/win modifier being flagged as unparseable
entries.zh: 修复了仅使用 cmd/super/win 修饰符的键绑定被标记为不可解析的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude_code.active_time.total` OpenTelemetry metric not being emitted in `--print` mode
entries.zh: 修复了在`--print`模式下未发出`claude_code.active_time.total` OpenTelemetry 指标的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin update` not preserving cross-plugin symlinks inside a marketplace
entries.zh: 修复了“claude 插件更新”不保留市场内跨插件符号链接的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T to reopen the most recently closed session tab, configurable via `claudeCode.enableReopenClosedSessionShortcut`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 按 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T 可重新打开最近关闭的会话标签页，可通过 `claudeCode.enableReopenClosedSessionShortcut` 配置

entries.en: Internal fixes
entries.zh: 内部修复

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed extension failing to activate on Windows
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展在 Windows 上无法激活的问题

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_FOR_OTEL` to re-enable the session quality survey for enterprises capturing responses through OpenTelemetry
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_FOR_OTEL`，以便为通过 OpenTelemetry 捕获响应的企业重新启用会话质量调查

entries.en: Added `settings.autoMode.hard_deny` for auto mode classifier rules that block unconditionally regardless of user intent or allow exceptions
entries.zh: 为自动模式分类器规则添加了`settings.autoMode.hard_deny`，无论用户意图如何，都会无条件阻止或允许例外

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers configured in `.mcp.json`, plugins, and claude.ai connectors silently disappearing after `/clear` in the VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and Agent SDK
entries.zh: 修复了`.mcp.json`、插件和 claude.ai 连接器中配置的 MCP 服务器在 VS Code 扩展、JetBrains 插件和 Agent SDK 中的`/clear`之后默默消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare login loop where a concurrent credential write could overwrite a freshly-rotated OAuth token and force re-login
entries.zh: 修复了罕见的登录循环，其中并发凭据写入可能会覆盖新旋转的 OAuth 令牌并强制重新登录

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth refresh tokens being lost when multiple servers refresh concurrently — users with several remote MCP servers should no longer need daily re-authentication
entries.zh: 修复了多个服务器同时刷新时 MCP OAuth 刷新令牌丢失的问题 — 拥有多个远程 MCP 服务器的用户不再需要每天重新进行身份验证

entries.en: Fixed an API error (400) when extended thinking emitted a redacted thinking block after a tool call
entries.zh: 修复了工具调用后扩展思维发出经过编辑的思维块时的 API 错误 (400)

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` / `--continue` not finding sessions when the project path contains underscores
entries.zh: 修复了当项目路径包含下划线时 `--resume` / `--continue` 找不到会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode not blocking file writes when a matching `Edit(...)` allow rule exists
entries.zh: 修复了当存在匹配的`Edit(...)`允许规则时，计划模式不会阻止文件写入的问题

entries.en: WSL2: image paste from Windows clipboard now works via a PowerShell fallback when xclip/wl-paste cannot read image data
entries.zh: WSL2：当 xclip/wl-paste 无法读取图片数据时，可通过 PowerShell 备用方式粘贴 Windows 剪贴板中的图片

entries.en: Fixed plugin `Stop`/`UserPromptSubmit` hooks failing when cache cleanup deletes a version still in use by a running session
entries.zh: 修复了当缓存清理删除正在运行的会话仍在使用的版本时插件`Stop`/`UserPromptSubmit`挂钩失败的问题

entries.en: Improved visual consistency across slash command dialogs: standardized footer hints, dialog spacing, and arrow-key styling, and the dialog frame now appears immediately during loading instead of popping in after
entries.zh: 改进斜杠命令对话框的视觉一致性：统一底部提示、对话框间距和方向键样式；加载时对话框外框立即显示，不再突然弹出

entries.en: Fixed colors appearing at wrong positions in bash command output and markdown code blocks
entries.zh: 修复了 bash 命令输出和 Markdown 代码块中出现错误位置的颜色

entries.en: Fixed ReasonML diffs rendering corrupted "undefined" text artifacts at word-diff boundaries
entries.zh: 修复了 ReasonML 差异在单词差异边界处渲染损坏的“未定义”文本工件

entries.en: Fixed worktree exit dialog warning about uncommitted files in the wrong directory after worktree removal
entries.zh: 修复工作树移除后，退出对话框在错误目录中警告有未提交文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed `@` file picker not matching files created mid-session in small non-git directories
entries.zh: 修复了`@`文件选择器与小型非 git 目录中会话中创建的文件不匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed `@`-mention file picker not finding files in directories with more than 100 entries
entries.zh: 修复了`@`提及文件选择器无法在条目超过 100 的目录中找到文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed failed tool calls not being click-to-expand in fullscreen mode when their output was truncated
entries.zh: 修复了失败的工具调用在其输出被截断时无法在全屏模式下单击展开的问题

entries.en: Fixed Backspace and Ctrl+Backspace getting swapped after using Ctrl+G to open an external editor on terminals with persistent extended-key modes
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Ctrl+G 在具有持久扩展键模式的终端上打开外部编辑器后 Backspace 和 Ctrl+Backspace 发生交换的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` weekly reset showing time of day instead of the calendar date
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`每周重置显示一天中的时间而不是日历日期的问题

entries.en: Fixed welcome banner ellipsis causing column overflow on CJK terminals
entries.zh: 修复欢迎横幅的省略号在中日韩字符终端中导致列溢出的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/insights` crash when session history contains tool calls with malformed input fields
entries.zh: 修复了当会话历史记录包含带有格式错误的输入字段的工具调用时`/insights`崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a renderer crash when a tool's collapsibility classification changes mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了工具的可折叠性分类在会话中更改时渲染器崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a `skills` entry in `plugin.json` hiding the plugin's default `skills/` directory, and listing a file path now shows an error instead of failing silently
entries.zh: 修复了`plugin.json`中隐藏插件默认`skills/`目录的`skills`条目，列出文件路径现在显示错误而不是默默失败

entries.en: Fixed IDE shell-integration lock files not respecting `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`
entries.zh: 修复了 IDE shell 集成锁定文件不遵守`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`的问题

entries.en: Fixed trailing whitespace in copied terminal output during streaming
entries.zh: 修复流式输出时复制终端输出，末尾多出空白字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin uninstall and enable/disable not matching slugs case-insensitively
entries.zh: 修复了插件卸载和启用/禁用不匹配 slugs 的问题（不区分大小写）

entries.en: Fixed tool error truncation marker showing a negative count for surrogate-pair strings
entries.zh: 修复工具错误截断标记对于代理对（surrogate pair）字符串显示负数计数的问题

entries.en: Fixed env vars from `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` SessionStart hooks going stale after `/resume` or `/clear`
entries.zh: 修复了 `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` SessionStart 挂钩中的环境变量在 `/resume` 或 `/clear` 之后变得过时的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` saving a multi-line session title when given a pasted multi-line name
entries.zh: 修复了在给定粘贴的多行名称时保存多行会话标题的`/branch`

entries.en: Fixed a stray leading space on the second line of wrapped text at the column boundary
entries.zh: 修复了列边界处换行文本第二行上的杂散前导空格

entries.en: Fixed Esc not dismissing dialogs in `/install-github-app`, `/desktop`, `/resume`, and `/web-setup`
entries.zh: 修复了 Esc 不会关闭 `/install-github-app`、`/desktop`、`/resume` 和 `/web-setup` 中的对话框

entries.en: Fixed `/doctor` MCP schema errors not naming the missing field or showing the source file path
entries.zh: 修复了`/doctor`MCP 架构错误，未命名缺失字段或显示源文件路径

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission prompts showing an internal parser diagnostic instead of a user-readable explanation
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限提示，显示内部解析器诊断而不是用户可读的解释

entries.en: Fixed plugin slash commands with spaces (e.g. `/myplugin review`) not resolving to their namespaced form
entries.zh: 修复了带有空格的插件斜杠命令（例如`/myplugin review`）未解析为其命名空间形式

entries.en: Fixed `AskUserQuestion` discarding multi-select answers when supplied as an array
entries.zh: 修复了`AskUserQuestion`在作为数组提供时丢弃多选答案的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/clear <name>` not labeling the cleared session for `/resume`
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear <name>`未标记`/resume`已清除会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CronList` output missing qualifiers and the scheduled prompt
entries.zh: 修复了`CronList`输出缺少限定符和预定提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Jump to bottom" overlay leaving color artifacts on CJK characters in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了“跳到底部”叠加在全屏模式下 CJK 字符上留下颜色伪影的问题

entries.en: Fixed wide markdown tables leaving a stale bordered render in terminal scrollback while streaming
entries.zh: 修复宽 Markdown 表格在流式输出时，在终端滚动缓冲区中留下过期的带边框渲染的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasted text being silently dropped when a long prompt with a pasted-text placeholder was auto-truncated
entries.zh: 修复了当带有粘贴文本占位符的长提示被自动截断时，粘贴的文本会被静默丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/release-notes` getting stuck on an old version after a failed changelog refresh
entries.zh: 修复了更新日志刷新失败后`/release-notes`卡在旧版本上的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` server list not scrolling when there are more servers than fit in the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器数量超出终端容量时`/mcp`服务器列表不滚动的问题

entries.en: Fixed mid-input slash command autocomplete not working after an initial slash command
entries.zh: 修复了中间输入斜杠命令自动完成在初始斜杠命令后不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed scrolling to bottom re-engaging auto-follow with `autoScrollEnabled: false`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`autoScrollEnabled: false`滚动到底部重新启用自动跟随的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions being auto-submitted by Enter on an empty input instead of requiring Tab or arrow to accept
entries.zh: 修复了在空输入上按 Enter 键自动提交的提示建议，而不是需要 Tab 或箭头来接受

entries.en: Fixed keyboard shortcut hints not reflecting rebound keys from `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了键盘快捷键提示不反映`keybindings.json`中的反弹键的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/settings` language change being reverted on Escape after confirming
entries.zh: 修复了确认后在 Escape 上恢复的`/settings`语言更改

entries.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` only appearing in autocomplete on exact name match instead of partial prefixes
entries.zh: 修复了`/terminal-setup`仅出现在精确名称匹配而不是部分前缀的自动完成中的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Chat about this" on an `AskUserQuestion` dialog erasing the question text
entries.zh: 修复了`AskUserQuestion`对话框中的“对此进行聊天”会删除问题文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool results being invisible when the server returns content blocks
entries.zh: 修复了服务器返回内容块时 MCP 工具结果不可见的问题

entries.en: Improved error message when `--worktree` collides with an existing or stale worktree
entries.zh: 改进 `--worktree` 与已有或过期 worktree 冲突时的错误提示

entries.en: Changed plugin marketplace removal key to `d` (matching delete elsewhere) instead of `r` which collided with retry
entries.zh: 将插件市场删除键更改为`d`（与其他地方的删除匹配）而不是与重试发生冲突的`r`

entries.en: Added `worktree.baseRef` setting (`fresh` | `head`) to choose whether `--worktree`, `EnterWorktree`, and agent-isolation worktrees branch from `origin/<default>` or local `HEAD`. **Note:** the default `fresh` changes `EnterWorktree`'s base back to `origin/<default>` (it has been local `HEAD` since 2.1.128) — set `worktree.baseRef: "head"` to keep unpushed commits in new worktrees
entries.zh: 添加了`worktree.baseRef`设置（“fresh”|`head`）以选择`--worktree`、“EnterWorktree”和代理隔离工作树是否从“origin/<default>”或本地“HEAD”分支。 **注意：** 默认 `fresh` 将 `EnterWorktree` 的基础更改回 `origin/<default>` （自 2.1.128 起它一直是本地 `HEAD`） — 设置 `worktree.baseRef: `head`` 以在新工作树中保留未推送的提交

entries.en: Added `sandbox.bwrapPath` and `sandbox.socatPath` managed settings (Linux/WSL) to specify custom bubblewrap and socat binary locations
entries.zh: 添加了 `sandbox.bwrapPath` 和 `sandbox.socatPath` 托管设置 (Linux/WSL) 以指定自定义 bubblewrap 和 socat 二进制位置

entries.en: Added `parentSettingsBehavior` admin-tier key (`'first-wins' | 'merge'`) to let admins opt SDK `managedSettings` (parent tier) into the policy merge
entries.zh: 添加了`parentSettingsBehavior`管理层密钥（“first-wins”|“merge”），以让管理员选择 SDK“managementSettings”（父层）进入策略合并

entries.en: Hooks now receive the active effort level via the `effort.level` JSON input field and the `$CLAUDE_EFFORT` environment variable, and Bash tool commands can read `$CLAUDE_EFFORT`
entries.zh: Hooks 现在通过 `effort.level` JSON 输入字段和 `$CLAUDE_EFFORT` 环境变量接收当前的 effort 级别，Bash 工具命令也能读取 `$CLAUDE_EFFORT`

entries.en: Improved focus mode behavior
entries.zh: 改进专注模式的行为

entries.en: Improved memory usage by releasing warm-spare background workers under memory pressure
entries.zh: 改进内存压力下的处理：释放待命的备用后台 worker

entries.en: Fixed parallel sessions all dead-ending at 401 after a refresh-token race wiped shared credentials
entries.zh: 修复了刷新令牌竞赛擦除共享凭据后所有并行会话都在 401 处陷入死胡同的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Edit`/`Write` allow rules scoped to a drive root (`C:\`) or POSIX `/` matching incorrectly and always prompting
entries.zh: 修复了“编辑”/“写入”允许范围为驱动器根目录（`C:\`）或 POSIX`/` 匹配不正确且始终提示的规则

entries.en: Fixed an unhandled rejection (`ECOMPROMISED`) when a history or session-log file lock is compromised by clock skew or slow disk
entries.zh: 修复了当历史记录或会话日志文件锁因时钟偏差或磁盘缓慢而受到损害时未处理的拒绝（`ECOMPROMISED`）

entries.en: Fixed pressing Esc during conversation compaction showing a spurious "Error compacting conversation" notification
entries.zh: 修复了在对话压缩期间按 Esc 键显示虚假的“压缩对话时出错”通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed `HTTP(S)_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` / mTLS not being respected for the full MCP OAuth flow including discovery, dynamic client registration, token exchange, and token refresh
entries.zh: 修复了完整 MCP OAuth 流程（包括发现、动态客户端注册、令牌交换和令牌刷新）不遵守`HTTP(S)_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY`/mTLS 的问题

entries.en: Fixed Read/Write/Edit being denied on mapped network drives passed via `--add-dir` / SDK `additionalDirectories`
entries.zh: 修复了通过`--add-dir`/SDK`additionalDirectories`传递的映射网络驱动器上的读/写/编辑被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control stop/interrupt from claude.ai not fully canceling the CLI session the same way local Esc does, causing queued messages to never advance after interrupting a stuck tool or prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 claude.ai 的远程控制停止/中断未像本地 Esc 那样完全取消 CLI 会话，导致排队的消息在中断卡住的工具或提示后永远不会前进的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/effort` in one session unexpectedly changing the effort level of other concurrent sessions, and a related issue where an IDE effort change could be silently dropped
entries.zh: 修复了一个会话中的`/effort`意外更改其他并发会话的工作量级别，以及 IDE 工作量更改可能会被静默删除的相关问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents not discovering project, user, or plugin skills via the Skill tool
entries.zh: 修复了子代理无法通过技能工具发现项目、用户或插件技能的问题

entries.en: `claude --help` now lists `--remote-control` alongside `--remote-control-session-name-prefix`
entries.zh: `claude --help` 现在会在 `--remote-control-session-name-prefix` 旁边列出 `--remote-control`

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` failing with "Unsupported platform" when the extension build doesn't bundle a Claude binary
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展构建中未内置 Claude 二进制文件时，`claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` 报 "Unsupported platform" 的问题

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` environment variable to the Bash tool subprocess environment, matching the `session_id` passed to hooks
entries.zh: 将`CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`环境变量添加到 Bash 工具子进程环境中，与传递给钩子的`session_id`相匹配

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1` env var to opt out of the fullscreen alternate-screen renderer and keep the conversation in the terminal's native scrollback
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1`环境变量以选择退出全屏备用屏幕渲染器并将对话保留在终端的本机回滚中

entries.en: Added a "Pasting…" footer hint while a Ctrl+V image paste is being read from the clipboard
entries.zh: 从剪贴板读取 Ctrl+V 图像粘贴时添加了“正在粘贴...”页脚提示

entries.en: Fixed external SIGINT (e.g. IDE stop button, `kill -INT`) not running graceful shutdown — terminal modes are now restored and the `--resume` hint is printed instead of an abrupt exit
entries.zh: 修复了外部 SIGINT（例如 IDE 停止按钮、`kill -INT`）未运行正常关闭的问题 — 终端模式现已恢复，并打印`--resume`提示，而不是突然退出

entries.en: Fixed an uncaught exception when the terminal is closed or SSH disconnects mid-session under the native build
entries.zh: 修复了在本机构建下关闭终端或 SSH 在会话中途断开连接时未捕获的异常

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` failing with `no low surrogate in string` when a tool error truncation split an emoji; pre-corrupted sessions are sanitized on load
entries.zh: 修复了当工具错误截断分割表情符号时`--resume`因“字符串中没有低代理项”而失败的问题；预损坏的会话在加载时被清理

entries.en: Fixed `--permission-mode` flag being ignored when resuming a plan-mode session with `-p --continue`/`--resume`, and plan mode not being re-applied after `ExitPlanMode` within the same session
entries.zh: 修复了使用“-p --Continue”/`--resume`恢复计划模式会话时忽略`--permission-mode`标志，以及在同一会话中的`ExitPlanMode`之后不重新应用计划模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode showing a blank screen after laptop sleep/wake or Ctrl+Z/`fg` until the next keystroke or stream output
entries.zh: 修复了笔记本电脑睡眠/唤醒或 Ctrl+Z/`fg` 后显示空白屏幕的全屏模式，直到下一次击键或流输出

entries.en: Fixed cursor landing mid-grapheme on Ctrl+E/A/K/U/arrow keys when an Indic conjunct or ZWJ emoji wraps across lines
entries.zh: 修复了当印度语连词或 ZWJ 表情符号跨行换行时，光标在 Ctrl+E/A/K/U/箭头键上停留在中间字素的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim operators corrupting text containing decomposed (NFD) accented characters
entries.zh: 修复 vim 操作符会破坏包含分解形式（NFD）重音字符的文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasting text starting with `/` silently swallowing the input or triggering an unknown-command reply
entries.zh: 修复了以`/`开头的粘贴文本默默吞下输入或触发未知命令回复的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasting dumping stray escape sequences into the prompt when focus events or mouse-tracking reports interleave with the bracketed paste
entries.zh: 修复了当焦点事件或鼠标跟踪报告与括号内的粘贴交错时，将杂散转义序列粘贴到提示中的问题

entries.en: Fixed mouse wheel scrolling being too fast in Cursor and VS Code 1.92–1.104 due to an upstream xterm.js bug
entries.zh: 修复了由于上游 xterm.js 错误而导致 Cursor 和 VS Code 1.92–1.104 中鼠标滚轮滚动过快的问题

entries.en: Fixed scroll-wheel handling in JetBrains IDE 2025.2 terminals (spurious arrow keys, wrong-direction events, runaway acceleration)
entries.zh: 修复了 JetBrains IDE 2025.2 终端中的滚轮处理（虚假箭头键、错误方向事件、失控加速）

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` Ctrl+S hanging when copying the stats screenshot to the clipboard on Linux/X11
entries.zh: 修复了在 Linux/X11 上将统计屏幕截图复制到剪贴板时`/usage` Ctrl+S 挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` showing a contradictory error in Windows Terminal — Shift+Enter is natively supported there
entries.zh: 修复了`/terminal-setup`在 Windows 终端中显示矛盾错误的问题 — Shift+Enter 是本地支持的

entries.en: Fixed `/effort` picker not reflecting the `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` env var override
entries.zh: 修复了`/effort`选择器不反映`CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`环境变量覆盖的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/status` showing the wrong default model for some users
entries.zh: 修复了`/status`为某些用户显示错误的默认模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash command autocomplete popup being capped at ~3–5 visible commands instead of scaling with terminal height
entries.zh: 修复了斜杠命令自动完成弹出窗口被限制为 ~3-5 个可见命令，而不是随终端高度缩放

entries.en: Fixed statusline `context_window` token counts reflecting cumulative session totals instead of current context usage
entries.zh: 修复了状态行`context_window`令牌计数，反映累积会话总数而不是当前上下文使用情况

entries.en: Fixed Alt+T (thinking toggle) not working on macOS terminals without "Option as Meta" enabled (iTerm2, Terminal.app defaults)
entries.zh: 修复了 Alt+T（思维切换）在未启用“Option as Meta”的 macOS 终端上不起作用的问题（iTerm2、Terminal.app 默认值）

entries.en: Fixed dead keyboard input on Windows after re-opening a background session from `claude agents`
entries.zh: 修复了从“克劳德代理”重新打开后台会话后 Windows 上无效的键盘输入

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth (10GB+ RSS) when a stdio MCP server writes non-protocol data to stdout
entries.zh: 修复 stdio MCP 服务器向 stdout 写入非协议数据时，内存无限增长（RSS 超过 10GB）的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers that connect but fail `tools/list` silently showing 0 tools — they now retry once and show "connected · tools fetch failed" in `/mcp`
entries.zh: 修复了连接但失败的`tools/list`服务器默默地显示 0 个工具 — 它们现在重试一次并在`/mcp`中显示“已连接·工具获取失败”

entries.en: Fixed unauthorized claude.ai MCP connectors showing as "failed" instead of "needs auth", and headless `-p` mode retrying non-transient 4xx connection failures
entries.zh: 修复未授权的 claude.ai MCP 连接器显示为"failed"而非"needs auth"的问题，以及无界面的 `-p` 模式会重试非临时性的 4xx 连接失败的问题

entries.en: Improved visual consistency in slash command dialogs and `/login`, `/upgrade`, `/extra-usage` dialog spacing
entries.zh: 改进斜杠命令对话框，以及 `/login`、`/upgrade`、`/extra-usage` 对话框的间距，使视觉更统一

entries.en: Updated the `/tui fullscreen` startup banner to describe additional renderer benefits (lower memory usage, mouse support, auto-copy on select)
entries.zh: 设置中 `/tui fullscreen` 启动横幅现在说明了更多渲染器的优点（更低内存占用、支持鼠标、选中即自动复制）

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock and Vertex 400 errors when `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H`时的基岩和顶点 400 错误

entries.en: Fixed VS Code extension failing to activate on Windows due to a hardcoded build path in the bundled SDK (`createRequire` polyfill bug)
entries.zh: 修复了由于捆绑 SDK 中的硬编码构建路径而导致 VS Code 扩展无法在 Windows 上激活的问题（`createRequire`polyfill 错误）

entries.en: Fixed Mantle endpoint authentication failing with missing `x-api-key` header
entries.zh: 修复了 Mantle 端点身份验证因缺少`x-api-key`标头而失败的问题

entries.en: Added `--plugin-url <url>` flag to fetch a plugin `.zip` archive from a URL for the current session
entries.zh: 添加了 `--plugin-url <url>` 标志以从当前会话的 URL 获取插件 `.zip` 存档

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SYNC_OUTPUT=1` env var to force-enable synchronized output on terminals that auto-detection misses (e.g. Emacs `eat`)
entries.zh: 添加了 `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SYNC_OUTPUT=1` 环境变量，以在自动检测错过的终端上强制启用同步输出（例如 Emacs `eat`）

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PACKAGE_MANAGER_AUTO_UPDATE`: when set on Homebrew or WinGet installations, Claude Code runs the upgrade command in the background and prompts to restart
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_PACKAGE_MANAGER_AUTO_UPDATE`：在 Homebrew 或 WinGet 安装上设置时，Claude Code 在后台运行升级命令并提示重新启动

entries.en: Plugin manifests: `themes` and `monitors` should now be declared under `"experimental": { ... }`. Top-level declarations still work but `claude plugin validate` will warn
entries.zh: 插件清单：`themes` 和 `monitors` 现应声明在 `"experimental": { ... }` 下。顶层声明仍然有效，但 `claude plugin validate` 会发出警告

entries.en: Gateway `/v1/models` discovery for the `/model` picker is now opt-in via `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1` (was automatic in 2.1.126–2.1.128)
entries.zh: `/model` 选择器的网关 `/v1/models` 发现功能改为可选，需设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1`（在 2.1.126–2.1.128 版本中是自动开启的）

entries.en: Ctrl+R history picker now defaults to searching all prompts across all projects, matching pre-2.1.124 behavior. Press Ctrl+S to narrow to the current project or session
entries.zh: Ctrl+R 历史记录选择器现在默认搜索所有项目中的所有提示，与 2.1.124 之前的行为相匹配。按 Ctrl+S 缩小到当前项目或会话

entries.en: Third-party deployments (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway) no longer see spinner tips pointing at first-party Anthropic surfaces
entries.zh: 第三方部署（Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 网关）不再看到指向 Anthropic 官方产品的加载提示

entries.en: `skillOverrides` setting now works: `off` hides from model and `/`, `user-invocable-only` hides from model only, `name-only` collapses description
entries.zh: `skillOverrides` 设置现在生效：`off` 对模型和 `/` 都隐藏，`user-invocable-only` 只对模型隐藏，`name-only` 则会折叠描述

entries.en: The `claude_code.pull_request.count` OTel metric now counts PRs/MRs created via MCP tools, not just shell commands
entries.zh: `claude_code.pull_request.count` OTel 指标现在也统计通过 MCP 工具创建的 PR/MR，而不只是 shell 命令创建的

entries.en: Policy refusal error messages now include the API Request ID for easier support debugging
entries.zh: 策略拒绝的报错信息现在包含 API 请求 ID，便于支持人员排查

entries.en: Fixed API errors with unrecognized 400 status codes showing raw JSON instead of the underlying error message
entries.zh: 修复了 API 错误，其中无法识别的 400 状态代码显示原始 JSON，而不是底层错误消息

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` not resetting the terminal tab title after a conversation
entries.zh: 修复了对话后`/clear`不重置终端选项卡标题的问题

entries.en: Fixed session title chip from `/rename` disappearing while a permission or other dialog is active
entries.zh: 修复了权限或其他对话框处于活动状态时“/重命名”中的会话标题芯片消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent panel below the prompt being hidden when subagents are running (regression in 2.1.122)
entries.zh: 修复了子代理运行时提示下方的代理面板被隐藏的问题（2.1.122 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed external-editor handoff (Ctrl+G) blanking the conversation history above the prompt
entries.zh: 修复了外部编辑器切换 (Ctrl+G) 使提示上方的对话历史记录清空的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/context` dumping its rendered ASCII visualization grid into the conversation, wasting ~1.6k tokens per call
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`将其渲染的 ASCII 可视化网格转储到对话中，每次调用浪费约 1.6k 令牌的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/agents` Library list arrow-key navigation: the highlighted agent now stays visible when the list exceeds the viewport
entries.zh: 修复了`/agents`库列表箭头键导航：当列表超出视口时，突出显示的代理现在保持可见

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` success message not including the new branch's session id for `/resume`
entries.zh: 修复了`/branch`成功消息不包括`/resume`的新分支的会话 ID

entries.en: Fixed bold headers with keycap/ZWJ/skin-tone emoji losing trailing characters in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了带有键帽/ZWJ/肤色表情符号的粗体标题在全屏模式下丢失尾随字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed server-managed settings policy not applying for enterprise/team users whose stored OAuth credentials lacked the `user:inference` scope
entries.zh: 修复了服务器管理的设置策略不适用于存储的 OAuth 凭据缺少`user:inference`范围的企业/团队用户的问题

entries.en: Fixed OAuth refresh race after wake-from-sleep that could log out all running sessions
entries.zh: 修复了从睡眠中唤醒后可能会注销所有正在运行的会话的 OAuth 刷新竞赛

entries.en: Fixed 1-hour prompt cache TTL being silently downgraded to 5 minutes
entries.zh: 修复了 1 小时提示缓存 TTL 被静默降级为 5 分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed cache-miss warning appearing spuriously after `/clear` or compaction when changing `/effort` or `/model`
entries.zh: 修复了更改`/effort`或`/model`时`/clear`或压缩后虚假出现的缓存未命中警告

entries.en: Fixed `Bash(mkdir *)`, `Bash(touch *)` and similar allow rules not being honored for in-project paths
entries.zh: 修复了项目内路径不遵守`Bash(mkdir *)`、`Bash(touch *)`和类似允许规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed `deniedMcpServers` patterns with a `*://` scheme wildcard not matching mixed-case hostnames
entries.zh: 修复了带有`*://`方案通配符的`deniedMcpServers`模式与混合大小写主机名不匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed harmless WebSocket warning being logged as an error in `--debug` during voice mode
entries.zh: 修复了无害的 WebSocket 警告在语音模式下被记录为`--debug`中的错误的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `/clear` not clearing the conversation context and displayed transcript
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 `/clear` 无法清除对话上下文和显示的记录的问题

entries.en: Bare `/color` (no args) now picks a random session color
entries.zh: 裸`/color`（无参数）现在选择随机会话颜色

entries.en: `/mcp` now shows the tool count for connected servers and flags servers that connected with 0 tools
entries.zh: `/mcp` 现在会显示已连接服务器的工具数量，并标记连接成功但工具数为 0 的服务器

entries.en: `--plugin-dir` now accepts `.zip` plugin archives in addition to directories
entries.zh: `--plugin-dir` 现在除了文件夹，还支持 `.zip` 格式的插件压缩包

entries.en: `--channels` now works with console (API key) authentication — console orgs with managed settings must set `channelsEnabled: true` to enable
entries.zh: `--channels` 现在支持 console（API key）认证；启用了托管设置的 console 组织需要设置 `channelsEnabled: true` 才能开启

entries.en: Updated `/model` picker: collapsed duplicate Opus 4.7 entries, and current Opus now shows as "Opus" instead of "Opus 4.7"
entries.zh: `/model` 选择器：合并了重复的 Opus 4.7 条目；当前的 Opus 现在显示为 "Opus" 而不是 "Opus 4.7"

entries.en: Subprocesses (Bash, hooks, MCP, LSP) no longer inherit `OTEL_*` environment variables, so OTEL-instrumented apps run via the Bash tool no longer pick up the CLI's own OTLP endpoint
entries.zh: 子进程（Bash、钩子、MCP、LSP）不再继承 `OTEL_*` 环境变量，因此通过 Bash 工具运行的、带 OTEL 埋点的应用，不会再误用 Claude Code 自身的 OTLP 端点

entries.en: MCP: `workspace` is now a reserved server name — existing servers with that name will be skipped with a warning
entries.zh: MCP：`workspace` 现在是保留的服务器名称，已用该名称的现有服务器会被跳过并给出警告

entries.en: Reconnecting MCP servers no longer flood the conversation with full tool-name lists on every reconnect — re-announced tools are summarized by server prefix
entries.zh: MCP 服务器重连时，不再在每次重连时向对话里刷出完整的工具名列表，重新公布的工具会按服务器前缀汇总

entries.en: SDK hosts now receive a persistent `localSettings` suggestion for Bash permission prompts, so "Always allow" writes to `.claude/settings.local.json`
entries.zh: SDK 宿主现在会为 Bash 权限提示收到一个持久的 `localSettings` 建议，因此 "Always allow" 会写入 `.claude/settings.local.json`

entries.en: `EnterWorktree` now creates the new branch from local HEAD as documented, instead of `origin/<default-branch>` — unpushed commits are no longer dropped
entries.zh: `EnterWorktree` 现在会按文档说明，从本地 HEAD 创建新分支，而不是 `origin/<默认分支>`；未推送的提交不再丢失

entries.en: Auto mode: when the classifier can't evaluate an action, the error now includes a hint (retry, `/compact`, or run with `--debug`)
entries.zh: 自动模式：当分类器无法评估某个操作时，错误现在包含提示（重试、`/compact`或使用`--debug`运行）

entries.en: Fixed focus mode briefly dimming the previous response when submitting a new prompt
entries.zh: 修复了提交新提示时焦点模式会暂时使之前的响应变暗的问题

entries.en: Fixed stray "4;0;" desktop notification on every `/exit` in Kitty and other terminals that interpret OSC 9 as a notification
entries.zh: 修复了杂散“4;0;” Kitty 和其他将 OSC 9 解释为通知的终端上的每个`/exit`上的桌面通知

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control showing an empty "Opening your options…" message on rate limit instead of actionable upsell options
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制在速率限制上显示空的“打开您的选项...”消息，而不是可操作的追加销售选项的问题

entries.en: Fixed drag-and-drop image upload hanging on "Pasting text…" when the image read fails
entries.zh: 修复了图像读取失败时拖放图像上传挂在“粘贴文本...”上的问题

entries.en: Fixed crash loop when piping very large input (>10 MB) to `claude -p` via stdin
entries.zh: 修复了通过标准输入将非常大的输入（> 10 MB）传输到`claude -p`时的崩溃循环

entries.en: Fixed long URLs not being individually clickable on every wrapped row in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下每个包装行上无法单独单击长 URL 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Components panel showing "Marketplace 'inline' not found" for plugins loaded via `--plugin-dir`
entries.zh: 修复了通过 `--plugin-dir` 加载的插件显示“未找到市场‘内联’”的`/plugin`组件面板

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool results dropping images when the server returns both structured content and content blocks
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器返回结构化内容和内容块时 MCP 工具导致图像丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed fenced code blocks inside list items carrying leading whitespace into the clipboard on copy-paste
entries.zh: 修复了列表项内的围栏代码块，在复制粘贴时将前导空格带入剪贴板

entries.en: Fixed tab navigation in `/config` stranding focus — the tab header now stays focused so arrows and Esc keep working
entries.zh: 修复了`/config`中搁浅焦点的选项卡导航 - 选项卡标题现在保持焦点，因此箭头和 Esc 继续工作

entries.en: Fixed markdown link labels being lost on terminals without OSC 8 hyperlink support — links now render as `label (url)` instead of just the URL
entries.zh: 修复了在没有 OSC 8 超链接支持的终端上丢失的 Markdown 链接标签 — 链接现在呈现为“标签（url）”，而不仅仅是 URL

entries.en: Fixed sessions on 1M-context models with a smaller autocompact window being falsely blocked with "Prompt is too long" before reaching the actual API limit
entries.zh: 修复了在达到实际 API 限制之前，具有较小自动压缩窗口的 1M 上下文模型上的会话被错误地阻止为“提示太长”的问题

entries.en: Fixed parallel shell tool calls: a failing read-only command (grep, git diff, ls) no longer cancels sibling calls
entries.zh: 修复了并行 shell 工具调用：失败的只读命令（grep、git diff、ls）不再取消同级调用

entries.en: Fixed banner showing "with X effort" on models that don't support effort
entries.zh: 修复了在不支持努力的模型上显示“X 努力”的横幅

entries.en: Fixed `/fast` on 3P providers fuzzy-matching to an unrelated skill instead of showing "not available"
entries.zh: 修复了 3P 提供商上的`/fast`与不相关技能的模糊匹配，而不是显示“不可用”

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock default model resolving to `global.*` instead of the region-appropriate prefix
entries.zh: 修复了基岩默认模型解析为`global.*`而不是适合区域的前缀

entries.en: Fixed vim mode: `Space` in NORMAL mode now moves the cursor right, matching standard vi/vim behavior
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式：NORMAL 模式下的空格键现在会右移光标，与标准 vi/vim 行为一致
