entries.en: Fixed terminal progress indicator (OSC 9;4) flickering off between tool calls — stays visible across the full turn
entries.zh: 修复终端进度指示器（OSC 9;4）在工具调用之间闪烁熄灭的问题，现在会在整个回合中保持可见

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` without args failing on resumed sessions whose last entry is a compact boundary
entries.zh: 修复了没有参数的`/rename`在最后一个条目是紧凑边界的恢复会话上失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed stale "remote-control is active" status lines from prior sessions appearing after `--resume`/`--continue`
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`/`--continue`之后出现的先前会话中过时的“远程控制处于活动状态”状态行

entries.en: Fixed stale `installed_plugins.json` entries pointing at deleted cache directories polluting PATH
entries.zh: 修复了指向已删除缓存目录污染 PATH 的过时`installed_plugins.json`条目

entries.en: Fixed MCP stdio servers receiving corrupted arguments when `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX` is set and an argument contains spaces or shell metacharacters
entries.zh: 修复了当设置`CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX`并且参数包含空格或 shell 元字符时 MCP stdio 服务器接收损坏的参数

entries.en: Fixed sub-agent progress summaries missing the prompt cache (~3× `cache_creation` reduction)
entries.zh: 修复了缺少提示缓存的子代理进度摘要（~3×`cache_creation`减少）

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin update` never detecting new versions of npm-sourced plugins
entries.zh: 修复了 `/plugin update` 永远不会检测到 npm 来源的插件的新版本

entries.en: Fixed sub-agent summaries firing repeatedly while a sub-agent's transcript is static, capping worst-case token cost on idle sub-agents
entries.zh: 修复了子代理摘要在子代理的记录是静态时重复触发的问题，从而限制了空闲子代理的最坏情况令牌成本

entries.en: Headless `--output-format stream-json`: `init.plugin_errors` now includes `--plugin-dir` load failures in addition to dependency demotions
entries.zh: 无界面模式 `--output-format stream-json`：`init.plugin_errors` 现在除了依赖降级，还包含 `--plugin-dir` 加载失败的情况

entries.en: The `/model` picker now lists models from your gateway's `/v1/models` endpoint when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at an Anthropic-compatible gateway
entries.zh: 当 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 指向兼容 Anthropic 的网关时，`/model` 选择器会列出网关 `/v1/models` 接口返回的模型

entries.en: - Added `claude project purge [path]` to delete all Claude Code state for a project (transcripts, tasks, file history, config entry) — supports `--dry-run`, `-y/--yes`, `-i/--interactive`, and `--all`
entries.zh: - 添加了`claude project purge [path]`以删除项目的所有 Claude 代码状态（脚本、任务、文件历史记录、配置条目）——支持`--dry-run`、`-y/--yes`、`-i/--interactive`和`--all`

entries.en: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` now bypasses prompts for writes to `.claude/`, `.git/`, `.vscode/`, shell config files, and other previously-protected paths (catastrophic removal commands still prompt as a safety net)
entries.zh: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 现在会跳过对 `.claude/`、`.git/`、`.vscode/`、shell 配置文件及其他原先受保护路径的写入提示（灾难性的删除命令仍会提示，作为安全兜底）

entries.en: `claude auth login` now accepts the OAuth code pasted into the terminal when the browser callback can't reach localhost (WSL2, SSH, containers)
entries.zh: 当浏览器回调无法连接 localhost 时（WSL2、SSH、容器），`claude auth login` 现在可以接受粘贴到终端中的 OAuth 代码

entries.en: `claude_code.skill_activated` OpenTelemetry event now fires for user-typed slash commands and carries a new `invocation_trigger` attribute (`"user-slash"`, `"claude-proactive"`, or `"nested-skill"`)
entries.zh: 用户手动输入的斜杠命令现在会触发 `claude_code.skill_activated` OpenTelemetry 事件，并带有新属性 `invocation_trigger`（`"user-slash"`、`"claude-proactive"` 或 `"nested-skill"`）

entries.en: Auto mode: the spinner now turns red when a permission check stalls, instead of looking like the tool is running
entries.zh: 自动模式：当权限检查停止时，微调器现在会变成红色，而不是看起来工具正在运行

entries.en: Host-managed deployments (`CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST`) no longer auto-disable analytics on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry
entries.zh: 托管宿主部署（`CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST`）不再在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 上自动关闭统计分析

entries.en: Windows: PowerShell 7 installed via the Microsoft Store, MSI without PATH, or `.NET global tool` is now detected
entries.zh: Windows：现在可以识别通过 Microsoft Store 安装的 PowerShell 7、未加入 PATH 的 MSI 安装版，以及 `.NET global tool` 安装版

entries.en: Windows: when the PowerShell tool is enabled, Claude now treats PowerShell as the primary shell instead of defaulting to Bash
entries.zh: Windows：启用 PowerShell 工具后，Claude 会把 PowerShell 作为主要 shell，不再默认使用 Bash

entries.en: Read tool: removed the per-file malware-assessment reminder that could cause spurious refusals and "this is not malware" commentary on legacy models
entries.zh: Read 工具：移除了每个文件的恶意软件评估提醒，该提醒可能在旧模型上导致误拒绝，以及“这不是恶意软件”之类多余的评论

entries.en: **Security:** Fixed `allowManagedDomainsOnly` / `allowManagedReadPathsOnly` being ignored when a higher-priority managed-settings source lacked a `sandbox` block
entries.zh: **安全性：**修复了当优先级较高的托管设置源缺少“沙箱”块时忽略`allowManagedDomainsOnly`/`allowManagedReadPathsOnly`的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasting an image larger than 2000px breaking the session — images are now downscaled on paste, and oversized images in history are automatically removed and the request retried
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴大于 2000 像素的图像会破坏会话的问题 — 图像现在在粘贴时会缩小，并且历史记录中的超大图像会自动删除并重试请求

entries.en: Fixed showing the login screen for "OAuth not allowed for organization" errors — now shows guidance to contact your admin
entries.zh: 修复了显示“组织不允许 OAuth”错误的登录屏幕 — 现在显示联系管理员的指南

entries.en: Fixed OAuth login failing with timeout on slow or proxied connections, in IPv6-only devcontainers, and when the browser callback can't reach localhost
entries.zh: 修复了 OAuth 登录在慢速或代理连接、仅 IPv6 开发容器中以及浏览器回调无法到达 localhost 时失败并超时的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare race where a concurrent credential write could clear a valid OAuth refresh token
entries.zh: 修复了并发凭证写入可能会清除有效 OAuth 刷新令牌的罕见情况

entries.en: Fixed API retry countdown sticking at "0s" instead of counting down between attempts
entries.zh: 修复了 API 重试倒计时停留在“0s”而不是尝试之间倒计时的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Stream idle timeout" error after waking Mac from sleep mid-request
entries.zh: 修复了在请求中将 Mac 从睡眠状态唤醒后出现的“流空闲超时”错误

entries.en: Fixed background and remote sessions falsely aborting with "Stream idle timeout" during long model thinking pauses
entries.zh: 修复了长时间模型思考暂停期间后台和远程会话因“流空闲超时”错误中止的问题

entries.en: Fixed a hang where the assistant could finish thinking but show no output after a run of empty turns
entries.zh: 修复了助手可以完成思考但在空转后没有显示输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed overly fast trackpad scrolling in Cursor and VS Code 1.92–1.104 integrated terminals
entries.zh: 修复了光标和 VS Code 1.92–1.104 集成终端中触控板滚动过快的问题

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai MCP connectors being suppressed by manual servers stuck in needs-auth state
entries.zh: 修复了 claude.ai MCP 连接器被陷入需求验证状态的手动服务器抑制的问题

entries.en: Fixed Japanese/Korean/Chinese text rendering as garbled characters on Windows in no-flicker mode
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上无闪烁模式下日文/韩文/中文文本呈现为乱码的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Ctrl+L` clearing the prompt input — it now only forces a screen redraw, matching readline behavior
entries.zh: 修复了`Ctrl+L`清除提示输入的问题 - 现在它只强制屏幕重绘，匹配 readline 行为

entries.en: Fixed deferred tools (WebSearch, WebFetch, etc.) not being available to skills with `context: fork` and other subagents on their first turn
entries.zh: 修复了具有“context:fork”和其他子代理的技能在第一轮无法使用延迟工具（WebSearch、WebFetch 等）的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan-mode tools being unavailable in interactive sessions launched with `--channels`
entries.zh: 修复了计划模式工具在使用`--channels`启动的交互式会话中不可用的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Uninstall reporting "Enabled" instead of "Uninstalled"
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`卸载报告“已启用”而不是“已卸载”

entries.en: Bounded total size of file-modified reminders when a linter touches many files at once
entries.zh: 当 linter 一次触及多个文件时，文件修改提醒的总大小有限

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` retries appearing stuck on "connecting…" — each retry now shows its result
entries.zh: 修复了`/remote-control`重试卡在“正在连接…”上的问题——现在每次重试都会显示其结果

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control failure notification not showing the error reason for initial connection failures
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制失败通知不显示初始连接失败的错误原因

entries.en: Windows: clipboard writes no longer expose copied content in process command-line arguments visible to EDR/SIEM telemetry; also fixes >22KB selections not reaching the clipboard
entries.zh: Windows：写入剪贴板时，复制的内容不再出现在进程命令行参数中，避免被 EDR/SIEM 遥测看到；同时修复了超过 22KB 的选中内容无法进入剪贴板的问题

entries.en: PowerShell tool: bare `--` (e.g. `git diff -- file`) is no longer mis-flagged as the `--%` stop-parsing token
entries.zh: PowerShell 工具：单独的 `--`（如 `git diff -- file`）不再被误判为 `--%` 停止解析标记

entries.en: Fixed Agent SDK hang when the model emits a malformed tool name in a parallel tool call batch
entries.zh: 修复了模型在并行工具调用批处理中发出格式错误的工具名称时代理 SDK 挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed OAuth authentication failing with a 401 retry loop when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1`时 OAuth 身份验证失败并出现 401 重试循环的问题

entries.en: Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER` environment variable to select a Bedrock service tier (`default`, `flex`, or `priority`), sent as the `X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier` header
entries.zh: 添加了`ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER`环境变量来选择 Bedrock 服务层（`default`、`flex`或`priority`），作为`X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier`标头发送

entries.en: Pasting a PR URL into the `/resume` search box now finds the session that created that PR (GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, and Bitbucket)
entries.zh: 将 PR 链接粘贴到 `/resume` 搜索框中，可以找到创建该 PR 的会话（支持 GitHub、GitHub Enterprise、GitLab 和 Bitbucket）

entries.en: `/mcp` now shows claude.ai connectors hidden by a manually-added server with the same URL, with a hint to remove the duplicate
entries.zh: `/mcp` 现在会显示被同一 URL 的手动添加服务器隐藏的 claude.ai 连接器，并提示删除重复项

entries.en: Clarified the `/mcp` message shown when an MCP server is still unauthorized after the browser sign-in flow
entries.zh: 澄清了在浏览器登录流程后 MCP 服务器仍然未经授权时显示的`/mcp`消息

entries.en: OpenTelemetry: numeric attributes on `api_request`/`api_error` log events are now emitted as numbers, not strings
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry：`api_request`/`api_error` 日志事件中的数字属性现在以数字形式输出，而不是字符串

entries.en: OpenTelemetry: added `claude_code.at_mention` log event for `@`-mention resolution
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry：新增 `claude_code.at_mention` 日志事件，用于记录 `@` 提及的解析

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` producing forks that fail with "tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks" when the source session contained entries from rewound timelines
entries.zh: 修复了当源会话包含来自倒回时间线的条目时，`/branch` 生成的分叉失败并显示“在没有 tool_result 块的情况下找到了 tool_use id”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` not showing the Effort option for Bedrock application inference profile ARNs, and those ARNs not receiving `output_config.effort`
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`未显示 Bedrock 应用程序推理配置文件 ARN 的“Effort”选项，以及那些 ARN 未接收`output_config.effort`的问题

entries.en: Fixed Vertex AI / Bedrock returning `invalid_request_error: output_config: Extra inputs are not permitted` on session-title generation and other structured-output queries
entries.zh: 修复了 Vertex AI / Bedrock 在会话标题生成和其他结构化输出查询中返回“invalid_request_error：output_config：不允许额外输入”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Vertex AI `count_tokens` endpoint returning 400 errors for users behind proxy gateways
entries.zh: 修复了 Vertex AI`count_tokens`端点为代理网关后面的用户返回 400 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `spinnerTipsOverride.excludeDefault` not suppressing the time-based spinner tips
entries.zh: 修复了`spinnerTipsOverride.excludeDefault`不抑制基于时间的微调器提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed ToolSearch missing MCP tools that connected after session start in nonblocking mode
entries.zh: 修复了 ToolSearch 丢失在非阻塞模式下会话启动后连接的 MCP 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed `!exit` / `!quit` in bash mode terminating the CLI instead of running as a shell command
entries.zh: 修复了 bash 模式下的 `!exit` / `!quit` 终止 CLI，而不是作为 shell 命令运行

entries.en: Fixed images sent to newer models being resized to 2576px per side instead of the correct 2000px maximum
entries.zh: 修复了发送到较新型号的图像尺寸调整为每边 2576 像素，而不是正确的最大 2000 像素

entries.en: Fixed remote control session idle status redrawing twice per second, which could flood `tmux -CC` control pipes and pause the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话空闲状态每秒重绘两次，这可能会淹没`tmux -CC`控制管道并暂停终端

entries.en: Fixed assistant messages appearing blank in some sessions due to a stale view preference
entries.zh: 修复了由于陈旧的视图首选项而导致某些会话中助理消息显示为空白的问题

entries.en: Fixed a malformed hooks entry in `settings.json` no longer invalidating the entire file
entries.zh: 修复了`settings.json`中格式错误的钩子条目，不再使整个文件无效

entries.en: Voice mode: keybindings bound to Caps Lock now show an error since terminals don't deliver Caps Lock as a key event
entries.zh: 语音模式：绑定到 Caps Lock 的快捷键现在会显示错误，因为终端不会把 Caps Lock 当作按键事件发送

entries.en: Added `alwaysLoad` option to MCP server config — when `true`, all tools from that server skip tool-search deferral and are always available
entries.zh: 在 MCP 服务器配置中添加了`alwaysLoad`选项 - 当`true`时，该服务器中的所有工具都会跳过工具搜索延迟并始终可用

entries.en: Added `claude plugin prune` to remove orphaned auto-installed plugin dependencies; `plugin uninstall --prune` cascades
entries.zh: 添加了`claude plugin prune`以删除孤立的自动安装插件依赖项； `插件卸载 --prune` 级联

entries.en: Added a type-to-filter search box to `/skills` so you can find a skill in long lists without scrolling
entries.zh: 在`/skills`中添加了一个类型过滤搜索框，这样您就可以在长列表中找到技能而无需滚动

entries.en: PostToolUse hooks can now replace tool output for all tools via `hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput` (previously MCP-only)
entries.zh: PostToolUse hook 现在可以通过 `hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput` 替换所有工具的输出（之前只支持 MCP 工具）

entries.en: Fullscreen mode: typing into the prompt no longer jumps scroll back to the bottom after you've scrolled up to read earlier output
entries.zh: 全屏模式：向上滚动阅读历史输出后，在输入框打字不再把滚动位置跳回底部

entries.en: Dialogs that overflow the terminal are now scrollable with arrow keys, PgUp/PgDn, home/end, and mouse wheel in both fullscreen and non-fullscreen modes
entries.zh: 现在，在全屏和非全屏模式下，可以使用箭头键、PgUp/PgDn、home/end 和鼠标滚轮滚动溢出终端的对话框

entries.en: Clicking any line of a long URL that wraps across rows in fullscreen mode now opens the full URL
entries.zh: 现在，单击在全屏模式下跨行换行的长 URL 的任何行都会打开完整 URL

entries.en: SDK and `claude -p`: `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1` now works in non-interactive sessions
entries.zh: SDK 和 `claude -p`：`CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1` 现在可在非交互式会话中使用

entries.en: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` no longer prompts for writes to `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/agents/`, and `.claude/commands/`
entries.zh: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 不再对写入 `.claude/skills/`、`.claude/agents/` 和 `.claude/commands/` 进行提示

entries.en: `/terminal-setup` now enables iTerm2's "Applications in terminal may access clipboard" setting so `/copy` works, including from tmux
entries.zh: `/terminal-setup` 现在会开启 iTerm2 的 "Applications in terminal may access clipboard" 设置，使 `/copy` 可用，包括在 tmux 中

entries.en: MCP servers that hit a transient error during startup now auto-retry up to 3 times instead of staying disconnected
entries.zh: 启动时遇到暂时性错误的 MCP 服务器，现在会自动重试最多 3 次，而不是一直保持断开

entries.en: The terminal tab session title is now generated in your configured `language` setting
entries.zh: 终端标签页的会话标题现在使用你配置的 `language` 设置生成

entries.en: Claude.ai connectors with the same upstream URL are now deduplicated instead of appearing as duplicates
entries.zh: 具有相同上游 URL 的 Claude.ai 连接器现在已进行重复数据删除，而不是显示为重复项

entries.en: Vertex AI: support X.509 certificate-based Workload Identity Federation (mTLS ADC)
entries.zh: Vertex AI：支持基于 X.509 证书的工作负载身份联合（mTLS ADC）

entries.en: Faster startup after upgrading: removed the Recent Activity panel from the release-notes splash
entries.zh: 升级后启动速度更快：从发行说明启动中删除了“最近的活动”面板

entries.en: LSP diagnostic summaries now expand on click/ctrl+o and show the expand hint
entries.zh: LSP 诊断摘要现在可以点击或按 ctrl+o 展开，并显示展开提示

entries.en: SDK: `mcp_authenticate` now supports `redirectUri` for custom scheme completion and claude.ai connectors
entries.zh: SDK：`mcp_authenticate` 现在支持 `redirectUri`，用于自定义协议完成认证以及 claude.ai 连接器

entries.en: OpenTelemetry: added `stop_reason`, `gen_ai.response.finish_reasons`, and `user_system_prompt` (gated behind `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`) to LLM request spans
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry：LLM 请求 span 中新增 `stop_reason`、`gen_ai.response.finish_reasons` 和 `user_system_prompt`（后者需设置 `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS` 才会记录）

entries.en: [VSCode] Voice dictation now respects the `accessibility.voice.speechLanguage` setting when no Claude Code language is configured
entries.zh: [VSCode] 未配置 Claude Code 语言时，语音听写现在会遵循 `accessibility.voice.speechLanguage` 设置

entries.en: [VSCode] `/context` now opens a native token usage dialog
entries.zh: [VSCode] `/context` 现在会打开原生的 token 用量对话框

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth (multi-GB RSS) when processing many images in a session
entries.zh: 修复会话中处理大量图片时，内存无限增长（RSS 达数 GB）的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` leaking up to ~2GB of memory on machines with large transcript histories
entries.zh: 修复了在具有大量转录历史记录的计算机上`/usage`泄漏高达约 2GB 内存的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory leak when long-running tools fail to emit a clear progress event
entries.zh: 修复了长时间运行的工具无法发出清晰的进度事件时的内存泄漏问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool becoming permanently unusable when the directory Claude was started in is deleted or moved mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude 启动目录在会话中被删除或移动时 Bash 工具永久无法使用的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` crashing on startup in external builds
entries.zh: 修复了外部构建中启动时`--resume`崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` failing on large sessions when a transcript line was corrupted by an unclean shutdown — the corrupt line is now skipped
entries.zh: 修复了当转录行因不干净的关闭而损坏时`--resume`在大型会话中失败的问题 - 现在会跳过损坏的行

entries.en: Fixed `thinking.type.enabled is not supported` error when using Bedrock application inference profile ARNs
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Bedrock 应用程序推理配置文件 ARN 时的“不支持thinking.type.enabled”错误

entries.en: Fixed Microsoft 365 MCP OAuth failing with duplicate or unsupported `prompt` parameter
entries.zh: 修复了 Microsoft 365 MCP OAuth 因重复或不受支持的“提示”参数而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed scrollback duplication when pressing Ctrl+L or triggering a redraw in non-fullscreen mode on tmux, GNOME Terminal, Windows Terminal, and Konsole
entries.zh: 修复了在 tmux、GNOME 终端、Windows 终端和 Konsole 上按 Ctrl+L 或在非全屏模式下触发重绘时的回滚重复问题

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai MCP connectors silently disappearing when the connector-list fetch hits a transient auth error at startup
entries.zh: 修复了当连接器列表获取在启动时遇到暂时性身份验证错误时 claude.ai MCP 连接器默默消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Always allow" rules for built-in tools in remote sessions not surviving worker restarts
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话中内置工具的“始终允许”规则在工作进程重新启动后无法幸存的问题

entries.en: Fixed `NO_PROXY` not being respected for all HTTP clients when set via `managed-settings.json` under the native build
entries.zh: 修复了在本机构建下通过`managed-settings.json`设置时所有 HTTP 客户端都不会遵守`NO_PROXY`的问题

entries.en: Fixed managed settings approval prompt exiting the session even when accepted — now applies settings and continues
entries.zh: 修复了托管设置批准提示即使在接受时也会退出会话的问题 - 现在应用设置并继续

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` returning "rate limited" after a stale OAuth token — now refreshes automatically
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`在过时的 OAuth 令牌后返回“速率受限”的问题 - 现在会自动刷新

entries.en: Fixed invalid legacy enum values in `settings.json` invalidating the entire settings file
entries.zh: 修复了`settings.json`中无效的旧枚举值，导致整个设置文件无效

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` dialog content being clipped when no-flicker mode is off
entries.zh: 修复了无闪烁模式关闭时`/usage`对话框内容被剪辑的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/focus` showing "Unknown command" when the fullscreen renderer is off — now explains how to enable it
entries.zh: 修复了当全屏渲染器关闭时`/focus`显示“未知命令”的问题 - 现在解释了如何启用它

entries.en: Fixed embedded grep/find/rg shell wrappers failing when the running binary is deleted mid-session — now falls back to installed tools
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中删除正在运行的二进制文件时嵌入式 grep/find/rg shell 包装器失败的问题 - 现在回退到已安装的工具

entries.en: Reduced peak file descriptor usage during `find` in the Bash tool on large directory trees
entries.zh: 在大目录树上使用 Bash 工具运行 `find` 时，文件描述符峰值用量降低

entries.en: Windows: Git for Windows (Git Bash) is no longer required — when absent, Claude Code uses PowerShell as the shell tool
entries.zh: Windows：不再必须安装 Git for Windows（Git Bash）；未安装时，Claude Code 会使用 PowerShell 作为 shell 工具

entries.en: Added `claude ultrareview [target]` subcommand to run `/ultrareview` non-interactively from CI or scripts — prints findings to stdout (`--json` for raw output) and exits 0 on completion or 1 on failure
entries.zh: 添加了`claude ultrareview [target]`子命令，以便从 CI 或脚本以非交互方式运行`/ultrareview`——将结果打印到 stdout（原始输出为`--json`）并在完成时退出 0 或在失败时退出 1

entries.en: Skills can now reference the current effort level with `${CLAUDE_EFFORT}` in their content
entries.zh: 技能内容现在可以使用 `${CLAUDE_EFFORT}` 引用当前的强度级别

entries.en: Set `AI_AGENT` environment variable for subprocesses so `gh` can attribute traffic to Claude Code
entries.zh: 为子进程设置 `AI_AGENT` 环境变量，使 `gh` 能把流量归因于 Claude Code

entries.en: Spinner tips that recommend installing the desktop app or creating skills/agents are now hidden when you already have them
entries.zh: 如果你已安装桌面应用或已创建技能/代理，相关的推荐提示现在会隐藏

entries.en: Show a "use PgUp/PgDn to scroll" hint when the terminal sends arrow keys instead of scroll events
entries.zh: 当终端发送方向键而不是滚动事件时，显示 "use PgUp/PgDn to scroll" 提示

entries.en: Faster session start when you have many claude.ai connectors configured but not authorized
entries.zh: 当您配置了许多 claude.ai 连接器但未授权时，会话启动速度更快

entries.en: The auto mode denial message now links to the configuration docs
entries.zh: 自动模式的拒绝消息现在会链接到配置文档

entries.en: `claude plugin validate` now accepts `$schema`, `version`, and `description` at the top level of `marketplace.json` and `$schema` in `plugin.json`
entries.zh: `claude plugin validate` 现在在 `marketplace.json` 顶层接受 `$schema`、`version` 和 `description`，并在 `plugin.json` 中接受 `$schema`

entries.en: Auto-compact in auto mode now displays `auto` (lowercase, no token count) instead of a misleading token value
entries.zh: 自动模式下的自动压缩现在显示`auto`（小写，无令牌计数）而不是误导性的令牌值

entries.en: Fixed pressing Esc during a stdio MCP tool call closing the entire server connection (regression in 2.1.105)
entries.zh: 修复了在 stdio MCP 工具调用期间按 Esc 关闭整个服务器连接的问题（2.1.105 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed `/rewind` and other interactive overlays not responding to keyboard input after launching with `claude --resume`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`claude --resume`启动后`/rewind`和其他交互式叠加层不响应键盘输入的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal scrollback duplication in non-fullscreen mode (resize, dialog dismiss, long sessions)
entries.zh: 修复非全屏模式下终端滚动缓冲区内容重复的问题（调整大小、关闭对话框、长会话时）

entries.en: Fixed `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` / `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` not suppressing usage metrics telemetry for API and enterprise users
entries.zh: 修复了`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`/`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`不抑制 API 和企业用户的使用指标遥测的问题

entries.en: Fixed false-positive "Dangerous rm operation" permission prompts in auto mode for multi-line bash commands containing both a pipe and a redirect
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式下包含管道和重定向的多行 bash 命令的误报“危险 rm 操作”权限提示

entries.en: Fixed long selection menus clipping below the terminal in fullscreen mode — the focused option now stays on screen as you scroll
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下长选择菜单在终端下方剪辑的问题 - 当您滚动时，焦点选项现在保留在屏幕上

entries.en: Fixed Write tool output collapsing instead of expanding when clicking "+N lines" in fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏中单击“+N 行”时写入工具输出折叠而不是展开的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash command picker jumping while typing, and improved highlight to only match contiguous substrings in blue
entries.zh: 修复了打字时斜杠命令选择器跳跃的问题，并改进了突出显示以仅匹配蓝色的连续子字符串

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` marketplace failing to load when one entry uses an unrecognized source format — that entry is shown but installing it prompts you to update
entries.zh: 修复了当一个条目使用无法识别的源格式时`/plugin`市场无法加载的问题 - 该条目已显示，但安装它会提示您更新

entries.en: [VSCode] `/usage` now opens the native Account & Usage dialog instead of returning plain-text session cost
entries.zh: [VSCode] `/usage` 现在会打开原生的 Account & Usage 对话框，而不再返回纯文本的会话费用

entries.en: [VSCode] Voice dictation now respects the `language` setting in `~/.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 语音听写现在会遵循 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中的 `language` 设置

entries.en: Fixed `find` in the Bash tool exhausting open file descriptors on large directory trees, causing host-wide crashes (macOS/Linux native builds)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具中的`find`耗尽大型目录树上打开的文件描述符，导致主机范围崩溃（macOS/Linux 本机构建）

entries.en: `/config` settings (theme, editor mode, verbose, etc.) now persist to `~/.claude/settings.json` and participate in project/local/policy override precedence
entries.zh: `/config` 的设置（主题、编辑器模式、verbose 等）现在会保存到 `~/.claude/settings.json`，并参与项目/本地/策略的覆盖优先级

entries.en: Added `prUrlTemplate` setting to point the footer PR badge at a custom code-review URL instead of github.com
entries.zh: 添加了`prUrlTemplate`设置，将页脚 PR 徽章指向自定义代码审查 URL，而不是 github.com

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD` environment variable to hide the working directory in the startup logo
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD`环境变量以隐藏启动徽标中的工作目录

entries.en: `--from-pr` now accepts GitLab merge-request, Bitbucket pull-request, and GitHub Enterprise PR URLs
entries.zh: `--from-pr` 现在支持 GitLab merge request、Bitbucket pull request 和 GitHub Enterprise 的 PR 链接

entries.en: `--print` mode now honors the agent's `tools:` and `disallowedTools:` frontmatter, matching interactive-mode behavior
entries.zh: `--print` 模式现在会遵循 agent 前置配置中的 `tools:` 和 `disallowedTools:`，与交互模式保持一致

entries.en: `--agent <name>` now honors the agent definition's `permissionMode` for built-in agents
entries.zh: `--agent <name>` 现在对内置 agent 也会遵循 agent 定义中的 `permissionMode`

entries.en: PowerShell tool commands can now be auto-approved in permission mode, matching Bash behavior
entries.zh: PowerShell 工具的命令现在可以像 Bash 一样，在权限模式下被自动批准

entries.en: Hooks: `PostToolUse` and `PostToolUseFailure` hook inputs now include `duration_ms` (tool execution time, excluding permission prompts and PreToolUse hooks)
entries.zh: `PostToolUse` 和 `PostToolUseFailure` 的 hook 输入现在包含 `duration_ms`（工具执行耗时，不含权限弹窗和 PreToolUse 钩子的时间）

entries.en: Subagent and SDK MCP server reconfiguration now connects servers in parallel instead of serially
entries.zh: 子代理和 SDK MCP 服务器重新配置时改为并行连接，而不是串行连接

entries.en: Plugins pinned by another plugin's version constraint now auto-update to the highest satisfying git tag
entries.zh: 被另一个插件的版本约束固定的插件，现在会自动更新到满足约束的最高 git 标签

entries.en: Vim mode: Esc in INSERT no longer pulls a queued message back into the input; press Esc again to interrupt
entries.zh: Vim 模式：在 INSERT 模式下按 Esc 不再把排队中的消息拉回输入框；再按一次 Esc 即可打断

entries.en: Slash command suggestions now highlight the characters that matched your query
entries.zh: 斜杠命令建议现在会高亮显示与你输入内容匹配的字符

entries.en: Slash command picker now wraps long descriptions onto a second line instead of truncating
entries.zh: 斜杠命令选择器中的长描述现在会换行到第二行显示，而不是截断

entries.en: `owner/repo#N` shorthand links in output now use your git remote's host instead of always pointing at github.com
entries.zh: 输出中的 `owner/repo#N` 简写链接现在会使用你 git 远端的主机，而不再总是指向 github.com

entries.en: Security: `blockedMarketplaces` now correctly enforces `hostPattern` and `pathPattern` entries
entries.zh: 安全：`blockedMarketplaces` 现在正确执行 `hostPattern` 和 `pathPattern` 条目

entries.en: OpenTelemetry: `tool_result` and `tool_decision` events now include `tool_use_id`; `tool_result` also includes `tool_input_size_bytes`
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry：`tool_result` 和 `tool_decision` 事件现在包含 `tool_use_id`；`tool_result` 还包含 `tool_input_size_bytes`

entries.en: Status line: stdin JSON now includes `effort.level` and `thinking.enabled`
entries.zh: 状态栏的标准输入 JSON 现在包含 `effort.level` 和 `thinking.enabled`

entries.en: Fixed pasting CRLF content (Windows clipboards, Xcode console) inserting an extra blank line between every line
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴 CRLF 内容（Windows 剪贴板、Xcode 控制台）时在每行之间插入额外的空行

entries.en: Fixed multi-line paste losing newlines in terminals using kitty keyboard protocol sequences inside bracketed paste
entries.zh: 修复了使用括号粘贴内的 kitty 键盘协议序列在终端中丢失换行符的多行粘贴问题

entries.en: Fixed Glob and Grep tools disappearing on native macOS/Linux builds when the Bash tool is denied via permissions
entries.zh: 修复了当 Bash 工具被权限拒绝时，Glob 和 Grep 工具在本机 macOS/Linux 构建上消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed scrolling up in fullscreen mode snapping back to the bottom every time a tool finishes
entries.zh: 修复了每次工具完成时在全屏模式下向上滚动到底部的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP HTTP connections failing with "Invalid OAuth error response" when servers returned non-JSON bodies for OAuth discovery requests
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器为 OAuth 发现请求返回非 JSON 正文时，MCP HTTP 连接因“无效的 OAuth 错误响应”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Rewind overlay showing "(no prompt)" for messages with image attachments
entries.zh: 修复了带有图像附件的消息的倒回叠加层显示“（无提示）”的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode overriding plan mode with conflicting "Execute immediately" instructions
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式覆盖计划模式与“立即执行”指令冲突的问题

entries.en: Fixed async `PostToolUse` hooks that emit no response payload writing empty entries to the session transcript
entries.zh: 修复了异步`PostToolUse`挂钩，该挂钩不发出响应负载，将空条目写入会话记录

entries.en: Fixed spinner staying on when a subagent task notification is orphaned in the queue
entries.zh: 修复了当子代理任务通知在队列中孤立时旋转器保持打开状态的问题

entries.en: Tool search is now disabled by default on Vertex AI to avoid an unsupported beta header error (opt in with `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH`)
entries.zh: Vertex AI 上默认禁用工具搜索，以避免不支持的 beta 请求头错误（如需开启，请设置 `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH`）

entries.en: Fixed `@`-file Tab completion replacing the entire prompt when used inside a slash command with an absolute path
entries.zh: 修复了在带有绝对路径的斜杠命令中使用时`@`文件制表符补全替换整个提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed a stray `p` character appearing at the prompt on startup in macOS Terminal.app via Docker or SSH
entries.zh: 修复了通过 Docker 或 SSH 在 macOS Terminal.app 中启动时提示符处出现的杂散`p`字符

entries.en: Fixed `${ENV_VAR}` placeholders in `headers` for HTTP/SSE/WebSocket MCP servers not being substituted before requests
entries.zh: 修复了 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket MCP 服务器`headers`中的`${ENV_VAR}`占位符在请求之前未被替换的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth client secret stored via `--client-secret` not being sent during token exchange for servers requiring `client_secret_post`
entries.zh: 修复了通过`--client-secret`存储的 MCP OAuth 客户端密钥在需要`client_secret_post`的服务器的令牌交换期间不会发送的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/skills` Enter key closing the dialog instead of pre-filling `/<skill-name>` in the prompt
entries.zh: 修复了`/skills`输入键关闭对话框而不是在提示中预先填写`/<skill-name>`

entries.en: Fixed `/agents` detail view mislabeling built-in tools unavailable to subagents as "Unrecognized"
entries.zh: 修复了`/agents`详细视图将子代理无法使用的内置工具错误标记为“无法识别”的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers from plugins not spawning on Windows when the plugin cache was incomplete
entries.zh: 修复了当插件缓存不完整时插件中的 MCP 服务器不会在 Windows 上生成的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/export` showing the current default model instead of the model the conversation actually used
entries.zh: 修复了显示当前默认模型而不是对话实际使用的模型的`/export`

entries.en: Fixed verbose output setting not persisting after restart
entries.zh: 修复详细输出设置重启后不保留的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` progress bars overlapping with their "Resets …" labels
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`进度条与其“重置...”标签重叠的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin MCP servers failing when `${user_config.*}` references an optional field left blank
entries.zh: 修复了当`${user_config.*}`引用留空的可选字段时插件 MCP 服务器失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed list items containing a sentence-final number wrapping the number onto its own line
entries.zh: 修复了包含句子最终数字的列表项，该数字将数字包装在自己的行上

entries.en: Fixed `/plan` and `/plan open` not acting on the existing plan when entering plan mode
entries.zh: 修复了进入计划模式时`/plan`和`/plan open`不作用于现有计划的问题

entries.en: Fixed skills invoked before auto-compaction being re-executed against the next user message
entries.zh: 修复了在针对下一条用户消息重新执行自动压缩之前调用的技能

entries.en: Fixed `/reload-plugins` and `/doctor` reporting load errors for disabled plugins
entries.zh: 修复了`/reload-plugins`和`/doctor`报告禁用插件的加载错误

entries.en: Fixed Agent tool with `isolation: "worktree"` reusing stale worktrees from prior sessions
entries.zh: 修复了具有“隔离：“工作树””的代理工具，重用了先前会话中的陈旧工作树

entries.en: Fixed disabled MCP servers appearing as "failed" in `/status`
entries.zh: 修复了已禁用的 MCP 服务器在`/status`中显示为“失败”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `TaskList` returning tasks in arbitrary filesystem order instead of sorted by ID
entries.zh: 修复了`TaskList`以任意文件系统顺序返回任务而不是按 ID 排序的问题

entries.en: Fixed spurious "GitHub API rate limit exceeded" hints when `gh` output contained PR titles mentioning "rate limit"
entries.zh: 修复了当 `gh` 输出包含提及“速率限制”的 PR 标题时虚假的“超出 GitHub API 速率限制”提示

entries.en: Fixed SDK/bridge `read_file` not correctly enforcing size cap on growing files
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK/bridge`read_file`未正确对不断增长的文件强制执行大小上限的问题

entries.en: Fixed PR not linked to session when working in a git worktree
entries.zh: 修复了在 git 工作树中工作时 PR 未链接到会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/doctor` warning about MCP server entries overridden by a higher-precedence scope
entries.zh: 修复了有关 MCP 服务器条目被更高优先级范围覆盖的`/doctor`警告

entries.en: Windows: removed false-positive "Windows requires 'cmd /c' wrapper" MCP config warning
entries.zh: Windows：移除了误报的 "Windows requires 'cmd /c' wrapper" MCP 配置警告

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed voice dictation's first recording producing nothing on macOS while the microphone permission prompt is showing
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 macOS 上麦克风权限提示显示期间，语音听写的第一次录音没有任何结果的问题

entries.en: Added vim visual mode (`v`) and visual-line mode (`V`) with selection, operators, and visual feedback
entries.zh: 添加了带有选择、操作符和视觉反馈的 vim 视觉模式 (`v`) 和视觉线模式 (`V`)

entries.en: Merged `/cost` and `/stats` into `/usage` — both remain as typing shortcuts that open the relevant tab
entries.zh: 将 `/cost` 和 `/stats` 合并进 `/usage`，两者仍保留为输入快捷方式，会打开对应的标签页

entries.en: Create and switch between named custom themes from `/theme`, or hand-edit JSON files in `~/.claude/themes/`; plugins can also ship themes via a `themes/` directory
entries.zh: 从 `/theme` 创建并切换命名的自定义主题，或在 `~/.claude/themes/` 中手动编辑 JSON 文件；插件还可以通过`themes/`目录发送主题

entries.en: Hooks can now invoke MCP tools directly via `type: "mcp_tool"`
entries.zh: Hooks 现在可以通过 `type: "mcp_tool"` 直接调用 MCP 工具

entries.en: Added `DISABLE_UPDATES` env var to completely block all update paths including manual `claude update` — stricter than `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER`
entries.zh: 添加了`DISABLE_UPDATES`环境变量以完全阻止所有更新路径，包括手动`claude update`——比`DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER`更严格

entries.en: WSL on Windows can now inherit Windows-side managed settings via the `wslInheritsWindowsSettings` policy key
entries.zh: WSL 上可通过 `wslInheritsWindowsSettings` 策略键，继承 Windows 端的托管设置

entries.en: Auto mode: include `"$defaults"` in `autoMode.allow`, `autoMode.soft_deny`, or `autoMode.environment` to add custom rules alongside the built-in list instead of replacing it
entries.zh: 自动模式：在 `autoMode.allow`、`autoMode.soft_deny` 或 `autoMode.environment` 中包含 `"$defaults"` 以在内置列表旁边添加自定义规则，而不是替换它

entries.en: Added a "Don't ask again" option to the auto mode opt-in prompt
entries.zh: 在自动模式选择提示中添加了“不再询问”选项

entries.en: Added `claude plugin tag` to create release git tags for plugins with version validation
entries.zh: 添加了“claude 插件标签”，为具有版本验证的插件创建发布 git 标签

entries.en: `--continue`/`--resume` now find sessions that added the current directory via `/add-dir`
entries.zh: `--continue`/`--resume` 现在能找到通过 `/add-dir` 把当前目录加入过的会话

entries.en: `/color` now syncs the session accent color to claude.ai/code when Remote Control is connected
entries.zh: Remote Control 连接时，`/color` 现在会把会话的强调色同步到 claude.ai/code

entries.en: The `/model` picker now honors `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL_NAME`/`_DESCRIPTION` overrides when using a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway
entries.zh: 使用自定义 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 网关时，`/model` 选择器现在会遵守 `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL_NAME`/`_DESCRIPTION` 覆盖设置

entries.en: When auto-update skips a plugin due to another plugin's version constraint, the skip now appears in `/doctor` and the `/plugin` Errors tab
entries.zh: 自动更新因另一插件的版本约束跳过某插件时，该跳过情况现在会显示在 `/doctor` 和 `/plugin` 的错误标签页中

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp` menu hiding OAuth Authenticate/Re-authenticate actions for servers configured with `headersHelper`, and HTTP/SSE MCP servers with custom headers being stuck in "needs authentication" after a transient 401
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp`菜单隐藏配置了`headersHelper`的服务器的 OAuth 身份验证/重新身份验证操作，以及具有自定义标头的 HTTP/SSE MCP 服务器在瞬时 401 后陷入“需要身份验证”的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers whose OAuth token response omits `expires_in` requiring re-authentication every hour
entries.zh: 修复了 OAuth 令牌响应忽略`expires_in`的 MCP 服务器，需要每小时重新进行身份验证

entries.en: Fixed MCP step-up authorization silently refreshing instead of prompting for re-consent when the server's `insufficient_scope` 403 names a scope the current token already has
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器的`insufficient_scope` 403 命名当前令牌已具有的范围时，MCP 逐步授权以静默方式刷新而不是提示重新同意的问题

entries.en: Fixed an unhandled promise rejection when an MCP server's OAuth flow times out or is cancelled
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 服务器的 OAuth 流超时或取消时未处理的承诺拒绝

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth refresh proceeding without its cross-process lock under contention
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP OAuth 刷新过程，且没有争用的跨进程锁定

entries.en: Fixed macOS keychain race where a concurrent MCP token refresh could overwrite a freshly-refreshed OAuth token, causing unexpected "Please run /login" prompts
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 钥匙串竞争，其中并发 MCP 令牌刷新可能会覆盖新刷新的 OAuth 令牌，导致意外的“请运行/登录”提示

entries.en: Fixed OAuth token refresh failing when the server revokes a token before its local expiry time
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器在本地到期时间之前撤销令牌时 OAuth 令牌刷新失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed credential save crash on Linux/Windows corrupting `~/.claude/.credentials.json`
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux/Windows 上的凭证保存崩溃损坏 `~/.claude/.credentials.json` 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/login` having no effect in a session launched with `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` — the env token is now cleared so disk credentials take effect
entries.zh: 修复了`/login`在使用`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`启动的会话中无效的问题 — env 令牌现已被清除，以便磁盘凭据生效

entries.en: Fixed unreadable text in the "new messages" scroll pill and `/plugin` badges
entries.zh: 修复"新消息"滚动提示和 `/plugin` 徽章中的文字难以辨认的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan acceptance dialog offering "auto mode" instead of "bypass permissions" when running with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--dangerously-skip-permissions`运行时提供“自动模式”而不是“绕过权限”的计划接受对话框

entries.en: Fixed agent-type hooks failing with "Messages are required for agent hooks" when configured for events other than `Stop` or `SubagentStop`
entries.zh: 修复了为`Stop`或`SubagentStop`以外的事件配置时，代理类型挂钩失败并显示“代理挂钩需要消息”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `prompt` hooks re-firing on tool calls made by an agent-hook verifier subagent
entries.zh: 修复了代理挂钩验证程序子代理发出的工具调用时重新触发“提示”挂钩的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/fork` writing the full parent conversation to disk per fork — now writes a pointer and hydrates on read
entries.zh: 修复了`/fork`将完整的父级对话写入每个 fork 的磁盘的问题 - 现在写入一个指针并在读取时进行水合

entries.en: Fixed Alt+K / Alt+X / Alt+^ / Alt+_ freezing keyboard input
entries.zh: 修复了 Alt+K / Alt+X / Alt+^ / Alt+_ 冻结键盘输入的问题

entries.en: Fixed connecting to a remote session overwriting your local `model` setting in `~/.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了连接到远程会话覆盖`~/.claude/settings.json`中的本地`model`设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed typeahead showing "No commands match" error when pasting file paths that start with `/`
entries.zh: 修复粘贴以 `/` 开头的文件路径时，类型预览显示"No commands match"错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `plugin install` on an already-installed plugin not re-resolving a dependency installed at the wrong version
entries.zh: 修复了已安装插件上的“插件安装”未重新解析以错误版本安装的依赖项

entries.en: Fixed unhandled errors from file watcher on invalid paths or fd exhaustion
entries.zh: 修复文件监视器在无效路径或文件描述符耗尽时出现未处理错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions getting archived on transient CCR initialization blips during JWT refresh
entries.zh: 修复了 JWT 刷新期间在瞬态 CCR 初始化点上存档远程控制会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents resumed via `SendMessage` not restoring the explicit `cwd` they were spawned with
entries.zh: 修复了通过`SendMessage`恢复的子代理不恢复它们生成的显式`cwd`的问题

entries.en: Forked subagents can now be enabled on external builds by setting `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1`
entries.zh: 外部构建版本现在可以通过设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1` 启用分叉子代理

entries.en: Agent frontmatter `mcpServers` are now loaded for main-thread agent sessions via `--agent`
entries.zh: 现在通过`--agent`为主线程代理会话加载代理前端`mcpServers`

entries.en: Improved `/model`: selections now persist across restarts even when the project pins a different model, and the startup header shows when the active model comes from a project or managed-settings pin
entries.zh: 改进 `/model`：即使项目固定了其他模型，选择也会在重启后保留；启动页头会显示当前模型是来自项目还是托管设置的固定

entries.en: The `/resume` command now offers to summarize stale, large sessions before re-reading them, matching the existing `--resume` behavior
entries.zh: `/resume` 命令在重新读取过时的大型会话前，现在会先提示是否要先总结，与 `--resume` 的现有行为一致

entries.en: Faster startup when both local and claude.ai MCP servers are configured (concurrent connect now default)
entries.zh: 配置本地和 claude.ai MCP 服务器时启动速度更快（现在默认为并发连接）

entries.en: `plugin install` on an already-installed plugin now installs any missing dependencies instead of stopping at "already installed"
entries.zh: 对已安装的插件执行 `plugin install` 时，现在会安装缺失的依赖，而不是停在 "already installed"

entries.en: Plugin dependency errors now say "not installed" with an install hint, and `claude plugin marketplace add` now auto-resolves missing dependencies from configured marketplaces
entries.zh: 插件依赖错误现在会显示「未安装」并附带安装提示；`claude plugin marketplace add` 现在会从已配置的市场自动解析缺失的依赖

entries.en: Managed-settings `blockedMarketplaces` and `strictKnownMarketplaces` are now enforced on plugin install, update, refresh, and autoupdate
entries.zh: 托管设置中的 `blockedMarketplaces` 和 `strictKnownMarketplaces` 现在会在插件安装、更新、刷新和自动更新时强制执行

entries.en: Advisor Tool (experimental): dialog now carries an "experimental" label, learn-more link, and startup notification when enabled; sessions no longer get stuck with "Advisor tool result content could not be processed" errors on every prompt and `/compact`
entries.zh: Advisor Tool（实验性）：对话框现在带有“实验性”标签、了解更多链接以及启用时的启动通知；会话不再在每个提示和`/compact`上陷入“无法处理顾问工具结果内容”错误

entries.en: The `cleanupPeriodDays` retention sweep now also covers `~/.claude/tasks/`, `~/.claude/shell-snapshots/`, and `~/.claude/backups/`
entries.zh: `cleanupPeriodDays` 的保留清理现在也覆盖 `~/.claude/tasks/`、`~/.claude/shell-snapshots/` 和 `~/.claude/backups/`

entries.en: OpenTelemetry: `user_prompt` events now include `command_name` and `command_source` for slash commands; `cost.usage`, `token.usage`, `api_request`, and `api_error` now include an `effort` attribute when the model supports effort levels. Custom/MCP command names are redacted unless `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` is set
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry：`user_prompt` 事件对斜杠命令新增 `command_name` 和 `command_source`；当模型支持 effort 级别时，`cost.usage`、`token.usage`、`api_request` 和 `api_error` 新增 `effort` 属性。除非设置 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`，否则自定义或 MCP 命令名会被脱敏

entries.en: Native builds on macOS and Linux: the `Glob` and `Grep` tools are replaced by embedded `bfs` and `ugrep` available through the Bash tool — faster searches without a separate tool round-trip (Windows and npm-installed builds unchanged)
entries.zh: macOS 和 Linux 原生构建版：`Glob` 和 `Grep` 工具被内置的 `bfs` 和 `ugrep` 取代，通过 Bash 工具即可使用，搜索更快，且无需额外的工具往返（Windows 和 npm 安装版不变）

entries.en: Windows: cached `where.exe` executable lookups per process for faster subprocess launches
entries.zh: Windows：每个进程缓存 `where.exe` 的可执行文件查找结果，子进程启动更快

entries.en: Default effort for Pro/Max subscribers on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 is now `high` (was `medium`)
entries.zh: Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 上 Pro/Max 订阅者的默认努力现在为“高”（原为“中”）

entries.en: Fixed Plain-CLI OAuth sessions dying with "Please run /login" when the access token expires mid-session — the token is now refreshed reactively on 401
entries.zh: 修复了当访问令牌在会话中过期时，Plain-CLI OAuth 会话因“请运行/登录”而终止的问题 — 令牌现在会在 401 上响应式刷新

entries.en: Fixed `WebFetch` hanging on very large HTML pages by truncating input before HTML-to-markdown conversion
entries.zh: 通过在 HTML 到 Markdown 转换之前截断输入，修复了挂在非常大的 HTML 页面上的`WebFetch`

entries.en: Fixed a crash when a proxy returns HTTP 204 No Content — now surfaces a clear error instead of a `TypeError`
entries.zh: 修复了代理返回 HTTP 204 No Content 时发生的崩溃 — 现在显示一个明显的错误，而不是`TypeError`

entries.en: Fixed `/login` having no effect when launched with `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` env var and that token expires
entries.zh: 修复了使用`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`环境变量启动且该令牌过期时`/login`无效的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt-input undo (`Ctrl+_`) doing nothing immediately after typing, and skipping a state on each undo step
entries.zh: 修复了提示输入撤消（`Ctrl+_`）在键入后立即不执行任何操作，并在每个撤消步骤中跳过状态

entries.en: Fixed `NO_PROXY` not being respected for remote API requests when running under Bun
entries.zh: 修复了在 Bun 下运行时远程 API 请求不遵守`NO_PROXY`的问题

entries.en: Fixed rare spurious escape/return triggers when key names arrive as coalesced text over slow connections
entries.zh: 修复了当键名称通过慢速连接作为合并文本到达时罕见的虚假转义/返回触发器

entries.en: Fixed SDK `reload_plugins` reconnecting all user MCP servers serially
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK`reload_plugins`串行重新连接所有用户 MCP 服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock application-inference-profile requests failing with 400 when backed by Opus 4.7 with thinking disabled
entries.zh: 修复了由 Opus 4.7 支持且禁用思考时的 Bedrock 应用程序推理配置文件请求失败并显示 400

entries.en: Fixed MCP `elicitation/create` requests auto-cancelling in print/SDK mode when the server finishes connecting mid-turn
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器中途完成连接时，MCP“诱导/创建”请求在打印/SDK 模式下自动取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents running a different model than the main agent incorrectly flagging file reads with a malware warning
entries.zh: 修复了运行与主代理不同模型的子代理错误地标记文件读取并带有恶意软件警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed idle re-render loop when background tasks are present, reducing memory growth on Linux
entries.zh: 修复了存在后台任务时的空闲重新渲染循环，减少了 Linux 上的内存增长

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Manage Plugins" panel breaking when multiple large marketplaces are configured
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复配置了多个大型插件市场时，"Manage Plugins" 面板崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed Opus 4.7 sessions showing inflated `/context` percentages and autocompacting too early — Claude Code was computing against a 200K context window instead of Opus 4.7's native 1M
entries.zh: 修复了 Opus 4.7 会话显示膨胀的`/context`百分比和过早自动压缩的问题 - Claude Code 是针对 200K 上下文窗口而不是 Opus 4.7 的原生 1M 进行计算

entries.en: `/resume` on large sessions is significantly faster (up to 67% on 40MB+ sessions) and handles sessions with many dead-fork entries more efficiently
entries.zh: 大型会话的 `/resume` 明显更快（40MB 以上的会话最多快 67%），并且能更高效地处理包含大量失效分叉记录的会话

entries.en: Faster MCP startup when multiple stdio servers are configured; `resources/templates/list` is now deferred to first `@`-mention
entries.zh: 配置多个 stdio 服务器时 MCP 启动速度更快； `resources/templates/list` 现在推迟到第一个 `@` 提及

entries.en: Smoother fullscreen scrolling in VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf terminals — `/terminal-setup` now configures the editor's scroll sensitivity
entries.zh: VS Code、Cursor 和 Windsurf 终端中全屏滚动更顺滑；`/terminal-setup` 现在会配置编辑器的滚动灵敏度

entries.en: Thinking spinner now shows progress inline ("still thinking", "thinking more", "almost done thinking"), replacing the separate hint row
entries.zh: 思考时的加载动画现在在行内显示进度（"still thinking"、"thinking more"、"almost done thinking"），取代了单独的提示行

entries.en: `/config` search now matches option values (e.g. searching "vim" finds the Editor mode setting)
entries.zh: `/config` 搜索现在会匹配选项的值（例如搜索 "vim" 可找到 Editor mode 设置）

entries.en: `/doctor` can now be opened while Claude is responding, without waiting for the current turn to finish
entries.zh: Claude 回复时也可以打开 `/doctor`，无需等待当前轮次结束

entries.en: `/reload-plugins` and background plugin auto-update now auto-install missing plugin dependencies from marketplaces you've already added
entries.zh: `/reload-plugins` 和后台插件自动更新，现在会从你已添加的市场中自动安装缺失的插件依赖

entries.en: Bash tool now surfaces a hint when `gh` commands hit GitHub's API rate limit, so agents can back off instead of retrying
entries.zh: 现在，当`gh`命令达到 GitHub 的 API 速率限制时，Bash 工具会显示提示，因此代理可以后退而不是重试

entries.en: The Usage tab in Settings now shows your 5-hour and weekly usage immediately and no longer fails when the usage endpoint is rate-limited
entries.zh: 设置中的 Usage 标签页现在会立即显示 5 小时和每周用量，且在用量接口被限流时不再报错

entries.en: Agent frontmatter `hooks:` now fire when running as a main-thread agent via `--agent`
entries.zh: 现在，通过`--agent`作为主线程代理运行时，代理 frontmatter`hooks:`会触发

entries.en: Slash command menu now shows "No commands match" when your filter has zero results, instead of disappearing
entries.zh: 筛选结果为零时，斜杠命令菜单显示 "No commands match"，而不再直接消失

entries.en: Security: sandbox auto-allow no longer bypasses the dangerous-path safety check for `rm`/`rmdir` targeting `/`, `$HOME`, or other critical system directories
entries.zh: 安全：沙箱自动允许不再绕过对 `rm`/`rmdir` 删除 `/`、`$HOME` 或其他关键系统目录的危险路径检查

entries.en: Claude Code and installer now use `https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases` instead of `https://storage.googleapis.com/claude-code-dist-86c565f3-f756-42ad-8dfa-d59b1c096819/claude-code-releases`
entries.zh: Claude Code 和安装程序现在使用`https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases`，而不是`https://storage.googleapis.com/claude-code-dist-86c565f3-f756-42ad-8dfa-d59b1c096819/claude-code-releases`

entries.en: Fixed Devanagari and other Indic scripts rendering with broken column alignment in the terminal UI
entries.zh: 修复了天城文和其他印度文脚本在终端 UI 中呈现的列对齐方式损坏的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+- not triggering undo in terminals using the Kitty keyboard protocol (iTerm2, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, Windows Terminal)
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+- 在使用 Kitty 键盘协议的终端（iTerm2、Ghostty、kitty、WezTerm、Windows 终端）中不触发撤消的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cmd+Left/Right not jumping to line start/end in terminals that use the Kitty keyboard protocol (Warp fullscreen, kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm)
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Kitty 键盘协议（Warp 全屏、kitty、Ghostty、WezTerm）的终端中 Cmd+Left/Right 不跳转到行开始/结束的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+Z hanging the terminal when Claude Code is launched via a wrapper process (e.g. `npx`, `bun run`)
entries.zh: 修复了当通过包装进程启动 Claude Code 时 Ctrl+Z 挂起终端的问题（例如`npx`、`bun run`）

entries.en: Fixed scrollback duplication in inline mode where resizing the terminal or large output bursts would repeat earlier conversation history
entries.zh: 修复了内联模式下的回滚重复问题，其中调整终端大小或大输出突发会重复早期的对话历史记录

entries.en: Fixed modal search dialogs overflowing the screen at short terminal heights, hiding the search box and keyboard hints
entries.zh: 修复了模式搜索对话框在终端高度较短时溢出屏幕、隐藏搜索框和键盘提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed scattered blank cells and disappearing composer chrome in the VS Code integrated terminal during scrolling
entries.zh: 修复了滚动期间 VS Code 集成终端中分散的空白单元格和消失的 Composer chrome

entries.en: Fixed an intermittent API 400 error related to cache control TTL ordering that could occur when a parallel request completed during request setup
entries.zh: 修复了与缓存控制 TTL 排序相关的间歇性 API 400 错误，该错误可能在请求设置期间完成并行请求时发生

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` rejecting conversations with transcripts larger than 50MB
entries.zh: 修复了`/branch`拒绝对话文本大于 50MB 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` silently showing an empty conversation on large session files instead of reporting the load error
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`在大型会话文件上静默显示空对话而不是报告加载错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Installed tab showing the same item twice when it appears under Needs attention or Favorites
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`已安装选项卡在同一项目出现在“需要注意”或“收藏夹”下时显示两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/update` and `/tui` not working after entering a worktree mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了`/update`和`/tui`在进入工作树中间会话后不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash in the permission dialog when an agent teams teammate requested tool permission
entries.zh: 修复了当代理团队队友请求工具权限时权限对话框中的崩溃

entries.en: Changed the CLI to spawn a native Claude Code binary (via a per-platform optional dependency) instead of bundled JavaScript
entries.zh: 更改了 CLI 以生成本机 Claude Code 二进制文件（通过每个平台的可选依赖项）而不是捆绑的 JavaScript

entries.en: Added `sandbox.network.deniedDomains` setting to block specific domains even when a broader `allowedDomains` wildcard would otherwise permit them
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.network.deniedDomains`设置以阻止特定域，即使更广泛的`allowedDomains`通配符允许它们

entries.en: Fullscreen mode: Shift+↑/↓ now scrolls the viewport when extending a selection past the visible edge
entries.zh: 全屏模式：扩展选区超出可见边缘时，Shift+↑/↓ 现在会滚动视口

entries.en: `Ctrl+A` and `Ctrl+E` now move to the start/end of the current logical line in multiline input, matching readline behavior
entries.zh: 多行输入中，`Ctrl+A` 和 `Ctrl+E` 现在会移动到当前逻辑行的开头/结尾，与 readline 的行为一致

entries.en: Windows: `Ctrl+Backspace` now deletes the previous word
entries.zh: Windows：`Ctrl+Backspace` 现在会删除前一个单词

entries.en: Long URLs in responses and bash output stay clickable when they wrap across lines (in terminals with OSC 8 hyperlinks)
entries.zh: 回复和 bash 输出中的长 URL 即使换行后也保持可点击（需要终端支持 OSC 8 超链接）

entries.en: Improved `/loop`: pressing Esc now cancels pending wakeups, and wakeups display as "Claude resuming /loop wakeup" for clarity
entries.zh: 改进 `/loop`：按 Esc 可取消待执行的唤醒；唤醒显示为“Claude resuming /loop wakeup”，更清楚

entries.en: `/extra-usage` now works from Remote Control (mobile/web) clients
entries.zh: `/extra-usage` 现在可在 Remote Control（手机/网页）客户端中使用

entries.en: Remote Control clients can now query `@`-file autocomplete suggestions
entries.zh: Remote Control 客户端现在可以查询 `@` 文件自动补全的建议

entries.en: Improved `/ultrareview`: faster launch with parallelized checks, diffstat in the launch dialog, and animated launching state
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview`：检查并行化，启动更快；启动对话框显示差异统计，并有启动中的动画

entries.en: Subagents that stall mid-stream now fail with a clear error after 10 minutes instead of hanging silently
entries.zh: 子代理如果在流式输出中途卡住，现在会在 10 分钟后报出清晰的错误，而不是无声挂起

entries.en: Bash tool: multi-line commands whose first line is a comment now show the full command in the transcript, closing a UI-spoofing vector
entries.zh: Bash 工具：第一行是注释的多行命令现在显示记录中的完整命令，从而关闭 UI 欺骗向量

entries.en: Running `cd <current-directory> && git …` no longer triggers a permission prompt when the `cd` is a no-op
entries.zh: 当 `cd` 是空操作时，`cd <当前目录> && git …` 不再触发权限提示

entries.en: Security: on macOS, `/private/{etc,var,tmp,home}` paths are now treated as dangerous removal targets under `Bash(rm:*)` allow rules
entries.zh: 安全（macOS）：在 `Bash(rm:*)` 允许规则下，`/private/{etc,var,tmp,home}` 路径现在被视为危险的删除目标

entries.en: Security: Bash deny rules now match commands wrapped in `env`/`sudo`/`watch`/`ionice`/`setsid` and similar exec wrappers
entries.zh: 安全：Bash 拒绝规则现在可匹配被 `env`/`sudo`/`watch`/`ionice`/`setsid` 等执行包装器包裹的命令

entries.en: Security: `Bash(find:*)` allow rules no longer auto-approve `find -exec`/`-delete`
entries.zh: 安全：`Bash(find:*)` 允许规则不再自动批准 `find -exec`/`-delete`

entries.en: Fixed MCP concurrent-call timeout handling where a message for one tool call could silently disarm another call's watchdog
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 并发调用超时处理，其中一个工具调用的消息可能会静默解除另一个调用的看门狗

entries.en: Fixed Cmd-backspace / `Ctrl+U` to once again delete from the cursor to the start of the line
entries.zh: 修复了 Cmd-backspace / `Ctrl+U` 以再次从光标删除到行首

entries.en: Fixed markdown tables breaking when a cell contains an inline code span with a pipe character
entries.zh: 修复了当单元格包含带竖线字符的内联代码范围时 Markdown 表中断的问题

entries.en: Fixed session recap auto-firing while composing unsent text in the prompt
entries.zh: 修复了在提示中撰写未发送文本时自动触发会话回顾的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/copy` "Full response" not aligning markdown table columns for pasting into GitHub, Notion, or Slack
entries.zh: 修复了`/copy`“完整响应”未对齐 Markdown 表列以粘贴到 GitHub、Notion 或 Slack 的问题

entries.en: Fixed messages typed while viewing a running subagent being hidden from its transcript and misattributed to the parent AI
entries.zh: 修复了查看正在运行的子代理时键入的消息被隐藏在其记录中并被错误归因于父 AI 的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` running commands outside the sandbox without a permission prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` 在没有权限提示的情况下在沙箱外运行命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/effort auto` confirmation — now says "Effort level set to max" to match the status bar label
entries.zh: 修复了`/effort auto`确认 - 现在显示“Effort level set to max”以匹配状态栏标签

entries.en: Fixed the "copied N chars" toast overcounting emoji and other multi-code-unit characters
entries.zh: 修复了“复制 N 个字符”toast 过多计算表情符号和其他多代码单元字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/insights` crashing with `EBUSY` on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上`/insights`因`EBUSY`而崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed exit confirmation dialog mislabeling one-shot scheduled tasks as recurring — now shows a countdown
entries.zh: 修复了退出确认对话框将一次性计划任务错误标记为重复任务 - 现在显示倒计时

entries.en: Fixed slash/@ completion menu not sitting flush against the prompt border in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了斜杠/@完成菜单在全屏模式下未与提示边框齐平的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` `output_config.effort` causing 400 errors on subagent calls to models that don't support effort and on Vertex AI
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY``output_config.effort`在对不支持工作量的模型和 Vertex AI 上的子代理调用时导致 400 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt cursor disappearing when `NO_COLOR` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`NO_COLOR`时提示光标消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `ToolSearch` ranking so pasted MCP tool names surface the actual tool instead of description-matching siblings
entries.zh: 修复了`ToolSearch`排名，以便粘贴的 MCP 工具名称显示实际工具而不是描述匹配的同级工具

entries.en: Fixed compacting a resumed long-context session failing with "Extra usage is required for long context requests"
entries.zh: 修复了压缩已恢复的长上下文会话失败并显示“长上下文请求需要额外使用”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `plugin install` succeeding when a dependency version conflicts with an already-installed plugin — now reports `range-conflict`
entries.zh: 修复了当依赖项版本与已安装的插件冲突时“插件安装”成功的问题 - 现在报告“范围冲突”

entries.en: Fixed "Refine with Ultraplan" not showing the remote session URL in the transcript
entries.zh: 修复了“Refine with Ultraplan”在记录中不显示远程会话 URL 的问题

entries.en: Fixed SDK image content blocks that fail to process crashing the session — now degrade to a text placeholder
entries.zh: 修复了无法处理导致会话崩溃的 SDK 图像内容块 — 现在降级为文本占位符

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions not streaming subagent transcripts
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话不传输子代理记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions not being archived when Claude Code exits
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Code 退出时远程控制会话未存档的问题

entries.en: Fixed `thinking.type.enabled is not supported` 400 error when using Opus 4.7 via a Bedrock Application Inference Profile ARN
entries.zh: 修复了通过 Bedrock 应用程序推理配置文件 ARN 使用 Opus 4.7 时出现的“不支持thinking.type.enabled”400 错误

entries.en: Fixed "claude-opus-4-7 is temporarily unavailable" for auto mode
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式的“claude-opus-4-7 暂时不可用”

entries.en: Claude Opus 4.7 xhigh is now available! Use /effort to tune speed vs. intelligence
entries.zh: Claude Opus 4.7 xhigh 现已上市！使用/努力来调整速度与智力

entries.en: Auto mode is now available for Max subscribers when using Opus 4.7
entries.zh: 使用 Opus 4.7 时，自动模式现在可供最大订阅者使用

entries.en: Added `xhigh` effort level for Opus 4.7, sitting between `high` and `max`. Available via `/effort`, `--effort`, and the model picker; other models fall back to `high`
entries.zh: 为 Opus 4.7 添加了`xhigh`努力级别，位于`high`和`max`之间。通过`/effort`、`--effort`和模型选择器可用；其他型号回落至“高位”

entries.en: `/effort` now opens an interactive slider when called without arguments, with arrow-key navigation between levels and Enter to confirm
entries.zh: 不带参数调用 `/effort` 时，现在会打开交互式滑块，可用方向键切换级别、按 Enter 确认

entries.en: Added "Auto (match terminal)" theme option that matches your terminal's dark/light mode — select it from `/theme`
entries.zh: 添加了与您的终端的暗/亮模式相匹配的“自动（匹配终端）”主题选项 - 从`/theme`中选择它

entries.en: Added `/less-permission-prompts` skill — scans transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls and proposes a prioritized allowlist for `.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: 添加了`/less-permission-prompts`技能 - 扫描常见只读 Bash 和 MCP 工具调用的记录，并为`.claude/settings.json`提出优先允许列表

entries.en: Added `/ultrareview` for running comprehensive code review in the cloud using parallel multi-agent analysis and critique — invoke with no arguments to review your current branch, or `/ultrareview <PR#>` to fetch and review a specific GitHub PR
entries.zh: 添加了`/ultrareview`，用于使用并行多代理分析和评论在云中运行全面的代码审查 - 不带参数调用来审查当前分支，或`/ultrareview <PR#>`来获取和审查特定的 GitHub PR

entries.en: Auto mode no longer requires `--enable-auto-mode`
entries.zh: 自动模式不再需要`--enable-auto-mode`

entries.en: Windows: PowerShell tool is progressively rolling out. Opt in or out with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL`. On Linux and macOS, enable with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=1` (requires `pwsh` on PATH)
entries.zh: Windows：PowerShell 工具正在逐步推出。可用 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL` 选择开启或关闭。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，用 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=1` 开启（需要 PATH 中有 `pwsh`）

entries.en: Read-only bash commands with glob patterns (e.g. `ls *.ts`) and commands starting with `cd <project-dir> &&` no longer trigger a permission prompt
entries.zh: 带通配符的只读 bash 命令（如 `ls *.ts`），以及以 `cd <项目目录> &&` 开头的命令，不再触发权限提示

entries.en: Suggest the closest matching subcommand when `claude <word>` is invoked with a near-miss typo (e.g. `claude udpate` → "Did you mean `claude update`?")
entries.zh: 执行 `claude <词>` 时如果拼错，现在会提示最接近的子命令（例如 `claude udpate` → "Did you mean `claude update`?"）

entries.en: Plan files are now named after your prompt (e.g. `fix-auth-race-snug-otter.md`) instead of purely random words
entries.zh: 计划文件现在以你的提示命名（如 `fix-auth-race-snug-otter.md`），而不再完全使用随机词

entries.en: Improved `/setup-vertex` and `/setup-bedrock` to show the actual `settings.json` path when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set, seed model candidates from existing pins on re-run, and offer a "with 1M context" option for supported models
entries.zh: 改进 `/setup-vertex` 和 `/setup-bedrock`：设置了 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 时显示实际的 `settings.json` 路径；重新运行时以已有的固定模型作为候选；对支持的模型提供“1M 上下文”选项

entries.en: `/skills` menu now supports sorting by estimated token count — press `t` to toggle
entries.zh: `/skills` 菜单现在支持按估算的 token 数排序，按 `t` 切换

entries.en: `Ctrl+U` now clears the entire input buffer (previously: delete to start of line); press `Ctrl+Y` to restore
entries.zh: `Ctrl+U` 现在会清空整个输入缓冲区（此前是删到行首）；按 `Ctrl+Y` 可恢复

entries.en: `Ctrl+L` now forces a full screen redraw in addition to clearing the prompt input
entries.zh: `Ctrl+L` 现在除了清空提示输入外，还会强制整个屏幕重绘

entries.en: Transcript view footer now shows `[` (dump to scrollback) and `v` (open in editor) shortcuts
entries.zh: 转录视图的底部现在显示 `[`（输出到回滚缓冲区）和 `v`（在编辑器中打开）快捷键

entries.en: The "+N lines" marker for truncated long pastes is now a full-width rule for easier scanning
entries.zh: 长粘贴被截断时的 "+N lines" 标记改为全宽分隔线，更容易扫读

entries.en: Headless `--output-format stream-json` now includes `plugin_errors` on the init event when plugins are demoted for unsatisfied dependencies
entries.zh: 无界面模式 `--output-format stream-json` 的 init 事件中，插件因依赖不满足被降级时，现在会包含 `plugin_errors`

entries.en: Added `OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES` environment variable to emit full API request and response bodies as OpenTelemetry log events for debugging
entries.zh: 添加了`OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES`环境变量，以将完整的 API 请求和响应正文作为 OpenTelemetry 日志事件发出以进行调试

entries.en: Suppressed spurious decompression, network, and transient error messages that could appear in the TUI during normal operation
entries.zh: 隐藏正常运行时终端界面中偶尔出现的解压、网络和临时错误提示

entries.en: Reverted the v2.1.110 cap on non-streaming fallback retries — it traded long waits for more outright failures during API overload
entries.zh: 撤销了 v2.1.110 中对非流式回退重试次数的上限：它在 API 过载时以更长的等待换来了更多直接失败，弊大于利

entries.en: Fixed terminal display tearing (random characters, drifting input) in iTerm2 + tmux setups when terminal notifications are sent
entries.zh: 修复在 iTerm2 + tmux 环境下发送终端通知时，终端显示撕裂（随机字符、输入漂移）的问题

entries.en: Fixed `@` file suggestions re-scanning the entire project on every turn in non-git working directories, and showing only config files in freshly-initialized git repos with no tracked files
entries.zh: 修复了`@`文件建议，每次在非 git 工作目录中重新扫描整个项目，并仅显示新初始化的 git 存储库中的配置文件，而没有跟踪文件

entries.en: Fixed LSP diagnostics from before an edit appearing after it, causing the model to re-read files it just edited
entries.zh: 修复了编辑之前出现的 LSP 诊断，导致模型重新读取刚刚编辑的文件

entries.en: Fixed tab-completing `/resume` immediately resuming an arbitrary titled session instead of showing the session picker
entries.zh: 修复 Tab 补全 `/resume` 时直接恢复了某个随机命名的会话，而不是显示会话选择器的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/context` grid rendering with extra blank lines between rows
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`网格渲染，行之间有额外的空白行

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` dropping the session name set by `/rename`, causing statusline output to lose `session_name`
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`删除`/rename`设置的会话名称，导致状态行输出丢失`session_name`的问题

entries.en: Improved plugin error handling: dependency errors now distinguish conflicting, invalid, and overly complex version requirements; fixed stale resolved versions after `plugin update`; `plugin install` now recovers from interrupted prior installs
entries.zh: 改进插件错误处理：依赖错误现在能区分冲突、无效和过于复杂的版本要求；修复了 `plugin update` 后残留的旧版本号问题；`plugin install` 现在能从之前中断的安装中恢复

entries.en: Fixed Claude calling a non-existent `commit` skill and showing "Unknown skill: commit" for users without a custom `/commit` command
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德调用不存在的`commit`技能并为没有自定义`/commit`命令的用户显示“未知技能：提交”的问题

entries.en: Fixed 429 rate-limit errors on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry referencing status.claude.com (it only covers Anthropic-operated providers)
entries.zh: 修复了引用 status.claude.com 的 Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry 上的 429 个速率限制错误（仅涵盖 Anthropic 运营的提供商）

entries.en: Fixed feedback surveys appearing back-to-back after dismissing one
entries.zh: 修正了反馈调查在驳回后连续出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed bare URLs in bash/PowerShell/MCP tool output being unclickable when the terminal wraps them across lines
entries.zh: 修复了终端将 bash/PowerShell/MCP 工具输出中的裸 URL 换行时无法单击的问题

entries.en: Windows: `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` and SessionStart hook environment files now apply (previously a no-op)
entries.zh: Windows：`CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` 和 SessionStart 钩子的环境文件现在会生效（之前没有作用）

entries.en: Windows: permission rules with drive-letter paths are now correctly root-anchored, and paths differing only by drive-letter case are recognized as the same path
entries.zh: Windows：带盘符的路径权限规则现在正确以根目录为锚点，仅盘符大小写不同的路径被识别为同一路径

entries.en: Added `/tui` command and `tui` setting — run `/tui fullscreen` to switch to flicker-free rendering in the same conversation
entries.zh: 添加了`/tui`命令和`tui`设置 - 运行`/tui fullscreen`以在同一对话中切换到无闪烁渲染

entries.en: Added push notification tool — Claude can send mobile push notifications when Remote Control and "Push when Claude decides" config are enabled
entries.zh: 添加了推送通知工具 - 当启用远程控制和“克劳德决定时推送”配置时，克劳德可以发送移动推送通知

entries.en: Changed `Ctrl+O` to toggle between normal and verbose transcript only; focus view is now toggled separately with the new `/focus` command
entries.zh: 更改了`Ctrl+O`以仅在正常和详细记录之间切换；现在可以使用新的`/focus`命令单独切换焦点视图

entries.en: Added `autoScrollEnabled` config to disable conversation auto-scroll in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 添加了`autoScrollEnabled`配置以禁用全屏模式下的对话自动滚动

entries.en: Added option to show Claude's last response as commented context in the `Ctrl+G` external editor (enable via `/config`)
entries.zh: 添加了在`Ctrl+G`外部编辑器中将克劳德的最后响应显示为注释上下文的选项（通过`/config`启用）

entries.en: Improved `/plugin` Installed tab — items needing attention and favorites appear at the top, disabled items are hidden behind a fold, and `f` favorites the selected item
entries.zh: 改进 `/plugin` 的“Installed”标签页：需要注意的项和收藏项置顶，已禁用的项收进折叠区；按 `f` 可收藏所选项

entries.en: Improved `/doctor` to warn when an MCP server is defined in multiple config scopes with different endpoints
entries.zh: 改进 `/doctor`：同一个 MCP 服务器在多个配置范围中定义且端点不同时，会给出警告

entries.en: `--resume`/`--continue` now resurrects unexpired scheduled tasks
entries.zh: `--resume`/`--continue` 现在会恢复尚未过期的定时任务

entries.en: `/context`, `/exit`, and `/reload-plugins` now work from Remote Control (mobile/web) clients
entries.zh: `/context`、`/exit` 和 `/reload-plugins` 现在可在 Remote Control（手机/网页）客户端中使用

entries.en: Write tool now informs the model when you edit the proposed content in the IDE diff before accepting
entries.zh: Write 工具现在会在你接受前、于 IDE 差异视图中修改了提议内容时，告知模型

entries.en: Bash tool now enforces the documented maximum timeout instead of accepting arbitrarily large values
entries.zh: Bash 工具现在强制执行记录的最大超时，而不是接受任意大的值

entries.en: SDK/headless sessions now read `TRACEPARENT`/`TRACESTATE` from the environment for distributed trace linking
entries.zh: SDK 和无界面会话现在会从环境变量中读取 `TRACEPARENT`/`TRACESTATE`，用于分布式追踪关联

entries.en: Session recap is now enabled for users with telemetry disabled (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`). Opt out via `/config` or `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY=0`.
entries.zh: 现在为禁用了遥测的用户（Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry，或设置了 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`）启用会话回顾。可在 `/config` 或通过 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY=0` 关闭

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls hanging indefinitely when the server connection drops mid-response on SSE/HTTP transports
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器连接在 SSE/HTTP 传输上响应中途中断时 MCP 工具调用无限期挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed non-streaming fallback retries causing multi-minute hangs when the API is unreachable
entries.zh: 修复了当 API 无法访问时非流回退重试导致多分钟挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed session recap, local slash-command output, and other system status lines not appearing in focus mode
entries.zh: 修复了会话回顾、本地斜杠命令输出和其他系统状态行在焦点模式下不出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed high CPU usage in fullscreen when text is selected while a tool is running
entries.zh: 修复了在工具运行时选择文本时全屏 CPU 使用率较高的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin install not honoring dependencies declared in `plugin.json` when the marketplace entry omits them; `/plugin` install now lists auto-installed dependencies
entries.zh: 修复了当市场条目忽略`plugin.json`中声明的依赖项时插件安装不遵守的问题； `/plugin` install 现在列出自动安装的依赖项

entries.en: Fixed skills with `disable-model-invocation: true` failing when invoked via `/<skill>` mid-message
entries.zh: 修复了通过`/<skill>`消息中调用时“disable-model-inspiration: true”的技能失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` sometimes showing the first prompt instead of the `/rename` name for sessions still running or exited uncleanly
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`有时会显示第一个提示，而不是仍在运行或不正常退出的会话的`/rename`名称

entries.en: Fixed queued messages briefly appearing twice during multi-tool-call turns
entries.zh: 修复了多工具调用期间排队消息短暂出现两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed session cleanup not removing the full session directory including subagent transcripts
entries.zh: 修复了会话清理不会删除完整会话目录（包括子代理记录）的问题

entries.en: Fixed dropped keystrokes after the CLI relaunches (e.g. `/tui`, provider setup wizards)
entries.zh: 修复了 CLI 重新启动后按键丢失的问题（例如 `/tui`、提供程序设置向导）

entries.en: Fixed garbled startup rendering in macOS Terminal.app and other terminals that don't support synchronized output
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS Terminal.app 和其他不支持同步输出的终端中的乱码启动渲染

entries.en: Hardened "Open in editor" actions against command injection from untrusted filenames
entries.zh: 加固“在编辑器中打开”功能，防止不可信文件名引发命令注入

entries.en: Fixed `PermissionRequest` hooks returning `updatedInput` not being re-checked against `permissions.deny` rules; `setMode:'bypassPermissions'` updates now respect `disableBypassPermissionsMode`
entries.zh: 修复了返回`updatedInput`的`PermissionRequest`挂钩未根据`permissions.deny`规则重新检查的问题； `setMode:'bypassPermissions'` 更新现在遵循 `disableBypassPermissionsMode`

entries.en: Fixed `PreToolUse` hook `additionalContext` being dropped when the tool call fails
entries.zh: 修复了工具调用失败时删除`PreToolUse`挂钩`additionalContext`的问题

entries.en: Fixed stdio MCP servers that print stray non-JSON lines to stdout being disconnected on the first stray line (regression in 2.1.105)
entries.zh: 修复了将杂散非 JSON 行打印到 stdout 的 stdio MCP 服务器在第一个杂散行上断开连接的问题（2.1.105 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed headless/SDK session auto-title firing an extra Haiku request when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` is set
entries.zh: 修复了当设置`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`或`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE`时无头/SDK 会话自动标题触发额外俳句请求的问题

entries.en: Fixed potential excessive memory allocation when piped (non-TTY) Ink output contains a single very wide line
entries.zh: 修复了管道（非 TTY）墨水输出包含单个非常宽的行时潜在的过多内存分配

entries.en: Fixed `/skills` menu not scrolling when the list overflows the modal in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下列表溢出模式时`/skills`菜单不滚动的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions showing a generic error instead of prompting for re-login when the session is too old
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话在会话太旧时显示一般错误而不是提示重新登录的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control session renames from claude.ai not persisting the title to the local CLI session
entries.zh: 修复了 claude.ai 的远程控制会话重命名未将标题保留到本地 CLI 会话的问题

entries.en: Improved the extended-thinking indicator with a rotating progress hint
entries.zh: 改进扩展思考指示器：增加了轮换显示的进度提示

entries.en: Added `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H` env var to opt into 1-hour prompt cache TTL on API key, Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry (`ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H_BEDROCK` is deprecated but still honored), and `FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M` to force 5-minute TTL
entries.zh: 添加了`ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H`环境变量以选择在 API 密钥、Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上选择 1 小时提示缓存 TTL（`ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H_BEDROCK`已弃用，但仍受尊重），以及`FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M`以强制使用 5 分钟 TTL

entries.en: Added recap feature to provide context when returning to a session, configurable in `/config` and manually invocable with `/recap`; force with `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY` if telemetry disabled.
entries.zh: 添加了回顾功能，以在返回会话时提供上下文，可在`/config`中配置并使用`/recap`手动调用；如果遥测禁用，则强制使用`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY`。

entries.en: The model can now discover and invoke built-in slash commands like `/init`, `/review`, and `/security-review` via the Skill tool
entries.zh: 模型现在可以通过 Skill 工具发现并调用内置斜杠命令，如 `/init`、`/review` 和 `/security-review`

entries.en: `/undo` is now an alias for `/rewind`
entries.zh: `/undo` 现在是 `/rewind` 的别名

entries.en: Improved `/model` to warn before switching models mid-conversation, since the next response re-reads the full history uncached
entries.zh: 改进 `/model`：对话中途切换模型前会提醒你，因为下一条回复会完整重新读取历史且无法使用缓存

entries.en: Improved `/resume` picker to default to sessions from the current directory; press `Ctrl+A` to show all projects
entries.zh: 改进 `/resume` 选择器：默认显示当前目录的会话，按 `Ctrl+A` 可显示所有项目

entries.en: Improved error messages: server rate limits are now distinguished from plan usage limits; 5xx/529 errors show a link to status.claude.com; unknown slash commands suggest the closest match
entries.zh: 改进错误提示：服务器限流与套餐用量上限分开显示；5xx/529 错误附上 status.claude.com 状态页链接；未知斜杠命令会建议最接近的命令

entries.en: Reduced memory footprint for file reads, edits, and syntax highlighting by loading language grammars on demand
entries.zh: 通过按需加载语言语法，文件读取、编辑和语法高亮的内存占用降低

entries.en: Added "verbose" indicator when viewing the detailed transcript (`Ctrl+O`)
entries.zh: 查看详细记录时添加了“详细”指示符（`Ctrl+O`）

entries.en: Added a warning at startup when prompt caching is disabled via `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING*` environment variables
entries.zh: 当通过`DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING*`环境变量禁用提示缓存时，在启动时添加了警告

entries.en: Fixed paste not working in the `/login` code prompt (regression in 2.1.105)
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴在`/login`代码提示中不起作用的问题（2.1.105 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed subscribers who set `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` falling back to 5-minute prompt cache TTL instead of 1 hour
entries.zh: 修复了设置`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`的订阅者回退到 5 分钟提示缓存 TTL（而不是 1 小时）的问题

entries.en: Fixed Agent tool prompting for permission in auto mode when the safety classifier's transcript exceeded its context window
entries.zh: 修复了当安全分类器的记录超出其上下文窗口时，代理工具在自动模式下提示许可的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool producing no output when `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` (e.g. `~/.zprofile`) ends with a `#` comment line
entries.zh: 修复了当`CLAUDE_ENV_FILE`（例如`~/.zprofile`）以`#`注释行结尾时 Bash 工具不产生输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --resume <session-id>` losing the session's custom name and color set via `/rename`
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --resume <session-id>`通过`/rename`丢失会话的自定义名称和颜色设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed session titles showing placeholder example text when the first message is a short greeting
entries.zh: 修复了当第一条消息是简短问候语时显示占位符示例文本的会话标题

entries.en: Fixed terminal escape codes appearing as garbage text in the prompt input after `--teleport`
entries.zh: 修复 `--teleport` 之后，终端转义码在提示输入框中显示为乱码文字的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/feedback` retry: pressing Enter to resubmit after a failure now works without first editing the description
entries.zh: 修复了`/feedback`重试：失败后按 Enter 重新提交现在无需先编辑描述即可工作

entries.en: Fixed `--teleport` and `--resume <id>` precondition errors (e.g. dirty git tree, session not found) exiting silently instead of showing the error message
entries.zh: 修复了 `--teleport` 和 `--resume <id>` 前提条件错误（例如脏 git 树、未找到会话）静默退出而不是显示错误消息

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control session titles set in the web UI being overwritten by auto-generated titles after the third message
entries.zh: 修复了 Web UI 中设置的远程控制会话标题在第三条消息后被自动生成的标题覆盖的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` truncating sessions when the transcript contained a self-referencing message
entries.zh: 修复了当记录包含自引用消息时`--resume`截断会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed transcript write failures (e.g., disk full) being silently dropped instead of being logged
entries.zh: 修复转录写入失败（例如磁盘已满）被静默丢弃而不记录日志的问题

entries.en: Fixed diacritical marks (accents, umlauts, cedillas) being dropped from responses when the `language` setting is configured
entries.zh: 修复了配置“语言”设置时从响应中删除变音符号（重音、变音符号、变音符号）的问题

entries.en: Fixed policy-managed plugins never auto-updating when running from a different project than where they were first installed
entries.zh: 修复了策略管理插件在从与首次安装位置不同的项目运行时永远不会自动更新的问题

entries.en: Show thinking hints sooner during long operations
entries.zh: 长时间操作期间，更早显示思考提示

entries.en: Added `path` parameter to the `EnterWorktree` tool to switch into an existing worktree of the current repository
entries.zh: 在`EnterWorktree`工具中添加了`path`参数，以切换到当前存储库的现有工作树

entries.en: Added PreCompact hook support: hooks can now block compaction by exiting with code 2 or returning `{"decision":"block"}`
entries.zh: 添加了 PreCompact 挂钩支持：挂钩现在可以通过使用代码 2 退出或返回 `{"decision":"block"}` 来阻止压缩

entries.en: Added background monitor support for plugins via a top-level `monitors` manifest key that auto-arms at session start or on skill invoke
entries.zh: 通过顶级“监视器”清单键添加了对插件的后台监视器支持，该键在会话启动或技能调用时自动装备

entries.en: `/proactive` is now an alias for `/loop`
entries.zh: `/proactive` 现在是 `/loop` 的别名

entries.en: Improved stalled API stream handling: streams now abort after 5 minutes of no data and retry non-streaming instead of hanging indefinitely
entries.zh: 改进 API 流卡住的处理：超过 5 分钟没有数据就中止，并改用非流式请求重试，而不是无限挂起

entries.en: Improved network error messages: connection errors now show a retry message immediately instead of a silent spinner
entries.zh: 改进网络错误提示：连接错误立即显示重试提示，而不是静默的加载动画

entries.en: Improved file write display: long single-line writes (e.g. minified JSON) are now truncated in the UI instead of paginating across many screens
entries.zh: 改进文件写入的显示：超长的单行写入（如压缩后的 JSON）在界面中截断，而不是翻页显示到许多屏

entries.en: Improved `/doctor` layout with status icons; press `f` to have Claude fix reported issues
entries.zh: 改进 `/doctor` 布局：增加状态图标；按 `f` 可让 Claude 修复报告的问题

entries.en: Improved `/config` labels and descriptions for clarity
entries.zh: 改进 `/config` 的标签和说明，更清楚

entries.en: Improved skill description handling: raised the listing cap from 250 to 1,536 characters and added a startup warning when descriptions are truncated
entries.zh: 改进技能描述处理：技能列表的字数上限从 250 提高到 1,536 个字符，描述被截断时启动会给出警告

entries.en: Improved `WebFetch` to strip `<style>` and `<script>` contents from fetched pages so CSS-heavy pages no longer exhaust the content budget before reaching actual text
entries.zh: 改进 `WebFetch`：去掉抓取页面中 `<style>` 和 `<script>` 的内容，避免大量 CSS 的页面在读到正文前就耗尽内容配额

entries.en: Improved stale agent worktree cleanup to remove worktrees whose PR was squash-merged instead of keeping them indefinitely
entries.zh: 改进陈旧智能体工作树的清理：PR 以 squash 方式合并后，对应的工作树会被删除，而不是无限期保留

entries.en: Improved MCP large-output truncation prompt to give format-specific recipes (e.g. `jq` for JSON, computed Read chunk sizes for text)
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 大输出截断提示：按格式给出具体做法（如 JSON 用 `jq`，文本则按计算好的 Read 分块大小读取）

entries.en: Fixed images attached to queued messages (sent while Claude is working) being dropped
entries.zh: 修复了附加到排队消息（克劳德工作时发送）的图像被丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed screen going blank when the prompt input wraps to a second line in long conversations
entries.zh: 修复了在长对话中提示输入换行至第二行时屏幕变为空白的问题

entries.en: Fixed leading whitespace getting copied when selecting multi-line assistant responses in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下选择多行助手响应时复制前导空格的问题

entries.en: Fixed leading whitespace being trimmed from assistant messages, breaking ASCII art and indented diagrams
entries.zh: 修复了辅助消息中前导空白被修剪、破坏 ASCII 艺术和缩进图表的问题

entries.en: Fixed garbled bash output when commands print clickable file links (e.g. Python `rich`/`loguru` logging)
