entries.zh: 修复了命令打印可点击文件链接时出现的乱码 bash 输出（例如 Python `rich`/`loguru` 日志记录）

entries.en: Fixed alt+enter not inserting a newline in terminals using ESC-prefix alt encoding, and Ctrl+J not inserting a newline (regression in 2.1.100)
entries.zh: 修复了 alt+enter 不会在使用 ESC 前缀 alt 编码的终端中插入换行符，以及 Ctrl+J 不会插入换行符的问题（2.1.100 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed duplicate "Creating worktree" text in EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree tool display
entries.zh: 修复了 EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree 工具显示中重复的“创建工作树”文本

entries.en: Fixed queued user prompts disappearing from focus mode
entries.zh: 修复了排队的用户提示从焦点模式中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed one-shot scheduled tasks re-firing repeatedly when the file watcher missed the post-fire cleanup
entries.zh: 修复了当文件观察器错过触发后清理时一次性计划任务重复重新触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed inbound channel notifications being silently dropped after the first message for Team/Enterprise users
entries.zh: 修复了团队/企业用户收到第一条消息后入站通道通知被静默丢弃的问题

entries.en: Fixed marketplace plugins with `package.json` and lockfile not having dependencies installed automatically after install/update
entries.zh: 修复了带有 `package.json` 和 lockfile 的市场插件在安装/更新后没有自动安装依赖项的问题

entries.en: Fixed marketplace auto-update leaving the official marketplace in a broken state when a plugin process holds files open during the update
entries.zh: 修复了当插件进程在更新期间保持文件打开时，市场自动更新导致官方市场处于损坏状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Resume this session with..." hint not printing on exit after `/resume`, `--worktree`, or `/branch`
entries.zh: 修复了“通过...恢复此会话”提示在`/resume`、`--worktree`或`/branch`之后退出时不打印的问题

entries.en: Fixed feedback survey shortcut keys firing when typed at the end of a longer prompt
entries.zh: 修复了在较长提示结束时键入反馈调查快捷键时触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed stdio MCP server emitting malformed (non-JSON) output hanging the session instead of failing fast with "Connection closed"
entries.zh: 修复了 stdio MCP 服务器发出格式错误（非 JSON）的输出，导致会话挂起，而不是因“连接关闭”而快速失败

entries.en: Fixed MCP tools missing on the first turn of headless/remote-trigger sessions when MCP servers connect asynchronously
entries.zh: 修复了当 MCP 服务器异步连接时，第一轮无头/远程触发会话中 MCP 工具丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` picker on AWS Bedrock in non-US regions persisting invalid `us.*` model IDs to `settings.json` when inference profile discovery is still in-flight
entries.zh: 修复了非美国区域中 AWS Bedrock 上的`/model`选择器，当推理配置文件发现仍在进行时，将无效的`us.*`模型 ID 保留为`settings.json`

entries.en: Fixed 429 rate-limit errors showing a raw JSON dump instead of a clean message for API-key, Bedrock, and Vertex users
entries.zh: 修复了 429 个速率限制错误，为 API 密钥、Bedrock 和 Vertex 用户显示原始 JSON 转储而不是干净消息

entries.en: Fixed crash on resume when session contains malformed text blocks
entries.zh: 修复了会话包含格式错误的文本块时恢复时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed `/help` dropping the tab bar, Shortcuts heading, and footer at short terminal heights
entries.zh: 修复了`/help`将选项卡栏、快捷方式标题和页脚放置在短终端高度的问题

entries.en: Fixed malformed keybinding entry values in `keybindings.json` being silently loaded instead of rejected with a clear error
entries.zh: 修复了`keybindings.json`中格式错误的键绑定条目值被静默加载而不是因明显错误而被拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` in one project's settings permanently disabling usage metrics for all projects on the machine
entries.zh: 修复了一个项目设置中的`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`，永久禁用计算机上所有项目的使用指标

entries.en: Fixed washed-out 16-color palette when using Ghostty, Kitty, Alacritty, WezTerm, foot, rio, or Contour over SSH/mosh
entries.zh: 修复在 SSH/mosh 中使用 Ghostty、Kitty、Alacritty、WezTerm、foot、rio 或 Contour 时，16 色调色板显示褪色的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool suggesting `acceptEdits` permission mode when exiting plan mode would downgrade from a higher permission level
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具在退出计划模式时建议`acceptEdits`权限模式将从较高权限级别降级的问题

entries.en: Added `/team-onboarding` command to generate a teammate ramp-up guide from your local Claude Code usage
entries.zh: 添加了`/team-onboarding`命令，以根据您当地的克劳德代码使用情况生成队友入门指南

entries.en: Added OS CA certificate store trust by default, so enterprise TLS proxies work without extra setup (set `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE=bundled` to use only bundled CAs)
entries.zh: 默认情况下添加了 OS CA 证书存储信任，因此企业 TLS 代理无需额外设置即可工作（设置`CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE=bundled`以仅使用捆绑 CA）

entries.en: `/ultraplan` and other remote-session features now auto-create a default cloud environment instead of requiring web setup first
entries.zh: `/ultraplan` 和其他远程会话功能现在会自动创建默认的云端环境，而不再需要先进行网页设置

entries.en: Improved brief mode to retry once when Claude responds with plain text instead of a structured message
entries.zh: 改进 brief 模式：Claude 以纯文本而非结构化消息回复时，会自动重试一次

entries.en: Improved focus mode: Claude now writes more self-contained summaries since it knows you only see its final message
entries.zh: 改进专注模式：Claude 写的总结更加自洽，因为它知道你只会看到它的最终消息

entries.en: Improved tool-not-available errors to explain why and how to proceed when the model calls a tool that exists but isn't available in the current context
entries.zh: 改进工具不可用的报错：当模型调用一个存在但在当前上下文中不可用的工具时，会说明原因以及接下来该怎么做

entries.en: Improved rate-limit retry messages to show which limit was hit and when it resets instead of an opaque seconds countdown
entries.zh: 改进限流重试提示：显示触发的是哪个限额以及何时重置，而不是只显示一个不透明的秒数倒计时

entries.en: Improved refusal error messages to include the API-provided explanation when available
entries.zh: 改进拒绝错误信息：在 API 提供解释时，会包含该解释

entries.en: Improved `claude -p --resume <name>` to accept session titles set via `/rename` or `--name`
entries.zh: 改进 `claude -p --resume <name>`：可接受通过 `/rename` 或 `--name` 设置的会话标题

entries.en: Improved settings resilience: an unrecognized hook event name in `settings.json` no longer causes the entire file to be ignored
entries.zh: 改进设置容错：`settings.json` 中无法识别的 hook 事件名不再导致整个文件被忽略

entries.en: Improved plugin hooks from plugins force-enabled by managed settings to run when `allowManagedHooksOnly` is set
entries.zh: 改进：被托管设置强制启用的插件，在设置了 `allowManagedHooksOnly` 时，其 hook 也能正常运行

entries.en: Improved `/plugin` and `claude plugin update` to show a warning when the marketplace could not be refreshed, instead of silently reporting a stale version
entries.zh: 改进 `/plugin` 和 `claude plugin update`：无法刷新市场时显示警告，而不是悄悄报告过期的版本

entries.en: Improved plan mode to hide the "Refine with Ultraplan" option when the user's org or auth setup can't reach Claude Code on the web
entries.zh: 改进计划模式：当组织或认证设置无法访问 Claude Code 网页版时，隐藏「用 Ultraplan 优化」选项

entries.en: Improved beta tracing to honor `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`, `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`, and `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT`; sensitive span attributes are no longer emitted unless opted in
entries.zh: 改进 beta 追踪：遵循 `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`、`OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS` 和 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT`；敏感的 span 属性只有主动开启后才会输出

entries.en: Improved SDK `query()` to clean up subprocess and temp files when consumers `break` from `for await` or use `await using`
entries.zh: 改进 SDK `query()`：调用方用 `break` 退出 `for await`，或使用 `await using` 时，会清理子进程和临时文件

entries.en: Fixed a command injection vulnerability in the POSIX `which` fallback used by LSP binary detection
entries.zh: 修复了 LSP 二进制检测使用的 POSIX `which` 回退中的命令注入漏洞

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where long sessions retained dozens of historical copies of the message list in the virtual scroller
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，其中长会话在虚拟滚动条中保留了数十个消息列表的历史副本

entries.en: Fixed `--resume`/`--continue` losing conversation context on large sessions when the loader anchored on a dead-end branch instead of the live conversation
entries.zh: 修复了当加载程序锚定在死胡同分支而不是实时对话时，`--resume`/`--continue`在大型会话中丢失对话上下文的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` chain recovery bridging into an unrelated subagent conversation when a subagent message landed near a main-chain write gap
entries.zh: 修复了当子代理消息落在主链写入间隙附近时，`--resume`链恢复桥接到不相关的子代理对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash on `--resume` when a persisted Edit/Write tool result was missing its `file_path`
entries.zh: 修复了当持久编辑/写入工具结果缺少其“文件路径”时`--resume`崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a hardcoded 5-minute request timeout that aborted slow backends (local LLMs, extended thinking, slow gateways) regardless of `API_TIMEOUT_MS`
entries.zh: 修复了硬编码的 5 分钟请求超时，该超时会中止缓慢的后端（本地 LLM、扩展思维、缓慢的网关），无论`API_TIMEOUT_MS`如何

entries.en: Fixed `permissions.deny` rules not overriding a PreToolUse hook's `permissionDecision: "ask"` — previously the hook could downgrade a deny into a prompt
entries.zh: 修复了`permissions.deny`规则不覆盖 PreToolUse 钩子的“permissionDecision:“ask””的问题——之前该钩子可以将拒绝降级为提示

entries.en: Fixed `--setting-sources` without `user` causing background cleanup to ignore `cleanupPeriodDays` and delete conversation history older than 30 days
entries.zh: 修复了没有`user`的`--setting-sources`导致后台清理忽略`cleanupPeriodDays`并删除超过 30 天的对话历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock SigV4 authentication failing with 403 when `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `apiKeyHelper`, or `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` set an Authorization header
entries.zh: 修复了当`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`、`apiKeyHelper`或`ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS`设置授权标头时，Bedrock SigV4 身份验证失败并显示 403

entries.en: Fixed `claude -w <name>` failing with "already exists" after a previous session's worktree cleanup left a stale directory
entries.zh: 修复了在上一个会话的工作树清理留下过时目录后`claude -w <name>`失败并显示“已存在”的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents not inheriting MCP tools from dynamically-injected servers
entries.zh: 修复了子代理不从动态注入服务器继承 MCP 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed sub-agents running in isolated worktrees being denied Read/Edit access to files inside their own worktree
entries.zh: 修复了在独立工作树中运行的子代理被拒绝对其自己的工作树内的文件进行读取/编辑访问的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `mktemp: No such file or directory` after a fresh boot
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒 Bash 命令在全新启动后失败并显示“mktemp：没有此类文件或目录”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp serve` tool calls failing with "Tool execution failed" in MCP clients that validate `outputSchema`
entries.zh: 修复了在验证`outputSchema`的 MCP 客户端中“claude mcpserve”工具调用失败并显示“工具执行失败”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `RemoteTrigger` tool's `run` action sending an empty body and being rejected by the server
entries.zh: 修复了`RemoteTrigger`工具的`run`操作发送空正文并被服务器拒绝的问题

entries.en: Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: narrow default view hiding sessions from other projects, unreachable preview on Windows Terminal, incorrect cwd in worktrees, session-not-found errors not surfacing in stderr, terminal title not being set, and resume hint overlapping the prompt input
entries.zh: 修复了几个`/resume`选择器问题：狭窄的默认视图隐藏来自其他项目的会话、Windows 终端上无法预览、工作树中的 cwd 不正确、未在 stderr 中显示会话未找到的错误、未设置终端标题以及恢复提示与提示输入重叠

entries.en: Fixed Grep tool ENOENT when the embedded ripgrep binary path becomes stale (VS Code extension auto-update, macOS App Translocation); now falls back to system `rg` and self-heals mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了嵌入式 ripgrep 二进制路径过时时的 Grep 工具 ENOENT（VS Code 扩展自动更新、macOS 应用易位）；现在回退到系统`rg`并在会话中进行自我修复

entries.en: Fixed `/btw` writing a copy of the entire conversation to disk on every use
entries.zh: 修复了每次使用时将整个对话的副本写入磁盘的`/btw`

entries.en: Fixed `/context` Free space and Messages breakdown disagreeing with the header percentage
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`可用空间和消息细分与标题百分比不一致的问题

entries.en: Fixed several plugin issues: slash commands resolving to the wrong plugin with duplicate `name:` frontmatter, `/plugin update` failing with `ENAMETOOLONG`, Discover showing already-installed plugins, directory-source plugins loading from a stale version cache, and skills not honoring `context: fork` and `agent` frontmatter fields
entries.zh: 修复了几个插件问题：斜杠命令解析为具有重复`name:`frontmatter的错误插件，`/plugin update`因`ENAMETOOLONG`失败，发现显示已安装的插件，从过时版本缓存加载目录源插件，以及不尊重`context: fork`和`agent` frontmatter字段的技能

entries.en: Fixed the `/mcp` menu offering OAuth-specific actions for MCP servers configured with `headersHelper`; Reconnect is now offered instead to re-invoke the helper script
entries.zh: 修复 `/mcp` 菜单对配置了 `headersHelper` 的 MCP 服务器仍提供 OAuth 专用操作的问题；现在改为提供"重新连接"，以重新调用该辅助脚本

entries.en: Fixed `ctrl+]`, `ctrl+\`, and `ctrl+^` keybindings not firing in terminals that send raw C0 control bytes (Terminal.app, default iTerm2, xterm)
entries.zh: 修复了`ctrl+]`、`ctrl+\`和`ctrl+^`键绑定在发送原始 C0 控制字节的终端中不触发的问题（Terminal.app、默认 iTerm2、xterm）

entries.en: Fixed `/login` OAuth URL rendering with padding that prevented clean mouse selection
entries.zh: 修复了`/login`OAuth URL 渲染，并使用填充阻止了干净的鼠标选择

entries.en: Fixed rendering issues: flicker in non-fullscreen mode when content above the visible area changed, terminal scrollback being wiped during long sessions in non-fullscreen mode, and mouse-scroll escape sequences occasionally leaking into the prompt as text
entries.zh: 修复了渲染问题：当可见区域上方的内容发生更改时，在非全屏模式下闪烁；在非全屏模式下的长时间会话期间终端回滚被擦除；鼠标滚动转义序列偶尔会作为文本泄漏到提示中

entries.en: Fixed crash when `settings.json` env values are numbers instead of strings
entries.zh: 修复了`settings.json`环境值是数字而不是字符串时的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed in-app settings writes (e.g. `/add-dir --remember`, `/config`) not refreshing the in-memory snapshot, preventing removed directories from being revoked mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了应用内设置写入（例如`/add-dir --remember`、`/config`）不刷新内存快照的问题，从而防止已删除的目录在会话中被撤销

entries.en: Fixed custom keybindings (`~/.claude/keybindings.json`) not loading on Bedrock, Vertex, and other third-party providers
entries.zh: 修复了未在 Bedrock、Vertex 和其他第三方提供商上加载的自定义键绑定 (`~/.claude/keybindings.json`)

entries.en: Fixed `claude --continue -p` not correctly continuing sessions created by `-p` or the SDK
entries.zh: 修复了 `claude --continue -p` 无法正确继续由 `-p` 或 SDK 创建的会话

entries.en: Fixed several Remote Control issues: worktrees removed on session crash, connection failures not persisting in the transcript, spurious "Disconnected" indicator in brief mode for local sessions, and `/remote-control` failing over SSH when only `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` is set
entries.zh: 修复了几个远程控制问题：会话崩溃时删除了工作树、连接失败未在记录中持续存在、本地会话的简短模式下虚假的“断开连接”指示器，以及仅设置`CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID`时`/remote-control`在 SSH 上失败

entries.en: Fixed `/insights` sometimes omitting the report file link from its response
entries.zh: 修复了`/insights`有时会从其响应中省略报告文件链接的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the file attachment below the chat input not clearing when the last editor tab is closed
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复关闭最后一个编辑器标签页后，聊天输入框下方的文件附件没有被清除的问题

entries.en: Added interactive Google Vertex AI setup wizard accessible from the login screen when selecting "3rd-party platform", guiding you through GCP authentication, project and region configuration, credential verification, and model pinning
entries.zh: 添加了交互式 Google Vertex AI 设置向导，可在选择“第 3 方平台”时从登录屏幕访问，指导您完成 GCP 身份验证、项目和区域配置、凭证验证和模型固定

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE` env var: when set, Edit/Write/NotebookEdit fail on read-only files with a `p4 edit` hint instead of silently overwriting them
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE`环境变量：设置后，编辑/写入/笔记本编辑在只读文件上失败，并显示`p4 edit`提示，而不是默默地覆盖它们

entries.en: Added Monitor tool for streaming events from background scripts
entries.zh: 添加了用于从后台脚本流式传输事件的监视器工具

entries.en: Added subprocess sandboxing with PID namespace isolation on Linux when `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` is set, and `CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS` env var to limit per-session script invocations
entries.zh: 设置`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB`时，在 Linux 上添加了具有 PID 命名空间隔离的子进程沙箱，并且设置了`CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS`环境变量以限制每个会话脚本调用

entries.en: Added `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` flag to print mode for improved cross-user prompt caching
entries.zh: 在打印模式中添加了`--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections`标志，以改进跨用户提示缓存

entries.en: Added `workspace.git_worktree` to the status line JSON input, set whenever the current directory is inside a linked git worktree
entries.zh: 将`workspace.git_worktree`添加到状态行 JSON 输入，只要当前目录位于链接的 git 工作树中即可设置

entries.en: Added W3C `TRACEPARENT` env var to Bash tool subprocesses when OTEL tracing is enabled, so child-process spans correctly parent to Claude Code's trace tree
entries.zh: 当启用 OTEL 跟踪时，将 W3C `TRACEPARENT` env var 添加到 Bash 工具子进程，因此子进程正确地跨越 Claude Code 跟踪树的父进程

entries.en: LSP: Claude Code now identifies itself to language servers via `clientInfo` in the initialize request
entries.zh: LSP：Claude Code 现在会在 initialize 请求的 `clientInfo` 中向语言服务器标明自己的身份

entries.en: Fixed a Bash tool permission bypass where a backslash-escaped flag could be auto-allowed as read-only and lead to arbitrary code execution
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具权限绕过，其中反斜杠转义标志可以自动允许为只读并导致任意代码执行

entries.en: Fixed compound Bash commands bypassing forced permission prompts for safety checks and explicit ask rules in auto and bypass-permissions modes
entries.zh: 修复了复合 Bash 命令绕过自动和旁路权限模式下的安全检查和显式询问规则的强制权限提示

entries.en: Fixed read-only commands with env-var prefixes not prompting unless the var is known-safe (`LANG`, `TZ`, `NO_COLOR`, etc.)
entries.zh: 修复了带有 env-var 前缀的只读命令，除非该 var 是已知安全的（`LANG`、`TZ`、`NO_COLOR`等），否则不会提示

entries.en: Fixed redirects to `/dev/tcp/...` or `/dev/udp/...` not prompting instead of auto-allowing
entries.zh: 修复了重定向到`/dev/tcp/...`或`/dev/udp/...`时不提示而不是自动允许的问题

entries.en: Fixed stalled streaming responses timing out instead of falling back to non-streaming mode
entries.zh: 修复了停滞的流响应超时而不是回退到非流模式

entries.en: Fixed 429 retries burning all attempts in ~13s when the server returns a small `Retry-After` — exponential backoff now applies as a minimum
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器返回一个小的`Retry-After`时，429 次重试会在约 13 秒内烧毁所有尝试 - 指数退避现在适用于最小值

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` config override not being honored on token refresh after restart, affecting ADFS and similar IdPs
entries.zh: 修复了重新启动后令牌刷新时不支持 MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` 配置覆盖，从而影响 ADFS 和类似的 IdP

entries.en: Fixed capital letters being dropped to lowercase on xterm and VS Code integrated terminal when the kitty keyboard protocol is active
entries.zh: 修复了当 kitty 键盘协议处于活动状态时，xterm 和 VS Code 集成终端上的大写字母被删除为小写的问题

entries.en: Fixed macOS text replacements deleting the trigger word instead of inserting the substitution
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 文本替换删除触发词而不是插入替换的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` being silently downgraded to accept-edits mode after approving a write to a protected path via Bash
entries.zh: 修复了通过 Bash 批准写入受保护路径后`--dangerously-skip-permissions`被默默降级为接受编辑模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed managed-settings allow rules remaining active after an admin removed them, until process restart
entries.zh: 固定的托管设置允许规则在管理员删除规则后保持活动状态，直到进程重新启动

entries.en: Fixed `permissions.additionalDirectories` changes not applying mid-session — removed directories lose access immediately and added ones work without restart
entries.zh: 修复了`permissions.additionalDirectories`更改未在会话中应用的问题 - 删除的目录立即失去访问权限，添加的目录无需重新启动即可工作

entries.en: Fixed removing a directory from `additionalDirectories` revoking access to the same directory passed via `--add-dir`
entries.zh: 修复了从`additionalDirectories`中删除目录并撤销通过`--add-dir`传递的同一目录的访问权限的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Bash(cmd:*)` and `Bash(git commit *)` wildcard permission rules failing to match commands with extra spaces or tabs
entries.zh: 修复了 `Bash(cmd:*)` 和 `Bash(git commit *)` 通配符权限规则无法匹配带有额外空格或制表符的命令

entries.en: Fixed `Bash(...)` deny rules being downgraded to a prompt for piped commands that mix `cd` with other segments
entries.zh: 修复了`Bash(...)`拒绝规则被降级为提示将`cd`与其他段混合的管道命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed false Bash permission prompts for `cut -d /`, `paste -d /`, `column -s /`, `awk '{print $1}' file`, and filenames containing `%`
entries.zh: 修复了`cut -d /`、`paste -d /`、`column -s /`、`awk '{print $1}' file`和包含`%`的文件名的错误 Bash 权限提示

entries.en: Fixed permission rules with names matching JavaScript prototype properties (e.g. `toString`) causing `settings.json` to be silently ignored
entries.zh: 修复了名称与 JavaScript 原型属性（例如`toString`）匹配的权限规则，导致`settings.json`被默默忽略

entries.en: Fixed agent team members not inheriting the leader's permission mode when using `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--dangerously-skip-permissions`时代理团队成员不继承领导者权限模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash in fullscreen mode when hovering over MCP tool results
entries.zh: 修复了将鼠标悬停在 MCP 工具结果上时全屏模式下的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed copying wrapped URLs in fullscreen mode inserting spaces at line breaks
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下复制包装 URL 时在换行符处插入空格的问题

entries.en: Fixed file-edit diffs disappearing from the UI on `--resume` when the edited file was larger than 10KB
entries.zh: 修复了当编辑的文件大于 10KB 时，文件编辑差异在`--resume`上从 UI 中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: `--resume <name>` opening uneditable, filter reload wiping search state, empty list swallowing arrow keys, cross-project staleness, and transient task-status text replacing conversation summaries
entries.zh: 修复了几个`/resume`选择器问题：`--resume <name>`打开不可编辑、过滤器重新加载擦除搜索状态、空列表吞噬箭头键、跨项目陈旧性以及临时任务状态文本替换对话摘要

entries.en: Fixed `/export` not honoring absolute paths and `~`, and silently rewriting user-supplied extensions to `.txt`
entries.zh: 修复了`/export`不支持绝对路径和`~`，并以静默方式将用户提供的扩展名重写为`.txt`的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/effort max` being denied for unknown or future model IDs
entries.zh: 修复了未知或未来模型 ID 拒绝`/effort max`的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash command picker breaking when a plugin's frontmatter `name` is a YAML boolean keyword
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的 frontmatter `name` 是 YAML 布尔关键字时斜杠命令选择器中断的问题

entries.en: Fixed rate-limit upsell text being hidden after message remounts
entries.zh: 修复了消息重新安装后隐藏的速率限制追加销售文本

entries.en: Fixed MCP tools with `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` not bypassing the token-based persist layer
entries.zh: 修复了带有 `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` 的 MCP 工具不绕过基于令牌的持久层

entries.en: Fixed voice mode leaking dozens of space characters into the input when re-holding the push-to-talk key while the previous transcript is still processing
entries.zh: 修复上一段转录仍在处理时重新按住一键通话键，导致数十个空格被插入输入框的问题

entries.en: Fixed `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER` not fully suppressing the npm registry version check and symlink modification on npm-based installs
entries.zh: 修复了`DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER`未完全抑制基于 npm 安装的 npm 注册表版本检查和符号链接修改

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where Remote Control permission handler entries were retained for the lifetime of the session
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，其中远程控制权限处理程序条目在会话的生命周期内保留

entries.en: Fixed background subagents that fail with an error not reporting partial progress to the parent agent
entries.zh: 修复了因不向父代理报告部分进度而失败的后台子代理

entries.en: Fixed prompt-type Stop/SubagentStop hooks failing on long sessions, and hook evaluator API errors showing "JSON validation failed" instead of the real message
entries.zh: 修复了提示类型 Stop/SubagentStop 挂钩在长时间会话中失败的问题，以及挂钩评估器 API 错误显示“JSON 验证失败”而不是真实消息

entries.en: Fixed feedback survey rendering when dismissed
entries.zh: 修复了反馈调查被驳回时的渲染问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash `grep -f FILE` / `rg -f FILE` not prompting when reading a pattern file outside the working directory
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash `grep -f FILE` / `rg -f FILE` 在读取工作目录之外的模式文件时不提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed stale subagent worktree cleanup removing worktrees that contain untracked files
entries.zh: 修复了过时的子代理工作树清理，删除包含未跟踪文件的工作树

entries.en: Fixed `sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` not taking effect on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了 `sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` 在 macOS 上不生效的问题

entries.en: Improved `/resume` filter hint labels and added project/worktree/branch names in the filter indicator
entries.zh: 改进 `/resume` 的筛选提示标签，并在筛选指示器中加入项目、worktree 和分支名称

entries.en: Improved footer indicators (Focus, notifications) to stay on the mode-indicator row instead of wrapping at narrow terminal widths
entries.zh: 改进页脚指示器（专注模式、通知）：在窄终端中保持在模式指示行上，不再换行

entries.en: Improved `/agents` with a tabbed layout: a Running tab shows live subagents, and the Library tab adds Run agent and View running instance actions
entries.zh: 改进 `/agents`：采用标签页布局，“Running”标签显示正在运行的子代理；“Library”标签新增“运行代理”和“查看运行中实例”操作

entries.en: Improved `/reload-plugins` to pick up plugin-provided skills without requiring a restart
entries.zh: 改进 `/reload-plugins`：无需重启即可加载插件提供的技能

entries.en: Improved Accept Edits mode to auto-approve filesystem commands prefixed with safe env vars or process wrappers
entries.zh: 改进“接受编辑”模式：对带有安全环境变量或进程包装器前缀的文件系统命令自动批准

entries.en: Improved Vim mode: `j`/`k` in NORMAL mode now navigate history and select the footer pill at the input boundary
entries.zh: 改进 Vim 模式：NORMAL 模式下，`j`/`k` 可在输入框边界处切换历史记录，并选中底部的状态胶囊

entries.en: Improved hook errors in the transcript to include the first line of stderr for self-diagnosis without `--debug`
entries.zh: 改进 transcript 中的 hook 错误：包含 stderr 的第一行，不加 `--debug` 也能自行排查

entries.en: Improved OTEL tracing: interaction spans now correctly wrap full turns under concurrent SDK calls, and headless turns end spans per-turn
entries.zh: 改进 OTEL 追踪：并发 SDK 调用下，交互 span 现在能正确包住完整的一轮对话；无界面模式的每轮结束时都会结束对应的 span

entries.en: Improved transcript entries to carry final token usage instead of streaming placeholders
entries.zh: 改进转录记录：带上最终的 token 用量，而不是流式输出的占位值

entries.en: Updated the `/claude-api` skill to cover Managed Agents alongside Claude API
entries.zh: `/claude-api` 技能现在涵盖 Managed Agents 以及 Claude API

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed false-positive "requires git-bash" error on Windows when `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` is set or Git is installed at a default location
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 Windows 上设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` 或 Git 安装在默认位置时，误报 "requires git-bash" 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` to honor `DISABLE_COMPACT` when it is set.
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS`以在设置时遵守`DISABLE_COMPACT`。

entries.en: Dropped `/compact` hints when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set.
entries.zh: 设置`DISABLE_COMPACT`时删除`/compact`提示。

entries.en: Added focus view toggle (`Ctrl+O`) in `NO_FLICKER` mode showing prompt, one-line tool summary with edit diffstats, and final response
entries.zh: 在`NO_FLICKER`模式下添加了焦点视图切换（`Ctrl+O`），显示提示、带有编辑差异统计的单行工具摘要以及最终响应

entries.en: Added `refreshInterval` status line setting to re-run the status line command every N seconds
entries.zh: 添加了 `refreshInterval` 状态行设置以每 N 秒重新运行一次状态行命令

entries.en: Added `workspace.git_worktree` to the status line JSON input, set when the current directory is inside a linked git worktree
entries.zh: 将`workspace.git_worktree`添加到状态行 JSON 输入，当当前目录位于链接的 git 工作树内时设置

entries.en: Added `● N running` indicator in `/agents` next to agent types with live subagent instances
entries.zh: 在具有实时子代理实例的代理类型旁边的`/agents`中添加了`● N running`指示符

entries.en: Added syntax highlighting for Cedar policy files (`.cedar`, `.cedarpolicy`)
entries.zh: 添加了 Cedar 策略文件的语法突出显示（`.cedar`、`.cedarpolicy`）

entries.en: Fixed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` being silently downgraded to accept-edits mode after approving a write to a protected path
entries.zh: 修复了在批准写入受保护路径后`--dangerously-skip-permissions`被默默降级为接受编辑模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed and hardened Bash tool permissions, tightening checks around env-var prefixes and network redirects, and reducing false prompts on common commands
entries.zh: 修复并强化了 Bash 工具权限，加强了对 env-var 前缀和网络重定向的检查，并减少了常见命令的错误提示

entries.en: Fixed permission rules with names matching JavaScript prototype properties (e.g. `toString`) causing `settings.json` to be silently ignored
entries.zh: 修复了名称与 JavaScript 原型属性（例如`toString`）匹配的权限规则，导致`settings.json`被默默忽略

entries.en: Fixed managed-settings allow rules remaining active after an admin removed them until process restart
entries.zh: 固定的托管设置允许规则在管理员删除规则后保持活动状态，直到进程重新启动

entries.en: Fixed `permissions.additionalDirectories` changes in settings not applying mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了设置中的`permissions.additionalDirectories`更改未在会话中应用的问题

entries.en: Fixed removing a directory from `settings.permissions.additionalDirectories` revoking access to the same directory passed via `--add-dir`
entries.zh: 修复了从`settings.permissions.additionalDirectories`中删除目录以撤销通过`--add-dir`传递的同一目录的访问权限

entries.en: Fixed MCP HTTP/SSE connections accumulating ~50 MB/hr of unreleased buffers when servers reconnect
entries.zh: 修复了服务器重新连接时 MCP HTTP/SSE 连接每小时累积约 50 MB 未释放缓冲区的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` not being honored on token refresh after restart, fixing ADFS and similar IdPs
entries.zh: 修复了重启后令牌刷新时不支持 MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` 的问题，修复了 ADFS 和类似的 IdP

entries.en: Fixed 429 retries burning all attempts in ~13 seconds when the server returns a small `Retry-After` — exponential backoff now applies as a minimum
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器返回一个小的`Retry-After`时，429 次重试会在约 13 秒内烧毁所有尝试 - 现在应用指数退避作为最小值

entries.en: Fixed rate-limit upgrade options disappearing after context compaction
entries.zh: 修复了上下文压缩后速率限制升级选项消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: `--resume <name>` opening uneditable, Ctrl+A reload wiping search, empty list swallowing navigation, task-status text replacing conversation summary, and cross-project staleness
entries.zh: 修复了几个`/resume`选择器问题：`--resume <name>`打开不可编辑、Ctrl+A 重新加载擦除搜索、空列表吞噬导航、任务状态文本替换对话摘要以及跨项目陈旧性

entries.en: Fixed file-edit diffs disappearing on `--resume` when the edited file was larger than 10KB
entries.zh: 修复了当编辑的文件大于 10KB 时文件编辑差异在`--resume`上消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` cache misses and lost mid-turn input from attachment messages not being saved to the transcript
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`缓存未命中和丢失的附件消息中的输入未保存到记录中的问题

entries.en: Fixed messages typed while Claude is working not being persisted to the transcript
entries.zh: 修正了克劳德工作时输入的消息不会保留到文字记录中的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt-type `Stop`/`SubagentStop` hooks failing on long sessions, and hook evaluator API errors displaying "JSON validation failed" instead of the actual message
entries.zh: 修复了提示类型 `Stop`/`SubagentStop` 挂钩在长时间会话中失败，以及挂钩评估器 API 错误显示“JSON 验证失败”而不是实际消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents with worktree isolation or `cwd:` override leaking their working directory back to the parent session's Bash tool
entries.zh: 修复了具有工作树隔离或`cwd:`覆盖的子代理将其工作目录泄漏回父会话的 Bash 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed compaction writing duplicate multi-MB subagent transcript files on prompt-too-long retries
entries.zh: 修复了在提示时间过长的重试时压缩写入重复的多 MB 子代理转录文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin update` reporting "already at the latest version" for git-based marketplace plugins when the remote had newer commits
entries.zh: 修复了当远程有更新的提交时，基于 git 的市场插件的“claude 插件更新”报告“已经是最新版本”的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash command picker breaking when a plugin's frontmatter `name` is a YAML boolean keyword
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的 frontmatter `name` 是 YAML 布尔关键字时斜杠命令选择器中断的问题

entries.en: Fixed copying wrapped URLs in `NO_FLICKER` mode inserting spaces at line breaks
entries.zh: 修复了在`NO_FLICKER`模式下复制包装 URL 时在换行符处插入空格的问题

entries.en: Fixed scroll rendering artifacts in `NO_FLICKER` mode when running inside zellij
entries.zh: 修复了在 zellij 内运行时`NO_FLICKER`模式下的滚动渲染伪影

entries.en: Fixed a crash in `NO_FLICKER` mode when hovering over MCP tool results
entries.zh: 修复了将鼠标悬停在 MCP 工具结果上时`NO_FLICKER`模式下的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed a `NO_FLICKER` mode memory leak where API retries left stale streaming state
entries.zh: 修复了`NO_FLICKER`模式内存泄漏，其中 API 重试留下陈旧的流状态

entries.en: Fixed slow mouse-wheel scrolling in `NO_FLICKER` mode on Windows Terminal
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 终端上`NO_FLICKER`模式下鼠标滚轮滚动缓慢的问题

entries.en: Fixed custom status line not displaying in `NO_FLICKER` mode on terminals shorter than 24 rows
entries.zh: 修复了在少于 24 行的终端上以`NO_FLICKER`模式不显示的自定义状态行

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Enter and Alt/Cmd+arrow shortcuts not working in Warp with `NO_FLICKER` mode
entries.zh: 修复了 Shift+Enter 和 Alt/Cmd+arrow 快捷键在`NO_FLICKER`模式下的 Warp 中不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed Korean/Japanese/Unicode text becoming garbled when copied in no-flicker mode on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 上以无闪烁模式复制时韩文/日文/Unicode 文本变得乱码的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock SigV4 authentication failing when `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` or `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` are set to empty strings (as GitHub Actions does for unset inputs)
entries.zh: 修复了当`AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`或`ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL`设置为空字符串时 Bedrock SigV4 身份验证失败的问题（正如 GitHub Actions 对于未设置的输入所做的那样）

entries.en: Improved Accept Edits mode to auto-approve filesystem commands prefixed with safe env vars or process wrappers (e.g. `LANG=C rm foo`, `timeout 5 mkdir out`)
entries.zh: 改进“接受编辑”模式：对带有安全环境变量或进程包装器前缀的文件系统命令自动批准（如 `LANG=C rm foo`、`timeout 5 mkdir out`）

entries.en: Improved auto mode and bypass-permissions mode to auto-approve sandbox network access prompts
entries.zh: 改进自动模式和绕过权限模式：自动批准沙箱网络访问提示

entries.en: Improved sandbox: `sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` now takes effect on macOS
entries.zh: 改进：`sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` 现在在 macOS 上生效

entries.en: Improved image handling: pasted and attached images are now compressed to the same token budget as images read via the Read tool
entries.zh: 改进图片处理：粘贴和附加的图片现在压缩到与 Read 工具读取图片相同的 token 预算

entries.en: Improved slash command and `@`-mention completion to trigger after CJK sentence punctuation, so Japanese/Chinese input no longer requires a space before `/` or `@`
entries.zh: 改进斜杠命令和 `@` 提及的补全：中日文句号之后也会触发，因此日语和中文输入时，`/` 或 `@` 前不再需要空格

entries.en: Improved Bridge sessions to show the local git repo, branch, and working directory on the claude.ai session card
entries.zh: 改进 Bridge 会话：在 claude.ai 会话卡片上显示本地 git 仓库、分支和工作目录

entries.en: Improved footer layout: indicators (Focus, notifications) now stay on the mode-indicator row instead of wrapping below
entries.zh: 改进页脚布局：专注模式、通知等指示器保留在模式指示行上，不再换到下一行

entries.en: Improved context-low warning to show as a transient footer notification instead of a persistent row
entries.zh: 改进上下文不足警告：以临时的页脚通知显示，不再占用一行固定位置

entries.en: Improved markdown blockquotes to show a continuous left bar across wrapped lines
entries.zh: 改进 Markdown 引用块：跨行换行时显示连续的左侧竖线

entries.en: Improved session transcript size by skipping empty hook entries and capping stored pre-edit file copies
entries.zh: 改进会话转录大小：跳过空的 hook 条目，并限制保存的编辑前文件副本数量

entries.en: Improved transcript accuracy: per-block entries now carry the final token usage instead of the streaming placeholder
entries.zh: 改进转录准确性：每个块的记录现在带有最终的 token 用量，而不是流式输出时的占位值

entries.en: Improved Bash tool OTEL tracing: subprocesses now inherit a W3C `TRACEPARENT` env var when tracing is enabled
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 工具的 OTEL 追踪：开启追踪时，子进程会继承 W3C `TRACEPARENT` 环境变量

entries.en: Updated `/claude-api` skill to cover Managed Agents alongside the Claude API
entries.zh: `/claude-api` 技能现在涵盖 Managed Agents 以及 Claude API

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock requests failing with `403 "Authorization header is missing"` when using `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` or `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_BEDROCK_AUTH` (regression in 2.1.94)
entries.zh: 修复了使用`AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`或`CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_BEDROCK_AUTH`时基岩请求失败并显示“403“授权标头丢失””的问题（2.1.94 中的回归）

entries.en: Added support for Amazon Bedrock powered by Mantle, set `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1`
entries.zh: 添加了对由 Mantle 提供支持的 Amazon Bedrock 的支持，设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1`

entries.en: Changed default effort level from medium to high for API-key, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, Team, and Enterprise users (control this with `/effort`)
entries.zh: 将 API 密钥、Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry、团队和企业用户的默认工作级别从中更改为高（使用`/effort`控制此）

entries.en: Added compact `Slacked #channel` header with a clickable channel link for Slack MCP send-message tool calls
entries.zh: 添加了紧凑的`Slacked #channel`标头，其中包含用于 Slack MCP 发送消息工具调用的可点击通道链接

entries.en: Added `keep-coding-instructions` frontmatter field support for plugin output styles
entries.zh: 添加了对插件输出样式的`keep-coding-instructions` frontmatter 字段支持

entries.en: Added `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle` to `UserPromptSubmit` hooks for setting the session title
entries.zh: 将 `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle` 添加到 `UserPromptSubmit` 挂钩以设置会话标题

entries.en: Plugin skills declared via `"skills": ["./"]` now use the skill's frontmatter `name` for the invocation name instead of the directory basename, giving a stable name across install methods
entries.zh: 通过 `"skills": ["./"]` 声明的插件技能，现在使用技能 frontmatter 中的 `name` 作为调用名，而不是目录名，从而在不同安装方式下名称保持一致

entries.en: Fixed agents appearing stuck after a 429 rate-limit response with a long Retry-After header — the error now surfaces immediately instead of silently waiting
entries.zh: 修复了代理在使用长 Retry-After 标头的 429 速率限制响应后出现卡住的问题 — 错误现在立即浮出水面，而不是默默等待

entries.en: Fixed Console login on macOS silently failing with "Not logged in" when the login keychain is locked or its password is out of sync — the error is now surfaced and `claude doctor` diagnoses the fix
entries.zh: 修复了当登录钥匙串被锁定或其密码不同步时，macOS 上的控制台登录无提示地失败并显示“未登录”的问题 — 该错误现已浮出水面，并且`claude doctor`诊断修复

entries.en: Fixed plugin skill hooks defined in YAML frontmatter being silently ignored
entries.zh: 修复了 YAML frontmatter 中定义的插件技能挂钩被默默忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin hooks failing with "No such file or directory" when `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` was not set
entries.zh: 修复了未设置`CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`时插件挂钩失败并显示“没有此类文件或目录”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` resolving to the marketplace source directory instead of the installed cache for local-marketplace plugins on startup
entries.zh: 修复了`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`在启动时解析为市场源目录而不是本地市场插件已安装的缓存

entries.en: Fixed scrollback showing the same diff repeated and blank pages in long-running sessions
entries.zh: 修复了在长时间运行的会话中显示相同差异重复页面和空白页面的回滚问题

entries.en: Fixed multiline user prompts in the transcript indenting wrapped lines under the `❯` caret instead of under the text
entries.zh: 修复了记录中的多行用户提示，在`❯`插入符号下（而不是在文本下）缩进换行

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Space inserting the literal word "space" instead of a space character in search inputs
entries.zh: 修复了 Shift+Space 在搜索输入中插入文字“空格”而不是空格字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed hyperlinks opening two browser tabs when clicked inside tmux running in an xterm.js-based terminal (VS Code, Hyper, Tabby)
entries.zh: 修复了在基于 xterm.js 的终端（VS Code、Hyper、Tabby）中运行的 tmux 中单击超链接时打开两个浏览器选项卡的问题

entries.en: Fixed an alt-screen rendering bug where content height changes mid-scroll could leave compounding ghost lines
entries.zh: 修复了替代屏幕渲染错误，其中内容高度在滚动中发生变化可能会留下复合的鬼线

entries.en: Fixed `FORCE_HYPERLINK` environment variable being ignored when set via `settings.json` `env`
entries.zh: 修复了通过`settings.json``env`设置时忽略`FORCE_HYPERLINK`环境变量的问题

entries.en: Fixed native terminal cursor not tracking the selected tab in dialogs, so screen readers and magnifiers can follow tab navigation
entries.zh: 修复了本机终端光标不跟踪对话框中选定的选项卡的问题，因此屏幕阅读器和放大器可以遵循选项卡导航

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock invocation of Sonnet 3.5 v2 by using the `us.` inference profile ID
entries.zh: 修复了使用`us.`推理配置文件 ID 对 Sonnet 3.5 v2 的 Bedrock 调用

entries.en: Fixed SDK/print mode not preserving the partial assistant response in conversation history when interrupted mid-stream
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK/打印模式在中途中断时不会在对话历史记录中保留部分助手响应的问题

entries.en: Improved `--resume` to resume sessions from other worktrees of the same repo directly instead of printing a `cd` command
entries.zh: 改进 `--resume`：同一仓库其他 worktree 中的会话可直接恢复，不再只打印一条 `cd` 命令

entries.en: Fixed CJK and other multibyte text being corrupted with U+FFFD in stream-json input/output when chunk boundaries split a UTF-8 sequence
entries.zh: 修复了当块边界分割 UTF-8 序列时，CJK 和其他多字节文本在流 json 输入/输出中被 U+FFFD 损坏的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Reduced cold-open subprocess work on starting a session
entries.zh: [VSCode] 减少冷启动打开会话时的子进程工作量

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed dropdown menus selecting the wrong item when the mouse was over the list while typing or using arrow keys
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复输入或使用方向键时，鼠标停在列表上会导致下拉菜单选中错误项目的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a warning banner when `settings.json` files fail to parse, so users know their permission rules are not being applied
entries.zh: [VSCode] 当 `settings.json` 文件解析失败时，新增警告横幅，提示用户其权限规则未生效

entries.en: Added `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` policy setting: when set, the CLI blocks startup until remote managed settings are freshly fetched, and exits if the fetch fails (fail-closed)
entries.zh: 添加了`forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`策略设置：设置后，CLI 会阻止启动，直到重新获取远程托管设置为止，如果获取失败则退出（失败关闭）

entries.en: Added interactive Bedrock setup wizard accessible from the login screen when selecting "3rd-party platform" — guides you through AWS authentication, region configuration, credential verification, and model pinning
entries.zh: 添加了选择“第 3 方平台”时可从登录屏幕访问的交互式 Bedrock 设置向导 — 指导您完成 AWS 身份验证、区域配置、凭证验证和模型固定

entries.en: Added per-model and cache-hit breakdown to `/cost` for subscription users
entries.zh: 为订阅用户添加了每个模型和缓存命中的细分到`/cost`

entries.en: `/release-notes` is now an interactive version picker
entries.zh: `/release-notes` 现在是交互式的版本选择器

entries.en: Remote Control session names now use your hostname as the default prefix (e.g. `myhost-graceful-unicorn`), overridable with `--remote-control-session-name-prefix`
entries.zh: Remote Control 会话名称现在默认以主机名作为前缀（例如 `myhost-graceful-unicorn`），可用 `--remote-control-session-name-prefix` 覆盖

entries.en: Pro users now see a footer hint when returning to a session after the prompt cache has expired, showing roughly how many tokens the next turn will send uncached
entries.zh: Pro 用户回到会话时，如果提示词缓存已过期，底部会出现提示，告诉你下一轮大约有多少 token 将不走缓存发送

entries.en: Fixed subagent spawning permanently failing with "Could not determine pane count" after tmux windows are killed or renumbered during a long-running session
entries.zh: 修复了在长时间运行的会话期间 tmux 窗口被终止或重新编号后，子代理生成永久失败并显示“无法确定窗格计数”的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt-type Stop hooks incorrectly failing when the small fast model returns `ok:false`, and restored `preventContinuation:true` semantics for non-Stop prompt-type hooks
entries.zh: 修复了当小型快速模型返回 `ok:false` 时提示类型 Stop 钩子错误地失败的问题，并恢复了非 Stop 提示类型钩子的 `preventContinuation:true` 语义

entries.en: Fixed tool input validation failures when streaming emits array/object fields as JSON-encoded strings
entries.zh: 修复流式输出时数组或对象字段以 JSON 字符串形式发出，导致工具输入校验失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed an API 400 error that could occur when extended thinking produced a whitespace-only text block alongside real content
entries.zh: 修复了扩展思维在实际内容旁边生成纯空白文本块时可能发生的 API 400 错误

entries.en: Fixed accidental feedback survey submissions from auto-pilot keypresses and consecutive-prompt digit collisions
entries.zh: 修复了自动驾驶按键和连续提示数字碰撞导致的意外反馈调查提交

entries.en: Fixed misleading "esc to interrupt" hint appearing alongside "esc to clear" when a text selection exists in fullscreen mode during processing
entries.zh: 修复了处理过程中全屏模式下存在文本选择时，“esc 中断”提示与“esc 清除”旁边出现的误导性“esc 中断”提示

entries.en: Fixed Homebrew install update prompts to use the cask's release channel (`claude-code` → stable, `claude-code@latest` → latest)
entries.zh: 修复了 Homebrew 安装更新提示使用 cask 的发布通道（`claude-code` → 稳定，`claude-code@latest` → 最新）

entries.en: Fixed `ctrl+e` jumping to the end of the next line when already at end of line in multiline prompts
entries.zh: 修复了在多行提示中已位于行尾时`ctrl+e`跳转到下一行末尾的问题

entries.en: Fixed an issue where the same message could appear at two positions when scrolling up in fullscreen mode (iTerm2, Ghostty, and other terminals with DEC 2026 support)
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下向上滚动时同一消息可能出现在两个位置的问题（iTerm2、Ghostty 和其他支持 DEC 2026 的终端）

entries.en: Fixed idle-return "/clear to save X tokens" hint showing cumulative session tokens instead of current context size
entries.zh: 修复了空闲返回“/clear 以保存 X 令牌”提示，显示累积会话令牌而不是当前上下文大小

entries.en: Fixed plugin MCP servers stuck "connecting" on session start when they duplicate a claude.ai connector that is unauthenticated
entries.zh: 修复了插件 MCP 服务器在复制未经身份验证的 claude.ai 连接器时在会话启动时陷入“连接”状态

entries.en: Improved Write tool diff computation speed for large files (60% faster on files with tabs/`&`/`$`)
entries.zh: 改进 Write 工具计算大文件差异（diff）的速度：含制表符、`&`、`$` 的文件快 60%

entries.en: Removed `/tag` command
entries.zh: 移除 `/tag` 命令

entries.en: Removed `/vim` command (toggle vim mode via `/config` → Editor mode)
entries.zh: 移除 `/vim` 命令（请通过 `/config` → Editor mode 切换 vim 模式）

entries.en: Linux sandbox now ships the `apply-seccomp` helper in both npm and native builds, restoring unix-socket blocking for sandboxed commands
entries.zh: Linux 沙盒现在在 npm 和原生构建版本中都附带 `apply-seccomp` 辅助程序，恢复了对沙盒命令的 unix 套接字拦截

entries.en: Added MCP tool result persistence override via `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` annotation (up to 500K), allowing larger results like DB schemas to pass through without truncation
entries.zh: 通过 `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` 注释添加了 MCP 工具结果持久性覆盖（最多 500K），允许更大的结果（例如数据库模式）通过而无需截断

entries.en: Added `disableSkillShellExecution` setting to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands
entries.zh: 添加了`disableSkillShellExecution`设置以禁用技能、自定义斜线命令和插件命令中的内联 shell 执行

entries.en: Added support for multi-line prompts in `claude-cli://open?q=` deep links (encoded newlines `%0A` no longer rejected)
entries.zh: 在 `claude-cli://open?q=` 深层链接中添加了对多行提示的支持（编码换行符 `%0A` 不再被拒绝）

entries.en: Plugins can now ship executables under `bin/` and invoke them as bare commands from the Bash tool
entries.zh: 插件现在可以在 `bin/` 下附带可执行文件，并在 Bash 工具中直接用命令名调用

entries.en: Fixed transcript chain breaks on `--resume` that could lose conversation history when async transcript writes fail silently
entries.zh: 修复 `--resume` 时转录链断裂，异步转录写入静默失败可能导致对话历史丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `cmd+delete` not deleting to start of line on iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty, and Windows Terminal
entries.zh: 修复了`cmd+delete`在 iTerm2、kitty、WezTerm、Ghostty 和 Windows 终端上不删除到行首的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode in remote sessions losing track of the plan file after a container restart, which caused permission prompts on plan edits and an empty plan-approval modal
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话中的计划模式在容器重新启动后丢失计划文件的情况，这导致计划编辑时出现权限提示和空的计划批准模式

entries.en: Fixed JSON schema validation for `permissions.defaultMode: "auto"` in settings.json
entries.zh: 修复了 settings.json 中 `permissions.defaultMode: "auto"` 的 JSON 模式验证

entries.en: Fixed Windows version cleanup not protecting the active version's rollback copy
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 版本清理不保护活动版本的回滚副本的问题

entries.en: `/feedback` now explains why it's unavailable instead of disappearing from the slash menu
entries.zh: `/feedback` 不可用时，现在会说明原因，而不是从斜杠菜单中消失

entries.en: Improved `/claude-api` skill guidance for agent design patterns including tool surface decisions, context management, and caching strategy
entries.zh: 改进 `/claude-api` 技能指导：增加代理设计模式的内容，包括工具范围决策、上下文管理和缓存策略

entries.en: Improved performance: faster `stripAnsi` on Bun by routing through `Bun.stripANSI`
entries.zh: 改进性能：在 Bun 上通过 `Bun.stripANSI` 处理，`stripAnsi` 更快

entries.en: Edit tool now uses shorter `old_string` anchors, reducing output tokens
entries.zh: 编辑工具现在使用较短的`old_string`锚点，减少输出标记

entries.en: Added `/powerup` — interactive lessons teaching Claude Code features with animated demos
entries.zh: 添加了`/powerup`——通过动画演示教授 Claude Code 功能的互动课程

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE` env var to keep the existing marketplace cache when `git pull` fails, useful in offline environments
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE`环境变量，以在`git pull`失败时保留现有的市场缓存，这在离线环境中很有用

entries.en: Added `.husky` to protected directories (acceptEdits mode)
entries.zh: 将 `.husky` 添加到受保护目录（acceptEdits 模式）

entries.en: Fixed an infinite loop where the rate-limit options dialog would repeatedly auto-open after hitting your usage limit, eventually crashing the session
entries.zh: 修复了无限循环，其中速率限制选项对话框在达到使用限制后会重复自动打开，最终导致会话崩溃

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` causing a full prompt-cache miss on the first request for users with deferred tools, MCP servers, or custom agents (regression since v2.1.69)
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`导致使用延迟工具、MCP 服务器或自定义代理的用户在第一次请求时出现完全提示缓存未命中的问题（自 v2.1.69 以来的回归）

entries.en: Fixed `Edit`/`Write` failing with "File content has changed" when a PostToolUse format-on-save hook rewrites the file between consecutive edits
entries.zh: 修复了当 PostToolUse 保存格式挂钩在连续编辑之间重写文件时，“编辑”/“写入”失败并显示“文件内容已更改”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `PreToolUse` hooks that emit JSON to stdout and exit with code 2 not correctly blocking the tool call
entries.zh: 修复了将 JSON 发送到 stdout 并以代码 2 退出的`PreToolUse`挂钩，未正确阻止工具调用

entries.en: Fixed collapsed search/read summary badge appearing multiple times in fullscreen scrollback when a CLAUDE.md file auto-loads during a tool call
entries.zh: 修复了在工具调用期间自动加载 CLAUDE.md 文件时，折叠搜索/阅读摘要徽章在全屏回滚中多次出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode not respecting explicit user boundaries ("don't push", "wait for X before Y") even when the action would otherwise be allowed
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式不尊重明确用户边界的问题（“不要推送”、“在 Y 之前等待 X”），即使该操作本来是允许的

entries.en: Fixed click-to-expand hover text being nearly invisible on light terminal themes
entries.zh: 修复了点击展开悬停文本在轻型终端主题上几乎不可见的问题

entries.en: Fixed UI crash when malformed tool input reached the permission dialog
entries.zh: 修复了格式错误的工具输入到达权限对话框时 UI 崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed headers disappearing when scrolling `/model`, `/config`, and other selection screens
entries.zh: 修复了滚动`/model`、`/config`和其他选择屏幕时标题消失的问题

entries.en: Hardened PowerShell tool permission checks: fixed trailing `&` background job bypass, `-ErrorAction Break` debugger hang, archive-extraction TOCTOU, and parse-fail fallback deny-rule degradation
entries.zh: 加固 PowerShell 工具的权限检查：修复末尾 `&` 后台任务绕过、`-ErrorAction Break` 导致调试器挂起、归档解压的 TOCTOU 问题，以及解析失败时拒绝规则降级的问题

entries.en: Improved performance: eliminated per-turn JSON.stringify of MCP tool schemas on cache-key lookup
entries.zh: 改进性能：去掉了每轮对话在缓存键查找时对 MCP 工具定义做的 JSON.stringify

entries.en: Improved performance: SSE transport now handles large streamed frames in linear time (was quadratic)
entries.zh: 改进性能：SSE 传输现在以线性时间处理大的流式数据帧（之前是平方级）

entries.en: Improved performance: SDK sessions with long conversations no longer slow down quadratically on transcript writes
entries.zh: 改进性能：长对话的 SDK 会话写入转录时不再随长度呈平方级变慢

entries.en: Improved `/resume` all-projects view to load project sessions in parallel, improving load times for users with many projects
entries.zh: 改进 `/resume` 的全部项目视图：并行加载各项目的会话，项目多的用户加载更快

entries.en: Changed `--resume` picker to no longer show sessions created by `claude -p` or SDK invocations
entries.zh: 更改了`--resume`选择器，不再显示由`claude -p`或 SDK 调用创建的会话

entries.en: Removed `Get-DnsClientCache` and `ipconfig /displaydns` from auto-allow (DNS cache privacy)
entries.zh: 从自动允许列表中移除 `Get-DnsClientCache` 和 `ipconfig /displaydns`（保护 DNS 缓存隐私）

entries.en: Added `"defer"` permission decision to `PreToolUse` hooks — headless sessions can pause at a tool call and resume with `-p --resume` to have the hook re-evaluate
entries.zh: 向`PreToolUse`挂钩添加了“defer”权限决策 - 无头会话可以在工具调用时暂停，并使用`-p --resume`恢复以使挂钩重新评估

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1` environment variable to opt into flicker-free alt-screen rendering with virtualized scrollback
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1`环境变量以选择具有虚拟回滚功能的无闪烁替代屏幕渲染

entries.en: Added `PermissionDenied` hook that fires after auto mode classifier denials — return `{retry: true}` to tell the model it can retry
entries.zh: 添加了`PermissionDenied`钩子，该钩子在自动模式分类器拒绝后触发 - 返回`{retry: true}`以告诉模型它可以重试

entries.en: Added named subagents to `@` mention typeahead suggestions
entries.zh: 将命名子代理添加到`@`提及提前输入建议

entries.en: Added `MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true` for `-p` mode to skip the MCP connection wait entirely, and bounded `--mcp-config` server connections at 5s instead of blocking on the slowest server
entries.zh: 为`-p`模式添加了`MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true`，以完全跳过 MCP 连接等待，并将`--mcp-config`服务器连接限制在 5 秒，而不是在最慢的服务器上阻塞

entries.en: Auto mode: denied commands now show a notification and appear in `/permissions` → Recent tab where you can retry with `r`
entries.zh: 自动模式：被拒绝的命令现在显示通知并出现在`/permissions`→“最近”选项卡中，您可以在其中使用`r`重试

entries.en: Fixed `Edit(//path/**)` and `Read(//path/**)` allow rules to check the resolved symlink target, not just the requested path
entries.zh: 修复了 `Edit(//path/**)` 和 `Read(//path/**)` 允许规则检查解析的符号链接目标，而不仅仅是请求的路径

entries.en: Fixed voice push-to-talk not activating for some modifier-combo bindings, and voice mode on Windows failing with "WebSocket upgrade rejected with HTTP 101"
entries.zh: 修复部分修饰键组合的语音一键通话绑定无法激活的问题，以及 Windows 上语音模式报"WebSocket upgrade rejected with HTTP 101"而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Edit/Write tools doubling CRLF on Windows and stripping Markdown hard line breaks (two trailing spaces)
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的编辑/写入工具加倍 CRLF 并剥离 Markdown 硬换行符（两个尾随空格）

entries.en: Fixed `StructuredOutput` schema cache bug causing ~50% failure rate when using multiple schemas
entries.zh: 修复了使用多个模式时导致约 50% 失败率的`StructuredOutput`模式缓存错误

entries.en: Fixed memory leak where large JSON inputs were retained as LRU cache keys in long-running sessions
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，其中大型 JSON 输入在长时间运行的会话中保留为 LRU 缓存键

entries.en: Fixed a crash when removing a message from very large session files (over 50MB)
entries.zh: 修复了从非常大的会话文件（超过 50MB）中删除消息时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed LSP server zombie state after crash — server now restarts on next request instead of failing until session restart
entries.zh: 修复了崩溃后 LSP 服务器僵尸状态 — 服务器现在在下一个请求时重新启动，而不是在会话重新启动之前失败

entries.en: Fixed prompt history entries containing CJK or emoji being silently dropped when they fall on a 4KB boundary in `~/.claude/history.jsonl`
entries.zh: 修复了包含 CJK 或表情符号的提示历史条目在落在 `~/.claude/history.jsonl` 中的 4KB 边界上时被静默删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/stats` undercounting tokens by excluding subagent usage, and losing historical data beyond 30 days when the stats cache format changes
entries.zh: 修复了`/stats`通过排除子代理使用而低估令牌的问题，并在统计缓存格式更改时丢失超过 30 天的历史数据

entries.en: Fixed `-p --resume` hangs when the deferred tool input exceeds 64KB or no deferred marker exists, and `-p --continue` not resuming deferred tools
entries.zh: 修复了当延迟工具输入超过 64KB 或不存在延迟标记时`-p --resume`挂起，以及`-p --continue`不恢复延迟工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude-cli://` deep links not opening on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了`claude-cli://`深层链接无法在 macOS 上打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool errors truncating to only the first content block when the server returns multi-element error content
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器返回多元素错误内容时 MCP 工具错误仅截断为第一个内容块的问题

entries.en: Fixed skill reminders and other system context being dropped when sending messages with images via the SDK
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SDK 发送带有图像的消息时技能提醒和其他系统上下文被删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks to receive `file_path` as an absolute path for Write/Edit/Read tools, matching the documented behavior
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse/PostToolUse 挂钩以接收`file_path`作为写入/编辑/读取工具的绝对路径，与记录的行为相匹配

entries.en: Fixed autocompact thrash loop — now detects when context refills to the limit immediately after compacting three times in a row and stops with an actionable error instead of burning API calls
entries.zh: 修复了 autocompact thrash 循环 - 现在检测连续压缩 3 次后上下文何时重新填充到限制，并以可操作的错误停止，而不是烧毁 API 调用

entries.en: Fixed prompt cache misses in long sessions caused by tool schema bytes changing mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了由于工具模式字节在会话中更改而导致长会话中的提示缓存丢失

entries.en: Fixed nested CLAUDE.md files being re-injected dozens of times in long sessions that read many files
entries.zh: 修复了在读取许多文件的长会话中嵌套的 CLAUDE.md 文件被重新注入数十次的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` crash when transcript contains a tool result from an older CLI version or interrupted write
entries.zh: 修复了当脚本包含旧 CLI 版本或中断写入的工具结果时`--resume`崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed misleading "Rate limit reached" message when the API returned an entitlement error — now shows the actual error with actionable hints
entries.zh: 修复了 API 返回授权错误时误导性的“已达到速率限制”消息 — 现在显示带有可操作提示的实际错误

entries.en: Fixed hooks `if` condition filtering not matching compound commands (`ls && git push`) or commands with env-var prefixes (`FOO=bar git push`)
entries.zh: 修复了钩子`if`条件过滤与复合命令（`ls && git push`）或带有 env-var 前缀的命令（`FOO=bar git push`）不匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed collapsed search/read group badges duplicating in terminal scrollback during heavy parallel tool use
entries.zh: 修复了在大量并行工具使用期间折叠搜索/读取组徽章在终端回滚中重复的问题

entries.en: Fixed notification `invalidates` not clearing the currently-displayed notification immediately
entries.zh: 修复了通知“无效”未立即清除当前显示的通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt briefly disappearing after submit when background messages arrived during processing
entries.zh: 修复了处理过程中后台消息到达时提交后提示短暂消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Devanagari and other combining-mark text being truncated in assistant output
entries.zh: 修复了梵文和其他组合标记文本在助理输出中被截断的问题

entries.en: Fixed rendering artifacts on main-screen terminals after layout shifts
entries.zh: 修复了布局变化后主屏幕终端上的渲染伪影

entries.en: Fixed voice mode failing to request microphone permission on macOS Apple Silicon
entries.zh: 修复 macOS Apple Silicon 上语音模式无法请求麦克风权限的问题

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Enter submitting instead of inserting a newline on Windows Terminal Preview 1.25
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows Terminal Preview 1.25 上 Shift+Enter 提交而不是插入换行符的问题

entries.en: Fixed periodic UI jitter during streaming in iTerm2 when running inside tmux
entries.zh: 修复了在 tmux 内运行时在 iTerm2 中进行流传输期间的周期性 UI 抖动

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell tool incorrectly reporting failures when commands like `git push` wrote progress to stderr on Windows PowerShell 5.1
entries.zh: 修复了当`git push`等命令在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上将进度写入 stderr 时 PowerShell 工具错误报告失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed a potential out-of-memory crash when the Edit tool was used on very large files (>1 GiB)
entries.zh: 修复了在非常大的文件 (>1 GiB) 上使用编辑工具时可能出现的内存不足崩溃问题

entries.en: Improved collapsed tool summary to show "Listed N directories" for `ls`/`tree`/`du` instead of "Read N files"
entries.zh: 改进折叠的工具摘要：对 `ls`/`tree`/`du` 显示“Listed N directories”（列出了 N 个目录），而不是“Read N files”

entries.en: Improved Bash tool to warn when a formatter/linter command modifies files you have previously read, preventing stale-edit errors
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 工具：格式化或代码检查命令修改了你之前读过的文件时发出警告，避免“过期编辑”错误

entries.en: Improved `@`-mention typeahead to rank source files above MCP resources with similar names
entries.zh: 改进 `@` 提及的输入提示：源代码文件排在名称相近的 MCP 资源之前

entries.en: Improved PowerShell tool prompt with version-appropriate syntax guidance (5.1 vs 7+)
entries.zh: 改进 PowerShell 工具提示：按版本给出对应的语法指导（5.1 与 7+ 不同）

entries.en: Changed `Edit` to work on files viewed via `Bash` with `sed -n` or `cat`, without requiring a separate `Read` call first
entries.zh: 更改了`Edit`以处理通过`Bash`使用`sed -n`或`cat`查看的文件，而不需要先单独调用`Read`

entries.en: Changed hook output over 10,000 characters to be saved to disk with a file path + a 2,000-character preview instead of being injected directly into context
entries.zh: 更改了超过 10,000 个字符的挂钩输出，以使用文件路径 + 2,000 个字符的预览保存到磁盘，而不是直接注入到上下文中

entries.en: Changed `cleanupPeriodDays: 0` in settings.json to be rejected with a validation error — it previously silently disabled transcript persistence
entries.zh: 将 settings.json 中的 `cleanupPeriodDays: 0` 更改为因验证错误而被拒绝 - 它之前默默地禁用了转录持久性

entries.en: Changed thinking summaries to no longer be generated by default in interactive sessions — set `showThinkingSummaries: true` in settings.json to restore
entries.zh: 更改了交互式会话中默认情况下不再生成的思维摘要 - 在 settings.json 中设置 `showThinkingSummaries: true` 来恢复

entries.en: Documented `TaskCreated` hook event and its blocking behavior
entries.zh: 记录了`TaskCreated`挂钩事件及其阻塞行为

entries.en: Preserved task notifications when backgrounding a running command with Ctrl+B
entries.zh: 用 Ctrl+B 把正在运行的命令转入后台时，保留任务通知

entries.en: PowerShell tool on Windows: external-command arguments containing both a double-quote and whitespace now prompt instead of auto-allowing (PS 5.1 argument-splitting hardening)
entries.zh: Windows 上的 PowerShell 工具：外部命令参数中同时含双引号和空白字符时，现在会提示确认，而不是自动放行（PS 5.1 参数拆分加固）

entries.en: `/env` now applies to PowerShell tool commands (previously only affected Bash)
entries.zh: `/env` 现在对 PowerShell 工具命令也生效（此前只影响 Bash）

entries.en: `/usage` now hides redundant "Current week (Sonnet only)" bar for Pro and Enterprise plans
entries.zh: `/usage` 现在会对 Pro 和 Enterprise 套餐隐藏多余的 "Current week (Sonnet only)" 进度条

entries.en: Image paste no longer inserts a trailing space
entries.zh: 粘贴图片后不再多出一个末尾空格

entries.en: Pasting `!command` into an empty prompt now enters bash mode, matching typed `!` behavior
entries.zh: 在空提示中粘贴 `!command` 现在会进入 bash 模式，与手动输入 `!` 的效果一致

entries.en: `/buddy` is here for April 1st — hatch a small creature that watches you code
entries.zh: `/buddy` 为 4 月 1 日愚人节上线：孵化一只会看着你写代码的小生物

entries.en: Fixed messages in Cowork Dispatch not getting delivered
entries.zh: 修复了 Cowork Dispatch 中的消息未送达的问题

entries.en: Added `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id` header to API requests so proxies can aggregate requests by session without parsing the body
entries.zh: 向 API 请求添加了`X-Claude-Code-Session-Id`标头，以便代理可以按会话聚合请求，而无需解析正文

entries.en: Added `.jj` and `.sl` to VCS directory exclusion lists so Grep and file autocomplete don't descend into Jujutsu or Sapling metadata
entries.zh: 将 `.jj` 和 `.sl` 添加到 VCS 目录排除列表，以便 Grep 和文件自动完成不会下降到 Jujutsu 或 Sapling 元数据中

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` failing with "tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks" on sessions created before v2.1.85
entries.zh: 修复了在 v2.1.85 之前创建的会话上`--resume`失败并显示“在没有 tool_result 块的情况下找到 tool_use id”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Write/Edit/Read failing on files outside the project root (e.g., `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`) when conditional skills or rules are configured
entries.zh: 修复了配置条件技能或规则时项目根目录外部文件（例如`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`）的写入/编辑/读取失败问题

entries.en: Fixed unnecessary config disk writes on every skill invocation that could cause performance issues and config corruption on Windows
entries.zh: 修复每次调用技能都会不必要地写入配置文件磁盘，可能导致 Windows 上性能问题和配置损坏的问题

entries.en: Fixed potential out-of-memory crash when using `/feedback` on very long sessions with large transcript files
entries.zh: 修复了在具有大型转录文件的非常长的会话中使用`/feedback`时潜在的内存不足崩溃

entries.en: Fixed `--bare` mode dropping MCP tools in interactive sessions and silently discarding messages enqueued mid-turn
entries.zh: 修复了`--bare`模式在交互式会话中丢弃 MCP 工具并默默丢弃中途排队的消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `c` shortcut copying only ~20 characters of the OAuth login URL instead of the full URL
entries.zh: 修复 `c` 快捷键只复制 OAuth 登录链接前约 20 个字符，而非完整链接的问题

entries.en: Fixed masked input (e.g., OAuth code paste) leaking the start of the token when wrapping across multiple lines on narrow terminals
entries.zh: 修复了在窄终端上跨多行换行时泄漏令牌开头的屏蔽输入（例如，OAuth 代码粘贴）

entries.en: Fixed official marketplace plugin scripts failing with "Permission denied" on macOS/Linux since v2.1.83
entries.zh: 修复了自 v2.1.83 起在 macOS/Linux 上官方市场插件脚本因“权限被拒绝”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed statusline showing another session's model when running multiple Claude Code instances and using `/model` in one of them
entries.zh: 修复了运行多个 Claude Code 实例并在其中一个实例中使用`/model`时显示另一个会话模型的状态行

entries.en: Fixed scroll not following new messages after wheel scroll or click-to-select at the bottom of a long conversation
entries.zh: 修复了滚轮滚动或在长对话底部单击选择后滚动不跟随新消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` uninstall dialog: pressing `n` now correctly uninstalls the plugin while preserving its data directory
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`卸载对话框：按`n`现在可以正确卸载插件，同时保留其数据目录

entries.en: Fixed a regression where pressing Enter after clicking could leave the transcript blank until the response arrived
entries.zh: 修复了单击后按 Enter 可能会使转录文本留空直至响应到达的回归问题

entries.en: Fixed `ultrathink` hint lingering after deleting the keyword
entries.zh: 修复了删除关键字后`ultrathink`提示挥之不去的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory growth in long sessions from markdown/highlight render caches retaining full content strings
entries.zh: 修复了来自降价/突出显示渲染缓存的长会话中的内存增长，保留了完整的内容字符串

entries.en: Reduced startup event-loop stalls when many claude.ai MCP connectors are configured (macOS keychain cache extended from 5s to 30s)
entries.zh: 配置了很多 claude.ai MCP 连接器时，启动时的事件循环卡顿减少（macOS 钥匙串缓存从 5 秒延长到 30 秒）

entries.en: Reduced token overhead when mentioning files with `@` — raw string content no longer JSON-escaped
entries.zh: 用 `@` 提及文件时的 token 开销减少：原始字符串内容不再做 JSON 转义

entries.en: Improved prompt cache hit rate for Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry users by removing dynamic content from tool descriptions
entries.zh: 改进 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 用户的提示缓存命中率：去掉了工具描述中的动态内容

entries.en: Memory filenames in the "Saved N memories" notice now highlight on hover and open on click
entries.zh: 「已保存 N 条记忆」提示中的记忆文件名现在悬停时高亮，点击即可打开

entries.en: Skill descriptions in the `/skills` listing are now capped at 250 characters to reduce context usage
entries.zh: `/skills` 列表中的技能描述上限为 250 个字符，以减少上下文占用

entries.en: Changed `/skills` menu to sort alphabetically for easier scanning
entries.zh: 更改了`/skills`菜单以按字母顺序排序以便于扫描

entries.en: Auto mode now shows "unavailable for your plan" when disabled by plan restrictions (was "temporarily unavailable")
entries.zh: 当因计划限制而禁用时，自动模式现在显示“不可用于您的计划”（“暂时不可用”）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed extension incorrectly showing "Not responding" during long-running operations
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展在长时间运行的操作中错误显示 "Not responding" 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed extension defaulting Max plan users to Sonnet after the OAuth token refreshes (8 hours after login)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 OAuth 令牌刷新后（登录后 8 小时），扩展把 Max 套餐用户默认切换为 Sonnet 的问题

entries.en: Read tool now uses compact line-number format and deduplicates unchanged re-reads, reducing token usage
entries.zh: Read 工具改用紧凑的行号格式，并对未变化的重复读取去重，减少 token 用量

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME` and `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL` environment variables to MCP `headersHelper` scripts, allowing one helper to serve multiple servers
entries.zh: 向 MCP `headersHelper` 脚本添加了 `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME` 和 `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL` 环境变量，允许一个助手为多个服务器提供服务

entries.en: Added conditional `if` field for hooks using permission rule syntax (e.g., `Bash(git *)`) to filter when they run, reducing process spawning overhead
entries.zh: 使用权限规则语法（例如`Bash(git *)`）为钩子添加了条件`if`字段，以在运行时进行过滤，从而减少进程生成开销

entries.en: Added timestamp markers in transcripts when scheduled tasks (`/loop`, `CronCreate`) fire
entries.zh: 当计划任务（`/loop`、`CronCreate`）触发时，在记录中添加了时间戳标记

entries.en: Added trailing space after `[Image #N]` placeholder when pasting images
entries.zh: 粘贴图像时在`[Image #N]`占位符后添加尾随空格

entries.en: Deep link queries (`claude-cli://open?q=…`) now support up to 5,000 characters, with a "scroll to review" warning for long pre-filled prompts
entries.zh: 深层链接查询 (`claude-cli://open?q=…`) 现在支持最多 5,000 个字符，并针对长的预填充提示显示“滚动查看”警告

entries.en: MCP OAuth now follows RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata discovery to find the authorization server
entries.zh: MCP OAuth 现在通过 RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata 发现机制查找授权服务器

entries.en: Plugins blocked by organization policy (`managed-settings.json`) can no longer be installed or enabled, and are hidden from marketplace views
entries.zh: 被组织策略（`managed-settings.json`）屏蔽的插件不能再安装或启用，并会从市场视图中隐藏

entries.en: PreToolUse hooks can now satisfy `AskUserQuestion` by returning `updatedInput` alongside `permissionDecision: "allow"`, enabling headless integrations that collect answers via their own UI
entries.zh: PreToolUse hook 现在可以通过返回 `updatedInput` 并配合 `permissionDecision: "allow"` 来完成 `AskUserQuestion`，使通过自有界面收集答案的无头集成得以实现

entries.en: `tool_parameters` in OpenTelemetry tool_result events are now gated behind `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry 工具结果事件中的 `tool_parameters` 现在需要设置 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` 才会输出

entries.en: Fixed `/compact` failing with "context exceeded" when the conversation has grown too large for the compact request itself to fit
entries.zh: 修复了当对话变得太大而紧凑请求本身无法容纳时`/compact`失败并出现“上下文超出”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin enable` and `/plugin disable` failing when a plugin's install location differs from where it's declared in settings
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的安装位置与其在设置中声明的位置不同时“/plugin启用”和“/plugin禁用”失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree` exiting with an error in non-git repositories before the `WorktreeCreate` hook could run
entries.zh: 修复了在`WorktreeCreate`挂钩运行之前`--worktree`在非 git 存储库中退出并出现错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `deniedMcpServers` setting not blocking claude.ai MCP servers
entries.zh: 修复了`deniedMcpServers`设置不阻止 claude.ai MCP 服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed `switch_display` in the computer-use tool returning "not available in this session" on multi-monitor setups
entries.zh: 修复了计算机使用工具中的`switch_display`在多显示器设置上返回“在此会话中不可用”的问题

entries.en: Fixed crash when `OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER`, `OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER`, or `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER` is set to `none`
entries.zh: 修复了`OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER`、`OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER`或`OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER`设置为`none`时的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed diff syntax highlighting not working in non-native builds
entries.zh: 修复了 diff 语法突出显示在非本机构建中不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP step-up authorization failing when a refresh token exists — servers requesting elevated scopes via `403 insufficient_scope` now correctly trigger the re-authorization flow
entries.zh: 修复了存在刷新令牌时 MCP 升级授权失败的问题 - 通过“403 unavailable_scope”请求提升范围的服务器现在可以正确触发重新授权流程

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in remote sessions when a streaming response is interrupted
entries.zh: 修复了流响应中断时远程会话中的内存泄漏

entries.en: Fixed persistent ECONNRESET errors during edge connection churn by using a fresh TCP connection on retry
entries.zh: 通过在重试时使用新的 TCP 连接，修复了边缘连接流失期间持续存在的 ECONNRESET 错误

entries.en: Fixed prompts getting stuck in the queue after running certain slash commands, with up-arrow unable to retrieve them
entries.zh: 修复了运行某些斜线命令后提示卡在队列中且向上箭头无法检索它们的问题

entries.en: Fixed Python Agent SDK: `type:'sdk'` MCP servers passed via `--mcp-config` are no longer dropped during startup
entries.zh: 修复了 Python Agent SDK：通过 `--mcp-config` 传递的 `type:'sdk'` MCP 服务器在启动期间不再被删除

entries.en: Fixed raw key sequences appearing in the prompt when running over SSH or in the VS Code integrated terminal
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SSH 或 VS Code 集成终端运行时提示中出现的原始按键序列

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control session status staying stuck on "Requires Action" after a permission is resolved
entries.zh: 修复了权限解决后远程控制会话状态停留在“需要操作”的问题

entries.en: Fixed shift+enter and meta+enter being intercepted by typeahead suggestions instead of inserting newlines
entries.zh: 修复了 shift+enter 和 meta+enter 被预输入建议拦截而不是插入换行符的问题

entries.en: Fixed stale content bleeding through when scrolling up during streaming
entries.zh: 修复了在流式传输期间向上滚动时陈旧内容渗漏的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal left in enhanced keyboard mode after exit in Ghostty, Kitty, WezTerm, and other terminals supporting the Kitty keyboard protocol — Ctrl+C and Ctrl+D now work correctly after quitting
entries.zh: 修复在 Ghostty、Kitty、WezTerm 以及其他支持 Kitty 键盘协议的终端中，退出后终端仍停留在增强键盘模式的问题；现在退出后 Ctrl+C 和 Ctrl+D 可正常使用

entries.en: Improved @-mention file autocomplete performance on large repositories
entries.zh: 改进大型仓库中 @ 文件自动补全的性能

entries.en: Improved PowerShell dangerous command detection
entries.zh: 改进 PowerShell 危险命令检测

entries.en: Improved scroll performance with large transcripts by replacing WASM yoga-layout with a pure TypeScript implementation
entries.zh: 改进长转录的滚动性能：用纯 TypeScript 实现替换了 WASM 版 yoga 布局

entries.en: Reduced UI stutter when compaction triggers on large sessions
entries.zh: 会话较大时，压缩上下文时的界面卡顿减少

entries.en: Added PowerShell tool for Windows as an opt-in preview. Learn more at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference#powershell-tool
entries.zh: 添加了适用于 Windows 的 PowerShell 工具作为选择加入预览。了解更多信息 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference#powershell-tool

entries.en: Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL_SUPPORTS` env vars to override effort/thinking capability detection for pinned default models for 3p (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry), and `_MODEL_NAME`/`_DESCRIPTION` to customize the `/model` picker label
entries.zh: 添加了 `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL_SUPPORTS` 环境变量以覆盖 3p（Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry）固定默认模型的努力/思考能力检测，并添加了 `_MODEL_NAME`/`_DESCRIPTION` 以自定义 `/model` 选择器标签

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` env var to configure the streaming idle watchdog threshold (default 90s)
entries.zh: 添加了 `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` 环境变量来配置流空闲看门狗阈值（默认 90 秒）

entries.en: Added `TaskCreated` hook that fires when a task is created via `TaskCreate`
entries.zh: 添加了`TaskCreated`钩子，当通过`TaskCreate`创建任务时会触发该钩子

entries.en: Added `WorktreeCreate` hook support for `type: "http"` — return the created worktree path via `hookSpecificOutput.worktreePath` in the response JSON
entries.zh: 添加了对 `type: "http"` 的 `WorktreeCreate` 钩子支持 — 通过响应 JSON 中的 `hookSpecificOutput.worktreePath` 返回创建的工作树路径

entries.en: Added `allowedChannelPlugins` managed setting for team/enterprise admins to define a channel plugin allowlist
entries.zh: 添加了`allowedChannelPlugins`托管设置，供团队/企业管理员定义通道插件白名单

entries.en: Added `x-client-request-id` header to API requests for debugging timeouts
entries.zh: 在 API 请求中添加了`x-client-request-id`标头以调试超时

entries.en: Added idle-return prompt that nudges users returning after 75+ minutes to `/clear`, reducing unnecessary token re-caching on stale sessions
entries.zh: 添加了空闲返回提示，促使用户在 75 分钟以上后返回`/clear`，从而减少过时会话中不必要的令牌重新缓存

entries.en: Deep links (`claude-cli://`) now open in your preferred terminal instead of whichever terminal happens to be first in the detection list
entries.zh: 深层链接 (`claude-cli://`) 现在在您的首选终端中打开，而不是在检测列表中恰好位于第一个的终端中打开

entries.en: Rules and skills `paths:` frontmatter now accepts a YAML list of globs
entries.zh: 规则和技能的 `paths:` 前置字段现在支持 YAML 列表形式的 glob

entries.en: MCP tool descriptions and server instructions are now capped at 2KB to prevent OpenAPI-generated servers from bloating context
entries.zh: MCP 工具描述和服务器说明现在上限为 2KB，防止由 OpenAPI 生成的服务器占满上下文

entries.en: MCP servers configured both locally and via claude.ai connectors are now deduplicated — the local config wins
entries.zh: 同时在本地和通过 claude.ai 连接器配置的 MCP 服务器现在会去重，以本地配置为准

entries.en: Background bash tasks that appear stuck on an interactive prompt now surface a notification after ~45 seconds
entries.zh: 出现在交互式提示上的后台 bash 任务现在会在约 45 秒后显示通知

entries.en: Token counts ≥1M now display as "1.5m" instead of "1512.6k"
entries.zh: 不小于 1M 的 token 数现在显示为 "1.5m"，而不是 "1512.6k"

entries.en: Global system-prompt caching now works when `ToolSearch` is enabled, including for users with MCP tools configured
entries.zh: 启用 `ToolSearch` 时，全局系统提示缓存现在也能生效，包括配置了 MCP 工具的用户

entries.en: Fixed voice push-to-talk: holding the voice key no longer leaks characters into the text input, and transcripts now insert at the correct position
entries.zh: 修复语音一键通话：长按语音键不再把字符泄漏到文本输入框中，转录内容现在会插入到正确位置

entries.en: Fixed up/down arrow keys being unresponsive when a footer item is focused
entries.zh: 修复页脚项目获得焦点时，上/下方向键无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Ctrl+U` (kill-to-line-start) being a no-op at line boundaries in multiline input, so repeated `Ctrl+U` now clears across lines
entries.zh: 修复了`Ctrl+U`（kill-to-line-start）在多行输入中的行边界处无操作的问题，因此重复的`Ctrl+U`现在可以跨行清除

entries.en: Fixed null-unbinding a default chord binding (e.g. `"ctrl+x ctrl+k": null`) still entering chord-wait mode instead of freeing the prefix key
entries.zh: 修复了空解除绑定默认和弦绑定（例如 `"ctrl+x ctrl+k": null`）仍进入和弦等待模式而不是释放前缀键的问题

entries.en: Fixed mouse events inserting literal "mouse" text into transcript search input
entries.zh: 修复了鼠标事件，将文字“鼠标”文本插入转录搜索输入

entries.en: Fixed workflow subagents failing with API 400 when the outer session uses `--json-schema` and the subagent also specifies a schema
entries.zh: 修复外层会话使用 `--json-schema`，且子智能体也指定了 schema 时，工作流子智能体报 API 400 失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed missing background color behind certain emoji in user message bubbles on some terminals
entries.zh: 修复了某些终端上用户消息气泡中某些表情符号背后缺少背景颜色的问题

entries.en: Fixed the "allow Claude to edit its own settings for this session" permission option not sticking for users with `Edit(.claude)` allow rules
entries.zh: 修复了“允许 Claude 编辑此会话的自己的设置”权限选项不适用于具有“编辑（.claude）”允许规则的用户

entries.en: Fixed a hang when generating attachment snippets for large edited files
entries.zh: 修复了为大型编辑文件生成附件片段时的挂起问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool/resource cache leak on server reconnect
entries.zh: 修复了服务器重新连接时的 MCP 工具/资源缓存泄漏

entries.en: Fixed a startup performance issue where partial clone repositories (Scalar/GVFS) triggered mass blob downloads
entries.zh: 修复了部分克隆存储库 (Scalar/GVFS) 触发大量 Blob 下载的启动性能问题

entries.en: Fixed native terminal cursor not tracking the text input caret, so IME composition (CJK input) now renders inline and screen readers can follow the input position
entries.zh: 修复了本机终端光标不跟踪文本输入插入符的问题，因此 IME 组合（CJK 输入）现在呈现内联，并且屏幕阅读器可以跟随输入位置

entries.en: Fixed spurious "Not logged in" errors on macOS caused by transient keychain read failures
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上因暂时钥匙串读取失败而导致的虚假“未登录”错误

entries.en: Fixed cold-start race where core tools could be deferred without their bypass active, causing Edit/Write to fail with InputValidationError on typed parameters
entries.zh: 修复了冷启动竞赛，其中核心工具可能会在没有激活旁路的情况下被推迟，从而导致编辑/写入失败，并在类型参数上出现 InputValidationError

entries.en: Improved detection for dangerous removals of Windows drive roots (`C:\`, `C:\Windows`, etc.)
entries.zh: 改进对 Windows 驱动器根目录危险删除（如 `C:\`、`C:\Windows`）的检测

entries.en: Improved interactive startup by ~30ms by running `setup()` in parallel with slash command and agent loading
entries.zh: 改进交互式启动：`setup()` 与斜杠命令、agent 的加载并行执行，启动快约 30 毫秒

entries.en: Improved startup for `claude "prompt"` with MCP servers — the REPL now renders immediately instead of blocking until all servers connect
entries.zh: 改进带 MCP 服务器的 `claude "prompt"` 启动：REPL 立即显示，不再等所有服务器连接完成才出现

entries.en: Improved Remote Control to show a specific reason when blocked instead of a generic "not yet enabled" message
entries.zh: 改进远程控制：被阻止时显示具体原因，不再是笼统的“未启用”

entries.en: Improved p90 prompt cache rate
entries.zh: 改进 p90 提示词缓存命中率

entries.en: Reduced scroll-to-top resets in long sessions by making the message window immune to compaction and grouping changes
entries.zh: 通过让消息窗口不受压缩和分组变化影响，长会话中滚动回到顶部的情况减少

entries.en: Reduced terminal flickering when animated tool progress scrolls above the viewport
entries.zh: 动画形式的工具进度滚动到视口上方时，终端闪烁减少

entries.en: Changed issue/PR references to only become clickable links when written as `owner/repo#123` — bare `#123` is no longer auto-linked
entries.zh: 将问题/PR 引用更改为仅在编写为`owner/repo#123`时才变为可点击链接 - 裸露的`#123`不再自动链接

entries.en: Slash commands unavailable for the current auth setup (`/voice`, `/mobile`, `/chrome`, `/upgrade`, etc.) are now hidden instead of shown
entries.zh: 当前认证方式不可用的斜杠命令（如 `/voice`、`/mobile`、`/chrome`、`/upgrade` 等）现在会被隐藏，而不是显示出来

entries.en: [VSCode] Added rate limit warning banner with usage percentage and reset time
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增速率限制警告横幅，显示用量百分比和重置时间

entries.en: Stats screenshot (Ctrl+S in /stats) now works in all builds and is 16× faster
entries.zh: 状态截图（`/stats` 中的 Ctrl+S）现在在所有版本中可用，且速度快了 16 倍

entries.en: Added `managed-settings.d/` drop-in directory alongside `managed-settings.json`, letting separate teams deploy independent policy fragments that merge alphabetically
entries.zh: 添加了`managed-settings.d/`插入目录以及“management-settings.json”，让单独的团队部署按字母顺序合并的独立策略片段

entries.en: Added `CwdChanged` and `FileChanged` hook events for reactive environment management (e.g., direnv)
entries.zh: 添加了用于反应式环境管理的`CwdChanged`和`FileChanged`挂钩事件（例如，direnv）

entries.en: Added `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` setting to exit with an error when sandbox is enabled but cannot start, instead of running unsandboxed
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.failIfUnavailable`设置，以便在启用沙箱但无法启动时退出并显示错误，而不是运行未沙箱的

entries.en: Added `disableDeepLinkRegistration` setting to prevent `claude-cli://` protocol handler registration
entries.zh: 添加了`disableDeepLinkRegistration`设置以防止`claude-cli://`协议处理程序注册

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1` to strip Anthropic and cloud provider credentials from subprocess environments (Bash tool, hooks, MCP stdio servers)
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1`以从子进程环境（Bash 工具、挂钩、MCP stdio 服务器）中剥离 Anthropic 和云提供商凭据

entries.en: Added transcript search — press `/` in transcript mode (`Ctrl+O`) to search, `n`/`N` to step through matches
entries.zh: 添加了转录搜索 - 在转录模式下按`/`（`Ctrl+O`）进行搜索，按`n`/`N`逐步执行匹配

entries.en: Added `Ctrl+X Ctrl+E` as an alias for opening the external editor (readline-native binding; `Ctrl+G` still works)
entries.zh: 添加了`Ctrl+X Ctrl+E`作为打开外部编辑器的别名（readline-native 绑定；`Ctrl+G`仍然有效）

entries.en: Pasted images now insert an `[Image #N]` chip at the cursor so you can reference them positionally in your prompt
entries.zh: 粘贴图片时，光标处会插入一个 `[Image #N]` 标签，便于你在提示中按编号引用

entries.en: Agents can now declare `initialPrompt` in frontmatter to auto-submit a first turn
entries.zh: 代理现在可以在 frontmatter 中声明`initialPrompt`以自动提交第一轮

entries.en: `chat:killAgents` and `chat:fastMode` are now rebindable via `~/.claude/keybindings.json`
entries.zh: `chat:killAgents` 和 `chat:fastMode` 现在可以通过 `~/.claude/keybindings.json` 重新绑定

entries.en: Fixed mouse tracking escape sequences leaking to shell prompt after exit
entries.zh: 修复了退出后鼠标跟踪转义序列泄漏到 shell 提示符的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code hanging on exit on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上退出时挂起的克劳德代码

entries.en: Fixed screen flashing blank after being idle for a few seconds
