entries.zh: 修复闲置几秒后屏幕闪烁的问题

entries.en: Fixed a hang when diffing very large files with few common lines — diffs now time out after 5 seconds and fall back gracefully
entries.zh: 修复了比较非常大的文件与很少公共行时的挂起 - 差异现在在 5 秒后超时并优雅地回退

entries.en: Fixed a 1–8 second UI freeze on startup when voice input was enabled, caused by eagerly loading the native audio module
entries.zh: 修复了启用语音输入时由于急切加载本机音频模块而导致启动时 1-8 秒 UI 冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed a startup regression where Claude Code would wait ~3s for claude.ai MCP config fetch before proceeding
entries.zh: 修复了启动回归问题，其中 Claude Code 在继续之前会等待 claude.ai MCP 配置获取约 3 秒

entries.en: Fixed `--mcp-config` CLI flag bypassing `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` managed policy enforcement
entries.zh: 修复了绕过`allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers`托管策略实施的`--mcp-config` CLI 标志

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai MCP connectors (Slack, Gmail, etc.) not being available in single-turn `--print` mode
entries.zh: 修复了 claude.ai MCP 连接器（Slack、Gmail 等）在单轮`--print`模式下不可用的问题

entries.en: Fixed `caffeinate` process not properly terminating when Claude Code exits, preventing Mac from sleeping
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 退出时`caffeinate`进程无法正确终止，从而阻止 Mac 休眠的问题

entries.en: Fixed bash mode not activating when tab-accepting `!`-prefixed command suggestions
entries.zh: 修复了在接受带有`!`前缀的命令建议时未激活 bash 模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed stale slash command selection showing wrong highlighted command after navigating suggestions
entries.zh: 修复了过时的斜杠命令选择在导航建议后显示错误的突出显示命令

entries.en: Fixed `/config` menu showing both the search cursor and list selection at the same time
entries.zh: 修复了同时显示搜索光标和列表选择的`/config`菜单

entries.en: Fixed background subagents becoming invisible after context compaction, which could cause duplicate agents to be spawned
entries.zh: 修复了背景子代理在上下文压缩后变得不可见的问题，这可能会导致生成重复的代理

entries.en: Fixed background agent tasks staying stuck in "running" state when git or API calls hang during cleanup
entries.zh: 修复了清理期间 git 或 API 调用挂起时后台代理任务停留在“运行”状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--channels` showing "Channels are not currently available" on first launch after upgrade
entries.zh: 修复了`--channels`在升级后首次启动时显示“频道当前不可用”的问题

entries.en: Fixed uninstalled plugin hooks continuing to fire until the next session
entries.zh: 修复已卸载插件的钩子在下次会话前仍继续触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed queued commands flickering during streaming responses
entries.zh: 修复了流响应期间排队命令闪烁的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash commands being sent to the model as text when submitted while a message is processing
entries.zh: 修复了在处理消息时提交的斜杠命令作为文本发送到模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed scrollback jumping when collapsed read/search groups finish after scrolling offscreen
entries.zh: 修复了滚动到屏幕外后折叠的读取/搜索组完成时的回滚跳跃问题

entries.en: Fixed scrollback jumping to top when the model starts or stops thinking
entries.zh: 修复了当模型开始或停止思考时回滚跳到顶部的问题

entries.en: Fixed SDK session history loss on resume caused by hook progress/attachment messages forking the parentUuid chain
entries.zh: 修复了因分叉 ParentUuid 链的钩子进度/附件消息而导致恢复时 SDK 会话历史记录丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed copy-on-select not firing when you release the mouse outside the terminal window
entries.zh: 修复了在终端窗口外释放鼠标时选择复制不会触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed ghost characters appearing in height-constrained lists when items overflow
entries.zh: 修复了项目溢出时高度受限列表中出现的幽灵字符

entries.en: Fixed `Ctrl+B` interfering with readline backward-char at an idle prompt — it now only fires when a foreground task can be backgrounded
entries.zh: 修复了`Ctrl+B`在空闲提示下干扰 readline back-char — 现在仅当前台任务可以后台运行时才会触发

entries.en: Fixed tool result files never being cleaned up, ignoring the `cleanupPeriodDays` setting
entries.zh: 修复工具结果文件从未被清理、忽略 `cleanupPeriodDays` 设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed space key being swallowed for up to 3 seconds after releasing voice hold-to-talk
entries.zh: 修复了释放语音保持通话后空格键被吞咽长达 3 秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed ALSA library errors corrupting the terminal UI when using voice mode on Linux without audio hardware (Docker, headless, WSL1)
entries.zh: 修复了在没有音频硬件（Docker、headless、WSL1）的 Linux 上使用语音模式时损坏终端 UI 的 ALSA 库错误

entries.en: Fixed voice mode SoX detection on Termux/Android where spawning `which` is kernel-restricted
entries.zh: 修复 Termux/Android 上语音模式 SoX 检测失败的问题，因为其内核限制了 `which` 的启动

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions showing as Idle in the web session list while actively running
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话在主动运行时在 Web 会话列表中显示为空闲的问题

entries.en: Fixed footer navigation selecting an invisible Remote Control pill in config-driven mode
entries.zh: 修复了页脚导航在配置驱动模式下选择不可见的远程控制药丸的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in remote sessions where tool use IDs accumulate indefinitely
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话中工具使用 ID 无限期累积的内存泄漏问题

entries.en: Improved Bedrock SDK cold-start latency by overlapping profile fetch with other boot work
entries.zh: 改进 Bedrock SDK 冷启动延迟：配置文件获取与其他启动工作并行进行

entries.en: Improved `--resume` memory usage and startup latency on large sessions
entries.zh: 改进 `--resume` 在大型会话中的内存占用和启动延迟

entries.en: Improved plugin startup — commands, skills, and agents now load from disk cache without re-fetching
entries.zh: 改进插件启动：命令、技能和智能体现在直接从磁盘缓存加载，无需重新获取

entries.en: Improved Remote Control session titles: AI-generated titles now appear within seconds of the first message
entries.zh: 改进远程控制会话标题：AI 生成的标题在第一条消息后几秒内就会出现

entries.en: Improved `WebFetch` to identify as `Claude-User` so site operators can recognize and allowlist Claude Code traffic via `robots.txt`
entries.zh: 改进 `WebFetch`：以 `Claude-User` 身份发出请求，网站运营者可以通过 `robots.txt` 识别 Claude Code 的流量并加入白名单

entries.en: Reduced `WebFetch` peak memory usage for large pages
entries.zh: 大页面下 `WebFetch` 的峰值内存占用降低

entries.en: Reduced scrollback resets in long sessions from once per turn to once per ~50 messages
entries.zh: 长会话中回滚缓冲区的重置频率，从每轮一次降为约每 50 条消息一次

entries.en: Faster `claude -p` startup with unauthenticated HTTP/SSE MCP servers (~600ms saved)
entries.zh: 使用未经身份验证的 HTTP/SSE MCP 服务器更快地启动`claude -p`（节省约 600 毫秒）

entries.en: Bash ghost-text suggestions now include just-submitted commands immediately
entries.zh: Bash 幽灵文本建议现在立即包括刚刚提交的命令

entries.en: Increased non-streaming fallback token cap (21k → 64k) and timeout (120s → 300s local) so fallback requests are less likely to be truncated
entries.zh: 提高非流式回退的 token 上限（21k 提高到 64k）和超时时间（本地从 120 秒提高到 300 秒），降低回退请求被截断的可能

entries.en: Interrupting a prompt before any response now automatically restores your input so you can edit and resubmit
entries.zh: 在收到任何回复之前打断提示，会自动恢复你的输入内容，方便你修改后重新提交

entries.en: `/status` now works while Claude is responding, instead of being queued until the turn finishes
entries.zh: Claude 回复时也能运行 `/status`，不再排队等待轮次结束

entries.en: Plugin MCP servers that duplicate an org-managed connector are now suppressed instead of running a second connection
entries.zh: 与组织托管连接器重复的插件 MCP 服务器现在会被屏蔽，不再额外建立第二个连接

entries.en: Linux: respect `XDG_DATA_HOME` when registering the `claude-cli://` protocol handler
entries.zh: Linux：注册 `claude-cli://` 协议处理器时遵循 `XDG_DATA_HOME`

entries.en: Changed "stop all background agents" keybinding from `Ctrl+F` to `Ctrl+X Ctrl+K` to stop shadowing readline forward-char
entries.zh: 将“停止所有后台代理”键绑定从`Ctrl+F`更改为`Ctrl+X Ctrl+K`以停止隐藏 readline 前向字符

entries.en: Deprecated `TaskOutput` tool in favor of using `Read` on the background task's output file path
entries.zh: 已弃用`TaskOutput`工具，转而在后台任务的输出文件路径上使用`Read`

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK` env var to disable the non-streaming fallback when streaming fails
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK`环境变量以在流式传输失败时禁用非流式回退

entries.en: Plugin options (`manifest.userConfig`) now available externally — plugins can prompt for configuration at enable time, with `sensitive: true` values stored in keychain (macOS) or protected credentials file (other platforms)
entries.zh: 插件选项（`manifest.userConfig`）现已对外开放：插件可在启用时提示用户进行配置，标记为 `sensitive: true` 的值会存入钥匙串（macOS）或受保护的凭证文件（其他平台）

entries.en: Claude can now reference the on-disk path of clipboard-pasted images for file operations
entries.zh: Claude 现在可以引用剪贴板粘贴图像的磁盘路径进行文件操作

entries.en: `Ctrl+L` now clears the screen and forces a full redraw — use this to recover when Cmd+K leaves the UI partially blank. Use `Ctrl+U` or double-Esc to clear prompt input.
entries.zh: `Ctrl+L` 现在会清屏并强制完整重绘——如果 Cmd+K 导致界面部分空白，可用它恢复。清空提示输入请用 `Ctrl+U` 或连按两次 Esc。

entries.en: `--bare -p` (SDK pattern) is ~14% faster to the API request
entries.zh: `--bare -p`（SDK 用法）发出 API 请求的速度快约 14%

entries.en: Memory: `MEMORY.md` index now truncates at 25KB as well as 200 lines
entries.zh: 记忆：`MEMORY.md` 索引现在除了 200 行上限外，还会在 25KB 处截断

entries.en: Disabled `AskUserQuestion` and plan-mode tools when `--channels` is active
entries.zh: 当`--channels`处于活动状态时禁用`AskUserQuestion`和计划模式工具

entries.en: Fixed API 400 error when a pasted image was queued during a failing tool call
entries.zh: 修复了工具调用失败期间粘贴的图像排队时出现的 API 400 错误

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls hanging indefinitely when an SSE connection drops mid-call and exhausts its reconnection attempts
entries.zh: 修复了当 SSE 连接在呼叫中断开并耗尽其重新连接尝试时 MCP 工具呼叫无限期挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control session titles showing raw XML when a background agent completed before the first user message
entries.zh: 修复了当后台代理在第一条用户消息之前完成时显示原始 XML 的远程控制会话标题

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions forgetting conversation history after a container restart due to progress-message gaps in the resumed transcript chain
entries.zh: 修复了由于恢复的转录链中的进度消息间隙导致容器重新启动后远程会话忘记对话历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote sessions requiring re-login on transient auth errors instead of retrying automatically
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话在出现短暂身份验证错误时需要重新登录而不是自动重试的问题

entries.en: Fixed `rg ... | wc -l` and similar piped commands hanging and returning `0` in sandbox mode on Linux
entries.zh: 修复了`rg ... | wc -l` 和类似的管道命令在 Linux 上的沙箱模式下挂起并返回`0`

entries.en: Fixed voice input hold-to-talk not activating when a CJK IME inserts a full-width space
entries.zh: 修复中日韩输入法插入全角空格时，语音输入的长按说话不能激活的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree` hanging silently when the worktree name contained a forward slash
entries.zh: 修复了当工作树名称包含正斜杠时`--worktree`静默挂起的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Spinner now turns red with "Not responding" when the backend hasn't responded for 60 seconds
entries.zh: [VSCode] 当后端 60 秒没有响应时，加载动画会变红并显示 "Not responding"

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed session history not loading correctly when reopening a session via URL or after restart
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复通过 URL 或重启后重新打开会话时，会话历史无法正确加载的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Added Esc-twice (or `/rewind`) to open a keyboard-navigable rewind picker
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增按两次 Esc（或输入 `/rewind`）打开可用键盘导航的回退选择器

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Fork conversation from here" and rewind actions failing silently after the session cache goes stale
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复会话缓存过期后，"Fork conversation from here" 和回退操作静默失败的问题

entries.en: Added `--bare` flag for scripted `-p` calls — skips hooks, LSP, plugin sync, and skill directory walks; requires `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an `apiKeyHelper` via `--settings` (OAuth and keychain auth disabled); auto-memory fully disabled
entries.zh: 为脚本化的`-p`调用添加了`--bare`标志——跳过钩子、LSP、插件同步和技能目录遍历；需要通过`--settings`设置`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`或`apiKeyHelper`（禁用 OAuth 和钥匙串身份验证）；自动记忆功能完全禁用

entries.en: Added `--channels` permission relay — channel servers that declare the permission capability can forward tool approval prompts to your phone
entries.zh: 添加了`--channels`权限中继 - 声明权限功能的通道服务器可以将工具批准提示转发到您的手机

entries.en: Fixed multiple concurrent Claude Code sessions requiring repeated re-authentication when one session refreshes its OAuth token
entries.zh: 修复了多个并发 Claude Code 会话在一个会话刷新其 OAuth 令牌时需要重复重新身份验证的问题

entries.en: Fixed voice mode silently swallowing retry failures and showing a misleading "check your network" message instead of the actual error
entries.zh: 修复语音模式静默吞掉重试失败，并显示误导性的"检查网络"信息而非实际错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed voice mode audio not recovering when the server silently drops the WebSocket connection
entries.zh: 修复服务器静默断开 WebSocket 连接后，语音模式音频无法恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not suppressing the structured-outputs beta header, causing 400 errors on proxy gateways forwarding to Vertex/Bedrock
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS`不抑制结构化输出 beta 标头，导致转发到 Vertex/Bedrock 的代理网关上出现 400 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--channels` bypass for Team/Enterprise orgs with no other managed settings configured
entries.zh: 修复了未配置其他托管设置的团队/企业组织的`--channels`绕过问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash on Node.js 18
entries.zh: 修复了 Node.js 18 上的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed unnecessary permission prompts for Bash commands containing dashes in strings
entries.zh: 修复 Bash 命令的字符串中含有连字符时，出现不必要的权限提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin hooks blocking prompt submission when the plugin directory is deleted mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中删除插件目录时插件挂钩阻止提示提交的问题

entries.en: Fixed a race condition where background agent task output could hang indefinitely when the task completed between polling intervals
entries.zh: 修复了当任务在轮询间隔之间完成时后台代理任务输出可能无限期挂起的竞争条件

entries.en: Resuming a session that was in a worktree now switches back to that worktree
entries.zh: 恢复一个在 worktree 中的会话时，现在会切换回该 worktree

entries.en: Fixed `/btw` not including pasted text when used during an active response
entries.zh: 修复了在主动响应期间使用时不包括粘贴文本的`/btw`

entries.en: Fixed a race where fast Cmd+Tab followed by paste could beat the clipboard copy under tmux
entries.zh: 修复了快速 Cmd+Tab 后粘贴可以击败 tmux 下的剪贴板副本的竞赛

entries.en: Fixed terminal tab title not updating with an auto-generated session description
entries.zh: 修复终端标签页标题不会随自动生成的会话描述更新的问题

entries.en: Fixed invisible hook attachments inflating the message count in transcript mode
entries.zh: 修复了隐形钩子附件在转录模式下夸大消息计数的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions showing a generic title instead of deriving from the first prompt
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制会话显示通用标题而不是源自第一个提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` not syncing the title for Remote Control sessions
entries.zh: 修复了`/rename`不同步远程控制会话的标题的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control `/exit` not reliably archiving the session
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制`/exit`无法可靠地存档会话的问题

entries.en: Improved MCP read/search tool calls to collapse into a single "Queried {server}" line (expand with Ctrl+O)
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 读取和搜索工具调用：合并为一行“Queried {server}”（按 Ctrl+O 展开）

entries.en: Improved `!` bash mode discoverability — Claude now suggests it when you need to run an interactive command
entries.zh: 改进 `!` bash 模式的可发现性：需要运行交互式命令时，Claude 会主动建议使用

entries.en: Improved plugin freshness — ref-tracked plugins now re-clone on every load to pick up upstream changes
entries.zh: 改进插件新鲜度：按引用跟踪的插件每次加载时都会重新克隆，以获取上游更新

entries.en: Improved Remote Control session titles to refresh after your third message
entries.zh: 改进远程控制会话标题：你发出第三条消息后刷新

entries.en: Updated MCP OAuth to support Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD / SEP-991) for servers without Dynamic Client Registration
entries.zh: MCP OAuth 现在支持 Client ID Metadata Document（CIMD / SEP-991），适用于不支持动态客户端注册的服务器

entries.en: Changed plan mode to hide the "clear context" option by default (restore with `"showClearContextOnPlanAccept": true`)
entries.zh: 更改计划模式以默认隐藏“清除上下文”选项（使用“showClearContextOnPlanAccept”恢复：true）

entries.en: Disabled line-by-line response streaming on Windows (including WSL in Windows Terminal) due to rendering issues
entries.zh: 由于渲染问题，在 Windows 上禁用逐行响应流（包括 Windows 终端中的 WSL）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Windows PATH inheritance for Bash tool when using Git Bash (regression in v2.1.78)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复使用 Git Bash 时 Bash 工具的 Windows PATH 继承问题（v2.1.78 中的回归问题）

entries.en: Added `rate_limits` field to statusline scripts for displaying Claude.ai rate limit usage (5-hour and 7-day windows with `used_percentage` and `resets_at`)
entries.zh: 在状态行脚本中添加了`rate_limits`字段，用于显示 Claude.ai 速率限制使用情况（带有`used_percentage`和`resets_at`的 5 小时和 7 天窗口）

entries.en: Added `source: 'settings'` plugin marketplace source — declare plugin entries inline in settings.json
entries.zh: 添加了 `source: 'settings'` 插件市场源 — 在 settings.json 中内嵌声明插件条目

entries.en: Added CLI tool usage detection to plugin tips, in addition to file pattern matching
entries.zh: 除了文件模式匹配之外，还为插件提示添加了 CLI 工具使用情况检测

entries.en: Added `effort` frontmatter support for skills and slash commands to override the model effort level when invoked
entries.zh: 添加了对技能和斜杠命令的“努力”frontmatter 支持，以在调用时覆盖模型努力水平

entries.en: Added `--channels` (research preview) — allow MCP servers to push messages into your session
entries.zh: 添加了`--channels`（研究预览）——允许 MCP 服务器将消息推送到您的会话中

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` dropping parallel tool results — sessions with parallel tool calls now restore all tool_use/tool_result pairs instead of showing `[Tool result missing]` placeholders
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`删除并行工具结果的问题 - 具有并行工具调用的会话现在恢复所有 tool_use/tool_result 对，而不是显示“[工具结果丢失]”占位符

entries.en: Fixed voice mode WebSocket failures caused by Cloudflare bot detection on non-browser TLS fingerprints
entries.zh: 修复非浏览器 TLS 指纹被 Cloudflare 机器人检测拦截，导致语音模式 WebSocket 失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed 400 errors when using fine-grained tool streaming through API proxies, Bedrock, or Vertex
entries.zh: 修复了通过 API 代理、Bedrock 或 Vertex 使用细粒度工具流时的 400 个错误

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` appearing for gateway and third-party provider deployments where it cannot function
entries.zh: 修复了网关和第三方提供商部署中出现的`/remote-control`无法运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/sandbox` tab switching not responding to Tab or arrow keys
entries.zh: 修复了`/sandbox`选项卡切换不响应 Tab 或箭头键的问题

entries.en: Improved responsiveness of `@` file autocomplete in large git repositories
entries.zh: 改进大型 git 仓库中 `@` 文件自动补全的响应速度

entries.en: Improved `/effort` to show what auto currently resolves to, matching the status bar indicator
entries.zh: 改进 `/effort`：显示 auto 当前实际解析为哪个级别，与状态栏指示一致

entries.en: Improved `/permissions` — Tab and arrow keys now switch tabs from within a list
entries.zh: 改进 `/permissions`：在列表内按 Tab 和方向键即可切换标签页

entries.en: Improved background tasks panel — left arrow now closes from the list view
entries.zh: 改进后台任务面板：在列表视图中按左方向键即可关闭

entries.en: Simplified plugin install tips to use a single `/plugin install` command instead of a two-step flow
entries.zh: 插件安装提示简化为一条 `/plugin install` 命令，不再是两步流程

entries.en: Reduced memory usage on startup in large repositories (~80 MB saved on 250k-file repos)
entries.zh: 大型代码仓库的启动内存占用降低（25 万文件的仓库节省约 80 MB）

entries.en: Fixed managed settings (`enabledPlugins`, `permissions.defaultMode`, policy-set env vars) not being applied at startup when `remote-settings.json` was cached from a prior session
entries.zh: 修复了当从先前会话缓存`remote-settings.json`时，启动时未应用托管设置（`enabledPlugins`、`permissions.defaultMode`、策略集环境变量）

entries.en: Added `--console` flag to `claude auth login` for Anthropic Console (API billing) authentication
entries.zh: 在`claude auth login`中添加了`--console`标志，以进行 Anthropic 控制台（API 计费）身份验证

entries.en: Added "Show turn duration" toggle to the `/config` menu
entries.zh: 在 `/config` 菜单中添加了“显示回合持续时间”开关

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` hanging when spawned as a subprocess without explicit stdin (e.g. Python `subprocess.run`)
entries.zh: 修复了在没有显式 stdin 的情况下作为子进程生成时`claude -p`挂起的问题（例如 Python`subprocess.run`）

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C not working in `-p` (print) mode
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+C 在`-p`（打印）模式下不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/btw` returning the main agent's output instead of answering the side question when triggered during streaming
entries.zh: 修复了在流媒体期间触发时返回主代理的输出而不是回答附带问题的`/btw`

entries.en: Fixed voice mode not activating correctly on startup when `voiceEnabled: true` is set
entries.zh: 修复设置了 `voiceEnabled: true` 后，语音模式在启动时无法正确激活的问题

entries.en: Fixed left/right arrow tab navigation in `/permissions`
entries.zh: 修复了`/permissions`中的左/右箭头选项卡导航

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` not preventing terminal title from being set on startup
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE`不阻止在启动时设置终端标题的问题

entries.en: Fixed custom status line showing nothing when workspace trust is blocking it
entries.zh: 修复了当工作区信任阻止自定义状态行时不显示任何内容的问题

entries.en: Fixed enterprise users being unable to retry on rate limit (429) errors
entries.zh: 修复了企业用户因速率限制 (429) 错误而无法重试的问题

entries.en: Fixed `SessionEnd` hooks not firing when using interactive `/resume` to switch sessions
entries.zh: 修复了使用交互式`/resume`切换会话时`SessionEnd`挂钩未触发的问题

entries.en: Improved startup memory usage by ~18MB across all scenarios
entries.zh: 改进启动内存占用：所有场景下约减少 18MB

entries.en: Improved non-streaming API fallback with a 2-minute per-attempt timeout, preventing sessions from hanging indefinitely
entries.zh: 改进非流式 API 回退：每次尝试设置 2 分钟超时，防止会话无限期挂起

entries.en: `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` now supports multiple seed directories separated by the platform path delimiter (`:` on Unix, `;` on Windows)
entries.zh: `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` 现在支持多个种子目录，用平台路径分隔符分开（Unix 上为 `:`，Windows 上为 `;`）

entries.en: [VSCode] Added `/remote-control` — bridge your session to claude.ai/code to continue from a browser or phone
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增 `/remote-control`，可将你的会话连接到 claude.ai/code，以便在浏览器或手机上继续

entries.en: [VSCode] Session tabs now get AI-generated titles based on your first message
entries.zh: [VSCode] 会话标签页现在会根据你的第一条消息由 AI 自动生成标题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the thinking pill showing "Thinking" instead of "Thought for Ns" after a response completes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复回复完成后，思考标签显示 "Thinking"、而不是 "Thought for Ns" 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed missing session diff button when opening sessions from the left sidebar
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复从左侧边栏打开会话时，缺少会话差异按钮的问题

entries.en: Added `StopFailure` hook event that fires when the turn ends due to an API error (rate limit, auth failure, etc.)
entries.zh: 添加了`StopFailure`挂钩事件，该事件在回合由于 API 错误（速率限制、身份验证失败等）而结束时触发

entries.en: Added `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}` variable for plugin persistent state that survives plugin updates; `/plugin uninstall` prompts before deleting it
entries.zh: 添加了`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}`变量，用于在插件更新后仍然存在的插件持久状态；删除前提示`/plugin uninstall`

entries.en: Added `effort`, `maxTurns`, and `disallowedTools` frontmatter support for plugin-shipped agents
entries.zh: 为插件提供的代理添加了 `effort`、`maxTurns` 和 `disallowedTools` frontmatter 支持

entries.en: Terminal notifications (iTerm2/Kitty/Ghostty popups, progress bar) now reach the outer terminal when running inside tmux with `set -g allow-passthrough on`
entries.zh: 在 tmux 中运行时，只要设置 `set -g allow-passthrough on`，终端通知（iTerm2/Kitty/Ghostty 弹窗、进度条）就能送达外层终端

entries.en: Response text now streams line-by-line as it's generated
entries.zh: 回复文本现在会在生成时逐行流式显示

entries.en: Fixed `git log HEAD` failing with "ambiguous argument" inside sandboxed Bash on Linux, and stub files polluting `git status` in the working directory
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上沙盒 Bash 中`git log HEAD`因“模糊参数”而失败，以及存根文件污染工作目录中的`git status`的问题

entries.en: Fixed `cc log` and `--resume` silently truncating conversation history on large sessions (>5 MB) that used subagents
entries.zh: 修复了使用子代理的大型会话 (>5 MB) 上的`cc log`和`--resume`静默截断对话历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed infinite loop when API errors triggered stop hooks that re-fed blocking errors to the model
entries.zh: 修复了当 API 错误触发停止钩子时的无限循环，该停止钩子将阻塞错误重新馈送到模型

entries.en: Fixed `deny: ["mcp__servername"]` permission rules not removing MCP server tools before sending to the model, allowing it to see and attempt blocked tools
entries.zh: 修复了 `deny: ["mcp__servername"]` 权限规则，在发送到模型之前不会删除 MCP 服务器工具，从而允许其查看并尝试阻止的工具

entries.en: Fixed `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite` not working with absolute paths (previously required `//` prefix)
entries.zh: 修复了`sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite`不适用于绝对路径（之前需要`//`前缀）

entries.en: Fixed `/sandbox` Dependencies tab showing Linux prerequisites on macOS instead of macOS-specific info
entries.zh: 修复了`/sandbox`“依赖项”选项卡，显示 macOS 上的 Linux 先决条件，而不是 macOS 特定的信息

entries.en: **Security:** Fixed silent sandbox disable when `sandbox.enabled: true` is set but dependencies are missing — now shows a visible startup warning
entries.zh: **安全性：** 修复了设置`sandbox.enabled: true`但缺少依赖项时静默沙箱禁用的问题 - 现在显示可见的启动警告

entries.en: Fixed `.git`, `.claude`, and other protected directories being writable without a prompt in `bypassPermissions` mode
entries.zh: 修复了`.git`、`.claude`和其他受保护目录在`bypassPermissions`模式下可写且无提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed ctrl+u in normal mode scrolling instead of readline kill-line (ctrl+u/ctrl+d half-page scroll moved to transcript mode only)
entries.zh: 修复了正常模式滚动中的 ctrl+u 而不是 readlinekill-line（ctrl+u/ctrl+d 半页滚动仅移至转录模式）

entries.en: Fixed voice mode modifier-combo push-to-talk keybindings (e.g. ctrl+k) requiring a hold instead of activating immediately
entries.zh: 修复一键通话的组合修饰键绑定（如 ctrl+k）需要长按才能激活、无法立即生效的问题

entries.en: Fixed voice mode not working on WSL2 with WSLg (Windows 11); WSL1/Win10 users now get a clear error
entries.zh: 修复 Windows 11 上 WSL2 与 WSLg 中语音模式无法工作的问题；WSL1 和 Win10 用户现在会收到明确错误

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree` flag not loading skills and hooks from the worktree directory
entries.zh: 修复了`--worktree`标志未从工作树目录加载技能和挂钩的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` and `includeGitInstructions` setting not suppressing the git status section in the system prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` 和 `includeGitInstructions` 设置不抑制系统提示中的 git status 部分

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool not finding Homebrew and other PATH-dependent binaries when VS Code is launched from Dock/Spotlight
entries.zh: 修复了从 Dock/Spotlight 启动 VS Code 时 Bash 工具找不到 Homebrew 和其他依赖于 PATH 的二进制文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed washed-out Claude orange color in VS Code/Cursor/code-server terminals that don't advertise truecolor support
entries.zh: 修复在不声明支持 truecolor 的 VS Code/Cursor/code-server 终端中，Claude 橙色显示褪色的问题

entries.en: Added `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION` env var to add a custom entry to the `/model` picker, with optional `_NAME` and `_DESCRIPTION` suffixed vars for display
entries.zh: 添加了`ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION`环境变量以将自定义条目添加到`/model`选择器，并带有可选的`_NAME`和`_DESCRIPTION`后缀变量用于显示

entries.en: Fixed `ANTHROPIC_BETAS` environment variable being silently ignored when using Haiku models
entries.zh: 修复了使用俳句模型时`ANTHROPIC_BETAS`环境变量被默默忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed queued prompts being concatenated without a newline separator
entries.zh: 修复了在没有换行符的情况下连接排队提示的问题

entries.en: Improved memory usage and startup time when resuming large sessions
entries.zh: 改进恢复大型会话时的内存占用和启动时间

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a brief flash of the login screen when opening the sidebar while already authenticated
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复已登录状态下打开侧边栏时，登录界面短暂闪现的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "API Error: Rate limit reached" when selecting Opus — model dropdown no longer offers 1M context variant to subscribers whose plan tier is unknown
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复选择 Opus 时出现 "API Error: Rate limit reached" 的问题：当套餐等级未知时，模型下拉菜单不再向订阅用户提供 1M 上下文版本

entries.en: Increased default maximum output token limits for Claude Opus 4.6 to 64k tokens, and the upper bound for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 models to 128k tokens
entries.zh: 将 Claude Opus 4.6 的默认最大输出 token 上限提高到 64k，Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 模型的上限提高到 128k

entries.en: Added `allowRead` sandbox filesystem setting to re-allow read access within `denyRead` regions
entries.zh: 添加了`allowRead`沙箱文件系统设置以重新允许`denyRead`区域内的读取访问

entries.en: `/copy` now accepts an optional index: `/copy N` copies the Nth-latest assistant response
entries.zh: `/copy` 现在可接受可选序号：`/copy N` 会复制倒数第 N 条 assistant 回复

entries.en: Fixed "Always Allow" on compound bash commands (e.g. `cd src && npm test`) saving a single rule for the full string instead of per-subcommand, leading to dead rules and repeated permission prompts
entries.zh: 修复了复合 bash 命令（例如 `cd src && npm test`）上的“始终允许”，为完整字符串而不是每个子命令保存单个规则，导致死规则和重复的权限提示

entries.en: Fixed auto-updater starting overlapping binary downloads when the slash-command overlay repeatedly opened and closed, accumulating tens of gigabytes of memory
entries.zh: 修复了当斜杠命令覆盖重复打开和关闭时自动更新程序开始重叠二进制下载，累积数十 GB 内存的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` silently truncating recent conversation history due to a race between memory-extraction writes and the main transcript
entries.zh: 修复了由于内存提取写入和主记录之间的竞争而导致`--resume`默默截断最近的对话历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed PreToolUse hooks returning `"allow"` bypassing `deny` permission rules, including enterprise managed settings
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse 挂钩绕过“拒绝”权限规则返回“允许”的问题，包括企业托管设置

entries.en: Fixed Write tool silently converting line endings when overwriting CRLF files or creating files in CRLF directories
entries.zh: 修复了写入工具在覆盖 CRLF 文件或在 CRLF 目录中创建文件时以静默方式转换行结尾的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory growth in long-running sessions from progress messages surviving compaction
entries.zh: 修复了长期运行会话中因压缩中幸存的进度消息而导致的内存增长问题

entries.en: Fixed cost and token usage not being tracked when the API falls back to non-streaming mode
entries.zh: 修复了当 API 回退到非流模式时无法跟踪成本和令牌使用情况的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not stripping beta tool-schema fields, causing proxy gateways to reject requests
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS`不剥离测试工具架构字段，导致代理网关拒绝请求的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool reporting errors for successful commands when the system temp directory path contains spaces
entries.zh: 修复了当系统临时目录路径包含空格时 Bash 工具报告成功命令的错误

entries.en: Fixed paste being lost when typing immediately after pasting
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴后立即输入时粘贴丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+D in `/feedback` text input deleting forward instead of the second press exiting the session
entries.zh: 修复了`/feedback`文本输入中的 Ctrl+D 向前删除而不是按第二次退出会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed API error when dragging a 0-byte image file into the prompt
entries.zh: 修复了将 0 字节图像文件拖入提示时出现的 API 错误

entries.en: Fixed Claude Desktop sessions incorrectly using the terminal CLI's configured API key instead of OAuth
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Desktop 会话错误地使用终端 CLI 配置的 API 密钥而不是 OAuth 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `git-subdir` plugins at different subdirectories of the same monorepo commit colliding in the plugin cache
entries.zh: 修复了同一 monorepo 提交的不同子目录中的`git-subdir`插件在插件缓存中发生冲突的问题

entries.en: Fixed ordered list numbers not rendering in terminal UI
entries.zh: 修复了终端 UI 中未呈现的有序列表编号

entries.en: Fixed a race condition where stale-worktree cleanup could delete an agent worktree just resumed from a previous crash
entries.zh: 修复了一个竞争条件，其中陈旧工作树清理可能会删除刚刚从上次崩溃中恢复的代理工作树

entries.en: Fixed input deadlock when opening `/mcp` or similar dialogs while the agent is running
entries.zh: 修复了代理运行时打开`/mcp`或类似对话框时的输入死锁

entries.en: Fixed Backspace and Delete keys not working in vim NORMAL mode
entries.zh: 修复了退格键和删除键在 vim NORMAL 模式下不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed status line not updating when vim mode is toggled on or off
entries.zh: 修复了打开或关闭 vim 模式时状态行不更新的问题

entries.en: Fixed hyperlinks opening twice on Cmd+click in VS Code, Cursor, and other xterm.js-based terminals
entries.zh: 修复了在 VS Code、Cursor 和其他基于 xterm.js 的终端中，在 Cmd+click 上打开两次超链接的问题

entries.en: Fixed background colors rendering as terminal-default inside tmux with default configuration
entries.zh: 修复了使用默认配置在 tmux 内将背景颜色渲染为终端默认的问题

entries.en: Fixed iTerm2 session crash when selecting text inside tmux over SSH
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SSH 在 tmux 内选择文本时 iTerm2 会话崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed clipboard copy silently failing in tmux sessions; copy toast now indicates whether to paste with `⌘V` or tmux `prefix+]`
entries.zh: 修复了 tmux 会话中剪贴板复制静默失败的问题；复制 toast 现在指示是否使用 `⌘V` 或 tmux `prefix+]` 进行粘贴

entries.en: Fixed `←`/`→` accidentally switching tabs in settings, permissions, and sandbox dialogs while navigating lists
entries.zh: 修复了导航列表时`←`/`→`意外切换设置、权限和沙箱对话框中的选项卡的问题

entries.en: Fixed IDE integration not auto-connecting when Claude Code is launched inside tmux or screen
entries.zh: 修复了当 Claude Code 在 tmux 或屏幕内启动时 IDE 集成不会自动连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed CJK characters visually bleeding into adjacent UI elements when clipped at the right edge
entries.zh: 修复了 CJK 字符在右边缘被剪切时视觉上渗入相邻 UI 元素的问题

entries.en: Fixed teammate panes not closing when the leader exits
entries.zh: 修复负责人退出时，队友窗格没有关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed iTerm2 auto mode not detecting iTerm2 for native split-pane teammates
entries.zh: 修复了 iTerm2 自动模式未检测到本机拆分窗格队友的 iTerm2

entries.en: Faster startup on macOS (~60ms) by reading keychain credentials in parallel with module loading
entries.zh: 通过在模块加载的同时读取钥匙串凭证，在 macOS 上启动速度更快（约 60 毫秒）

entries.en: Faster `--resume` on fork-heavy and very large sessions — up to 45% faster loading and ~100-150MB less peak memory
entries.zh: 在 fork 繁重和非常大的会话上更快的`--resume`——加载速度提高了 45%，峰值内存减少了约 100-150MB

entries.en: Improved Esc to abort in-flight non-streaming API requests
entries.zh: 改进 Esc 中断：可以中止正在进行中的非流式 API 请求

entries.en: Improved `claude plugin validate` to check skill, agent, and command frontmatter plus `hooks/hooks.json`, catching YAML parse errors and schema violations
entries.zh: 改进 `claude plugin validate`：检查技能、代理和命令的 frontmatter，以及 `hooks/hooks.json`，能发现 YAML 解析错误和结构违规

entries.en: Background bash tasks are now killed if output exceeds 5GB, preventing runaway processes from filling disk
entries.zh: 现在，如果输出超过 5GB，后台 bash 任务将被终止，从而防止失控进程填满磁盘

entries.en: Sessions are now auto-named from plan content when you accept a plan
entries.zh: 接受计划时，会话会根据计划内容自动命名

entries.en: Improved headless mode plugin installation to compose correctly with `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR`
entries.zh: 改进无界面模式下的插件安装，使其能与 `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` 正确配合

entries.en: Show a notice when `apiKeyHelper` takes longer than 10s, preventing it from blocking the main loop
entries.zh: `apiKeyHelper` 耗时超过 10 秒时显示提示，避免阻塞主循环

entries.en: The Agent tool no longer accepts a `resume` parameter — use `SendMessage({to: agentId})` to continue a previously spawned agent
entries.zh: Agent 工具不再接受 `resume` 参数；如需继续之前启动的代理，请使用 `SendMessage({to: agentId})`

entries.en: `SendMessage` now auto-resumes stopped agents in the background instead of returning an error
entries.zh: `SendMessage` 现在会在后台自动恢复已停止的 agent，而不是返回错误

entries.en: Renamed `/fork` to `/branch` (`/fork` still works as an alias)
entries.zh: `/fork` 改名为 `/branch`（`/fork` 仍可作为别名使用）

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved plan preview tab titles to use the plan's heading instead of "Claude's Plan"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进计划预览标签页的标题：使用计划的标题，而不是 "Claude's Plan"

entries.en: [VSCode] When option+click doesn't trigger native selection on macOS, the footer now points to the `macOptionClickForcesSelection` setting
entries.zh: [VSCode] 当 macOS 上按住 option 点击未触发原生选择时，页脚现在会指向 `macOptionClickForcesSelection` 设置

entries.en: Added MCP elicitation support — MCP servers can now request structured input mid-task via an interactive dialog (form fields or browser URL)
entries.zh: 添加了 MCP 启发支持 - MCP 服务器现在可以通过交互式对话框（表单字段或浏览器 URL）在任务中请求结构化输入

entries.en: Added new `Elicitation` and `ElicitationResult` hooks to intercept and override responses before they're sent back
entries.zh: 添加了新的`Elicitation`和`ElicitationResult`挂钩，以在发送回之前拦截和覆盖响应

entries.en: Added `-n` / `--name <name>` CLI flag to set a display name for the session at startup
entries.zh: 添加了 `-n` / `--name <name>` CLI 标志以设置启动时会话的显示名称

entries.en: Added `worktree.sparsePaths` setting for `claude --worktree` in large monorepos to check out only the directories you need via git sparse-checkout
entries.zh: 在大型 monorepos 中为`claude --worktree`添加了`worktree.sparsePaths`设置，以通过 git稀疏签出仅检查您需要的目录

entries.en: Added `PostCompact` hook that fires after compaction completes
entries.zh: 添加了在压缩完成后触发的`PostCompact`钩子

entries.en: Added `/effort` slash command to set model effort level
entries.zh: 添加了`/effort`斜杠命令来设置模型的努力级别

entries.en: Added session quality survey — enterprise admins can configure the sample rate via the `feedbackSurveyRate` setting
entries.zh: 添加了会话质量调查 - 企业管理员可以通过`feedbackSurveyRate`设置配置采样率

entries.en: Fixed deferred tools (loaded via `ToolSearch`) losing their input schemas after conversation compaction, causing array and number parameters to be rejected with type errors
entries.zh: 修复了延迟工具（通过`ToolSearch`加载）在对话压缩后丢失其输入模式，导致数组和数字参数因类型错误而被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed slash commands showing "Unknown skill"
entries.zh: 修复了显示“未知技能”的斜杠命令

entries.en: Fixed plan mode asking for re-approval after the plan was already accepted
entries.zh: 固定计划模式在计划被接受后要求重新批准

entries.en: Fixed voice mode swallowing keypresses while a permission dialog or plan editor was open
entries.zh: 修复权限对话框或计划编辑器打开时，语音模式吞掉按键的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/voice` not working on Windows when installed via npm
entries.zh: 修复了通过 npm 安装时`/voice`在 Windows 上不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed spurious "Context limit reached" when invoking a skill with `model:` frontmatter on a 1M-context session
entries.zh: 修复了在 1M 上下文会话上使用`model:`frontmatter 调用技能时出现的虚假“已达到上下文限制”

entries.en: Fixed "adaptive thinking is not supported on this model" error when using non-standard model strings
entries.zh: 修复了使用非标准模型字符串时“此模型不支持自适应思维”的错误

entries.en: Fixed `Bash(cmd:*)` permission rules not matching when a quoted argument contains `#`
entries.zh: 修复了当带引号的参数包含`#`时`Bash(cmd:*)`权限规则不匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed "don't ask again" in the Bash permission dialog showing the full raw command for pipes and compound commands
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限对话框中的“不再询问”，显示管道和复合命令的完整原始命令

entries.en: Fixed auto-compaction retrying indefinitely after consecutive failures — a circuit breaker now stops after 3 attempts
entries.zh: 修复了自动压缩在连续失败后无限期重试的问题 - 断路器现在在 3 次尝试后停止

entries.en: Fixed MCP reconnect spinner persisting after successful reconnection
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 重新连接微调器在成功重新连接后仍然存在的问题

entries.en: Fixed LSP plugins not registering servers when the LSP Manager initialized before marketplaces were reconciled
entries.zh: 修复了 LSP 管理器在市场协调之前初始化时 LSP 插件不注册服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed clipboard copying in tmux over SSH — now attempts both direct terminal write and tmux clipboard integration
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SSH 在 tmux 中进行剪贴板复制的问题 — 现在尝试直接终端写入和 tmux 剪贴板集成

entries.en: Fixed `/export` showing only the filename instead of the full file path in the success message
entries.zh: 修复了`/export`在成功消息中仅显示文件名而不是完整文件路径的问题

entries.en: Fixed transcript not auto-scrolling to new messages after selecting text
entries.zh: 修复选中文本后转录不会自动滚动到新消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed Escape key not working to exit the login method selection screen
entries.zh: 修复了 Escape 键无法退出登录方法选择屏幕的问题

entries.en: Fixed several Remote Control issues: sessions silently dying when the server reaps an idle environment, rapid messages being queued one-at-a-time instead of batched, and stale work items causing redelivery after JWT refresh
entries.zh: 修复了几个远程控制问题：当服务器获得空闲环境时，会话会默默地终止，快速消息一次排队一个而不是批量，以及陈旧的工作项目导致 JWT 刷新后重新传递

entries.en: Fixed bridge sessions failing to recover after extended WebSocket disconnects
entries.zh: 修复了扩展 WebSocket 断开连接后桥接会话无法恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash commands not found when typing the exact name of a soft-hidden command
entries.zh: 修复了键入软隐藏命令的确切名称时找不到斜杠命令的问题

entries.en: Improved `--worktree` startup performance by reading git refs directly and skipping redundant `git fetch` when the remote branch is already available locally
entries.zh: 改进 `--worktree` 启动性能：直接读取 git 引用；远程分支本地已有时，跳过多余的 `git fetch`

entries.en: Improved background agent behavior — killing a background agent now preserves its partial results in the conversation context
entries.zh: 改进后台 agent：终止后台 agent 时，保留其部分结果在对话上下文中

entries.en: Improved model fallback notifications — now always visible instead of hidden behind verbose mode, with human-friendly model names
entries.zh: 改进模型降级通知：现在始终可见，不再隐藏在详细模式里，并使用更友好的模型名称

entries.en: Improved blockquote readability on dark terminal themes — text is now italic with a left bar instead of dim
entries.zh: 改进深色终端主题下引用块的可读性：文字改为斜体并带左侧竖线，不再是暗淡显示

entries.en: Improved stale worktree cleanup — worktrees left behind after an interrupted parallel run are now automatically cleaned up
entries.zh: 改进陈旧工作树清理：并行运行被中断后留下的工作树现在会被自动清理

entries.en: Improved Remote Control session titles — now derived from your first prompt instead of showing "Interactive session"
entries.zh: 改进远程控制会话标题：改为根据你的第一条提示词生成，不再显示“Interactive session”

entries.en: Improved `/voice` to show your dictation language on enable and warn when your `language` setting isn't supported for voice input
entries.zh: 改进 `/voice`：开启时显示你的听写语言；如果 `language` 设置不支持语音输入，会给出警告

entries.en: Updated `--plugin-dir` to only accept one path to support subcommands — use repeated `--plugin-dir` for multiple directories
entries.zh: `--plugin-dir` 现在只接受一个路径，以支持子命令；如需多个目录，请重复使用 `--plugin-dir`

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed gitignore patterns containing commas silently excluding entire filetypes from the @-mention file picker
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 gitignore 规则中含逗号的模式，导致整个文件类型被 @ 提及文件选择器静默排除的问题

entries.en: Added 1M context window for Opus 4.6 by default for Max, Team, and Enterprise plans (previously required extra usage)
entries.zh: Max、Team 和 Enterprise 计划默认为 Opus 4.6 添加 1M 上下文窗口（之前需要额外使用）

entries.en: Added `/color` command for all users to set a prompt-bar color for your session
entries.zh: 添加了`/color`命令，供所有用户为会话设置提示栏颜色

entries.en: Added session name display on the prompt bar when using `/rename`
entries.zh: 添加使用`/rename`时提示栏上显示会话名称

entries.en: Added last-modified timestamps to memory files, helping Claude reason about which memories are fresh vs. stale
entries.zh: 向内存文件添加了最后修改的时间戳，帮助 Claude 推断哪些内存是新鲜的，哪些是陈旧的

entries.en: Added hook source display (settings/plugin/skill) in permission prompts when a hook requires confirmation
entries.zh: 新增Hook需要确认时权限提示中的Hook来源显示（设置/插件/技能）

entries.en: Fixed voice mode not activating correctly on fresh installs without toggling `/voice` twice
entries.zh: 修复全新安装后，语音模式需要切换两次 `/voice` 才能正确激活的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Claude Code header not updating the displayed model name after switching models with `/model` or Option+P
entries.zh: 修复了使用`/model`或 Option+P 切换模型后 Claude Code 标头不更新显示的模型名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed session crash when an attachment message computation returns undefined values
entries.zh: 修复了附件消息计算返回未定义值时会话崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool mangling `!` in piped commands (e.g., `jq 'select(.x != .y)'` now works correctly)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具在管道命令中损坏 `!`（例如，`jq 'select(.x != .y)'` 现在可以正常工作）

entries.en: Fixed managed-disabled plugins showing up in the `/plugin` Installed tab — plugins force-disabled by your organization are now hidden
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`“已安装”选项卡中显示的托管禁用插件 - 由您的组织强制禁用的插件现在已隐藏

entries.en: Fixed token estimation over-counting for thinking and `tool_use` blocks, preventing premature context compaction
entries.zh: 修复思考和 `tool_use` 块的 token 估算过高，导致上下文过早被压缩的问题

entries.en: Fixed corrupted marketplace config path handling
entries.zh: 修复了损坏的市场配置路径处理

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` losing session names after resuming a forked or continued session
entries.zh: 修复了恢复分叉或连续会话后`/resume`丢失会话名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc not closing the `/status` dialog after visiting the Config tab
entries.zh: 修复了访问“配置”选项卡后 Esc 未关闭`/status`对话框的问题

entries.en: Fixed input handling when accepting or rejecting a plan
entries.zh: 修复了接受或拒绝计划时的输入处理

entries.en: Fixed footer hint in agent teams showing "↓ to expand" instead of the correct "shift + ↓ to expand"
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队中的页脚提示，显示“↓ 展开”，而不是正确的“shift + ↓ 展开”

entries.en: Improved startup performance on macOS non-MDM machines by skipping unnecessary subprocess spawns
entries.zh: 改进非 MDM 管理的 macOS 机器的启动性能：跳过不必要的子进程启动

entries.en: Suppressed async hook completion messages by default (visible with `--verbose` or transcript mode)
entries.zh: 默认隐藏异步钩子的完成消息（加上 `--verbose` 或转录模式后可见）

entries.en: Breaking change: Removed deprecated Windows managed settings fallback at `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json` — use `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json`
entries.zh: 重大更改：删除了“C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\driven-settings.json”中已弃用的 Windows 托管设置回退 — 使用“C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\driven-settings.json”

entries.en: Added actionable suggestions to `/context` command — identifies context-heavy tools, memory bloat, and capacity warnings with specific optimization tips
entries.zh: 向`/context`命令添加了可操作的建议——通过特定的优化提示识别上下文繁重的工具、内存膨胀和容量警告

entries.en: Added `autoMemoryDirectory` setting to configure a custom directory for auto-memory storage
entries.zh: 添加了`autoMemoryDirectory`设置来配置自动内存存储的自定义目录

entries.en: Fixed memory leak where streaming API response buffers were not released when the generator was terminated early, causing unbounded RSS growth on the Node.js/npm code path
entries.zh: 修复了生成器提前终止时未释放流式 API 响应缓冲区的内存泄漏，导致 Node.js/npm 代码路径上的 RSS 无限增长

entries.en: Fixed managed policy `ask` rules being bypassed by user `allow` rules or skill `allowed-tools`
entries.zh: 修复了用户“允许”规则或技能“允许工具”绕过托管策略“询问”规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed full model IDs (e.g., `claude-opus-4-5`) being silently ignored in agent frontmatter `model:` field and `--agents` JSON config — agents now accept the same model values as `--model`
entries.zh: 修复了代理 frontmatter `model:` 字段和 `--agents` JSON 配置中默默忽略的完整模型 ID（例如，`claude-opus-4-5`） — 代理现在接受与 `--model` 相同的模型值

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth authentication hanging when the callback port is already in use
entries.zh: 修复了回调端口已在使用时 MCP OAuth 身份验证挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth refresh never prompting for re-auth after the refresh token expires, for OAuth servers that return errors with HTTP 200 (e.g. Slack)
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP OAuth 刷新在刷新令牌过期后从不提示重新验证的问题，对于返回 HTTP 200 错误的 OAuth 服务器（例如 Slack）

entries.en: Fixed voice mode silently failing on the macOS native binary for users whose terminal had never been granted microphone permission — the binary now includes the `audio-input` entitlement so macOS prompts correctly
entries.zh: 修复终端从未被授予麦克风权限的 macOS 用户，语音模式在原生二进制下静默失败的问题；现在二进制包含 `audio-input` 授权，macOS 会正确弹出请求

entries.en: Fixed `SessionEnd` hooks being killed after 1.5 s on exit regardless of `hook.timeout` — now configurable via `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS`
entries.zh: 修复了`SessionEnd`挂钩在退出 1.5 秒后被终止的问题，无论`hook.timeout`如何——现在可通过`CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS`进行配置

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin install` failing inside the REPL for marketplace plugins with local sources
entries.zh: 修复了带有本地源的市场插件在 REPL 内`/plugin install`失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed marketplace update not syncing git submodules — plugin sources in submodules no longer break after update
entries.zh: 修复了市场更新不同步 git 子模块的问题 - 子模块中的插件源在更新后不再中断

entries.en: Fixed unknown slash commands with arguments silently dropping input — now shows your input as a warning
entries.zh: 修复带参数的未知斜杠命令会静默丢弃输入的问题；现在会把你的输入作为警告显示出来

entries.en: Fixed Hebrew, Arabic, and other RTL text not rendering correctly in Windows Terminal, conhost, and VS Code integrated terminal
entries.zh: 修复了希伯来语、阿拉伯语和其他 RTL 文本在 Windows 终端、conhost 和 VS Code 集成终端中无法正确呈现的问题

entries.en: Fixed LSP servers not working on Windows due to malformed file URIs
entries.zh: 修复了由于文件 URI 格式错误而导致 LSP 服务器无法在 Windows 上运行的问题

entries.en: Changed `--plugin-dir` so local dev copies now override installed marketplace plugins with the same name (unless that plugin is force-enabled by managed settings)
entries.zh: 更改了`--plugin-dir`，因此本地开发副本现在会覆盖已安装的同名市场插件（除非该插件由托管设置强制启用）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed delete button not working for Untitled sessions
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复未命名（Untitled）会话的删除按钮无法使用的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved scroll wheel responsiveness in the integrated terminal with terminal-aware acceleration
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进集成终端的滚轮响应：加入了感知终端的加速

entries.en: Added `modelOverrides` setting to map model picker entries to custom provider model IDs (e.g. Bedrock inference profile ARNs)
entries.zh: 添加了`modelOverrides`设置，以将模型选择器条目映射到自定义提供程序模型 ID（例如 Bedrock 推理配置文件 ARN）

entries.en: Added actionable guidance when OAuth login or connectivity checks fail due to SSL certificate errors (corporate proxies, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`)
entries.zh: 添加了当 OAuth 登录或连接检查由于 SSL 证书错误而失败时的可操作指南（公司代理，`NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`）

entries.en: Fixed freezes and 100% CPU loops triggered by permission prompts for complex bash commands
entries.zh: 修复了复杂 bash 命令的权限提示触发的冻结和 100% CPU 循环

entries.en: Fixed a deadlock that could freeze Claude Code when many skill files changed at once (e.g. during `git pull` in a repo with a large `.claude/skills/` directory)
entries.zh: 修复了当许多技能文件同时更改时可能冻结克劳德代码的死锁（例如，在具有大型`.claude/skills/`目录的存储库中的`git pull`期间）

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool output being lost when running multiple Claude Code sessions in the same project directory
entries.zh: 修复了在同一项目目录中运行多个 Claude Code 会话时 Bash 工具输出丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents with `model: opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` being silently downgraded to older model versions on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry
entries.zh: 修复了`model: opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku`的子代理在 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Microsoft Foundry 上默默降级为旧模型版本的问题

entries.en: Fixed background bash processes spawned by subagents not being cleaned up when the agent exits
entries.zh: 修复了代理退出时子代理生成的后台 bash 进程未被清理的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` showing the current session in the picker
entries.zh: 修复了在选择器中显示当前会话的`/resume`

entries.en: Fixed `/ide` crashing with `onInstall is not defined` when auto-installing the extension
entries.zh: 修复了自动安装扩展时`/ide`因“onInstall is not Defined”而崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/loop` not being available on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry and when telemetry was disabled
entries.zh: 修复了`/loop`在基岩/顶点/铸造厂上以及禁用遥测时不可用的问题

entries.en: Fixed SessionStart hooks firing twice when resuming a session via `--resume` or `--continue`
entries.zh: 修复了通过`--resume`或`--continue`恢复会话时 SessionStart 挂钩触发两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed JSON-output hooks injecting no-op system-reminder messages into the model's context on every turn
entries.zh: 修复了 JSON 输出挂钩，每次都会将无操作系统提醒消息注入到模型的上下文中

entries.en: Fixed voice mode session corruption when a slow connection overlaps a new recording
entries.zh: 修复慢速连接与新录音重叠时，语音模式会话损坏的问题

entries.en: Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start with "ripgrep (rg) not found" on native builds
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 沙箱在本机构建上无法启动并出现“ripgrep (rg) not found”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Linux native modules not loading on Amazon Linux 2 and other glibc 2.26 systems
entries.zh: 修复了在 Amazon Linux 2 和其他 glibc 2.26 系统上无法加载的 Linux 本机模块

entries.en: Fixed "media_type: Field required" API error when receiving images via Remote Control
entries.zh: 修复了通过远程控制接收图像时“media_type: Field required”API 错误

entries.en: Fixed `/heapdump` failing on Windows with `EEXIST` error when the Desktop folder already exists
entries.zh: 修复了当桌面文件夹已存在时`/heapdump`在 Windows 上失败并出现`EEXIST`错误的问题

entries.en: Improved Up arrow after interrupting Claude — now restores the interrupted prompt and rewinds the conversation in one step
entries.zh: 改进：中断 Claude 后按上方向键，现在会一步完成：恢复被中断的提示词，并回退对话

entries.en: Improved IDE detection speed at startup
entries.zh: 改进启动时的 IDE 检测速度

entries.en: Improved clipboard image pasting performance on macOS
entries.zh: 改进 macOS 上粘贴剪贴板图片的性能

entries.en: Improved `/effort` to work while Claude is responding, matching `/model` behavior
entries.zh: 改进 `/effort`：Claude 回复时也能使用，与 `/model` 的行为一致

entries.en: Improved voice mode to automatically retry transient connection failures during rapid push-to-talk re-press
entries.zh: 改进语音模式：快速重复按下按键说话时，遇到短暂的连接失败会自动重试

entries.en: Improved the Remote Control spawn mode selection prompt with better context
entries.zh: 改进 Remote Control 启动方式选择提示，增加了更多上下文说明

entries.en: Changed default Opus model on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry to Opus 4.6 (was Opus 4.1)
entries.zh: 将 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Microsoft Foundry 上的默认 Opus 模型更改为 Opus 4.6（原为 Opus 4.1）

entries.en: Deprecated `/output-style` command — use `/config` instead. Output style is now fixed at session start for better prompt caching
entries.zh: 已弃用的`/output-style`命令 - 使用`/config`代替。现在在会话开始时固定输出样式，以实现更好的提示缓存

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed HTTP 400 errors for users behind proxies or on Bedrock/Vertex with Claude 4.5 models
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了用户位于代理后，或在 Bedrock/Vertex 上使用 Claude 4.5 模型时出现的 HTTP 400 错误

entries.en: Fixed tool search to activate even with `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` as long as `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` is set.
entries.zh: 修复设置了 `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` 后，即使有 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 工具搜索也会启用的问题。

entries.en: Added `w` key in `/copy` to write the focused selection directly to a file, bypassing the clipboard (useful over SSH)
entries.zh: 在`/copy`中添加了`w`键，以绕过剪贴板将焦点选择直接写入文件（通过 SSH 有用）

entries.en: Added optional description argument to `/plan` (e.g., `/plan fix the auth bug`) that enters plan mode and immediately starts
entries.zh: 向`/plan`添加了可选的描述参数（例如，“/plan 修复身份验证错误”），进入计划模式并立即启动

entries.en: Added `ExitWorktree` tool to leave an `EnterWorktree` session
entries.zh: 添加了`ExitWorktree`工具以离开`EnterWorktree`会话

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON` environment variable to immediately stop scheduled cron jobs mid-session
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON`环境变量以在会话中立即停止计划的 cron 作业

entries.en: Added `lsof`, `pgrep`, `tput`, `ss`, `fd`, and `fdfind` to the bash auto-approval allowlist, reducing permission prompts for common read-only operations
entries.zh: 将 `lsof`、`pgrep`、`tput`、`ss`、`fd` 和 `fdfind` 添加到 bash 自动批准白名单中，减少常见只读操作的权限提示

entries.en: Restored the `model` parameter on the Agent tool for per-invocation model overrides
entries.zh: 恢复 Agent 工具上的 `model` 参数，可按每次调用覆盖模型

entries.en: Simplified effort levels to low/medium/high (removed max) with new symbols (○ ◐ ●) and a brief notification instead of a persistent icon. Use `/effort auto` to reset to default
entries.zh: 思考强度简化为低/中/高（移除了“最高”），并改用新符号（○ ◐ ●），通过简短通知提示，不再显示常驻图标。使用 `/effort auto` 可恢复默认

entries.en: Improved `/config` — Escape now cancels changes, Enter saves and closes, Space toggles settings
entries.zh: 改进 `/config`：Escape 取消更改，Enter 保存并关闭，Space 切换设置

entries.en: Improved up-arrow history to show current session's messages first when running multiple concurrent sessions
entries.zh: 改进上箭头历史记录：同时运行多个会话时，优先显示当前会话的消息

entries.en: Improved voice input transcription accuracy for repo names and common dev terms (regex, OAuth, JSON)
entries.zh: 改进语音输入对仓库名和常见开发术语（regex、OAuth、JSON）的转写准确度

entries.en: Improved bash command parsing by switching to a native module — faster initialization and no memory leak
entries.zh: 改进 bash 命令解析：改用原生模块，初始化更快，且不再有内存泄漏

entries.en: Reduced bundle size by ~510 KB
entries.zh: 打包体积减少约 510 KB

entries.en: Changed CLAUDE.md HTML comments (`<!-- ... -->`) to be hidden from Claude when auto-injected. Comments remain visible when read with the Read tool
entries.zh: 更改了 CLAUDE.md HTML 注释 (`<!-- ... -->`)，使其在自动注入时对 Claude 隐藏。使用阅读工具阅读时评论仍然可见

entries.en: Fixed slow exits when background tasks or hooks were slow to respond
entries.zh: 修复了后台任务或挂钩响应缓慢时退出缓慢的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent task progress stuck on "Initializing…"
entries.zh: 修复了代理任务进度停留在“正在初始化...”的问题

entries.en: Fixed skill hooks firing twice per event when a hooks-enabled skill is invoked by the model
entries.zh: 当模型调用启用钩子的技能时，修复了每个事件的技能钩子触发两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed several voice mode issues: occasional input lag, false "No speech detected" errors after releasing push-to-talk, and stale transcripts re-filling the prompt after submission
entries.zh: 修复了多个语音模式问题：偶尔的输入延迟、释放一键通后错误的“未检测到语音”错误以及提交后重新填写提示的陈旧记录

entries.en: Fixed `--continue` not resuming from the most recent point after `--compact`
entries.zh: 修复了`--continue`不从`--compact`之后的最近点恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed bash security parsing edge cases
entries.zh: 修复了 bash 安全解析边缘情况

entries.en: Added support for marketplace git URLs without `.git` suffix (Azure DevOps, AWS CodeCommit)
entries.zh: 添加了对不带`.git`后缀的市场 git URL 的支持（Azure DevOps、AWS CodeCommit）

entries.en: Improved marketplace clone failure messages to show diagnostic info even when git produces no stderr
entries.zh: 改进 marketplace 克隆失败的提示：即使 git 没有输出 stderr，也会显示诊断信息

entries.en: Fixed several plugin issues: installation failing on Windows with `EEXIST` error in OneDrive folders, marketplace blocking user-scope installs when a project-scope install exists, `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR` creating literal `~` directories, and `plugin.json` with marketplace-only fields failing to load
entries.zh: 修复了几个插件问题：在 Windows 上安装失败，OneDrive 文件夹中出现`EEXIST`错误，当项目范围安装存在时，市场阻止用户范围安装，`CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR`创建文字`~`目录，以及`plugin.json`仅包含市场字段无法加载

entries.en: Fixed feedback survey appearing too frequently in long sessions
entries.zh: 修复了反馈调查在长时间会话中出现过于频繁的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--effort` CLI flag being reset by unrelated settings writes on startup
entries.zh: 修复了`--effort`CLI 标志在启动时被不相关设置写入重置的问题

entries.en: Fixed backgrounded Ctrl+B queries losing their transcript or corrupting the new conversation after `/clear`
entries.zh: 修复了后台 Ctrl+B 查询在`/clear`之后丢失其记录或损坏新对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` killing background agent/bash tasks — only foreground tasks are now cleared
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`杀死后台代理/bash任务的问题——现在只有前台任务被清除

entries.en: Fixed worktree isolation issues: Task tool resume not restoring cwd, and background task notifications missing `worktreePath` and `worktreeBranch`
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离问题：Task 工具恢复时未还原工作目录，且后台任务通知缺少 `worktreePath` 和 `worktreeBranch`

entries.en: Fixed `/model` not displaying results when run while Claude is working
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德工作时运行时`/model`不显示结果的问题

entries.en: Fixed digit keys selecting menu options instead of typing in plan mode permission prompt's text input
entries.zh: 修复了选择菜单选项而不是在计划模式权限提示的文本输入中键入数字键的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandbox permission issues: certain file write operations incorrectly allowed without prompting, and output redirections to allowlisted directories (like `/tmp/claude/`) prompting unnecessarily
entries.zh: 修复了沙箱权限问题：某些文件写入操作在没有提示的情况下被错误地允许，并且输出重定向到白名单目录（如`/tmp/claude/`），不必要地提示

entries.en: Improved CPU utilization in long sessions
entries.zh: 改进长会话中的 CPU 使用率

entries.en: Fixed prompt cache invalidation in SDK `query()` calls, reducing input token costs up to 12x
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK`query()`调用中的提示缓存失效问题，将输入令牌成本降低高达 12 倍

entries.en: Fixed Escape key becoming unresponsive after cancelling a query
entries.zh: 修复了取消查询后 Escape 键变得无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed double Ctrl+C not exiting when background agents or tasks are running
entries.zh: 修复后台代理或任务运行时双 Ctrl+C 不退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed team agents to inherit the leader's model
entries.zh: 修复团队智能体未继承负责人（leader）模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Always Allow" saving permission rules that never match again
entries.zh: 修复了“始终允许”保存权限规则不再匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed several hooks issues: `transcript_path` pointing to the wrong directory for resumed/forked sessions, agent `prompt` being silently deleted from settings.json on every settings write, PostToolUse block reason displaying twice, async hooks not receiving stdin with bash `read -r`, and validation error message showing an example that fails validation
entries.zh: 修复了几个钩子问题：`transcript_path`指向恢复/分叉会话的错误目录，每次设置写入时都会从 settings.json 中默默删除代理`prompt`，PostToolUse 阻止原因显示两次，异步钩子未使用 bash`read -r`接收标准输入，以及显示验证失败示例的验证错误消息

entries.en: Fixed session crashes in Desktop/SDK when Read returned files containing U+2028/U+2029 characters
entries.zh: 修复了读取返回的包含 U+2028/U+2029 字符的文件时桌面/SDK 中的会话崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal title being cleared on exit even when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` was set
entries.zh: 修复设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` 后，退出时终端标题仍被清除的问题

entries.en: Fixed several permission rule matching issues: wildcard rules not matching commands with heredocs, embedded newlines, or no arguments; `sandbox.excludedCommands` failing with env var prefixes; "always allow" suggesting overly broad prefixes for nested CLI tools; and deny rules not applying to all command forms
entries.zh: 修复了多个权限规则匹配问题：通配符规则不匹配带有heredocs、嵌入换行符或无参数的命令； `sandbox.excludedCommands` 因 env var 前缀而失败； “始终允许”建议嵌套 CLI 工具使用过于宽泛的前缀；并拒绝不适用于所有命令形式的规则

entries.en: Fixed oversized and truncated images from Bash data-URL output
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 数据 URL 输出中过大和截断的图像

entries.en: Fixed a crash when resuming sessions that contained Bedrock API errors
entries.zh: 修复了恢复包含 Bedrock API 错误的会话时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed intermittent "expected boolean, received string" validation errors on Edit, Bash, and Grep tool inputs
entries.zh: 修复了 Edit、Bash 和 Grep 工具输入上的间歇性“预期布尔值，收到字符串”验证错误

entries.en: Fixed multi-line session titles when forking from a conversation whose first message contained newlines
entries.zh: 修复了从第一条消息包含换行符的对话中分叉时的多行会话标题

entries.en: Fixed queued messages not showing attached images, and images being lost when pressing ↑ to edit a queued message
entries.zh: 修复了排队消息不显示附加图像以及按 ↑ 编辑排队消息时图像丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed parallel tool calls where a failed Read/WebFetch/Glob would cancel its siblings — only Bash errors now cascade
entries.zh: 修复了并行工具调用，其中失败的 Read/WebFetch/Glob 将取消其同级工具 - 现在只有 Bash 错误级联

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed scroll speed in integrated terminals not matching native terminals
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了集成终端中的滚动速度与原生终端不一致的问题

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed Shift+Enter submitting input instead of inserting a newline for users with older keybindings
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了旧快捷键配置下 Shift+Enter 会提交输入而不是换行的问题

entries.en: VSCode: Added effort level indicator on the input border
entries.zh: VS Code：输入框边框上新增强度级别指示器

entries.en: VSCode: Added `vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open` URI handler to open a new Claude Code tab programmatically, with optional `prompt` and `session` query parameters
entries.zh: VS Code：新增 `vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open` URI 处理器，可通过程序打开新的 Claude Code 标签页，并可选择带上 `prompt` 和 `session` 查询参数

entries.en: Added `/loop` command to run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. `/loop 5m check the deploy`)
entries.zh: 添加了`/loop`命令以定期运行提示或斜杠命令（例如“/loop 5m 检查部署”）

entries.en: Added cron scheduling tools for recurring prompts within a session
entries.zh: 添加了 cron 调度工具，用于在会话中重复提示

entries.en: Added `voice:pushToTalk` keybinding to make the voice activation key rebindable in `keybindings.json` (default: space) — modifier+letter combos like `meta+k` have zero typing interference
entries.zh: 添加了`voice:pushToTalk`键绑定，使语音激活键可在`keybindings.json`中重新绑定（默认：空格）——像`meta+k`这样的修饰符+字母组合具有零打字干扰

entries.en: Added `fmt`, `comm`, `cmp`, `numfmt`, `expr`, `test`, `printf`, `getconf`, `seq`, `tsort`, and `pr` to the bash auto-approval allowlist
entries.zh: 将`fmt`、`comm`、`cmp`、`numfmt`、`expr`、`test`、`printf`、`getconf`、`seq`、`tsort`和`pr`添加到 bash 自动批准白名单中

entries.en: Fixed stdin freeze in long-running sessions where keystrokes stop being processed but the process stays alive
entries.zh: 修复了长时间运行会话中的标准输入冻结问题，其中击键停止处理，但进程保持活动状态

entries.en: Fixed a 5–8 second startup freeze for users with voice mode enabled, caused by CoreAudio initialization blocking the main thread after system wake
entries.zh: 修复了启用语音模式的用户因 CoreAudio 初始化在系统唤醒后阻塞主线程而导致 5-8 秒启动冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed startup UI freeze when many claude.ai proxy connectors refresh an expired OAuth token simultaneously
entries.zh: 修复了当许多 claude.ai 代理连接器同时刷新过期的 OAuth 令牌时启动 UI 冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed forked conversations (`/fork`) sharing the same plan file, which caused plan edits in one fork to overwrite the other
entries.zh: 修复了共享相同计划文件的分叉对话 (`/fork`)，这会导致一个分叉中的计划编辑覆盖另一个分叉

entries.en: Fixed the Read tool putting oversized images into context when image processing failed, breaking subsequent turns in long image-heavy sessions
entries.zh: 修复图片处理失败时，Read 工具仍把超大图片放入上下文，导致图片较多的长会话后续回合全部出错的问题

entries.en: Fixed false-positive permission prompts for compound bash commands containing heredoc commit messages
entries.zh: 修复了包含定界符提交消息的复合 bash 命令的误报权限提示

entries.en: Fixed plugin installations being lost when running multiple Claude Code instances
entries.zh: 修复了运行多个 Claude Code 实例时插件安装丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai connectors failing to reconnect after OAuth token refresh
entries.zh: 修复了 claude.ai 连接器在 OAuth 令牌刷新后无法重新连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed claude.ai MCP connector startup notifications appearing for every org-configured connector instead of only previously connected ones
entries.zh: 修复了为每个组织配置的连接器显示的 claude.ai MCP 连接器启动通知，而不是仅先前连接的连接器

entries.en: Fixed background agent completion notifications missing the output file path, which made it difficult for parent agents to recover agent results after context compaction
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理完成通知缺少输出文件路径，这使得父代理在上下文压缩后很难恢复代理结果

entries.en: Fixed duplicate output in Bash tool error messages when commands exit with non-zero status
entries.zh: 修复了命令以非零状态退出时 Bash 工具错误消息中的重复输出

entries.en: Fixed Chrome extension auto-detection getting permanently stuck on "not installed" after running on a machine without local Chrome
entries.zh: 修复了在没有本地 Chrome 的计算机上运行后 Chrome 扩展自动检测永久卡在“未安装”状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin marketplace update` failing with merge conflicts when the marketplace is pinned to a branch/tag ref
entries.zh: 修复了当市场固定到分支/标签引用时“/插件市场更新”因合并冲突而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin marketplace add owner/repo@ref` incorrectly parsing `@` — previously only `#` worked as a ref separator, causing undiagnosable errors with `strictKnownMarketplaces`
entries.zh: 修复了“/pluginmarketplaceaddowner/repo@ref”错误地解析`@`的问题——之前只有`#`作为引用分隔符，导致`strictKnownMarketplaces`出现不可诊断的错误

entries.en: Fixed duplicate entries in `/permissions` Workspace tab when the same directory is added with and without a trailing slash
entries.zh: 修复了添加带有或不带有尾部斜杠的同一目录时`/permissions`工作空间选项卡中的重复条目

entries.en: Fixed `--print` hanging forever when team agents are configured — the exit loop no longer waits on long-lived `in_process_teammate` tasks
entries.zh: 修复了配置团队代理时`--print`永远挂起的问题 - 退出循环不再等待长期存在的`in_process_teammate`任务

entries.en: Fixed "❯ Tool loaded." appearing in the REPL after every `ToolSearch` call
entries.zh: 修复了“❯工具已加载”的问题。每次`ToolSearch`调用后出现在 REPL 中

entries.en: Fixed prompting for `cd <cwd> && git ...` on Windows when the model uses a mingw-style path
entries.zh: 修复了模型使用 mingw 样式路径时在 Windows 上输入`cd <cwd> && git ...`的提示

entries.en: Improved startup time by deferring native image processor loading to first use
entries.zh: 改进启动时间：原生图片处理器改为第一次使用时才加载

entries.en: Improved bridge session reconnection to complete within seconds after laptop wake from sleep, instead of waiting up to 10 minutes
entries.zh: 改进笔记本从睡眠唤醒后 bridge 会话的重连：几秒内即可完成，不再等待长达 10 分钟

entries.en: Improved `/plugin uninstall` to disable project-scoped plugins in `.claude/settings.local.json` instead of modifying `.claude/settings.json`, so changes don't affect teammates
entries.zh: 改进 `/plugin uninstall`：卸载项目级插件时，改为在 `.claude/settings.local.json` 中禁用，不再修改 `.claude/settings.json`，避免影响团队成员

entries.en: Improved plugin-provided MCP server deduplication — servers that duplicate a manually-configured server (same command/URL) are now skipped, preventing duplicate connections and tool sets. Suppressions are shown in the `/plugin` menu.
entries.zh: 改进插件提供的 MCP 服务器去重：与手动配置的服务器重复（相同命令或 URL）的会被跳过，避免重复连接和重复工具集。被跳过的项会显示在 `/plugin` 菜单中

entries.en: Updated `/debug` to toggle debug logging on mid-session, since debug logs are no longer written by default
entries.zh: 由于调试日志默认不再写入，`/debug` 现在可在会话中途开启或关闭调试日志

entries.en: Removed startup notification noise for unauthenticated org-registered claude.ai connectors
entries.zh: 未登录的组织注册 claude.ai 连接器，不再显示启动通知干扰

entries.en: Fixed API 400 errors when using `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` with a third-party gateway — tool search now correctly detects proxy endpoints and disables `tool_reference` blocks
entries.zh: 修复了将`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`与第三方网关一起使用时的 API 400 错误 - 工具搜索现在可以正确检测代理端点并禁用`tool_reference`块

entries.en: Fixed `API Error: 400 This model does not support the effort parameter` when using custom Bedrock inference profiles or other model identifiers not matching standard Claude naming patterns
entries.zh: 修复了使用自定义基岩推理配置文件或与标准 Claude 命名模式不匹配的其他模型标识符时“API 错误：400 该模型不支持工作量参数”的问题

entries.en: Fixed empty model responses immediately after `ToolSearch` — the server renders tool schemas with system-prompt-style tags at the prompt tail, which could confuse models into stopping early
entries.zh: 修复了`ToolSearch`之后立即出现的空模型响应 - 服务器在提示尾部使用系统提示样式标签呈现工具架构，这可能会混淆模型以提前停止

entries.en: Fixed prompt-cache bust when an MCP server with `instructions` connects after the first turn
entries.zh: 修复了带有“指令”的 MCP 服务器在第一回合后连接时提示缓存崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed Enter inserting a newline instead of submitting when typing over a slow SSH connection
entries.zh: 修复了通过慢速 SSH 连接键入时 Enter 插入换行符而不是提交的问题

entries.en: Fixed clipboard corrupting non-ASCII text (CJK, emoji) on Windows/WSL by using PowerShell `Set-Clipboard`
entries.zh: 使用 PowerShell `Set-Clipboard` 修复了剪贴板在 Windows/WSL 上损坏非 ASCII 文本（CJK、表情符号）的问题

entries.en: Fixed extra VS Code windows opening at startup on Windows when running from the VS Code integrated terminal
entries.zh: 修复了从 VS Code 集成终端运行时在 Windows 上启动时打开的额外 VS Code 窗口

entries.en: Fixed voice mode failing on Windows native binary with "native audio module could not be loaded"
entries.zh: 修复 Windows 原生二进制中语音模式报"native audio module could not be loaded"而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed push-to-talk not activating on session start when `voiceEnabled: true` was set in settings
entries.zh: 修复了在设置中设置`voiceEnabled: true`时，一键通无法在会话开始时激活的问题

entries.en: Fixed markdown links containing `#NNN` references incorrectly pointing to the current repository instead of the linked URL
entries.zh: 修复了包含`#NNN`引用的 Markdown 链接错误地指向当前存储库而不是链接的 URL

entries.en: Fixed repeated "Model updated to Opus 4.6" notification when a project's `.claude/settings.json` has a legacy Opus model string pinned
entries.zh: 修复了当项目的 `.claude/settings.json` 固定了旧版 Opus 模型字符串时重复出现的“模型已更新到 Opus 4.6”通知

entries.en: Fixed plugins showing as inaccurately installed in `/plugin`
entries.zh: 修复了在`/plugin`中显示不正确安装的插件

entries.en: Fixed plugins showing "not found in marketplace" errors on fresh startup by auto-refreshing after marketplace installation
entries.zh: 修复了在市场安装后通过自动刷新重新启动时显示“在市场中找不到”错误的插件

entries.en: Fixed `/security-review` command failing with `unknown option merge-base` on older git versions
entries.zh: 修复了旧 git 版本上的`/security-review`命令因“未知选项合并基础”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/color` command having no way to reset back to the default color — `/color default`, `/color gray`, `/color reset`, and `/color none` now restore the default
entries.zh: 修复了`/color`命令无法重置回默认颜色的问题 - `/color default`、“/color grey”、“/color Reset”和`/color none`现在恢复默认值

entries.en: Fixed a performance regression in the `AskUserQuestion` preview dialog that re-ran markdown rendering on every keystroke in the notes input
entries.zh: 修复了`AskUserQuestion`预览对话框中的性能回归，该对话框在笔记输入中的每次击键时重新运行 Markdown 渲染

entries.en: Fixed feature flags read during early startup never refreshing their disk cache, causing stale values to persist across sessions
entries.zh: 修复了早期启动期间读取的功能标志从不刷新其磁盘缓存，导致过时的值在会话中持续存在的问题

entries.en: Fixed `permissions.defaultMode` settings values other than `acceptEdits` or `plan` being applied in Claude Code Remote environments — they are now ignored
entries.zh: 修复了在 Claude Code Remote 环境中应用除`acceptEdits`或`plan`之外的`permissions.defaultMode`设置值 - 它们现在被忽略

entries.en: Fixed skill listing being re-injected on every `--resume` (~600 tokens saved per resume)
entries.zh: 修复了在每个`--resume`上重新注入的技能列表（每个简历保存约 600 个令牌）

entries.en: Fixed teleport marker not rendering in VS Code teleported sessions
entries.zh: 修复 VS Code 中被传送（teleport）的会话里，传送标记不显示的问题

entries.en: Improved error message when microphone captures silence to distinguish from "no speech detected"
entries.zh: 改进麦克风录到静音时的错误提示，使其与“未检测到语音”区分开

entries.en: Improved compaction to preserve images in the summarizer request, allowing prompt cache reuse for faster and cheaper compaction
entries.zh: 改进压缩：摘要器请求中保留图片，可以复用提示词缓存，使压缩更快、更省

entries.en: Improved `/rename` to work while Claude is processing, instead of being silently queued
entries.zh: 改进 `/rename`：Claude 处理中也能使用，不再被悄悄排队

entries.en: Reduced prompt input re-renders during turns by ~74%
entries.zh: 一轮对话期间，输入框的重渲染减少约 74%

entries.en: Reduced startup memory by ~426KB for users without custom CA certificates
entries.zh: 没有自定义 CA 证书的用户，启动内存减少约 426KB

entries.en: Reduced Remote Control `/poll` rate to once per 10 minutes while connected (was 1–2s), cutting server load ~300×. Reconnection is unaffected — transport loss immediately wakes fast polling.
entries.zh: 连接时，Remote Control 的 `/poll` 频率降为每 10 分钟一次（原为每 1–2 秒），服务器负载降低约 300 倍。断线重连不受影响：连接断开会立即唤醒快速轮询。

entries.en: [VSCode] Added spark icon in VS Code activity bar that lists all Claude Code sessions, with sessions opening as full editors
entries.zh: [VSCode] VS Code 活动栏新增火花图标，列出所有 Claude Code 会话，会话以完整编辑器打开

entries.en: [VSCode] Added full markdown document view for plans in VS Code, with support for adding comments to provide feedback
entries.zh: [VSCode] 计划可在 VS Code 中以完整 Markdown 文档视图查看，并支持添加批注提供反馈

entries.en: [VSCode] Added native MCP server management dialog — use `/mcp` in the chat panel to enable/disable servers, reconnect, and manage OAuth authentication without switching to the terminal
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增原生 MCP 服务器管理对话框：在聊天面板中使用 `/mcp` 即可启用或禁用服务器、重新连接，并管理 OAuth 认证，无需切换到终端

entries.en: Added the `/claude-api` skill for building applications with the Claude API and Anthropic SDK
entries.zh: 添加了`/claude-api`技能，用于使用 Claude API 和 Anthropic SDK 构建应用程序

entries.en: Added Ctrl+U on an empty bash prompt (`!`) to exit bash mode, matching `escape` and `backspace`
entries.zh: 在空 bash 提示符 (`!`) 上添加了 Ctrl+U 来退出 bash 模式，匹配 `escape` 和 `backspace`

entries.en: Added numeric keypad support for selecting options in Claude's interview questions (previously only the number row above QWERTY worked)
entries.zh: 添加了数字键盘支持，用于在克劳德的面试问题中选择选项（之前只有 QWERTY 上方的数字行有效）

entries.en: Added optional name argument to `/remote-control` and `claude remote-control` (`/remote-control My Project` or `--name "My Project"`) to set a custom session title visible in claude.ai/code
entries.zh: 向 `/remote-control` 和 `claude remote-control` 添加了可选名称参数（`/remote-control My Project` 或 `--name "My Project"`），以设置在 claude.ai/code 中可见的自定义会话标题

entries.en: Added Voice STT support for 10 new languages (20 total) — Russian, Polish, Turkish, Dutch, Ukrainian, Greek, Czech, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian
entries.zh: 添加了对 10 种新语言（总共 20 种）的语音 STT 支持 - 俄语、波兰语、土耳其语、荷兰语、乌克兰语、希腊语、捷克语、丹麦语、瑞典语、挪威语

entries.en: Added effort level display (e.g., "with low effort") to the logo and spinner, making it easier to see which effort setting is active
entries.zh: 在徽标和微调器中添加了工作量级别显示（例如“低工作量”），以便更轻松地查看哪个工作量设置处于活动状态

entries.en: Added agent name display in terminal title when using `claude --agent`
entries.zh: 使用`claude --agent`时在终端标题中添加了代理名称显示

entries.en: Added `sandbox.enableWeakerNetworkIsolation` setting (macOS only) to allow Go programs like `gh`, `gcloud`, and `terraform` to verify TLS certificates when using a custom MITM proxy with `httpProxyPort`
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.enableWeakerNetworkIsolation`设置（仅限 macOS），以允许`gh`、`gcloud`和`terraform`等 Go 程序在使用带有`httpProxyPort`的自定义 MITM 代理时验证 TLS 证书

entries.en: Added `includeGitInstructions` setting (and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` env var) to remove built-in commit and PR workflow instructions from Claude's system prompt
entries.zh: 添加了`includeGitInstructions`设置（和`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS`环境变量）以从 Claude 的系统提示符中删除内置提交和 PR 工作流程指令

entries.en: Added `/reload-plugins` command to activate pending plugin changes without restarting
entries.zh: 添加了`/reload-plugins`命令以激活挂起的插件更改而无需重新启动

entries.en: Added a one-time startup prompt suggesting Claude Code Desktop on macOS and Windows (max 3 showings, dismissible)
entries.zh: 添加了一次性启动提示，建议在 macOS 和 Windows 上使用 Claude Code Desktop（最多显示 3 次，可忽略）

entries.en: Added `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` variable for skills to reference their own directory in SKILL.md content
entries.zh: 添加了`${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}`变量，以便技能在 SKILL.md 内容中引用自己的目录

entries.en: Added `InstructionsLoaded` hook event that fires when CLAUDE.md or `.claude/rules/*.md` files are loaded into context
entries.zh: 添加了`InstructionsLoaded`挂钩事件，当 CLAUDE.md 或`.claude/rules/*.md`文件加载到上下文中时会触发该事件

entries.en: Added `agent_id` (for subagents) and `agent_type` (for subagents and `--agent`) to hook events
entries.zh: 添加了 `agent_id` （对于子代理）和 `agent_type` （对于子代理和 `--agent`）来挂钩事件

entries.en: Added `worktree` field to status line hook commands with name, path, branch, and original repo directory when running in a `--worktree` session
entries.zh: 在`--worktree`会话中运行时，向状态行挂钩命令添加了`worktree`字段，其中包含名称、路径、分支和原始存储库目录

entries.en: Added `pluginTrustMessage` in managed settings to append organization-specific context to the plugin trust warning shown before installation
entries.zh: 在托管设置中添加了`pluginTrustMessage`，以将特定于组织的上下文附加到安装前显示的插件信任警告中

entries.en: Added policy limit fetching (e.g., remote control restrictions) for Team plan OAuth users, not just Enterprise
entries.zh: 为团队计划 OAuth 用户（而不仅仅是企业用户）添加了策略限制获取（例如远程控制限制）

entries.en: Added `pathPattern` to `strictKnownMarketplaces` for regex-matching file/directory marketplace sources alongside `hostPattern` restrictions
entries.zh: 将`pathPattern`添加到`strictKnownMarketplaces`，用于正则表达式匹配文件/目录市场源以及`hostPattern`限制

entries.en: Added plugin source type `git-subdir` to point to a subdirectory within a git repo
entries.zh: 添加了插件源类型 `git-subdir` 以指向 git 存储库中的子目录

entries.en: Added `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` config option for MCP servers to specify a custom OAuth metadata discovery URL when standard discovery fails
entries.zh: 为 MCP 服务器添加了`oauth.authServerMetadataUrl`配置选项，以在标准发现失败时指定自定义 OAuth 元数据发现 URL

entries.en: Fixed a security issue where nested skill discovery could load skills from gitignored directories like `node_modules`
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套技能发现可能从 gitignored 目录（如`node_modules`）加载技能的安全问题

entries.en: Fixed trust dialog silently enabling all `.mcp.json` servers on first run. You'll now see the per-server approval dialog as expected
entries.zh: 修复首次运行时信任对话框静默启用了所有 `.mcp.json` 服务器的问题。现在会按预期显示逐个服务器的审批对话框

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control` crashing immediately on npm installs with "bad option: --sdk-url" (anthropics/claude-code#28334)
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Remote-control”在使用“错误选项：--sdk-url”安装 npm 时立即崩溃的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#28334)

entries.en: Fixed `--model claude-opus-4-0` and `--model claude-opus-4-1` resolving to deprecated Opus versions instead of current
entries.zh: 修复了 `--model claude-opus-4-0` 和 `--model claude-opus-4-1` 解析为已弃用的 Opus 版本而不是当前版本

entries.en: Fixed macOS keychain corruption when using multiple OAuth MCP servers. Large OAuth metadata blobs could overflow the `security -i` stdin buffer, silently leaving stale credentials behind and causing repeated `/login` prompts.
entries.zh: 修复了使用多个 OAuth MCP 服务器时 macOS 钥匙串损坏的问题。大型 OAuth 元数据 blob 可能会溢出`security -i`标准输入缓冲区，默默地留下过时的凭据并导致重复的`/login`提示。

entries.en: Fixed `.credentials.json` losing `subscriptionType` (showing "Claude API" instead of "Claude Pro"/"Claude Max") when the profile endpoint transiently fails during token refresh (anthropics/claude-code#30185)
entries.zh: 修复了当配置文件端点在令牌刷新期间短暂失败时`.credentials.json`丢失`subscriptionType`（显示“Claude API”而不是“Claude Pro”/“Claude Max”）的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#30185)

entries.en: Fixed ghost dotfiles (`.bashrc`, `HEAD`, etc.) appearing as untracked files in the working directory after sandboxed Bash commands on Linux
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上的沙盒 Bash 命令后，幽灵点文件（`.bashrc`、`HEAD` 等）在工作目录中显示为未跟踪文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Enter printing `[27;2;13~` instead of inserting a newline in Ghostty over SSH
entries.zh: 修复了 Shift+Enter 打印 `[27;2;13~` 而不是通过 SSH 在 Ghostty 中插入换行符

entries.en: Fixed stash (Ctrl+S) being cleared when submitting a message while Claude is working
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德工作时提交消息时存储（Ctrl+S）被清除的问题

entries.en: Fixed ctrl+o (transcript toggle) freezing for many seconds in long sessions with lots of file edits
entries.zh: 修复了在进行大量文件编辑的长时间会话中 ctrl+o（脚本切换）冻结数秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode feedback input not supporting multi-line text entry (backslash+Enter and Shift+Enter now insert newlines)
entries.zh: 修复了计划模式反馈输入不支持多行文本输入的问题（反斜杠+Enter 和 Shift+Enter 现在插入换行符）

entries.en: Fixed cursor not moving down into blank lines at the top of the input box
entries.zh: 修复了光标未向下移动到输入框顶部的空白行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/stats` crash when transcript files contain entries with missing or malformed timestamps
entries.zh: 修复了当转录文件包含时间戳缺失或格式错误的条目时`/stats`崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a brief hang after a streaming error on long sessions (the transcript was being fully rewritten to drop one line; it is now truncated in place)
entries.zh: 修复了长时间会话中发生流式传输错误后的短暂挂起（记录被完全重写以删除一行；现在已就地截断）

entries.en: Fixed `--setting-sources user` not blocking dynamically discovered project skills
entries.zh: 修复了“--setting-source user”不阻止动态发现的项目技能的问题
