entries.en: Fixed duplicate CLAUDE.md, slash commands, agents, and rules when running from a worktree nested inside its main repo (e.g. `claude -w`)
entries.zh: 修复了从嵌套在其主存储库中的工作树运行时重复的 CLAUDE.md、斜线命令、代理和规则（例如`claude -w`）

entries.en: Fixed plugin Stop/SessionEnd/etc hooks not firing after any `/plugin` operation
entries.zh: 修复了插件 Stop/SessionEnd/etc 挂钩在任何`/plugin`操作后不会触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin hooks being silently dropped when two plugins use the same `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/...` command template
entries.zh: 修复了当两个插件使用相同的 `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/...` 命令模板时插件挂钩会被默默删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in long-running SDK/CCR sessions where conversation messages were retained unnecessarily
entries.zh: 修复了长时间运行的 SDK/CCR 会话中不必要地保留对话消息的内存泄漏问题

entries.en: Fixed API 400 errors in forked agents (autocompact, summarization) when resuming sessions that were interrupted mid-tool-batch
entries.zh: 修复了恢复工具批次中中断的会话时分叉代理（自动压缩、汇总）中的 API 400 错误

entries.en: Fixed "unexpected tool_use_id found in tool_result blocks" error when resuming conversations that start with an orphaned tool result
entries.zh: 修复了恢复以孤立工具结果开始的对话时出现“在 tool_result 块中发现意外的 tool_use_id”错误

entries.en: Fixed teammates accidentally spawning nested teammates via the Agent tool's `name` parameter
entries.zh: 修复队友通过 Agent 工具的 `name` 参数意外生成嵌套队友的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` being ignored during conversation compaction
entries.zh: 修复了对话压缩期间忽略`CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/compact` summary rendering as a user bubble in SDK consumers (Claude Code Remote web UI, VSCode extension)
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK 使用者中`/compact`摘要呈现为用户气泡的问题（Claude Code Remote Web UI、VSCode 扩展）

entries.en: Fixed voice space bar getting stuck after a failed voice activation (module loading race, cold GrowthBook)
entries.zh: 修复语音激活失败后（模块加载竞态、GrowthBook 冷启动）空格键卡住的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree file copy on Windows
entries.zh: 修复 Windows 上的工作树文件复制问题

entries.en: Fixed global `.claude` folder detection on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的全局`.claude`文件夹检测

entries.en: Fixed symlink bypass where writing new files through a symlinked parent directory could escape the working directory in `acceptEdits` mode
entries.zh: 修复了符号链接绕过问题，其中通过符号链接父目录写入新文件可能会在`acceptEdits`模式下转义工作目录

entries.en: Fixed sandbox prompting users to approve non-allowed domains when `allowManagedDomainsOnly` is enabled in managed settings — non-allowed domains are now blocked automatically with no bypass
entries.zh: 修复了在托管设置中启用`allowManagedDomainsOnly`时提示用户批准非允许域的沙箱 — 非允许域现在会自动阻止，不会绕过

entries.en: Fixed interactive tools (e.g., `AskUserQuestion`) being silently auto-allowed when listed in a skill's allowed-tools, bypassing the permission prompt and running with empty answers
entries.zh: 修复了交互式工具（例如`AskUserQuestion`）在技能的允许工具中列出时被静默自动允许，绕过权限提示并以空答案运行

entries.en: Fixed multi-GB memory spike when committing with large untracked binary files in the working tree
entries.zh: 修复了在工作树中提交大型未跟踪二进制文件时出现的多 GB 内存峰值

entries.en: Fixed Escape not interrupting a running turn when the input box has draft text. Use Up arrow to pull queued messages back for editing, or Ctrl+U to clear the input line.
entries.zh: 修复了当输入框有草稿文本时 Escape 不会中断正在运行的转弯。使用向上箭头将排队的消息拉回进行编辑，或使用 Ctrl+U 清除输入行。

entries.en: Fixed Android app crash when running local slash commands (`/voice`, `/cost`) in Remote Control sessions
entries.zh: 修复了在远程控制会话中运行本地斜杠命令（`/voice`、`/cost`）时 Android 应用程序崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where old message array versions accumulated in React Compiler `memoCache` over long sessions
entries.zh: 修复了长期会话中旧消息数组版本在 React Compiler`memoCache`中累积的内存泄漏问题

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where REPL render scopes accumulated over long sessions (~35MB over 1000 turns)
entries.zh: 修复了 REPL 渲染范围在长时间会话中累积的内存泄漏（超过 1000 回合约 35MB）

entries.en: Fixed memory retention in in-process teammates where the parent's full conversation history was pinned for the teammate's lifetime, preventing GC after `/clear` or auto-compact
entries.zh: 修复了进程内队友中的内存保留问题，其中父级的完整对话历史记录被固定在队友的生命周期中，从而防止在`/clear`或自动压缩后发生GC

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak in interactive mode where hook events could accumulate unboundedly during long sessions
entries.zh: 修复了交互模式下的内存泄漏，其中挂钩事件在长时间会话期间可能无限累积

entries.en: Fixed hang when `--mcp-config` points to a corrupted file
entries.zh: 修复了`--mcp-config`指向损坏文件时的挂起问题

entries.en: Fixed slow startup when many skills/plugins are installed
entries.zh: 修复了安装许多技能/插件时启动缓慢的问题

entries.en: Fixed `cd <outside-dir> && <cmd>` permission prompt to surface the chained command instead of only showing "Yes, allow reading from <dir>/"
entries.zh: 修复了 `cd <outside-dir> && <cmd>` 权限提示以显示链接命令，而不是仅显示“是，允许从 <dir>/ 读取”

entries.en: Fixed conditional `.claude/rules/*.md` files (with `paths:` frontmatter) and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading in print mode (`claude -p`)
entries.zh: 修复了条件 `.claude/rules/*.md` 文件（带有 `paths:` frontmatter）和嵌套 CLAUDE.md 文件未在打印模式下加载（`claude -p`）

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` not fully clearing all session caches, reducing memory retention in long sessions
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`未完全清除所有会话缓存的问题，减少了长时间会话中的内存保留

entries.en: Fixed terminal flicker caused by animated elements at the scrollback boundary
entries.zh: 修复动画元素位于滚动缓冲区边界时造成的终端闪烁问题

entries.en: Fixed UI frame drops on macOS when using MCP servers with OAuth (regression from 2.1.x)
entries.zh: 修复了使用带有 OAuth 的 MCP 服务器时 macOS 上的 UI 帧丢失问题（从 2.1.x 回归）

entries.en: Fixed occasional frame stalls during typing caused by synchronous debug log flushes
entries.zh: 修复了同步调试日志刷新导致打字期间偶尔出现的帧停顿问题

entries.en: Fixed `TeammateIdle` and `TaskCompleted` hooks to support `{"continue": false, "stopReason": "..."}` to stop the teammate, matching `Stop` hook behavior
entries.zh: 修复了`TeammateIdle`和`TaskCompleted`钩子以支持`{"continue": false, "stopReason": "..."}`来停止队友，匹配`Stop`钩子行为

entries.en: Fixed `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` plugin hooks being silently ignored
entries.zh: 修复了`WorktreeCreate`和`WorktreeRemove`插件挂钩被默默忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed skill descriptions with colons (e.g., "Triggers include: X, Y, Z") failing to load from SKILL.md frontmatter
entries.zh: 修复了带有冒号的技能描述（例如“触发器包括：X、Y、Z”）无法从 SKILL.md frontmatter 加载的问题

entries.en: Fixed project skills without a `description:` frontmatter field not appearing in Claude's available skills list
entries.zh: 修复了没有“描述：”frontmatter 字段的项目技能未出现在克劳德的可用技能列表中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/context` showing identical token counts for all MCP tools from a server
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`显示服务器中所有 MCP 工具的相同令牌计数的问题

entries.en: Fixed literal `nul` file creation on Windows when the model uses CMD-style `2>nul` redirection in Git Bash
entries.zh: 修复了模型在 Git Bash 中使用 CMD 样式`2>nul`重定向时在 Windows 上创建文字`nul`文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed extra blank lines appearing below each tool call in the expanded subagent transcript view (Ctrl+O)
entries.zh: 修复了扩展子代理记录视图 (Ctrl+O) 中每个工具调用下方出现的额外空白行

entries.en: Fixed Tab/arrow keys not cycling Settings tabs when `/config` search box is focused but empty
entries.zh: 修复了当`/config`搜索框聚焦但为空时选项卡/箭头键不循环“设置”选项卡的问题

entries.en: Fixed service key OAuth sessions (CCR containers) spamming `[ERROR]` logs with 403s from profile-scoped endpoints
entries.zh: 修复了服务密钥 OAuth 会话（CCR 容器）从配置文件范围端点向`[ERROR]`日志发送 403 垃圾邮件的问题

entries.en: Fixed inconsistent color for "Remote Control active" status indicator
entries.zh: 修复了“远程控制活动”状态指示器颜色不一致的问题

entries.en: Fixed Voice waveform cursor covering the first suffix letter when dictating mid-input
entries.zh: 修复了在听写中间输入时语音波形光标覆盖第一个后缀字母的问题

entries.en: Fixed Voice input showing all 5 spaces during warmup instead of capping at ~2 (aligning with the "keep holding…" hint)
entries.zh: 修复了语音输入在热身期间显示所有 5 个空格的问题，而不是上限为 ~2（与“保持按住…”提示一致）

entries.en: Improved spinner performance by isolating the 50ms animation loop from the surrounding shell, reducing render and CPU overhead during turns
entries.zh: 改进加载动画性能：50 毫秒的动画循环与外层 shell 隔离，减少每轮对话中的渲染和 CPU 开销

entries.en: Improved UI rendering performance in native binaries with React Compiler
entries.zh: 借助 React Compiler 提升原生构建版本的界面渲染性能

entries.en: Improved `--worktree` startup by eliminating a git subprocess on the startup path
entries.zh: 改进 `--worktree` 启动：去掉启动路径上的一个 git 子进程

entries.en: Improved macOS startup by eliminating redundant settings-file reloads when managed settings resolve
entries.zh: 改进 macOS 启动：托管设置解析完成后，不再重复重新加载设置文件

entries.en: Improved macOS startup for Claude.ai enterprise/team users by skipping an unnecessary keychain lookup
entries.zh: 改进 macOS 启动：Claude.ai 企业版和团队版用户跳过了不必要的钥匙串查找

entries.en: Improved MCP `-p` startup by pipelining claude.ai config fetch with local connections and using a concurrency pool instead of sequential batching
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 的 `-p` 启动：claude.ai 配置获取与本地连接并行进行，并用并发池代替顺序分批

entries.en: Improved voice startup by removing imperceptible warmup pulse animations that were causing re-render stutter
entries.zh: 改进语音启动：去掉了不易察觉的预热脉冲动画，这些动画曾导致重绘卡顿

entries.en: Improved MCP binary content handling: tools returning PDFs, Office documents, or audio now save decoded bytes to disk with the correct file extension instead of dumping raw base64 into the conversation context. WebFetch also saves binary responses alongside its summary.
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 二进制内容处理：返回 PDF、Office 文档或音频的工具，现在会把解码后的字节按正确扩展名存到磁盘，而不是把原始 base64 倒进对话上下文；WebFetch 遇到二进制响应时也会与摘要一起保存

entries.en: Improved memory usage in long sessions by stabilizing `onSubmit` across message updates
entries.zh: 改进长会话的内存占用：`onSubmit` 在消息更新之间保持稳定

entries.en: Improved LSP tool rendering and memory context building to no longer read entire files
entries.zh: 改进 LSP 工具的渲染和内存上下文构建，不再整文件读取

entries.en: Improved session upload and memory sync to avoid reading large files into memory before size/binary checks
entries.zh: 改进会话上传和内存同步：在检查文件大小和是否为二进制之前，不再把大文件整个读入内存

entries.en: Improved file operation performance by avoiding reading file contents for existence checks (6 sites)
entries.zh: 改进文件操作性能：检查文件是否存在时不再读取文件内容（共 6 处）

entries.en: Improved documentation to clarify that `--append-system-prompt-file` and `--system-prompt-file` work in interactive mode (the docs previously said print mode only)
entries.zh: 改进文档：说明 `--append-system-prompt-file` 和 `--system-prompt-file` 在交互模式下也可用（文档此前只写了 print 模式）

entries.en: Reduced baseline memory by ~16MB by deferring Yoga WASM preloading
entries.zh: 通过延后预加载 Yoga WASM，基础内存降低约 16MB

entries.en: Reduced memory footprint for SDK and CCR sessions using stream-json output
entries.zh: 使用 stream-json 输出的 SDK 和 CCR 会话，内存占用降低

entries.en: Reduced memory usage when resuming large sessions (including compacted history)
entries.zh: 恢复大型会话（包括压缩过的历史）时，内存占用降低

entries.en: Reduced token usage on multi-agent tasks with more concise subagent final reports
entries.zh: 多代理任务中子代理的最终报告更简洁，token 用量减少

entries.en: Changed Sonnet 4.5 users on Pro/Max/Team Premium to be automatically migrated to Sonnet 4.6
entries.zh: 将 Pro/Max/Team Premium 上的 Sonnet 4.5 用户更改为自动迁移到 Sonnet 4.6

entries.en: Changed the `/resume` picker to show your most recent prompt instead of the first one. This also resolves some titles appearing as `(session)`.
entries.zh: 更改了`/resume`选择器以显示最近的提示而不是第一个提示。这也解决了一些显示为“（会话）”的标题。

entries.en: Changed claude.ai MCP connector failures to show a notification instead of silently disappearing from the tool list
entries.zh: 更改了 claude.ai MCP 连接器故障以显示通知，而不是从工具列表中默默消失

entries.en: Changed example command suggestions to be generated deterministically instead of calling Haiku
entries.zh: 更改了示例命令建议以确定性方式生成，而不是调用 Haiku

entries.en: Changed resuming after compaction to no longer produce a preamble recap before continuing
entries.zh: 更改了压缩后的恢复，以在继续之前不再生成前导码回顾

entries.en: [SDK] Changed task creation to no longer require the `activeForm` field — the spinner falls back to the task subject
entries.zh: [SDK] 创建任务时不再需要 `activeForm` 字段；加载动画会改用任务标题显示

entries.en: [VSCode] Added compaction display as a collapsible "Compacted chat" card with the summary inside
entries.zh: [VSCode] 压缩显示为可折叠的「Compacted chat」卡片，卡片内含摘要

entries.en: [VSCode] The permission mode picker now respects `permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode` from your effective Claude Code settings (including managed/policy settings) — when set to `disable`, bypass permissions mode is hidden from the picker
entries.zh: [VSCode] 权限模式选择器现在遵循你生效的 Claude Code 设置（包括托管/策略设置）中的 `permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode`；设为 `disable` 时，选择器中会隐藏 bypass permissions 模式

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed RTL text (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian) rendering reversed in the chat panel (regression in v2.1.63)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复聊天面板中 RTL 文本（阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语）显示顺序反转的问题（v2.1.63 中的回归问题）

entries.en: Opus 4.6 now defaults to medium effort for Max and Team subscribers. Medium effort works well for most tasks — it's the sweet spot between speed and thoroughness. You can change this anytime with `/model`
entries.zh: Opus 4.6 对 Max 和 Team 订阅用户默认使用中等 effort。中等 effort 适合大多数任务，是速度和细致程度之间的平衡点。你随时可以用 `/model` 修改

entries.en: Re-introduced the "ultrathink" keyword to enable high effort for the next turn
entries.zh: 重新加入 "ultrathink" 关键词，可让下一轮启用高强度思考

entries.en: Removed Opus 4 and 4.1 from Claude Code on the first-party API — users with these models pinned are automatically moved to Opus 4.6
entries.zh: 第一方 API 上的 Claude Code 已移除 Opus 4 和 4.1；仍固定使用这些模型的用户会自动迁移到 Opus 4.6

entries.en: Reduced spurious error logging
entries.zh: 减少不必要的错误日志

entries.en: Added `/simplify` and `/batch` bundled slash commands
entries.zh: 添加了`/simplify`和`/batch`捆绑斜杠命令

entries.en: Fixed local slash command output like /cost appearing as user-sent messages instead of system messages in the UI
entries.zh: 修复了本地斜杠命令输出（例如 /cost）在 UI 中显示为用户发送的消息而不是系统消息

entries.en: Project configs & auto memory now shared across git worktrees of the same repository
entries.zh: 项目配置和自动记忆现在可以在同一个 git 仓库的多个 worktree 之间共享

entries.en: Added `ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false` env var to opt out from making claude.ai MCP servers available
entries.zh: 添加了`ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false`环境变量以选择不使 claude.ai MCP 服务器可用

entries.en: Improved `/model` command to show the currently active model in the slash command menu
entries.zh: 改进 `/model` 命令：在斜杠命令菜单中显示当前生效的模型

entries.en: Added HTTP hooks, which can POST JSON to a URL and receive JSON instead of running a shell command
entries.zh: 添加了 HTTP 挂钩，它可以将 JSON POST 到 URL 并接收 JSON，而不是运行 shell 命令

entries.en: Fixed listener leak in bridge polling loop
entries.zh: 修复了桥接轮询循环中的侦听器泄漏

entries.en: Fixed listener leak in MCP OAuth flow cleanup
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP OAuth 流清理中的侦听器泄漏

entries.en: Added manual URL paste fallback during MCP OAuth authentication. If the automatic localhost redirect doesn't work, you can paste the callback URL to complete authentication.
entries.zh: 在 MCP OAuth 身份验证期间添加了手动 URL 粘贴回退。如果自动本地主机重定向不起作用，您可以粘贴回调 URL 以完成身份验证。

entries.en: Fixed memory leak when navigating hooks configuration menu
entries.zh: 修复了导航钩子配置菜单时的内存泄漏

entries.en: Fixed listener leak in interactive permission handler during auto-approvals
entries.zh: 修复了自动批准期间交互式权限处理程序中的侦听器泄漏

entries.en: Fixed file count cache ignoring glob ignore patterns
entries.zh: 修复了忽略 glob 忽略模式的文件计数缓存

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in bash command prefix cache
entries.zh: 修复了 bash 命令前缀缓存中的内存泄漏

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool/resource cache leak on server reconnect
entries.zh: 修复了服务器重新连接时的 MCP 工具/资源缓存泄漏

entries.en: Fixed IDE host IP detection cache incorrectly sharing results across ports
entries.zh: 修复了 IDE 主机 IP 检测缓存错误地跨端口共享结果的问题

entries.en: Fixed WebSocket listener leak on transport reconnect
entries.zh: 修复了传输重新连接时的 WebSocket 侦听器泄漏

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in git root detection cache that could cause unbounded growth in long-running sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 git root 检测缓存中的内存泄漏，该泄漏可能导致长时间运行的会话无限增长

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in JSON parsing cache that grew unbounded over long sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 JSON 解析缓存中的内存泄漏，该泄漏在长时间会话中无限增长

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed remote sessions not appearing in conversation history
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了远程会话不显示在对话历史中的问题

entries.en: Fixed a race condition in the REPL bridge where new messages could arrive at the server interleaved with historical messages during the initial connection flush, causing message ordering issues.
entries.zh: 修复 REPL 桥接中的竞态条件：初次连接刷新时，新消息可能与历史消息交错到达服务器，导致消息顺序错乱的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory leak where long-running teammates retained all messages in AppState even after conversation compaction
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，即使在对话压缩后，长时间运行的队友仍保留 AppState 中的所有消息

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where MCP server fetch caches were not cleared on disconnect, causing growing memory usage with servers that reconnect frequently
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，其中 MCP 服务器获取缓存在断开连接时未清除，导致频繁重新连接的服务器内存使用量增加

entries.en: Improved memory usage in long sessions with subagents by stripping heavy progress message payloads during context compaction
entries.zh: 改进含子代理的长会话的内存占用：压缩上下文时，去掉繁重的进度消息负载

entries.en: Added "Always copy full response" option to the `/copy` picker. When selected, future `/copy` commands will skip the code block picker and copy the full response directly.
entries.zh: 在`/copy`选择器中添加了“始终复制完整响应”选项。选择后，未来的`/copy`命令将跳过代码块选择器并直接复制完整响应。

entries.en: VSCode: Added session rename and remove actions to the sessions list
entries.zh: VS Code：会话列表中新增会话重命名和删除操作

entries.en: Fixed `/clear` not resetting cached skills, which could cause stale skill content to persist in the new conversation
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`不重置缓存技能的问题，这可能导致过时的技能内容保留在新对话中

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestion cache regression that reduced cache hit rates
entries.zh: 修复了提示建议缓存回归，降低了缓存命中率

entries.en: Fixed concurrent writes corrupting config file on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上并发写入损坏配置文件的问题

entries.en: Claude automatically saves useful context to auto-memory. Manage with /memory
entries.zh: 克劳德自动将有用的上下文保存到自动记忆中。使用/内存进行管理

entries.en: Added `/copy` command to show an interactive picker when code blocks are present, allowing selection of individual code blocks or the full response.
entries.zh: 添加了`/copy`命令以在存在代码块时显示交互式选择器，从而允许选择单个代码块或完整响应。

entries.en: Improved "always allow" prefix suggestions for compound bash commands (e.g. `cd /tmp && git fetch && git push`) to compute smarter per-subcommand prefixes instead of treating the whole command as one
entries.zh: 改进复合 bash 命令（如 `cd /tmp && git fetch && git push`）的“始终允许”前缀建议：按子命令分别计算更精确的前缀，而不是把整条命令当成一个整体

entries.en: Improved ordering of short task lists
entries.zh: 改进短任务列表的排序

entries.en: Improved memory usage in multi-agent sessions by releasing completed subagent task state
entries.zh: 改进多 agent 会话的内存占用：释放已完成子代理的任务状态

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth token refresh race condition when running multiple Claude Code instances simultaneously
entries.zh: 修复了同时运行多个 Claude Code 实例时的 MCP OAuth 令牌刷新竞争条件

entries.en: Fixed shell commands not showing a clear error message when the working directory has been deleted
entries.zh: 修复了删除工作目录时 shell 命令不显示明确错误消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed config file corruption that could wipe authentication when multiple Claude Code instances ran simultaneously
entries.zh: 修复了配置文件损坏，当多个 Claude Code 实例同时运行时可能会擦除身份验证

entries.en: Expand Remote Control to more users
entries.zh: 将远程控制扩展到更多用户

entries.en: VS Code: Fixed another cause of "command 'claude-vscode.editor.openLast' not found" crashes
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了另一个导致 "command 'claude-vscode.editor.openLast' not found" 崩溃的原因

entries.en: Fixed BashTool failing on Windows with EINVAL error
entries.zh: 修复了 BashTool 在 Windows 上失败并出现 EINVAL 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed a UI flicker where user input would briefly disappear after submission before the message rendered
entries.zh: 修复了用户输入在提交后、消息渲染之前会短暂消失的 UI 闪烁问题

entries.en: Fixed bulk agent kill (ctrl+f) to send a single aggregate notification instead of one per agent, and to properly clear the command queue
entries.zh: 修复了批量代理终止（ctrl+f）以发送单个聚合通知而不是每个代理一个，并正确清除命令队列

entries.en: Fixed graceful shutdown sometimes leaving stale sessions when using Remote Control by parallelizing teardown network calls
entries.zh: 通过并行拆卸网络调用，修复了使用远程控制时有时会留下陈旧会话的正常关闭问题

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree` sometimes being ignored on first launch
entries.zh: 修复了首次启动时有时会忽略`--worktree`的问题

entries.en: Fixed a panic ("switch on corrupted value") on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的恐慌（“打开损坏的值”）

entries.en: Fixed a crash that could occur when spawning many processes on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 上生成多个进程时可能发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed a crash in the WebAssembly interpreter on Linux x64 & Windows x64
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux x64 和 Windows x64 上的 WebAssembly 解释器崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred after 2 minutes on Windows ARM64
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows ARM64 上有时 2 分钟后发生的崩溃

entries.en: VS Code: Fixed extension crash on Windows ("command 'claude-vscode.editor.openLast' not found")
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了 Windows 上扩展因 "command 'claude-vscode.editor.openLast' not found" 崩溃的问题

entries.en: Added `claude remote-control` subcommand for external builds, enabling local environment serving for all users.
entries.zh: 添加了用于外部构建的“claude Remote-control”子命令，为所有用户提供本地环境服务。

entries.en: Updated plugin marketplace default git timeout from 30s to 120s and added `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS` to configure.
entries.zh: 插件市场默认的 git 超时从 30 秒改为 120 秒，并新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS` 用于配置

entries.en: Added support for custom npm registries and specific version pinning when installing plugins from npm sources
entries.zh: 添加了对自定义 npm 注册表和从 npm 源安装插件时固定特定版本的支持

entries.en: BashTool now skips login shell (`-l` flag) by default when a shell snapshot is available, improving command execution performance. Previously this required setting `CLAUDE_BASH_NO_LOGIN=true`.
entries.zh: 当 shell 快照可用时，BashTool 现在默认跳过登录 shell（`-l`标志），从而提高命令执行性能。以前这需要设置`CLAUDE_BASH_NO_LOGIN=true`。

entries.en: Fixed a security issue where `statusLine` and `fileSuggestion` hook commands could execute without workspace trust acceptance in interactive mode.
entries.zh: 修复了`statusLine`和`fileSuggestion`挂钩命令在交互模式下无需工作区信任接受即可执行的安全问题。

entries.en: Tool results larger than 50K characters are now persisted to disk (previously 100K). This reduces context window usage and improves conversation longevity.
entries.zh: 超过 50K 字符的工具结果现在会保存到磁盘（原为 100K）。这样可以减少上下文窗口占用，延长对话的可用时间

entries.en: Fixed a bug where duplicate `control_response` messages (e.g. from WebSocket reconnects) could cause API 400 errors by pushing duplicate assistant messages into the conversation.
entries.zh: 修复了重复的`control_response`消息（例如来自 WebSocket 重新连接）可能通过将重复的助理消息推送到对话中而导致 API 400 错误的错误。

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` environment variables for SDK callers to provide account info synchronously, eliminating a race condition where early telemetry events lacked account metadata.
entries.zh: 为 SDK 调用者添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID`、`CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL`和`CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID`环境变量，以同步提供帐户信息，从而消除了早期遥测事件缺乏帐户元数据的竞争情况。

entries.en: Fixed slash command autocomplete crashing when a plugin's SKILL.md description is a YAML array or other non-string type
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的 SKILL.md 描述是 YAML 数组或其他非字符串类型时斜杠命令自动完成崩溃的问题

entries.en: The `/model` picker now shows human-readable labels (e.g., "Sonnet 4.5") instead of raw model IDs for pinned model versions, with an upgrade hint when a newer version is available.
entries.zh: `/model` 选择器对固定的模型版本，现在显示易读的名称（如 "Sonnet 4.5"），而不是原始模型 ID；有新版本时会给出升级提示

entries.en: Managed settings can now be set via macOS plist or Windows Registry. Learn more at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#settings-files
entries.zh: 托管设置现在可以通过 macOS plist 或 Windows 注册表设置。详见 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#settings-files

entries.en: Added support for `startupTimeout` configuration for LSP servers
entries.zh: 添加了对 LSP 服务器`startupTimeout`配置的支持

entries.en: Added `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hook events, enabling custom VCS setup and teardown when agent worktree isolation creates or removes worktrees.
entries.zh: 添加了`WorktreeCreate`和`WorktreeRemove`挂钩事件，以便在代理工作树隔离创建或删除工作树时启用自定义 VCS 设置和拆卸。

entries.en: Fixed a bug where resumed sessions could be invisible when the working directory involved symlinks, because the session storage path was resolved at different times during startup. Also fixed session data loss on SSH disconnect by flushing session data before hooks and analytics in the graceful shutdown sequence.
entries.zh: 修复了当工作目录涉及符号链接时恢复的会话可能不可见的错误，因为会话存储路径是在启动过程中的不同时间解析的。还通过在正常关闭序列中的挂钩和分析之前刷新会话数据，修复了 SSH 断开连接时的会话数据丢失问题。

entries.en: Linux: Fixed native modules not loading on systems with glibc older than 2.30 (e.g., RHEL 8)
entries.zh: Linux：修复了在 glibc 版本低于 2.30 的系统（如 RHEL 8）上原生模块无法加载的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in agent teams where completed teammate tasks were never garbage collected from session state
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队中的内存泄漏问题，其中已完成的队友任务从未从会话状态中进行垃圾收集

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE` to fully strip down skills, session memory, custom agents, and CLAUDE.md token counting
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE`以完全精简技能、会话内存、自定义代理和 CLAUDE.md 令牌计数

entries.en: Fixed `/mcp reconnect` freezing the CLI when given a server name that doesn't exist
entries.zh: 修复了`/mcp reconnect`在给定不存在的服务器名称时冻结 CLI 的问题

entries.en: Fixed memory leak where completed task state objects were never removed from AppState
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，已完成的任务状态对象从未从 AppState 中删除

entries.en: Added support for `isolation: worktree` in agent definitions, allowing agents to declaratively run in isolated git worktrees.
entries.zh: 在代理定义中添加了对`isolation: worktree`的支持，允许代理以声明方式在隔离的 git 工作树中运行。

entries.en: `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE` mode now also disables MCP tools, attachments, hooks, and CLAUDE.md file loading for a fully minimal experience.
entries.zh: `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE` 模式现在还会禁用 MCP 工具、附件、hook 和 CLAUDE.md 文件加载，实现完全精简的体验。

entries.en: Fixed bug where MCP tools were not discovered when tool search is enabled and a prompt is passed in as a launch argument
entries.zh: 修复了启用工具搜索并且提示作为启动参数传入时未发现 MCP 工具的错误

entries.en: Improved memory usage during long sessions by clearing internal caches after compaction
entries.zh: 改进长会话的内存占用：压缩后清理内部缓存

entries.en: Added `claude agents` CLI command to list all configured agents
entries.zh: 添加了“claudeagents”CLI 命令来列出所有已配置的代理

entries.en: Improved memory usage during long sessions by clearing large tool results after they have been processed
entries.zh: 改进长会话的内存占用：大的工具结果在处理完后被清理

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where LSP diagnostic data was never cleaned up after delivery, causing unbounded memory growth in long sessions
entries.zh: 修复了 LSP 诊断数据在交付后从未清理的内存泄漏，导致长会话中内存无限增长

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where completed task output was not freed from memory, reducing memory usage in long sessions with many tasks
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，其中已完成的任务输出未从内存中释放，从而减少了具有许多任务的长会话中的内存使用量

entries.en: Improved startup performance for headless mode (`-p` flag) by deferring Yoga WASM and UI component imports
entries.zh: 改进无头模式（`-p` 参数）的启动性能：推迟加载 Yoga WASM 和界面组件

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestion cache regression that reduced cache hit rates
entries.zh: 修复了提示建议缓存回归，降低了缓存命中率

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth in long sessions by capping file history snapshots
entries.zh: 修复长会话中文件历史快照无上限导致内存增长的问题；现在会对快照数量设置上限

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` environment variable to disable 1M context window support
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT`环境变量以禁用 1M 上下文窗口支持

entries.en: Opus 4.6 (fast mode) now includes the full 1M context window
entries.zh: Opus 4.6（快速模式）现在包含完整的 100 万 token 上下文窗口

entries.en: VSCode: Added `/extra-usage` command support in VS Code sessions
entries.zh: VS Code：在 VS Code 会话中新增 `/extra-usage` 命令支持

entries.en: Fixed memory leak where TaskOutput retained recent lines after cleanup
entries.zh: 修复了 TaskOutput 在清理后保留最近行的内存泄漏问题

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in CircularBuffer where cleared items were retained in the backing array
entries.zh: 修复了 CircularBuffer 中的内存泄漏问题，其中已清除的项目保留在后备数组中

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in shell command execution where ChildProcess and AbortController references were retained after cleanup
entries.zh: 修复了 shell 命令执行中的内存泄漏，其中 ChildProcess 和 AbortController 引用在清理后被保留

entries.en: Improved MCP OAuth authentication with step-up auth support and discovery caching, reducing redundant network requests during server connections
entries.zh: 改进 MCP OAuth 认证：支持 step-up 认证并缓存发现结果，减少连接服务器时多余的网络请求

entries.en: Added `--worktree` (`-w`) flag to start Claude in an isolated git worktree
entries.zh: 添加了 `--worktree` (`-w`) 标志以在隔离的 git 工作树中启动 Claude

entries.en: Subagents support `isolation: "worktree"` for working in a temporary git worktree
entries.zh: 子代理支持 `isolation: "worktree"`，可在临时的 git worktree 中工作

entries.en: Added Ctrl+F keybinding to kill background agents (two-press confirmation)
entries.zh: 添加了 Ctrl+F 键绑定来杀死后台代理（按两次确认）

entries.en: Agent definitions support `background: true` to always run as a background task
entries.zh: 代理定义支持`background: true`始终作为后台任务运行

entries.en: Plugins can ship `settings.json` for default configuration
entries.zh: 插件可附带 `settings.json` 作为默认配置

entries.en: Fixed file-not-found errors to suggest corrected paths when the model drops the repo folder
entries.zh: 修复了文件未找到错误，以在模型删除存储库文件夹时建议更正的路径

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C and ESC being silently ignored when background agents are running and the main thread is idle. Pressing twice within 3 seconds now kills all background agents.
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理运行且主线程空闲时 Ctrl+C 和 ESC 被静默忽略的问题。现在在 3 秒内按两次会杀死所有后台代理。

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestion cache regression that reduced cache hit rates.
entries.zh: 修复了提示建议缓存回归，降低了缓存命中率。

entries.en: Fixed `plugin enable` and `plugin disable` to auto-detect the correct scope when `--scope` is not specified, instead of always defaulting to user scope
entries.zh: 修复了“插件启用”和“插件禁用”，以便在未指定`--scope`时自动检测正确的范围，而不是始终默认为用户范围

entries.en: Simple mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE`) now includes the file edit tool in addition to the Bash tool, allowing direct file editing in simple mode.
entries.zh: 简单模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE`）现在除 Bash 工具外还包含文件编辑工具，可在简单模式下直接编辑文件

entries.en: Permission suggestions are now populated when safety checks trigger an ask response, enabling SDK consumers to display permission options
entries.zh: 安全检查触发 ask 响应时，现在会填充权限建议，使 SDK 使用方可以显示权限选项

entries.en: Sonnet 4.5 with 1M context is being removed from the Max plan in favor of our frontier Sonnet 4.6 model, which now has 1M context. Please switch in /model.
entries.zh: Sonnet 4.5（1M 上下文）将从 Max 套餐中移除，改用前沿的 Sonnet 4.6（现已支持 1M 上下文）。请在 `/model` 中切换

entries.en: Fixed verbose mode not updating thinking block display when toggled via `/config` — memo comparators now correctly detect verbose changes
entries.zh: 修复通过 `/config` 切换详细模式时，思考块显示不更新的问题；现在备忘录比较器能正确检测详细模式的变化

entries.en: Fixed unbounded WASM memory growth during long sessions by periodically resetting the tree-sitter parser
entries.zh: 修复长会话中 WASM 内存无限增长的问题：现在会定期重置 tree-sitter 解析器

entries.en: Fixed potential rendering issues caused by stale yoga layout references
entries.zh: 修复了因过时的瑜伽布局参考引起的潜在渲染问题

entries.en: Improved performance in non-interactive mode (`-p`) by skipping unnecessary API calls during startup
entries.zh: 改进非交互模式（`-p`）性能：启动时跳过不必要的 API 调用

entries.en: Improved performance by caching authentication failures for HTTP and SSE MCP servers, avoiding repeated connection attempts to servers requiring auth
entries.zh: 改进性能：缓存 HTTP 和 SSE 类 MCP 服务器的认证失败结果，避免反复连接需要认证的服务器

entries.en: Fixed unbounded memory growth during long-running sessions caused by Yoga WASM linear memory never shrinking
entries.zh: 修复长时间运行的会话中，Yoga WASM 线性内存从不收缩导致内存无限增长的问题

entries.en: SDK model info now includes `supportsEffort`, `supportedEffortLevels`, and `supportsAdaptiveThinking` fields so consumers can discover model capabilities.
entries.zh: SDK 的模型信息现在包含 `supportsEffort`、`supportedEffortLevels` 和 `supportsAdaptiveThinking` 字段，方便调用方了解模型能力

entries.en: Added `ConfigChange` hook event that fires when configuration files change during a session, enabling enterprise security auditing and optional blocking of settings changes.
entries.zh: 添加了`ConfigChange`挂钩事件，该事件在会话期间配置文件更改时触发，从而启用企业安全审核和可选的设置更改阻止。

entries.en: Improved startup performance by caching MCP auth failures to avoid redundant connection attempts
entries.zh: 改进启动性能：缓存 MCP 认证失败的结果，避免重复的连接尝试

entries.en: Improved startup performance by reducing HTTP calls for analytics token counting
entries.zh: 改进启动性能：减少分析用 token 计数的 HTTP 调用次数

entries.en: Improved startup performance by batching MCP tool token counting into a single API call
entries.zh: 改进启动性能：MCP 工具的 token 计数合并为一次 API 调用

entries.en: Fixed `disableAllHooks` setting to respect managed settings hierarchy — non-managed settings can no longer disable managed hooks set by policy (#26637)
entries.zh: 修复了`disableAllHooks`设置以尊重托管设置层次结构 - 非托管设置无法再禁用由策略设置的托管挂钩 (#26637)

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` session picker showing raw XML tags for sessions that start with commands like `/clear`. Now correctly falls through to the session ID fallback.
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`会话选择器，显示以`/clear`等命令开头的会话的原始 XML 标签。现在正确地转入会话 ID 后备。

entries.en: Improved permission prompts for path safety and working directory blocks to show the reason for the restriction instead of a bare prompt with no context
entries.zh: 改进路径安全和工作目录拦截时的权限提示：显示受限原因，而不是只给一个没有上下文的提示

entries.en: Fixed FileWriteTool line counting to preserve intentional trailing blank lines instead of stripping them with `trimEnd()`.
entries.zh: 修复了 FileWriteTool 行计数以保留有意的尾随空白行，而不是使用`trimEnd()`删除它们。

entries.en: Fixed Windows terminal rendering bugs caused by `os.EOL` (`\r\n`) in display code — line counts now show correct values instead of always showing 1 on Windows.
entries.zh: 修复了显示代码中由 `os.EOL` (`\r\n`) 引起的 Windows 终端渲染错误 — 行计数现在显示正确的值，而不是在 Windows 上始终显示 1。

entries.en: Improved VS Code plan preview: auto-updates as Claude iterates, enables commenting only when the plan is ready for review, and keeps the preview open when rejecting so Claude can revise.
entries.zh: 改进 VS Code 计划预览：随 Claude 迭代自动更新；仅在计划可供审阅时才允许评论；拒绝计划时预览保持打开，方便 Claude 修改

entries.en: Fixed a bug where bold and colored text in markdown output could shift to the wrong characters on Windows due to `\r\n` line endings.
entries.zh: 修复了以下错误：由于`\r\n`行结尾，Markdown 输出中的粗体和彩色文本可能会在 Windows 上转换为错误字符。

entries.en: Fixed compaction failing when conversation contains many PDF documents by stripping document blocks alongside images before sending to the compaction API (anthropics/claude-code#26188)
entries.zh: 通过在发送到压缩 API 之前剥离文档块和图像来修复对话包含许多 PDF 文档时压缩失败的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26188)

entries.en: Improved memory usage in long-running sessions by releasing API stream buffers, agent context, and skill state after use
entries.zh: 改进长时间运行会话的内存占用：API 流缓冲区、agent 上下文和技能状态在使用后即释放

entries.en: Improved startup performance by deferring SessionStart hook execution, reducing time-to-interactive by ~500ms.
entries.zh: 改进启动性能：推迟执行 SessionStart hook，可交互时间约缩短 500 毫秒

entries.en: Fixed an issue where bash tool output was silently discarded on Windows when using MSYS2 or Cygwin shells.
entries.zh: 修复了使用 MSYS2 或 Cygwin shell 时 bash 工具输出在 Windows 上被默默丢弃的问题。

entries.en: Improved performance of `@` file mentions - file suggestions now appear faster by pre-warming the index on startup and using session-based caching with background refresh.
entries.zh: 改进 `@` 文件提及的性能：启动时预热索引，并采用基于会话的缓存加后台刷新，文件建议出现更快

entries.en: Improved memory usage by trimming agent task message history after tasks complete
entries.zh: 改进 agent 任务完成后修剪任务消息历史，降低内存占用

entries.en: Improved memory usage during long agent sessions by eliminating O(n²) message accumulation in progress updates
entries.zh: 改进长时间 agent 会话的内存占用：消除了进度更新中 O(n²) 的消息累积

entries.en: Fixed the bash permission classifier to validate that returned match descriptions correspond to actual input rules, preventing hallucinated descriptions from incorrectly granting permissions
entries.zh: 修复 bash 权限分类器未校验返回的匹配描述是否对应真实输入规则，导致幻觉出来的描述可能错误放行权限的问题

entries.en: Fixed user-defined agents only loading one file on NFS/FUSE filesystems that report zero inodes (anthropics/claude-code#26044)
entries.zh: 修复用户自定义智能体在报告 inode 数为零的 NFS/FUSE 文件系统上只加载一个文件的问题（anthropics/claude-code#26044）

entries.en: Fixed plugin agent skills silently failing to load when referenced by bare name instead of fully-qualified plugin name (anthropics/claude-code#25834)
entries.zh: 修复了当通过裸名称而不是完全限定的插件名称引用时插件代理技能静默加载失败的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25834)

entries.en: Search patterns in collapsed tool results are now displayed in quotes for clarity
entries.zh: 折叠的工具结果中的搜索模式现在用引号括起来显示，更清楚

entries.en: Windows: Fixed CWD tracking temp files never being cleaned up, causing them to accumulate indefinitely (anthropics/claude-code#17600)
entries.zh: Windows：修复了工作目录追踪的临时文件从不清理、无限累积的问题（anthropics/claude-code#17600）

entries.en: Use `ctrl+f` to kill all background agents instead of double-pressing ESC. Background agents now continue running when you press ESC to cancel the main thread, giving you more control over agent lifecycle.
entries.zh: 使用 `ctrl+f` 结束所有后台代理，不再需要连按两次 ESC。按 ESC 取消主线程时，后台代理现在会继续运行，让你更好地控制代理的生命周期

entries.en: Fixed API 400 errors ("thinking blocks cannot be modified") that occurred in sessions with concurrent agents, caused by interleaved streaming content blocks preventing proper message merging.
entries.zh: 修复了在具有并发代理的会话中发生的 API 400 错误（“思维块无法修改”），该错误是由交错的流内容块阻止正确的消息合并引起的。

entries.en: Simplified teammate navigation to use only Shift+Down (with wrapping) instead of both Shift+Up and Shift+Down.
entries.zh: 队友导航只使用 Shift+Down（循环切换），不再同时使用 Shift+Up 和 Shift+Down

entries.en: Fixed an issue where a single file write/edit error would abort all other parallel file write/edit operations. Independent file mutations now complete even when a sibling fails.
entries.zh: 修复了单个文件写入/编辑错误会中止所有其他并行文件写入/编辑操作的问题。即使同级文件失败，独立文件突变现在也会完成。

entries.en: Added `last_assistant_message` field to Stop and SubagentStop hook inputs, providing the final assistant response text so hooks can access it without parsing transcript files.
entries.zh: 在 Stop 和 SubagentStop 挂钩输入中添加了`last_assistant_message`字段，提供最终的助手响应文本，以便挂钩可以访问它而无需解析脚本文件。

entries.en: Fixed custom session titles set via `/rename` being lost after resuming a conversation (anthropics/claude-code#23610)
entries.zh: 修复了通过`/rename`设置的自定义会话标题在恢复对话后丢失的问题（anthropics/claude-code#23610）

entries.en: Fixed collapsed read/search hint text overflowing on narrow terminals by truncating from the start.
entries.zh: 通过从头开始截断，修复了折叠的读取/搜索提示文本在狭窄终端上溢出的问题。

entries.en: Fixed an issue where bash commands with backslash-newline continuation lines (e.g., long commands split across multiple lines with `\`) would produce spurious empty arguments, potentially breaking command execution.
entries.zh: 修复了带有反斜杠换行符连续行的 bash 命令（例如，用`\`跨多行分割的长命令）会产生虚假的空参数，可能会破坏命令执行的问题。

entries.en: Fixed built-in slash commands (`/help`, `/model`, `/compact`, etc.) being hidden from the autocomplete dropdown when many user skills are installed (anthropics/claude-code#22020)
entries.zh: 修复了安装许多用户技能时，内置斜杠命令（`/help`、`/model`、`/compact` 等）从自动完成下拉列表中隐藏的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#22020)

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers not appearing in the MCP Management Dialog after deferred loading
entries.zh: 修复了延迟加载后 MCP 服务器未出现在 MCP 管理对话框中的问题

entries.en: Fixed session name persisting in status bar after `/clear` command (anthropics/claude-code#26082)
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear`命令后会话名称在状态栏中持续存在的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26082)

entries.en: Fixed crash when a skill's `name` or `description` in SKILL.md frontmatter is a bare number (e.g., `name: 3000`) — the value is now properly coerced to a string (anthropics/claude-code#25837)
entries.zh: 修复了当 SKILL.md frontmatter 中技能的“名称”或“描述”为裸数字（例如“名称：3000”）时发生的崩溃 - 该值现在已正确强制为字符串（anthropics/claude-code#25837）

entries.en: Fixed /resume silently dropping sessions when the first message exceeds 16KB or uses array-format content (anthropics/claude-code#25721)
entries.zh: 修复了当第一条消息超过 16KB 或使用数组格式内容时 /resume 静默删除会话 (anthropics/claude-code#25721)

entries.en: Added `chat:newline` keybinding action for configurable multi-line input (anthropics/claude-code#26075)
entries.zh: 添加了`chat:newline`键绑定操作以用于可配置的多行输入（anthropics/claude-code#26075）

entries.en: Added `added_dirs` to the statusline JSON `workspace` section, exposing directories added via `/add-dir` to external scripts (anthropics/claude-code#26096)
entries.zh: 将 `added_dirs` 添加到状态行 JSON `workspace` 部分，将通过 `/add-dir` 添加的目录公开到外部脚本 (anthropics/claude-code#26096)

entries.en: Fixed `claude doctor` misclassifying mise and asdf-managed installations as native installs (anthropics/claude-code#26033)
entries.zh: 修复了`claude doctor`将 mise 和 asdf 管理的安装错误分类为本机安装的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26033)

entries.en: Fixed zsh heredoc failing with "read-only file system" error in sandboxed commands (anthropics/claude-code#25990)
entries.zh: 修复 zsh heredoc 在沙盒命令中报"read-only file system"错误的问题（anthropics/claude-code#25990）

entries.en: Fixed agent progress indicator showing inflated tool use count (anthropics/claude-code#26023)
entries.zh: 修复了代理进度指示器，显示夸大的工具使用计数（anthropics/claude-code#26023）

entries.en: Fixed image pasting not working on WSL2 systems where Windows copies images as BMP format (anthropics/claude-code#25935)
entries.zh: 修复了图像粘贴在 Windows 将图像复制为 BMP 格式的 WSL2 系统上不起作用的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25935)

entries.en: Fixed background agent results returning raw transcript data instead of the agent's final answer (anthropics/claude-code#26012)
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理结果返回原始转录数据而不是代理的最终答案（anthropics/claude-code#26012）

entries.en: Fixed Warp terminal incorrectly prompting for Shift+Enter setup when it supports it natively (anthropics/claude-code#25957)
entries.zh: 修复了 Warp 终端在本机支持时错误提示 Shift+Enter 设置的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25957)

entries.en: Fixed CJK wide characters causing misaligned timestamps and layout elements in the TUI (anthropics/claude-code#26084)
entries.zh: 修复了导致 TUI 中时间戳和布局元素未对齐的 CJK 宽字符 (anthropics/claude-code#26084)

entries.en: Fixed custom agent `model` field in `.claude/agents/*.md` being ignored when spawning team teammates (anthropics/claude-code#26064)
entries.zh: 修复了在生成团队队友时忽略`.claude/agents/*.md`中的自定义代理`model`字段（anthropics/claude-code#26064）

entries.en: Fixed plan mode being lost after context compaction, causing the model to switch from planning to implementation mode (anthropics/claude-code#26061)
entries.zh: 修复了上下文压缩后计划模式丢失，导致模型从计划模式切换到实施模式的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26061)

entries.en: Fixed `alwaysThinkingEnabled: true` in settings.json not enabling thinking mode on Bedrock and Vertex providers (anthropics/claude-code#26074)
entries.zh: 修复了 settings.json 中的`alwaysThinkingEnabled: true`未在 Bedrock 和 Vertex 提供程序上启用思考模式的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26074)

entries.en: Fixed `tool_decision` OTel telemetry event not being emitted in headless/SDK mode (anthropics/claude-code#26059)
entries.zh: 修复了在 headless/SDK 模式下未发出`tool_decision` OTel 遥测事件的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26059)

entries.en: Fixed session name being lost after context compaction — renamed sessions now preserve their custom title through compaction (anthropics/claude-code#26121)
entries.zh: 修复了上下文压缩后会话名称丢失的问题 - 重命名的会话现在通过压缩保留其自定义标题 (anthropics/claude-code#26121)

entries.en: Increased initial session count in resume picker from 10 to 50 for faster session discovery (anthropics/claude-code#26123)
entries.zh: 将恢复会话选择器的初始会话数从 10 提高到 50，便于更快找到会话（anthropics/claude-code#26123）

entries.en: Windows: fixed worktree session matching when drive letter casing differs (anthropics/claude-code#26123)
entries.zh: Windows：修复盘符大小写不同时工作树会话匹配失败的问题（anthropics/claude-code#26123）

entries.en: Fixed `/resume <session-id>` failing to find sessions whose first message exceeds 16KB (anthropics/claude-code#25920)
entries.zh: 修复了 `/resume <session-id>` 无法找到第一条消息超过 16KB 的会话的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25920)

entries.en: Fixed "Always allow" on multiline bash commands creating invalid permission patterns that corrupt settings (anthropics/claude-code#25909)
entries.zh: 修复了多行 bash 命令上的“始终允许”创建损坏设置的无效权限模式 (anthropics/claude-code#25909)

entries.en: Fixed React crash (error #31) when a skill's `argument-hint` in SKILL.md frontmatter uses YAML sequence syntax (e.g., `[topic: foo | bar]`) — the value is now properly coerced to a string (anthropics/claude-code#25826)
entries.zh: 修复了当 SKILL.md frontmatter 中技能的`argument-hint`使用 YAML 序列语法（例如`[topic: foo | bar]`）时 React 崩溃（错误 #31） - 该值现在已正确强制为字符串（anthropics/claude-code#25826）

entries.en: Fixed crash when using `/fork` on sessions that used web search — null entries in search results from transcript deserialization are now handled gracefully (anthropics/claude-code#25811)
entries.zh: 修复了在使用 Web 搜索的会话上使用 `/fork` 时发生的崩溃 — 现在可以妥善处理来自转录本反序列化的搜索结果中的空条目 (anthropics/claude-code#25811)

entries.en: Fixed read-only git commands triggering FSEvents file watcher loops on macOS by adding --no-optional-locks flag (anthropics/claude-code#25750)
entries.zh: 通过添加 --no-optional-locks 标志，修复了在 macOS 上触发 FSEvents 文件观察程序循环的只读 git 命令 (anthropics/claude-code#25750)

entries.en: Fixed custom agents and skills not being discovered when running from a git worktree — project-level `.claude/agents/` and `.claude/skills/` from the main repository are now included (anthropics/claude-code#25816)
entries.zh: 修复了从 git 工作树运行时未发现的自定义代理和技能 - 现在包含主存储库中的项目级 `.claude/agents/` 和 `.claude/skills/` (anthropics/claude-code#25816)

entries.en: Fixed non-interactive subcommands like `claude doctor` and `claude plugin validate` being blocked inside nested Claude sessions (anthropics/claude-code#25803)
entries.zh: 修复了诸如`claude doctor`和`claude plugin validate`之类的非交互式子命令在嵌套的 Claude 会话中被阻止的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25803)

entries.en: Windows: Fixed the same CLAUDE.md file being loaded twice when drive letter casing differs between paths (anthropics/claude-code#25756)
entries.zh: Windows：修复了路径的盘符大小写不同时，同一个 CLAUDE.md 文件被加载两次的问题（anthropics/claude-code#25756）

entries.en: Fixed inline code spans in markdown being incorrectly parsed as bash commands (anthropics/claude-code#25792)
entries.zh: 修复了 markdown 中的内联代码跨度被错误地解析为 bash 命令的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25792)

entries.en: Fixed teammate spinners not respecting custom spinnerVerbs from settings (anthropics/claude-code#25748)
entries.zh: 修复队友旋转动画未遵循设置中自定义 `spinnerVerbs` 的问题（anthropics/claude-code#25748）

entries.en: Fixed shell commands permanently failing after a command deletes its own working directory (anthropics/claude-code#26136)
entries.zh: 修复了命令删除其自己的工作目录后 shell 命令永久失败的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26136)

entries.en: Fixed hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse) silently failing to execute on Windows by using Git Bash instead of cmd.exe (anthropics/claude-code#25981)
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Git Bash 而不是 cmd.exe 时挂钩（PreToolUse、PostToolUse）无法在 Windows 上静默执行的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25981)

entries.en: Fixed LSP `findReferences` and other location-based operations returning results from gitignored files (e.g., `node_modules/`, `venv/`) (anthropics/claude-code#26051)
entries.zh: 修复了 LSP `findReferences` 和其他基于位置的操作从 gitignored 文件返回结果的问题（例如，`node_modules/`、`venv/`）（anthropics/claude-code#26051）

entries.en: Moved config backup files from home directory root to `~/.claude/backups/` to reduce home directory clutter (anthropics/claude-code#26130)
entries.zh: 配置备份文件从主目录根目录移到 `~/.claude/backups/`，减少主目录的杂乱（anthropics/claude-code#26130）

entries.en: Fixed sessions with large first prompts (>16KB) disappearing from the /resume list (anthropics/claude-code#26140)
entries.zh: 修复了带有较大第一个提示 (>16KB) 的会话从 /resume 列表中消失的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26140)

entries.en: Fixed shell functions with double-underscore prefixes (e.g., `__git_ps1`) not being preserved across shell sessions (anthropics/claude-code#25824)
entries.zh: 修复了带有双下划线前缀的 shell 函数（例如，`__git_ps1`）未在 shell 会话中保留的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25824)

entries.en: Fixed spinner showing "0 tokens" counter before any tokens have been received (anthropics/claude-code#26105)
entries.zh: 修复了在收到任何令牌之前显示“0 令牌”计数器的微调器（anthropics/claude-code#26105）

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed conversation messages appearing dimmed while the AskUserQuestion dialog is open (anthropics/claude-code#26078)
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了 AskUserQuestion 对话框打开时，对话消息显示为暗淡的问题（anthropics/claude-code#26078）

entries.en: Fixed background tasks failing in git worktrees due to remote URL resolution reading from worktree-specific gitdir instead of the main repository config (anthropics/claude-code#26065)
entries.zh: 修复了由于从特定于工作树的 gitdir 而不是主存储库配置读取远程 URL 解析而导致 git 工作树中后台任务失败的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#26065)

entries.en: Fixed Right Alt key leaving visible `[25~` escape sequence residue in the input field on Windows/Git Bash terminals (anthropics/claude-code#25943)
entries.zh: 修复了右 Alt 键在 Windows/Git Bash 终端上的输入字段中留下可见的`[25~`转义序列残基的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#25943)

entries.en: The `/rename` command now updates the terminal tab title by default (anthropics/claude-code#25789)
entries.zh: `/rename` 命令现在默认会更新终端标签页的标题（anthropics/claude-code#25789）

entries.en: Fixed Edit tool silently corrupting Unicode curly quotes (\u201c\u201d \u2018\u2019) by replacing them with straight quotes when making edits (anthropics/claude-code#26141)
entries.zh: 修复了编辑工具在编辑时将 Unicode 弯引号 (\u201c\u201d \u2018\u2019) 替换为直引号（anthropics/claude-code#26141）

entries.en: Fixed OSC 8 hyperlinks only being clickable on the first line when link text wraps across multiple terminal lines.
entries.zh: 修复了当链接文本跨多个终端行换行时，OSC 8 超链接只能在第一行单击。

entries.en: Fixed orphaned CC processes after terminal disconnect on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上终端断开连接后孤立的 CC 进程

entries.en: Added support for using claude.ai MCP connectors in Claude Code
entries.zh: 添加了对在 Claude 代码中使用 claude.ai MCP 连接器的支持

entries.en: Added support for Claude Sonnet 4.6
entries.zh: 添加了对克劳德十四行诗 4.6 的支持

entries.en: Added support for reading `enabledPlugins` and `extraKnownMarketplaces` from `--add-dir` directories
entries.zh: 添加了对从`--add-dir`目录读取`enabledPlugins`和`extraKnownMarketplaces`的支持

entries.en: Added `spinnerTipsOverride` setting to customize spinner tips — configure `tips` with an array of custom tip strings, and optionally set `excludeDefault: true` to show only your custom tips instead of the built-in ones
entries.zh: 添加了`spinnerTipsOverride`设置来自定义微调器提示 - 使用自定义提示字符串数组配置`tips`，并可选择设置`excludeDefault: true`以仅显示自定义提示而不是内置提示

entries.en: Added `SDKRateLimitInfo` and `SDKRateLimitEvent` types to the SDK, enabling consumers to receive rate limit status updates including utilization, reset times, and overage information
entries.zh: 在 SDK 中添加了`SDKRateLimitInfo`和`SDKRateLimitEvent`类型，使消费者能够接收速率限制状态更新，包括利用率、重置时间和超额信息

entries.en: Fixed Agent Teams teammates failing on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry by propagating API provider environment variables to tmux-spawned processes (anthropics/claude-code#23561)
entries.zh: 通过将 API 提供程序环境变量传播到 tmux 生成的进程，修复了 Agent Teams 队友在 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上失败的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#23561)

entries.en: Fixed sandbox "operation not permitted" errors when writing temporary files on macOS by using the correct per-user temp directory (anthropics/claude-code#21654)
entries.zh: 修复了使用正确的每用户临时目录在 macOS 上写入临时文件时沙箱“不允许操作”的错误 (anthropics/claude-code#21654)

entries.en: Fixed Task tool (backgrounded agents) crashing with a `ReferenceError` on completion (anthropics/claude-code#22087)
entries.zh: 修复了任务工具（后台代理）在完成时因`ReferenceError`崩溃的问题（anthropics/claude-code#22087）

entries.en: Fixed autocomplete suggestions not being accepted on Enter when images are pasted in the input
entries.zh: 修复了当图像粘贴到输入中时，在 Enter 上不接受自动完成建议的问题

entries.en: Fixed skills invoked by subagents incorrectly appearing in main session context after compaction
entries.zh: 修复了压缩后子代理调用的技能错误地出现在主会话上下文中的问题

entries.en: Fixed excessive `.claude.json.backup` files accumulating on every startup
entries.zh: 修复了每次启动时累积过多的`.claude.json.backup`文件

entries.en: Fixed plugin-provided commands, agents, and hooks not being available immediately after installation without requiring a restart
entries.zh: 修复了插件提供的命令、代理和挂钩在安装后无法立即使用而无需重新启动的问题

entries.en: Improved startup performance by removing eager loading of session history for stats caching
entries.zh: 改进启动性能：不再为统计缓存预先加载全部会话历史

entries.en: Improved memory usage for shell commands that produce large output — RSS no longer grows unboundedly with command output size
entries.zh: 改进产生大量输出的 shell 命令的内存占用：常驻内存不再随命令输出大小无限增长

entries.en: Improved collapsed read/search groups to show the current file or search pattern being processed beneath the summary line while active
entries.zh: 改进折叠的读取/搜索分组：运行时，在摘要行下方显示当前正在处理的文件或搜索模式

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved permission destination choice (project/user/session) to persist across sessions
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进权限保存位置（项目/用户/会话）的选择，使其能跨会话保留

entries.en: Fixed ENAMETOOLONG errors for deeply-nested directory paths
entries.zh: 修复了深层嵌套目录路径的 ENAMETOOLONG 错误

entries.en: Fixed auth refresh errors
entries.zh: 修复了身份验证刷新错误

entries.en: Fixed AWS auth refresh hanging indefinitely by adding a 3-minute timeout
entries.zh: 通过添加 3 分钟超时修复了 AWS 身份验证刷新无限期挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed spurious warnings for non-agent markdown files in `.claude/agents/` directory
entries.zh: 修复了`.claude/agents/`目录中非代理降价文件的虚假警告

entries.en: Fixed structured-outputs beta header being sent unconditionally on Vertex/Bedrock
entries.zh: 修复了在 Vertex/Bedrock 上无条件发送的结构化输出 beta 标头

entries.en: Improved startup performance by deferring Zod schema construction
entries.zh: 改进启动性能：推迟构建 Zod schema

entries.en: Improved prompt cache hit rates by moving date out of system prompt
entries.zh: 改进提示缓存命中率：把日期移出了系统提示

entries.en: Added one-time Opus 4.6 effort callout for eligible users
entries.zh: 为符合条件的用户添加了一次性 Opus 4.6 工作量标注

entries.en: Fixed /resume showing interrupt messages as session titles
entries.zh: 修复/恢复将中断消息显示为会话标题

entries.en: Fixed image dimension limit errors to suggest /compact
entries.zh: 修复了建议 /compact 的图像尺寸限制错误

entries.en: Added guard against launching Claude Code inside another Claude Code session
entries.zh: 添加了防止在另一个 Claude Code 会话中启动 Claude Code 的防护

entries.en: Fixed Agent Teams using wrong model identifier for Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry customers
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队对 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 客户使用错误模型标识符的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash when MCP tools return image content during streaming
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 工具在流式传输期间返回图像内容时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed /resume session previews showing raw XML tags instead of readable command names
entries.zh: 修复了 /resume 会话预览显示原始 XML 标签而不是可读命令名称的问题

entries.en: Improved model error messages for Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry users with fallback suggestions
entries.zh: 改进 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 用户的模型错误提示，并附上备选方案建议

entries.en: Fixed plugin browse showing misleading "Space to Toggle" hint for already-installed plugins
entries.zh: 修复了插件浏览显示已安装插件的误导性“空格切换”提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed hook blocking errors (exit code 2) not showing stderr to the user
entries.zh: 修复了钩子阻塞错误（退出代码 2），不向用户显示 stderr

entries.en: Added `speed` attribute to OTel events and trace spans for fast mode visibility
entries.zh: 为 OTel 事件和跟踪范围添加了“速度”属性，以实现快速模式可见性

entries.en: Added `claude auth login`, `claude auth status`, and `claude auth logout` CLI subcommands
entries.zh: 添加了`claude auth login`、`claude auth status`和`claude auth logout`CLI 子命令

entries.en: Added Windows ARM64 (win32-arm64) native binary support
entries.zh: 添加了 Windows ARM64 (win32-arm64) 本机二进制支持

entries.en: Improved `/rename` to auto-generate session name from conversation context when called without arguments
entries.zh: 改进 `/rename`：不带参数调用时，可根据对话内容自动生成会话名称

entries.en: Improved narrow terminal layout for prompt footer
entries.zh: 改进窄终端下提示栏底部的布局

entries.en: Fixed file resolution failing for @-mentions with anchor fragments (e.g., `@README.md#installation`)
entries.zh: 修复了带有锚片段的@提及时文件解析失败的问题（例如`@README.md#installation`）

entries.en: Fixed FileReadTool blocking the process on FIFOs, `/dev/stdin`, and large files
entries.zh: 修复了 FileReadTool 阻塞 FIFO、`/dev/stdin`和大文件上的进程的问题

entries.en: Fixed background task notifications not being delivered in streaming Agent SDK mode
entries.zh: 修复了流式 Agent SDK 模式下未传递后台任务通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed cursor jumping to end on each keystroke in classifier rule input
entries.zh: 修复了分类器规则输入中每次击键时光标跳到末尾的问题

entries.en: Fixed markdown link display text being dropped for raw URL
entries.zh: 修复了原始 URL 被删除的 Markdown 链接显示文本

entries.en: Fixed auto-compact failure error notifications being shown to users
entries.zh: 修复了向用户显示的自动压缩失败错误通知

entries.en: Fixed permission wait time being included in subagent elapsed time display
entries.zh: 修复了子代理经过时间显示中包含的权限等待时间

entries.en: Fixed proactive ticks firing while in plan mode
entries.zh: 修复了计划模式下主动滴答声触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed clear stale permission rules when settings change on disk
entries.zh: 修复了磁盘上设置更改时清除过时权限规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed hook blocking errors showing stderr content in UI
entries.zh: 修复了 UI 中显示 stderr 内容的钩子阻塞错误

entries.en: Improved terminal rendering performance
entries.zh: 改进终端渲染性能

entries.en: Fixed fatal errors being swallowed instead of displayed
entries.zh: 修复了被吞没而不是显示的致命错误

entries.en: Fixed process hanging after session close
entries.zh: 修复了会话关闭后进程挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed character loss at terminal screen boundary
entries.zh: 修复了终端屏幕边界处的字符丢失问题

entries.en: Fixed blank lines in verbose transcript view
entries.zh: 修复了详细记录视图中的空白行

entries.en: Fixed VS Code terminal scroll-to-top regression introduced in 2.1.37
entries.zh: 修复了 2.1.37 中引入的 VS Code 终端滚动到顶部回归问题

entries.en: Fixed Tab key queueing slash commands instead of autocompleting
entries.zh: 修复了 Tab 键排队斜杠命令而不是自动完成的问题

entries.en: Fixed bash permission matching for commands using environment variable wrappers
entries.zh: 修复了使用环境变量包装器的命令的 bash 权限匹配

entries.en: Fixed text between tool uses disappearing when not using streaming
entries.zh: 修复非流式输出时，工具调用之间的文字消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed duplicate sessions when resuming in VS Code extension
entries.zh: 修复了在 VS Code 扩展中恢复时的重复会话

entries.en: Improved heredoc delimiter parsing to prevent command smuggling
entries.zh: 改进 heredoc 分隔符的解析，防止命令夹带

entries.en: Blocked writes to `.claude/skills` directory in sandbox mode
entries.zh: 在沙箱模式下阻止写入`.claude/skills`目录

entries.en: Fixed an issue where /fast was not immediately available after enabling /extra-usage
entries.zh: 修复了启用 /extra-usage 后 /fast 无法立即可用的问题

entries.en: Fast mode is now available for Opus 4.6. Learn more at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fast-mode
entries.zh: Opus 4.6 现已提供快速模式。了解更多信息 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fast-mode

entries.en: Fixed a crash when agent teams setting changed between renders
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队设置在渲染之间更改时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed a bug where commands excluded from sandboxing (via `sandbox.excludedCommands` or `dangerouslyDisableSandbox`) could bypass the Bash ask permission rule when `autoAllowBashIfSandboxed` was enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用`autoAllowBashIfSandboxed`时从沙箱中排除的命令（通过`sandbox.excludedCommands`或`dangerouslyDisableSandbox`）可能绕过 Bash 询问权限规则的错误

entries.en: Fixed agent teammate sessions in tmux to send and receive messages
entries.zh: 修复了 tmux 中的代理队友会话以发送和接收消息

entries.en: Fixed warnings about agent teams not being available on your current plan
entries.zh: 修复关于当前套餐不支持智能体团队的警告问题

entries.en: Added `TeammateIdle` and `TaskCompleted` hook events for multi-agent workflows
entries.zh: 为多代理工作流程添加了`TeammateIdle`和`TaskCompleted`挂钩事件

entries.en: Added support for restricting which sub-agents can be spawned via `Task(agent_type)` syntax in agent "tools" frontmatter
entries.zh: 添加了对通过代理“工具”frontmatter 中的`Task(agent_type)`语法限制可以生成哪些子代理的支持

entries.en: Added `memory` frontmatter field support for agents, enabling persistent memory with `user`, `project`, or `local` scope
entries.zh: 为代理添加了“内存”frontmatter 字段支持，启用具有“用户”、“项目”或“本地”范围的持久内存

entries.en: Added plugin name to skill descriptions and `/skills` menu for better discoverability
entries.zh: 在技能描述和`/skills`菜单中添加了插件名称，以提高可发现性

entries.en: Fixed an issue where submitting a new message while the model was in extended thinking would interrupt the thinking phase
entries.zh: 修复了模型处于扩展思考时提交新消息会中断思考阶段的问题

entries.en: Fixed an API error that could occur when aborting mid-stream, where whitespace text combined with a thinking block would bypass normalization and produce an invalid request
entries.zh: 修复了中止中止时可能发生的 API 错误，其中空白文本与思考块相结合将绕过规范化并产生无效请求

entries.en: Fixed API proxy compatibility issue where 404 errors on streaming endpoints no longer triggered non-streaming fallback
entries.zh: 修复了 API 代理兼容性问题，其中流端点上的 404 错误不再触发非流回退

entries.en: Fixed an issue where proxy settings configured via `settings.json` environment variables were not applied to WebFetch and other HTTP requests on the Node.js build
entries.zh: 修复了通过`settings.json`环境变量配置的代理设置未应用于 Node.js 构建上的 WebFetch 和其他 HTTP 请求的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` session picker showing raw XML markup instead of clean titles for sessions started with slash commands
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`会话选择器，显示原始 XML 标记，而不是使用斜线命令启动的会话的干净标题

entries.en: Improved error messages for API connection failures — now shows specific cause (e.g., ECONNREFUSED, SSL errors) instead of generic "Connection error"
entries.zh: 改进 API 连接失败的错误提示：显示具体原因（如 ECONNREFUSED、SSL 错误），而不是笼统的“Connection error”

entries.en: Errors from invalid managed settings are now surfaced
entries.zh: 现在会出现来自无效托管设置的错误

entries.en: VSCode: Added support for remote sessions, allowing OAuth users to browse and resume sessions from claude.ai
entries.zh: VS Code：支持远程会话，OAuth 用户可以浏览并恢复 claude.ai 上的会话

entries.en: VSCode: Added git branch and message count to the session picker, with support for searching by branch name
entries.zh: VS Code：会话选择器中新增 git 分支和消息数，并支持按分支名搜索

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed scroll-to-bottom under-scrolling on initial session load and session switch
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了首次加载会话和切换会话时，滚动到底部的距离不够的问题

entries.en: Claude Opus 4.6 is now available!
entries.zh: 克劳德 Opus 4.6 现已推出！

entries.en: Added research preview agent teams feature for multi-agent collaboration (token-intensive feature, requires setting CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1)
entries.zh: 添加了用于多代理协作的研究预览代理团队功能（令牌密集型功能，需要设置 CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1）

entries.en: Claude now automatically records and recalls memories as it works
entries.zh: 克劳德现在可以在工作时自动记录和回忆记忆

entries.en: Added "Summarize from here" to the message selector, allowing partial conversation summarization.
entries.zh: 在消息选择器中添加了“从此处摘要”，允许部分对话摘要。

entries.en: Skills defined in `.claude/skills/` within additional directories (`--add-dir`) are now loaded automatically.
entries.zh: `--add-dir` 额外目录中 `.claude/skills/` 里定义的技能，现在会自动加载

entries.en: Fixed `@` file completion showing incorrect relative paths when running from a subdirectory
entries.zh: 修复了从子目录运行时显示不正确的相对路径的`@`文件完成

entries.en: Updated --resume to re-use --agent value specified in previous conversation by default.
entries.zh: `--resume` 默认会沿用上一次对话中指定的 `--agent` 值

entries.en: Fixed: Bash tool no longer throws "Bad substitution" errors when heredocs contain JavaScript template literals like `${index + 1}`, which previously interrupted tool execution
entries.zh: 修复：Bash 工具在 heredoc 中包含 `${index + 1}` 等 JavaScript 模板字面量时，不再抛出"Bad substitution"错误（此前会中断工具执行）

entries.en: Skill character budget now scales with context window (2% of context), so users with larger context windows can see more skill descriptions without truncation
entries.zh: 技能字符预算按上下文窗口的 2% 缩放，窗口越大，能显示的技能描述越多且不被截断

entries.en: Fixed Thai/Lao spacing vowels (สระ า, ำ) not rendering correctly in the input field
entries.zh: 修复了泰语/老挝语间隔元音 (สระ า, ำ) 在输入字段中无法正确呈现的问题

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed slash commands incorrectly being executed when pressing Enter with preceding text in the input field
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了输入框中前面有文字时按 Enter，斜杠命令被错误执行的问题

entries.en: VSCode: Added spinner when loading past conversations list
entries.zh: VS Code：加载过往对话列表时新增加载动画

entries.en: Added session resume hint on exit, showing how to continue your conversation later
entries.zh: 添加了退出时的会话恢复提示，显示稍后如何继续对话

entries.en: Added support for full-width (zenkaku) space input from Japanese IME in checkbox selection
entries.zh: 在复选框选择中添加了对从日语 IME 输入全角 (zenkaku) 空格的支持

entries.en: Fixed PDF too large errors permanently locking up sessions, requiring users to start a new conversation
entries.zh: 修复了 PDF 太大错误，永久锁定会话，要求用户开始新对话

entries.en: Fixed bash commands incorrectly reporting failure with "Read-only file system" errors when sandbox mode was enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用沙箱模式时 bash 命令错误地报告失败并出现“只读文件系统”错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash that made sessions unusable after entering plan mode when project config in `~/.claude.json` was missing default fields
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude.json`中的项目配置缺少默认字段时导致会话在进入计划模式后无法使用的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed `temperatureOverride` being silently ignored in the streaming API path, causing all streaming requests to use the default temperature (1) regardless of the configured override
entries.zh: 修复了“温度覆盖”在流 API 路径中被静默忽略的问题，导致所有流请求都使用默认温度 (1)，无论配置的覆盖如何

entries.en: Fixed LSP shutdown/exit compatibility with strict language servers that reject null params
entries.zh: 修复了 LSP 关闭/退出与拒绝空参数的严格语言服务器的兼容性

entries.en: Improved system prompts to more clearly guide the model toward using dedicated tools (Read, Edit, Glob, Grep) instead of bash equivalents (`cat`, `sed`, `grep`, `find`), reducing unnecessary bash command usage
entries.zh: 改进系统提示，更明确地引导模型优先使用专用工具（Read、Edit、Glob、Grep），而不是 bash 等价命令（`cat`、`sed`、`grep`、`find`），减少不必要的 bash 命令

entries.en: Improved PDF and request size error messages to show actual limits (100 pages, 20MB)
entries.zh: 改进 PDF 和请求大小的错误提示：显示实际限制（100 页、20MB）

entries.en: Reduced layout jitter in the terminal when the spinner appears and disappears during streaming
entries.zh: 回复流式输出时，加载动画出现或消失造成的终端排版抖动减少

entries.en: Removed misleading Anthropic API pricing from model selector for third-party provider (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry) users
entries.zh: 第三方提供商（Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry）用户的模型选择器中，已移除容易引起误解的 Anthropic API 价格

entries.en: Added `pages` parameter to the Read tool for PDFs, allowing specific page ranges to be read (e.g., `pages: "1-5"`). Large PDFs (>10 pages) now return a lightweight reference when `@` mentioned instead of being inlined into context.
entries.zh: 在 PDF 的读取工具中添加了`pages`参数，允许读取特定的页面范围（例如`pages: "1-5"`）。现在，大型 PDF（>10 页）在提及`@`时返回轻量级引用，而不是内联到上下文中。

entries.en: Added pre-configured OAuth client credentials for MCP servers that don't support Dynamic Client Registration (e.g., Slack). Use `--client-id` and `--client-secret` with `claude mcp add`.
entries.zh: 为不支持动态客户端注册（例如 Slack）的 MCP 服务器添加了预配置的 OAuth 客户端凭据。将 `--client-id` 和 `--client-secret` 与 `claude mcp add` 一起使用。

entries.en: Added `/debug` for Claude to help troubleshoot the current session
entries.zh: 为 Claude 添加了`/debug`以帮助排除当前会话的故障

entries.en: Added support for additional `git log` and `git show` flags in read-only mode (e.g., `--topo-order`, `--cherry-pick`, `--format`, `--raw`)
entries.zh: 添加了对只读模式下的附加 `git log` 和 `git show` 标志的支持（例如，`--topo-order`、`--cherry-pick`、`--format`、`--raw`）

entries.en: Added token count, tool uses, and duration metrics to Task tool results
entries.zh: 在任务工具结果中添加了令牌计数、工具使用和持续时间指标

entries.en: Added reduced motion mode to the config
entries.zh: 在配置中添加了简化运动模式

entries.en: Fixed phantom "(no content)" text blocks appearing in API conversation history, reducing token waste and potential model confusion
entries.zh: 修复了 API 对话历史记录中出现的虚拟“（无内容）”文本块，减少了令牌浪费和潜在的模型混乱

entries.en: Fixed prompt cache not correctly invalidating when tool descriptions or input schemas changed, only when tool names changed
entries.zh: 修复了当工具描述或输入模式更改时，仅当工具名称更改时，提示缓存不会正确失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed 400 errors that could occur after running `/login` when the conversation contained thinking blocks
entries.zh: 修复了当对话包含思维障碍时运行`/login`后可能出现的 400 错误

entries.en: Fixed a hang when resuming sessions with corrupted transcript files containing `parentUuid` cycles
entries.zh: 修复了使用包含`parentUuid`循环的损坏的转录文件恢复会话时的挂起

entries.en: Fixed rate limit message showing incorrect "/upgrade" suggestion for Max 20x users when extra-usage is unavailable
entries.zh: 修复了当额外使用不可用时，为最多 20 倍用户显示错误的“/升级”建议的速率限制消息

entries.en: Fixed permission dialogs stealing focus while actively typing
entries.zh: 修复了主动打字时权限对话框窃取焦点的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents not being able to access SDK-provided MCP tools because they were not synced to the shared application state
entries.zh: 修复了子代理无法访问 SDK 提供的 MCP 工具的问题，因为它们未同步到共享应用程序状态

entries.en: Fixed a regression where Windows users with a `.bashrc` file could not run bash commands
entries.zh: 修复了具有`.bashrc`文件的 Windows 用户无法运行 bash 命令的回归问题

entries.en: Improved memory usage for `--resume` (68% reduction for users with many sessions) by replacing the session index with lightweight stat-based loading and progressive enrichment
entries.zh: 改进 `--resume` 的内存占用（拥有大量会话的用户降低 68%）：用轻量的、基于文件状态信息的加载方式替换会话索引，并逐步补全信息

entries.en: Improved `TaskStop` tool to display the stopped command/task description in the result line instead of a generic "Task stopped" message
entries.zh: 改进 `TaskStop` 工具：结果行显示被停止的命令或任务描述，而不是笼统的“Task stopped”

entries.en: Changed `/model` to execute immediately instead of being queued
entries.zh: 将 `/model` 更改为立即执行而不是排队

entries.en: [VSCode] Added multiline input support to the "Other" text input in question dialogs (use Shift+Enter for new lines)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 问题对话框中的「Other」文本输入框支持多行输入（使用 Shift+Enter 换行）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed duplicate sessions appearing in the session list when starting a new conversation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复新建对话时，会话列表中出现重复会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed startup performance issues when resuming sessions that have `saved_hook_context`
entries.zh: 修复了恢复具有`saved_hook_context`的会话时的启动性能问题

entries.en: Added tool call failures and denials to debug logs
entries.zh: 添加了工具调用失败和拒绝调试日志

entries.en: Fixed context management validation error for gateway users, ensuring `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1` avoids the error
entries.zh: 修复了网关用户的上下文管理验证错误，确保`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1`避免该错误

entries.en: Added `--from-pr` flag to resume sessions linked to a specific GitHub PR number or URL
entries.zh: 添加了`--from-pr`标志以恢复链接到特定 GitHub PR 编号或 URL 的会话

entries.en: Sessions are now automatically linked to PRs when created via `gh pr create`
entries.zh: 通过 `gh pr create` 创建的会话，现在会自动关联到 PR

entries.en: Fixed /context command not displaying colored output
entries.zh: 修复了 /context 命令不显示彩色输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed status bar duplicating background task indicator when PR status was shown
entries.zh: 修复了显示 PR 状态时状态栏重复后台任务指示器的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed bash command execution failing for users with `.bashrc` files
entries.zh: Windows：修复了拥有 `.bashrc` 文件的用户，bash 命令执行失败的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed console windows flashing when spawning child processes
entries.zh: Windows：修复了生成子进程时控制台窗口闪烁的问题

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed OAuth token expiration causing 401 errors after extended sessions
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了长时间会话后 OAuth 令牌过期导致的 401 错误

entries.en: Fixed beta header validation error for gateway users on Bedrock and Vertex, ensuring `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1` avoids the error
entries.zh: 修复了 Bedrock 和 Vertex 上网关用户的 Beta 标头验证错误，确保`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1`避免该错误

entries.en: Added customizable spinner verbs setting (`spinnerVerbs`)
entries.zh: 添加了可自定义的微调动词设置（`spinnerVerbs`）

entries.en: Fixed mTLS and proxy connectivity for users behind corporate proxies or using client certificates
entries.zh: 修复了企业代理背后或使用客户端证书的用户的 mTLS 和代理连接

entries.en: Fixed per-user temp directory isolation to prevent permission conflicts on shared systems
entries.zh: 修复了每用户临时目录隔离，以防止共享系统上的权限冲突

entries.en: Fixed a race condition that could cause 400 errors when prompt caching scope was enabled
entries.zh: 修复了启用提示缓存范围时可能导致 400 错误的竞争条件

entries.en: Fixed pending async hooks not being cancelled when headless streaming sessions ended
entries.zh: 修复了无头流会话结束时挂起的异步挂钩不会被取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed tab completion not updating the input field when accepting a suggestion
entries.zh: 修复了接受建议时选项卡补全不更新输入字段的问题

entries.en: Fixed ripgrep search timeouts silently returning empty results instead of reporting errors
entries.zh: 修复了 ripgrep 搜索超时默默返回空结果而不是报告错误的问题

entries.en: Improved terminal rendering performance with optimized screen data layout
entries.zh: 改进终端渲染性能：优化了屏幕数据布局

entries.en: Changed Bash commands to show timeout duration alongside elapsed time
entries.zh: 更改了 Bash 命令以显示超时持续时间以及经过的时间

entries.en: Changed merged pull requests to show a purple status indicator in the prompt footer
entries.zh: 更改了合并的拉取请求以在提示页脚中显示紫色状态指示器

entries.en: [IDE] Fixed model options displaying incorrect region strings for Bedrock users in headless mode
entries.zh: [IDE] 修复无头模式下，Bedrock 用户的模型选项显示错误地区字符串的问题

entries.en: Fixed structured outputs for non-interactive (-p) mode
entries.zh: 非交互式 (-p) 模式的固定结构化输出

entries.en: Added support for full-width (zenkaku) number input from Japanese IME in option selection prompts
entries.zh: 在选项选择提示中添加了对从日语 IME 输入全角 (zenkaku) 数字的支持

entries.en: Fixed shell completion cache files being truncated on exit
entries.zh: 修复了 shell 完成缓存文件在退出时被截断的问题

entries.en: Fixed API errors when resuming sessions that were interrupted during tool execution
entries.zh: 修复了恢复工具执行期间中断的会话时的 API 错误

entries.en: Fixed auto-compact triggering too early on models with large output token limits
entries.zh: 修复了在具有大输出令牌限制的模型上过早触发自动压缩的问题

entries.en: Fixed task IDs potentially being reused after deletion
entries.zh: 修复任务 ID 在删除后可能被复用的问题

entries.en: Fixed file search not working in VS Code extension on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了文件搜索在 Windows 上的 VS Code 扩展中不起作用的问题

entries.en: Improved read/search progress indicators to show "Reading…" while in progress and "Read" when complete
entries.zh: 改进读取/搜索进度指示：进行中显示「Reading…」，完成后显示「Read」

entries.en: Improved Claude to prefer file operation tools (Read, Edit, Write) over bash equivalents (cat, sed, awk)
entries.zh: 改进：Claude 优先使用文件操作工具（Read、Edit、Write），而不是 bash 的等价命令（cat、sed、awk）

entries.en: [VSCode] Added automatic Python virtual environment activation, ensuring `python` and `pip` commands use the correct interpreter (configurable via `claudeCode.usePythonEnvironment` setting)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增自动激活 Python 虚拟环境，确保 `python` 和 `pip` 命令使用正确的解释器（可通过 `claudeCode.usePythonEnvironment` 设置配置）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed message action buttons having incorrect background colors
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复消息操作按钮的背景颜色不正确的问题

entries.en: Added arrow key history navigation in vim normal mode when cursor cannot move further
entries.zh: 添加了 vim 正常模式下光标无法进一步移动时的箭头键历史导航

entries.en: Added external editor shortcut (Ctrl+G) to the help menu for better discoverability
entries.zh: 在帮助菜单中添加了外部编辑器快捷方式 (Ctrl+G)，以提高可发现性

entries.en: Added PR review status indicator to the prompt footer, showing the current branch's PR state (approved, changes requested, pending, or draft) as a colored dot with a clickable link
entries.zh: 在提示页脚中添加了 PR 审核状态指示器，以带有可点击链接的彩色点显示当前分支的 PR 状态（已批准、请求更改、待处理或草稿）

entries.en: Added support for loading `CLAUDE.md` files from additional directories specified via `--add-dir` flag (requires setting `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
entries.zh: 添加了对从通过`--add-dir`标志指定的其他目录加载`CLAUDE.md`文件的支持（需要设置`CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`）

entries.en: Added ability to delete tasks via the `TaskUpdate` tool
entries.zh: 添加了通过`TaskUpdate`工具删除任务的功能

entries.en: Fixed session compaction issues that could cause resume to load full history instead of the compact summary
entries.zh: 修复了会话压缩问题，该问题可能导致恢复加载完整历史记录而不是压缩摘要

entries.en: Fixed agents sometimes ignoring user messages sent while actively working on a task
entries.zh: 修复了代理有时会忽略在积极执行任务时发送的用户消息

entries.en: Fixed wide character (emoji, CJK) rendering artifacts where trailing columns were not cleared when replaced by narrower characters
entries.zh: 修复宽字符（emoji、中日韩字符）被较窄字符替换时，末尾列未被清除而留下渲染残影的问题

entries.en: Fixed JSON parsing errors when MCP tool responses contain special Unicode characters
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 工具响应包含特殊 Unicode 字符时的 JSON 解析错误

entries.en: Fixed up/down arrow keys in multi-line and wrapped text input to prioritize cursor movement over history navigation
entries.zh: 修复多行和换行的文本输入中，上/下方向键优先移动光标而非浏览历史的问题

entries.en: Fixed draft prompt being lost when pressing UP arrow to navigate command history
entries.zh: 修复了按向上箭头导航命令历史记录时草稿提示丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed ghost text flickering when typing slash commands mid-input
entries.zh: 修复了在输入中输入斜杠命令时幻影文本闪烁的问题

entries.en: Fixed marketplace source removal not properly deleting settings
entries.zh: 修复了市场源删除未正确删除设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed duplicate output in some commands like `/context`
entries.zh: 修复了某些命令（如`/context`）中的重复输出

entries.en: Fixed task list sometimes showing outside the main conversation view
entries.zh: 修复任务列表有时会显示在主对话视图之外的问题

entries.en: Fixed syntax highlighting for diffs occurring within multiline constructs like Python docstrings
entries.zh: 修复了 Python 文档字符串等多行结构中发生的差异的语法突出显示

entries.en: Fixed crashes when cancelling tool use
entries.zh: 修复了取消工具使用时的崩溃问题

entries.en: Improved `/sandbox` command UI to show dependency status with installation instructions when dependencies are missing
entries.zh: 改进 `/sandbox` 界面：缺少依赖时，显示依赖状态和安装说明

entries.en: Improved thinking status text with a subtle shimmer animation
entries.zh: 改进思考状态文字：加入了细微的闪烁动画

entries.en: Improved task list to dynamically adjust visible items based on terminal height
entries.zh: 改进任务列表：可见条目数量根据终端高度动态调整

entries.en: Improved fork conversation hint to show how to resume the original session
entries.zh: 改进分叉对话的提示：显示如何恢复原始会话

entries.en: Changed collapsed read/search groups to show present tense ("Reading", "Searching for") while in progress, and past tense ("Read", "Searched for") when complete
entries.zh: 更改了折叠的阅读/搜索组，以在进行时显示现在时（“阅读”、“搜索”），并在完成时显示过去时（“阅读”、“搜索”）

entries.en: Changed `ToolSearch` results to appear as a brief notification instead of inline in the conversation
entries.zh: 更改了`ToolSearch`结果，使其显示为简短通知，而不是内嵌在对话中

entries.en: Changed the `/commit-push-pr` skill to automatically post PR URLs to Slack channels when configured via MCP tools
entries.zh: 更改了`/commit-push-pr`技能，以便在通过 MCP 工具配置时自动将 PR URL 发布到 Slack 频道

entries.en: Changed the `/copy` command to be available to all users
entries.zh: 更改了`/copy`命令以供所有用户使用

entries.en: Changed background agents to prompt for tool permissions before launching
entries.zh: 更改了后台代理以在启动前提示工具权限

entries.en: Changed permission rules like `Bash(*)` to be accepted and treated as equivalent to `Bash`
entries.zh: 更改了`Bash(*)`等权限规则，使其被接受并视为等同于`Bash`

entries.en: Changed config backups to be timestamped and rotated (keeping 5 most recent) to prevent data loss
entries.zh: 将配置备份更改为带有时间戳和轮换（保留 5 个最新的）以防止数据丢失

entries.en: Added env var `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS`, set to `false` to keep the old system temporarily
entries.zh: 添加了环境变量`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS`，设置为`false`以暂时保留旧系统

entries.en: Added shorthand `$0`, `$1`, etc. for accessing individual arguments in custom commands
entries.zh: 添加了简写`$0`、`$1`等，用于访问自定义命令中的各个参数

entries.en: Fixed crashes on processors without AVX instruction support
entries.zh: 修复了不支持 AVX 指令的处理器上的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed dangling Claude Code processes when terminal is closed by catching EIO errors from `process.exit()` and using SIGKILL as fallback
entries.zh: 通过从`process.exit()`捕获 EIO 错误并使用 SIGKILL 作为后备，修复了终端关闭时悬空的 Claude Code 进程

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` and `/tag` not updating the correct session when resuming from a different directory (e.g., git worktrees)
entries.zh: 修复了从不同目录（例如 git worktrees）恢复时`/rename`和`/tag`不更新正确会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed resuming sessions by custom title not working when run from a different directory
entries.zh: 修复了从不同目录运行时按自定义标题恢复会话不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasted text content being lost when using prompt stash (Ctrl+S) and restore
entries.zh: 修复了使用提示存储 (Ctrl+S) 和恢复时粘贴的文本内容丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent list displaying "Sonnet (default)" instead of "Inherit (default)" for agents without an explicit model setting
entries.zh: 修复了没有显式模型设置的代理列表显示“Sonnet（默认）”而不是“继承（默认）”的问题
