entries.en: Fixed backgrounded hook commands not returning early, potentially causing the session to wait on a process that was intentionally backgrounded
entries.zh: 修复了后台挂钩命令未提前返回，可能导致会话等待有意后台进程的问题

entries.en: Fixed file write preview omitting empty lines
entries.zh: 修复了文件写入预览省略空行的问题

entries.en: Changed skills without additional permissions or hooks to be allowed without requiring approval
entries.zh: 无需额外权限即可更改技能或无需批准即可允许挂钩

entries.en: Changed indexed argument syntax from `$ARGUMENTS.0` to `$ARGUMENTS[0]` (bracket syntax)
entries.zh: 将索引参数语法从`$ARGUMENTS.0`更改为`$ARGUMENTS[0]`（括号语法）

entries.en: [SDK] Added replay of `queued_command` attachment messages as `SDKUserMessageReplay` events when `replayUserMessages` is enabled
entries.zh: [SDK] 启用 `replayUserMessages` 时，新增将 `queued_command` 附件消息作为 `SDKUserMessageReplay` 事件回放

entries.en: [VSCode] Enabled session forking and rewind functionality for all users
entries.zh: [VSCode] 对所有用户开启会话分叉（fork）和回退（rewind）功能

entries.en: Added customizable keyboard shortcuts. Configure keybindings per context, create chord sequences, and personalize your workflow. Run `/keybindings` to get started. Learn more at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/keybindings
entries.zh: 添加了可自定义的键盘快捷键。根据上下文配置键绑定、创建和弦序列并个性化您的工作流程。运行`/keybindings`即可开始。了解更多信息，请访问 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/keybindings

entries.en: Fixed crashes on processors without AVX instruction support
entries.zh: 修复了不支持 AVX 指令的处理器上的崩溃问题

entries.en: Added new task management system, including new capabilities like dependency tracking
entries.zh: 添加了新的任务管理系统，包括依赖性跟踪等新功能

entries.en: [VSCode] Added native plugin management support
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增原生插件管理支持

entries.en: [VSCode] Added ability for OAuth users to browse and resume remote Claude sessions from the Sessions dialog
entries.zh: [VSCode] OAuth 用户可在会话对话框中浏览并恢复远程 Claude 会话

entries.en: Fixed out-of-memory crashes when resuming sessions with heavy subagent usage
entries.zh: 修复了在大量使用子代理的情况下恢复会话时内存不足崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed an issue where the "context remaining" warning was not hidden after running `/compact`
entries.zh: 修复了运行`/compact`后未隐藏“上下文剩余”警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed session titles on the resume screen not respecting the user's language setting
entries.zh: 修复了简历屏幕上的会话标题不尊重用户语言设置的问题

entries.en: [IDE] Fixed a race condition on Windows where the Claude Code sidebar view container would not appear on start
entries.zh: [IDE] 修复 Windows 上 Claude Code 侧边栏视图容器有时在启动时不出现的竞争条件问题

entries.en: Added deprecation notification for npm installations - run `claude install` or see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup for more options
entries.zh: 添加了 npm 安装的弃用通知 - 运行 `claude install` 或参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup 了解更多选项

entries.en: Improved UI rendering performance with React Compiler
entries.zh: 借助 React Compiler 提升界面渲染性能

entries.en: Fixed the "Context left until auto-compact" warning not disappearing after running `/compact`
entries.zh: 修复了运行`/compact`后“上下文剩余直至自动压缩”警告不消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP stdio server timeout not killing child process, which could cause UI freezes
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP stdio 服务器超时未终止子进程，这可能导致 UI 冻结的问题

entries.en: Added history-based autocomplete in bash mode (`!`) - type a partial command and press Tab to complete from your bash command history
entries.zh: 在 bash 模式下添加了基于历史记录的自动完成功能 (`!`) - 输入部分命令并按 Tab 键从 bash 命令历史记录中完成

entries.en: Added search to installed plugins list - type to filter by name or description
entries.zh: 添加了对已安装插件列表的搜索 - 类型可按名称或描述进行过滤

entries.en: Added support for pinning plugins to specific git commit SHAs, allowing marketplace entries to install exact versions
entries.zh: 添加了对将插件固定到特定 git commit SHA 的支持，允许市场条目安装确切的版本

entries.en: Fixed a regression where the context window blocking limit was calculated too aggressively, blocking users at ~65% context usage instead of the intended ~98%
entries.zh: 修复了上下文窗口阻止限制计算过于激进的回归，阻止用户使用约 65% 的上下文使用，而不是预期的约 98%

entries.en: Fixed memory issues that could cause crashes when running parallel subagents
entries.zh: 修复了运行并行子代理时可能导致崩溃的内存问题

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in long-running sessions where stream resources were not cleaned up after shell commands completed
entries.zh: 修复了长时间运行会话中的内存泄漏问题，其中 shell 命令完成后流资源未清理

entries.en: Fixed `@` symbol incorrectly triggering file autocomplete suggestions in bash mode
entries.zh: 修复了`@`符号在 bash 模式下错误地触发文件自动完成建议的问题

entries.en: Fixed `@`-mention menu folder click behavior to navigate into directories instead of selecting them
entries.zh: 修复了`@`提及菜单文件夹单击行为以导航到目录而不是选择它们

entries.en: Fixed `/feedback` command generating invalid GitHub issue URLs when description is very long
entries.zh: 修复了当描述很长时`/feedback`命令生成无效的 GitHub 问题 URL

entries.en: Fixed `/context` command to show the same token count and percentage as the status line in verbose mode
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`命令，以在详细模式下显示与状态行相同的令牌计数和百分比

entries.en: Fixed an issue where `/config`, `/context`, `/model`, and `/todos` command overlays could close unexpectedly
entries.zh: 修复了`/config`、`/context`、`/model`和`/todos`命令叠加层可能意外关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash command autocomplete selecting wrong command when typing similar commands (e.g., `/context` vs `/compact`)
entries.zh: 修复了输入类似命令时斜杠命令自动完成选择错误命令的问题（例如，`/context`与`/compact`）

entries.en: Fixed inconsistent back navigation in plugin marketplace when only one marketplace is configured
entries.zh: 修复了仅配置一个市场时插件市场中返回导航不一致的问题

entries.en: Fixed iTerm2 progress bar not clearing properly on exit, preventing lingering indicators and bell sounds
entries.zh: 修复了 iTerm2 进度条在退出时无法正确清除的问题，从而防止指示器和铃声出现挥之不去的情况

entries.en: Improved backspace to delete pasted text as a single token instead of one character at a time
entries.zh: 改进退格键：一次删除整段粘贴的文本，而不是一个字符一个字符地删

entries.en: [VSCode] Added `/usage` command to display current plan usage
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增 `/usage` 命令，用于显示当前套餐用量

entries.en: Fixed message rendering bug
entries.zh: 修复消息渲染错误

entries.en: Fixed excessive MCP connection requests for HTTP/SSE transports
entries.zh: 修复了 HTTP/SSE 传输的过多 MCP 连接请求

entries.en: Added new `Setup` hook event that can be triggered via `--init`, `--init-only`, or `--maintenance` CLI flags for repository setup and maintenance operations
entries.zh: 添加了新的`Setup`挂钩事件，可以通过`--init`、`--init-only`或`--maintenance` CLI 标志触发，以进行存储库设置和维护操作

entries.en: Added keyboard shortcut 'c' to copy OAuth URL when browser doesn't open automatically during login
entries.zh: 添加了键盘快捷键“c”，用于在登录期间浏览器未自动打开时复制 OAuth URL

entries.en: Fixed a crash when running bash commands containing heredocs with JavaScript template literals like `${index + 1}`
entries.zh: 修复了运行包含带有 JavaScript 模板文字（如`${index + 1}`）的 heredocs 的 bash 命令时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Improved startup to capture keystrokes typed before the REPL is fully ready
entries.zh: 改进启动：REPL 完全就绪前输入的按键也能被捕获

entries.en: Improved file suggestions to show as removable attachments instead of inserting text when accepted
entries.zh: 改进文件建议：接受后以可移除的附件形式出现，而不是直接插入文本

entries.en: [VSCode] Added install count display to plugin listings
entries.zh: [VSCode] 插件列表中显示安装次数

entries.en: [VSCode] Added trust warning when installing plugins
entries.zh: [VSCode] 安装插件时新增信任警告

entries.en: Added `auto:N` syntax for configuring the MCP tool search auto-enable threshold, where N is the context window percentage (0-100)
entries.zh: 添加了用于配置 MCP 工具搜索自动启用阈值的`auto:N`语法，其中 N 是上下文窗口百分比 (0-100)

entries.en: Added `plansDirectory` setting to customize where plan files are stored
entries.zh: 添加了`plansDirectory`设置以自定义计划文件的存储位置

entries.en: Added external editor support (Ctrl+G) in AskUserQuestion "Other" input field
entries.zh: 在 AskUserQuestion“其他”输入字段中添加了外部编辑器支持 (Ctrl+G)

entries.en: Added session URL attribution to commits and PRs created from web sessions
entries.zh: 添加了对从网络会话创建的提交和 PR 的会话 URL 属性

entries.en: Added support for `PreToolUse` hooks to return `additionalContext` to the model
entries.zh: 添加了对`PreToolUse`挂钩的支持，以将`additionalContext`返回到模型

entries.en: Added `${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}` string substitution for skills to access the current session ID
entries.zh: 添加了`${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}`字符串替换来访问当前会话 ID 的技能

entries.en: Fixed long sessions with parallel tool calls failing with an API error about orphan tool_result blocks
entries.zh: 修复了并行工具调用的长会话因有关孤立 tool_result 块的 API 错误而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP server reconnection hanging when cached connection promise never resolves
entries.zh: 修复了缓存连接承诺从未解决时 MCP 服务器重新连接挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+Z suspend not working in terminals using Kitty keyboard protocol (Ghostty, iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm)
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+Z 暂停在使用 Kitty 键盘协议的终端（Ghostty、iTerm2、kitty、WezTerm）中不起作用的问题

entries.en: Added `showTurnDuration` setting to hide turn duration messages (e.g., "Cooked for 1m 6s")
entries.zh: 添加了`showTurnDuration`设置以隐藏回合持续时间消息（例如“煮了 1m 6s”）

entries.en: Added ability to provide feedback when accepting permission prompts
entries.zh: 添加了在接受权限提示时提供反馈的功能

entries.en: Added inline display of agent's final response in task notifications, making it easier to see results without reading the full transcript file
entries.zh: 在任务通知中添加了代理最终响应的内联显示，无需阅读完整的记录文件即可更轻松地查看结果

entries.en: Fixed security vulnerability where wildcard permission rules could match compound commands containing shell operators
entries.zh: 修复了通配符权限规则可能与包含 shell 运算符的复合命令相匹配的安全漏洞

entries.en: Fixed false "file modified" errors on Windows when cloud sync tools, antivirus scanners, or Git touch file timestamps without changing content
entries.zh: 修复了当云同步工具、防病毒扫描程序或 Git 触摸文件时间戳而不更改内容时 Windows 上的错误“文件已修改”错误

entries.en: Fixed orphaned tool_result errors when sibling tools fail during streaming execution
entries.zh: 修复了同级工具在流执行期间失败时出现的孤立 tool_result 错误

entries.en: Fixed context window blocking limit being calculated using the full context window instead of the effective context window (which reserves space for max output tokens)
entries.zh: 修复了使用完整上下文窗口而不是有效上下文窗口（为最大输出令牌保留空间）计算的上下文窗口阻塞限制

entries.en: Fixed spinner briefly flashing when running local slash commands like `/model` or `/theme`
entries.zh: 修复了运行`/model`或`/theme`等本地斜杠命令时微调器短暂闪烁的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal title animation jitter by using fixed-width braille characters
entries.zh: 修复终端标题动画抖动的问题，改用等宽盲文字符

entries.en: Fixed plugins with git submodules not being fully initialized when installed
entries.zh: 修复了 git 子模块的插件在安装时未完全初始化的问题

entries.en: Fixed bash commands failing on Windows when temp directory paths contained characters like `t` or `n` that were misinterpreted as escape sequences
entries.zh: 修复了当临时目录路径包含`t`或`n`等被误解为转义序列的字符时，bash 命令在 Windows 上失败的问题

entries.en: Improved typing responsiveness by reducing memory allocation overhead in terminal rendering
entries.zh: 改进输入响应速度：减少终端渲染中的内存分配开销

entries.en: Enabled MCP tool search auto mode by default for all users. When MCP tool descriptions exceed 10% of the context window, they are automatically deferred and discovered via the MCPSearch tool instead of being loaded upfront. This reduces context usage for users with many MCP tools configured. Users can disable this by adding `MCPSearch` to `disallowedTools` in their settings.
entries.zh: 默认为所有用户启用 MCP 工具搜索自动模式。当 MCP 工具描述超过上下文窗口的 10% 时，它们会自动延迟并通过 MCPSearch 工具发现，而不是预先加载。这可以减少配置了许多 MCP 工具的用户的上下文使用情况。用户可以通过将`MCPSearch`添加到其设置中的`disallowedTools`来禁用此功能。

entries.en: Changed OAuth and API Console URLs from console.anthropic.com to platform.claude.com
entries.zh: 将 OAuth 和 API 控制台 URL 从 console.anthropic.com 更改为 platform.claude.com

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `claudeProcessWrapper` setting passing the wrapper path instead of the Claude binary path
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 `claudeProcessWrapper` 设置传入的是包装器路径而不是 Claude 二进制文件路径的问题

entries.en: Added search functionality to `/config` command for quickly filtering settings
entries.zh: 为`/config`命令添加了搜索功能，以快速过滤设置

entries.en: Added Updates section to `/doctor` showing auto-update channel and available npm versions (stable/latest)
entries.zh: 在`/doctor`中添加了更新部分，显示自动更新通道和可用的 npm 版本（稳定/最新）

entries.en: Added date range filtering to `/stats` command - press `r` to cycle between Last 7 days, Last 30 days, and All time
entries.zh: 在`/stats`命令中添加了日期范围过滤 - 按`r`在过去 7 天、过去 30 天和所有时间之间循环

entries.en: Added automatic discovery of skills from nested `.claude/skills` directories when working with files in subdirectories
entries.zh: 添加了在处理子目录中的文件时自动发现嵌套`.claude/skills`目录中的技能

entries.en: Added `context_window.used_percentage` and `context_window.remaining_percentage` fields to status line input for easier context window display
entries.zh: 在状态行输入中添加了 `context_window.used_percentage` 和 `context_window.remaining_percentage` 字段，以便于上下文窗口显示

entries.en: Added an error display when the editor fails during Ctrl+G
entries.zh: 添加了在 Ctrl+G 期间编辑器失败时的错误显示

entries.en: Fixed permission bypass via shell line continuation that could allow blocked commands to execute
entries.zh: 通过 shell 行延续修复了权限绕过，可能允许执行被阻止的命令

entries.en: Fixed false "File has been unexpectedly modified" errors when file watchers touch files without changing content
entries.zh: 修复了当文件观察者触摸文件而不更改内容时出现的错误“文件已被意外修改”的错误

entries.en: Fixed text styling (bold, colors) getting progressively misaligned in multi-line responses
entries.zh: 修复多行回复中文字样式（粗体、颜色）逐渐错位的问题

entries.en: Fixed the feedback panel closing unexpectedly when typing 'n' in the description field
entries.zh: 修复在描述输入框中输入字母 "n" 时，反馈面板意外关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed rate limit warning appearing at low usage after weekly reset (now requires 70% usage)
entries.zh: 修复了每周重置后低使用率时出现的速率限制警告（现在需要 70% 使用率）

entries.en: Fixed rate limit options menu incorrectly auto-opening when resuming a previous session
entries.zh: 修复了恢复上一个会话时速率限制选项菜单错误地自动打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed numpad keys outputting escape sequences instead of characters in Kitty keyboard protocol terminals
entries.zh: 修复了小键盘按键输出转义序列而不是 Kitty 键盘协议终端中的字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed Option+Return not inserting newlines in Kitty keyboard protocol terminals
entries.zh: 修复了 Option+Return 不在 Kitty 键盘协议终端中插入换行符的问题

entries.en: Fixed corrupted config backup files accumulating in the home directory (now only one backup is created per config file)
entries.zh: 修复了主目录中累积的损坏的配置备份文件（现在每个配置文件仅创建一个备份）

entries.en: Fixed `mcp list` and `mcp get` commands leaving orphaned MCP server processes
entries.zh: 修复了`mcp list`和`mcp get`命令留下孤立的 MCP 服务器进程的问题

entries.en: Fixed visual artifacts in ink2 mode when nodes become hidden via `display:none`
entries.zh: 修复 ink2 模式下，节点通过 `display:none` 隐藏时出现的视觉残留问题

entries.en: Improved the external CLAUDE.md imports approval dialog to show which files are being imported and from where
entries.zh: 改进外部 CLAUDE.md 导入的批准对话框：会显示正在导入哪些文件，以及它们来自哪里

entries.en: Improved the `/tasks` dialog to go directly to task details when there's only one background task running
entries.zh: 改进 `/tasks` 对话框：只有一个后台任务运行时，直接进入任务详情

entries.en: Improved @ autocomplete with icons for different suggestion types and single-line formatting
entries.zh: 改进 @ 自动补全：不同建议类型带上图标，并改为单行显示

entries.en: Updated "Help improve Claude" setting fetch to refresh OAuth and retry when it fails due to a stale OAuth token
entries.zh: "Help improve Claude" 设置在 OAuth 令牌过期导致获取失败时，现在会刷新 OAuth 并重试

entries.en: Changed task notification display to cap at 3 lines with overflow summary when multiple background tasks complete simultaneously
entries.zh: 当多个后台任务同时完成时，将任务通知显示更改为最多 3 行并带有溢出摘要

entries.en: Changed terminal title to "Claude Code" on startup for better window identification
entries.zh: 在启动时将终端标题更改为“Claude Code”，以便更好地识别窗口

entries.en: Removed ability to @-mention MCP servers to enable/disable - use `/mcp enable <name>` instead
entries.zh: 移除通过 @ 提及 MCP 服务器来启用或禁用的功能，请改用 `/mcp enable <名称>`

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed usage indicator not updating after manual compact
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复手动压缩后用量指示器不更新的问题

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` environment variable to override the temp directory used for internal temp files, useful for environments with custom temp directory requirements
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`环境变量来覆盖用于内部临时文件的临时目录，对于具有自定义临时目录要求的环境非常有用

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS` environment variable to disable all background task functionality including auto-backgrounding and the Ctrl+B shortcut
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS`环境变量以禁用所有后台任务功能，包括自动后台和 Ctrl+B 快捷键

entries.en: Fixed "Help improve Claude" setting fetch to refresh OAuth and retry when it fails due to a stale OAuth token
entries.zh: 修复了“帮助改进 Claude”设置获取以刷新 OAuth 并在由于 OAuth 令牌过时而失败时重试的问题

entries.en: Merged slash commands and skills, simplifying the mental model with no change in behavior
entries.zh: 斜杠命令与技能合并，简化了使用时的理解方式，行为不变

entries.en: Added release channel (`stable` or `latest`) toggle to `/config`
entries.zh: 添加了发布通道（“稳定”或“最新”）切换到`/config`

entries.en: Added detection and warnings for unreachable permission rules, with warnings in `/doctor` and after saving rules that include the source of each rule and actionable fix guidance
entries.zh: 添加了对无法访问的权限规则的检测和警告，并在`/doctor`中以及保存规则后发出警告，其中包括每个规则的来源和可操作的修复指南

entries.en: Fixed plan files persisting across `/clear` commands, now ensuring a fresh plan file is used after clearing a conversation
entries.zh: 修复了在`/clear`命令中持续存在的计划文件，现在确保在清除对话后使用新的计划文件

entries.en: Fixed false skill duplicate detection on filesystems with large inodes (e.g., ExFAT) by using 64-bit precision for inode values
entries.zh: 通过对 inode 值使用 64 位精度，修复了具有大型 inode（例如 ExFAT）的文件系统上的错误技能重复检测

entries.en: Fixed mismatch between background task count in status bar and items shown in tasks dialog
entries.zh: 修复了状态栏中的后台任务计数与任务对话框中显示的项目之间的不匹配问题

entries.en: Fixed sub-agents using the wrong model during conversation compaction
entries.zh: 修复了子代理在对话压缩期间使用错误模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed web search in sub-agents using incorrect model
entries.zh: 修复子智能体中的网页搜索使用了错误模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed trust dialog acceptance when running from the home directory not enabling trust-requiring features like hooks during the session
entries.zh: 修复在主目录中运行时，接受信任对话框后，钩子等需要信任的功能在本会话中未启用的问题

entries.en: Improved terminal rendering stability by preventing uncontrolled writes from corrupting cursor state
entries.zh: 改进终端渲染稳定性：防止不受控的写入破坏光标状态

entries.en: Improved slash command suggestion readability by truncating long descriptions to 2 lines
entries.zh: 改进斜杠命令建议的可读性：过长的描述截断为 2 行

entries.en: Changed tool hook execution timeout from 60 seconds to 10 minutes
entries.zh: 将工具挂钩执行超时从 60 秒更改为 10 分钟

entries.en: [VSCode] Added clickable destination selector for permission requests, allowing you to choose where settings are saved (this project, all projects, shared with team, or session only)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 权限请求新增可点击的保存位置选择器，可选择保存到本项目、所有项目、与团队共享或仅本次会话

entries.en: Added source path metadata to images dragged onto the terminal, helping Claude understand where images originated
entries.zh: 为拖到终端的图像添加源路径元数据，帮助 Claude 了解图像的来源

entries.en: Added clickable hyperlinks for file paths in tool output in terminals that support OSC 8 (like iTerm)
entries.zh: 在支持 OSC 8 的终端（如 iTerm）中，为工具输出中的文件路径添加了可单击的超链接

entries.en: Added support for Windows Package Manager (winget) installations with automatic detection and update instructions
entries.zh: 添加了对 Windows 包管理器 (winget) 安装的支持，并具有自动检测和更新说明

entries.en: Added Shift+Tab keyboard shortcut in plan mode to quickly select "auto-accept edits" option
entries.zh: 在计划模式下添加 Shift+Tab 键盘快捷键以快速选择“自动接受编辑”选项

entries.en: Added `FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS` environment variable to allow plugin autoupdate even when the main auto-updater is disabled
entries.zh: 添加了`FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS`环境变量，以允许插件自动更新，即使主自动更新程序已禁用

entries.en: Added `agent_type` to SessionStart hook input, populated if `--agent` is specified
entries.zh: 将 `agent_type` 添加到 SessionStart 挂钩输入，如果指定了 `--agent` 则填充

entries.en: Fixed a command injection vulnerability in bash command processing where malformed input could execute arbitrary commands
entries.zh: 修复了 bash 命令处理中的命令注入漏洞，其中格式错误的输入可能会执行任意命令

entries.en: Fixed a memory leak where tree-sitter parse trees were not being freed, causing WASM memory to grow unbounded over long sessions
entries.zh: 修复了树守护者解析树未释放的内存泄漏，导致 WASM 内存在长时间会话中无限增长

entries.en: Fixed binary files (images, PDFs, etc.) being accidentally included in memory when using `@include` directives in CLAUDE.md files
entries.zh: 修复了在 CLAUDE.md 文件中使用`@include`指令时二进制文件（图像、PDF 等）意外包含在内存中的问题

entries.en: Fixed updates incorrectly claiming another installation is in progress
entries.zh: 修复更新时错误地提示另一个安装正在进行的问题

entries.en: Fixed crash when socket files exist in watched directories (defense-in-depth for EOPNOTSUPP errors)
entries.zh: 修复了监视目录中存在套接字文件时的崩溃（EOPNOTSUPP 错误的深度防御）

entries.en: Fixed remote session URL and teleport being broken when using `/tasks` command
entries.zh: 修复了使用`/tasks`命令时远程会话 URL 和传送被破坏的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool names being exposed in analytics events by sanitizing user-specific server configurations
entries.zh: 通过清理用户特定的服务器配置，修复了在分析事件中暴露的 MCP 工具名称

entries.en: Improved Option-as-Meta hint on macOS to show terminal-specific instructions for native CSIu terminals like iTerm2, Kitty, and WezTerm
entries.zh: 改进 macOS 上的 Option-as-Meta 提示：针对 iTerm2、Kitty、WezTerm 等原生 CSIu 终端，显示各自专用的设置说明

entries.en: Improved error message when pasting images over SSH to suggest using `scp` instead of the unhelpful clipboard shortcut hint
entries.zh: 改进通过 SSH 粘贴图片时的错误提示：建议改用 `scp`，而不是没用的剪贴板快捷键提示

entries.en: Improved permission explainer to not flag routine dev workflows (git fetch/rebase, npm install, tests, PRs) as medium risk
entries.zh: 改进权限解释器：常规开发流程（git fetch/rebase、npm install、测试、PR）不再被标为中等风险

entries.en: Changed large bash command outputs to be saved to disk instead of truncated, allowing Claude to read the full content
entries.zh: 将大型 bash 命令输出更改为保存到磁盘而不是截断，从而允许 Claude 读取完整内容

entries.en: Changed large tool outputs to be persisted to disk instead of truncated, providing full output access via file references
entries.zh: 将大型工具输出更改为持久保存到磁盘而不是截断，通过文件引用提供完整的输出访问

entries.en: Changed `/plugins` installed tab to unify plugins and MCPs with scope-based grouping
entries.zh: 更改了`/plugins`安装选项卡，以将插件和 MCP 与基于范围的分组统一起来

entries.en: Deprecated Windows managed settings path `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json` - administrators should migrate to `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json`
entries.zh: 已弃用的 Windows 托管设置路径“C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\driven-settings.json” - 管理员应迁移到“C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\driven-settings.json”

entries.en: [SDK] Changed minimum zod peer dependency to ^4.0.0
entries.zh: [SDK] 将 zod 的最低 peer 依赖版本改为 ^4.0.0

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed usage display not updating after manual compact
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复手动压缩后用量显示不更新的问题

entries.en: Added automatic skill hot-reload - skills created or modified in `~/.claude/skills` or `.claude/skills` are now immediately available without restarting the session
entries.zh: 添加了自动技能热重载 - 在 `~/.claude/skills` 或 `.claude/skills` 中创建或修改的技能现在无需重新启动会话即可立即可用

entries.en: Added support for running skills and slash commands in a forked sub-agent context using `context: fork` in skill frontmatter
entries.zh: 添加了对在技能 frontmatter 中使用`context: fork`的分叉子代理上下文中运行技能和斜线命令的支持

entries.en: Added support for `agent` field in skills to specify agent type for execution
entries.zh: 添加了对技能中`agent`字段的支持，以指定要执行的代理类型

entries.en: Added `language` setting to configure Claude's response language (e.g., language: "japanese")
entries.zh: 添加了“语言”设置来配置克劳德的响应语言（例如，语言：“日语”）

entries.en: Changed Shift+Enter to work out of the box in iTerm2, WezTerm, Ghostty, and Kitty without modifying terminal configs
entries.zh: 将 Shift+Enter 更改为在 iTerm2、WezTerm、Ghostty 和 Kitty 中开箱即用，无需修改终端配置

entries.en: Added `respectGitignore` support in `settings.json` for per-project control over @-mention file picker behavior
entries.zh: 在`settings.json`中添加了`respectGitignore`支持，用于按项目控制 @-mention 文件选择器行为

entries.en: Added `IS_DEMO` environment variable to hide email and organization from the UI, useful for streaming or recording sessions
entries.zh: 添加了`IS_DEMO`环境变量以隐藏 UI 中的电子邮件和组织，对于流式传输或录制会话非常有用

entries.en: Fixed security issue where sensitive data (OAuth tokens, API keys, passwords) could be exposed in debug logs
entries.zh: 修复了敏感数据（OAuth 令牌、API 密钥、密码）可能在调试日志中暴露的安全问题

entries.en: Fixed files and skills not being properly discovered when resuming sessions with `-c` or `--resume`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`-c`或`--resume`恢复会话时无法正确发现文件和技能的问题

entries.en: Fixed pasted content being lost when replaying prompts from history using up arrow or Ctrl+R search
entries.zh: 修复了使用向上箭头或 Ctrl+R 搜索重播历史提示时粘贴的内容丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc key with queued prompts to only move them to input without canceling the running task
entries.zh: 修复了带有排队提示的 Esc 键，仅将它们移至输入而不取消正在运行的任务

entries.en: Reduced permission prompts for complex bash commands
entries.zh: 复杂 bash 命令的权限提示减少

entries.en: Fixed command search to prioritize exact and prefix matches on command names over fuzzy matches in descriptions
entries.zh: 修复了命令搜索，以优先考虑命令名称中的精确匹配和前缀匹配而不是描述中的模糊匹配

entries.en: Fixed PreToolUse hooks to allow `updatedInput` when returning `ask` permission decision, enabling hooks to act as middleware while still requesting user consent
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse 挂钩，以在返回`ask`权限决策时允许`updatedInput`，使挂钩能够充当中间件，同时仍然请求用户同意

entries.en: Fixed plugin path resolution for file-based marketplace sources
entries.zh: 修复了基于文件的市场源的插件路径解析

entries.en: Fixed LSP tool being incorrectly enabled when no LSP servers were configured
entries.zh: 修复了未配置 LSP 服务器时错误启用 LSP 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed background tasks failing with "git repository not found" error for repositories with dots in their names
entries.zh: 修复了名称中带有点的存储库的后台任务失败并出现“未找到 git 存储库”错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome support for WSL environments
entries.zh: 修复了 Chrome 中的 Claude 对 WSL 环境的支持

entries.en: Fixed Windows native installer silently failing when executable creation fails
entries.zh: 修复了可执行文件创建失败时 Windows 本机安装程序静默失败的问题

entries.en: Improved CLI help output to display options and subcommands in alphabetical order for easier navigation
entries.zh: 改进 CLI 帮助输出：选项和子命令按字母顺序排列，便于查找

entries.en: Added wildcard pattern matching for Bash tool permissions using `*` at any position in rules (e.g., `Bash(npm *)`, `Bash(* install)`, `Bash(git * main)`)
entries.zh: 在规则中的任何位置使用`*`添加了 Bash 工具权限的通配符模式匹配（例如，`Bash(npm *)`、`Bash(* install)`、`Bash(git * main)`）

entries.en: Added unified Ctrl+B backgrounding for both bash commands and agents - pressing Ctrl+B now backgrounds all running foreground tasks simultaneously
entries.zh: 为 bash 命令和代理添加了统一的 Ctrl+B 后台 - 按 Ctrl+B 现在可以同时后台所有正在运行的前台任务

entries.en: Added support for MCP `list_changed` notifications, allowing MCP servers to dynamically update their available tools, prompts, and resources without requiring reconnection
entries.zh: 添加了对 MCP`list_changed`通知的支持，允许 MCP 服务器动态更新其可用工具、提示和资源，而无需重新连接

entries.en: Added `/teleport` and `/remote-env` slash commands for claude.ai subscribers, allowing them to resume and configure remote sessions
entries.zh: 为 claude.ai 订阅者添加了`/teleport`和`/remote-env`斜杠命令，允许他们恢复和配置远程会话

entries.en: Added support for disabling specific agents using `Task(AgentName)` syntax in settings.json permissions or the `--disallowedTools` CLI flag
entries.zh: 添加了对使用 settings.json 权限中的 `Task(AgentName)` 语法或 `--disallowedTools` CLI 标志禁用特定代理的支持

entries.en: Added hooks support to agent frontmatter, allowing agents to define PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop hooks scoped to the agent's lifecycle
entries.zh: 为代理 frontmatter 添加了钩子支持，允许代理定义作用于代理生命周期的 PreToolUse、PostToolUse 和 Stop 钩子

entries.en: Added hooks support for skill and slash command frontmatter
entries.zh: 添加了对技能和斜杠命令 frontmatter 的钩子支持

entries.en: Added new Vim motions: `;` and `,` to repeat f/F/t/T motions, `y` operator for yank with `yy`/`Y`, `p`/`P` for paste, text objects (`iw`, `aw`, `iW`, `aW`, `i"`, `a"`, `i'`, `a'`, `i(`, `a(`, `i[`, `a[`, `i{`, `a{`), `>>` and `<<` for indent/dedent, and `J` to join lines
entries.zh: 添加了新的 Vim 动作：`;` 和 `,` 来重复 f/F/t/T 动作，`y` 运算符用于用 `yy`/`Y` 进行拉取，`p`/`P` 用于粘贴，文本对象（`iw`、`aw`、`iW`、`aW`、`i"`、`a"`、`i'`、`a'`、`i(`、`a(`、`i[`、`a[`、 `i{`、`a{`)、`>>` 和 `<<` 用于缩进/缩进，`J` 用于连接行

entries.en: Added `/plan` command shortcut to enable plan mode directly from the prompt
entries.zh: 添加了`/plan`命令快捷方式以直接从提示符启用计划模式

entries.en: Added slash command autocomplete support when `/` appears anywhere in input, not just at the beginning
entries.zh: 当`/`出现在输入中的任何位置（而不仅仅是开头）时，添加了斜杠命令自动完成支持

entries.en: Added `--tools` flag support in interactive mode to restrict which built-in tools Claude can use during interactive sessions
entries.zh: 在交互模式下添加了`--tools`标志支持，以限制克劳德在交互会话期间可以使用哪些内置工具

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` environment variable to override the default file read token limit
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`环境变量以覆盖默认文件读取令牌限制

entries.en: Added support for `once: true` config for hooks
entries.zh: 添加了对钩子`once: true`配置的支持

entries.en: Added support for YAML-style lists in frontmatter `allowed-tools` field for cleaner skill declarations
entries.zh: 在 frontmatter `allowed-tools` 字段中添加了对 YAML 样式列表的支持，以实现更清晰的技能声明

entries.en: Added support for prompt and agent hook types from plugins (previously only command hooks were supported)
entries.zh: 添加了对插件中的提示和代理挂钩类型的支持（以前仅支持命令挂钩）

entries.en: Added Cmd+V support for image paste in iTerm2 (maps to Ctrl+V)
entries.zh: 在 iTerm2 中添加了对图像粘贴的 Cmd+V 支持（映射到 Ctrl+V）

entries.en: Added left/right arrow key navigation for cycling through tabs in dialogs
entries.zh: 添加了左/右箭头键导航，用于循环浏览对话框中的选项卡

entries.en: Added real-time thinking block display in Ctrl+O transcript mode
entries.zh: 新增Ctrl+O转录模式下实时思维块显示

entries.en: Added filepath to full output in background bash task details dialog
entries.zh: 在后台 bash 任务详细信息对话框中将文件路径添加到完整输出

entries.en: Added Skills as a separate category in the context visualization
entries.zh: 在上下文可视化中添加了技能作为单独的类别

entries.en: Fixed OAuth token refresh not triggering when server reports token expired but local expiration check disagrees
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器报告令牌过期但本地过期检查不同意时不触发 OAuth 令牌刷新的问题

entries.en: Fixed session persistence getting stuck after transient server errors by recovering from 409 conflicts when the entry was actually stored
entries.zh: 通过在实际存储条目时从 409 冲突中恢复，修复了短暂服务器错误后会话持久性卡住的问题

entries.en: Fixed session resume failures caused by orphaned tool results during concurrent tool execution
entries.zh: 修复了并发工具执行期间由孤立工具结果导致的会话恢复失败

entries.en: Fixed a race condition where stale OAuth tokens could be read from the keychain cache during concurrent token refresh attempts
entries.zh: 修复了在并发令牌刷新尝试期间可以从钥匙串缓存中读取过时的 OAuth 令牌的竞争条件

entries.en: Fixed AWS Bedrock subagents not inheriting EU/APAC cross-region inference model configuration, causing 403 errors when IAM permissions are scoped to specific regions
entries.zh: 修复了 AWS Bedrock 子代理不继承 EU/APAC 跨区域推理模型配置，导致 IAM 权限范围仅限于特定区域时出现 403 错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed API context overflow when background tasks produce large output by truncating to 30K chars with file path reference
entries.zh: 修复了当后台任务通过文件路径引用截断为 30K 字符来产生大量输出时 API 上下文溢出的问题

entries.en: Fixed a hang when reading FIFO files by skipping symlink resolution for special file types
entries.zh: 通过跳过特殊文件类型的符号链接解析，修复了读取 FIFO 文件时的挂起问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal keyboard mode not being reset on exit in Ghostty, iTerm2, Kitty, and WezTerm
entries.zh: 修复在 Ghostty、iTerm2、Kitty 和 WezTerm 中退出后，终端键盘模式未被重置的问题

entries.en: Fixed Alt+B and Alt+F (word navigation) not working in iTerm2, Ghostty, Kitty, and WezTerm
entries.zh: 修复了 Alt+B 和 Alt+F（单词导航）在 iTerm2、Ghostty、Kitty 和 WezTerm 中不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` not being substituted in plugin `allowed-tools` frontmatter, which caused tools to incorrectly require approval
entries.zh: 修复了插件`allowed-tools`frontmatter 中的`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`未被替换，导致工具错误地需要批准的问题

entries.en: Fixed files created by the Write tool using hardcoded 0o600 permissions instead of respecting the system umask
entries.zh: 修复了写入工具使用硬编码 0o600 权限而不是遵循系统 umask 创建的文件

entries.en: Fixed commands with `$()` command substitution failing with parse errors
entries.zh: 修复了带有`$()`命令替换的命令因解析错误而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed multi-line bash commands with backslash continuations being incorrectly split and flagged for permissions
entries.zh: 修复了带有反斜杠延续的多行 bash 命令被错误地分割和标记为权限的问题

entries.en: Fixed bash command prefix extraction to correctly identify subcommands after global options (e.g., `git -C /path log` now correctly matches `Bash(git log:*)` rules)
entries.zh: 修复了 bash 命令前缀提取，以正确识别全局选项后的子命令（例如，`git -C /path log` 现在可以正确匹配 `Bash(git log:*)` 规则）

entries.en: Fixed slash commands passed as CLI arguments (e.g., `claude /context`) not being executed properly
entries.zh: 修复了作为 CLI 参数传递的斜杠命令（例如`claude /context`）未正确执行的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing Enter after Tab-completing a slash command selecting a different command instead of submitting the completed one
entries.zh: 修复了在 Tab 完成斜线命令后按 Enter 键选择其他命令而不是提交已完成的命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash command argument hint flickering and inconsistent display when typing commands with arguments
entries.zh: 修复了输入带有参数的命令时斜杠命令参数提示闪烁和显示不一致的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude sometimes redundantly invoking the Skill tool when running slash commands directly
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在直接运行斜杠命令时有时会多余地调用技能工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed skill token estimates in `/context` to accurately reflect frontmatter-only loading
entries.zh: 修复了`/context`中的技能标记估计，以准确反映仅 frontmatter 的加载

entries.en: Fixed subagents sometimes not inheriting the parent's model by default
entries.zh: 修复了子代理有时默认不继承父代理的模型的问题

entries.en: Fixed model picker showing incorrect selection for Bedrock/Vertex users using `--model haiku`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--model haiku`为 Bedrock/Vertex 用户显示错误选择的模型选择器

entries.en: Fixed duplicate Bash commands appearing in permission request option labels
entries.zh: 修复了权限请求选项标签中出现的重复 Bash 命令

entries.en: Fixed noisy output when background tasks complete - now shows clean completion message instead of raw output
entries.zh: 修复了后台任务完成时的嘈杂输出 - 现在显示干净的完成消息而不是原始输出

entries.en: Fixed background task completion notifications to appear proactively with bullet point
entries.zh: 修复了后台任务完成通知，以主动显示项目符号点

entries.en: Fixed forked slash commands showing "AbortError" instead of "Interrupted" message when cancelled
entries.zh: 修复了取消时显示“AbortError”而不是“Interrupted”消息的分叉斜杠命令

entries.en: Fixed cursor disappearing after dismissing permission dialogs
entries.zh: 修复了关闭权限对话框后光标消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/hooks` menu selecting wrong hook type when scrolling to a different option
entries.zh: 修复了`/hooks`菜单在滚动到不同选项时选择错误的挂钩类型

entries.en: Fixed images in queued prompts showing as "[object Object]" when pressing Esc to cancel
entries.zh: 修复了按 Esc 取消时排队提示中的图像显示为“[对象对象]”的问题

entries.en: Fixed images being silently dropped when queueing messages while backgrounding a task
entries.zh: 修复了在后台执行任务时排队消息时图像被默默删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed large pasted images failing with "Image was too large" error
entries.zh: 修复了大型粘贴图像因“图像太大”错误而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed extra blank lines in multiline prompts containing CJK characters (Japanese, Chinese, Korean)
entries.zh: 修复了包含 CJK 字符（日语、中文、韩语）的多行提示中的额外空白行

entries.en: Fixed ultrathink keyword highlighting being applied to wrong characters when user prompt text wraps to multiple lines
entries.zh: 修复用户提示文字换行成多行时，ultrathink 关键词高亮应用到错误字符的问题

entries.en: Fixed collapsed "Reading X files…" indicator incorrectly switching to past tense when thinking blocks appear mid-stream
entries.zh: 修复了当思维块出现在中流时折叠的“正在阅读 X 文件…”指示器错误地切换到过去时态的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash read commands (like `ls` and `cat`) not being counted in collapsed read/search groups, causing groups to incorrectly show "Read 0 files"
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 读取命令（如`ls`和`cat`）未计入折叠的读取/搜索组中，导致组错误地显示“读取 0 个文件”的问题

entries.en: Fixed spinner token counter to properly accumulate tokens from subagents during execution
entries.zh: 修复了旋转器令牌计数器，以便在执行期间正确累积来自子代理的令牌

entries.en: Fixed memory leak in git diff parsing where sliced strings retained large parent strings
entries.zh: 修复了 git diff 解析中的内存泄漏，其中切片字符串保留了较大的父字符串

entries.en: Fixed race condition where LSP tool could return "no server available" during startup
entries.zh: 修复了 LSP 工具在启动期间可能返回“无可用服务器”的竞争条件

entries.en: Fixed feedback submission hanging indefinitely when network requests timeout
entries.zh: 修复了网络请求超时时反馈提交无限期挂起的问题

entries.en: Fixed search mode in plugin discovery and log selector views exiting when pressing up arrow
entries.zh: 修复了按向上箭头时退出插件发现和日志选择器视图中的搜索模式

entries.en: Fixed hook success message showing trailing colon when hook has no output
entries.zh: 修复了当钩子没有输出时显示尾随冒号的钩子成功消息

entries.en: Multiple optimizations to improve startup performance
entries.zh: 多项优化，提升启动性能

entries.en: Improved terminal rendering performance when using native installer or Bun, especially for text with emoji, ANSI codes, and Unicode characters
entries.zh: 改进使用原生安装器或 Bun 时的终端渲染性能，对带表情符号、ANSI 代码和 Unicode 字符的文本尤其明显

entries.en: Improved performance when reading Jupyter notebooks with many cells
entries.zh: 改进读取含大量单元格的 Jupyter 笔记本时的性能

entries.en: Improved reliability for piped input like `cat refactor.md | claude`
entries.zh: 改进管道输入（如 `cat refactor.md | claude`）的可靠性

entries.en: Improved reliability for AskQuestion tool
entries.zh: 改进 AskQuestion 工具的可靠性

entries.en: Improved sed in-place edit commands to render as file edits with diff preview
entries.zh: 改进 sed 原地编辑命令：以带差异预览的文件编辑形式显示

entries.en: Improved Claude to automatically continue when response is cut off due to output token limit, instead of showing an error message
entries.zh: 改进：回复因输出 token 上限被截断时，Claude 会自动继续，不再直接显示错误信息

entries.en: Improved compaction reliability
entries.zh: 改进压缩的可靠性

entries.en: Improved subagents (Task tool) to continue working after permission denial, allowing them to try alternative approaches
entries.zh: 改进子智能体（Task 工具）：权限被拒绝后仍可继续工作，可以尝试其他方法

entries.en: Improved skills to show progress while executing, displaying tool uses as they happen
entries.zh: 改进技能执行体验：执行过程中显示进度，实时展示每次工具调用

entries.en: Improved skills from `/skills/` directories to be visible in the slash command menu by default (opt-out with `user-invocable: false` in frontmatter)
entries.zh: 改进 `/skills/` 目录中的技能：默认就会出现在斜杠命令菜单中（如需关闭，在 frontmatter 中写 `user-invocable: false`）

entries.en: Improved skill suggestions to prioritize recently and frequently used skills
entries.zh: 改进技能推荐：优先推荐最近和常用的技能

entries.en: Improved spinner feedback when waiting for the first response token
entries.zh: 改进等待第一个回复字符时的加载动画提示

entries.en: Improved token count display in spinner to include tokens from background agents
entries.zh: 改进加载动画中的 token 计数显示：现在包含后台智能体的 token

entries.en: Improved incremental output for async agents to give the main thread more control and visibility
entries.zh: 改进异步 agent 的增量输出，让主线程拥有更多控制力和可见性

entries.en: Improved permission prompt UX with Tab hint moved to footer, cleaner Yes/No input labels with contextual placeholders
entries.zh: 改进权限提示界面：Tab 提示移到底部，Yes/No 选项标签更简洁，并带有上下文占位提示

entries.en: Improved the Claude in Chrome notification with shortened help text and persistent display until dismissed
entries.zh: 改进 Claude in Chrome 通知：帮助文字缩短，并且会一直显示直到你关闭

entries.en: Improved macOS screenshot paste reliability with TIFF format support
entries.zh: 改进 macOS 截图粘贴的可靠性，增加 TIFF 格式支持

entries.en: Improved `/stats` output
entries.zh: 改进 `/stats` 的输出

entries.en: Updated Atlassian MCP integration to use a more reliable default configuration (streamable HTTP)
entries.zh: Atlassian MCP 集成改用更可靠的默认配置（streamable HTTP）

entries.en: Changed "Interrupted" message color from red to grey for a less alarming appearance
entries.zh: 将“中断”消息颜色从红色更改为灰色，以减少令人惊慌的外观

entries.en: Removed permission prompt when entering plan mode - users can now enter plan mode without approval
entries.zh: 进入计划模式不再弹出权限提示，用户无需审批即可进入计划模式

entries.en: Removed underline styling from image reference links
entries.zh: 移除图片引用链接的下划线样式

entries.en: [SDK] Changed minimum zod peer dependency to ^4.0.0
entries.zh: [SDK] 将 zod 的最低 peer 依赖版本改为 ^4.0.0

entries.en: [VSCode] Added currently selected model name to the context menu
entries.zh: [VSCode] 右键菜单中新增当前所选模型的名称

entries.en: [VSCode] Added descriptive labels on auto-accept permission button (e.g., "Yes, allow npm for this project" instead of "Yes, and don't ask again")
entries.zh: [VSCode] 自动接受权限按钮新增描述性标签（例如「Yes, allow npm for this project」，而非「Yes, and don't ask again」）

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed paragraph breaks not rendering in markdown content
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Markdown 内容中段落分隔不显示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed scrolling in the extension inadvertently scrolling the parent iframe
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复扩展中的滚动会意外带动父级 iframe 滚动的问题

entries.en: [Windows] Fixed issue with improper rendering
entries.zh: [Windows] 修复了渲染不正确的问题

entries.en: Fixed issue with macOS code-sign warning when using Claude in Chrome integration
entries.zh: 修复了在 Chrome 集成中使用 Claude 时 macOS 代码签名警告的问题

entries.en: Minor bugfixes
entries.zh: 若干小错误修复

entries.en: Added LSP (Language Server Protocol) tool for code intelligence features like go-to-definition, find references, and hover documentation
entries.zh: 添加了 LSP（语言服务器协议）工具，用于代码智能功能，例如转到定义、查找引用和悬停文档

entries.en: Added `/terminal-setup` support for Kitty, Alacritty, Zed, and Warp terminals
entries.zh: 添加了对 Kitty、Alacritty、Zed 和 Warp 终端的`/terminal-setup`支持

entries.en: Added ctrl+t shortcut in `/theme` to toggle syntax highlighting on/off
entries.zh: 在`/theme`中添加了 ctrl+t 快捷方式以打开/关闭语法突出显示

entries.en: Added syntax highlighting info to theme picker
entries.zh: 向主题选择器添加了语法突出显示信息

entries.en: Added guidance for macOS users when Alt shortcuts fail due to terminal configuration
entries.zh: 为 macOS 用户添加了当 Alt 快捷键因终端配置而失败时的指导

entries.en: Fixed skill `allowed-tools` not being applied to tools invoked by the skill
entries.zh: 修复了技能“允许的工具”未应用于该技能调用的工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed Opus 4.5 tip incorrectly showing when user was already using Opus
entries.zh: 修复了 Opus 4.5 提示在用户已经使用 Opus 时错误显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed a potential crash when syntax highlighting isn't initialized correctly
entries.zh: 修复了语法突出显示未正确初始化时潜在的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed visual bug in `/plugins discover` where list selection indicator showed while search box was focused
entries.zh: 修复 `/plugins discover` 中，搜索框获得焦点时列表选中指示器仍然显示的视觉错误

entries.en: Fixed macOS keyboard shortcuts to display 'opt' instead of 'alt'
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 键盘快捷键以显示“opt”而不是“alt”

entries.en: Improved `/context` command visualization with grouped skills and agents by source, slash commands, and sorted token count
entries.zh: 改进 `/context` 的可视化：按来源对技能和代理分组，斜杠命令单独列出，token 数量排序

entries.en: [Windows] Fixed issue with improper rendering
entries.zh: [Windows] 修复了渲染不正确的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Added gift tag pictogram for year-end promotion message
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增年末促销消息用的礼物标签图标

entries.en: Added clickable `[Image #N]` links that open attached images in the default viewer
entries.zh: 添加了可点击的`[Image #N]`链接，可在默认查看器中打开附加图像

entries.en: Added alt-y yank-pop to cycle through kill ring history after ctrl-y yank
entries.zh: 添加了 alt-y yank-pop 以在 ctrl-y yank 后循环浏览杀戮环历史记录

entries.en: Added search filtering to the plugin discover screen (type to filter by name, description, or marketplace)
entries.zh: 在插件发现屏幕中添加了搜索过滤（键入按名称、描述或市场进行过滤）

entries.en: Added support for custom session IDs when forking sessions with `--session-id` combined with `--resume` or `--continue` and `--fork-session`
entries.zh: 使用`--session-id`与`--resume`或`--continue`和`--fork-session`组合分叉会话时添加了对自定义会话 ID 的支持

entries.en: Fixed slow input history cycling and race condition that could overwrite text after message submission
entries.zh: 修复了缓慢的输入历史记录循环和竞争条件，可能会在消息提交后覆盖文本

entries.en: Improved `/theme` command to open theme picker directly
entries.zh: 改进 `/theme` 命令：直接打开主题选择器

entries.en: Improved theme picker UI
entries.zh: 改进主题选择器界面

entries.en: Improved search UX across resume session, permissions, and plugins screens with a unified SearchBox component
entries.zh: 改进恢复会话、权限和插件页面的搜索体验：统一使用 SearchBox 组件

entries.en: [VSCode] Added tab icon badges showing pending permissions (blue) and unread completions (orange)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 标签页图标新增徽标：蓝色表示待处理的权限请求，橙色表示未读的完成通知

entries.en: Added Claude in Chrome (Beta) feature that works with the Chrome extension (https://claude.ai/chrome) to let you control your browser directly from Claude Code
entries.zh: 在 Chrome (Beta) 中添加了 Claude 功能，可与 Chrome 扩展 (https://claude.ai/chrome) 配合使用，让您直接从 Claude 代码控制浏览器

entries.en: Reduced terminal flickering
entries.zh: 减少终端闪烁

entries.en: Added scannable QR code to mobile app tip for quick app downloads
entries.zh: 在移动应用程序提示中添加了可扫描的二维码，以便快速下载应用程序

entries.en: Added loading indicator when resuming conversations for better feedback
entries.zh: 恢复对话时添加加载指示器以获得更好的反馈

entries.en: Fixed `/context` command not respecting custom system prompts in non-interactive mode
entries.zh: 修复了非交互模式下`/context`命令不遵守自定义系统提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed order of consecutive Ctrl+K lines when pasting with Ctrl+Y
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Ctrl+Y 粘贴时连续 Ctrl+K 行的顺序

entries.en: Improved @ mention file suggestion speed (~3× faster in git repositories)
entries.zh: 改进 @ 提及文件建议的速度（在 git 仓库中约快 3 倍）

entries.en: Improved file suggestion performance in repos with `.ignore` or `.rgignore` files
entries.zh: 改进含 `.ignore` 或 `.rgignore` 文件的仓库中的文件建议性能

entries.en: Improved settings validation errors to be more prominent
entries.zh: 改进设置验证报错，使其更醒目

entries.en: Changed thinking toggle from Tab to Alt+T to avoid accidental triggers
entries.zh: 将思维切换从 Tab 更改为 Alt+T，以避免意外触发

entries.en: Added /config toggle to enable/disable prompt suggestions
entries.zh: 添加了 /config 开关以启用/禁用提示建议

entries.en: Added `/settings` as an alias for the `/config` command
entries.zh: 添加了`/settings`作为`/config`命令的别名

entries.en: Fixed @ file reference suggestions incorrectly triggering when cursor is in the middle of a path
entries.zh: 修复了当光标位于路径中间时错误触发的@文件引用建议

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers from `.mcp.json` not loading when using `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--dangerously-skip-permissions`时未加载`.mcp.json`中的 MCP 服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed permission rules incorrectly rejecting valid bash commands containing shell glob patterns (e.g., `ls *.txt`, `for f in *.png`)
entries.zh: 修复了权限规则错误地拒绝包含 shell glob 模式的有效 bash 命令（例如，`ls *.txt`、`for f in *.png`）

entries.en: Bedrock: Environment variable `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` is now respected for token counting and inference profile listing
entries.zh: Bedrock：环境变量`ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL`现在受到令牌计数和推理配置文件列表的尊重

entries.en: New syntax highlighting engine for native build
entries.zh: 原生构建版采用全新的语法高亮引擎

entries.en: Added Enter key to accept and submit prompt suggestions immediately (tab still accepts for editing)
entries.zh: 添加回车键以立即接受并提交提示建议（选项卡仍接受编辑）

entries.en: Added wildcard syntax `mcp__server__*` for MCP tool permissions to allow or deny all tools from a server
entries.zh: 为 MCP 工具权限添加了通配符语法`mcp__server__*`，以允许或拒绝来自服务器的所有工具

entries.en: Added auto-update toggle for plugin marketplaces, allowing per-marketplace control over automatic updates
entries.zh: 为插件市场添加了自动更新切换，允许每个市场控制自动更新

entries.en: Added `current_usage` field to status line input, enabling accurate context window percentage calculations
entries.zh: 在状态行输入中添加了`current_usage`字段，以实现准确的上下文窗口百分比计算

entries.en: Fixed input being cleared when processing queued commands while the user was typing
entries.zh: 修复了用户键入时处理排队命令时输入被清除的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions replacing typed input when pressing Tab
entries.zh: 修复了按 Tab 时替换键入输入的提示建议

entries.en: Fixed diff view not updating when terminal is resized
entries.zh: 修复了调整终端大小时差异视图不更新的问题

entries.en: Improved memory usage by 3x for large conversations
entries.zh: 改进大型对话的内存占用，降低为原来的三分之一

entries.en: Improved resolution of stats screenshots copied to clipboard (Ctrl+S) for crisper images
entries.zh: 改进用 Ctrl+S 复制到剪贴板的统计截图清晰度

entries.en: Removed # shortcut for quick memory entry (tell Claude to edit your CLAUDE.md instead)
entries.zh: 移除用 `#` 快速添加记忆的快捷方式（请让 Claude 直接编辑你的 CLAUDE.md）

entries.en: Fix thinking mode toggle in /config not persisting correctly
entries.zh: 修复 /config 中的思维模式切换未正确持续的问题

entries.en: Improve UI for file creation permission dialog
entries.zh: 改进文件创建权限对话框的界面

entries.en: Minor bugfixes
entries.zh: 若干小错误修复

entries.en: Fixed IME (Input Method Editor) support for languages like Chinese, Japanese, and Korean by correctly positioning the composition window at the cursor
entries.zh: 通过将合成窗口正确定位在光标处，修复了 IME（输入法编辑器）对中文、日语和韩语等语言的支持

entries.en: Fixed a bug where disallowed MCP tools were visible to the model
entries.zh: 修复了模型可以看到不允许的 MCP 工具的错误

entries.en: Fixed an issue where steering messages could be lost while a subagent is working
entries.zh: 修复了子代理工作时转向消息可能丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Option+Arrow word navigation treating entire CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) text sequences as a single word instead of navigating by word boundaries
entries.zh: 修复了选项+箭头单词导航将整个 CJK（中文、日语、韩语）文本序列视为单个单词，而不是按单词边界导航

entries.en: Improved plan mode exit UX: show simplified yes/no dialog when exiting with empty or missing plan instead of throwing an error
entries.zh: 改进计划模式退出体验：计划为空或缺失时，显示简化的是/否对话框，而不是报错

entries.en: Add support for enterprise managed settings. Contact your Anthropic account team to enable this feature.
entries.zh: 添加对企业托管设置的支持。请联系您的 Anthropic 客户团队以启用此功能。

entries.en: Thinking mode is now enabled by default for Opus 4.5
entries.zh: Opus 4.5 现在默认启用思考模式

entries.en: Thinking mode configuration has moved to /config
entries.zh: 思考模式的设置已移至 `/config`

entries.en: Added search functionality to `/permissions` command with `/` keyboard shortcut for filtering rules by tool name
entries.zh: 使用`/`键盘快捷键向`/permissions`命令添加了搜索功能，用于按工具名称过滤规则

entries.en: Show reason why autoupdater is disabled in `/doctor`
entries.zh: 在 `/doctor` 中显示自动更新被禁用的原因

entries.en: Fixed false "Another process is currently updating Claude" error when running `claude update` while another instance is already on the latest version
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个实例已经是最新版本时运行`claude update`时出现的错误“另一个进程当前正在更新 Claude”错误

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers from `.mcp.json` being stuck in pending state when running in non-interactive mode (`-p` flag or piped input)
entries.zh: 修复了`.mcp.json`中的 MCP 服务器在非交互模式下运行时陷入挂起状态的问题（`-p`标志或管道输入）

entries.en: Fixed scroll position resetting after deleting a permission rule in `/permissions`
entries.zh: 修复了删除`/permissions`中的权限规则后滚动位置重置的问题

entries.en: Fixed word deletion (opt+delete) and word navigation (opt+arrow) not working correctly with non-Latin text such as Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, and Chinese
entries.zh: 修复 opt+delete（删除单词）和 opt+方向键（单词移动）在西里尔文、希腊文、阿拉伯文、希伯来文、泰文、中文等非拉丁文字中工作不正确的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude install --force` not bypassing stale lock files
entries.zh: 修复了`claude install --force`不绕过过时的锁定文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed consecutive @~/ file references in CLAUDE.md being incorrectly parsed due to markdown strikethrough interference
entries.zh: 修复了 CLAUDE.md 中的连续 @~/ 文件引用由于 markdown 删除线干扰而被错误解析的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed plugin MCP servers failing due to colons in log directory paths
entries.zh: Windows：修复了日志目录路径中包含冒号导致插件 MCP 服务器失败的问题

entries.en: Added ability to switch models while writing a prompt using alt+p (linux, windows), option+p (macos).
entries.zh: 添加了使用 alt+p（linux、windows）、option+p（macos）编写提示时切换模型的功能。

entries.en: Added context window information to status line input
entries.zh: 将上下文窗口信息添加到状态行输入

entries.en: Added `fileSuggestion` setting for custom `@` file search commands
entries.zh: 为自定义`@`文件搜索命令添加了`fileSuggestion`设置

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL` environment variable to override automatic shell detection (useful when login shell differs from actual working shell)
entries.zh: 添加了 `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL` 环境变量来覆盖自动 shell 检测（当登录 shell 与实际工作 shell 不同时有用）

entries.en: Fixed prompt not being saved to history when aborting a query with Escape
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Escape 中止查询时提示未保存到历史记录中的问题

entries.en: Fixed Read tool image handling to identify format from bytes instead of file extension
entries.zh: 修复了读取工具图像处理，以从字节而不是文件扩展名识别格式

entries.en: Made auto-compacting instant
entries.zh: 自动压缩改为即时完成

entries.en: Agents and bash commands can run asynchronously and send messages to wake up the main agent
entries.zh: 代理和bash命令可以异步运行并发送消息来唤醒主代理

entries.en: /stats now provides users with interesting CC stats, such as favorite model, usage graph, usage streak
entries.zh: /stats 现在为用户提供有趣的 CC 统计数据，例如最喜欢的型号、使用情况图表、使用情况记录

entries.en: Added named session support: use `/rename` to name sessions, `/resume <name>` in REPL or `claude --resume <name>` from the terminal to resume them
entries.zh: 添加了命名会话支持：使用`/rename`来命名会话，在 REPL 中使用`/resume <name>`或从终端使用`claude --resume <name>`来恢复会话

entries.en: Added support for .claude/rules/`.  See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory for details.
entries.zh: 添加了对 .claude/rules/` 的支持。  有关详细信息，请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory。

entries.en: Added image dimension metadata when images are resized, enabling accurate coordinate mappings for large images
entries.zh: 调整图像大小时添加图像尺寸元数据，实现大图像的精确坐标映射

entries.en: Fixed auto-loading .env when using native installer
entries.zh: 修复了使用本机安装程序时自动加载 .env

entries.en: Fixed `--system-prompt` being ignored when using `--continue` or `--resume` flags
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--continue`或`--resume`标志时忽略`--system-prompt`的问题

entries.en: Improved `/resume` screen with grouped forked sessions and keyboard shortcuts for preview (P) and rename (R)
entries.zh: 改进 `/resume` 界面：分叉会话分组显示，并新增预览（P）和重命名（R）快捷键

entries.en: VSCode: Added copy-to-clipboard button on code blocks and bash tool inputs
entries.zh: VS Code：代码块和 Bash 工具输入上新增复制到剪贴板的按钮

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed extension not working on Windows ARM64 by falling back to x64 binary via emulation
entries.zh: VS Code：通过 x64 版本的二进制文件模拟运行，修复了扩展在 Windows ARM64 上无法工作的问题

entries.en: Bedrock: Improve efficiency of token counting
entries.zh: 基岩：提高代币计数效率

entries.en: Bedrock: Add support for `aws login` AWS Management Console credentials
entries.zh: Bedrock：添加对`aws login`AWS 管理控制台凭证的支持

entries.en: Unshipped AgentOutputTool and BashOutputTool, in favor of a new unified TaskOutputTool
entries.zh: 取消发布 AgentOutputTool 和 BashOutputTool，改用新的统一 TaskOutputTool

entries.en: Added "(Recommended)" indicator for multiple-choice questions, with the recommended option moved to the top of the list
entries.zh: 多项选择题添加“（推荐）”指示器，推荐选项移至列表顶部

entries.en: Added `attribution` setting to customize commit and PR bylines (deprecates `includeCoAuthoredBy`)
entries.zh: 添加了`attribution`设置以自定义提交和 PR 署名（不推荐使用`includeCoAuthoredBy`）

entries.en: Fixed duplicate slash commands appearing when ~/.claude is symlinked to a project directory
entries.zh: 修复了 ~/.claude 符号链接到项目目录时出现的重复斜杠命令

entries.en: Fixed slash command selection not working when multiple commands share the same name
entries.zh: 修复了当多个命令共享相同名称时斜杠命令选择不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed an issue where skill files inside symlinked skill directories could become circular symlinks
entries.zh: 修复了符号链接技能目录内的技能文件可能变成循环符号链接的问题

entries.en: Fixed running versions getting removed because lock file incorrectly going stale
entries.zh: 修复了由于锁定文件错误地过时而导致运行版本被删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed IDE diff tab not closing when rejecting file changes
entries.zh: 修复了拒绝文件更改时 IDE diff 选项卡未关闭的问题

entries.en: Reverted VSCode support for multiple terminal clients due to responsiveness issues.
entries.zh: 由于响应速度问题，撤销了 VSCode 对多个终端客户端的支持

entries.en: Added background agent support. Agents run in the background while you work
entries.zh: 添加了后台代理支持。当您工作时，代理会在后台运行

entries.en: Added --disable-slash-commands CLI flag to disable all slash commands
entries.zh: 添加了 --disable-slash-commands CLI 标志以禁用所有斜杠命令

entries.en: Added model name to "Co-Authored-By" commit messages
entries.zh: 将模型名称添加到“Co-Authored-By”提交消息中

entries.en: Enabled "/mcp enable [server-name]" or "/mcp disable [server-name]" to quickly toggle all servers
entries.zh: 启用“/mcp启用[服务器名称]”或“/mcp禁用[服务器名称]”以快速切换所有服务器

entries.en: Updated Fetch to skip summarization for pre-approved websites
entries.zh: 对预先批准的网站，Fetch 跳过摘要

entries.en: VSCode: Added support for multiple terminal clients connecting to the IDE server simultaneously
entries.zh: VS Code：支持多个终端客户端同时连接到 IDE 服务器

entries.en: Added --agent CLI flag to override the agent setting for the current session
entries.zh: 添加了 --agent CLI 标志以覆盖当前会话的代理设置

entries.en: Added `agent` setting to configure main thread with a specific agent's system prompt, tool restrictions, and model
entries.zh: 添加了`agent`设置，以使用特定代理的系统提示、工具限制和模型配置主线程

entries.en: VS Code: Fixed .claude.json config file being read from incorrect location
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了从错误位置读取 `.claude.json` 配置文件的问题

entries.en: Pro users now have access to Opus 4.5 as part of their subscription!
entries.zh: Pro 用户现在可以把 Opus 4.5 作为订阅的一部分使用！

entries.en: Fixed timer duration showing "11m 60s" instead of "12m 0s"
entries.zh: 修复计时器时长显示为"11m 60s"而非"12m 0s"的问题

entries.en: Windows: Managed settings now prefer `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode` if it exists. Support for `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode` will be removed in a future version.
entries.zh: Windows：如果 `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode` 存在，托管设置现在优先使用它。`C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode` 的支持将在未来版本中移除。

entries.en: Added feedback input when rejecting plans, allowing users to tell Claude what to change
entries.zh: 添加了拒绝计划时的反馈输入，允许用户告诉克劳德要更改什么

entries.en: VSCode: Added streaming message support for real-time response display
entries.zh: VS Code：新增流式消息支持，可实时显示回复

entries.en: Added setting to enable/disable terminal progress bar (OSC 9;4)
entries.zh: 添加了启用/禁用终端进度条的设置（OSC 9;4）

entries.en: VSCode Extension: Added support for VS Code's secondary sidebar (VS Code 1.97+), allowing Claude Code to be displayed in the right sidebar while keeping the file explorer on the left. Requires setting sidebar as Preferred Location in the config.
entries.zh: VS Code 扩展：支持 VS Code 的次级侧边栏（VS Code 1.97+），可在右侧边栏显示 Claude Code，同时左侧保留文件浏览器。需要在配置中将侧边栏设为首选位置

entries.en: Fixed proxy DNS resolution being forced on by default. Now opt-in via `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS=true` environment variable
entries.zh: 修复了默认强制启用代理 DNS 解析的问题。现在通过`CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS=true`环境变量选择加入

entries.en: Fixed keyboard navigation becoming unresponsive when holding down arrow keys in memory location selector
entries.zh: 修复了在内存位置选择器中按住箭头键时键盘导航变得无响应的问题

entries.en: Improved AskUserQuestion tool to auto-submit single-select questions on the last question, eliminating the extra review screen for simple question flows
entries.zh: 改进 AskUserQuestion 工具：单选题作为最后一题时自动提交，去掉简单问答流程中多余的确认页

entries.en: Improved fuzzy matching for `@` file suggestions with faster, more accurate results
entries.zh: 改进 `@` 文件建议的模糊匹配：更快、更准确

entries.en: Hooks: Enable PermissionRequest hooks to process 'always allow' suggestions and apply permission updates
entries.zh: Hooks：PermissionRequest 钩子现在可以处理“始终允许”建议，并应用权限更新

entries.en: Fix issue with excessive iTerm notifications
entries.zh: 修复 iTerm 通知过多的问题

entries.en: Fixed duplicate message display when starting Claude with a command line argument
entries.zh: 修复了使用命令行参数启动 Claude 时的重复消息显示

entries.en: Fixed `/usage` command progress bars to fill up as usage increases (instead of showing remaining percentage)
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`命令进度条，随着使用量的增加而填充（而不是显示剩余百分比）

entries.en: Fixed image pasting not working on Linux systems running Wayland (now falls back to wl-paste when xclip is unavailable)
entries.zh: 修复了图像粘贴在运行 Wayland 的 Linux 系统上不起作用的问题（现在当 xclip 不可用时回退到 wl-paste）

entries.en: Permit some uses of `$!` in bash commands
entries.zh: 允许 bash 命令中使用部分 `$!` 写法

entries.en: Added Opus 4.5! https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-5
entries.zh: 添加了 Opus 4.5！ https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-5

entries.en: Introducing Claude Code for Desktop: https://claude.com/download
entries.zh: 推出 Claude Code 桌面版：https://claude.com/download

entries.en: To give you room to try out our new model, we've updated usage limits for Claude Code users. See the Claude Opus 4.5 blog for full details
entries.zh: 为了让你试用新模型，我们调整了 Claude Code 用户的用量限额。详情请见 Claude Opus 4.5 博客

entries.en: Pro users can now purchase extra usage for access to Opus 4.5 in Claude Code
entries.zh: Pro 用户现在可以额外购买用量，以便在 Claude Code 中使用 Opus 4.5

entries.en: Plan Mode now builds more precise plans and executes more thoroughly
entries.zh: 计划模式现在能制定更精确的计划，执行也更彻底

entries.en: Usage limit notifications now easier to understand
entries.zh: 用量限制通知的文字更容易理解

entries.en: Switched `/usage` back to "% used"
entries.zh: `/usage` 改回显示 "% used"

entries.en: Fixed handling of thinking errors
entries.zh: 修正了思维错误的处理

entries.en: Fixed performance regression
entries.zh: 固定性能回归

entries.en: Fixed bug preventing calling MCP tools that have nested references in their input schemas
entries.zh: 修复了阻止调用在其输入模式中具有嵌套引用的 MCP 工具的错误

entries.en: Silenced a noisy but harmless error during upgrades
entries.zh: 减少升级时一个吵闹但无害的错误

entries.en: Improved ultrathink text display
entries.zh: 改进 ultrathink 文字的显示

entries.en: Improved clarity of 5-hour session limit warning message
entries.zh: 改进 5 小时会话限额警告的表述，更清楚

entries.en: Added readline-style ctrl-y for pasting deleted text
entries.zh: 添加了 readline-style ctrl-y 用于粘贴已删除的文本

entries.en: Improved clarity of usage limit warning message
entries.zh: 改进用量上限警告的表述，更清楚

entries.en: Fixed handling of subagent permissions
entries.zh: 修复了子代理权限的处理

entries.en: Improved error messages and validation for `claude --teleport`
entries.zh: 改进 `claude --teleport` 的错误提示和校验

entries.en: Improved error handling in `/usage`
entries.zh: 改进 `/usage` 的错误处理

entries.en: Fixed race condition with history entry not getting logged at exit
entries.zh: 修复了退出时未记录历史条目的竞争条件

entries.en: Fixed Vertex AI configuration not being applied from `settings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了 Vertex AI 配置未从`settings.json`应用的问题

entries.en: Fixed image files being reported with incorrect media type when format cannot be detected from metadata
entries.zh: 修复了当无法从元数据中检测到格式时报告的图像文件媒体类型不正确的问题

entries.en: Added support for Microsoft Foundry! See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/azure-ai-foundry
entries.zh: 添加了对 Microsoft Foundry 的支持！请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/azure-ai-foundry

entries.en: Added `PermissionRequest` hook to automatically approve or deny tool permission requests with custom logic
entries.zh: 添加了`PermissionRequest`挂钩，以使用自定义逻辑自动批准或拒绝工具权限请求

entries.en: Send background tasks to Claude Code on the web by starting a message with `&`
entries.zh: 在消息开头输入 `&`，即可把后台任务发送到 Claude Code on the web

entries.en: Added `permissionMode` field for custom agents
entries.zh: 为自定义代理添加了`permissionMode`字段

entries.en: Added `tool_use_id` field to `PreToolUseHookInput` and `PostToolUseHookInput` types
entries.zh: 将`tool_use_id`字段添加到`PreToolUseHookInput`和`PostToolUseHookInput`类型

entries.en: Added skills frontmatter field to declare skills to auto-load for subagents
entries.zh: 添加了技能 frontmatter 字段来声明为子代理自动加载的技能

entries.en: Added the `SubagentStart` hook event
entries.zh: 添加了`SubagentStart`挂钩事件

entries.en: Fixed nested `CLAUDE.md` files not loading when @-mentioning files
entries.zh: 修复了@提及文件时未加载嵌套的`CLAUDE.md`文件

entries.en: Fixed duplicate rendering of some messages in the UI
entries.zh: 修复了 UI 中某些消息的重复渲染

entries.en: Fixed some visual flickers
entries.zh: 修复了一些视觉闪烁问题

entries.en: Fixed NotebookEdit tool inserting cells at incorrect positions when cell IDs matched the pattern `cell-N`
entries.zh: 修复了当单元格 ID 与模式`cell-N`匹配时，NotebookEdit 工具在不正确的位置插入单元格的问题

entries.en: Added `agent_id` and `agent_transcript_path` fields to `SubagentStop` hooks.
entries.zh: 将`agent_id`和`agent_transcript_path`字段添加到`SubagentStop`挂钩中。

entries.en: Added `model` parameter to prompt-based stop hooks, allowing users to specify a custom model for hook evaluation
entries.zh: 为基于提示的停止挂钩添加了`model`参数，允许用户指定用于挂钩评估的自定义模型

entries.en: Fixed slash commands from user settings being loaded twice, which could cause rendering issues
entries.zh: 修复了用户设置中的斜杠命令被加载两次，这可能会导致渲染问题

entries.en: Fixed incorrect labeling of user settings vs project settings in command descriptions
entries.zh: 修复了命令描述中用户设置与项目设置的错误标签

entries.en: Fixed crash when plugin command hooks timeout during execution
entries.zh: 修复了插件命令在执行过程中挂钩超时时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed: Bedrock users no longer see duplicate Opus entries in the /model picker when using `--model haiku`
entries.zh: 修复：使用 `--model haiku` 时，Bedrock 用户在 /model 选择器中不再看到重复的 Opus 条目

entries.en: Fixed broken security documentation links in trust dialogs and onboarding
entries.zh: 修复了信任对话框和入门中损坏的安全文档链接

entries.en: Fixed issue where pressing ESC to close the diff modal would also interrupt the model
entries.zh: 修复了按 ESC 关闭 diff 模式也会中断模型的问题

entries.en: ctrl-r history search landing on a slash command no longer cancels the search
entries.zh: ctrl-r 历史搜索跳到斜杠命令时，不再取消搜索

entries.en: SDK: Support custom timeouts for hooks
entries.zh: SDK：支持为钩子设置自定义超时

entries.en: Allow more safe git commands to run without approval
entries.zh: 允许更安全的 git 命令在未经批准的情况下运行

entries.en: Plugins: Added support for sharing and installing output styles
entries.zh: 插件：支持分享和安装输出样式

entries.en: Teleporting a session from web will automatically set the upstream branch
entries.zh: 从网页端传送会话时，会自动设置上游分支

entries.en: Fixed how idleness is computed for notifications
entries.zh: 修复了通知空闲度的计算方式

entries.en: Hooks: Added matcher values for Notification hook events
entries.zh: Hooks：为 Notification 钩子事件新增 matcher 值

entries.en: Output Styles: Added `keep-coding-instructions` option to frontmatter
entries.zh: 输出样式：frontmatter 新增 `keep-coding-instructions` 选项

entries.en: Fixed: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER environment variable now properly disables package manager update notifications
entries.zh: 修复：`DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER` 环境变量现在能正确禁用包管理器的更新通知

entries.en: Fixed queued messages being incorrectly executed as bash commands
entries.zh: 修复了排队消息被错误地执行为 bash 命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed input being lost when typing while a queued message is processed
entries.zh: 修复了在处理排队消息时键入时丢失输入的问题

entries.en: Improve fuzzy search results when searching commands
entries.zh: 改进搜索命令时的模糊匹配结果

entries.en: Improved VS Code extension to respect `chat.fontSize` and `chat.fontFamily` settings throughout the entire UI, and apply font changes immediately without requiring reload
entries.zh: 改进 VS Code 扩展：整个界面都遵循 `chat.fontSize` 和 `chat.fontFamily` 设置，字体修改立即生效，无需重新加载

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY` environment variable to automatically exit SDK mode after a specified idle duration, useful for automated workflows and scripts
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY`环境变量，以在指定的空闲持续时间后自动退出 SDK 模式，对于自动化工作流程和脚本非常有用

entries.en: Migrated `ignorePatterns` from project config to deny permissions in the localSettings.
entries.zh: 将 `ignorePatterns` 从项目配置迁移为 localSettings 中的拒绝权限

entries.en: Fixed menu navigation getting stuck on items with empty string or other falsy values (e.g., in the `/hooks` menu)
entries.zh: 修复了菜单导航卡在具有空字符串或其他虚假值的项目上的问题（例如，在`/hooks`菜单中）

entries.en: VSCode Extension: Added setting to configure the initial permission mode for new conversations
entries.zh: VS Code 扩展：新增设置，可配置新对话的初始权限模式

entries.en: Improved file path suggestion performance with native Rust-based fuzzy finder
entries.zh: 改进文件路径建议的性能：使用基于 Rust 的原生模糊查找器

entries.en: Fixed infinite token refresh loop that caused MCP servers with OAuth (e.g., Slack) to hang during connection
entries.zh: 修复了导致具有 OAuth（例如 Slack）的 MCP 服务器在连接期间挂起的无限令牌刷新循环

entries.en: Fixed memory crash when reading or writing large files (especially base64-encoded images)
entries.zh: 修复了读取或写入大文件（尤其是 base64 编码的图像）时的内存崩溃问题

entries.en: Native binary installs now launch quicker.
entries.zh: 原生二进制安装版启动更快

entries.en: Fixed `claude doctor` incorrectly detecting Homebrew vs npm-global installations by properly resolving symlinks
entries.zh: 通过正确解析符号链接修复了`claude doctor`错误地检测 Homebrew 与 npm-global 安装的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp serve` exposing tools with incompatible outputSchemas
entries.zh: 修复了“claude mcpserve”暴露具有不兼容输出模式的工具

entries.en: Un-deprecate output styles based on community feedback
entries.zh: 根据社区反馈，取消输出风格的弃用标记

entries.en: Added `companyAnnouncements` setting for displaying announcements on startup
entries.zh: 添加了`companyAnnouncements`设置，用于在启动时显示公告

entries.en: Fixed hook progress messages not updating correctly during PostToolUse hook execution
entries.zh: 修复了 PostToolUse 挂钩执行期间挂钩进度消息未正确更新的问题

entries.en: Windows: native installation uses shift+tab as shortcut for mode switching, instead of alt+m
entries.zh: Windows：原生安装版改用 shift+tab 切换模式，不再用 alt+m

entries.en: Vertex: add support for Web Search on supported models
entries.zh: Vertex：支持的模型现在可使用网页搜索

entries.en: VSCode: Adding the respectGitIgnore configuration to include .gitignored files in file searches (defaults to true)
entries.zh: VS Code：新增 respectGitIgnore 配置，可在文件搜索中包含被 .gitignore 忽略的文件（默认为 true）

entries.en: Fixed a bug with subagents and MCP servers related to "Tool names must be unique" error
entries.zh: 修复了与“工具名称必须是唯一的”错误相关的子代理和 MCP 服务器的错误

entries.en: Fixed issue causing `/compact` to fail with `prompt_too_long` by making it respect existing compact boundaries
entries.zh: 修复了导致`/compact`因`prompt_too_long`而失败的问题，使其尊重现有的紧凑边界

entries.en: Fixed plugin uninstall not removing plugins
entries.zh: 修复了插件卸载不删除插件的问题

entries.en: Added helpful hint to run `security unlock-keychain` when encountering API key errors on macOS with locked keychain
entries.zh: 添加了有用的提示，以在 macOS 上遇到具有锁定钥匙串的 API 密钥错误时运行“安全解锁钥匙串”

entries.en: Added `allowUnsandboxedCommands` sandbox setting to disable the dangerouslyDisableSandbox escape hatch at policy level
entries.zh: 添加了`allowUnsandboxedCommands`沙箱设置，以在策略级别禁用危险的DisableSandbox逃生舱口

entries.en: Added `disallowedTools` field to custom agent definitions for explicit tool blocking
entries.zh: 在自定义代理定义中添加了`disallowedTools`字段，以实现显式工具阻止

entries.en: Added prompt-based stop hooks
entries.zh: 添加了基于提示的停止挂钩

entries.en: VSCode: Added respectGitIgnore configuration to include .gitignored files in file searches (defaults to true)
entries.zh: VS Code：新增 respectGitIgnore 配置，可在文件搜索中包含被 .gitignore 忽略的文件（默认为 true）

entries.en: Enabled SSE MCP servers on native build
entries.zh: 在本机构建上启用 SSE MCP 服务器

entries.en: Deprecated output styles. Review options in `/output-style` and use --system-prompt-file, --system-prompt, --append-system-prompt, CLAUDE.md, or plugins instead
entries.zh: 已弃用的输出样式。查看 `/output-style` 中的选项并使用 --system-prompt-file、--system-prompt、--append-system-prompt、CLAUDE.md 或插件代替

entries.en: Removed support for custom ripgrep configuration, resolving an issue where Search returns no results and config discovery fails
entries.zh: 移除对自定义 ripgrep 配置的支持，解决搜索返回空结果、配置查找失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Explore agent creating unwanted .md investigation files during codebase exploration
entries.zh: 修复了探索代理在代码库探索期间创建不需要的 .md 调查文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a bug where `/context` would sometimes fail with "max_tokens must be greater than thinking.budget_tokens" error message
entries.zh: 修复了 `/context` 有时会失败并显示“max_tokens 必须大于 Thinking.budget_tokens”错误消息的错误

entries.en: Fixed `--mcp-config` flag to correctly override file-based MCP configurations
entries.zh: 修复了`--mcp-config`标志以正确覆盖基于文件的 MCP 配置
